senses.definition_en: used before a singular countable noun when the person or object is not specifically identified.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh na khat a kuapen cih kician takin gen nailo in, khat cihna tawh singular noun ma-a kizang hi.

examples.english: She bought a book yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zani in laibu khat lei hi.

examples.english: He ate an apple after lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun-an nek khit ciangin apple khat ne hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound. The choice depends on sound, not simply on spelling.
senses.usage_zomi: Consonant aw tawh kipan kammal ma-ah a zang inla, vowel aw tawh kipan kammal ma-ah an zang in. Gelhdanbek hilo in, a ginkhiat aw dungzui in teel ding hi.

senses.definition_en: to leave a person, place or activity permanently.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, mun khat, ahih kei leh nasepna khat a tawntungin nusia/paisan.

examples.english: They abandoned the plan because it was too expensive.
examples.zomi: Sum tampi kisap ahih manin tua geelna nusia uh hi.

examples.english: The family had to abandon their home during the fighting.
examples.zomi: Kidouna laitakin innkuan in amau inn paisan kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Abandon normally means leaving someone or something completely, not temporarily.
senses.usage_zomi: Abandon cih kammal pen mi khat, mun khat, nasepna khat cihte a tawntungin nusia/paisan cihna hi; tawmvei sungbek nusia cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: the skill or power needed to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hih theih nadingin mi khat in a neih siamna leh theihna.

examples.english: She has the ability to explain difficult ideas clearly.
examples.zomi: Amah in ngaihsutna haksa-te kician takin hilhcian theihna nei hi.

examples.english: Regular practice can improve your speaking ability.
examples.zomi: Tawntung kisinna in pau theihna hong khangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Ability may refer to natural talent or to a skill developed through learning and practice.
senses.usage_zomi: Ability cihpen pianpih siamna hi thei a, sinna leh kisinna tungtawnin a khantoh siamna zong hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: having the skill, strength or opportunity needed to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hih nading siamna, thatang ahih kei leh hunlem nei.

examples.english: Will you be able to attend the meeting tomorrow?
examples.zomi: Zing kikhopna ah na hong pai thei diam?

examples.english: After several weeks of practice, she was able to drive alone.
examples.zomi: Nipawl tawm khat sung kisinna nei khit ciangin amah guakin mawtaw hawl thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Able is commonly used in the construction be able to + verb. It can be used in verb tenses where can is not possible.
senses.usage_zomi: Able pen be able to + verb tawh kizang tam hi. Can zat theihloh verb tense pawlkhat ah be able to zang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: concerning or relating to a particular subject, person or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat, mi khat ahih kei leh thu piang khat tawh kisai.

examples.english: We talked about the problem for an hour.
examples.zomi: Nai khat sung tua buaina thu kigen uh hi.

examples.english: This book is about the history of Zomi people.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu pen Zomi mite’ tangthu tawh kisai hi.

senses.usage_en: As a preposition, about is followed by a noun, pronoun or -ing form. It can also be an adverb meaning “approximately,” but that is a different grammatical use.
senses.usage_zomi: Preposition ahih ciangin about nungah noun, pronoun ahih kei leh -ing form hong om hi. “Approximately” bangin “tuabang zah” cihna nei adverb in zong kizang a, tua pen a zatdan tuam hi.

senses.heading: At a higher position
senses.definition_en: in or at a position higher than someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh na khat sangin mun sangzaw ah om.

examples.english: A clock hangs above the door.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak tungah dak khat khai hi.

examples.english: The plane flew above the clouds.
examples.zomi: Vanleng pen meii tungah leng hi.

senses.usage_en: Above usually means higher than something without necessarily touching it.
senses.usage_zomi: Above cihpen a tamzaw in na khat sangin a sangzaw ah om cihna hi; tua na tawh kituak ngiat kullo hi.

senses.heading: More than
senses.definition_en: greater than a particular number, level or amount.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat, tan ahih kei leh zah khat sangin tamzaw/sangzaw.

examples.english: The temperature rose above 90 degrees.
examples.zomi: Khuahun lumna pen degree 90 sangin sangzaw hi.

examples.english: Children above twelve must pay the full price.
examples.zomi: Kum sawmlehnih sangin upazaw naupangte in a man vekpi pia ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: With measurements and numbers, above means “more than” or “higher than.”
senses.usage_zomi: Tehna leh nambat tawh kizang ciangin above in “sangin tamzaw” ahih kei leh “sangzaw” cihna nei hi.

senses.definition_en: in or to a foreign country.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamdang ah ahih kei leh gamdang lamah.

examples.english: She plans to study abroad next year.
examples.zomi: Kumkik ciangin gamdang ah lai sin dingin geel hi.

examples.english: Many Zomi families now live abroad.
examples.zomi: Tu in Zomi innkuan tampi gamdang ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Abroad does not normally take to before it. Say go abroad, not go to abroad.
senses.usage_zomi: Abroad ma-ah to koih ngeilo hi. Go to abroad cih loin go abroad ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Complete or total
senses.definition_en: complete and not limited in any way.
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi hi a, ciangtan ahih kei leh kinakna neilo.

examples.english: The room was in absolute silence.
examples.zomi: Innkhaan sung gamdai bukim hi.

examples.english: No leader should have absolute power.
examples.zomi: Makaipa kuamah ukzawhna ciangtan neilo nei sak loh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Absolute strengthens a noun by showing that the condition is complete, total or unrestricted.
senses.usage_zomi: Absolute in noun khat a thahat sak a, tua dinmun pen bukim, a vekpi ahih kei leh ciangtan neilo cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: Definite and unquestionable
senses.definition_en: certain, definite and not dependent on another condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kician takin a kip, thu dang khat tungah kingalo.

examples.english: There is no absolute proof that the story is true.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu a man taktakna teci kician omlo hi.

examples.english: Honesty is an absolute requirement for this position.
examples.zomi: Hih dinmun adingin thuman genna pen kisapna kician ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, absolute describes something regarded as fixed or unquestionably true.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah absolute in a kip, a kikhel lo ahih kei leh thuman kicianin a kici na khat gen hi.

senses.heading: Completely
senses.definition_en: completely or in every way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a vekin; bukim takin; cikmah in
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekin ahih kei leh bukim takin.

examples.english: Clean water is absolutely necessary for life.
examples.zomi: Nuntak nadingin tui siangtho kisam mahmah hi.

examples.english: It is absolutely impossible to finish this work today.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep tuni in zoh cikmah in hithei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Absolutely is commonly used to strengthen adjectives with an already complete meaning, such as impossible, certain and essential.
senses.usage_zomi: Absolutely pen impossible, certain leh essential bang khiatna bukim nei adjective-te thahat sak nadingin kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Yes, certainly
senses.definition_en: used to express strong agreement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukimna kician leh thahat takin lak.

examples.english: “Can we trust her?” “Absolutely.”
examples.zomi: “Amah muang thei ding hiam?” “Muang thei veve hi.”

examples.english: You are absolutely right about this issue.
examples.zomi: Hih thu ah na gen man taktak hi.

senses.usage_en: When used alone in conversation, absolutely is an emphatic way of saying “yes.”
senses.usage_zomi: Kiholimna ah amah guakin kizang ciangin absolutely pen “hi” cihna thahat takin genna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Related to education or study
senses.definition_en: connected with schools, colleges, universities or serious study.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pilna sinna tawh kisai; sang tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Sang, college, university ahih kei leh pilna sinna tawh kisai.

examples.english: The academic year begins in August.
examples.zomi: Sang kum pen August kha in kipan hi.

examples.english: She received an award for her academic achievement.
examples.zomi: A laisimna gualzawhna hangin kipahman ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Academic usually describes education, formal study or work performed in a school or university.
senses.usage_zomi: Academic in pilna, ngeina tawh sinna, sang ahih kei leh university sunga nasep gen hi.

senses.heading: Theoretical rather than practical
senses.definition_en: based mainly on ideas and study rather than practical experience.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsutna bek tawh kisai; a tak zatna neilote
senses.explanation_zomi: A takin hihna sangin ngaihsutna leh laisinna tungah kinga zaw.

examples.english: Without enough money, the plan became an academic discussion.
examples.zomi: Sum kicing omloh manin tua geelna pen ngaihsutna bek tawh kikumna suak hi.

examples.english: The question is academic because the decision has already been made.
examples.zomi: Thu khensat khin ahih manin tua dotna pen ngaihsutna lam dotna bek ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, academic may suggest that an idea has little immediate practical effect.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah academic in ngaihsutna om napi, a takin tu laitak zatkhiatna neilo cihna lak thei hi.

senses.heading: Receive willingly
senses.definition_en: to receive or take something that is offered willingly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi in hong pia na khat utna tawh la/saang.

examples.english: She accepted the job offer yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zani in nasep thupiakna saang hi.

examples.english: Please accept this gift from our family.
examples.zomi: Ka innkuan uh hong piak hih letsong hong saang in.

senses.usage_en: Accept means receiving something willingly. It does not necessarily mean that you approve of everything connected with it.
senses.usage_zomi: Accept cihpen na khat utna tawh saang cihna hi. Tua na tawh kisai khempeuh na thukimpih cihna ahih pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Agree with or recognize
senses.definition_en: to agree that something is true, correct or unavoidable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a man hi ci-in pom ahih kei leh kikhel theilo dinmun khat saang.

examples.english: We must accept responsibility for our mistakes.
examples.zomi: Eite’ khialhnate hangin mawhpuakna i saang kul hi.

examples.english: He found it difficult to accept the truth.
examples.zomi: Thuman pom ding ama adingin haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse accept with except. Accept is normally a verb; except means leaving someone or something out.
senses.usage_zomi: Accept leh except helkhawm kei in. Accept pen a tamzaw in verb hi a, except in mi khat ahih kei leh na khat simloh cihna nei hi.

senses.definition_en: good enough to be approved, allowed or received.
senses.explanation_zomi: Saangtheih, phaltheih ahih kei leh kisapna tan a kicing.

examples.english: Your work is acceptable, but it can still be improved.
examples.zomi: Na nasep saangtheih hi napi, hoihzaw sem dingin bawltheih lai hi.

examples.english: Such behavior is not acceptable in this school.
examples.zomi: Tuabang gamtatna hih sang ah phaltheih hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Acceptable usually means satisfactory or permitted; it does not always mean excellent.
senses.usage_zomi: Acceptable cihpen a kicing ahih kei leh phaltheih cihna hi; ahoihpen cihna ahih pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Right or opportunity to use something
senses.definition_en: the right or opportunity to enter a place or use something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lut theihna; zat theihna; thu phalna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat lut theihna ahih kei leh na khat zang theih nading thu phalna leh hunlem.

examples.english: Every child should have access to education.
examples.zomi: Naupang khempeuh in pilna ngah theihna nei ding uh hi.

examples.english: Guests do not have access to this room.
examples.zomi: Zinmite in hih innkhaan sung lut theihna nei lo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Access is usually uncountable when it means permission or opportunity. Say have access to, not have an access to.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu phalna ahih kei leh hunlem cihna ah kizang ciangin access pen a tamzaw in uncountable noun hi. Have an access to cih loin have access to ci ding hi.

senses.heading: A way of entering or reaching a place
senses.definition_en: a way or means of entering, reaching or approaching a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat lutna, tunna ahih kei leh naihna lampi.

examples.english: The building has wheelchair access.
examples.zomi: Tua innpi ah wheel-chair tawh lut theihna om hi.

examples.english: Snow blocked access to the village.
examples.zomi: Vua in khuami tunna lampi daal hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, access refers to the route or method used to reach a place.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah access in mun khat tunna ahih kei leh lutna lampi gen hi.

senses.definition_en: an unexpected event that causes damage, injury or another unwanted result.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khuaphawkloh thu piang; deihloh thu piang
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuaphawkloh leh deihloh kalin hong piang a, siatna, liamna ahih kei leh noptatlohna hong tun sak thu piang.

examples.english: Two people were injured in the car accident.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw khuaphawkloh thu piang ah mi nih liam uh hi.

examples.english: I deleted the file by accident.
examples.zomi: Khuaphawkloh in file ka phiat hi.

senses.usage_en: An accident is an unwanted event. The phrase by accident means that something happened unintentionally.
senses.usage_zomi: An accident cihpen deihloh kalin hong piang thu ahi hi. By accident cihpen khentatna neiloh leh khuaphawkloh in na khat piang cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: a place where someone can live or stay temporarily.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawmvei sung teen theihna ahih kei leh tamna mun.

examples.english: The university provides accommodation for international students.
examples.zomi: University in gamdang sangnaupangte adingin teenna mun vaihawm sak hi.

examples.english: We need to find affordable accommodation near the hospital.
examples.zomi: Siibuk nai ah man tawm tamna mun i zong kul hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, accommodation is normally uncountable. In American English, the plural accommodations is often used for rooms or lodging.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah accommodation pen a tamzaw in uncountable noun hi. American English ah innkhaan ahih kei leh tamna mun gen nadingin plural accommodations kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Go somewhere with someone
senses.definition_en: to go somewhere with another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat mun khat ah a pai ciangin zui/pih.

examples.english: Her mother accompanied her to the hospital.
examples.zomi: A nu in siibuk dong pih hi.

examples.english: Children must be accompanied by an adult.
examples.zomi: Naupangte pen mi picing khat in pih ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Accompany takes a direct object. Say accompany someone, not normally accompany with someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Accompany nungah direct object hong pai hi. A ngeina in accompany with someone cih loin accompany someone ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Happen or exist together
senses.definition_en: to happen or exist at the same time as something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na dang khat tawh hun kibangin piangkhawm ahih kei leh omkhawm.

common_phrases.zomi: natna tawh hong piangkhawm natna limte

examples.english: The fever was accompanied by a severe headache.
examples.zomi: Tua cisa pen lutang nat mahmahna tawh piangkhawm hi.

examples.english: The singer was accompanied by a piano.
examples.zomi: Laa sapa pen piano tumna tawh kipawl hi.

senses.usage_en: The passive form be accompanied by is common when two people, events or conditions occur together.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi nih, thu piang nih ahih kei leh dinmun nih omkhawm ciangin passive form be accompanied by kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: As stated by someone or something
senses.definition_en: as reported, written or stated by a person or source.
senses.zomi_equivalents: genna dungzui in; gelhna dungzui in
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat genna, laibu gelhna ahih kei leh thuthangna khat dungzui in.

examples.english: According to the report, the population is increasing.
examples.zomi: Report genna dungzui in, mihing tawm tam hong khang hi.

examples.english: According to the doctor, he needs more rest.
examples.zomi: Siavuan genna dungzui in, amah tawlnga tampi kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use according to when giving information from another person or source. Do not normally use it to introduce your own opinion.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi dang ahih kei leh thu bul dang khat pan thutheihna pia ciangin according to zang in. Nangma ngaihsutna gen kipatna dingin a ngeina in zang kei in.

senses.heading: In agreement with a rule or system
senses.definition_en: in a way that follows a rule, plan or established system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, geelna ahih kei leh a kipsa ngeina khat dungzui in.

examples.english: Everything went according to plan.
examples.zomi: Na khempeuh geelna dungzui in pai hi.

examples.english: The money will be shared according to need.
examples.zomi: Sum pen kisapna dungzui in kihawm ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, according to shows that an action follows a particular rule, plan or standard.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah according to in nasep khat pen thukhun, geelna ahih kei leh tehna khat dungzui in kihi cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: A bank arrangement
senses.definition_en: an arrangement with a bank for keeping, receiving or paying money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum koih, sum saang ahih kei leh sum pia theih nading bank tawh kibawl sum kepna.

examples.english: She opened a savings account for her daughter.
examples.zomi: A tanu adingin sum kholhna account khat hon hi.

examples.english: The payment was sent directly to my bank account.
examples.zomi: Sum pen ka bank account sungah hong kikhak hi.

senses.usage_en: Bank-related expressions commonly use open, close, deposit into and withdraw from an account.
senses.usage_zomi: Bank account tawh kisai kammal ah open, close, deposit into leh withdraw from cihte kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: An online record or membership
senses.definition_en: a personal record that allows someone to use a website, application or service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Website, application ahih kei leh nasepna khat zat theih nading mi khat ading a kibawl min leh thutheihna kepna.

examples.english: You must create an account before using the application.
examples.zomi: Application na zat ma-in account khat na bawl kul hi.

examples.english: Someone tried to enter my email account.
examples.zomi: Mi khat in ka email account sung lut sawm hi.

senses.usage_en: An online account normally has a username, email address or password connected with it.
senses.usage_zomi: Online account ah zangtu min, email address ahih kei leh password kizom tawntung hi.

senses.heading: A description or report
senses.definition_en: a spoken or written description of an event or experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang khat ahih kei leh phutkhak khat kam tawh genna ahih kei leh lai tawh gelhna.

examples.english: She gave a detailed account of the accident.
examples.zomi: Khuaphawkloh thu piang thu kician takin gen hi.

examples.english: The book contains eyewitness accounts of the war.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu sungah kidouna a muta-te’ teci genna om hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, account is countable and refers to one version or description of what happened.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah account pen countable noun hi a, thu piang bangci piang cih mi khat in a genna khat cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: correct and free from mistakes, especially in details or measurements.
senses.explanation_zomi: A man a, khialhna neilo; a diak in thu kician, nambat leh tehna-te a man.

examples.english: Please make sure that the information is accurate.
examples.zomi: Thutheihna a man taktakna kipsak in.

examples.english: This machine gives accurate measurements.
examples.zomi: Hih van in tehna man pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Accurate describes information, calculations or measurements that are correct. For a person, it usually means that the person works or reports carefully and correctly.
senses.usage_zomi: Accurate in thutheihna, simna ahih kei leh tehna a man cihna gen hi. Mi khat genna ah kizang ciangin tua mi pen kidawm takin sem a, thu man takin gen cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in khialhna ahih kei leh thukham palsatna bawl hi ci-in mawhsak.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat zuau gen hi ci-in mawhsak

examples.english: They accused him of stealing the money.
examples.zomi: Amah in sum gu hi ci-in mawhsak uh hi.

examples.english: She was wrongly accused of breaking the rules.
examples.zomi: Thukhun palsat hi ci-in maan loin mawhsak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the pattern accuse someone of + noun/-ing form. Do not use accuse someone for doing something in standard English.
senses.usage_zomi: Accuse someone of + noun/-ing form cihdan tawh zang in. Standard English ah accuse someone for doing something cihdan zang kei in.

senses.definition_en: to succeed in reaching a goal or obtaining a desired result through effort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna tawh ngiimna khat tangtun ahih kei leh deihna bang gah ngah.

examples.english: She worked hard to achieve her goal.
examples.zomi: A ngiimna tangtun nadingin hahkat takin sem hi.

examples.english: The team achieved better results this year.
examples.zomi: Hih kum in pawl in gah hoihzaw ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Achieve is normally used with a goal, success, result or standard—not with an ordinary physical object.
senses.usage_zomi: Achieve pen ngiimna, gualzawhna, gah ahih kei leh tehna tawh kizang tam hi; khut tawh a kilak na ngeina tawh kizang lo hi.

senses.heading: Something successfully completed
senses.definition_en: something important or difficult that someone has successfully completed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in hanciamna tawh a zo ahih kei leh a tangtun na thupi leh haksapi.

examples.english: Graduating from college was a major achievement for her.
examples.zomi: College zoh pen ama adingin tangtunna thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Building the community center was a great achievement.
examples.zomi: Khawtang kikhopna inn lamzoh pen gualzawhna lian khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Achievement is countable when it refers to a particular success that has been completed.
senses.usage_zomi: Gualzawhna khat bek gen ciangin achievement pen countable noun hi.

senses.heading: The act or process of succeeding
senses.definition_en: the act or result of reaching a goal through effort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna tawh ngiimna khat tangtunna ahih kei leh gualzawhna ngahna.

examples.english: Hard work is important for academic achievement.
examples.zomi: Laisimna gualzawhna adingin hahkat taka semna thupi hi.

examples.english: Finishing the project gave us a sense of achievement.
examples.zomi: Project zohna in gualzo i kicih theihna leh lungkimna hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this broader sense, achievement may be uncountable when referring generally to success or progress.
senses.usage_zomi: Gualzawhna ahih kei leh khantohna a zaizaw in gen ciangin achievement pen uncountable noun in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Accept or recognize as true
senses.definition_en: to accept or recognize that something is true or exists.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a man ahihna ahih kei leh a om taktakna thei a, pom.

examples.english: He acknowledged that he had made a mistake.
examples.zomi: Amah in khialhna a bawl hi ci-in pom hi.

examples.english: The government acknowledged the seriousness of the problem.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in tua buaina a lipkhaphuaina thei a, pom hi.

senses.usage_en: Acknowledge means openly recognizing a fact. It does not necessarily mean approving of it.
senses.usage_zomi: Acknowledge cihpen thu khat om taktak cih phuang takin pomna hi. Tua thu thukimpih cihna ahih pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Confirm receipt or show recognition
senses.definition_en: to confirm that something has been received or to show that someone has been noticed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngah khin cih kipsak ahih kei leh mi khat muh/theih cih gamtatna tawh lak.

examples.english: Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
examples.zomi: Hih email na ngah khin cih hong kipsak in.

examples.english: The director acknowledged everyone who had helped.
examples.zomi: Director in a huh mi khempeuh panpihna theihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In formal communication, acknowledge receipt means confirming that a document, message or payment arrived.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina tawh kizui kihopihna ah acknowledge receipt cihpen lai, thupuak ahih kei leh sum piakna hong tung khin cih kipsakna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: to obtain, buy or gradually develop something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngah, lei ahih kei leh hun la in neihna/siamna khangsak.

examples.english: She acquired valuable experience through her work.
examples.zomi: A nasep tungtawnin phattuamna nei phutkhakna ngah hi.

examples.english: The company plans to acquire a smaller business.
examples.zomi: Company in sumleina nasepna neu zaw khat lei dingin geel hi.

senses.usage_en: Acquire is more formal than get. It is often used for knowledge, skills, property or businesses.
senses.usage_zomi: Acquire pen get sangin ngeina kizui zaw hi. Pilna, siamna, neihsa ahih kei leh sumleina nasepna ngahna gen nadingin kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: From one side to the other
senses.definition_en: from one side of a place or object to the opposite side.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat langkhat pan a langkhat dong kantan.

examples.english: They walked across the bridge together.
examples.zomi: Lei kantanin khawm pai uh hi.

examples.english: The store is across the street from the bank.
examples.zomi: Dawk pen bank langkhat lampi galkhat ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Across describes movement or position from one side to another. Cross is usually a verb, while across is a preposition or adverb.
senses.usage_zomi: Across in langkhat pan langkhat dong paina ahih kei leh omna gen hi. Cross pen a tamzaw in verb hi a, across pen preposition ahih kei leh adverb hi.

senses.heading: Throughout an area
senses.definition_en: in many parts of an area, country or group.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun khempeuh ah; mun tuamtuam ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam, mun ahih kei leh pawl khat sung mun tuamtuam ah.

examples.english: The news spread quickly across the country.
examples.zomi: Thuthang pen gam khempeuh ah manlang takin kizel hi.

examples.english: Zomi people live across many countries.
examples.zomi: Zomi mite gam tampi sung mun tuamtuam ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, across means throughout an area, not merely crossing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah across in mun khat kantan cihna bek hilo in, tua mun sung mun tuamtuam ah cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: Do something or take action
senses.definition_en: to do something, especially in response to a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat hangin na khat hih ahih kei leh sep ding kipan.

examples.english: We must act quickly before the problem becomes worse.
examples.zomi: Buaina siazaw ma-in manlang takin i gamta kul hi.

examples.english: The police acted immediately after receiving the report.
examples.zomi: Police-te in report ngah phetin sem pah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, act means doing something rather than only thinking or talking about it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah act cihpen ngaihsun ahih kei leh gen bek loin, na khat a takin hih cihna hi.

senses.heading: Behave in a particular way
senses.definition_en: to behave in a particular manner.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat ah gamtatdan tuam khat tawh gamta.

examples.english: He acted calmly during the emergency.
examples.zomi: Lauhuai hunin lungnop takin gamta hi.

examples.english: Do not act as if you know everything.
examples.zomi: Na khempeuh na thei bangin gamta kei in.

senses.usage_en: Act like is followed by a noun or clause and describes behavior that resembles someone or something else.
senses.usage_zomi: Act like nungah noun ahih kei leh clause hong pai a, mi khat ahih kei leh na khat tawh kibang gamtatna gen hi.

senses.heading: Perform in a play, film or program
senses.definition_en: to perform the part of a character in a play, film or television program.
senses.zomi_equivalents: limlak ah gamta; mi dinmun la
senses.explanation_zomi: Zatpual, limlak ahih kei leh television program ah mi khat dinmun la in gamta.

examples.english: She began acting in films when she was young.
examples.zomi: A naupang lai in limlak sungah gamta kipan hi.

examples.english: He acted the part of a doctor in the play.
examples.zomi: Zatpual ah siavuan dinmun la hi.

senses.usage_en: When act means performing, the related noun for a performer is actor.
senses.usage_zomi: Act in limlak ahih kei leh zatpual ah gamtatna gen ciangin, tua nasep sem mi pen actor kici hi.

senses.heading: Something done
senses.definition_en: something that a person or organization does.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh pawl khat in a hih/a sep na.

examples.english: The city must take action to improve road safety.
examples.zomi: Lampi bitna hoihsak nadingin khuapi in nasep kipan kul hi.

examples.english: Her actions showed that she cared about the community.
examples.zomi: A gamtatnate in khawtang a ngaihsakna lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Take action means beginning to do something about a problem. Do not usually say do an action in this context.
senses.usage_zomi: Take action cihpen buaina khat bawlphat nading nasep kipan cihna hi. Hih khiatna ah do an action cihdan a ngeina in kizang lo hi.

senses.heading: Movement or exciting events
senses.definition_en: movement or a series of exciting events, especially in a film or story.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in limlak ahih kei leh tangthu sungah gamtatna leh thu piang lunglut huai tampi omna.

common_phrases.zomi: kidona leh gamtatna tampi nei limlak

examples.english: The film is full of action from beginning to end.
examples.zomi: Limlak pen a kipatna pan a tawpna dong gamtatna lunglut huai tawh kidim hi.

examples.english: The final action scene was exciting.
examples.zomi: A tawpna gamtatna limlak khen lunglut huai mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In entertainment, action often refers to fast movement, fighting, danger or exciting events.
senses.usage_zomi: Noptatna limlak ah action in manlang taka gamtatna, kidona, lauhuaina ahih kei leh thu piang lunglut huai gen hi.

senses.heading: Regularly moving or doing things
senses.definition_en: busy, energetic and regularly involved in physical or other activities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tatlawh takin gamta a, nasepna ah pang tawntung.

examples.english: Walking every day helps older adults remain active.
examples.zomi: Nisim lampaihna in mi upate tatlawh taka om paisuak nading huh hi.

examples.english: The children are active throughout the day.
examples.zomi: Naupangte ni khat sung gamta tawntung uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Active describes someone who moves, works or participates regularly. Its opposite is inactive.
senses.usage_zomi: Active in gamta, sem ahih kei leh nasepna ah pang tawntung mi gen hi. A langkhat pen inactive ahi hi.

senses.heading: Operating or currently in use
senses.definition_en: operating, working or currently being used.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sem lai; kizang lai; nungta lai
senses.explanation_zomi: Sem lai, kizang lai ahih kei leh a nasepna zom lai.

common_phrases.zomi: pawl nasepna ah pang tawntung mi

examples.english: Your account is still active.
examples.zomi: Na account kizang lai hi.

examples.english: She is an active member of the organization.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi nasepna ah tatlawh takin pang hi.

senses.usage_en: For systems, accounts and organizations, active means currently operating, valid or participating.
senses.usage_zomi: System, account leh pawlpi tawh kisai ah active in tu laitak sem, kizang ahih kei leh pang lai cihna nei hi.

senses.definition_en: something that people do for work, learning, exercise or enjoyment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi in nasep, sinna, pumpi kisinna ahih kei leh noptatna dingin a hih na.

examples.english: Regular physical activity is good for your health.
examples.zomi: Pumpi gamtatna tawntung neih pen cidamna adingin hoih hi.

examples.english: The teacher prepared a group activity for the students.
examples.zomi: Sia in sangnaupangte adingin pawl tawh kihih sinna nasepna bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Activity is countable when referring to a particular task, but it can be uncountable when referring generally to movement or action.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasepna khat bek gen ciangin activity pen countable noun hi. Gamtatna ahih kei leh nasepna a zaizaw in gen ciangin uncountable noun in kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: a person who performs a character in a film, play or television program.
senses.explanation_zomi: Limlak, zatpual ahih kei leh television program ah mi khat dinmun la in gamta mi.

examples.english: He is a well-known actor in Myanmar.
examples.zomi: Amah Myanmar ah minthang limlak gamtami khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The actor practiced his lines before the performance.
examples.zomi: Limlak gamtapa in a gamtat ma-in a gen ding kammalte sin hi.

senses.usage_en: Actor can now refer to a performer of any gender. It is often preferred when gender is not relevant.
senses.usage_zomi: Tu hunin actor pen pasal leh numei deihdeih adingin kizang thei hi. Nupa lam thupi lo ciangin actor zat hoihzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: a woman who performs a character in a film, play or television program.
senses.zomi_equivalents: numei limlak gamtami; numei zatpual gamtami
senses.explanation_zomi: Limlak, zatpual ahih kei leh television program ah mi khat dinmun la in gamta numei.

examples.english: She became a successful actress at a young age.
examples.zomi: A naupang lai mah in gualzo numei limlak gamtami suak hi.

examples.english: The actress received an award for her performance.
examples.zomi: Numei limlak gamtami in a gamtat hoihna hangin kipahman ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Actress specifically identifies a female performer. In modern English, many people use the gender-neutral word actor for both men and women.
senses.usage_zomi: Actress in numei gamtami cihna kician takin lak hi. Tuhun English ah mi tampi in pasal leh numei adingin nupa deidan neilo actor zang uh hi.

senses.definition_en: real or true, rather than expected, imagined or reported.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lametna, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh thugen bek hilo in, a om taktak/a man taktak.

examples.english: The actual cost was higher than we expected.
examples.zomi: A man taktak pen ka lam-et uh sangin tamzaw hi.

examples.english: The report does not describe the actual situation.
examples.zomi: Report in dinmun a taktak genlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Actual means real or true. It does not usually mean current, although speakers of some languages may confuse the two.
senses.usage_zomi: Actual cihpen a taktak ahih kei leh a man taktak cihna hi. A ngeina in “tu laitak” cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: In fact or in reality
senses.definition_en: used to state what is true or real, especially when it differs from what was expected.
senses.explanation_zomi: A taktak in ahih kei leh a manin, lam-etna tawh kibang lo thu kician sak nadingin kizang.

common_phrases.zomi: bang a taktak in piang hiam

examples.english: The work was actually easier than I expected.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep pen ka lam-et sangin a taktak in baihzaw hi.

examples.english: Nobody knows what actually happened.
examples.zomi: Bang a taktak in piang hiam cih kuamah theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Actually often introduces information that corrects an assumption or shows an unexpected fact.
senses.usage_zomi: Actually pen ngaihsut kholhna khat puahna ahih kei leh lam-etloh thuman khat lakna ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Used to correct or clarify
senses.definition_en: used politely to correct what someone has said or to clarify a fact.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a man takin; a taktak in
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat thugen puah ding ahih kei leh thu kician sak dingin zahtakna tawh kizang.

common_phrases.zomi: A taktak in, ka thukim lo hi.
A man takin, Monday ni ahi hi.
A taktak in, thu dang ka cihnopna ahi hi.

examples.english: Actually, the meeting begins at ten, not nine.
examples.zomi: A man takin, kikhopna dak sawm in kipan ding a, dak kua hilo hi.

examples.english: I actually meant the other document.
examples.zomi: A taktak in lai dang khat ka cihnopna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Although actually can make a correction gentler, tone of voice still matters because it may sometimes sound argumentative.
senses.usage_zomi: Actually in thu puahna nemsak thei napi, awging thupi veve hi; awging hoihlo leh kinialna bangin ging thei hi.

senses.definition_en: a public message designed to persuade people to buy, use or support something; a short form of advertisement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi in na khat lei, zang ahih kei leh panpih nadingin mipi tungah kipuang thupuak; advertisement a tomlakna.

examples.english: I saw an ad for the new phone online.
examples.zomi: Internet ah phone thak tangko khat ka mu hi.

examples.english: The company placed an ad in the local newspaper.
examples.zomi: Company in khuami newspaper ah tangko khat koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Ad is the common informal short form of advertisement. Advert is also used in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Ad pen advertisement a tomlakna hi a, ngeina kizui hetlo kiholimna ah kizang tam hi. British English ah advert zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: Change to suit new conditions
senses.definition_en: to change behavior, methods or arrangements so that they work in a new situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun thak tawh kituak theih nadingin gamtatdan, sepdang ahih kei leh vaihawmna kheek.

examples.english: Children often adapt quickly to a new school.
examples.zomi: Naupangte sang thak tawh manlang takin kituak zel uh hi.

examples.english: Businesses must adapt to changing technology.
examples.zomi: Sumleina nasepnate in technology kikhelna tawh kituak dingin kikheek kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use adapt to when someone or something becomes suited to a new condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh na khat dinmun thak tawh kituak hong suak ciangin adapt to zang in.

senses.heading: Change something for a new purpose
senses.definition_en: to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a ngiimna dang ahih kei leh mi pawl dang adingin zat theih nadingin puah/kheek.

examples.english: The teacher adapted the lesson for younger students.
examples.zomi: Sia in naupang zaw sangnaupangte tawh kituak dingin lesson puah hi.

examples.english: The novel was adapted for television.
examples.zomi: Tangthu laibu pen television program dingin khek hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse adapt with adopt. Adapt means changing something; adopt means choosing or beginning to use it.
senses.usage_zomi: Adapt leh adopt helkhawm kei in. Adapt in na khat puah/kheek cihna nei a, adopt in na khat teel a, zat kipan cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: Put something together with something else
senses.definition_en: to put something with another thing or group so that the amount becomes greater.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tungah na dang khat behlap a, a zah tamzaw sak.

common_phrases.english: add a name to the list

examples.english: Add a little salt to the soup.
examples.zomi: Annek tui sungah ci tawm khat behlap in.

examples.english: Please add my name to the list.
examples.zomi: Laigelhna ah ka min hong behlap in.

senses.usage_en: Use add something to something. The item being added normally comes before to.
senses.usage_zomi: Add something to something cihdan zang in. A kibehlap na pen to ma-ah hong om hi.

senses.heading: Calculate a total
senses.definition_en: to combine numbers to find their total.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambatte gawmkhawm a, a vekpi a zah simkhia.

examples.english: Add five and seven to get twelve.
examples.zomi: Nga leh sagih gawm lecin sawmlehnih ngah ding hi.

examples.english: She added up all the expenses.
examples.zomi: Sumzat khempeuh gawmkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: In mathematics, add is the opposite of subtract.
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics ah add a langkhat pen subtract ahi hi.

senses.heading: Something added
senses.definition_en: a person or thing added to something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, mun ahih kei leh na khat tungah a kibehlap mi ahih kei leh na.

examples.english: The new nurse is a valuable addition to the team.
examples.zomi: Nurse thak pen pawl adingin manpha behlapna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The library’s latest addition is a collection of Zomi books.
examples.zomi: Laibuk sung a thakpen behlapna pen Zomi laibu kigawmkhawm ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: An addition to refers to someone or something newly included in a group, place or collection.
senses.usage_zomi: An addition to cihpen pawl, mun ahih kei leh kigawmkhawmna sungah a thak in a kibehlap mi/na gen hi.

senses.heading: The process of adding numbers
senses.definition_en: the mathematical process of combining numbers to find a total.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambatte gawmkhawm a, a vekpi a zah zonna simna.

examples.english: The children are learning addition and subtraction.
examples.zomi: Naupangte nambat gawmna leh khiamna sin uh hi.

examples.english: Check the addition before submitting the report.
examples.zomi: Report na piak ma-in nambat gawmna kician takin en in.

senses.usage_en: In mathematics, addition uses the plus sign (+).
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics ah addition pen plus lim (+) tawh kizang hi.

senses.heading: In addition
senses.definition_en: used to introduce another fact or point.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat behlap dingin kizang.

examples.english: The job pays well; in addition, it provides health insurance.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep in thaman hoih pia hi; tua banah, cidamna insurance zong pia hi.

examples.english: In addition to English, she speaks Zomi and Burmese.
examples.zomi: English banah, Zomi leh Burmese zong pau hi.

senses.usage_en: In addition connects another complete point. In addition to is followed by a noun, pronoun or -ing form.
senses.usage_zomi: In addition in thu bukim dang khat zom hi. In addition to nungah noun, pronoun ahih kei leh -ing form hong pai hi.

senses.definition_en: added, extra or more than what was already available.
senses.explanation_zomi: A om khin tungah a kibehlap ahih kei leh a tamzaw.

examples.english: Please provide additional information about your application.
examples.zomi: Na application tawh kisai thutheihna behlap hong pia in.

examples.english: The repair required additional time and money.
examples.zomi: Puahna adingin hun leh sum behlap kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Additional comes before a noun. It means extra or added to what already exists.
senses.usage_zomi: Additional pen noun ma-ah hong om hi. A om khin tungah a dang behlap cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: Details showing where someone lives or works
senses.definition_en: the information that identifies where a person or organization is located.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh pawl khat a omna mun theih theih nading inn nambat, lampi min, khuapi leh gam cihte.

examples.english: Please write your address on the form.
examples.zomi: Form tungah na omna address gelh in.

examples.english: We sent the letter to the wrong address.
examples.zomi: Lai pen address khial ah ka khak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun address is usually pronounced /ˈædˌrɛs/ in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah noun address pen a tamzaw in /ˈædˌrɛs/ ci-in kigen hi.

senses.heading: A formal speech
senses.definition_en: a formal speech given to an audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Makaipa ahih kei leh mi khat in mipi mai-a ngeina kizui takin a gen thugen.

examples.english: The mayor gave an address at the ceremony.
examples.zomi: Pawlkhopna ah khuapi makaipa in mipi tungah thugen hi.

examples.english: Her address focused on education and public health.
examples.zomi: A thugen pen pilna leh mipi cidamna tungah kinga hi.

senses.usage_en: As a noun meaning a speech, address is formal. In everyday conversation, speech is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Mipi thugen cihna ah address pen ngeina kizui kammal hi. Nisim kiholimna ah speech kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Management of an organization
senses.definition_en: the work of organizing and managing a business, school or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumleina, sang ahih kei leh pawl khat nasepna vaihawm leh ukna.

examples.english: She works in university administration.
examples.zomi: University vaihawmna lamah sem hi.

examples.english: Good administration helps an organization operate effectively.
examples.zomi: Vaihawmna hoih in pawl khat gah nei takin sem thei sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, administration may refer to the work itself or to the people responsible for managing an organization.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah administration in vaihawmna nasep ahih kei leh tua nasep sem mite gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A government in power
senses.definition_en: the group of officials who govern a country under a particular leader.
senses.explanation_zomi: Makaipa khat nuai-ah gam uk kumpi makaite leh ukna pawl.

examples.english: The new administration announced its economic policy.
examples.zomi: Kumpi ukna thak in sumleina thukhun puang hi.

examples.english: The program began under the previous administration.
examples.zomi: Tua program pen kumpi ukna a luisa nuai-ah kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, an administration often means the government serving under a president, governor or mayor.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah an administration in president, governor ahih kei leh mayor khat nuai-a kumpi ukna gen zel hi.

senses.definition_en: to respect or feel approval for someone or something because of good qualities or achievements.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a omzia hoih, siamna ahih kei leh gualzawhna hangin zahtak a, pahtawi.

common_phrases.zomi: mun hoih en a nuam sa

examples.english: I admire her courage and honesty.
examples.zomi: A hangsanna leh thuman genna ka zahtak hi.

examples.english: Visitors stopped to admire the beautiful view.
examples.zomi: Zinmite in mun hoih en a, nuam sa dingin tawlnga uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Admire can express respect for a person or appreciation of something beautiful. It does not always suggest romantic love.
senses.usage_zomi: Admire in mi khat zahtakna ahih kei leh na hoih khat nuam sakna gen thei hi. Nulehpa itna lam cihna ahih pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Accept that something is true
senses.definition_en: to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true or that you did something wrong.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a man cih ahih kei leh khialhna khat na bawl cih ut samlo napi pom.

examples.english: He admitted that he had lied.
examples.zomi: Zuau a gen hi ci-in pom hi.

examples.english: She refused to admit her mistake.
examples.zomi: A khialhna pom ding nial hi.

senses.usage_en: Use admit doing something or admit that.... Do not normally use admit to do something for confessing an action.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep khat na hihna pom ciangin admit doing something ahih kei leh admit that... zang in. A ngeina in admit to do something zang kei in.

senses.heading: Allow someone to enter
senses.definition_en: to allow someone to enter a place, school, organization or hospital.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat mun, sang, pawl ahih kei leh siibuk sungah lut/pang sak.

examples.english: The hospital admitted three patients last night.
examples.zomi: Zankim in siibuk in cina thum saang hi.

examples.english: Only members will be admitted to the meeting.
examples.zomi: Pawl sung mite bek kikhopna ah lutsak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In hospital English, be admitted means being formally accepted as a patient for treatment.
senses.usage_zomi: Siibuk tawh kisai English ah be admitted cihpen zatui kilak dingin cina khat siibuk sungah a ngeina bangin kisaang cihna hi.

senses.heading: Legally become a child’s parent
senses.definition_en: to legally take another person’s child into your family and become that child’s parent.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ta in la; ta in kem
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang’ naupang thukham tawh kizui in na innkuan sungah la a, na ta in kem.

common_phrases.zomi: ta in la nu leh pa
thukham tawh kizui in ta in la

examples.english: The couple decided to adopt a child.
examples.zomi: Nupa in naupang khat ta in la dingin khensat uh hi.

examples.english: She was adopted when she was two years old.
examples.zomi: Kum nih a cih lai in ta in kilak hi.

senses.usage_en: Adopt refers to the legal and permanent parent-child relationship. It is different from temporarily caring for a child.
senses.usage_zomi: Adopt cihpen thukham tawh kizui a, a tawntung nulehpa leh ta kizopna bawl cihna hi. Tawmvei sung naupang kepna tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Begin to use or accept something
senses.definition_en: to choose and begin using a particular plan, method, policy or attitude.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna, sepdang, thukhun ahih kei leh lungsim putdan khat teel a, zat kipan.

examples.english: The company adopted a new safety policy.
examples.zomi: Company in bitna thukhun thak khat saang hi.

examples.english: Schools are adopting new teaching methods.
examples.zomi: Sangte in hilhdan thak zang kipan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse adopt with adapt. You adopt something by choosing it; you adapt it by changing it to suit a situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Adopt leh adapt helkhawm kei in. Na khat na teel a, na zat kipat ciangin adopt hi a; dinmun tawh kituak dingin na puah/kheek ciangin adapt ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: a fully grown person who is legally old enough to be responsible for their own decisions.
senses.explanation_zomi: A khangcing a, ama thu khensatnate amah mawhpuak theih zah kumcing mi.

examples.english: Children must be accompanied by an adult.
examples.zomi: Naupangte pen mi picing khat in pih ding hi.

examples.english: The course is designed for adults who want to improve their English.
examples.zomi: Tua course pen amau English hoihsak nuam mi picingte adingin kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: The legal age of adulthood differs among countries and purposes. Adult can also be an adjective, as in adult education.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi picing kicih theih kum pen gam leh zatna dungzui in kibanglo thei hi. Adult education cih bangin adult pen adjective in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Progress or improvement
senses.definition_en: progress or development that makes something better, more successful or more modern.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a masang sangin hoihzaw, gualzozaw ahih kei leh tuhun tawh kituakzaw suakna khantohna.

examples.english: Medical advances have saved many lives.
examples.zomi: Si lam khantohna in mi tampi nuntakna honkhia hi.

examples.english: The new system represents a major advance in technology.
examples.zomi: System thak pen technology lam khantohna lian khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Advance is countable when it refers to a particular improvement. Progress is normally uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Khantohna khat kician takin gen ciangin advance pen countable noun hi. Progress pen a tamzaw in uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Money paid before it is due
senses.definition_en: money paid before the usual or agreed payment time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sum piak khol; sum la khol
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum piak hun tun ma-in a kipiak khol sum.

examples.english: He asked his employer for a salary advance.
examples.zomi: A thaman la khol dingin a naseppipa tungah ngen hi.

examples.english: The company requires an advance payment of fifty dollars.
examples.zomi: Company in dollar sawmnga piak khol ding kisam sak hi.

senses.usage_en: An advance is paid before the normal payment date and is usually deducted from money due later.
senses.usage_zomi: Advance pen sum piak hun ngeina ma-in kipia a, a nung cianga sum ngah ding pan a tamzaw in kilakhia hi.

senses.heading: Highly developed
senses.definition_en: developed to a high or modern level.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tan sang tak dong khangto khin a, tuhun pilna leh siamna tawh kituak.

examples.english: The hospital uses advanced medical technology.
examples.zomi: Siibuk in si lam technology khantohsa zang hi.

examples.english: This machine has several advanced safety features.
examples.zomi: Hih van in bitna vaihawmna khantohsa pawlkhat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, advanced means modern, highly developed or technically complex.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah advanced in tuhun tawh kituak, khantohsa ahih kei leh siamtheihna sang kisam cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: At a higher level of learning
senses.definition_en: intended for learners who already have considerable knowledge or skill.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna ahih kei leh siamna tampi nei khin mite ading tan sang sinna.

common_phrases.zomi: siamna tan sang sinna nei mi

examples.english: She is taking an advanced English course.
examples.zomi: English course tan sang kai hi.

examples.english: This book is too difficult for beginners because it is advanced.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu pen tan sang ahih manin a kipan thakte adingin haksa lua hi.

senses.usage_en: Advanced is the opposite of beginner or elementary when describing a course or skill level.
senses.usage_zomi: Course ahih kei leh siamna tan gen ciangin advanced a langkhat pen beginner ahih kei leh elementary ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: a condition, quality or opportunity that makes success easier or gives someone a better position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzawhna baihsak ahih kei leh mi dang sangin dinmun hoihzaw pia dinmun, hoihna ahih kei leh hunlem.

examples.english: Speaking two languages is a major advantage in this job.
examples.zomi: Pau nam nih pau theihna pen hih nasep ah phattuamna lian ahi hi.

examples.english: The team had the advantage of playing at home.
examples.zomi: Pawl in amau mun ah kimawl theihna hamphatna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Have an advantage over means being in a better position than someone else. Take advantage of can mean using an opportunity well, but it can also mean unfairly using a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Have an advantage over cihpen mi dang sangin dinmun hoihzaw nei cihna hi. Take advantage of in hunlem zang siam cihna nei thei a, mi khat thuman loin zang cihna zong nei thei hi.

senses.definition_en: an unusual, exciting and sometimes dangerous experience or journey.
senses.zomi_equivalents: phutkhakna lunglut huai; khualzin lunglut huai
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina tawh kibanglo, lunglut huai leh a khatvei ciang lauhuai thei phutkhakna ahih kei leh khualzin.

examples.english: Their journey through the mountains was a great adventure.
examples.zomi: Mualte lakah amau khualzin pen phutkhakna lunglut huai mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: The children enjoyed reading adventure stories.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in tangthu lunglut huai sim nuam sa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An adventure is usually exciting and unfamiliar. It may involve some difficulty or risk, but danger is not always necessary.
senses.usage_zomi: Adventure pen a tamzaw in lunglut huai a, a ngeina tawh kibanglo hi. Haksatna ahih kei leh lauhuaina om thei napi, om kul pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: to publicly present information about a product, service, job or event so that people will notice or support it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi in sumleina na, nasepna, sepna mun ahih kei leh pawlkhop theih nadingin mipi tungah tangko/puangzak.

examples.english: The company advertised its new product online.
examples.zomi: Company in a sumleina na thak internet tungah tangko hi.

examples.english: The school is advertising for a new teacher.
examples.zomi: Sang in sia thak khat kisap cih puangzak hi.

senses.usage_en: Advertise something means promoting it. Advertise for someone means publicly announcing that a person or worker is needed.
senses.usage_zomi: Advertise something cihpen na khat tangko cihna hi. Advertise for someone cihpen mi ahih kei leh nasem khat kisap cih mipi tungah puangzak cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: a public message that promotes a product, service, job or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumleina na, nasepna, sepna mun ahih kei leh pawlkhop khat mipi in thei dingin a kipuang thupuak.

examples.english: I saw the job advertisement in the newspaper.
examples.zomi: Newspaper ah nasepna mun awng puanzakna ka mu hi.

examples.english: The advertisement encouraged people to buy the product.
examples.zomi: Tangko in mite tua sumleina na lei dingin hanthawn hi.

senses.usage_en: Advertisement is the full form. Ad is its common informal shortened form.
senses.usage_zomi: Advertisement pen kammal a bukim hi. Ad pen ngeina kizui hetlo kiholimna ah a kizang a tomlakna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: the activity or business of creating and distributing advertisements.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangko bawl leh mipi tungah tangko puanzak nasepna ahih kei leh sumleina.

examples.english: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.
examples.zomi: Company in tangko nasepna ah sum tampi zang hi.

examples.english: Online advertising can reach people quickly.
examples.zomi: Internet tunga tangko nasepna in mite manlang takin phathei hi.

senses.usage_en: Advertising is normally uncountable when referring to the industry or general activity. An individual promotional message is an advertisement or ad.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumleina lam ahih kei leh tangko nasepna a zaizaw in gen ciangin advertising pen uncountable noun hi. Tangko thupuak khat bek pen advertisement ahih kei leh ad kici hi.

senses.definition_en: an opinion or recommendation given to help someone decide what to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in bang hih ding cih a khensat theih nadingin a kipiak thuhilhna ahih kei leh ngaihsutna.

examples.english: My teacher gave me useful advice about studying.
examples.zomi: Ka sia in lai sinna tawh kisai phattuamna nei thuhilhna hong pia hi.

examples.english: You should ask a doctor for medical advice.
examples.zomi: Si lam thuhilhna siavuan tungah na ngen ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Advice is an uncountable noun. Say some advice or a piece of advice, not an advice. Its final sound is /s/.
senses.usage_zomi: Advice pen uncountable noun hi. An advice cih loin some advice ahih kei leh a piece of advice ci ding hi. A tawpna aw pen /s/ ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: to give someone an opinion or recommendation about what they should do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in bang hih ding cih thei theih nading thuhilh ahih kei leh ngaihsutna pia.

examples.english: The doctor advised me to get more rest.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in tawlnga tampi la dingin hong thuhilh hi.

examples.english: We advised them against traveling during the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi laitak khualzin lo dingin amaute ka thuhilh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use advise someone to do something or advise against doing something. Advise is a verb, and its final sound is /z/.
senses.usage_zomi: Advise someone to do something ahih kei leh advise against doing something cihdan zang in. Advise pen verb hi a, a tawpna aw pen /z/ ahi hi.

senses.heading: A matter or situation
senses.definition_en: a matter, event or situation that concerns someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh pawl khat tawh kisai thu, thu piang ahih kei leh dinmun.

examples.english: He keeps his personal affairs private.
examples.zomi: A mimal vai midang theihsak lo in kem hi.

examples.english: The committee discussed the organization’s financial affairs.
examples.zomi: Committee in pawlpi sum vai kikum uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Affairs in the plural often refers to a person’s, organization’s or country’s important business and responsibilities.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural affairs pen mi, pawl ahih kei leh gam khat tawh kisai vai thupi leh mawhpuakna-te gen nadingin kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: An organized event
senses.definition_en: an event or social occasion, especially one that has been organized for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna khat adingin a kigeel pawlkhop ahih kei leh kipawlkhopna.

examples.english: The celebration was a small family affair.
examples.zomi: Gualnopna pen innkuan sung pawlkhop neu khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The ceremony was a formal affair.
examples.zomi: Pawlkhop pen ngeina kizui takin kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, affair describes the nature or style of an organized event.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah affair in a kigeel pawlkhop khat a omzia ahih kei leh kibawldan gen hi.

senses.heading: A secret romantic relationship
senses.definition_en: a secret sexual or romantic relationship, especially when one or both people are married to someone else.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in khatpeuh nupa nei napi, a simtham in mi dang tawh itna leh numei-pasal kizopna nei.

examples.english: The affair seriously damaged their marriage.
examples.zomi: Simtham itna kizopna in amau nupa nuntakna nasia takin susia hi.

examples.english: He denied having an affair.
examples.zomi: Simtham itna kizopna nei cih nial hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense of affair can be sensitive and usually implies secrecy and unfaithfulness.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih affair khiatna pen pau kidop huai hi a, simthamna leh nupa tungah thumanlohna cihna nei zel hi.

senses.definition_en: to cause a change in someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh na khat a dinmun, lungsim, cidamna ahih kei leh nasepna kikhel sak.

examples.english: Lack of sleep can affect your health.
examples.zomi: Ihmu lohna in na cidamna kha thei hi.

examples.english: The weather affected our travel plans.
examples.zomi: Khuahun in ka khualzin geelna uh huzaap hi.

senses.usage_en: Affect is usually a verb meaning “influence.” Effect is usually a noun meaning “a result.”
senses.usage_zomi: Affect pen a tamzaw in huzaap cihna nei verb hi. Effect pen a tamzaw in gah ahih kei leh hong piangkhia cihna nei noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Have enough money
senses.definition_en: to have enough money to pay for something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat lei ahih kei leh a man pia theih nading sum kicing nei.

examples.english: We cannot afford a new car right now.
examples.zomi: Tu laitak mawtaw thak khat ka lei zo nailo uh hi.

examples.english: Can you afford the monthly payment?
examples.zomi: Kha sim sum piak ding na pia zo ding hiam?

senses.usage_en: Afford is commonly used with can, could or be able to. It is rarely used in continuous forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Afford pen can, could ahih kei leh be able to tawh kizang tam hi. Continuous form in kizang tamlo hi.

senses.heading: Be able to give time or accept a risk
senses.definition_en: to be able to give time or accept a loss, delay or risk without serious harm.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thuak zo; hun nei; hihzawhna nei
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun pia ahih kei leh supna, sawtna, lauhuaina khat nasia takin liamsakloh ding zah thuak zo.

examples.english: We cannot afford to wait another week.
examples.zomi: Nipi khat dang ngak theih nawnlo hi.

examples.english: The hospital cannot afford to lose more nurses.
examples.zomi: Siibuk in nurse tampi suahbeh thuak zo nawnlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Cannot afford to may describe an unacceptable consequence, not only a lack of money.
senses.usage_zomi: Cannot afford to in sum neihlohna bek genlo a, hong piang ding gah pen saangtheih hilo cihna zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Frightened or worried
senses.definition_en: feeling fear or worry about someone, something or a possible event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na ahih kei leh hong piang thei thu khat hangin lau ahih kei leh lungkham.

examples.english: The child is afraid of the dark.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen khuamial lau hi.

examples.english: She was afraid to tell her parents the truth.
examples.zomi: A nulehpa tungah thuman gen ding lau hi.

senses.usage_en: Use afraid of + noun/-ing form and afraid to + verb. Afraid normally comes after a linking verb, not directly before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Afraid of + noun/-ing form leh afraid to + verb cihdan zang in. Afraid pen linking verb nungah hong om zel a, noun ma-ah a ngeina in hong omlo hi.

senses.heading: Used to introduce bad news politely
senses.definition_en: used in the phrase I’m afraid to politely introduce an apology, disagreement or unwelcome fact.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sorry cihna, thukimlohna ahih kei leh lungnop huailo thu khat zahtakna tawh gen kipatna.

common_phrases.zomi: Sorry hi napi, ka hong pai theilo ding hi.

examples.english: I’m afraid the office is already closed.
examples.zomi: Sorry hi napi, office khak khin hi.

examples.english: I’m afraid I cannot agree with you.
examples.zomi: Sorry hi napi, nang tawh ka thukim theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this expression, afraid does not necessarily mean frightened. It softens an unpleasant statement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan ah afraid in launa cihna nei pahpah lo hi. Lungnop huailo thugen khat nemsak nadingin kizang hi.

senses.heading: Later than a time or event
senses.definition_en: later than a particular time, event or action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, thu piang ahih kei leh nasep khat khit ciangin.

examples.english: We will talk after the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna khit ciangin i kiholim ding hi.

examples.english: She went for a walk after dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak-an nek khit ciangin lampai hi.

senses.usage_en: After is followed by a noun, pronoun or -ing form. Use afterwards when no object follows.
senses.usage_zomi: After nungah noun, pronoun ahih kei leh -ing form hong pai hi. A nungah object omlo leh afterwards zang in.

senses.heading: Following someone or something
senses.definition_en: behind or following someone or something in order or movement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh na khat nungah, a nung zui in.

examples.english: The dog ran after the ball.
examples.zomi: Ui in bawl nung delh hi.

examples.english: The children entered the room one after another.
examples.zomi: Naupangte khat khit khat innkhaan sungah lut uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In expressions such as look after, take after and name after, the complete phrase has a meaning that cannot always be understood from after alone.
senses.usage_zomi: Look after, take after leh name after bang kammal kigawmte ah, after khiatna bek tawh tua kammal kigawm khiatna theih pah theihlo hi.

senses.definition_en: the part of the day between noon and evening.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sun dak sawmlehnih khit pan nitak ma dong hun.

examples.english: The meeting begins at two in the afternoon.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna pen sun nunglam dak nih in kipan hi.

examples.english: It rained heavily yesterday afternoon.
examples.zomi: Zani sun nunglam in guah na takin zu hi.

senses.usage_en: Say in the afternoon, but do not use in before this, tomorrow or yesterday: this afternoon, not in this afternoon.
senses.usage_zomi: In the afternoon ci ding hi. Ahih hangin this, tomorrow leh yesterday ma-ah in zang kei in: in this afternoon cih loin this afternoon ci ding hi.

senses.definition_en: at a later time, after an event or action has finished.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang ahih kei leh nasep khat khit ciangin; a nung ciangin.

examples.english: We ate dinner and went for a walk afterwards.
examples.zomi: Nitak-an ka ne uh a, a nung ciangin lampai ka pai uh hi.

examples.english: He apologized shortly afterwards.
examples.zomi: Sawtlo nungin ngaihdam ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: Afterwards does not take an object. Use after when a noun or event follows: after the meeting.
senses.usage_zomi: Afterwards nungah object hong omlo hi. Noun ahih kei leh thu piang hong zui leh after zang in: after the meeting.

senses.heading: One more time
senses.definition_en: another time; once more.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khatvei semsem; nawnkhat.

examples.english: Please say your name again.
examples.zomi: Na min hong gen nawn in.

examples.english: She tried again and passed the test.
examples.zomi: Hanciam nawn a, sittelna zo hi.

senses.usage_en: Again usually comes after the object or at the end of a clause: read the book again.
senses.usage_zomi: Again pen a tamzaw in object nungah ahih kei leh clause tawpna ah hong om hi: read the book again.

senses.heading: Back to a previous condition
senses.definition_en: returned to a condition or situation that existed before.
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa dinmun ahih kei leh omzia ah hong kik.

examples.english: The store is open again after the repairs.
examples.zomi: Puah khit ciangin dawk kihong kik hi.

examples.english: I hope you feel well again soon.
examples.zomi: Sawtlo sungin na cidam kik ding ka lam-en hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, again shows restoration or return, not simply repetition.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah again in na khat hih nawn cihna bek hilo in, dinmun lui ah hong kik cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: Opposing someone or something
senses.definition_en: disagreeing with, competing with or trying to prevent someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh na khat thukimpih lo, langpang ahih kei leh khaktan sawm.

examples.english: Most members voted against the proposal.
examples.zomi: Pawl sung mi a tamzaw in thupiakna langpangin vote pia uh hi.

examples.english: The organization works against discrimination.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi in deidan kibanglohna langdo dingin sem hi.

senses.usage_en: Against is followed by a noun, pronoun or -ing form. It does not function as a verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Against nungah noun, pronoun ahih kei leh -ing form hong pai hi. Verb in kizang lo hi.

senses.heading: Touching or supported by something
senses.definition_en: touching, pressing on or supported by a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat lang, pang ahih kei leh maitang tawh kituak a, tua tungah kinga.

examples.english: He leaned his bicycle against the wall.
examples.zomi: A lengnih pen bang tungah kinga sak hi.

examples.english: She stood with her back against the door.
examples.zomi: A nung kongkhak tawh kituak in ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, against describes direct contact with a surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah against in na khat leh a maitang kituak in a omna gen hi.

senses.heading: Providing protection from something
senses.definition_en: providing protection or preparation for a harmful event, illness or risk.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siatna, natna ahih kei leh lauhuaina khat pan kidal/kikep.

examples.english: The vaccine provides protection against the disease.
examples.zomi: Dawi in tua natna pan kidalna pia hi.

examples.english: They insured the building against fire.
examples.zomi: Innpi mei kangna pan sumsup kidal nadingin insurance bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Protection against identifies the danger or harm from which protection is provided.
senses.usage_zomi: Protection against nungah bang lauhuaina ahih kei leh siatna pan kidal hiam cih hong om hi.

senses.heading: The number of years someone has lived
senses.definition_en: the length of time that a person has lived or something has existed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a pian pan, ahih kei leh na khat a kipat pan hun sawt zah.

examples.english: She began learning English at the age of twelve.
examples.zomi: Kum sawmlehnih in English sin kipan hi.

examples.english: Children under the age of five can enter free.
examples.zomi: Kum nga nuai naupangte man loin lut thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Ask How old are you?, not normally What is your age? in everyday conversation. Age is more common in formal writing and forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim kiholimna ah What is your age? sangin How old are you? ci-in dong in. Age pen ngeina kizui laigelhna leh form-te ah kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: A period in history
senses.definition_en: a particular period of history known for certain events, ideas or developments.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh khantohna tuam khat tawh a kiciamteh tangthu hun khat.

examples.english: We live in the digital age.
examples.zomi: Digital khantawn ah i nungta hi.

examples.english: The museum contains tools from the Stone Age.
examples.zomi: Museum sungah suang khantawn pan vanzat om hi.

senses.usage_en: When age names a recognized historical period, it is often capitalized, as in the Stone Age.
senses.usage_zomi: Age in tangthu hun min kician khat gen ciangin, the Stone Age cih bangin a lai mal masapen capital letter tawh kigelh zel hi.

senses.heading: Having a particular age — /eɪdʒd/
senses.definition_en: having lived or existed for a stated number of years.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum zat kician khat pha khin.

common_phrases.zomi: kum nga pan sawm kikak naupangte
kum sawmlehgiat leh a tunglam mite

examples.english: The program is for children aged six to twelve.
examples.zomi: Program pen kum guk pan sawmlehnih kikak naupangte ading ahi hi.

examples.english: Applicants must be aged eighteen or older.
examples.zomi: Application pia mite kum sawmlehgiat ahih kei leh upazaw ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When aged means “having a stated age,” it is pronounced /eɪdʒd/.
senses.usage_zomi: Aged in kum zat kician nei cihna ah kizang ciangin /eɪdʒd/ ci-in kigen hi.

senses.heading: Old — /ˈeɪdʒɪd/
senses.definition_en: old or having the physical qualities associated with old age.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum upa ahih kei leh upatna lim nei.

examples.english: She cares for her aged parents.
examples.zomi: A kum upa nulehpa kem hi.

examples.english: The organization provides meals for the aged.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi in mi upate adingin an vaihawm hi.

senses.usage_en: When aged means “old,” it is pronounced /ˈeɪdʒɪd/. In everyday English, older people or older adults is often more natural and respectful than the aged.
senses.usage_zomi: Aged in “upa” cihna nei ciangin /ˈeɪdʒɪd/ ci-in kigen hi. Nisim English ah the aged sangin older people ahih kei leh older adults cihna ngeina zaw a, zahtak huai zaw hi.

senses.heading: An organization providing a service
senses.definition_en: a business or organization that provides a particular service for people or other organizations.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl dangte adingin nasepna tuam khat pia sumleina ahih kei leh pawl.

examples.english: We booked our flights through a travel agency.
examples.zomi: Travel agency tungtawnin vanleng ticket ka lei uh hi.

examples.english: The employment agency helped her find a job.
examples.zomi: Nasepna zongsak pawl in nasepna khat muh nading huh hi.

senses.usage_en: The word before agency normally identifies the service it provides, such as travel, employment or advertising.
senses.usage_zomi: Agency ma-a kammal in tua pawl in bang nasepna pia hiam cih gen hi; entawnin, travel, employment ahih kei leh advertising agency.

senses.heading: A government organization
senses.definition_en: an official organization responsible for a particular area of government work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi nasep khen tuam khat kem leh vaihawm ding mawhpuakna nei kumpi pawl.

examples.english: The agency is responsible for protecting public health.
examples.zomi: Tua kumpi pawl in mipi cidamna kep mawhpuak hi.

examples.english: Several federal agencies are investigating the case.
examples.zomi: Federal kumpi pawl pawlkhat in tua thu zongkhiat uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A government agency usually has legal authority and responsibility for one particular area of public work.
senses.usage_zomi: Kumpi agency in thukham tawh kipia ukzawhna nei a, mipi nasepna khen tuam khat mawhpuak hi.

senses.definition_en: a list of subjects to be discussed or tasks to be completed at a meeting.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kikhopna thute; kikum ding thu laigelhna
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhopna ah kikum ding thu ahih kei leh hih ding nasepnate a kizom danin kigelh laigelhna.

examples.english: The budget is the first item on today’s agenda.
examples.zomi: Tuni kikhopna ah kikum ding thu masapen pen sum vai ahi hi.

examples.english: Please send the meeting agenda before Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ma-in kikhopna ah kikum ding thute hong khak in.

senses.usage_en: Agenda usually refers to one complete list. Its plural is agendas. A hidden agenda is a purpose that someone does not openly reveal.
senses.usage_zomi: Agenda in kikhopna thu laigelhna bukim khat gen zel hi. A plural pen agendas ahi hi. Hidden agenda cihpen mi khat in phuang takin a genloh a simtham ngiimna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A person or business acting for someone else
senses.definition_en: a person or company that represents another person or provides a particular service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat aiawh ahih kei leh mi dangte adingin nasepna tuam khat vaihawm sak mi/company.

examples.english: The travel agent booked our hotel and flights.
examples.zomi: Khualzin vaihawmsak mi in ka hotel leh vanleng ticket uh bawl sak hi.

examples.english: You should speak with an insurance agent about the policy.
examples.zomi: Insurance thukhun thu insurance aiawh tawh na kiholim ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The word before agent often identifies the service provided, such as travel, insurance or real-estate agent.
senses.usage_zomi: Agent ma-a kammal in tua mi in bang nasepna pia hiam cih gen hi; entawnin, travel, insurance ahih kei leh real-estate agent.

senses.heading: A person working secretly for a government
senses.definition_en: a person who secretly collects information or performs work for a government or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi ahih kei leh pawl khat adingin simtham takin thutheihna zong ahih kei leh nasep sem mi.

examples.english: The agent secretly collected information about the group.
examples.zomi: Simtham nasem in tua pawl thu simtham takin zong hi.

examples.english: She worked as an undercover agent for several years.
examples.zomi: Kum pawlkhat sung a dinmun seel simtham nasem in sem hi.

senses.usage_en: A secret agent may work for a government, police organization or intelligence service.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtham agent pen kumpi, police pawl ahih kei leh thusim zong nasepna adingin sem thei hi.

senses.heading: Ready to attack or behave violently
senses.definition_en: likely to attack, argue or behave in an angry and forceful way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mi do nuam; heh; thagum zang nuam
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi do, kinial ahih kei leh hehna tawh thahat takin gamta pahpah.

examples.english: The dog becomes aggressive around strangers.
examples.zomi: Mi theihloh a om ciangin ui pen mi do nuam hi.

examples.english: Aggressive behavior will not be accepted at school.
examples.zomi: Sang ah mi dona gamtatna saangtheih hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing behavior, aggressive usually has a negative meaning and suggests hostility or possible violence.
