senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna gen ciangin aggressive in khiatna hoihlo nei zel a, langdona ahih kei leh thagum zat theihna lak hi.

senses.heading: Very forceful and determined
senses.definition_en: acting with great energy and determination to achieve a result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gah khat ngah nadingin thahat leh kip takin sem.

examples.english: The company adopted an aggressive growth strategy.
examples.zomi: Company in khantohna sepdingdan thahat khat teel hi.

examples.english: The team played aggressively during the final minutes.
examples.zomi: A tawp minute pawlkhat sung pawl pen thahat takin kimawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In business or sports, aggressive may describe strong determination rather than angry or violent behavior.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumleina ahih kei leh kimawlna ah aggressive in hehna leh thagum cihna sangin, ngiimna ngah nading thahat leh kip taka sepna gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: before the present time, used to show how much time has passed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu hun pan simkik in, hun zah khat beisa.

examples.english: We moved to this city three years ago.
examples.zomi: Kum thum beisa in hih khuapi ah ka hong kikuan uh hi.

examples.english: She called me a few minutes ago.
examples.zomi: Minute tawm khat beisa in hong phone hi.

senses.usage_en: Ago is counted backward from the present and normally follows a time expression. For a time counted backward from a past event, use before.
senses.usage_zomi: Ago pen tu hun pan nunglam simkikna hi a, hun genna nungah hong om zel hi. Thu piang beisa khat pan nunglam sim leh before zang in.

senses.heading: Have the same opinion
senses.definition_en: to have the same opinion as another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang khat tawh ngaihsutna kibang ahih kei leh ama thugen thukimpih.

examples.english: I agree with you about the need for better education.
examples.zomi: Pilna hoihzaw kisapna thu ah nang tawh ka thukim hi.

examples.english: The committee members did not all agree.
examples.zomi: Committee sung mi khempeuh thukim khawmlo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use agree with a person or opinion. Use agree about/on a subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh ngaihsutna thukimpih ciangin agree with zang in. Thu khat tungah thukimna gen ciangin agree about/on zang in.

senses.heading: Decide something together
senses.definition_en: to reach a shared decision after discussion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kiholim khit ciangin thu khat khawm khensat a, thukim.

examples.english: We agreed to meet again next week.
examples.zomi: Nipi masa ciangin kimu nawn dingin ka thukim uh hi.

examples.english: The two sides agreed on a new schedule.
examples.zomi: Langnih in hun geelna thak khat thukim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use agree to + verb for an action and agree on + noun for a decision or subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep khat hih ding thukimna ah agree to + verb zang in. Thu ahih kei leh khensatna khat thukimna ah agree on + noun zang in.

senses.heading: Match or be consistent
senses.definition_en: to be the same as or consistent with information, facts or results.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thutheihna, thuman ahih kei leh gah tawh kibang/kituak.

examples.english: The witness’s account agrees with the evidence.
examples.zomi: Teci genna pen a omlai teci tawh kituak hi.

examples.english: The numbers in the two reports do not agree.
examples.zomi: Report nih sunga nambatte kituaklo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, agree with means matching or being consistent with something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah agree with in na khat tawh kibang ahih kei leh kituak cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: A shared opinion or decision
senses.definition_en: a situation in which people have the same opinion or reach the same decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite ngaihsutna kibang ahih kei leh thu khat khawm khensatna.

examples.english: After a long discussion, we reached an agreement.
examples.zomi: Sawt takin kikum khit ciangin thukimna ka ngah uh hi.

examples.english: The members were in agreement about the new policy.
examples.zomi: Pawl sung mite thukhun thak thu ah thukim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In agreement means sharing the same opinion. Reach an agreement means successfully deciding something together.
senses.usage_zomi: In agreement cihpen ngaihsutna kibang cihna hi. Reach an agreement cihpen thu khat kikum a, thukimna ngah cihna hi.

senses.heading: A formal arrangement or contract
senses.definition_en: a spoken or written arrangement that states what people or organizations have agreed to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawlte in bang hih ding cih a thukimna uh kam tawh ahih kei leh lai tawh a kiciamteh.

examples.english: Both companies signed the agreement.
examples.zomi: Company nihgel in thukim lai min gelh uh hi.

examples.english: The agreement will remain in effect for three years.
examples.zomi: Thukimna pen kum thum sung kizang ding hi.

senses.usage_en: A formal agreement may be legally binding, but not every agreement is a legal contract.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina kizui thukimna khat thukham tawh khen theih hi thei hi. Ahih hangin thukimna khempeuh thukham tawh khen theih contract ahi veklo hi.

senses.definition_en: used to express understanding, recognition, surprise, pleasure, pain or disappointment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu theihna, theihkhiatna, lamdanna, nuamna, natna ahih kei leh dahna aw tawh lakna.

common_phrases.zomi: Ah, tua ah na om maw!

examples.english: “The meeting is tomorrow.” “Ah, I understand now.”
examples.zomi: “Kikhopna zing ahi hi.” “Ah, tu in ka thei ta hi.”

examples.english: Ah, what a beautiful view!
examples.zomi: Ah, munhoih mahmah e!

senses.usage_en: The meaning of ah depends mainly on tone of voice and context. It is common in speech but uncommon in formal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Ah khiatna pen awging leh a kimkot thu tungah kinga hi. Kam tawh kiholimna ah kizang tam a, ngeina kizui laigelhna ah kizang tamlo hi.

senses.heading: In front
senses.definition_en: in or toward a position in front of someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh na khat ma-ah; mailam ah.

examples.english: The school is just ahead on the right.
examples.zomi: Sang pen mailam taklam ah om hi.

examples.english: She walked ahead of the group.
examples.zomi: Pawl ma-ah lampai hi.

senses.usage_en: Ahead of is followed by a noun or pronoun. Ahead alone does not need an object.
senses.usage_zomi: Ahead of nungah noun ahih kei leh pronoun hong pai hi. Ahead amah guak kizang leh object kisamlo hi.

senses.heading: Earlier or more advanced
senses.definition_en: earlier than expected, further developed or in a better position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun sehpiasa sangin manlangzaw, khantohzaw ahih kei leh dinmun hoihzaw ah om.

examples.english: The project is two weeks ahead of schedule.
examples.zomi: Project pen hun sehpiasa sangin nipi nih masa zaw hi.

examples.english: Planning ahead can prevent many problems.
examples.zomi: Mailam ading geel kholna in buaina tampi khaktan thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Ahead of time means earlier than required. Go ahead means beginning or continuing with permission.
senses.usage_zomi: Ahead of time cihpen hun kisap ma-a masa zaw cihna hi. Go ahead cihpen thu phalna tawh kipan ahih kei leh zom paisuak cihna hi.

senses.heading: Help or support
senses.definition_en: help, money, food or other support given to someone in need.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisapna nei mi huh nadingin a kipiak huhna, sum, an ahih kei leh panpihna dang.

examples.english: The organization provides food aid to displaced families.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi in amau inn pan a kikhiin innkuante tungah an panpihna pia hi.

examples.english: She applied for financial aid to attend college.
examples.zomi: College kai theih nading sum panpihna ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: Aid is often used in formal or official contexts. Help is more common in everyday conversation.
senses.usage_zomi: Aid pen ngeina kizui ahih kei leh kumpi/pawlpi nasepna ah kizang tam hi. Nisim kiholimna ah help kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Something that helps
senses.definition_en: a device, method or resource that makes a task easier or helps someone function.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep khat baihsak ahih kei leh mi khat semthei nading huh van, sepdingdan ahih kei leh thubul.

examples.english: He uses a hearing aid in his left ear.
examples.zomi: A veilam bil ah zakna huh van zang hi.

examples.english: The teacher used pictures as visual aids.
examples.zomi: Sia in limte muhna tawh sinna huh van in zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In compounds such as hearing aid and teaching aid, aid refers to something designed to help.
senses.usage_zomi: Hearing aid leh teaching aid bang kammal kigawm ah aid in huh nadingin a kibawl na khat gen hi.

senses.heading: Point toward a target
senses.definition_en: to point a weapon, camera or other object toward a particular target.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thau, camera ahih kei leh van khat ngiimna kician khat lamah mansak.

examples.english: He aimed the camera at the bird.
examples.zomi: Camera pen vasa lamah ngiim hi.

examples.english: The player aimed carefully at the goal.
examples.zomi: Kimawlpa in goal lamah kidawm takin ngiim hi.

senses.usage_en: Use aim something at a target or simply aim at a target.
senses.usage_zomi: Van khat ngiimna tungah mansak leh aim something at zang in. Van gen loin ngiimna bek gen leh aim at zang in.

senses.heading: Intend or try to achieve something
senses.definition_en: to intend or make a serious effort to achieve a particular result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gah khat ngah ding ngiim ahih kei leh ngah nading thupi takin hanciam.

examples.english: The program aims to improve public health.
examples.zomi: Program in mipi cidamna hoihsak ding ngiim hi.

examples.english: We aim to finish the work by Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ciangin nasep zo dingin ka ngiim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use aim to + verb for an intended action and aim for + noun for a desired result.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih ding nasep gen leh aim to + verb zang in. Ngah nop gah gen leh aim for + noun zang in.

senses.definition_en: the invisible mixture of gases around Earth that people and animals breathe.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung kimah a om, mit tawh muh theihloh, mihing leh ganhingte in a hu a kaih uh huih.

examples.english: Open the window and let some fresh air in.
examples.zomi: Kong-awi hon inla, huih siangtho lutsak in.

examples.english: Air pollution can damage people’s health.
examples.zomi: Huih niin in mihing cidamna susia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Air is normally uncountable when it refers to the gases we breathe. By air means traveling by aircraft.
senses.usage_zomi: I hu i lak huih gen ciangin air pen a tamzaw in uncountable noun hi. By air cihpen vanleng tawh khualzin cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: any vehicle designed to fly, such as an airplane or helicopter.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van ah leng thei dingin a kibawl van, entawnin vanleng ahih kei leh helicopter.

examples.english: The aircraft landed safely despite the strong wind.
examples.zomi: Huih nasia napi vanleng bit takin tu hi.

examples.english: Several aircraft were waiting to take off.
examples.zomi: Vanleng pawlkhat lengto dingin ngak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The singular and plural forms are both aircraft: one aircraft, several aircrafts hilo in, several aircraft.
senses.usage_zomi: Singular leh plural pen aircraft mah ahi hi: one aircraft leh several aircraft. Several aircrafts cihlo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: a company that transports passengers or goods by aircraft.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanleng tawh khualzinte ahih kei leh vante pua sumleina company.

common_phrases.zomi: gamkhat leh gamkhat kikak vanleng company

examples.english: The airline canceled our flight because of the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi hangin vanleng company in ka flight uh phiat hi.

examples.english: She works for an international airline.
examples.zomi: Gamkhat leh gamkhat kikak vanleng company khat ah sem hi.

senses.usage_en: An airline is the company. A flight is one particular journey made by an aircraft.
senses.usage_zomi: Airline pen vanleng company ahi hi. Flight pen vanleng in a khualzin khatvei bek ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: a place where aircraft take off and land and where passengers begin or end air journeys.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanleng lengto leh tu a, khualzinte van-a khualzin kipatna ahih kei leh tawpna mun.

examples.english: We arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.
examples.zomi: Flight ma nai nih in airport ka tung uh hi.

examples.english: The new airport can serve millions of passengers each year.
examples.zomi: Airport thak in kum sim khualzin awn tampi kem thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use at the airport for general location and to the airport for movement toward it.
senses.usage_zomi: Airport ah omna gen leh at the airport zang in. Airport lamah paina gen leh to the airport zang in.

senses.heading: A warning device or signal
senses.definition_en: a device or sound that warns people of danger or calls attention to something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina om cih theihsak ahih kei leh mite’ lungsim la dingin awging pia van/lim.

examples.english: The fire alarm sounded during the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhop laitak mei lauhuai theihsakna ging hi.

examples.english: I set the alarm for six in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsang dak guk in alarm ka seh hi.

senses.usage_en: An alarm clock wakes someone. A fire alarm or security alarm warns people of possible danger.
senses.usage_zomi: Alarm clock in mi tho sak hi. Fire alarm ahih kei leh security alarm in lauhuaina om thei cih mi vau hi.

senses.heading: Sudden fear or worry
senses.definition_en: a sudden strong feeling of fear or concern caused by possible danger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina om thei cih theih cianga hong piang launa ahih kei leh lungkhamna thahat.

examples.english: The sudden noise caused alarm among the passengers.
examples.zomi: Awging hong piangvat in khualzinte lakah launa piangsak hi.

examples.english: Doctors expressed alarm about the spread of the disease.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te in natna kizelna thu lungkhamna lak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, alarm is usually uncountable and refers to serious, sudden concern.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah alarm pen a tamzaw in uncountable noun hi a, thupi leh thakhat in hong piang lungkhamna gen hi.

senses.heading: A collection of recorded music
senses.definition_en: a collection of songs or musical recordings released together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laa ahih kei leh music recording pawlkhat khatvei in a kikhahkhia kigawmna.

examples.english: The singer released a new album last month.
examples.zomi: Laa sapa in kha beisa laa album thak khahkhia hi.

examples.english: This album contains twelve songs.
examples.zomi: Hih album sungah laa sawmlehnih om hi.

senses.usage_en: An album may be released digitally, on a CD or on a vinyl record.
senses.usage_zomi: Album pen digital tawh, CD tungah ahih kei leh vinyl record tungah kikhahkhia thei hi.

senses.heading: A book for keeping photographs or collections
senses.definition_en: a book used for storing photographs, stamps or similar collected items.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim, stamp ahih kei leh a kigawm na dangte koihna laibu.

examples.english: She showed us her family photo album.
examples.zomi: A innkuan lim laibu hong lak hi.

examples.english: They placed the wedding pictures in an album.
examples.zomi: Mopawi limte album sungah koih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A digital collection of photographs may also be called an album.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer ahih kei leh phone sunga digital lim kigawmna zong album kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Alcoholic drinks
senses.definition_en: drinks such as beer, wine or liquor that can make a person drunk.
senses.explanation_zomi: Beer, wine ahih kei leh zu thahat bang, mi kham sak thei dawnna.

examples.english: The doctor advised him to avoid alcohol.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in zu dawnlo dingin amah thuhilh hi.

examples.english: Alcohol is not allowed at this event.
examples.zomi: Hih pawlkhopna ah zu phallo hi.

senses.usage_en: Alcohol is uncountable when referring generally to alcoholic drinks. A particular type or serving is called a drink.
senses.usage_zomi: Zu dawnna a zaizaw in gen ciangin alcohol pen uncountable noun hi. Zu nam khat ahih kei leh khatvei dawn pen a drink kici hi.

senses.heading: A chemical substance
senses.definition_en: a colorless chemical used in drinks, medicines, cleaning products and industry.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawnna, zatui, siansuahna na leh van bawlna ah kizang color neilo chemical tui.

examples.english: The nurse cleaned the skin with alcohol.
examples.zomi: Nurse in alcohol tawh vun siansuah hi.

examples.english: Check the alcohol content on the label.
examples.zomi: Label tungah alcohol om zah en in.

senses.usage_en: Not every chemical called alcohol is intended for drinking. Some forms are poisonous.
senses.usage_zomi: Alcohol kici chemical khempeuh dawn ding hilo hi. Pawlkhat gu nei a, sihna dong tun thei hi.

senses.definition_en: containing alcohol or connected with alcoholic drinks.
senses.explanation_zomi: Alcohol nei ahih kei leh zu dawnna tawh kisai.

examples.english: The restaurant serves both alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks.
examples.zomi: Anzuakna mun in alcohol nei leh alcohol neilo dawnna gel pia hi.

examples.english: This medicine should not be mixed with alcoholic drinks.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui zu dawnna tawh helkhawm loh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Alcoholic as an adjective means containing or relating to alcohol. As a noun, it traditionally refers to a person with alcohol dependence, but a person with alcohol-use disorder is often more respectful and precise.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective in kizang alcoholic pen alcohol nei ahih kei leh alcohol tawh kisai cihna hi. Noun in mi khat zu tawh kinaihna buaina nei cihna a ngeina in nei napi, a person with alcohol-use disorder cihna zahtak huai leh kician zaw hi.

senses.heading: Living and not dead
senses.definition_en: living; not dead.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nungta lai a, si nailo.

examples.english: The missing child was found alive.
examples.zomi: A mang naupang pen nungta in kimukha hi.

examples.english: Plants need water and light to stay alive.
examples.zomi: Singkungte nungta theih nading tui leh khuavak kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Alive normally comes after a linking verb: The animal is alive. Before a noun, use live or living: a live animal.
senses.usage_zomi: Alive pen linking verb nungah hong om zel hi: The animal is alive. Noun ma-ah live ahih kei leh living zang in: a live animal.

senses.heading: Active, exciting or full of energy
senses.definition_en: active, exciting or filled with movement and energy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, noptatna leh thatang tawh kidim.

examples.english: The town comes alive during the festival.
examples.zomi: Pawi laitak khuapi pen gamtatna leh noptatna tawh nungta hong suak hi.

examples.english: They are working to keep the Zomi language alive.
examples.zomi: Zomi pau nungta sak paisuak dingin sem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, alive describes energy, activity or continued existence.
senses.usage_zomi: Lim tawh gen hih khiatna ah alive in thatang, gamtatna ahih kei leh om paisuakna gen hi.

senses.heading: Every member or part
senses.definition_en: every person or thing in a group, without exception.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat sunga mi ahih kei leh na khempeuh, khat zong a kihello.

examples.english: All students must complete the assignment.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang khempeuh in a kipiak nasep zo ding uh hi.

examples.english: All children need love and protection.
examples.zomi: Naupang khempeuh in itna leh kepbitna kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use all + plural noun for every member of a group. With a pronoun, use all of us, all of them or all of you.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawl khat sunga mi khempeuh gen leh all + plural noun zang in. Pronoun tawh all of us, all of them ahih kei leh all of you zang in.

senses.heading: The whole amount or period
senses.definition_en: the complete amount, quantity or duration of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a zah khempeuh ahih kei leh hun khat a vekpi.

examples.english: It rained all day.
examples.zomi: Ni khat a vekpi guah zu hi.

examples.english: She spent all the money on medical care.
examples.zomi: Sum khempeuh siibawlna ah zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use all the + singular/uncountable noun when referring to a complete specific amount: all the water, all the time. Use whole before a singular countable noun: the whole day.
senses.usage_zomi: Na kician khat a zah vekpi gen leh all the + singular/uncountable noun zang in: all the water, all the time. Singular countable noun ma-ah whole zang in: the whole day.

senses.heading: Give permission
senses.definition_en: to give someone permission to do or have something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat na khat hih ahih kei leh nei theih nading thu phal.

examples.english: The teacher allowed the students to leave early.
examples.zomi: Sia in sangnaupangte inn manlang takin ciah phal hi.

examples.english: Food is not allowed in this room.
examples.zomi: Hih innkhaan sungah an nek kiphallo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use allow someone to do something. Do not use allow someone do something without to.
senses.usage_zomi: Allow someone to do something cihdan zang in. To koih loin allow someone do something ci kei in.

senses.heading: Make something possible
senses.definition_en: to make it possible for something to happen or for someone to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat piangthei ahih kei leh mi khat in na khat hih thei dingin hunlem pia.

examples.english: The application allows users to share photographs.
examples.zomi: Application in zangtute lim kihawm thei sak hi.

examples.english: The new road will allow easier access to the village.
examples.zomi: Lampi thak in khua baihzaw takin tun thei sak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the subject is often a system, method or condition rather than a person giving permission.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah subject pen thu phal mi sangin system, sepdingdan ahih kei leh dinmun khat hi zel hi.

senses.heading: Satisfactory or acceptable
senses.definition_en: satisfactory, acceptable or good enough, although not excellent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Saangtheih leh kisap zah a kicing napi, ahoihpen hilo.

examples.english: The food was all right, but it was not excellent.
examples.zomi: Annek hoih lel napi, ahoih mahmah hilo hi.

examples.english: Your work is all right, but a few parts need correction.
examples.zomi: Na nasep saangtheih napi, a khen pawlkhat puah kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: All right often means acceptable rather than very good. Before a noun, it is sometimes hyphenated as all-right, although this use is informal.
senses.usage_zomi: All right in ahoih mahmah cihna sangin saangtheih cihna nei zel hi. Noun ma-ah kizang ciangin all-right ci-in hyphen tawh kigelh thei napi, hih zatdan pen ngeina kizui hetlo hi.

senses.heading: Safe, well or not injured
senses.definition_en: safe, healthy or not seriously harmed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bit, cidam ahih kei leh nasia takin liamlo.

examples.english: Are you all right after the accident?
examples.zomi: Khuaphawkloh thu piang khit nang na hoih hiam?

examples.english: Do not worry; everyone is all right.
examples.zomi: Lungkhia kei in; mi khempeuh hoih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: All right is the standard spelling. Alright is common in informal writing, but some editors still consider it nonstandard.
senses.usage_zomi: All right pen gelhdan standard ahi hi. Alright pen ngeina kizui hetlo laigelhna ah kizang tam napi, lai puah siam pawlkhat in standard hilo ci uh hi.

senses.definition_en: very nearly, but not completely or not quite.
senses.zomi_equivalents: dektak; nai mahmah; tawm khat bek kisam
senses.explanation_zomi: Bukim takin hithei nailo napi, tua tan nai mahmah.

examples.english: I have almost finished the report.
examples.zomi: Report ka zo dektak hi.

examples.english: Almost everyone agreed with the decision.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh dektak in thu khensatna thukimpih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Almost means that something is close to being true or complete, but has not fully reached that point.
senses.usage_zomi: Almost cihpen na khat a man ahih kei leh bukim ding nai mahmah napi, tua tan a tun nailohna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: without another person; not accompanied by anyone else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang kuamah om lo in, amah guak om.

examples.english: She lives alone in a small apartment.
examples.zomi: Innkhaan neu khat ah amah guakin teng hi.

examples.english: The child should not be left alone at home.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen inn ah amah guakin nusia loh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Alone describes being without other people. Lonely describes feeling unhappy because of being alone. A person can be alone without feeling lonely.
senses.usage_zomi: Alone in mi dang om loin amah guak om cihna hi. Lonely in amah guak omna hangin dah leh lawm kisap cihna nei hi. Mi khat amah guak om napi dahlo thei hi.

senses.definition_en: from one part of a road, river, line or surface toward another part, following its direction.
senses.zomi_equivalents: zui in; tawh kizui in; a pangah
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi, gun, laigui ahih kei leh na sau khat zui in a pang tawh pai.

examples.english: We walked along the river for an hour.
examples.zomi: Nai khat sung gun zui in ka lampai uh hi.

examples.english: There are several stores along this street.
examples.zomi: Hih lampi zui in dawk pawlkhat om hi.

senses.usage_en: Along follows the length or direction of something. Across means moving from one side to the other.
senses.usage_zomi: Along in na khat a sauna ahih kei leh a paina zui cihna hi. Across in langkhat pan langkhat kantan cihna nei hi.

senses.definition_en: before now or before a particular time, often earlier than expected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu hun ahih kei leh hun kician khat ma-a, a hih khin; lam-et sangin masa zaw.

examples.english: She has already finished her homework.
examples.zomi: A inn ah a hih ding sang nasep zo khin hi.

examples.english: When we arrived, the meeting had already begun.
examples.zomi: Ka tun uh ciangin kikhopna kipan khin hi.

senses.usage_en: In standard affirmative sentences, already commonly appears between the auxiliary verb and main verb, or before a simple main verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Affirmative sentence ah already pen auxiliary verb leh main verb kikaal ah, ahih kei leh simple main verb ma-ah hong om zel hi.

senses.definition_en: in addition; used to add another person, thing or fact.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na ahih kei leh thu dang khat behlapna; zong.

examples.english: She speaks English and also understands Burmese.
examples.zomi: English pau a, Burmese zong thei hi.

examples.english: The program is useful and also easy to use.
examples.zomi: Program phattuam a, zat zong baih hi.

senses.usage_en: Also usually appears before a main verb but after the verb be. At the end of a sentence, too is often more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Also pen main verb ma-ah hong om zel a, be verb nungah hong om hi. Sentence tawpna ah too zat ngeina zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: to change something, usually partly rather than completely.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a vekpi kheek loin, a khen khat ahih kei leh a omzia tawm khat kheek.

examples.english: We had to alter our plans because of the weather.
examples.zomi: Khuahun hangin ka geelna uh kheek kul hi.

examples.english: The tailor altered the jacket so that it fitted me.
examples.zomi: Puan siampa in jacket pen kei tawh hong kituak dingin puah hi.

senses.usage_en: Alter normally means changing part of something while keeping its basic identity. Change has a broader meaning and may involve complete replacement.
senses.usage_zomi: Alter in na khat a bulpi omlai in a khen khat puah cihna nei zel hi. Change khiatna zaizaw a, a vekpi kheekna zong huam thei hi.

senses.definition_en: another choice or possibility available instead of the first one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teel masa pen aiawhin teeltheih na dang khat ahih kei leh sepdingdan dang.

examples.english: Public transportation is an alternative to driving.
examples.zomi: Mipi mawtaw zatna pen mawtaw hawl aiawh teeltheihna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: We need to find a less expensive alternative.
examples.zomi: Sum tawmzaw kisap teeltheihna dang khat i zong kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an alternative to something, not normally an alternative of something.
senses.usage_zomi: An alternative to something cihdan zang in. A ngeina in an alternative of something ci kei in.

senses.definition_en: used to introduce a fact that contrasts with the main statement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu nih a kilehbulh dan lak nadingin, “...napi” cih khiatna tawh kizang.

examples.english: Although it was raining, we continued walking.
examples.zomi: Guah zu napi, ka lampai zom uh hi.

examples.english: Although the work was difficult, she completed it on time.
examples.zomi: Nasep haksa napi, hun seh sungin zo hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not use but in the same clause structure after although. Say Although it was raining, we left, not Although it was raining, but we left.
senses.usage_zomi: Although tawh clause kipan khit ciangin tua sentence sungah but behlap kei in. Although it was raining, but we left cih loin Although it was raining, we left ci ding hi.

senses.definition_en: at every time, on every occasion or throughout a period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khempeuh ah, khatvei zong a kihello in.

examples.english: She always arrives at work on time.
examples.zomi: Nasepna ah hun kician takin tung tawntung hi.

examples.english: I will always remember your kindness.
examples.zomi: Na hoihna ka phawk tawntung ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Always usually appears before a main verb but after the verb be: She always works; She is always ready.
senses.usage_zomi: Always pen main verb ma-ah hong om zel a, be verb nungah hong om hi: She always works; She is always ready.

senses.definition_en: feeling great surprise because something is unexpected or impressive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam-etloh ahih kei leh lamdang mahmah na khat hangin lamdang sa mahmah.

examples.english: We were amazed by her ability to speak five languages.
examples.zomi: Pau nam nga a pau theihna hangin lamdang ka sa mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: She was amazed to see how much the city had changed.
examples.zomi: Khuapi a kikhel mahmahna muh ciangin lamdang sa hi.

senses.usage_en: Amazed describes how a person feels. It is commonly followed by at, by or an infinitive: amazed at the result; amazed to see.
senses.usage_zomi: Amazed in mi khat lungsim a omdan gen hi. At, by ahih kei leh infinitive tawh kizang tam hi: amazed at the result; amazed to see.

senses.definition_en: causing great surprise or admiration because something is unusually good, impressive or unexpected.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lamdang huai; lamdang sak; hoih mahmah
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoih mahmah, a lamdang mahmah ahih kei leh lam-etloh ahih manin mi lamdang sak.

examples.english: The view from the mountain was amazing.
examples.zomi: Mual tung pan khuamuh pen lamdang huai mahmah hi.

examples.english: She made amazing progress in a short time.
examples.zomi: Hun tomno sungin khantohna lamdang huai ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Amazing describes the person, event or thing that causes the feeling. Amazed describes the person who experiences the feeling.
senses.usage_zomi: Amazing in lamdanna piangsak mi, thu piang ahih kei leh na gen hi. Amazed in tua lamdanna a phut mi lungsim omzia gen hi.

senses.heading: A strong desire to achieve something
senses.definition_en: a strong desire and determination to succeed or achieve an important goal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzo ahih kei leh ngiimna thupi khat tangtun nuamna leh kip taka hanciamna.

examples.english: Her ambition helped her become a doctor.
examples.zomi: A ngiimna in siavuan a suak theih nading huh hi.

examples.english: He has the ambition and discipline needed to succeed.
examples.zomi: Gualzo nading kisap ngiimna leh amah kidemna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Ambition can be positive when it encourages effort, but it may sound negative if success is pursued without concern for others.
senses.usage_zomi: Ambition in hahkatna piangsak leh khiatna hoih nei thei hi. Ahih hangin midang ngaihsak loin gualzawhna bek zong leh khiatna hoihlo nei thei hi.

senses.heading: A particular goal
senses.definition_en: a particular goal that someone strongly wants to achieve.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in tangtun nuam mahmah ngiimna kician.

examples.english: Her lifelong ambition was to write a book.
examples.zomi: A nuntak sung ngiimna pen laibu khat gelh ding ahi hi.

examples.english: He finally achieved his ambition of owning a business.
examples.zomi: Sumleina nasepna neih ding a ngiimna a tawpna ah tangtun hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to a specific goal, ambition is countable: an ambition, several ambitions.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngiimna khat kician gen ciangin ambition pen countable noun hi: an ambition, several ambitions.

senses.heading: Determined to succeed
senses.definition_en: strongly determined to become successful or achieve important goals.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngiimna sang nei; gualzo nuam; kip
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzo ahih kei leh ngiimna thupi tangtun dingin kip leh thahat takin hanciam.

examples.english: She is ambitious and works hard to reach her goals.
examples.zomi: Ngiimna sang nei a, a ngiimnate tangtun dingin hahkat takin sem hi.

examples.english: The company is looking for ambitious young workers.
examples.zomi: Company in ngiimna sang nei nasem khangno-te zong hi.

senses.usage_en: Describing a person as ambitious may be positive or negative depending on whether that person pursues success fairly and responsibly.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat ambitious ci-in genna in a gualzawhna zongdan thuman leh mawhpuakna nei hiam cih dungzui in khiatna hoih ahih kei leh hoihlo nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Difficult and requiring great effort
senses.definition_en: involving a large goal that will be difficult to achieve.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngiimna lian; haksapi; hanciamna tampi kisam
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna lian nei a, tangtun nading hanciamna tampi kisam.

examples.english: The city announced an ambitious housing plan.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in inn lamna ngiimna lian nei geelna khat puang hi.

examples.english: Finishing the project in one month is an ambitious target.
examples.zomi: Kha khat sung project zoh pen tangtun hak ngiimna khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing a plan or project, ambitious means large, challenging and requiring considerable effort.
senses.usage_zomi: Geelna ahih kei leh project gen ciangin ambitious in ngiimna lian, haksa leh hanciamna tampi kisam cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: Surrounded by or included in a group
senses.definition_en: in the middle of, surrounded by or included as part of a group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat lakah, pawl khat sunga khat in kihel.

examples.english: She felt comfortable among her friends.
examples.zomi: A lawmte lakah lungmuang takin om hi.

examples.english: This application is popular among students.
examples.zomi: Hih application pen sangnaupangte lakah minthang hi.

senses.usage_en: Among is normally used with a group of three or more or when people or objects are considered collectively. Between is often used for two distinct sides or individual relationships.
senses.usage_zomi: Among pen mi/na thum leh a tamzaw lakah ahih kei leh pawl khat a vekin ngaihsun ciangin kizang hi. Between pen langnih ahih kei leh mi khat ciat kizopna gen ciangin kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Shared or divided within a group
senses.definition_en: shared, distributed or divided between members of a group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat sunga mite kiangah kihawm ahih kei leh kikhen.

examples.english: The food was shared among the families.
examples.zomi: An pen innkuante lakah kihawm hi.

examples.english: They divided the work among the team members.
examples.zomi: Nasep pen pawl sung mite lakah hawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use among when something is distributed throughout a group rather than assigned between two clearly separate parties.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat pawl khat sungah kihawm ciangin among zang in. Langnih kician bek kikaal ah kihawm leh between kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: a quantity of something, especially something that cannot normally be counted as separate units.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a zah; a tam a tawm; vekpi
senses.explanation_zomi: A tam a tawm teh theih napi, khat khat in sim ngeina neiloh na khat a zah.

examples.english: The project requires a large amount of money.
examples.zomi: Project in sum tampi kisam hi.

examples.english: Add a small amount of water to the mixture.
examples.zomi: A kihelna sungah tui tawm khat behlap in.

senses.usage_en: Use amount with uncountable nouns, such as money, water and time. Use number with countable plural nouns, such as people, books and cars.
senses.usage_zomi: Amount pen money, water leh time bang uncountable noun-te tawh zang in. People, books leh cars bang countable plural noun-te tawh number zang in.

senses.definition_en: to examine something carefully by separating it into parts in order to understand or explain it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih kei leh na khat telcian nadingin a khen khat ciat kidawm takin kantel/zongkhiat.

examples.english: Researchers analysed the data from the survey.
examples.zomi: Zongkhiate in survey pan data kantel uh hi.

examples.english: We need to analyse the problem before making a decision.
examples.zomi: Thu i khensat ma-in buaina i kantel kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Analyse is the British spelling. Analyze is the standard American spelling. Their pronunciation and meaning are the same.
senses.usage_zomi: Analyse pen British English gelhdan hi. Analyze pen American English gelhdan standard ahi hi. A ginkhiatna leh khiatna uh kibang hi.

senses.definition_en: a careful examination of something by studying its separate parts, causes or results.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih kei leh na khat a khen khat ciat, a hang leh a gah kidawm takin kantel/zongkhiatna.

examples.english: The report includes an analysis of the survey results.
examples.zomi: Report sungah survey gah kantelna kihel hi.

examples.english: Further analysis is needed before we reach a conclusion.
examples.zomi: Thu i khensat ma-in kantelna behlap kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural of analysis is analyses /əˈnæləsiz/. Do not confuse the noun analysis with the verb analyse/analyze.
senses.usage_zomi: Analysis plural pen analyses /əˈnæləsiz/ ahi hi. Noun analysis leh verb analyse/analyze helkhawm kei in.

senses.definition_en: belonging to a period of history thousands of years ago or having existed for a very long time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tanglai; beisa pek; hun sawtpi a om
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum tul tampi beisa tangthu hun tawh kisai ahih kei leh hun sawtpi pan a om khin.

examples.english: The museum contains objects from ancient civilizations.
examples.zomi: Museum sungah tanglai mihing khantohna pan vante om hi.

examples.english: They visited the ruins of an ancient city.
examples.zomi: Tanglai khuapi a kisiat khin mun veh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Ancient normally refers to the distant past or to something extremely old. It is stronger than simply saying old.
senses.usage_zomi: Ancient in tanglai pek ahih kei leh a upa mahmah na gen hi. Old cih sangin khiatna thahatzaw nei hi.

senses.definition_en: used to connect words, phrases or clauses that are added together or closely related.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, kammal pawl ahih kei leh clause-te gawm a, thu khat tungah thu dang behlap nadingin kizang.

examples.english: She speaks English and Zomi.
examples.zomi: English leh Zomi pau hi.

examples.english: He opened the door and entered the room.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak hon a, innkhaan sungah lut hi.

senses.usage_en: And connects equal grammatical elements. In a list of three or more items, a comma may be placed before the final and; this is called the Oxford comma.
senses.usage_zomi: And in grammar lamah a dinmun kibang kammal, kammal pawl leh clause-te zom hi. Na thum leh a tamzaw laigelh ciangin a tawpna and ma-ah comma koih thei a, tua pen Oxford comma kici hi.

senses.definition_en: a strong feeling of displeasure or hostility caused by something wrong, unfair or hurtful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khial, thumanlo ahih kei leh nasakna pia na khat hangin hong piang hehna leh lungkimlohna thahat.

examples.english: He found it difficult to control his anger.
examples.zomi: A hehna uk ding haksa sa hi.

examples.english: The decision caused anger among community members.
examples.zomi: Thu khensatna in khawtang mite lakah hehna piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Anger is normally uncountable. Use anger at/about something and anger toward someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Anger pen a tamzaw in uncountable noun hi. Na khat tungah hehna gen leh anger at/about something zang inla, mi khat tungah hehna gen leh anger toward someone zang in.

senses.heading: The space between two meeting lines
senses.definition_en: the space or shape formed where two lines or surfaces meet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laigui nih ahih kei leh maitang nih a kituahna ah hong piang kil.

examples.english: A square has four right angles.
examples.zomi: Square khat in degree sawmkua kil li nei hi.

examples.english: Measure the angle with the correct instrument.
examples.zomi: Tehna van maan tawh kil teh in.

senses.usage_en: In geometry, angles are commonly measured in degrees.
senses.usage_zomi: Geometry ah kilte degree tawh kiteh zel hi.

senses.heading: A particular way of considering something
senses.definition_en: a particular position, viewpoint or way of considering a subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a etna lam ahih kei leh ngaihsutna mun tuam khat.

examples.english: Let us examine the problem from another angle.
examples.zomi: Buaina pen etna lam dang khat pan i kantel dih uh.

examples.english: The article presents a different angle on the issue.
examples.zomi: Article in tua thu ngaihsutna lam tuam khat pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, angle means a viewpoint or approach, not a geometric shape.
senses.usage_zomi: Lim tawh gen hih khiatna ah angle in geometry kil hilo in, etna lam ahih kei leh ngaihsutdan cihna nei hi.

senses.definition_en: feeling or showing strong displeasure because of something wrong, unfair or hurtful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khial, thumanlo ahih kei leh nasakna pia na khat hangin heh leh lungkimlo.

examples.english: She was angry with him for breaking his promise.
examples.zomi: A kamciam a palsat manin ama tungah heh hi.

examples.english: People are angry about the sudden price increase.
examples.zomi: A man hong khantohvat manin mite heh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use angry with/at someone and angry about/at something. Do not normally use angry to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat tungah hehna gen leh angry with/at someone zang in. Thu khat hangin hehna gen leh angry about/at something zang in. Angry to someone ci kei in.

senses.definition_en: a living creature that can usually move and obtain food, but is not a plant.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung hilo a, a tamzaw in amah leh amah gamta thei leh an zong thei nungta na.

examples.english: The forest is home to many wild animals.
examples.zomi: Gam sungah gamlak ganhing tampi teng hi.

examples.english: Some animals are active mainly at night.
examples.zomi: Ganhing pawlkhat pen a diak in zan in gamta uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Scientifically, humans are animals, but in everyday English animal often means a nonhuman living creature.
senses.usage_zomi: Science dungzui in mihing zong ganhing sungah kihel hi. Ahih hangin nisim English ah animal in a tamzaw in mihing hilo nungta gan gen hi.

senses.definition_en: the joint connecting the foot to the lower leg.
senses.explanation_zomi: Keng leh khegol nuailam a kizopna guhtuam.

examples.english: She injured her ankle while playing soccer.
examples.zomi: Soccer kimawl laitak a kengguhtuam liam hi.

examples.english: My ankle is swollen and painful.
examples.zomi: Ka kengguhtuam vung a, na hi.

senses.usage_en: The ankle is the joint above the foot. Do not confuse it with the heel, which is the back part of the foot.
senses.usage_zomi: Ankle pen keng tunglam guhtuam ahi hi. Keng nunglam pen heel hi a, tua tawh helkhawm loh ding hi.

senses.definition_en: the date on which an important event happened in an earlier year and is remembered each year.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kumcin ni; kum sim phawkna ni
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu thupi khat a pian ni kum sim a hong tun kik cianga kiphawk ni.

examples.english: They celebrated their tenth wedding anniversary.
examples.zomi: Amau mopawi kum sawm cinna lawp uh hi.

examples.english: Today is the anniversary of the organization’s founding.
examples.zomi: Tuni pen pawlpi phuhna kumcin ni ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: An anniversary normally returns every year. For a period measured in months, say three-month anniversary only in informal usage; three months since... is often more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Anniversary pen a tamzaw in kum sim hong tung kik ni gen hi. Kha tawh kiteh hun adingin ngeina kizui hetlo kiholimna ah three-month anniversary ci thei napi, three months since... cihdan a ngeina zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: to make information or a decision publicly or officially known.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thutheihna ahih kei leh thu khensatna khat mipi in thei dingin ngeina kizui takin puang.

examples.english: The school announced the examination results.
examples.zomi: Sang in sittelna gahte puang hi.

examples.english: The company announced plans to open a new office.
examples.zomi: Company in office thak hon ding geelna puang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use announce something or announce that.... Do not normally use announce about something.
senses.usage_zomi: Announce something ahih kei leh announce that... cihdan zang in. A ngeina in announce about something ci kei in.

senses.definition_en: a public or official statement that gives people information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi tungah ahih kei leh ngeina kizui takin thutheihna pia thupuak.

examples.english: The principal made an announcement during the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhop laitak sang makaipa in thupuak khat puang hi.

examples.english: We are waiting for the official announcement.
examples.zomi: Ngeina kizui puanzakna ka ngak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Make an announcement is the usual expression. An announcement may be spoken, written or published online.
senses.usage_zomi: Make an announcement pen a kizang ngeina ahi hi. Puanzakna pen kam tawh kigen, lai tawh kigelh ahih kei leh internet tungah kikhah thei hi.

senses.definition_en: to make someone slightly angry, impatient or uncomfortable.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungkimlo sak; buai sak; nuamlo sak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungkimlo, thuakzolo ahih kei leh nuamlo sak.

examples.english: The repeated noise annoyed everyone in the office.
examples.zomi: Awging hong ging nawnnawn in office sunga mi khempeuh buai sak hi.

examples.english: It annoys me when people arrive late.
examples.zomi: Mite hong tun nung ciangin kei hong lungkimlo sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Annoy describes the cause: something annoys a person. Annoyed describes how the person feels.
senses.usage_zomi: Annoy in lungkimlohna piangsak mi ahih kei leh na gen hi. Annoyed in tua lungkimlohna a nei mi lungsim omzia gen hi.

senses.definition_en: slightly angry or impatient because of someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat hangin tawm khat heh, lungkimlo ahih kei leh thuakzolo.

examples.english: She was annoyed with him for arriving late.
examples.zomi: A hong tun nung manin ama tungah lungkimlo hi.

examples.english: I was annoyed by the constant interruptions.
examples.zomi: Hong sukbuai nawnnawn manin ka lungkimlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use annoyed with/at someone and annoyed about/by something. Annoyed describes a person’s feeling.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat tungah lungkimlohna gen leh annoyed with/at someone zang in. Na khat hangin lungkimlohna gen leh annoyed about/by something zang in. Annoyed in mi lungsim omzia gen hi.

senses.definition_en: causing slight anger, impatience or discomfort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi lungkimlo, thuakzolo ahih kei leh nuamlo sak.

examples.english: The alarm makes an annoying sound.
examples.zomi: Alarm in awging buaihuai pia hi.

examples.english: It is annoying when the internet stops working.
examples.zomi: Internet sem nawnlo ciangin buaihuai hi.

senses.usage_en: Annoying describes the person, behavior or situation that causes the feeling. Annoyed describes the person who experiences it.
senses.usage_zomi: Annoying in lungkimlohna piangsak mi, gamtatna ahih kei leh dinmun gen hi. Annoyed in tua lungkimlohna a phut mi gen hi.

senses.definition_en: happening once every year or relating to a period of one year.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sim khatvei piang ahih kei leh kum khat sung tawh kisai.

examples.english: The organization will hold its annual meeting in June.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi in June kha in kum sim kikhopna nei ding hi.

examples.english: The report shows the company’s annual income.
examples.zomi: Report in company kum khat sung sumlut lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Annual means once each year. Biannual can mean twice a year, but because it may be confusing, twice a year is often clearer.
senses.usage_zomi: Annual cihpen kum sim khatvei cihna hi. Biannual in kum khat sung nihvei cihna nei napi, heltheih ahih manin twice a year cihdan kician zaw hi.

senses.heading: One more
senses.definition_en: one more person or thing of the same type.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibang nam mi ahih kei leh na khat behlap.

examples.english: Would you like another cup of coffee?
examples.zomi: Coffee hai khat dang na deih hiam?

examples.english: We need another week to finish the work.
examples.zomi: Nasep zoh nading nipi khat behlap ka kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Another is normally followed by a singular countable noun. With numbers and plural nouns, use another + number + plural noun: another three days.
senses.usage_zomi: Another nungah singular countable noun hong pai zel hi. Nambat leh plural noun tawh another + number + plural noun cihdan zang in: another three days.

senses.heading: A different one
senses.definition_en: a different person or thing from the one already mentioned.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen khin mi ahih kei leh na hilo, a dang khat.

examples.english: This key does not work; try another one.
examples.zomi: Hih tawhtang semlo hi; a dang khat hanciam in.

examples.english: We must find another way to solve the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaina veng nading sepdingdan dang khat i zong kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Another combines the meanings of an and other. It is written as one word.
senses.usage_zomi: Another in an leh other khiatna gawmkhawm hi. Kammal khat in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: A reply to a question
senses.definition_en: something said, written or done in response to a question or request.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dotna ahih kei leh ngenna khat dawnna dingin a kigen, kigelh ahih kei leh kihih na.

examples.english: She knew the correct answer to the question.
examples.zomi: Dotna dawnna maan thei hi.

examples.english: I sent an email but have not received an answer.
examples.zomi: Email ka khak napi, dawnna ka ngah nailo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the answer to a question, not normally the answer of a question.
senses.usage_zomi: The answer to a question cihdan zang in. A ngeina in the answer of a question ci kei in.

senses.heading: A solution to a problem
senses.definition_en: a method or idea that solves a problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina khat veng ahih kei leh siansuah thei sepdingdan/ngaihsutna.

examples.english: There is no easy answer to this problem.
examples.zomi: Hih buaina adingin dawnna baih omlo hi.

examples.english: Education may be part of the answer.
examples.zomi: Pilna pen buaina vengna khen khat hi thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, answer means a solution, not merely a spoken reply.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah answer in kam tawh dawnna bek hilo in, buaina vengna cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: Worried or nervous
senses.definition_en: worried or nervous about something that may happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hong piang thei thu khat hangin lungkham ahih kei leh lungmuanglo.

examples.english: She felt anxious before the examination.
examples.zomi: Sittelna ma-in lungkham hi.

examples.english: Many families are anxious about rising costs.
examples.zomi: Innkuan tampi sumzat hong khantohna thu lungkham uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use anxious about something and anxious for someone whose safety or welfare concerns you.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu khat hangin lungkhamna gen leh anxious about zang in. Mi khat bitna ahih kei leh hoihna ngaihsutna hangin lungkham leh anxious for zang in.

senses.heading: Eager for something to happen
senses.definition_en: strongly wanting to do something or wanting something to happen soon.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hih nuam mahmah ahih kei leh hong piang pah ding deih mahmah.

examples.english: The students were anxious to see their results.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte amau gah muh nuam mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: He is anxious to begin his new job.
examples.zomi: A nasepna thak kipan nuam mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Anxious to can mean eager, but because anxious often suggests worry, eager to may be clearer when no worry is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Anxious to in hih nuam mahmah cihna nei thei hi. Ahih hangin anxious in lungkhamna cihna nei tam ahih manin, lungkhamna omlo leh eager to cihdan kician zaw hi.

senses.heading: Some, used mainly in questions and negatives
senses.definition_en: one or more of a number or amount, used especially in questions and negative statements.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zah kician gen loin khatpeuh ahih kei leh tawm khat; dotna leh nialna sentence ah kizang tam.

examples.english: Do you have any questions?
examples.zomi: Dotna khatpeuh na nei hiam?

examples.english: We do not have any milk.
examples.zomi: Milk bangmah ka nei kei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Any is common in questions and negative statements. In ordinary affirmative statements, some is often used instead.
senses.usage_zomi: Any pen dotna leh nialna sentence ah kizang tam hi. Affirmative sentence ngeina ah some kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: It does not matter which
senses.definition_en: every person or thing of a particular type without restriction about which one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kuapen ahih kei leh bangpen cih deidan om loin, khatpeuh.

examples.english: You may choose any book on the shelf.
examples.zomi: Laibu koihna tunga laibu bangpeuh na teel thei hi.

examples.english: Any student can apply for the program.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang kuapeuh in program adingin application pia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In affirmative statements, any often means that there is no restriction on the choice.
senses.usage_zomi: Affirmative sentence ah any in teelna tungah ciangtan omlo a, khatpeuh teeltheih cihna nei zel hi.

senses.definition_en: any person; used when the person is not known, identified or limited.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi kuapeuh; kuamah kician takin genlo.

examples.english: Does anybody know the answer?
examples.zomi: Dawnna kuapeuh in a thei hiam?

examples.english: I did not see anybody in the office.
examples.zomi: Office ah kuamah ka mu lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Anybody is common in questions and negative statements. It has the same basic meaning as anyone, but anybody can sound slightly more conversational.
senses.usage_zomi: Anybody pen dotna leh nialna sentence ah kizang tam hi. Anyone tawh khiatna kibang a, anybody pen nisim kiholimna ah kizang tamzaw thei hi.

senses.definition_en: any person; used when no particular person is identified or limited.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi kuapeuh; mi khat kician takin genlo.

examples.english: Anyone can attend the public meeting.
examples.zomi: Mipi kikhopna ah kuapeuh pangthei hi.

examples.english: I do not know anyone in this town.
examples.zomi: Hih khuapi ah kuamah ka thei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Anyone and anybody usually have the same meaning. Anyone is often slightly more neutral in formal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Anyone leh anybody in khiatna kibang zel hi. Ngeina kizui laigelhna ah anyone in deidan nei hetlo kammal bangin kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Any object, event or matter
senses.definition_en: any object, event, idea or matter when no particular one is identified.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na, thu piang, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh thu kuapeuh; khat kician takin genlo.

examples.english: Do you need anything from the store?
examples.zomi: Dawk pan na khatpeuh na kisam hiam?

examples.english: I did not hear anything during the night.
examples.zomi: Zan sung bangmah ka za lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Anything is common in questions and negative statements. In affirmative statements, something is normally used unless the meaning is “no restriction.”
senses.usage_zomi: Anything pen dotna leh nialna sentence ah kizang tam hi. Affirmative sentence ah a ngeina in something kizang a, bangpeuh cih deidan omlo khiatna ahih leh anything kizang hi.

senses.heading: No matter what
senses.definition_en: any action or object without restriction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bangpen cih deidan leh ciangtan om loin, bangpeuh.

examples.english: You may ask me anything.
examples.zomi: Bangpeuh hong dong thei hi.

examples.english: She will do anything to protect her children.
examples.zomi: A tate kepbit nadingin bangpeuh hih ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In affirmative sentences, anything often emphasizes that there is no limit or restriction.
senses.usage_zomi: Affirmative sentence ah anything in ciangtan ahih kei leh deidan omlo cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Despite a difficulty or opposing fact
senses.definition_en: despite something already mentioned; in spite of that.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna ahih kei leh kilehbulhna om napi; tuabang napi.

examples.english: It was raining, but we went anyway.
examples.zomi: Guah zu napi, ka pai teitei uh hi.

examples.english: The work was difficult, but she finished it anyway.
examples.zomi: Nasep haksa napi, zo teitei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, anyway shows that an action happens despite a difficulty, objection or contrary fact.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah anyway in haksatna, nialna ahih kei leh thu kilehbulh om napi, nasep khat kihi cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: Returning to or changing the subject
senses.definition_en: used in conversation to return to an earlier subject, change the subject or conclude a discussion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kiholimna ah thu lui ah kik ding, thu dang ah kihei ding ahih kei leh thugen khup dingin kizang.

common_phrases.zomi: Bangbang hitaleh, ka gen zom leh...
Bangbang hitaleh, i zom dih uh.

examples.english: Anyway, let us return to the main question.
examples.zomi: Bangbang hitaleh, dotna bulpi ah i kik dih uh.

examples.english: I do not know why he left. Anyway, we must continue.
examples.zomi: Banghangin paikhia hiam ka thei lo hi. Bangbang hitaleh, i zom kul hi.

senses.usage_en: This conversational use of anyway helps organize speech. It is less common in very formal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih anyway zatdan in kiholimna thu kizom dan vaihawm hi. Ngeina kizui mahmah laigelhna ah kizang tamlo hi.

senses.heading: In or to any place
senses.definition_en: in, at or to any place when no particular place is identified or restricted.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun kuapeuh ah; mun khatpeuh ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun kuapeuh ah ahih kei leh mun kuapeuh lamah.

examples.english: You may sit anywhere in the room.
examples.zomi: Innkhaan sung mun khatpeuh ah na tu thei hi.

examples.english: This application lets you work from anywhere.
examples.zomi: Hih application in mun kuapeuh pan sem thei sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In affirmative statements, anywhere often means that there is no restriction on the place.
senses.usage_zomi: Affirmative sentence ah anywhere in mun teelna ciangtan omlo cihna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: In questions and negative statements
senses.definition_en: in or to some place, used especially when asking or saying that no place exists.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khatpeuh ah; dotna ahih kei leh mun omlo cih nialna sentence ah kizang.

common_phrases.zomi: Mun khatpeuh ah na pai hiam?

examples.english: Did you go anywhere during the weekend?
examples.zomi: Weekend sung mun khatpeuh ah na pai hiam?

examples.english: I cannot find my keys anywhere.
examples.zomi: Ka tawhtangte kuamah ka zong mu theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Anywhere is common in questions and negative statements. Somewhere is normally used in affirmative statements referring to an unspecified place.
senses.usage_zomi: Anywhere pen dotna leh nialna sentence ah kizang tam hi. Mun kicianlo khat affirmative sentence ah gen leh somewhere kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: now or in the future, used in negative statements to show that a previous situation has ended.
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa lai-a om ngeina ahih kei leh nasep khat tu in a om/hih nawnlohna.

common_phrases.english: do not use it any more

examples.english: She does not work here any more.
examples.zomi: Hih munah sem nawnlo hi.

examples.english: I cannot wait any more.
examples.zomi: Ka ngakzawh nawnlo hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, the adverb is usually written as one word: anymore. In British English, any more is normally written as two words. The two-word form also means an additional quantity: Do you need any more water?
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah adverb pen kammal khat anymore ci-in kigelh zel hi. British English ah kammal nih any more ci-in kigelh hi. Kammal nih gelhdan in a zah behlap cihna zong nei hi: Do you need any more water?

senses.heading: Separated by distance
senses.definition_en: with a distance or space between two or more people or things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na nih leh a tamzaw kikak ah gamlatna om in.

examples.english: The chairs were placed two meters apart.
examples.zomi: Tokhomte meter nih kigamla in kikoih hi.

examples.english: The two families live far apart.
examples.zomi: Innkuan nih kigamla takin teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Apart follows the measurement of distance: three feet apart. Do not use apart directly before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Apart pen gamlatna tehna nungah hong om hi: three feet apart. Noun ma-ah apart koih pah kei in.

senses.heading: Separated into pieces or no longer together
senses.definition_en: into separate pieces or in a state of no longer being together.
senses.explanation_zomi: A khen tuamtuam in kikhen ahih kei leh a beisa bangin kizomkhawm nawnlo.

examples.english: The old book began to fall apart.
examples.zomi: Laibu lui pen kitat kipan hi.

examples.english: The mechanic took the engine apart.
examples.zomi: Vanpuah siampa in engine pen a khen khat ciat in suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Apart occurs in several phrasal verbs, including fall apart, take apart and grow apart. Their meanings depend on the complete expression.
senses.usage_zomi: Apart pen fall apart, take apart leh grow apart bang phrasal verb-te ah kizang hi. A khiatna pen kammal kigawm bukim tungah kinga hi.

senses.definition_en: a set of rooms used as a home within a larger building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Innpi khat sungah mimal ahih kei leh innkuan khat teenna dingin a tuam in a kibawl innkhaan kigawm.

examples.english: She rents a small apartment near her office.
examples.zomi: A office nai ah innkhaan neu khat luah hi.

examples.english: The apartment has two bedrooms and a kitchen.
examples.zomi: Apartment ah ihna innkhaan nih leh anhuan om hi.

senses.usage_en: Apartment is standard in American English. British English commonly uses flat.
senses.usage_zomi: Apartment pen American English ah kizang standard hi. British English ah flat kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: to tell someone that you are sorry for something wrong or hurtful that you did.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khialhna ahih kei leh mi na nasakna hangin dahna lak a, ngaihdam ngen.

examples.english: He apologized for arriving late.
examples.zomi: A hong tun nung manin ngaihdam ngen hi.

examples.english: You should apologize to her for what you said.
examples.zomi: Na thugen hangin ama tungah ngaihdam na ngen ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Use apologize to someone for something/doing something. American English uses apologize; British English also uses the spelling apologise.
senses.usage_zomi: Apologize to someone for something/doing something cihdan zang in. American English ah apologize kigelh a, British English ah apologise zong kigelh hi.

senses.definition_en: a computer program designed to perform a particular task, especially on a phone, tablet or computer.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phone, tablet ahih kei leh computer tungah nasep tuam khat hih dingin a kibawl computer program.

examples.english: I use an app to learn English vocabulary.
examples.zomi: English kammal sin nadingin app khat ka zang hi.

examples.english: Download the app from the official website.
examples.zomi: Ngeina kizui website pan app download in.

senses.usage_en: App is the shortened form of application. It most commonly refers to software for phones and tablets, but it can also describe computer or web applications.
senses.usage_zomi: App pen application a tomlakna ahi hi. Phone leh tablet software gen nadingin kizang tam pen a, computer ahih kei leh web application zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Easy to notice or understand
senses.definition_en: clear or easy to recognize from what can be seen or known.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muhna ahih kei leh thutheihna pan kician takin theih theih.

examples.english: The difference between the two plans was immediately apparent.
examples.zomi: Geelna nih kilamdanna pahpah in kician hi.

examples.english: It soon became apparent that we needed more help.
examples.zomi: Huhna tampi ka kisap uh cih sawtlo in kician hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, apparent describes something that can be clearly seen or understood.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah apparent in muh ahih kei leh telcian baih thu khat gen hi.

senses.heading: Seeming to be true
senses.definition_en: seeming to be true or real, although it may not actually be so.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a bangin kilang; a kizatdan bang
senses.explanation_zomi: A taktak hilo thei napi, a man ahih kei leh a taktak bangin kilang.

examples.english: His apparent confidence hid his nervousness.
examples.zomi: A lungmuanna bangin kilang pen a lungkhamna seel hi.

examples.english: The machine stopped for no apparent reason.
examples.zomi: Van pen hang kician omlo in khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Apparent may indicate uncertainty. Something that is apparently true may later prove to be false.
senses.usage_zomi: Apparent in kician nailohna lak thei hi. A man bangin kilang thu khat a nung ciangin a manlo kisuak thei hi.

senses.definition_en: according to what is known, seen or reported, although complete certainty is not available.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kilatdan in; kigen bangin; a bangin
senses.explanation_zomi: A kimuh, kitheih ahih kei leh kigen dungzui in a man bang hi napi, kician takin theih nailo.

examples.english: Apparently, the meeting has been canceled.
examples.zomi: Kigen bangin, kikhopna phiat khin hi.

examples.english: The fire was apparently caused by an electrical problem.
examples.zomi: Mei kangna pen electric buaina hangin piang bangin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Apparently shows that a statement is based on available evidence or reports, not complete personal certainty.
senses.usage_zomi: Apparently in thugen pen a omlai teci ahih kei leh mite thugen tungah kinga a, a gente’n kician takin a theihlohna lak hi.

senses.heading: A serious request
senses.definition_en: a serious or urgent request for help, money, information or support.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huhna, sum, thutheihna ahih kei leh panpihna thupi leh manlang takin ngetna.

examples.english: The organization made an appeal for emergency donations.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi in lauhuai hun panpihna sum ngen hi.

examples.english: Police issued an appeal for information.
examples.zomi: Police-te in thutheihna pia dingin mipi tungah ngen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an appeal for the help or resource requested and an appeal to the person or group being asked.
senses.usage_zomi: Bang huhna ngen hiam cih gen leh an appeal for zang in. Ku tungah ngen hiam cih gen leh an appeal to zang in.

senses.heading: A request to change an official decision
senses.definition_en: a formal request for a court or authority to examine and change a decision.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thu khenkik ngetna; thu khensatna puah ngetna
senses.explanation_zomi: Court ahih kei leh ukzawhna sangzaw in thu khensatna khat en kik a, kheek ding ngeina kizui takin ngetna.

examples.english: His lawyer filed an appeal against the decision.
examples.zomi: A sihni in thu khensatna khenkik ngetna pia hi.

examples.english: The court rejected the appeal.
examples.zomi: Court in thu khenkik ngetna nial hi.

senses.usage_en: A legal appeal does not automatically cancel the original decision. A higher court or authority must review it.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukham tawh kisai appeal in thu khensatna masa phiat pahpah lo hi. Court ahih kei leh ukzawhna sangzaw in en kik kul hi.

senses.heading: An attractive quality
senses.definition_en: a quality that makes someone or something interesting or attractive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat lunglut huai ahih kei leh deihhuai sak hoihna.

examples.english: The program has strong appeal for young people.
examples.zomi: Program pen khangnote adingin lunglut huai mahmah hi.

examples.english: The town’s natural beauty is part of its appeal.
examples.zomi: Khuapi kimkot pianpih hoihna pen a lunglut huaina khen khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, appeal is the power to attract interest, liking or support.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah appeal in mi lunglutna, deihna ahih kei leh panpihna la theihna gen hi.

senses.heading: Become visible or present
senses.definition_en: to become visible, arrive or begin to exist.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muh theih in hong kilang, hong tung ahih kei leh om kipan.

examples.english: A rainbow appeared after the rain.
examples.zomi: Guah khit ciangin tuahkhak kilang hi.

examples.english: She will appear in court next Monday.
examples.zomi: Monday masa ciangin court ah pai ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Appear may describe becoming visible, attending an official place or performing before the public.
senses.usage_zomi: Appear in hong kilangna, ngeina kizui mun khat ah paina ahih kei leh mipi mai-a kilakna gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Seem to be
senses.definition_en: to seem to be true or to give a particular impression.
senses.explanation_zomi: A taktak kician nailo napi, tuabang hi dinga kilang.

examples.english: The problem appears to be more serious than we expected.
examples.zomi: Buaina pen ka lam-et uh sangin lipkhaphuai zaw bangin kilang hi.

examples.english: She appeared calm during the interview.
examples.zomi: Interview laitak lungnop bangin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use appear to + verb or appear + adjective. In this sense, appear does not guarantee that the impression is true.
senses.usage_zomi: Appear to + verb ahih kei leh appear + adjective cihdan zang in. Hih khiatna ah a kilatdan pen a taktak hi cih kipsaklo hi.

senses.heading: The way someone or something looks
senses.definition_en: the way a person or thing looks from the outside.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat pualam pan a mel leh a muhtheih omzia.

examples.english: The building’s appearance changed after the repairs.
examples.zomi: Innpi puah khit ciangin a pualam mel kikhel hi.

examples.english: You should not judge people only by their appearance.
examples.zomi: Mite amau pualam mel bek tawh na khen loh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Appearance describes how someone or something looks, not necessarily what that person or thing is actually like.
senses.usage_zomi: Appearance in pualam pan a kilatdan gen a, a sunglam omzia taktak tawh kibang pahpah lo thei hi.

senses.heading: An occasion when someone appears publicly
senses.definition_en: an occasion when someone is present, performs or is seen in public.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat mipi mai-ah a hong kilak, a gamtat ahih kei leh a hong paina khatvei.

examples.english: The singer made her first public appearance after the illness.
examples.zomi: A nat khit mipi mai-ah kilakna masapen nei hi.

examples.english: He missed his scheduled court appearance.
examples.zomi: Court ah pai ding hun sehpiasa mangngilh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, make an appearance means attending or being seen at an event, sometimes only briefly.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah make an appearance in pawlkhop khat ah pai ahih kei leh kilang cihna hi; tawmvei sungbek zong hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: a round fruit with firm flesh and usually red, green or yellow skin.
senses.explanation_zomi: A pum a tamzaw in a beem, a sung a khauh deuh a, a vun san, hing ahih kei leh eng hi thei singgah khat.

examples.english: She ate an apple with her lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun-an tawh apple khat ne hi.

examples.english: The children picked apples from the tree.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in singkung pan apple gah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Apple is countable when referring to individual fruit. Products made from apples are often used before another noun: apple juice, apple pie.
senses.usage_zomi: Singgah khat ciat gen ciangin apple pen countable noun hi. Apple tawh kibawl na gen ciangin noun dang ma-ah kizang tam hi: apple juice, apple pie.

senses.heading: A formal request
senses.definition_en: a formal request for a job, place, benefit, permission or service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna, sang lutna, panpihna, thu phalna ahih kei leh nasepna tuam khat ngah ding ngeina kizui takin ngetna.

examples.english: She submitted an application for the position.
examples.zomi: Tua dinmun adingin application pia hi.

examples.english: The application deadline is April 30.
examples.zomi: Application piak hun tawp pen April 30 ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an application for a job, benefit or service and an application to a school, organization or authority.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasepna, panpihna ahih kei leh nasepna tuam khat nget leh an application for zang in. Sang, pawl ahih kei leh ukzawhna khat tungah pia leh an application to zang in.

senses.heading: A form used to make a request
senses.definition_en: a paper or electronic form used to provide information when making a formal request.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina kizui ngetna pia cianga mimal thutheihna leh a kisam thute gelhna lai ahih kei leh electronic form.

examples.english: Complete every section of the application.
examples.zomi: Application khen khempeuh zo in.

examples.english: You can fill out the application online.
examples.zomi: Internet tungah application na zo thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday speech, application can mean either the request itself or the form used to submit it.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim kiholimna ah application in ngetna amah ahih kei leh tua ngetna piakna form gen thei hi.

senses.heading: The practical use of something
senses.definition_en: the act or method of using knowledge, a rule or a technique for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna, thukhun ahih kei leh sepdingdan khat ngiimna tuam khat adingin a takin zatna.

examples.english: The course emphasizes the practical application of knowledge.
examples.zomi: Course in pilna a takin zatkhiatna thupisak hi.

examples.english: This technology has many medical applications.
examples.zomi: Hih technology si lamah zatna tampi nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A software application is commonly shortened to app.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer software application pen a tamzaw in app ci-in tomlak hi.

senses.heading: Make a formal request
senses.definition_en: to make a formal request for a job, place, benefit, permission or service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna, sang lutna, panpihna, thu phalna ahih kei leh nasepna tuam khat ngah dingin ngeina kizui ngetna pia.

examples.english: She applied for a teaching position.
examples.zomi: Sia nasepna dinmun adingin application pia hi.

examples.english: You can apply online before Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ma-in internet tungah application na pia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use apply for the job, benefit or item requested. Use apply to the organization, school or person receiving the request.
senses.usage_zomi: Bang na ngen hiam cih gen leh apply for zang in. Ku ahih kei leh bang pawl tungah application pia hiam cih gen leh apply to zang in.

senses.heading: Put or spread something on a surface
senses.definition_en: to put or spread a substance onto a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui, zatui, cream ahih kei leh na khat maitang khat tungah koih/nawt.

examples.english: Apply the medicine to the affected area twice a day.
examples.zomi: Ni khat nihvei a natna munah zatui nawt in.

examples.english: The worker applied paint to the wall.
examples.zomi: Nasem in bang tungah paint zut hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, use apply something to a surface or area.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah apply something to a surface or area cihdan zang in.

senses.heading: Be relevant or put into use
senses.definition_en: to be relevant to a person or situation, or to put a rule, idea or method into use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh dinmun khat tawh kisai ahih kei leh thukhun, ngaihsutna leh sepdingdan a takin zang.

examples.english: The same rules apply to everyone.
examples.zomi: Thukhun kibang mi khempeuh kha hi.

examples.english: Students must apply what they have learned.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in a sin khin uh pilna zang kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When apply means “be relevant,” the thing affected commonly follows to: The rule applies to all employees.
senses.usage_zomi: Apply in “kha/kisai” cihna nei ciangin, a khak mi ahih kei leh na pen to nungah hong om hi: The rule applies to all employees.

senses.heading: An arranged meeting
senses.definition_en: an arranged time to meet someone, especially a doctor or professional.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, a diak in siavuan ahih kei leh siamna nei mi tawh kimu ding hun sehsa.

examples.english: I have a doctor’s appointment tomorrow morning.
examples.zomi: Zing zingsang siavuan tawh kimu hun ka nei hi.

examples.english: Please call to make an appointment.
examples.zomi: Kimu hun seh dingin phone in.

senses.usage_en: Use have an appointment with someone and an appointment for a particular time.
senses.usage_zomi: Ku tawh kimu ding hiam cih gen leh have an appointment with someone zang in. Bang hunah hiam cih gen leh an appointment for a particular time zang in.

senses.heading: Selection for an official position
senses.definition_en: the act of choosing someone for an official job or position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ngeina kizui nasepna ahih kei leh dinmun khat ah sep dingin teel/seh na.
