examples.english: The board approved her appointment as director.
examples.zomi: Board in director ding a sehkhiatna thukim hi.

examples.english: His appointment was announced on Monday.
examples.zomi: Monday ni in a sehkhiatna kipuang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, appointment refers to being officially selected, not to a scheduled meeting.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah appointment in kimu hun sehna hilo in, dinmun khat ading ngeina kizui sehkhiatna gen hi.

senses.heading: Be grateful for something
senses.definition_en: to feel thankful for something that someone has done or given.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nasep ahih kei leh hong piak na hangin kipah a, phat.

examples.english: I appreciate your help with this project.
examples.zomi: Hih project ah nong huhna ka kipahpih hi.

examples.english: We greatly appreciate your support.
examples.zomi: Na panpihna ka kipahpih mahmah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: I appreciate... is followed by a noun or -ing form: I appreciate your help; I appreciate you coming. Do not normally say I appreciate to....
senses.usage_zomi: I appreciate... nungah noun ahih kei leh -ing form hong pai hi: I appreciate your help; I appreciate you coming. A ngeina in I appreciate to... ci kei in.

senses.heading: Recognize value or quality
senses.definition_en: to understand and recognize the value, importance or good quality of someone or something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: manphatna thei; hoihna phat; thupina thei
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a manphatna, thupina ahih kei leh hoihna thei a, phat.

examples.english: She appreciates traditional Zomi music.
examples.zomi: Zomi ngeina laa a manphatna thei hi.

examples.english: Young people may not fully appreciate the sacrifices of earlier generations.
examples.zomi: Khangnote in khang masa mite’ kipiakkhiatna a manphatna telcian takin theilo thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, appreciate means understanding value, not merely liking something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah appreciate in na khat deih bek cihna hilo in, a manphatna telcian cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: Understand a situation
senses.definition_en: to understand the full meaning, difficulty or importance of a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat a khiatna, a haksatna ahih kei leh a thupina telcian.

examples.english: I appreciate how difficult this decision is for you.
examples.zomi: Hih thu khensatna nang adingin a haksatna ka telcian hi.

examples.english: We must appreciate the seriousness of the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaina a lipkhaphuaina i telcian kul hi.

senses.usage_en: This use of appreciate is slightly formal and means fully understanding a fact or situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih appreciate zatdan pen ngeina kizui deuh a, thu ahih kei leh dinmun khat telcian takin thei cihna hi.

senses.heading: A method of dealing with something
senses.definition_en: a way of thinking about or dealing with a problem, task or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina, nasep ahih kei leh dinmun khat a ngaihsut leh a sepdingdan.

examples.english: We need a different approach to this problem.
examples.zomi: Hih buaina adingin sepdingdan tuam khat i kisam hi.

examples.english: The teacher uses a practical approach to language learning.
examples.zomi: Sia in pau sinna ah a takin zat theih sepdingdan zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an approach to something, not normally an approach of something.
senses.usage_zomi: An approach to something cihdan zang in. A ngeina in an approach of something ci kei in.

senses.heading: Movement toward something
senses.definition_en: movement toward a person, place or object, or the act of coming nearer.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun ahih kei leh na khat lamah hong pai a, hong naihna.

common_phrases.english: on the approach to the airport

common_phrases.zomi: vanleng tu kuan a tawpna naihna

examples.english: The road becomes narrow on the approach to the village.
examples.zomi: Khua tun kuan lampi neu hong suak hi.

examples.english: Farmers prepared for the approach of winter.
examples.zomi: Phalbi hong naih nading lokho mite kiging uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, approach can refer to physical movement or to a time or event drawing nearer.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah approach in mun khat lamah hong naihna ahih kei leh hun/thu piang khat hong tun kuanna gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: suitable or correct for a particular person, purpose, situation or occasion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ngiimna, dinmun ahih kei leh hun tuam khat tawh kituak leh kilawm.

examples.english: Wear appropriate clothing for the weather.
examples.zomi: Khuahun tawh kituak puan silh in.

examples.english: His comment was not appropriate for the meeting.
examples.zomi: A thugen pen kikhopna tawh kituaklo hi.

senses.usage_en: Appropriate is followed by for when identifying the person, purpose or situation: appropriate for children.
senses.usage_zomi: Ku ading ahih kei leh bang dinmun tawh kituak hiam cih gen leh appropriate for zang in: appropriate for children.

senses.heading: Official permission
senses.definition_en: official permission for something to happen or be done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat piang ahih kei leh kihih theih nading ngeina kizui thu phalna.

examples.english: The project cannot begin without government approval.
examples.zomi: Kumpi thu phalna omlo in project kipan theilo hi.

examples.english: The board gave its approval to the plan.
examples.zomi: Board in geelna thukim a, thu phal hi.

senses.usage_en: Use approval for/of a plan and approval from a person or authority.
senses.usage_zomi: Geelna khat thukimna gen leh approval for/of a plan zang in. Ku pan thu phalna ngah hiam cih gen leh approval from zang in.

senses.heading: A favorable opinion
senses.definition_en: the belief that someone or something is good, acceptable or deserving support.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat hoih, saangtheih ahih kei leh panpih taak hi cih ngaihsutna.

examples.english: She nodded her head in approval.
examples.zomi: A thukimna lak dingin a lutang liingsak hi.

examples.english: The policy has gained public approval.
examples.zomi: Thukhun in mipi deihpihna ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, approval concerns a positive judgment rather than legal permission.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah approval in thukham thu phalna sangin, hoih leh saangtheih hi cih ngaihsutna gen hi.

senses.heading: Officially accept or permit
senses.definition_en: to officially accept a plan, request or action and give permission for it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna, ngetna ahih kei leh nasep khat ngeina kizui takin thukim a, thu phal.

examples.english: The council approved the new housing plan.
examples.zomi: Council in inn lamna geelna thak thukim hi.

examples.english: Your application has been approved.
examples.zomi: Na application kithukim khin hi.

senses.usage_en: Use approve something when giving official permission. Do not use approve of for this meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina kizui thu phalna gen leh approve something cihdan zang in. Hih khiatna adingin approve of zang kei in.

senses.heading: Have a favorable opinion
senses.definition_en: to think that someone or something is good, right or acceptable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat hoih, maan ahih kei leh saangtheih hi ci-in ngaihsun.

examples.english: Her parents do not approve of her decision.
examples.zomi: A nulehpa in a thu khensatna deihpih lo uh hi.

examples.english: I approve of the way the problem was handled.
examples.zomi: Buaina a kivaipua dan ka thukimpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use approve of someone/something when expressing a favorable opinion.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat hoih ci-in deihpihna gen leh approve of someone/something zang in.

senses.definition_en: close to a particular number, amount or time, but not exact.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat, a zah ahih kei leh hun kician khat nai napi, a maan taktak hilo.

examples.english: The journey takes approximately two hours.
examples.zomi: Khualzin pen nai nih kimkot sawt hi.

examples.english: Approximately one hundred people attended the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ah mi zakhat kimkot pang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Approximately is more formal than about or around. It is common with numbers, measurements and times.
senses.usage_zomi: Approximately pen about ahih kei leh around sangin ngeina kizui zaw hi. Nambat, tehna leh hun tawh kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: the fourth month of the year, following March and preceding May.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sunga kha lina; March khit leh May ma-a kha.

examples.english: The course begins in April.
examples.zomi: Course pen April kha in kipan hi.

examples.english: Her birthday is on April 12.
examples.zomi: A suah ni pen April 12 ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Months begin with capital letters in English. Use in April for the month and on April 12 for a particular date.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah kha minte capital letter tawh kipan hi. Kha gen leh in April zang inla, ni kician gen leh on April 12 zang in.

senses.definition_en: a person trained to design buildings and often supervise their construction.
senses.zomi_equivalents: inn limpuak siampa; inn lamna lim bawlmi
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn leh innpi a lim bawl dingin a kisin a, a lamna zong enkai thei siampa.

examples.english: The architect designed the new library.
examples.zomi: Architect in laibuk thak limpuak bawl hi.

examples.english: They hired an architect to plan their house.
examples.zomi: Amau inn geel dingin architect khat goih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An architect designs buildings. An engineer usually focuses more on technical systems, structure and construction safety.
senses.usage_zomi: Architect in inn leh innpi limpuak bawl hi. Engineer in a tamzaw in technical system, inn a kiphuhna leh lamna bitna ngaihsak hi.

senses.heading: The design of buildings
senses.definition_en: the art, study and practice of designing buildings.
senses.zomi_equivalents: inn limpuak pilna; inn bawlna sepdingdan
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn leh innpi limpuak bawlna pilna, sinna leh nasepna.

examples.english: She is studying architecture at university.
examples.zomi: University ah inn limpuak pilna sin hi.

examples.english: Modern architecture often uses glass and steel.
examples.zomi: Tuhun inn limpuakna ah liimlang leh sik kizang tam hi.

senses.usage_en: Architecture is uncountable when referring to the field of study or profession.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna khen ahih kei leh nasepna tuam khat gen ciangin architecture pen uncountable noun hi.

senses.heading: The design style or structure of something
senses.definition_en: the characteristic design of a building or the organized structure of a complex system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn khat limpuak kibawldan ahih kei leh system kigawm khat a khen khat ciat a kizop dan.

examples.english: The town is known for its traditional architecture.
examples.zomi: Khuapi pen a ngeina inn limpuak hangin minthang hi.

examples.english: The software uses a simple system architecture.
examples.zomi: Software in system kizopdan baih khat zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Architecture can describe buildings and also the structure of computers, software and other complex systems.
senses.usage_zomi: Architecture in inn leh innpi limpuak bek hilo in, computer, software leh system kigawmte kizopdan zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A particular part of a place
senses.definition_en: a particular part of a town, country, building or other place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuapi, gam, innpi ahih kei leh mun khat sunga khen tuam khat.

examples.english: This area has several good schools.
examples.zomi: Hih munah sang hoih pawlkhat om hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain caused flooding in low-lying areas.
examples.zomi: Guahpi in mun niamte tuikhang sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Area can refer to a place of any size, from part of a room to a large region.
senses.usage_zomi: Area in innkhaan khen neu khat pan gam khen lian dong mun a zah tuamtuam gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A subject or field of activity
senses.definition_en: a particular subject, type of work or field of knowledge.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pilna khen; nasepna khen; thu khen
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna, nasepna ahih kei leh zongkhiatna khen tuam khat.

examples.english: Public health is her main area of research.
examples.zomi: Mipi cidamna pen a zongkhiatna khen lianpen ahi hi.

examples.english: The report identifies three areas for improvement.
examples.zomi: Report in hoihsak ding khen thum kawk hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, area groups related knowledge, responsibilities or activities.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah area in pilna, mawhpuakna ahih kei leh nasepna kizomte khen khat in gawm hi.

senses.heading: The measurement of a surface
senses.definition_en: the amount of flat space inside the boundary of a shape or surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim ahih kei leh maitang khat a gamgi sung mun zauna tehna.

examples.english: Calculate the area of the room.
examples.zomi: Innkhaan a zauna simkhia in.

examples.english: The garden covers an area of fifty square meters.
examples.zomi: Huan zauna pen square meter sawmnga ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In mathematics, area is measured in square units, such as square meters or square feet.
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics ah area pen square meter ahih kei leh square feet bang square unit tawh kiteh hi.

senses.heading: Speak angrily because of disagreement
senses.definition_en: to speak with someone in an angry or forceful way because you disagree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat tungah thukimlo a, hehna ahih kei leh aw thahat tawh kinial.

examples.english: The two brothers argued about money.
examples.zomi: Unau pasal nih sum thu kinial uh hi.

examples.english: We should discuss the problem calmly instead of arguing.
examples.zomi: Kinial sangin buaina lungnop takin i kikum ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Use argue with someone about/over something. In this sense, argue suggests disagreement and may include anger.
senses.usage_zomi: Argue with someone about/over something cihdan zang in. Hih khiatna ah argue in thukimlohna leh hehna om theihna lak hi.

senses.heading: Give reasons supporting an opinion
senses.definition_en: to give reasons or evidence to support an opinion or position.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a hang gen; thu kipsak; teci tawh gen
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna ahih kei leh dinmun khat kipsak nadingin a hang leh teci-te gen.

examples.english: The author argues that education should be available to everyone.
examples.zomi: Laigelhpa in pilna mi khempeuh ngah theih ding hi ci-in a hangte gen hi.

examples.english: She argued in favor of changing the policy.
examples.zomi: Thukhun kheek ding deihpihna lamah a hangte gen hi.

senses.usage_en: In academic or formal English, argue often means presenting reasons, not having an angry disagreement.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna leh ngeina kizui English ah argue in hehna tawh kinialna sangin, ngaihsutna kipsak nading a hangte gen cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: An angry disagreement
senses.definition_en: a disagreement in which people speak angrily or forcefully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite thu khat tungah thukimlo a, hehna ahih kei leh aw thahat tawh a kinialna uh.

examples.english: They had an argument about household expenses.
examples.zomi: Innkuan sumzat thu kinialna nei uh hi.

examples.english: The argument ended when both sides became calm.
examples.zomi: Langnih lung a nop ciangin kinialna tawp hi.

senses.usage_en: Have an argument means disagreeing angrily. It does not necessarily involve physical fighting.
senses.usage_zomi: Have an argument cihpen hehna tawh kinial cihna hi. Pumpi tawh kidona a huam pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: A reason or set of reasons
senses.definition_en: a reason or group of reasons used to support or oppose an idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna khat deihpih ahih kei leh langpang nadingin a kipiak a hang leh teci-te.

examples.english: The report presents a strong argument for reform.
examples.zomi: Report in puahphatna deihpih nading thu kipsakna thahat pia hi.

examples.english: His argument was supported by clear evidence.
examples.zomi: A thu kipsakna pen teci kician in panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: In formal discussion, an argument is a reasoned position. It does not necessarily mean a quarrel.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina kizui kiholimna ah argument pen a hang leh teci tawh a kipsak ngaihsutna ahi hi. Kinialna cihna nei ngiatlo hi.

senses.heading: Begin to exist or happen
senses.definition_en: to begin to exist, happen or become noticeable.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hong piang; hong om; hong kilang
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina, kisapna ahih kei leh dinmun khat hong piang ahih kei leh hong kilang.

examples.english: A problem arose during the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhop laitak buaina khat hong piang hi.

examples.english: Call me if the need arises.
examples.zomi: Kisapna hong om leh hong phone in.

senses.usage_en: The past tense of arise is arose, and the past participle is arisen. Do not confuse it with raise, which normally takes an object.
senses.usage_zomi: Arise past tense pen arose hi a, past participle pen arisen ahi hi. Object nei zel raise tawh helkhawm kei in.

senses.heading: Get up from sitting or lying
senses.definition_en: to get up from a sitting, kneeling or lying position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tutna, khukdin ahih kei leh lupna pan hong ding.

examples.english: He arose from his chair to welcome the guest.
examples.zomi: Zinmi na pak dingin tokhom pan hong ding hi.

examples.english: She arose early and prepared breakfast.
examples.zomi: Zingsangin tho a, zing-an bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning of arise is formal or literary. In everyday English, get up or stand up is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih arise zatdan pen ngeina kizui ahih kei leh laibu pau ahi hi. Nisim English ah get up ahih kei leh stand up kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: either of the two upper limbs of the human body, extending from the shoulder to the hand.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing pumpi langnih ah om, liang pan khut dong a kizom pumpi khen.

examples.english: She carried the child in her arms.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen a ban tawh pua hi.

examples.english: He injured his right arm while playing basketball.
examples.zomi: Basketball kimawl laitak a taklam ban liam hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday English, arm extends from the shoulder to the hand. The part between the elbow and wrist is specifically the forearm.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim English ah arm pen liang pan khut dong huam hi. Khutkuak leh khut kizopna kikaal pen forearm kici hi.

senses.definition_en: carrying or equipped with a weapon or weapons.
senses.explanation_zomi: Galvan khat ahih kei leh galvan tampi tawi/nei.

examples.english: Armed police guarded the building.
examples.zomi: Galvan nei police-te in innpi veng uh hi.

examples.english: The officers believed that the suspect was armed.
examples.zomi: Officers-te in mawhna a kingaih mi pen galvan nei hi ci-in um uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Armed with can also be used figuratively: armed with knowledge means prepared with useful knowledge.
senses.usage_zomi: Armed with pen lim tawh zong kizang thei hi. Armed with knowledge cihpen pilna tawh kiging khin cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: weapons, especially those used by military forces.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in galkap in a zat uh thau, bomb leh kidona galvan dangte.

common_phrases.zomi: galvan tawi a, kidona ah pang

examples.english: The government introduced controls on the arms trade.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in galvan sumleina ukna thukhun bawl hi.

examples.english: The agreement called on both sides to lay down their arms.
examples.zomi: Thukimna in langnih galvan koihkhia dingin ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: In this meaning, arms is a plural noun referring to weapons. It is different from the plural of the body part arm, although the spelling is the same.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah arms pen galvan cihna nei plural noun ahi hi. Gelhdan kibang napi, pumpi khen arm plural tawh khiatna kibanglo hi.

senses.definition_en: the part of a country’s military forces trained mainly to fight on land.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam khat galkap pawl sunga, a diak in leitung tungah galdo dingin a kisin galkapte.

examples.english: He joined the army when he was twenty years old.
examples.zomi: Kum sawmnih a cih in leigalkap sungah pang hi.

examples.english: The army helped people after the flood.
examples.zomi: Tuikhang khit ciangin leigalkap in mite huh hi.

senses.usage_en: The army normally fights on land. The navy operates mainly at sea, and the air force operates in the air.
senses.usage_zomi: Army pen a diak in leitung tungah sem hi. Navy pen tuipi tungah sem a, air force pen vanah sem hi.

senses.heading: Surrounding or on every side
senses.definition_en: on all sides of or surrounding someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat kimkot leh a lang khempeuh ah.

examples.english: The family sat around the table.
examples.zomi: Innkuan pen sabuai kimah tu uh hi.

examples.english: They built a fence around the garden.
examples.zomi: Huan kimkot ah kulh bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, around means surrounding something or being positioned on several sides.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah around in na khat kimkot huam ahih kei leh a lang tuamtuam ah om cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: In different parts of a place
senses.definition_en: in, to or through different parts of a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat sunga mun tuamtuam ah ahih kei leh mun tuamtuam kantanin.

common_phrases.zomi: gam sung mun tuamtuam ah khualzin
khuapi sung mun tuamtuam ah lampai

examples.english: We traveled around the country for two weeks.
examples.zomi: Nipi nih sung gam sung mun tuamtuam ah ka khualzin uh hi.

examples.english: She looked around the office for her keys.
examples.zomi: A tawhtang zongin office sung kiimvel en hi.

senses.usage_en: Around is common in American English. British English also frequently uses round with similar meanings.
senses.usage_zomi: Around pen American English ah kizang tam hi. British English ah khiatna kibang round zong kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Organize or put in order
senses.definition_en: to organize or place people or things in a particular order or position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na-te a kizom dan ahih kei leh omna kician khat tawh kituaksak/vaihawm.

examples.english: Please arrange the chairs in a circle.
examples.zomi: Tokhomte a beemin hong koih kituak in.

examples.english: She arranged the documents by date.
examples.zomi: Laite ni dungzui in kizomsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Arrange something can mean putting objects in order or organizing information systematically.
senses.usage_zomi: Arrange something in vante a kizom danin koih ahih kei leh thutheihnate a ngeina tawh vaihawm cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Plan or make preparations
senses.definition_en: to plan and prepare for an event, meeting or service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawlkhop, kimu hun ahih kei leh nasepna khat omthei dingin geel leh kiging.

examples.english: We arranged a meeting for Friday morning.
examples.zomi: Friday zingsang kikhopna khat ka vaihawm uh hi.

examples.english: The hotel arranged transportation to the airport.
examples.zomi: Hotel in airport dong pua ding vaihawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Use arrange something, arrange for someone to do something or arrange to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Arrange something, arrange for someone to do something ahih kei leh arrange to do something cihdan zang in.

senses.heading: A plan or preparation
senses.definition_en: a plan or preparation made so that something can happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat piangthei ahih kei leh kihih theih nading a kibawl geelna leh kigingna.

examples.english: We have made arrangements for your transportation.
examples.zomi: Nang hong pua ding vaihawmna ka bawl khin uh hi.

examples.english: Please confirm the meeting arrangements.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna vaihawmna hong kipsak in.

senses.usage_en: Arrangements in the plural often refers to several practical preparations for an event or journey.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural arrangements in pawlkhop ahih kei leh khualzin khat ading kigingna leh vaihawmna pawlkhat gen zel hi.

senses.heading: The way things are organized or positioned
senses.definition_en: the way in which people or things are organized, grouped or placed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na-te a kigawm, a kikhen ahih kei leh a kikoih dan.

examples.english: The seating arrangement allowed everyone to see the speaker.
examples.zomi: Tutna kikoihdan in mi khempeuh thugenpa mu thei sak hi.

examples.english: She created a beautiful flower arrangement.
examples.zomi: Pakte hoih takin koih kituak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, arrangement refers to the order, pattern or position of people or objects.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah arrangement in mi ahih kei leh vante a kizom dan, limpuak ahih kei leh omna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: to take someone into police custody because that person is suspected of committing a crime.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat mawhna bawl hi ci-in kingaih manin police in man a, thukham nuai-ah kem.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat kiman hi ci-in theihsak

examples.english: Police arrested the suspect near the station.
examples.zomi: Police in mawhna a kingaih mi station nai ah man hi.

examples.english: He was arrested for driving while drunk.
examples.zomi: Zu kham kawm mawtaw a hawl manin kiman hi.

senses.usage_en: Use arrest someone for a crime and be arrested on suspicion of a crime. An arrest does not prove that the person is guilty.
senses.usage_zomi: Mawhna hangin mi khat kiman leh arrest someone for a crime zang in. Mawhna bawl hi ci-in kingaih manin kiman leh be arrested on suspicion of a crime zang in. Kiman bek tawh mawhnei cih kipsak nailo hi.

senses.definition_en: the act or time of reaching a place after traveling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzin khit mun khat tungna ahih kei leh a tun hun.

examples.english: Please call me upon your arrival at the airport.
examples.zomi: Airport na tun phetin hong phone in.

examples.english: The flight’s expected arrival time is 8:30.
examples.zomi: Flight tun ding hun pen dak giat leh minute sawmthum ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use arrival at a building or specific place and arrival in a city or country.
senses.usage_zomi: Inn ahih kei leh mun kician khat tunna gen leh arrival at zang in. Khuapi ahih kei leh gam khat tunna gen leh arrival in zang in.

senses.definition_en: to reach a place at the end of a journey.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzin khit ciangin mun khat tung.

examples.english: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
examples.zomi: Airport ah nai nih masa in ka tung uh hi.

examples.english: She arrived in New York yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zani in New York khuapi tung hi.

senses.usage_en: Use arrive at a building or specific place, arrive in a city or country, and arrive home without a preposition.
senses.usage_zomi: Inn ahih kei leh mun kician khat tun leh arrive at zang in. Khuapi ahih kei leh gam tun leh arrive in zang in. Inn tunna ah preposition koih loin arrive home ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Creative works
senses.definition_en: the creation or expression of ideas and feelings through painting, drawing, sculpture, music, drama or similar forms.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim suai, lim bawl, laa, zatpual leh a dangte tungtawnin ngaihsutna leh lungsim omzia piangsak/puangkhia siamthiamna.

examples.english: The museum displays traditional Zomi art.
examples.zomi: Museum in Zomi ngeina khuasakna vante lak hi.

examples.english: She studies art at college.
examples.zomi: College ah khuasakna pilna sin hi.

senses.usage_en: Art is usually uncountable when referring to creative activity generally. A particular creation is a work of art.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuasakna nasep a zaizaw in gen ciangin art pen uncountable noun hi. Khuasakna van khat bek pen a work of art kici hi.

senses.heading: A skill developed through practice
senses.definition_en: a skill or ability developed through knowledge, experience and practice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna, phutkhakna leh kisinna tungtawnin a khangto siamthiamna.

examples.english: Good communication is an art that requires practice.
examples.zomi: Kihopih hoih pen kisinna kisam siamthiamna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She has mastered the art of public speaking.
examples.zomi: Mipi mai-a thugen siamthiamna neizo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, art refers to a refined practical skill, not necessarily painting or sculpture.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah art in lim suai ahih kei leh lim bawlna bek hilo in, a kisinsa sepkhiat siamthiamna gen hi.

senses.heading: A piece of writing
senses.definition_en: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine or website.
senses.explanation_zomi: Newspaper, magazine ahih kei leh website ah thu kician khat tawh kisai laigelhna.

examples.english: She wrote an article about Zomi history.
examples.zomi: Zomi tangthu tawh kisai article khat gelh hi.

examples.english: I read the article on the newspaper’s website.
examples.zomi: Newspaper website ah article ka sim hi.

senses.usage_en: An article is normally shorter than a book and focuses on one main subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Article pen a tamzaw in laibu sangin tomzaw a, thu bulpi khat tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: A grammar word: a, an or the
senses.definition_en: a word placed before a noun to show whether the noun is general or specific.
senses.explanation_zomi: Noun khat a zaizaw hiam, a kician hiam cih lak nading noun ma-a kikoih a, an ahih kei leh the.

examples.english: “The” is the definite article in English.
examples.zomi: The pen English definite article ahi hi.

examples.english: Use “an” before a vowel sound.
examples.zomi: Vowel aw ma-ah an zang in.

senses.usage_en: English has the indefinite articles a/an and the definite article the.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah indefinite article a/an leh definite article the om hi.

senses.heading: An individual object or item
senses.definition_en: one particular object or item, especially one being sold or discussed formally.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van ahih kei leh na tuam khat, a diak in zuakna ahih kei leh ngeina kizui thu ah.

examples.english: Each article has a price label.
examples.zomi: Van khat ciat in a man label nei hi.

examples.english: Do not leave valuable articles in the car.
examples.zomi: Van manpha-te mawtaw sungah nusia kei in.

senses.usage_en: This use of article is formal. In everyday English, item or the specific name of the object is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih article zatdan pen ngeina kizui hi. Nisim English ah item ahih kei leh van min kician zat ngeina zaw hi.

senses.heading: Made by people rather than occurring naturally
senses.definition_en: made or produced by people to copy or replace something natural.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pianpih in om hilo a, pianpih na khat etteh ahih kei leh aiawh dingin mihing in a bawl.

examples.english: The room was lit by artificial light.
examples.zomi: Innkhaan pen mihing bawltawm khuavak tawh kivak hi.

examples.english: These flowers are artificial, but they look real.
examples.zomi: Hih pakte bawltawm hi napi, a taktak bangin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Artificial contrasts with natural. It does not always mean poor quality; it simply indicates that people made it.
senses.usage_zomi: Artificial a langkhat pen natural ahi hi. A hoihlo cihna nei pahpah lo a, mihing bawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not sincere or natural in behavior
senses.definition_en: not sincere, genuine or natural in manner or expression.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim takpi pan hilo a, bawltawm ahih kei leh etteh in a kilak gamtatna.

examples.english: His smile seemed artificial.
examples.zomi: A nuihna bawltawm bangin kilang hi.

examples.english: The conversation felt formal and artificial.
examples.zomi: Kiholimna pen ngeina kizui lua leh lungsim takpi hilo bang hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing behavior, artificial usually has a negative meaning and suggests a lack of sincerity.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna gen ciangin artificial in khiatna hoihlo nei zel a, lungsim takpi omlo cihna lak hi.

senses.definition_en: a person who creates paintings, drawings, sculptures, music or other creative works.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim suai, lim bawl, laa bawl ahih kei leh khuasakna nasep dang bawl mi.

examples.english: The artist painted a picture of the village.
examples.zomi: Lim siampa in khua lim suai hi.

examples.english: Local artists displayed their work at the festival.
examples.zomi: Pawi ah khuami khuasak siamte in amau nasepte lak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Artist commonly refers to someone working in the visual arts, but it may also refer more broadly to a highly skilled creative performer.
senses.usage_zomi: Artist in a tamzaw in lim suai leh lim bawl siampa gen hi. Khiatna zaizaw ah khuasakna gamtat siam mahmah mi zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Related to art or artists
senses.definition_en: connected with art, artists or the creation of beautiful or expressive work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuasakna, khuasak siamte ahih kei leh hoihna leh lungsim omzia lak nasep bawlna tawh kisai.

examples.english: The program supports artistic expression among young people.
examples.zomi: Program in khangnote khuasakna tawh lungsim omzia lakna panpih hi.

examples.english: The building has great artistic value.
examples.zomi: Innpi in khuasakna lam manphatna lian nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, artistic describes something connected with art rather than the person’s level of skill.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah artistic in khuasakna tawh kisai cihna gen a, mi khat a siamdan gen ngiatlo hi.

senses.heading: Having creative skill
senses.definition_en: having skill, imagination or sensitivity in creating art or beautiful designs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuasakna ah siamna, ngaihsutna thak leh hoihna teltheihna nei.

examples.english: She is artistic and enjoys designing clothes.
examples.zomi: Khuasak siam a, puan limpuak bawl nuam sa hi.

examples.english: The child showed strong artistic ability.
examples.zomi: Naupang in khuasak siamna thahat lak hi.

senses.usage_en: An artistic person is creative or skilled in art. An artist is someone who actually creates or performs art.
senses.usage_zomi: Artistic person pen khuasak ngaihsutna ahih kei leh siamna nei mi hi. Artist pen khuasakna nasep a takin bawl mi ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: in the role, position, function or form of someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat dinmun, nasep, zatna ahih kei leh lim in.

examples.english: She works as a nurse at the hospital.
examples.zomi: Siibuk ah nurse in sem hi.

examples.english: We use this room as an office.
examples.zomi: Hih innkhaan office in ka zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: As describes someone’s real role or function. Like normally expresses similarity: She works as a teacher means she is a teacher; She talks like a teacher means her manner resembles one.
senses.usage_zomi: As in mi khat dinmun taktak ahih kei leh zatna gen hi. Like in kibatna gen hi: She works as a teacher cihpen sia ahi hi; She talks like a teacher cihpen a pauzia sia tawh kibang cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: feeling guilty, embarrassed or disappointed because of something wrong or foolish.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna, gamtatna hoihlo ahih kei leh haina khat hangin mawh sa, zum ahih kei leh dah.

examples.english: He felt ashamed of his rude behavior.
examples.zomi: A gamtatna zahtak huailo hangin zum hi.

examples.english: You should not be ashamed to ask for help.
examples.zomi: Huhna ngen ding na zum loh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Use ashamed of + noun/-ing form and ashamed to + verb. Ashamed describes a person’s feeling; shameful describes the behavior that causes shame.
senses.usage_zomi: Ashamed of + noun/-ing form leh ashamed to + verb cihdan zang in. Ashamed in mi lungsim omzia gen a, shameful in zumhuai gamtatna gen hi.

senses.heading: Say a question
senses.definition_en: to say or write a question in order to obtain information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thutheihna ngah nadingin dotna kam tawh gen ahih kei leh lai tawh gelh.

examples.english: She asked me where I lived.
examples.zomi: Bang munah ka teng hiam ci-in hong dong hi.

examples.english: The students asked several questions.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in dotna pawlkhat dong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use ask someone a question or ask someone about something. Do not normally use ask a question to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Ask someone a question ahih kei leh ask someone about something cihdan zang in. A ngeina in ask a question to someone ci kei in.

senses.heading: Request something or request an action
senses.definition_en: to request something or tell someone politely that you want them to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngen ahih kei leh mi khat nasep khat hih ding zahtakna tawh ngen.

examples.english: He asked for help with the application.
examples.zomi: Application tawh kisai huhna ngen hi.

examples.english: The teacher asked the students to remain quiet.
examples.zomi: Sia in sangnaupangte gamdai takin om dingin ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: Use ask for something and ask someone to do something. Do not use ask to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Ask for something leh ask someone to do something cihdan zang in. Ask to someone ci kei in.

senses.definition_en: sleeping; in the state of sleep.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ihmu lai; ihmu dinmun ah om.

examples.english: The baby is asleep in the next room.
examples.zomi: Innkhaan dangah naungek ihmu hi.

examples.english: I fell asleep while reading the book.
examples.zomi: Laibu ka sim laitak ka ihmu hi.

senses.usage_en: Asleep normally comes after a linking verb: The child is asleep. Before a noun, use sleeping: a sleeping child, not normally an asleep child.
senses.usage_zomi: Asleep pen linking verb nungah hong om zel hi: The child is asleep. Noun ma-ah sleeping zang in: a sleeping child. A ngeina in an asleep child ci kei in.

senses.definition_en: one particular part, feature or way of considering a situation, subject or problem.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a khen; a omzia; etna lam
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, thu ahih kei leh buaina khat a khen, a omzia ahih kei leh etna lam tuam khat.

examples.english: Cost is an important aspect of the project.
examples.zomi: Sum kisapna pen project a khen thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The report examines every aspect of the problem.
examples.zomi: Report in buaina a khen khempeuh kantel hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an aspect of something. An aspect is one part or viewpoint, not necessarily the whole subject.
senses.usage_zomi: An aspect of something cihdan zang in. Aspect pen thu a vekpi hilo in, a khen khat ahih kei leh etna lam khat ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: to examine someone or something carefully in order to judge quality, value, ability, condition or risk.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a hoihzia, man, siamna, dinmun ahih kei leh lauhuaina khensat nadingin kidawm takin kantel.

examples.english: Doctors assessed the patient’s condition.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te in cina dinmun kantel uh hi.

examples.english: We need to assess the risks before starting the project.
examples.zomi: Project i kipat ma-in lauhuinate i kantel kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Assess means examining evidence before making a judgment. It is more formal than simply saying check.
senses.usage_zomi: Assess cihpen thu khat khensat ma-in teci leh thutheihna kantel cihna hi. Check sangin ngeina kizui zaw hi.

senses.heading: An evaluation or judgment
senses.definition_en: a careful evaluation of someone or something in order to judge quality, ability, condition or risk.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a hoihzia, siamna, dinmun ahih kei leh lauhuaina theih nading kantelna leh khensatna.

examples.english: The nurse completed a health assessment.
examples.zomi: Nurse in cidamna kantelna zo hi.

examples.english: The decision was based on a careful assessment of the evidence.
examples.zomi: Thu khensatna pen teci kidawm taka kantelna tungah kinga hi.

senses.usage_en: An assessment of something is the resulting evaluation or judgment.
senses.usage_zomi: An assessment of something cihpen thu khat kantel khit cianga a ngah khensatna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A test of knowledge or ability
senses.definition_en: a test, task or activity used to measure a learner’s knowledge or ability.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sinna nei mi khat a pilna ahih kei leh siamna teh nading sittelna, nasepna ahih kei leh gamtatna.

examples.english: Students will complete a written assessment on Friday.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in Friday ni lai tawh sittelna bawl ding uh hi.

examples.english: The assessment measures reading and writing ability.
examples.zomi: Sittelna in lai sim leh gelh siamna teh hi.

senses.usage_en: In education, an assessment may be an examination, project, presentation or other method of measuring learning.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna ah assessment pen sittelna, project, thugenna ahih kei leh sinna tehna sepdingdan dang hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: a particular piece of work given to someone as part of a job or course of study.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna ahih kei leh laisinna khen in mi khat hih dingin a kipiak nasep.

common_phrases.zomi: inn ah hih ding sang nasep

examples.english: The teacher gave us a writing assignment.
examples.zomi: Sia in laigelh nasep hong pia hi.

examples.english: She completed the assignment before the deadline.
examples.zomi: Hun tawp ma-in a kipiak nasep zo hi.

senses.usage_en: An assignment is the task itself. Homework specifically refers to schoolwork completed outside class.
senses.usage_zomi: Assignment pen a kipiak nasep amah ahi hi. Homework pen sangkhaan pua-a kihih sang nasep gen hi.

senses.definition_en: to help someone do a task or deal with a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nasep hih ahih kei leh dinmun khat vaihawm theih nading huh/panpih.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat nasep hihna ah huh

examples.english: A staff member assisted me with the application.
examples.zomi: Nasem khat in application ah hong huh hi.

examples.english: The nurse assisted the doctor during the procedure.
examples.zomi: Siibawl laitak nurse in siavuan panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Assist is more formal than help. Use assist someone with something or assist someone in doing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Assist pen help sangin ngeina kizui zaw hi. Assist someone with something ahih kei leh assist someone in doing something cihdan zang in.

senses.definition_en: a person whose job is to help another person perform work or responsibilities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang khat a nasep leh mawhpuakna sepkhiatna ah huh dingin a sem mi.

examples.english: The assistant scheduled the director’s meetings.
examples.zomi: Huhmi in director kikhop hunte vaihawm hi.

examples.english: She works as a teaching assistant at the university.
examples.zomi: University ah laihilh huhmi in sem hi.

senses.usage_en: The word before assistant normally identifies the person assisted or the type of work performed.
senses.usage_zomi: Assistant ma-a kammal in kua huh hiam ahih kei leh bang nasep sem hiam cih gen hi.

senses.heading: Connect people or things in your mind
senses.definition_en: to connect one person, thing or idea with another in your mind.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat leh a dang khat lungsim ah kizomsak.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat na dang khat tawh kizomsak

examples.english: Many people associate summer with travel.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi in khuakhal leh khualzin kizomsak uh hi.

examples.english: The color red is often associated with danger.
examples.zomi: A tamzaw in color san leh lauhuaina kizomsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use associate one thing with another. Do not normally use associate one thing to another.
senses.usage_zomi: Associate one thing with another cihdan zang in. A ngeina in associate one thing to another ci kei in.

senses.heading: Spend time or work with someone
senses.definition_en: to spend time, work or have regular contact with someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh hun zang, semkhawm ahih kei leh kizopna nei tawntung.

examples.english: He associates with people from many backgrounds.
examples.zomi: Nuntakna bul tuamtuam nei mite tawh kipawl hi.

examples.english: The two organizations have associated closely for years.
examples.zomi: Pawl nih kum tampi sung nai takin semkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Associate with someone may simply mean spending time or working together. Context determines whether the relationship is personal or professional.
senses.usage_zomi: Associate with someone in hun zatkhawm ahih kei leh semkhawm cihna nei thei hi. Kizopna pen mimal hiam, nasepna hiam cih a kimkot thu in khensat hi.

senses.definition_en: connected or related to someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat tawh kizom/kisai.

examples.english: Smoking is associated with several serious diseases.
examples.zomi: Zial dawnna pen natna lipkhaphuai pawlkhat tawh kizom hi.

examples.english: The report describes the costs associated with the project.
examples.zomi: Report in project tawh kizom sumzatte gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Associated with shows a connection, but it does not always prove that one thing directly causes the other.
senses.usage_zomi: Associated with in kizopna om cih lak napi, na khat in a dang khat piangsak taktak cih kipsak pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: An organized group
senses.definition_en: an organized group of people who share a profession, interest or purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, lunglutna ahih kei leh ngiimna kibang nei mite a kigeel takin kipawlna.

examples.english: She is a member of a professional association.
examples.zomi: Nasep siamte pawlpi sung mi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The community association organized the event.
examples.zomi: Khawtang pawlpi in pawlkhopna vaihawm hi.

senses.usage_en: An association usually has members, rules and a shared purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Association in a tamzaw in pawl sung mite, thukhun leh ngiimna kibang nei hi.

senses.heading: A connection between people or things
senses.definition_en: a connection or relationship between people, ideas, events or conditions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ngaihsutna, thu piang ahih kei leh dinmunte kikaal kizopna.

examples.english: Researchers found an association between sleep and health.
examples.zomi: Zongkhiate in ihmutna leh cidamna kikaal kizopna mu uh hi.

examples.english: The program was developed in association with local schools.
examples.zomi: Program pen khuami sangte tawh kipawl in kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: An association between two conditions shows a relationship, but not necessarily direct cause and effect.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun nih kikaal association in kizopna lak napi, khat in a dang khat piangsak taktak cihna ahih pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Accept something as true without proof
senses.definition_en: to believe that something is true without having complete evidence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci kicing nei loin, thu khat a man dingin ngaihsun/pom khol.

examples.english: I assumed that the meeting began at nine.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna dak kua in kipan dingin ka ngaihsun khol hi.

examples.english: Do not assume that everyone agrees with you.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh nang tawh thukim dingin ngaihsun khol kei in.

senses.usage_en: An assumption may be reasonable, but it has not yet been completely proved.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngaihsun kholna khat hang nei thei napi, a man taktakna teci kicing tawh kipsak nailo hi.

senses.heading: Take responsibility, control or a role
senses.definition_en: to begin having responsibility, control, power or a particular role.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhpuakna, ukzawhna, hihna ahih kei leh dinmun khat la/saang kipan.

examples.english: She assumed responsibility for the project.
examples.zomi: Project mawhpuakna saang hi.

examples.english: The new director will assume office in April.
examples.zomi: Director thak in April kha dinmun nasep kipan ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, assume means taking on something, not guessing that it is true.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah assume in thu khat ngaihsun khol cihna hilo in, mawhpuakna ahih kei leh dinmun khat la cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: In or near a particular place
senses.definition_en: used to show a particular point, place or location.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun kician khat ah ahih kei leh tua mun nai-ah omna gen nadingin kizang.

examples.english: She is waiting at the bus stop.
examples.zomi: Bus ngakna munah ngak hi.

examples.english: We met at the library.
examples.zomi: Laibuk ah ka kimu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: At usually identifies a point or specific location. In often refers to being inside an enclosed place or larger area.
senses.usage_zomi: At in mun kician khat kawk zel hi. In in inn sung ahih kei leh mun lianzaw sungah omna gen tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: At a particular time
senses.definition_en: used to show an exact time or a particular point in time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun kician ahih kei leh hun khat a kician na gen nadingin kizang.

examples.english: The meeting begins at ten o’clock.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna dak sawm in kipan hi.

examples.english: The store closes at night.
examples.zomi: Dawk pen zan in khak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use at with exact clock times, in with months and years, and on with days and dates.
senses.usage_zomi: Dak hun kician tawh at, kha leh kum tawh in, ni leh date tawh on zang in.

senses.heading: Directed toward a target
senses.definition_en: used to show the person or thing toward which an action, look or feeling is directed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, etna ahih kei leh lungsim omzia pen mi ahih kei leh na kuapeuh lamah kihei hiam cih lak.

examples.english: She smiled at the child.
examples.zomi: Naupang nuihsak hi.

examples.english: Do not shout at me.
examples.zomi: Kei tungah awng kei in.

senses.usage_en: The complete verb phrase determines whether at is natural: look at, smile at, laugh at, shout at.
senses.usage_zomi: At zat ding leh zatloh ding pen verb phrase bukim in khensat hi: look at, smile at, laugh at, shout at.

senses.definition_en: a person trained or skilled in sports, especially competitive physical events.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna, a diak in pumpi thahatna kidemna ah a kisin leh siam mi.

examples.english: The athlete trains for several hours every day.
examples.zomi: Kimawlpa in nisim nai pawlkhat pumpi kisinsak hi.

examples.english: She hopes to become a professional athlete.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna tawh nasep mi suak ding lam-en hi.

senses.usage_en: Athlete can refer to a person of any gender. In American English, it may include participants in many sports, not only track-and-field events.
senses.usage_zomi: Athlete pen pasal leh numei deihdeih gen thei hi. American English ah taai, diil leh lawnna bek hilo in kimawlna nam tampi a pang mite huam thei hi.

senses.heading: The gases surrounding a planet
senses.definition_en: the mixture of gases surrounding Earth or another planet.
senses.zomi_equivalents: leitung tuam huih; van huih thuah
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung ahih kei leh aksi khat kimkot a tuam huih nam tuamtuam kigawm.

examples.english: Earth’s atmosphere contains the air that we breathe.
examples.zomi: Leitung tuam huih sungah i hu i lak huih om hi.

examples.english: The spacecraft entered the planet’s atmosphere.
examples.zomi: Vanleng pen aksi tuam huih sungah lut hi.

senses.usage_en: The atmosphere protects Earth and contains the gases necessary for life.
senses.usage_zomi: Atmosphere in leitung dal a, nuntak nading kisam huih namte nei hi.

senses.heading: The feeling or mood of a place
senses.definition_en: the general feeling, mood or character of a place or situation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun omzia; lungsim omzia; kimkot omzia
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih kei leh dinmun khat ah mi in a phut lungsim omzia leh a kimkot omzia.

examples.english: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
examples.zomi: Anzuakna mun pen nuam leh kipawl nuamhuai hi.

examples.english: The disagreement created a tense atmosphere.
examples.zomi: Thukimlohna in lungkham huai omzia piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, atmosphere describes how a place or situation feels.
senses.usage_zomi: Lim tawh gen hih khiatna ah atmosphere in mun ahih kei leh dinmun khat a kimkot omzia leh mi lungsim a khakdan gen hi.

senses.heading: Fasten or connect something
senses.definition_en: to fasten, join or connect one thing to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat na dang khat tawh khen theihlo dingin zom, hen ahih kei leh bel.

examples.english: Attach the label to the package.
examples.zomi: Package tungah label bel in.

examples.english: The worker attached the rope to the pole.
examples.zomi: Nasem in khau pen singtang ah hen hi.

senses.usage_en: Use attach something to something. The object being connected normally comes before to.
senses.usage_zomi: Attach something to something cihdan zang in. A kizom na pen to ma-ah hong om hi.

senses.heading: Add a file to an electronic message
senses.definition_en: to add a document, photograph or other file to an email or electronic message.
senses.explanation_zomi: Document, lim ahih kei leh file khat email ahih kei leh electronic thupuak tawh zom.

examples.english: Please attach the document to your email.
examples.zomi: Na email ah document hong zom in.

examples.english: I attached three photographs to the message.
examples.zomi: Thupuak ah lim thum ka zom hi.

senses.usage_en: An email file that has been attached is called an attachment.
senses.usage_zomi: Email tawh a kizom file pen attachment kici hi.

senses.heading: A violent act intended to cause harm
senses.definition_en: a violent action intended to injure, damage, defeat or kill someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi liamsak, van susia, guallel sak ahih kei leh that nading thagum tawh a kibawl gamtatna.

examples.english: The village was damaged during the attack.
examples.zomi: Langdona laitak khua kisusia hi.

examples.english: Police prevented an attack on the building.
examples.zomi: Police in innpi tungah langdona khaktan hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an attack on/against a person, place or organization and an attack by the attacker.
senses.usage_zomi: Kua ahih kei leh bang mun kidona hiam cih gen leh an attack on/against zang in. Kua in do hiam cih gen leh an attack by zang in.

senses.heading: A sudden period of illness or strong symptoms
senses.definition_en: a sudden period of illness, pain, fear or another medical condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Natna, natna thuak, launa ahih kei leh cidamna buaina thakhat in hong piang hun.

examples.english: He was taken to the hospital after a heart attack.
examples.zomi: Lungsim natna hong piangvat khit siibuk ah kipuak hi.

examples.english: The medicine can help prevent asthma attacks.
examples.zomi: Zatui in asthma natna hong piangvat khaktan thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In medical expressions, attack refers to a sudden episode, not an intentional violent action.
senses.usage_zomi: Si lam kammal ah attack in thagum tawh langdona hilo in, natna thakhat in hong piang hun gen hi.

senses.definition_en: an effort to do or achieve something, especially something difficult.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hih ahih kei leh ngiimna khat tangtun nading hanciamna.

examples.english: She passed the examination on her first attempt.
examples.zomi: Hanciamna masapen ah sittelna zo hi.

examples.english: The rescue attempt was unsuccessful.
examples.zomi: Honkhia ding hanciamna gualzo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an attempt to do something or an attempt at something. Attempt suggests effort but does not guarantee success.
senses.usage_zomi: An attempt to do something ahih kei leh an attempt at something cihdan zang in. Attempt in hanciamna gen napi, gualzo taktak cih kipsaklo hi.

senses.heading: Be present at an event or place
senses.definition_en: to go to and be present at a meeting, school, ceremony or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhopna, sang, pawlkhop ahih kei leh pawi khat ah pai a, pang.

examples.english: More than one hundred people attended the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ah mi zakhat val pang uh hi.

examples.english: She attends college in Columbus.
examples.zomi: Columbus ah college kai hi.

senses.usage_en: Attend takes a direct object. Say attend the meeting, not attend to the meeting. Attend to has a different meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Attend nungah direct object hong pai hi. Attend to the meeting cih loin attend the meeting ci ding hi. Attend to in khiatna dang nei hi.

senses.heading: Deal with or care for
senses.definition_en: to give attention or care to a person, task or problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, nasep ahih kei leh buaina khat ngaihsak a, kem/vaihawm.

examples.english: The nurse attended to the injured child.
examples.zomi: Nurse in a liam naupang kem hi.

examples.english: I must attend to several urgent matters.
examples.zomi: Manlang taka vaihawm ding thu pawlkhat ka ngaihsak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Attend to means dealing with, caring for or giving attention to something.
senses.usage_zomi: Attend to cihpen thu khat vaihawm, mi khat kem ahih kei leh ngaihsak cihna hi.

senses.heading: Mental focus
senses.definition_en: careful thought, listening or observation directed toward someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat telcian nadingin lungsim, zakna leh muhna a tungah koihna.

examples.english: Please pay attention to the instructions.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna-te lungsim takin ngai in.

examples.english: The work requires careful attention to detail.
examples.zomi: Nasep in a khen neute dong kidawm taka ngaihsakna kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Say pay attention, not give attention in most everyday learning situations. Use attention to the subject receiving focus.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim sinna dinmun ah give attention sangin pay attention cihdan kizang tamzaw hi. Bang thu lungsim koih hiam cih gen leh attention to zang in.

senses.heading: Notice, care or help
senses.definition_en: notice, care or special treatment given to someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat tungah muh, ngaihsak, kem ahih kei leh huhna piak.

examples.english: The injury requires immediate medical attention.
examples.zomi: Liamna pen pahpah in si lam kemna kisam hi.

examples.english: The problem needs your attention.
examples.zomi: Buaina pen na ngaihsakna kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Medical attention means examination or treatment by a health professional.
senses.usage_zomi: Medical attention cihpen si lam siamna nei mi in kantel ahih kei leh bawl cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: a person’s way of thinking or feeling about someone or something, often shown through behavior.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in mi ahih kei leh thu khat a ngaihsut leh a lunggulh dan, a gamtatna tungtawnin a kilang zel.

examples.english: A positive attitude can help during difficult times.
examples.zomi: Lungsim putdan hoih in hun haksa laitak huh thei hi.

examples.english: His attitude toward work has improved.
examples.zomi: Nasep tungah a lungsim putdan hoihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Use attitude toward/to someone or something. Attitude may be positive, negative or neutral depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Attitude toward/to someone or something cihdan zang in. A kimkot thu dungzui in attitude pen a hoih, a hoihlo ahih kei leh deidan neilo hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Cause interest or draw people
senses.definition_en: to make someone interested in or want to come to a person, place, event or product.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lunglut sak ahih kei leh mi khat mun, pawlkhop, mi ahih kei leh sumleina na khat lamah hong pai nuam sak.

examples.english: The festival attracts visitors from many states.
examples.zomi: Pawi in state tampi pan zinmite lungsim la hi.

examples.english: Bright colors attract attention.
examples.zomi: Color taangte in mite’ lungsim la hi.

senses.usage_en: Attract describes drawing interest or movement toward something. The related adjective is attractive.
senses.usage_zomi: Attract in mi lunglutna ahih kei leh pai nuamna na khat lamah kai cihna hi. A tawh kisai adjective pen attractive ahi hi.

senses.heading: Pull physically
senses.definition_en: to pull something toward another object by a physical force.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi thahatna ahih kei leh science thahatna khat tawh na khat a dang khat lamah kai.

examples.english: A magnet attracts some kinds of metal.
examples.zomi: Magnet in sik nam pawlkhat kai hi.

examples.english: Opposite electrical charges attract each other.
examples.zomi: Electric charge kilehbulhte khat leh khat kihip uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In science, attract is the opposite of repel.
senses.usage_zomi: Science ah attract a langkhat pen repel ahi hi.

senses.heading: A quality that creates interest or liking
senses.definition_en: a quality that makes someone or something interesting, enjoyable or desirable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat lunglut huai, nuamhuai ahih kei leh deihhuai sak hoihna.

examples.english: The lake is the area’s main tourist attraction.
examples.zomi: Tua bualpi pen khualzinte adingin tua mun a lunglut huaina lianpen ahi hi.

examples.english: The town’s natural beauty is part of its attraction.
examples.zomi: Khuapi kimkot pianpih hoihna pen a lunglut huaina khen khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A tourist attraction is a place or event that people want to visit. It does not necessarily refer to romantic attraction.
senses.usage_zomi: Tourist attraction cihpen mite veh nuam mun ahih kei leh pawlkhopna ahi hi. Nupa lam lunglutna cihna bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: A force that pulls things together
senses.definition_en: a physical force that pulls objects toward one another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vante khat leh khat a kihip a, a kinaisak science thahatna.

examples.english: Magnetic attraction pulls the two objects together.
examples.zomi: Magnet kihipna in van nih khat leh khat a kinaisak hi.

examples.english: Gravitational attraction keeps the Moon near Earth.
examples.zomi: Leitung kaihna thahatna in kha pen leitung nai-ah kem hi.

senses.usage_en: In science, attraction is the opposite of repulsion.
senses.usage_zomi: Science ah attraction a langkhat pen repulsion ahi hi.

senses.heading: Pleasant or beautiful in appearance
senses.definition_en: pleasant to look at or having a pleasing appearance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muh nuamhuai ahih kei leh pualam mel hoih.

examples.english: The building has a simple but attractive design.
examples.zomi: Innpi limpuak baih napi, muh nuamhuai hi.

examples.english: The garden looks attractive in spring.
examples.zomi: Khuakhal kipat hunin huan muh nuamhuai hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing a person, attractive often refers to physical appearance, but it can also include personality and manner.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat gen ciangin attractive in a tamzaw in pualam mel gen hi. Ahih hangin a lungsim omzia leh gamtatdan zong huam thei hi.

senses.heading: Interesting or offering an advantage
senses.definition_en: interesting, desirable or offering a useful benefit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunglut huai, deihhuai ahih kei leh phattuamna hoih nei.

examples.english: The company made her an attractive job offer.
examples.zomi: Company in ama tungah nasep thupiakna deihhuai khat pia hi.

examples.english: The lower price makes the product more attractive.
examples.zomi: A man niamzaw in sumleina na pen deihhuai zaw sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In business, attractive often means offering good value or useful advantages.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumleina ah attractive in a man hoih ahih kei leh phattuamna nei cihna nei tam hi.

senses.definition_en: the people who watch or listen to a performance, speech, program or broadcast.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zatpual gamtatna, thugenna, program ahih kei leh radio/television thupuak en leh ngaikhe mite.

examples.english: The audience applauded at the end of the performance.
examples.zomi: Gamtatna a tawp ciangin en mite in khutbeng uh hi.

examples.english: The program is intended for a young audience.
examples.zomi: Program pen khangnote en dingin kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Audience can take a singular verb when treated as one group or a plural verb when emphasizing its individual members, especially in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Audience pen pawl khat in kingaihsun leh singular verb tawh kizang thei hi. Pawl sung mi khat ciat thupisak leh, a diak in British English ah plural verb tawh zong kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: the eighth month of the year, following July and preceding September.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sunga kha giatna; July khit leh September ma-a kha.

examples.english: The new school year begins in August.
examples.zomi: Sang kum thak pen August kha in kipan hi.

examples.english: The event will be held on August 20.
examples.zomi: Pawlkhopna pen August 20 ni in om ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The month August begins with a capital letter. Use in August for the month and on August 20 for a particular date.
senses.usage_zomi: Kha min August capital letter tawh kipan hi. Kha gen leh in August zang inla, ni kician gen leh on August 20 zang in.

senses.definition_en: the sister of someone’s mother or father, or the wife of someone’s uncle.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nulehpa sanggam numei; nulehpa sanggampa zi
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nu ahih kei leh pa sanggam numei, ahih kei leh a nulehpa sanggampa zi.

examples.english: My aunt lives near our family.
examples.zomi: Ka nulehpa sanggam numei pen ka innkuan uh nai-ah teng hi.

examples.english: We visited our aunt during the weekend.
examples.zomi: Weekend sung ka nulehpa sanggam numei uh va veh ung.

senses.usage_en: English uses the general word aunt for several family relationships. Zomi may identify the exact relationship more specifically.
senses.usage_zomi: English in innkuan kizopna nam tuamtuam adingin aunt kammal khat zang hi. Zomi in nu lam, pa lam ahih kei leh kitenna tungtawn kizopna kician zawin gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: a person who writes a book, article, story or other written work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, article, tangthu ahih kei leh laigelhna dang gelh mi.

examples.english: The author wrote several books about history.
examples.zomi: Laigelhpa in tangthu tawh kisai laibu pawlkhat gelh hi.

examples.english: She is the author of this article.
examples.zomi: Amah hih article gelhpa ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the author of a book or article. Writer has a broader meaning and can include anyone who writes as a job or activity.
senses.usage_zomi: The author of a book or article cihdan zang in. Writer in khiatna zaizaw nei a, nasep ahih kei leh gamtatna in lai gelh mi khempeuh huam thei hi.

senses.heading: Official power or right
senses.definition_en: the official or legal power to make decisions, give orders and control people or activities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khensat, thupiak leh mi/nasepna uk nading ngeina kizui ahih kei leh thukham tawh kipia ukzawhna.

examples.english: The manager has authority to approve the payment.
examples.zomi: Manager in sum piakna thukim theih ukzawhna nei hi.

examples.english: Police have the legal authority to make arrests.
examples.zomi: Police-te in mi man theih thukham ukzawhna nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Authority is normally uncountable when it means power. Use authority to do something and authority over someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: Ukzawhna cihna ah authority pen a tamzaw in uncountable noun hi. Authority to do something leh authority over someone or something cihdan zang in.

senses.heading: A person or organization with official power
senses.definition_en: a person or organization responsible for making decisions, enforcing rules or managing public services.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khensat, thukhun zuihsak ahih kei leh mipi nasepna vaihawm mawhpuak mi/pawl.

examples.english: Local authorities closed the road after the flood.
examples.zomi: Tuikhang khit khuami ukna pawlte in lampi khak uh hi.

examples.english: The incident was reported to the authorities.
examples.zomi: Thu piang pen ukna pawlte tungah kireport hi.

senses.usage_en: In the plural, the authorities normally means officials, police or government organizations.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural the authorities in a tamzaw in kumpi makaite, police ahih kei leh kumpi pawlte gen hi.

senses.heading: An expert on a subject
senses.definition_en: a person with extensive knowledge and recognized expertise in a particular subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khen khat ah pilna tampi leh a kiphatsak siamna nei mi.

examples.english: She is a leading authority on Zomi history.
examples.zomi: Amah Zomi tangthu siammi lian khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor is a recognized authority on the disease.
examples.zomi: Siavuan pen tua natna thu a kiphatsak siammi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an authority on a subject when referring to an expert.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu khat siammi gen leh an authority on a subject cihdan zang in.

senses.definition_en: the season between summer and winter, when temperatures become cooler and leaves change color and fall in many regions.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khuahun lum khit leh phalbi ma hun; fall [sittel-ding]
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuahun lum khit leh phalbi ma kikaal hun; gam tampi ah khuahun dai hong suak a, singte a lai kikhel a, kial hun.

examples.english: The leaves change color in autumn.
examples.zomi: Autumn hunin singlaite a color kikhel hi.

examples.english: The weather becomes cooler during autumn.
examples.zomi: Autumn hunin khuahun dai deuh hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Autumn is used in both British and American English. Fall is the more common everyday term in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Autumn pen British leh American English gel ah kizang hi. American nisim English ah fall kizang tamzaw hi. Standard Zomi khuahun min kician pen native-speaker in sittel lai ding hi.

senses.heading: Able to be obtained or used
senses.definition_en: ready and able to be obtained, bought, used or accessed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngah, lei, zang ahih kei leh lut theih dingin om.

examples.english: The report is available online.
examples.zomi: Report pen internet tungah ngah theih hi.

examples.english: This medicine is not available without a prescription.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui pen siavuan zatui lai lo in ngah theihlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use available to someone and available for a purpose: available to students; available for use.
senses.usage_zomi: Ku in ngah thei hiam cih gen leh available to someone zang in. Bang ading zat theih hiam cih gen leh available for a purpose zang in.

senses.heading: Free and able to meet or work
senses.definition_en: free and able to meet, speak, work or help at a particular time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hun awng nei; kimu thei; semthei
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat ah sem, kimu, kiholim ahih kei leh huh dingin hun awng nei.

examples.english: The doctor is available this afternoon.
examples.zomi: Siavuan tuni sun nunglam hun awng nei hi.

examples.english: Are you available for a meeting on Friday?
examples.zomi: Friday ni kikhopna adingin hun awng na nei hiam?

senses.usage_en: When referring to a person, available usually means that the person is free and able to participate.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat gen ciangin available in a hun awng a, a pang theihna gen hi.

senses.heading: Ordinary or typical
senses.definition_en: normal or typical, without being especially good or bad.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina tawh kibang a, a hoih mahmah zong hilo, a sia mahmah zong hilo.

examples.english: His examination score was about average.
examples.zomi: A sittelna ngah zah pen a lailak kimkot ahi hi.

examples.english: The restaurant serves average food at a high price.
examples.zomi: Anzuakna mun in a man sang tawh annek lailak pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Describing something as average may suggest that it is acceptable but not impressive.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat average ci-in genna in saangtheih napi, lamdang sak huai hilo cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Calculated by dividing a total
senses.definition_en: equal to the total of several amounts divided by the number of amounts.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zah pawlkhat gawmkhawm a, a om zah tawh khenkhia cianga a lailak zah.

examples.english: The average score was eighty percent.
examples.zomi: Score lailak pen za-a sawmgiat ahi hi.

examples.english: The city’s average temperature is rising.
examples.zomi: Khuapi khuahun lumna lailak hong sangto hi.

senses.usage_en: A mathematical average is often called the mean, although other kinds of average also exist.
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics ah average pen a tamzaw in mean kici hi. Ahih hangin average simna nam dangte zong om hi.

senses.definition_en: to stay away from someone or something, or to prevent something undesirable from happening.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat pan gamla in om, ahih kei leh deihloh thu khat pianglo dingin kidawm/khaktan.

examples.english: Drivers should avoid using phones while driving.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawlte in mawtaw hawl laitak phone zat pelh ding uh hi.

examples.english: Careful planning can help avoid unnecessary costs.
examples.zomi: Kidawm taka geelna in kisaploh sumzat pelh nading huh thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use avoid + noun/-ing form. Do not use avoid to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Avoid + noun/-ing form cihdan zang in. Avoid to do something ci kei in.

senses.definition_en: a prize, honor or official recognition given for achievement, service or excellent work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzawhna, nasep hoih ahih kei leh panpihna phat nadingin a kipiak kipahman ahih kei leh zahtakna.

examples.english: She received an award for her community service.
examples.zomi: Khawtang nasepna hangin kipahman ngah hi.

examples.english: The film won several international awards.
examples.zomi: Limlak in gamkhat leh gamkhat kikaal kipahman pawlkhat ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: An award recognizes achievement or service. A reward is usually offered in return for a helpful action or information.
senses.usage_zomi: Award in gualzawhna ahih kei leh nasep hoih phatna ahi hi. Reward pen huhna nasep ahih kei leh thutheihna piak manin a kipiak na hi zel hi.

senses.definition_en: knowing that someone or something exists, or understanding a situation or fact.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat om cih thei, ahih kei leh dinmun leh thuman khat telcian.

examples.english: Are you aware of the risks involved?
examples.zomi: Tua tawh kizom lauhuainate na thei hiam?

examples.english: She became aware that someone was following her.
examples.zomi: Mi khat in a nung a zuihna hong theikha hi.

senses.usage_en: Use aware of + noun and aware that + clause. Aware normally follows a linking verb and is not usually placed directly before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Aware of + noun leh aware that + clause cihdan zang in. Aware pen linking verb nungah hong om zel a, noun ma-ah a ngeina in hong omlo hi.

senses.heading: At or toward another place
senses.definition_en: at or toward a place different from the speaker’s present location.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu-a omna mun pan mun dang ah ahih kei leh mun dang lamah.

examples.english: She is away from the office today.
examples.zomi: Tuni office ah omlo hi.

examples.english: The children ran away from the fire.
examples.zomi: Naupangte mei pan tai gamla uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Away often combines with verbs to form phrasal verbs, including go away, run away, give away and throw away.
senses.usage_zomi: Away pen verb tawh kigawm a, go away, run away, give away leh throw away bang phrasal verb-te bawl hi.

senses.heading: At a stated distance in space or time
senses.definition_en: separated from something by a particular distance or amount of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih kei leh hun khat pan gamlatna/hun sawt zah khat om.

examples.english: The airport is ten miles away.
examples.zomi: Airport pen mile sawm gamla hi.

examples.english: The examination is only one week away.
examples.zomi: Sittelna pen nipi khat bek lai hi.

senses.usage_en: The expression a week away means that one week remains before an event.
senses.usage_zomi: A week away cihpen thu piang khat tun ma nipi khat lai cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: extremely bad, unpleasant or of very poor quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sia mahmah, nuamlo mahmah ahih kei leh hoihna nei hetlo.

examples.english: The weather was awful throughout the weekend.
examples.zomi: Weekend sung khuahun sia mahmah hi.

examples.english: I feel awful about what happened.
examples.zomi: Thu piang hangin ka lungsim nuamlo mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Awful is a strong, informal adjective. It usually means very bad. In older or literary English, it could mean inspiring great fear or wonder, but that meaning is uncommon today.
senses.usage_zomi: Awful pen khiatna thahat nei nisim kammal hi a, a tamzaw in a sia mahmah cihna hi. Tanglai ahih kei leh laibu pau ah launa leh lamdanna lian piangsak cihna nei ngei napi, tuhunin tua khiatna kizang tamlo hi.

senses.definition_en: a very young child, especially one who has not yet learned to walk or talk.
senses.explanation_zomi: A nau mahmah, a diak in lampai leh pau thei nailo naupang.

examples.english: The baby is sleeping in the next room.
examples.zomi: Innkhaan dangah naungek ihmu hi.

examples.english: Their baby began walking last month.
examples.zomi: Amau naungek kha beisa in lampai kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Baby is normally used for a very young child. It may also refer to the youngest member of a family or the young of some animals.
senses.usage_zomi: Baby pen a tamzaw in naupang nau mahmah gen hi. Innkuan sunga a neupen ahih kei leh ganhing pawlkhat a note zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: The rear part of the body
senses.definition_en: the part of the body extending from the shoulders to the hips on the side opposite the chest and stomach.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi liang pan ngawng dong, awm leh gil langkhat a om pumpi nunglam khen.

examples.english: He injured his back while lifting a heavy box.
examples.zomi: Bawm gik khat a lamto laitak a nung liam hi.

examples.english: She lay on her back and looked at the sky.
examples.zomi: A nung tawh lum a, van en hi.

senses.usage_en: Back refers to the rear surface of the upper body. The lower part is called the lower back.
senses.usage_zomi: Back in pumpi tunglam nung a maitang gen hi. A nuailam pen lower back kici hi.

senses.heading: The rear part of something
senses.definition_en: the part of an object, place or group that is farthest from the front.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, mun ahih kei leh pawl khat a mai langkhat a om nunglam khen.

examples.english: The answers are at the back of the book.
examples.zomi: Dawnnate laibu nunglam ah om hi.

examples.english: We sat at the back of the room.
examples.zomi: Innkhaan nunglam ah ka tu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the back of an object or place. At the back indicates a position in the rear part.
