senses.usage_zomi: Van ahih kei leh mun khat a nunglam gen leh the back of zang in. Nunglam ah omna gen leh at the back zang in.

senses.heading: A person’s history and experience
senses.definition_en: a person’s family, education, culture, work and previous experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat innkuan, pilna, ngeina, nasep leh a beisa phutkhaknate.

examples.english: She has a strong background in finance.
examples.zomi: Sum vai-ah pilna leh phutkhakna hoih nei hi.

examples.english: The students come from different cultural backgrounds.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte ngeina tuamtuam pan hong pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A person’s background describes earlier influences and experience, not only where that person was born.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat background in a suahna mun bek hilo in, a innkuan, pilna, ngeina leh phutkhakna huam hi.

senses.heading: The area behind the main subject
senses.definition_en: the part of a picture, scene or place behind the main person or object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim, khuamuh ahih kei leh mun khat ah a thupi mi/na nunglam a om khen.

examples.english: Mountains can be seen in the background of the photograph.
examples.zomi: Lim nunglam ah mualte muhtheih hi.

examples.english: I could hear music playing in the background.
examples.zomi: Nunglam ah laa kigitna ka za hi.

senses.usage_en: In the background may refer to something less noticeable or less important than the main subject.
senses.usage_zomi: In the background in a thupi pen sangin a kilang hetlo zaw ahih kei leh a thupi zawlo na khat gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Toward the back
senses.definition_en: toward the direction that is behind someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mai lam hilo in, nunglamah.

examples.english: He stepped backwards to avoid the bicycle.
examples.zomi: Lengnih pelh nadingin nunglamah kalsuan hi.

examples.english: She fell backwards onto the floor.
examples.zomi: Nunglamah leitang tungah puk hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses backward as an adverb, while British English commonly uses backwards. Both are understood.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah adverb in backward kizang tam a, British English ah backwards kizang tam hi. Anihgel teltheih hi.

senses.heading: In the reverse order or direction
senses.definition_en: in the opposite order or direction from the usual one.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kikhel in; nunghei in; a kilehbulh in
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina kizom dan ahih kei leh paina tawh kilehbulh in.

common_phrases.zomi: nambat lian pan neu lam sim

examples.english: Count backwards from ten to one.
examples.zomi: Sawm pan khat dong nunghei in sim in.

examples.english: The word was written backwards on the sign.
examples.zomi: Kammal pen lim tungah a kilehbulh in kigelh hi.

senses.usage_en: Backwards may describe physical movement or an order that has been reversed.
senses.usage_zomi: Backwards in pumpi nunglamah paina ahih kei leh kizom dan kilehbulhna gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: extremely small living organisms, some of which cause disease while others are harmless or useful.
senses.zomi_equivalents: bacteria; mit tawh muh theihloh nungta neute
senses.explanation_zomi: Mit guak tawh muh theihloh nungta neute; pawlkhat in natna piangsak a, pawlkhat mi susia lo ahih kei leh phattuam.

examples.english: Washing your hands helps remove harmful bacteria.
examples.zomi: Khut sawpna in mi susia bacteria paihkhiat nading huh hi.

examples.english: Some bacteria help the human body digest food.
examples.zomi: Bacteria pawlkhat in mihing pumpi an neksuk theih nading huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Bacteria is plural. The singular form is bacterium. Not all bacteria cause disease.
senses.usage_zomi: Bacteria pen plural ahi hi. Singular form pen bacterium ahi hi. Bacteria khempeuh in natna piangsaklo hi.

senses.heading: Poor in quality or unpleasant
senses.definition_en: poor in quality, unpleasant or not satisfactory.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihlo, nuamlo ahih kei leh saangtheih zah a kicinglo.

examples.english: The weather was bad throughout the weekend.
examples.zomi: Weekend sung khuahun sia hi.

examples.english: We received bad service at the restaurant.
examples.zomi: Anzuakna munah nasepna hoihlo ka ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Bad is an adjective. Use it after a linking verb or before a noun: The food is bad; bad food.
senses.usage_zomi: Bad pen adjective ahi hi. Linking verb nungah ahih kei leh noun ma-ah zang in: The food is bad; bad food.

senses.heading: Wrong, harmful or serious
senses.definition_en: morally wrong, harmful or serious enough to cause concern.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thumanlo, siatna pia ahih kei leh lungkham huai zahin nasia.

examples.english: Lying to customers is bad business practice.
examples.zomi: Customer-te tungah zuau genna pen sumleina gamtatna hoihlo ahi hi.

examples.english: He suffered a bad injury during the game.
examples.zomi: Kimawl laitak liamna nasia thuak hi.

senses.usage_en: The comparative form is worse, and the superlative form is worst.
senses.usage_zomi: Bad comparative form pen worse hi a, superlative form pen worst ahi hi.

senses.heading: In a poor or unsuccessful way
senses.definition_en: in a way that is poor, unsuccessful or not skillful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihlo takin, gualzo loin ahih kei leh siamna neilo takin.

examples.english: The team played badly in the first half.
examples.zomi: A masa khen ah pawl pen hoihlo takin kimawl hi.

examples.english: The report was badly written.
examples.zomi: Report pen hoihlo takin kigelh hi.

senses.usage_en: Badly is the usual adverb corresponding to the adjective bad: a bad performance; performed badly.
senses.usage_zomi: Badly pen adjective bad tawh kisai adverb ahi hi: a bad performance; performed badly.

senses.heading: Severely or very much
senses.definition_en: severely, seriously or very much.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasia takin ahih kei leh mahmah.

examples.english: The building was badly damaged by the fire.
examples.zomi: Innpi pen mei in nasia takin susia hi.

examples.english: She badly wanted to attend college.
examples.zomi: College kai nuam mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Before a past participle such as injured or damaged, badly often means severely.
senses.usage_zomi: Injured leh damaged bang past participle ma-ah badly kizang ciangin, nasia takin cihna nei zel hi.

senses.definition_en: a flexible container used for carrying or storing things, usually made of cloth, leather, paper or plastic.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van tawi ahih kei leh koih nadingin puan, savun, lai ahih kei leh plastic tawh a kibawl ip.

examples.english: She put the books in her bag.
examples.zomi: Laibute a ip sungah koih hi.

examples.english: We brought reusable bags to the store.
examples.zomi: Dawk ah zat nawn theih ipte ka pua uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Bag is a general word. More specific types include handbag, backpack, suitcase and shopping bag.
senses.usage_zomi: Bag pen khiatna zaizaw nei kammal ahi hi. A nam kician pawlkhat pen handbag, backpack, suitcase leh shopping bag ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: to cook food using dry heat, especially inside an oven.
senses.zomi_equivalents: oven sungah huan; mei lum tawh em
senses.explanation_zomi: Annek oven sungah, tui zang loin lumna tawh huan.

examples.english: She baked a cake for her daughter’s birthday.
examples.zomi: A tanu suah ni adingin cake khat huan hi.

examples.english: The bread is baking in the oven.
examples.zomi: Tanghou pen oven sungah kihuang hi.

senses.usage_en: Bake uses dry heat in an oven. Boil cooks in hot water, and fry cooks in hot oil or fat.
senses.usage_zomi: Bake in oven sunga lumna kang tawh an huan hi. Boil in tui sa tawh huan a, fry in sathau sa tawh huan hi.

senses.heading: A steady and equal position
senses.definition_en: a steady position in which weight is distributed so that someone or something does not fall.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat puklo dingin a gikna lang khempeuh ah a kikhawm kituak dinmun.

examples.english: She lost her balance and fell.
examples.zomi: A pumpi kiplo a, puk hi.

examples.english: The child is learning to keep his balance on a bicycle.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen lengnih tungah a pumpi kip sak dan sin hi.

senses.usage_en: Keep your balance means remaining steady. Lose your balance means becoming unsteady and possibly falling.
senses.usage_zomi: Keep your balance cihpen pumpi kip takin om cihna hi. Lose your balance cihpen pumpi kiplo a, puk theih cihna hi.

senses.heading: Money remaining in an account
senses.definition_en: the amount of money remaining in a bank account or still owed after payments.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sum omlai; leiba omlai; account balance
senses.explanation_zomi: Bank account sunga sum omlai ahih kei leh sum piak khit cianga leiba omlai.

examples.english: You can check your account balance online.
examples.zomi: Internet tungah na account sunga sum omlai na en thei hi.

examples.english: The remaining balance must be paid by Friday.
examples.zomi: Leiba omlai pen Friday ciangin pia ding hi.

senses.usage_en: A bank balance may be positive or negative depending on whether money is available or owed.
senses.usage_zomi: Bank balance pen sum a om leh positive hi a, sum leiba a om leh negative hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: a round object used in games and sports, or another object shaped like a sphere.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna ah kizang, a beem khatpeuh ahih kei leh tua bang lim nei van.

examples.english: The children threw the ball to one another.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in bawl khat leh khat kilawn uh hi.

examples.english: He kicked the ball into the goal.
examples.zomi: Bawl pen goal sungah keng tawh sut hi.

senses.usage_en: Different sports use balls of different shapes and sizes. Not every object called a ball is perfectly round.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna nam tuamtuam in a lim leh a lianzia kibanglo bawlte zang uh hi. Ball kici van khempeuh a beem sitset ahi veklo hi.

senses.definition_en: to officially state that something must not be done, used, sold or allowed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hih, zang, zuak ahih kei leh phal lo dingin ngeina kizui takin kham.

examples.english: The city banned smoking in public buildings.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in mipi innpite sungah zial dawn kham hi.

examples.english: The school banned students from using phones during examinations.
examples.zomi: Sang in sittel laitak sangnaupangte phone zat kham hi.

senses.usage_en: Use ban something or ban someone from doing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Ban something ahih kei leh ban someone from doing something cihdan zang in.

senses.definition_en: a long, curved tropical fruit with yellow skin and soft, pale flesh.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sau deuh leh a kawi, a vun eng a, a sung a nem tropical singgah.

examples.english: She ate a banana for breakfast.
examples.zomi: Zing-an in banana khat ne hi.

examples.english: The bananas are not ripe yet.
examples.zomi: Banana-te min nailo hi.

senses.usage_en: The outer skin of a banana is called its peel. The verb peel means removing that skin.
senses.usage_zomi: Banana a vun pen peel kici hi. Verb peel in tua vun hawkkhiat cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: A group of musicians
senses.definition_en: a group of people who play musical instruments together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laa tumna van tawh laa tumkhawm mi pawl.

examples.english: He plays the guitar in a local band.
examples.zomi: Khuami laa tum pawl khat sungah guitar tum hi.

examples.english: The band performed at the festival.
examples.zomi: Pawi ah laa tum pawl in laa tum uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A band usually plays instruments. A group of singers without instruments is more commonly called a choir or vocal group.
senses.usage_zomi: Band in laa tumna van zang zel hi. Laa tumna van lo in laa sa mite bek pen choir ahih kei leh vocal group kici tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: A narrow strip or ring
senses.definition_en: a narrow strip, belt or ring of material around or across something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tuam ahih kei leh kantan in a om puan, rubber, sik ahih kei leh van sau leh neu.

examples.english: She tied the papers together with a rubber band.
examples.zomi: Laite rubber kual tawh henkhawm hi.

examples.english: The hat has a red band around it.
examples.zomi: Lukhu kimah tuam san khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, band describes a narrow strip or ring rather than a music group.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah band in laa tum pawl hilo in, van sau neu ahih kei leh kual khat gen hi.

senses.definition_en: a business that keeps, lends, receives and transfers money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum kem, leitawi pia, saang leh mun khat pan mun khat ah sum khak nasepna sem sumleina pawl.

examples.english: She deposited the money in her bank account.
examples.zomi: Sum pen a bank account sungah koih hi.

examples.english: The bank approved their home loan.
examples.zomi: Bank in amau inn lei ding sum leitawi thukim hi.

senses.usage_en: A bank provides financial services. Do not confuse it with the bank beside a river.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih bank pen sum tawh kisai nasepna pia pawl ahi hi. Gun gei bank tawh helkhawm kei in.

senses.definition_en: the land along the side of a river, stream or other body of water.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gun, gunneute ahih kei leh tui omna a gei lei.

examples.english: They sat on the river bank and watched the water.
examples.zomi: Gungei ah tu a, tui en uh hi.

examples.english: Trees grow along both banks of the river.
examples.zomi: Gun langnih gei-ah singkungte po hi.

senses.usage_en: A river has two banks, one on each side. This meaning is unrelated to a financial bank.
senses.usage_zomi: Gun khat in langnih ah gei nih nei hi. Hih khiatna pen sum tawh kisai bank tawh kizomlo hi.

senses.heading: A place where alcoholic drinks are served
senses.definition_en: a place or counter where alcoholic drinks and sometimes food are sold and served.
senses.zomi_equivalents: zu dawnna mun; zu zuakna mun
senses.explanation_zomi: Zu leh dawnna dang, a khatvei ciang annek zong kizuak leh kipia mun ahih kei leh sabuai.

common_phrases.zomi: kimawlna en kawm zu dawnna mun

examples.english: They met at a bar near the hotel.
examples.zomi: Hotel nai zu dawnna mun khat ah kimu uh hi.

examples.english: The bar also serves food.
examples.zomi: Zu dawnna mun in annek zong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A bar may mean the entire business or the long counter where drinks are served.
senses.usage_zomi: Bar in zu zuakna mun a vekpi ahih kei leh dawnna kipia sabuai sau gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A long, solid piece of material
senses.definition_en: a long, narrow and solid piece of metal, wood, chocolate or another material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sik, sing, chocolate ahih kei leh van dang tawh a kibawl, a sau leh a khauh van khen.

examples.english: The window was protected by metal bars.
examples.zomi: Kong-awi pen sik tangte tawh kidal hi.

examples.english: She bought a bar of soap.
examples.zomi: Sabun tang khat lei hi.

senses.usage_en: The material or item normally follows a bar of: a bar of chocolate, a bar of soap.
senses.usage_zomi: Bang tawh kibawl hiam ahih kei leh bang van hiam cih a bar of nungah hong pai hi: a bar of chocolate, a bar of soap.

senses.definition_en: something that blocks movement, prevents access or makes progress difficult.
senses.explanation_zomi: Paina daal, lutna khaktan ahih kei leh mainawtna haksasak na.

examples.english: The fence forms a barrier around the property.
examples.zomi: Kulh in neihsa mun kimah daalna bawl hi.

examples.english: Language can be a barrier to communication.
examples.zomi: Pau kilamdanna in kihopihna daal thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A barrier may be a physical object or a nonphysical difficulty, such as cost, language or lack of information.
senses.usage_zomi: Barrier pen pumpi tawh muh theih daalna hi thei a, sum, pau kilamdanna ahih kei leh thutheihna neihlohna bang haksatna zong hi thei hi.

senses.heading: The bottom or supporting part
senses.definition_en: the lowest part of something on which the rest stands or is supported.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a nuailam khen, a dangte a tungah ding ahih kei leh kinga sak.

examples.english: They built a shelter at the base of the mountain.
examples.zomi: Mual bulah buk khat lam uh hi.

examples.english: The lamp has a heavy metal base.
examples.zomi: Mei-inn in sik gik kiphuhna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: The base supports the rest of an object. The top is the opposite end.
senses.usage_zomi: Base in van a dangte kinga sak hi. A langkhat pen a tunglam ahi hi.

senses.heading: A main place of operation
senses.definition_en: the main place from which a person, organization or military group operates.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl ahih kei leh galkap pawl in amau nasep a kipat sak uh munpi.

examples.english: The organization has its main base in Columbus.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi nasepna munpi Columbus ah om hi.

examples.english: The aircraft returned to the military base.
examples.zomi: Vanleng pen galkap phualpi ah kik hi.

senses.usage_en: A base may be permanent or temporary and may serve civilian, scientific or military work.
senses.usage_zomi: Base pen a tawntung ahih kei leh tawmvei sung nasepna mun hi thei a, mipi, science ahih kei leh galkap nasepna ading hi thei hi.

senses.heading: A foundation for an idea or system
senses.definition_en: the main idea, fact or structure on which something is developed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, thu ahih kei leh system khat a kiphuhna bulpi.

examples.english: Education provides a strong base for future success.
examples.zomi: Pilna in mailam gualzawhna adingin kiphuhna kip pia hi.

examples.english: The policy has a sound scientific base.
examples.zomi: Thukhun pen science teci hoih tungah kiphut hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, base means the foundation from which something develops.
senses.usage_zomi: Lim tawh gen hih khiatna ah base in na khat a khantohna kiphuhna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: a game in which two teams take turns hitting a ball with a bat and running around four bases.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl nih in a kikheng in stick tawh bawl sat a, base li kiim taai in a kimawl kimawlna.

examples.english: The children play baseball after school.
examples.zomi: Naupangte sang khit ciangin baseball kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: He joined the school baseball team.
examples.zomi: Sang baseball pawl sungah pang hi.

senses.usage_en: Baseball may mean the sport or the ball used in that sport. It is especially popular in the United States, Japan, Korea and parts of Latin America.
senses.usage_zomi: Baseball in kimawlna ahih kei leh tua kimawlna ah kizang bawl gen thei hi. United States, Japan, Korea leh Latin America mun pawlkhat ah kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: Located or operating in a place
senses.definition_en: having a main home, office or center of operations in a particular place.
senses.zomi_equivalents: munah kiphut; munah nasepna bul nei
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn, office ahih kei leh nasepna munpi mun kician khat ah nei.

examples.english: She works for a Columbus-based organization.
examples.zomi: Columbus-a kiphut pawlpi khat adingin sem hi.

examples.english: They operate a home-based business.
examples.zomi: Inn-a kiphut sumleina nasepna nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A place name and based are normally hyphenated before a noun: a Columbus-based company.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun min leh based pen noun ma-ah kizangkhawm ciangin hyphen tawh kizom zel hi: a Columbus-based company.

senses.heading: Developed from particular information or ideas
senses.definition_en: using particular facts, evidence, ideas or materials as a foundation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thuman, teci, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh van khat tungah kiphut a, tua pan kibawl.

examples.english: The decision was based on clear evidence.
examples.zomi: Thu khensatna pen teci kician tungah kiphut hi.

examples.english: This course uses a research-based teaching method.
examples.zomi: Hih course in zongkhiatna tungah kiphut laihilhdan zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use based on, not normally based from, when identifying the foundation or source.
senses.usage_zomi: Bulphuhna ahih kei leh thu bul gen leh based on zang in. A ngeina in based from ci kei in.

senses.heading: Fundamental or most important
senses.definition_en: forming the main foundation or most necessary part of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kiphuhna bulpi ahih kei leh a kisappen khen.

examples.english: Food, water and shelter are basic human needs.
examples.zomi: An, tui leh teenna mun pen mihing kisapna bulpite ahi hi.

examples.english: The course teaches basic computer skills.
examples.zomi: Course in computer siamna bulpite hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, basic means essential or foundational, not unimportant.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah basic in a thupi lo cihna hilo in, a kisam leh a kiphuhna ahi cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: Simple and not advanced
senses.definition_en: simple, limited or intended for beginners.
senses.explanation_zomi: Baih a, tan sang hilo ahih kei leh a kipan thakte ading.

examples.english: The application offers a basic free version.
examples.zomi: Application in version baih man neilo khat pia hi.

examples.english: Students begin with basic grammar.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte grammar a kipatna pan sin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Basic may neutrally mean simple, but in informal speech it can sometimes suggest that something lacks originality or quality.
senses.usage_zomi: Basic in a ngeina in baih cihna nei hi. Ahih hangin ngeina kizui hetlo kiholimna ah khatvei ciang thaklo ahih kei leh hoihna niam cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: In the most important or fundamental way
senses.definition_en: when only the most important or fundamental facts are considered.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a bulpina in; a thupipen ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu a bulpi leh a thupipen bek ngaihsun ciangin.

examples.english: The two proposals are basically the same.
examples.zomi: Thupiakna nih a bulpina in kibang hi.

examples.english: Your answer is basically correct, but it needs more detail.
examples.zomi: Na dawnna a thupipen ah maan napi, thu kicianzaw behlap kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Basically removes less important details and focuses on the central fact or idea.
senses.usage_zomi: Basically in thu neute paihkhiat a, thu bulpi ahih kei leh ngaihsutna thupipen tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: Used to give a simple explanation
senses.definition_en: used to introduce a simple summary or explanation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tom takin gen leng; baih takin gen leng
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat tom leh baih takin hilhcian kipat nadingin kizang.

examples.english: Basically, the application helps people manage their money.
examples.zomi: Tom takin gen leng, application in mite amau sum vaihawm nading huh hi.

examples.english: The machine basically works by heating water.
examples.zomi: A sepdana baih takin gen leng, van in tui lum sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Basically is common in conversation. In formal writing, a more precise explanation may be preferable.
senses.usage_zomi: Basically pen kiholimna ah kizang tam hi. Ngeina kizui laigelhna ah thugen kicianzaw zat hoihzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: A foundation for something
senses.definition_en: the main fact, idea or principle on which something is developed or decided.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, ngaihsutna, geelna ahih kei leh thu khensatna a kiphuhna bulpi.

examples.english: The decision has a strong legal basis.
examples.zomi: Thu khensatna in thukham kiphuhna kip nei hi.

examples.english: Trust is the basis of a healthy relationship.
examples.zomi: Kimuanna pen kizopna hoih kiphuhna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the basis of something and the basis for a decision, action or claim.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a kiphuhna gen leh the basis of zang in. Thu khensatna, nasep ahih kei leh thugen kiphuhna gen leh the basis for zang in.

senses.heading: A regular system or frequency
senses.definition_en: the way or frequency with which something is organized or done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep khat bang hun danin ahih kei leh bang vaihawmdan tawh kihi hiam cih.

examples.english: The equipment is checked on a daily basis.
examples.zomi: Van pen ni sim kicien hi.

examples.english: She works from home on a temporary basis.
examples.zomi: Tawmvei sung inn pan sem hi.

senses.usage_en: Expressions such as on a daily basis are often more simply written as daily.
senses.usage_zomi: On a daily basis bang thugen pen daily ci-in tomzaw leh kicianzaw in gelh theih hi.

senses.definition_en: a game in which two teams try to score by throwing a ball through a raised circular net.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl nih in bawl a kikheng in kisa a, a sangah a kikhai kualnei net sungah lawn lut dingin a kimawl kimawlna.

examples.english: The students play basketball after school.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte sang khit ciangin basketball kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: She joined the college basketball team.
examples.zomi: College basketball pawl sungah pang hi.

senses.usage_en: Basketball may refer to the sport or to the ball used in the sport.
senses.usage_zomi: Basketball in kimawlna ahih kei leh tua kimawlna ah kizang bawl gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: the act of washing the body in water, especially while sitting or lying in a container filled with water.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi siangtho nadingin tui sungah tu ahih kei leh lum a, tui kisilna.

examples.english: The child took a warm bath before bed.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen ihmut ma-in tui lum tawh kisil hi.

examples.english: She gave the baby a bath.
examples.zomi: Naungek tui silsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, say take a bath. In British English, have a bath is also common. A bath usually involves sitting in water; a shower uses falling water.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah take a bath ci ding hi. British English ah have a bath zong kizang tam hi. Bath in tui sungah tu in kisilna gen zel a, shower in tung pan hong luang tui tawh kisilna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: a room containing a toilet and usually a sink, bathtub or shower.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ekbuk leh a tamzaw in khut silna tui-um, tui kisilna bual ahih kei leh shower a omna innkhaan.

examples.english: The bathroom is at the end of the hall.
examples.zomi: Ekbuk innkhaan pen innlai lampi tawpah om hi.

examples.english: May I use your bathroom?
examples.zomi: Na ekbuk ka zang thei diam?

senses.usage_en: In American English, bathroom is a polite general word for a room with a toilet, even if it has no bathtub. British English commonly uses toilet or loo.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah bathtub omlo napi, ekbuk nei innkhaan pen zahtakna tawh bathroom kici hi. British English ah toilet ahih kei leh loo kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: a device that stores chemical energy and supplies electrical power.
senses.explanation_zomi: Chemical tha kem a, electric tha pia van.

examples.english: My phone battery is almost empty.
examples.zomi: Ka phone battery bei dektak hi.

examples.english: This device uses two small batteries.
examples.zomi: Hih van in battery neu nih zang hi.

senses.usage_en: A battery may be disposable or rechargeable. In everyday English, battery is dead means it no longer has enough electrical power.
senses.usage_zomi: Battery pen zatkhin cianga kipai hi thei a, charge nawn theih zong hi thei hi. Nisim English ah battery is dead cihpen electric tha kicing neilo cihna hi.

senses.heading: A fight between armed forces
senses.definition_en: a fight between armies or armed groups as part of a war.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidouna sungah galkap ahih kei leh galvan nei pawl nih a kidona uh.

examples.english: Many soldiers were killed in the battle.
examples.zomi: Gal kidona ah galkap tampi si uh hi.

examples.english: The battle continued for three days.
examples.zomi: Gal kidona ni thum sung kizom hi.

senses.usage_en: A battle is one particular period or event within a larger war.
senses.usage_zomi: Battle pen kidouna lianzaw sung a kidona hun ahih kei leh thu piang khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: A difficult struggle
senses.definition_en: a long or difficult effort to solve a problem, defeat an illness or achieve something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina veng, natna zo ahih kei leh ngiimna tangtun nading sawt leh haksa takin hanciamna.

examples.english: She won her long battle against cancer.
examples.zomi: Cancer natna tawh sawt takin a kidona ah gualzo hi.

examples.english: Reducing poverty is a difficult battle.
examples.zomi: Zawngkhalna khiamna pen hanciamna haksa khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes a serious struggle, not necessarily physical fighting.
senses.usage_zomi: Lim tawh gen hih khiatna ah pumpi tawh kidona kisamlo a, buaina khat tawh hanciamna thupi gen hi.

senses.heading: Exist or have a particular identity
senses.definition_en: to exist or to identify someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Om ahih kei leh mi/na khat bang ahi hiam cih lak.

examples.english: She wants to be a doctor.
examples.zomi: Siavuan hi nuam hi.

examples.english: There will be a meeting tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing kikhopna khat om ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Be is highly irregular. Its common forms are am, is, are, was, were, being and been.
senses.usage_zomi: Be pen verb form kikhel dan ngeina lo khat ahi hi. A form kizang tamte pen am, is, are, was, were, being leh been ahi hi.

senses.heading: Describe a condition or quality
senses.definition_en: to connect a subject with a condition, quality, place or description.
senses.explanation_zomi: Subject khat a dinmun, omzia, omna ahih kei leh hilhcian na tawh zom.

examples.english: The children are ready for school.
examples.zomi: Naupangte sang kai dingin kigingsa uh hi.

examples.english: The documents were on the table.
examples.zomi: Laite sabuai tungah om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Be is used as both a main verb and an auxiliary verb. As an auxiliary, it forms continuous and passive constructions.
senses.usage_zomi: Be pen main verb leh auxiliary verb gel in kizang hi. Auxiliary in kizang ciangin continuous leh passive construction bawl hi.

senses.definition_en: an area of sand or small stones beside the sea, a lake or a wide river.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuipi, bualpi ahih kei leh gun lian gei-a sehnel ahih kei leh suang neute tawh kidim mun.

examples.english: The children played on the beach.
examples.zomi: Naupangte tuipi gei sehnel tungah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: We walked along the beach at sunset.
examples.zomi: Ni tum laitak tuipi gei zui in ka lampai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A beach may be beside an ocean, sea, lake or large river. It is not limited to the ocean.
senses.usage_zomi: Beach pen tuipi gei bek hilo in, bualpi ahih kei leh gun lian gei zong hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: an edible seed, usually shaped like a small oval, that grows inside a long pod.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ak hawk sungah a po, a tamzaw in a oval bang lim nei leh nek theih tang.

examples.english: She cooked beans with rice.
examples.zomi: Buhu tawh be huan hi.

examples.english: Beans are a useful source of protein.
examples.zomi: Be pen protein ngahna phattuam khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Bean may refer to the seed or, for some varieties, the whole edible pod.
senses.usage_zomi: Bean in be tang ahih kei leh be nam pawlkhat adingin a hawk tawh nek theih be a vekpi gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: a large, strong wild animal with thick fur, a short tail and powerful legs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mul thah nei, a mei tom, a khe thahat leh a pumpi lian gamlak ganhing khat.

examples.english: The hikers saw a bear near the forest.
examples.zomi: Mual kaite in gam nai-ah bear khat mu uh hi.

examples.english: Bears usually search for food before winter.
examples.zomi: Bear-te phalbi ma-in an zong zel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is bears. Different species include brown bears, black bears and polar bears.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural pen bears ahi hi. Bear nam tuamtuam lakah brown bear, black bear leh polar bear om hi.

senses.definition_en: to accept, deal with or endure something difficult, painful or unpleasant.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna, natna ahih kei leh nuamlohna khat thuak a, zo.

examples.english: She could not bear the pain any longer.
examples.zomi: Natna thuakzawh nawnlo hi.

examples.english: He had to bear the consequences of his decision.
examples.zomi: A thu khensatna gah thuak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is bore, and the past participle is borne: She has borne many difficulties. The form born is used mainly for birth.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen bore hi a, past participle pen borne ahi hi: She has borne many difficulties. Born pen a tamzaw in suahna tawh kisai in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Hit repeatedly
senses.definition_en: to hit someone or something repeatedly and forcefully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat thahat takin veitam sat/vuak.

examples.english: The musician beat the drum loudly.
examples.zomi: Laa tum siampa in drum aw ngai takin tum hi.

examples.english: Beat the eggs until they are smooth.
examples.zomi: Aktui-te a nem kituak dong tok in.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are both beat: beat–beat–beaten is wrong for the past participle; the correct forms are beat–beat–beaten—the base and past are beat, while the participle is beaten.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb form-te pen beat–beat–beaten ahi hi. Base form leh past tense beat kibang a, past participle pen beaten ahi hi.

senses.heading: Defeat someone
senses.definition_en: to defeat a person or team in a competition, election or game.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna, vote piakna ahih kei leh kimawlna ah mi/pawl dang guallel sak.

examples.english: Our team beat the champions by two points.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl un gualzo pawl point nih tawh zo uh hi.

examples.english: She beat her opponent in the final match.
examples.zomi: A tawpna kidemna ah a kidemgual zo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use beat a person or team, but win a game, competition or prize.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat zohna ah beat zang in. Kimawlna, kidemna ahih kei leh kipahman ngahna ah win zang in.

senses.heading: Have a regular rhythm
senses.definition_en: to move or make a sound with a regular rhythm, especially the heart.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun kizom kituak tawh gamta ahih kei leh awging pia, a diak in lungsim.

examples.english: Her heart was beating quickly.
examples.zomi: A lungsim manlang takin tung hi.

examples.english: The music has a strong beat.
examples.zomi: Laa in awging kizom thahat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: As a verb, beat describes rhythmic movement. As a noun, a beat is one rhythmic movement or sound.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb in kizang beat in hun kizom tawh gamtatna gen hi. Noun a beat in gamtatna ahih kei leh awging khatvei gen hi.

senses.definition_en: very pleasing to see, hear or experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muh, zak ahih kei leh phut cianga nuam leh hoih mahmah.

examples.english: The mountains are beautiful in the morning light.
examples.zomi: Zingsang khuavak ah mualte hoih mahmah hi.

examples.english: She has a beautiful singing voice.
examples.zomi: Laa sakna aw ngai nuam nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Beautiful is stronger than pretty and can describe people, places, sounds, ideas and experiences.
senses.usage_zomi: Beautiful pen pretty sangin khiatna thahatzaw nei a, mi, mun, awging, ngaihsutna leh phutkhakna gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: the quality of being beautiful or giving pleasure to the senses or mind.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muh, zak ahih kei leh ngaihsut cianga lungsim nuamsak hoihna.

examples.english: Visitors admire the natural beauty of the region.
examples.zomi: Zinmite in tua gam khen pianpih hoihna pahtawi uh hi.

examples.english: Kindness is an important part of inner beauty.
examples.zomi: Hehpihna pen lungsim sung hoihna khen thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Beauty is usually uncountable when referring to the quality of being beautiful. It can be countable when referring to a beautiful person or example, but that use requires careful context.
senses.usage_zomi: Hoihna omzia gen ciangin beauty pen a tamzaw in uncountable noun hi. Mi melhoih ahih kei leh entawn huai hoih khat gen ciangin countable hi thei napi, a kimkot thu kidawm takin en kul hi.

senses.definition_en: used to introduce the reason why something happens or is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat banghangin piang ahih kei leh a man hiam cih a hang gen kipat nadingin kizang.

examples.english: We stayed home because it was raining.
examples.zomi: Guah zu ahih manin inn ah ka om uh hi.

examples.english: She succeeded because she worked hard.
examples.zomi: Hahkat takin a sep manin gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: Because is followed by a clause. Because of is followed by a noun or noun phrase: because it rained; because of the rain.
senses.usage_zomi: Because nungah clause hong pai hi. Because of nungah noun ahih kei leh noun phrase hong pai hi: because it rained; because of the rain.

senses.definition_en: to begin to be something or to develop into a new condition, role or state.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, omzia ahih kei leh hihna thak khat hong nei; hong suak.

examples.english: She became a doctor after years of study.
examples.zomi: Kum tampi lai sin khit ciangin siavuan hong suak hi.

examples.english: The weather became colder during the night.
examples.zomi: Zan sung khuahun dai zaw hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is became, and the past participle is become. Become is followed by a noun or adjective.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen became hi a, past participle pen become ahi hi. Become nungah noun ahih kei leh adjective hong pai hi.

senses.definition_en: a piece of furniture designed for sleeping or resting.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ihmut ahih kei leh tawlngak nadingin a kibawl inn van.

examples.english: The child went to bed at eight o’clock.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen dak giat in ihmut dingin lum hi.

examples.english: She sat on the edge of the bed.
examples.zomi: Lupna gei-ah tu hi.

senses.usage_en: Say go to bed when referring to the purpose of sleeping. Use the bed when referring to the physical object: sit on the bed.
senses.usage_zomi: Ihmut ding paina gen leh article koih loin go to bed ci ding hi. Lupna van taktak gen leh the bed zang in: sit on the bed.

senses.definition_en: a room used mainly for sleeping.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in ihmut nadingin kizang innkhaan.

examples.english: The apartment has two bedrooms.
examples.zomi: Apartment ah ihna innkhaan nih om hi.

examples.english: She painted the bedroom light blue.
examples.zomi: Ihna innkhaan pen blue vang tawh zut hi.

senses.usage_en: Bedroom describes the room. Bed describes the furniture used for sleeping.
senses.usage_zomi: Bedroom pen innkhaan gen hi. Bed pen ihmut nading van gen hi.

senses.definition_en: a flying insect that collects nectar and pollen from flowers; some kinds produce honey and can sting.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pak pan nek leh pakvui zongin a leng, nam pawlkhat khuaizu bawl a, sun thei khuai.

examples.english: Bees were flying around the flowers.
examples.zomi: Pakte kimah khuai leng uh hi.

examples.english: A bee stung him on the hand.
examples.zomi: Khuai in a khut sung hi.

senses.usage_en: Bees are important pollinators. Do not confuse a bee with a wasp, which generally has a thinner body and does not produce honey.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuai in singkung leh pakte gah nadingin panpih hi. Pumpi zaangzaw leh khuaizu bawllo wasp tawh helkhawm loh ding hi.

senses.definition_en: meat from a cow or other adult cattle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawng ahih kei leh bawng nam gan picing sa.

examples.english: They cooked beef with vegetables.
examples.zomi: Bawngsa nawhte tawh huan uh hi.

examples.english: This restaurant does not serve beef.
examples.zomi: Hih anzuakna mun in bawngsa zuaklo hi.

senses.usage_en: Beef is normally uncountable when referring to meat. A living animal is a cow, bull or cattle, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Sa gen ciangin beef pen a tamzaw in uncountable noun hi. Nungta gan pen a kimkot thu dungzui in cow, bull ahih kei leh cattle kici hi.

senses.definition_en: an alcoholic drink usually made from grain, water, hops and yeast.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in buh nam, tui, hops leh yeast tawh a kibawl alcohol nei zu dawnna.

examples.english: The restaurant serves several kinds of beer.
examples.zomi: Anzuakna mun in beer nam pawlkhat pia hi.

examples.english: He decided to stop drinking beer.
examples.zomi: Beer dawn tawpsan dingin khensat hi.

senses.usage_en: Beer may be uncountable when referring generally to the drink and countable when referring to servings or types: some beer; two beers.
senses.usage_zomi: Beer dawnna a zaizaw in gen ciangin beer pen uncountable hi thei a, hai nih ahih kei leh nam nih gen ciangin countable hi thei hi: some beer; two beers.

senses.heading: Earlier than a time or event
senses.definition_en: earlier than a particular time, event or action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, thu piang ahih kei leh nasep khat ma-in.

examples.english: Please arrive before ten o’clock.
examples.zomi: Dak sawm ma-in hong tung in.

examples.english: Wash your hands before eating.
examples.zomi: An na nek ma-in na khut sawp in.

senses.usage_en: Before is followed by a noun, pronoun or -ing form. Beforehand is used when no object follows.
senses.usage_zomi: Before nungah noun, pronoun ahih kei leh -ing form hong pai hi. A nungah object omlo leh beforehand zang in.

senses.heading: In front of or in the presence of
senses.definition_en: in front of someone or something, especially in a formal situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat mai-ah, a diak in ngeina kizui dinmun ah.

examples.english: He appeared before the judge on Monday.
examples.zomi: Monday ni thukhenpa mai-ah pai hi.

examples.english: She spoke before a large audience.
examples.zomi: Mipi tampi mai-ah thugen hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning of before is formal and often describes appearing in front of a court, committee or audience.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih before zatdan pen ngeina kizui hi a, court, committee ahih kei leh mipi mai-ah kilakna gen tam hi.

senses.heading: Ask urgently or emotionally
senses.definition_en: to ask someone very strongly or emotionally to do or give something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat na khat hih ahih kei leh pia dingin lungsim takpi leh thupi takin ngen.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat om lai dingin ngen

examples.english: She begged them to give her another chance.
examples.zomi: Hunlem khat dang pia dingin amaute thupi takin ngen hi.

examples.english: He begged for forgiveness.
examples.zomi: Ngaihdamna ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: Use beg someone to do something and beg for something.
senses.usage_zomi: Beg someone to do something leh beg for something cihdan zang in.

senses.heading: Ask strangers for food or money
senses.definition_en: to ask people for food or money because of poverty or urgent need.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zawngkhalna ahih kei leh kisapna nasia hangin mite tungah an ahih kei leh sum ngen.

examples.english: The man was begging for food near the station.
examples.zomi: Station nai-ah pasal in an ngen hi.

examples.english: The program helps children who beg on the streets.
examples.zomi: Program in lampi gei-a khutdoh naupangte huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Referring to a person as a beggar can sound judgmental. When possible, describe the person’s situation more respectfully and precisely.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a beggar ci-in sapna in simmawhna bangin ging thei hi. Hithei leh tua mi dinmun zahtakna leh kician takin gen hoihzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: to start doing something or to start happening.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep khat hih kipan ahih kei leh thu khat piang kipan.

examples.english: The meeting will begin at nine o’clock.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna dak kua in kipan ding hi.

examples.english: She began learning English at school.
examples.zomi: Sang ah English sin kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is began, and the past participle is begun. Both begin to do and begin doing are normally possible.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen began hi a, past participle pen begun ahi hi. Begin to do leh begin doing cihdan gel a ngeina in zang theih hi.

senses.heading: The time or place where something starts
senses.definition_en: the point in time or place at which something starts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, nasep, hun ahih kei leh na khat a kipatna.

examples.english: The beginning of the book was interesting.
examples.zomi: Laibu kipatna lunglut huai hi.

examples.english: Please explain the story from the beginning.
examples.zomi: Tangthu a kipatna pan hong hilhcian in.

senses.usage_en: Use the beginning of something: the beginning of the meeting. In the beginning often refers to the earliest stage of a long story or period.
senses.usage_zomi: The beginning of something cihdan zang in: the beginning of the meeting. In the beginning in tangthu ahih kei leh hun saau khat a kipatna masa mahmah gen zel hi.

senses.heading: The early part of something
senses.definition_en: the first or early stage of an activity, development or period.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kipat lam; a tan masa
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, khantohna ahih kei leh hun khat a tan masate.

examples.english: The new job marked a new beginning in her life.
examples.zomi: Nasepna thak in a nuntakna kipatna thak khat ciamteh hi.

examples.english: The company grew from a small beginning.
examples.zomi: Company pen kipatna neu khat pan khangto hi.

senses.usage_en: A new beginning means starting a new stage after an earlier situation has ended or changed.
senses.usage_zomi: A new beginning cihpen dinmun masa tawp ahih kei leh kikhel khit nuntakna tan thak kipan cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: to act in a particular way, especially in relation to rules or other people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun leh midangte tawh kizopna ah gamtatdan tuam khat tawh gamta.

examples.english: The children behaved well during the ceremony.
examples.zomi: Pawlkhop laitak naupangte hoih takin gamta uh hi.

examples.english: Students are expected to behave respectfully.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte zahtakna tawh gamta dingin kilamen hi.

senses.usage_en: Behave yourself is often said to a child or another person as an instruction to act properly.
senses.usage_zomi: Behave yourself pen naupang ahih kei leh mi khat tungah hoih takin gamta ding thupiakna in kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: the way a person, animal or organization acts, especially toward others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing ahih kei leh pawl khat a gamtatdan, a diak in midangte tungah a gamtatna.

examples.english: The teacher praised the child’s good behaviour.
examples.zomi: Sia in naupang gamtatna hoih phat hi.

examples.english: The policy is intended to prevent harmful behaviour.
examples.zomi: Thukhun pen siatna pia gamtatna khaktan nadingin kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Behaviour is the British spelling. Behavior is the standard American spelling. It is normally uncountable when referring generally to how someone acts.
senses.usage_zomi: Behaviour pen British English gelhdan hi. Behavior pen American English gelhdan standard ahi hi. Mi khat a gamtatdan a zaizaw in gen ciangin uncountable noun hi zel hi.

senses.heading: At the back of someone or something
senses.definition_en: at or toward the back of a person, object or place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van ahih kei leh mun khat nungah ahih kei leh nunglamah.

examples.english: The garden is behind the house.
examples.zomi: Huan pen inn nungah om hi.

examples.english: She stood behind me in the line.
examples.zomi: Kizomna ah ka nungah ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Behind describes a position at the back. Its opposite is in front of.
senses.usage_zomi: Behind in nunglam omna gen hi. A langkhat pen in front of ahi hi.

senses.heading: Later or less advanced than
senses.definition_en: later than a schedule or less advanced than another person or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun sehpiasa sangin nungzaw ahih kei leh mi/pawl dang sangin khantohna niamzaw.

examples.english: The project is two weeks behind schedule.
examples.zomi: Project pen hun geel sangin nipi nih nungzaw hi.

examples.english: He fell behind in his schoolwork.
examples.zomi: A sang nasepna ah nung hong tang hi.

senses.usage_en: Behind schedule means later than planned. Behind in work means that expected work has not been completed.
senses.usage_zomi: Behind schedule cihpen hun sehpiasa sangin nungzaw cihna hi. Behind in work cihpen zoh ding nasep zo nailo cihna hi.

senses.heading: A living creature
senses.definition_en: a living person, animal or other creature.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nungta mi, ganhing ahih kei leh nungta dang khat.

examples.english: Every human being deserves respect.
examples.zomi: Mihing khempeuh zahtakna ngah taak hi.

examples.english: Scientists continue to search for living beings beyond Earth.
examples.zomi: Science siamte in leitung pua-ah nungta om hiam ci-in zong paisuak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Human being is a formal or emphatic way of saying person.
senses.usage_zomi: Human being pen person cihna ngeina kizui zaw ahih kei leh thupisakna tawh genna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Existence
senses.definition_en: the state of existing or living.
senses.explanation_zomi: Omna ahih kei leh nuntakna dinmun.

examples.english: The organization came into being in 2010.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi pen 2010 kum in hong om kipan hi.

examples.english: The law brought a new system into being.
examples.zomi: Thukham in system thak khat om sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Come into being means beginning to exist.
senses.usage_zomi: Come into being cihpen hong om kipan cihna hi.

senses.heading: Acceptance that something is true
senses.definition_en: the feeling or opinion that something is true, even when complete proof may not be available.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci kicing om hetlo thei napi, thu khat a man hi ci-in up/pomna.

examples.english: She has a strong belief that education can change lives.
examples.zomi: Pilna in nuntakna kheek thei hi cih upna thahat nei hi.

examples.english: The evidence challenged their earlier belief.
examples.zomi: Teci in amau upna masa dotna piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use belief in a person, idea or system and belief that + clause for a statement considered true.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh system upna gen leh belief in zang in. Thu khat man hi cih gen leh belief that + clause zang in.

senses.heading: A religious conviction
senses.definition_en: an idea or teaching accepted as true as part of a religion or faith.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna ahih kei leh upna sunga a man hi ci-in kisaang thuhilhna/ngaihsutna.

examples.english: The students discussed different religious beliefs.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte biakna upna tuamtuam kikum uh hi.

examples.english: Everyone has the right to express their beliefs peacefully.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in amau upna lungnop takin gen theihna nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Belief may be countable when referring to a particular teaching and uncountable when referring generally to faith or trust.
senses.usage_zomi: Thuhilhna khat kician gen ciangin belief pen countable hi thei a, upna a zaizaw in gen ciangin uncountable hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Accept something as true
senses.definition_en: to accept that something is true, especially without complete proof.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a man hi ci-in up/pom.

examples.english: I believe that she is telling the truth.
examples.zomi: Amah thuman gen hi ci-in ka up hi.

examples.english: Do not believe everything you read online.
examples.zomi: Internet tungah na sim khempeuh up kei in.

senses.usage_en: Believe someone means accepting that the person is telling the truth. Believe in someone means trusting that person’s ability or character.
senses.usage_zomi: Believe someone cihpen tua mi thuman gen hi ci-in up cihna hi. Believe in someone cihpen tua mi siamna ahih kei leh omzia muang cihna hi.

senses.heading: Have faith or trust in
senses.definition_en: to have religious faith in someone or something, or confidence in a person’s ability.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna upna tawh up ahih kei leh mi khat siamna leh omzia muang.

examples.english: Christians believe in Pasian.
examples.zomi: Khazih mite in Pasian um uh hi.

examples.english: You must believe in your ability to improve.
examples.zomi: Na hoihzaw theih nading na siamna na muang kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Use believe in for religious faith, confidence in someone or support for an idea or system.
senses.usage_zomi: Biakna upna, mi khat muanna ahih kei leh ngaihsutna/system khat panpihna gen leh believe in zang in.

senses.definition_en: a hollow metal object that makes a ringing sound when struck or moved.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisat ahih kei leh kiliing cianga aw ging a, a sung a awng sik van.

examples.english: The school bell rang at eight o’clock.
examples.zomi: Dak giat in sang dak ging hi.

examples.english: Someone rang the doorbell.
examples.zomi: Mi khat in kongkhak dak meek hi.

senses.usage_en: A bell is the sound-making object. The verb ring describes making the bell sound.
senses.usage_zomi: Bell pen awging pia van ahi hi. Ring pen dak ging sakna gen hi.

senses.heading: Be owned by someone
senses.definition_en: to be the property of a particular person, group or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl ahih kei leh organization khat neihsa hi.

examples.english: This book belongs to the library.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu pen laibuk neihsa ahi hi.

examples.english: Who does this bag belong to?
examples.zomi: Hih ip kua neihsa ahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use belong to, not belong with, when identifying an owner. Belong is not normally used in continuous forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Neipa gen leh belong to zang in; belong with zang kei in. Belong pen continuous form in kizang ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Be a member or fit naturally
senses.definition_en: to be a member of a group or to feel accepted and suitable in a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat sung mi hi ahih kei leh mun khat ah kituak leh kisaang in om.

examples.english: She belongs to a professional association.
examples.zomi: Nasep siamte pawlpi sungah pang hi.

examples.english: The welcoming community helped us feel that we belonged.
examples.zomi: Khawtang hong saang nuamhuaina in pawl sung mi ka kicih theih nading uh huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Belong to a group means being a member. Feel that you belong refers to acceptance and social connection.
senses.usage_zomi: Belong to a group cihpen pawl sung mi hi cihna hi. Feel that you belong cihpen kisaang leh kipawltheih sa cihna hi.

senses.heading: In or to a lower position
senses.definition_en: in or to a position lower than another person or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na dang khat sangin a niamzaw ah ahih kei leh nuailam ah.

examples.english: The valley lies below.
examples.zomi: Guam pen a nuai-ah om hi.

examples.english: We could hear voices from below.
examples.zomi: A nuai pan awgingte ka za uh hi.

senses.usage_en: As an adverb, below has no object. As a preposition, it is followed by a noun: below the window.
senses.usage_zomi: Adverb in kizang ciangin below in object neilo hi. Preposition in kizang ciangin noun in zui hi: below the window.

senses.heading: Later in a text or list
senses.definition_en: in a later part of a page, document, message or list.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, document, thupuak ahih kei leh laigelhna a nuailam khenah.

examples.english: The required documents are listed below.
examples.zomi: Kisam document-te a nuai-ah kigelh hi.

examples.english: See below for more information.
examples.zomi: Thutheihna tamzaw adingin a nuai en in.

senses.usage_en: In documents, below refers to information appearing later or lower on the page.
senses.usage_zomi: Document ah below in laimai a nuailam ahih kei leh a nung lamah a om thutheihna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: a long, narrow strip worn around the waist to hold clothing in place or for decoration.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan silh kip sak ahih kei leh kizep nadingin kawngah a kihen van sau leh neu.

examples.english: He wore a black leather belt.
examples.zomi: Savun kawnggak vom khat gag hi.

examples.english: Fasten your seat belt before the car moves.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw a pai ma-in na seat belt hen in.

senses.usage_en: A clothing belt goes around the waist. A seat belt is a safety strap used in a vehicle.
senses.usage_zomi: Puan belt pen kawngah kigak hi. Seat belt pen mawtaw sunga bitna ading khau ahi hi.

senses.heading: Make something curved
senses.definition_en: to make something that was straight become curved or angled.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a tawnna pan kawi ahih kei leh kinkulh sak.

examples.english: Bend the wire into a circle.
examples.zomi: Sikgui pen a beemin kawi sak in.

examples.english: Do not bend the card.
examples.zomi: Card kawi sak kei in.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are both bent.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense leh past participle gel pen bent ahi hi.

senses.heading: Move the body into a curved position
senses.definition_en: to move the body or part of it forward, downward or into a curved position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi ahih kei leh pumpi khen khat ma, nuai ahih kei leh a kawi dinmunah kun/kawi.

examples.english: She bent down to pick up the book.
examples.zomi: Laibu la dingin kun hi.

examples.english: Bend your knees when lifting the box.
examples.zomi: Bawm na lamto ciangin na khuk kawi in.

senses.usage_en: Bend down means moving the upper body toward the ground.
senses.usage_zomi: Bend down cihpen pumpi tunglam leitang lamah kun cihna hi.

senses.heading: An advantage or helpful result
senses.definition_en: an advantage, improvement or helpful result gained from something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat pan a kingah hoihna, panpihna ahih kei leh gah hoih.

examples.english: Regular exercise has many health benefits.
examples.zomi: Pumpi kisinsakna tawntung in cidamna phattuamna tampi nei hi.

examples.english: One benefit of working from home is saving travel time.
examples.zomi: Inn pan sepna phattuamna khat pen khualzin hun kholhna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the benefit of something and a benefit to/for someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat pan phattuamna gen leh the benefit of something zang in. Ku adingin phattuam hiam cih gen leh a benefit to/for someone zang in.

senses.heading: Money or assistance provided by an employer or government
senses.definition_en: money, insurance or another form of assistance provided by an employer or government.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasemte ahih kei leh kisapna nei mite tungah employer/kumpi in a piak sum, insurance ahih kei leh panpihna.

examples.english: The job includes health insurance and retirement benefits.
examples.zomi: Nasepna ah cidamna insurance leh pension phattuamna kihel hi.

examples.english: She applied for government benefits.
examples.zomi: Kumpi panpihna ngah dingin application pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Benefits in the plural often refers to employment or government assistance.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural benefits in a tamzaw in nasepna phattuamna ahih kei leh kumpi panpihna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: curved, folded or no longer straight.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tawnna pan kawi, kinkulh ahih kei leh a maan nawnlo.

examples.english: The metal bar was bent in the accident.
examples.zomi: Khuaphawkloh thu piang ah sik tang kawi hi.

examples.english: He stood with his knees slightly bent.
examples.zomi: A khuk tawm khat kawi in ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Bent is the past participle of bend, but it also functions as an adjective describing shape or position.
senses.usage_zomi: Bent pen bend past participle ahi hi. Lim ahih kei leh dinmun kawi gen adjective in zong kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: better than every other person or thing in quality, ability or suitability.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihna, siamna ahih kei leh kituakna ah a dang khempeuh sangin hoihpen.

examples.english: This is the best solution to the problem.
examples.zomi: Hih pen buaina vengna hoihpen ahi hi.

examples.english: She is one of the best students in the class.
examples.zomi: Sanginn sunga sangnaupang hoihpente lakah khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Best is the superlative form of good. The forms are good–better–best.
senses.usage_zomi: Best pen good superlative form ahi hi. A form-te pen good–better–best ahi hi.

senses.heading: Risk money on an uncertain result
senses.definition_en: to risk money or something valuable on the result of a game, race or uncertain event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna, kidemna ahih kei leh thu kicianlo khat a gah tungah sum/van manpha khat koih.

examples.english: He bet twenty dollars on the game.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna gah tungah dollar sawmnih koih hi.

examples.english: It is illegal for children to bet money.
examples.zomi: Naupangte sum tawh kidem pen thukham kalh ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Gambling can cause serious financial and personal harm. Use bet on an event and bet someone an amount.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum tawh kidemna in sum leh mimal nuntakna siatna nasia piangsak thei hi. Thu piang khat tungah kidem leh bet on zang in.

senses.heading: Feel certain, used informally
senses.definition_en: to feel confident that something is true or will happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a man taktak ahih kei leh hong piang taktak dingin kimuang.

common_phrases.zomi: amah in a thei dingin ka um

examples.english: I bet she will arrive early.
examples.zomi: Amah hong tung manlang dingin ka um hi.

examples.english: You can bet that they will ask questions.
examples.zomi: Amaute in dotna hong dong ding cih kician takin na um thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Informal I bet means “I am fairly certain.” No actual gambling is involved.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina kizui hetlo I bet in “ka kimuang mahmah hi” cihna nei hi. Sum tawh kidemna omlo hi.

senses.heading: Of higher quality or more suitable
senses.definition_en: of higher quality, more effective or more suitable than someone or something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na dang khat sangin hoihzaw, gah neizaw ahih kei leh kituakzaw.

examples.english: This plan is better than the earlier one.
examples.zomi: Hih geelna pen a masa sangin hoihzaw hi.

examples.english: We need a better way to communicate.
examples.zomi: Kihopih nading sepdingdan hoihzaw i kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Better is the comparative form of good. Use better than, not more better than.
senses.usage_zomi: Better pen good comparative form ahi hi. More better than cih loin better than ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Healthier or improved
senses.definition_en: healthier, less ill or improved after a problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cidamzaw, natna tawmzaw ahih kei leh dinmun hoihzaw.

examples.english: I feel much better today.
examples.zomi: Tuni ka cidamzaw mahmah hi.

examples.english: The situation is getting better.
examples.zomi: Dinmun hoihzaw hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Feel better usually refers to improved health or emotion. Get better may refer to health, ability or a situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Feel better in cidamna ahih kei leh lungsim hoihzawna gen zel hi. Get better in cidamna, siamna ahih kei leh dinmun hoihzawna gen thei hi.

senses.heading: In the space separating people or things
senses.definition_en: in or into the space separating two or more distinct people, places or things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun ahih kei leh na tuamtuam nih leh a tamzaw kikaal ah.

examples.english: The bank is between the library and the post office.
examples.zomi: Bank pen laibuk leh post office kikaal ah om hi.

examples.english: She divided the food between the two children.
examples.zomi: An pen naupang nih kikaal ah hawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Between is common with two items and with clearly separate individual items. Among is often used for a group considered collectively.
senses.usage_zomi: Between pen na nih tawh ahih kei leh khat ciat kician takin a kikhen na-te tawh kizang tam hi. Pawl khat a vekin ngaihsun leh among kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: From one time or amount to another
senses.definition_en: within the period, range or limits separating two times, numbers or amounts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, nambat ahih kei leh a zah nih kikaal sungah.

examples.english: The office is open between nine and five.
examples.zomi: Office pen dak kua pan nga kikaal kihong hi.

examples.english: The course is for children between six and twelve years old.
examples.zomi: Course pen kum guk pan sawmlehnih kikaal naupangte ading ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use between A and B, not between A to B.
senses.usage_zomi: Between A and B cihdan zang in. Between A to B ci kei in.

senses.heading: Farther than a place or limit
senses.definition_en: on or to the farther side of a place, object or boundary.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, van ahih kei leh gamgi khat galkhat ah ahih kei leh a val ah.

examples.english: The village lies beyond the mountains.
examples.zomi: Khua pen mualte galkhat ah om hi.

examples.english: They traveled beyond the city limits.
examples.zomi: Khuapi gamgi val ah khualzin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In physical location, beyond means farther than a particular point.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun taktak gen ciangin beyond in mun kician khat sangin gamla zaw ahih kei leh a val ah cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: Outside a limit, ability or understanding
senses.definition_en: outside or greater than a particular limit, ability or level of understanding.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ciangtan, siamna ahih kei leh teltheihna khat val.

examples.english: The damage was beyond repair.
examples.zomi: Siatna pen puahzawhloh zah ahi hi.

examples.english: The question is beyond my knowledge.
examples.zomi: Tua dotna pen ka pilna phakloh ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Beyond often shows that a limit has been passed and something is no longer possible or understandable.
senses.usage_zomi: Beyond in ciangtan khat khel a, hihzawh ahih kei leh telzawh nawnlohna lak zel hi.

senses.definition_en: a vehicle with two wheels that a person moves by pushing pedals with the feet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leng nih nei a, keng tawh pedal meek in a kipaisak van.

examples.english: She rides her bicycle to school.
examples.zomi: Sang ah lengnih tuangin pai hi.

examples.english: Always wear a helmet when riding a bicycle.
examples.zomi: Lengnih na tuang ciangin lukhu bitna khup tawntung in.

senses.usage_en: Bicycle is the full word. Bike is its common informal shortened form, but bike may also mean a motorcycle.
senses.usage_zomi: Bicycle pen kammal a bukim ahi hi. Bike pen a tomlakna kizang tam hi napi, motorcycle zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Large in size or amount
senses.definition_en: large in physical size, quantity, number or degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi, a zah, a tamna ahih kei leh a tan ah lian.

examples.english: They live in a big house outside the city.
examples.zomi: Khuapi pua-ah inn lian khat sungah teng uh hi.

examples.english: There is a big difference between the two plans.
examples.zomi: Geelna nih kikaal ah kilamdanna lian om hi.

senses.usage_en: Big is common in everyday English. Large is often preferred in formal writing and with quantities.
senses.usage_zomi: Big pen nisim English ah kizang tam hi. Ngeina kizui laigelhna leh a zah genna ah large kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Important or serious
senses.definition_en: important, influential, serious or having a strong effect.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupi, huzaap nei ahih kei leh nasia.

examples.english: Moving to another country is a big decision.
examples.zomi: Gam dangah kikuan pen thu khensatna thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The delay created a big problem.
examples.zomi: Hun sawtna in buaina lian piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, big often strengthens abstract nouns such as decision, problem, opportunity and change.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina kizui hetlo English ah big pen decision, problem, opportunity leh change bang nounte thupisak nadingin kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: a bicycle; informally, it may also mean a motorcycle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lengnih; ngeina kizui hetlo kiholimna ah motorcycle zong gen thei hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mual leh lampi sia tuang lengnih

examples.english: He rides his bike to work every day.
examples.zomi: Nisim lengnih tuangin nasepna ah pai hi.

examples.english: She bought a new mountain bike.
examples.zomi: Mual leh lampi sia tuang lengnih thak khat lei hi.

senses.usage_en: Context usually shows whether bike means a bicycle or motorcycle. Use bicycle or motorcycle when clarity is important.
senses.usage_zomi: A kimkot thu in bike pen lengnih hiam, motorcycle hiam cih lak zel hi. Thu kician ding thupi leh bicycle ahih kei leh motorcycle zang in.

senses.heading: A written request for payment
senses.definition_en: a document showing how much money is owed for goods or services.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sum piak ding lai; sum ngenna lai
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumleina na ahih kei leh nasepna ngah man bangzah pia ding hiam cih a lak lai.

examples.english: I paid the electricity bill online.
examples.zomi: Electric man internet tungah ka pia hi.

examples.english: The hospital sent us a large bill.
examples.zomi: Siibuk in sum tampi piak ding lai hong khak hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, a restaurant gives you a check. In British English, it is normally called a bill.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah anzuakna mun pan sum piak ding lai pen check kici hi. British English ah bill kici hi.

senses.heading: A proposed law
senses.definition_en: a written proposal for a new law that a legislature discusses and votes on.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham bawl pawl in kikum a, vote pia ding thukham geelna kigelh.

common_phrases.zomi: bill min gelh a, thukham suaksak

examples.english: The legislature passed the education bill.
examples.zomi: Thukham bawl pawl in pilna bill thukim hi.

examples.english: The governor signed the bill into law.
examples.zomi: Governor in bill min gelh a, thukham suaksak hi.

senses.usage_en: A bill becomes a law only after the required legislative and executive approval.
senses.usage_zomi: Bill pen thukham bawl pawl leh ukna makaipa pan a kisam thukimna ngah khit ciangbek thukham suak hi.

senses.heading: A paper banknote
senses.definition_en: a piece of paper money, especially in American English.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai tawh a kibawl sum, a diak in American English ah.

examples.english: She paid with a twenty-dollar bill.
examples.zomi: Dollar sawmnih sumlai tawh pia hi.

examples.english: Do you have a five-dollar bill?
examples.zomi: Dollar nga sumlai na nei hiam?

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses bill. British English normally uses note: a five-pound note.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah bill kizang tam hi. British English ah note kizang hi: a five-pound note.

senses.definition_en: the number 1,000,000,000; one thousand million.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat 1,000,000,000; million tul khat.

examples.english: The world’s population is more than eight billion.
examples.zomi: Leitung mihing tawm pen billion giat val hi.

examples.english: The project will cost approximately one billion dollars.
examples.zomi: Project in dollar billion khat kimkot kisam ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In modern American and British English, billion means one thousand million. Use a singular noun after a precise number: two billion dollars, not two billions dollars.
senses.usage_zomi: Tuhun American leh British English ah billion cihpen million tul khat ahi hi. Nambat kician khit noun pen singular form in koih in: two billion dollars, two billions dollars hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: a container used for storing or disposing of particular materials.
senses.zomi_equivalents: bawm; van koihna bawm; niin bawm
senses.explanation_zomi: Van koih ahih kei leh paih nadingin a kizang bawm.

common_phrases.zomi: zat nawn ding van koihna bawm

examples.english: Put the empty bottle in the recycling bin.
examples.zomi: Thawl awng pen zat nawn ding van koihna bawm sungah koih in.

examples.english: The documents are kept in labeled storage bins.
examples.zomi: Document-te min kigelh van kepna bawm sungah kikoih hi.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses bin. American English often uses trash can, garbage can or container, depending on the purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah bin kizang tam hi. American English ah zatna dungzui in trash can, garbage can ahih kei leh container kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: the scientific study of living organisms and their structure, development and relationships.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nungta na-te a pumpi kibawldan, khantohdan leh khat leh khat a kizopdan science tawh sinna.

examples.english: She is studying biology at university.
examples.zomi: University ah biology sin hi.

examples.english: Biology helps us understand living organisms.
examples.zomi: Biology in nungtate i telcian theih nading hong huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Biology is uncountable when referring to the field of science. A person who studies biology professionally is a biologist.
senses.usage_zomi: Science pilna khen khat gen ciangin biology pen uncountable noun hi. Biology a siam taka sin mi pen biologist kici hi.

senses.definition_en: a warm-blooded animal with feathers, wings and a beak that lays eggs; most kinds can fly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mulnem nei, kha nei, muk nei a,  a tui, a nam a tamzaw leng thei ganhing.

examples.english: A small bird built a nest in the tree.
examples.zomi: Vasa neu khat in singkung tungah bu bawl hi.

examples.english: Some birds cannot fly.
examples.zomi: Vasa pawlkhat leng theilo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Although most birds can fly, flight is not required for an animal to be classified as a bird.
senses.usage_zomi: Vasa a tamzaw leng thei napi, vasa kicih nadingin lengtheihna kisam ngiatlo hi.

senses.definition_en: the process or event of a baby or young animal being born.
senses.explanation_zomi: Naungek ahih kei leh ganhing no khat nu pumpi pan hong suahna.

examples.english: She gave birth to a healthy baby.
examples.zomi: Naungek cidam khat nei hi.

examples.english: Write your date of birth on the form.
examples.zomi: Form tungah na suah ni gelh in.

senses.usage_en: Use give birth to a baby. A person’s date of birth is the official date on which that person was born.
senses.usage_zomi: Give birth to a baby cihdan zang in. Mi khat date of birth pen tua mi a suah ni ngeina kizui ciaptehna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: the anniversary of the day on which someone was born.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a suah ni kum sim a hong tun kik ni.

examples.english: Today is my daughter’s birthday.
examples.zomi: Tuni ka tanu suah ni ahi hi.

examples.english: We gave him a book for his birthday.
examples.zomi: A suah ni adingin laibu khat ka pia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A birthday occurs every year. The original event is a person’s birth.
senses.usage_zomi: Birthday pen kum sim hong tung kik hi. A thu piang masa pen mi khat birth, a suahna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: a small baked food made mainly from flour; its exact form differs between British and American English.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in vaimim tawh kibawl a, oven sungah a kihuan annek neu.

examples.english: She served tea with sweet biscuits.
examples.zomi: Tea tawh biscuit khum pia hi.

examples.english: They baked warm biscuits for breakfast.
examples.zomi: Zing-an adingin biscuit lum huan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, a biscuit is usually a crisp baked food similar to an American cookie or cracker. In American English, a biscuit is usually a soft, bread-like baked food.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah biscuit pen a tamzaw in American cookie ahih kei leh cracker tawh kibang an khauh ahi hi. American English ah biscuit pen tanghou bang nem an ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: A small piece or amount
senses.definition_en: a small piece, part or amount of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a khen neu ahih kei leh a zah tawm.

examples.english: Could you give me a bit of help?
examples.zomi: Huhna tawm khat hong pia thei diam?

examples.english: There were bits of glass on the floor.
examples.zomi: Leitang tungah liimlang khen neute om hi.

senses.usage_en: Informal a bit often means “slightly” or “a small amount”: a bit tired, a bit of water.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina kizui hetlo a bit in tawm khat cihna nei zel hi: a bit tired, a bit of water.

senses.heading: A unit of computer information
senses.definition_en: the smallest unit of digital information, having a value of either 0 or 1.
senses.explanation_zomi: Digital thutheihna unit neupen, 0 ahih kei leh 1 man nei.

examples.english: Eight bits make one byte.
examples.zomi: Bit giat in byte khat bawl hi.

examples.english: The connection supports a higher bit rate.
examples.zomi: Kizopna in bit pai manlangna sangzaw zangthei hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse bit with byte. One byte normally contains eight bits.
senses.usage_zomi: Bit leh byte helkhawm kei in. Byte khat sungah a ngeina in bit giat om hi.

senses.definition_en: to cut, grip or injure something using the teeth or mouthparts.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ha tawh nek; ha tawh len; seh
senses.explanation_zomi: Ha ahih kei leh ganhing kam khen tawh na khat nek, len ahih kei leh liamsak.

examples.english: The dog bit him on the leg.
examples.zomi: Ui in a khe seh hi.

examples.english: She bit into the apple.
examples.zomi: Apple pen ha tawh nek hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is bit, and the past participle is bitten: bite–bit–bitten.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen bit hi a, past participle pen bitten ahi hi: bite–bit–bitten.

senses.heading: Having a sharp, unpleasant taste
senses.definition_en: having a strong, sharp taste that is not sweet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khumlo a, kam leh lei tungah kha takin a ki-im.

examples.english: The medicine has a bitter taste.
examples.zomi: Zatui aih kha hi.

examples.english: The coffee was too bitter for me.
examples.zomi: Coffee pen kei adingin kha lua hi.

senses.usage_en: Bitter is one of the basic tastes. It is different from sour, which describes an acidic taste.
senses.usage_zomi: Bitter pen aihna bulpi lakah khat ahi hi. Acid bang aihna nei sour tawh kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: Very angry or resentful
senses.definition_en: feeling strong and continuing anger because of unfair treatment or disappointment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thumanlohna ahih kei leh lam-etna tangtunlohna hangin sawt takin heh leh lungkimlo.

examples.english: He felt bitter about the unfair decision.
examples.zomi: Thu khensatna thumanlo hangin heh leh lungkimlo hi.

examples.english: The election caused a bitter division in the community.
examples.zomi: Vote piakna in khawtang sung kikhenna nasia piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Figurative bitter describes deep, continuing anger or painful disappointment.
senses.usage_zomi: Lim tawh gen bitter in hehna thuuk leh sawt ahih kei leh lam-etna tangtunlohna nasia gen hi.

senses.definition_en: having the darkest color, like coal or a night without light.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavak neilo zan ahih kei leh coal bang color a khuamialpen nei.

examples.english: He wore a black jacket.
examples.zomi: Jacket vom silh hi.
