examples.english: She drinks her coffee black.
examples.zomi: A coffee milk helh loin dawn hi.

senses.usage_en: Black coffee means coffee without milk or cream. When referring to racial or cultural identity, Black is commonly capitalized in current English.
senses.usage_zomi: Black coffee cihpen milk ahih kei leh cream helhloh coffee ahi hi. Mihing nam leh ngeina dinmun gen ciangin tuhun English ah Black capital letter tawh kigelh tam hi.

senses.definition_en: to say or believe that someone or something is responsible for a mistake, problem or harmful event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna, buaina ahih kei leh siatna khat mi/na khat mawh ahi hi ci-in mawhsak.

examples.english: They blamed him for the delay.
examples.zomi: Hun sawtna hangin amah mawhsak uh hi.

examples.english: Do not blame yourself for everything.
examples.zomi: Thu khempeuh adingin nangma na kimawegsak kei in.

senses.usage_en: Use blame someone/something for a problem or blame a problem on someone/something.
senses.usage_zomi: Blame someone/something for a problem ahih kei leh blame a problem on someone/something cihdan zang in.

senses.heading: Empty or not written on
senses.definition_en: empty, unmarked or containing no writing or information.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sungah bangmah omlo, kigelhlo ahih kei leh ciaptehna neilo.

examples.english: Write your answer in the blank space.
examples.zomi: Mun awngah na dawnna gelh in.

examples.english: Leave this section blank if it does not apply to you.
examples.zomi: Hih khen in nang hong kha lo leh gelh loin nusia in.

senses.usage_en: A blank form has not yet been completed. A blank space is an empty place intended for information.
senses.usage_zomi: Blank form pen kizo nailo form ahi hi. Blank space pen thutheihna gelhna ding mun awng ahi hi.

senses.heading: Showing no expression
senses.definition_en: showing no emotion, understanding or reaction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim omzia, theihna ahih kei leh dawnkikna bangmah laklo.

examples.english: He gave me a blank look.
examples.zomi: Bangmah a theihloh bangin hong en hi.

examples.english: My mind went blank during the interview.
examples.zomi: Interview laitak ka lungsim ah bangmah hong omlo hi.

senses.usage_en: My mind went blank means that someone temporarily could not remember or think of anything.
senses.usage_zomi: My mind went blank cihpen mi khat tawmvei sung bangmah phawk ahih kei leh ngaihsun theilo cihna hi.

senses.heading: Unable to see
senses.definition_en: unable to see, either completely or to a significant degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mit tawh mu theilo ahih kei leh muhna niam mahmah.

examples.english: The organization provides services for blind people.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi in mitmial mite adingin nasepna pia hi.

examples.english: He has been blind since birth.
examples.zomi: A suah pan kipan mitmial hi.

senses.usage_en: Blind person and person who is blind are both used. Follow the individual’s preferred wording when known.
senses.usage_zomi: Blind person leh person who is blind cihdan gel kizang hi. Tua mi in bang kammal deih hiam theih leh a deihna zui ding hi.

senses.heading: Unwilling or unable to recognize something
senses.definition_en: unable or unwilling to notice, understand or accept an obvious fact.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kician khat mu, tel ahih kei leh pom nuamlo.

examples.english: We must not remain blind to the risks.
examples.zomi: Lauhuainate i phawklo bangin i om loh ding hi.

examples.english: Blind trust can lead to serious mistakes.
examples.zomi: Dotna neiloh muanna in khialhna nasia piangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Figurative blind can be sensitive. Use it carefully and prefer precise wording when discussing ignorance or unwillingness.
senses.usage_zomi: Lim tawh gen blind pen midang lungsim nasak thei hi. Theihlohna ahih kei leh pom nuamlohna gen ciangin kammal kicianzaw zat hoih hi.

senses.heading: A solid piece of material
senses.definition_en: a solid piece of wood, stone, metal or another material, often with flat sides.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sing, suang, sik ahih kei leh van dang tawh a kibawl, a khauh leh a langte a maam van khen.

examples.english: The wall was built from concrete blocks.
examples.zomi: Bang pen concrete tangte tawh kilam hi.

examples.english: The child played with wooden blocks.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen sing tangte tawh kimawl hi.

senses.usage_en: The material normally follows a block of: a block of wood, a block of ice.
senses.usage_zomi: Bang van tawh kibawl hiam cih a block of nungah hong pai hi: a block of wood, a block of ice.

senses.heading: A section of a town
senses.definition_en: the area of buildings surrounded by streets, or the distance from one street to the next.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampite in a kimkot a tuam innte omna mun khen ahih kei leh lampi khat pan a dang khat dong gamla.

examples.english: The bank is two blocks away.
examples.zomi: Bank pen block nih gamla hi.

examples.english: We walked around the block after dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak-an nek khit ciangin block kimah ka lampai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This measurement is common in towns and cities with streets arranged in sections.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehna pen lampite mun khen tawh a kigeel khuapi leh khua-ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Something that prevents movement or progress
senses.definition_en: something that stops movement, access, communication or progress.
senses.explanation_zomi: Paina, lutna, kihopihna ahih kei leh mainawtna khaktan na.

examples.english: A fallen tree created a block in the road.
examples.zomi: Singkung puk in lampi khak hi.

examples.english: Fear can become a block to progress.
examples.zomi: Launa in khantohna daalna hong suak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, block refers to an obstacle. The more usual general noun is often barrier or obstacle.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah block in khakna gen hi. A zaizaw in barrier ahih kei leh obstacle kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: a regularly updated website or webpage containing articles, opinions, photographs or other posts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Article, ngaihsutna, lim ahih kei leh thupuak dangte hun tawntung a kibehlap website/webpage.

examples.english: She writes a blog about personal finance.
examples.zomi: Mimal sum vai tawh kisai blog gelh hi.

examples.english: I read the article on his travel blog.
examples.zomi: A khualzin blog ah article ka sim hi.

senses.usage_en: A blog is the website or continuing publication. One individual entry is a blog post.
senses.usage_zomi: Blog pen website ahih kei leh laigelhna kizom ahi hi. Tua sunga laigelhna khat bek pen blog post kici hi.

senses.definition_en: having pale yellow or golden hair.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sam engvang ahih kei leh sana bang color nei.

examples.english: She has long blonde hair.
examples.zomi: Sam sau leh engvang nei hi.

examples.english: The child was born with blonde hair.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen sam engvang tawh suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Blond and blonde are both used. Traditionally, blond described males and blonde females, but modern English often uses either form without gender distinction.
senses.usage_zomi: Blond leh blonde gel kizang hi. Tanglai ngeina ah blond pen pasal ading, blonde pen numei ading kizang napi, tuhun English ah nupa deidan loin form khatpeuh kizang uh hi.

senses.definition_en: the red liquid that flows through the bodies of humans and many animals, carrying oxygen and nutrients.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing leh ganhing tampi pumpi sungah a luang, oxygen leh pumpi anpuite pua tui san.

examples.english: The nurse took a blood sample.
examples.zomi: Nurse in sisan sittel ding tawm khat la hi.

examples.english: Regular exercise can help control blood pressure.
examples.zomi: Pumpi kisinsakna tawntung in sisan nawhna uk nading huh thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Blood is normally uncountable. A measured quantity may be described as a drop, sample, unit or type of blood.
senses.usage_zomi: Blood pen a tamzaw in uncountable noun hi. A zah gen leh a drop, sample, unit ahih kei leh type of blood cihte zang in.

senses.heading: Move air or be moved by air
senses.definition_en: to send air from the mouth, or for wind to move.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kam pan huih suah ahih kei leh huih nungta/gamta.

examples.english: She blew out the candles on the cake.
examples.zomi: Cake tunga meivakte mutmit hi.

examples.english: A strong wind was blowing from the north.
examples.zomi: Saklam pan huih thahat nung hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is blew, and the past participle is blown: blow–blew–blown.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen blew hi a, past participle pen blown ahi hi: blow–blew–blown.

senses.heading: Move or damage something with air or an explosion
senses.definition_en: to cause something to move, fall or break through wind, air pressure or an explosion.
senses.zomi_equivalents: huih tawh nawlkhiat; puakkham tawh susia
senses.explanation_zomi: Huih, huih nawhna ahih kei leh puakkham tawh na khat gamta, puk ahih kei leh keh sak.

examples.english: The wind blew the papers away.
examples.zomi: Huih in laite pua mang hi.

examples.english: The storm blew down several trees.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in singkung pawlkhat puk sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Blow up can mean exploding something or filling something with air. Context determines the meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Blow up in na khat puakkham tawh susia cihna ahih kei leh huih tawh dim sak cihna nei thei hi. A kimkot thu in a khiatna khensat hi.

senses.heading: Having the color of a clear sky
senses.definition_en: having the color of a clear daytime sky.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni khuavak lai van siang bang color nei.

examples.english: She wore a blue dress.
examples.zomi: Puan blue silh hi.

examples.english: The sky was clear and blue.
examples.zomi: Van siang a, blue hi.

senses.usage_en: English has many specific shades of blue, including light blue, dark blue, navy blue and sky blue.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah blue color nam tuamtuam om a, light blue, dark blue, navy blue leh sky blue cihte kihel hi.

senses.heading: Sad or emotionally low
senses.definition_en: sad, unhappy or emotionally low.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dah, lungnuamlo ahih kei leh lungsim niam.

examples.english: She felt blue after her friend moved away.
examples.zomi: A lawm a kikuan khit ciangin dah hi.

examples.english: Music sometimes helps when I feel blue.
examples.zomi: Ka dah ciangin laa in hong huh thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Feel blue is an informal expression meaning to feel sad. It does not describe the color of a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Feel blue pen ngeina kizui hetlo thugen hi a, dah cihna nei hi. Mi khat a color gen hilo hi.

senses.heading: A flat, firm piece of material
senses.definition_en: a flat, usually rectangular piece of wood or another firm material.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in sing ahih kei leh van khauh dang tawh a kibawl, a maam leh a phei van.

examples.english: She cut the vegetables on a wooden board.
examples.zomi: Nawhte singpeh tungah tan hi.

examples.english: The announcement was posted on the notice board.
examples.zomi: Puanzakna pen thupuak belhna board tungah kibel hi.

senses.usage_en: The word before board often identifies its material or purpose: wooden board, cutting board, notice board.
senses.usage_zomi: Board ma-a kammal in bang van tawh kibawl hiam ahih kei leh bang ading kizang hiam cih gen hi.

senses.heading: A group responsible for governing an organization
senses.definition_en: a group of people with authority to govern, supervise or make major decisions for an organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat uk, enkai ahih kei leh thu liante khensat ukzawhna nei mite pawl.

examples.english: The board approved the annual budget.
examples.zomi: Board in kum sim sum geelna thukim hi.

examples.english: She serves on the school board.
examples.zomi: Sang ukna pawl sungah sem hi.

senses.usage_en: A governing board is treated as one collective group, although British English may use a plural verb when emphasizing individual members.
senses.usage_zomi: Ukna board pen pawl khat in kingaihsun zel hi. British English ah pawl sung mi khat ciat thupisak leh plural verb zang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: a vessel used for traveling on water, usually smaller than a ship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui tungah khualzin ahih kei leh van pua nading vanleng; a tamzaw in ship sangin neu.

examples.english: They crossed the river by boat.
examples.zomi: Tembaw tawh gun kantan uh hi.

examples.english: The fishing boats returned before sunset.
examples.zomi: Ni tum ma-in ngasa matna tembawte hong kik uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A boat is generally smaller than a ship, although the distinction depends on context and type.
senses.usage_zomi: Boat pen a tamzaw in ship sangin neu hi. Ahih hangin a kilamdanna pen zatna leh a nam tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: The physical structure of a person or animal
senses.definition_en: the complete physical form of a person or animal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih kei leh ganhing pumpi a vekpi.

examples.english: Exercise helps keep the body healthy.
examples.zomi: Pumpi kisinsakna in pumpi cidam sak nading huh hi.

examples.english: The human body needs water every day.
examples.zomi: Mihing pumpi in ni sim tui kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Body may refer to the complete physical person or animal, excluding thoughts, emotions or spirit.
senses.usage_zomi: Body in mihing ahih kei leh ganhing pumpi a vekpi gen a, ngaihsutna, lungsim omzia ahih kei leh kha a huamlo hi.

senses.heading: An organized group
senses.definition_en: an organized group of people with a shared responsibility or purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhpuakna ahih kei leh ngiimna kibang tawh a kigeel mite pawl.

examples.english: The governing body approved the new rules.
examples.zomi: Ukna pawl in thukhun thakte thukim hi.

examples.english: An independent body will investigate the complaint.
examples.zomi: Pawl tuam khat in mawhsakna zongkhiat ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, body means an organization or committee, not a physical body.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah body in pumpi hilo in, pawlpi ahih kei leh committee gen hi.

senses.heading: Heat a liquid until it bubbles
senses.definition_en: to heat a liquid until it reaches the temperature at which bubbles rise continuously.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui ahih kei leh tui bang na khat phul tawntung dong sa sak.

examples.english: Boil the water before drinking it.
examples.zomi: Tui na dawn ma-in phul sak in.

examples.english: The soup is boiling on the stove.
examples.zomi: Annek tui meikuang tungah phul hi.

senses.usage_en: A liquid boils by itself; a person boils the liquid: The water is boiling; boil the water.
senses.usage_zomi: Tui amah phul leh The water is boiling ci ding hi. Mi khat in tui phul sak leh boil the water ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Cook food in boiling water
senses.definition_en: to cook food by placing it in water that is boiling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Annek tui phul sungah koih a, huan.

examples.english: Boil the eggs for eight minutes.
examples.zomi: Aktui-te minute giat sung huan in.

examples.english: She boiled the vegetables until they were soft.
examples.zomi: Nawhte a nem dong tui sungah huan hi.

senses.usage_en: Boil differs from fry, which uses hot oil, and bake, which uses dry heat.
senses.usage_zomi: Boil in tui sa zang hi. Fry in sathau sa zang a, bake in lumna kang zang hi.

senses.definition_en: a weapon designed to explode and cause damage, injury or death.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puak a, inn leh van susia, mi liamsak ahih kei leh that dingin a kibawl galvan.

examples.english: The police safely removed the bomb.
examples.zomi: Police in bomb bit takin paikhiat hi.

examples.english: The explosion damaged several buildings.
examples.zomi: Bomb puahna in innpi pawlkhat susia hi.

senses.usage_en: Bomb is pronounced /bɑm/; the final b is silent. Use this word carefully because it refers to serious violence.
senses.usage_zomi: Bomb pen /bɑm/ ci-in kigen a, a tawpna b ginglo hi. Thagum zatna nasia gen ahih manin kidawm takin zat ding hi.

senses.heading: A close connection
senses.definition_en: a strong relationship or connection between people, groups or things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl ahih kei leh na-te kikaal kizopna thahat.

examples.english: The experience created a strong bond between them.
examples.zomi: Phutkhakna in amau kikaal kizopna thahat piangsak hi.

examples.english: Family bonds can provide support during difficult times.
examples.zomi: Innkuan kizopna in hun haksa laitak panpihna pia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A bond between people describes closeness, loyalty or shared experience.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi kikaal bond in kinaijiatna, cihtakna ahih kei leh phutkhakna kibatna gen hi.

senses.heading: A financial investment
senses.definition_en: an investment in which money is lent to a government or company in return for interest and later repayment.
senses.zomi_equivalents: bond sum koihna; sum leitawi lai
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi ahih kei leh company tungah sum leitawi a, sum pung leh a bulsum kik piak dingin a kibawl sum koihna.

examples.english: She invested part of her savings in government bonds.
examples.zomi: A sum khol khen khat kumpi bond ah koih hi.

examples.english: Bonds usually pay interest to investors.
examples.zomi: Bond in a tamzaw in sum koihte tungah sum pung pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A bond is generally a loan to an issuer, while a stock represents partial ownership of a company.
senses.usage_zomi: Bond pen a tamzaw in bond bawlpa tungah sum leitawi ahi hi. Stock pen company neihna khen khat ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: one of the hard parts forming the internal skeleton of a human or animal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih kei leh ganhing pumpi sunga a khauh pumpi kiphuhna khen khat.

examples.english: The X-ray showed a broken bone.
examples.zomi: X-ray in guh ke lak hi.

examples.english: Calcium helps keep bones strong.
examples.zomi: Calcium in guh khauh sak nading huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Bone is countable when referring to individual bones. Bone may be uncountable when referring to the material generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Guh khat ciat gen ciangin bone pen countable noun hi. Guh kibawldan van a zaizaw in gen ciangin uncountable hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: a written or printed work consisting of pages fastened together, or its electronic equivalent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai kigelh ahih kei leh kiciamteh laimai tampi kizomkhawm, ahih kei leh a digital form.

examples.english: She borrowed a book from the library.
examples.zomi: Laibuk pan laibu khat hawl hi.

examples.english: He is writing a book about Zomi history.
examples.zomi: Zomi tangthu tawh kisai laibu khat gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: A digital book is usually called an e-book. Use a book about a subject and a book by an author.
senses.usage_zomi: Digital laibu pen a tamzaw in e-book kici hi. Thu khat tawh kisai laibu gen leh a book about a subject zang in. Laigelhpa gen leh a book by an author zang in.

senses.definition_en: A strong shoe that covers the foot and part of the ankle or leg.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khepek sang, khe leh khebul kim tuam thei in kibawl khepek nam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore boots because the ground was wet.
examples.zomi: Lei a vot manin khepek sang bulh hi.

examples.english: These boots keep my feet warm in winter.
examples.zomi: Hunkhal sungin hih khepek sangte in ka khe a lum sak hi.

senses.usage_en: A boot covers more of the ankle or leg than an ordinary shoe.
senses.usage_zomi: Boot pen khepek biasa sangin khebul leh khe lang khat zong tuamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A line that separates two countries, regions, or areas.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam nih, khuamun nih, ahih kei leh mun tuamtuam khenkhia gamgi ahi hi.

examples.english: They crossed the border early in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsangin gamgi kantan uh hi.

examples.english: The two countries share a long border.
examples.zomi: Tua gam nihte in gamgi saupi nei khawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use border for the dividing line or area between places. A boundary can also separate smaller properties or abstract areas.
senses.usage_zomi: Border pen gam leh khuamun kikal khenna gi ah kizang hi. Boundary ahih leh lote, innmunte leh muh theihloh huam sungte khenna ah zong kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Feeling tired and uninterested because nothing is enjoyable or interesting.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunglutna piangsak na omlo ahih manin lungsim nuamlo in om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children became bored during the long meeting.
examples.zomi: Kimuhkhopna a sawt manin naupangte lung nuamlo suak uh hi.

examples.english: I am bored with watching the same program every day.
examples.zomi: Nisim program kibang bek en ka lunglut nawnlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Bored describes how a person feels. Do not use it to describe the thing that causes this feeling; use boring instead.
senses.usage_zomi: Bored pen mi khat in a lung a nuamlohna genna ahi hi. Tua lungsim piangsak na genna ah boring kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Not interesting or enjoyable.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lunglut huai lo; lung nuamsak lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunglut huai lo ahih kei leh mi lung nuamsak lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The lecture was long and boring.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna a sau a, lunglut huai lo hi.

examples.english: This book may seem boring at first, but it becomes interesting later.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu kipatcilin lunglut huai lo bang hi napi, nunglam ciangin lunglut huai suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Boring describes someone or something that causes boredom. A person who has this feeling is bored.
senses.usage_zomi: Boring pen mi khat lung nuamlo sak thei mi ahih kei leh na khat genna ahi hi. Tua bangin a lungsim a om mi pen bored kici hi.

senses.definition_en: Brought into life through birth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nu sungpanin leitung ah hong piang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She was born in a small village.
examples.zomi: Amah khuata neu khat ah piang hi.

examples.english: Their baby was born last night.
examples.zomi: Zaan in amaute naungeek piang hi.

senses.usage_en: Born is normally used with a form of be: was born, were born, or is born. Do not say “She born in May.”
senses.usage_zomi: Born pen be tawh kizom in was born, were born leh is born ci in kizang zel hi. “She born in May” ci in gen lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: To take and use something belonging to someone else, intending to return it later.
senses.zomi_equivalents: la in zang; zang dingin ngen
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang neihsa khat, a nungciangin piak kik ding geelna tawh, zang dingin la cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat kiangpan na khat la

examples.english: May I borrow your pen for a minute?
examples.zomi: Na lai-at tawlkhat ka zang thei diam?

examples.english: He borrowed some money from his brother and repaid it later.
examples.zomi: A sanggampa kiangpan sum tawm la a, a nung ciangin piak kik hi.

senses.usage_en: You borrow something from someone, but you lend something to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat kiangpan na khat nangma in na lak ciangin borrow kizang a, mi khat tungah zang dingin na piak ciangin lend kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who is responsible for workers and tells them what work to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasemte uk in, a sep ding uh sawl a, nasepna makaih mi ahi hi.

examples.english: My boss asked me to finish the report today.
examples.zomi: Ka nasep ukpa in tuni in report zo dingin hong ngen hi.

examples.english: She is the boss of a small company.
examples.zomi: Amah company neu khat ukpa ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Boss is common in informal speech. In formal situations, a more specific title such as manager or supervisor may be better.
senses.usage_zomi: Boss pen nisim kiholna ah kizang tampi hi. Thupi takin kizang ding ahih leh manager ahih kei leh supervisor bang mun tawh kituak min kizang hoihzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to refer to two people or things together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nih ahih kei leh na nih, gel mah huam in genna ahi hi.

examples.english: Both answers are correct.
examples.zomi: Dawnna nihgel man hi.

examples.english: Both children enjoy reading.
examples.zomi: Naupang nihgel in laibu sim nuam sa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Both refers to exactly two. With a plural noun, say both students; with a pronoun, say both of them.
senses.usage_zomi: Both pen nih bek genna ahi hi. Plural noun tawh both students ci a, pronoun tawh both of them ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: To annoy or disturb
senses.definition_en: To make someone feel annoyed, worried, or uncomfortable.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lung hihmawh; lungbuai sak; buai sak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lung hihmawh, lungbuai ahih kei leh nuamlo sak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: kong buai sak khak leh ngaih hong
tua in nang hong lung hihmawh sak hiam?

examples.english: The loud music bothered the neighbors.
examples.zomi: La ginglian in innpaamte buai sak hi.

examples.english: It bothers me when people are dishonest.
examples.zomi: Mihingte thumaan lohna in kei hong lung hihmawh sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, bother is normally followed by the person affected.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah bother nungah a thuak mi kipahpah in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: To make an effort
senses.definition_en: To make the effort to do something, especially when it may be difficult or inconvenient.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna ahih kei leh lemlohna om napi, na khat sem dingin hanciam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He did not bother to read the instructions.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna sim dingin hanciam lo hi.

examples.english: You do not need to bother coming with me.
examples.zomi: Kei tawh hong pai dingin na hanciam kullo hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is commonly used in negative sentences and questions: didn’t bother to call or Why bother?
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen a tamzaw in nialna sentence leh dotna sungah didn’t bother to call ahih kei leh Why bother? ci in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A container with a narrow opening, used mainly for holding liquids.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawnna tui leh tuikhang bang koihna dingin, a kam neu deuh in kibawl beel ahi hi.

examples.english: Please bring me a bottle of water.
examples.zomi: Tui-um khat hong tawi in.

examples.english: She filled the bottle with milk.
examples.zomi: Tui-um sungah nawitui dimsak hi.

senses.usage_en: When counting the liquid by its container, use a bottle of: a bottle of water, not a water bottle unless you mean the container itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Tui khat a um tawh sim ciangin a bottle of water ci in kizang hi. A water bottle ahih leh tui koihna um mah genna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The lowest part or surface of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a nuaipen ahih kei leh a tawlam pen ahi hi.

examples.english: Write your name at the bottom of the page.
examples.zomi: Laimai a nuai ah na min gelh in.

examples.english: The keys were at the bottom of the bag.
examples.zomi: Tawhpite sakhau a taw ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Bottom means the lowest part. Its opposite is top.
senses.usage_zomi: Bottom pen a nuai ahih kei leh a tawlam pen cihna ahi a, a langkhat pen top ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A round, deep dish used for holding or serving food or liquid.
senses.explanation_zomi: An, meh ahih kei leh tui koihna dingin, a sung kuam in a kam a za in kibawl kheng ahi hi.

examples.english: He ate a bowl of soup for lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun-an in soup kheng khat ne hi.

examples.english: Put the fruit in a large bowl.
examples.zomi: Thei gahte kheng lian sungah koih in.

senses.usage_en: Bowl refers to both the container and, in expressions such as a bowl of soup, the amount it holds.
senses.usage_zomi: Bowl pen kheng mah gen thei a, a bowl of soup bang kammal ahih leh tua kheng khat dim zah zong gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A container with flat sides, usually square or rectangular.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na koihna dingin, a langte phei in a kil li nei in kibawl kuang ahi hi.

examples.english: She packed the books into a box.
examples.zomi: Laibute kuang sungah koih hi.

examples.english: The gift came in a small box.
examples.zomi: Letsong pen kuang neu khat sungah hong tung hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a box of to describe the contents or amount: a box of cereal or a box of tools.
senses.usage_zomi: Kuang sungah om na ahih kei leh kuang khat dim zah gen dingin a box of kizang hi: a box of cereal ahih kei leh a box of tools.

senses.definition_en: A male child or young male person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pasal naupang ahih kei leh pasal khangno khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The boy is playing outside.
examples.zomi: Tangvalno pen pualam ah kimawl hi.

examples.english: They have two boys and one girl.
examples.zomi: Amaute tangvalno nih leh nungakno khat nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Boy normally refers to a male child. Use man for an adult male.
senses.usage_zomi: Boy pen pasal naupang genna ahi hi. Pasal picing genna ah man kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A man or boy with whom someone has a romantic relationship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nungak ahih kei leh mi khat tawh itna kizopna nei tangval ahih kei leh pasal ahi hi.

examples.english: She introduced her boyfriend to her parents.
examples.zomi: A itpa a nulepa kiangah theisak hi.

examples.english: Her boyfriend lives in another city.
examples.zomi: A itpa khuapi dang khat ah teng hi.

senses.usage_en: Boyfriend usually means a romantic partner, not simply a male friend. Use male friend when there is no romantic relationship.
senses.usage_zomi: Boyfriend pen itna kizopna nei pasal genna ahi a, pasal lawm lel genna hilo hi. Itna kizopna omlo leh male friend kizang hi.

senses.heading: The organ inside the head
senses.definition_en: The organ inside the head that controls thought, memory, feeling, movement, and other body functions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lutung sungah om, ngaihsutna, phawkna, lungsim thu, kalsuanna leh pumpi nasepna tuamtuam uk pumpi langkhat ahi hi.

examples.english: The brain controls many functions of the body.
examples.zomi: Khuak in pumpi nasepna tampi uk hi.

examples.english: He suffered a serious brain injury in the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident sungah khuak liamna nasia thuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Brain is countable when referring to the organ, but it is often singular when discussing its general function.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi sungah om khuak gen ciangin brain simtheih noun ahi a, khuak nasepna a kim gen ciangin singular in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Intelligence or mental ability
senses.definition_en: A person’s ability to think, understand, and solve problems.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ngaihsut, tel leh buaina veng theihna lungsim pilna ahi hi.

examples.english: Use your brain before making a decision.
examples.zomi: Thukhenma in na khuak zang in.

examples.english: She has a good brain for numbers.
examples.zomi: Number thu ah khuak pil mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, brain can mean intelligence. Be careful because comments about someone’s brain can sound personal.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim English kammal ah brain in khuak pilna cihna zong nei hi. Ahih hang mi khat khuak tawh kisai pau pen amah mimal simmawhna bangin ngaih theih ahih manin kidawm ding hi.

senses.heading: Part of a tree
senses.definition_en: A part of a tree that grows out from the trunk and supports leaves, flowers, or fruit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung a nungpui pan hong khangkhia a, singteh, pak leh gahte dom sing-bah ahi hi.

examples.english: A bird was sitting on a branch.
examples.zomi: Vasa khat sing-bah tungah tu hi.

examples.english: The storm broke several branches.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in sing-bah pawlkhat tan hi.

senses.usage_en: A large branch grows from the trunk; smaller growth from a branch may be called a twig.
senses.usage_zomi: Sing-bah lian pen sing a nungpui pan khangkhia a, bah pan khangkhia a neute pen twig kici thei hi.

senses.heading: A local office or division
senses.definition_en: A local office or one part of a larger organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawlpi ahih kei leh nasepna lian khat sungah khuamun khat ading a khenkhia ophis ahih kei leh khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The bank opened a new branch downtown.
examples.zomi: Bank in khuapi laizang ah ophis khen thak khat hon hi.

examples.english: Please contact your nearest branch.
examples.zomi: Nang tawh a kinai pen ophis khen hopih in.

senses.usage_en: In organizations, branch means a smaller unit that belongs to a larger main organization.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawl sungah branch pen pawlpi lianzaw sungah a kihel, a neuzaw khen khat cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A name, symbol, or design that identifies the products of a particular company.
senses.explanation_zomi: Company khat in a bawl vante midang van tawh khen theihna dingin a zat min, lim ahih kei leh mel ahi hi.

examples.english: This brand is known for making reliable tools.
examples.zomi: Hih van min pen muanhuai vanzat bawlna tawh minthang hi.

examples.english: The store sells several brands of coffee.
examples.zomi: Dawr in coffee van min tuamtuam zuak hi.

senses.usage_en: A brand is the identity used for products or services. A company is the business organization that may own one or more brands.
senses.usage_zomi: Brand pen van ahih kei leh nasepna khat theihna min ahi hi. Company ahih leh brand khat sang tamzaw nei thei sumdawnna pawl ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Willing to face danger, pain, or difficulty without giving in to fear.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina, natna ahih kei leh haksatna om napi, launa tawh nunglehlo in maingat ngam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The brave firefighter entered the burning building.
examples.zomi: Meithalpa hangsan in meikuang inn sungah lut hi.

examples.english: She was brave enough to speak the truth.
examples.zomi: Thumaan gen dingin hangsan zaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Being brave does not necessarily mean feeling no fear; it often means acting despite fear.
senses.usage_zomi: Hangsan cih pen launa neilo cihna bek hilo a, lau napi gamtat ngam cihna ahi zawsop hi.

senses.definition_en: Food made mainly from flour and water, mixed into dough and baked.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mehl leh tui a bulpi in helkhawmin, sawi khit ciangin mei tawh a kihong an nam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: We bought some fresh bread this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsangin khangphong thak tawm lei ung.

examples.english: She ate two slices of bread for breakfast.
examples.zomi: Zing-an in khangphong pheek nih ne hi.

senses.usage_en: Bread is normally uncountable. Say some bread, a loaf of bread, or two slices of bread, not two breads when referring to ordinary pieces.
senses.usage_zomi: Bread pen a tamzaw in simtheihloh noun ahi hi. Khangphong biasa pheek nih gen dingin two breads ci lo in, some bread, a loaf of bread ahih kei leh two slices of bread ci ding hi.

senses.heading: To damage something into pieces or make it stop working
senses.definition_en: To damage something so that it separates into pieces or no longer works properly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat phelnih ahih kei leh tawm tuamtuam suak sak, ahih kei leh na sem theilo sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Be careful not to break the glass.
examples.zomi: Lim na khehloh ding kidawm in.

examples.english: The children broke the window while playing.
examples.zomi: Naupangte kimawl laitak in thlalang kheh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Break is irregular: break–broke–broken.
senses.usage_zomi: Break pen a paizia a kibanglo irregular verb ahi a, break–broke–broken ci in kikhel hi.

senses.heading: To fail to obey or keep something
senses.definition_en: To fail to obey a rule, law, agreement, or promise.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, daan, thukimna ahih kei leh kamciam zui lo ahih kei leh tangtun lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Anyone who breaks the law may be punished.
examples.zomi: Daan a palsat mi kuamah gim piak theih hi.

examples.english: He promised to help and did not break his promise.
examples.zomi: Panpih ding kamciam a, a kamciam susia lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, break does not mean physically damaging something. It means failing to follow or honor it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah break in na khat pumpi suksiatna cihna hilo hi. Thukhun zui lo ahih kei leh kamciam tangtun lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The first meal eaten in the morning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zingsangin nek masak pen an ahi hi.

examples.english: I usually eat breakfast at seven o’clock.
examples.zomi: A tamzaw in nai sagih ciangin zing-an ka ne hi.

examples.english: She made eggs and bread for breakfast.
examples.zomi: Zing-an dingin ak-tui leh pongmoh bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In ordinary English, say have breakfast or eat breakfast without a. Use a breakfast only when describing a particular kind or occasion.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim English pau ah have breakfast ahih kei leh eat breakfast ci in, a tello in kizang hi. Zing-an nam khat ahih kei leh hun tuam khat a zing-an gen ciang bek a breakfast kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Either of the two soft parts on the front of a person’s chest.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing awm mai ah om pumpi lang nihte lakah khat ahi hi; numei in naungeek nawitui nawkna zong ahi hi.

examples.english: Breast milk provides important nutrition for a baby.
examples.zomi: Nu-nawi in naungeek ading kisam mahmah ankhau pia hi.

examples.english: She went to the hospital for a breast examination.
examples.zomi: A nawi kisittel dingin zato ah pai hi.

senses.usage_en: Breast may refer to part of a person’s body or to the chest meat of a bird. Use the word respectfully when referring to the body.
senses.usage_zomi: Breast in mihing pumpi lang khat ahih kei leh vasa awm-sa gen thei hi. Mihing pumpi genna ah zahtakna tawh kizang ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The air that moves into and out of the lungs when a person or animal breathes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih kei leh ganhing in a huuphung sungah a hip lut leh a khahkhia huih ahi hi.

examples.english: Take a deep breath and try to relax.
examples.zomi: Hu thukpi in hip inla, tawldam dingin hanciam in.

examples.english: He was out of breath after running upstairs.
examples.zomi: Inn tunga tai in a kah khit ciangin hu vengvang hi.

senses.usage_en: Breath is a noun. The final sound is /θ/. The related verb is breathe, pronounced with /ð/.
senses.usage_zomi: Breath pen noun ahi a, a tawp aw pen /θ/ ahi hi. A verb pen breathe ahi a, /ð/ tawh kisa hi.

senses.definition_en: To take air into the lungs and send it out again.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huih huuphung sungah hip lut a, a pualam ah khahkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: It was difficult to breathe in the smoky room.
examples.zomi: Meikhu dim inn sungah hu haksa hi.

examples.english: The doctor told her to breathe slowly.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in hu damtak in hip dingin hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: Breathe is a verb and is pronounced /briːð/. Do not confuse it with the noun breath /breθ/.
senses.usage_zomi: Breathe pen verb ahi a, /briːð/ ci in kisa hi. Noun breath /breθ/ tawh helkhawm lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The process of taking air into the lungs and sending it out.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huuphung sungah huih hip lut leh khahkhia tawntungna ahi hi.

examples.english: His breathing became slower after he rested.
examples.zomi: A tawldam khit ciangin a hu-hamna damzaw suak hi.

examples.english: Call for help if the patient has difficulty breathing.
examples.zomi: Cinate hu a haksa leh huhna ngen in.

senses.usage_en: Breathing can describe the bodily process itself. The phrase difficulty breathing means that taking in air is hard.
senses.usage_zomi: Breathing in pumpi hu-hamna nasep gen hi. Difficulty breathing cih pen hu hip leh khahkhia a haksa cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A woman who is getting married or has just been married.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kiteenna nei ding ahih kei leh a kiteeng thak numei ahi hi.

examples.english: The bride wore a white dress.
examples.zomi: Mo in puanpak a silh hi.

examples.english: The bride and groom greeted their guests.
examples.zomi: Mo leh moupa in a zinpite uh paupih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Bride refers only to the woman. The man who is getting married is the groom or bridegroom.
senses.usage_zomi: Bride pen a kiteeng ding numei bek genna ahi hi. A kiteeng ding pasal pen groom ahih kei leh bridegroom kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A structure built over a river, road, or other obstacle so that people or vehicles can cross it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gun, lampi ahih kei leh kantan haksa mun tungah mihing leh mawtawte kantan theihna dingin a kibawl kantanna ahi hi.

examples.english: We crossed the river by a wooden bridge.
examples.zomi: Sing tawh kibawl lei tungpan gun kantan ung.

examples.english: The new bridge will connect the two villages.
examples.zomi: Lei thak in khuate nih kizomsak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Bridge can also be used figuratively for something that connects people, cultures, or ideas.
senses.usage_zomi: Bridge pen gentehna in mihingte, ngeinate ahih kei leh ngaihsutnate kizomsak na khat genna ah zong kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Lasting only a short time or using only a few words.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tawm bek sawt ahih kei leh kammal tawm bek zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We had a brief meeting before lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun-an nekma in tomno kiholem ung.

examples.english: Please give me a brief explanation.
examples.zomi: Hilhna tomno hong pia in.

senses.usage_en: Brief emphasizes short length or duration. It does not necessarily mean incomplete.
senses.usage_zomi: Brief in kammal tawm ahih kei leh hun tom cihna thupi sak hi. Tua in a kimlo cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: Producing or reflecting much light
senses.definition_en: Giving out or reflecting a large amount of light.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavak tampi pia ahih kei leh khuavak nasatak in lengkik sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bright light hurt my eyes.
examples.zomi: Khuavak taang in ka mitte na sak hi.

examples.english: The room is bright in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsangin inn sung khuavak hi.

senses.usage_en: Bright may describe light or a strong, clear color.
senses.usage_zomi: Bright in khuavak ahih kei leh mel pian nasatak leh siang gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Intelligent and quick to learn
senses.definition_en: Intelligent and able to understand or learn quickly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuak pil a, thu hong tel leh sin baih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a bright student who learns quickly.
examples.zomi: Amah manlangtak in sin thei sangnaupang khuak pil ahi hi.

examples.english: That was a bright idea.
examples.zomi: Tua pen ngaihsutna hoih ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: When bright describes a person, it means intelligent, not physically full of light.
senses.usage_zomi: Bright in mi khat a gen ciangin khuak pil cihna ahi a, khuavak tawh kidim cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Extremely intelligent or skillful
senses.definition_en: Exceptionally intelligent, skillful, or successful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuak pil mahmah, siamna sang mahmah ahih kei leh a lawcing mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a brilliant young scientist.
examples.zomi: Amah science siampa khangno khuak pil mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: The team gave a brilliant performance.
examples.zomi: Pawl in a siam mahmah in lahna nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In informal British English, brilliant can also mean “excellent.” In American English, great or excellent is more common in that use.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim British English ah brilliant in “hoih mahmah” cihna zong nei hi. American English ah tua khiatna ading great ahih kei leh excellent kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Very bright or shining
senses.definition_en: Producing or reflecting a strong, vivid light or color.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavak nasatak in taang ahih kei leh mel khat a pian nasatak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A brilliant light appeared in the sky.
examples.zomi: Van ah khuavak taang mahmah khat kilang hi.

examples.english: The diamond looked brilliant in the sunlight.
examples.zomi: Nitaang sungah ngun suang leng mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, brilliant is stronger than bright.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah brilliant pen bright sangin khuavak ahih kei leh mel nasazaw cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To take or carry someone or something to the place where the speaker or another person is.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat paupa omna ahih kei leh a kigensa mun ah tawi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please bring your passport to the appointment.
examples.zomi: Kimuh hunah na passport tawi in.

examples.english: She brought some food for everyone.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh ading an tawm hong tawi hi.

senses.usage_en: Bring means movement toward the speaker or destination. Take usually means movement away from the speaker. Its forms are bring–brought–brought.
senses.usage_zomi: Bring pen paupa kiang ahih kei leh a tunna ding mun lamah tawina ahi hi. Take pen paupa omna pan mun dang lamah tawina ahi zel hi. A paizia pen bring–brought–brought ahi hi.

senses.heading: Wide
senses.definition_en: Measuring a large distance from one side to the other.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lang khat pan lang khat dong a za cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A broad river flows through the valley.
examples.zomi: Gun za khat kuam sungah luang hi.

examples.english: He has broad shoulders.
examples.zomi: A liang za hi.

senses.usage_en: Broad and wide are similar, but some established phrases use only broad, such as broad shoulders and broad smile.
senses.usage_zomi: Broad leh wide a khiatna kinai hi. Ahih hang broad shoulders leh broad smile bang kammal kizomsa ah broad kizang hi.

senses.heading: Covering many subjects or people
senses.definition_en: Including many different subjects, kinds, or people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, nam ahih kei leh mihing tuamtuam tampi huam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The course gives students a broad knowledge of history.
examples.zomi: Tua sang sinna in sangnaupangte tangthu theihna huamza pia hi.

examples.english: The proposal received broad public support.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna in mipite pan panpihna lian ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, broad means extensive rather than physically wide.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah broad pen pumpi in a za cihna hilo a, thu tuamtuam tampi huam cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To send a television or radio program to the public, or to transmit content over the internet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Television, radio ahih kei leh internet tungtawnin mipite kiangah program, aw ahih kei leh lim khah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The station will broadcast the game live tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zanin station in kimawlna a nungta in khah ding hi.

examples.english: The speech was broadcast across the country.
examples.zomi: Thugenna gam sung khempeuh ah kikhah hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are usually also broadcast, not broadcasted.
senses.usage_zomi: Broadcast a past tense leh past participle pen a tamzaw in broadcast mah ahi a, broadcasted kizang khollo hi.

senses.definition_en: Damaged, separated into pieces, or no longer working properly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kitan, kek ahih kei leh sia ahih manin a semthei nawnlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The chair is broken, so do not sit on it.
examples.zomi: Tutna sia ahih manin tu kei in.

examples.english: He went to the hospital with a broken arm.
examples.zomi: A khut guh kitan tawh zato ah pai hi.

senses.usage_en: Broken is the past participle of break, but it is also commonly used as an adjective.
senses.usage_zomi: Broken pen break a past participle ahi a, adjective in zong kizang tampi hi.

senses.definition_en: A male who has the same parent or parents as another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nu ahih kei leh pa kibang tawh a piangkhawm pasal sanggam ahi hi.

examples.english: My older brother lives in another state.
examples.zomi: Ka sanggampa upa state dang khat ah teng hi.

examples.english: The two brothers work together.
examples.zomi: Sanggampa nihte nasem khawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses brother for both older and younger male siblings. Add older or younger when the distinction matters.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah sanggampa upa leh naugel ading brother kizang hi. A upa leh a nau khen ding kisap ciangin older ahih kei leh younger behlap ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Having the color of earth, wood, or chocolate.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei, sing ahih kei leh chocolate mel bang pian nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore a brown coat.
examples.zomi: Puandum neel-eng pian silh hi.

examples.english: The leaves turn brown in autumn.
examples.zomi: Autumn hunin singteh neel-eng pianin kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Brown is a color adjective and normally comes before the noun: brown shoes.
senses.usage_zomi: Brown pen mel genna adjective ahi a, a tamzaw in noun ma ah brown shoes ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: To clean or arrange with a brush
senses.definition_en: To clean, smooth, or arrange something by moving a brush over it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Brush tawh na khat nual in siansuah ahih kei leh kituak sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Brush your teeth before going to bed.
examples.zomi: Ihma in na ha nual in.

examples.english: She brushed her hair carefully.
examples.zomi: Kidawmtak in a sam nual hi.

senses.usage_en: Use brush with the object being cleaned: brush your teeth or brush your hair.
senses.usage_zomi: Brush pen a kisiansuah ding na tawh kizom in brush your teeth ahih kei leh brush your hair ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: To touch lightly while moving past
senses.definition_en: To touch someone or something lightly while moving past.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat kiangpan a paisuak laitak in tawm bek suk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her coat brushed against the wall.
examples.zomi: A puandum in bang tawm suk hi.

examples.english: Someone brushed past me in the crowd.
examples.zomi: Mihon sungah mi khat in kei hong suk zawk in paisuak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the contact is light and usually brief.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah a kisukna pen a khauhlua lo a, hun tomno sung bek ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A small ball of air or gas inside a liquid or surrounded by a thin layer of liquid.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui sungah ahih kei leh tui pheek tawm tawh a ki-uum huih lum neu ahi hi.

examples.english: Bubbles rose to the surface of the water.
examples.zomi: Huih lumte tui tungah hong kahto hi.

examples.english: The children blew soap bubbles outside.
examples.zomi: Naupangte pualam ah sabun huih lum mut uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Bubble is countable. Several small balls of gas are bubbles.
senses.usage_zomi: Bubble pen simtheih noun ahi hi. Huih lum tampi om leh bubbles kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A plan showing how much money is available and how it will be received or spent.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sum geelna; sum zat ding geelsa
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum bangzah om ding, koipan lut ding leh bangbang ah kizang ding cih lak sum geelna ahi hi.

examples.english: We created a monthly budget for our family.
examples.zomi: Ka innkuan un kha khat sum geelna bawl ung.

examples.english: The project was completed within budget.
examples.zomi: Geelna pen sum geelsa zah sungah kizosak hi.

senses.usage_en: A budget is a financial plan, not simply the amount of money someone owns.
senses.usage_zomi: Budget pen sum neih zah bek hilo a, sum lut leh sum zat ding geelna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To make a structure
senses.definition_en: To make a house, road, machine, or other structure by joining materials or parts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van leh a lang tuamtuam kizomsakin inn, lampi, machine ahih kei leh na dang khat bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They plan to build a new school next year.
examples.zomi: Kum naungin sanginn thak khat lam dingin geel uh hi.

examples.english: Workers are building a bridge over the river.
examples.zomi: Nasemte gun tungah lei lam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Its forms are build–built–built.
senses.usage_zomi: Build pen irregular verb ahi a, build–built–built ci in kikhel hi.

senses.heading: To develop something gradually
senses.definition_en: To develop or increase something gradually over time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tawh na khat tawm tawm in khangtosak ahih kei leh kipkhosak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Practice will help you build confidence.
examples.zomi: Zonsimna in kimuanna khangtosak ding hi.

examples.english: It takes time to build a strong relationship.
examples.zomi: Kizopna kip khat bawl dingin hun kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, build describes gradual development rather than physical construction.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah build pen inn lam bang pumpi tawh kibawl na hilo a, na khat tawm tawm in khangtosak cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A structure with walls and a roof, such as a house, school, office, or store.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bang leh innkhum nei in, inn, sanginn, ophis ahih kei leh dawr in kizang lamna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company moved into a new office building.
examples.zomi: Company pen ophis innpi thak sungah ki-uan hi.

examples.english: Smoking is not allowed inside the building.
examples.zomi: Inn sungah zial zu dawn phal lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Building means the completed structure. Construction refers to the process of building it.
senses.usage_zomi: Building pen lam khitsa innpi genna ahi hi. Construction ahih leh tua inn lamna nasep kizom laitak genna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A small metal object fired from a gun.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meithal tawh a kikap, sik tawh kibawl kapna mu ahi hi.

examples.english: The police found a bullet near the door.
examples.zomi: Police in kongpi kiangah meithal mu khat mu hi.

examples.english: The wall was damaged by bullets.
examples.zomi: Bang pen meithal mute in susia hi.

senses.usage_en: A bullet is the object fired from a gun. It is not the gun itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Bullet pen meithal tawh a kikap mu ahi a, meithal mah hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A group of similar things held, tied, or growing together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na kibang pawlkhat, kigawm, kikhih ahih kei leh khat in khangkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She carried a bunch of flowers.
examples.zomi: Pak bawm khat tawi hi.

examples.english: A bunch of bananas was hanging from the tree.
examples.zomi: Banana bu khat singkung ah kikhai hi.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, a bunch of can also mean “many” or “a group of,” as in a bunch of people.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim English ah a bunch of in “tampi” ahih kei leh “pawl khat” cihna zong nei a, a bunch of people ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: To be on fire or destroy with fire
senses.definition_en: To be damaged or destroyed by fire, or to cause something to be damaged by fire.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mei kuang ahih kei leh mei tawh na khat kangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They burned dry wood to keep warm.
examples.zomi: A lumna dingun singkang hal uh hi.

examples.english: The old building burned down during the night.
examples.zomi: Innpi lui zankim in kangtum hi.

senses.usage_en: Burn can be transitive or intransitive: They burned the paper; The paper burned.
senses.usage_zomi: Burn pen object tawh zong kizang thei a, object tello in zong kizang thei hi: They burned the paper; The paper burned.

senses.heading: To injure with heat or chemicals
senses.definition_en: To injure skin or another material with heat, fire, or a chemical.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mei, a sa mahmah na ahih kei leh chemical in vun ahih kei leh na dang khat kangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Be careful not to burn your hand.
examples.zomi: Na khut a kanloh ding kidawm in.

examples.english: She burned herself on the hot pan.
examples.zomi: Beel sa in amah leh amah kangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: When the injured person and the subject are the same, English often uses a reflexive pronoun: I burned myself.
senses.usage_zomi: A kangliam mi leh sentence a subject kibang leh English ah reflexive pronoun zang in I burned myself ci hi.

senses.definition_en: To put a dead body or another object into the ground and cover it with earth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Misisa ahih kei leh na khat lei sungah vui in lei tawh tuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The family buried him near his parents.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in a nulepa kiangah amah vui uh hi.

examples.english: The dog buried the bone in the yard.
examples.zomi: Ui in guh innmai lei sungah phum hi.

senses.usage_en: Bury is pronounced /ˈberi/, like the first part of berry. Its past tense is buried.
senses.usage_zomi: Bury pen /ˈberi/ ci in kisa a, berry a kipatna tawh a aw kibang hi. A past tense pen buried ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A large road vehicle that carries many passengers along a route.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi tungah mi tampi tawi in, a geelsa lampi zui in a vak mawtaw lian ahi hi.

examples.english: I take the bus to work every morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsang simin nasepna ah bus ka tuang hi.

examples.english: The school bus arrived late today.
examples.zomi: Tuni in sang bus hong tung man lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, people usually say take the bus. In British English, travel by bus is also common.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah take the bus kizang tampi hi. British English ah travel by bus zong kizang tampi hi.

senses.definition_en: A low woody plant with many branches growing close to the ground.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei kiangpan bah tampi khangkhia in, singkung sangin a niamzaw sing-no ahi hi.

examples.english: A bird built its nest in the bush.
examples.zomi: Vasa khat in sing-no sungah bu bawl hi.

examples.english: They planted bushes around the house.
examples.zomi: Inn kiimah sing-note phut uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A bush is usually lower and has more stems near the ground than a tree.
senses.usage_zomi: Bush pen singkung sangin niamzaw a, lei kiangpan a bah tampi khangkhia zel hi.

senses.heading: The activity of buying, selling, or providing services
senses.definition_en: Work involving the production, buying, or selling of goods or services.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van bawl, lei, zuak ahih kei leh nasepna pia in sum lakna nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: She started a small catering business.
examples.zomi: An bawl leh zuak sumdawnna neu khat kipan hi.

examples.english: His family has run the business for twenty years.
examples.zomi: A innkuan un kum sawmnih sung tua sumdawnna makaih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Business is uncountable when referring to commercial activity generally, but countable when referring to a particular company.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumdawnna nasep a kim gen ciangin business simtheihloh noun ahi hi. Company khat gen ciangin simtheih noun in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: A matter or responsibility
senses.definition_en: A matter, situation, or responsibility that concerns a particular person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh kisai thu, a mawpuakna ahih kei leh a sep ding ahi hi.

examples.english: I have some personal business to handle this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsangin ka mimal thu pawlkhat ka sem ding hi.

examples.english: That decision is not my business.
examples.zomi: Tua thukhenna kei tawh kisai lo hi.

senses.usage_en: None of your business is direct and may sound rude. Use it carefully.
senses.usage_zomi: None of your business pen kammal khauh tak ahi a, zahtaklohna bangin a zaktheih manin kidawm takin kizang ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A man who works in business, especially one who owns or manages a company.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumdawnna sungah nasem, a diak in company khat nei ahih kei leh uk pasal ahi hi.

examples.english: He became a successful businessman.
examples.zomi: Sumdawnpa lawcing khat hong suak hi.

examples.english: A local businessman donated money to the school.
examples.zomi: Khuami sumdawnpa khat in sanginn tungah sum pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Businessperson is a gender-neutral alternative. Use businesswoman when specifically referring to a woman.
senses.usage_zomi: Businessperson pen pasal leh numei khenlo in kizangtheih kammal ahi hi. Numei bek gen dingin businesswoman kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Having many things to do and little free time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sep ding tampi nei ahih manin hun awng tawm bek nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am busy this afternoon.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitaklamin ka mawh hi.

examples.english: She has been busy preparing for the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kimuhkhopna ading kisakholhna tawh mawh hi.

senses.usage_en: Say busy with something or busy doing something: busy with work; busy writing a report.
senses.usage_zomi: Busy pen busy with something ahih kei leh busy doing something ci in kizang hi: busy with work; busy writing a report.

senses.definition_en: Used to connect two statements when the second contrasts with or limits the first.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu nih kizom sak a, a nihna in thu masa tawh kilamdanna ahih kei leh ciangtan om cih lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The work was difficult, but we finished it.
examples.zomi: Nasep a haksa napi, zo ung.

examples.english: She is young but very responsible.
examples.zomi: A khangno napi, a mawpuakna kem siam mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: But introduces a contrast. In formal writing, avoid using it repeatedly when a clearer connection is possible.
senses.usage_zomi: But in thu nih kikal kilamdanna lak hi. Lai gelhna thupi ah a kizang nawnnawn sangin, thu kizopna a siangzaw kammal kizang hoihzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A soft yellow food made from cream or milk and used in cooking or spread on bread.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nawitui pan kibawl, a eng deuh a nem an, an huan leh khangphong tungah zutna in kizang ahi hi.

examples.english: She spread butter on the bread.
examples.zomi: Khangphong tungah butter zut hi.

examples.english: Add a little butter to the pan.
examples.zomi: Beel sungah butter tawm behlap in.

senses.usage_en: Butter is normally uncountable. Say some butter or a piece of butter, not a butter.
senses.usage_zomi: Butter pen simtheihloh noun ahi hi. A butter ci lo in some butter ahih kei leh a piece of butter ci ding hi.

senses.heading: A small fastener on clothing
senses.definition_en: A small round object attached to clothing and pushed through a hole to fasten it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan kikhakna dingin puan tungah a kitui a, a vang sungah a kilutsak na neu ahi hi.

examples.english: One button is missing from my shirt.
examples.zomi: Ka puan button khat mang hi.

examples.english: Please fasten the top button.
examples.zomi: A tung pen button khak in.

senses.usage_en: The verb button means to fasten clothing using buttons.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb button in puan a buttonte tawh khak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A control that is pressed
senses.definition_en: A small control on a machine or device that is pressed to operate it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine ahih kei leh vanzat khat semsak dingin a kineih na neu ahi hi.

examples.english: Press the green button to start the machine.
examples.zomi: Machine kipansak dingin button a hing nei in.

examples.english: The power button is on the side of the phone.
examples.zomi: Phone meima neihna a langah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Say press a button, not normally push on a button.
senses.usage_zomi: A tamzaw in push on a button ci lo in press a button ci in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: To obtain something by paying money for it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngahna dingin sum pia in lei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I need to buy some groceries after work.
examples.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin annek ding pawlkhat ka lei kul hi.

examples.english: They bought a new car last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in mawtaw thak khat lei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Its forms are buy–bought–bought. The opposite commercial action is sell.
senses.usage_zomi: Buy pen irregular verb ahi a, buy–bought–bought ci in kikhel hi. A langkhat sumdawnna gamtat pen sell ahi hi.

senses.heading: Near or beside
senses.definition_en: At or near the side of someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat kiangah ahih kei leh a nai ah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She sat by the window.
examples.zomi: Thlalang kiangah tu hi.

examples.english: There is a small café by the station.
examples.zomi: Station kiangah café neu khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, by means near or beside.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah by in near ahih kei leh beside bangin “kiangah” cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: Showing who performs an action
senses.definition_en: Used to identify the person or thing that performs an action in a passive sentence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Passive sentence sungah nasep a sem mi ahih kei leh na lahna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: The book was written by a local author.
examples.zomi: Laibu pen khuami laigelhpa khat in gelh hi.

examples.english: The bridge was built by local workers.
examples.zomi: Lei pen khuami nasemte in lam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In a passive sentence, by introduces the person or agent responsible for the action.
senses.usage_zomi: Passive sentence ah by in tua nasep a sem mi ahih kei leh a piangsak na lak hi.

senses.heading: Not later than a particular time
senses.definition_en: At or before a stated time, but not later.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigensa hun ciang dong ahih kei leh tua hun ma in, tua sang nungzaw lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please finish the report by Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ciang dong report zo in.

examples.english: We should arrive by noon.
examples.zomi: Sun laitak ciang dong tung ding hang.

senses.usage_en: By Friday means no later than Friday. Until Friday means that something continues up to Friday.
senses.usage_zomi: By Friday cih pen Friday sang nungzaw lo cihna ahi hi. Until Friday ahih leh na khat Friday dong kizom cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Through a method or means
senses.definition_en: Using a particular method, form of transport, or means.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi, mawtaw nam ahih kei leh vanzat khat zangin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We traveled by bus.
examples.zomi: Bus tawh khualzin ung.

examples.english: Send the document by email.
examples.zomi: Document pen email tungtawnin khak in.

senses.usage_en: Do not normally use an article after by when naming transport: by bus, not by the bus. Use on the bus when referring to a particular bus journey or location.
senses.usage_zomi: Khualzinna van nam gen ciangin by nungah article kizang khollo hi: by bus, by the bus hilo hi. Bus khat tungah omna ahih kei leh tua bus khualzinna gen ciangin on the bus kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Used when leaving someone or ending a conversation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh kikhen ding ahih kei leh kiholna khawl ding ciangin kimang kammal ahi hi.

examples.english: Bye! I will see you tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Hoih un! Zing ciangin kimukik ni.

examples.english: She waved and said, “Bye!”
examples.zomi: A khut vai a, “Hoih un!” ci hi.

senses.usage_en: Bye is informal. Goodbye is slightly more complete and may sound more formal or final.
senses.usage_zomi: Bye pen nisim kiholna ah kizang kammal ahi hi. Goodbye pen a kimzaw a, tawmkhat thupizaw ahih kei leh kikhenna nunungzaw bangin a zaktheih hi.

senses.heading: A thick wire or group of wires
senses.definition_en: A thick wire or group of wires used to carry electricity or electronic signals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meima ahih kei leh electronic signal paisakna dingin kibawl thirgui lian ahih kei leh thirgui kigawm ahi hi.

examples.english: Connect the cable to the back of the computer.
examples.zomi: Thirgui pen computer a nunglamah zom in.

examples.english: The damaged cable caused the power failure.
examples.zomi: Meima thirgui sia in meima khawlsak hi.

senses.usage_en: A cable is usually thicker and stronger than an ordinary wire and may contain several wires.
senses.usage_zomi: Cable pen wire biasa sangin a lianzaw leh khauhzaw hi a, a sungah wire tampi om thei hi.

senses.heading: A television service delivered through cables
senses.definition_en: A television service that sends programs through a cable network.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thirgui kizopna tungtawnin television programte inn sungah khahna nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: They receive local news through cable television.
examples.zomi: Cable television tungtawnin khuamun thuthak ngah uh hi.

examples.english: We canceled our cable service last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in ka cable nasep uh khawlsak ung.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, cable is often used before another noun, as in cable TV or cable company.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah cable pen noun dang ma ah cable TV ahih kei leh cable company ci in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A small restaurant where people can buy drinks and simple meals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Coffee leh dawnna dangte, annek baihte leitheihna annek dawr neu ahi hi.

examples.english: We met for coffee at a small cafe.
examples.zomi: Coffee dawr neu khat ah coffee dawn dingin kimuh ung.

examples.english: The cafe serves breakfast all day.
examples.zomi: Coffee dawr in sun ni vekpi zing-an zuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Cafe may also be written café. The accent mark does not change the meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Cafe pen café ci in zong kigelh thei hi. Accent mark in a khiatna khelsak lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A sweet baked food usually made from flour, sugar, eggs, and fat.
senses.explanation_zomi: anneel, cikhum, ak-tui leh thau a bulpi in helkhawmin, mei tawh a ki-em anlum khum ahi hi.

examples.english: She baked a cake for her son’s birthday.
examples.zomi: A tapa suahni ading cake khat huan hi.

examples.english: Would you like another piece of cake?
examples.zomi: Cake tawm khat na ne beh nuam hiam?

senses.usage_en: The expression a piece of cake can informally mean that something is very easy.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim kiholna ah a piece of cake in na khat baih mahmah cihna zong nei hi.

senses.definition_en: To find an amount or answer by using numbers.
senses.explanation_zomi: Numberte zangin zah, man ahih kei leh dawnna khat simkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We need to calculate the total cost.
examples.zomi: Man a vekpi simkhia kul hi.

examples.english: The computer calculated the result in a few seconds.
examples.zomi: Computer in second tawm sungin dawnna simkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: Calculate usually involves numbers or a logical estimate. Use count when finding how many separate items there are.
senses.usage_zomi: Calculate pen number zangin simna ahih kei leh ngaihsut simna ah kizang hi. Na tuamtuam bangzah om cih sim dingin count kizang hi.

senses.heading: To telephone someone
senses.definition_en: To speak to someone by telephone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phone tawh mi khat hopih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please call me when you arrive.
examples.zomi: Na tun ciangin kei hong phone in.

examples.english: I called the office this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsangin ophis ah ka phone hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, both call someone and phone someone are common. Do not normally add to: say call her, not call to her, when you mean telephone.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah call someone leh phone someone kizang khawm hi. Phone tawh hopihna gen ciangin call to her ci lo in call her ci ding hi.

senses.heading: To give someone or something a name
senses.definition_en: To give a person or thing a particular name, or to use that name for them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat min sak ahih kei leh tua min tawh sam cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: naungeek John ci in min sak

examples.english: They called their baby Daniel.
examples.zomi: A naungeek uh Daniel ci in min sak uh hi.

examples.english: This flower is called a rose.
examples.zomi: Hih pak pen rose kici hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern is call someone/something + name: They called him David.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan pen call someone/something + name ahi hi: They called him David.

senses.heading: To ask someone to come or request help
senses.definition_en: To ask a person or service to come, especially because help is needed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat hong pai dingin sam ahih kei leh huhna nasep ngen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Call a doctor immediately.
examples.zomi: Tu mahmah in siavuan sam in.

examples.english: The neighbors called the police.
examples.zomi: Innpaamte in police sam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Call for help means request help. Call someone may mean telephone or summon them, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Call for help in huhna ngen cihna ahi hi. Call someone ahih leh thu omdan ciangin phone tawh hopih ahih kei leh hong pai dingin sam cihna theih ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Peaceful, quiet, and not nervous, angry, or excited.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungbuai, lungthang ahih kei leh lunglawp loin, lungsim dai in om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Try to stay calm during an emergency.
examples.zomi: Thupiang lian om laitak in lungsim dai in om dingin hanciam in.

examples.english: She spoke in a calm voice.
examples.zomi: Aw daitak in pau hi.

senses.usage_en: Calm describes a peaceful emotional state or a place without much movement or disturbance.
senses.usage_zomi: Calm in mi khat lungsim daina ahih kei leh gamtatna leh kihingalna tampi omlo mun gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A device used to take photographs or record video.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim la ahih kei leh video record dingin kizang vanzat ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: take a picture with a camera

examples.english: She used her camera to photograph the mountains.
examples.zomi: Mualte lim lakna dingin a camera zang hi.

examples.english: The security camera recorded the accident.
examples.zomi: Bitna enna camera in accident record hi.

senses.usage_en: A camera takes or records the image. In English, say take a photograph, not make a photograph.
senses.usage_zomi: Camera in lim la ahih kei leh record hi. English ah make a photograph ci lo in take a photograph ci ding hi.

senses.heading: A place where people stay temporarily in tents or simple shelters
senses.definition_en: A place where people live temporarily in tents, cabins, or other simple shelters.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte puanbuk, inn-no ahih kei leh buk baih sungah hun tomno omna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The hikers returned to camp before dark.
examples.zomi: Khe tawh khualzinte khuamial ma in bukkhual ah ciah uh hi.

examples.english: The families lived in a temporary camp.
examples.zomi: Innkuante hun tomno bukkhual ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Camp can refer to the place itself or to the people staying there.
senses.usage_zomi: Camp in bukna mun mah ahih kei leh tua munah a om mite zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: An organized program for a group
senses.definition_en: An organized program where people, often children, stay or meet for training or activities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte, a diak in naupangte, sinna, kimawlna ahih kei leh ngeina tuamtuam adingun hun ciangtan sung a kimuhkhopna geelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children attended a summer camp.
examples.zomi: Naupangte khuasa kimuhkhopna ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: The team began training camp on Monday.
examples.zomi: Pawl in Monday ni-in kisinsakna bukkhual kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: This kind of camp may include overnight lodging, but some programs take place only during the day.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih bang camp ah zan ihna om thei a, pawlkhat ahih leh sun sung bek kimuhkhopna nei uh hi.

senses.definition_en: A planned series of activities intended to achieve a political, social, or commercial goal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamvai, mipite hoihna ahih kei leh sumdawnna ngiimna khat tangtun dingin nasep tuamtuam a kigeel kholsa ahi hi.

examples.english: The candidate began her election campaign.
examples.zomi: Teel dingmi in a teelna kampai kipan hi.

examples.english: The city launched a campaign to reduce waste.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in ninsia kiam sakna kampai kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: A campaign consists of connected actions directed toward one main goal. It is not usually a single event.
senses.usage_zomi: Campaign pen ngiimna lian khat tangtun dingin nasep tuamtuam kizom khawm ahi a, thupiang khat bek hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity of staying outdoors temporarily in a tent or simple shelter.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pualam ah puanbuk ahih kei leh buk baih sungah hun tomno omna ahi hi.

examples.english: We went camping beside the lake.
examples.zomi: Tuili kiangah puanbuk khual pai ung.

examples.english: Bring warm clothes for the camping trip.
examples.zomi: Puanbuk khualzinna ading puan lum tawi in.

senses.usage_en: Camping is uncountable. Say go camping, not normally go to camping.
senses.usage_zomi: Camping pen simtheihloh noun ahi hi. A tamzaw in go to camping ci lo in go camping ci ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The land and buildings belonging to a university, college, or school.
senses.explanation_zomi: University, college ahih kei leh sanginn khat neihsa lei leh a tungah om innpite ahi hi.

examples.english: The university has a large campus.
examples.zomi: University in sang innmun lian nei hi.

examples.english: Students are not allowed to park in this part of the campus.
examples.zomi: Campus hih khen sungah sangnaupangte mawtaw koih phal lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use on campus, not normally in campus, when referring generally to being at a school or university site.
senses.usage_zomi: Sang innmunah omna a kim gen ciangin in campus ci lo in on campus ci ding hi.

senses.heading: To be able to do something
senses.definition_en: Used to say that someone has the ability or opportunity to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in na khat semthei ahih kei leh sepna hun leh lampi nei cih lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: She can speak three languages.
examples.zomi: Amah pau nam thum pau thei hi.

examples.english: I can help you tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing ciangin kong panpihthei hi.

senses.usage_en: A modal verb is followed by the base form: can go, not can goes or can to go.
senses.usage_zomi: Modal verb nungah verb a bulpi hong pai hi: can go ci ding a, can goes ahih kei leh can to go ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: To ask for or give permission
senses.definition_en: Used to ask whether something is allowed or to say that it is allowed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sem phalna ngen ahih kei leh phalna pia cih lakna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: Tu in na paikhia thei hi.

examples.english: Can I borrow your phone?
examples.zomi: Na phone ka zangthei diam?

examples.english: You can go home after the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kimuhkhopna khit ciangin inn na ciah thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Can is common for everyday permission. May can sound more formal.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim phalna ngenna ah can kizang tampi hi. May ahih leh zahtak huai leh thupizaw in a zaktheih hi.

senses.heading: To express possibility
senses.definition_en: Used to say that something is sometimes possible.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat piangthei ahih kei leh hih thei cih lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Learning a new language can be difficult.
