examples.zomi: Pau thak khat sinna haksa thei hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain can cause flooding.
examples.zomi: Guah tampi in tuiciin piangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In affirmative statements, can often expresses general possibility. For one uncertain future event, may or might is often more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Affirmative sentence ah can in a kim in piangtheihna gen hi. Mailam thupiang khat a pian ding lungmuanglo takin gen ciangin may ahih kei leh might kizang hoihzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: To decide that a planned event, arrangement, or service will not happen or continue.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigeel kholsa thupiang, thukimna ahih kei leh nasep khat pianglo ding ahih kei leh kizom nawnlo dingin khawlsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They canceled the game because of heavy rain.
examples.zomi: Guah a tam manin kimawlna khawlsak uh hi.

examples.english: I need to cancel my appointment.
examples.zomi: Ka kimuh hun lawhkhia kul hi.

senses.usage_en: American English normally uses canceled and canceling. British English commonly uses cancelled and cancelling.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah canceled leh canceling kigelh hi. British English ah cancelled leh cancelling kigelh zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A serious disease in which abnormal cells grow uncontrollably and may spread through the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi cell hoihlo te a uk zawhloh in khang a, pumpi khen dangte ah zong kizelh thei natna nasia ahi hi.

examples.english: Early testing can help doctors find cancer sooner.
examples.zomi: A manin kisittelna in siavuan te cancer manlangzaw in mukhia sakthei hi.

examples.english: He is receiving treatment for lung cancer.
examples.zomi: Huuphung cancer ading cidamna ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Cancer is a general name for many related diseases, not one single disease. Medical diagnosis and treatment require qualified health professionals.
senses.usage_zomi: Cancer pen kizopna nei natna nam tampi min ahi a, natna nam khat bek hilo hi. Natna sittel leh cidamna ading siavuan siamte kisam hi.

senses.heading: A person seeking election
senses.definition_en: A person who is trying to be chosen for a political office through an election.
senses.zomi_equivalents: teel dingmi; teelna a kihel mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Teelna tungtawnin gamvai mun khat ngah dingin mite teelna a ngen mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Each candidate answered questions from voters.
examples.zomi: Teel dingmi simin teel mite dotna dawng uh hi.

examples.english: She became a candidate for mayor.
examples.zomi: Khuapi makaipa teel dingmi hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: A candidate is not yet the officeholder; the person is seeking to be selected or elected.
senses.usage_zomi: Candidate pen tua mun ngahsa mi hilo a, teel ahih kei leh seh ding a kingak mi ahi hi.

senses.heading: A person being considered for a position or opportunity
senses.definition_en: A person who is being considered for a job, award, course, or another opportunity.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsut dingmi; sep dingin a kingak mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, letsong, sinna ahih kei leh hamphatna khat ading ngaihsutna sungah a koih mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The company interviewed five candidates for the job.
examples.zomi: Company in tua nasep ading ngenmi nga dong hi.

examples.english: She is a strong candidate for the award.
examples.zomi: Amah tua letsong ngah dingin a kituak mahmah mi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The preposition is usually candidate for: a candidate for the position.
senses.usage_zomi: A tamzaw in candidate for ci in kizang hi: a candidate for the position.

senses.definition_en: Used to say that someone is unable or not permitted to do something, or that something is impossible.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in na khat semtheilo, sep phallo ahih kei leh na khat piangtheilo cih lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: I cannot attend the meeting tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing kimuhkhopna ah ka kiheltheilo hi.

examples.english: You cannot park your car here.
examples.zomi: Hih munah na mawtaw na koih phallo hi.

senses.usage_en: Cannot is normally written as one word. The contracted form is can’t. Write can not as two words only in special constructions such as You can choose not to go.
senses.usage_zomi: Cannot pen a tamzaw in kammal khat in kigelh hi. A tomlakna pen can’t ahi hi. Can not khennih in gelhna pen You can choose not to go bang zatdan tuam ah bek kizang hi.

senses.heading: A soft hat with a curved or flat front part
senses.definition_en: A soft, close-fitting hat, often with a stiff part projecting over the eyes.
senses.explanation_zomi: A nem a, lutung tawh a kituak in a om, mit tungah liim pia ding a maitang a nei lukhu ahi hi.

examples.english: He wore a blue baseball cap.
examples.zomi: Baseball lukhu dum khum hi.

examples.english: Take off your cap inside the building.
examples.zomi: Inn sungah na lukhu suah in.

senses.usage_en: A cap usually fits closely around the head. Hat is the broader general word.
senses.usage_zomi: Cap pen lutung tawh a kituak in a om lukhu ahi zel hi. Hat ahih leh lukhu nam tuamtuam huam a kizang kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: A cover for the top of a container
senses.definition_en: A small cover that closes the opening of a bottle, tube, or similar container.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui-um, tube ahih kei leh beel bang a kam khakna ding a tuam neu ahi hi.

examples.english: Put the cap back on the bottle.
examples.zomi: Tui-um tuam khak kik in.

examples.english: The cap was difficult to open.
examples.zomi: Tuam hon haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: A cap normally fits over a small opening. A lid usually covers a wider container such as a pot or box.
senses.usage_zomi: Cap pen a tamzaw in kam neu tuamna ahi hi. Lid ahih leh beel ahih kei leh kuang bang kam za tuamna ahi zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Having the ability, skill, or qualities needed to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat semtheihna, siamna ahih kei leh a kisam dinmun nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is capable of managing the entire project.
examples.zomi: Amah geelna a vekpi makaih zo dingin semthei hi.

examples.english: This machine is capable of producing clean water.
examples.zomi: Hih machine in tui siangtho bawlkhia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use capable of followed by a noun or an -ing form: capable of success; capable of solving the problem.
senses.usage_zomi: Capable of nungah noun ahih kei leh -ing form kizang hi: capable of success; capable of solving the problem.

senses.heading: The greatest amount something can hold
senses.definition_en: The maximum amount that a container, room, vehicle, or place can hold.
senses.explanation_zomi: Beel, inn, mawtaw ahih kei leh mun khat in a kemtheih pen zah ahi hi.

examples.english: The theater has a seating capacity of five hundred.
examples.zomi: Khuamuh inn sungah mi zanga tu thei hi.

examples.english: The bus was filled to capacity.
examples.zomi: Bus pen a dimdong in mi tuang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, capacity refers to the maximum amount, not necessarily the amount currently inside.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah capacity pen a kemtheih pen zah genna ahi a, tu in a sungah om zah genna hilo hi.

senses.heading: The ability to do, understand, or produce something
senses.definition_en: The ability or power to do, understand, experience, or produce something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sem, tel, thuak ahih kei leh bawlkhia theihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Children have a great capacity to learn languages.
examples.zomi: Naupangte pau sin theihna lian nei uh hi.

examples.english: The factory increased its production capacity.
examples.zomi: Vanbawlna inn in van bawlkhia theih zah khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: The structure capacity to do something is common when talking about ability.
senses.usage_zomi: Siamtheihna gen ciangin capacity to do something cih zatdan kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: The main city of a country or region
senses.definition_en: The city where the government of a country or region is officially based.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam ahih kei leh gamkhen ukna kumpi ophiste a omna khuapi bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: Washington, D.C., is the capital of the United States.
examples.zomi: Washington, D.C. pen United States khuapi bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: They traveled to the capital for an official meeting.
examples.zomi: Kumpi kimuhkhopna ading khuapi bulpi ah khualzin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A capital is the seat of government. It is not always the largest city in the country.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuapi bulpi pen kumpi ukna a omna khuapi ahi hi. Gam sungah khuapi lianpen hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Money or property used to start or operate a business
senses.definition_en: Money, equipment, or property used to start, support, or expand a business.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumdawnna khat kipat, kizomsak ahih kei leh khangsakna dingin kizang sum, vanzat leh neihsa ahi hi.

examples.english: They needed more capital to expand the business.
examples.zomi: Sumdawnna khangsak dingin sum bul tamzaw kisam uh hi.

examples.english: She used her savings as starting capital.
examples.zomi: A sumkhol kipatna sum bul in zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In business, capital means resources used to create more economic value, not ordinary spending money.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumdawnna ah capital pen sum manpha tamzaw piangsakna dingin kizang neihsa ahi a, nisim zat ding sum biasa hilo hi.

senses.heading: A large form of a letter
senses.definition_en: The large form of a written letter, such as A, B, or C.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laihawmla tungah A, B, C bangin a lian in kigelh lai mal ahi hi.

examples.english: Begin each sentence with a capital letter.
examples.zomi: Sentence sim lai mal lian tawh kipan in.

examples.english: Write your last name in capital letters.
examples.zomi: Na innkuan min lai mal liante tawh gelh in.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly says capital letter. British English also uses capital as a noun for the letter itself.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah capital letter kizang tampi hi. British English ah lai mal lian mah genna in capital bek zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: The person in command of a ship or aircraft
senses.definition_en: The person who commands and is responsible for a ship or aircraft.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tembaw ahih kei leh vanleng uk a, a bitna leh a khualzinna a mawpuak mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The captain guided the ship safely into port.
examples.zomi: Tembaw ukpa in tembaw bit takin tembaw khawhna ah tun hi.

examples.english: The captain welcomed the passengers aboard the aircraft.
examples.zomi: Vanleng ukpa in vanleng sung khualzinte nawl hi.

senses.usage_en: The professional title Captain is capitalized when it comes directly before a person’s name.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep min Captain pen mi min ma-ah om leh lai mal lian tawh kipan ding hi.

senses.heading: The leader of a sports team
senses.definition_en: A player chosen to lead a sports team.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawl pawl makaih dingin a kiteel kimawlmi ahi hi.

examples.english: The players chose her as team captain.
examples.zomi: Kimawlmite in amah pawl makaipa in teel uh hi.

examples.english: The captain encouraged the team before the game.
examples.zomi: Kimawlma in pawl makaipa in a pawl hansak hi.

senses.usage_en: The captain leads the players but is not necessarily the same person as the coach.
senses.usage_zomi: Captain in kimawlmite makaih hi napi, coach tawh mi khat hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: To catch and take control of someone or something
senses.definition_en: To catch a person, animal, or place and bring it under control.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing ahih kei leh mun khat man in, ukna nuai ah koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The police captured the suspect near the border.
examples.zomi: Police in mawhnei kigingna mi gamgi kiangah man hi.

examples.english: The soldiers captured the town after a long battle.
examples.zomi: Kidona sawtpi khit ciangin galkapte in khuapi ukzaw uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Capture usually suggests gaining control. Catch is the more general everyday word.
senses.usage_zomi: Capture in na khat man in ukzaw cihna thupi sak hi. Catch pen nisim ah a kimzaw in kizang kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: To record an image, sound, feeling, or event
senses.definition_en: To record or accurately represent an image, sound, event, or feeling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim, aw, thupiang ahih kei leh lungsim dinmun khat record ahih kei leh lim sungah muhtheih in koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The camera captured the accident clearly.
examples.zomi: Camera in accident siang takin record hi.

examples.english: The photograph captures the beauty of the valley.
examples.zomi: Lim in kuam hoihna muhtheih in lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, capture means preserving or representing something so that it can be seen, heard, or understood later.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah capture in na khat a nungciangin mu, za ahih kei leh teltheihna dingin kem cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A road vehicle with four wheels, usually carrying a small number of people.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in leng li nei a, lampi tungah mi tawm tawi in a pai mawtaw ahi hi.

examples.english: She drives her car to work every day.
examples.zomi: Nisim a mawtaw tawh nasepna ah pai hi.

examples.english: We left the bags in the car.
examples.zomi: Sakhau te mawtaw sungah nusia ung.

senses.usage_en: In American English, car usually means a passenger automobile. Larger passenger vehicles may be called vans, buses, or trucks according to their design and use.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah car pen mi tawm tawi mawtaw genna ahi hi. A lianzawte pen a kibawlna leh a zatna ciangin van, bus ahih kei leh truck kici hi.

senses.heading: A small, flat piece of stiff paper or plastic
senses.definition_en: A small, flat piece of stiff paper or plastic used to show information, send a message, or make a payment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu leh min lakna, thupuak gelhna ahih kei leh sum piakna dingin kizang lai-khau ahih kei leh plastic pheek neu ahi hi.

examples.english: Please show your identity card.
examples.zomi: Na minneihna card lak in.

examples.english: She paid for the meal by credit card.
examples.zomi: An man credit card tawh pia hi.

senses.usage_en: The meaning of card is often shown by the word before it, such as credit card, business card, or birthday card.
senses.usage_zomi: Card khiatna pen a ma-ah om kammal in lak zel hi; gentehna, credit card, business card leh birthday card.

senses.heading: One of a set of playing cards
senses.definition_en: One of a set of specially marked cards used in games.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna ah kizang lim leh number tuamtuam nei lai-khau pheekte lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: They played cards after dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak-an nek khit ciangin card kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: He placed three cards on the table.
examples.zomi: Dohkan tungah card thum koih hi.

senses.usage_en: In the phrase play cards, no article is used before cards.
senses.usage_zomi: Play cards cih kammal ah cards ma-ah article kizang lo hi.

senses.heading: Attention given to keep someone safe and healthy
senses.definition_en: The attention and help given to protect someone’s health, safety, or well-being.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat cidam, bit leh nop takin a omtheihna ding a kipiak huhna leh kepna ahi hi.

examples.english: The patient needs continuous medical care.
examples.zomi: Cinate in a tawntung zatna kepna kisam hi.

examples.english: The children are in their grandmother’s care.
examples.zomi: Naupangte a pi kepna nuai ah om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Care is often uncountable when it means help or treatment. Take care of means to look after someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: Huhna ahih kei leh cidamna a cihna ah care simtheihloh noun ahi zel hi. Take care of in mi ahih kei leh na khat kem cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Serious attention used to avoid mistakes or damage
senses.definition_en: Close attention used to do something properly and avoid mistakes or harm.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hoih takin sem a, khialhna leh siatna pelh ding a kisam kidopna ahi hi.

examples.english: Handle the glass with care.
examples.zomi: Lim kidawmtak in len in.

examples.english: The documents were prepared with great care.
examples.zomi: Documentte kidopna lian tawh kithawi hi.

senses.usage_en: Take care! can also be a friendly way to say goodbye and wish someone safety.
senses.usage_zomi: Take care! pen kikhen laitak in lawm takin “Kidawm in!” ci a bitna deihsakna in zong kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: The work a person does and develops through a significant part of life.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a nuntak sung hun sawtpi a sep a, siamna leh dinmun a khantohpih nasep lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: She chose a career in medicine.
examples.zomi: Zatna lam nasep lampi teel hi.

examples.english: He began his teaching career twenty years ago.
examples.zomi: Kum sawmnih beisa in a sangsiah nasep lampi kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: A job is a particular position, while a career is the longer course of a person’s working life.
senses.usage_zomi: Job pen nasep dinmun khat ahi a, career ahih leh mi khat nuntak sung nasep lampi sawtzaw ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Giving close attention to avoid mistakes, damage, or danger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna, siatna ahih kei leh lauhuaina pelh dingin pilvang leh kidawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Be careful when you cross the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi na kantan ciangin kidawm in.

examples.english: She made a careful examination of the report.
examples.zomi: Report pen pilvang takin sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: Use careful after a linking verb or before a noun: Be careful; a careful worker.
senses.usage_zomi: Careful pen linking verb nungah ahih kei leh noun ma-ah kizang hi: Be careful; a careful worker.

senses.definition_en: In a way that gives close attention and avoids mistakes, damage, or danger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna, siatna leh lauhuaina a omlohna dingin kidawm leh pilvang takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Read the instructions carefully before you begin.
examples.zomi: Na kipatma in thuhilhnate kidawmtak in sim in.

examples.english: She carefully placed the glass on the table.
examples.zomi: Lim pen dohkan tungah kidawmtak in koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Carefully describes how an action is performed. The adjective form is careful.
senses.usage_zomi: Carefully in nasep khat bangci sem cih lak hi. A adjective form pen careful ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Not giving enough attention and therefore likely to make mistakes or cause damage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidopna leh pilvangna kicing neiloin, khialhna ahih kei leh siatna piangsak baih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A careless mistake changed the final total.
examples.zomi: Kidoplohna khialhna khat in a vekpi simna khelsak hi.

examples.english: Do not be careless with important documents.
examples.zomi: Document thupite tawh kidawmlo in om kei in.

senses.usage_en: Careless means insufficient attention. It does not necessarily mean that the person intended to cause harm.
senses.usage_zomi: Careless in kidopna kicinglo cihna ahi a, tua mi in siatna piangsak nuam pahpah cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Thick material used to cover the floor of a room.
senses.explanation_zomi: Innkuang tuam dingin kizang puan khau leh nem ahi hi.

examples.english: The room has a soft gray carpet.
examples.zomi: Inn sungah carpet vomdeuh nem om hi.

examples.english: Please remove your shoes before walking on the carpet.
examples.zomi: Carpet tungah na kalsuanma in na khepek suah in.

senses.usage_en: Carpet usually covers most or all of a floor. A smaller movable floor covering is called a rug.
senses.usage_zomi: Carpet in innkuang a tamzaw ahih kei leh a vekpi tuam hi. Innkuang puan neu a kisuan thei pen rug kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A long, usually orange root vegetable eaten raw or cooked.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in a pian san-eng, a sau a, a zung nek dingin a kiphut anhang nam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She added carrots to the soup.
examples.zomi: Soup sungah carrot behlap hi.

examples.english: The children ate raw carrots as a snack.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in anlakna in carrot huanlo ne uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Carrot is countable when referring to individual vegetables and uncountable when referring generally to the food.
senses.usage_zomi: Carrot pakhat sim a gen ciangin simtheih noun ahi a, an nam in a kim gen ciangin simtheihloh in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: To hold and take someone or something from one place to another
senses.definition_en: To support and move someone or something from one place to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat khut, liang ahih kei leh pumpi tawh tawi in mun dangah paisak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you carry this box for me?
examples.zomi: Hih kuang kei ading hong tawi thei diam?

examples.english: She carried the baby in her arms.
examples.zomi: Naungeek a khut tawh pua hi.

senses.usage_en: Carry focuses on supporting and moving something. Bring and take also show the direction of movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Carry in na khat dom in tawi cihna thupi sak hi. Bring leh take in a tawina a paina lam zong lak hi.

senses.heading: To contain, transport, or communicate something
senses.definition_en: To contain or transport people, goods, information, sound, or disease.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, van, thupuak, aw ahih kei leh natna khat tawi ahih kei leh paisak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bus can carry fifty passengers.
examples.zomi: Bus in khualzin mi sawmnga tawi thei hi.

examples.english: Mosquitoes can carry serious diseases.
examples.zomi: Tho in natna nasia puak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, carry does not always involve holding something in the hands.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah carry pen khut tawh tawi cihna bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: A humorous or simplified drawing
senses.definition_en: A drawing, often humorous, that shows a person, event, or idea in a simplified way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, thupiang ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat nuihza huai ahih kei leh baih takin lak lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The newspaper published a political cartoon.
examples.zomi: Thuthak lai in gamvai cartoon khat suah hi.

examples.english: The cartoon made the readers laugh.
examples.zomi: Cartoon in lai simte nuisak hi.

senses.usage_en: A single cartoon may be one drawing, while a comic strip usually contains a sequence of drawings.
senses.usage_zomi: Cartoon khat pen lim khat bek hithei a, comic strip ahih leh lim tuamtuam kizom khawm ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: An animated film or television program
senses.definition_en: A film or television program made from drawings or computer-generated images.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim kigelh ahih kei leh computer tawh kibawl limte nungta bangin a kalsak khuamuh ahi hi.

examples.english: The children watched a cartoon after school.
examples.zomi: Sang khit ciangin naupangte cartoon en uh hi.

examples.english: This cartoon teaches children about friendship.
examples.zomi: Hih cartoon in naupangte lawmkina thu hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday English, cartoon often means an animated children’s program, but cartoons can also be made for adults.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim English ah cartoon in naupangte lim kalsuan program gen zel napi, mihing picingte ading zong kibawl thei hi.

senses.heading: A particular situation or example
senses.definition_en: A particular situation, event, or example of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, thupiang ahih kei leh thu khat a tuam in a kigente lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: In this case, we need more information.
examples.zomi: Hih dinmun ah thu tamzaw kisam hi.

examples.english: Each case must be examined separately.
examples.zomi: Thu sim tuamtuam in kisittel ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In case can also introduce preparation for a possible situation: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
senses.usage_zomi: In case in thupiang khat a pian theih manin kisakholhna zong lak thei hi: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

senses.heading: A matter investigated by police or considered by a court
senses.definition_en: A crime or legal matter being investigated or decided.
senses.explanation_zomi: Police in a sittel ahih kei leh thukhenna zumpi in a ngaihsut mawhna thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The police are investigating the case.
examples.zomi: Police in tua thu sittel uh hi.

examples.english: The court will hear the case next week.
examples.zomi: Kal naungin thukhenna zumpi in tua thu za ding hi.

senses.usage_en: A legal case may be criminal or civil. It does not always involve a crime.
senses.usage_zomi: Daan lam case pen mawhna thu ahih kei leh mihingte kikal thu hithei hi. Mawhna thu hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: A protective container
senses.definition_en: A container designed to hold or protect a particular object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanzat khat koih leh siatna pan kem dingin a kibawl kuang ahih kei leh tuam ahi hi.

examples.english: She put her glasses in their case.
examples.zomi: A mitkha a kuang sungah koih hi.

examples.english: This phone case protects the screen and edges.
examples.zomi: Hih phone tuam in screen leh a geite kem hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the type of case is normally identified by another word, such as phone case or glasses case.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah case nam pen phone case ahih kei leh glasses case bangin kammal dang tawh kician sak hi.

senses.definition_en: Money in the form of coins and paper notes rather than a check, card, or electronic payment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Check, card ahih kei leh electronic sum piakna hilo in, sum pheek leh sum tang in a om sum ahi hi.

examples.english: The store accepts cash and credit cards.
examples.zomi: Dawr in sumtang leh credit card sang hi.

examples.english: I do not have enough cash with me.
examples.zomi: Ka kiangah sumtang kicing ka nei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Cash is uncountable. Say some cash or an amount of cash, not a cash.
senses.usage_zomi: Cash pen simtheihloh noun ahi hi. A cash ci lo in some cash ahih kei leh an amount of cash ci ding hi.

senses.heading: The actors in a play, film, or television program
senses.definition_en: All the actors who perform in a play, film, or television program.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zatna, khuamuh ahih kei leh television program sungah mi lim a la khempeuh ahi uh hi.

examples.english: The film has a large cast.
examples.zomi: Khuamuh sungah lim-la tampi om hi.

examples.english: The entire cast returned for the final scene.
examples.zomi: A tawpna mun ading lim-late khempeuh hong kik uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Cast is a collective noun. It may take a singular or plural verb depending on the variety of English and whether the group is viewed as one unit or as individuals.
senses.usage_zomi: Cast pen mihon genna collective noun ahi hi. English nam leh mihon khat in ahih kei leh mimal tuamtuam in a kingaihna ciangin singular ahih kei leh plural verb tawh kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: A hard covering used to protect a broken bone
senses.definition_en: A hard protective covering placed around an injured or broken body part while it heals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Guh kitan ahih kei leh pumpi lang a liam pen damkik laitak a kilinglo dingin a kituam tuam khauh ahi hi.

examples.english: He wore a cast on his broken leg.
examples.zomi: A khe guh kitan tungah cast tuam hi.

examples.english: The doctor removed the cast after six weeks.
examples.zomi: Kal guk khit ciangin siavuan in cast suah hi.

senses.usage_en: This medical covering is often called a plaster cast, although modern casts may be made from other materials.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna tuam pen plaster cast zong kici napi, tulai castte van dang tawh zong kibawl thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A large, strong building formerly built to protect a ruler or important family from attack.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tanglai in kumpi ahih kei leh innkuan thupi khat gal pan kepna dingin bang khau leh lian tak tawh a kilam innpi ahi hi.

examples.english: The old castle stands on a hill.
examples.zomi: Kulh inn lui mualtungah ding hi.

examples.english: Thousands of tourists visit the castle each year.
examples.zomi: Kum simin khualzin mi tul tampi in kulh inn veh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In castle, the letter t is silent.
senses.usage_zomi: Castle kammal sungah t aw kisasak lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A small domesticated animal with soft fur, pointed ears, and a long tail, often kept as a pet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sam nem, bil zum leh mei sau nei, innah a kivulh zel ganhing neu ahi hi.

examples.english: The cat is sleeping under the chair.
examples.zomi: Zawng tutna nuai ah ih hi.

examples.english: She feeds her cat twice a day.
examples.zomi: Ni khat in a zawng an nihvei pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A young cat is called a kitten.
senses.usage_zomi: Zawngno pen English in kitten kici hi.

senses.heading: To stop and hold something moving through the air
senses.definition_en: To take hold of something that is moving or has been thrown.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kihei ahih kei leh a kileh na khat man in len cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: khut khat tawh na khat man

examples.english: She caught the ball with both hands.
examples.zomi: Ball pen khut nihgel tawh man hi.

examples.english: Can you catch the keys if I throw them?
examples.zomi: Tawhpite ka lawn leh na man thei diam?

senses.usage_en: Its forms are catch–caught–caught.
senses.usage_zomi: Catch pen irregular verb ahi a, catch–caught–caught ci in kikhel hi.

senses.heading: To capture a person or animal
senses.definition_en: To find, reach, and capture a person or animal that is escaping or hiding.
senses.explanation_zomi: A taisan ahih kei leh a buk mi ahih kei leh ganhing zui in man cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The police caught the thief.
examples.zomi: Police in guta man hi.

examples.english: They caught three fish in the river.
examples.zomi: Gun sungah ngasa thum man uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Catch is general. Capture often emphasizes taking control of someone, an animal, or a place.
senses.usage_zomi: Catch pen a kimzaw kammal ahi hi. Capture in mi, ganhing ahih kei leh mun khat man in ukzaw cihna thupi sak hi.

senses.heading: To reach transport before it leaves
senses.definition_en: To arrive in time to travel on a bus, train, plane, or similar form of transport.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bus, meileng, vanleng ahih kei leh khualzinna mawtaw khat a paihma in tuangzawh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We left early to catch the train.
examples.zomi: Meileng man dingin manlang takin kipan ung.

examples.english: She ran to catch the last bus.
examples.zomi: Bus nunung man dingin tai hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, catch means successfully reaching and boarding the transport, not physically holding it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah catch in mawtaw a paihma in tuangzawh cihna ahi a, khut tawh len cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: To become infected with an illness
senses.definition_en: To become infected with an illness, especially one that spreads between people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pan midang ah a kizelh thei natna kai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He caught a cold during the trip.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna sungah khuasik natna kai hi.

examples.english: Wash your hands to reduce the risk of catching an infection.
examples.zomi: Natna kai lauhuaina kiam sak dingin na khut sil in.

senses.usage_en: English commonly uses catch with infectious illnesses such as a cold or the flu, but not with every disease.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah catch pen a cold leh the flu bang kizelh natnate tawh kizang zel a, natna khempeuh tawh kizang lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A group of people or things that share particular qualities.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibang dinmun, mel ahih kei leh zia nei mite ahih kei leh na-te kigawm pawl khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Books are arranged by category.
examples.zomi: Laibute a nam ciangin kikhen hi.

examples.english: This product belongs in a different category.
examples.zomi: Hih van pen khen dang sungah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: A category is created by grouping items according to shared features or purposes.
senses.usage_zomi: Category pen na-te a mel, zia ahih kei leh a zatna kibang ciangin pawl khat in khenna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The reason something happens
senses.definition_en: The person, event, or condition that makes something happen.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a pianna hang; a bulpi; hang
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupiang khat piangsak mi, thupiang ahih kei leh dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: Doctors are trying to find the cause of the illness.
examples.zomi: Siavuan te natna pianna hang zongkhia dingin hanciam uh hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain was the main cause of the flooding.
examples.zomi: Guah tampi pen tuiciin pianna hang bulpi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A cause produces a result. A reason explains why someone acts or why something is believed.
senses.usage_zomi: Cause in thupiang khat piangsak hi. Reason in mi khat banghangin gamta ahih kei leh thu khat banghangin a kingai cih hilh hi.

senses.heading: An aim or principle that people support
senses.definition_en: An aim, belief, or social effort that people support and work for.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte in hoih asak uh, a panpih uh a, tangtun ding a nasem uh ngiimna ahih kei leh upna thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The event raised money for a good cause.
examples.zomi: Tua thupiang in ngiimna hoih khat ading sum kaikhawm hi.

examples.english: Many people support the cause of equal rights.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi in dinmun kikim neihna ngiimna panpih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a cause is something people believe deserves support.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah cause pen mihingte in panpih dingin kilawm a sak uh ngiimna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A small plastic disc used to store and play music, data, or other digital information.
senses.explanation_zomi: La, data ahih kei leh digital thu koih a, computer ahih kei leh CD player tawh sim dingin kizang plastic pheek kim ahi hi.

examples.english: She played an old music CD in the car.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw sungah la CD lui khat khah hi.

examples.english: The software was stored on a CD.
examples.zomi: Software pen CD sungah kikhol hi.

senses.usage_en: CD stands for compact disc. Digital downloads and streaming have replaced CDs for many uses.
senses.usage_zomi: CD pen compact disc a tomlakna ahi hi. Tuni in a zatna tampi ah digital download leh streaming in CD laanta hi.

senses.definition_en: The inside surface at the top of a room.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn sungah lutunglam a tuam, innkhum nuai a phei lang ahi hi.

examples.english: A fan hangs from the ceiling.
examples.zomi: Ceiling pan huihmut khat kikhai hi.

examples.english: Water was leaking through the ceiling.
examples.zomi: Ceiling pan tui hong luang hi.

senses.usage_en: The ceiling is inside a room. The roof is the outside covering on top of a building.
senses.usage_zomi: Ceiling pen inn sung tunglam ahi hi. Roof ahih leh inn pualam tungah a tuam innkhum ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To do something enjoyable or special to honor an important event, achievement, or occasion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupiang, gualzawhna ahih kei leh hun thupi khat zahtak leh lungdamna tawh pawina bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We celebrated her graduation with a family meal.
examples.zomi: A sangzawhna innkuan ankuang tawh pawl ung.

examples.english: The team celebrated its victory.
examples.zomi: Pawl in a gualzawhna uh pawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Celebrate is followed directly by the event: celebrate a birthday, not normally celebrate for a birthday.
senses.usage_zomi: Celebrate nungah a kipawl thupiang hong pai pah hi: celebrate a birthday ci ding a, celebrate for a birthday ci khollo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: An enjoyable event or activity held to honor an important occasion or achievement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun thupi ahih kei leh gualzawhna zahtak leh lungdamna tawh kipawlna thupiang ahi hi.

examples.english: The graduation celebration lasted all afternoon.
examples.zomi: Sangzawhna pawina nitaklam vekpi sawt hi.

examples.english: They invited their neighbors to the celebration.
examples.zomi: Pawina ah a innpaamte uh sam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Celebration may refer to one organized event or to the general act of celebrating.
senses.usage_zomi: Celebration in pawi khat ahih kei leh lungdamna tawh pawlna a kim gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A famous person, especially someone well known through entertainment or the media.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in khuamuh, la, kimawlna ahih kei leh media tungtawnin minthang mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Several celebrities attended the event.
examples.zomi: Mi minthang pawlkhat tua thupiang ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: He became a celebrity after appearing on television.
examples.zomi: Television ah kilang khit ciangin mi minthang hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: A celebrity is widely known by the public. Fame does not necessarily mean expertise or authority.
senses.usage_zomi: Celebrity pen mipite in a theih mahmah mi ahi hi. Minthanna in thu khat siam ahih kei leh ukna nei cihna pia pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: The smallest basic unit of a living organism
senses.definition_en: The smallest structural and functional unit of a plant, animal, or other living organism.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung, ganhing leh nuntakna nei a dangte a pumpi bawlkhia, a neupen nuntakna lang ahi hi.

examples.english: The human body contains trillions of cells.
examples.zomi: Mihing pumpi sungah cell trillion tampi om hi.

examples.english: Cancer begins when abnormal cells grow without control.
examples.zomi: Cell hoihlo te ukzawhloh in a khan ciangin cancer kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: In biology, a cell is a living unit. Different cells perform different functions.
senses.usage_zomi: Biology ah cell pen nuntakna nei lang neu ahi hi. Cell nam tuamtuam in nasep tuamtuam nei hi.

senses.heading: A small room in a prison
senses.definition_en: A small locked room where one or more prisoners are kept.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thongtakte khum dingin a kikhak thonginn sung innkhan neu ahi hi.

examples.english: The prisoner was returned to his cell.
examples.zomi: Thongtak pen a thongkhan ah kikhual kik hi.

examples.english: Two prisoners shared the same cell.
examples.zomi: Thongtak nih in thongkhan khat zangkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, cell means one small room within a larger prison.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah cell pen thonginn lian sungah om innkhan neu khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: A battery unit that produces electricity
senses.definition_en: A device or unit within a battery that produces electrical energy through a chemical reaction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Chemical kikhelna tungtawnin meima bawlkhia battery lang khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The battery contains several individual cells.
examples.zomi: Battery sungah cell tuamtuam pawlkhat om hi.

examples.english: Solar cells convert sunlight into electricity.
examples.zomi: Nitaang meima cell te in ni khuavak meima suaksak hi.

senses.usage_en: A battery may contain one cell or several cells joined together.
senses.usage_zomi: Battery khat sungah cell khat bek ahih kei leh cell tampi kizom khawm om thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A unit of money equal to one hundredth of a dollar or certain other currencies.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dollar khat a za khenkhat tawh a kikim sum simna ahi hi.

examples.english: The stamp costs sixty cents.
examples.zomi: Stamp man cent sawmguk ahi hi.

examples.english: She found a ten-cent coin on the floor.
examples.zomi: Innkuang ah cent sawm sum tang khat mu hi.

senses.usage_en: One hundred cents equal one dollar. Use singular cent after one and plural cents after most other numbers.
senses.usage_zomi: Cent za in dollar khat pha hi. Khat nungah singular cent zang a, number dangte nungah plural cents kizang hi.

senses.heading: In or near the middle
senses.definition_en: Located in or near the middle of a place or area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih kei leh gam khat a laizang ah ahih kei leh laizang kiangah om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel is in a central location.
examples.zomi: Hotel pen khuapi laizang munah om hi.

examples.english: They live in central Ohio.
examples.zomi: Amaute Ohio laizang ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Central describes something in or near the center. Center or centre is usually the noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Central in laizang ah om na khat gen hi. Center ahih kei leh centre pen noun ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Most important or basic
senses.definition_en: Having the greatest importance or forming the main part of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat sungah a thupipen ahih kei leh a bulpi pen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Trust is central to a strong relationship.
examples.zomi: Kizopna kip ading kimuanna pen a thupipen ahi hi.

examples.english: The central idea of the speech was unity.
examples.zomi: Thugenna a ngaihsutna bulpi pen pumkhatna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, central means essential or highly important, not physically in the middle.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah central pen mun laizang ah om cihna hilo a, kisam mahmah leh thupi mahmah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The middle point or part
senses.definition_en: The middle point or area of a place, object, or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, na ahih kei leh nasep khat a laizang pen ahi hi.

examples.english: A table stood in the centre of the room.
examples.zomi: Innkhan laizang ah dohkan khat om hi.

examples.english: The shop is near the city centre.
examples.zomi: Dawr pen khuapi laizang kiangah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Centre is the British spelling. The American spelling is center.
senses.usage_zomi: Centre pen British spelling ahi hi. American spelling pen center ahi hi.

senses.heading: A place providing a particular service or activity
senses.definition_en: A building or place used for a particular service, purpose, or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, huhna ahih kei leh gamtatna tuam khat ading a kizang inn ahih kei leh mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The health centre opens at eight o’clock.
examples.zomi: Cidamna phual nai giat ciangin kihong hi.

examples.english: The children attend activities at the community centre.
examples.zomi: Naupangte khua mipite phualah gamtatna tuamtuam ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The spelling remains centre in British English compounds such as shopping centre. American English uses shopping center.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah shopping centre bang kammal kizomte sungah centre kigelh hi. American English ah shopping center kigelh hi.

senses.definition_en: A period of one hundred years.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum za khat sung hun ciangtan ahi hi.

examples.english: The building was constructed in the nineteenth century.
examples.zomi: Innpi pen kum zabi sawmkuana sungin kilam hi.

examples.english: Technology changed rapidly during the last century.
examples.zomi: Kum zabi beisa sungin technology manlang takin kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: The first century covers years 1–100, so the years 1901–2000 form the twentieth century.
senses.usage_zomi: Kum zabi masa in kum 1 pan 100 dong huam ahih manin, kum 1901 pan 2000 dong pen kum zabi sawmnihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A formal event held to mark an important religious, social, or public occasion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna, mipite ngeina ahih kei leh mipi thu tawh kisai hun thupi khat ciamtehna ding a kibawl pawi leh ngeina ahi hi.

examples.english: The wedding ceremony began at noon.
examples.zomi: Kiteenna pawi sun laitak in kipan hi.

examples.english: Parents attended the graduation ceremony.
examples.zomi: Nulepate sangzawhna pawi ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A ceremony is usually formal and follows an established order. A celebration may be less formal and focuses on enjoyment.
senses.usage_zomi: Ceremony pen a tamzaw in ngeina kizui in a thupi takin kibawl hi. Celebration ahih leh lungdamna leh nopna thupi sak a, a thupi mahmah hi kullo hi.

senses.heading: Completely sure
senses.definition_en: Having no doubt that something is true or will happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat thumaan ahih kei leh piang taktak ding cih lunghianna neilo in muang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am certain that I locked the door.
examples.zomi: Kong ka khak cih ka lungmuang hi.

examples.english: Are you certain about the date?
examples.zomi: Ni tawh kisai na lungmuang hiam?

senses.usage_en: Certain is stronger than likely. It expresses confidence rather than probability.
senses.usage_zomi: Certain pen likely sangin kicianzaw hi. Piangthei ciang bek hilo in lungmuanna lak hi.

senses.heading: Particular but not named exactly
senses.definition_en: Used to refer to a particular person or thing without naming or identifying them exactly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat gen napi, min leh a hihna kician takin genlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Certain foods can cause allergic reactions.
examples.zomi: An pawlkhat in pumpi nialna piangsak thei hi.

examples.english: A certain man asked to speak with you.
examples.zomi: Pasal khat in nang hong hopih nuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Before a plural noun, certain often means “some particular”: certain rules. Before a singular noun, a certain may refer to someone or something not named.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural noun ma-ah certain in “a tuam pawlkhat” cihna nei hi. Singular noun ma-ah a certain in min genloh mi ahih kei leh na khat gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Without doubt; used to show strong confidence, agreement, or willingness.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kician takin; taktak in; ahi mah
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunghianna omlo in kician takin cihna ahi a, thukimna leh sem nuamna khauh takin lakna in zong kizang hi.

examples.english: The decision will certainly affect many people.
examples.zomi: Tua thukhenna in mi tampi kician takin suk ding hi.

examples.english: “Can you help me?” “Certainly.”
examples.zomi: “Kei hong panpih thei diam?” “Panpih ing.”

senses.usage_en: As a short answer, Certainly is a polite and confident way to say yes.
senses.usage_zomi: Dawnna tom in Certainly pen zahtakna leh lungmuanna tawh “Ahi” cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A series of connected metal rings
senses.definition_en: A strong length made from metal rings connected together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thir kualte khat leh khat kizomsakin a kibawl thirgui khauh ahi hi.

examples.english: The gate was secured with a heavy chain.
examples.zomi: Kongpi thir-kol gik tawh kikhak hi.

examples.english: The bicycle chain came off.
examples.zomi: Bicycle thir-kol pusuak hi.

senses.usage_en: A chain consists of connected links. It may be used for fastening, pulling, lifting, or decoration.
senses.usage_zomi: Chain pen thir kual kizomte tawh kibawl a, khakna, kaihna, domna ahih kei leh kizepna in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: A group of businesses under the same ownership or name
senses.definition_en: A group of stores, hotels, or other businesses owned or managed as one organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Neipa ahih kei leh min khat nuai ah a kizom dawr, hotel ahih kei leh sumdawnna pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: She works for a national hotel chain.
examples.zomi: Gam sung hotel pawl khat ading nasem hi.

examples.english: The restaurant chain opened three new locations.
examples.zomi: Annek dawr pawl in mun thak thum hon hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, each business location belongs to the same larger company or system.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah sumdawnna mun sim company ahih kei leh ukna lian khat nuai ah kihel hi.

senses.heading: A seat for one person
senses.definition_en: A piece of furniture designed for one person to sit on, usually with a back.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tutna dingin a kibawl, a tamzaw in a nung-nga nei innvan ahi hi.

examples.english: Please sit on the chair beside the desk.
examples.zomi: Dohkan kiang tutna tungah tu in.

examples.english: He pulled a chair closer to the table.
examples.zomi: Tutna khat dohkan kiangzaw ah kai hi.

senses.usage_en: Sit on a chair, but sit in an armchair when emphasizing that it surrounds or supports the body.
senses.usage_zomi: Tutna biasa ah sit on a chair ci a, pumpi a tuam deuh khutngak nei tutna ah sit in an armchair ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: The person leading a meeting or organization
senses.definition_en: The person responsible for leading a meeting, committee, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimuhkhopna, committee ahih kei leh pawl khat makaih leh uk mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The chair opened the meeting at nine o’clock.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in nai kua ciangin kimuhkhopna hon hi.

examples.english: Members elected her chair of the committee.
examples.zomi: Pawlte in amah committee makaipa in teel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Chair and chairperson are gender-neutral alternatives to chairman or chairwoman.
senses.usage_zomi: Chair leh chairperson pen pasal leh numei khenlo in kizang theih chairman leh chairwoman a laan kammalte ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A man who leads a meeting, committee, board, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimuhkhopna, committee, board ahih kei leh pawl khat makaih leh uk pasal ahi hi.

examples.english: The chairman welcomed the board members.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in board memberte nawl hi.

examples.english: He served as chairman for four years.
examples.zomi: Kum li sung makaipa in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Chairman specifically refers to a man. Chair, chairperson, or sometimes presiding officer can be used without identifying gender.
senses.usage_zomi: Chairman pen pasal makaipa genna ahi hi. Pasal leh numei khenlo dingin chair, chairperson ahih kei leh presiding officer kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: A difficult task or problem
senses.definition_en: A difficult task, situation, or problem that requires effort and skill.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna leh siamna kisam haksatna, nasep ahih kei leh buaina ahi hi.

examples.english: Learning a new language is a major challenge.
examples.zomi: Pau thak khat sinna pen haksatna lian ahi hi.

examples.english: The team overcame many challenges.
examples.zomi: Pawl in haksatna tampi zawh hi.

senses.usage_en: A challenge is difficult, but it may also provide an opportunity to improve or succeed.
senses.usage_zomi: Challenge pen haksa napi, khantohna ahih kei leh lawcinna ngahna hun hoih zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: An invitation to compete or prove something
senses.definition_en: An invitation or demand to compete, test an ability, or prove that a claim is correct.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidem, siamna sittel ahih kei leh thu khat thumaan cih kipsak ding a kisapna ahi hi.

examples.english: She accepted the challenge to run the race.
examples.zomi: Taisiamna kidem ding samna sang hi.

examples.english: The decision faced a legal challenge.
examples.zomi: Tua thukhenna daan tawh kinial hi.

senses.usage_en: A challenge may be friendly, competitive, or legal depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu omdan ciangin challenge pen lawm tak a kidemna, gualzawhna ding kidemna ahih kei leh daan tawh nialna hithei hi.

senses.heading: A person or team that wins a competition
senses.definition_en: A person or team that has defeated all other competitors and won first place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna ah a dangte khempeuh zo in mun masa ngah mi ahih kei leh pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: She became the national chess champion.
examples.zomi: Gam chess gualzonu hong suak hi.

examples.english: The team defeated last year’s champion.
examples.zomi: Pawl in kum beisa gualzopa zo hi.

senses.usage_en: The feminine form champion is also used for women; championess is not normally used.
senses.usage_zomi: Numei gualzo ading zong champion mah kizang a, championess kizang khollo hi.

senses.heading: A strong public supporter of a cause or group
senses.definition_en: A person who strongly supports and defends a cause, right, or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna, dikna ahih kei leh mihon khat khauh takin panpih leh kem mi ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mihing dikna ading a pang mi

examples.english: She was a champion of equal rights.
examples.zomi: Amah dikna kikim ading a pang mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor became a champion for rural health care.
examples.zomi: Siavuan pen khuata cidamna ading panpihpa hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a champion actively supports and defends something, not merely agrees with it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah champion pen thu khat thukim lel hilo a, a ading nasem leh kem mi ahi hi.

senses.heading: A possibility that something may happen
senses.definition_en: The possibility or likelihood that something will happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pian theihna ahih kei leh a pian ding lam-ettheih zah ahi hi.

examples.english: There is a good chance of rain tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zanin guah zuk theihna lian hi.

examples.english: She has little chance of missing the deadline.
examples.zomi: Hun ciangtan khial ding pian theihna tawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Use chance of before a noun or -ing form: a chance of success; a chance of winning.
senses.usage_zomi: Chance of nungah noun ahih kei leh -ing form kizang hi: a chance of success; a chance of winning.

senses.heading: An opportunity to do something
senses.definition_en: An opportunity to do or experience something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sem ahih kei leh thuak ding hun hoih ahi hi.

examples.english: I had a chance to speak with the director.
examples.zomi: Director tawh kiholna hun hoih ka ngah hi.

examples.english: Give her a chance to explain.
examples.zomi: A hilhcian theihna ding hun hoih pia in.

senses.usage_en: Use chance to do something when chance means opportunity.
senses.usage_zomi: Chance in hun hoih cihna a neih ciangin chance to do something ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: The way unpredictable events happen
senses.definition_en: The occurrence of events without a known plan or cause.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna kician ahih kei leh pianna hang theihsa omlo in thupiang khat piang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We met by chance at the airport.
examples.zomi: Airport ah tawmkhatthu in kimuh ung.

examples.english: Success did not happen by chance.
examples.zomi: Lawcinna tawmkhatthu in piang lo hi.

senses.usage_en: By chance means accidentally or without planning.
senses.usage_zomi: By chance in geelkholna omlo ahih kei leh tawmkhatthu in cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To become or make something different
senses.definition_en: To become different or to make someone or something different.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a omlam pan a dang suak ahih kei leh dang sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The weather changed suddenly.
examples.zomi: Khuahun thakhat in kikhel hi.

examples.english: We need to change our plan.
examples.zomi: Ka geelna uh khelsak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Change can be intransitive or transitive: The situation changed; They changed the situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Change pen object tello in zong kizang thei a, object tawh zong kizang thei hi: The situation changed; They changed the situation.

senses.heading: To replace one thing with another
senses.definition_en: To remove or stop using one thing and use another instead.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat suah ahih kei leh zat khawl a, tua a laan na dang khat zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I need to change my clothes.
examples.zomi: Ka puan ka khek kul hi.

examples.english: They stopped to change a flat tire.
examples.zomi: Huihbei mawtaw leng laan dingin khawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Change clothes usually means putting on different clothes. It does not mean altering the clothes themselves.
senses.usage_zomi: Change clothes in puan dang silh cihna ahi zel a, puan mah khelsak cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: To exchange money
senses.definition_en: To exchange money for a different currency or for notes and coins of different values.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum khat gamdang sum tawh ahih kei leh sum pheek leh sum tang man tuamtuam tawh khek cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Where can I change dollars into euros?
examples.zomi: Koiah dollar euro tawh ka khek thei ding hiam?

examples.english: Can you change this twenty-dollar bill?
examples.zomi: Hih dollar sawmnih pheek na khek thei diam?

senses.usage_en: When changing currency, use change A into B or exchange A for B.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamdang sum kikhek ciangin change A into B ahih kei leh exchange A for B ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: A television or radio service
senses.definition_en: A television or radio station or service that provides particular programs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Program tuamtuam khah television ahih kei leh radio station nasep khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The game is on a sports channel.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna sports channel ah om hi.

examples.english: Please change the channel to the news.
examples.zomi: Channel thuthak lamah khek in.

senses.usage_en: A channel may refer to the service itself or to its numbered position on a television or radio system.
senses.usage_zomi: Channel in program khahna nasep mah ahih kei leh television leh radio system sung a number nei mun gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A means through which information or communication passes
senses.definition_en: A route or system through which information, communication, or resources pass.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, kihopihna ahih kei leh van khat a paisuahna lampi leh system ahi hi.

examples.english: Use the official channel to report the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaina gen dingin ukna lampi zang in.

examples.english: Email is our main communication channel.
examples.zomi: Email pen ka kihopihna lampi bulpi uh ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, channel is often figurative and refers to an organized route or method.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah channel pen gentehna in kizang a, a kigeel kizopna lampi ahih kei leh zatdan gen hi.

senses.heading: A passage through which water flows
senses.definition_en: A natural or artificial passage through which water flows.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui luanna dingin a pian ahih kei leh mihing in a bawl tui lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: Water flows through a narrow channel.
examples.zomi: Tui lampi cik sungah tui luang hi.

examples.english: Farmers dug a channel to carry water to the fields.
examples.zomi: Lote ah tui paisak dingin lousiamte in tui lampi to uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A channel is usually longer than it is wide and directs water along a particular route.
senses.usage_zomi: Channel pen a za sangin a sauzaw a, tui lampi khat zui in luangsak hi.

senses.heading: A main division of a book
senses.definition_en: One of the main sections into which a book is divided.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu khat sungah a khenkhia thu khen liante lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: We read the first chapter in class.
examples.zomi: Sangkhan sungah khen masa sim ung.

examples.english: The answer appears in Chapter Five.
examples.zomi: Dawnna Khen Nga sungah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Chapter when it is followed by a number or title referring to a specific chapter.
senses.usage_zomi: Khen kician khat genna in number ahih kei leh min tawh a kizom ciangin Chapter lai mal lian tawh kipan ding hi.

senses.heading: A local branch of a larger organization
senses.definition_en: A local group that forms part of a larger organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawlpi lian khat nuai ah khuamun khat ading a kizom pawl khen ahi hi.

examples.english: The local chapter meets every month.
examples.zomi: Khuamun pawl khen kha simin kimuhkhawm hi.

examples.english: She joined the university chapter of the organization.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi a university pawl khen ah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a chapter belongs to a larger national or international organization.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah chapter pen gam sung ahih kei leh leitung huam pawlpi lianzaw sungah kihel hi.

senses.heading: A person in a story, play, film, or television program
senses.definition_en: A person, animal, or imagined being represented in a story, play, or film.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu, zatna ahih kei leh khuamuh sungah a kihel mihing, ganhing ahih kei leh ngaihsutna tawh kibawl nungta ahi hi.

examples.english: The main character leaves home to find work.
examples.zomi: Tangthu sung mi bulpi nasep zong dingin inn pan paikhia hi.

examples.english: She plays a doctor in the film.
examples.zomi: Khuamuh sungah siavuan dinmun la hi.

senses.usage_en: A character is the person or being represented in the story. The performer who plays the character is the actor.
senses.usage_zomi: Character pen tangthu sung mi ahi a, tua mi dinmun a la mi pen actor ahi hi.

senses.heading: The qualities that form a person’s nature
senses.definition_en: The combination of moral, mental, and emotional qualities that make a person behave in a particular way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat gamtatdan piangsak lungsim, thuman leh ngaihsutna ziate a kigawm ahi hi.

examples.english: Honesty is an important part of good character.
examples.zomi: Thumaan pen zia hoih a khen thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Hard experiences helped build her character.
examples.zomi: Thuakna haksate in a zia khangtosak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, character refers to inner qualities, not physical appearance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah character pen pualam mel hilo in, sunglam zia leh gamtatdan genna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A written or printed letter, number, or symbol
senses.definition_en: A letter, number, punctuation mark, or other symbol used in writing or computing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai-gelh ahih kei leh computer sungah kizang lai mal, number, ciamtehna ahih kei leh lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The password must contain at least eight characters.
examples.zomi: Password sungah lai mal, number leh lim a tawmpen giat om ding hi.

examples.english: Do not use special characters in the filename.
examples.zomi: File min sungah ciamtehna tuam zang kei in.

senses.usage_en: In computing, spaces and punctuation marks may also be counted as characters.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer thu ah mun awng leh lai ciamtehnate zong character in kisial thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A typical or noticeable quality that helps identify a person, group, or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mihon ahih kei leh na khat theihkhiatna ding a zia biasa ahih kei leh muhtheih zia ahi hi.

examples.english: Patience is an important characteristic of a good teacher.
examples.zomi: Thinsau theihna pen sangsiah hoih a zia thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The two plants share several characteristics.
examples.zomi: Sing nihte in zia kibang pawlkhat nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A characteristic may be positive, negative, or neutral. It simply helps describe or identify someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: Characteristic pen zia hoih, hoihlo ahih kei leh langnih a omlo zia hithei hi. Mi ahih kei leh na khat hilhcian leh theihkhiatna dingin kizang hi.

senses.heading: An amount of money requested for a service or product
senses.definition_en: An amount of money that must be paid for a service, activity, or product.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, gamtatna ahih kei leh van khat ading a kipia ding sum man ahi hi.

examples.english: There is an extra charge for delivery.
examples.zomi: Van tunsakna ading beh man om hi.

examples.english: Children may enter free of charge.
examples.zomi: Naupangte man neilo in lutthei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Charge is the amount requested. Cost is the amount required or paid more generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Charge pen van ahih kei leh nasep khat ading a kingen man ahi hi. Cost pen a kim in a kisam ahih kei leh a kipia man ahi hi.

senses.heading: A formal accusation of a crime
senses.definition_en: An official statement accusing someone of committing a crime.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat mawhna khat bawl ci in daan tawh a mawhsakna thu ahi hi.

examples.english: He faces a charge of theft.
examples.zomi: Gukna mawhsakna thuak hi.

examples.english: The court dismissed the charge.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi in mawhsakna paihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: A charge is an accusation, not proof that the person is guilty.
senses.usage_zomi: Charge pen mawhsakna ahi a, tua mi mawhnei taktak cih kipsakna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Responsibility for someone or something
senses.definition_en: Responsibility for controlling, protecting, or managing someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat uk, kem ahih kei leh makaih ding mawpuakna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is in charge of the finance department.
examples.zomi: Amah sumvai khen uk ding mawpuak hi.

examples.english: Who is in charge here?
examples.zomi: Hih munah kua in ukna mawpuak hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use in charge of before the person, group, or activity being managed.
senses.usage_zomi: In charge of nungah a ki-uk mi, pawl ahih kei leh nasep hong pai hi.

senses.heading: Electricity stored in an object
senses.definition_en: An amount of electricity held in a battery or another object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Battery ahih kei leh van khat sungah a kikhol meima ahi hi.

examples.english: The battery has lost its charge.
examples.zomi: Battery meima bei hi.

examples.english: The phone has enough charge for the trip.
examples.zomi: Phone in khualzinna ading meima kicing nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday technology, charge often refers to the electricity available in a rechargeable battery.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim technology zatna ah charge pen meima behkiktheih battery sungah a om meima gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Help given to people in need
senses.definition_en: Money, food, services, or other help given to people who need support.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huhna kisam mite ading a kipia sum, an, nasep ahih kei leh panpihna dang ahi hi.

examples.english: They donated clothes to charity.
examples.zomi: Mizawng huhna dingin puante pia uh hi.

examples.english: She does charity work on weekends.
examples.zomi: Kal tawp ciangin mizawng huhna nasep sem hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, charity is often uncountable and refers generally to helping people in need.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah charity pen simtheihloh noun ahi zel a, huhna kisam mite panpihna a kim gen hi.

senses.heading: An organization that helps people, animals, or a public cause
senses.definition_en: An organization established to provide help rather than make profit for owners.
senses.explanation_zomi: Neite ading sumpha zong hilo in, mihing, ganhing ahih kei leh mipi ngiimna khat huh ding a kipawl pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The charity provides meals to homeless people.
examples.zomi: Huhna pawl in inn neilo mite an pia hi.

examples.english: She works for a children’s charity.
examples.zomi: Naupang huhna pawl ading nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: A charity is a type of nonprofit organization, but not every nonprofit organization is legally a charity.
senses.usage_zomi: Charity pen sumpha zonglo pawl nam khat ahi napi, sumpha zonglo pawl khempeuh daan ciangin charity hi vek lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A diagram, table, or graphic that organizes information so it is easier to understand.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu leh numberte tel baihzaw dingin lim, dohkan ahih kei leh graph in a kigeelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The chart shows changes in population.
examples.zomi: Chart in mipha kikhelna lak hi.

examples.english: Use the chart to compare the results.
examples.zomi: Dawnnate etkak dingin chart zang in.

senses.usage_en: A chart presents information visually. A graph usually emphasizes numerical relationships, while a table arranges information in rows and columns.
senses.usage_zomi: Chart in thu muhtheih in lak hi. Graph in numberte kizopna thupi sak zel a, table in thu a khang leh a khuam ciangin koih hi.

senses.definition_en: To talk with someone in a friendly, informal way, either in person or through messages online.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh lawm tak leh nisim zatdan in kimaitakin ahih kei leh internet thupuak tawh kiholim cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We chatted for a few minutes after the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kimuhkhopna khit ciangin minute tawm kiholim ung.

examples.english: She often chats with her family online.
examples.zomi: A innkuanpihte tawh internet tungah kiholim zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Chat is informal and usually suggests a relaxed conversation. For a serious or formal discussion, use talk, discuss, or meet according to context.
senses.usage_zomi: Chat pen lawm tak leh daitak a kiholna ahi hi. Thu thupi ahih kei leh thupi tak a kiholimna ading thu omdan ciangin talk, discuss ahih kei leh meet kizang ding hi.

senses.heading: Costing little money
senses.definition_en: Low in price and costing less than similar things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van kibang dangte tawh etkak ciangin a man tawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We found a cheap hotel near the airport.
examples.zomi: Airport kiangah hotel man ol khat mu ung.

examples.english: Fresh vegetables are cheap at this market.
examples.zomi: Hih zawl ah anhang thakte man tawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Cheap means low-priced, but it can sometimes suggest poor quality. Use inexpensive when you want a more neutral or positive expression.
senses.usage_zomi: Cheap in man tawm cihna nei napi, ciang pawlkhat in quality niam cihna bang zong nei thei hi. Langnih a omlo ahih kei leh hoihzaw in gen dingin inexpensive kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Low in quality
senses.definition_en: Made poorly or lacking good quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoih takin kibawllo ahih kei leh quality niam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bag was cheap and broke quickly.
examples.zomi: Sakhau quality niam a, manlang takin sia hi.

examples.english: This furniture looks cheap.
examples.zomi: Hih innvan quality niam bang kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, cheap criticizes quality rather than price.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah cheap in man tawmna sangin quality niamna gen hi.

senses.heading: To act dishonestly to gain an advantage
senses.definition_en: To break rules or act dishonestly in order to win or gain an unfair advantage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzo ahih kei leh thutanglo hamphatna ngah dingin thukhun palsat ahih kei leh thumaanlo in gamta cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The student was punished for cheating on the exam.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang pen sittelna ah thumaanlo in a gamtat manin gim kipia hi.

examples.english: It is wrong to cheat in a competition.
examples.zomi: Kidemna ah thukhun palsat khial hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, students usually cheat on an exam. British English also commonly uses cheat in an exam.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah sangnaupangte cheat on an exam kici zel hi. British English ah cheat in an exam zong kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: To deceive someone, especially to take money or something valuable
senses.definition_en: To deceive someone so that they lose money, property, or a right.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat khem in a sum, neihsa ahih kei leh a dikna laksak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat khem in sum laksak

examples.english: The dishonest seller cheated customers out of their money.
examples.zomi: Vanzuakpa thumaanlo in leite khem in a sum uh laksak hi.

examples.english: She felt cheated by the unfair agreement.
examples.zomi: Thukimna thutanglo hangin khem a kisa hi.

senses.usage_en: Use cheat someone out of something when deception causes a person to lose it.
senses.usage_zomi: Khemna hangin mi khat in na khat a suploh gen dingin cheat someone out of something kizang hi.

senses.heading: To examine something for accuracy, safety, or condition
senses.definition_en: To examine something carefully to make sure it is correct, safe, complete, or working properly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat man, bit, kim ahih kei leh hoih takin sem cih kician dingin sittel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Check your answers before submitting the test.
examples.zomi: Sittelna lai na piakma in na dawnnate endik in.

examples.english: The mechanic checked the engine.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw siampa in engine sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: Check often means examining something to discover whether it is correct or in good condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Check in na khat man hiam ahih kei leh dinmun hoih hiam cih theihna dingin sittel cihna ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: To discover or confirm information
senses.definition_en: To look for information or confirm whether something is true or available.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat zong ahih kei leh thumaan, om ahih kei leh ngah theih hiam cih kiciansak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I checked the schedule online.
examples.zomi: Hun kigeelna internet tungah ka zong hi.

examples.english: Please check whether the door is locked.
examples.zomi: Kong kikhak hiam cih kiciansak in.

senses.usage_en: Check whether/if introduces the information that needs confirmation.
senses.usage_zomi: Check whether/if nungah a kiciansak ding thu hong pai hi.

senses.definition_en: Noticeably happy, positive, and pleasant.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungdamna leh lungnopna kilang a, nuam leh lawmhuai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She greeted us with a cheerful smile.
examples.zomi: Nuihna lungdam tawh kote hong nawl hi.

examples.english: He remained cheerful during a difficult week.
examples.zomi: Kal haksa sung zong lungnuam in om hi.

senses.usage_en: Cheerful describes happiness that is visible in a person’s behavior, voice, or appearance.
senses.usage_zomi: Cheerful in mi khat a gamtatna, aw ahih kei leh mel ah a kilang lungdamna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A food made from milk that is separated, pressed, and often left to develop flavor.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nawitui khenkhia in, nem ahih kei leh khauhsak a, ciang pawlkhat in a lim nam khangtosak dingin a kikoih an ahi hi.

examples.english: She added cheese to the sandwich.
examples.zomi: Sandwich sungah cheese behlap hi.

examples.english: This cheese has a strong flavor.
examples.zomi: Hih cheese a lim nam khauh hi.

senses.usage_en: Cheese is usually uncountable. Use a piece of cheese or a type of cheese when counting.
senses.usage_zomi: Cheese pen a tamzaw in simtheihloh noun ahi hi. Sim dingin a piece of cheese ahih kei leh a type of cheese kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A trained professional cook, especially the person responsible for a restaurant kitchen.
senses.explanation_zomi: An huan siamna a kisin a, a diak in annek dawr meikhuk uk leh an huan mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The chef prepared a special meal for the guests.
examples.zomi: Anhuan siampa in zinpite ading an tuam khat bawl hi.

examples.english: She trained for several years to become a chef.
examples.zomi: Anhuan siampa suak dingin kum pawlkhat kisin hi.

senses.usage_en: A chef is usually a trained professional. A cook may be anyone who prepares food.
senses.usage_zomi: Chef pen a tamzaw in siamna a kisin nasepna siampa ahi hi. Cook ahih leh an a huan mi kuamah hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to chemicals, chemistry, or changes involving substances.
senses.zomi_equivalents: chemical tawh kisai; zat kikhelna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Chemical, chemistry ahih kei leh zat tuamtuam kikhelna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The experiment produced a chemical reaction.
examples.zomi: Sittelna in chemical kikhelna piangsak hi.

examples.english: Workers must wear gloves when handling chemical substances.
examples.zomi: Nasemte chemical zat a len ciangun khut tuam silh ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Chemical is an adjective here. It can also be a noun meaning a substance used in or produced by a chemical process.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih munah chemical pen adjective ahi hi. Chemical nasep sungah a kizang ahih kei leh a piang zat khat genna noun in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: The science of substances and how they change
senses.definition_en: The science that studies substances, their properties, and how they react or change.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat tuamtuam, a ziate leh a kizop ciangin bangci kikhel cih sinna science ahi hi.

examples.english: She studies chemistry at university.
examples.zomi: University ah chemistry sin hi.

examples.english: The students conducted an experiment in the chemistry laboratory.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte chemistry sittelna innah sittelna khat bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Chemistry is normally uncountable when it means the scientific subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Science sinna lam a khiatna ah chemistry pen simtheihloh noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: A natural connection between people
senses.definition_en: A natural feeling of understanding, attraction, or cooperation between people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte kikalah a pianpih bangin a om kitelna, ki-itna ahih kei leh na semkhawm theihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two actors had excellent chemistry on screen.
examples.zomi: Lim-la nihte khuamuh sungah kituak mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: Good team chemistry can improve performance.
examples.zomi: Pawl sung kituakna hoih in nasepna hoihzaw sakthei hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal sense does not refer to scientific chemicals. It describes how naturally people connect or work together.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim zatdan in science chemical gen lo hi. Mihingte bangzah in kituak leh nasemkhawm thei uh cih gen hi.

senses.heading: The front part of the body between the neck and the stomach
senses.definition_en: The upper front part of the body containing the heart and lungs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngawng leh gil kikal pumpi maitang a, lungsim leh huuphung omna lang ahi hi.

examples.english: He felt a sharp pain in his chest.
examples.zomi: A awm sungah natna hiam mahmah a thei hi.

examples.english: The doctor listened to the patient’s chest.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in cinate awm ngai hi.

senses.usage_en: Sudden or severe chest pain can require urgent medical attention.
senses.usage_zomi: Thakhat in awm na ahih kei leh awm natna a nasia leh, manlang takin zato huhna kisam thei hi.

senses.heading: A large strong box used for storage
senses.definition_en: A large, strong box used for storing or transporting possessions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Neihsa koih ahih kei leh tawi dingin a kibawl kuang lian leh khauh ahi hi.

examples.english: Old photographs were stored in a wooden chest.
examples.zomi: Lim luiten sing kuang lian sungah kikhol hi.

examples.english: The children pretended to search for a treasure chest.
examples.zomi: Naupangte sum-leh-pai kuang zong bangin kimawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A chest usually has a lid on top and is larger and stronger than an ordinary box.
senses.usage_zomi: Chest pen a tamzaw in a tungah tuam nei a, kuang biasa sangin lianzaw leh khauhzaw hi.

senses.heading: A common farm bird
senses.definition_en: A domesticated bird raised for its eggs or meat.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tui leh a sa nek dingin inn leh lo ah a ki-khawi vasa namkhat ahi hi.

examples.english: The family raises chickens behind the house.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in innnungah ak vulh uh hi.

examples.english: The chicken laid an egg this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsangin ak in a-tui khat nei hi.
