senses.usage_en: An adult female chicken is a hen, an adult male is a rooster, and a young chicken is a chick.
senses.usage_zomi: Ak numei picing pen hen, ak pasal picing pen rooster, akno pen chick kici hi.

senses.heading: Meat from a chicken
senses.definition_en: The meat of a chicken used as food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An in a kinek ak-sa ahi hi.

examples.english: We ate rice and chicken for dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak-an in an leh ak-sa ne ung.

examples.english: She added chicken to the soup.
examples.zomi: Soup sungah ak-sa behlap hi.

senses.usage_en: Chicken is usually uncountable when it means meat but countable when it means the living bird.
senses.usage_zomi: Ak-sa a khiatna ah chicken simtheihloh noun ahi zel a, ak nungta a khiatna ah simtheih noun ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Most important, highest in rank, or having the main responsibility.
senses.explanation_zomi: A thupipen, dinmun a sangpen ahih kei leh mawpuakna bulpi nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Safety is our chief concern.
examples.zomi: Bitna pen ka lungkhamna bulpi uh ahi hi.

examples.english: She is the chief medical officer.
examples.zomi: Amah zatna ukpa lianpen ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Chief usually comes before a noun. In titles, it indicates the highest or principal position.
senses.usage_zomi: Chief pen a tamzaw in noun ma-ah om hi. Nasep min sungah dinmun a sangpen ahih kei leh a bulpi pen cih lak hi.

senses.heading: A young person
senses.definition_en: A young human being who has not yet become an adult.
senses.explanation_zomi: Picing nailo mihing naupang ahi hi.

examples.english: Every child needs love and protection.
examples.zomi: Naupang sim in itna leh kepna kisam hi.

examples.english: The child is learning to read.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen lai sim ding sin hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural of child is children, not childs.
senses.usage_zomi: Child a plural pen children ahi a, childs hilo hi.

senses.heading: Someone’s son or daughter
senses.definition_en: A person’s son or daughter of any age.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ta; tapa ahih kei leh tanu
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a tapa ahih kei leh a tanu ahi a, picing khit zong hithei hi.

examples.english: They have two children, a son and a daughter.
examples.zomi: Tapa khat leh tanu khat, ta nih nei uh hi.

examples.english: Their youngest child is now an adult.
examples.zomi: A ta naupen uh tu in picingta hi.

senses.usage_en: In family relationships, child can refer to a son or daughter even when that person is an adult.
senses.usage_zomi: Innkuan kizopna ah child pen tua mi picing khit zong, mi khat a tapa ahih kei leh a tanu gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The period of a person’s life when they are a child.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a naupanlai nuntak hun ahi hi.

examples.english: She spent her childhood in a small village.
examples.zomi: A naupanlai khuata neu khat ah zang hi.

examples.english: This song brings back childhood memories.
examples.zomi: Hih la in naupanlai phawknate hong musak kik hi.

senses.usage_en: Childhood is normally uncountable when referring to this period of life.
senses.usage_zomi: Nuntak hun khat a khiatna ah childhood pen simtheihloh noun ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: A small piece broken from something hard
senses.definition_en: A small piece that has broken off a hard material such as wood, stone, glass, or paint.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sing, suang, lim ahih kei leh vutna bang a khauh na khat pan a kitan tawm neu ahi hi.

examples.english: Wood chips covered the ground.
examples.zomi: Sing kheekte lei tungah kidim hi.

examples.english: A small chip broke off the plate.
examples.zomi: Ankuang pan kheek neu khat kitan hi.

senses.usage_en: A chip is usually small, thin, and separated from a larger object.
senses.usage_zomi: Chip pen a tamzaw in neu leh phei a, na lianzaw khat pan kitan ahi hi.

senses.heading: A small electronic component
senses.definition_en: A very small electronic component containing circuits that process or store information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu leh data sem ahih kei leh khol thei circuitte a sungah a kikoih electronic van neu ahi hi.

examples.english: The computer uses a powerful new chip.
examples.zomi: Computer in chip thak thahat khat zang hi.

examples.english: A damaged chip caused the device to fail.
examples.zomi: Chip sia khat in vanzat semtheilo sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Electronic chips are also called microchips or integrated circuits.
senses.usage_zomi: Electronic chipte microchips ahih kei leh integrated circuits zong kici hi.

senses.heading: A thin piece of fried potato
senses.definition_en: A thin piece of potato cooked in hot oil until crisp.
senses.explanation_zomi: Alu pheek khat sathau sungah khauhsak dong kikan an ahi hi.

examples.english: He opened a bag of potato chips.
examples.zomi: Alu pheek kikan sakhau khat hon hi.

examples.english: The children ate chips during the movie.
examples.zomi: Khuamuh en laitak in naupangte chips ne uh hi.

senses.usage_en: American English uses chips for thin, crisp potato slices. British English usually calls them crisps; British chips are similar to American fries.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah alu pheek khau kikan pen chips kici hi. British English ah crisps kici a, British chips pen American fries tawh kibang hi.

senses.definition_en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often mixed with sugar and milk.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cocoa pan kibawl a, a tamzaw in khum leh nawitui tawh kihel an khum ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave the children some chocolate.
examples.zomi: Naupangte chocolate tawm pia hi.

examples.english: This cake is covered with dark chocolate.
examples.zomi: Hih cake chocolate vom tawh kituam hi.

senses.usage_en: Chocolate is uncountable when referring generally to the food. Individual pieces may be called chocolates.
senses.usage_zomi: An khum a kim gen ciangin chocolate simtheihloh noun ahi hi. A tawm tuamtuam sim dingin chocolates kici thei hi.

senses.heading: An act of choosing
senses.definition_en: The act or decision of selecting between two or more possibilities.
senses.explanation_zomi: A piangthei lampi nih ahih kei leh tamzaw lakpan khat teelna ahi hi.

examples.english: You must make a choice by Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ciang dong na teelna na bawl ding hi.

examples.english: Leaving the job was a difficult choice.
examples.zomi: Nasep nusiatna pen teelna haksa ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The usual expression is make a choice, not do a choice.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan biasa pen make a choice ahi a, do a choice hilo hi.

senses.heading: The range of things available to choose from
senses.definition_en: The number or variety of people or things available for selection.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teeltheih dingin a om mi ahih kei leh na nam leh a tamzah ahi hi.

examples.english: The store offers a wide choice of shoes.
examples.zomi: Dawr in khepek nam tuamtuam teeltheih ding pia hi.

examples.english: We had little choice in the matter.
examples.zomi: Tua thu ah teeltheihna tawm bek nei ung.

senses.usage_en: Have no choice but to do something means that no reasonable alternative is available.
senses.usage_zomi: Have no choice but to do something cih pen tua nasep loh loh ding bek a om a, teeltheih lampi dang omlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A person or thing selected
senses.definition_en: The person or thing that has been chosen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teelkhitsa mi ahih kei leh na ahi hi.

examples.english: This book is a good choice for beginners.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu pen sin kipan mite ading teelsa hoih ahi hi.

examples.english: She was our first choice for the position.
examples.zomi: Tua dinmun ading amah ka teel masakpen uh ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, choice refers to the result of choosing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah choice pen teelna nasep hilo in, a teelkhitsa mi ahih kei leh na gen hi.

senses.definition_en: To decide which person or thing you want from two or more possibilities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na nih ahih kei leh tamzaw lakpan deih leh kituak khat teel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Choose the answer that best completes the sentence.
examples.zomi: Sentence a kicingpen sak dawnna teel in.

examples.english: They chose her as team leader.
examples.zomi: Amah pawl makaipa in teel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Its forms are choose–chose–chosen. Use choose to do something for a decision about an action.
senses.usage_zomi: Choose pen irregular verb ahi a, choose–chose–chosen ci in kikhel hi. Gamtatna khat sem ding thukhenna genna ah choose to do something kizang hi.

senses.heading: A building used for Christian worship
senses.definition_en: A building where Christians gather for worship, prayer, teaching, and fellowship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khazih mite biakna, thungetna, thuhilhna leh kipawlkhopna ading a kikaikhop uh inn ahi hi.

examples.english: The family goes to church every Sunday.
examples.zomi: Innkuan Sunday simin biakinn pai hi.

examples.english: The old church stands near the town square.
examples.zomi: Biakinn lui khuapi laizang kiangah om hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to worship as an activity, English often says go to church without the. Use go to the church when referring to a particular building or location.
senses.usage_zomi: Biakna ading paina gen ciangin go to church ci a, the kizang lo hi. Inn kician khat ahih kei leh mun gen ciangin go to the church kizang hi.

senses.heading: A Christian congregation or organization
senses.definition_en: A group or organization of Christians who worship and serve together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna nei leh nasemkhawm Khazih mite pawl ahih kei leh pawlpi ahi hi.

examples.english: The church provides food for families in need.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi in huhna kisam innkuante an pia hi.

examples.english: Church members met to discuss the project.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi mite geelna kiholim dingin kimuhkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In the New Testament and Christian theology, church often means the community of believers rather than a building.
senses.usage_zomi: Thuciam Thak leh Christian theology ah church in inn khat sangin thu-umte pawl gen zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A thin roll of tobacco wrapped in paper and smoked.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zial singteh gawp lai tawh tuam in a neih a, a khu a kihip zial ahi hi.

examples.english: He stopped smoking cigarettes for his health.
examples.zomi: A cidamna ading zial dawn khawl hi.

examples.english: Cigarette smoke can harm other people nearby.
examples.zomi: Zial khu in a kiangah om midangte susia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Cigarette smoking is addictive and increases the risk of cancer, heart disease, lung disease, and other serious health problems.
senses.usage_zomi: Zial dawnna in kholsak haksa a, cancer, lungsim natna, huuphung natna leh natna nasia dangte ngah lauhuaina khangsak hi.

senses.heading: A place where films are shown
senses.definition_en: A building or room where people watch films on a large screen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte screen lian tungah khuamuh enna ding a kikaikhop uh inn ahih kei leh innkhan ahi hi.

examples.english: We went to the cinema on Saturday.
examples.zomi: Saturday ni-in khuamuh inn pai ung.

examples.english: The cinema shows new films every week.
examples.zomi: Khuamuh inn in kal simin khuamuh thak lak hi.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses cinema. American English more often uses movie theater for the building.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah cinema kizang tampi hi. American English ah inn genna in movie theater kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Films considered as an art or industry
senses.definition_en: Films collectively, especially when considered as an art form or industry.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuamuhte a vekpi ahih kei leh limkalsuan bawlna siamna leh sumdawnna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is studying the history of cinema.
examples.zomi: Khuamuh tangthu sin hi.

examples.english: Digital technology changed the cinema industry.
examples.zomi: Digital technology in khuamuh sumdawnna khelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, cinema refers to filmmaking and films generally, not one building.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah cinema pen khuamuh inn khat genlo in, khuamuh bawlna leh khuamuhte a kim gen hi.

senses.heading: A perfectly round, flat shape
senses.definition_en: A flat, round shape whose edge is the same distance from its center at every point.
senses.explanation_zomi: A laizang pan a gei mun sim a gamla kibang, a kim a kual phei lim ahi hi.

examples.english: Draw a circle around the correct answer.
examples.zomi: Dawnna man kiimah lim kual gelh in.

examples.english: The children sat in a circle.
examples.zomi: Naupangte a kual in tu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A circle is a two-dimensional shape. A ball or sphere is three-dimensional.
senses.usage_zomi: Circle pen a phei lim ahi hi. Ball ahih kei leh sphere pen a pumpi nei lim kual ahi hi.

senses.heading: A group of people connected by interests or relationships
senses.definition_en: A group of people who know one another or share similar interests, work, or influence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kih thei ahih kei leh lunglutna, nasep ahih kei leh ukzawhna kibang mihing pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a wide circle of friends.
examples.zomi: Lawm pawl za tak nei hi.

examples.english: The news spread quickly through political circles.
examples.zomi: Thuthak gamvai pawlte sungah manlang takin kizel hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, circle describes a connected social or professional group, not a formal organization necessarily.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah circle in kizopna nei lawm ahih kei leh naseppih pawl gen a, ukna tawh a kipawl pawl hithei pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A fact or condition connected with an event, situation, or person that affects what happens.
senses.zomi_equivalents: dinmun; thu omzia; a kiim a thu
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupiang, dinmun ahih kei leh mi khat tawh kisai a, bang piang ding cih a suk na leh a omzia ahi hi.

examples.english: They continued working despite difficult circumstances.
examples.zomi: Dinmun a haksa napi nasem zom uh hi.

examples.english: Under the circumstances, postponing the meeting was reasonable.
examples.zomi: Tua dinmun ah kimuhkhopna nungdelhna kilawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Circumstance is often used in the plural, circumstances, when describing the conditions surrounding a situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun khat a kiim a thu omziate gen ciangin circumstance pen plural circumstances in kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: To refer to a source as evidence
senses.definition_en: To mention a book, article, author, or other source as evidence or support.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a kipsakna dingin laibu, article, laigelhpa ahih kei leh thukhual dang min leh thu kawk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Students must cite every source used in the essay.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in essay sungah a zat thukhual sim kawk ding uh hi.

examples.english: The report cites several scientific studies.
examples.zomi: Report in science sittelna pawlkhat kawk hi.

senses.usage_en: To cite a source is to identify where information or words came from. It is different from merely including the source in a general reading list.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhual cite cih pen thu leh kammal koipan lak cih kician takin kawkna ahi hi. Sim ding laibu minza sungah koih lel tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: To mention something as an example or reason
senses.definition_en: To mention a fact, case, or example to support an explanation or decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hilhcian na ahih kei leh thukhenna khat kipsak dingin thu, thupiang ahih kei leh gentehna khat gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She cited cost as the main reason for the decision.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna a bawlna hang bulpi pen man ahi hi ci in gen hi.

examples.english: The teacher cited two examples from history.
examples.zomi: Sangsiah in tangthu pan gentehna nih gen hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern cite something as something is common: cite safety as the main concern.
senses.usage_zomi: Cite something as something cih zatdan kizang tampi hi: cite safety as the main concern.

senses.definition_en: A person who legally belongs to a country and has rights and responsibilities there.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam khat a daan sungah gammi in a kiphawka, tua gam sungah dikna leh mawpuakna nei mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She became a United States citizen last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa in United States gammi hong suak hi.

examples.english: Citizens have both rights and responsibilities.
examples.zomi: Gam mite dikna leh mawpuakna anih in nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A citizen has a formal legal relationship with a country. A resident lives in a place but may not be a citizen.
senses.usage_zomi: Citizen in gam khat tawh daan kizopna nei hi. Resident pen mun khat ah teng napi, tua gam a gammi hithei pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A large and important town where many people live and work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing tampi teng leh nasemna, sumdawnna leh kumpi nasepna tampi a om khua lian ahi hi.

examples.english: Columbus is the capital city of Ohio.
examples.zomi: Columbus pen Ohio khuapi bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: Many people travel into the city for work.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi nasep dingin khuapi sungah khualzin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The official difference between a city and a town varies by country and local law.
senses.usage_zomi: City leh town a daan ciang a kilamdanna pen gam leh khuamun daan ciangin kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Relating to ordinary citizens rather than the military
senses.definition_en: Relating to citizens and public life rather than military or religious institutions.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gammi tawh kisai; mipi tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Galkapte ahih kei leh biakna ukna hilo in, gam mite leh mipi nuntakna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Civil authorities organized the emergency response.
examples.zomi: Mipi ukte in thupiang baihloh huhna geelkhol uh hi.

examples.english: The country returned to civil government.
examples.zomi: Gam pen mipi kumpi ukna ah kik hi.

senses.usage_en: Civilian is the noun or adjective normally used specifically for someone who is not in the armed forces.
senses.usage_zomi: Galkap sungah a kihello mi gen dingin noun ahih kei leh adjective civilian kizang tampizaw hi.

senses.heading: Relating to private legal disputes rather than crimes
senses.definition_en: Relating to legal disagreements between people or organizations rather than criminal offenses.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mimal daan thu; mawhna hilo thukhenna thu
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhna daan thu hilo in, mimalte ahih kei leh pawlte kikal neihsa, sum leh thukimna tawh kisai daan thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The dispute became a civil case.
examples.zomi: Kinialna pen mimal daan thu hong suak hi.

examples.english: She brought a civil claim against the company.
examples.zomi: Company tungah mimal daan tawh thudotna bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A civil case usually seeks compensation or another legal remedy, while a criminal case concerns an alleged crime.
senses.usage_zomi: Civil case in a tamzaw in sum thukkikna ahih kei leh daan vai vengna khat zong hi. Criminal case ahih leh mawhna kibawl ci a mawhsakna tawh kisai hi.

senses.heading: Polite and controlled
senses.definition_en: Polite enough to avoid open anger or rude behavior.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungthang tak leh zahtakloh tak a gamta loin, zahna nei in om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They disagreed but remained civil.
examples.zomi: Thukimlo uh napi, zahna nei in om uh hi.

examples.english: Please keep the discussion civil.
examples.zomi: Kiholimna zahna tawh nei un.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, civil may mean only minimally polite, not necessarily warm or friendly.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah civil in zahna a tawmpen neihna gen thei a, lawm leh lungdam takin om cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: To state that something is true
senses.definition_en: To say that something is true, often before it has been fully proved.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat kipsak nailo napi, thumaan hi ci in gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company claims that its product is safe.
examples.zomi: Company in a van bit hi ci in gen hi.

examples.english: He claimed that he had never seen the document.
examples.zomi: Document a mu ngeilo hi ci hi.

senses.usage_en: Claim reports what someone says without confirming that it is true.
senses.usage_zomi: Claim in mi khat a gen thu pulak napi, tua thu thumaan cih kipsak lo hi.

senses.heading: To ask for or take something that you have a right to receive
senses.definition_en: To formally request or take money, property, a prize, or a right that belongs to you.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nangma ngah ding sum, neihsa, letsong ahih kei leh dikna daan bangin ngen ahih kei leh la cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She went to the office to claim her prize.
examples.zomi: A letsong la dingin ophis ah pai hi.

examples.english: Workers may claim compensation for the injury.
examples.zomi: Nasemte a liamna uh ading sum thukkikna ngen thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the person says that the item or right legally belongs to them.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah mi in tua sum, van ahih kei leh dikna daan bangin ama neih ding ahi hi ci hi.

senses.heading: A lesson or a series of lessons
senses.definition_en: A period or course of instruction in which students learn a subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sangnaupangte in thu khat a sin uh hun ahih kei leh sinna geelna ahi hi.

examples.english: Our English class begins at nine.
examples.zomi: Ka English sang hun uh nai kua ciangin kipan hi.

examples.english: She attends a computer class twice a week.
examples.zomi: Kal khat in nihvei computer sang kah hi.

senses.usage_en: American English often says in class. British English also commonly uses in lessons depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah in class kizang tampi hi. British English ah thu omdan ciangin in lessons zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: A group of students taught together
senses.definition_en: A group of students who study together under a teacher.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sangsiah khat nuai ah sin khawm sangnaupangte pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The whole class visited the museum.
examples.zomi: Sangkhan a vekpi museum veh uh hi.

examples.english: There are twenty students in the class.
examples.zomi: Sangkhan sungah sangnaupang sawmnih om hi.

senses.usage_en: Class may refer either to the students or to the instructional period; context shows which meaning is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Class in sangnaupang pawl ahih kei leh sinna hun gen thei a, thu omdan in a khiatna lak hi.

senses.heading: A group of similar things
senses.definition_en: A group or category of people or things sharing similar qualities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zia, zatna ahih kei leh dinmun kibang nei mi ahih kei leh na-te pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: These medicines belong to the same class.
examples.zomi: Hih site zatna nam khat sungah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: The animals are divided into several classes.
examples.zomi: Ganhingte khen tuamtuam in kikhen hi.

senses.usage_en: In classification, class groups members according to shared features.
senses.usage_zomi: Khenna system ah class in zia kibang nei mi ahih kei leh na-te pawl khat in koih hi.

senses.heading: A social or economic group
senses.definition_en: A group of people with a similar social or economic position.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mipi dinmun khen; sum dinmun khen
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina, sum dinmun ahih kei leh mipi lak dinmun kibang nei mihing pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The policy affected many working-class families.
examples.zomi: Thukhun in nasepna tawh nungta innkuan tampi suk hi.

examples.english: Education can influence social class and opportunity.
examples.zomi: Pilna in mipi dinmun leh hamphatna suk thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Social-class terms can be sensitive and may have different meanings across societies.
senses.usage_zomi: Mipi dinmun khen tawh kisai kammalte mi lungsim suk thei a, mipi ngeina tuamtuam ciangin a khiatna zong kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: Judged to be excellent and lasting in value
senses.definition_en: Of very high quality and respected over a long period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Quality sang mahmah a, hun sawtpi sung zahtak leh manpha in a kingai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The novel is considered a classic work.
examples.zomi: Laibu pen nasep manpha ngeisa in kingai hi.

examples.english: We watched a classic film from the 1950s.
examples.zomi: 1950 kumte a khuamuh manpha ngeisa khat en ung.

senses.usage_en: Classic describes something considered outstanding within its type. It does not simply mean old.
senses.usage_zomi: Classic in a nam sungah a hoih leh minthang na khat gen a, lui cihna bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: Very typical of its kind
senses.definition_en: Showing the most typical or well-known features of a particular type.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nam khat a zia biasa leh a theihna pen kician takin nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This is a classic example of poor planning.
examples.zomi: Hih pen geelna hoihlo a gentehna kicing ahi hi.

examples.english: He made the classic mistake of leaving too late.
examples.zomi: A nungluat in a kipatna khialhna biasa bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes that something is a clear and recognizable example.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah na khat pen a nam a gentehna siang leh theih baih ahihna thupi sak hi.

senses.heading: Relating to the ancient Greek and Roman world
senses.definition_en: Relating to the language, art, literature, history, or culture of ancient Greece and Rome.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tanglai Greece leh Rome a pau, limsiamna, laibu, tangthu ahih kei leh ngeina tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She studies classical history at university.
examples.zomi: University ah tanglai Greece leh Rome tangthu sin hi.

examples.english: The building was influenced by classical architecture.
examples.zomi: Innpi pen tanglai Greece-Rome inn-lamzia in suk hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, classical refers specifically to ancient Greece and Rome, not merely to anything old.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah classical pen tanglai Greece leh Rome tawh kisai thu kician ahi a, na lui khempeuh genna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Relating to an established traditional form of art or music
senses.definition_en: Relating to a traditional and formally developed style of music, dance, or art.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngeina la; ngeina siamna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: La, lam ahih kei leh limsiamna a ngeina tawh a khangto leh zatdan kician nei nam tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He enjoys listening to classical music.
examples.zomi: Ngeina la ngai nuam sa hi.

examples.english: She trained in classical dance for many years.
examples.zomi: Kum tampi sung ngeina lam kisin hi.

senses.usage_en: Classical music names a broad musical tradition. It is different from classic music, which would mean music regarded as especially excellent or representative.
senses.usage_zomi: Classical music in la ngeina nam lian khat gen hi. Classic music ahih leh la hoih leh minthang ngeisa genna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A room in a school or college where students are taught.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sanginn ahih kei leh college sungah sangnaupangte sin leh kihilhna innkhan ahi hi.

examples.english: The students entered the classroom quietly.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte dai takin sangkhan sung lut uh hi.

examples.english: Computers are available in every classroom.
examples.zomi: Sangkhan simah computer om hi.

senses.usage_en: Classroom refers to the room. Class may refer to the lesson or the students.
senses.usage_zomi: Classroom pen sangkhan inn genna ahi hi. Class in sinna hun ahih kei leh sangnaupang pawl gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A grammatical unit containing a subject and a verb
senses.definition_en: A group of words containing a subject and a verb and forming part or all of a sentence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Subject leh verb nei a, sentence khat a khen ahih kei leh sentence kicing in a om kammal pawl ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: amah bek a kicinglo sentence khen

examples.english: The sentence contains two clauses.
examples.zomi: Sentence sungah clause nih om hi.

examples.english: A dependent clause cannot usually stand alone.
examples.zomi: Dependent clause pen a tamzaw in amah bek sentence kicing in omtheilo hi.

senses.usage_en: A clause contains a subject and a verb. A phrase does not necessarily contain both.
senses.usage_zomi: Clause sungah subject leh verb om hi. Phrase sungah anihgel om kullo hi.

senses.heading: A particular condition in a legal document or agreement
senses.definition_en: A separately stated condition or rule in a contract, law, or formal agreement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Contract, daan ahih kei leh thukimna lai sungah a tuam in kigelh thukhun ahih kei leh khen ahi hi.

examples.english: The contract contains a clause about early termination.
examples.zomi: Contract sungah manlang tak a khawlsakna tawh kisai thukhun khat om hi.

examples.english: Read every clause before signing the agreement.
examples.zomi: Thukimna lai na min gelhma in thukhun khen sim in.

senses.usage_en: In legal writing, each clause deals with a particular right, duty, condition, or procedure.
senses.usage_zomi: Daan lai sungah clause sim in dikna, mawpuakna, dinmun ahih kei leh sepzia kician khat gen hi.

senses.heading: Free from dirt or unwanted substances
senses.definition_en: Not dirty and free from dirt, marks, waste, or harmful substances.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ninsia, niin, ciamtehna ahih kei leh zat lauhuai omlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Everyone needs access to clean drinking water.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in dawn ding tui siang ngah kul hi.

examples.english: The kitchen must be kept clean.
examples.zomi: Meikhuk siang in kikem ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Clean describes the condition. The verb clean means to remove dirt or unwanted substances.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective clean in a dinmun siang cih lak hi. Verb clean in ninsia leh niinte siansuah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not involving pollution or harmful emissions
senses.definition_en: Producing little or no pollution or environmental harm.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khuadum saklo; leitung kiim a susia lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuadum sakna ahih kei leh leitung kiim a susia zat tawm bek piangsak ahih kei leh piangsaklo cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: leitung kiim a susia lo meima

examples.english: The city is investing in clean energy.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in leitung kiim a susia lo meima ah sum koih hi.

examples.english: Electric buses can provide cleaner transportation.
examples.zomi: Meima bus-te in khuadum sak tawmzaw khualzinna pia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In environmental contexts, clean is relative and does not always mean that there is absolutely no environmental effect.
senses.usage_zomi: Leitung kiim tawh kisai zatna ah clean pen etkakna khiatna ahi a, leitung kiim tungah sukna himhim omlo cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: Easy to understand
senses.definition_en: Expressed or explained in a way that is easy to understand.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tel baih dingin siang leh kician takin kigen ahih kei leh kigelh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave a clear explanation.
examples.zomi: Sangsiah in hilhna kician pia hi.

examples.english: Please make your question clear.
examples.zomi: Na dotna kician sak in.

senses.usage_en: Clear may describe information, speech, writing, or understanding.
senses.usage_zomi: Clear in thu, thugenna, laigelhna ahih kei leh telna a kician cih gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Certain and without doubt
senses.definition_en: Obvious or certain, with little or no doubt.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunghianna tawm bek om ahih kei leh omlo in muhtheih leh theih kician cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: There is clear evidence that the climate is changing.
examples.zomi: Khuahun kikhel cih teci kician om hi.

examples.english: The two plans have a clear difference.
examples.zomi: Geelna nihte kilamdanna kician nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, clear means evident rather than merely easy to explain.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah clear pen hilhcian baih cihna bek hilo in, thumaan cih muhtheih leh kician cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Transparent or easy to see through
senses.definition_en: Allowing light to pass through so that objects can be seen through it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavak kantan thei a, a langkhat na-te muhtheih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The water was clear enough to see the bottom.
examples.zomi: Tui a siang manin a taw muhtheih hi.

examples.english: The documents were kept in a clear plastic folder.
examples.zomi: Documentte plastic folder langthei sungah kikoih hi.

senses.usage_en: Clear does not always mean colorless, but it means that light and images can pass through with little obstruction.
senses.usage_zomi: Clear in mel himhim neilo cihna pahpah hilo napi, khuavak leh lim a kantan theih cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Free from clouds, smoke, or obstacles
senses.definition_en: Having no clouds, smoke, blockage, or other obstruction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mei, meikhu, kongkhak ahih kei leh lampi khakna omlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The sky was clear after the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi khit ciangin van siang hi.

examples.english: Keep the doorway clear.
examples.zomi: Kongpi ah khakna koih kei in.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning depends on the noun: clear sky means no clouds, while clear path means no obstacles.
senses.usage_zomi: A khiatna pen noun ciangin kibanglo hi: clear sky in meii omlo cihna a, clear path in lampi khakna omlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: In a way that is easy to understand or perceive
senses.definition_en: In a way that can be understood, heard, or seen easily.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tel, za ahih kei leh mu baih dingin kician takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please speak slowly and clearly.
examples.zomi: Dam tak leh kician takin pau in.

examples.english: The diagram clearly explains the process.
examples.zomi: Lim in sepzia kician takin hilhcian hi.

senses.usage_en: Clearly may describe how an action is done or how easy something is to understand.
senses.usage_zomi: Clearly in nasep khat bangci sem cih ahih kei leh thu khat bangzah tel baih cih gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Obviously or without doubt
senses.definition_en: In a way that is obvious and leaves little or no doubt.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunghianna tawm bek om ahih kei leh omlo in kician takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two documents are clearly different.
examples.zomi: Document nihte kician takin kilam hi.

examples.english: She was clearly disappointed by the result.
examples.zomi: Dawnna hangin lungkimlo cih kician takin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: At the beginning of a sentence, clearly can express the speaker’s judgment that something is obvious.
senses.usage_zomi: Sentence kipatna ah clearly in thu khat muhtheih leh kician hi ci a paupa ngaihsutna lak thei hi.

senses.heading: Quick to understand, learn, or solve problems
senses.definition_en: Intelligent and able to understand or solve things quickly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuak pil a, thu manlang takin tel ahih kei leh buaina veng siam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a clever student who learns quickly.
examples.zomi: Amah manlang takin sin thei sangnaupang khuak pil ahi hi.

examples.english: The clever child solved the puzzle.
examples.zomi: Naupang khuak pil in puzzle veng hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, smart is often more common than clever for general intelligence.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah khuak pilna a kim genna in clever sangin smart kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Skillfully designed or invented
senses.definition_en: Showing skill and originality in solving a problem or creating something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina veng ahih kei leh na thak bawlna ah siamna leh ngaihsutna thak a kilang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They found a clever solution to the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaina vengna ngaihsut siam khat mu uh hi.

examples.english: The tool has a clever design.
examples.zomi: Vanzat pen siamtak in kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, clever praises the idea or design rather than a person’s general intelligence.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah clever in mi khat a khuak pilna a kim genlo in, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh kibawlna siamna phat hi.

senses.heading: To press a computer mouse button or select something on a screen
senses.definition_en: To press and release a mouse button, or select an item on a digital screen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer mouse button nei leh khah ahih kei leh screen tungah na khat teel dingin suk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Click the link to open the document.
examples.zomi: Document hon dingin link click in.

examples.english: She clicked the save button.
examples.zomi: Save button click hi.

senses.usage_en: Say click the button or click on the button. Both are common, though the shorter form is often preferred.
senses.usage_zomi: Click the button leh click on the button anih in kizang hi napi, a tomzaw zatdan kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: To make a short, sharp sound
senses.definition_en: To make a short, sharp sound, often when two hard parts touch or a mechanism moves.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tak ci in ging; aw tom ging
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khauh nih kisuk ahih kei leh machine lang khat a kalsuan ciangin aw tom leh hiam khat ging cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The lock clicked into place.
examples.zomi: Tawh a munah lut in tak ci in ging hi.

examples.english: I heard the camera click.
examples.zomi: Camera click ging ka za hi.

senses.usage_en: Click can imitate the sound itself as well as describe the action producing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Click in “tak” ci a ging aw mah zong genteh a, tua aw piangsak gamtatna zong gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A person or organization that receives professional services from a business or specialist.
senses.explanation_zomi: Company ahih kei leh siamna nei mi khat kiangpan nasep leh huhna a ngah mi ahih kei leh pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The lawyer met with her client.
examples.zomi: Daan siamin a nasep ngahmi tawh kimuh hi.

examples.english: The company protects its clients’ personal information.
examples.zomi: Company in a nasep ngahmite mimal thu kem hi.

senses.usage_en: A client usually receives professional services, such as legal, financial, or consulting help. A customer usually buys goods or ordinary services.
senses.usage_zomi: Client in daan, sumvai ahih kei leh thukhilhna bang siamna nasep ngah zel hi. Customer in van ahih kei leh nasep biasa lei zel hi.

senses.heading: The usual weather conditions of a place over a long period
senses.definition_en: The typical pattern of temperature, rain, wind, and other weather conditions in a place over many years.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah kum tampi sung a om zel khuasak, guah, huih leh khuahun omzia ahi hi.

examples.english: This region has a warm, wet climate.
examples.zomi: Hih gam khen khuahun lum leh guah tam hi.

examples.english: Climate change affects weather patterns around the world.
examples.zomi: Khuahun kikhelna in leitung khempeuh a khuahun pai dan suk hi.

senses.usage_en: Weather describes short-term atmospheric conditions. Climate describes usual patterns over many years.
senses.usage_zomi: Weather in hun tom sung khuahun dinmun gen hi. Climate in kum tampi sung a om zel khuahun omzia gen hi.

senses.heading: The general attitudes or conditions in a place or period
senses.definition_en: The general opinions, feelings, or conditions influencing a society, organization, or period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi, pawl ahih kei leh hun khat sungah mihingte ngaihsutna, lungsim leh dinmun a kim ahi hi.

examples.english: The political climate changed after the election.
examples.zomi: Teelna khit ciangin gamvai dinmun kikhel hi.

examples.english: The policy created a climate of uncertainty.
examples.zomi: Thukhun in lungmuanna omlo dinmun piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, climate refers to the surrounding social or emotional conditions, not weather.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna ah climate pen khuahun hilo in, mipi ahih kei leh pawl sung a ngaihsutna leh lungsim dinmun gen hi.

senses.heading: To move upward using the feet and often the hands
senses.definition_en: To move up, down, or across something steep by using the feet and sometimes the hands.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe leh ciang pawlkhat in khut zong zangin mual, kuang, sing ahih kei leh na sang khat kah ahih kei leh tuaksuk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They climbed the mountain early in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsangin mual kah uh hi.

examples.english: The child climbed down the ladder carefully.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen kuang tungpan kidawmtak in tuaksuk hi.

senses.usage_en: Climb can describe movement upward or downward when the surface is steep and effort is required.
senses.usage_zomi: Climb in a sanglam kahna bek hilo in, mun a khing ah hanciamna tawh tuaksukna zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: To increase gradually
senses.definition_en: To rise or increase, especially in number, level, price, or temperature.
senses.explanation_zomi: Number, ciangtan, man ahih kei leh khuasak tawm tawm in khang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Housing prices continued to climb.
examples.zomi: Inn mante khangto zom hi.

examples.english: The temperature climbed above ninety degrees.
examples.zomi: Khuasak degree sawmkua sangin kahto hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, climb describes a noticeable increase and does not involve physical movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah climb pen pumpi kalsuanna hilo in, number ahih kei leh zah khantohna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A device that shows and measures time, usually kept on a wall, table, or electronic screen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun bangzah cih lak leh sim vanzat ahi a, bang, dohkan ahih kei leh electronic screen tungah om zel hi.

examples.english: The clock on the wall is five minutes fast.
examples.zomi: Bang nai minute nga man hi.

examples.english: I set the alarm clock for six o’clock.
examples.zomi: Hongphawng nai pen nai guk ading ka koih hi.

senses.usage_en: A clock is usually placed somewhere, while a watch is worn or carried. Use o’clock only for exact hours: six o’clock.
senses.usage_zomi: Clock pen mun khat ah kikoih zel a, watch pen pumpi ah kisilh ahih kei leh kitawi hi. Nai kicing gen ciang bek o’clock kizang hi: six o’clock.

senses.heading: To move something so that an opening is covered or blocked
senses.definition_en: To shut a door, window, container, or other opening.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kong, thlalang, kuang ahih kei leh mun hawng khak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please close the door quietly.
examples.zomi: Kong daitak in khak in.

examples.english: She closed the window before leaving.
examples.zomi: A paikhiatma in thlalang khak hi.

senses.usage_en: The verb close is pronounced /kloʊz/, with a /z/ sound. The adjective close, meaning near, is pronounced /kloʊs/.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb close pen /kloʊz/ ci in /z/ aw tawh kisa hi. “Nai” cihna adjective close pen /kloʊs/ ci in kisa hi.

senses.heading: To stop operating or being available
senses.definition_en: To stop a business, service, event, or place from operating or being available.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawr, nasep, pawi ahih kei leh mun khat nasep khawlsak ahih kei leh mihing lut theilo dingin khak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The store closes at nine o’clock.
examples.zomi: Dawr nai kua ciangin kikhak hi.

examples.english: Heavy snow forced the school to close.
examples.zomi: Vuk a tam manin sanginn kikhak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Close can be transitive or intransitive: They closed the store; The store closed.
senses.usage_zomi: Close pen object tawh zong kizang thei a, object tello in zong kizang thei hi: They closed the store; The store closed.

senses.heading: To end something
senses.definition_en: To bring an activity, meeting, account, or discussion to an end.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, kimuhkhopna, account ahih kei leh kiholimna khat tawpsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The chair closed the meeting at noon.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in sun laitak in kimuhkhopna tawpsak hi.

examples.english: I decided to close the old bank account.
examples.zomi: Bank account lui khak dingin ka thukim hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, close means formally or completely ending something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah close in na khat a thupi tak ahih kei leh a kicing in tawpsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not open
senses.definition_en: Shut so that people, air, or objects cannot pass through.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, huih ahih kei leh vante kantan theilo dingin kikhak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The door remained closed.
examples.zomi: Kong kikhak in om hi.

examples.english: She sat with her eyes closed.
examples.zomi: A mitte sing in tu hi.

senses.usage_en: Closed describes the condition. Close /kloʊz/ is the action that produces that condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Closed in kikhak dinmun gen hi. Close /kloʊz/ in tua dinmun piangsak gamtatna gen hi.

senses.heading: Not operating or available
senses.definition_en: Not open for business, service, entry, or public use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumdawnna, nasep, lutna ahih kei leh mipi zatna ading kihonglo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The library is closed on Sundays.
examples.zomi: Sunday ni-in laibu-inn kikhak hi.

examples.english: The road is closed because of construction.
examples.zomi: Lamna nasep hangin lampi kikhak hi.

senses.usage_en: For a business or public place, closed means that it is not currently serving or admitting people.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumdawnna ahih kei leh mipi zatna mun ading closed in tu in nasep leh lutna ading kihonglo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Carefully and with close attention
senses.definition_en: In a careful way that gives detailed attention to someone or something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kician takin; kidawmtak in; a nai pan
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat thu kician takin theihna dingin pilvang leh kidawmtak in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Listen closely to the instructions.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhnate kician takin ngai in.

examples.english: The doctor examined the patient closely.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in cinate a kicing in sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: Closely often means carefully, not physically near.
senses.usage_zomi: Closely in ciang tampi ah pumpi nai takin cihna sangin, kidawmtak leh a kicing in cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: In a way that shows a strong connection or similarity
senses.definition_en: In a way that shows a strong relationship, connection, or similarity.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nai takin; kip takin; kibang takin
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizopna, kinaihkhopna ahih kei leh kibatna lian om cihna lak in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two languages are closely related.
examples.zomi: Pau nihte nai takin kizom hi.

examples.english: The departments work closely together.
examples.zomi: Khen tuamtuamte kip takin nasemkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Closely related may refer to family, language, ideas, subjects, or other strong connections.
senses.usage_zomi: Closely related in innkuan, pau, ngaihsutna, sinna thu ahih kei leh kizopna khauhte gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Material made by weaving or joining fibers
senses.definition_en: Material made from cotton, wool, or other fibers and used for making clothes or covering things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan, van tuam leh zatna dangte bawl dingin cotton, tuumul ahih kei leh gui dangte tawh a kikhui puan ahi hi.

examples.english: She bought two meters of cloth.
examples.zomi: Puan meter nih lei hi.

examples.english: The table was covered with a white cloth.
examples.zomi: Dohkan puanpak tawh kituam hi.

senses.usage_en: Cloth is the material. Clothes are the items people wear.
senses.usage_zomi: Cloth pen puan kang ahih kei leh material ahi hi. Clothes ahih leh mihingte a silh puante ahi hi.

senses.heading: A small piece of material used for cleaning
senses.definition_en: A piece of material used for wiping or cleaning surfaces.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dohkan, van ahih kei leh munte nual leh siansuahna ding a kizang puan tawm ahi hi.

examples.english: Wipe the table with a damp cloth.
examples.zomi: Dohkan puan vot tawh nual in.

examples.english: Use a clean cloth on the wound.
examples.zomi: Liamna tungah puan siang zang in.

senses.usage_en: When it means a cleaning item, cloth is countable: a cloth, two cloths.
senses.usage_zomi: Siansuahna van a khiatna ah cloth simtheih noun ahi hi: a cloth, two cloths.

senses.definition_en: Items worn to cover, protect, or decorate the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tuam, kem ahih kei leh kizepna dingin a kisilh puante ahi hi.

examples.english: She packed her clothes into a suitcase.
examples.zomi: A puante puan-kuang sungah koih hi.

examples.english: The children need warm clothes for winter.
examples.zomi: Naupangte hunkhal ading puan lum kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Clothes is always plural and has no singular form. Use an item of clothing or name the particular item when referring to one piece.
senses.usage_zomi: Clothes pen plural tawntung ahi a, singular form nei lo hi. Puan khat gen dingin an item of clothing ci ahih kei leh puan min kician zang ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Clothes considered generally or as a type of product.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tuam leh silhna ding puante a kim ahih kei leh van nam khat in a kingai ahi hi.

examples.english: Workers must wear protective clothing.
examples.zomi: Nasemte pumpi kepna puan silh ding uh hi.

examples.english: The charity provides food and clothing.
examples.zomi: Huhna pawl in an leh silhpuan pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Clothing is uncountable and more general or formal than clothes. Do not say a clothing for one item.
senses.usage_zomi: Clothing pen simtheihloh noun ahi a, clothes sangin a kimzaw leh a thupizaw zatdan ahi hi. Puan khat genna in a clothing ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: A mass of tiny drops of water or ice in the sky
senses.definition_en: A visible mass of tiny water drops or ice crystals floating in the sky.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui mal neute ahih kei leh vuk malte vanah a kaikhawm a kilang ahi hi.

examples.english: Dark clouds covered the sky.
examples.zomi: Meii vom in van tuam hi.

examples.english: The clouds cleared after the rain.
examples.zomi: Guah khit ciangin meii bei hi.

senses.usage_en: Cloud is countable when referring to separate visible masses and uncountable in some figurative expressions.
senses.usage_zomi: Vanah a kilang meii tuamtuam gen ciangin cloud simtheih noun ahi hi. Gentehna zatdan pawlkhat ah simtheihloh in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Online computer storage and services
senses.definition_en: Internet-based systems used to store data or run software on remote computers.
senses.explanation_zomi: Data khol ahih kei leh software zang dingin internet tungtawn a gamla computerte a kizang system ahi hi.

examples.english: The files are stored in the cloud.
examples.zomi: File-te cloud sungah kikhol hi.

examples.english: Cloud storage lets users access data from different devices.
examples.zomi: Cloud kholna in vanzat tuamtuam pan data musak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In technology, the cloud does not mean one physical place. It refers to remote computer systems reached through the internet.
senses.usage_zomi: Technology ah the cloud pen mun pumpi khat genna hilo hi. Internet tungtawn a kizang gamla computer systemte gen hi.

senses.heading: An organized group with a shared interest or activity
senses.definition_en: An organized group of people who meet because they share an interest, activity, or purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunglutna, gamtatna ahih kei leh ngiimna khat a neihkhawm manun a kimuhkhawm mihing pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: She joined the school science club.
examples.zomi: Sang science pawl ah kihel hi.

examples.english: The book club meets once a month.
examples.zomi: Laibu sim pawl kha khat in khatvei kimuhkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: A club usually has members and may have rules, leaders, meetings, or membership fees.
senses.usage_zomi: Club khat in a tamzaw in memberte nei a, thukhun, makaite, kimuhkhopna ahih kei leh member sum zong nei thei hi.

senses.heading: A sports organization and its players
senses.definition_en: An organization that owns, manages, or supports a sports team.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawl pawl khat nei, uk ahih kei leh panpih pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: He signed with a professional football club.
examples.zomi: Professional football club khat tawh nasep thukimna bawl hi.

examples.english: The club won the national championship.
examples.zomi: Club in gam kidemna gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: In sports, club may refer to the whole organization, not only the players on the team.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna ah club in kimawlmite bek hilo in, pawlpi a vekpi gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A place where people gather for entertainment
senses.definition_en: A place where people gather for music, dancing, social activity, or entertainment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte la, lam, kipawlkhopna ahih kei leh lungnopna ading a kikaikhop uh mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The club plays live music on weekends.
examples.zomi: Club in kal tawp ciangin la nungta khah hi.

examples.english: They met at a music club.
examples.zomi: La club khat ah kimuh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether club means an organization, its members, or a social venue.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu omdan in club pen pawlpi, memberte ahih kei leh kipawlna mun cih lak hi.

senses.definition_en: A fact, sign, or piece of information that helps solve a problem, mystery, or crime.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina, thusim, thuthuk ahih kei leh mawhna khat vengna ding a huh thu, ciamtehna ahih kei leh teci ahi hi.

examples.english: The police found an important clue near the door.
examples.zomi: Police in kongpi kiangah thu kawk thupi khat mu hi.

examples.english: This sentence gives us a clue to the word’s meaning.
examples.zomi: Hih sentence in kammal khiatna theihna ding thu tawm hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: The informal expression have no clue means to have no knowledge or idea about something.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim kammal have no clue in thu khat theihna ahih kei leh ngaihsutna himhim neilo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A person who trains an athlete or team
senses.definition_en: A person who teaches, trains, and directs an athlete or sports team.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlmi ahih kei leh kimawl pawl khat hilh, kisinsak leh makaih mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The coach encouraged the players before the game.
examples.zomi: Coach in kimawlma in kimawlmite hansak hi.

examples.english: She works as a basketball coach.
examples.zomi: Basketball coach in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: A coach trains and directs players. A captain is usually a player chosen to lead the team on the field.
senses.usage_zomi: Coach in kimawlmite kisinsak leh makaih hi. Captain ahih leh kimawlna munah pawl makaih ding a kiteel kimawlmi ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: A person who helps someone improve a skill or performance
senses.definition_en: A person who guides and trains someone to improve a particular skill, habit, or performance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a siamna, ngeina ahih kei leh nasepna khangtosak dingin makaih leh kisinsak mi ahi hi.

examples.english: A career coach helped her prepare for interviews.
examples.zomi: Nasep lampi makaihpa in nasep dotna ading a kisakholhna panpih hi.

examples.english: The singer worked with a voice coach.
examples.zomi: La-sakpa pen aw kisinsakpa tawh nasemkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense extends beyond sports to education, work, speaking, music, and personal development.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen kimawlna bek hilo in, pilna, nasep, thugenna, la leh mimal khantohna ah zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: A comfortable bus used for longer journeys
senses.definition_en: A large, comfortable bus used for carrying passengers over long distances.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzin mite gamla ah tawi dingin a kibawl bus lian leh nuam ahi hi.

examples.english: We traveled to the city by coach.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah bus lian tawh khualzin ung.

examples.english: The coach stopped for a short break.
examples.zomi: Bus lian tawldamna tomno ading khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is especially common in British English. American English more often uses bus or motorcoach.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna British English ah kizang tampi hi. American English ah bus ahih kei leh motorcoach kizangzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A hard black or brown rock taken from the ground and burned as fuel.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei sungpan a kitohkhia, meihol in a kihal, a vom ahih kei leh neel-eng suang nam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The power plant burns coal to produce electricity.
examples.zomi: Meima bawlna inn in meima bawl dingin meihol hal hi.

examples.english: Many coal mines have closed.
examples.zomi: Meihol tohna tampi kikhakta hi.

senses.usage_en: Coal is uncountable when referring generally to the fuel. A separate piece may be called a piece of coal or a lump of coal.
senses.usage_zomi: Meihol a kim gen ciangin coal simtheihloh noun ahi hi. A tawm khat gen dingin a piece of coal ahih kei leh a lump of coal ci ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The land beside the sea or ocean.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuipi tawh a kizom lei gei ahih kei leh tuipi kam ahi hi.

examples.english: They live near the coast.
examples.zomi: Tuipi kam kiangah teng uh hi.

examples.english: A storm moved toward the east coast.
examples.zomi: Huihpi nisuahna tuipi kam lamah pai hi.

senses.usage_en: The coast is the broader land area beside the sea. A beach is a particular sandy or stony area at the water’s edge.
senses.usage_zomi: Coast pen tuipi gei a lei gam a za in huam hi. Beach pen tuipi tui gei a piaunel ahih kei leh suangtum mun kician ahi hi.

senses.heading: An outer piece of clothing
senses.definition_en: A piece of outer clothing worn over other clothes to keep warm or dry.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lum ahih kei leh guah leh tui pan pumpi kem dingin puan dangte tungah a kisilh puandum ahi hi.

examples.english: Wear a warm coat because it is cold outside.
examples.zomi: Pualam a vot manin puandum lum silh in.

examples.english: She hung her coat beside the door.
examples.zomi: A puandum kongpi kiangah khai hi.

senses.usage_en: A coat is normally worn outdoors over other clothing. A jacket is often shorter and lighter.
senses.usage_zomi: Coat pen a tamzaw in pualam ah puan dangte tungah kisilh hi. Jacket pen a tomzaw leh a zangzaw ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: An animal’s natural covering of hair or fur
senses.definition_en: The hair, wool, or fur covering an animal’s body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ganhing pumpi tuam a sam, tuumul ahih kei leh vun-sam ahi hi.

examples.english: The dog has a thick black coat.
examples.zomi: Ui in vun-sam vom leh khau nei hi.

examples.english: The horse’s coat looked healthy and shiny.
examples.zomi: Sakol vun-sam cidam leh leng in kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, coat is the animal’s natural body covering, not clothing put on the animal.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah coat pen ganhing a pianpih sam ahi a, ganhing tungah kisilh puan hilo hi.

senses.heading: A layer covering a surface
senses.definition_en: A thin layer of paint, liquid, or another substance spread over a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat mai-ah vutna, tui ahih kei leh zat dang tawh a kizut pheek khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The wall needs another coat of paint.
examples.zomi: Bang pen vutna pheek khat beh kisam hi.

examples.english: Apply a thin coat of oil to the pan.
examples.zomi: Beel tungah sathau pheek tawm zut in.

senses.usage_en: Use a coat of before the covering substance: a coat of paint or a coat of oil.
senses.usage_zomi: A tuam zat gen dingin a coat of kizang hi: a coat of paint ahih kei leh a coat of oil.

senses.heading: A system of rules or principles
senses.definition_en: An organized set of rules, laws, or standards controlling behavior or practice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih kei leh nasepna uk ding a kigawm thukhun, daan ahih kei leh ciangtan ahi hi.

examples.english: The building must meet the safety code.
examples.zomi: Innpi in bitna daan zui ding hi.

examples.english: Employees must follow the company’s code of conduct.
examples.zomi: Nasemte company gamtatna thukhun zui ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A code may be legally required or may be a professional or organizational standard.
senses.usage_zomi: Code khat daan tawh zuih kul hithei a, siamna nasep ahih kei leh pawlpi ciangtan zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: A system of signs or symbols used to communicate information
senses.definition_en: A system in which letters, numbers, signs, or signals represent information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu pulakna dingin lai mal, number, lim ahih kei leh signal in thu dang a aiawh system ahi hi.

examples.english: Enter the security code from the message.
examples.zomi: Thupuak sung bitna code gelh lut in.

examples.english: They used a secret code to communicate.
examples.zomi: Kihopihna dingin thuthuk code zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A code may identify something, protect access, or hide the meaning of a message.
senses.usage_zomi: Code in na khat theihkhiatna, lutna kepna ahih kei leh thupuak khiatna phawkna in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Instructions written for a computer
senses.definition_en: Instructions written in a programming language that tell a computer what to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer in bang sem ding cih hilh programming language tawh a kigelh thuhilhna ahi hi.

examples.english: She writes code for mobile applications.
examples.zomi: Mobile application-te ading computer code gelh hi.

examples.english: The error was found in the source code.
examples.zomi: Source code sungah khialhna kimu hi.

senses.usage_en: In computing, code is normally uncountable when referring generally to program instructions.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer zatna ah program thuhilhna a kim gen ciangin code simtheihloh noun ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: A dark drink made from roasted coffee beans
senses.definition_en: A drink made by mixing hot water with roasted and ground coffee beans.
senses.explanation_zomi: Coffee gah kikan leh kigawp tui sa tawh a kibawl dawnna ahi hi.

examples.english: I drink a cup of coffee every morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsang simin coffee hai khat ka dawn hi.

examples.english: Would you like milk in your coffee?
examples.zomi: Na coffee sungah nawitui na deih hiam?

senses.usage_en: Coffee is normally uncountable for the drink, but a coffee can informally mean one cup or serving.
senses.usage_zomi: Dawnna a kim gen ciangin coffee simtheihloh noun ahi hi. Nisim kiholna ah a coffee in coffee hai khat cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: The beans or plant used to make coffee
senses.definition_en: The beans, seeds, or plant from which the coffee drink is made.
senses.explanation_zomi: Coffee tui bawlna ding gah, mu ahih kei leh singkung ahi hi.

examples.english: The farmers grow coffee in the hills.
examples.zomi: Lousiamte mualte ah coffee phut uh hi.

examples.english: Fresh coffee beans have a strong smell.
examples.zomi: Coffee gah thak a gim nam khauh hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether coffee means the drink, the beans, or the crop.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu omdan in coffee pen dawnna, gah ahih kei leh loh an cih lak hi.

senses.definition_en: A small, flat piece of metal used as money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum in a kizang, metal tawh kibawl sum tang phei leh kual ahi hi.

examples.english: She found a coin under the chair.
examples.zomi: Tutna nuai ah sum tang khat mu hi.

examples.english: The machine accepts coins but not paper money.
examples.zomi: Machine in sum tang sang a, sum pheek sang lo hi.

senses.usage_en: A coin is made of metal. Paper currency is called a note in British English and a bill in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Coin pen metal tawh kibawl hi. Sum pheek pen British English ah note, American English ah bill kici hi.

senses.heading: Having a low temperature
senses.definition_en: Having a lower temperature than is comfortable, expected, or normal.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lum kicinglo ahih kei leh a biasa sangin khuasak niam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The water is too cold for swimming.
examples.zomi: Tui a vot mahmah manin tui leuh theihlo hi.

examples.english: Wear a coat because it is cold outside.
examples.zomi: Pualam a vot manin puandum silh in.

senses.usage_en: Cold describes low temperature. The noun a cold means a common viral illness affecting the nose and throat.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective cold in khuasak niam gen hi. Noun a cold ahih leh nak leh ngawng a suk khuasik natna biasa ahi hi.

senses.heading: Unfriendly or without visible emotion
senses.definition_en: Not showing warmth, kindness, affection, or emotion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lawmna, hehpihna, itna ahih kei leh lungsim thu kilangsak lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave him a cold reply.
examples.zomi: Amah tungah lawmhuailo takin dawng hi.

examples.english: Their relationship became cold and distant.
examples.zomi: A kizopna uh lungnemlo leh kigamla hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: When used about behavior or relationships, cold is figurative and does not refer to temperature.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna leh kizopna a gen ciangin cold pen gentehna ahi a, khuasak genna hilo hi.

senses.heading: To fall down suddenly because support or strength is lost
senses.definition_en: To fall down or break apart suddenly because a structure or body can no longer support itself.
senses.explanation_zomi: Domna ahih kei leh thahatna a bei manin thakhat in cim ahih kei leh puk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The old building collapsed during the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi sungah innpi lui cim hi.

examples.english: He collapsed from exhaustion.
examples.zomi: A gimluat manin puk hi.

senses.usage_en: A structure may collapse by falling apart. A person may collapse by suddenly falling because of illness, weakness, or exhaustion.
senses.usage_zomi: Inn ahih kei leh lamna khat kitamin cim thei hi. Mi khat natna, tha-neihlohna ahih kei leh gimluatna hangin thakhat in puk thei hi.

senses.heading: To fail completely
senses.definition_en: To fail suddenly and completely, especially when referring to a system, organization, economy, or plan.
senses.explanation_zomi: System, pawl, sumvai ahih kei leh geelna khat thakhat in a vekpi semtheilo suak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company collapsed after losing its main customer.
examples.zomi: A leipa bulpi a suploh khit ciangin company kitam hi.

examples.english: The peace talks collapsed without an agreement.
examples.zomi: Thukimna omlo in kilemna kiholimna sia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, collapse describes total or severe failure, not a small problem.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah collapse in buaina neu hilo in, a vekpi ahih kei leh nasatak in sia cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who works with another person, especially in the same profession or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in siamna nasep ahih kei leh pawl khat sungah midang tawh nasemkhawm mi ahi hi.

examples.english: I discussed the report with my colleagues.
examples.zomi: Ka naseppihte tawh report kiholim ung.

examples.english: A former colleague recommended her for the position.
examples.zomi: Naseppih ngei khat in tua dinmun ading amah phat hi.

senses.usage_en: A colleague is someone you work with, not necessarily a personal friend.
senses.usage_zomi: Colleague pen nang tawh nasemkhawm mi ahi a, mimal lawm hithei pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: To bring things together
senses.definition_en: To gather people or things together from different places.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun tuamtuam pan mihing ahih kei leh na-te kaikhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Researchers collected information from five villages.
examples.zomi: Zongkhiate in khua nga pan thu kaikhawm uh hi.

examples.english: The city collects rubbish every Tuesday.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in Tuesday simin ninsia kaikhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Collect emphasizes bringing separate people or things into one place or group.
senses.usage_zomi: Collect in a kikhenkhia mi ahih kei leh na-te mun khat ah kaikhopna thupi sak hi.

senses.heading: To keep and build a group of objects as a hobby
senses.definition_en: To obtain and keep particular objects because they are interesting or valuable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunglutna ahih kei leh manphatna hangin van nam khat zong in kemkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He collects old coins as a hobby.
examples.zomi: Lunglutna in sum tang lui kholkhawm hi.

examples.english: She has collected stamps since childhood.
examples.zomi: A naupanlai pan stamp kholkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, objects are collected systematically rather than gathered for immediate use.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah vante tu in zang ding a kikaikhawm hilo in, zatdan nei in zong leh kikemkhawm hi.

senses.heading: To receive or obtain something that is waiting
senses.definition_en: To go somewhere and receive or take something that is ready or waiting.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisakholsa ahih kei leh a kingak na khat mun khat ah pai in la cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I need to collect my package from the post office.
examples.zomi: Post office pan ka van-bawm ka la kul hi.

examples.english: She collected the children after school.
examples.zomi: Sang khit ciangin naupangte va la hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is especially common in British English. American English often uses pick up.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan British English ah kizang tampi hi. American English ah pick up kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: To request and receive money owed
senses.definition_en: To request and receive money such as rent, tax, fees, or debt.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn-lo man, sia, nasep man ahih kei leh leiba ngen in sang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The landlord collects rent at the beginning of each month.
examples.zomi: Inn-neipa in kha kipat simin inn-lo man dong hi.

examples.english: The government collects taxes to fund public services.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in mipi nasepna sum guan dingin sia kaikhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, collect means obtaining money that is due or officially required.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah collect in piak ding ahih kei leh daan tawh a kisam sum ngen in lak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A group of objects gathered together
senses.definition_en: A group of related objects that have been gathered and kept together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizopna nei van tuamtuam a kikaikhawm leh kikemkhawm pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The library has a large collection of history books.
examples.zomi: Laibu-inn in tangthu laibu kholsa tampi nei hi.

examples.english: She showed us her coin collection.
examples.zomi: A sum tang kholsa kote hong lak hi.

senses.usage_en: A collection may be organized for study, interest, display, or preservation.
senses.usage_zomi: Collection pen sinna, lunglutna, lakna ahih kei leh kepna ading a kigeel in kikaikhawm hithei hi.

senses.heading: The act or process of gathering something
senses.definition_en: The act or organized process of gathering, receiving, or picking up things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na-te kaikhop, lak ahih kei leh sangna nasep leh sepzia ahi hi.

examples.english: Rubbish collection takes place every Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday simin ninsia kaikhopna om hi.

examples.english: Data collection continued for six months.
examples.zomi: Data kaikhopna kha guk sung kizom hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, collection names the process rather than the resulting group.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah collection in a kikaikhopsa pawl sangin, kaikhopna nasep gen hi.

senses.heading: Money gathered for a purpose
senses.definition_en: Money gathered from several people for a particular purpose, person, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna, mi ahih kei leh pawl khat ading mi tuamtuam kiangpan a kikaikhawm sum ahi hi.

examples.english: They took a collection for the family.
examples.zomi: Innkuan ading sum kaikhawm uh hi.

examples.english: The charity collection raised five hundred dollars.
examples.zomi: Huhna sum kaikhopna in dollar zanga ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: A collection may refer to both the activity of gathering money and the total amount gathered.
senses.usage_zomi: Collection in sum kaikhopna nasep leh sum a kikaikhawm zah anih in gen thei hi.

senses.heading: An institution providing education after high school
senses.definition_en: An institution where students study after high school, often to earn a degree or professional qualification.
senses.explanation_zomi: High school khit ciangin degree ahih kei leh siamna lailet ngah ding a kisinna sang ahi hi.

examples.english: She plans to attend college next year.
examples.zomi: Kum naungin college kah dingin geel hi.

examples.english: He studied business in college.
examples.zomi: College ah sumdawnna thu sin hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, college may refer broadly to undergraduate higher education, including study at a university.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah college in university sung undergraduate sinna zong huam in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: A part of a university or a specialized educational institution
senses.definition_en: A division of a university or an institution specializing in a particular type of education.
senses.explanation_zomi: University sung a sinna khen lian ahih kei leh sinna nam khat bek a thupi sak sang ahi hi.

examples.english: She teaches in the College of Education.
examples.zomi: Sangsiah Sinna Khen ah thu hilh hi.

examples.english: He was admitted to a medical college.
examples.zomi: Siavuan sinna sang ah sang hi.

senses.usage_en: The meaning and structure of college differ between countries. In some systems, it may provide education below university level.
senses.usage_zomi: College a khiatna leh a kibawlzia gam ciangin kibang lo hi. Gam pawlkhat ah university sang a niamzaw sinna pia thei hi.

senses.heading: The appearance produced by the way something reflects light
senses.definition_en: A quality such as red, blue, green, or yellow that is seen when light reaches the eyes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavak mit sung a tun ciangin san, dum, hing, eng leh a dangte bangin a kimuh na khat mel ahi hi.

examples.english: What colour is your car?
examples.zomi: Na mawtaw bang pian hiam?

examples.english: The leaves change colour in autumn.
examples.zomi: Autumn hunin singteh mel kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Colour is the British spelling. The American spelling is color.
senses.usage_zomi: Colour pen British spelling ahi hi. American spelling pen color ahi hi.

senses.heading: A substance used to give something a particular appearance
senses.definition_en: Paint, dye, or another substance used to make something a particular colour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan, bang, sam ahih kei leh na dangte mel tuam khat nei sak ding a kizang vutna ahih kei leh mel pia zat ahi hi.

examples.english: She added blue colour to the mixture.
examples.zomi: A kihel zat sungah mel dum behlap hi.

examples.english: The product contains no artificial colouring.
examples.zomi: Hih van sungah bawltawm mel-piakna zat om lo hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to a dye or colouring substance, English may use colour or a more exact term such as paint, dye, or food colouring.
senses.usage_zomi: Mel pia zat gen ciangin colour ahih kei leh paint, dye, food colouring bang a kicianzaw kammal kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a particular colour or several colours rather than being plain, white, or transparent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mel tuam khat ahih kei leh mel tuamtuam nei a, a mawk, a pak ahih kei leh langthei bek hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children used coloured paper for the project.
examples.zomi: Naupangte geelna ading lai mel nei zang uh hi.

examples.english: A brightly coloured bird landed in the tree.
examples.zomi: Vasa mel taang khat singkung tungah tu hi.

senses.usage_en: Coloured is the British spelling; American English uses colored. When used as a label for people, colored is outdated and offensive in the United States. Use the respectful identity term appropriate to the people and context.
senses.usage_zomi: Coloured pen British spelling ahi a, American English ah colored kigelh hi. United States ah mihingte min sakna in colored zat pen lui leh simmawh huai in kingai hi. Mihingte a cihnopna uh leh thu omdan tawh kituak zahtak huai min kizang ding hi.

senses.heading: A vertical arrangement of words, numbers, or information
senses.definition_en: A group of words, numbers, or other information arranged vertically from top to bottom.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, number ahih kei leh thu-te tungpan nuai dong a khuam in kigeel ahi hi.

examples.english: Write the totals in the final column.
examples.zomi: A vekpi simna khuam nunungah gelh in.

examples.english: The names appear in the left-hand column.
examples.zomi: Minte veilam khuam ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: A column runs vertically. A row runs horizontally from side to side.
senses.usage_zomi: Column pen tungpan nuai dong a ding in pai hi. Row pen lang khat pan lang khat dong a phei in pai hi.

senses.heading: A regular newspaper or magazine article
senses.definition_en: An article on a particular subject written regularly for a newspaper, magazine, or website.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thuthak lai, magazine ahih kei leh website ah thu nam khat tawh kisai a hun sehsa bang a kigelh article ahi hi.

examples.english: She writes a weekly column about education.
examples.zomi: Pilna thu tawh kisai kal sim article gelh hi.

examples.english: I read his column in the morning newspaper.
examples.zomi: Zingsang thuthak lai sungah a article ka sim hi.

senses.usage_en: A column may be named because it originally occupied a vertical section of a printed page, but it now also appears online.
senses.usage_zomi: Column pen lai pheek tungah a ding khen khat a laak manin tua min nei hi napi, tu in internet tungah zong om hi.

senses.heading: A tall vertical structure
senses.definition_en: A tall upright structure, often round, used to support or decorate a building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn dom ahih kei leh kizepna ding a kibawl, a sang leh a ding khuam ahi hi.

examples.english: Four stone columns support the roof.
examples.zomi: Suang khuam li in innkhum dom hi.

examples.english: The entrance is decorated with tall columns.
examples.zomi: Lutna mun khuam sangte tawh kizep hi.

senses.usage_en: A structural column supports weight. A decorative column may be used mainly for appearance.
senses.usage_zomi: Inn dom khuam in gik pua hi. Kizepna khuam ahih leh a mel hoihna ding bek hithei hi.

senses.heading: Two or more things joined or used together
senses.definition_en: Two or more people, things, qualities, or actions joined or used together.
