senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na, zia ahih kei leh gamtatna nih leh a tamzaw a kihelkhawm ahih kei leh a kizopkhawm ahi hi.

examples.english: The meal has a good combination of flavors.
examples.zomi: An in a lim nam kihelkhopna hoih nei hi.

examples.english: Success came from a combination of skill and hard work.
examples.zomi: Siamna leh hanciamna kizopkhopna pan lawcinna hong piang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a combination of before the things that are joined.
senses.usage_zomi: A kihelkhawmte gen dingin a combination of kizang hi.

senses.heading: A sequence of numbers or symbols used to open a lock
senses.definition_en: A particular sequence of numbers, letters, or symbols used to open a lock or gain access.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tawh hon ahih kei leh mun khat lutna ding a kizang number, lai mal ahih kei leh lim a kizomzia kician ahi hi.

examples.english: I forgot the combination to the lock.
examples.zomi: Tawh honna number ka mangngilh hi.

examples.english: Enter the correct combination to open the safe.
examples.zomi: Sum-kuang hon dingin number kizomsa man gelh lut in.

senses.usage_en: A combination lock opens when the correct sequence is entered, usually without a key.
senses.usage_zomi: Combination lock pen a tamzaw in tawhpi zanglo in, number kizomsa man a kigelh ciangin kihong hi.

senses.definition_en: To join two or more people, things, qualities, or activities so that they work or exist together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na, zia ahih kei leh nasep nih leh a tamzaw khat in kizomsak ahih kei leh helkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Combine the flour, sugar, and eggs in a bowl.
examples.zomi: Anneel, cikhum leh ak-tui kuangkum sungah helkhawm in.

examples.english: The plan combines education with practical training.
examples.zomi: Geelna in laisin pilna leh khut tawh kisinna zomkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Combine A with B and combine A and B are both common patterns.
senses.usage_zomi: Combine A with B leh combine A and B cih zatdan anih in kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: To move toward the speaker or a particular place
senses.definition_en: To move or travel toward the speaker, listener, or a stated destination.
senses.explanation_zomi: Paupa, ngaipa ahih kei leh a kigensa mun lamah pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please come here for a moment.
examples.zomi: Tawlkhat hih lai-ah hong pai in.

examples.english: She came home late last night.
examples.zomi: Zaan in inn hong ciah man lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Come usually shows movement toward the speaker or destination. Go usually shows movement away from the speaker.
senses.usage_zomi: Come in paupa ahih kei leh tunna ding mun lamah paina lak zel hi. Go in paupa kiangpan gamla lamah paina lak zel hi.

senses.heading: To arrive
senses.definition_en: To reach a place or arrive at a particular time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah tung ahih kei leh hun khat hong pha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bus came ten minutes late.
examples.zomi: Bus minute sawm man lo in hong tung hi.

examples.english: Winter came early this year.
examples.zomi: Tukum in hunkhal manlang in hong tung hi.

senses.usage_en: Its forms are come–came–come.
senses.usage_zomi: Come pen irregular verb ahi a, come–came–come ci in kikhel hi.

senses.heading: To become available or happen
senses.definition_en: To become available, happen, or enter a particular state.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hong piang; hong suak; hong tung
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngahtheih hong suak, piang ahih kei leh dinmun tuam khat hong tung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her dream finally came true.
examples.zomi: A mangmatna a tawpna ah thumaan taktak hong suak hi.

examples.english: The new law comes into effect next month.
examples.zomi: Daan thak kha naungin hong kipan in kizang ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Many common meanings of come appear in fixed combinations such as come true, come to an end, and come into effect.
senses.usage_zomi: Come a khiatna tampi pen come true, come to an end leh come into effect bang kammal kizomsa sungah om hi.

senses.heading: Entertainment intended to make people laugh
senses.definition_en: A film, play, television program, or performance designed to make people laugh.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte nuisak dingin a kibawl khuamuh, zatna, television program ahih kei leh lahna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat a dingin nuihza thugenna

examples.english: We watched a comedy after dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak-an nek khit ciangin nuihza khuamuh khat en ung.

examples.english: The comedy show made everyone laugh.
examples.zomi: Nuihza program in mi khempeuh nuisak hi.

senses.usage_en: A comedy may contain serious moments, but its main purpose or form is humorous.
senses.usage_zomi: Comedy sungah thu thupi om thei napi, a ngiimna ahih kei leh a kibawlzia bulpi pen nuihza ahi hi.

senses.heading: The art or style of creating humor
senses.definition_en: The art, profession, or style of entertaining people through humor.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuihza tawh mihingte lungnuamsakna siamna, nasep ahih kei leh zatdan ahi hi.

examples.english: She began her career in comedy.
examples.zomi: Nuihza nasepna ah a nasep lampi kipan hi.

examples.english: His comedy often focuses on family life.
examples.zomi: A nuihza in innkuan nuntakna bulphuh zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Comedy is uncountable when referring generally to the art or profession.
senses.usage_zomi: Nuihza siamna ahih kei leh nasep a kim gen ciangin comedy simtheihloh noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Physical ease and freedom from pain
senses.definition_en: A pleasant physical state in which a person is relaxed, warm, safe, or free from pain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawldam, lum, bit ahih kei leh natna neilo in nuam tak a omna dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The chair was designed for comfort.
examples.zomi: Tutna pen nuam tak a tutna dingin kibawl hi.

examples.english: The nurse adjusted the pillow for the patient’s comfort.
examples.zomi: Cinate a nopna dingin nurse in lukhung bawlpha hi.

senses.usage_en: Comfort is usually uncountable when it refers generally to physical ease.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi nopna a kim gen ciangin comfort pen simtheihloh noun ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Emotional support during sadness or difficulty
senses.definition_en: Support that makes someone feel less sad, worried, or distressed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungkham, dah ahih kei leh haksatna thuak laitak a lungsim nuamsak leh hansak panpihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her friends gave her comfort after the loss.
examples.zomi: A suploh khit ciangin a lawmte in amah hamuan uh hi.

examples.english: He found comfort in prayer.
examples.zomi: Thungetna sungah hamuanna mu hi.

senses.usage_en: Emotional comfort does not remove the problem; it helps a person endure distress or sadness.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungsim hamuanna in buaina lawhkhia pahpah lo napi, dahna leh haksatna thuakzo dingin mi khat panpih hi.

senses.heading: Physically relaxed and free from discomfort
senses.definition_en: Feeling physically relaxed, safe, and free from pain or unpleasant pressure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tawldam, bit leh natna ahih kei leh nuamlohna neilo in om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This chair is very comfortable.
examples.zomi: Hih tutna nuam mahmah hi.

examples.english: Wear comfortable shoes for the long walk.
examples.zomi: Khe tawh khualzinna sau ading khepek nuam silh in.

senses.usage_en: Something is comfortable when it creates comfort. A person may also feel comfortable.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat in pumpi nopna a piak ciangin comfortable kici hi. Mi khat zong nuam takin om thei hi.

senses.heading: Feeling relaxed and confident in a situation
senses.definition_en: Feeling calm, confident, and not embarrassed or worried in a situation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungmuang; zaklo in nuam takin om
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat ah lungmuang, zum leh zak ahih kei leh lungkham loin om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She feels comfortable speaking in public.
examples.zomi: Mipi ma-ah pau ding lungmuang hi.

examples.english: Are you comfortable with this plan?
examples.zomi: Hih geelna tawh na lungmuang hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use comfortable with before a person, idea, or situation, and comfortable doing before an activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh dinmun ma-ah comfortable with kizang a, gamtatna ma-ah comfortable doing kizang hi.

senses.heading: A strong official order
senses.definition_en: An official order given by someone who has authority.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ukna nei mi khat in sem ding ahih kei leh semlo dingin a piak thupiak khauh ahi hi.

examples.english: The soldiers obeyed the command.
examples.zomi: Galkapte in thupiak mang uh hi.

examples.english: The officer gave a command to stop.
examples.zomi: Ukpa in khawl dingin thupiak pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A command is stronger than an ordinary request because it comes from authority.
senses.usage_zomi: Command pen ukna pan a hong pai ahih manin, ngetna biasa sangin khauhzaw hi.

senses.heading: Control or authority over people or operations
senses.definition_en: The authority or responsibility to control and direct people, forces, or an operation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, galkap ahih kei leh nasep khat uk leh makaih ding ukna leh mawpuakna ahi hi.

examples.english: She took command of the rescue operation.
examples.zomi: Huhkhiahna nasep ukna la hi.

examples.english: Five hundred soldiers were under his command.
examples.zomi: Galkap zanga a ukna nuai ah om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In command of identifies the people, unit, or operation that someone controls.
senses.usage_zomi: In command of nungah mi, pawl ahih kei leh nasep a ki-uk pen hong pai hi.

senses.heading: An instruction given to a computer
senses.definition_en: A word or instruction that tells a computer or program to perform an action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer ahih kei leh program in nasep khat sem dingin a kipia thuhilhna ahi hi.

examples.english: Enter the command and press Enter.
examples.zomi: Thupiak gelh lut inla, Enter nei in.

examples.english: The device responds to voice commands.
examples.zomi: Vanzat in aw tawh thupiakte dawng hi.

senses.usage_en: A computer command must follow the form expected by the system.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer command pen system in a kisap gelhdan leh zatdan zui ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A spoken or written statement expressing an opinion, explanation, or reaction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, hilhcian na ahih kei leh dawnkikna lak ding a kigen ahih kei leh kigelh thu ahi hi.

examples.english: She made a helpful comment about the report.
examples.zomi: Report tawh kisai huhna pia ngaihsutna khat gen hi.

examples.english: The article received hundreds of online comments.
examples.zomi: Article in internet dawnkikna zatel ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: A comment is usually brief. A longer, organized exchange of views is a discussion.
senses.usage_zomi: Comment pen a tamzaw in tomno ahi hi. Ngaihsutna a sau leh a kigeel in kikupna pen discussion ahi hi.

senses.heading: Relating to business, trade, or making money
senses.definition_en: Relating to buying, selling, business activity, or the aim of making a profit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van lei leh zuak, sumdawnna ahih kei leh sumpha bawlna ngiimna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The building is used for commercial purposes.
examples.zomi: Innpi pen sumdawnna ngiimna ading kizang hi.

examples.english: The film was a commercial success.
examples.zomi: Khuamuh pen sumdawnna lamah lawcing hi.

senses.usage_en: Commercial often contrasts with personal, charitable, governmental, or noncommercial activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Commercial pen mimal, huhna, kumpi ahih kei leh sumpha ngiimlo nasep tawh kilamdang hi.

senses.heading: Produced or developed for the general market
senses.definition_en: Produced on a large scale for sale to the public.
senses.zomi_equivalents: zuak ding a kibawl; dawr zatna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipite kiangah zuak dingin a tam in a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The crop is grown for commercial use.
examples.zomi: Lo-an pen zuak dingin kiphut hi.

examples.english: They developed a commercial version of the software.
examples.zomi: Software man tawh zuak ding version khat bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A commercial product is intended for sale, not merely for private experiment or personal use.
senses.usage_zomi: Commercial product pen zuak ding ngiimna tawh kibawl a, mimal sittelna ahih kei leh mimal zatna bek ading hilo hi.

senses.heading: An official group appointed for a particular purpose
senses.definition_en: A group officially appointed to investigate, regulate, advise, or manage a particular matter.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat sittel, uk, thuhilh ahih kei leh makaih dingin ukna tawh a kiseh pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The government formed a commission to investigate the accident.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in accident sittel dingin commission khat bawl hi.

examples.english: The election commission announced the results.
examples.zomi: Teelna commission in dawnna tangko hi.

senses.usage_en: A commission is usually created formally and given specific responsibilities or authority.
senses.usage_zomi: Commission pen a tamzaw in thupi takin kibawl a, mawpuakna ahih kei leh ukna kician kipia hi.

senses.heading: Money paid for arranging a sale or transaction
senses.definition_en: Money paid to someone, often as a percentage of the value of goods or services sold.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van ahih kei leh nasep khat zuak sakna man in, a tamzaw in van man a za khen bang a kipia sum ahi hi.

examples.english: The salesperson earns a commission on each sale.
examples.zomi: Vanzuakpa in van a zuak simin commission sum ngah hi.

examples.english: The agent charged a five-percent commission.
examples.zomi: Agent in a za khen nga commission la hi.

senses.usage_en: Commission is often calculated as a percentage, but it may also be a fixed amount.
senses.usage_zomi: Commission pen a tamzaw in za khen tawh kisin napi, sum kician khat zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: A request and payment for a special work
senses.definition_en: A formal request for someone to create or perform a particular piece of work for payment.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sum tawh nasep thuh; bawl ding ngetna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in sum ngahna tawh nasep tuam khat bawl ding a thupiak ahih kei leh ngetna ahi hi.

examples.english: The artist received a commission to paint a portrait.
examples.zomi: Limsiampa in milim khat zut ding nasep thuh ngah hi.

examples.english: She completed the commission in two months.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep thuh kha nih sungin zo hi.

senses.usage_en: A commissioned work is created because a client specifically requested and usually paid for it.
senses.usage_zomi: Commission tawh kibawl nasep pen client khat in a kician in a nget leh a tamzaw in a man a piak nasep ahi hi.

senses.heading: To perform a crime or seriously wrong act
senses.definition_en: To do something illegal or seriously wrong.
senses.explanation_zomi: Daan palsat mawhna ahih kei leh gamtat khial nasia khat bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The police accused him of committing a crime.
examples.zomi: Police in mawhna bawl hi ci in amah mawhsak hi.

examples.english: Anyone who commits fraud may face punishment.
examples.zomi: Khemna mawhna a bawl mi kuamah gim thuak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses commit with crimes and serious wrongs: commit theft, commit fraud, or commit murder.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah commit pen mawhna leh khialhna nasia tawh kizang hi: commit theft, commit fraud, commit murder.

senses.heading: To promise or firmly decide to do something
senses.definition_en: To make a firm promise or decision to give time, effort, money, or support to something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ading hun, hanciamna, sum ahih kei leh panpihna pia dingin kip takin kamciam ahih kei leh thukim cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: hun leh sum pia ding thukim

examples.english: The organization committed more money to the project.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi in geelna ading sum tamzaw pia dingin thukim hi.

examples.english: She committed herself to helping the children.
examples.zomi: Naupangte panpih dingin amah leh amah ki-ap hi.

senses.usage_en: Use commit to followed by a noun or an -ing form: commit to the plan; commit to helping.
senses.usage_zomi: Commit to nungah noun ahih kei leh -ing form kizang hi: commit to the plan; commit to helping.

senses.heading: To officially send someone to a hospital, prison, or institution
senses.definition_en: To officially order that someone be placed in a hospital, prison, or another institution.
senses.zomi_equivalents: koih ding thukhen; khum ding thukhen
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat zato, thonginn ahih kei leh kepna inn khat ah koih dingin daan ahih kei leh ukna tawh thukhen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The court committed him to prison.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi in amah thonginn ah khum dingin thukhen hi.

examples.english: She was committed to a hospital for treatment.
examples.zomi: Cidamna ading zato ah koih dingin kithukhen hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a formal legal or medical use and may involve specific rights and procedures.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen daan leh zatna a thupi zatdan ahi a, dikna leh sepzia kician tawh kisai thei hi.

senses.heading: A firm promise or decision
senses.definition_en: A firm promise or decision to support, do, or continue something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat panpih, sem ahih kei leh zom ding a kip tak a kamciam leh thukimna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company made a commitment to improve safety.
examples.zomi: Company in bitna hoihzaw sak dingin kamciamna bawl hi.

examples.english: Her commitment to the community is clear.
examples.zomi: Khua mipite ading a ki-apna kician hi.

senses.usage_en: Use commitment to before a noun or an -ing form.
senses.usage_zomi: Commitment to nungah noun ahih kei leh -ing form kizang hi.

senses.heading: A responsibility or arrangement requiring time or effort
senses.definition_en: A responsibility, appointment, or arrangement that requires time, effort, or attention.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, hanciamna ahih kei leh ngaihsutna kisam mawpuakna, kimuh hun ahih kei leh geelna ahi hi.

examples.english: I cannot attend because of a family commitment.
examples.zomi: Innkuan mawpuakna hangin ka kiheltheilo hi.

examples.english: She has several work commitments this week.
examples.zomi: Tukal sungah nasep mawpuakna pawlkhat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a commitment is something already promised or arranged that must receive your time or attention.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah commitment pen hun ahih kei leh ngaihsutna piak ding a kamciamsa ahih kei leh geelsa na ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A group of people chosen to discuss, investigate, decide, or manage a particular matter.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat kiholim, sittel, thukhen ahih kei leh makaih dingin a kiteel mihing pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee will review the proposal.
examples.zomi: Committee in thu utna sittel ding hi.

examples.english: She serves on the finance committee.
examples.zomi: Sumvai committee ah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: A committee usually works under a larger organization and has a defined purpose or responsibility.
senses.usage_zomi: Committee pen pawlpi lianzaw khat nuai ah nasem zel a, ngiimna ahih kei leh mawpuakna kician nei hi.

senses.heading: Happening or existing frequently
senses.definition_en: Happening often or found in many people, places, or things.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a om zel; a tam; biasa
senses.explanation_zomi: Piang kinken ahih kei leh mi, mun leh na-te tampi sungah a kimuh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This is a common mistake among learners.
examples.zomi: Hih pen sinmite lakah khialhna biasa ahi hi.

examples.english: Colds are common during winter.
examples.zomi: Hunkhal sungin khuasik natna om zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Common means frequent or widespread. It does not necessarily mean normal, correct, or acceptable.
senses.usage_zomi: Common in piang kinken ahih kei leh a kizel cihna ahi hi. Tua in a man, a hoih ahih kei leh a saangtheih cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: Shared by two or more people or things
senses.definition_en: Belonging to, affecting, or shared by two or more people or things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na nih leh a tamzaw in a neihkhawm ahih kei leh a thuakkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two groups share a common goal.
examples.zomi: Pawl nihte in ngiimna khat nei khawm uh hi.

examples.english: We have many interests in common.
examples.zomi: Lunglutna tampi kibang in nei khawm ung.

senses.usage_en: Have something in common means to share a quality, experience, or interest.
senses.usage_zomi: Have something in common in zia, thuakna ahih kei leh lunglutna khat neihkhopna cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Belonging to or available to everyone in a group
senses.definition_en: Belonging to, used by, or available to all members of a group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl sung member khempeuh neih, zat ahih kei leh ngah theih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Residents share a common kitchen.
examples.zomi: Teng mite in meikhuk khat zangkhawm uh hi.

examples.english: English became their common language.
examples.zomi: English pen a pau neihkhawm uh hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, common means shared, not ordinary or low-quality.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah common in neihkhawm ahih kei leh zatkhawm cihna ahi a, a biasa ahih kei leh quality niam cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Frequently, usually, or by many people.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tamzaw in; kizang zel; vei tampi
senses.explanation_zomi: Vei tampi, a tamzaw in ahih kei leh mi tampi in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This word is commonly used in conversation.
examples.zomi: Hih kammal kiholimna ah kizang zel hi.

examples.english: The plant is commonly found near rivers.
examples.zomi: Hih sing pen gun kiangah kimu zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Commonly describes frequency or widespread use. It does not by itself mean that something is correct or recommended.
senses.usage_zomi: Commonly in vei tampi a om ahih kei leh a kizang cih lak hi. Tua bek in a man ahih kei leh zat ding a kiphatsak cihna pia lo hi.

senses.heading: To exchange information, ideas, or feelings
senses.definition_en: To give and receive information, ideas, or feelings through speech, writing, signs, or other methods.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pau, lai, lim ahih kei leh lampi dang tawh thu, ngaihsutna leh lungsim dinmun piak leh sangkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Good leaders communicate clearly with their teams.
examples.zomi: Makaipa hoihte in a pawlte uh tawh kician takin kihopih uh hi.

examples.english: We communicate mainly by email.
examples.zomi: A tamzaw in email tungtawnin kihopih ung.

senses.usage_en: Use communicate with for the person and communicate by/through for the method.
senses.usage_zomi: A kihopihpih mi ma-ah communicate with kizang a, a zat lampi ma-ah communicate by/through kizang hi.

senses.heading: To make information or meaning understood
senses.definition_en: To express information, an idea, or a feeling so that others understand it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte in teltheihna dingin thu, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh lungsim dinmun kilangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The chart communicates the main findings clearly.
examples.zomi: Chart in a kimuhkhiatna bulpite kician takin telsak hi.

examples.english: Her expression communicated disappointment.
examples.zomi: A mel in a lungkimlohna kilangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, communication may happen without spoken or written words.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah pau leh lai zanglo in zong thu kilangsak thei hi.

senses.heading: The process of exchanging information or feelings
senses.definition_en: The process of giving, receiving, and understanding information, ideas, or feelings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh lungsim dinmun piak, sang leh telkhopna sepzia ahi hi.

examples.english: Clear communication can prevent misunderstandings.
examples.zomi: Kihopihna kician in kitelkhialhna khaktan thei hi.

examples.english: Communication is important in every relationship.
examples.zomi: Kizopna simah kihopihna thupi hi.

senses.usage_en: Communication is usually uncountable when it means the general process or skill.
senses.usage_zomi: Kihopihna sepzia ahih kei leh siamna a kim gen ciangin communication simtheihloh noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: A message or an instance of contact
senses.definition_en: A letter, message, announcement, or other contact sent or received.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kikhak ahih kei leh a kisang lai, thupuak, tangkona ahih kei leh kizopna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: We received an official communication from the agency.
examples.zomi: Agency pan ukna thupuak khat ngah ung.

examples.english: All written communications must be recorded.
examples.zomi: Lai tawh thupuak khempeuh ciamteh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: This countable use is more formal and usually refers to a specific message or contact.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih simtheih zatdan pen thupizaw a, thupuak ahih kei leh kizopna kician khat gen hi.

senses.heading: Systems used for sending information
senses.definition_en: Methods and systems used to send information, such as telephone, radio, internet, or satellite networks.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phone, radio, internet ahih kei leh satellite kizopna bang thu khakna lampi leh systemte ahi hi.

examples.english: The storm damaged communication systems.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in thukhakna systemte susia hi.

examples.english: Modern communication connects people across the world.
examples.zomi: Tulai kihopihna system in leitung mun tuamtuam a mite kizomsak hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural communications is often used for the industry, technology, or systems as a whole.
senses.usage_zomi: Industry, technology ahih kei leh systemte a kim gen ciangin plural communications kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: People living in the same area
senses.definition_en: The people who live in a particular town, neighborhood, or area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khua, veng ahih kei leh khuamun khat sungah tengkhawm mite ahi uh hi.

examples.english: The new clinic will serve the local community.
examples.zomi: Zatna inn thak in khuami mipi nasem ding hi.

examples.english: Community members met to discuss road safety.
examples.zomi: Khuamite lampi bitna kiholim dingin kimuhkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A community includes the people and often their shared institutions, relationships, and activities.
senses.usage_zomi: Community in mihingte bek hilo in, a pawlte, kizopnate leh a gamtatnate uh zong huam thei hi.

senses.heading: A group sharing an identity, interest, profession, or experience
senses.definition_en: A group of people connected by a shared identity, interest, occupation, belief, or experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Min, lunglutna, nasep, upna ahih kei leh thuakna khat a neihkhawm mihing pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The Zomi community organized a cultural event.
examples.zomi: Zomi mipi in ngeina pawi khat geelkhol uh hi.

examples.english: The scientific community reviewed the findings.
examples.zomi: Science siamate in a kimuhkhiatnate sittel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Members of this kind of community do not need to live in the same place.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih bang community memberte mun khat ah tengkhawm kullo hi.

senses.heading: A feeling of connection and shared responsibility
senses.definition_en: A sense of belonging, mutual support, and shared responsibility among people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte pawl sungah ka kihel hi ci a kisakna, kipanpihna leh mawpuakna neihkhopna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mipi pawl sung a kihel kisakna

examples.english: The festival created a strong sense of community.
examples.zomi: Pawi in mipi pawl sung a kihel kisakna khauh piangsak hi.

examples.english: Volunteering helps build community.
examples.zomi: Man neilo nasep in pumkhatna khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes social connection rather than a particular location or group.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah khuamun ahih kei leh pawl kician khat sangin, mihingte kizopna leh kipanpihna thupi sak hi.

senses.heading: A business organization
senses.definition_en: An organization that produces or sells goods or services, usually to make money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van bawl ahih kei leh zuak, nasep pia a, a tamzaw in sumpha bawl ding a kipawl sumdawnna pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: She works for a technology company.
examples.zomi: Technology company khat ading nasem hi.

examples.english: The company opened a new office in Columbus.
examples.zomi: Company in Columbus ah ophis thak khat hon hi.

senses.usage_en: A company is a business organization. Its exact legal structure may be a corporation, partnership, limited-liability company, or another form.
senses.usage_zomi: Company pen sumdawnna pawl ahi hi. A daan kibawlna pen corporation, partnership, limited-liability company ahih kei leh nam dang hithei hi.

senses.heading: The presence or companionship of another person
senses.definition_en: The state of being with someone, especially for companionship rather than a particular task.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep kician khat hang hilo in, lawm leh kipawlkhopna ading mi khat tawh omkhopna ahi hi.

examples.english: I enjoyed your company this evening.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitak na ompihna ka nuam sa hi.

examples.english: She stayed to keep her grandmother company.
examples.zomi: A pi ompih dingin om hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, company is uncountable and refers to companionship, not a business.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah company pen simtheihloh noun ahi a, sumdawnna pawl hilo in ompihna gen hi.

senses.heading: A group of guests or visitors
senses.definition_en: Guests or visitors present in someone’s home.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat innah hong hawh ahih kei leh hong zin mite ahi uh hi.

examples.english: We are having company for dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak-an ading zin nei ding ung.

examples.english: Please clean the living room before the company arrives.
examples.zomi: Zinte a tunma un khuakhan siansuah in.

senses.usage_en: This use is common in American English. We have company means that guests are visiting.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan American English ah kizang tampi hi. We have company in ka inn-ah zin hong hawh uh hi cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To examine similarities and differences
senses.definition_en: To examine two or more people or things to discover how they are similar or different.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na nih leh a tamzaw etkak in a kibatna leh kilamdanna zongkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Compare the two reports before making a decision.
examples.zomi: Thukhenma in report nihte etkak in.

examples.english: We compared prices at several stores.
examples.zomi: Dawr pawlkhat a mante etkak ung.

senses.usage_en: Use compare A with B when examining similarities and differences. Compare A to B is often used when emphasizing a similarity.
senses.usage_zomi: Kibatna leh kilamdanna etkak dingin compare A with B kizang hi. Kibatna thupi sak dingin compare A to B kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: To state that someone or something is similar to another
senses.definition_en: To describe someone or something as being similar to another person or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat midang ahih kei leh na dang khat tawh kibang hi ci in gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The writer compared life to a journey.
examples.zomi: Laigelhpa in nuntakna khualzinna tawh tehkak hi.

examples.english: This year’s harvest cannot compare with last year’s.
examples.zomi: Tukum lo-an pen kum beisa lo-an tawh tehkak zawhlo hi.

senses.usage_en: A comparison does not mean that two things are identical; it identifies particular similarities or differences.
senses.usage_zomi: Tehkakna in na nih kibang sitset cihna hilo a, a kibatna ahih kei leh kilamdanna kician khat lakna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The act of examining similarities and differences
senses.definition_en: The process of examining people or things to determine their similarities and differences.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na-te a kibatna leh kilamdanna theihna ding a etkakna sepzia ahi hi.

examples.english: The report provides a comparison of the two systems.
examples.zomi: Report in system nihte etkakna pia hi.

examples.english: A price comparison helped us choose the cheaper product.
examples.zomi: Man etkakna in van man tawmzaw teel ding hong panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use comparison between A and B or comparison of A with B when naming the things examined.
senses.usage_zomi: A ki-etkakte gen dingin comparison between A and B ahih kei leh comparison of A with B kizang hi.

senses.heading: A statement showing similarity
senses.definition_en: A statement or idea that shows how one person or thing resembles another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat midang ahih kei leh na dang tawh bangci kibang cih a lak thugen ahih kei leh ngaihsutna ahi hi.

examples.english: The speaker drew a comparison between learning and farming.
examples.zomi: Thugenpa in sinna leh loh nasep kikal kibatna lak hi.

examples.english: The comparison is useful but not exact.
examples.zomi: Tehkakna in phattuamna nei napi, a kibang sitset lo hi.

senses.usage_en: The phrase by comparison introduces a contrast with something already mentioned.
senses.usage_zomi: By comparison in a kigensa thu tawh etkak a kilamdanna khat pulak hi.

senses.definition_en: To try to win or succeed against another person, team, organization, or business.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl ahih kei leh sumdawnna dangte tawh gualzo ahih kei leh lawcinzaw dingin kidem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Athletes from twenty countries will compete in the event.
examples.zomi: Gam sawmnih pan kimawl siamte tua kidemna ah kihel ding uh hi.

examples.english: Small businesses find it difficult to compete with large companies.
examples.zomi: Sumdawnna neute in company liante tawh kidem ding haksa sa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use compete with/against for the opponent, compete for for the goal, and compete in for the event.
senses.usage_zomi: A kidempih ma-ah compete with/against, a ngah nuam na ma-ah compete for, kidemna thupiang ma-ah compete in kizang hi.

senses.heading: An organized event in which people try to win
senses.definition_en: An organized event in which people or teams try to perform better than others and win.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawlte midangte sangin hoihzaw sem a gualzo ding a kidemna thupiang ahi hi.

examples.english: She won first prize in the writing competition.
examples.zomi: Laigelh kidemna ah letsong masa ngah hi.

examples.english: Ten schools entered the competition.
examples.zomi: Sanginn sawm kidemna ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, contest is also common for a particular organized competition.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah kidemna thupiang kician khat genna in contest zong kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: Rivalry between people or organizations seeking the same goal
senses.definition_en: The situation in which people or organizations try to succeed against others seeking the same customers, position, or result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawlte leipa, dinmun ahih kei leh dawnna kibang ngah dingin a kidem uh dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: Competition between the two companies is strong.
examples.zomi: Company nihte kikal kidemna khauh hi.

examples.english: The store lowered its prices because of competition.
examples.zomi: Kidemna hangin dawr in a van mante khiamsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Competition is usually uncountable when referring generally to rivalry.
senses.usage_zomi: Kidemna dinmun a kim gen ciangin competition simtheihloh noun ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Other people or organizations trying to win
senses.definition_en: The other people, teams, or businesses competing against someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh pawl khat tawh a kidem midangte ahih kei leh pawl dangte ahi uh hi.

examples.english: Their product is cheaper than the competition.
examples.zomi: A van uh kidempihte van sangin man tawmzaw hi.

examples.english: The team trained hard to beat the competition.
examples.zomi: Pawl in kidempihte zo dingin nasatak in kisin hi.

senses.usage_en: When the competition means competitors collectively, it refers to the opposing people or organizations.
senses.usage_zomi: The competition in kidempihte a vekpi a cihna a neih ciangin, a langkhat mite ahih kei leh pawlte gen hi.

senses.heading: Wanting strongly to win
senses.definition_en: Having a strong desire to win or to perform better than others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzo ahih kei leh midangte sangin hoihzaw sem ding a deihna khauh nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is competitive but respects her opponents.
examples.zomi: Kidem nuam mahmah napi, a kidempihte zahtak hi.

examples.english: Competitive players work hard to improve.
examples.zomi: Kimawlmi kidem nuamte a khantohna dingun hanciam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Being competitive can motivate improvement, but excessive competitiveness may harm cooperation.
senses.usage_zomi: Kidem nuamna in khantohna piangsak thei napi, a luat leh nasemkhopna susia thei hi.

senses.heading: Involving strong competition
senses.definition_en: Having many people or organizations trying to obtain the same goal, position, or customers.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl tampi in ngiimna, dinmun ahih kei leh leite kibang ngah ding a kidem uh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Technology is a highly competitive industry.
examples.zomi: Technology pen kidemna khauh mahmah industry ahi hi.

examples.english: Admission to the program is competitive.
examples.zomi: Program sung lutna ngah ding kidemna khauh hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, competitive describes the situation, not the personality of a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah competitive in mi khat a zia genlo in, kidemna dinmun gen hi.

senses.heading: As good as or better than similar alternatives
senses.definition_en: Similar to or better than others in price, quality, or performance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Man, quality ahih kei leh nasepna ah a dangte tawh kibang ahih kei leh hoihzaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company offers competitive salaries.
examples.zomi: Company in thaman kituak pia hi.

examples.english: Our prices remain competitive.
examples.zomi: Ka van man uh a dangte tawh kidemzo lai hi.

senses.usage_en: A competitive price is attractive compared with prices offered by others; it does not necessarily mean the lowest price.
senses.usage_zomi: Competitive price pen midangte man tawh etkak ciangin lei huai cihna ahi a, a niampen man hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person, team, company, or product that competes against another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, company ahih kei leh van dang tawh gualzo ahih kei leh lawcinzaw ding a kidem ahi hi.

examples.english: She defeated her closest competitor in the final race.
examples.zomi: Taisiamna nunungah a kidempih khauhpente lakah khat zo hi.

examples.english: The company studies its competitors’ prices.
examples.zomi: Company in a kidempihte van mante sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: A competitor may be an opponent in an event or a rival business in a market.
senses.usage_zomi: Competitor pen kidemna sung langkhat mi ahih kei leh sumdawnna zawl sung kidempih company hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: To say that you are unhappy, dissatisfied, uncomfortable, or annoyed about something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hangin lungkimlo, nuamlo, haksat ahih kei leh lung hihmawh cih gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Several customers complained about the slow service.
examples.zomi: Leite pawlkhat in nasep a manloh manin phun uh hi.

examples.english: She complained to the landlord about the broken heater.
examples.zomi: Meilumna sia tawh kisai inn-neipa kiangah lungkimlohna gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Use complain about for the problem and complain to for the person or organization receiving the complaint.
senses.usage_zomi: Buaina ma-ah complain about kizang a, lungkimlohna a kigenna mi ahih kei leh pawl ma-ah complain to kizang hi.

senses.heading: A statement expressing dissatisfaction
senses.definition_en: A spoken or written statement saying that something is wrong, unsatisfactory, or unfair.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat khial, lungkimhuailo ahih kei leh thutanglo cih a kigen ahih kei leh kigelh thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The customer made a complaint about the bill.
examples.zomi: Leipa in sum piak ding lai tawh kisai lungkimlohna thu gen hi.

examples.english: The agency investigated the complaint.
examples.zomi: Agency in lungkimlohna thu sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: The usual expression is make/file a complaint, not do a complaint.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan biasa pen make a complaint ahih kei leh file a complaint ahi a, do a complaint hilo hi.

senses.heading: An illness or physical problem
senses.definition_en: A medical condition, illness, or symptom that causes discomfort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi nuamlo sak zatna dinmun, natna ahih kei leh natna ciamtehna ahi hi.

examples.english: Back pain is a common complaint among office workers.
examples.zomi: Nung natna pen ophis nasemte lakah natna om zel ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor asked about her main complaint.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in a natna bulpi dong hi.

senses.usage_en: This medical use is more common in formal or clinical English. In ordinary conversation, people usually say health problem, symptom, or name the illness.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna khiatna pen thupi English ah kizangzaw hi. Nisim kiholna ah health problem, symptom ahih kei leh natna min kician kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Having every necessary part
senses.definition_en: Containing all the parts or information needed, with nothing missing.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisam khen leh thu khempeuh nei a, kimang himhim omlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please submit a complete application.
examples.zomi: Application kicing pia in.

examples.english: The report contains a complete list of expenses.
examples.zomi: Report sungah sum zatna minza kicing om hi.

senses.usage_en: Complete means that no necessary part is absent. Full often emphasizes quantity, capacity, or degree.
senses.usage_zomi: Complete in a kisam khen khat zong kimanglo cihna ahi hi. Full in zah, dimna ahih kei leh ciangtan thupi sak zel hi.

senses.heading: Finished
senses.definition_en: Finished, with all planned work or activity ended.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelsa nasep ahih kei leh gamtatna khempeuh kizo in a tawp hong tung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The new bridge is now complete.
examples.zomi: Lei thak tu in kizo hi.

examples.english: Construction will be complete by December.
examples.zomi: December ciang dong lamna nasep kizo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: As an adjective, complete describes the finished state. As a verb, complete means to finish something.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective complete in kizo dinmun gen hi. Verb complete in na khat zosak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Total or absolute
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that a quality or situation is total or extreme.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zia ahih kei leh dinmun khat a vekpi leh a sangpen ciangtan pha cih thupi sakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The room fell into complete silence.
examples.zomi: Innkhan dai sitset hi.

examples.english: The plan was a complete failure.
examples.zomi: Geelna pen a vekpi in lawcinglo hi.

senses.usage_en: Before some nouns, complete intensifies the meaning: complete silence, complete surprise, or complete failure.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun pawlkhat ma-ah complete in a khiatna khauhsak hi: complete silence, complete surprise, complete failure.

senses.definition_en: Fully, totally, or in every way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a vekpi in; pumlum in; sitset in
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi in, pumlum in ahih kei leh lampi khempeuh ah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two plans are completely different.
examples.zomi: Geelna nihte a vekpi in kilam hi.

examples.english: I completely agree with your conclusion.
examples.zomi: Na thukhupna a vekpi in ka thukim hi.

senses.usage_en: Completely is a strong degree adverb and usually modifies words that can describe total states, such as different, finished, or destroyed.
senses.usage_zomi: Completely pen ciangtan khauh lakna adverb ahi a, different, finished, destroyed bang a vekpi dinmun gen thei kammalte tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Made of many connected parts or ideas and therefore not simple.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khen, thu ahih kei leh ngaihsutna tampi kizomkhawm ahih manin a baihlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Climate change is a complex global problem.
examples.zomi: Khuahun kikhelna pen leitung huam buaina khen tampi nei ahi hi.

examples.english: The human brain is extremely complex.
examples.zomi: Mihing khuak a kizomna buai mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Complex often describes something with many interacting parts. It does not necessarily mean poorly designed or impossible to understand.
senses.usage_zomi: Complex in khen tampi a kizomkhopna gen zel hi. Tua in kibawllo ahih kei leh teltheihloh cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Difficult to understand, explain, operate, or deal with because many details or problems are involved.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu neu leh buaina tampi kihel ahih manin tel, hilhcian, zang ahih kei leh veng haksa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The application process is too complicated.
examples.zomi: Application sepzia buai mahmah hi.

examples.english: The instructions look complicated at first.
examples.zomi: Kipatcilin thuhilhnate tel haksa bang kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Complex neutrally describes many connected parts. Complicated more often emphasizes that something is difficult or troublesome.
senses.usage_zomi: Complex in khen tampi kizomkhawm cih langnih a omlo in gen hi. Complicated in tel ahih kei leh veng a haksa leh buai cih thupi sakzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: One of the parts that combine to form a larger machine, system, structure, or idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine, system, lamna ahih kei leh ngaihsutna lianzaw khat bawlkhia khen tuamtuamte lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The battery is an essential component of the device.
examples.zomi: Battery pen vanzat a khen kisam mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: The system has several connected components.
examples.zomi: System in khen kizom pawlkhat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A component is a functional part of a larger whole. It may be physical or abstract.
senses.usage_zomi: Component pen na lianzaw khat a nasep nei khen ahi hi. Pumpi tawh muhtheih ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khen hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: An electronic device that stores and processes data according to programmed instructions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Program thuhilhna bangin data khol leh sem electronic vanzat ahi hi.

examples.english: Students use computers to research and write reports.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte thu zong leh report gelh dingin computer zang uh hi.

examples.english: The computer stores thousands of files.
examples.zomi: Computer in file tul tampi khol hi.

senses.usage_en: A desktop, laptop, tablet, and smartphone all perform computer functions, although everyday English may name each device separately.
senses.usage_zomi: Desktop, laptop, tablet leh smartphone in computer nasep sem thei uh napi, nisim English ah vanzat sim a min tuam in kisam zel hi.

senses.heading: To direct attention toward one activity or subject
senses.definition_en: To give full attention to what you are doing, reading, hearing, or thinking about.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na sep, sim, zak ahih kei leh ngaihsut thu tungah lungsim a vekpi koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I cannot concentrate when the room is noisy.
examples.zomi: Innkhan a gam ciangin lungsim ka koih theilo hi.

examples.english: Please concentrate on the instructions.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhnate tungah lungsim koih in.

senses.usage_en: Use concentrate on before the activity or subject receiving attention.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungsim a kipiakna nasep ahih kei leh thu ma-ah concentrate on kizang hi.

senses.heading: To gather people or things in one place
senses.definition_en: To bring people, resources, or activities together in one place or area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, van, sum-leh-pai ahih kei leh gamtatnate mun khat ah kaikhawm cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: van leh sum mun khat ah koihkhawm

examples.english: The company concentrated its resources on one project.
examples.zomi: Company in a van leh sum-leh-pai geelna khat tungah koihkhawm hi.

examples.english: Most services are concentrated in the city.
examples.zomi: Nasep a tamzaw khuapi ah kikaikhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes gathering or focusing a large amount in a limited place or purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah zah tampi mun ahih kei leh ngiimna khat sungah kaikhopna gen hi.

senses.heading: To make a substance stronger by removing water or other material
senses.definition_en: To increase the strength of a substance by removing water or reducing its volume.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui ahih kei leh zat dang lawhkhia in zat khat a thahatna khangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The juice is concentrated by removing water.
examples.zomi: Gah-tui pen tui lawhkhia in thahatsak hi.

examples.english: This cleaning liquid is highly concentrated.
examples.zomi: Hih siansuahna tui a zat thahat mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In science and manufacturing, concentration refers to the amount of a substance present within a mixture.
senses.usage_zomi: Science leh vanbawlna ah concentration in kihelna khat sungah zat khat bangzah om cih gen hi.

senses.heading: Careful attention to one activity or subject
senses.definition_en: The ability or act of directing full attention toward one thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tungah lungsim a vekpi koih theihna ahih kei leh koihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The work requires careful concentration.
examples.zomi: Nasep in kidawm tak a lungsim piakna kisam hi.

examples.english: Noise can break your concentration.
examples.zomi: Ging in na lungsim piakna susia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Concentration is normally uncountable when referring to focused attention.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungsim piakna a khiatna ah concentration pen simtheihloh noun ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: A large amount gathered in one place
senses.definition_en: A large number or amount of people or things located in a particular area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuamun kician khat ah mihing ahih kei leh na-te tampi kikaikhawm in omna ahi hi.

examples.english: The highest concentration of shops is downtown.
examples.zomi: Khuapi laizang ah dawr a tampen kikaikhawm hi.

examples.english: The area has a large concentration of factories.
examples.zomi: Tua gam khenah vanbawlna inn tampi kikaikhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes density or clustering within a place.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mun khat sungah mi ahih kei leh na bangzah tam leh bangci kikaikhawm cih gen hi.

senses.heading: The amount of a substance in a mixture
senses.definition_en: The amount or proportion of a particular substance contained in a mixture or solution.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kihelna ahih kei leh tui sungah zat kician khat bangzah kihel cih ahi hi.

examples.english: The solution contains a high concentration of salt.
examples.zomi: Tui kihelna sungah ci kihel zah sang hi.

examples.english: Scientists measured the concentration of oxygen in the water.
examples.zomi: Science siamate in tui sung oxygen kihel zah teh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A higher concentration means that more of the named substance is present within a given amount of the mixture.
senses.usage_zomi: Concentration sangzaw cih pen kihelna zah kician sungah zat a kigensa tamzaw om cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A general idea or mental understanding of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat tawh kisai a lungsim sungah a kibawl ngaihsutna ahih kei leh telna a kim ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher explained the concept of equality.
examples.zomi: Sangsiah in kikimna ngaihsutna hilhcian hi.

examples.english: Young children may find this concept difficult.
examples.zomi: Naupangnote in hih ngaihsutna tel haksa sa thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A concept is an abstract idea, not usually one particular physical object.
senses.usage_zomi: Concept pen pumpi van khat hilo in, thu khat a kim a ngaihsutna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A feeling of worry
senses.definition_en: A feeling of worry about a person, problem, or possible danger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, buaina ahih kei leh lauhuaina piangthei khat hang a lungkhamna ahi hi.

examples.english: Parents expressed concern about school safety.
examples.zomi: Nulepate in sanginn bitna tawh kisai lungkhamna pulak uh hi.

examples.english: The patient’s high fever is a serious concern.
examples.zomi: Cinate a khuasik sang pen lungkhamna lian ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Concern about/over introduces the subject causing worry.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungkhamna piangsak thu ma-ah concern about/over kizang hi.

senses.heading: An important matter or issue
senses.definition_en: A subject, problem, or responsibility that is important to someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ading thupi ahih kei leh a mawpuakna sungah a kihel thu leh buaina ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: leitung kiim tawh kisai thu thupi

examples.english: Cost is our main concern.
examples.zomi: Man pen ka thu thupi pen uh ahi hi.

examples.english: Road safety is a public concern.
examples.zomi: Lampi bitna pen mipi thu thupi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, concern may be important without causing personal anxiety.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah concern pen thupi napi, mimal lungkhamna piangsak pahpah lo thei hi.

senses.heading: A matter belonging to someone’s responsibility or interest
senses.definition_en: Something that affects, belongs to, or is the responsibility of a particular person or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat suk, a mawpuakna ahih kei leh a vai sungah a kihel thu ahi hi.

examples.english: Employee safety is the manager’s concern.
examples.zomi: Nasemte bitna pen ukpa mawpuakna ahi hi.

examples.english: That private matter is not our concern.
examples.zomi: Tua mimal thu kote tawh kisai lo hi.

senses.usage_en: That is none of your concern is direct and can sound rude. Use it cautiously.
senses.usage_zomi: That is none of your concern pen kammal khauh ahi a, simmawhna bangin a zaktheih manin kidawmtak in kizang ding hi.

senses.heading: Worried
senses.definition_en: Feeling worried about a person, situation, or possible problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, dinmun ahih kei leh buaina piangthei khat hangin lungkham cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am concerned about his health.
examples.zomi: A cidamna tawh kisai ka lungkham hi.

examples.english: Residents became concerned when the water changed color.
examples.zomi: Tui mel a kikhel ciangin khuamite lungkham uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use concerned about before the person or problem causing worry, and concerned that before a clause.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungkhamna piangsak mi ahih kei leh thu ma-ah concerned about, clause ma-ah concerned that kizang hi.

senses.heading: Involved in or affected by something
senses.definition_en: Involved in, responsible for, or affected by a particular matter.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat sungah kihel, mawpuak ahih kei leh tua thu in a suk cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: tua thu in a suk mi khempeuh

examples.english: Everyone concerned was informed of the change.
examples.zomi: Tua thu tawh kisai mi khempeuh kikhelna kitheisak hi.

examples.english: The departments concerned will review the policy.
examples.zomi: A kihel khen-te in thukhun sittel ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When concerned follows a noun, it often means “involved or affected”: the people concerned. Before a noun, concerned people more often means worried people.
senses.usage_zomi: Concerned pen noun nungah om leh “kihel ahih kei leh a suk” cihna nei zel hi: the people concerned. Noun ma-ah concerned people cih leh mi lungkhamte cihna neizaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A public performance of music by singers or musicians.
senses.explanation_zomi: La-sakte ahih kei leh tumging tumte in mipite ma-ah la leh tumging a lahna ahi hi.

examples.english: We attended a concert on Saturday night.
examples.zomi: Saturday zanin concert ah kihel ung.

examples.english: The singer performed three new songs at the concert.
examples.zomi: La-sakpa in concert ah la thak thum sa hi.

senses.usage_en: A concert focuses mainly on a musical performance. An event containing acting, speeches, and other entertainment may be called a show or performance.
senses.usage_zomi: Concert in la leh tumging lahna thupi sak hi. Zatna, thugenna leh lungnopna dangte kihel leh show ahih kei leh performance kici thei hi.

senses.heading: To decide something after considering the evidence
senses.definition_en: To form a final opinion or judgment after examining information or evidence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu leh tecite sittel leh ngaihsun khit ciangin ngaihsutna ahih kei leh thukhenna nunung bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The researchers concluded that the treatment was effective.
examples.zomi: Zongkhiate in cidamna in phattuamna nei hi ci in thukhup uh hi.

examples.english: We cannot conclude from one example alone.
examples.zomi: Gentehna khat bek pan thukhup theilo hang.

senses.usage_en: Use conclude that before a complete statement and conclude from before the evidence.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kicing ma-ah conclude that kizang a, teci ahih kei leh thukhual ma-ah conclude from kizang hi.

senses.heading: To end something
senses.definition_en: To bring an activity, speech, meeting, or agreement to an end.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, thugenna, kimuhkhopna ahih kei leh thukimna khat tawpsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The chair concluded the meeting at noon.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in sun laitak in kimuhkhopna tawpsak hi.

examples.english: The speaker concluded with a short prayer.
examples.zomi: Thugenpa in thungetna tomno tawh a thugenna tawpsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This is more formal than finish or end.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan pen finish ahih kei leh end sangin thupizaw hi.

senses.heading: A final opinion or judgment
senses.definition_en: An opinion or judgment reached after considering information, evidence, or arguments.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, teci leh nialna ngaihsun khit ciang a kingah ngaihsutna ahih kei leh thukhenna nunung ahi hi.

examples.english: The evidence supports the conclusion.
examples.zomi: Tecite in thukhupna kipsak hi.

examples.english: Do not reach a conclusion before hearing both sides.
examples.zomi: Lang nihgel thu na zakma in thukhup kei in.

senses.usage_en: The usual expression is reach/come to a conclusion, not make a conclusion.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatdan biasa pen reach a conclusion ahih kei leh come to a conclusion ahi a, make a conclusion hilo hi.

senses.heading: The final part or ending
senses.definition_en: The final part of a speech, piece of writing, event, or process.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thugenna, laigelhna, thupiang ahih kei leh sepzia khat a khen nunung leh a tawpna ahi hi.

examples.english: Summarize your main argument in the conclusion.
examples.zomi: Thukhupna sungah na nialna bulpi tomlak in.

examples.english: They shook hands at the conclusion of the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kimuhkhopna a tawp ciangin khut kilet uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In formal writing, the conclusion summarizes or completes the main discussion rather than introducing an unrelated major idea.
senses.usage_zomi: Thupi laigelhna ah thukhupna in kiholimna bulpi tomlak leh zousak a, thu bulpi thak leh kizomlo pulak lo hi.

senses.heading: The physical state of someone or something
senses.definition_en: The state that a person or thing is in, especially regarding health, quality, or repair.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a cidamna, quality, siat leh hoihna tawh kisai a omzia ahi hi.

examples.english: The car is still in good condition.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw dinmun hoih lai hi.

examples.english: The patient’s condition improved overnight.
examples.zomi: Zan sungin cinate dinmun hoihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: A medical condition may be an illness, disorder, injury, or another health state.
senses.usage_zomi: Medical condition pen natna, pumpi nasep buaina, liamna ahih kei leh cidamna dinmun dang hithei hi.

senses.heading: A requirement that must be satisfied
senses.definition_en: A rule or requirement that must be met before something can happen or be accepted.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat piang ahih kei leh kisang theihma a kizuih leh tangtun ding thukhun ahi hi.

examples.english: They accepted the offer under one condition.
examples.zomi: Thu utna thukhun khat tawh sang uh hi.

examples.english: Applicants must meet all the conditions.
examples.zomi: Application a bawlte thukhun khempeuh tangtun ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A condition may limit an agreement or state what must happen for it to take effect.
senses.usage_zomi: Condition in thukimna ciangtan thei a, thukimna hong kipat theihna ding a piang ding zong lak thei hi.

senses.heading: The circumstances in which people live or work
senses.definition_en: The environment or circumstances affecting how people live, work, or perform an activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte nuntak, nasem ahih kei leh gamta dan a suk a kiim leh dinmunte ahi hi.

examples.english: Workers demanded safer working conditions.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in nasepna dinmun bitzaw ngen uh hi.

examples.english: Road conditions became dangerous after the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi khit ciangin lampi dinmun lauhuai hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is frequently plural: living conditions, working conditions, and weather conditions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen living conditions, working conditions, weather conditions ci in plural tawh kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: To organize and carry out an activity
senses.definition_en: To plan, organize, and perform an investigation, experiment, survey, or other activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sittelna, zongkhiatna, dotna ahih kei leh nasep khat geel, makaih leh sem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The university conducted a public survey.
examples.zomi: University in mipi dotna khat nei hi.

examples.english: Scientists conducted several experiments.
examples.zomi: Science siamate in sittelna pawlkhat sem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Conduct is formal and commonly used with research, investigations, surveys, interviews, and experiments.
senses.usage_zomi: Conduct pen thupi zatdan ahi a, research, investigation, survey, interview leh experiment tawh kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: To lead or direct people or a performance
senses.definition_en: To lead, guide, or direct an orchestra, ceremony, tour, or group activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tumging pawl, pawi, khualzinna ahih kei leh mihon gamtatna khat makaih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She conducted the orchestra during the concert.
examples.zomi: Concert sungah tumging pawl makaih hi.

examples.english: The pastor conducted the wedding ceremony.
examples.zomi: Pastor in kiteenna pawi makaih hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun conduct, meaning behavior, is pronounced /ˈkɑːndʌkt/. The verb is pronounced /kənˈdʌkt/.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna cihna noun conduct pen /ˈkɑːndʌkt/ ci in kisa hi. Verb pen /kənˈdʌkt/ ci in kisa hi.

senses.heading: To allow heat or electricity to pass through
senses.definition_en: To carry heat, electricity, or another form of energy through a material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat sungpan khuasak, meima ahih kei leh energy nam dang kantan paisak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Copper conducts electricity well.
examples.zomi: Tau in meima hoih takin paisak hi.

examples.english: Metal conducts heat faster than wood.
examples.zomi: Metal in sing sangin khuasak manlangzaw in paisak hi.

senses.usage_en: Materials that conduct electricity or heat easily are called conductors.
senses.usage_zomi: Meima ahih kei leh khuasak baih takin a paisak vant e conductors kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A formal meeting where many people discuss a subject, share research, or coordinate work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tampi in thu khat kiholim, zongkhiatna hawmsawn ahih kei leh nasep kituaksak ding a nei kimuhkhopna thupi ahi hi.

examples.english: She presented her research at an international conference.
examples.zomi: Leitung huam conference ah a zongkhiatna pulak hi.

examples.english: The conference brought together health professionals from many countries.
examples.zomi: Conference in gam tampi pan zatna siamate kaikhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: A conference is usually larger and more formal than an ordinary meeting and may last for several sessions or days.
senses.usage_zomi: Conference pen kimuhkhopna biasa sangin lianzaw leh thupizaw a, session tampi ahih kei leh ni pawlkhat sawt thei hi.

senses.heading: Belief in your own ability
senses.definition_en: A feeling of trust in your own ability, judgment, or qualities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nangma siamna, thukhen theihna ahih kei leh zia tungah kimuanna nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Practice helped her gain confidence.
examples.zomi: Zonsimna in kimuanna ngah ding amah panpih hi.

examples.english: He answered the questions with confidence.
examples.zomi: Dotnate kimuanna tawh dawng hi.

senses.usage_en: Confidence is normally uncountable when it means self-belief.
senses.usage_zomi: Kipum muanna a khiatna ah confidence simtheihloh noun ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Trust in someone or something
senses.definition_en: A strong belief that someone or something is reliable, capable, or likely to succeed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat muanhuai, semzo ahih kei leh lawcing ding ci a upna ahi hi.

examples.english: The board has confidence in the new director.
examples.zomi: Board in director thak tungah muanna nei hi.

examples.english: The mistake reduced public confidence in the system.
examples.zomi: Khialhna in system tung a mipi muanna khiamsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use confidence in before the person, organization, plan, or ability that is trusted.
senses.usage_zomi: A kimuan mi, pawl, geelna ahih kei leh siamna ma-ah confidence in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Private or secret communication
senses.definition_en: A situation in which private information is shared with the expectation that it will not be repeated.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mimal thu midang kiangah gen nawnlo ding cih kimuanna tawh a kihawmna dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: She told me the news in confidence.
examples.zomi: Thuthak kei hong hilh a, midang kiangah genlo dingin hong muang hi.

examples.english: Information shared in confidence must remain private.
examples.zomi: Thuthuk in a kihawm thu mimal thu in kikem ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In confidence means privately and with an expectation of secrecy.
senses.usage_zomi: In confidence in mimal takin leh thuthuk kikem ding lametna tawh cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Sure of your own ability
senses.definition_en: Feeling sure about your ability, judgment, or likelihood of success.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nangma siamna, thukhenna ahih kei leh lawcin ding tungah lungmuang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She feels confident about the interview.
examples.zomi: Nasep dotna tawh kisai lungmuang hi.

examples.english: He gave a confident answer.
examples.zomi: Kimuang takin dawnna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use confident about before a situation or result and confident in before an ability or person.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun ahih kei leh dawnna ma-ah confident about kizang a, siamna ahih kei leh mi ma-ah confident in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Certain that something is true or will happen
senses.definition_en: Having a strong belief that something is true or will happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat thumaan ahih kei leh piang ding cih lungmuang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We are confident that the plan will work.
examples.zomi: Geelna lawcing ding ci in ka lungmuang uh hi.

examples.english: The doctor is confident of a full recovery.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in a vekpi in damkik ding ci in lungmuang hi.

senses.usage_en: Confident expresses strong belief but does not always mean absolute certainty.
senses.usage_zomi: Confident in upna khauh lak napi, za khat a za in kician cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: To establish that something is true or correct
senses.definition_en: To provide evidence or information showing that something is true, correct, or certain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat thumaan, man ahih kei leh kician cih lak dingin teci leh thu pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Tests confirmed that the water was safe.
examples.zomi: Sittelna in tui bit hi cih kipsak hi.

examples.english: The police confirmed the identity of the victim.
examples.zomi: Police in a thuak mi a min leh hihna kiciansak hi.

senses.usage_en: Confirm requires stronger evidence than simply believing or expecting something.
senses.usage_zomi: Confirm in thu khat up ahih kei leh lam-et lel sangin teci khauhzaw kisam hi.

senses.heading: To state that an arrangement will happen
senses.definition_en: To state or communicate that an appointment, booking, order, or plan is definite.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimuh hun, mun kholhna, vanthuk ahih kei leh geelna piang taktak ding cih kiciansak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please confirm your appointment by email.
examples.zomi: Na kimuh hun email tawh kiciansak in.

examples.english: The hotel confirmed our reservation.
examples.zomi: Hotel in ka mun kholhna uh kiciansak hi.

senses.usage_en: A confirmation may be spoken or written and shows that an arrangement is now definite.
senses.usage_zomi: Confirmation pen kam tawh ahih kei leh lai tawh hithei a, geelna tu in kician cih lak hi.

senses.heading: Serious disagreement or struggle
senses.definition_en: A serious disagreement, argument, or struggle between people, groups, or countries.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, pawl ahih kei leh gamte kikal thukimlohna, kinialna ahih kei leh kidohna nasia ahi hi.

examples.english: The two groups resolved their conflict peacefully.
examples.zomi: Pawl nihte in a kibuaina uh kilem takin veng uh hi.

examples.english: Many families fled the armed conflict.
examples.zomi: Innkuan tampi galvan nei kidona pan taisan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Conflict ranges from serious disagreement to armed warfare; context shows the level of severity.
senses.usage_zomi: Conflict in thukimlohna nasia pan galvan nei kidona dong huam thei a, thu omdan in a nasat zah lak hi.

senses.heading: A situation in which needs, duties, or interests oppose each other
senses.definition_en: A situation in which two duties, interests, plans, or ideas cannot easily exist or be satisfied together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawpuakna, lunglutna, geelna ahih kei leh ngaihsutna nih khat leh khat kituaklo in tangtun khawm haksa dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: I have a schedule conflict that afternoon.
examples.zomi: Tua nitaklamin ka hun kigeelna nih kituaklo hi.

examples.english: The official disclosed a possible conflict of interest.
examples.zomi: Ukna nasem in mimal hamphatna leh mawpuakna kilehkalh theihna pulak hi.

senses.usage_en: A conflict of interest occurs when personal interests may improperly influence an official or professional duty.
senses.usage_zomi: Conflict of interest pen mimal hamphatna in ukna ahih kei leh siamna nasep mawpuakna man tak a sepna a suk theih ciangin piang hi.

senses.heading: To make someone unable to understand clearly
senses.definition_en: To make someone uncertain or unable to understand something clearly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungbuai sak a, thu khat kician takin teltheilo sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The unclear instructions confused everyone.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna kicianlo in mi khempeuh telbuai sak hi.

examples.english: Too many details may confuse beginners.
examples.zomi: Thu neu tampi in sin kipan mite lungbuai sak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: The person or thing causing uncertainty confuses someone. The affected person is confused.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungbuaina a piangsak mi ahih kei leh na in midang confuses hi. Tua a thuak mi pen confused ahi hi.

senses.heading: To mistake one person or thing for another
senses.definition_en: To wrongly think that one person or thing is another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat midang ahih kei leh na dang khat hi ci in theihkhial cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: People often confuse the two brothers.
examples.zomi: Mihingte in sanggampa nihte theihkhial zel uh hi.

examples.english: Do not confuse price with value.
examples.zomi: Man leh manphatna theihkhial kei in.

senses.usage_en: Use confuse A with B, not normally confuse A to B.
senses.usage_zomi: Confuse A with B ci ding a, a tamzaw in confuse A to B ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Unable to understand clearly or uncertain about what to think or do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat kician takin teltheilo ahih kei leh bang ngaihsun leh bang sem ding cih theilo in lungbuai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am confused about the new instructions.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna thak tawh kisai ka telbuai hi.

examples.english: The child looked confused and frightened.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen lungbuai leh lau bang kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Confused describes how someone feels. Confusing describes what causes that feeling.
senses.usage_zomi: Confused in mi khat a lungsim dinmun gen hi. Confusing in tua lungsim a piangsak thu ahih kei leh na gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Difficult to understand and likely to make someone uncertain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tel haksa a, mi khat lungbuai ahih kei leh theihkhial sakthei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The application form is confusing.
examples.zomi: Application form tel haksa hi.

examples.english: The similar names are confusing for new students.
examples.zomi: Min a kibangte in sangnaupang thakte lungbuai sak hi.

senses.usage_en: A situation or explanation is confusing; the person who cannot understand it is confused.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun ahih kei leh hilhna tel haksa pen confusing ahi a, a teltheilo mi pen confused ahi hi.

senses.heading: To join two or more things
senses.definition_en: To join two or more people, places, objects, or systems so that they are linked.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun, van ahih kei leh system nih leh a tamzaw khat leh khat kizomsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This bridge connects the two villages.
examples.zomi: Hih lei in khua nih kizomsak hi.

examples.english: Connect the printer to the computer.
examples.zomi: Printer pen computer tawh zom in.

senses.usage_en: Use connect A to/with B. For networks and services, connect to is especially common.
senses.usage_zomi: Connect A to/with B ci in kizang hi. Network leh nasepna tawh kizopna ah connect to kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: To establish a relationship or communicate successfully
senses.definition_en: To form a social or emotional relationship, or to communicate in a way that creates understanding.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte tawh kizopna bawl ahih kei leh kitelna piangsak dingin hoih takin kihopih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher connects well with young students.
examples.zomi: Sangsiah pen sangnaupangnote tawh kizop siam hi.

examples.english: Her story connected with the audience.
examples.zomi: A tangthu in ngaite lungsim suk hi.

senses.usage_en: Connect with often describes a successful personal or emotional relationship.
senses.usage_zomi: Connect with in mimal ahih kei leh lungsim kizopna lawcing gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Joined or linked
senses.definition_en: Joined physically, electronically, logically, or through a system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi, electronic, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh system tungtawnin khat leh khat kizom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: All the computers are connected to one network.
examples.zomi: Computer khempeuh network khat tawh kizom hi.

examples.english: The two buildings are connected by a hallway.
examples.zomi: Innpi nihte kalsuanna innkhan tawh kizom hi.

senses.usage_en: Use connected to for a direct link and connected with for a broader relationship or association.
senses.usage_zomi: Zopna kician ma-ah connected to kizang a, kizopna a za deuh ma-ah connected with kizang hi.

senses.heading: Having a relationship or association
senses.definition_en: Related to, involved with, or associated with a person, group, event, or idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, thupiang ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat tawh kizopna nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two problems are closely connected.
examples.zomi: Buaina nihte nai takin kizom hi.

examples.english: Police questioned everyone connected with the case.
examples.zomi: Police in mawhna thu tawh kizom mi khempeuh dong hi.

senses.usage_en: Well-connected describes someone who knows influential or useful people.
senses.usage_zomi: Well-connected in ukzawhna nei ahih kei leh huh thei mi tampi thei mi gen hi.

senses.heading: A physical, electronic, or logical link
senses.definition_en: A link joining two or more people, places, objects, or systems.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun, van ahih kei leh system nih leh a tamzaw khat leh khat a kizopna ahi hi.

examples.english: The internet connection is slow today.
examples.zomi: Tuni in internet kizopna man lo hi.

examples.english: Check the connection between the cable and the computer.
examples.zomi: Thirgui leh computer kikal kizopna sittel in.

senses.usage_en: A connection may be physical, electronic, logical, or social.
senses.usage_zomi: Kizopna pen pumpi, electronic, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh mihing kizopna hithei hi.

senses.heading: A relationship between people or things
senses.definition_en: A relationship or association between people, events, ideas, or facts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, thupiang, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh thu-te kikal kizopna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a pianna hang leh a gah kikal kizopna

examples.english: Researchers found a connection between sleep and health.
examples.zomi: Zongkhiate in ihmutna leh cidamna kikal kizopna mu uh hi.

examples.english: They have a strong family connection.
examples.zomi: Innkuan kizopna khauh nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use connection between A and B when identifying two linked subjects.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu nih kizom cih lak dingin connection between A and B kizang hi.

senses.heading: A transport service that continues a journey
senses.definition_en: A bus, train, or flight used after another service to continue a journey.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzinna khat pan a paisuak khit ciangin khualzinna zom ding a kituan bus, meileng ahih kei leh vanleng ahi hi.

examples.english: We missed our connection in Chicago.
examples.zomi: Chicago ah ka khualzinna zomna uh manlo ung.

examples.english: She has a two-hour wait for her next connection.
examples.zomi: A khualzinna zomna naung ding nai nih ngak ding hi.
