senses.usage_en: A connection is not the entire journey; it is the next service linking one part of the journey to another.
senses.usage_zomi: Connection pen khualzinna a vekpi hilo a, khual khen khat leh khual khen dang a kizomsakna mawtaw ahi hi.

senses.heading: An influential person you know
senses.definition_en: A person you know who may provide information, influence, or an opportunity.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kizopna nei mi; huh thei theihmi
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, ukzawhna ahih kei leh hamphatna pia thei na theih mi ahi hi.

examples.english: He found the job through a personal connection.
examples.zomi: A theih mi khat tungtawnin nasep ngah hi.

examples.english: She has strong connections in the business community.
examples.zomi: Sumdawn mite lakah kizopna khauh nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This use may be neutral, but it can suggest unfair influence if connections replace a fair process.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan langnih a omlo hithei napi, thutang sepzia laanta in kizopna a kizang leh thutanglohna cihna neithei hi.

senses.heading: Awake and able to know what is happening
senses.definition_en: Awake and able to see, hear, think, and respond to the surroundings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muttomlo ahih kei leh lung manglo in, a kiimah bang piang cih thei leh dawn thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The patient was conscious and able to speak.
examples.zomi: Cinate lungdam a, pau thei hi.

examples.english: He remained conscious after the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident khit zong lungmanglo in om hi.

senses.usage_en: The opposite is unconscious. In medical emergencies, consciousness means awareness and the ability to respond.
senses.usage_zomi: A langkhat pen unconscious ahi hi. Zatna thupiang baihloh ah consciousness in a kiim theih leh dawn theihna cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Aware of something
senses.definition_en: Knowing that something exists or is happening.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat om ahih kei leh piang cih thei leh phawk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She was conscious of the risks.
examples.zomi: La huainate phawk hi.

examples.english: Consumers are becoming more environmentally conscious.
examples.zomi: Leite leitung kiim khohsakzaw hong suak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use conscious of before the fact, feeling, or condition being noticed.
senses.usage_zomi: A kithei ahih kei leh a kiphawk thu ma-ah conscious of kizang hi.

senses.heading: Deliberate and intentional
senses.definition_en: Done intentionally after thought rather than by accident or habit.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsun khit a sem; deihna tawh sem
senses.explanation_zomi: Tawmkhatthu ahih kei leh ngeina hang hilo in, ngaihsun khit a kisem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She made a conscious decision to spend less.
examples.zomi: Sum tawmzaw zang dingin ngaihsun khit a thukhenna bawl hi.

examples.english: Changing a habit requires conscious effort.
examples.zomi: Ngeina khat kikhelna in deihna tawh hanciamna kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: A conscious action is intentional and noticed by the person doing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Conscious gamtatna pen deihna tawh kisem a, a sem mi in zong phawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A result or effect caused by an action, decision, or situation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a gah; a dawnna; a zom
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, thukhenna ahih kei leh dinmun khat in a piangsak dawnna ahih kei leh gah ahi hi.

examples.english: The decision may have serious consequences.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna in a gah nasia piangsak thei hi.

examples.english: Every action has consequences.
examples.zomi: Gamtatna sim in a gah nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A consequence may be positive or negative, but the word often suggests an undesirable result.
senses.usage_zomi: Consequence pen a gah hoih ahih kei leh hoihlo hithei napi, a tamzaw in a gah hoihlo genna bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: Preferring gradual change and traditional practices
senses.definition_en: Favoring established traditions and cautious, gradual change rather than rapid or major change.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngeina kem nuam; kikhelna ah kidawm
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina leh zatdan lui a kem nuam a, kikhelna manlang leh lian sangin kidawm leh tawm tawm a kikhelna deih cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mipi ngeina ah lui kem nuam

examples.english: The organization takes a conservative approach to change.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi in kikhelna tawh kisai zatdan kidawm zang hi.

examples.english: Her family holds conservative social values.
examples.zomi: A innkuan in mipi ngeina lui kem thukhunte nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Conservative may describe social attitudes, religious practice, culture, business decisions, or personal behavior without necessarily identifying a political party.
senses.usage_zomi: Conservative in mipi ngaihsutna, biakna, ngeina, sumdawnna thukhenna ahih kei leh mimal gamtatna gen thei a, gamvai pawl khat member cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: Relating to conservative politics
senses.definition_en: Supporting political ideas that generally emphasize tradition, limited or cautious change, private institutions, or established social order.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina, kikhelna ciangtan, mimal leh pawl neihsa ahih kei leh mipi omzia saiksa kemna thupi sak gamvai ngaihsutna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The conservative party proposed a different tax policy.
examples.zomi: Conservative gamvai pawl in sia thukhun tuam khat hong ut hi.

examples.english: He is conservative on several political issues.
examples.zomi: Gamvai thu pawlkhat ah conservative ngaihsutna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning of political conservative differs across countries, parties, historical periods, and policy issues.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamvai conservative a khiatna pen gam, gamvai pawl, tangthu hun leh thukhun ciangin kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Cautious and lower than the possible maximum
senses.definition_en: Carefully limited to avoid risk, error, or overstatement.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kidawm; niam deuh in sim; ciangtan
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina, khialhna ahih kei leh genluatna pelh dingin kidawm tak a kiciangtan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The report gives a conservative estimate of the cost.
examples.zomi: Report in man kidawm tak a simna pia hi.

examples.english: She prefers a conservative investment strategy.
examples.zomi: Lauhuaina niam sum-koihna geelna deihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: A conservative estimate avoids exaggeration and is often intentionally cautious.
senses.usage_zomi: Conservative simna in genluatna pelh a, deihna tawh kidawm takin kisin hi.

senses.heading: To think carefully about something
senses.definition_en: To think about a fact, problem, choice, or plan carefully before deciding.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, buaina, teelna ahih kei leh geelna khat thukhenma in kidawmtak in ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We are considering several possible solutions.
examples.zomi: Buaina vengna piangthei pawlkhat ngaihsun ung.

examples.english: She is considering applying for the position.
examples.zomi: Tua dinmun ading application bawl ding ngaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: Use consider doing, not normally consider to do: consider moving, not consider to move.
senses.usage_zomi: Consider doing ci ding a, a tamzaw in consider to do ci lo ding hi: consider moving, consider to move hilo hi.

senses.heading: To regard someone or something in a particular way
senses.definition_en: To have a particular opinion about someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat zia ahih kei leh dinmun tuam khat nei hi ci in ngai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Many people consider the book a classic.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi in laibu pen laibu manpha ngeisa in ngai uh hi.

examples.english: She is considered an expert in the field.
examples.zomi: Tua sinna lamah siampa in kingai hi.

senses.usage_en: Use consider someone/something + noun or adjective: consider him a leader; consider the plan risky.
senses.usage_zomi: Consider someone/something + noun or adjective ci in kizang hi: consider him a leader; consider the plan risky.

senses.heading: To take someone’s needs or feelings into account
senses.definition_en: To think about another person’s needs, wishes, rights, or feelings when deciding or acting.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhen ahih kei leh gamta ciangin midang kisapna, deihna, dikna leh lungsim dinmun ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please consider how the decision will affect employees.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna in nasemte bangci suk ding cih ngaihsun in.

examples.english: A good policy considers the needs of vulnerable people.
examples.zomi: Thukhun hoih in thanem mite kisapna ngaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, considerate describes a person who regularly thinks about other people’s needs and feelings.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pan considerate in midangte kisapna leh lungsim dinmun a khohsak zel mi gen hi.

senses.heading: Careful thought
senses.definition_en: Careful thought given to a fact, choice, plan, or problem before making a decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhenma in thu, teelna, geelna ahih kei leh buaina khat kidawmtak a ngaihsutna ahi hi.

examples.english: The proposal is still under consideration.
examples.zomi: Thu utna ngaihsut laitak ahi hi.

examples.english: After careful consideration, we accepted the offer.
examples.zomi: Kidawm tak a ngaihsut khit ciangin thu utna sang ung.

senses.usage_en: Under consideration means being examined or thought about but not yet decided.
senses.usage_zomi: Under consideration in thu khat sittel leh ngaihsut laitak a, thukhen nailo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A fact or issue that must be considered
senses.definition_en: A fact, need, or issue that should influence a decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhenna a suk ding ngaihsut kul thu, kisapna ahih kei leh buaina ahi hi.

examples.english: Cost is an important consideration.
examples.zomi: Man pen ngaihsut ding thu thupi ahi hi.

examples.english: Safety was the main consideration in the design.
examples.zomi: Kibatna a kibawl ciangin bitna ngaihsut ding thu bulpi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a consideration is one factor among the matters influencing a decision.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah consideration pen thukhenna a suk thu-te lakah khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Care for another person’s needs or feelings
senses.definition_en: Thoughtfulness and respect shown toward another person’s needs, rights, or feelings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang kisapna, dikna leh lungsim dinmun a kilangsak khohsakna leh zahtakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please show consideration for other passengers.
examples.zomi: Khualzin dangte khohsakna lak in.

examples.english: He lowered his voice out of consideration for the sleeping baby.
examples.zomi: Naungeek a ih manin khohsakna tawh a aw niam sak hi.

senses.usage_en: The expression out of consideration for explains that an action is done to respect or protect someone else.
senses.usage_zomi: Out of consideration for in midang zahtak ahih kei leh kem ding a na khat kisem cih hilh hi.

senses.definition_en: To be formed or made from particular people, parts, or materials.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, khen ahih kei leh van kician pawlkhat tawh a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee consists of twelve members.
examples.zomi: Committee pen member sawmlehnih tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: The meal consists mainly of rice and vegetables.
examples.zomi: An pen a tamzaw in an leh anhang tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use consist of, not consist from. Because consist already describes composition, it is not normally used in the passive.
senses.usage_zomi: Consist of ci ding a, consist from ci lo ding hi. Consist in kibawlna mah a gen khit manin, passive form in kizang khollo hi.

senses.heading: Continuing at the same standard or behaving in the same way
senses.definition_en: Remaining regular, reliable, or similar over time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tawh a quality, gamtatdan ahih kei leh dawnna kikhel lua loin, kibang leh muanhuai in om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her work is consistently accurate and reliable.
examples.zomi: A nasep man leh muanhuai tawntung hi.

examples.english: Regular practice leads to more consistent performance.
examples.zomi: Zonsim tawntungna in nasepna kibang leh muanhuai zaw piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Consistent does not necessarily mean perfect; it means that the standard or behavior does not vary greatly.
senses.usage_zomi: Consistent in kicing sitset cihna pahpah hilo a, standard ahih kei leh gamtatdan kikhel lua lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Agreeing with or not contradicting something
senses.definition_en: Matching or agreeing with another fact, statement, rule, or result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, thugen, thukhun ahih kei leh dawnna dang tawh kituak a, kilehkalh lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The findings are consistent with earlier research.
examples.zomi: A kimuhkhiatnate zongkhiatna masa tawh kituak hi.

examples.english: Your explanation is not consistent with the evidence.
examples.zomi: Na hilhcian na teci tawh kituak lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use consistent with, not normally consistent to, when showing agreement.
senses.usage_zomi: Kituakna lak dingin consistent with ci a, a tamzaw in consistent to ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Continuing without stopping
senses.definition_en: Happening or existing continuously or very frequently.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khawl loin kizom ahih kei leh vei tampi mahmah piang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The constant noise made it difficult to concentrate.
examples.zomi: Ging tawntung in lungsim koih ding haksasak hi.

examples.english: She has been in constant pain since the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident pan kipan natna khawllo nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Constant may mean literally without stopping or, more loosely, happening extremely often.
senses.usage_zomi: Constant in khawl himhim lo cihna hithei a, zatdan tawm zai deuh ah vei tampi mahmah piang cihna zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: Remaining unchanged
senses.definition_en: Staying the same and not changing over time or across conditions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ahih kei leh dinmun a kikhel zong, kibang in om a kikhello cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Keep the temperature constant during the experiment.
examples.zomi: Sittelna sungah khuasak kibang in koih in.

examples.english: The car traveled at a constant speed.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw speed kibang tawntung tawh pai hi.

senses.usage_en: Constant emphasizes no change. Consistent usually means regular or reliably similar, allowing small variations.
senses.usage_zomi: Constant in kikhel himhim lo cih thupi sak hi. Consistent in a tamzaw in zatdan kibang leh muanhuai cihna ahi a, kikhelna neu om thei hi.

senses.heading: Continuously without stopping
senses.definition_en: Continuously over a period of time without interruption.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat sung khawl loin tawntung in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The machine runs constantly throughout the day.
examples.zomi: Machine sun ni vekpi tai tawntung hi.

examples.english: The patient needs to be constantly monitored.
examples.zomi: Cinate khawllo in kilet ding kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Constantly may mean literally without stopping, but it is also used less exactly to mean “very frequently.”
senses.usage_zomi: Constantly in khawl himhim lo cihna hithei a, a kicianlo deuh zatdan ah vei tampi mahmah cihna zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: Very frequently
senses.definition_en: Happening again and again, very often.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khatvei khit khatvei, vei tampi mahmah piang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He constantly checks his phone.
examples.zomi: A phone en kinken hi.

examples.english: The students were constantly interrupted by noise.
examples.zomi: Ging in sangnaupangte nawngkaih kinken hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, short breaks may occur; the speaker means that the action happens unusually often.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah khawl tawm omthei napi, gamtatna pen biasa sangin vei tampi mahmah piang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To build something from separate parts or materials
senses.definition_en: To build a structure, machine, or object by joining materials or parts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van leh a lang tuamtuam kizomsakin inn, machine ahih kei leh na khat bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Workers are constructing a new bridge.
examples.zomi: Nasemte lei thak khat lam uh hi.

examples.english: The shelter was constructed from wood and metal.
examples.zomi: Bukna pen sing leh metal tawh kilam hi.

senses.usage_en: Construct is more formal than build and often emphasizes the planned joining of parts.
senses.usage_zomi: Construct pen build sangin thupizaw a, khen tuamtuam geelkholna tawh a kizomsakna thupi sak hi.

senses.heading: To create an idea, argument, system, or sentence
senses.definition_en: To create something abstract by arranging ideas or information in an organized way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna leh thu-te geelkholna tawh a kigeel in koihkhawm a, nialna, system ahih kei leh sentence khat bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Students learned how to construct a clear argument.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte nialna thu kician bangci bawl ding cih sin uh hi.

examples.english: Use these words to construct a sentence.
examples.zomi: Hih kammalte zangin sentence khat phuah in.

senses.usage_en: This sense applies to organized mental or linguistic creations, not only physical structures.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen pumpi tawh muhtheih lamna bek hilo in, ngaihsutna leh pau tawh a kibawl na-te ah zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: The process of building
senses.definition_en: The work or process of building houses, roads, bridges, or other structures.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn, lampi, lei ahih kei leh lamna dangte bawl leh lamna nasep leh sepzia ahi hi.

examples.english: The new hospital is under construction.
examples.zomi: Zato thak lam laitak ahi hi.

examples.english: Construction work will begin next month.
examples.zomi: Kha naungin lamna nasep kipan ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Under construction means currently being built. It can also figuratively describe something still being developed.
senses.usage_zomi: Under construction in tu in lam laitak cihna ahi hi. Gentehna in khangto ahih kei leh bawlphat laitak na genna zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: A building or structure and the way it is made
senses.definition_en: A structure or the method and quality used to build it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lamna khat ahih kei leh tua na bangci leh bang quality tawh kilam cih ahi hi.

examples.english: The bridge is of strong steel construction.
examples.zomi: Lei pen sik khauh tawh kilam hi.

examples.english: The old house has a simple wooden construction.
examples.zomi: Inn lui sing tawh baih takin kilam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, construction refers to the completed structure or its method of assembly.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah construction in lamkhitsa na ahih kei leh a kilam zatdan gen hi.

senses.heading: The grammatical arrangement of words
senses.definition_en: A particular way of arranging words to form a phrase or sentence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phrase ahih kei leh sentence khat bawl ding a kammalte kigeel in a kikoihzia ahi hi.

examples.english: This sentence has an unusual construction.
examples.zomi: Hih sentence a kibawlzia biasa lo hi.

examples.english: Students practiced different grammatical constructions.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte grammar kibawlzia tuamtuam zonsim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In grammar, a construction is a recognized pattern of words and grammatical relationships.
senses.usage_zomi: Grammar ah construction pen kammal leh grammar kizopna a ciamtehsa bang a kigeelna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To eat or drink something
senses.definition_en: To eat or drink food, liquid, or another substance.
senses.explanation_zomi: An, dawnna ahih kei leh zat khat ne ahih kei leh dawn cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The product should be consumed within three days.
examples.zomi: Hih van ni thum sungin nek ding hi.

examples.english: Children should not consume too much sugar.
examples.zomi: Naupangte khum tampi ne lo ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Consume is more formal than eat or drink and is common in health, scientific, and official writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Consume pen eat leh drink sangin thupizaw a, cidamna, science leh ukna laigelhna ah kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: To use resources, energy, time, or goods
senses.definition_en: To use electricity, fuel, time, money, goods, or other resources.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meima, meihol, hun, sum, van ahih kei leh neihsa dangte zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Large buildings consume a great deal of energy.
examples.zomi: Innpi liante energy tampi zang hi.

examples.english: The process consumes too much time and money.
examples.zomi: Sepzia in hun leh sum tampi zang hi.

senses.usage_en: When resources are consumed, they are used partly or completely and may no longer be available.
senses.usage_zomi: Neihsate a kizat ciangin tawm ahih kei leh a vekpi beithei a, zatkik theih nawnlo thei hi.

senses.heading: To completely occupy someone’s attention or feelings
senses.definition_en: To fill someone’s thoughts or emotions so strongly that little attention remains for anything else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a ngaihsutna ahih kei leh lungsim a vekpi tuam a, thu dang ngaihsut theilo dingin suk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He was consumed by worry about his family.
examples.zomi: A innkuan tawh kisai lungkhamna in a lungsim tuam hi.

examples.english: The project consumed all her attention.
examples.zomi: Geelna in a ngaihsutna a vekpi la hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense is usually passive: consumed by or consumed with an emotion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna zatdan passive in consumed by ahih kei leh consumed with lungsim thu khat tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who buys or uses goods and services.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van leh nasep leileh zang mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Consumers have the right to accurate product information.
examples.zomi: Leite in van tawh kisai thu man ngahna dikna nei uh hi.

examples.english: Higher prices may reduce consumer demand.
examples.zomi: Man sangzaw in leite deihna khiamsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A consumer buys or uses the final product or service. A customer is the person or organization buying from a particular seller.
senses.usage_zomi: Consumer pen van ahih kei leh nasep a zang nunung mi ahi hi. Customer pen vanzuakpa kician khat kiangpan a lei mi ahih kei leh pawl ahi hi.

senses.heading: Communication with someone
senses.definition_en: Communication or interaction with a person or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat tawh kihopihna ahih kei leh kimuhkhopna ahi hi.

examples.english: We have remained in contact since college.
examples.zomi: College pan kipan kizom tawntung ung.

examples.english: The agency made contact with the family.
examples.zomi: Agency in innkuan tawh kizopna bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In contact with means communicating or maintaining a relationship with someone.
senses.usage_zomi: In contact with in mi khat tawh kihopih ahih kei leh kizopna nei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A person who may provide information or assistance
senses.definition_en: A person you know who can provide information, help, or access.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, huhna ahih kei leh lutna lampi pia thei na theih mi ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: thupiang baihloh a hopih ding mi

examples.english: List an emergency contact on the form.
examples.zomi: Form tungah thupiang baihloh a hopih ding mi khat min gelh in.

examples.english: She has several contacts in the technology industry.
examples.zomi: Technology industry sungah theihmi pawlkhat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: An emergency contact is the person who should be called if an urgent problem occurs.
senses.usage_zomi: Emergency contact pen thupiang baihloh a om ciangin phone ding mi ahi hi.

senses.heading: Physical touching
senses.definition_en: A situation in which two people or objects touch each other.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih kei leh van nih khat leh khat a kisukna ahi hi.

examples.english: Avoid direct contact with the chemical.
examples.zomi: Chemical tawh kimaitak a kisukna pelh in.

examples.english: The disease can spread through close contact.
examples.zomi: Natna pen kinai tak a kisukna leh kipawlna tungtawnin kizel thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Come into contact with can mean physically touching or encountering something.
senses.usage_zomi: Come into contact with in na khat tawh pumpi a kisuk ahih kei leh kimuh cihna neithei hi.

senses.heading: To have something inside
senses.definition_en: To have or hold something within a container, place, document, or larger whole.
senses.explanation_zomi: Beel, mun, document ahih kei leh na lianzaw khat sungah na khat nei ahih kei leh kem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bottle contains one liter of water.
examples.zomi: Tui-um sungah tui liter khat om hi.

examples.english: The report contains confidential information.
examples.zomi: Report sungah mimal thuthuk thu om hi.

senses.usage_en: Contain describes what is inside something. Include may name only some of the parts rather than all the contents.
senses.usage_zomi: Contain in na khat sungah bang om cih gen hi. Include in a sung a khen pawlkhat bek min gen thei hi.

senses.heading: To control or prevent something from spreading
senses.definition_en: To control a dangerous situation, emotion, fire, disease, or substance and prevent it from spreading.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun lauhuai, lungsim thu, mei, natna ahih kei leh zat khat uk a, kizelhlo dingin khaktan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Firefighters worked to contain the fire.
examples.zomi: Meithalpite mei kizelh khaktan dingin nasem uh hi.

examples.english: Health officials acted quickly to contain the disease.
examples.zomi: Cidamna ukte natna kizelh khaktan dingin manlang takin gamta uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, containment may limit the spread without completely ending the danger.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah ukna in lauhuaina tawpsak sitset lo napi, kizelhna ciangtan thei hi.

senses.definition_en: An object used to hold, store, protect, or transport something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat koih, khol, kem ahih kei leh tawi dingin a kizang beel, kuang, sakhau ahih kei leh tuam ahi hi.

examples.english: Store the food in a sealed container.
examples.zomi: An pen beel kikhak sungah khol in.

examples.english: The chemicals must remain in their original containers.
examples.zomi: Chemical-te a beel masa sungah om lai ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Container is a general word. More specific containers include bottles, boxes, cans, jars, bags, and bowls.
senses.usage_zomi: Container pen a kimzaw kammal ahi hi. A kicianzawte lakah tui-um, kuang, can, jar, sakhau leh kheng kihel hi.

senses.heading: Belonging to the present time
senses.definition_en: Existing, happening, or being produced in the present period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuni hunah om, piang ahih kei leh kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The course examines contemporary social issues.
examples.zomi: Sinna in tulai mipi thu-te sittel hi.

examples.english: She is a contemporary Zomi writer.
examples.zomi: Amah tulai Zomi laigelhtu ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Contemporary often means modern or current, but it does not necessarily mean newly created today.
senses.usage_zomi: Contemporary in tulai ahih kei leh tuhun tawh kisai cihna nei zel napi, tuni mah a kibawl thak cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: Existing during the same historical period
senses.definition_en: Living or existing at the same time as another person or thing.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hun kibang a om; khang khat
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na dang khat tawh tangthu hun kibang sungah nungta ahih kei leh omkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two philosophers were contemporary with each other.
examples.zomi: Philosophy siampa nihte hun kibang sungah nungta uh hi.

examples.english: Contemporary records describe the event differently.
examples.zomi: Tua hun a ciamtehnate in thupiang kilamdang in hilh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A contemporary source was produced during the period being studied, not necessarily in the present day.
senses.usage_zomi: Contemporary thukhual pen a kisittel tangthu hun sungah a kibawl ahi a, tuni hun a kibawl hi kullo hi.

senses.heading: The information, ideas, or material in something
senses.definition_en: The information, ideas, words, images, or other material contained in a book, document, program, or website.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a sung thu; thu leh limte
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, document, program ahih kei leh website sungah om thu, ngaihsutna, kammal, lim leh van dangte ahi hi.

examples.english: The website provides educational content in Zomi.
examples.zomi: Website in Zomi pau tawh pilna thu pia hi.

examples.english: Editors reviewed the content before publication.
examples.zomi: Suahma in editors-te in a sung thu sittel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Content is normally uncountable when it refers generally to information or media.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu leh media a kim gen ciangin content simtheihloh noun ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: The amount of a substance contained in something
senses.definition_en: The amount or proportion of a particular substance present in food, material, or another product.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a sung a om zah; kihel zah
senses.explanation_zomi: An, van ahih kei leh product khat sungah zat kician khat bangzah kihel cih ahi hi.

examples.english: Check the sugar content on the label.
examples.zomi: Label tungah khum kihel zah en in.

examples.english: This food has a high salt content.
examples.zomi: Hih an sungah ci kihel zah sang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, content follows the substance being measured: protein content, water content, or alcohol content.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah a kiteh zat nungah content hong pai hi: protein content, water content, alcohol content.

senses.heading: The separate items inside a container or document
senses.definition_en: The things contained inside a container, room, book, or other place.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a sung a omte; sunga vante
senses.explanation_zomi: Beel, innkhan, laibu ahih kei leh mun dang khat sungah om na-te ahi hi.

examples.english: The contents of the box were damaged.
examples.zomi: Kuang sung a vante sia hi.

examples.english: Use the table of contents to find the chapter.
examples.zomi: Khen zong dingin laibu sunga thute minza zang in.

senses.usage_en: When referring to the separate things inside something, English normally uses the plural contents.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat sung a van tuamtuam gen ciangin English ah plural contents kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: An organized competition
senses.definition_en: An event in which people try to win by showing skill, knowledge, strength, or quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte siamna, theihna, thahatna ahih kei leh quality lak in gualzo ding a kidemna ahi hi.

examples.english: She won the school writing contest.
examples.zomi: Sang laigelh kidemna gualzo hi.

examples.english: Twenty students entered the contest.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang sawmnih kidemna ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Contest often refers to one organized event. Competition may refer to either an event or rivalry generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Contest in a tamzaw in kidemna thupiang khat gen hi. Competition in kidemna thupiang ahih kei leh kidemna dinmun a kim gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A struggle to gain a position or victory
senses.definition_en: A situation in which people or groups struggle to win power, a position, or an election.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih kei leh pawlte ukna, dinmun ahih kei leh teelna gualzawhna ngah ding a kidem uh dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The election became a close contest.
examples.zomi: Teelna pen gualzawh kilamdanna tawm kidemna hong suak hi.

examples.english: Three candidates entered the leadership contest.
examples.zomi: Teel dingmi thum makaihna kidemna ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, contest emphasizes the struggle between opposing candidates or groups.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah contest in teel dingmi ahih kei leh pawl langnihte kikal kilehna thupi sak hi.

senses.heading: The words or information surrounding a statement
senses.definition_en: The words, sentences, or information around an expression that help explain its meaning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal ahih kei leh thugen khat a khiatna teltheihna ding a kiimah om kammal, sentence leh thu-te ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: thu kiim pan a khiatna kawk

examples.english: Use the context to understand the unfamiliar word.
examples.zomi: Kammal theihloh tel dingin thu kiim zang in.

examples.english: The quotation was taken out of context.
examples.zomi: Thugen kammal pen a thu kiim pan khenkhia in kila hi.

senses.usage_en: Taking words out of context can change or distort their intended meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Kammalte out of context a lak ciangin a deih khiatna kikhel ahih kei leh mangkhal thei hi.

senses.heading: The circumstances surrounding an event or idea
senses.definition_en: The social, historical, political, or practical circumstances in which something happens or exists.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupiang ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat a omna mipi, tangthu, gamvai leh nuntakna dinmunte ahi hi.

examples.english: The law must be understood in its historical context.
examples.zomi: Daan pen a tangthu thu omzia sungah kitel ding hi.

examples.english: Behavior can have different meanings in different cultural contexts.
examples.zomi: Gamtatna in ngeina thu omzia tuamtuam sungah khiatna kilamdang neithei hi.

senses.usage_en: Context helps explain why an event, idea, or behavior has a particular meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Context in thupiang, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh gamtatna khat banghangin khiatna tuam nei cih hilhcian hi.

senses.definition_en: One of the world’s largest continuous areas of land.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung a lei-gam lian leh kizomkhawm khen liante lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Asia is the world’s largest continent.
examples.zomi: Asia pen leitung a leigam lianpen ahi hi.

examples.english: The species is found across the continent.
examples.zomi: Tua ganhing nam leigam lian a mun tuamtuam ah kimu hi.

senses.usage_en: The commonly taught seven-continent model names Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Australia; other geographic traditions group them differently.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangsak zel continent sagih model in Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, South America leh Australia ci hi; geography ngeina dangte in khenzia kilamdang zang uh hi.

senses.heading: To keep happening or existing
senses.definition_en: To keep happening, existing, or operating without ending.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tawplo in piang, om ahih kei leh nasem zom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The rain continued throughout the night.
examples.zomi: Zan vekpi guah zu zom hi.

examples.english: The company will continue to operate.
examples.zomi: Company nasem zom ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Continue doing and continue to do are both correct, with little difference in many contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Continue doing leh continue to do anih in man a, thu omdan tampi ah a khiatna kilamdanna tawm bek nei hi.

senses.heading: To resume after a pause
senses.definition_en: To begin again after stopping for a short time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tomno khawl khit ciangin kipan kik ahih kei leh sem zom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: After lunch, we continued the meeting.
examples.zomi: Sun-an khit ciangin kimuhkhopna zom ung.

examples.english: She paused and then continued speaking.
examples.zomi: Tawlkhat khawl a, tua khit ciangin pau zom hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense allows a temporary interruption before the action resumes.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah nasep a kizomkikma in hun tomno khawlna omthei hi.

senses.heading: To remain in a particular direction or position
senses.definition_en: To keep moving in the same direction or remain in a particular state or place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam khat mah zui in pai zom ahih kei leh dinmun leh mun khat mahah om zom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Continue straight for two miles.
examples.zomi: Mile nih a tungtang in pai zom in.

examples.english: She continued in her position for another year.
examples.zomi: A dinmunah kum khat om zom hi.

senses.usage_en: In directions, continue means to keep moving without changing route.
senses.usage_zomi: Lampi hilhna ah continue in lampi khek loin pai zom cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Continuing without stopping, interruption, or a break.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tawldamna, nawngkaihna ahih kei leh khenkhiahna omlo in kizom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The machine ran for eight continuous hours.
examples.zomi: Machine nai giat khawllo in tai hi.

examples.english: Continuous rain caused flooding.
examples.zomi: Guah khawllo in tuiciin piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Continuous means without interruption. Continual usually means repeated frequently but with pauses between occurrences.
senses.usage_zomi: Continuous in nawngkaihna omlo cihna ahi hi. Continual in a kikal ah khawlna om napi, vei tampi piang cihna ahi zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A legally enforceable agreement between two or more people or organizations.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl nih leh a tamzaw kikal, daan tawh zuih ding a kipsak thukimna ahi hi.

examples.english: Read the contract carefully before signing it.
examples.zomi: Contract na min gelhma in kidawmtak in sim in.

examples.english: The company offered her a two-year contract.
examples.zomi: Company in amah kum nih nasep thukimna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A contract creates legal rights and duties. Not every informal promise is legally enforceable as a contract.
senses.usage_zomi: Contract in daan dikna leh mawpuakna piangsak hi. Nisim kamciam khempeuh daan tawh contract in kipsaktheih hi vek lo hi.

senses.heading: A noticeable difference
senses.definition_en: A clear and noticeable difference between two or more people or things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na nih leh a tamzaw kikal a kician leh muhtheih kilamdanna ahi hi.

examples.english: There is a clear contrast between the two plans.
examples.zomi: Geelna nihte kikal kilamdanna kician om hi.

examples.english: Her calm voice was in contrast to the noisy crowd.
examples.zomi: A aw dai pen mihon ging tawh kilamdang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use contrast between A and B or in contrast to/with something.
senses.usage_zomi: Contrast between A and B ahih kei leh in contrast to/with something ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: A person or thing that is very different from another
senses.definition_en: Someone or something whose qualities are clearly different from those of another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang ahih kei leh na dang khat tawh a zia kician takin kilamdang mi ahih kei leh na ahi hi.

examples.english: The quiet village is a complete contrast to the busy city.
examples.zomi: Khua dai pen khuapi mawh tawh a vekpi in kilamdang hi.

examples.english: The dark frame provides a contrast to the white wall.
examples.zomi: Lim-kuang vom in bang pak tawh kilamdanna lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the contrasting item helps make the difference more noticeable.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah a kilamdang na in kilamdanna muhtheihzaw sak hi.

senses.heading: To give money, time, effort, ideas, or goods to help
senses.definition_en: To give money, time, work, ideas, or goods to support a person, group, or purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl ahih kei leh ngiimna khat panpih dingin sum, hun, hanciamna, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh van pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Everyone contributed ideas to the discussion.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in kiholimna ah ngaihsutna behlap uh hi.

examples.english: The company contributed money to the community center.
examples.zomi: Company in khua mipite phual ading sum pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use contribute to before the person, group, project, or purpose receiving the contribution.
senses.usage_zomi: A ngah mi, pawl, geelna ahih kei leh ngiimna ma-ah contribute to kizang hi.

senses.heading: To help cause a result
senses.definition_en: To be one of several causes that help produce a result or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawnna ahih kei leh dinmun khat piangsak thu tuamtuamte lakah khat hi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Poor sleep can contribute to health problems.
examples.zomi: Ihmutna hoihlo in cidamna buaina piangsakpih thei hi.

examples.english: Several factors contributed to the accident.
examples.zomi: Thu tuamtuam pawlkhat accident pianna ah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: Contribute to does not necessarily mean being the only or main cause.
senses.usage_zomi: Contribute to in a pianna hang khat hi cihna ahi a, a pianna hang neihsun ahih kei leh bulpi hi cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: To provide writing or other content for a publication
senses.definition_en: To produce an article, image, recording, or other material for a publication or program.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lai behlap; a sung thu pia
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai suahna ahih kei leh program khat ading article, lim, aw record ahih kei leh a sung thu bawl in pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She contributes articles to a local newspaper.
examples.zomi: Khuami thuthak lai ading article-te gelh hi.

examples.english: Several photographers contributed images to the book.
examples.zomi: Lim-late pawlkhat in laibu ading limte pia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A person who regularly provides material is called a contributor.
senses.usage_zomi: Lai, lim ahih kei leh thu a pia zel mi pen contributor kici hi.

senses.heading: Money, time, work, ideas, or goods given to help
senses.definition_en: Money, time, effort, an idea, or an object given to support a person, organization, or purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl ahih kei leh ngiimna khat panpih ding a kipia sum, hun, hanciamna, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh van ahi hi.

examples.english: Thank you for your contribution to the project.
examples.zomi: Geelna tung a na panpihna tungah lungdam.

examples.english: Each member made a financial contribution.
examples.zomi: Member sim in sum panpihna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A contribution may be financial, but it can also be time, labor, knowledge, or another form of help.
senses.usage_zomi: Contribution pen sum hithei a, hun, nasep, theihna ahih kei leh panpihna nam dang zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: A part played in producing a result
senses.definition_en: The part that someone or something plays in causing, improving, or completing a result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat in dawnna piangsak, hoihzaw sak ahih kei leh zousakna ah a sep khen ahi hi.

examples.english: Her research made an important contribution to medical science.
examples.zomi: A zongkhiatna in zatna science tungah panpihna thupi pia hi.

examples.english: The report recognizes each team member’s contribution.
examples.zomi: Report in pawl member sim a sep khen zahtak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes the effect or value of someone’s work, not merely what was physically given.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah pumpi van a kipia pen bek hilo in, mi khat nasepna in a piangsak phattuamna thupi sak hi.

senses.heading: Material supplied for a publication or program
senses.definition_en: An article, image, recording, or other work supplied for publication or presentation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lai behlap; a sung thu piakna
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai suahna ahih kei leh program khat ading a kipia article, lim, aw record ahih kei leh nasep dang ahi hi.

examples.english: The editor welcomed contributions from readers.
examples.zomi: Editor in lai simte pan article leh laigelhna sang nuam hi.

examples.english: Her contribution appears in the final chapter.
examples.zomi: A laigelhna khen nunungah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Publications may use contribution for material submitted by someone other than the main author or editor.
senses.usage_zomi: Lai suahnate in laigelhpa bulpi ahih kei leh editor hilo mi khat a piak lai ading contribution ci thei uh hi.

senses.heading: Power to direct or manage someone or something
senses.definition_en: The power or authority to direct, manage, or govern a person, organization, system, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, system ahih kei leh dinmun khat uk, makaih ahih kei leh vaihawm theihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The government took control of the emergency response.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in thupiang baihloh dawnkikna ukna la hi.

examples.english: She has full control of the project budget.
examples.zomi: Geelna sum geelna tungah ukna kicing nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Control over is common for authority, while control of often identifies the thing being managed.
senses.usage_zomi: Ukzawhna a kim genna ah control over kizang tampi a, a ki-uk na genna ah control of kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: The ability to limit or regulate something
senses.definition_en: The ability or process of keeping something within desired limits or preventing it from becoming harmful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat deih ciangtan sungah koih ahih kei leh lauhuai leh sia hong suaklo dingin ukna ahi hi.

examples.english: The city introduced new traffic controls.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in mawtaw vakna ukna thak hong zang hi.

examples.english: Mosquito control can reduce the spread of disease.
examples.zomi: Tho ukna in natna kizelhna khiamsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In compounds such as disease control or pollution control, the aim may be reduction rather than complete elimination.
senses.usage_zomi: Disease control leh pollution control bang kammal kizom ah, a vekpi lawhkhiahna sangin khiamsakna ngiimna hithei hi.

senses.heading: Self-restraint over feelings or behavior
senses.definition_en: The ability to manage your emotions, reactions, or behavior.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nangma lungsim thu, dawnkikna ahih kei leh gamtatna ukzo theihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He lost control of his anger.
examples.zomi: A lungthanna ukzolo hi.

examples.english: She remained calm and in control.
examples.zomi: Lungsim dai leh kipum ukzo in om hi.

senses.usage_en: Lose control means becoming unable to manage a situation, emotion, vehicle, or behavior.
senses.usage_zomi: Lose control in dinmun, lungsim thu, mawtaw ahih kei leh gamtatna ukzawh nawnlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A device used to operate a machine or system
senses.definition_en: A button, switch, lever, or other device used to operate or adjust a machine or system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine ahih kei leh system khat semsak ahih kei leh bawl dikna ding a kizang button, switch, khutkai ahih kei leh vanzat ahi hi.

examples.english: Use the remote control to change the channel.
examples.zomi: Channel khek dingin gamla pan ukna van zang in.

examples.english: The temperature controls are on the wall.
examples.zomi: Khuasak ukna buttonte bangah om hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural controls often refers collectively to the buttons, switches, and other operating devices.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural controls in machine semsakna button, switch leh ukna van tuamtuam a kigawm gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Suitable for someone’s time or plans
senses.definition_en: Fitting well with someone’s schedule, needs, or plans.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a hun kigeelna, kisapna ahih kei leh geelna tawh a kituak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Is Friday afternoon convenient for you?
examples.zomi: Friday nitaklam nang ading hun lem hiam?

examples.english: Call me at a convenient time.
examples.zomi: Hun lem ciangin kei hong phone in.

senses.usage_en: Use convenient for someone when discussing a person’s needs or schedule.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a kisapna ahih kei leh hun kigeelna tawh kituakna gen dingin convenient for someone kizang hi.

senses.heading: Easy and useful
senses.definition_en: Easy to use, reach, obtain, or access and therefore useful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, tun, ngah ahih kei leh lut baih ahih manin phattuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel is in a convenient location near the airport.
examples.zomi: Hotel pen airport kiang mun tun baih ah om hi.

examples.english: Online banking is convenient for many customers.
examples.zomi: Internet bank nasep leimi tampi ading zat baih hi.

senses.usage_en: Something convenient saves time or effort, but it is not necessarily the best or least expensive option.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a lem leh hun leh hanciamna a kep theih hangin, a hoihpen ahih kei leh man a tawm pen hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: An informal spoken exchange in which two or more people talk and listen to one another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nih leh a tamzaw in lawm tak leh nisim zatdan in pau leh ngai khawm a kiholimna ahi hi.

examples.english: We had a long conversation about education.
examples.zomi: Pilna thu tawh kisai sawtpi kiholim ung.

examples.english: Their conversation ended when the meeting began.
examples.zomi: Kimuhkhopna a kipat ciangin a kiholimna uh tawp hi.

senses.usage_en: The usual expression is have a conversation with someone about something.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatdan biasa pen have a conversation with someone about something ahi hi.

senses.heading: To change something into a different form, system, or use
senses.definition_en: To change something from one form, purpose, measurement, or system into another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pianzia, a zatna, tehna ahih kei leh system khat pan na dang khat in khelsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity.
examples.zomi: Nitaang panel-te in ni khuavak meima suaksak hi.

examples.english: The software converts the document to PDF.
examples.zomi: Software in document pen PDF in khelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use convert A into/to B. Into often emphasizes transformation, while to is common with currencies, measurements, and file formats.
senses.usage_zomi: Convert A into/to B ci in kizang hi. Into in kikhelna thupi sak a, sum nam, tehna leh file format tawh to kizang tampi hi.

senses.heading: To change religious beliefs or persuade someone to do so
senses.definition_en: To adopt a different religion or set of beliefs, or cause someone to adopt them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna ahih kei leh upna nam dang khat sang ahih kei leh mi khat tua bangin sangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He later converted to Christianity.
examples.zomi: A nungciangin Christian upna sang hi.

examples.english: The discussion did not convert everyone to her position.
examples.zomi: Kiholimna in mi khempeuh a ngaihsutna lamah khelsak lo hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing another person’s religion, use respectful and neutral wording and avoid assuming why the person changed beliefs.
senses.usage_zomi: Midang biakna a gen ciangin zahtakna leh langnih a omlo kammal zang a, banghangin upna kikhel cih ngaisak lo ding hi.

senses.heading: To make someone believe that something is true
senses.definition_en: To cause someone to believe that a fact, statement, or idea is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, thugen ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat thumaan hi ci in mi khat umsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The evidence convinced the jury that he was innocent.
examples.zomi: Tecite in amah mawhneilo hi ci in thukhen pawlte umsak hi.

examples.english: I am not convinced that the plan will work.
examples.zomi: Geelna lawcing ding cih ka um nailo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use convince someone that + clause when changing a person’s belief.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a upna khelsakna gen dingin convince someone that + clause kizang hi.

senses.heading: To persuade someone to do something
senses.definition_en: To persuade someone by reasons or discussion to take a particular action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hang leh kiholimna zangin mi khat gamtatna kician khat sem dingin thukimsak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat zong ding in zol

examples.english: She convinced him to see a doctor.
examples.zomi: Siavuan muh dingin amah thukimsak hi.

examples.english: They convinced the council to review the policy.
examples.zomi: Council in thukhun sittel dingin thukimsak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use convince someone to do something. Do not normally say convince someone of doing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Convince someone to do something ci in kizang hi. A tamzaw in convince someone of doing something ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Completely or strongly believing that something is true or that a particular action is right.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat thumaan ahih kei leh gamtatna kician khat man hi ci in khauh takin um cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is convinced that the decision was correct.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna man hi ci in um hi.

examples.english: I am not yet convinced by the evidence.
examples.zomi: Tecite in kei hong umsak nailo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use convinced that before a statement, convinced of before a noun, and convinced by before the evidence or argument.
senses.usage_zomi: Thugen kicing ma-ah convinced that, noun ma-ah convinced of, teci ahih kei leh nialna ma-ah convinced by kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: To prepare food by heating it, for example by boiling, baking, frying, or grilling.
senses.explanation_zomi: An pen tui-a-suan, mei-a-hong, sathau-a-kan ahih kei leh mei-a-kaw tawh nek dingin bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She cooked rice and chicken for dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak-an ading an leh ak-sa huan hi.

examples.english: Cook the meat thoroughly before eating it.
examples.zomi: Sa na nekma in a sung dong huan mat in.

senses.usage_en: Cook is the general verb. More exact verbs include boil, bake, fry, roast, and grill.
senses.usage_zomi: Cook pen a kimzaw verb ahi hi. A kicianzawte lakah boil, bake, fry, roast leh grill kihel hi.

senses.definition_en: An appliance or container used for cooking food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An huan dingin a kizang machine, vanzat ahih kei leh beel ahi hi.

examples.english: The rice cooker turns off automatically.
examples.zomi: Anhuan beel amah leh amah kikhum hi.

examples.english: She prepared the beans in a pressure cooker.
examples.zomi: Beh pen huih thawh tawh anhuan beel sungah huan hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, cooker can mean a stove or range. In American English, the exact appliance name—such as stove, rice cooker, or slow cooker—is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah cooker in stove ahih kei leh range gen thei hi. American English ah stove, rice cooker, slow cooker bang vanzat min kician kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: The activity of preparing food with heat
senses.definition_en: The activity or skill of preparing food, especially by heating it.
senses.explanation_zomi: An bawl, a diak in mei leh khuasak zang a huanna gamtatna leh siamna ahi hi.

examples.english: Cooking is an important life skill.
examples.zomi: Anhuan siamna pen nuntakna siamna thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: He does most of the cooking in the family.
examples.zomi: Innkuan sung an a tamzaw amah in huan hi.

senses.usage_en: Cooking is normally uncountable when referring to the activity or skill.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna ahih kei leh siamna a khiatna ah cooking simtheihloh noun ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Food prepared in a particular style
senses.definition_en: Food prepared in the style of a particular person, place, or tradition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, khuamun ahih kei leh ngeina khat a zatdan bang a kibawl an ahi hi.

examples.english: I enjoy my mother’s cooking.
examples.zomi: Ka nu anhuan ka nuam sa hi.

examples.english: The restaurant specializes in traditional cooking.
examples.zomi: Annek dawr in ngeina anhuanna bulphuh hi.

senses.usage_en: Someone’s cooking usually means the food that person prepares or their way of preparing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Someone’s cooking in tua mi a huan an ahih kei leh a anhuan zatdan gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Slightly cold in a pleasant or noticeable way
senses.definition_en: Having a fairly low temperature but not being extremely cold.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vot mahmah loin, tawmkhat vot ahih kei leh nuam tak a vot cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The evening air was cool and pleasant.
examples.zomi: Nitak huih vot deuh leh nuam hi.

examples.english: Keep the medicine in a cool place.
examples.zomi: Si pen mun vot deuh ah koih in.

senses.usage_en: Cool is warmer than cold. The exact temperature depends on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Cool pen cold sangin lumzaw hi. Khuasak bangzah cih thu omdan ciangin kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Calm and controlled
senses.definition_en: Calm and able to control feelings or behavior, especially in a difficult situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun haksa sung zong lungsim dai a, lungsim thu leh gamtatna ukzo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Try to stay cool during the emergency.
examples.zomi: Thupiang baihloh sungah lungsim dai in om dingin hanciam in.

examples.english: She remained cool under pressure.
examples.zomi: Sawlna nuai zong kipum ukzo in om hi.

senses.usage_en: Keep cool informally means remain calm, not only remain physically cool.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim kammal keep cool in pumpi vot in om cihna bek hilo a, lungsim dai in om cihna zong ahi hi.

senses.heading: Fashionable, impressive, or socially attractive
senses.definition_en: Informally used to describe someone or something considered fashionable, impressive, attractive, or admirable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nisim kiholna ah mi ahih kei leh na khat tulai zatdan nei, lunglut huai, melhoih ahih kei leh phat huai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: That is a cool idea.
examples.zomi: Tua pen ngaihsutna hoih ahi hi.

examples.english: He bought a cool new jacket.
examples.zomi: Jacket thak lunglut huai khat lei hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal meaning changes with culture, age, and social group. Avoid it in very formal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim khiatna ngeina, kum leh mihon ciangin kikhel thei hi. Lai thupi mahmah ah zat kholloh hoih hi.

senses.heading: Acceptable or agreeable
senses.definition_en: Informally used to say that something is acceptable or that you agree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nisim kiholna ah na khat saangtheih hi ahih kei leh ka thukim hi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: “Can we meet at six?” “Cool.”
examples.zomi: “Nai guk ciangin kimuthei ding hiam?” “Hoih hi.”

examples.english: I am cool with changing the schedule.
examples.zomi: Hun kigeelna kikhelna ka thukim hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is highly informal. In formal situations, use acceptable, fine, or I agree.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan nisim kiholna mahmah ahi hi. Thu thupi ah acceptable, fine ahih kei leh I agree kizang ding hi.

senses.heading: Something made to look or be the same as an original
senses.definition_en: A reproduction of an original document, image, recording, object, or file.
senses.explanation_zomi: Document, lim, aw record, van ahih kei leh file a bulpi tawh kibang ding a kibawl laan ahi hi.

examples.english: Please keep a copy of the signed contract.
examples.zomi: Min gelhsa contract laan khat kem in.

examples.english: The file is a copy of the original.
examples.zomi: File pen a bulpi laan ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A copy may be exact or may contain small differences. The original is the source from which it was made.
senses.usage_zomi: Copy pen a bulpi tawh kibang sitset ahih kei leh kilamdanna neu nei thei hi. Original pen tua copy a kibawlna thukhual ahi hi.

senses.heading: One individual example of a book, newspaper, or other publication
senses.definition_en: One particular book, newspaper, magazine, or other printed publication.
senses.zomi_equivalents: laibu khat; lai suahna bu khat
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, thuthak lai, magazine ahih kei leh lai suahna khat a bu khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The library owns three copies of the book.
examples.zomi: Laibu-inn in tua laibu bu thum nei hi.

examples.english: She gave me a free copy of the magazine.
examples.zomi: Magazine bu khat man neilo in hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, copy counts separate physical or digital examples of the same publication.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah copy in lai suahna kibang a bu tuamtuamte sim hi.

senses.heading: Written material prepared for publication or advertising
senses.definition_en: Words written for an advertisement, website, newspaper, or publication.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangko, website, thuthak lai ahih kei leh lai suahna ading a kigelh kammal leh thu ahi hi.

examples.english: She writes advertising copy for local businesses.
examples.zomi: Khuami sumdawnnate ading tangko lai gelh hi.

examples.english: The editor revised the website copy.
examples.zomi: Editor in website lai puahpha hi.

senses.usage_en: In publishing and advertising, copy is uncountable when it means text prepared for use.
senses.usage_zomi: Lai suahna leh tangko nasep ah a kizang ding lai a khiatna ah copy simtheihloh noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: The central or most important part
senses.definition_en: The central, essential, or most important part of something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a laizang; a bulpi; a thupipen
senses.explanation_zomi: Na, system, pawl ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat a laizang, a kisam mahmah ahih kei leh a thupipen khen ahi hi.

examples.english: Trust is at the core of a strong relationship.
examples.zomi: Kimuanna pen kizopna kip a bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: The course teaches core computer skills.
examples.zomi: Sinna in computer siamna bulpite hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is often figurative and identifies what is most essential.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen gentehna in kizang zel a, a kisam leh thupi pen lak hi.

senses.heading: The firm central part of certain fruits
senses.definition_en: The firm center of a fruit that contains its seeds.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thei gah laizang; thei mu omna
senses.explanation_zomi: Thei gah pawlkhat a laizang a khauh leh a mu omna khen ahi hi.

examples.english: She removed the apple core before cooking it.
examples.zomi: Apple a huanma in a laizang lawhkhia hi.

examples.english: He threw the apple core into the compost bin.
examples.zomi: Apple laizang pen annek ninsia beel sungah paih hi.

senses.usage_en: Not every fruit has a part normally called a core; the term is especially common with apples and pears.
senses.usage_zomi: Thei gah khempeuh a laizang core kici lo hi; apple leh pear tawh kizang diak hi.

senses.heading: The inner part of an object, planet, or system
senses.definition_en: The central inner part of an object, machine, planet, or structure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, machine, leitung ahih kei leh lamna khat a sung laizang khen ahi hi.

examples.english: The Earth’s core is extremely hot.
examples.zomi: Leitung sung laizang a sa mahmah hi.

examples.english: The cable has a metal core.
examples.zomi: Thirgui sung laizang metal tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In scientific and technical contexts, core often names the central working or structural region.
senses.usage_zomi: Science leh technology ah core in nasepna ahih kei leh lamna a sung laizang khen gen zel hi.

senses.heading: The point or area where two sides, edges, or lines meet
senses.definition_en: The point or area where two sides, edges, walls, or lines meet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lang, gei, bang ahih kei leh lai nih a kimuhna kil ahi hi.

examples.english: The chair is in the corner of the room.
examples.zomi: Tutna pen innkhan kilah om hi.

examples.english: Write your name in the top-right corner.
examples.zomi: Ziatung kilah na min gelh in.

senses.usage_en: For a room or page, a corner is where two sides meet.
senses.usage_zomi: Innkhan ahih kei leh laimai ah kil pen lang nih a kimuhna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A place where two streets meet
senses.definition_en: A point or area where two streets meet or where a street changes direction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi nih a kimuhna ahih kei leh lampi a kihei mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The bank is on the corner of Main Street.
examples.zomi: Bank pen Main Street lampi kilah om hi.

examples.english: Turn left at the next corner.
examples.zomi: Lampi kil naungah veilam hei in.

senses.usage_en: Around the corner can mean physically nearby or figuratively happening very soon.
senses.usage_zomi: Around the corner in mun nai ah cihna hithei a, gentehna in manlang takin piang ding cihna zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: A difficult position with few choices
senses.definition_en: A situation in which someone is forced into a difficult position with limited choices.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat teeltheihna tawm bek nei a, dinmun haksa sungah a kikhum dinmun ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: nangma gamtatna tawh lampi neilo suak

examples.english: The unexpected cost pushed the company into a corner.
examples.zomi: Man lam-etloh in company dinmun haksa sungah koih hi.

examples.english: Do not make promises that back you into a corner.
examples.zomi: Dinmun haksa sungah hong koih ding kamciam bawl kei in.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense suggests being trapped or having very limited options.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in kikhum bang a om ahih kei leh teeltheihna tawm bek neihna lak hi.

senses.heading: Relating to a corporation or large company
senses.definition_en: Relating to a corporation, company, or business organization.
senses.zomi_equivalents: company tawh kisai; corporation tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Corporation, company ahih kei leh sumdawnna pawl tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She works in corporate finance.
examples.zomi: Company sumvai lamah nasem hi.

examples.english: The decision was made at the corporate office.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna company ophis bulpi ah kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Corporate may describe legal structure, business management, company culture, finance, or other company activities.
senses.usage_zomi: Corporate in daan kibawlna, sumdawnna makaihna, company ngeina, sumvai ahih kei leh company nasep dangte gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Shared by or involving an organization as a whole
senses.definition_en: Belonging to or involving the whole organization rather than one individual or department.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mimal khat ahih kei leh khen khat bek hilo in, pawlpi a vekpi tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Environmental protection is part of the company’s corporate responsibility.
examples.zomi: Leitung kiim kepna pen company pumlum mawpuakna sungah kihel hi.

examples.english: The company introduced a new corporate identity.
examples.zomi: Company in company a hihna thak hong zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, corporate emphasizes the organization acting as one body.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah corporate in pawlpi pen pumkhat bangin gamta cih thupi sak hi.

senses.heading: Free from error
senses.definition_en: Accurate, true, or without a mistake.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna omlo a, man ahih kei leh thumaan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Your answer is correct.
examples.zomi: Na dawnna man hi.

examples.english: Make sure the address is correct.
examples.zomi: Address man cih kiciansak in.

senses.usage_en: Correct describes accuracy. Right can also mean correct, but it has several other meanings.
senses.usage_zomi: Correct in a man cihna gen hi. Right in a man cihna zong nei napi, khiatna dang tampi nei hi.

senses.heading: Suitable or proper for a situation
senses.definition_en: Appropriate or accepted as the proper choice, method, behavior, or form.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat ading a kituak, a kilawm ahih kei leh a kisaang zatdan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Follow the correct safety procedure.
examples.zomi: Bitna sepzia man zui in.

examples.english: This is the correct form for the application.
examples.zomi: Hih pen application ading form kituak ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, correct may depend on rules, customs, or the needs of the situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah a man cih pen thukhun, ngeina ahih kei leh dinmun kisapna ciangin kibanglo thei hi.

senses.definition_en: In a way that is accurate, proper, or free from mistakes.
senses.explanation_zomi: A man, a kilawm ahih kei leh khialhna omlo in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She answered every question correctly.
examples.zomi: Dotna khempeuh man takin dawng hi.

examples.english: Make sure the machine is installed correctly.
examples.zomi: Machine zatdan man tawh kikoih cih kiciansak in.

senses.usage_en: Correctly describes how an action is done. The adjective form is correct.
senses.usage_zomi: Correctly in nasep khat bangci sem cih lak hi. A adjective form pen correct ahi hi.

senses.heading: The amount of money needed to buy or do something
senses.definition_en: The amount of money required to buy, produce, maintain, or perform something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat lei, bawl, kem ahih kei leh nasep khat sem ding a kisam sum zah ahi hi.

examples.english: The total cost of the repairs was five hundred dollars.
examples.zomi: Puahna man a vekpi dollar zanga ahi hi.

examples.english: Higher fuel costs increased food prices.
examples.zomi: Meihol man khantohna in annek mante khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Cost refers broadly to the money required or spent. Price usually refers to the amount a seller asks for a particular product or service.
senses.usage_zomi: Cost in a kisam ahih kei leh a kizang sum a kim gen hi. Price in van ahih kei leh nasep khat ading vanzuakpa in a ngen man gen zel hi.

senses.heading: A loss, harm, or sacrifice required by an action
senses.definition_en: A harmful effect, loss, effort, or sacrifice caused by an action or result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih kei leh dawnna khat hang a kisup, a kisiat, a kihanciam ahih kei leh a kipiak kul na ahi hi.

examples.english: The war had a terrible human cost.
examples.zomi: Kidona in mihingte tungah siatna nasia piangsak hi.

examples.english: Economic growth came at a high environmental cost.
examples.zomi: Sumvai khantohna leitung kiim tung a siatna lian tawh hong piang hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative meaning is not limited to money; the cost may be injury, time, stress, lost opportunity, or environmental damage.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna pen sum bek hilo a, liamna, hun, lunggimna, hamphatna suplohna ahih kei leh leitung kiim siatna hithei hi.

senses.heading: Special clothing worn to represent a character
senses.definition_en: Special clothing worn to look like a particular person, character, animal, or imaginary being.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, tangthu sung mi, ganhing ahih kei leh ngaihsutna tawh kibawl nungta khat bang kilang ding a kisilh puan tuam ahi hi.

examples.english: The child wore a superhero costume.
examples.zomi: Naupang in gualhang lim-la puan silh hi.

examples.english: Actors changed costumes between scenes.
examples.zomi: Lim-late scene kikal ah a puan uh khek uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A costume represents a role or character. Ordinary clothes worn by an actor may still be called costume when prepared for a production.
senses.usage_zomi: Costume in dinmun ahih kei leh character khat aiawh hi. Lim-la in a silh puan biasa zong khuamuh ading kigeelsa leh costume kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Traditional clothing associated with a culture or historical period
senses.definition_en: Clothing typical of a particular culture, community, occupation, or historical period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina, mipi, nasep ahih kei leh tangthu hun khat a zia kilangsak puan ahi hi.

examples.english: The dancers wore traditional Zomi costumes.
examples.zomi: Lamte in Zomi ngeina puan silh uh hi.

examples.english: The museum displays costumes from the nineteenth century.
examples.zomi: Museum in kum zabi sawmkuana hun puante lak hi.

senses.usage_en: When discussing living cultures, traditional clothing or the community’s own name for the clothing may be more precise and respectful than costume.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina nungta a gen ciangin traditional clothing ahih kei leh tua mipi in a zat puan min mah zat a kicianzaw leh zahtak huai zaw thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A small house, especially one in the countryside or used for holidays.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in khuata leh lo gamah om ahih kei leh khawl hun a kizang inn neu ahi hi.

examples.english: They rented a cottage beside the lake.
examples.zomi: Tuili kiang inn neu khat a laan in zang uh hi.

examples.english: The old cottage has a stone roof.
examples.zomi: Inn neu lui suang innkhum nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Cottage often suggests a small, simple, or attractive rural home, but the exact style varies by country.
senses.usage_zomi: Cottage in khuata a inn neu, baih ahih kei leh melhoih cih ngaihsutsak zel napi, a kibawlzia gam ciangin kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: A plant that produces soft white fibers
senses.definition_en: A plant grown for the soft white fibers surrounding its seeds.
senses.explanation_zomi: A mu kiimah puan bawlna ding a pak leh a nem sam bang nei, loh an in a kiphut sing ahi hi.

examples.english: Farmers grow cotton in warm regions.
examples.zomi: Lousiamte khuasa gamte ah laang phut uh hi.

examples.english: The cotton is ready to be harvested.
examples.zomi: Laang a-at hun pha hi.

senses.usage_en: Cotton is an agricultural crop as well as the fiber produced by the plant.
senses.usage_zomi: Cotton pen loh an zong ahi a, sing pan a kingah puan-bawlna sam zong ahi hi.

senses.heading: Soft fiber or cloth made from the cotton plant
senses.definition_en: The soft fiber from the cotton plant or fabric made from that fiber.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laang sing pan a kingah sam nem ahih kei leh tua sam tawh a kikhui puan ahi hi.

examples.english: This shirt is made from cotton.
examples.zomi: Hih puan laang tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Cotton feels soft against the skin.
examples.zomi: Laang vun tawh a kisuk ciangin nem hi.

senses.usage_en: Cotton is normally uncountable when referring to the material.
senses.usage_zomi: Material a khiatna ah cotton simtheihloh noun ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Past ability
senses.definition_en: Used to say that someone had the general ability or opportunity to do something in the past.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in abeisa hunah na khat semthei ahih kei leh sepna hun nei cih lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: She could read before she started school.
examples.zomi: Sang a kahma in lai simthei hi.

examples.english: We could not travel because of the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi hangin khualzintheilo ung.

senses.usage_en: For one successful action on a particular past occasion, English often uses was/were able to rather than affirmative could.
senses.usage_zomi: Abeisa hun thupiang kician khat ah na khat a lawcin tak a semtheihna gen dingin affirmative could sangin was/were able to kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Possibility
senses.definition_en: Used to say that something is possible now or in the future.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tu in ahih kei leh mailam hunah piangthei cih lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain could cause flooding tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zanin guah tampi in tuiciin piangsak thei hi.

examples.english: The plan could be successful.
examples.zomi: Geelna lawcing thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Could often expresses a less certain possibility than can.
senses.usage_zomi: Could in a tamzaw in can sangin kician zawlo piangtheihna gen hi.

senses.heading: A polite request or question
senses.definition_en: Used to ask someone politely to do something or to ask for permission.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat zahtakna tawh na khat sem ding ngen ahih kei leh phalna ngenna in kizang hi.

examples.english: Could you close the door, please?
examples.zomi: Kong hong khak thei diam?

examples.english: Could I use your phone?
examples.zomi: Na phone ka zangthei diam?

senses.usage_en: In requests, could is usually more polite and indirect than can. It does not refer to past time here.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngetna ah could pen can sangin zahtakhuai leh thukhauhlo zaw hi. Hih munah abeisa hun genlo hi.

senses.heading: A suggestion
senses.definition_en: Used to suggest a possible action or solution.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih kei leh buaina vengna piangthei khat thu utna in pulakna ahi hi.

examples.english: We could meet tomorrow afternoon.
examples.zomi: Zing nitaklamin kimuthei hang.

examples.english: You could ask the teacher for help.
examples.zomi: Huhna ading sangsiah na dongthei hi.

senses.usage_en: This use presents an option rather than a command.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan in thupiak hilo in, teeltheih ding lampi khat pulak hi.

senses.heading: A hypothetical result
senses.definition_en: Used to describe what would be possible under an imagined or stated condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna ahih kei leh a kigensa dinmun khat a piang leh, bang piangthei ding cih lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The project could succeed if it receives enough funding.
examples.zomi: Geelna in sum kicing ngah leh lawcingthei hi.

examples.english: Without quick action, the situation could become worse.
examples.zomi: Manlang tak a gamtatloh leh dinmun siazaw thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In conditional sentences, could expresses possible ability or result, not certainty.
senses.usage_zomi: Conditional sentence ah could in semtheihna ahih kei leh dawnna piangthei lak a, kician cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: A group chosen to govern or advise
senses.definition_en: A group of people elected or appointed to make decisions, govern an area, or advise an organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuamun uk, thukhen ahih kei leh pawl khat thu hilh dingin a kiteel ahih kei leh kiseh mihing pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The city council approved the new budget.
examples.zomi: Khuapi council in sum geelna thak phalsak hi.

examples.english: She was elected to the local council.
examples.zomi: Khuami council ah kiteel hi.

senses.usage_en: A council is the decision-making or advisory group. Counsel is a different word meaning advice or a legal adviser.
senses.usage_zomi: Council pen thukhen ahih kei leh thuhilh pawl ahi hi. Counsel pen kammal dang ahi a, thuhilhna ahih kei leh daan siampa cihna nei hi.

senses.heading: A formal meeting of such a group
senses.definition_en: A formal meeting at which a council discusses and decides matters.
senses.explanation_zomi: Council in thu kiholim leh thukhen ding a nei kimuhkhopna thupi ahi hi.

examples.english: Residents spoke at the council meeting.
examples.zomi: Khuamite council kimuhkhopna ah pau uh hi.

examples.english: The issue will be discussed at the next council.
examples.zomi: Thu pen council kimuhkhopna naungah kiholim ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Council meeting is usually clearer than council alone when referring specifically to the meeting.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimuhkhopna kician gen dingin council bek sangin council meeting a kicianzaw hi.

senses.heading: To determine the number of people or things
senses.definition_en: To say numbers in order to find how many people or things there are.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih kei leh na-te bangzah om cih theihna dingin number tawh sim cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Count the chairs in the room.
