examples.zomi: Innkhan sung tutnate sim in.

examples.english: She counted the money twice.
examples.zomi: Sum nihvei sim hi.

senses.usage_en: Use count for separate people or things. Use calculate when working out an amount through arithmetic.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na tuamtuam sim dingin count kizang hi. Number nasep tawh zah khat simkhia dingin calculate kizang hi.

senses.heading: To say numbers in their correct order
senses.definition_en: To say or think the numbers in sequence.
senses.zomi_equivalents: number sim; a kizom in sim
senses.explanation_zomi: Numberte a kizomzia man bangin pau ahih kei leh ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Count to twenty before opening your eyes.
examples.zomi: Na mit na honma in sawmnih dong sim in.

examples.english: The children practiced counting backward.
examples.zomi: Naupangte nunglam pan number simna zonsim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In count to ten, the purpose may be measuring time rather than finding a quantity.
senses.usage_zomi: Count to ten ah number zat zong hilo in, hun tomno tehna in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: To include someone or something in a total
senses.definition_en: To include a person or thing when calculating a number or considering a group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Number sim ahih kei leh pawl khat ngaihsut ciangin mi ahih kei leh na khat sungah hel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: There are ten people, not counting the children.
examples.zomi: Naupangte simloh in mi sawm om hi.

examples.english: If you are ordering food, count me in.
examples.zomi: An na thuk ding leh kei zong hong hel in.

senses.usage_en: The informal phrase count me in means “include me in the activity or plan.”
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim kammal count me in in nasep ahih kei leh geelna sungah kei zong hong hel cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To be important or accepted as valid
senses.definition_en: To matter, have value, or be accepted as part of a result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupi, manpha ahih kei leh dawnna sungah a kisaang in kihel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Every vote counts in a close election.
examples.zomi: Teelna a kinai ciangin teelna aw sim thupi hi.

examples.english: Late applications will not count.
examples.zomi: Application hun khit a hong tungte kisaanglo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, count does not mean saying numbers; it means having importance or being included as valid.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah count in number sim cihna hilo a, thupi ahih kei leh a man in kisang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To depend on someone or something
senses.definition_en: To trust or depend on someone or something for help or support.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huhna leh panpihna ading mi ahih kei leh na khat muang ahih kei leh kinga cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You can count on me to help.
examples.zomi: Huhna ading kei hong muangthei hi.

examples.english: The community counts on volunteers.
examples.zomi: Khuami mipi in man neilo nasemte muang hi.

senses.usage_en: The phrasal verb is count on, followed by the person or thing depended upon.
senses.usage_zomi: Phrasal verb pen count on ahi a, a kimuan mi ahih kei leh na nungah hong pai hi.

senses.heading: A nation with its own territory and government
senses.definition_en: A nation or political territory with its own government, laws, and population.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ama gamgi, kumpi, daan leh mipi nei gamvai leigam ahi hi.

examples.english: Myanmar is a country in Southeast Asia.
examples.zomi: Myanmar pen Southeast Asia sung a gam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: People from many countries live in the city.
examples.zomi: Gam tampi pan mite khuapi ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A country may be called a state or nation in some contexts, but these words are not always exact synonyms.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu omdan pawlkhat ah gam khat state ahih kei leh nation kici thei napi, hih kammalte a khiatna kibang sitset lo hi.

senses.heading: Land outside towns and cities
senses.definition_en: Rural land away from large towns and cities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khua leh khuapi liante pualam a khuata, lo leh gamdai munte ahi hi.

examples.english: They moved from the city to the country.
examples.zomi: Khuapi pan khuata ah ki-uan uh hi.

examples.english: We drove along a quiet country road.
examples.zomi: Khuata lampi dai zui in mawtaw hawl ung.

senses.usage_en: Use the country for rural areas. Without the, country usually means a nation.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuata leh lo-gam gen dingin the country kizang hi. The tello country in gam khat gen zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Land outside towns and cities, especially areas with farms, fields, and natural scenery.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khua leh khuapi pualam ah om, lo, gamlak leh leitung pianzia kilawmna-te a tamna mun.

examples.english: They moved from the city to the countryside.
examples.zomi: Khuapi panin gamlak ah a kisuan uh hi.

examples.english: We enjoyed the beautiful countryside during our journey.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna sungin gamlak kilawm mahmah en nuam kasa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Countryside is usually uncountable and refers generally to rural land, not to one particular village.
senses.usage_zomi: Countryside pen simsawm theihloh min hi a, gamlak mun khempeuh kawk in kizang hi; khua khatbek kawklo hi.

senses.definition_en: A geographical or administrative area within a state or country.
senses.explanation_zomi: State ahi a, gam khat sung ahi zongin kumpi ukna leh gamkee khenna dingin kikhen sehseh ukna peng khat.

examples.english: The county government is building a new hospital.
examples.zomi: County ukna in zato inn thak khat lam hi.

examples.english: She lives in the next county.
examples.zomi: Ama pen gei county dang khat ah teng hi.

senses.usage_en: The meaning and function of a county differ between countries. In the United States, it is normally a division of a state.
senses.usage_zomi: County ukna leh a nasep pen gam simin kibanglo hi. United States ah state khat sung gamkee khenna khat hi.

senses.heading: Two people in a romantic relationship
senses.definition_en: Two people who are married or have a romantic relationship.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nupa; itna tawh kizom mi nih
senses.explanation_zomi: Kitengsa ahi a, itna tawh kizom mi nih.

examples.english: The young couple got married last month.
examples.zomi: Nupa khangno tegel kha beisa in kiteng uh hi.

examples.english: The couple live in a small apartment.
examples.zomi: Nupa tegel innkhan neu khat ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When couple means two people, it may take either a singular or plural verb depending on whether they are viewed as one unit or as two individuals.
senses.usage_zomi: Couple in mi nih a kawk ciangin, a kigawm khat bangin en leh singular verb kizang a, mi nih tuamtuam bangin en leh plural verb kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Two or a small number
senses.definition_en: Two things or a small number of things or people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na nih, mi nih, ahih keileh tawmno khat.

examples.english: I need a couple of minutes to finish this work.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep zohna dingin dakika tawmno kisam ing.

examples.english: She asked me a couple of questions.
examples.zomi: Ama in dotna nih khawng hong dong hi.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, a couple of can mean exactly two or simply a small number.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim kampau ah a couple of in nih taktak ahih keileh tawmno khat a cihna ahi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The ability to face danger, pain, or difficulty without giving in to fear.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina, natna, ahih keileh haksatna om napi lungkia hetlo in maingat ngamna.

examples.english: She showed great courage during the crisis.
examples.zomi: Haksatna lianpi sungin ama in hangsanna lianpi lak hi.

examples.english: He finally found the courage to tell the truth.
examples.zomi: A tawpna ah thumaan gen ngamna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Courage is normally uncountable. A person has courage or shows courage; we do not normally say a courage.
senses.usage_zomi: Courage pen simsawm theihloh min hi. Mi khat in hangsanna nei ahih keileh hangsanna lak kici a, a courage ci in kizang ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: A series of lessons
senses.definition_en: A planned series of lessons about a particular subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Subject khat pilna dingin a kizom in kisin dingin geelkholh sinna khen khat.

examples.english: She is taking an English course this semester.
examples.zomi: Hih semester sungin English course khat sin hi.

examples.english: The training course lasts six weeks.
examples.zomi: Siamna sinna course in kal guk sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: In education, course can mean one subject studied for a period or a complete program of study, depending on the education system.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna ah course in hun khat sung sinna subject khat a kawk thei a, pilna system dungzui in sinna program kicing khat zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: A direction or route
senses.definition_en: The direction or route that someone or something follows.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahi a, na khat ahi zongin a paihna lampi leh a zuatna lam.

examples.english: The ship changed course to avoid the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi pelhna dingin tembaw in a paihna lam khe hi.

examples.english: The river follows a winding course through the valley.
examples.zomi: Gun in kuam sungah kawi kawikawi in luang hi.

senses.usage_en: Course is also used figuratively for the progress or development of an event.
senses.usage_zomi: Course pen thu khat a pianzia leh a ma khang toto dan genna dingin zong limpuak in kizang hi.

senses.heading: A place where legal cases are decided
senses.definition_en: A place or official body where a judge decides legal cases.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhenpa in thukham tawh kisai thu khenna mun ahih keileh kumpi thukhenna pawl.

examples.english: The case will return to court next week.
examples.zomi: Tua thukhenna thu pen maikal in thukhenna inn ah kikum kik ding hi.

examples.english: She told the court what she had seen.
examples.zomi: Ama in a muhsa thu thukhenna maiah gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Court may mean the building, the judge and officials, or the legal process itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Court in thukhenna inn, thukhenpa leh uliante, ahih keileh thukhenna nasep mahmah kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: An area for playing a sport
senses.definition_en: A marked area where games such as tennis or basketball are played.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tennis, basketball leh kimawlna dang kimawlna dingin a ciapteh mun.

examples.english: The players walked onto the court.
examples.zomi: Kimawlte kimawlna mun sungah lut uh hi.

examples.english: A new basketball court was built near the school.
examples.zomi: Sang gei ah basketball kimawlna mun thak khat kilam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use court for sports such as tennis and basketball, but field or pitch for many outdoor team sports.
senses.usage_zomi: Tennis leh basketball bang kimawlna ah court kizang a, pualam ah pawl tawh kimawlna tampi ah field ahih keileh pitch kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A child of your aunt or uncle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na ni ahih keileh na pupate’ tapa leh tanu.

examples.english: My cousin lives in another state.
examples.zomi: Ka sanggam ta state dang khat ah teng hi.

examples.english: We played together with our cousins during the holiday.
examples.zomi: Khawl hunin ka sanggam tate uh tawh kikhawm in kimawl khawm ung.

senses.usage_en: English uses cousin for both males and females. Add male or female only when that distinction is important.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah cousin pen pasal leh numei a tuamtuam in khenlo hi. Numei leh pasal khenna kisap bek ciangin male cousin ahih keileh female cousin kici hi.

senses.heading: To put something over or around something else
senses.definition_en: To place something over or around an object or person in order to protect, hide, or enclose it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat dal, seel, hu, ahih keileh vengna dingin a tungah na dang khat koihna.

examples.english: Cover the food to keep the flies away.
examples.zomi: Siktui-te hong tunlohna dingin an seel in.

examples.english: She covered the child with a warm blanket.
examples.zomi: Ama in naupang pen puan lum tawh hu hi.

senses.usage_en: Cover something with something names the material placed over it. Cover something up often suggests hiding it completely or concealing a fact.
senses.usage_zomi: Cover something with something in a huhna van a gen hi. Cover something up in na khat sitset in seel ahih keileh thu maan khat phawkloh dingin seel cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: To include or deal with a subject
senses.definition_en: To include, discuss, report, or deal with a particular subject or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu khat, thu piang khat, ahih keileh mun khat tel in hilh, gen, laigelh, ahih keileh report bawl.

examples.english: This course covers basic computer skills.
examples.zomi: Hih course in computer zat siamna bulphuhte hilh hi.

examples.english: Several reporters covered the election.
examples.zomi: Thuthang gelh mi pawlkhat in teelna thu report bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, cover means including enough information about a subject, not physically placing something over it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah cover in na khat a tungah na dang khat koih cihna hilo a, thulu khat tawh kisai thu a huamzah in gen cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Having something spread over, placed over, or surrounding it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tawh kihusa, kidalsa, kiseelsa, ahih keileh a tuamkim in kizelsa.

examples.english: The ground was covered with snow.
examples.zomi: Lei pen vuk tawh a vekpi in kihusa hi.

examples.english: His clothes were covered in mud.
examples.zomi: A puante pen buan tawh kizel dim hi.

senses.usage_en: Both covered in and covered with are common. Covered in often emphasizes that something is spread all over a surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Covered in leh covered with tegel kizang thei hi. Covered in in na khat a mai khempeuh ah na dang khat kizel dim cihna a khauh zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A large female farm animal kept for milk, meat, or breeding.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nawi, sa leh ta neihna dingin kivul gan numei lian khat.

examples.english: The farmer milks the cows every morning.
examples.zomi: Lo neipa in zingsang simin vawngte’ nawi suah hi.

examples.english: The cow is feeding its calf.
examples.zomi: Vawng numei in a note nawi pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Strictly, a cow is an adult female. An adult male is a bull, and the general term is cattle.
senses.usage_zomi: A khiatna maan takin cow pen vawng numei picing hi. Vawng pasal picing pen bull kici a, vawng khempeuh huam in cattle kici hi.

senses.heading: A violent accident
senses.definition_en: An accident in which a vehicle hits something or another vehicle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw, vanleng, ahih keileh vankhat in na dang khat tawh nasatak in kituak in a suksiatna.

examples.english: Two people were injured in the car crash.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw kituahna ah mi nih liam uh hi.

examples.english: Investigators are trying to discover the cause of the plane crash.
examples.zomi: Vanleng a kisia ziang thu kanmite in kan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Crash emphasizes a sudden, violent collision. Accident is a broader word and may describe less serious events.
senses.usage_zomi: Crash in thakhatthu in nasatak in kituahna kawk hi. Accident pen a huamzai zaw a, alauhuai hetlo thu piang zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: A sudden computer failure
senses.definition_en: A sudden failure that causes a computer or program to stop working.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer ahih keileh program khat thakhatthu in nasem theilo in khawlna.

examples.english: The computer crash caused us to lose some files.
examples.zomi: Computer a khawlvat manin file pawlkhat mangsak ung.

examples.english: Save your work regularly in case of a system crash.
examples.zomi: System a kisia kha ding venna in na nasep tawntung save in.

senses.usage_en: For computers, crash can be both a noun and a verb: a system crash; the system crashed.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer tawh kisai ah crash pen noun leh verb in kizang thei hi: a system crash leh the system crashed.

senses.heading: Very foolish, strange, or unreasonable
senses.definition_en: Extremely foolish, unusual, or difficult to believe.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna omlo bang, lamdang mahmah, ahih keileh uploh ding zah a mawkna.

examples.english: It would be crazy to drive in this storm.
examples.zomi: Hih huihpi sungah mawtaw hawl pen mawkna ahi ding hi.

examples.english: That sounds like a crazy idea, but it might work.
examples.zomi: Tua ngaihsutna mawk bangin ging napi, tangtun thei ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Avoid using crazy as a medical description of someone with a mental-health condition. It may sound disrespectful.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungpilna cidamna buaina nei mi khat pulakna dingin crazy zat pelh hoih hi; mi simmawhna bangin zakha thei hi.

senses.heading: Very enthusiastic about something
senses.definition_en: Extremely interested in or enthusiastic about someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh na khat tungah lunglut mahmah in it mahmah.

examples.english: My brother is crazy about basketball.
examples.zomi: Ka sanggampa basketball tungah lunglut mahmah hi.

examples.english: The children went crazy over the new game.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in kimawlna thak lunglut mahmah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Be crazy about is informal and usually means to like someone or something very much.
senses.usage_zomi: Be crazy about pen nisim kampau hi a, mi khat ahih keileh na khat it mahmah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The thick, fatty part of milk
senses.definition_en: The thick part of milk that contains a large amount of fat.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nawi sunga thau a tam, a sahzaw nawi khen.

examples.english: She added cream to her coffee.
examples.zomi: Ama in a coffee sungah cream beh hi.

examples.english: The cake is filled with fresh cream.
examples.zomi: Mukhom sungah cream thak kidim hi.

senses.usage_en: In this meaning, cream is normally uncountable. Do not say a cream when referring to food.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah cream pen simsawm theihloh min hi. Annek cream a kawk ciangin a cream kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: A soft substance put on the skin
senses.definition_en: A smooth substance applied to the skin for treatment, protection, or beauty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vun damsakna, kepna, ahih keileh melhoihna dingin vun tungah kinuh na neem.

examples.english: Apply the cream twice a day.
examples.zomi: Ni khat in nih vei cream nuh in.

examples.english: This cream protects your skin from the sun.
examples.zomi: Hih cream in ni pan na vun kem hi.

senses.usage_en: A medicinal cream is countable when referring to a type or container: The doctor prescribed a cream.
senses.usage_zomi: Damlopna ding cream pen cream nam khat ahih keileh a bawm khat a kawk ciangin simsawm theih min ahi thei hi: The doctor prescribed a cream.

senses.definition_en: To make something new or cause something to exist.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na thak khat bawl, piangsak, ahih keileh omlo pan omsak.

examples.english: The new business will create more jobs.
examples.zomi: Sum nasepna thak in nasepna tampizaw piangsak ding hi.

examples.english: She created a useful learning app.
examples.zomi: Ama in pilna ding app phatuam khat bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Create often suggests producing something new. Make is more general and can describe many ordinary actions.
senses.usage_zomi: Create in na thak khat piangsak cihna a nei hi. Make pen a huamzai zaw a, nisim bawlna nam tampi genna dingin kizang hi.

senses.heading: The act of making something
senses.definition_en: The act or process of making something new.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na thak khat bawlna ahih keileh piangsakna nasep.

examples.english: The project supports the creation of new jobs.
examples.zomi: Hih geelna in nasepna thak piansakna huh hi.

examples.english: The creation of the website took several months.
examples.zomi: Website bawlna in kha pawlkhat sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: When creation describes an activity or process, it is often followed by of: the creation of a new program.
senses.usage_zomi: Creation in bawlna nasep a kawk ciangin of tawh kizom zel hi: the creation of a new program.

senses.heading: Something that has been made
senses.definition_en: Something produced by a person’s skill, thought, or imagination.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a siamna, ngaihsutna, ahih keileh a lungsim mitkha tawh a bawlsa na.

examples.english: This painting is one of her finest creations.
examples.zomi: Hih lim pen ama’ bawlsa hoihpen lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The machine was the inventor’s greatest creation.
examples.zomi: Tua van pen a bawlpa’ bawlsa lianpen ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A countable creation is the result of creative work, while uncountable creation refers to the process.
senses.usage_zomi: Simsawm theih creation in bawlkhit na khat kawk a, simsawm theihloh creation in bawlna nasep kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Able to produce new and imaginative ideas, designs, or works.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna thak, lim thak, ahih keileh nasep thak a lungsim mitkha tawh bawlkhia thei.

common_phrases.zomi: siamna leh lungsim mitkha tawh bawl nasep

examples.english: The students found a creative solution to the problem.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in buaina vengna ding ngaihsutna thak hoih khat mu uh hi.

examples.english: She is a highly creative artist.
examples.zomi: Ama pen lungsim mitkha nei mahmah lim bawl siam khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Creative describes originality and imagination. It does not simply mean that someone makes something.
senses.usage_zomi: Creative in ngaihsutna thak leh lungsim mitkha tawh bawltheihna kawk hi. Mi khat in na khat a bawl bek tawh creative kici pahlo hi.

senses.definition_en: A living being, especially an animal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuntakna nei piansaksa, a diakin ganhing khat.

examples.english: Many strange creatures live in the deep ocean.
examples.zomi: Tuipi thuk sungah ganhing lamdang tampi nungta hi.

examples.english: We should treat every living creature with care.
examples.zomi: Nuntakna nei piansaksa khempeuh don leh kep ding i hi.

senses.usage_en: Creature is often used for animals, especially when their exact species is unknown. It can include humans in formal or religious contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Creature pen a gan nam taktak kitheihloh ciangin ganhing genna dingin kizang zel hi. Formal ahih keileh biakna tawh kisai thu ah mihing zong huam thei hi.

senses.heading: Praise or recognition
senses.definition_en: Praise or public recognition given to someone for something they have done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a nasep hoih manin pahtawina leh a minthanpiakna.

common_phrases.zomi: nasep khat ama’ bawl bangin minla

examples.english: She deserves credit for improving the program.
examples.zomi: Program a hoihzaw sak manin ama pahtawih taak hi.

examples.english: He took credit for work that others had done.
examples.zomi: Midangte’ bawlsa nasep ama’ bawl bangin a min la hi.

senses.usage_en: Give someone credit for something means recognizing that person’s contribution. Take credit may be negative if the work was done by someone else.
senses.usage_zomi: Give someone credit for something in mi khat a panpihna leh nasep pawm in pahtawi cihna ahi hi. Nasep pen midang bawl ahih hang take credit leh hoihlo khiatna nei hi.

senses.heading: An arrangement to receive something now and pay later
senses.definition_en: An arrangement that allows someone to buy or borrow money now and pay it back later.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu laitak in sum ahih keileh van ngah masa in nungciang a thukna dingin kithukimna.

examples.english: They bought the furniture on credit.
examples.zomi: Inn vante leiba tawh lei uh hi.

examples.english: Paying bills on time helps you build good credit.
examples.zomi: Hun maan in leiba piak in leiba thuk lamah minhoihna neisak hi.

senses.usage_en: Financial credit is normally uncountable. A credit card is a card used to borrow money for purchases.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum tawh kisai credit pen simsawm theihloh min hi. Credit card pen van leihna ding sum lohna card ahi hi.

senses.heading: A unit showing completed study
senses.definition_en: A unit that shows a student has successfully completed part of a course.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sangnaupang khat in sinna khen khat a zohkhitna leh a tangtun kal a lakna.

examples.english: This class gives students three college credits.
examples.zomi: Hih class in sangnaupangte college credit thum pia hi.

examples.english: She needs six more credits to graduate.
examples.zomi: Sangzawhna dingin credit guk kisam lai hi.

senses.usage_en: Educational credits are countable: one credit, three credits.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna tawh kisai credit pen simsawm theih hi: one credit, three credits.

senses.definition_en: A group of people who work together, especially on a ship, aircraft, or production.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diakin tembaw, vanleng, ahih keileh film bawlna ah khat tawh khat kizom in nasem pawl.

examples.english: The flight crew welcomed the passengers.
examples.zomi: Vanleng nasem pawl in khualzinte na lungdam takin sang uh hi.

examples.english: A film crew arrived early this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsangin film bawl pawl hong tung baih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Crew is a collective noun. It may take a singular or plural verb depending on whether the group is viewed as one unit or as individual members.
senses.usage_zomi: Crew pen pawl min hi. Pawl khat bangin en leh singular verb kizang a, pawl sung mite tuamtuam bangin en leh plural verb kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: An illegal act
senses.definition_en: An action that breaks the law and can be punished by the state.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi thukham palsatna leh thukham dungzui in gimpiak theih gamtatna.

examples.english: The police are investigating the crime.
examples.zomi: Police-te in mawhna thu kan uh hi.

examples.english: He was punished for committing a serious crime.
examples.zomi: Mawhna lianpi a bawl manin gim kipia hi.

senses.usage_en: Crime can be countable for a particular illegal act and uncountable when referring to illegal activity generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Mawhna khat a kawk ciangin crime pen simsawm theih hi. Thukham palsat gamtatna khempeuh a huam ciangin simsawm theihloh min ahi hi.

senses.heading: Illegal activity in general
senses.definition_en: Illegal activity considered as a social problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing khawlbawlna sung buaina khat ahi thukham palsatna gamtatna khempeuh.

examples.english: The city is taking steps to reduce crime.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in mawhna tawm sakna dingin kalsuan hi.

examples.english: Better lighting may help prevent crime at night.
examples.zomi: Zan khuavak hoihzaw in mawhna kham thei ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this general meaning, do not use a: say Crime is increasing, not A crime is increasing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih a huamzai khiatna ah a kizanglo hi: Crime is increasing kici a, A crime is increasing kici lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who commits a crime.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi thukham palsat in mawhna bawl mi.

common_phrases.zomi: mawhnei taktak ci in thukhen mawhbawl mi

examples.english: The police arrested the criminal yesterday.
examples.zomi: Police-te in zani in mawhbawl mi pen man uh hi.

examples.english: The court sent the convicted criminal to prison.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna in mawhnei ci in kikhen mi pen thong sungah sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use criminal only when someone has committed a crime. Avoid using it merely for a person who has been accused but not convicted.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat in mawhna a bawl taktak ciangbekin criminal kizang ding hi. Mawhpuhna a thuak bek, mawhnei ci in a kikhensalo mi kawkna dingin zat loh ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A time of great danger, difficulty, or uncertainty that requires urgent action.
senses.zomi_equivalents: haksat hun; lauhuai hun; buaina lian
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina, haksatna, ahih keileh lungsim khensat haksa mahmah in thakhatthu khutzat kisap hun.

examples.english: The country is facing a serious economic crisis.
examples.zomi: Gam in sumlehpai haksatna lianpi maingat hi.

examples.english: Good leadership is especially important during a crisis.
examples.zomi: Haksat hunin makaihna hoih kisam mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural of crisis is crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/, not crisises.
senses.usage_zomi: Crisis a plural pen crises /ˈkraɪsiːz/ ahi a, crisises hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A standard used for judging, comparing, or deciding something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat thukhenna, etkakna, ahih keileh teelna dingin kizang tehna.

examples.english: Experience is an important criterion for this job.
examples.zomi: Hih nasepna dingin muhkhakna nei pen tehna thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Each application is judged according to the same criteria.
examples.zomi: Ngetna laikhakte tehna kibang tawh khen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Criterion is singular. Its plural is criteria: one criterion, several criteria.
senses.usage_zomi: Criterion pen singular hi. A plural pen criteria ahi hi: one criterion, several criteria.

senses.heading: A person who professionally judges artistic work
senses.definition_en: A person whose job is to evaluate and write or speak about books, films, music, art, or performances.
senses.zomi_equivalents: bawlna khen siam; lai leh kunst khen mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, film, la, kunst, ahih keileh limlakna-te a hoih leh a hoihloh khen in a gelh ahih keileh a gen mi.

examples.english: The film received praise from several critics.
examples.zomi: Film pen film khen mi pawlkhat in phat uh hi.

examples.english: She works as a music critic for a newspaper.
examples.zomi: Ama thuthang laibu khat ah la khen mi in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: A professional critic evaluates both strengths and weaknesses; the word does not always mean someone who dislikes the work.
senses.usage_zomi: Siamsa critic in nasep khat a hoihna leh a hoihlohna tegel khen hi; nasep pen a deihloh mi cihna bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: A person who expresses disapproval
senses.definition_en: A person who frequently criticizes or opposes someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh na khat a mawkmawhna leh a langdona a gen zel mi.

common_phrases.english: a strong critic of the government

examples.english: He is a strong critic of the new policy.
examples.zomi: Ama pen thukhun thak a langdo mahmah mi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The company’s critics demanded an explanation.
examples.zomi: Company mawhsiam mite in hilhcian ding ngen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A critic of something is a person who publicly expresses disagreement or disapproval.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat critic of mi in tua na a langdona ahih keileh a mawhsiamna mipite maiah gen hi.

senses.heading: Expressing disapproval or identifying faults
senses.definition_en: Showing that you believe someone or something has faults or problems.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh na khat a khialhna leh a hoihlohna om ci in mawkmawhna.

examples.english: The report was critical of the company’s safety practices.
examples.zomi: Report in company’ bitna nasepzia mawhsiam hi.

examples.english: She is often too critical of herself.
examples.zomi: Ama in amah leh amah kisik mahmah zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Be critical of means expressing disapproval. It is different from critical thinking, which means careful and analytical thinking.
senses.usage_zomi: Be critical of in mawhsiam cihna ahi hi. Critical thinking ahihleh pilvang takin kan in ngaihsutna cihna hi.

senses.heading: Extremely important
senses.definition_en: Very important to the success or result of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tangtun leh tangtunloh khensat thei zahin thupi mahmah.

examples.english: Clear communication is critical to the project’s success.
examples.zomi: Geelna a tangtun nadingin kizopna kician thupi mahmah hi.

examples.english: The next few hours will be critical.
examples.zomi: Nai tawmno hong tung dingte thupi mahmah ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, critical is stronger than important and suggests that the result may depend on it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah critical pen important sangin khauh zaw a, a thu piang ding pen tua tungah kinga ci in lak hi.

senses.heading: Seriously ill or dangerous
senses.definition_en: Extremely serious and possibly life-threatening.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasatak in lauhuai a, sihna dong piangsak thei dinmun.

examples.english: The patient remains in critical condition.
examples.zomi: Cinate cidamna dinmun lauhuai mahah om lai hi.

examples.english: Two people were critically injured in the crash.
examples.zomi: Kituahna ah mi nih nasatak in liam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In medical contexts, critical means that a person’s condition is extremely serious and requires close care.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna tawh kisai ah critical in cina dinmun lauhuai mahmah a, nai takin don leh kep kisam cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Disapproval based on faults or problems
senses.definition_en: Comments that express disapproval by pointing out faults or problems.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh na khat a khialhna leh a hoihlohna genna.

examples.english: The decision received strong criticism from the public.
examples.zomi: Khensatna pen mipite in mawhsiam mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: She accepted the criticism and corrected her mistake.
examples.zomi: Ama in mawhsiamna sang a, a khialhna puah hi.

senses.usage_en: Criticism is usually uncountable when referring generally to disapproval. A particular critical comment can be called a criticism.
senses.usage_zomi: Mawhsiamna khempeuh a huam ciangin criticism pen simsawm theihloh min hi. Mawhsiam kammal khatbek a kawk ciangin a criticism kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Careful evaluation of art or literature
senses.definition_en: The study and evaluation of literature, art, music, or similar work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, kunst, la leh bawlna dangte a hoihna leh a hoihlohna kan in khenna.

examples.english: She studied literary criticism at college.
examples.zomi: Ama in college ah laibu khenna sin hi.

examples.english: The article offers thoughtful criticism of the novel.
examples.zomi: Laigelh in tangthu laibu pen pilvang takin khen hi.

senses.usage_en: In academic contexts, criticism means analysis and evaluation, not simply negative judgment.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna tawh kisai ah criticism in a hoihlo ci in mawhsiam bek hilo a, a thu thuk takin kan in khen cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To express disapproval of someone or something by pointing out faults or problems.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh na khat a khialhna leh a hoihlohna pulak in mawhsiam.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat manin mi khat mawhsiam

examples.english: Several experts criticized the government’s decision.
examples.zomi: Siamna nei mi pawlkhat in kumpi khensatna mawhsiam uh hi.

examples.english: Do not criticize someone without understanding the situation.
examples.zomi: Dinmun thei hetlo in mi khat mawhsiam kei in.

senses.usage_en: The normal pattern is criticize someone or something for something: They criticized him for arriving late.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan ngeina pen criticize someone or something for something ahi hi: They criticized him for arriving late.

senses.heading: A plant grown for food or another useful product
senses.definition_en: A plant grown by farmers in large amounts for food, materials, or sale.
senses.explanation_zomi: Annek, van bawlna, ahih keileh zuakna dingin lo neite in a tampi in a khawng singkung leh ankung.

examples.english: Rice is the main crop in this region.
examples.zomi: Hih gamkee ah tang pen lo an thupi pen ahi hi.

examples.english: Farmers grow several crops during the rainy season.
examples.zomi: Gua khuahun sungin lo neite in lo an nam tuamtuam khawng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Crop can refer to one kind of cultivated plant, while crops refers to several kinds or cultivated plants generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Crop in lo an nam khat kawk a, crops in lo an nam tuamtuam ahih keileh lo a khawng an khempeuh kawk hi.

senses.heading: The amount harvested in one season
senses.definition_en: The total amount of a particular farm product gathered during a season.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuahun khat sungin lo pan a kikholh an nam khat a vekpi.

examples.english: Heavy rain damaged this year’s corn crop.
examples.zomi: Gua tampi in kum hih sunga mangbuh ngah ding susia hi.

examples.english: The farm produced a good crop of tomatoes.
examples.zomi: Lo pan tomato tampi ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, crop refers to the harvest or yield, not only to the plants themselves.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah crop in lo a kungte bek hilo a, a pan a ngah an zah a kawk hi.

senses.heading: To go from one side to the other
senses.definition_en: To move from one side of a place, road, river, or area to the other side.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi, gun, mun, ahih keileh gam khat langkhat pan langkhat ah kantan.

examples.english: Look both ways before you cross the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi na kantan ma in langnih en masa in.

examples.english: The family crossed the border safely.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in bit takin gamgi kantan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Cross is transitive in this sense, so it takes a direct object: cross the street. Do not say cross across the street.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah cross in direct object nei hi: cross the street. Cross across the street ci in kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: To make two lines or paths pass over each other
senses.definition_en: To place one thing over another so that they form an X shape, or to pass across another line or path.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na nih khat leh khat a tungah kantan sak in X lim bangin koih.

common_phrases.zomi: na khut nih kikhai in koih
na khe nih kikhai in koih

examples.english: She crossed her arms and waited.
examples.zomi: Ama in a khut nih kikhai in koih a, ngak hi.

examples.english: The two roads cross near the school.
examples.zomi: Lampi tegel sang gei ah kikantan hi.

senses.usage_en: Cross your fingers is also an idiom meaning to hope that something will happen successfully.
senses.usage_zomi: Cross your fingers pen pauciamna zong ahi a, na khat hoih takin tangtun ding lam-en cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A large group of people gathered closely together in one place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah mi tampi a nai nai in a kikhopna pawl.

examples.english: A large crowd gathered outside the building.
examples.zomi: Inn pualam ah mipi tampi kikhawm uh hi.

examples.english: She disappeared into the crowd.
examples.zomi: Ama mipi lakah lut in kimuh nawnlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Crowd is a collective noun. It may take a singular or plural verb depending on whether the people are viewed as one group or as individuals.
senses.usage_zomi: Crowd pen pawl min hi. Pawl khat bangin en leh singular verb kizang a, pawl sunga mite tuamtuam bangin en leh plural verb kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Filled with too many people or objects, leaving little space.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh van a tamlua manin omna mun tawm bek a omlai dinmun.

examples.english: The train was crowded during the morning rush.
examples.zomi: Zingsang nasep kai hunin train sunga mi kitungtang hi.

examples.english: The market becomes crowded on weekends.
examples.zomi: Kal tawp ciangin zuakna mun mi kidim zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Use crowded with before the people or objects filling a place: The beach was crowded with visitors.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun khat a dimsakte genna dingin crowded with kizang hi: The beach was crowded with visitors.

senses.definition_en: Extremely important because the success or result of something depends on it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a tangtun leh a tangtunloh a tungah kinga ahih manin thupi mahmah.

examples.english: Good communication is crucial to the success of the project.
examples.zomi: Geelna a tangtun nadingin kizopna hoih thupi mahmah hi.

examples.english: The final interview will be crucial in choosing the right candidate.
examples.zomi: Teel ding mi maan teelna ah a nunungpen kiholimna thupi mahmah ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Crucial is stronger than important. Use it when something may determine the final result.
senses.usage_zomi: Crucial pen important sangin khauh zaw hi. Na khat in a tawpna thu piang ding khensat thei ciangin kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Willing to cause pain or suffering, or showing no concern for another person’s suffering.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang na sak, bawlsia, ahih keileh a thuakna donlo in gamta.

examples.english: It is cruel to hurt animals for fun.
examples.zomi: Nuam kisa dingin ganhingte bawlsia pen ngongtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: The prisoners received cruel treatment.
examples.zomi: Thongkiate ngongtat takin kibawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Cruel describes a person, action, or situation that deliberately or carelessly causes suffering. Unkind is usually less severe.
senses.usage_zomi: Cruel in lungsim takpi tawh ahih keileh donlohna tawh midang thuaksak mi, gamtatna, leh dinmun kawk hi. Unkind pen a nemzaw hi.

senses.heading: To produce tears because of emotion or pain
senses.definition_en: To have tears come from your eyes because you are sad, hurt, frightened, or strongly moved.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dahna, natna, launa, ahih keileh lungsim sukna khauh manin mittui luangsak.

examples.english: The child began to cry when his mother left.
examples.zomi: A nu a paikhiat ciangin naupang kap kipan hi.

examples.english: She cried with happiness when she heard the news.
examples.zomi: Thuthang a zak ciangin lungdamna tawh kap hi.

senses.usage_en: Cry can express sadness, pain, fear, relief, or happiness. The reason is often introduced with with, from, or because.
senses.usage_zomi: Cry in dahna, natna, launa, lungnopna, ahih keileh lungdamna lak thei hi. A ziang thu genna dingin with, from, ahih keileh because kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: To shout or call loudly
senses.definition_en: To say or shout something in a loud voice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw ngai takin sap, kiko, ahih keileh thu khat gen.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat min ngai takin sap

examples.english: He cried for help when he fell into the river.
examples.zomi: Gun sungah a puk ciangin huhna ngen in kiko hi.

examples.english: “Stop!” she cried.
examples.zomi: “Khawl in!” ci in ama ngai takin kiko hi.

senses.usage_en: This use of cry is more common in written stories than in ordinary conversation. In everyday speech, shout or call is often more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih cry zatdan pen nisim kiholimna sangin tangthu gelhna ah kizang tamzaw hi. Nisim kampau ah shout ahih keileh call zat a ngeinazaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Connected with the beliefs, customs, arts, and way of life of a society or group.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngeina tawh kisai; miphun nuntakzia tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi pawl khat upna, ngeina, kunst, leh nuntakzia tawh kisai.

common_phrases.zomi: pu leh pate kiang pan ngeina gamh

examples.english: The festival celebrates the community’s cultural heritage.
examples.zomi: Pawi in khawlsung mipite’ ngeina gamh phawkna bawl hi.

examples.english: We should respect cultural differences.
examples.zomi: Ngeina kilamdanna-te zahtak ding i hi.

senses.usage_en: Cultural concerns a group’s shared way of life. It does not necessarily refer only to traditional clothing, food, or festivals.
senses.usage_zomi: Cultural in mipi pawl khat in a neihkhawm nuntakzia kawk hi. Puansilh, annek, leh pawi ngeina bek kawklo hi.

senses.heading: A society’s shared way of life
senses.definition_en: The beliefs, customs, language, arts, and way of life shared by a society or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Miphun ahih keileh mipi pawl khat in a neihkhawm upna, ngeina, pau, kunst leh nuntakzia.

examples.english: Language is an important part of Zomi culture.
examples.zomi: Pau pen Zomi ngeina khen thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The museum helps preserve local culture.
examples.zomi: Museum in tua gam ngeina kepcingna ah panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Culture may refer to the shared life of a whole society or to the traditions of a particular group.
senses.usage_zomi: Culture in mipi khempeuh neihkhawm nuntakzia kawk thei a, pawl khatbek ngeina zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: The arts and intellectual activities
senses.definition_en: Art, music, literature, theatre, and other activities valued by a society.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kunst leh pilna nasep; laibu leh limlak ngeina
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi in manpha a sak kunst, la, laibu, limlakna leh pilna nasep dangte.

examples.english: The city is known for its art and culture.
examples.zomi: Khuapi pen a kunst leh ngeina manin minthang hi.

examples.english: The program introduces young people to music and culture.
examples.zomi: Program in khangnote la leh kunst tawh kitheisak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, culture includes creative and intellectual activities, not every part of daily life.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah culture in lungsim mitkha leh pilna tawh kisai nasepte huam a, nisim nuntakzia khempeuh huamlo hi.

senses.heading: A small container used for drinking
senses.definition_en: A small, usually round container with an open top, used for drinking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui, coffee, tea leh dawn ding dangte dawnna ding a kangneiawl, a neu no.

examples.english: Would you like a cup of coffee?
examples.zomi: Coffee no khat na dawn nuam diam?

examples.english: She filled the cup with water.
examples.zomi: Ama in no sung tui dimsak hi.

senses.usage_en: The container is countable, but the drink itself may be uncountable: a cup, but some coffee.
senses.usage_zomi: Dawnna no pen simsawm theih hi; a sung dawn ding ahihleh simsawm theihloh ahi thei hi: a cup, ahih hang some coffee.

senses.heading: A unit used in cooking
senses.definition_en: A standard amount used for measuring food or liquid in cooking.
senses.explanation_zomi: An bawl ciangin annek ahih keileh tui tehna ding zat tehna no khat.

examples.english: Add two cups of water to the pot.
examples.zomi: Beel sungah tui cup nih beh in.

examples.english: The recipe requires half a cup of sugar.
examples.zomi: An bawldan in sukha cup langkhat kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: A measuring cup is a fixed cooking measure, not simply any cup used for drinking.
senses.usage_zomi: An bawlna cup pen tehna a kikhensat khat ahi a, dawnna no bangbang hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A piece of furniture with shelves and doors, used for storing food, dishes, clothes, or other objects.
senses.zomi_equivalents: van koihna bawm; kuang koihna bawm
senses.explanation_zomi: Annek, kuang, puan, ahih keileh van dangte koihna ding kongkhak leh van koihna pang nei inn van.

examples.english: The plates are in the kitchen cupboard.
examples.zomi: Kuangte anhuan sunga van koihna bawm sungah om hi.

examples.english: She opened the cupboard and took out some rice.
examples.zomi: Ama in van koihna bawm hong a, tang tawmno lakhia hi.

senses.usage_en: The letters p and b in cupboard are not pronounced separately; it is pronounced /ˈkʌbərd/.
senses.usage_zomi: Cupboard sung p leh b tegel tuam in kipaukhia lo a, /ˈkʌbərd/ ci in kipau hi.

senses.heading: To make an illness or medical condition go away
senses.definition_en: To make a sick person healthy again or completely remove an illness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cina mi damsak kik ahih keileh natna khat susia in a om nawnlo sak.

examples.english: The medicine cured the infection.
examples.zomi: Si in natna kaat pen damsak hi.

examples.english: Doctors have not yet found a way to cure the disease.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te in tua natna damsakna ding lampi mu nailo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Cure means removing an illness completely. Treat means giving medical care and may not result in a complete cure.
senses.usage_zomi: Cure in natna a om nawnlo dong damsak cihna ahi hi. Treat in cidamna kepna pia cihna hi a, natna dam sitset cihna hituanlo hi.

senses.heading: To solve a problem or stop an undesirable condition
senses.definition_en: To remove or solve a continuing problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina ahih keileh dinmun hoihlo khat a ziang tawh a susia in veng.

examples.english: More money alone will not cure the problem.
examples.zomi: Sum tamzaw bek in buaina vengtheilo ding hi.

examples.english: The new policy is intended to cure weaknesses in the system.
examples.zomi: Thukhun thak pen system a thanemna-te puahna dingin kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is often figurative. It compares solving a social or practical problem to curing an illness.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen limpuak in kizang hi. Mihing khawlbawlna ahih keileh nisim buaina vengna pen natna damsakna tawh tehkak hi.

senses.definition_en: Formed into curves, rings, or loose circles rather than being straight.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zang hilo in a kawi kawi, a kizial zial, ahih keileh a kual kual pianzia nei.

examples.english: The child has thick, curly hair.
examples.zomi: Naupang in sam tam leh kawi nei hi.

examples.english: Her hair becomes curly when it is wet.
examples.zomi: A sam a ci ciangin kawi hi.

senses.usage_en: Curly most often describes hair, but it can also describe lines, leaves, ribbons, or other curved objects.
senses.usage_zomi: Curly pen sam genna dingin kizang tam hi. Ahih hang lai kawi, singteh, nakzang leh na kawi dangte zong kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The system or type of money officially used in a country.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam khat in sumtang maan in a zat sum nam ahih keileh a sum zatdan.

examples.english: The dollar is the official currency of the United States.
examples.zomi: Dollar pen United States gam sum maan ahi hi.

examples.english: You can exchange foreign currency at the bank.
examples.zomi: Bank ah gamdang sum na laih thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Currency can be countable when referring to different national money systems: several Asian currencies. Money is the more general everyday word.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam tuamtuam sum namte a kawk ciangin currency pen simsawm theih hi: several Asian currencies. Nisim kampau ah money pen a huamzai zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Existing, happening, or being used now.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tuhun; a om lai; a kizang lai
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun in a om, a piang, ahih keileh a kizang lai.

examples.english: The current situation requires careful planning.
examples.zomi: Tuhun dinmun in pilvang takin geelkholhna kisam hi.

examples.english: Please enter your current address.
examples.zomi: Tuhun na omna mun laigelh in.

senses.usage_en: Current means true or existing now. Do not confuse it with recent, which means happening a short time ago.
senses.usage_zomi: Current in tuhun a maan ahih keileh a om lai cihna ahi hi. Hun sawtlo beisa a piang cihna recent tawh helkhawm loh ding hi.

senses.definition_en: At the present time; now.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun laitak in; tuhun mahmah in.

examples.english: She is currently working in Ohio.
examples.zomi: Ama tuhun Ohio ah nasem hi.

examples.english: The service is currently unavailable.
examples.zomi: Tuhun laitak in tua nasepna kizang theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Currently usually appears before a main verb or after the verb be: currently works; is currently working.
senses.usage_zomi: Currently pen main verb ma ah ahih keileh be verb khit ah kizang zel hi: currently works; is currently working.

senses.definition_en: A piece of cloth that hangs over a window, doorway, or stage for privacy, decoration, or blocking light.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kongkhak puan; limlang puan; dalna puan
senses.explanation_zomi: Tua mun mi muhlohna, zeetna, ahih keileh khuavak dalna dingin kong, limlang, ahih keileh stage ah kikhai puan.

examples.english: She closed the curtains before going to bed.
examples.zomi: Ama ihma in limlang puante khaak hi.

examples.english: Sunlight came through the thin curtain.
examples.zomi: Puan vang sungpan ni khuavak hong lut hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, draw the curtains commonly means close them. To avoid confusion, learners can use open or close the curtains.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah draw the curtains in puan khaak cihna ahi zel hi. Kicianzaw dingin open the curtains ahih keileh close the curtains zat hoih hi.

senses.heading: A line or surface that bends smoothly
senses.definition_en: A line, edge, or surface that bends gradually rather than remaining straight.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zang ding sangin nem takin a kawi lai, a mong, ahih keileh a mai.

examples.english: Draw a smooth curve between the two points.
examples.zomi: Ciaptehna tegel kikal ah lai kawi neem khat suai in.

examples.english: The road follows the curve of the river.
examples.zomi: Lampi in gun a kawi dung zui hi.

senses.usage_en: A curve bends continuously. An angle is formed where two lines meet and change direction more sharply.
senses.usage_zomi: Curve pen kizom toto in nem takin kawi hi. Angle pen lai nih a kituahna leh a paihna lam thakhatthu a kikhelna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A bend in a road
senses.definition_en: A place where a road changes direction gradually.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lampi kawi; lampi a kawi lai
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi nem takin a kawi lai.

examples.english: Slow down before the sharp curve.
examples.zomi: Lampi kawi ngul na tun ma in mawtaw khawlsak in.

examples.english: A truck appeared around the curve.
examples.zomi: Lampi kawi langpan truck khat hong kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: A road curve is usually gradual. A sudden directional change may be called a sharp turn.
senses.usage_zomi: Lampi curve pen nem takin kawi zel hi. Thakhatthu in a kawi pen sharp turn kici thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a shape that bends smoothly and is not straight.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zanglo in nem takin a kawi pianzia nei.

examples.english: The building has a curved roof.
examples.zomi: Inn in innkhuh kawi nei hi.

examples.english: They followed a narrow, curved path through the forest.
examples.zomi: Gam sungah lampi cik leh kawi zui uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Curved describes the shape of something. Curly usually describes repeated curls or rings, especially in hair.
senses.usage_zomi: Curved in na khat pianzia a kawi cihna ahi hi. Curly in a kawi kawi ahih keileh a kizial zial, a diakin sam gen hi.

senses.heading: A traditional way of behaving
senses.definition_en: A traditional practice or way of behaving followed by a community or society.
senses.explanation_zomi: Miphun ahih keileh mipi pawl khat in khang tampi a zui ngeina leh gamtatdan.

examples.english: Removing your shoes before entering is a local custom.
examples.zomi: Inn sung lutma in khedap suah pen tua gam ngeina ahi hi.

examples.english: The community is trying to preserve its traditional customs.
examples.zomi: Khawlsung mipite in amau ngeina lui kemcing ding hanciam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A custom is a practice shared by a group. A habit is usually a repeated behavior of one person.
senses.usage_zomi: Custom pen pawl khat in a neihkhawm ngeina ahi hi. Habit pen mi khat in a bawl nawnnawn ngeina ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: The usual way a person behaves
senses.definition_en: A person’s established and usual practice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in hun sawtpi a zui in a bawl ngeina.

examples.english: As was her custom, she arrived early.
examples.zomi: A ngeina bangin ama hong tung baih hi.

examples.english: He made it his custom to read every morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsang simin simna pen ama’ ngeina suaksak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is somewhat formal. In everyday English, habit is often used for an individual’s repeated behavior.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen formal deuh hi. Nisim English ah mi khat a gamtat nawnnawn genna dingin habit kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A person or organization that buys goods or services from a business.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum nasepna khat kiang pan van leite ahih keileh nasepna zangte.

examples.english: The shop offers good service to its customers.
examples.zomi: Dawr in a leimite tungah nasepna hoih pia hi.

examples.english: She is a regular customer at this café.
examples.zomi: Ama hih café ah hong lei tawntung mi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A customer buys goods or services. A client usually receives professional or specialized services over a continuing period.
senses.usage_zomi: Customer in van ahih keileh nasepna lei hi. Client in siamsa nasepna ahih keileh a tuamdiak nasepna hun sawt deuh sang zel hi.

senses.heading: To divide or open something with a sharp tool
senses.definition_en: To use a knife, scissors, or another sharp tool to divide, shorten, or make an opening in something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tem, katna, ahih keileh van hiam dang tawh na khat tan, tomsak, ahih keileh phawng.

examples.english: Cut the vegetables into small pieces.
examples.zomi: Antuamte khen neu neute in tan in.

examples.english: Be careful not to cut your finger.
examples.zomi: Na khutme kat kha lo dingin pilvang in.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle of cut are also cut: cut–cut–cut.
senses.usage_zomi: Cut a past tense leh past participle zong cut mah ahi hi: cut–cut–cut.

senses.heading: To remove part of something
senses.definition_en: To remove part of something by using a sharp tool or by shortening it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat khen khat tan in lakhia ahih keileh tomsak.

examples.english: I need to cut my hair this week.
examples.zomi: Hih kal sungin ka sam metsak kul hi.

examples.english: He cut a dead branch from the tree.
examples.zomi: Singkung pan sing hiang keu khat tankhia hi.

senses.usage_en: When another person shortens your hair, English commonly says I had my hair cut, not I cut my hair, unless you did it yourself.
senses.usage_zomi: Midang in na sam hong met leh English ah I had my hair cut kici zel hi. I cut my hair cih leh nangmah in na sam na met cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To reduce an amount, number, cost, or activity
senses.definition_en: To make an amount, cost, number, or activity smaller.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, zat, man, ahih keileh nasep khat tawm sak.

examples.english: The company plans to cut costs next year.
examples.zomi: Company in kumkik in sum zatna tawm sak ding geelkhol hi.

examples.english: We need to cut our use of electricity.
examples.zomi: Meikhu zatna i tawm sak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, cut often means reducing something significantly. Cut down on means using or doing less of something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah cut in na khat zat a tampi in tawm sak cihna nei zel hi. Cut down on in na khat zat ahih keileh bawl tawm sak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To wound the skin
senses.definition_en: To make a wound in the skin with something sharp.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van hiam tawh vun phel in liamsak.

examples.english: She cut her hand while preparing dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak an a bawl laitak in a khut kat hi.

examples.english: I cut myself on a broken glass.
examples.zomi: Limlang a kitam tawh ka vun ka kat hi.

senses.usage_en: Cut can be transitive (I cut my hand) or reflexive (I cut myself).
senses.usage_zomi: Cut pen transitive in (I cut my hand) ahih keileh reflexive in (I cut myself) kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: A series of events that repeats in the same order
senses.definition_en: A group of events or changes that happen repeatedly in the same order.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pianna kizung; kizom in piang nawnnawnna
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang ahih keileh kikhelna pawlkhat a kibang kik in kizom toto in a piang nawnnawn.

common_phrases.zomi: sum nasepna khang leh kiamna kizung

examples.english: Water moves through a continuous natural cycle.
examples.zomi: Tui pen leitung pianzia sunga pianna kizung tawplo khat sungah kihei hi.

examples.english: The insect completes its life cycle in one month.
examples.zomi: Tua khu in a nuntakna pianna kizung kha khat sungin zo hi.

senses.usage_en: A cycle returns to its starting stage and begins again. A process may move forward without repeating.
senses.usage_zomi: Cycle pen a kipatna mun ah hong ciahkik a, kipan nawn hi. Process ahihleh a piang nawnnawn kullo in ma a khang toto thei hi.

senses.heading: A bicycle
senses.definition_en: A bicycle, especially in formal or compound expressions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe tawh sik in kileh sak lengke nih nei van.

examples.english: The hotel provides cycles for its guests.
examples.zomi: Hotel in a zin mite ding lengke pia hi.

examples.english: Always wear a helmet when riding a cycle.
examples.zomi: Lengke na tuang ciangin lukhu tawntung khuh in.

senses.usage_en: In everyday American English, bicycle or bike is more common than the noun cycle. In British English, cycle commonly appears in compounds such as cycle path.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim American English ah noun cycle sangin bicycle ahih keileh bike kizang tamzaw hi. British English ah cycle path bang compound sunga cycle kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: A person’s father.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a pasal suahkhapa ahih keileh a pa.

examples.english: My dad taught me how to drive.
examples.zomi: Ka pa in mawtaw hawl dan hong hilh hi.

examples.english: Her dad works at a hospital.
examples.zomi: A pa zato inn ah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Dad is informal and affectionate. Use father in more formal contexts. Capitalize Dad when it is used as a name: Thanks, Dad.
senses.usage_zomi: Dad pen innkuan lakah itna tawh kizang nisim kammal hi. Formal thu ah father kizang hi. Min bangin kizang leh Dad ci in lai lian tawh kipan hi: Thanks, Dad.

senses.definition_en: Happening, produced, or used every day.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni simin a piang, a kibawl, ahih keileh a kizang.

examples.english: Walking is part of her daily routine.
examples.zomi: Khe tawh pai pen ama’ nisim bawl ngeina khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The website provides daily news updates.
examples.zomi: Website in nisim thuthang thak pia hi.

senses.usage_en: As an adjective, daily comes before a noun. It can also be an adverb meaning every day: The bus runs daily.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective in kizang ciangin daily pen noun ma ah om hi. Ni simin cihna adverb in zong kizang thei hi: The bus runs daily.

senses.definition_en: Physical harm that makes something less useful, valuable, or attractive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat kisia, a man kiam, ahih keileh kizangtheihna tawm sak siatna.

examples.english: The storm caused serious damage to several homes.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in inn pawlkhat nasatak in susia hi.

examples.english: Fortunately, there was no permanent damage.
examples.zomi: Lungdamhuai takin, tawntung siatna omlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Damage is normally uncountable: say a lot of damage, not many damages. Damages is a legal term for money awarded as compensation.
senses.usage_zomi: Damage pen simsawm theihloh min hi: a lot of damage kici a, many damages kici lo hi. Thukham ah damages in siatna thukna ding sum kawk hi.

senses.heading: A series of movements performed to music
senses.definition_en: Movements of the body and feet performed in time with music.
senses.explanation_zomi: La aw tawh kituak in pumpi leh khe tawh kihihna.

examples.english: The students performed a traditional dance.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in ngeina lam lak uh hi.

examples.english: She learned the dance by watching her sister.
examples.zomi: Ama in a sanggamnu lam en in tua lam sin hi.

senses.usage_en: A particular set of movements is a dance. The general activity is usually called dancing.
senses.usage_zomi: Lamzia nam khat a kawk ciangin a dance kici hi. Lam gamtatna a huam in gen ciangin dancing kici zel hi.

senses.heading: A social event where people dance
senses.definition_en: A social event at which people dance, usually to music.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipite la tawh lamkhawm dingin kibawl nopbawlna pawi.

examples.english: The school is holding a dance on Friday evening.
examples.zomi: Friday nitak in sang in lamna pawi bawl ding hi.

examples.english: They met at a community dance.
examples.zomi: Khawlsung lamna pawi ah kimukha uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this meaning, dance refers to the event, not only to the physical movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah dance in pumpi tawh lamna bek hilo a, lamna pawi khempeuh kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who dances, especially as a performer or profession.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam mi, a diakin mipite maiah lam lim lak ahih keileh lamna tawh nasem mi.

examples.english: She trained for many years to become a professional dancer.
examples.zomi: Lamna tawh nasem mi suak dingin kum tampi kisinsak hi.

examples.english: The dancers wore traditional clothing.
examples.zomi: Lam mite ngeina puan silh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Dancer can describe anyone who dances, but it often refers to someone trained to perform.
senses.usage_zomi: Dancer in mi a lam peuhmah kawk thei napi, lam lim lakna dingin kisinsak mi kawk tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity or art of moving the body and feet in time with music.
senses.explanation_zomi: La aw tawh kituak in pumpi leh khe kihihna nasep ahih keileh lam siamna.

examples.english: Dancing is an important part of the celebration.
examples.zomi: Lamna pen pawi khen thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: They go dancing every Saturday night.
examples.zomi: Saturday zan simin lam dingin pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Dancing names the general activity. Use dance for a particular dance or a social event.
senses.usage_zomi: Dancing in lamna gamtat khempeuh a huam hi. Lam nam khat ahih keileh lamna pawi khat a kawk ciangin dance kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: The possibility that someone may be harmed or that something bad may happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat liam, si, ahih keileh thu hoihlo khat piang thei dinmun.

examples.english: The children were in danger near the busy road.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw tamna lampi gei ah naupangte lauhuai dinmun ah om uh hi.

examples.english: The warning sign tells visitors about the danger.
examples.zomi: Vauna lim in khualzinte lauhuaina thu hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: Say in danger, not in a danger, when someone is at risk. Use a danger for a particular source of harm: The broken bridge is a danger.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat lauhuai dinmun ah om leh in danger kici a, in a danger kici lo hi. Siatna piangsak thei na khat a kawk ciangin a danger kici hi.

senses.definition_en: Likely to cause injury, damage, or death.
senses.explanation_zomi: Liamna, siatna, ahih keileh sihna piangsak thei.

examples.english: It is dangerous to drive during a severe storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi nasia sungah mawtaw hawl lauhuai hi.

examples.english: Keep dangerous chemicals away from children.
examples.zomi: Chemical lauhuai-te naupangte tawh gamla takin koih in.

senses.usage_en: Something dangerous can cause harm. Someone in danger may receive the harm: The road is dangerous; the travelers are in danger.
senses.usage_zomi: Na dangerous khat in siatna piangsak thei hi. Mi in danger khat in tua siatna thuak thei hi: The road is dangerous; the travelers are in danger.

senses.heading: Having little or no light
senses.definition_en: Having very little light, so that it is difficult to see.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavak omlo ahih keileh tawm bek om manin muh haksa.

examples.english: The room was too dark to read in.
examples.zomi: Innkhan mial lua ahih manin laibu kisim theilo hi.

examples.english: It gets dark early in winter.
examples.zomi: Phalbi hunin khuamial baih hi.

senses.usage_en: Dark describes a lack of light. Dim means that some light is present, but it is not bright.
senses.usage_zomi: Dark in khuavak a omlohna ahih keileh a tawm mahmahna kawk hi. Dim in khuavak tawmno om napi a taang hetlohna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Close to black in colour
senses.definition_en: Having a colour that is deep and not light.
senses.explanation_zomi: A mialna tam, vom tawh kinai, a taanglo lai nei.

common_phrases.zomi: sam vom ahih keileh sam mial

examples.english: He wore a dark blue jacket.
examples.zomi: Ama puanlum pawl mial silh hi.

examples.english: Dark colours absorb more heat from the sun.
examples.zomi: Kiluam mialte in ni panin a lum tamzaw la hi.

senses.usage_en: Place dark before a colour name to describe a deeper shade: dark green. Its opposite is light green.
senses.usage_zomi: Kiluam khat a mialzaw a genna dingin kiluam min ma ah dark kizang hi: dark green. A langkhat pen light green ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Facts, measurements, or information collected for study, comparison, or decision-making.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kholna, etkakna, ahih keileh khensatna dingin kikholh thu, zat, leh ciaptehna-te.

examples.english: Researchers collected data from five hundred people.
examples.zomi: Kholmite in mi zanga pan data khol uh hi.

examples.english: The decision should be based on accurate data.
examples.zomi: Khensatna pen data maan tungah kinga ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Traditionally, data is the plural of datum. In modern general English, it is often treated as an uncountable singular noun. Both the data are and the data is occur, but one style should be used consistently.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina tawh enin data pen datum a plural ahi hi. Tuhun nisim English ah simsawm theihloh singular noun bangin kizang tam hi. The data are leh the data is tegel kizang napi, laigelh khat sungah zatdan khatbek zuih hoih hi.

senses.heading: A particular day
senses.definition_en: A particular day of a month or year, usually shown by a number and a month.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kha leh kum sung ni khat kitheihna dingin number leh kha min tawh a kiciapteh ni.

examples.english: What is today’s date?
examples.zomi: Tuni ni leh kha bangzah ahi hiam?

examples.english: We have not yet set a date for the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ni khensat nailo ung.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly writes the month before the day: October 6, 2026. British English commonly writes the day first: 6 October 2026.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah kha min pen ni ma ah kici gelh zel hi: October 6, 2026. British English ah ni pen kha min ma ah kici gelh zel hi: 6 October 2026.

senses.heading: A planned romantic meeting
senses.definition_en: A social meeting between two people who are or may become romantically interested in each other.
senses.zomi_equivalents: itna tawh kimuhna; nupa suakthei kimuhna
senses.explanation_zomi: Numei leh pasal itna tawh kizom ahih keileh kizom thei tegel a geelkhawl in a kimuhkhopna.

examples.english: They went on their first date last Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday beisa in a masapen itna kimuhna nei uh hi.

examples.english: He asked her to go on a dinner date.
examples.zomi: Ama in nitak an nekhawm dingin numeinu sam hi.

senses.usage_en: A date may mean the meeting or the person accompanying you: I have a date; She was his date.
senses.usage_zomi: Date in kimuhna pawi kawk thei a, nang tawh hong pai mi zong kawk thei hi: I have a date; She was his date.

senses.definition_en: A person’s female child.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a numei ta.

examples.english: Their daughter is studying medicine.
examples.zomi: Amau’ tanu in siasinna sin hi.

examples.english: She has two sons and one daughter.
examples.zomi: Ama in tapa nih leh tanu khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Daughter can describe a child of any age. An adult woman is still her parents’ daughter.
senses.usage_zomi: Daughter in kum bangzah ahi zongin tanu kawk hi. Numei picing khat zong a nu leh pa’ tanu mah ahi hi.

senses.heading: A period of twenty-four hours
senses.definition_en: A period of twenty-four hours, from one midnight to the next.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ni khat; nai sawmnih leh li
senses.explanation_zomi: Zanlaizang khat pan zanlaizang dang dong nai sawmnih leh li hun.

examples.english: The journey took three days.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna in ni thum sawt hi.

examples.english: You should take this medicine twice a day.
examples.zomi: Hih si ni khat in nih vei na nek ding ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Every day is an adverb phrase meaning each day. Everyday is an adjective meaning ordinary: everyday life.
senses.usage_zomi: Every day pen ni simin cihna adverb phrase ahi hi. Everyday pen nisim a ngeina cihna adjective ahi hi: everyday life.

senses.heading: The time when it is light
senses.definition_en: The part of a twenty-four-hour period when there is daylight.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni khuavak a om sun hun.

examples.english: The shop is open during the day but closes at night.
examples.zomi: Dawr pen sunin kihong a, zanin kikhak hi.

examples.english: Some animals sleep during the day.
examples.zomi: Ganhing pawlkhat sunin ihmu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, day contrasts with night. In the twenty-four-hour sense, a day includes both daytime and nighttime.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah day pen night tawh kilang hi. Nai sawmnih leh li khiatna ah ni khat in sun leh zan tegel huam hi.

senses.heading: A particular period in history or a person’s life
senses.definition_en: A time or period associated with particular events, people, or conditions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang, mi, ahih keileh dinmun tuam khat tawh kizom hun khen khat.

examples.english: Life was different in those days.
examples.zomi: Tua hun laiin nuntakzia kibanglo hi.

examples.english: She often talks about her school days.
examples.zomi: Ama in a sang kah hun thu gen zel hi.

senses.usage_en: In expressions such as those days and school days, day refers to a period, not one calendar day.
senses.usage_zomi: Those days leh school days bang kammal ah day in calendar ni khat hilo in hun khen khat kawk hi.

senses.heading: No longer alive
senses.definition_en: Not living; having died.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuntak nawnlo; si khin.

examples.english: The bird was already dead when we found it.
examples.zomi: Vasa pen ka muh uh ciangin si khin hi.

examples.english: The police found the man dead in his home.
examples.zomi: Police-te in tua pasal a inn sungah sisak in mu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Dead is an adjective, while die is a verb and death is a noun: He died; he is dead; his death was sudden.
senses.usage_zomi: Dead pen adjective, die pen verb, death pen noun ahi hi: He died; he is dead; his death was sudden.

senses.heading: No longer operating or functioning
senses.definition_en: No longer working, active, or able to produce power.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasem nawnlo, kizangthei nawnlo, ahih keileh tha nei nawnlo.

examples.english: My phone is dead because the battery has no power.
examples.zomi: Battery tha a bei manin ka phone nasem nawnlo hi.

examples.english: The car stopped because of a dead battery.
examples.zomi: Battery tha bei manin mawtaw khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: For electronic devices, dead usually means that there is no power. It does not necessarily mean that the device is permanently broken.
senses.usage_zomi: Electronic vante ah dead in tha omlo cihna ahi zel hi. Van pen kisia tawntung cihna hituanlo hi.

senses.heading: To take action concerning a person, problem, or situation
senses.definition_en: To manage, handle, or take action about a problem, situation, or person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina, dinmun, ahih keileh mi khat tawh kisai thu puah, uk, ahih keileh khutzat.

examples.english: We need to deal with this problem immediately.
examples.zomi: Hih buaina tu mahmah in i khutzat kul hi.

examples.english: She deals with customer complaints every day.
examples.zomi: Ama in ni simin leimite’ mawhsiamna thu khutzat hi.

senses.usage_en: In this meaning, deal is normally followed by with: deal with a problem. Do not omit with.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah deal pen with tawh kizom zel hi: deal with a problem. With pelh loh ding hi.

senses.heading: To distribute playing cards
senses.definition_en: To give playing cards to each player before or during a game.
senses.explanation_zomi: Card kimawlna ah kimawlte tungah card hawm.

examples.english: He dealt five cards to each player.
examples.zomi: Ama in kimawl mi khat ciang card nga ciat hawm hi.

examples.english: It is your turn to deal.
examples.zomi: Card na hawm hun ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle of deal are dealt /dɛlt/.
senses.usage_zomi: Deal a past tense leh past participle pen dealt /dɛlt/ ahi hi.

senses.heading: Loved or valued very much
senses.definition_en: Loved very much or considered especially important.
senses.explanation_zomi: It mahmah, zahtak mahmah, ahih keileh manpha sak mahmah.

examples.english: She is a very dear friend of mine.
examples.zomi: Ama pen ka lawm it mahmah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: This old photograph is very dear to me.
examples.zomi: Hih lim lui pen kei adingin manpha mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Dear can describe emotional closeness. Before a name in a letter, it is also a conventional greeting: Dear Maria.
senses.usage_zomi: Dear in itna leh kinaizawna kawk thei hi. Lai khat kipatna ah min ma ah salam piakna in zong kizang hi: Dear Maria.

senses.heading: Expensive
senses.definition_en: Costing a lot of money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Man tampi, man sang, ahih keileh leih haksa zahin man lian.

examples.english: That restaurant is too dear for us.
examples.zomi: Tua annekna dawr pen kote adingin man tam lua hi.

examples.english: Fresh fruit is becoming dearer.
examples.zomi: Singgah thakte man hong tamzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is common in British English. American English usually uses expensive.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen British English ah kizang tam hi. American English ah expensive kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: The end of a person’s, animal’s, or plant’s life.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, ganhing, ahih keileh singkung khat nuntakna a tawpna.

examples.english: The police are investigating the cause of death.
examples.zomi: Police-te in sihna ziang kan uh hi.

examples.english: Her grandfather’s death brought great sadness to the family.
examples.zomi: A pupapa sihna in innkuan sungah dahna lianpi tun hi.

senses.usage_en: Death is the noun, die is the verb, and dead is the adjective. Say his death, he died, and he is dead.
senses.usage_zomi: Death pen noun, die pen verb, dead pen adjective ahi hi. His death, he died, leh he is dead ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: A formal discussion presenting different opinions
senses.definition_en: A formal discussion in which people present opposing arguments about a subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu khat tungah ngaihsutdan kilamdangte thu leh la tawh a kikumna formal.

examples.english: The candidates took part in a televised debate.
examples.zomi: Teelna a kidem mite television tung thu kikumna ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: The class held a debate about school uniforms.
examples.zomi: Class in sang puan tawh kisai thu kikumna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A formal debate usually has rules, organized speakers, and arguments for different positions.
senses.usage_zomi: Formal debate in thukhun, pau ding mite, leh dinmun tuamtuam panin thu kikumna a geelkhawl in nei hi.

senses.heading: General discussion or disagreement
senses.definition_en: Discussion or disagreement about an important question.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dotna thupi khat tungah ngaihsutdan kilamdangte tawh kikumna leh kidemna.
