examples.english: The proposal has caused considerable public debate.
examples.zomi: Tua thu piakna in mipite lakah thu kikumna tampi piangsak hi.

examples.english: There is continuing debate about the best solution.
examples.zomi: Vengna hoihpen tawh kisai thu kikumna kizom lai hi.

senses.usage_en: In this broader sense, a debate does not need to be a formal event. It may continue through articles, meetings, or public discussion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih a huamzai khiatna ah debate pen formal pawi khat hi kullo hi. Laigelh, kikhopna, ahih keileh mipite kikumna tungtawnin kizom thei hi.

senses.heading: Money that must be repaid
senses.definition_en: Money that a person, company, or government owes to another person or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, company, ahih keileh kumpi in midang tungah a thuk ding sum.

examples.english: She worked hard to pay off her debt.
examples.zomi: A leiba khempeuh piak zawhna dingin hahkat takin nasem hi.

examples.english: The company has a large amount of debt.
examples.zomi: Company in leiba tampi nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Say in debt when someone owes money. Say a debt when referring to one particular amount owed.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat in sum bat leh in debt kici hi. A bat sum khat a tuam in gen leh a debt kici hi.

senses.heading: Something owed because of help or kindness
senses.definition_en: A feeling that you owe someone thanks or a return for help received.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat hong huhna ahih keileh hong hehpihna manin a tungah lungdamkohna leh thukkik nopna.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat tungah thuk ding nei

examples.english: I owe my teachers a great debt of gratitude.
examples.zomi: Ka siate tungah lungdamkoh leiba lianpi ka nei hi.

examples.english: He never forgot his debt to the family that helped him.
examples.zomi: Ama hong huh innkuan tungah a leiba cikmah in mangngilhlo hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use does not normally refer to money. It expresses gratitude or moral obligation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak zatdan in sum leiba kawklo hi. Lungdamkohna ahih keileh gamtat tawh thukkik ding cihna kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A period of ten years.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sawm hun.

examples.english: The city has changed greatly over the past decade.
examples.zomi: Kum sawm beisa sungin khuapi tampi kikhel hi.

examples.english: She worked at the hospital for three decades.
examples.zomi: Ama zato inn ah kum sawmthum nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: A named decade usually refers to years sharing the same tens number: the 1990s. Be clear whether a decade begins with a year ending in zero or simply means any ten-year period.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kipia kum sawm khat in a sawm zat kibang kumte kawk zel hi: the 1990s. Kum sawm khat pen zero tawh a tawp kum pan kipan maw, hun kum sawm peuhmah maw cih kician takin gen ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The twelfth and final month of the year.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum khat sunga kha sawmnihna leh a nunungpen kha.

examples.english: The semester ends in December.
examples.zomi: Semester pen December kha in bei hi.

examples.english: They plan to travel in early December.
examples.zomi: December kha kipat lamah khualzin ding geelkhol uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize December because month names are proper nouns. Use in December, but use on December 10 for a particular date.
senses.usage_zomi: Kha min pen proper noun ahih manin December lai lian tawh kipan hi. Kha bek gen leh in December kici a, ni khat ciangtan gen leh on December 10 kici hi.

senses.heading: Acceptably good
senses.definition_en: Good enough or of an acceptable quality, although not excellent.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoihpen hilo napi pawmtheih dingzah in hoih.

examples.english: They found a decent apartment at a reasonable price.
examples.zomi: Man pawmtheih tawh innkhan hoih kimkhat khat mu uh hi.

examples.english: The hotel serves a decent breakfast.
examples.zomi: Hotel in zingsang an pawmtheih khawng pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, decent is positive but not very strong. It usually means satisfactory rather than excellent.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah decent pen hoihna lak napi a khauh mahmah hilo hi. A hoihpen sangin pawmtheih cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Respectable, fair, and morally acceptable
senses.definition_en: Behaving in a kind, honest, fair, or socially acceptable way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mi hoih; gamtat hoih; zahtak huai
senses.explanation_zomi: Hehpihna, thumaan, thutang leh gamtat hoih tawh a gamta.

examples.english: He is a decent man who treats everyone fairly.
examples.zomi: Ama pen mi khempeuh thutang takin a bawl mi hoih khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Please show some decency and apologize.
examples.zomi: Gamtat hoih lak in, ngaihdam ngen in.

senses.usage_en: When describing a person, decent often praises character or behaviour rather than skill or appearance.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a gen ciangin decent in siamna ahih keileh melhoihna sangin a lungsim leh gamtat hoihna phat hi.

senses.heading: To choose after considering the possibilities
senses.definition_en: To choose what to do or which option to accept after thinking about the possibilities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi tuamtuam ngaihsun khit ciangin bang bawl ding ahih keileh bang teel ding khensat.

examples.english: We need to decide where to hold the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna koi ah bawl ding khensat kul hi.

examples.english: She decided to accept the job.
examples.zomi: Ama in nasepna sang ding khensat hi.

senses.usage_en: Use decide to do something, not decide doing something: They decided to leave.
senses.usage_zomi: Decide to do something ci in kizang a, decide doing something ci in kizanglo hi: They decided to leave.

senses.heading: To determine the result of something
senses.definition_en: To determine the result or outcome of a contest, case, or situation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a thu piang ding khensak; a gualzo khensak
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna, thukhenna, ahih keileh dinmun khat a tawpna thu piang ding khensak.

examples.english: One final goal decided the match.
examples.zomi: A nunungpen goal khat in kimawlna gualzo ding khensak hi.

examples.english: The judge will decide the case next week.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa in maikal ah tua thukhenna thu khen ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the subject may be a person, event, or fact that determines the outcome.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah subject pen mi, thu piang, ahih keileh thu maan khat ahi thei a, tua in a tawpna thu piang ding khensak hi.

senses.heading: A choice made after consideration
senses.definition_en: A choice or judgment made after thinking about several possibilities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi tuamtuam ngaihsun khit ciangin a kiteel leh a kikhensat thu.

examples.english: She made the decision after speaking with her family.
examples.zomi: A innkuante tawh kiholim khit ciangin khensatna bawl hi.

examples.english: Leaving the job was a difficult decision.
examples.zomi: Nasepna nusia pen khensat haksa thu khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: English normally uses make a decision, not do a decision.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah make a decision ci in kizang a, do a decision ci in kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: An official judgment or result
senses.definition_en: A formal judgment reached by a judge, committee, government, or other authority.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhenpa, committee, kumpi, ahih keileh ukna nei pawl in formal takin a kikhensat thu.

examples.english: The court will announce its decision tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna inn in zingciang a khensatna tangko ding hi.

examples.english: The committee’s decision surprised everyone.
examples.zomi: Committee khensatna in mi khempeuh lamdang sak hi.

senses.usage_en: An official decision may establish what will happen, even when some people disagree with it.
senses.usage_zomi: Ukna decision khat in mi pawlkhat a lungkimloh hangin zong bang piang ding cih kipsak thei hi.

senses.heading: To announce something officially or publicly
senses.definition_en: To state something clearly, firmly, or officially.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat kician leh kip takin mipite maiah ahih keileh ukna tawh tangko.

examples.english: The country declared independence in 1948.
examples.zomi: Gam in 1948 kum in suahtakna tangko hi.

examples.english: The officials declared the area safe.
examples.zomi: Uliante in tua mun bit hi ci in tangko uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Declare is more formal and forceful than say. It is often used for official announcements.
senses.usage_zomi: Declare pen say sangin formal leh khauhzaw hi. Ukna thu tangkona dingin kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: To report something officially
senses.definition_en: To provide official information about money, goods, income, or property.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, van, income, ahih keileh neihsa thu ukna tungah maan takin pulak.

examples.english: Travelers must declare certain goods at customs.
examples.zomi: Khualzinte in van nam pawlkhat customs ah pulak ding uh hi.

examples.english: You must declare all taxable income.
examples.zomi: Sia piak ding income khempeuh na pulak ding ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, declare means giving required information to an authority, not simply mentioning it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah declare in thu gen ziau bek hilo a, ukna in a nget thu piak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To politely refuse
senses.definition_en: To say politely that you will not accept, do, or attend something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sanglo, bawllo, ahih keileh pai lo ding zahtak takin gen.

examples.english: She declined the invitation because she was busy.
examples.zomi: Nasep a tam manin sapna nial hi.

examples.english: He politely declined our offer of help.
examples.zomi: Ama in ka huhna thu piak uh zahtak takin sanglo hi.

senses.usage_en: Decline is more formal and polite than refuse. It is commonly followed directly by a noun: decline an invitation.
senses.usage_zomi: Decline pen refuse sangin formal leh zahtakna neizaw hi. Noun tawh a kizom in kizang zel hi: decline an invitation.

senses.heading: To become smaller, weaker, or worse
senses.definition_en: To decrease in number, amount, strength, quality, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, tamna, tha, hoihna, ahih keileh dinmun hong kiam ahih keileh hong sia.

examples.english: The number of visitors declined during winter.
examples.zomi: Phalbi sungin khualzin mi zat kiam hi.

examples.english: His health began to decline after the illness.
examples.zomi: Natna khit ciangin a cidamna hong thanem kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, decline is often intransitive: Sales declined. When something causes a reduction, use reduce or decrease.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah decline pen intransitive in kizang tam hi: Sales declined. Na khat in zat khat a kiam sak leh reduce ahih keileh decrease kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: To make something more attractive by adding colours, lights, pictures, or other objects.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kiluam, khuavak, lim, ahih keileh van dangte beh in na khat zeen leh hoihsak.

examples.english: The children decorated the room with balloons.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in innkhan huihpak tawh zeen uh hi.

examples.english: She decorated the cake with fresh fruit.
examples.zomi: Ama in mukhom singgah thak tawh zeen hi.

senses.usage_en: Use decorate something with something to name the objects used: They decorated the hall with flowers.
senses.usage_zomi: Zeenna ding a kizang van genna ah decorate something with something kizang hi: They decorated the hall with flowers.

senses.heading: An object used to make something attractive
senses.definition_en: An object added to a place or thing to make it look more attractive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih keileh van khat kilawmzaw sakna dingin a kizang zeenna van.

examples.english: They hung colourful decorations around the room.
examples.zomi: Innkhan sungah zeenna van kiluam tuamtuam khai uh hi.

examples.english: We put the decorations away after the celebration.
examples.zomi: Pawi khit ciangin zeenna vante ka koihkhia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Particular decorative objects are countable: a decoration; several decorations.
senses.usage_zomi: Zeenna van khat ciat a kawk ciangin simsawm theih hi: a decoration; several decorations.

senses.heading: The style or activity of decorating
senses.definition_en: The activity of decorating something or the way it has been decorated.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat zeenna nasep ahih keileh a kizeen dan.

examples.english: She studied interior decoration at college.
examples.zomi: Ama in college ah inn sung zeenna sin hi.

examples.english: The room needs very little decoration.
examples.zomi: Innkhan in zeenna tawmno bek kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this general meaning, decoration is often uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Zeenna nasep ahih keileh zeendan a huam in gen ciangin decoration pen simsawm theihloh min ahi zel hi.

senses.definition_en: To become smaller or fewer, or to make an amount, number, or level smaller.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, tamna, man, ahih keileh dinmun hong kiam, ahih keileh mi khat in kiam sak.

examples.english: The number of accidents has decreased this year.
examples.zomi: Tukum mawtaw kituahna zat kiam hi.

examples.english: Regular exercise can decrease the risk of heart disease.
examples.zomi: Pumpi pattah tawntung in lungtang natna lauhuaina tawm sak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Decrease can be intransitive (Prices decreased) or transitive (The company decreased its costs). As a noun, the stress changes to /ˈdiːkriːs/.
senses.usage_zomi: Decrease pen intransitive (Prices decreased) leh transitive (The company decreased its costs) in kizang thei hi. Noun in kizang ciangin aw ngaihna pen /ˈdiːkriːs/ ah kikhel hi.

senses.heading: Extending far down or far inward
senses.definition_en: Having a long distance from the top or surface to the bottom.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tung ahih keileh a mai pan a taw ahih keileh a sunglam dong gamla.

examples.english: The water is too deep for children to swim in.
examples.zomi: Tui thuk lua ahih manin naupangte tuisep theilo ding uh hi.

examples.english: Workers dug a deep hole beside the road.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in lampi gei ah kok thuk khat lai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Deep usually measures downward or inward distance. High measures upward distance.
senses.usage_zomi: Deep in a nuaizaw ahih keileh a sunglam gamlatna teh hi. High in a tunglam sangzah teh hi.

senses.heading: Strong, serious, or intense
senses.definition_en: Strongly felt, serious, or involving careful thought.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim sukna khauh, a thupi, ahih keileh ngaihsutna a thuk.

examples.english: The news caused deep sadness in the community.
examples.zomi: Thuthang in khawlsung mipite lakah dahna lianpi piangsak hi.

examples.english: He was in deep thought and did not hear me.
examples.zomi: Ama ngaihsutna thuk sungah om ahih manin ka sapna zalo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, deep strengthens emotions, thoughts, relationships, or conditions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak khiatna ah deep in lungsim sukna, ngaihsutna, kizopna, ahih keileh dinmun khauhna laksak hi.

senses.heading: Low in sound
senses.definition_en: Having a low, strong sound.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw niam leh a ging khauh.

examples.english: He spoke in a deep voice.
examples.zomi: Ama aw niam tawh pau hi.

examples.english: We heard a deep sound from the engine.
examples.zomi: Engine pan ging niam khat za ung.

senses.usage_en: A deep voice is low in pitch. It does not mean that the speaker is far below the listener.
senses.usage_zomi: Deep voice in aw a niam cihna ahi hi. Paupa pen zaipa sangin a nuai ah om cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Very strongly, seriously, or completely.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasatak in; lungsim takpi tawh; thuk takin
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim takpi tawh, nasatak in, ahih keileh a thukpi in.

examples.english: We are deeply concerned about her health.
examples.zomi: Ama’ cidamna thu ka lunghihmawh mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: The experience deeply affected his life.
examples.zomi: Tua muhkhakna in a nuntakna nasatak in suk hi.

senses.usage_en: Deeply commonly strengthens feelings and attitudes. For physical movement downward, deep is often more natural: dig deep.
senses.usage_zomi: Deeply pen lungsim sukna leh ngaihsutna khauh sakna dingin kizang tam hi. Pumpi tawh a nuailam ah gamtatna gen leh deep zat a ngeinazaw hi: dig deep.

senses.heading: To win against someone
senses.definition_en: To win a game, contest, election, battle, or struggle against an opponent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna, kidemna, teelna, gal, ahih keileh kidona ah langdo tungah gualzo.

examples.english: Our team defeated the champions by two points.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl un championte point nih tawh zo ung.

examples.english: The candidate defeated her opponent in the election.
examples.zomi: Teelna ah ama in a langdo zo hi.

senses.usage_en: The winner defeats the opponent. The opponent is defeated or loses.
senses.usage_zomi: Gualzopa in langdo defeats hi. Langdopa pen is defeated ahih keileh loses hi.

senses.heading: To prevent something from succeeding
senses.definition_en: To prevent a plan, purpose, or effort from succeeding.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna, ngiimna, ahih keileh hanciamna khat tangtunlo sak.

examples.english: Adding too many rules may defeat the purpose of the program.
examples.zomi: Thukhun tamlua behna in program ngiimna susia thei hi.

examples.english: The security system defeated the thieves’ attempt to enter.
examples.zomi: Bitna system in gutate lut ding a hanciamna tangtunglo sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Defeat the purpose means producing a result opposite to the intended goal.
senses.usage_zomi: Defeat the purpose in a ngiimna tawh a kilehbulh thu piangsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Protection against attack or harm
senses.definition_en: Action taken to protect a person, place, country, or idea from attack or harm.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun, gam, ahih keileh ngaihsutna khat kisuksiatna leh kidona pan kepna nasep.

examples.english: The country increased its spending on national defence.
examples.zomi: Gam in gam kepna ding sum zatna beh hi.

examples.english: He acted in self-defence when he was attacked.
examples.zomi: A kidona uh ciangin amah leh amah kidalna in gamta hi.

senses.usage_en: Defence is the British spelling. The American spelling is defense. The pronunciation is the same in this general meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Defence pen British spelling ahi hi. American spelling pen defense ahi a, hih khiatna ah a kipaudan kibang hi.

senses.heading: Words or evidence used to support someone or something
senses.definition_en: An explanation, argument, or evidence used to protect someone from criticism or accusation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat mawhsiamna ahih keileh mawhpuhna pan dalna ding hilhcian na, thu kikumna, ahih keileh teci.

examples.english: She spoke in defence of the accused worker.
examples.zomi: Mawhpuh thuak nasempa dalna in thu gen hi.

examples.english: The lawyer prepared a strong defence.
examples.zomi: Thukham siam in kidalna thu khauh khat bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In law, the defence can mean the accused person’s legal case or the lawyers representing that person.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukham ah the defence in mawhpuhna thuakpa’ kidalna thu ahih keileh ama a aiawh thukham siamte kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: To protect someone or something from attack or harm
senses.definition_en: To protect a person, place, country, or thing against attack, criticism, or damage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun, gam, ahih keileh na khat kidona, mawhsiamna, leh siatna pan kem.

examples.english: The soldiers defended the town against attack.
examples.zomi: Galkapte in khuapi kidona pan kem uh hi.

examples.english: She defended her friend against unfair criticism.
examples.zomi: Ama in a lawm thutanglo mawhsiamna pan dal hi.

senses.usage_en: Use defend someone or something against/from something when naming the danger or attack.
senses.usage_zomi: Kidona ahih keileh lauhuaina a genna dingin defend someone or something against/from something kizang hi.

senses.heading: To support an opinion, decision, or action with reasons
senses.definition_en: To explain why an opinion, decision, or action is right or reasonable.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kidalna thu gen; a maan zia hilhcian
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, khensatna, ahih keileh gamtatna khat a maan ahih keileh a kilawm cih thu leh la tawh hilhcian.

examples.english: The minister defended the government’s decision.
examples.zomi: Minister in kumpi khensatna kidal hi.

examples.english: Students must be able to defend their conclusions.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in amau’ thu khupna kidal thei ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In academic discussion, defend does not require anger. It means supporting a position with evidence and reasoning.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna thu kikumna ah defend pen hehna tawh bawl kullo hi. Teci leh ngaihsutna tawh panmun khat kip sak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To explain the meaning of a word or idea
senses.definition_en: To state clearly what a word, phrase, or idea means.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, kammal pawl, ahih keileh ngaihsutna khat a khiatna kician takin gen.

examples.english: Can you define the word “justice”?
examples.zomi: “Justice” kammal khiatna na gen thei diam?

examples.english: The report clearly defines its main terms.
examples.zomi: Report in a kammal thupite khiatna kician takin hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: A good definition identifies the central meaning without simply repeating the word being defined.
senses.usage_zomi: Definition hoih in a hilhcian kammal mahmah genkik beklo in a khiatna bulpi pulak hi.

senses.heading: To establish the character, limits, or importance of something
senses.definition_en: To determine what something is like, what its limits are, or what makes it distinctive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pianzia, a gamgi, ahih keileh a dangte tawh kilamdanna kipsak.

examples.english: The agreement defines each person’s responsibilities.
examples.zomi: Kithukimna in mi ciat mawpuakna ciangtan hi.

examples.english: Her courage came to define her leadership.
examples.zomi: A hangsanna in a makaihna pianzia lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this broader sense, define means establishing identity, character, or boundaries rather than explaining a dictionary meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih a huamzai khiatna ah define in dictionary khiatna hilh bek hilo a, kimawhna, pianzia, ahih keileh gamgi kipsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Certain and without doubt
senses.definition_en: Known or decided with certainty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kician takin kithei ahih keileh kikhensat a, lunghianna omlo.

examples.english: We have not made a definite decision yet.
examples.zomi: Khensatna kip bawl nailo ung.

examples.english: Is there a definite date for the meeting?
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ding ni kician om hiam?

senses.usage_en: Definite means certain or firmly decided. It is stronger than possible or probable.
senses.usage_zomi: Definite in a maan takpi ahih keileh a kikhensat kip cihna ahi hi. Possible ahih keileh probable sangin khauh zaw hi.

senses.heading: Clear and easy to recognize
senses.definition_en: Clear, noticeable, and easy to identify.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kician, kimuh baih, ahih keileh theihkhiat baih.

examples.english: There has been a definite improvement in her health.
examples.zomi: A cidamna ah hoihna kician om hi.

examples.english: We noticed a definite change in his attitude.
examples.zomi: A lungsim puakzia ah kikhelna kician mu ung.

senses.usage_en: Here, definite emphasizes that a difference or change can clearly be noticed.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah definite in kilamdanna ahih keileh kikhelna khat kician takin kimuthei cihna khauh sak hi.

senses.definition_en: Without doubt; certainly.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kician takin; taktak in; lunghianna omlo in
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunghianna om hetlo in; kician takin; taktak in.

examples.english: I will definitely attend the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ah ka pai taktak ding hi.

examples.english: This book is definitely worth reading.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu sim taak taktak hi.

senses.usage_en: The correct spelling is definitely, not definately. In speech, it strongly confirms a statement.
senses.usage_zomi: Spelling maan pen definitely ahi a, definately hilo hi. Kampau ah thu khat maan taktak cihna khauh sak hi.

senses.definition_en: A statement that explains the meaning of a word, phrase, or idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, kammal pawl, ahih keileh ngaihsutna khat a khiatna a hilhcian thu.

examples.english: The dictionary gives a simple definition of the word.
examples.zomi: Dictionary in kammal khiatna baihlam takin gen hi.

examples.english: We need a clear definition of “success.”
examples.zomi: “Success” a khiatna kician i kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: A definition explains what something means. An example shows how it is used but does not replace a complete definition.
senses.usage_zomi: Definition in na khat a khiatna hilh hi. Example in a zatdan lak napi, khiatna hilhcian kicing khat aiawh theilo hi.

senses.heading: A unit for measuring temperature or angles
senses.definition_en: A unit used to measure temperature or the size of an angle.
senses.zomi_equivalents: degree tehna; lum leh vot tehna
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuahun lum leh votna ahih keileh angle a zaizia tehna unit.

examples.english: The temperature reached thirty degrees Celsius.
examples.zomi: Khuahun lumna Celsius degree sawmthum tung hi.

examples.english: A right angle measures ninety degrees.
examples.zomi: Angle maan khat pen degree sawmkua ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the plural degrees after numbers other than one: one degree; two degrees.
senses.usage_zomi: Khat lobuang number dang khit ah plural degrees kizang hi: one degree; two degrees.

senses.heading: A university qualification
senses.definition_en: A qualification awarded after successfully completing a program of study at a university or college.
senses.explanation_zomi: University ahih keileh college sinna program khat tangtun takin zoh khit ciangin a kipia pilna lai.

examples.english: She earned a degree in public administration.
examples.zomi: Ama in public administration degree ngah hi.

examples.english: A university degree is required for the position.
examples.zomi: Tua panmun dingin university degree kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a degree in before the subject studied: a degree in finance.
senses.usage_zomi: A kisinsa subject genna dingin a degree in kizang hi: a degree in finance.

senses.heading: An amount or level
senses.definition_en: The amount, level, or extent to which something happens or is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a omzah, a khauhzah, ahih keileh a huamzah dinmun.

examples.english: Everyone was affected to some degree.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh dinmun khatciat dong a suk hi.

examples.english: The job requires a high degree of patience.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep in thuakzawhna dinmun sang kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: To some degree means partly or to a limited extent.
senses.usage_zomi: To some degree in khen khat bek ahih keileh ciangtan khat dong cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To make something happen later
senses.definition_en: To cause an event, action, or journey to happen later than planned.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawi, nasep, ahih keileh khualzinna khat a geelkhawl hun sangin nungzaw sak.

examples.english: Heavy snow delayed the flight for three hours.
examples.zomi: Vuk tampi in vanleng paikhiatna nai thum nungzaw sak hi.

examples.english: They decided to delay the meeting until Monday.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna Monday dong khawlsak ding khensat uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Delay is followed directly by a noun: delay the meeting. Do not use delay to do.
senses.usage_zomi: Delay pen noun tawh a kizom in kizang hi: delay the meeting. Delay to do ci in kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: To wait before doing something
senses.definition_en: To wait or take too long before doing something necessary.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawl ding na khat tuanlo in ngak ahih keileh hun sawt sak.

examples.english: Do not delay in seeking medical help.
examples.zomi: Siavuan huhna zonna ah hun sawt kei in.

examples.english: If we delay, the problem may become worse.
examples.zomi: I ngak leh buaina siazaw thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Delay doing something is correct: They delayed leaving. Delay to leave is not normally used.
senses.usage_zomi: Delay doing something pen zatdan maan ahi hi: They delayed leaving. Delay to leave pen ngeina in kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: Intentional and planned
senses.definition_en: Done intentionally rather than by accident.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna tawh hilo in a lungsim takpi leh a geelkhawl in kibawl.

examples.english: The damage was deliberate, not accidental.
examples.zomi: Siatna pen accident tawh hilo a, a sepkholh in kibawl hi.

examples.english: He made a deliberate attempt to mislead us.
examples.zomi: Ama in kote hong lampialsak dingin a lungsim takpi tawh hanciam hi.

senses.usage_en: Deliberate /dɪˈlɪbərət/ as an adjective means intentional. The verb deliberate is pronounced /dɪˈlɪbəˌreɪt/ and means to consider carefully.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective deliberate /dɪˈlɪbərət/ in a lungsim takpi tawh kibawl cihna ahi hi. Verb deliberate /dɪˈlɪbəˌreɪt/ in pilvang takin ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Slow and careful
senses.definition_en: Done slowly and carefully because it has been thought about.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilvang takin ngaihsun khit in a manlanglo in kibawl.

examples.english: She spoke in a slow, deliberate manner.
examples.zomi: Ama khawdai leh pilvang takin pau hi.

examples.english: Every movement was careful and deliberate.
examples.zomi: A kihihna khempeuh pilvang leh ngaihsun khit in kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, deliberate does not mean lazy. It means controlled and carefully considered.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah deliberate in thadah cihna hilo hi. Kithunun leh pilvang takin ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Intentionally and with a clear purpose, rather than accidentally.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim takpi tawh; a sepkholh in
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna tawh hilo in lungsim takpi leh ngiimna kician tawh.

examples.english: He deliberately ignored the warning.
examples.zomi: Ama in vauna thu a lungsim takpi in awlmawhlo hi.

examples.english: The information was deliberately hidden from the public.
examples.zomi: Tua thu mipite theihloh dingin a sepkholh in kiseel hi.

senses.usage_en: Deliberately emphasizes that an action was intended. It is the opposite of accidentally.
senses.usage_zomi: Deliberately in gamtatna khat a lungsim takpi tawh kibawl cihna khauh sak hi. A langkhat pen accidentally ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a very pleasant taste or smell.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lim mahmah ahih keileh a namtui mahmah.

examples.english: The soup smells delicious.
examples.zomi: Tua anzu a namtui mahmah hi.

examples.english: We had a delicious meal at the restaurant.
examples.zomi: Annekna dawr ah an lim mahmah ne ung.

senses.usage_en: Delicious is already a strong adjective. In standard careful English, absolutely delicious is usually more natural than very delicious.
senses.usage_zomi: Delicious pen adjective khauh khat ahih manin, English kicing ah very delicious sangin absolutely delicious zat a ngeinazaw hi.

senses.definition_en: To give someone great pleasure or happiness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungdam mahmah sak ahih keileh lungnuam mahmah sak.

examples.english: The children’s performance delighted the audience.
examples.zomi: Naupangte’ limlakna in en mipite lungdam mahmah sak hi.

examples.english: The unexpected gift delighted her.
examples.zomi: Lam-etloh letsong in ama lungnuam mahmah sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Delight someone means causing great pleasure. The more common adjective is delighted: She was delighted with the gift.
senses.usage_zomi: Delight someone in mi khat lungdam mahmah sak cihna ahi hi. A adjective delighted pen kizang tamzaw hi: She was delighted with the gift.

senses.definition_en: Very pleased and happy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungdam leh lungnuam mahmah.

common_phrases.zomi: a thu piang tawh lungkim mahmah

examples.english: We are delighted to welcome you today.
examples.zomi: Tuni nang hong pai ka sangtheih manin ka lungdam mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: She was delighted with her examination results.
examples.zomi: Ama in a sittelna result tawh lungkim mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Common patterns are delighted to do something, delighted with something, and delighted that….
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan ngeina-te pen delighted to do something, delighted with something, leh delighted that… ahi hi.

senses.heading: To take goods, letters, or packages to a person or place
senses.definition_en: To transport and give goods, letters, food, or packages to their intended person or place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, lai, annek, ahih keileh package a sang ding mi ahih keileh mun ah puak in pia.

examples.english: The company will deliver the furniture tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Company in zingciang inn vante hong tun ding hi.

examples.english: Your package was delivered this morning.
examples.zomi: Na package tuni zingsangin hong kipia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use deliver something to someone or somewhere: They delivered the package to my office.
senses.usage_zomi: Deliver something to someone or somewhere ci in kizang hi: They delivered the package to my office.

senses.heading: To give a speech, message, or performance
senses.definition_en: To present a speech, message, judgment, or performance formally.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thugen, thupuak, thukhenna, ahih keileh limlakna khat formal takin pia.

examples.english: The president delivered a speech to the nation.
examples.zomi: President in gam mite tungah thugen pia hi.

examples.english: The judge will deliver the decision tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa in zingciang khensatna pulak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, deliver means presenting something formally and effectively, not transporting a physical object.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah deliver in van khat puak cihna hilo a, thu khat formal leh tangtun takin pulak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To help a baby be born
senses.definition_en: To assist medically during the birth of a baby, or for a mother to give birth to a baby.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nau suah laitak in cidamna lam pan huh ahih keileh nu khat in nau nei.

examples.english: The doctor delivered the baby safely.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in nau bit takin suahsak hi.

examples.english: She delivered a healthy baby boy.
examples.zomi: Ama in tapa cidam khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Because deliver a baby may describe either the medical professional’s assistance or the mother’s giving birth, the context must make the meaning clear.
senses.usage_zomi: Deliver a baby in siavuan in nau suahna a huhna ahih keileh nu in nau a neihna kawk thei ahih manin, a kizop thu pan khiatna kician ding hi.

senses.heading: The act of taking something to a person or place
senses.definition_en: The act or service of taking goods, food, letters, or packages to their intended destination.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, annek, lai, ahih keileh package a sang ding mi leh mun ah puak in piakna nasep.

examples.english: The store offers free delivery on large orders.
examples.zomi: Dawr in van tampi a kam mite tungah a thawn in puakpia hi.

examples.english: Your package is ready for delivery.
examples.zomi: Na package kipuakpiak dingin kigingsa hi.

senses.usage_en: Delivery can mean the service, the act, or the goods being delivered. A delivery often means one particular shipment.
senses.usage_zomi: Delivery in puakpiakna nasep, puakna gamtat, ahih keileh a kipuak van kawk thei hi. A delivery in van kipuakna khat kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: The birth of a baby
senses.definition_en: The process in which a baby is born.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nu khat sung pan nau a suahna.

examples.english: The mother and baby were healthy after the delivery.
examples.zomi: Nau suah khit ciangin nu leh nau tegel cidam uh hi.

examples.english: The nurse prepared the delivery room.
examples.zomi: Nurse in nau suahna innkhan bawlkhol hi.

senses.usage_en: In medical contexts, delivery refers to childbirth. It does not mean that the baby is treated as a package.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna thu ah delivery in nau suahna kawk hi. Nau pen package bangin kipuak cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: The way something is spoken or performed
senses.definition_en: The manner in which a speech, message, joke, or performance is presented.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thugen, thupuak, nuihsan thu, ahih keileh limlakna khat a kipiak dan.

examples.english: Her clear delivery made the speech easy to understand.
examples.zomi: A thugen piakdan kician manin thugen tel baih hi.

examples.english: The actor’s delivery made the line funny.
examples.zomi: Milimpa’ kampaudan in tua kammal nuihhuai sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, delivery refers to how something is presented, including voice, timing, and expression.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah delivery in thu a kipiakdan kawk a, aw, hun zatdan leh melpuak zong huam hi.

senses.heading: A firm request or requirement
senses.definition_en: A forceful request or a statement that something must be done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl takpi ding ahih keileh piak takpi ding khauhtak in ngetna.

examples.english: The workers made a demand for safer conditions.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in bitzaw nasepna dinmun ngen uh hi.

examples.english: The company refused to meet their demands.
examples.zomi: Company in amau’ ngetna-te tangtun ding nial hi.

senses.usage_en: A demand is stronger than a request. It suggests that the speaker believes compliance is necessary.
senses.usage_zomi: Demand pen request sangin khauh zaw hi. Genpa in a ngetna zuih kul hi ci in um cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: The desire or need for goods or services
senses.definition_en: The amount of a product or service that people want or need to buy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipite in van ahih keileh nasepna nam khat a leih nopzah leh a kisapzah.

examples.english: Demand for affordable housing is increasing.
examples.zomi: Man pawmtheih inn kisapna hong khang hi.

examples.english: The factory cannot produce enough goods to meet demand.
examples.zomi: Van bawlna in kisapna zah tangtun ding van kicing bawltheilo hi.

senses.usage_en: In economics, demand is normally uncountable and often followed by for: demand for electricity.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumlehpai thu ah demand pen simsawm theihloh min hi a, for tawh kizom zel hi: demand for electricity.

senses.heading: To show something clearly through evidence or action
senses.definition_en: To show clearly that something is true, exists, or works in a particular way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat maan, a om takpi, ahih keileh a nasep dan teci leh gamtatna tawh kician takin lak.

common_phrases.zomi: thu khat maan cih teci lak

examples.english: The study demonstrates that regular exercise improves health.
examples.zomi: Kholna in pumpi pattah tawntungna in cidamna hoihsak cih lak hi.

examples.english: She demonstrated excellent leadership during the crisis.
examples.zomi: Haksat hunin makaihna hoih mahmah nei cih lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Demonstrate that… is common in formal and academic writing when evidence supports a conclusion.
senses.usage_zomi: Teci in thu khupna khat a panpih ciangin formal leh pilna laigelh ah demonstrate that… kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: To show how something is done or used
senses.definition_en: To explain how to perform an action or use a product by showing it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep khat bawldan ahih keileh van khat zatdan bawl in lak.

examples.english: The teacher demonstrated how to use the equipment.
examples.zomi: Sia in van zatdan bawl in lak hi.

examples.english: A chef demonstrated the correct way to cut the vegetables.
examples.zomi: Anhu siam in antuam tanna dan maan lak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning involves showing, not merely explaining with words.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah kammal tawh hilh bek hilo in, bawl takpi in lakna huam hi.

senses.heading: To take part in a public protest
senses.definition_en: To join a public gathering that expresses opposition to or support for something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mipi langdona ah kihel; kikalna lak
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat langdo ahih keileh panpihna mipite maiah lak dingin kikhop.

examples.english: Thousands demonstrated against the new law.
examples.zomi: Mi tul tampi in thukham thak langdo in kikhawm uh hi.

examples.english: The students demonstrated peacefully outside the building.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte inn pualam ah lemna tawh langdona lak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, demonstrate is usually intransitive and is often followed by against or in support of.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah demonstrate pen intransitive in kizang a, against ahih keileh in support of tawh kizom zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A medical professional trained to care for and treat teeth and gums.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ha leh ha sa don, enkhol, leh damsakna dingin a kisinsak cidamna siam.

examples.english: You should visit the dentist twice a year.
examples.zomi: Kum khat in nih vei ha siavuan kiangah na pai ding ahi hi.

examples.english: The dentist repaired her broken tooth.
examples.zomi: Ha siavuan in a ha kitam bawlkik hi.

senses.usage_en: A dentist treats teeth and gums. A dental hygienist mainly cleans teeth and provides preventive care.
senses.usage_zomi: Dentist in ha leh ha sa damsak hi. Dental hygienist in ha a siansuah pen leh natna kham kepna pia hi.

senses.heading: To say that something is not true
senses.definition_en: To state that an accusation, statement, or belief is false.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhpuhna, kammal, ahih keileh upna khat maanlo hi ci in nial.

examples.english: He denied taking the money.
examples.zomi: Ama in sum a lakloh thu gen in nial hi.

examples.english: The company strongly denied the accusation.
examples.zomi: Company in mawhpuhna khauhtak in nial hi.

senses.usage_en: Use deny doing something, not deny to do something: She denied breaking the window.
senses.usage_zomi: Deny doing something ci in kizang a, deny to do something ci in kizanglo hi: She denied breaking the window.

senses.heading: To refuse to give or allow something
senses.definition_en: To refuse to give someone something they need, request, or have a right to receive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a kisap, a nget, ahih keileh a ngah ding tawh kisai na khat pia lo.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat a thu ngah ding ngahsak lo

examples.english: The guard denied us access to the building.
examples.zomi: Vengpa in inn sung luttheihna hong pia lo hi.

examples.english: No child should be denied an education.
examples.zomi: Naupang khat zong pilna ngahsakloh ding hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: The usual patterns are deny someone something and deny something to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan ngeina pen deny someone something leh deny something to someone ahi hi.

senses.heading: A division of an organization
senses.definition_en: A section of a company, government, school, or other organization responsible for a particular type of work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Company, kumpi, sang, ahih keileh pawlpi khat sungah nasep nam khat a mawpuak khen.

examples.english: She works in the finance department.
examples.zomi: Ama sumlehpai nasep khen ah nasem hi.

examples.english: Contact the customer-service department for help.
examples.zomi: Huhna dingin leimite don nasep khen hopih in.

senses.usage_en: Use department of before its subject or responsibility: the Department of Education.
senses.usage_zomi: A mawpuak thu genna dingin department of kizang hi: the Department of Education.

senses.heading: A section of a large store
senses.definition_en: An area of a large shop that sells one particular type of product.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawr lian khat sungah van nam khat a kizukna khen.

examples.english: The shoe department is on the second floor.
examples.zomi: Khedap zuakna khen innsang nihna ah om hi.

examples.english: I found this coat in the women’s department.
examples.zomi: Hih puanlum numei van zuakna khen ah ka mu hi.

senses.usage_en: In a store, department refers to a sales section, not an independent organization.
senses.usage_zomi: Dawr ah department in van zuakna khen khat kawk a, pawlpi tuam khat kawklo hi.

senses.heading: The act of leaving
senses.definition_en: The act or time of leaving a place, especially at the beginning of a journey.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat pan paikhiatna ahih keileh paikhiat hun, a diakin khualzinna kipatna.

examples.english: Passengers should arrive two hours before departure.
examples.zomi: Khualzinte paikhiat ma nai nihin hong tung ding uh hi.

examples.english: The flight’s departure was delayed by heavy snow.
examples.zomi: Vuk tampi manin vanleng paikhiatna nungzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Departure is the opposite of arrival. At an airport, departures means the area or list for flights leaving.
senses.usage_zomi: Departure a langkhat pen arrival ahi hi. Vanleng ngakna mun ah departures in paikhiat ding vanlengte’ mun ahih keileh list kawk hi.

senses.heading: A change from an established practice
senses.definition_en: A new action or method that is different from what was previously done.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngeina pan kikhelna; lampi thak zuihna
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa a zui ngeina pan kikhel in lampi thak zuihna.

examples.english: The new design is a major departure from the earlier style.
examples.zomi: Design thak pen a beisa style pan kikhelna lian ahi hi.

examples.english: This policy marks a departure from past practice.
examples.zomi: Hih thukhun in a beisa gamtat ngeina pan kikhelna lak hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal meaning uses departure from to show the practice or standard being left.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna ah a kinusia ngeina ahih keileh tehna genna dingin departure from kizang hi.

senses.heading: To be determined or affected by something
senses.definition_en: To be decided, controlled, or changed by another condition or factor.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a pian ding pen dinmun ahih keileh thu dang khat tungah kinga.

examples.english: The picnic will depend on the weather.
examples.zomi: Pualam annekpawi bawl ding pen khuahun tungah kinga ding hi.

examples.english: The final cost depends on how much material we use.
examples.zomi: Sum sen ding zat pen van zatzah tungah kinga hi.

senses.usage_en: Depend is normally followed by on or upon: It depends on the situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Depend pen on ahih keileh upon tawh kizom zel hi: It depends on the situation.

senses.heading: To trust or rely on someone or something
senses.definition_en: To trust someone or something to provide help or do what is needed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat in huhna hong pia ding ahih keileh a kisam bang hong bawl ding ci in muang.

examples.english: You can depend on her to keep her promise.
examples.zomi: A kamciam a tangtun ding na muangthei hi.

examples.english: The two communities depend on each other.
examples.zomi: Khawlsung tegel khat leh khat kinga uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Depend on can mean either “be affected by” or “trust.” The surrounding context shows which meaning is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Depend on in “a tungah kinga” ahih keileh “muang” cihna nei thei hi. A kizop thu in khiatna lak hi.

senses.heading: Very unhappy and without hope
senses.definition_en: Feeling very sad, discouraged, or without hope.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dah mahmah, lungkia, ahih keileh lam-etna nei nawnlo bangin om.

examples.english: He felt depressed after losing his job.
examples.zomi: A nasep a mansuah khit ciangin lungkia mahmah hi.

examples.english: She became depressed because she felt alone.
examples.zomi: Amah bek a om bang a kisak manin lungkia hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday speech, depressed may mean very unhappy. It can also refer to depression, a medical condition that should be assessed by a qualified health professional.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim kampau ah depressed in dah leh lungkia mahmah cihna ahi thei hi. Siavuan in a enkhol ding lungsim cidamna natna depression zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Economically weak
senses.definition_en: Having little economic activity, few jobs, or widespread poverty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumlehpai nasepna tawm, nasepna tawm, ahih keileh gentheihna a tam dinmun.

examples.english: The program supports businesses in economically depressed areas.
examples.zomi: Program in sumlehpai lamah a thanem gamte sunga sum nasepna-te panpih hi.

examples.english: The town remained depressed after the factory closed.
examples.zomi: Van bawlna a kikhak khit zongin khuapi sumlehpai dinmun thanem lai hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal meaning describes an economy or region, not a person’s emotions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna in sumlehpai ahih keileh gam dinmun kawk a, mi khat lungsim sukna kawklo hi.

senses.definition_en: Making someone feel sad, discouraged, or without hope.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat dahsak, lungkiasak, ahih keileh lam-etna beisak.

examples.english: The report contained depressing news about the economy.
examples.zomi: Report sungah sumlehpai tawh kisai thuthang dahhuai om hi.

examples.english: The empty and damaged town was a depressing sight.
examples.zomi: Khuapi awng leh kisia muh pen lungkiasak mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: A person feels depressed; an event, place, or piece of news can be depressing.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat pen depressed hi; thu piang, mun, ahih keileh thuthang khat pen depressing ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom
senses.definition_en: The measurement of how deep something is.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a tung ahih keileh a mai pan a taw dong a thukzah tehna.

examples.english: The lake reaches a depth of thirty metres.
examples.zomi: Dil pen metre sawmthum dong thuk hi.

examples.english: They measured the depth of the hole.
examples.zomi: Kok a thukzah teh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Deep is the adjective; depth is the noun: a deep lake; the depth of the lake.
senses.usage_zomi: Deep pen adjective a, depth pen noun ahi hi: a deep lake; the depth of the lake.

senses.heading: Seriousness, strength, or complexity
senses.definition_en: The degree to which an emotion, idea, or situation is serious, strong, or complex.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim sukna, ngaihsutna, ahih keileh dinmun khat a khauhzah leh a thukzah.

examples.english: Her writing shows great depth of thought.
examples.zomi: A laigelh in ngaihsutna thuk nei cih lak hi.

examples.english: We did not understand the depth of the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaina a thukzah ka telkei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense refers to seriousness or completeness, not physical distance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak khiatna in pumpi tawh teh gamlatna hilo a, a thu thukna ahih keileh a kicingna kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: To explain in words what a person, object, place, event, or experience is like.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, mun, thu piang, ahih keileh muhkhakna khat bang a hihlam kammal tawh hilh.

examples.english: Can you describe the person you saw?
examples.zomi: Na muh mi bang a hihlam na gen thei diam?

examples.english: She described what happened during the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident sungah bang thu piang cih gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Use describe something to someone, not describe someone something: Describe the problem to me.
senses.usage_zomi: Describe something to someone ci in kizang a, describe someone something ci in kizanglo hi: Describe the problem to me.

senses.definition_en: A spoken or written account explaining what someone or something is like.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat bang a hihlam kampau ahih keileh laigelh tawh a hilhcian thu.

examples.english: The witness gave a clear description of the car.
examples.zomi: Tecipa in mawtaw bang a hihlam kician takin gen hi.

examples.english: Read the job description before applying.
examples.zomi: Nasepna na nget ma in nasep mawpuakna pulaakna sim in.

senses.usage_en: A description explains characteristics or appearance. It is not necessarily an explanation of causes.
senses.usage_zomi: Description in pianzia ahih keileh melmuh dan hilh hi. Banghangin tua bangin om cih a ziang hilhcian pah tuanlo hi.

senses.definition_en: A large, dry area of land with very little rain and few plants.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gua tawm mahmah, tui leh singkung tawm, leikeu gam zaipi.

examples.english: Very little rain falls in the desert.
examples.zomi: Gamkeu ah gua tawm mahmah zu hi.

examples.english: Some plants can survive in the desert.
examples.zomi: Singkung pawlkhat gamkeu ah nungta thei hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun desert is pronounced /ˈdɛzərt/. Do not confuse it with dessert /dɪˈzɝːt/, the sweet food eaten after a meal.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun desert pen /ˈdɛzərt/ ci in kipau hi. Annek khit a kine nek lim dessert /dɪˈzɝːt/ tawh helkhawm loh ding hi.

senses.definition_en: To have earned or be worthy of something because of one’s actions, qualities, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, pianzia, ahih keileh dinmun hangin na khat ngah taak.

examples.english: The volunteers deserve our thanks.
examples.zomi: A thawn nasemte ka lungdamkohna uh ngah taak hi.

examples.english: She worked hard and deserved to succeed.
examples.zomi: Ama hahkat takin sem ahih manin gualzo taak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use deserve something or deserve to do something: deserve praise; deserve to win.
senses.usage_zomi: Deserve something ahih keileh deserve to do something ci in kizang hi: deserve praise; deserve to win.

senses.heading: A plan showing how something will be made
senses.definition_en: A drawing, plan, or arrangement showing the appearance, structure, or operation of something before it is made.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kibawl ma in a mel, a kizopzia, ahih keileh a nasep dan a lak lim leh geelna.

examples.english: The architect showed us the building design.
examples.zomi: Inn lam siam in inn bawldan geelna hong lak hi.

examples.english: The team is working on a new product design.
examples.zomi: Pawl in van thak bawldan geelna bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A design may be a plan, drawing, model, or complete arrangement—not only a decorative picture.
senses.usage_zomi: Design pen geelna, lim, limpuak model, ahih keileh a kizopzia kicing ahi thei a, zeenna lim bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: A decorative pattern or style
senses.definition_en: A pattern, arrangement, or style used to make something attractive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat kilawm sakna dingin a kibawl lim, zeendan, ahih keileh pianzia.

examples.english: The cloth has a beautiful traditional design.
examples.zomi: Puan in ngeina lim kilawm khat nei hi.

examples.english: She chose a simple design for the cover.
examples.zomi: A tuam dingin lim baihlam khat teel hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, design refers to visible style or pattern rather than a technical plan.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah design in muh theih zeendan ahih keileh lim kawk a, van bawlna technical geelna kawklo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who plans the appearance, structure, or function of products, buildings, clothing, graphics, or other creations.
senses.zomi_equivalents: design bawl mi; pianzia geel siam
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, inn, puan, lim, ahih keileh bawlkhia ding dangte a mel, kizopzia leh nasep dan geelkhol mi.

common_phrases.zomi: lim leh laigelh design bawl mi

examples.english: She works as a graphic designer.
examples.zomi: Ama lim leh laigelh design bawl mi in nasem hi.

examples.english: The designer created a safer chair.
examples.zomi: Designer in tokna bitzaw khat bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A designer plans how something will look or function. The person who physically makes it may be someone else.
senses.usage_zomi: Designer in na khat a mel leh a nasep dan geelkhol hi. A taktak in a bawl mi ahihleh mi dang ahi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A strong feeling of wanting something or wanting something to happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngah nopna ahih keileh thu khat piang sak nopna khauh.

examples.english: She has a strong desire to help others.
examples.zomi: Ama in midangte huh nopna khauh nei hi.

examples.english: The experience increased his desire to learn.
examples.zomi: Tua muhkhakna in a kisinna nopna khang sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Desire is stronger and more formal than want. Common patterns are desire for something and desire to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Desire pen want sangin khauh leh formal zaw hi. Desire for something leh desire to do something ci in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A table or piece of furniture used for reading, writing, studying, or office work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu simna, laigelhna, sinna, ahih keileh office nasep bawlna ding sabuai.

examples.english: The papers are on my desk.
examples.zomi: Laikhakte ka nasep sabuai tungah om hi.

examples.english: She spent the morning working at her desk.
examples.zomi: Zingsang a vekpi a sabuai ah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: At a desk usually describes working or studying there. On the desk describes the position of an object.
senses.usage_zomi: At a desk in tua munah nasep ahih keileh sinna gen hi. On the desk in van khat sabuai tungah a omna gen hi.

senses.heading: Feeling that a situation is hopeless
senses.definition_en: Feeling extremely worried or hopeless and willing to do almost anything to improve the situation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lam-etna bei; lunghihmawh lua; a haksat lua
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun hoih sakna ding lam-etna tawm mahmah in lunghihmawh lua a, na bangpeuh bawl ngam.

examples.english: The family was desperate for news about their missing son.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in a tapa mang thu theih nopna tawh lunghihmawh mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: She felt desperate after months without work.
examples.zomi: Kha tampi nasepna a neihloh khit ciangin lam-etna bei bangin om hi.

senses.usage_en: Desperate for something means needing or wanting it extremely badly. Desperate to do something means being willing to make a great effort.
senses.usage_zomi: Desperate for something in na khat kisam ahih keileh deih mahmah cihna ahi hi. Desperate to do something in hanciam mahmah ngam cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Extremely serious or urgent
senses.definition_en: Very serious and requiring immediate action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasia mahmah a, tu mahmah in khutzat kisam.

examples.english: The area is in desperate need of clean water.
examples.zomi: Tua gam in tui siangtho kisam mahmah hi.

examples.english: They made a desperate attempt to save the building.
examples.zomi: Inn honkhia dingin a nunungpen in hanciam mahmah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning describes the seriousness of a need, shortage, or attempt rather than a person’s emotion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mi khat lungsim sukna sangin kisapna, kicinglohna, ahih keileh hanciamna a nasiazia kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Without being prevented or changed by a difficulty, fact, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna, thu maan, ahih keileh dinmun khat om napi, tua in a dang sak hetlo in.

examples.english: Despite the rain, the event continued.
examples.zomi: Gua zu napi, pawi kizom lai hi.

examples.english: She succeeded despite many difficulties.
examples.zomi: Haksatna tampi om napi ama gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: Despite is followed by a noun, pronoun, or -ing form: despite the rain; despite being tired. Do not say despite of. Use in spite of instead.
senses.usage_zomi: Despite khit ah noun, pronoun, ahih keileh -ing form om hi: despite the rain; despite being tired. Despite of kici lo hi; in spite of kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: The place to which someone or something is travelling or being sent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh van khat a paihna ahih keileh a kipuakna a tawpna mun.

examples.english: We reached our destination before sunset.
examples.zomi: Ni tum ma in ka paihna mun uh tung ung.

examples.english: The package is on its way to its final destination.
examples.zomi: Package pen a nunungpen tunna mun lamah pai lai hi.

senses.usage_en: Destination is the endpoint of a journey. A route is the path taken to reach it.
senses.usage_zomi: Destination pen khualzinna a tawpna mun ahi hi. Route pen tua mun tunna ding a kizui lampi ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To damage something so severely that it no longer exists, works, or can be repaired.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a om nawnlo, nasem thei nawnlo, ahih keileh puah thei nawnlo dong susia.

examples.english: The fire destroyed several houses.
examples.zomi: Mei in inn pawlkhat susia hi.

examples.english: The documents were destroyed to hide the evidence.
examples.zomi: Teci seelna dingin laikhakte kisusia hi.

senses.usage_en: Destroy is stronger than damage. Damaged things may still exist or be repaired; destroyed things normally cannot be restored.
senses.usage_zomi: Destroy pen damage sangin khauh zaw hi. A kisia na khat om lai ahih keileh puahkik theih ahi thei a; a kisusia na khat pen ngeina in puahkik theih nawnlo hi.

senses.heading: A small piece of information
senses.definition_en: A small fact or piece of information about a larger subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu lianzaw khat tawh kisai thu neu ahih keileh ciaptehna neu khat.

examples.english: Please check every detail before signing the document.
examples.zomi: Laikhak na minthuh ma in thu neu khempeuh enpha in.

examples.english: The police asked for more details about the accident.
examples.zomi: Police-te in accident tawh kisai thu kicingzaw ngen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Detail is countable for individual facts. The phrase in detail means thoroughly and with full information.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu khat ciat a kawk ciangin detail pen simsawm theih hi. In detail in kicing leh thuk takin cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A small feature in a design or work
senses.definition_en: A small part or feature of a picture, design, building, or piece of work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim, design, inn, ahih keileh nasep khat sunga khen neu khat.

examples.english: The artist included many small details in the painting.
examples.zomi: Lim bawl siam in lim sungah khen neu tampi beh hi.

examples.english: Good editors pay attention to every detail.
examples.zomi: Laigelh puah siamsate in thu neu khempeuh don uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Attention to detail means carefully noticing and handling small but important parts.
senses.usage_zomi: Attention to detail in khen neu napi a thupi-te pilvang takin mu leh khutzat cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Containing many facts, explanations, or small features.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thu kicing; khen neu tampi nei
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, hilhcian na, ahih keileh khen neu tampi huam.

examples.english: The report provides a detailed analysis of the problem.
examples.zomi: Report in buaina thu kicing takin khenkhia in kan hi.

examples.english: She gave us detailed instructions.
examples.zomi: Ama in thu hilhna kicing hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Detailed means including many relevant particulars. It does not necessarily mean difficult or complicated.
senses.usage_zomi: Detailed in thu tawh kisai khen neu kicing a huam cihna ahi hi. Haksa ahih keileh buaihuai cihna hituanlo hi.

senses.definition_en: To discover or notice something that is hidden, difficult to see, or not immediately obvious.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kiseel, muh haksa, ahih keileh theih pahloh na khat zonkhia ahih keileh thei.

examples.english: The test can detect the disease at an early stage.
examples.zomi: Sittelna in natna pen a kipatcil pan theikhia thei hi.

examples.english: The alarm detected movement near the door.
examples.zomi: Vauna van in kong geia kihihna thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Detect often describes discovering something through careful observation, testing, or equipment. It is more precise than simply see.
senses.usage_zomi: Detect in pilvang takin enna, sittelna, ahih keileh van zatna tawh na khat theihkhia cihna ahi zel hi. See sangin a kicianzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A police officer or private investigator whose work is to discover facts about crimes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhna tawh kisai thu maan leh teci zonkhia dingin a nasem police ahih keileh mimal thu kantheipa.

examples.english: The detective interviewed several witnesses.
examples.zomi: Thu kan mi in teci pawlkhat dong hi.

examples.english: A private detective was hired to find the missing person.
examples.zomi: Mi mang zonna dingin mimal thu kan mi khat kisepsak hi.

senses.usage_en: A detective investigates crimes or mysteries. A police officer is not necessarily a detective.
senses.usage_zomi: Detective in mawhna ahih keileh theih haksa thu kan hi. Police officer khempeuh detective hituanlo hi.

senses.heading: To discover or establish a fact
senses.definition_en: To discover or decide the exact facts about something through examination or investigation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Enkholna ahih keileh thu kanna tawh thu khat a maan taktak kipsak.

examples.english: The test will determine the cause of the problem.
examples.zomi: Sittelna in buaina a ziang theikhia ding hi.

examples.english: Doctors are trying to determine whether the treatment worked.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te in cidamna kepna a tangtun leh tangtunloh khensat ding hanciam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, determine is formal and means finding a definite answer through evidence or examination.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah determine pen formal hi a, teci leh enkholna tawh dawnna kician zonkhia cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To control or decide a result
senses.definition_en: To control, influence, or decide what will happen.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khensak; uk; a thu piang ding kipsak
senses.explanation_zomi: Bang thu piang ding a uk, a suk, ahih keileh a khensak.

examples.english: Experience may determine who gets the job.
examples.zomi: Muhkhakna in kuamah nasepna ngah ding khensak thei hi.

examples.english: Several factors determine the final price.
examples.zomi: Thu tuamtuam in a nunungpen man khensak hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, the subject is the factor that causes or controls the final result.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah subject pen a tawpna thu piangsak ahih keileh uk thu ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Having made a firm decision and refusing to give up.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khensat kip; lungkia lo; hanciam kip
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tangtun ding kip takin khensat a, lungkiat hetlo in hanciam.

examples.english: She is determined to finish her education.
examples.zomi: Ama in a pilna zo takpi ding khensat kip hi.

examples.english: The team remained determined despite the early defeat.
examples.zomi: A kipatcil a guallel hangin pawl lungkia hetlo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The common pattern is determined to do something. Determined describes firm purpose, not merely a strong wish.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan ngeina pen determined to do something ahi hi. Determined in deihna bek hilo a, ngiimna tangtun ding khensat kip cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: To grow or change gradually
senses.definition_en: To grow, change, or become more advanced over time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tawh khang, kikhel, ahih keileh ma khang semsem.

examples.english: Children develop at different rates.
examples.zomi: Naupangte khan dan kibanglo hi.

examples.english: The small business developed into a large company.
examples.zomi: Sum nasepna neu pen company lian khat suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Develop into names the later form: The village developed into a town.
senses.usage_zomi: A nung ciangin bang hong suak cih genna dingin develop into kizang hi: The village developed into a town.

senses.heading: To create or improve something
senses.definition_en: To create a new product, system, idea, or plan, or make an existing one better.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, system, ngaihsutna, ahih keileh geelna thak bawl, a om khin zong hoihzaw sak.

examples.english: The company is developing a new medical device.
examples.zomi: Company in cidamna van thak khat bawl lai hi.

examples.english: We need to develop a better plan.
examples.zomi: Geelna hoihzaw khat i bawl kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Develop emphasizes a process of creating and improving something over time, not producing it instantly.
senses.usage_zomi: Develop in na khat thakhatthu in bawlkhit cihna hilo a, hun la in bawl leh hoihzaw sak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To begin to have an illness or condition
senses.definition_en: To begin to have a disease, problem, habit, or physical condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Natna, buaina, ngeina, ahih keileh pumpi dinmun khat hong nei kipan.

examples.english: He developed a fever during the night.
examples.zomi: Zan sungin a khosik hong naik hi.

examples.english: Some patients develop breathing problems.
examples.zomi: Cina pawlkhat in hu sang haksatna hong nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In medical contexts, develop means that a condition begins or appears; it does not mean that the person created it intentionally.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna thu ah develop in natna hong kipan ahih keileh hong kilang cihna ahi a, mi in a lungsim takpi tawh a bawl cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Growth or gradual improvement
senses.definition_en: The process of growing, changing, or becoming more advanced.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khan, kikhel, ahih keileh ma khang semsemna kalsuan.

examples.english: Education supports a child’s development.
examples.zomi: Pilna in naupang khanna panpih hi.

examples.english: The project promotes economic development in rural areas.
examples.zomi: Geelna in gamlak sumlehpai ma khanna khang sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is often uncountable when referring generally to growth or improvement.
senses.usage_zomi: Khan kikhelna ahih keileh ma khanna a huam in gen ciangin development pen simsawm theihloh min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: The creation of something new
senses.definition_en: The process of designing, creating, and improving a new product, system, or idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, system, ahih keileh ngaihsutna thak geel, bawl, leh hoihzaw sakna kalsuan.

examples.english: The company invested in software development.
examples.zomi: Company in software bawlna ah sum koih hi.

examples.english: The medicine is still under development.
examples.zomi: Si pen bawl leh sittel lai ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Under development means that something is still being designed, built, or improved.
senses.usage_zomi: Under development in na khat geel, bawl, ahih keileh hoihzaw sak lai cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A new event or change
senses.definition_en: A recent event or change in a continuing situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kizom khat sungah a thak in a piang thu ahih keileh kikhelna.

examples.english: Police announced a new development in the case.
examples.zomi: Police-te in thukhenna thu sunga thu thak khat tangko uh hi.

examples.english: We are following the latest political developments.
examples.zomi: Gamvai thu thak pente ka zui uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In news reporting, development often means a new fact or change in an ongoing story.
senses.usage_zomi: Thuthang ah development in thu kizom laia thu thak ahih keileh kikhelna khat kawk zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A machine, tool, or piece of electronic equipment made for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna tuam khat dingin a kibawl machine, vanzat, ahih keileh electronic van.

examples.english: This device measures blood pressure.
examples.zomi: Hih van in sisan pressure teh hi.

examples.english: Students must turn off electronic devices during the examination.
examples.zomi: Sittelna laitak in sangnaupangte electronic vante mit ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Device is a general word. Use a more specific name—such as phone, sensor, or machine—when it is known and useful.
senses.usage_zomi: Device pen vanzat a huamzai min hi. Phone, sensor, ahih keileh machine bang min kician kithei leh tua min zat hoihzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A simple drawing that explains how something works, is arranged, or is connected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a nasep dan, a kizopzia, ahih keileh a kiseh dan hilhcian dingin a kibawl lim baihlam.

examples.english: The diagram shows how the parts are connected.
examples.zomi: Lim in khen tuamtuam a kizop dan lak hi.

examples.english: Draw a diagram of the water cycle.
examples.zomi: Tui kihei kizung a hilhcian lim suai in.

senses.usage_en: A diagram explains structure or process. A picture mainly shows what something looks like.
senses.usage_zomi: Diagram in na khat a kizopzia ahih keileh a kalsuan dan hilh hi. Picture in na khat a mel pen lak hi.

senses.heading: A conversation between two or more people
senses.definition_en: A spoken or written conversation between two or more people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nih ahih keileh a tamzaw kikalah kampau ahih keileh laigelh tawh kiholimna.

examples.english: The students practised a dialogue in English.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte English kiholimna khat kisinsak uh hi.

examples.english: The novel contains realistic dialogue.
examples.zomi: Tangthu laibu sungah nisim kiholimna tawh a kibang kampau om hi.

senses.usage_en: In stories and plays, dialogue is the speech exchanged by characters.
senses.usage_zomi: Tangthu leh drama ah dialogue pen tangthu sunga mite kikal kiholimna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A serious discussion intended to solve a problem
senses.definition_en: A discussion between people or groups intended to improve understanding or resolve disagreement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh pawl kikal telkhopna khang sak leh kilemlohna veng dingin a kibawl thu kikumna.

examples.english: The two groups agreed to begin a dialogue.
examples.zomi: Pawl tegel thu kikum kipan ding kithukim uh hi.

examples.english: Open dialogue can reduce misunderstanding.
examples.zomi: Lungsim hong kiholimna in kitelkhialhna tawm sak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this formal sense, dialogue emphasizes communication and mutual understanding rather than argument.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna ah dialogue in kidemna sangin kizopna leh khat leh khat kitelna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: A very hard and valuable precious stone
senses.definition_en: A clear and extremely hard precious stone used especially in jewellery.
senses.explanation_zomi: A limlang, a khauh mahmah, a manpha a, a diakin zeenna van ah a kizang suang manpha.

examples.english: She wore a diamond ring.
examples.zomi: Ama diamond zung bulh hi.

examples.english: Diamonds are among the hardest natural materials.
examples.zomi: Diamond pen leitung pianpih van khauhpen-te lakah khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A diamond may be natural or laboratory-made. The word describes the material, not automatically its origin.
senses.usage_zomi: Diamond pen leitung pianpih ahi thei a, laboratory ah kibawl zong ahi thei hi. Tua kammal in a pianna mun khensat pahlo hi.

senses.heading: A shape with four sloping sides
senses.definition_en: A shape with four straight sides that looks like a square standing on one corner.
senses.explanation_zomi: A pang li nei a, square khat a mong khat tungah ding bangin a kilang lim.

examples.english: The road sign has a yellow diamond shape.
examples.zomi: Lampi lim in diamond lim eng nei hi.

examples.english: The cloth is decorated with a diamond pattern.
examples.zomi: Puan pen diamond lim tawh kizeen hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday English, diamond describes this visual shape, although its exact mathematical name may be rhombus.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim English ah hih lim pen diamond kici napi, mathematics min kician pen rhombus ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: A personal record of daily experiences
senses.definition_en: A book or digital record in which someone writes about personal experiences, thoughts, and feelings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in nisim a muhkhakna, ngaihsutna leh lungsim sukna a gelhna laibu ahih keileh digital ciaptehna.

examples.english: She writes in her diary every evening.
examples.zomi: Ama nitak simin a diary sungah gelh hi.

examples.english: His diary describes life during the war.
examples.zomi: A diary in gal hun nuntakzia pulak hi.

senses.usage_en: A diary is usually private and records personal experiences. A journal may be personal, academic, or professional.
senses.usage_zomi: Diary pen mimal a sim zaw hi a, mimal muhkhakna gelh hi. Journal pen mimal, pilna, ahih keileh nasep tawh kisai ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: A book or digital tool for planning appointments
senses.definition_en: A book or electronic calendar used to record appointments and planned activities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimuh hun leh geelkhawl nasepte ciaptehna laibu ahih keileh electronic calendar.

examples.english: I will check my diary before confirming the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ka kipsak ma in ka hun ciaptehna ka en ding hi.

examples.english: Please put the appointment in your diary.
examples.zomi: Kimuh hun na diary sungah gelh in.

senses.usage_en: This planning sense is especially common in British English. American English often uses calendar or planner.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih geelna khiatna pen British English ah kizang tam hi. American English ah calendar ahih keileh planner kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A book or digital reference that lists words and explains their meanings, pronunciations, spellings, or translations.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammalte a kizom in a kikoih a, a khiatna, kipaudan, spelling, ahih keileh pau dang khiatna a hilh laibu leh digital reference.

common_phrases.english: look up a word in a dictionary

examples.english: Use a dictionary to check the word’s pronunciation.
examples.zomi: Kammal kipaudan enkikna dingin dictionary zang in.

examples.english: This dictionary gives English words with Standard Zomi meanings.
examples.zomi: Hih dictionary in English kammalte Standard Zomi khiatna tawh pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A dictionary explains words. An encyclopedia gives broader information about people, places, events, and subjects.
senses.usage_zomi: Dictionary in kammal khiatna hilh hi. Encyclopedia in mi, mun, thu piang leh thulu tuamtuam tawh kisai thu zaizaw pia hi.

senses.heading: To stop living
senses.definition_en: To reach the end of life and stop being alive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuntakna tawp in nungta nawnlo.

examples.english: The old man died peacefully in his sleep.
examples.zomi: Upa pen a ihmut laitak in lungnuam takin si hi.

examples.english: Many plants died because of the extreme heat.
examples.zomi: Khuahun lum lua manin singkung tampi si hi.

senses.usage_en: Die is a verb, dead is an adjective, and death is a noun: The plant died; it is dead; its death was caused by heat.
senses.usage_zomi: Die pen verb, dead pen adjective, death pen noun ahi hi: The plant died; it is dead; its death was caused by heat.

senses.heading: To stop working or lose power
senses.definition_en: For a machine, battery, engine, or fire to stop working or producing energy.
