senses.explanation_zomi: Machine, battery, engine, ahih keileh mei a nasepna ahih keileh a tha tawp.

examples.english: My phone died during the trip.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna sungin ka phone battery tha bei hi.

examples.english: The fire slowly died during the night.
examples.zomi: Zan sungin mei tawm tawm in mit hi.

senses.usage_en: This is an informal figurative use. The object was not alive; it stopped operating or lost energy.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen nisim limpuak zatdan hi. Van pen nungta ahih man hilo a, a nasepna ahih keileh a tha tawp cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The food and drink normally consumed
senses.definition_en: The kinds of food and drink that a person or animal usually consumes.
senses.zomi_equivalents: annek ngeina; annek leh dawn nam
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh ganhing khat in a ngeina in a nek leh dawn an namte.

examples.english: A healthy diet includes different kinds of food.
examples.zomi: Annek ngeina cidam in an nam tuamtuam huam hi.

examples.english: Fruit is an important part of their daily diet.
examples.zomi: Singgah pen amau’ nisim annek ngeina khen thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, everyone and every animal has a diet; it does not necessarily mean eating less food.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah mi leh ganhing khempeuh in diet nei hi; an tawm nek cihna bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: A controlled eating plan
senses.definition_en: A planned way of eating intended to reduce weight or improve health.
senses.zomi_equivalents: annek geelna; cidamna ding annek dan
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi gikna kiam sak ahih keileh cidamna hoihsak dingin a geelkhawl annek dan.

examples.english: The doctor advised him to follow a low-salt diet.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ci tawm annek dan zui ding hilh hi.

examples.english: She went on a diet to improve her health.
examples.zomi: A cidamna hoihsak dingin annek geelna zui hi.

senses.usage_en: Go on a diet usually means beginning a controlled eating plan. Avoid assuming that every diet is for weight loss.
senses.usage_zomi: Go on a diet in a kigelh annek dan khat zui kipan cihna ahi hi. Diet khempeuh pumpi gikna kiam sakna ding hi ci in ngaihsut loh ding hi.

senses.heading: A way in which things are not the same
senses.definition_en: A quality or feature that makes one person or thing unlike another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh na khat midang ahih keileh na dang tawh a kibanglohna.

examples.english: There is an important difference between price and value.
examples.zomi: Man leh manphatna kikal ah kilamdanna thupi om hi.

examples.english: I noticed a difference in the quality.
examples.zomi: A hoihna dinmun ah kilamdanna ka mu hi.

senses.usage_en: Use difference between A and B, not normally difference of A and B.
senses.usage_zomi: Difference between A and B ci in kizang a, ngeina in difference of A and B ci in kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: A disagreement
senses.definition_en: A disagreement in opinion between people or groups.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh pawl kikal ngaihsutdan kibanglohna.

examples.english: The two leaders have serious political differences.
examples.zomi: Makaite tegel gamvai ngaihsutdan ah kilamdanna lian nei uh hi.

examples.english: They agreed to put their differences aside.
examples.zomi: Amau’ kilemlohna koihkhia ding kithukim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, differences is often plural because several points of disagreement may be involved.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah kilemlohna thu tampi om thei ahih manin differences ci in plural kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: An effect or improvement
senses.definition_en: A noticeable effect or change produced by someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat in a piangsak kikhelna ahih keileh hoihna.

examples.english: A small act of kindness can make a big difference.
examples.zomi: Hehpihna gamtat neu khat in kikhelna lian piangsak thei hi.

examples.english: The new medicine made no difference to his condition.
examples.zomi: Si thak in a cidamna dinmun kikhel saklo hi.

senses.usage_en: Make a difference means producing a noticeable effect, often a helpful one.
senses.usage_zomi: Make a difference in kimuthei kikhelna khat piangsak cihna ahi a, hoihna piangsakna gen zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Not the same as another person or thing, or unlike what was expected or usual.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na dang tawh kibanglo, ahih keileh ngeina leh lam-etna tawh kibanglo.

examples.english: Her experience was different from mine.
examples.zomi: Ama’ muhkhakna kei’ muhkhakna tawh kibanglo hi.

examples.english: The two words have different meanings.
examples.zomi: Kammal tegel khiatna kibanglo hi.

senses.usage_en: Different from is standard in all forms of English. Different than is also common in American English, especially before a clause.
senses.usage_zomi: Different from pen English nam khempeuh ah standard hi. American English ah, a diakin clause ma ah, different than zong kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: In a way that is not the same as another way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang ahih keileh bawldan dang tawh a kibanglo in.

examples.english: Different cultures may communicate differently.
examples.zomi: Ngeina tuamtuamte kizopdan kibanglo thei hi.

examples.english: We need to approach the problem differently.
examples.zomi: Buaina pen bawldan tuam tawh i khutzat kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Different modifies a noun; differently modifies a verb: a different method; work differently.
senses.usage_zomi: Different in noun a hilhcian a, differently in verb a hilhcian hi: a different method; work differently.

senses.heading: Requiring effort, skill, or thought
senses.definition_en: Not easy to do, understand, solve, or manage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawl, tel, veng, ahih keileh uk ding baihlo a, hanciamna leh siamna kisam.

examples.english: The examination was more difficult than expected.
examples.zomi: Sittelna pen lam-et sangin haksa zaw hi.

examples.english: This word is difficult to pronounce.
examples.zomi: Hih kammal paukhia haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: Use difficult to do something: The book is difficult to understand. Do not use difficult for understanding in this pattern.
senses.usage_zomi: Difficult to do something ci in kizang hi: The book is difficult to understand. Hih zatdan ah difficult for understanding kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: Hard to deal with
senses.definition_en: Uncooperative, demanding, or likely to cause problems.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khutzat, kihopih, ahih keileh uk ding haksa a, buaina piangsak thei.

examples.english: The manager remained calm with a difficult customer.
examples.zomi: Ukpa in leimi khutzat haksa tawh om ciangin lungnem takin om hi.

examples.english: They are facing a difficult situation.
examples.zomi: Dinmun haksa maingat uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling a person difficult usually comments on behaviour, not on that person’s value or worth.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat difficult kicih in a gamtatna khutzat haksa cihna ahi a, mi a manphatlohna gen hilo hi.

senses.heading: The condition of being difficult
senses.definition_en: The quality of requiring effort, skill, or thought.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl, tel, ahih keileh veng dingin hanciamna leh siamna a kisapna.

examples.english: She completed the task without difficulty.
examples.zomi: Nasep pen haksatna omlo in zo hi.

examples.english: Many learners have difficulty pronouncing this sound.
examples.zomi: Sin mi tampi in hih aw paukhia ding haksa sa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use have difficulty doing something, not normally have difficulty to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Have difficulty doing something ci in kizang a, ngeina in have difficulty to do something kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: A problem or obstacle
senses.definition_en: A problem or situation that makes progress harder.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ma khanna a khaktan buaina ahih keileh dalna.

examples.english: The business faced financial difficulties.
examples.zomi: Sum nasepna in sumlehpai haksatna maingat hi.

examples.english: They overcame many difficulties during the project.
examples.zomi: Geelna sungin haksatna tampi zo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Individual problems are countable and often plural: several difficulties. General difficulty is usually uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Buaina khat ciat a kawk ciangin simsawm theih a, several difficulties ci in plural kizang thei hi. Haksatna a huam in gen ciangin simsawm theihloh min ahi hi.

senses.heading: To make a hole by moving soil
senses.definition_en: To break and move earth with a tool, machine, hands, or feet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanzat, machine, khut, ahih keileh khe tawh lei lai leh suankhia.

examples.english: The workers dug a deep hole beside the road.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in lampi gei ah kok thuk khat lai uh hi.

examples.english: The dog was digging in the garden.
examples.zomi: Ui in huan sungah lei lai hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle of dig are dug: dig–dug–dug.
senses.usage_zomi: Dig a past tense leh past participle pen dug ahi hi: dig–dug–dug.

senses.heading: To search carefully
senses.definition_en: To search through something in order to find information or an object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih keileh van khat zonkhia dingin pilvang takin kan.

examples.english: The reporter dug into the company’s financial records.
examples.zomi: Thuthang gelhpa in company’ sumlehpai ciaptehna-te kan hi.

examples.english: We need to dig deeper to find the truth.
examples.zomi: Thu maan zonkhia dingin thukzaw in i kan kul hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense suggests persistent and careful investigation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak khiatna in lungkia lo leh pilvang takin thu kan cihna lak hi.

senses.definition_en: Using electronic technology to store, process, or communicate information as numbers or signals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu pen number ahih keileh signal in koih, khutzat, leh kizoppihna ding electronic technology zang.

examples.english: The library is converting old records into digital files.
examples.zomi: Laibu inn in ciaptehna luite digital file in khe lai hi.

examples.english: Digital technology has changed the way people communicate.
examples.zomi: Digital technology in mihingte kizopdan khe hi.

senses.usage_en: Digital describes electronic information and technology. It does not simply mean modern or connected to the internet.
senses.usage_zomi: Digital in electronic thu leh technology kawk hi. Tuhun van ahih keileh internet tawh kizom peuhmah cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: The main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni khat sunga annek thupi pen, ngeina in nitak a kine.

examples.english: We usually have dinner at seven o’clock.
examples.zomi: Ka ngeina un nai sagih ciangin nitak an ne ung.

examples.english: She invited her friends to dinner.
examples.zomi: Ama in a lawmte nitak an nekhawm dingin sam hi.

senses.usage_en: In some regions, dinner means the main meal even when it is eaten at midday. Supper usually refers to an evening meal.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam pawlkhat ah dinner pen sunlai a kine napi ni khat sunga annek thupi pen kawk hi. Supper in nitak an kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Going straight to a place without interruption
senses.definition_en: Going from one place to another without changing vehicles, stopping unnecessarily, or passing through an intermediary.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tang; kizom pah; mi dang tungtawnlo
senses.explanation_zomi: Van dang kilaihlo, kisawtlo, ahih keileh mi dang tungtawnlo in mun khat pan mun dang ah a pai.

examples.english: Is there a direct flight from Columbus to London?
examples.zomi: Columbus pan London dong vanleng tang om hiam?

examples.english: This road provides a direct route to the hospital.
examples.zomi: Hih lampi in zato inn tunna lampi tang pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Direct often means that there is no change, interruption, or intermediary.
senses.usage_zomi: Direct in kilaihlohna, khawllohna, ahih keileh mi dang tungtawnlohna kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Clear, honest, and straightforward
senses.definition_en: Saying clearly what you mean without avoiding the main point.
senses.explanation_zomi: A thu bulpi pelhlo in kician leh thumaan takin gen.

examples.english: She gave me a direct answer.
examples.zomi: Ama in dawnna kician hong pia hi.

examples.english: Please be direct about what you need.
examples.zomi: Na kisapna kician takin gen in.

senses.usage_en: Being direct can be helpful, but in some situations it may sound too forceful unless expressed politely.
senses.usage_zomi: Direct in thu kitel sak napi, dinmun pawlkhat ah zahtak takin kigenlo leh a khauh lua bangin ging thei hi.

senses.heading: Closely connected without an intermediate cause
senses.definition_en: Existing or happening as an immediate result or close connection.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu dang kikal ah omlo in thu khat pan a piang pah ahih keileh a kizom pah.

examples.english: The damage was a direct result of the storm.
examples.zomi: Siatna pen huihpi pan a piang tang ahi hi.

examples.english: There is a direct connection between the two events.
examples.zomi: Thu piang tegel kikal ah kizopna tang om hi.

senses.usage_en: A direct cause produces a result without another major cause between them.
senses.usage_zomi: Direct cause in a kikal ah thu dang thupi omlo in result khat piangsak hi.

senses.heading: The way toward which someone or something moves or faces
senses.definition_en: The path, course, or side toward which someone or something is moving or pointing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat a paihna, a maiah a enna, ahih keileh a kawhna lam.

examples.english: The two cars were travelling in opposite directions.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw tegel langnih lamah pai uh hi.

examples.english: The wind changed direction during the night.
examples.zomi: Zan sungin huih a nungna lam kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Use in the direction of to indicate movement toward a place: They walked in the direction of the river.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun khat lamah paihna genna dingin in the direction of kizang hi: They walked in the direction of the river.

senses.heading: Instructions explaining how to do or reach something
senses.definition_en: Information telling someone what to do or how to reach a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bang bawl ding ahih keileh mun khat koici tun ding a hilh thu.

examples.english: Follow the directions on the medicine bottle.
examples.zomi: Si thawl tung thu hilhna zui in.

examples.english: We stopped to ask for directions.
examples.zomi: Lampi dong dingin khawl ung.

senses.usage_en: Directions is usually plural when it means instructions or route guidance.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu hilhna ahih keileh lampi hilhna a kawk ciangin directions ci in plural kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Control or guidance
senses.definition_en: Management, supervision, or guidance provided by someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a ukna, a makaihna, ahih keileh lampi a hilhna.

examples.english: The project was completed under her direction.
examples.zomi: Geelna pen ama’ makaihna nuai ah kizo hi.

examples.english: The new manager gave the team clear direction.
examples.zomi: Ukpa thak in pawl tungah lampi kician takin hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, direction means leadership or guidance, not physical orientation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah direction in pumpi paihna lam hilo a, makaihna leh lampi hilhna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Without an intermediary
senses.definition_en: Without passing through another person, organization, or system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, ahih keileh system dang tungtawnlo in tangin.

examples.english: Please contact the office directly.
examples.zomi: Office tangin hopih in.

examples.english: We buy vegetables directly from local farmers.
examples.zomi: Antuamte tua gam lo neite kiang pan tangin lei ung.

senses.usage_en: This meaning emphasizes that no middle person or organization is involved.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in kikal ah mi ahih keileh pawl dang a omlohna khauh sak hi.

senses.heading: Immediately or very soon
senses.definition_en: At once or after a very short time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tua pahin ahih keileh hun sawtlo sungin.

examples.english: Come directly home after school.
examples.zomi: Sang khawl khit pahin inn ah hong pai in.

examples.english: She replied directly to my message.
examples.zomi: Ama in ka thupuak tua pahin hong dawng hi.

senses.usage_en: This “immediately” meaning is especially common in British English. In American English, right away or immediately may be clearer.
senses.usage_zomi: “Tua pahin” cih khiatna pen British English ah kizang tam hi. American English ah right away ahih keileh immediately kicianzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: In a straight line or exact manner
senses.definition_en: In a straight line, exact position, or clear relationship.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tangin, mun maan takah, ahih keileh kizopna kician tawh.

examples.english: The lamp hangs directly above the table.
examples.zomi: Meivak pen sabuai tung tepat ah khai hi.

examples.english: Education is directly related to this issue.
examples.zomi: Pilna hih buaina tawh kizom tang hi.

senses.usage_en: In location phrases, directly strengthens precision: directly behind means exactly behind.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun a genna ah directly in a tepatna khauh sak hi: directly behind in a nung tepat ah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A person who manages an organization or department
senses.definition_en: A senior person responsible for managing an organization, department, or important activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawlpi, nasep khen, ahih keileh nasep thupi khat uk leh makaih mawpuak mi.

examples.english: She was appointed director of the program.
examples.zomi: Ama program ukpa in kikoi hi.

examples.english: The director approved the new budget.
examples.zomi: Ukpa in sum zatna geelna thak phal hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact authority of a director differs among companies, governments, and nonprofit organizations.
senses.usage_zomi: Director a ukna leh a mawpuakna pen company, kumpi leh a phattuam zonglo pawl tuamtuam ah kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: A person who controls the making of a film or play
senses.definition_en: The person who guides actors and makes major creative decisions in a film, television program, or play.
senses.explanation_zomi: Film, television program, ahih keileh drama ah limlak mite makaih a, kunst lam khensatna thupite bawl mi.

examples.english: The director explained the scene to the actors.
examples.zomi: Film makai in milimte tungah scene hilhcian hi.

examples.english: She hopes to become a film director.
examples.zomi: Ama film makai suak ding lam-en hi.

senses.usage_en: A film director controls the creative production. A producer usually manages financing, organization, and business matters.
senses.usage_zomi: Film director in kunst lam bawlna makaih hi. Producer in sum, geelna nasep leh sum nasepna thu uk zel hi.

senses.heading: An unclean substance
senses.definition_en: Dust, mud, or another substance that makes something unclean.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat nin sak leivui, buan, ahih keileh na nin dang.

examples.english: Wash the dirt from your hands.
examples.zomi: Na khut tunga ninna sil in.

examples.english: The floor was covered in dirt.
examples.zomi: Inn nuai ninna tawh kizel dim hi.

senses.usage_en: In this meaning, dirt is uncountable. Individual marks may be called spots or stains.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah dirt pen simsawm theihloh min hi. Ninna ciaptehna khat ciat pen spots ahih keileh stains kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Soil or earth
senses.definition_en: Loose earth or soil on the ground.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei tunga lei neem ahih keileh leivui.

examples.english: The children were playing in the dirt.
examples.zomi: Naupangte lei tungah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: The village is connected by a dirt road.
examples.zomi: Khua pen leilampi tawh kizom hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses dirt for soil. In British English, soil or earth may be more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah lei kawkna dingin dirt kizang tam hi. British English ah soil ahih keileh earth zat a ngeinazaw hi.

senses.heading: Not clean
senses.definition_en: Covered with dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ninna, ciaptehna, ahih keileh na hoihlo tawh kizel a, sianglo.

examples.english: Take off your dirty shoes before entering.
examples.zomi: Inn sung na lut ma in na khedap nin suah in.

examples.english: The children got dirty while playing outside.
examples.zomi: Naupangte pualam ah a kimawl uh laitak in nin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Dirty is the opposite of clean. For polluted air or water, polluted or contaminated may be more precise.
senses.usage_zomi: Dirty a langkhat pen clean ahi hi. Huih ahih keileh tui a sianglohna gen leh polluted ahih keileh contaminated a kicianzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: Dishonest, unfair, or offensive
senses.definition_en: Dishonest, unfair, immoral, or sexually offensive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thumaanlo, thutanglo, gamtat hoihlo, ahih keileh zahmawhhuai.

examples.english: They used a dirty trick to win the election.
examples.zomi: Teelna ah gualzo dingin khemna thutanglo zang uh hi.

examples.english: He refused to take part in the dirty business.
examples.zomi: Sum nasepna thumaanlo ah kihel ding nial hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense can be strongly negative. Use it carefully when describing people or speech.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak khiatna in hoihlohna khauh takin lak hi. Mi ahih keileh kampau genna ah pilvang takin zat ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A condition or feature that makes success more difficult or places someone in a worse position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzawhna haksa sak ahih keileh mi khat dinmun hoihlozaw ah koih dinmun leh pianzia.

examples.english: The main disadvantage of the apartment is its high rent.
examples.zomi: Innkhan a phattuamlohna thupi pen a innlo man tam ahi hi.

examples.english: Lack of experience put him at a disadvantage.
examples.zomi: Muhkhakna a neihloh manin dinmun hoihlozaw ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Disadvantage is the opposite of advantage. Use at a disadvantage, not in a disadvantage.
senses.usage_zomi: Disadvantage a langkhat pen advantage ahi hi. At a disadvantage ci in kizang a, in a disadvantage ci in kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: To have a different opinion
senses.definition_en: To have an opinion that is different from another person’s opinion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang ngaihsutdan tawh kibanglo ngaihsutdan nei.

common_phrases.zomi: ngaihsutdan kibanglo in om ding kithukim

examples.english: I disagree with his conclusion.
examples.zomi: Ama’ thu khupna tawh ka ngaihsutdan kibanglo hi.

examples.english: The experts disagree about the best solution.
examples.zomi: Siamna nei mite vengna hoihpen tungah ngaihsutdan kibanglo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use disagree with a person or opinion and disagree about/on a subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih keileh ngaihsutna tawh kibanglohna gen leh disagree with kizang a, thulu khat tungah kibanglohna gen leh disagree about/on kizang hi.

senses.heading: To conflict or not match
senses.definition_en: For facts, figures, accounts, or results to be different from one another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu maan, number, pulakna, ahih keileh result-te khat leh khat kituaklo.

examples.english: The two reports disagree about the number of people affected.
examples.zomi: Report tegel a suk mi zat tungah kituaklo hi.

examples.english: The witness accounts disagree on several details.
examples.zomi: Tecite’ thu pulakna thu neu pawlkhat ah kibanglo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this formal sense, disagree can describe information, not only people.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna ah disagree in mite bek hilo in thu leh number-te kituaklohna zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: To become impossible to see
senses.definition_en: To move away, become hidden, or stop being visible.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pai mang, kiseel, ahih keileh kimuthei nawnlo.

examples.english: The car disappeared around the corner.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw pen lampi kawi langah mang hi.

examples.english: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.
examples.zomi: Ni meii nungah kiseel in kimuh nawnlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Disappear is intransitive, so it does not take a direct object. Say The stain disappeared, not Someone disappeared the stain.
senses.usage_zomi: Disappear pen intransitive verb ahih manin direct object nei lo hi. The stain disappeared kici a, Someone disappeared the stain kici lo hi.

senses.heading: To stop existing or become lost
senses.definition_en: To cease to exist or to become impossible to find.
senses.explanation_zomi: Om nawnlo, mansuah, ahih keileh zonphak nawnlo.

examples.english: Many traditional skills are slowly disappearing.
examples.zomi: Ngeina siamna tampi tawm tawm in mang suak hi.

examples.english: The documents disappeared from the office.
examples.zomi: Laikhakte office pan mang hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may describe either gradual loss or an unexplained absence.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in tawm tawm in mansuahna ahih keileh a ziang theihloh in mangna kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Unhappy because something was not as good as expected or did not happen as hoped.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam-et bang a hoihloh manin ahih keileh lam-et thu a pianloh manin lungkimlo leh dah.

examples.english: She was disappointed with her examination result.
examples.zomi: Ama in a sittelna result tawh lungkimlo hi.

examples.english: We were disappointed that the event was cancelled.
examples.zomi: Pawi a kisuk tawh manin ka lungkimlo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use disappointed with/by something, disappointed in someone, or disappointed that….
senses.usage_zomi: Disappointed with/by something, disappointed in someone, ahih keileh disappointed that… ci in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Failing to meet expectations and therefore causing unhappiness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam-etna bang a hoihloh manin mi khat lungkimlo sak.

examples.english: The team’s performance was disappointing.
examples.zomi: Pawl’ kimawl dan lungkimlohhuai hi.

examples.english: It was disappointing to receive no response.
examples.zomi: Dawnna bangmah ngahloh pen lungkimlohhuai hi.

senses.usage_en: A person feels disappointed; a result, event, or performance is disappointing.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat pen disappointed hi; result, thu piang, ahih keileh limlakna khat pen disappointing ahi hi.

senses.heading: An event causing great destruction or suffering
senses.definition_en: A sudden event that causes serious damage, death, or suffering.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siatna lian, sihna, ahih keileh thuakna nasia piangsak thakhatthu thu piang.

examples.english: The earthquake was a major natural disaster.
examples.zomi: Zinling pen leitung pianzia siatna lianpi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Aid workers arrived soon after the disaster.
examples.zomi: Siatna khit sawtlo in huhna nasemte hong tung uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A disaster causes severe harm. An accident may be much smaller and does not always become a disaster.
senses.usage_zomi: Disaster in siatna nasia piangsak hi. Accident pen a neu zaw thei a, disaster suak pah tuanlo hi.

senses.heading: A complete failure
senses.definition_en: A situation, event, or effort that fails very badly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, pawi, ahih keileh hanciamna a vekpi in a tangtunlohna.

examples.english: The event was a complete disaster.
examples.zomi: Pawi pen a vekpi in guallel hi.

examples.english: Poor planning turned the project into a financial disaster.
examples.zomi: Geelkholhna hoihlo in geelna pen sumlehpai siatna lian suaksak hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal sense may describe a serious failure even when no one is physically harmed.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim zatdan in mi liamna omlo napi, guallelhna lian khat disaster ci in gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A thin, flat, round object
senses.definition_en: A thin, flat object with a circular shape.
senses.explanation_zomi: A phei, a zang, leh a kual van khat.

examples.english: The machine contains a small metal disc.
examples.zomi: Machine sungah sik disc neu khat om hi.

examples.english: A damaged spinal disc can cause back pain.
examples.zomi: Nungzang guh kikal disc a kisia leh nung natna piangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Disc emphasizes a flat, circular shape and is used in medical and technical terms.
senses.usage_zomi: Disc in a phei leh a kual pianzia bulphuh a, cidamna leh technical kammal ah kizang hi.

senses.heading: A compact disc
senses.definition_en: A flat, round object used to store music, video, or computer information.
senses.explanation_zomi: La, video, ahih keileh computer thu koihna ding van kual phei.

examples.english: The album was released on compact disc.
examples.zomi: Album pen compact disc tawh kikhah hi.

examples.english: Insert the disc into the computer.
examples.zomi: Disc pen computer sungah koih in.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses disc for CDs and circular objects. In computing, disk is normally used for devices such as a hard disk.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah CD leh van kualte dingin disc kizang hi. Computer ah hard disk bang vante dingin disk kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Training that develops self-control and good behaviour
senses.definition_en: Training that teaches people to follow rules, control themselves, and behave responsibly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun zui, pumpi leh lungsim kithunun, leh mawpuakna tawh gamta ding hilhna leh kisinsakna.

examples.english: Learning a language requires patience and self-discipline.
examples.zomi: Pau khat sinna in thuakzawhna leh amah leh amah kithununna kisam hi.

examples.english: The coach expects discipline from every player.
examples.zomi: Coach in kimawl mi khempeuh thukhun zui ding lam-en hi.

senses.usage_en: Discipline should teach responsible behaviour. It does not necessarily mean harsh punishment.
senses.usage_zomi: Discipline in mawpuakna tawh gamtat ding hilh hi. Gimpiakna khauh cihna bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: Punishment for breaking rules
senses.definition_en: Action taken to correct or punish someone who has broken rules.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun palsat mi khat puah ding ahih keileh gim pia dingin a kikhutzatna.

examples.english: The employee faced discipline for repeated misconduct.
examples.zomi: Gamtat hoihlo a bawl nawnnawn manin nasempa gimpiakna thuak hi.

examples.english: School discipline should be fair and consistent.
examples.zomi: Sang thukhun kepna thutang leh kibang tawntung ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, discipline should be proportionate and intended to correct behaviour.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah gimpiakna pen a mawhna tawh kituak a, gamtatna puahna ngiimna nei ding hi.

senses.heading: A field of study
senses.definition_en: A particular branch of academic study or professional knowledge.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna ahih keileh siamsinna khen tuam khat.

examples.english: History is an academic discipline.
examples.zomi: Tangthu pen pilna khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The research combines several disciplines.
examples.zomi: Kholna in pilna khen tuamtuam gawm hi.

senses.usage_en: In education, a discipline means an organized area of knowledge, not punishment.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna ah discipline in theihna khen khat kawk a, gimpiakna kawklo hi.

senses.definition_en: A reduction from the usual price of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat a ngeina man pan a kiamsak man.

examples.english: Students receive a ten-percent discount.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte za ah sawm man kiamsakna ngah uh hi.

examples.english: The store offers discounts on winter clothing.
examples.zomi: Dawr in phalbi puante man kiamsak hi.

senses.usage_en: A discount reduces the original price. Use discount on something: a discount on shoes.
senses.usage_zomi: Discount in van a man masa tawm sak hi. Discount on something ci in kizang hi: a discount on shoes.

senses.heading: To find something previously unknown or hidden
senses.definition_en: To find a place, object, fact, or scientific truth that was not known before.
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa a kitheihlo ahih keileh a kiseel mun, van, thu maan, ahih keileh science thu khat mukhia.

examples.english: Scientists discovered a new species of plant.
examples.zomi: Science siamsate in singkung nam thak khat mukhia uh hi.

examples.english: The investigation discovered serious safety problems.
examples.zomi: Thu kanna in bitna buaina liante mukhia hi.

senses.usage_en: Discover means finding something that already existed but was unknown. Invent means creating something new.
senses.usage_zomi: Discover in a om khin napi kitheihlo na khat mukhia cihna ahi hi. Invent in na thak khat bawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To learn something unexpectedly
senses.definition_en: To realize or learn a fact through experience, observation, or chance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muhkhakna, etna, ahih keileh lam-etloh thu tungtawnin thu khat theikhia.

examples.english: She discovered that the door was unlocked.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak a kikallo cih theikhia hi.

examples.english: He discovered a talent for teaching.
examples.zomi: Sia nasep siam cih amah leh amah theikhia hi.

senses.usage_en: Discover that… introduces the fact learned: They discovered that the report was false.
senses.usage_zomi: A kitheihkhia thu maan genna dingin discover that… kizang hi: They discovered that the report was false.

senses.heading: The act of finding something unknown
senses.definition_en: The act or process of finding a place, object, fact, or truth that was previously unknown.
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa a kitheihlo mun, van, thu maan, ahih keileh science thu khat zonkhia in theihna.

examples.english: The discovery changed medical science.
examples.zomi: Tua muhkhia na in cidamna science khe hi.

examples.english: Researchers made an important discovery.
examples.zomi: Kholmite in thu thupi khat mukhia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses make a discovery, not normally do a discovery.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah make a discovery ci in kizang a, ngeina in do a discovery ci in kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: Something that has been found
senses.definition_en: A person, place, object, or fact that has newly been found or recognized.
senses.explanation_zomi: A thak in a kimukhia ahih keileh a kithei na.

examples.english: The ancient tool was a surprising discovery.
examples.zomi: Vanzat lui pen muhkhia na lamdang khat ahi hi.

examples.english: This medicine may be one of the century’s greatest discoveries.
examples.zomi: Hih si pen kum za khat sunga muhkhia na lianpen lakah khat ahi thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A countable discovery is the thing or fact found; uncountable discovery can refer to the process.
senses.usage_zomi: Simsawm theih discovery in a kimukhia van ahih keileh thu kawk hi. Simsawm theihloh in a muhkhia na kalsuan kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To talk or write about a subject carefully, often to exchange ideas or reach a decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu khat pilvang takin kikum ahih keileh laigelh in ngaihsutna kisel, khensatna khat bawl ding zong hithei.

examples.english: We need to discuss the problem with the manager.
examples.zomi: Buaina pen ukpa tawh i kikum kul hi.

examples.english: The report discusses several possible solutions.
examples.zomi: Report in vengna lampi tuamtuam kikum hi.

senses.usage_en: Discuss takes a direct object: discuss the issue. Do not say discuss about the issue.
senses.usage_zomi: Discuss in direct object nei hi: discuss the issue. Discuss about the issue ci in kizanglo hi.

senses.definition_en: A conversation or written examination in which people exchange ideas about a subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu khat tungah mi khat leh khat ngaihsutna kiselna ahih keileh laigelh tawh a kikumna.

examples.english: The meeting included a discussion about the budget.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna sungah sum zatna geelna thu kikumna om hi.

examples.english: The proposal is still under discussion.
examples.zomi: Thu piakna pen kikum lai ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a discussion about/on something or a discussion with someone. Unlike discuss, the noun commonly takes a preposition.
senses.usage_zomi: A discussion about/on something ahih keileh a discussion with someone ci in kizang hi. Verb discuss tawh kibanglo in noun khit ah preposition kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: An illness affecting a person, animal, or plant, usually with a recognized cause or set of symptoms.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, ganhing, ahih keileh singkung a suk a, ngeina in a ziang ahih keileh a lim kithei natna.

examples.english: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease.
examples.zomi: Pumpi pattah tawntung in lungtang natna lauhuaina tawm sak thei hi.

examples.english: The disease spreads through contaminated water.
examples.zomi: Natna pen tui a kisiatsak tungtawnin kizel hi.

senses.usage_en: Disease usually refers to a recognized medical condition. Illness may refer more generally to the experience of being unwell.
senses.usage_zomi: Disease in cidamna lamah a min leh a pianzia kithei natna kawk zel hi. Illness in cina kisa a, cidamlo in omna a huamzai in kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: A container used for serving or eating food
senses.definition_en: A shallow container used for cooking, serving, or eating food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An huanna, an piakna, ahih keileh an nekna ding a kheu deuh kuang.

examples.english: Put the vegetables in a clean dish.
examples.zomi: Antuamte kuang siang khat sungah koih in.

examples.english: He washed the dishes after dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak an nek khit ciangin kuangte sil hi.

senses.usage_en: The dishes often means all the plates, bowls, cups, and eating tools that need washing.
senses.usage_zomi: The dishes in kuang, no leh annekna van khempeuh, a diakin a kisil dingte kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: A particular type of prepared food
senses.definition_en: Food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Annek khat sunga bawldan tuam tawh a kibawl an nam khat.

examples.english: This spicy soup is a traditional Zomi dish.
examples.zomi: Hih anzu hih Zomi ngeina an khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Chicken is the main dish tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zanin ak sa pen an thupi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A dish is one prepared food item. A meal is the complete eating occasion and may include several dishes.
senses.usage_zomi: Dish pen an bawlsa nam khat ahi hi. Meal pen annek hun kicing ahi a, dish tuamtuam huam thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Willing to lie, cheat, steal, or hide the truth for personal benefit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mimal phattuamna dingin zuau gen, khem, gu, ahih keileh thu maan seel ngam.

examples.english: The employee was dismissed for dishonest behaviour.
examples.zomi: Gamtat thumaanlo manin nasempa nasep pan kihawl hi.

examples.english: It would be dishonest to keep the money.
examples.zomi: Sum kep pen gamtat thumaanlo ahi ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Dishonest describes behaviour or character involving deception. It is stronger than simply being mistaken or incorrect.
senses.usage_zomi: Dishonest in khemna nei gamtat ahih keileh pianzia kawk hi. Khialhna ziau ahih keileh maanlohna bek sangin khauh zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: To not like someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh na khat deihlo ahih keileh lunglutlo.

examples.english: She dislikes waiting in long lines.
examples.zomi: Mi a tan saupi in ngak pen ama deihlo hi.

examples.english: I dislike the way he treats his employees.
examples.zomi: Ama in a nasemte a bawldan ka deihlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Dislike is usually followed by a noun or an -ing form: dislike noise; dislike waiting. It is less strong than hate.
senses.usage_zomi: Dislike khit ah noun ahih keileh -ing form om zel hi: dislike noise; dislike waiting. Hate sangin a nemzaw hi.

senses.heading: To send someone away or allow them to leave
senses.definition_en: To tell someone that they may or must leave a place, meeting, class, or duty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat mun, kikhopna, class, ahih keileh mawpuakna pan paikhiat ding sawl.

examples.english: The teacher dismissed the class early.
examples.zomi: Sia in class hun ma in khah hi.

examples.english: The judge dismissed the witnesses for the day.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa in tua ni adingin tecite paikhiat sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, dismiss may simply mean allowing people to leave; it does not always imply punishment.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah dismiss in mi paikhiat phal cihna zong ahi thei a, gimpiakna cihna tawntung hilo hi.

senses.heading: To remove someone from a job
senses.definition_en: To officially remove someone from employment or a position.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasep pan hawl; panmun pan lakhia
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nasepna ahih keileh panmun pan formal takin hawlkhia.

examples.english: The company dismissed him for repeated dishonesty.
examples.zomi: Thumaanlohna a bawl nawnnawn manin company in nasep pan hawl hi.

examples.english: She claimed that she had been unfairly dismissed.
examples.zomi: Ama in thutanglo takin nasep pan kihawl hi ci in gen hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, fire is a common informal equivalent. Dismiss is more formal.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah fire pen nisim kammal in kizang tam hi. Dismiss pen formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: To reject an idea, claim, or case
senses.definition_en: To decide that an idea, claim, concern, or legal case is not worth considering or continuing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, mawhpuhna, lunghihmawhna, ahih keileh thukhenna thu khat pawmlo in koihkhia.

examples.english: The court dismissed the case because there was no evidence.
examples.zomi: Teci a omloh manin thukhenna inn in tua thu koihkhia hi.

examples.english: Do not dismiss her concerns without listening.
examples.zomi: A lunghihmawhna za masalo in nial pah kei in.

senses.usage_en: Dismiss something as something means rejecting it under a particular description: They dismissed the report as unreliable.
senses.usage_zomi: Dismiss something as something in na khat a pianzia khat tawh nial cihna ahi hi: They dismissed the report as unreliable.

senses.heading: To put something where people can see it
senses.definition_en: To arrange or place something so that it can be seen easily.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi muhtheih dingin na khat taklang ahih keileh mun kician ah koih.

examples.english: The museum displays ancient tools.
examples.zomi: Museum in vanzat luite taklang hi.

examples.english: Please display your permit where it can be seen.
examples.zomi: Na phalna lai kimuthei munah koih in.

senses.usage_en: Display suggests presenting something intentionally for others to view.
senses.usage_zomi: Display in midangte muhsak ding ngiimna tawh na khat taklang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To show a quality, feeling, or behaviour
senses.definition_en: To show a particular quality, emotion, skill, or type of behaviour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pianzia, lungsim sukna, siamna, ahih keileh gamtatna khat lak.

examples.english: The firefighters displayed great courage.
examples.zomi: Meikang that mite in hangsanna lianpi lak uh hi.

examples.english: She displayed excellent leadership during the emergency.
examples.zomi: Kin ngai dinmun sungin makaihna hoih mahmah lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, display is more formal than show.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah display pen show sangin formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: The amount of space between two places or objects
senses.definition_en: The length of space separating two people, places, or objects.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun, ahih keileh van nih kikal gamlatna.

examples.english: The school is within walking distance of our home.
examples.zomi: Sang pen ka inn uh pan khe tawh pai zawh gamlatna ah om hi.

examples.english: What is the distance between the two cities?
examples.zomi: Khuapi tegel kikal bangzah gamla hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use distance between A and B or distance from A to B.
senses.usage_zomi: Distance between A and B ahih keileh distance from A to B ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: A distant position or point
senses.definition_en: A place far away from the person looking or speaking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Enpa ahih keileh paupa tawh a gamla mun.

examples.english: We could see the mountains in the distance.
examples.zomi: Gamla ah mualte muthei ung.

examples.english: The animal should be observed from a safe distance.
examples.zomi: Ganhing pen bitna gamlatna pan et ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In the distance means far away but often still visible or audible.
senses.usage_zomi: In the distance in gamla ah om napi kimuthei ahih keileh kiza thei lai cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To give or deliver something to several people or places
senses.definition_en: To give, send, or deliver something to each person or place in a group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl sunga mi ciat ahih keileh mun ciat tungah na khat hawm, sawl, ahih keileh pia.

examples.english: Volunteers distributed food to the families.
examples.zomi: A thawn nasemte in innkuante tungah annek hawm uh hi.

examples.english: The teacher distributed the worksheets.
examples.zomi: Sia in nasep laikhakte sangnaupangte tungah hawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Use distribute something to someone: They distributed supplies to the residents.
senses.usage_zomi: Distribute something to someone ci in kizang hi: They distributed supplies to the residents.

senses.heading: To spread something over an area
senses.definition_en: To spread or arrange something across an area or among several locations.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat mun khat khempeuh ahih keileh mun tuamtuam ah a kikhen in koih.

examples.english: Distribute the weight evenly across the shelf.
examples.zomi: Van koihna pang tungah gikna a kibang in khen in.

examples.english: The population is unevenly distributed across the region.
examples.zomi: Tua gamkee ah mipite a kibanglo in om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, distribute concerns position or spread, not necessarily giving ownership to people.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah distribute in a omna mun leh a kizel dan kawk a, mite tungah neihna piak cihna hituanlo hi.

senses.heading: The act of giving or delivering things
senses.definition_en: The process of giving, sending, or delivering goods, information, or resources to people or places.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, thu, ahih keileh van kisap-te mi leh mun tuamtuam tungah hawm, sawl, leh puakpiakna.

examples.english: The organization manages food distribution after disasters.
examples.zomi: Pawl in siatna khit annek hawmna uk hi.

examples.english: The company opened a new distribution centre.
examples.zomi: Company in van hawmna munpi thak khat hong hi.

senses.usage_en: Distribution includes the movement of goods from producers or suppliers to users or customers.
senses.usage_zomi: Distribution in van bawlpa ahih keileh van piapa kiang pan zang ding mi leh leimite kiang dong van a paikhiatna huam hi.

senses.heading: The way something is spread or divided
senses.definition_en: The way people, objects, money, or qualities are spread across an area or divided among a group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, sum, ahih keileh pianzia khat mun tuamtuam ah a kizel dan leh pawl sungah a kikhen dan.

examples.english: The map shows the distribution of the population.
examples.zomi: Gamlim in mipite kizeldan lak hi.

examples.english: The report examines the distribution of income.
examples.zomi: Report in income kikhen dan enkhol hi.

senses.usage_en: In statistics, distribution describes how values or observations are spread across possible levels.
senses.usage_zomi: Statistics ah distribution in number ahih keileh ciaptehna-te dinmun tuamtuam ah a kizel dan pulak hi.

senses.definition_en: An area of a city, state, or country established for administration, elections, education, or another purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuapi, state, ahih keileh gam khat sungah ukna, teelna, pilna, ahih keileh ngiimna dang dingin a kikhen gamkee.

examples.english: The school district approved the new budget.
examples.zomi: Sang ukna gamkee in sum zatna geelna thak phal hi.

examples.english: She represents this district in the legislature.
examples.zomi: Ama in thukham bawlna ah hih gamkee aiawh hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning of district depends on its purpose, such as administration, elections, schools, or business.
senses.usage_zomi: District a khiatna kician pen a ngiimna—ukna, teelna, sang, ahih keileh sum nasepna—tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: To separate something into parts
senses.definition_en: To separate or split something into two or more parts or groups.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat khen nih ahih keileh a tamzaw in khen.

examples.english: Divide the class into four groups.
examples.zomi: Class pen pawl li in khen in.

examples.english: They divided the money equally among the children.
examples.zomi: Sum pen naupangte tungah a kibang in hawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use divide something into parts and divide something among people.
senses.usage_zomi: Divide something into parts leh divide something among people ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: To perform division in mathematics
senses.definition_en: To calculate how many times one number is contained in another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mathematics ah number khat number dang sungah bangzah vei om cih khenkhia in sim.

examples.english: Divide twenty by four.
examples.zomi: Sawmnih pen li tawh khen in.

examples.english: Twelve divided by three equals four.
examples.zomi: Sawmlehnih pen thum tawh khen leh li ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In twenty divided by four, twenty is the number being divided and four is the divisor.
senses.usage_zomi: Twenty divided by four ah sawmnih pen a kikhen number hi a, li pen a khen number ahi hi.

senses.heading: To cause disagreement or separation
senses.definition_en: To cause people or groups to disagree strongly or become separated.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh pawl kikal ah kilemlohna piangsak in kikhen sak.

examples.english: The issue divided the community.
examples.zomi: Tua thulu in khawlsung mite kikhen sak hi.

examples.english: The committee was divided over the proposal.
examples.zomi: Committee pen thu piakna tungah ngaihsutdan kikhen hi.

senses.usage_en: Be divided over/on something means having strongly different opinions about it.
senses.usage_zomi: Be divided over/on something in thulu khat tungah ngaihsutdan kibanglo mahmah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The act of separating something into parts
senses.definition_en: The process of separating something or being separated into parts or groups.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat khen tuamtuam in khenna ahih keileh kikhenna.

examples.english: The division of work made the task easier.
examples.zomi: Nasep kikhenna in nasep baihzaw sak hi.

examples.english: The land was divided through an equal division.
examples.zomi: Lei pen a kibang in kikhen hi.

senses.usage_en: Division of something refers to the process or arrangement of separating it.
senses.usage_zomi: Division of something in na khat khenna kalsuan ahih keileh a kikhen dan kawk hi.

senses.heading: Serious disagreement between people
senses.definition_en: A situation in which people or groups strongly disagree or are separated.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh pawl kikal ngaihsutdan a kibanglo mahmah in a kikhenna.

examples.english: The issue caused deep division in the community.
examples.zomi: Tua thulu in khawlsung ah kikhenna lian piangsak hi.

examples.english: Leaders called for unity instead of division.
examples.zomi: Makaite in kikhenna sangin pumkhatna ngen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, division is the opposite of unity.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah division a langkhat pen pumkhatna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A section of an organization
senses.definition_en: A large section of a company, government, army, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Company, kumpi, galkap, ahih keileh pawlpi sunga nasep khen lian khat.

examples.english: She manages the company’s technology division.
examples.zomi: Ama in company’ technology nasep khen uk hi.

examples.english: The division employs five hundred people.
examples.zomi: Nasep khen in mi zanga sepsak hi.

senses.usage_en: The difference between a division and a department depends on the organization; a division is often larger.
senses.usage_zomi: Division leh department a kilamdanna pen pawlpi tungah kinga a, division pen a lianzaw zel hi.

senses.heading: A mathematical operation
senses.definition_en: The mathematical process of dividing one number by another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Number khat number dang tawh khenna mathematics kalsuan.

examples.english: The students are learning multiplication and division.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte number suahna leh khenna sin uh hi.

examples.english: Use division to find the answer.
examples.zomi: Dawnna muhna dingin number khenna zang in.

senses.usage_en: Division is the opposite operation of multiplication.
senses.usage_zomi: Division pen multiplication a langkhat mathematics nasep ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: No longer legally married because a marriage has officially ended.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nupa kitengna thukham dungzui in a kikhensak khin.

examples.english: Her parents are divorced.
examples.zomi: A nu leh pa nupa kikhen uh hi.

examples.english: They got divorced after ten years of marriage.
examples.zomi: Nupa in kum sawm a omkhawm khit ciangin kikhen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Divorced describes legal marital status. Separated usually means living apart while still legally married.
senses.usage_zomi: Divorced in thukham dungzui a nupa kizopna tawp khin cihna ahi hi. Separated in thukham dungzui a kiteng lai napi a tuam in teng cihna ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: To perform an action, activity, or task
senses.definition_en: To perform, complete, or take part in an action, activity, or piece of work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, nasep, ahih keileh mawpuakna khat bawl ahih keileh zo.

examples.english: I need to do my homework before dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak an ka nek ma in ka inn nasep ka bawl kul hi.

examples.english: She always does her best.
examples.zomi: Ama in a hoihpen hanciamna tawntung bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use do for activities and tasks. Use make mainly for creating or producing something: do the work; make a table.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna leh nasep genna dingin do kizang hi. Na khat bawlkhia ahih keileh piangsakna dingin make kizang zel hi: do the work; make a table.

senses.heading: To be suitable or sufficient
senses.definition_en: To be acceptable, suitable, or enough for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna khat dingin pawmtheih, kituak, ahih keileh kicing.

examples.english: We do not need a large room; this one will do.
examples.zomi: Innkhan lian kisamlo hi; hih khat kicing ding hi.

examples.english: Will this chair do for the meeting?
examples.zomi: Hih tokna kikhopna dingin kicing diam?

senses.usage_en: That will do can mean “that is sufficient.” Depending on tone, it can also firmly tell someone to stop.
senses.usage_zomi: That will do in “tua kicing ding” cihna ahi thei hi. Awpuak dungzui in mi khat gamtatna khawlsakna khauh zong ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: An auxiliary verb used in questions, negatives, and emphasis
senses.definition_en: An auxiliary verb used to form many questions and negative statements or to add emphasis.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dotna, nialna, leh thu khauh sakna dingin main verb panpih auxiliary verb.

examples.english: Do you understand the question?
examples.zomi: Dotna na tel hiam?

examples.english: I do want to help you.
examples.zomi: Nang hong huh ka nuam taktak hi.

senses.usage_en: With most ordinary verbs, use do/does for present questions and negatives and did for past ones: Do you work? She does not work. Did they leave? Do not use it with the main verb be in ordinary questions: Are you ready?
senses.usage_zomi: Ordinary verb tampi tawh present dotna leh nialna ah do/does, past ah did kizang hi: Do you work? She does not work. Did they leave? Ordinary dotna ah main verb be tawh do kizanglo hi: Are you ready?

senses.heading: A person trained to treat illness and injury
senses.definition_en: A medical professional who examines patients and treats illnesses or injuries.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cinate enkhol a, natna leh liamna damsak dingin a kisinsak cidamna siam.

examples.english: You should see a doctor if the pain continues.
examples.zomi: Natna a kizom leh siavuan kiangah na ki-en ding ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor examined the patient carefully.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in cinapa pilvang takin enkhol hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, doctor commonly means a physician. Other healthcare professionals may hold doctoral degrees but have different roles.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah doctor in cina damsak siavuan kawk zel hi. Cidamna lam a nasem dangte doctoral degree nei thei napi, amau’ mawpuakna kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: A person holding the highest university degree
senses.definition_en: A person who has earned a doctoral degree in an academic or professional field.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna ahih keileh siamsinna khen khat ah doctoral degree ngah mi.

examples.english: She earned a doctorate in history and is now Dr Lee.
examples.zomi: Ama tangthu lam doctoral degree ngah a, tu in Dr Lee kici hi.

examples.english: Not every doctor works in a hospital.
examples.zomi: Doctor khempeuh zato inn ah nasem tuanlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Academic doctors are addressed as Doctor, but they are not necessarily medical doctors.
senses.usage_zomi: Academic doctor-te Doctor ci in kisam napi, cidamna siavuan hituanlo uh hi.

senses.definition_en: A written, printed, or digital file that provides information, evidence, or an official record.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, teci, ahih keileh official ciaptehna a pia laigelh, laikhak kisuah, ahih keileh digital file.

examples.english: Please sign the document at the bottom of the page.
examples.zomi: Laimai nuaiah laikhak minthuh in.

examples.english: Keep important documents in a safe place.
examples.zomi: Laikhak thupite mun bit ah kem in.

senses.usage_en: A document may be printed or electronic. It usually has an informational, legal, administrative, or evidential purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Document pen lai tungah kisuah ahih keileh electronic ahi thei hi. Thu piakna, thukham, ukna, ahih keileh teci mawpuakna nei zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A film, television program, or audio program that presents facts about real people, events, or subjects.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi taktak, thu piang taktak, ahih keileh thulu khat tawh kisai thu maan a lak film, television program, ahih keileh aw program.

examples.english: We watched a documentary about climate change.
examples.zomi: Khuahun kikhelna tawh kisai documentary khat en ung.

examples.english: The documentary includes interviews with survivors.
examples.zomi: Documentary sungah siatna pan a suakta mite kihopihna om hi.

senses.usage_en: A documentary presents real subjects, although its creators still select and arrange the material. It is different from a fictional film.
senses.usage_zomi: Documentary in thu maan taktak pulak napi, a bawlte in thu teel leh seh uh hi. Ngaihsutna tangthu film tawh kibanglo hi.

senses.definition_en: A common domestic animal often kept as a pet, companion, guard, or working animal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn ah a kivul, lawm, inn veng, ahih keileh nasep bawl dingin a kizang ganhing khat.

examples.english: Their dog barks when strangers approach the house.
examples.zomi: Mi theihloh inn gei a hong pai ciangin amau’ ui au hi.

examples.english: She takes her dog for a walk every morning.
examples.zomi: Ama zingsang simin a ui paipih hi.

senses.usage_en: Dog can refer generally to the species, but technically an adult female dog is a bitch. That technical word can be offensive when used about a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Dog in ui nam khempeuh huam thei hi. Technical English ah ui numei pen bitch kici napi, mihing kawkna in zat leh simmawhna khauh ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A unit of money used in the United States and several other countries.
senses.explanation_zomi: United States leh gam dang pawlkhat ah a kizang sum unit.

examples.english: The book costs twenty dollars.
examples.zomi: Laibu man dollar sawmnih ahi hi.

examples.english: She exchanged kyat for US dollars.
examples.zomi: Ama in kyat pen US dollar tawh laih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use singular dollar after one and plural dollars after other numbers: one dollar; five dollars. The symbol is $.
senses.usage_zomi: Khat khit ah singular dollar kizang a, number dang khit ah plural dollars kizang hi: one dollar; five dollars. A lim pen $ ahi hi.

senses.heading: Connected with the home or family
senses.definition_en: Related to the home, household, or family life.
senses.zomi_equivalents: inn sung tawh kisai; innkuan tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn, innkuan, ahih keileh inn sunga nuntakna tawh kisai.

examples.english: They share domestic responsibilities equally.
examples.zomi: Innkuan mawpuakna a kibang in kikhen uh hi.

examples.english: The organization supports victims of domestic violence.
examples.zomi: Pawl in innkuan sung ngongtatna thuakte panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Domestic violence is a fixed expression for abuse within a family or intimate relationship.
senses.usage_zomi: Domestic violence pen innkuan ahih keileh itna tawh kizom mite kikal ngongtatna genna kammal kipsa ahi hi.

senses.heading: Existing or happening within one country
senses.definition_en: Relating to activities, travel, products, or policies within a person’s own country.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gam sung; gam sung tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam khat sungah a piang ahih keileh tua gam sung bek tawh kisai.

examples.english: The airport serves both domestic and international flights.
examples.zomi: Vanleng ngakna mun in gam sung leh gam kikal vanlengte a lungkim sak hi.

examples.english: Domestic demand for the product has increased.
examples.zomi: Van tung gam sung kisapna hong khang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, domestic contrasts with international or foreign.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah domestic a langkhat pen international ahih keileh foreign ahi hi.

senses.heading: Tamed and kept by humans
senses.definition_en: Describing an animal that lives with or is kept by humans rather than living wild.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamlak a nungta hilo in mihingte in inn ahih keileh lo ah a vul ganhing.

examples.english: Dogs are domestic animals.
examples.zomi: Uite gan vulh ahi uh hi.

examples.english: Domestic animals depend on humans for care.
examples.zomi: Gan vulhte kepna dingin mihing tungah kinga uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A domestic animal has been tamed or bred to live with people. A wild animal lives independently in nature.
senses.usage_zomi: Domestic animal pen mihing tawh teng dingin kivulh ahih keileh kikhan ganhing ahi hi. Wild animal pen leitung pianzia sungah amah leh amah nungta hi.

senses.heading: To control someone or something
senses.definition_en: To have strong control, power, or influence over a person, group, place, or situation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ukcip; vangliatna nei; a tungah thuneih
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, mun, ahih keileh dinmun khat tungah ukna, vangliatna, ahih keileh sukna lian nei.

examples.english: One company dominates the local market.
examples.zomi: Company khat in tua gam van zuakna ukcip hi.

examples.english: He dominated the conversation and gave others little time to speak.
examples.zomi: Ama in kiholimna ukcip a, midangte pau ding hun tawm bek pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Dominate often has a negative meaning when someone unfairly controls other people.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat in midangte thutanglo takin a ukcip ciangin dominate in khiatna hoihlo nei zel hi.

senses.heading: To be the largest, strongest, or most noticeable
senses.definition_en: To be much more important, successful, powerful, or visible than everything else.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a thupi pen hi; a kilang pen hi; gualzo cip
senses.explanation_zomi: Na dangte sangin a lianpen, a thahatpen, a gualzopen, ahih keileh a kilangpen hi.

examples.english: The home team dominated the second half of the game.
examples.zomi: Inn pawl in kimawlna khen nihna ukcip hi.

examples.english: The tall building dominates the city skyline.
examples.zomi: Inn sang pen khuapi tunglam muhna ah kilangpen hi.

senses.usage_en: In sports, dominate means performing much better than the opponent, even if the final score is not extremely large.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna ah dominate in langdo sangin siamzaw leh hoihzaw takin kimawl cihna ahi a, point kilamdanna lian kul tuanlo hi.

senses.definition_en: To give money, goods, blood, or an organ voluntarily to help a person, organization, or cause.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a thawn pia; huhna pia; sumpia
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, ahih keileh ngiimna khat huh dingin sum, van, sisan, ahih keileh pumpi khen a utna tawh pia.

examples.english: They donated food and clothing to the families.
examples.zomi: Innkuante tungah annek leh puan a thawn in pia uh hi.

examples.english: Many people donated blood after the disaster.
examples.zomi: Siatna khit ciangin mi tampi in sisan pia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use donate something to someone or an organization: She donated books to the school.
senses.usage_zomi: Donate something to someone or an organization ci in kizang hi: She donated books to the school.

senses.heading: A movable barrier used to enter or leave a room or building
senses.definition_en: A movable part that opens and closes an entrance to a room, building, vehicle, or container.
senses.explanation_zomi: Innkhan, inn, mawtaw, ahih keileh bawm sung lut leh paikhiatna a kihong leh a kikhak kikhakna.

examples.english: Please close the door quietly.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak khawdai takin khaak in.

examples.english: Someone was standing outside the front door.
examples.zomi: Mi khat inn ma kongkhak pualam ah ding hi.

senses.usage_en: A door is the movable panel. A doorway is the opening through which people pass.
senses.usage_zomi: Door pen a kihong leh a kikhak panel ahi hi. Doorway pen mi a kalsuan kongkuak ahi hi.

senses.heading: An opportunity or means of access
senses.definition_en: An opportunity or way to enter a new situation, career, or area of knowledge.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, nasepna, ahih keileh theihna thak sung luttheihna hunhoih leh lampi.

examples.english: Education can open the door to better jobs.
examples.zomi: Pilna in nasepna hoihzaw ngahna lampi hon thei hi.

examples.english: The agreement opened the door to further cooperation.
examples.zomi: Kithukimna in pankhawmna khangzaw ding kong hong hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense compares an opportunity with an entrance into a new place.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak khiatna in hunhoih khat pen mun thak sung lutna kong tawh tehkak hi.

senses.heading: Twice as much or twice as many
senses.definition_en: Equal to two times the amount, number, size, or level.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, tamna, liatna, ahih keileh dinmun pen a nih suah.

examples.english: The new room is double the size of the old one.
examples.zomi: Innkhan thak pen a lui sangin nihzah in lianzaw hi.

examples.english: They paid double the normal price.
examples.zomi: A ngeina man sangin nihzah pia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Double the amount means two times the amount, not the original amount plus two.
senses.usage_zomi: Double the amount in a zat nih suah cihna ahi a, a zat masa tungah nih beh cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Made for or consisting of two people or things
senses.definition_en: Designed for two people or containing two similar parts.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mi nih ding; khen nih nei
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nih ding a kibawl ahih keileh khen kibang nih nei.

examples.english: We booked a double room at the hotel.
examples.zomi: Hotel ah mi nih ihna innkhan khat kam ung.

examples.english: The building has double doors at the entrance.
examples.zomi: Inn a lutna ah kongkhak nih om hi.

senses.usage_en: In hotels, a double room generally accommodates two people. It may contain one double bed or, depending on local usage, another arrangement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hotel ah double room pen mi nih omna ding ahi hi. Double bed khat nei thei a, tua mun zatdan dungzui in ihna dang zong nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Uncertainty about whether something is true or will happen
senses.definition_en: A feeling of uncertainty or lack of confidence about a fact, result, or decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat maan hiam, piang ding hiam, ahih keileh khensatna maan hiam cih lungmuanglohna.

examples.english: I have doubts about whether the plan will work.
examples.zomi: Geelna a tangtun ding leh dinglo ka lunghian hi.

examples.english: There is no doubt that the problem is serious.
examples.zomi: Buaina a nasia cih lunghianna omlo hi.

senses.usage_en: No doubt means that something is very likely or certain. Without a doubt gives even stronger certainty.
senses.usage_zomi: No doubt in thu khat piang ding takpi ahih keileh maan cihna ahi hi. Without a doubt in kician mahmah cihna khauh sakzaw hi.

senses.heading: A reason for uncertainty
senses.definition_en: A particular question or concern that makes someone uncertain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungmuanglo sak dotna ahih keileh lunghihmawhna khat.

examples.english: The missing evidence raised doubts about the case.
examples.zomi: Teci a kicingloh manin thukhenna thu tungah lunghianna piang hi.

examples.english: Her explanation removed our doubts.
examples.zomi: A hilhcian na in ka lunghianna uh siansuah hi.

senses.usage_en: In criminal law, beyond a reasonable doubt is a high standard of proof required for conviction.
senses.usage_zomi: Mawhna thukham ah beyond a reasonable doubt in mawhnei ci in thukhenna ding teci kician mahmah tehna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Toward or in a lower position
senses.definition_en: Toward a lower place or position, or in a lower place.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nuai ah; nuailam ah; niamzaw ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun niamzaw ah, a nuailam ah, ahih keileh a nuailam panmun ah.

examples.english: She walked down the stairs.
examples.zomi: Ama kailawn pan nuai ah tuaksuk hi.

examples.english: Please put the box down carefully.
examples.zomi: Bawm pen pilvang takin nuai ah koih in.

senses.usage_en: Down may describe movement to a lower place or a position already below.
senses.usage_zomi: Down in mun niamzaw lamah kisuan cihna ahih keileh mun niamzaw ah om cihna kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Along or farther on a road, path, or route
senses.definition_en: Along a road, path, river, or other route, often away from the starting point.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi, gun, ahih keileh khualzinna lampi dung zui in ma lamah.

examples.english: The bank is farther down the street.
examples.zomi: Bank pen lampi ma deuh ah om hi.

examples.english: We walked down the path toward the river.
examples.zomi: Gun lam zuan in lampi dungah pai ung.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, down does not always mean physically lower. It may simply mean along a route.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah down in a nuailam cihna tawntung hilo a, lampi dung zui cihna zong ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Into a weaker, smaller, or inactive condition
senses.definition_en: Into a lower level, reduced amount, closed state, or nonworking condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun niamzaw, zat tawmzaw, kikhak, ahih keileh nasem theilo dinmun ah.

examples.english: Prices have gone down this month.
examples.zomi: Hih kha in mante hong kiam hi.

examples.english: The website is down for maintenance.
examples.zomi: Website pen puahna dingin nasemlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Down appears in many phrasal verbs, and its exact meaning depends on the verb: slow down, write down, shut down.
senses.usage_zomi: Down pen phrasal verb tampi ah kizang a, a khiatna pen verb tawh a kizop dan tungah kinga hi: slow down, write down, shut down.

senses.definition_en: To copy data, a file, program, image, or other digital content from the internet or another computer onto a device.
senses.explanation_zomi: Internet ahih keileh computer dang pan data, file, program, lim, ahih keileh digital thu pen device sungah koih dingin lakhia.

examples.english: You can download the report from the website.
examples.zomi: Website pan report na download thei hi.

examples.english: She downloaded the app onto her phone.
examples.zomi: Ama in app pen a phone sungah download hi.

senses.usage_en: Download moves a copy to your device. Upload sends a copy from your device to another system or the internet.
senses.usage_zomi: Download in file copy khat na device sungah lak hi. Upload in na device pan system dang ahih keileh internet tungah file copy sawl hi.

senses.definition_en: To or on a lower floor of a building.
senses.zomi_equivalents: inn nuai ah; nuai innsang ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn a nuai zaw innsang ah ahih keileh tua lamah.

examples.english: She went downstairs to answer the door.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak dawng dingin inn nuai ah paisuk hi.

examples.english: The children are playing downstairs.
examples.zomi: Naupangte inn nuai ah kimawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: As an adverb, say go downstairs, not go to downstairs. As an adjective, it comes before a noun: the downstairs room.
senses.usage_zomi: Adverb in go downstairs kici a, go to downstairs kici lo hi. Adjective in noun ma ah om hi: the downstairs room.

senses.definition_en: Toward a lower place, position, level, or amount.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, panmun, dinmun, ahih keileh zat niamzaw lam zuan in.

examples.english: The road slopes downwards toward the river.
examples.zomi: Lampi pen gun lamah niam suk hi.

examples.english: The arrow points downwards.
examples.zomi: Thal lim in nuailam kawk hi.

senses.usage_en: Downward and downwards are both correct as adverbs. Downward is more common in American English; downwards is more common in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Adverb in downward leh downwards tegel maan hi. American English ah downward, British English ah downwards kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A group or quantity of twelve.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na sawmlehnih a kigawm pawl khat.

examples.english: She bought a dozen eggs.
examples.zomi: Ama in aktui dozen khat lei hi.

examples.english: Dozens of people attended the meeting.
examples.zomi: Mi sawm tampi kikhopna ah pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: After an exact number, dozen normally stays singular: two dozen eggs. Dozens of means many, not an exact total.
senses.usage_zomi: Number kician khit ah dozen singular mah in om hi: two dozen eggs. Dozens of in tampi cihna ahi a, zat kician hilo hi.

senses.heading: A preliminary version
senses.definition_en: A first or unfinished version of a document, plan, speech, or creative work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laikhak, geelna, thugen, ahih keileh bawlna khat a puahkik ding om lai version masa.

examples.english: I finished the first draft of the report.
examples.zomi: Report draft masa ka zo hi.

examples.english: Please review the draft before I send it.
examples.zomi: Ka sawl ma in draft enkik in.

senses.usage_en: A draft is not normally the final version. It is expected to be reviewed and revised.
senses.usage_zomi: Draft pen a nunungpen version hituanlo hi. Enkik leh puahkik ding lam-et ahi hi.

senses.heading: A current of cool air inside a building
senses.definition_en: A flow of cool air entering or moving through an enclosed place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn sungah hong lut ahih keileh hong nung huih vot luang khat.

examples.english: I can feel a cold draft near the window.
examples.zomi: Limlang gei ah huih vot ka za hi.

examples.english: Close the door to stop the draft.
examples.zomi: Huih lut khamna dingin kongkhak khaak in.

senses.usage_en: American English spells this meaning draft. British English normally spells it draught.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah hih khiatna draft ci in kigelh hi. British English ah draught ci in kigelh zel hi.

senses.heading: Compulsory selection for military service
senses.definition_en: A system requiring selected people to serve in the armed forces.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kiteel mite galkap nasep sem dingin thukham tawh a kisawl system.

examples.english: The country introduced a military draft during the war.
examples.zomi: Gal sungin gam in galkap sepsakna system kipan sak hi.

examples.english: Young men were required to register for the draft.
examples.zomi: Khangno pasalte galkap sepsakna ding min ciapteh ding kisawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is especially common in American English. British English commonly uses conscription.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen American English ah kizang tam hi. British English ah conscription kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: To pull something along a surface
senses.definition_en: To pull a person or object along the ground or another surface, usually with effort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh van khat lei ahih keileh a mai khat tungah haksat takin kai.

examples.english: They dragged the heavy table across the floor.
examples.zomi: Sabuai gik pen inn nuai ah kai uh hi.

examples.english: Do not drag the chair; lift it.
examples.zomi: Tokna kai kei in; dom in.

senses.usage_en: Drag suggests that something remains in contact with a surface while being pulled.
senses.usage_zomi: Drag in van khat a mai tawh kituak lai in kikai cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: To move something on a computer screen
senses.definition_en: To move an item on a screen by selecting it and moving the mouse or finger.
senses.zomi_equivalents: screen tungah kai in suan; drag
senses.explanation_zomi: Screen tunga na khat teel in mouse ahih keileh khutme tawh mun dang ah suan.

examples.english: Drag the file into the folder.
examples.zomi: File pen folder sungah kai in koih in.

examples.english: You can drag the image with your finger.
examples.zomi: Lim pen na khutme tawh na kai in suan thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Drag and drop means moving a digital item by selecting, moving, and releasing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Drag and drop in digital van khat teel, suan, a mun thak ah khah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To make someone go somewhere unwillingly
senses.definition_en: To force or persuade someone to go somewhere they do not want to go.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a pai noplohna munah sawl tentan ahih keileh pai sak teitei.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat kikhopna ah paipih teitei

examples.english: My friends dragged me to the party.
examples.zomi: Ka lawmte in pawi ah hong paipih teitei uh hi.

examples.english: She was dragged into an argument she wanted to avoid.
examples.zomi: A pelh nop thu kikum buai sungah kihen lut hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use often exaggerates reluctance; it does not always mean physical force.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak zatdan in pai noplohna khauh takin gen a, pumpi tawh kai taktak cihna tawntung hilo hi.

senses.heading: A play or serious story performed by actors
