senses.definition_en: A play, film, or television story performed by actors, especially one involving serious events and emotions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Milimte in a limlak tangthu, a diakin thu nasia leh lungsim sukna a huam.

examples.english: The class performed a short drama.
examples.zomi: Class in drama tom khat lak hi.

examples.english: We watched a historical drama on television.
examples.zomi: Television ah tangthu drama khat en ung.

senses.usage_en: A drama may be performed on a stage, in a film, on television, or through audio.
senses.usage_zomi: Drama pen stage, film, television, ahih keileh aw bek tawh zong kipia thei hi.

senses.heading: The art or study of acting and plays
senses.definition_en: The activity or academic subject of writing, studying, or performing plays.
senses.explanation_zomi: Drama gelh, sin, khen, leh limlakna siamna ahih keileh pilna.

examples.english: She studied drama at college.
examples.zomi: Ama in college ah drama sin hi.

examples.english: Drama helps students develop confidence.
examples.zomi: Drama in sangnaupangte lungmuanna khang sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this meaning, drama is generally uncountable because it names an activity or field of study.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah drama in gamtatna ahih keileh pilna khen kawk ahih manin simsawm theihloh min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: An exciting or emotional situation
senses.definition_en: A situation involving strong emotions, conflict, or unexpected events.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim sukna khauh, kilemlohna, ahih keileh lam-etloh thu piang a huam dinmun.

examples.english: There was a lot of drama during the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna sungah thu buai tampi om hi.

examples.english: She prefers to stay away from unnecessary drama.
examples.zomi: Ama in kisaploh thu buai pan gamla om nuam hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal sense can sound dismissive if it is used for someone’s genuine suffering.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim khiatna pen mi khat thuakna taktak genna ah kizang leh a thuakna mawk ngaihsaklo bangin ging thei hi.

senses.heading: Sudden, large, or striking
senses.definition_en: Very noticeable, sudden, impressive, or powerful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kician takin kimuthei, thakhatthu in piang, lamdang, ahih keileh a sukna lian.

examples.english: The patient showed dramatic improvement.
examples.zomi: Cinapa cidamna lian takin hoih hi.

examples.english: There was a dramatic increase in food prices.
examples.zomi: Annek man nasatak in khang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, dramatic emphasizes size, speed, or noticeable effect. It does not necessarily relate to theatre.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah dramatic in liatna, manlangna, ahih keileh a sukna kimuthei khauh sak hi. Drama tawh kisai kul tuanlo hi.

senses.heading: Connected with drama or acting
senses.definition_en: Relating to plays, acting, or theatrical performance.
senses.zomi_equivalents: drama tawh kisai; limlakna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Drama, milim limlakna, ahih keileh stage tung limlakna tawh kisai.

examples.english: The school offers dramatic arts classes.
examples.zomi: Sang in drama kunst class-te pia hi.

examples.english: Her dramatic performance impressed the audience.
examples.zomi: A drama limlakna in en mipite lamdang sak hi.

senses.usage_en: The adjective dramatic can describe theatre or a large, striking change. Context determines the meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective dramatic in drama tawh kisai thu ahih keileh kikhelna lian leh lamdang kawk thei hi. A kizop thu in khiatna lak hi.

senses.heading: To make a picture or design with lines
senses.definition_en: To make a picture, shape, or plan using a pencil, pen, or another tool.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pencil, pen, ahih keileh van dang tawh lim, pianzia, ahih keileh geelna suai.

examples.english: The child drew a picture of her family.
examples.zomi: Naupang in a innkuante lim suai hi.

examples.english: Draw a straight line between the two points.
examples.zomi: Ciaptehna tegel kikal ah lai zang khat suai in.

senses.usage_en: Draw usually uses lines. Paint normally uses paint and colour.
senses.usage_zomi: Draw in lai tawh lim suai zel hi. Paint in paint leh kiluam tawh lim bawl zel hi.

senses.heading: To pull something
senses.definition_en: To pull or move something toward oneself or in a particular direction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat amah lamah ahih keileh lam khat ah kai.

examples.english: He drew the chair closer to the table.
examples.zomi: Tokna pen sabuai nai ah kai hi.

examples.english: She drew the curtains before sunset.
examples.zomi: Ni tum ma in limlang puante khaak hi.

senses.usage_en: Draw the curtains can mean opening or closing them; context must make the intended movement clear.
senses.usage_zomi: Draw the curtains in puan hon ahih keileh khaak cihna nei thei hi. A kizop thu in a deihna lam kician sak ding hi.

senses.heading: To attract someone or something
senses.definition_en: To attract people’s attention, interest, or presence.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lunglut sak; zo; hong pai sak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi’ lungsim, lunglutna, ahih keileh hong paina zo.

examples.english: The festival draws thousands of visitors each year.
examples.zomi: Pawi in kum simin khualzin mi tul tampi zo hi.

examples.english: Her comments drew attention to the problem.
examples.zomi: A kammalte in mite’ lungsim buaina tungah zo hi.

senses.usage_en: Draw attention to something means making people notice it. It does not necessarily mean seeking attention for oneself.
senses.usage_zomi: Draw attention to something in mite in tua thu phawk sak cihna ahi hi. Amah kiangah lunglutna zon cihna kul tuanlo hi.

senses.heading: To finish with equal scores
senses.definition_en: To finish a game or competition with each side having the same score.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna ah pawl tegel point kibangin tawp.

examples.english: The teams drew two–two.
examples.zomi: Pawl tegel point nih ciat ngah uh hi.

examples.english: The match ended in a draw.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna point kibangin tawp hi.

senses.usage_en: This sports sense is common in British English. American English often uses tie.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kimawlna khiatna pen British English ah kizang tam hi. American English ah tie kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: To take liquid, air, or information from a source
senses.definition_en: To take, obtain, or pull something from a source.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui, huih, sisan, ahih keileh thu khat a pianna pan la.

examples.english: They draw water from the well every morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsang simin tuikhuk pan tui kaikhia uh hi.

examples.english: We should not draw a conclusion without enough evidence.
examples.zomi: Teci kicing omlo in thu khupna bawl loh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense of draw is drew, and the past participle is drawn: draw–drew–drawn.
senses.usage_zomi: Draw a past tense pen drew, past participle pen drawn ahi hi: draw–drew–drawn.

senses.heading: A picture made with lines
senses.definition_en: A picture or design made with a pencil, pen, or similar tool rather than with paint.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pencil, pen, ahih keileh van dang tawh lai suai in a kibawl lim.

examples.english: The child gave me a drawing of her family.
examples.zomi: Naupang in a innkuante lim a suai hong pia hi.

examples.english: The architect showed us a drawing of the building.
examples.zomi: Inn lam siam in inn geel lim hong lak hi.

senses.usage_en: A drawing is usually made mainly with lines. A painting is made with paint and colour.
senses.usage_zomi: Drawing pen lai tawh lim suai ahi zel hi. Painting pen paint leh kiluam tawh a kibawl lim ahi hi.

senses.heading: The activity or skill of making pictures
senses.definition_en: The activity or skill of making pictures with lines.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai tawh lim suaihna gamtatna ahih keileh siamna.

examples.english: Drawing helps children observe details.
examples.zomi: Lim suaihna in naupangte khen neute phawk theisak hi.

examples.english: She is studying drawing and painting.
examples.zomi: Ama lim suaihna leh paint lim bawlna sin hi.

senses.usage_en: In this general sense, drawing is normally uncountable. A completed picture is a drawing.
senses.usage_zomi: Lim suai gamtatna a huam in gen ciangin drawing pen simsawm theihloh min hi. A kizo lim khat pen a drawing kici hi.

senses.heading: Images and experiences during sleep
senses.definition_en: A series of images, thoughts, or experiences that occur in the mind while someone is sleeping.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a ihmut laitak in a lungsim sungah a muh leh a thuak bang a kisak lim leh thu piangte.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat tawh kisai mang mu

examples.english: I had a strange dream last night.
examples.zomi: Zani zanin mang lamdang khat ka mu hi.

examples.english: She dreamed about her childhood home.
examples.zomi: A naupan lai inn tawh kisai mang mu hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses have a dream, while Standard Zomi naturally expresses this as mang mu.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah have a dream kici napi, Standard Zomi ah mang mu ci in kigen a ngeina hi.

senses.heading: A strong hope or ambition
senses.definition_en: A strong hope or goal that someone wants to achieve in the future.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in mailam hunah tangtun nuam mahmah ngiimna ahih keileh lam-etna.

examples.english: Her dream is to become a doctor.
examples.zomi: Ama’ ngiimna pen siavuan suak ding ahi hi.

examples.english: He worked hard to achieve his dream.
examples.zomi: A ngiimna tangtun dingin hahkat takin nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: A future dream may be an inspiring ambition, but a practical plan requires clear steps and action.
senses.usage_zomi: Mailam dream pen ngiimna lunglawng ahi thei napi, geelna taktak in kalsuanna kician leh gamtatna kisam hi.

senses.heading: A one-piece garment worn especially by women or girls
senses.definition_en: A piece of clothing that covers the upper body and extends over part or all of the legs.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diakin numei leh numeino in a silh, pumpi tunglam pan khe lam dong a kizom puan khat.

examples.english: She wore a blue dress to the wedding.
examples.zomi: Mopawi ah dress pawl khat silh hi.

examples.english: The dress was made by a local designer.
examples.zomi: Dress pen tua gam designer khat in bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A dress is one complete garment. A skirt covers only the lower part of the body.
senses.usage_zomi: Dress pen puan kizom kicing khat ahi hi. Skirt in pumpi nuailam bek tuam hi.

senses.heading: Clothing of a particular type
senses.definition_en: Clothing considered according to its style, purpose, or level of formality.
senses.explanation_zomi: A style, a ngiimna, ahih keileh a formal dinmun dungzui puansilh nam.

examples.english: Traditional dress is encouraged at the celebration.
examples.zomi: Pawi ah ngeina puan silh ding kihan hi.

examples.english: The invitation states that formal dress is required.
examples.zomi: Sapna lai in formal puan silh kisam cih gen hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, dress is uncountable and refers generally to a style of clothing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah dress pen simsawm theihloh min hi a, puansilh style khat a huam in kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Wearing clothes, especially clothes of a particular type.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan silhsa, a diakin puan nam khat silhsa.

examples.english: The children were already dressed for school.
examples.zomi: Naupangte sang kai dingin puan silh khin uh hi.

examples.english: She was dressed in traditional Zomi clothing.
examples.zomi: Ama Zomi ngeina puan silh hi.

senses.usage_en: Common patterns are dressed in clothing or a colour and dressed for an occasion: dressed in white; dressed for work.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan ngeina pen dressed in puan ahih keileh kiluam, leh dressed for pawi ahih keileh nasep ahi hi: dressed in white; dressed for work.

senses.heading: A liquid intended for drinking
senses.definition_en: Water, juice, tea, coffee, or another liquid that a person can drink.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui, singgah tui, tea, coffee, ahih keileh dawn theih tui nam dang.

examples.english: Would you like a hot drink?
examples.zomi: Dawnna lum khat na dawn nuam diam?

examples.english: Water is the best drink after exercise.
examples.zomi: Pumpi pattah khit ciangin tui pen dawnna hoihpen ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A drink means one serving or type of liquid. Drink can also be uncountable when referring generally to liquid consumption.
senses.usage_zomi: A drink in dawnna khat ahih keileh dawnna nam khat kawk hi. Dawnna a huam in gen ciangin drink pen simsawm theihloh min ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: An alcoholic beverage
senses.definition_en: A beverage containing alcohol.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zu tha nei dawnna.

examples.english: He decided not to have an alcoholic drink.
examples.zomi: Ama in zu dawnlo ding khensat hi.

examples.english: The restaurant serves food and drinks.
examples.zomi: Annekna dawr in annek leh dawnna-te pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In some contexts, a drink is understood to mean alcohol. Context determines whether it means any beverage or an alcoholic one.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun pawlkhat ah a drink in zu kawk pah thei hi. A kizop thu in dawnna peuhmah maw, zu maw cih khiatna lak hi.

senses.heading: To control and operate a vehicle
senses.definition_en: To control a car, truck, bus, or another road vehicle and make it move.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw, truck, bus, ahih keileh lampi tung leng khat uk in hawl.

examples.english: She drives to work every morning.
examples.zomi: Ama zingsang simin mawtaw tawh nasepna ah pai hi.

examples.english: Do not drive when you are tired.
examples.zomi: Na gim ciangin mawtaw hawl kei in.

senses.usage_en: Drive is used for cars, trucks, and buses. For bicycles and motorcycles, English normally uses ride.
senses.usage_zomi: Drive pen car, truck leh bus-te dingin kizang hi. Bicycle leh motorcycle dingin English ah ride kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: To take someone somewhere by vehicle
senses.definition_en: To transport someone to a place in a vehicle that you control.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw hawl in mi khat mun khat ah paipih.

examples.english: I will drive you home after the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna khit ciangin inn ah kong hawlpih ding hi.

examples.english: Her father drives her to school.
examples.zomi: A pa in sang ah hawlpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Say drive someone somewhere, without to, before home: drive me home. Use to before most other places.
senses.usage_zomi: Home ma ah to omlo in drive me home kici hi. Mun dangte ma ah to kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: To force or motivate someone or something
senses.definition_en: To cause someone to act or cause a situation to develop, often through pressure or strong motivation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat gamta sak ahih keileh dinmun khat hong khang sak dingin sawlna leh lungsim tha khauh pia.

examples.english: Strong demand is driving prices higher.
examples.zomi: Kisapna tam in mante sangzaw sak hi.

examples.english: Her desire to help others drives her work.
examples.zomi: Midang huh nopna in a nasep sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense identifies the force or motivation causing action or change.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak khiatna in gamtatna ahih keileh kikhelna piangsak tha leh ngiimna pulak hi.

senses.heading: To make someone enter a difficult condition
senses.definition_en: To force someone into an unpleasant state or situation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: dinmun sungah lut sak; hong suaksak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat dinmun hoihlo ahih keileh lungsim sukna nasia sungah lut sak.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat leiba sungah lut sak

examples.english: High medical bills drove the family into debt.
examples.zomi: Cidamna sum piak tam in innkuan pen leiba sungah lut sak hi.

examples.english: The constant noise is driving me crazy.
examples.zomi: Aw ging tawntung in ka lungsim hong buaisak mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: The structure is often drive someone into/to something or drive someone away.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan ngeina pen drive someone into/to something ahih keileh drive someone away ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who controls and operates a car, truck, bus, or another vehicle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Car, truck, bus, ahih keileh leng dang khat a uk in hawl mi.

examples.english: The bus driver waited for the elderly passenger.
examples.zomi: Bus hawlpa in khualzin upa pen ngak hi.

examples.english: Every driver must obey traffic laws.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawl mi khempeuh lampi thukhun zui ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Driver usually refers to the person controlling a road vehicle. A person controlling an aircraft is a pilot.
senses.usage_zomi: Driver in lampi tung leng a hawl mi kawk zel hi. Vanleng a uk mi pen pilot kici hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity or skill of controlling and operating a road vehicle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi tung mawtaw ahih keileh leng dang khat uk in hawlna gamtatna leh siamna.

examples.english: She is taking driving lessons.
examples.zomi: Ama mawtaw hawl sinna la hi.

examples.english: Careless driving causes many accidents.
examples.zomi: Pilvanglo mawtaw hawlna in accident tampi piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, the official document is a driving licence. American English normally uses driver’s license.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah official lai pen driving licence kici hi. American English ah driver’s license kici zel hi.

senses.heading: To let something fall
senses.definition_en: To allow something to fall, usually unintentionally, from your hand or from a higher position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat khut ahih keileh mun sangzaw pan puk sak, a diakin khialhna tawh.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat inn nuai ah puk sak

examples.english: Be careful not to drop the glass.
examples.zomi: Limlang no na puk sakloh dingin pilvang in.

examples.english: She dropped her phone on the floor.
examples.zomi: Ama in a phone inn nuai ah puk sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Drop suggests that something falls from a higher position. It may be accidental or intentional, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Drop in na khat mun sangzaw pan puk cihna lak hi. A kizop thu dungzui in khialhna tawh ahih keileh a lungsim takpi tawh ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: To become lower or smaller
senses.definition_en: To decrease in amount, level, temperature, price, or number.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, dinmun, khuahun lumna, man, ahih keileh number hong kiam.

examples.english: The temperature dropped below freezing.
examples.zomi: Khuahun lumna tui kikhal theih dinmun nuai ah niam hi.

examples.english: Sales dropped sharply last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in zuakna nasatak in kiam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, drop is intransitive: Prices dropped. To cause a reduction, use it transitively: The store dropped its prices.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah drop pen intransitive in kizang thei hi: Prices dropped. Mi khat in kiam sak leh transitive in kizang hi: The store dropped its prices.

senses.heading: To stop or remove something
senses.definition_en: To stop doing, discussing, studying, or including something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl, kikum, sin, ahih keileh tel sakna tawpsak.

examples.english: She decided to drop the course.
examples.zomi: Ama in course nusia ding khensat hi.

examples.english: The police dropped the charge because there was no evidence.
examples.zomi: Teci a omloh manin police-te in mawhpuhna koihkhia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Drop a course means officially stop taking it. It does not mean physically allowing the course to fall.
senses.usage_zomi: Drop a course in course sinna official takin nusia cihna ahi hi. Course pen pumpi tawh puk sak cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: To take someone or something to a place
senses.definition_en: To transport someone or something to a place and leave them or it there.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh van khat mun khat ah paipih in koih.

common_phrases.english: drop a package at the office

examples.english: I will drop you off at the airport.
examples.zomi: Vanleng ngakna mun ah kong paipih in kong koih ding hi.

examples.english: She dropped the children at school.
examples.zomi: Ama in naupangte sang ah paipih hi.

senses.usage_en: The phrasal verb drop off is more common when leaving a person or object at a destination.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih keileh van khat mun khat ah koihna gen leh phrasal verb drop off kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: A chemical substance used as medicine
senses.definition_en: A substance used to prevent, treat, or control an illness or medical condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Natna kham, damsak, ahih keileh ukna dingin a kizang chemical si.

examples.english: The doctor prescribed a drug to control her blood pressure.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in a sisan pressure ukna ding si gelh hi.

examples.english: Researchers are testing a new drug.
examples.zomi: Kholmite in si thak khat sittel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In medical English, drug can mean medicine. In everyday conversation, medicine may sound clearer and less connected with illegal substances.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna English ah drug in si kawk thei hi. Nisim kiholimna ah medicine kicianzaw a, thukhamlo zatna tawh kizom khialhna tawmzaw hi.

senses.heading: An illegal or harmful substance
senses.definition_en: A substance taken for its effects on the mind or body, especially one whose possession or use is illegal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim ahih keileh pumpi sukna dingin a kizang a, a neih leh a zat thukham in a kham zatui.

examples.english: The police found illegal drugs in the car.
examples.zomi: Police-te in mawtaw sungah thukhamlo zatui mu uh hi.

examples.english: Drug addiction can harm individuals and families.
examples.zomi: Zatui tawh kikhihcipna in mimal leh innkuan susia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Context determines whether drug means a medicine or an illegal substance. Use a precise term whenever misunderstanding is possible.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizop thu in drug pen si maw, thukhamlo zatui maw cih khen hi. Kitelkhial theihna om leh kammal kician zat ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A musical instrument with a stretched surface that is struck with the hands or sticks.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khut ahih keileh ciang neu tawh tum dingin vun ahih keileh a phei kizak a kibawl tumging van.

examples.english: He played the drum during the celebration.
examples.zomi: Pawi laitak in drum tum hi.

examples.english: We heard the steady beat of a drum.
examples.zomi: Drum ging a kibang tawntung za ung.

senses.usage_en: In English, normally say play the drums when describing the musical skill and beat a drum when emphasizing striking it.
senses.usage_zomi: Music siamna gen leh English ah play the drums kici zel a, a tumna gamtat bulphuh leh beat a drum kici hi.

senses.definition_en: Affected by alcohol so that thinking, speech, movement, or judgment is impaired.
senses.zomi_equivalents: zu kham; zu dawn in lungpilna kiam
senses.explanation_zomi: Zu a dawn manin ngaihsutna, kampau, kihihna, ahih keileh khensatna maanlo dinmun ah om.

examples.english: He was too drunk to drive safely.
examples.zomi: Bit takin mawtaw hawltheihloh zahin zu kham hi.

examples.english: Never get into a car with a drunk driver.
examples.zomi: Zu kham mawtaw hawl mi tawh mawtaw sungah cikmah in tuang kei in.

senses.usage_en: Drunk is normally used after a linking verb: He is drunk. Before a noun, it may sound strongly judgmental, though fixed expressions such as drunk driver are common.
senses.usage_zomi: Drunk pen linking verb khit ah kizang zel hi: He is drunk. Noun ma ah zat leh mawhsakna khauh bangin ging thei napi, drunk driver bang kammal kipsa-te kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Not wet or containing little moisture
senses.definition_en: Not wet, damp, or covered with liquid.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ci lo, tui omlo, ahih keileh tui tawh kizello.

examples.english: The clothes are now completely dry.
examples.zomi: Puante tu in keu sitset hi.

examples.english: Keep the documents dry.
examples.zomi: Laikhakte tui ci sak kei in.

senses.usage_en: Dry is the opposite of wet. Something may be damp when it contains a small amount of moisture.
senses.usage_zomi: Dry a langkhat pen wet ahi hi. Tui tawmno a nei lai na khat pen damp kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Having little rain or water
senses.definition_en: Receiving little rain or lacking enough water.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gua tawm ahih keileh tui kicing nei lo.

examples.english: The region has a long dry season.
examples.zomi: Tua gamkee in khuakeu hun sau nei hi.

examples.english: Farmers need water during dry weather.
examples.zomi: Khuahun keu ciangin lo neite tui kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A dry season is a regular period with little rain. A drought is an unusually severe and damaging shortage of rain.
senses.usage_zomi: Dry season pen kum simin gua a tawm ngeina hun ahi hi. Drought pen ngeina sangin gua a tawm lua a, siatna piangsak khuakeu ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not sweet
senses.definition_en: Containing little sugar or having a taste that is not sweet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sukha tawm ahih keileh a limlo dawnna.

examples.english: He prefers dry wine to sweet wine.
examples.zomi: Ama in zu lim sangin zu limlo deihzaw hi.

examples.english: The drink has a dry taste.
examples.zomi: Dawnna in limlohna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: For wine and some drinks, dry means not sweet; it does not mean that the drink contains no liquid.
senses.usage_zomi: Zu leh dawnna pawlkhat ah dry in a limlo cihna ahi a, tui omlo cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Expected or scheduled to happen or arrive
senses.definition_en: Expected or planned to happen, arrive, or be completed at a particular time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hun ciang a piang ding; kigeelkholh
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat ciangin piang, tung, ahih keileh kizo dingin a kigeel.

examples.english: The train is due to arrive at six.
examples.zomi: Train nai guk ciangin hong tung ding hi.

examples.english: The assignment is due tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Nasep piak pen zingciang ap ding ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Due to do something often refers to an expected event. For deadlines, due on Friday means it must be submitted or paid by Friday.
senses.usage_zomi: Due to do something in piang ding a lam-et thu kawk zel hi. Deadline ah due on Friday in Friday ni ciangtan ap ahih keileh pia ding cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Owed to someone
senses.definition_en: Owed or required to be paid or given to someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tungah piak ding leiba ahih keileh a ngah ding.

examples.english: The full amount is due by the end of the month.
examples.zomi: Sum a vekpi kha tawp ciangtan piak ding ahi hi.

examples.english: She received the payment due to her.
examples.zomi: Ama’ ngah ding sum ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: In billing, amount due means the money that must now be paid.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum piakna lai ah amount due in tu laitak a piak ding sum zat kawk hi.

senses.heading: Properly deserved or suitable
senses.definition_en: Rightfully deserved by someone or suitable in the circumstances.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in ngah taak ahih keileh dinmun tawh a kituak.

examples.english: She received the praise due to her.
examples.zomi: Ama’ ngah taak phatna ngah hi.

examples.english: With due respect, I disagree with the decision.
examples.zomi: Zahtakna kicing tawh, tua khensatna tawh ka ngaihsutdan kibanglo hi.

senses.usage_en: The phrase due to can also mean “because of”: The flight was delayed due to snow.
senses.usage_zomi: Due to kammal in “hangin” cihna zong nei thei hi: The flight was delayed due to snow.

senses.definition_en: At some point within a period or throughout the time that an event continues.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat sungah, thu khat a piang laitak in, ahih keileh tua hun a vekpi in.

examples.english: Please turn off your phone during the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna sungin na phone mit in.

examples.english: It rained several times during the night.
examples.zomi: Zan sungin gua vei tampi zu hi.

senses.usage_en: During is followed by a noun phrase: during the class. While is followed by a clause: while the class was meeting.
senses.usage_zomi: During khit ah noun phrase om hi: during the class. While khit ah clause om hi: while the class was meeting.

senses.definition_en: Very small, dry particles of earth, skin, or other material that collect on surfaces or float in the air.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei, vun, ahih keileh van dang pan a piang a, van tungah a kikaikhawm ahih keileh huih sungah a leng particles neu mahmah.

examples.english: The old books were covered in dust.
examples.zomi: Laibu luite leivui tawh kizel dim hi.

examples.english: A cloud of dust rose behind the truck.
examples.zomi: Truck nungah leivui meii bangin tho hi.

senses.usage_en: Dust is normally uncountable. A small individual particle may be called a speck of dust.
senses.usage_zomi: Dust pen simsawm theihloh min ahi zel hi. Leivui neu khatbek pen a speck of dust kici thei hi.

senses.heading: A responsibility or obligation
senses.definition_en: Something that a person is expected or required to do because of a job, law, promise, or moral responsibility.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, thukham, kamciam, ahih keileh gamtat hoihna hangin mi khat in a bawl ding mawpuakna.

examples.english: Parents have a duty to care for their children.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pate in a tate uh don ding mawpuakna nei uh hi.

examples.english: The officer performed his duty carefully.
examples.zomi: Ulian in a mawpuakna pilvang takin tangtun hi.

senses.usage_en: A duty is something a person should or must do. A responsibility can also refer more broadly to something under a person’s care or control.
senses.usage_zomi: Duty pen mi khat in a bawl ding ahih keileh a bawl kul na ahi hi. Responsibility in mi khat kep leh ukna nuai a om na zong huam thei hi.

senses.heading: A period of working
senses.definition_en: A period when someone is officially working or available for work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat official takin a nasem ahih keileh nasep dingin a kigingsa hun.

examples.english: Two nurses are on duty tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zanin nurse nih nasem ding uh hi.

examples.english: The police officer was off duty when the accident happened.
examples.zomi: Accident a pian ciangin police officer nasep khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: On duty means officially working. Off duty means not working at that time.
senses.usage_zomi: On duty in official takin nasem lai cihna ahi hi. Off duty in tua hunah nasemlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A tax on certain goods
senses.definition_en: A tax charged by a government on particular goods, especially imported products.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi in van nam pawlkhat tungah, a diakin gamdang pan hong lut vante tungah a kai sia.

examples.english: Import duty must be paid on the goods.
examples.zomi: Vante tungah van lut sia piak ding ahi hi.

examples.english: The price includes all taxes and duties.
examples.zomi: Man sungah sia leh van sia khempeuh kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: In this financial sense, duty is a type of tax, not a work responsibility.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih sumlehpai khiatna ah duty pen sia nam khat ahi a, nasep mawpuakna kawklo hi.

senses.definition_en: A digital disc used to store or play video, audio, or computer data.
senses.explanation_zomi: Video, aw, ahih keileh computer data koih leh enna ding digital disc.

examples.english: We watched the film on DVD.
examples.zomi: Film pen DVD tawh en ung.

examples.english: This computer can read DVDs.
examples.zomi: Hih computer in DVD simthei hi.

senses.usage_en: DVD is pronounced one letter at a time. Streaming has replaced DVDs for many uses, but DVDs are still used for stored media.
senses.usage_zomi: DVD pen lai mal khat ciat in kipau hi. Streaming in zatna tampi ah DVD a laihkhia khin napi, media koihna dingin DVD kizang lai hi.

senses.definition_en: Used before a singular noun to refer separately to every person or thing in a group of two or more.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat sunga mi ahih keileh na khempeuh a tuamtuam in khat ciat kawkna dingin singular noun ma ah kizang.

examples.english: Each student received a dictionary.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang khat ciat in dictionary khat ngah uh hi.

examples.english: The tickets cost ten dollars each.
examples.zomi: Ticket-te khat ciat dollar sawm ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Each is followed by a singular countable noun: each student, not each students. Use each of before a plural pronoun or determiner phrase: each of them; each of the students.
senses.usage_zomi: Each khit ah singular countable noun om hi: each student kici a, each students kici lo hi. Plural pronoun ahih keileh determiner phrase ma ah each of kizang hi: each of them; each of the students.

senses.heading: The body part used for hearing
senses.definition_en: One of the two organs on the sides of the head used for hearing and balance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zaakna leh pumpi dingdetna dingin a kizang, lu pangnih ah a om pumpi khen nih lakah khat.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat bil ah aw nem in gen

examples.english: The child has an infection in his left ear.
examples.zomi: Naupang in a bil veilam ah natna kaat nei hi.

examples.english: She whispered the answer in my ear.
examples.zomi: Ama in dawnna ka bil ah aw nem in hong gen hi.

senses.usage_en: The outer ear helps collect sound, while structures inside the ear also help maintain balance.
senses.usage_zomi: Bil pualam in aw ging la a, bil sung khen pawlkhat in pumpi dingdetna zong huh hi.

senses.heading: The seed-bearing part of a grain plant
senses.definition_en: The part of a grain plant that contains its seeds.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buh, mangbuh, ahih keileh ankung dang a tangte a omna lutang khen.

examples.english: She picked an ear of corn from the field.
examples.zomi: Ama in lo pan mangbuh vui khat lo hi.

examples.english: The ears of grain were ready to harvest.
examples.zomi: Buh vuite la dingin min khin hi.

senses.usage_en: In this agricultural sense, ear refers to the seed-bearing head, not the hearing organ.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lo an khiatna ah ear in ankung a tang omna lutang kawk a, bil kawklo hi.

senses.heading: Before the expected or usual time
senses.definition_en: Happening or arriving before the planned, expected, or usual time.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigeelkholh, a lam-et, ahih keileh a ngeina hun ma in a piang ahih keileh a tung.

examples.english: We caught an early train to the city.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah train a baih man ung.

examples.english: Her early arrival gave us time to prepare.
examples.zomi: Hun ma a hong tun manin kigingsakna ding hun ngah ung.

senses.usage_en: Early means before the expected time. Soon means after a short period from now or from another stated time.
senses.usage_zomi: Early in hun kigeel ma cihna ahi hi. Soon in tu pan ahih keileh hun kigensa pan hun sawtlo khit cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Near the beginning of a period or development
senses.definition_en: Belonging to the beginning part of a period, process, life, or history.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, kalsuan, nuntakna, ahih keileh tangthu khat a kipat lam tawh kisai.

examples.english: The disease is easier to treat at an early stage.
examples.zomi: Natna pen a kipatcil dinmun ah damsak baihzaw hi.

examples.english: She spent her early childhood in Myanmar.
examples.zomi: A naupanlai masa Myanmar ah zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, early describes position near the beginning, not arrival before a scheduled time.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah early in hun ma a tunna kawklo a, hun khen khat a kipat lam kawk hi.

senses.heading: To receive money for work
senses.definition_en: To receive money in return for work or services.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih keileh nasepna piakna manin sum ngah.

examples.english: She earns enough money to support her family.
examples.zomi: A innkuan kemna ding sum kicing ngah hi.

examples.english: He earns a weekly salary.
examples.zomi: Ama kal simin thaman ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Earn refers to money received for work. Win is used for money received from a contest, lottery, or game.
senses.usage_zomi: Earn in nasep manin sum ngah cihna ahi hi. Kidemna, lottery, ahih keileh kimawlna pan sum ngah leh win kizang hi.

senses.heading: To deserve or gain something through effort or behaviour
senses.definition_en: To gain respect, praise, trust, or another result because of what you have done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna ahih keileh gamtatna hangin zahtakna, phatna, muanna, ahih keileh result khat ngah.

examples.english: Her honest work earned the community’s trust.
examples.zomi: A nasep thumaan in khawlsung mite’ muanna ngahsak hi.

examples.english: The team earned a place in the final.
examples.zomi: Pawl in a nunungpen kidemna ah kihelna ding panmun ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, earn implies that the result was gained through action, effort, or character.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah earn in result pen gamtatna, hanciamna, ahih keileh pianzia hangin a kingah cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: The planet on which humans live
senses.definition_en: The planet that is the home of humans and all other known life.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing leh nuntakna nei a kithei khempeuh a tengna planet.

examples.english: The Earth moves around the sun.
examples.zomi: Leitung in ni kiimah kihei hi.

examples.english: Most of the Earth’s surface is covered by water.
examples.zomi: Leitung mai a tamzaw tui in tuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Earth when it is used as the planet’s proper name. Lowercase earth may mean soil or land.
senses.usage_zomi: Planet min taktak in kizang leh Earth lai lian tawh kipan hi. Lai neu earth in lei ahih keileh gam kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Soil or ground
senses.definition_en: The soil or ground beneath people, plants, and buildings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, singkung leh innte a omna lei ahih keileh leitang.

examples.english: The seeds were planted deep in the earth.
examples.zomi: Ciinte lei sung thuk ah kiphum hi.

examples.english: The rain made the earth soft.
examples.zomi: Gua in lei neem sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, soil or dirt is often more natural when referring specifically to material used for planting.
senses.usage_zomi: Singkung phuhna lei a gen ciangin American English ah soil ahih keileh dirt zat a ngeinazaw hi.

senses.heading: Land rather than sky or sea
senses.definition_en: The solid land surface, in contrast with the sky or sea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van leh tuipi tawh a kilang, leitang khempeuh.

examples.english: The aircraft returned safely to earth.
examples.zomi: Vanleng bit takin lei tungah hong ciah hi.

examples.english: Smoke rose high above the earth.
examples.zomi: Meikhu lei tung sangpi ah kahto hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes solid land or the human world rather than the planet as an astronomical body.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in astronomy planet sangin leitang ahih keileh mihing omna leitung bulphuh hi.

senses.definition_en: A sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement within the Earth’s crust.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung puan sung a kikhelna manin leitang thakhatthu in a kiliing.

examples.english: The earthquake damaged many buildings.
examples.zomi: Zinling in inn tampi susia hi.

examples.english: People ran outside when the earthquake began.
examples.zomi: Zinling a kipat ciangin mipite pualam ah taikhia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An earthquake is the ground movement itself. Its strength may be described by magnitude, while its effects vary by location.
senses.usage_zomi: Earthquake pen lei kiliingna mahmah ahi hi. A khauhzah pen magnitude tawh gen thei a, a siatna pen mun simin kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: Without difficulty
senses.definition_en: Without needing much effort, skill, or thought.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna, siamna, ahih keileh ngaihsutna tampi kisamlo in baihlam takin.

examples.english: The instructions can be easily understood.
examples.zomi: Thu hilhna-te baihlam takin kitel thei hi.

examples.english: This glass breaks easily.
examples.zomi: Hih limlang no baihlam takin kitam hi.

senses.usage_en: Easy is an adjective; easily is an adverb: an easy task; complete it easily.
senses.usage_zomi: Easy pen adjective a, easily pen adverb ahi hi: an easy task; complete it easily.

senses.heading: By a large amount or without close competition
senses.definition_en: Certainly or by a large difference, especially when comparing results.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kician in; kilamdanna lian tawh
senses.explanation_zomi: Kilamdanna lian tawh ahih keileh kidemna khauh omlo in.

examples.english: She was easily the best player on the team.
examples.zomi: Ama pawl sunga kimawl siam pen kician ahi hi.

examples.english: The home team won easily.
examples.zomi: Inn pawl baihlam takin gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, easily strengthens a comparison or shows that little competition existed.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah easily in tehkakna khauh sak ahih keileh kidemna haksa a omlohna lak hi.

senses.definition_en: The direction where the sun rises, opposite west.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni a suahna lam, nitumna langkhat lam.

examples.english: The sun rises in the east.
examples.zomi: Ni nisuahlam pan suak hi.

examples.english: The mountains lie to the east of the city.
examples.zomi: Mualte khuapi nisuahlam ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the east for the direction or region. Use east before another noun in some fixed phrases: east coast.
senses.usage_zomi: Lam ahih keileh gamkee gen leh the east kizang hi. Kammal kipsa pawlkhat ah noun ma ah east kizang hi: east coast.

senses.definition_en: Located in, coming from, or connected with the east part of a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat a nisuahlam ah a om, tua lam pan a hong pai, ahih keileh tua lam tawh kisai.

examples.english: Heavy rain affected the eastern region.
examples.zomi: Gua tampi in nisuahlam gamkee suk hi.

examples.english: They live in the eastern part of the state.
examples.zomi: State nisuahlam khen ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: East is the noun or compass direction. Eastern is an adjective describing a broad area or connection with the east.
senses.usage_zomi: East pen noun ahih keileh lam min hi. Eastern pen nisuahlam gam zaizaw ahih keileh tua lam tawh kizopna a hilhcian adjective ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not difficult
senses.definition_en: Requiring little effort, skill, or thought.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna, siamna, ahih keileh ngaihsutna tampi kisamlo.

examples.english: The first question was easy to answer.
examples.zomi: Dotna masapen dawng baih hi.

examples.english: This app is easy to use.
examples.zomi: Hih app zat baih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use easy to do something: The instructions are easy to follow. Avoid easy for doing in this pattern.
senses.usage_zomi: Easy to do something ci in kizang hi: The instructions are easy to follow. Hih zatdan ah easy for doing kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: Comfortable, calm, or free from worry
senses.definition_en: Comfortable, relaxed, or not involving pressure and worry.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nopsak, lungmuang, ahih keileh sawlna leh lunghihmawhna tawm.

examples.english: He has an easy manner that makes people comfortable.
examples.zomi: Ama’ gamtat lungnuam in mite nopsak sak hi.

examples.english: Take it easy and get some rest.
examples.zomi: Khawdai takin om in, tawlnga in.

senses.usage_en: Take it easy is an informal expression meaning relax, avoid excessive effort, or remain calm.
senses.usage_zomi: Take it easy pen nisim pauciamna hi a, lungnuam takin om, hanciam lua lo, ahih keileh lungmuang takin om cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To put food in the mouth, chew it, and swallow it
senses.definition_en: To consume food by putting it in the mouth and swallowing it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Annek kam sungah koih, ne in, valh.

examples.english: The family eats dinner together every evening.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in nitak simin nitak an nekhawm uh hi.

examples.english: You should eat more vegetables.
examples.zomi: Antuam tamzaw na nek ding ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense of eat is ate /eɪt/, and the past participle is eaten: eat–ate–eaten.
senses.usage_zomi: Eat a past tense pen ate /eɪt/, past participle pen eaten ahi hi: eat–ate–eaten.

senses.heading: To have a meal
senses.definition_en: To have breakfast, lunch, dinner, or another meal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zingsang an, sun an, nitak an, ahih keileh annek hun khat nei.

examples.english: We ate at a restaurant last night.
examples.zomi: Zani zanin annekna dawr ah an ne ung.

examples.english: She rarely eats alone.
examples.zomi: Ama amah bek in an ne khollo hi.

senses.usage_en: Eat out means eating at a restaurant or somewhere away from home.
senses.usage_zomi: Eat out in inn pualam, a diakin annekna dawr ah an ne cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Connected with the production, trade, employment, income, and use of money and resources.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sumlehpai tawh kisai; economy tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Van bawlna, van kizuakna, nasepna, income, sum leh van neihte zatna tawh kisai.

examples.english: The country experienced strong economic growth.
examples.zomi: Gam in sumlehpai khanna khauh ngah hi.

examples.english: The report examines the economic effects of the policy.
examples.zomi: Report in thukhun a sumlehpai sukna enkhol hi.

senses.usage_en: Economic means related to the economy. Economical means avoiding waste or costing relatively little.
senses.usage_zomi: Economic in economy tawh kisai cihna ahi hi. Economical in a mawk zatlo ahih keileh sum tawm tawh kizangthei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A country’s system of producing and using goods, services, and money
senses.definition_en: The system through which a country or region produces, trades, and uses goods, services, money, and labour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam ahih keileh gamkee khat in van, nasepna, sum leh nasemte zang in a bawl, a zuak leh a zatdan system.

examples.english: Small businesses are important to the local economy.
examples.zomi: Sum nasepna neute tua gam sumlehpai system adingin thupi hi.

examples.english: The economy grew during the past year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa sungin sumlehpai khang hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to one country’s whole economic system, English commonly uses the economy.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam khat sumlehpai system a vekpi a kawk ciangin English ah the economy kici zel hi.

senses.heading: Careful use of money or resources
senses.definition_en: The careful use of money, time, fuel, or materials to avoid waste.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, hun, fuel, ahih keileh vante mawk zatlo in pilvang takin zatna.

examples.english: The car was designed for fuel economy.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw pen fuel tawm zatna dingin kibawl hi.

examples.english: For reasons of economy, they reused the materials.
examples.zomi: Sum khemkhatna dingin vante zangkik uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes efficiency and avoiding waste.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in a phattuam in zatna leh mawk zatlohna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: The least expensive class of travel
senses.definition_en: The least expensive seating class on an aircraft or some other forms of transport.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanleng ahih keileh khualzinna van pawlkhat a man tawmpen tutna class.

examples.english: We booked economy-class tickets.
examples.zomi: Economy-class ticket kam ung.

examples.english: She usually flies economy.
examples.zomi: Ama vanleng tuang ciangin economy class zang zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Economy in travel is usually short for economy class.
senses.usage_zomi: Khualzinna ah economy pen economy class kammal tomsakna ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: The outer limit or border of something
senses.definition_en: The outer line, boundary, or part of a surface, area, or object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a mong, a gamgi, ahih keileh pualam tawpna.

examples.english: Do not place the glass near the edge of the table.
examples.zomi: Limlang no sabuai mong gei ah koih kei in.

examples.english: They live on the edge of the city.
examples.zomi: Khuapi mong ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An edge is the line or narrow area where something ends.
senses.usage_zomi: Edge pen na khat a tawpna lai ahih keileh a mong gei mun kawk hi.

senses.heading: A sharp cutting side
senses.definition_en: The sharpened side of a knife, blade, or other cutting tool.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tem, steel, ahih keileh tanna van dang a hiam lai.

examples.english: The knife has a very sharp edge.
examples.zomi: Tem in a hiam lai hiam mahmah nei hi.

examples.english: Do not touch the edge of the blade.
examples.zomi: Steel a hiam lai lawng kei in.

senses.usage_en: A sharp edge can cut. The flat side of a blade is not its cutting edge.
senses.usage_zomi: Hiam lai in tan thei hi. Steel a pang phei pen a tanna hiam lai hilo hi.

senses.heading: A slight advantage
senses.definition_en: A small advantage that makes someone or something more likely to succeed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat gualzo theizaw sak phattuamna tawmno.

examples.english: Her experience gave her an edge over the other candidates.
examples.zomi: A muhkhakna in kidem mi dangte sangin phattuamna pia hi.

examples.english: Lower prices may give the company a competitive edge.
examples.zomi: Man tawmzaw in company tungah kidemna phattuamna pia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: The usual expression is have an edge over someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan ngeina pen have an edge over someone or something ahi hi.

senses.heading: To correct and improve written, recorded, or visual material
senses.definition_en: To review and change text, audio, video, or images to improve accuracy, clarity, quality, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laigelh, aw, video, ahih keileh lim enkik in a maan, a kician, a hoih leh a kizop hoihzaw dingin puah.

examples.english: Please edit the report before publishing it.
examples.zomi: Report na khah ma in enkik in puah in.

examples.english: She edited the video on her computer.
examples.zomi: Ama in video pen a computer tawh puah hi.

senses.usage_en: Editing may involve correcting errors, reorganizing material, shortening content, or improving presentation.
senses.usage_zomi: Editing in khialhna puahna, thu seh kikna, tom sakna, ahih keileh a kilakdan hoihzaw sakna huam thei hi.

senses.heading: To prepare material for publication or broadcast
senses.definition_en: To select, organize, revise, and approve material for a book, newspaper, program, or website.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kikhah ding thu puah; laigelh uk
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, thuthang laibu, program, ahih keileh website a kikhah ding thu teel, seh, puah leh phal.

examples.english: He edits a weekly newspaper.
examples.zomi: Ama in kal sim thuthang laibu uk leh puah hi.

examples.english: A specialist edited the medical handbook.
examples.zomi: Cidamna siam khat in cidamna laibu enkik in puah hi.

senses.usage_en: The person who edits material is an editor. The person who originally creates the text is the writer or author.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu a puah mi pen editor kici hi. Thu masa a gelh mi pen writer ahih keileh author kici hi.

senses.heading: A particular version of a published work
senses.definition_en: A particular version of a book, dictionary, newspaper, or other published work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, dictionary, thuthang laibu, ahih keileh lai kikhah dang khat a version tuam.

examples.english: This is the revised edition of the dictionary.
examples.zomi: Hih pen dictionary a kipuahkik edition ahi hi.

examples.english: The first edition was published ten years ago.
examples.zomi: Edition masapen kum sawm beisa in kikhah hi.

senses.usage_en: A new edition normally contains meaningful changes. A reprint may simply produce more copies without changing the content.
senses.usage_zomi: Edition thak in thu kikhelna thupi nei zel hi. Reprint ahihleh thu kikhello in copy tamzaw kisuah ziau thei hi.

senses.heading: One particular issue of a newspaper or program
senses.definition_en: One issue or broadcast of a newspaper, magazine, news program, or similar publication.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thuthang laibu, magazine, thuthang program, ahih keileh lai kikhah khat a ni ahih keileh hun tuam suahna.

examples.english: The story appeared in today’s edition.
examples.zomi: Tangthu pen tuni edition sungah om hi.

examples.english: The station broadcast a special edition of the news.
examples.zomi: Station in thuthang special edition khah hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, edition refers to a specific issue or broadcast, not a permanently revised version.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah edition in suahna ahih keileh broadcast khat kawk a, laibu version a kipuah tawntung kawklo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who selects, corrects, organizes, and prepares written, audio, or visual material for publication or broadcast.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laigelh, aw, ahih keileh lim thu teel, khialhna puah, seh, leh kikhahna dingin bawl mi.

examples.english: The editor corrected several errors in the article.
examples.zomi: Editor in laigelh sunga khialhna pawlkhat puah hi.

examples.english: She works as a video editor.
examples.zomi: Ama video puah mi in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: An editor improves and prepares material. An author or writer creates the original written content.
senses.usage_zomi: Editor in thu hoihzaw sak leh kikhahna dingin puah hi. Author ahih keileh writer in laigelh masa piangsak hi.

senses.heading: To teach someone through schooling or organized learning
senses.definition_en: To teach someone, especially through formal schooling or a planned course of learning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pilna pia, a diakin sang sinna ahih keileh a geelkhawl kisinna tawh hilh.

examples.english: Schools educate children for life and work.
examples.zomi: Sangte in naupangte nuntakna leh nasepna dingin pilna pia hi.

examples.english: Her parents worked hard to educate their children.
examples.zomi: A nu leh pa in a tate uh pilna piakna dingin hahkat takin nasem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Educate is broader than teaching one fact. It usually describes developing knowledge, skills, judgment, or character over time.
senses.usage_zomi: Educate in thu khatbek hilh sangin a huamzai zaw hi. Hun tawh theihna, siamna, ngaihsut theihna leh gamtatna khang sak cihna ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: To give information and increase understanding
senses.definition_en: To provide facts or explanations that help people understand an issue.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu khat mite telzaw sak dingin thu maan leh hilhcian na pia.

examples.english: The campaign educates the public about diabetes prevention.
examples.zomi: Kampai in mipite tungah diabetes khamna thu hilh hi.

examples.english: People should educate themselves before making a decision.
examples.zomi: Mite khensatna a bawl uh ma in thu sinna ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern is often educate someone about/on something.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan ngeina pen educate someone about/on something ahi hi.

senses.heading: Having received a good formal education
senses.definition_en: Having gained substantial knowledge and training through school, college, or university.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pilna nei; sang pilna kicing nei
senses.explanation_zomi: Sang, college, ahih keileh university pan pilna leh kisinsakna kicing ngah.

examples.english: She is a highly educated professional.
examples.zomi: Ama pen pilna sang nei siamsa khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The community needs more educated young leaders.
examples.zomi: Khawlsung in khangno makai pilna nei tamzaw kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Being educated usually refers to learning and training, not automatically to wisdom, kindness, or good judgment.
senses.usage_zomi: Educated in pilna leh kisinsakna nei cihna ahi hi. Pilna, hehpihna, ahih keileh khensatna hoih a neih teitei cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Based on knowledge and careful judgment
senses.definition_en: Formed after gaining relevant information and considering it carefully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kisamte sin leh pilvang takin ngaihsun khit ciangin a kibawl.

examples.english: Read the report before making an educated decision.
examples.zomi: Thu theihna tawh khensatna na bawl ma in report sim in.

examples.english: His estimate was an educated guess based on experience.
examples.zomi: A zah ngaihsutna pen muhkhakna tungah kinga ngaihsutna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: An educated guess is not random; it uses available knowledge even though the answer is not certain.
senses.usage_zomi: Educated guess pen ngaihsut mawk hilo hi. Dawnna kicianlo napi theihsa thu tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: Teaching and learning through school or training
senses.definition_en: The process of teaching, learning, and developing knowledge and skills, especially through schools or organized programs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Theihna leh siamna khang sak dingin sang ahih keileh a geelkhawl program tungtawnin hilhna leh kisinna kalsuan.

examples.english: Every child should have access to education.
examples.zomi: Naupang khempeuh pilna ngahthei ding uh hi.

examples.english: She completed her education in the United States.
examples.zomi: Ama in a pilna United States ah zo hi.

senses.usage_en: Education is normally uncountable when referring generally to teaching and learning.
senses.usage_zomi: Hilhna leh kisinna a huam in gen ciangin education pen simsawm theihloh min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Knowledge and development gained through learning
senses.definition_en: The knowledge, skills, judgment, and development a person gains from learning and experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisinna leh muhkhakna pan mi khat in a ngah theihna, siamna, ngaihsut theihna leh khanna.

examples.english: A good education can create new opportunities.
examples.zomi: Pilna hoih in hunhoih thak piangsak thei hi.

examples.english: Travel can be an important part of a person’s education.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna pen mi khat pilna khen thupi khat ahi thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Education can come from formal schooling, personal study, work, travel, and life experience.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna pen sang sinna, mimal kisinna, nasep, khualzinna leh nuntakna muhkhakna pan hong piang thei hi.

senses.heading: Connected with education
senses.definition_en: Related to teaching, learning, schools, or other forms of education.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pilna tawh kisai; kisinna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Hilhna, kisinna, sang, ahih keileh pilna nam dang tawh kisai.

examples.english: The government introduced a new educational policy.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in pilna thukhun thak khat kipan sak hi.

examples.english: The program provides educational opportunities for adults.
examples.zomi: Program in mipicingte tungah pilna hunhoih pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense simply means connected with education; it does not necessarily mean something is enjoyable or effective.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in pilna tawh kisai cihna bek ahi a, lungluthuai ahih keileh tangtun taktak cihna hituanlo hi.

senses.heading: Providing useful knowledge or learning
senses.definition_en: Helping someone learn useful facts, ideas, or skills.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat thu, ngaihsutna, ahih keileh siamna phatuam sin theisak.

examples.english: The documentary was both interesting and educational.
examples.zomi: Documentary pen lungluthuai a, pilna zong pia hi.

examples.english: These games are designed to be educational.
examples.zomi: Hih kimawlna-te pilna pia dingin kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Something educational teaches or informs. It may exist inside or outside a formal school.
senses.usage_zomi: Na educational khat in hilh ahih keileh thu theisak hi. Formal sang sung ahih keileh pualam ah zong om thei hi.

senses.heading: A change or result caused by something
senses.definition_en: A result or change produced by an action, event, condition, or substance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, thu piang, dinmun, ahih keileh zatui khat in a piangsak result leh kikhelna.

examples.english: Regular exercise has a positive effect on health.
examples.zomi: Pumpi pattah tawntung in cidamna tungah sukna hoih nei hi.

examples.english: The medicine may cause side effects.
examples.zomi: Si in sukna dangte piangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use effect on someone or something: the effect of stress on health. Effect is normally a noun; affect is normally a verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Effect on someone or something ci in kizang hi: the effect of stress on health. Effect pen noun ahi zel a, affect pen verb ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: A particular appearance or impression
senses.definition_en: A visual, sound, emotional, or artistic impression created by something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat in a piangsak muhna, aw, lungsim sukna, ahih keileh kunst kilatdan.

examples.english: The lighting created a dramatic effect.
examples.zomi: Khuavak in kilakdan lamdang piangsak hi.

examples.english: The film uses special visual effects.
examples.zomi: Film in special visual effects zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In film and design, an effect may be intentionally created to influence what people see, hear, or feel.
senses.usage_zomi: Film leh design ah effect pen mite’ muh, zak, ahih keileh lungsim sukna a suk dingin a sepkholh in kibawl thei hi.

senses.heading: Operation or legal force
senses.definition_en: The state of being active, operating, or legally valid.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasem lai, kizang lai, ahih keileh thukham in vang nei lai dinmun.

examples.english: The new law takes effect next month.
examples.zomi: Thukham thak kha kik ciangin kizang kipan ding hi.

examples.english: The medicine began to take effect after an hour.
examples.zomi: Nai khat khit ciangin si hong nasep kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Take effect means beginning to produce a result or beginning to operate officially.
senses.usage_zomi: Take effect in result piangsak kipan ahih keileh official takin kizang kipan cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Producing the intended result
senses.definition_en: Successful in producing the result that was intended.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tangtung; result hoih pia; nasep hoih
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimsa result a piangsak in tangtun.

examples.english: Regular exercise is an effective way to improve health.
examples.zomi: Pumpi pattah tawntung pen cidamna hoihsakna lampi tangtung khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The new treatment was effective in reducing pain.
examples.zomi: Cidamna kepna thak in natna tawm sakna ah tangtung hi.

senses.usage_en: Effective means producing the desired result. Efficient means producing a result without wasting time, money, or resources.
senses.usage_zomi: Effective in result deihsa piangsak cihna ahi hi. Efficient in hun, sum, leh vante mawk zatlo in result piangsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Officially operating or legally valid
senses.definition_en: Beginning to operate or having legal force from a particular time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat pan official takin kizang ahih keileh thukham in vang nei.

examples.english: The new policy becomes effective next month.
examples.zomi: Thukhun thak kha kik ciangin kizang kipan ding hi.

examples.english: The change is effective immediately.
examples.zomi: Kikhelna pen tu mahmah in kizang kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: An effective date is the date on which a rule, agreement, or change begins to operate.
senses.usage_zomi: Effective date pen thukhun, kithukimna, ahih keileh kikhelna khat kizang kipat ni ahi hi.

senses.heading: In a way that produces the intended result
senses.definition_en: Successfully and in a way that achieves the intended purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna tangtun sak in result hoih piangsak takin.

examples.english: The team worked effectively under pressure.
examples.zomi: Sawlna khauh nuai ah pawl tangtung takin nasem hi.

examples.english: Teachers must communicate effectively with students.
examples.zomi: Siate sangnaupangte tawh kitel takin kizom ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Effectively concerns successful results. Efficiently emphasizes avoiding waste while achieving those results.
senses.usage_zomi: Effectively in result a tangtun na bulphuh hi. Efficiently in result tangtun kawmkal ah hun leh van mawk zatlohna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: In practical reality, though not necessarily officially
senses.definition_en: In actual practice or result, even if the situation is not officially described that way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Official min a tua bang hilo napi, a taktak gamtat leh result ah tua bangin.

examples.english: Without electricity, the office was effectively closed.
examples.zomi: Meikhu a omloh manin office pen a taktak in kikhak bang ahi hi.

examples.english: The decision effectively ended the program.
examples.zomi: Khensatna in program pen a taktak in tawpsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is useful when the practical result matters more than the official label.
senses.usage_zomi: Official min sangin a taktak result thupi zaw ciangin hih khiatna kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Working well and producing good results without wasting time, energy, money, or materials.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasep siam; mawk zatlo; tangtung leh khemkhat
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, tha, sum, ahih keileh vante mawk zatlo in nasep hoih leh result hoih piangsak.

examples.english: The new system is faster and more efficient.
examples.zomi: System thak manlangzaw a, van mawk zatlo in nasem hoihzaw hi.

examples.english: This machine is energy-efficient.
examples.zomi: Hih machine in tha tawm bek zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Something may be effective because it works, but not efficient if it wastes too much time or money.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat in result a piangsak leh effective ahi thei hi. Ahih hang hun ahih keileh sum a mawk zatlua leh efficient hilo hi.

senses.heading: Physical or mental energy used to do something
senses.definition_en: The physical or mental energy needed to perform an action or achieve something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep khat bawl ahih keileh ngiimna khat tangtun dingin a kizang pumpi tha leh lungsim tha.

examples.english: Learning a new language requires effort.
examples.zomi: Pau thak khat sinna in hanciamna kisam hi.

examples.english: She made a great effort to finish the work on time.
examples.zomi: Nasep hun maan in zo dingin hanciam mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: English normally says make an effort, not do an effort.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah make an effort ci in kizang a, do an effort ci in kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: An organized attempt
senses.definition_en: A planned attempt by one person or a group to achieve a particular result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh pawl khat in result tuam khat ngah dingin a geelkhawl hanciamna.

examples.english: The rescue effort continued through the night.
examples.zomi: Hotkhiatna hanciamna zan a vekpi in kizom hi.

examples.english: The project succeeded through a community effort.
examples.zomi: Khawlsung mite hanciamkhopna tawh geelna gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, effort can refer to a whole campaign or coordinated activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah effort in kampai ahih keileh a kizom geelkhawl nasep khempeuh kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: An object produced by a bird from which a young bird may develop
senses.definition_en: A round or oval object laid by a female bird, containing a developing young bird or food material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vasa nu in a ci, atui, tua sung pan vasa no hong piangthei ahih keileh annek in a kizang tui.

examples.english: The hen laid three eggs.
examples.zomi: Akpi in tui thum tui hi.

examples.english: The bird is sitting on its eggs.
examples.zomi: Vasa in a tui-te tungah tu hi.

senses.usage_en: A chicken’s egg used as food is commonly called simply an egg.
senses.usage_zomi: Annek ding aktui pen English ah an egg ci ziau in kigen zel hi.

senses.heading: An egg used as food
senses.definition_en: A bird’s egg, especially a chicken’s egg, prepared or used as food.
senses.explanation_zomi: Annek dingin a kihuansa ahih keileh an dang bawlna ah a kizang vasa tui, a diakin aktui.

examples.english: I ate two boiled eggs for breakfast.
examples.zomi: Zingsang an in aktui huan taang nih ne ing.

examples.english: Add one egg to the mixture.
examples.zomi: Tua kigawm an sungah aktui khat behlap in.

senses.usage_en: Eggs are countable: one egg; two eggs. When used as an ingredient, egg can describe the substance generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Aktuite pen atang kisim theih hi: aktui tangkhat; aktui tangnih. An neek ding huanna ah a kizat ciangin aktui kihel an te a huam in kigen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 8.
senses.explanation_zomi: Number 8; sagih khit leh kua ma a number.

common_phrases.zomi: mi ahih keileh na giat pawl

examples.english: Eight is an even number.
examples.zomi: Giat pen number khen kicing khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The bus arrives at eight.
examples.zomi: Bus nai giat ciangin hong tung hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse eight /eɪt/ with ate /eɪt/, the past tense of eat. They sound the same but have different meanings and spellings.
senses.usage_zomi: Eight /eɪt/ pen eat a past tense ate /eɪt/ tawh helkhawm loh ding hi. A ging kibang napi spelling leh khiatna kibanglo hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 18.
senses.explanation_zomi: Number 18; sawmlehgiat.

examples.english: Eighteen is two more than sixteen.
examples.zomi: Sawmlehgiat pen sawmlehguk sangin nih tamzaw hi.

examples.english: She turned eighteen last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in kum sawmlehgiat pha hi.

senses.usage_en: The main stress is on -teen: eigh-TEEN. This helps distinguish it from eighty, whose stress is on the first syllable.
senses.usage_zomi: Aw ngaihna pen -teen tungah om hi: eigh-TEEN. Hih in a syllable masa tunga aw ngai eighty tawh khen hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 80.
senses.explanation_zomi: Number 80; sawmgiat.

examples.english: Eighty percent of the students completed the course.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte za ah sawmgiat in course zo uh hi.

examples.english: Her grandfather is eighty.
examples.zomi: A pupapa kum sawmgiat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Eighty has no second t in its spelling. Write eighty, not eightty.
senses.usage_zomi: Eighty spelling ah t nih omlo hi. Eighty ci in kigelh a, eightty ci in kigelh lo hi.

senses.heading: One or the other of two
senses.definition_en: One of two people or things, without specifying which one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na nih lakah khat, bang khat cih kicianlo.

examples.english: You may choose either colour.
examples.zomi: Kiluam tegel lakah khatpeuh na teel thei hi.

examples.english: Either answer is acceptable.
examples.zomi: Dawnna tegel lakah khatpeuh pawmtheih hi.

senses.usage_en: Either is followed by a singular noun: either option. Use either of before a plural pronoun or determiner phrase: either of them; either of the books.
senses.usage_zomi: Either khit ah singular noun om hi: either option. Plural pronoun ahih keileh determiner phrase ma ah either of kizang hi: either of them; either of the books.

senses.heading: Each of two sides or ends
senses.definition_en: Each one of two sides, ends, or positions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pangnih, mongnih, ahih keileh panmun nih a khat ciat.

examples.english: Trees were planted on either side of the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi pangnih ah singkung kiphut hi.

examples.english: There is a door at either end of the hall.
examples.zomi: Innpi mongnih ah kongkhak khat ciat om hi.

senses.usage_en: In expressions such as on either side, either may mean both sides considered separately.
senses.usage_zomi: On either side bang zatdan ah either in pangnih a khat ciat, a vekpi in tegel kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to or describing people who are old, especially those in later life.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum upa, a diakin nuntakna a nunung lam a om mite tawh kisai.

examples.english: The program provides meals for elderly residents.
examples.zomi: Program in khua sunga upate tungah annek pia hi.

examples.english: She cares for her elderly mother.
examples.zomi: Ama in a nu upa kem hi.

senses.usage_en: Elderly can sound impersonal if used as a label. Older person or older adult is often more respectful in ordinary communication. Avoid using the elderly when individuals can be named more directly.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi min bangin elderly zat leh mimal donloh bangin ging thei hi. Nisim kizopna ah older person ahih keileh older adult zahtakhuai zaw thei hi. Mi-te kician takin gen theih ciangin the elderly zat pelh hoih hi.

senses.heading: To choose someone for an official position by voting
senses.definition_en: To select a person for a public or organizational position through a vote.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi ahih keileh pawl in vote pia in official panmun khat ding mi teel.

examples.english: Citizens elect a president every four years.
examples.zomi: Gam mite in kum li simin president teel uh hi.

examples.english: She was elected chair of the committee.
examples.zomi: Ama committee makai in kiteel hi.

senses.usage_en: The voters elect a person; the successful person is elected. Use elect someone to a position or elect someone as chair.
senses.usage_zomi: Vote piate in mi khat elect uh a, gualzopa is elected hi. Elect someone to a position ahih keileh elect someone as chair ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: To choose to do something formally
senses.definition_en: To make a formal or deliberate choice, especially among legal, financial, or administrative options.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham, sumlehpai, ahih keileh ukna lam lampi tuamtuam lakah a lungsim takpi tawh formal takin teel.

examples.english: Employees may elect to receive the payment monthly.
examples.zomi: Nasemte sum kha simin ngah ding teel thei uh hi.

examples.english: She elected not to continue with the case.
examples.zomi: Ama in thukhenna thu zom nawnlo ding teel hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal pattern is elect to do something. In everyday speech, choose is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal zatdan pen elect to do something ahi hi. Nisim kampau ah choose kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: An organized process in which people vote to choose a person for office or decide a public question.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite vote pia in official panmun ding mi teel ahih keileh mipite thu khat khensatna ding a geelkhawl teelna.

examples.english: The country will hold an election next year.
examples.zomi: Gam in kumkik in teelna nei ding hi.

examples.english: She won the election by a narrow margin.
examples.zomi: Ama vote tawmno kilamdanna tawh teelna ah gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: Candidates stand/run in an election, voters vote in an election, and the winner is elected.
senses.usage_zomi: Kidem mite teelna ah stand/run uh a, vote piate teelna ah vote uh a, gualzopa is elected hi.

senses.heading: Powered by electricity
senses.definition_en: Using electricity as its source of power.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tha ngahna dingin meikhu zang.

examples.english: They bought an electric car.
examples.zomi: Electric mawtaw khat lei uh hi.

examples.english: The machine has an electric motor.
examples.zomi: Machine in electric motor nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Electric commonly describes a device that uses, produces, or is powered by electricity.
senses.usage_zomi: Electric in meikhu a zang, a piangsak, ahih keileh meikhu tawh tha a ngah van hilhcian zel hi.

senses.heading: Causing excitement
senses.definition_en: Extremely exciting or full of powerful energy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunglawngsak mahmah ahih keileh tha khauh tawh kidim.

examples.english: The atmosphere in the stadium was electric.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna mun sunga dinmun lunglawnghuai mahmah hi.

examples.english: She gave an electric performance.
examples.zomi: Ama in limlakna tha kidim pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal figurative sense describes strong excitement, not actual electrical power.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim limpuak khiatna in lunglawngna khauh kawk a, meikhu tha taktak kawklo hi.

senses.definition_en: Connected with electricity, its production, wiring, systems, or scientific study.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meikhu, meikhu piansakna, wire, system, ahih keileh a science tawh kisai.

examples.english: An electrical fault caused the fire.
examples.zomi: Meikhu system khialhna in mei kang sak hi.

examples.english: The building needs new electrical wiring.
examples.zomi: Inn in meikhu wire thak kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Electric usually describes a specific powered object, such as an electric car. Electrical more often describes systems, work, faults, or the general field.
senses.usage_zomi: Electric in electric car bang meikhu a zang van kician hilhcian zel hi. Electrical in system, nasep, khialhna, ahih keileh meikhu pilna khen a huamzai in hilhcian hi.

senses.definition_en: A form of energy carried by electric charge and used to provide light, heat, and power.
senses.explanation_zomi: Electric charge in a puak a, khuavak, a lum leh machine tha piakna dingin a kizang tha nam khat.

examples.english: The village now has electricity.
examples.zomi: Khua in tu in meikhu nei hi.

examples.english: Solar panels generate electricity from sunlight.
examples.zomi: Solar panel-te in ni khuavak pan meikhu tha piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Electricity is normally uncountable. Say some electricity or a supply of electricity, not an electricity.
senses.usage_zomi: Electricity pen simsawm theihloh min ahi hi. Some electricity ahih keileh a supply of electricity kici a, an electricity kici lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Using electronic circuits or digital technology to process, store, or communicate information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khutzat, koih, ahih keileh sawlna dingin electronic circuit ahih keileh digital technology zang.

examples.english: The office stores its records electronically.
examples.zomi: Office in a ciaptehna-te electronic system sungah koih hi.

examples.english: Electronic payments are becoming more common.
examples.zomi: Electronic sum piakna hong kizang tam semsem hi.

senses.usage_en: Electrical concerns electricity generally; electronic usually concerns circuits, computers, communication, or information processing.
senses.usage_zomi: Electrical in meikhu a huam in kawk hi. Electronic in circuit, computer, kizopna, ahih keileh thu khutzatna kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: An important part of something
senses.definition_en: One part or feature that combines with others to form a complete system, plan, situation, or work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khen dangte tawh kigawm in system, geelna, dinmun, ahih keileh nasep kicing khat a bawl khen.

examples.english: Trust is an essential element of a strong relationship.
examples.zomi: Muanna pen kizopna khauh khat a khen kisam ahi hi.

examples.english: The plan contains several important elements.
examples.zomi: Geelna sungah khen thupi pawlkhat om hi.

senses.usage_en: An element is one component of a larger whole.
senses.usage_zomi: Element pen na lianzaw khat a bawl khen khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: A basic chemical substance
senses.definition_en: A pure chemical substance made of only one type of atom.
senses.zomi_equivalents: chemical element; atom nam khat zatui
