senses.explanation_zomi: Atom nam khatbek tawh a kibawl chemical zatui siangtho.

examples.english: Oxygen is a chemical element.
examples.zomi: Oxygen pen chemical element khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The periodic table lists all known elements.
examples.zomi: Periodic table in element kithei khempeuh a list hi.

senses.usage_en: A chemical element cannot be separated into simpler substances by ordinary chemical methods.
senses.usage_zomi: Chemical element pen ordinary chemical bawldan tawh zatui baihlamzaw in khenkhia theilo hi.

senses.heading: A small amount of a quality or condition
senses.definition_en: A slight amount of a particular quality, feeling, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pianzia, lungsim sukna, ahih keileh dinmun khat a tawmno.

examples.english: There is an element of truth in his statement.
examples.zomi: A kammal sungah thu maan tawmno om hi.

examples.english: The plan includes an element of risk.
examples.zomi: Geelna sungah lauhuaina tawmno om hi.

senses.usage_en: The phrase an element of often means that a quality is present to some degree.
senses.usage_zomi: An element of in pianzia khat dinmun khat dong a om cihna ahi zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A very large land animal with thick grey skin, large ears, and a long trunk.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vun tau, bil lian leh nakpi sau nei leitang ganhing lian mahmah.

examples.english: Elephants use their trunks to pick up food and water.
examples.zomi: Saite in an leh tui lakna dingin a nakpi uh zang uh hi.

examples.english: A herd of elephants crossed the road.
examples.zomi: Sai hon khat lampi kantan hi.

senses.usage_en: The long nose of an elephant is called a trunk, not simply a nose.
senses.usage_zomi: Sai nakpi sau pen English ah trunk kici a, nose ci ziau in kici lo hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 11.
senses.explanation_zomi: Number 11; sawmleh khat.

common_phrases.zomi: mi ahih keileh na sawmleh khat pawl

examples.english: Eleven is one more than ten.
examples.zomi: Sawmleh khat pen sawm sangin khat tamzaw hi.

examples.english: The meeting begins at eleven.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna nai sawmleh khat ciangin kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Eleven may function as a number before a plural noun: eleven students. As a noun, it names the number itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Eleven pen plural noun ma ah number in kizang thei hi: eleven students. Noun in kizang ciangin number mahmah kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: In addition to, instead of, or different from the person or thing already mentioned.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigensa behlap in, a aiawh in, ahih keileh a kigensa tawh a kibanglo in.

examples.english: Would you like anything else?
examples.zomi: Na dang khatpeuh na deih lai hiam?

examples.english: Someone else has already completed the work.
examples.zomi: Mi dang khat in nasep zo khin hi.

senses.usage_en: Else normally follows indefinite pronouns and question words: someone else, nothing else, where else. It does not normally come before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Else pen indefinite pronoun leh question word khit ah om zel hi: someone else, nothing else, where else. Noun ma ah om ngeilo hi.

senses.definition_en: In, at, or to another place.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun dang ah; mun dang lamah
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun dang ah ahih keileh mun dang lamah.

examples.english: The product is cheaper elsewhere.
examples.zomi: Van pen mun dang ah man tawmzaw hi.

examples.english: If this office cannot help, try elsewhere.
examples.zomi: Hih office in hong huh theilo leh mun dang ah hanciam in.

senses.usage_en: Elsewhere already means “in another place,” so do not normally say in elsewhere.
senses.usage_zomi: Elsewhere in “mun dang ah” cihna nei khin ahih manin, ngeina in in elsewhere kici lo hi.

senses.heading: A message sent electronically
senses.definition_en: A written message sent from one electronic account to another through the internet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Internet tungtawnin electronic account khat pan account dang ah a kisawl laikhak.

examples.english: I sent you an email this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsangin email khat kong sawl hi.

examples.english: Please reply to my email by Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ciangtan ka email hong dawng in.

senses.usage_en: A particular message is countable: an email; three emails.
senses.usage_zomi: Email thupuak khat ciat pen simsawm theih hi: an email; three emails.

senses.heading: The system used for sending electronic messages
senses.definition_en: The electronic communication system used to send and receive messages over the internet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Internet tungtawnin thupuak sawl leh ngahna ding electronic kizopna system.

examples.english: You can contact the office by email.
examples.zomi: Office pen email tawh na hopih thei hi.

examples.english: Enter your email address in the form.
examples.zomi: Form sungah na email address gelh in.

senses.usage_en: When referring to the communication method generally, email is often uncountable: Send it by email.
senses.usage_zomi: Kizopna lampi a huam in kawk ciangin email pen simsawm theihloh min ahi zel hi: Send it by email.

senses.definition_en: Feeling uncomfortable, ashamed, or self-conscious because of a mistake, awkward situation, or unwanted attention.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna, dinmun zahmawhhuai, ahih keileh mite’ etna deihloh manin maizum leh omdan theilo in om.

examples.english: I felt embarrassed when I forgot her name.
examples.zomi: A min ka mangngilh ciangin ka maizum hi.

examples.english: He was embarrassed by the unwanted attention.
examples.zomi: Mite’ etna a deihloh manin maizum hi.

senses.usage_en: A person feels embarrassed. A situation, action, or mistake is embarrassing.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat pen embarrassed hi. Dinmun, gamtatna, ahih keileh khialhna khat pen embarrassing ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Causing someone to feel uncomfortable, ashamed, or self-conscious.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat maizum, zahmawh, ahih keileh omdan theilo sak.

examples.english: She made an embarrassing mistake during the speech.
examples.zomi: Thugen laitak in khialhna maizumhuai khat bawl hi.

examples.english: It was embarrassing to arrive at the wrong meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna maanlo ah a tun pen maizumhuai hi.

senses.usage_en: Embarrassing describes the cause of the feeling. Do not say I am embarrassing when you mean that you feel ashamed; say I am embarrassed.
senses.usage_zomi: Embarrassing in maizumna a piangsak na hilhcian hi. Nangmah maizum na kisa leh I am embarrassing ci kei in; I am embarrassed ci in.

senses.heading: To come out and become visible
senses.definition_en: To come out from a hidden, enclosed, or less visible place.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kiseel, a kikhaak, ahih keileh kimuh haksa mun pan hong paikhia in hong kilang.

examples.english: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
examples.zomi: Ni meii nung pan hong kilang hi.

examples.english: A man emerged from the building.
examples.zomi: Pasal khat inn sung pan hong paikhia hi.

senses.usage_en: Emerge is intransitive. Say something emerged, not someone emerged something.
senses.usage_zomi: Emerge pen intransitive verb ahi hi. Something emerged kici a, someone emerged something kici lo hi.

senses.heading: To become known or important
senses.definition_en: To become known, clear, successful, or important after a period of development.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hong kithei; hong kilang; hong thupi
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat khit ciangin hong kithei, hong kician, hong gualzo, ahih keileh hong thupi.

examples.english: New evidence emerged during the investigation.
examples.zomi: Thu kanna sungin teci thak hong kilang hi.

examples.english: She emerged as the strongest candidate.
examples.zomi: Ama pen teel ding mi thahatpen in hong kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern emerge as introduces a new role or status: He emerged as a national leader.
senses.usage_zomi: Panmun ahih keileh dinmun thak genna dingin emerge as kizang hi: He emerged as a national leader.

senses.heading: To recover from a difficult period
senses.definition_en: To come through and leave a difficult situation or period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna ahih keileh hun hoihlo khat kantan in hong suahta.

examples.english: The company emerged from the crisis in a stronger position.
examples.zomi: Company pen haksatna pan dinmun thahatzaw tawh hong suahta hi.

examples.english: The community is slowly emerging from the disaster.
examples.zomi: Khawlsung pen siatna pan tawm tawm in hong suahta hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense treats a difficult period as a place from which someone comes out.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak khiatna in haksat hun pen mi khat a paikhia theihna mun bangin tehkak hi.

senses.definition_en: A sudden, serious, or dangerous situation that requires immediate action.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kin ngai dinmun; thu lauhuai thakhatthu
senses.explanation_zomi: Thakhatthu in a piang, a nasia, ahih keileh a lauhuai a, tu mahmah in khutzat kisam dinmun.

examples.english: Call emergency services if someone cannot breathe.
examples.zomi: Mi khat hu sangtheilo leh kin ngai huhna nasep hopih in.

examples.english: The hospital prepared for the emergency.
examples.zomi: Zato inn in kin ngai dinmun dingin kigingsa hi.

senses.usage_en: An emergency needs prompt action. A problem may be serious without requiring an immediate emergency response.
senses.usage_zomi: Emergency in manlang takin khutzat kisam hi. Buaina khat nasia thei napi, tu mahmah a kin ngai huhna kisamlo thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A strong feeling such as happiness, sadness, anger, fear, or love.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungdamna, dahna, hehna, launa, itna bang lungsim sukna.

examples.english: Her voice was filled with emotion.
examples.zomi: A aw lungsim sukna tawh kidim hi.

examples.english: It is healthy to express emotions appropriately.
examples.zomi: Lungsim sukna mun leh hun tawh kituak in lak pen cidamna ding hoih hi.

senses.usage_en: Emotion may be countable when referring to particular feelings and uncountable when referring generally to strong feeling.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungsim sukna khat ciat a kawk ciangin emotion pen simsawm theih hi. Lungsim sukna a huam in gen ciangin simsawm theihloh min ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Connected with feelings
senses.definition_en: Relating to feelings rather than only to facts, reason, or physical needs.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim sukna tawh kisai; lungsim lam
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu maan, ngaihsutna, ahih keileh pumpi kisapna bek hilo in lungsim sukna tawh kisai.

examples.english: Children need both physical and emotional support.
examples.zomi: Naupangte pumpi leh lungsim lam panpihna tegel kisam uh hi.

examples.english: The experience had a strong emotional effect on her.
examples.zomi: Tua muhkhakna in a lungsim nasatak in suk hi.

senses.usage_en: Emotional does not always mean irrational. It can simply mean connected with feelings.
senses.usage_zomi: Emotional in ngaihsutna omlo cihna tawntung hilo hi. Lungsim sukna tawh kizom cihna zong ahi hi.

senses.heading: Showing strong feelings
senses.definition_en: Showing or experiencing strong feelings, especially sadness, happiness, or love.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim sukna khauh; lungsim sukna lak
senses.explanation_zomi: Dahna, lungdamna, itna, ahih keileh lungsim sukna dang khauh takin lak ahih keileh thuak.

examples.english: He became emotional while speaking about his family.
examples.zomi: A innkuan thu a gen laitak in a lungsim sukna hong khauh hi.

examples.english: It was an emotional reunion.
examples.zomi: Kimuhkikna pen lungsim suk hun khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling someone emotional may sound critical if it suggests that the person cannot control feelings. Context and tone matter.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat emotional kicih in a lungsim sukna uk theilo ci in mawhsak bangin ging thei hi. A kizop thu leh awpuak thupi hi.

senses.heading: Special importance or attention
senses.definition_en: Special importance, attention, or value given to something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tungah a tuamdiak in thupisakna, donkholhna, ahih keileh manphatsakna.

examples.english: The program places strong emphasis on practical skills.
examples.zomi: Program in a taktak a kizang siamna thupisak mahmah hi.

examples.english: The teacher put emphasis on clear writing.
examples.zomi: Sia in laigelh kician thupisak hi.

senses.usage_en: The common pattern is place/put emphasis on something.
senses.usage_zomi: A zatdan ngeina pen place/put emphasis on something ahi hi.

senses.heading: Extra force given to a word or sound
senses.definition_en: Additional force or stress used when saying a word, phrase, or syllable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, kammal pawl, ahih keileh syllable khat pau ciangin aw khauhzaw in piakna.

examples.english: Put the emphasis on the first syllable.
examples.zomi: Syllable masapen tungah aw ngaihna koih in.

examples.english: She repeated the final words for emphasis.
examples.zomi: Thu khauh sakna dingin kammal nunungte genkik hi.

senses.usage_en: Changing the emphasis can change the meaning or emotional force of a sentence.
senses.usage_zomi: Aw ngaihna kikhel leh sentence a khiatna ahih keileh lungsim sukna khauhzah kikhel thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To give special importance or attention to something, or make it more noticeable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a tuamdiak in thupisak, don, ahih keileh kicianzaw in kilangsak.

examples.english: The doctor emphasized the importance of regular exercise.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in pumpi pattah tawntung a thupina bulphuh hi.

examples.english: The report emphasizes the need for better training.
examples.zomi: Report in kisinsakna hoihzaw kisap cih thupisak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use emphasize something, without on: emphasize safety. The noun uses emphasis on safety.
senses.usage_zomi: Emphasize something ci in on omlo in kizang hi: emphasize safety. Noun ah emphasis on safety ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: To give someone paid work
senses.definition_en: To pay someone to work for a person, company, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat sum tawh nasep pia ahih keileh sepsak.

examples.english: The company employs five hundred people.
examples.zomi: Company in mi zanga sepsak hi.

examples.english: She is employed by the city government.
examples.zomi: Ama khuapi kumpi kiangah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: The organization employs a worker. The worker is employed by the organization.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawlpi in nasempa employs hi. Nasempa pen tua pawlpi kiangah is employed by hi.

senses.heading: To use a method, skill, or object
senses.definition_en: To use a method, technique, skill, or tool for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna khat dingin bawldan, siamna, ahih keileh vanzat khat zang.

examples.english: The researchers employed several methods.
examples.zomi: Kholmite in bawldan tuamtuam zang uh hi.

examples.english: The system employs modern technology.
examples.zomi: System in tuhun technology zang hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense of employ means use. It does not involve hiring a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal employ in zang cihna ahi a, mi khat sepsak cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who is paid to work for a person, company, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, company, ahih keileh pawlpi khat kiangah thaman tawh nasem mi.

examples.english: Every employee must complete the training.
examples.zomi: Nasempa khempeuh kisinsakna zo ding uh hi.

examples.english: The company provides health insurance for its employees.
examples.zomi: Company in a nasemte tungah cidamna insurance pia hi.

senses.usage_en: An employee works for an employer. Do not confuse it with employer, the person or organization providing the job.
senses.usage_zomi: Employee pen employer kiangah nasem hi. Nasep a pia mi ahih keileh pawlpi employer tawh helkhawm loh ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A person, company, or organization that pays people to work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite thaman tawh sepsak mi, company, ahih keileh pawlpi.

examples.english: The city is one of the region’s largest employers.
examples.zomi: Khuapi pen tua gamkee sunga nasem tampi sepsak pawl lianpen lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Employers must provide a safe workplace.
examples.zomi: Nasep piate in nasepna mun bit pia ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The employer provides and pays for the job; the employee performs the work.
senses.usage_zomi: Employer in nasep pia a, thaman pia hi; employee in nasep sem hi.

senses.heading: Paid work
senses.definition_en: Work that a person does in return for payment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in thaman ngahna ding a sem nasep.

examples.english: She found employment at a local hospital.
examples.zomi: Ama tua gam zato inn ah nasepna mu hi.

examples.english: The program helps young people find employment.
examples.zomi: Program in khangnote nasepna muhna ding huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Employment is normally uncountable when it means paid work generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Thaman ngah nasepna a huam in gen ciangin employment pen simsawm theihloh min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: The state or level of having jobs
senses.definition_en: The condition of having paid work or the number of people who have jobs.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasep neihna; nasep nei mi zat
senses.explanation_zomi: Thaman ngah nasep neih dinmun ahih keileh nasep nei mi zat.

examples.english: The new factory increased employment in the region.
examples.zomi: Van bawlna thak in tua gamkee sunga nasepna khang sak hi.

examples.english: Employment remained stable during the year.
examples.zomi: Kum sungin nasep neihna dinmun kip hi.

senses.usage_en: Employment means having work; unemployment means being without work while available and seeking it.
senses.usage_zomi: Employment in nasep neihna kawk hi. Unemployment in nasep semthei leh zong lai napi nasep neilo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Containing nothing
senses.definition_en: Having nothing inside.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sungah bangmah omlo.

examples.english: The box was completely empty.
examples.zomi: Bawm sung awng sitset hi.

examples.english: Please return the empty bottles.
examples.zomi: Thawl awngte hong puakik in.

senses.usage_en: Empty describes a container or place with nothing inside. Blank usually describes a surface or space with no writing or information.
senses.usage_zomi: Empty in bawm ahih keileh mun khat sungah bangmah omlo cihna ahi hi. Blank in a mai ah lai ahih keileh thu omlo cihna ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Having no people
senses.definition_en: Having no people present or being without occupants.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi omlo ahih keileh a sungah teng mi omlo.

examples.english: The office was empty when I arrived.
examples.zomi: Ka tun ciangin office ah mi omlo hi.

examples.english: There were several empty seats on the bus.
examples.zomi: Bus sungah mi tulo tokna pawlkhat om hi.

senses.usage_en: A place may be empty even when it contains furniture, if no people are present.
senses.usage_zomi: Inn van om napi mi omlo leh mun khat empty kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Without meaning, value, or sincere feeling
senses.definition_en: Lacking real meaning, value, emotion, or intention.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khiatna omlo; manpha lo; lungsim takpi omlo
senses.explanation_zomi: Khiatna, manphatna, lungsim sukna, ahih keileh ngiimna maan nei lo.

examples.english: The apology sounded like empty words.
examples.zomi: Ngaihdam ngetna pen lungsim takpi omlo kammal bangin ging hi.

examples.english: People no longer believed his empty promises.
examples.zomi: Mite in a kamciam a mawk um nawnlo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes words or actions that lack genuine meaning or intended follow-through.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak khiatna in kammal ahih keileh gamtatna khat a lungsim takpi leh a tangtun ding ngiimna neihlohna kawk hi.

senses.heading: To make something possible
senses.definition_en: To provide the means, ability, or opportunity needed for someone or something to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat na khat bawltheihna ding lampi, siamna, ahih keileh hunhoih pia.

examples.english: The scholarship enabled her to attend college.
examples.zomi: Scholarship in ama college kahthei sak hi.

examples.english: Technology enables people to work from home.
examples.zomi: Technology in mite inn pan nasemthei sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use enable someone to do something: The program enabled students to learn online.
senses.usage_zomi: Enable someone to do something ci in kizang hi: The program enabled students to learn online.

senses.heading: To activate a feature or function
senses.definition_en: To turn on or activate a setting, feature, or function in a device or system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Device ahih keileh system sunga setting, feature, ahih keileh function khat hong nasem sak.

examples.english: Enable notifications in the app settings.
examples.zomi: App setting sungah notification hong nasem sak in.

examples.english: The administrator enabled access for all users.
examples.zomi: Administrator in zang mi khempeuh zattheihna hon hi.

senses.usage_en: In technology, enable means making a function active. Its opposite is disable.
senses.usage_zomi: Technology ah enable in function khat nasem sak cihna ahi hi. A langkhat pen disable ahi hi.

senses.heading: To meet someone unexpectedly
senses.definition_en: To meet or come across someone by chance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lam-etloh in kimuhkhak.

examples.english: I encountered an old friend at the airport.
examples.zomi: Vanleng ngakna mun ah ka lawm lui khat ka muhkhak hi.

examples.english: The hikers encountered another group on the trail.
examples.zomi: Khe tawh khualzinte in lampi ah pawl dang khat muhkhak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Encounter is more formal than meet and often suggests an unexpected meeting.
senses.usage_zomi: Encounter pen meet sangin formal zaw a, lam-etloh kimuhkhakna kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: To experience a problem or situation
senses.definition_en: To experience or face a difficulty, condition, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna, dinmun, ahih keileh thu khat tuak ahih keileh maingat.

examples.english: The project encountered several difficulties.
examples.zomi: Geelna in haksatna pawlkhat tuak hi.

examples.english: Doctors sometimes encounter unusual cases.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te in khatvei khat natna thu lamdang tuak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense is common in reports and academic writing. In everyday speech, face or have may be more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna pen report leh pilna laigelh ah kizang tam hi. Nisim kampau ah face ahih keileh have zat a ngeinazaw thei hi.

senses.heading: To give someone confidence or hope
senses.definition_en: To give someone support, confidence, or hope so that they will continue or attempt something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat zomto, hanciam, ahih keileh na khat bawl ngam dingin panpihna, lungmuanna, leh lam-etna pia.

examples.english: Her teacher encouraged her to continue writing.
examples.zomi: A sia in laigelh zomto ding hanthawn hi.

examples.english: Your support encouraged me during a difficult time.
examples.zomi: Na panpihna in haksat hunin tha hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use encourage someone to do something: They encouraged him to apply.
senses.usage_zomi: Encourage someone to do something ci in kizang hi: They encouraged him to apply.

senses.heading: To promote or make something more likely
senses.definition_en: To support, promote, or create conditions that make an activity or development more likely.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih keileh khanna khat hong piangthei zaw dingin panpih leh dinmun bawl.

examples.english: Lower taxes may encourage business investment.
examples.zomi: Sia tawmzaw in sum nasepna ah sum koihna khang sak thei hi.

examples.english: The teacher encouraged open discussion.
examples.zomi: Sia in lungsim hong thu kikumna panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the object is often an activity, behaviour, or development rather than a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah object pen mi khat sangin gamtatna, bawldan, ahih keileh khanna ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: The final part or time
senses.definition_en: The last part, point, or moment of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a nunungpen khen, mun, ahih keileh hun.

examples.english: The meeting ended at the end of the day.
examples.zomi: Ni tawp lamah kikhopna bei hi.

examples.english: There is a review section at the end of the chapter.
examples.zomi: Chapter tawpna ah enkikna khen om hi.

senses.usage_en: Use at the end for the final point of something. Use in the end to mean finally or after everything has been considered.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a tawpna mun gen leh at the end kizang hi. A tawpna ah result bang hong piang cih gen leh in the end kizang hi.

senses.heading: The farthest part or edge
senses.definition_en: The point where a long object, road, room, or area finishes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van sau, lampi, innkhan, ahih keileh mun khat a tawpna mong.

examples.english: The pharmacy is at the end of the street.
examples.zomi: Sizuakna dawr lampi tawp ah om hi.

examples.english: Hold the rope at both ends.
examples.zomi: Khauli mongnih len in.

senses.usage_en: An end is the last or outermost part. An edge usually refers to the outer boundary along a side or surface.
senses.usage_zomi: End pen a nunungpen ahih keileh a mongpen khen ahi hi. Edge in a pang ahih keileh a mai a pualam gamgi kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: A purpose or desired result
senses.definition_en: A goal, purpose, or result that someone wants to achieve.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a tangtun nop ngiimna ahih keileh result.

examples.english: Money is a means to an end, not the final goal.
examples.zomi: Sum pen ngiimna tangtun nading lampi ahi a, ngiimna nunung hilo hi.

examples.english: To that end, the organization created a new program.
examples.zomi: Tua ngiimna dingin pawl in program thak khat bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense appears in expressions such as means to an end and to that end.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna pen means to an end leh to that end bang kammal ah kizang hi.

senses.heading: The final part of a story, film, or event
senses.definition_en: The way a story, film, performance, or event finishes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu, film, limlakna, ahih keileh thu piang khat a tawp dan.

examples.english: The film has a surprising ending.
examples.zomi: Film in tawpna lamdang nei hi.

examples.english: I did not understand the ending of the story.
examples.zomi: Tangthu tawpna ka telkei hi.

senses.usage_en: An ending often describes the particular way something finishes. End may simply identify its final point.
senses.usage_zomi: Ending in na khat a tawp dan kawk zel hi. End in a nunungpen mun ahih keileh hun bek kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: The final letters or sounds of a word
senses.definition_en: Letters or sounds added to or occurring at the end of a word.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal khat a tawpna ah a om ahih keileh a kihel lai mal leh aw.

examples.english: Add the ending “-ed” to form the past tense.
examples.zomi: Past tense bawl dingin tawpna “-ed” beh in.

examples.english: The two words have different endings.
examples.zomi: Kammal tegel tawpna kibanglo hi.

senses.usage_en: In grammar, an ending may show tense, number, or another grammatical function.
senses.usage_zomi: Grammar ah kammal tawpna in tense, singular leh plural, ahih keileh grammar mawpuakna dang lak thei hi.

senses.heading: A person or group that is hostile
senses.definition_en: A person or group that hates, opposes, attacks, or intends to harm another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang a mudah, a langdo, a do, ahih keileh susia nuam mi leh pawl.

examples.english: The two former enemies agreed to begin peace talks.
examples.zomi: Galmi ngei tegel lemna thu kikum kipan ding kithukim uh hi.

examples.english: They feared an attack by enemy forces.
examples.zomi: Langdo galkapte hong do ding lau uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Enemy is a strong word. A person who merely disagrees with you is not necessarily an enemy.
senses.usage_zomi: Enemy pen kammal khauh ahi hi. Nang tawh ngaihsutdan a kibanglo mi peuhmah galmi hituanlo hi.

senses.heading: Something harmful to a goal or condition
senses.definition_en: Something that damages, weakens, or works against a person, quality, or goal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pianzia, ahih keileh ngiimna khat susia, thanem sak, ahih keileh a langdo na.

common_phrases.english: fear is the enemy of confidence

examples.english: Misinformation is an enemy of good decision-making.
examples.zomi: Thu maanlo pen khensatna hoih a gal ahi hi.

examples.english: Rust is the enemy of metal.
examples.zomi: Sik-e in sik susia hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense treats a harmful condition or force as if it were a hostile person.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak khiatna in dinmun ahih keileh tha hoihlo khat pen galmi bangin tehkak hi.

senses.heading: Physical or mental strength
senses.definition_en: The physical or mental strength needed to be active, work, or think.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kihih, nasep, ahih keileh ngaihsutna ding a kisam pumpi tha leh lungsim tha.

examples.english: I do not have enough energy to exercise tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zanin pumpi pattahna ding tha kicing ka nei lo hi.

examples.english: The children were full of energy.
examples.zomi: Naupangte tha tawh kidim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, energy is normally uncountable. Say a lot of energy, not many energies.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah energy pen simsawm theihloh min hi. A lot of energy kici a, many energies kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Power used for heat, light, or movement
senses.definition_en: Power obtained from electricity, fuel, sunlight, wind, or another source.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meikhu, fuel, ni khuavak, huih, ahih keileh a pianna dang pan a kingah, a lum, khuavak leh kihihna piangsak tha.

examples.english: Solar panels convert sunlight into energy.
examples.zomi: Solar panel-te in ni khuavak pen tha in khe hi.

examples.english: The building uses less energy than before.
examples.zomi: Inn in a beisa sangin tha tawmzaw zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Electricity is one form of energy. Energy can also come from heat, movement, chemical reactions, light, and other sources.
senses.usage_zomi: Meikhu pen energy nam khat ahi hi. Energy pen a lum, kihihna, chemical kikhelna, khuavak leh a pianna dang pan zong hong piang thei hi.

senses.heading: Strong and lively activity
senses.definition_en: Enthusiasm, force, or liveliness shown in an activity or performance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih keileh limlakna khat sunga lunglutna, tha leh nuntakna kilak.

examples.english: She brings great energy to the team.
examples.zomi: Ama in pawl sungah tha lianpi pia hi.

examples.english: The musicians performed with energy.
examples.zomi: Tumging siamte tha tawh lim lak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes enthusiasm and liveliness rather than scientifically measurable power.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih limpuak khiatna in science tawh teh theih tha sangin lunglutna leh nuntakna kilak kawk hi.

senses.heading: To attract and hold attention or interest
senses.definition_en: To attract someone’s attention and keep them interested or involved.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim zo; lunglut sak; kihel sak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungsim zo a, lunglut in kihel sak.

examples.english: The speaker engaged the audience with clear examples.
examples.zomi: Thugenpa in gentehna kician tawh za mite lungsim zo hi.

examples.english: Good teachers engage students in learning.
examples.zomi: Sia hoihte in sangnaupangte kisinna ah lunglut sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, engage means gaining active attention, not merely being seen or heard.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah engage in kimuh ahih keileh kiza bek hilo a, lunglut takin kihel sak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To participate in an activity
senses.definition_en: To take part or become involved in an activity, discussion, or process.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, thu kikumna, ahih keileh kalsuan khat ah kihel.

examples.english: Students engaged in a group discussion.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte pawl thu kikumna ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: The organization engages with local communities.
examples.zomi: Pawl in tua gam khawlsung mite tawh kizom hi.

senses.usage_en: Use engage in an activity and engage with a person or group.
senses.usage_zomi: Engage in an activity leh engage with a person or group ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: To employ or hire someone
senses.definition_en: To arrange and pay for someone’s professional services.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a siamsa nasep bawl dingin sepsak ahih keileh thaman tawh hire.

examples.english: The company engaged a lawyer to review the contract.
examples.zomi: Company in contract enkik dingin thukham siam khat sepsak hi.

examples.english: They engaged an architect for the project.
examples.zomi: Geelna dingin inn lam siam khat sepsak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense is similar to hire, especially for professional or temporary services.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna pen hire tawh kibang a, a diakin siamsa ahih keileh hun tom sung nasepna dingin kizang hi.

senses.heading: To begin fighting or competing with someone
senses.definition_en: To enter into combat, conflict, or direct competition with another person or force.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh pawl dang tawh galdo, kilemlo, ahih keileh kidem kipan.

examples.english: The soldiers were ordered to engage the enemy.
examples.zomi: Galkapte galmi do ding kisawl uh hi.

examples.english: The company is ready to engage its competitors.
examples.zomi: Company in a kidemte tawh kidem ding kigingsa hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is formal and is common in military or competitive contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen formal hi a, galkap ahih keileh kidemna thu ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Formally promised to marry
senses.definition_en: Having agreed to marry someone.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kiteng ding kithukim; mo leh mou ding
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh kiteng dingin formal takin kithukim khin.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat tawh kiteng ding kithukim

examples.english: They became engaged last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in kiteng ding kithukim uh hi.

examples.english: She is engaged to her longtime friend.
examples.zomi: Ama in a lawm sawtpi tawh kiteng ding kithukim hi.

senses.usage_en: Use engaged to someone, not engaged with someone, when referring to marriage.
senses.usage_zomi: Kitengna a kawk ciangin engaged to someone ci in kizang a, engaged with someone ci in kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: Busy or involved in an activity
senses.definition_en: Busy, occupied, or actively involved in an activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep tawh buai ahih keileh gamtatna khat ah lunglut takin kihel.

examples.english: The students were fully engaged in the lesson.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte sinna ah lunglut takin kihel uh hi.

examples.english: She is currently engaged in research.
examples.zomi: Ama tuhun in kholna nasep sem lai hi.

senses.usage_en: Use engaged in an activity and engaged with a subject or group.
senses.usage_zomi: Engaged in an activity leh engaged with a subject or group ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Being used or occupied
senses.definition_en: Already in use, busy, or unavailable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizang lai, mi dang in a la khin, ahih keileh ngahtheihlo.

examples.english: I called twice, but the line was engaged.
examples.zomi: Nih vei ka phone napi, line kizang lai hi.

examples.english: The meeting room is engaged until noon.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna innkhan sunlai dong kizang ding hi.

senses.usage_en: For a busy telephone line, engaged is common in British English. American English usually uses busy.
senses.usage_zomi: Phone line a kizang laitak genna dingin British English ah engaged kizang tam hi. American English ah busy kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: A machine that produces power or movement
senses.definition_en: A machine that converts fuel, electricity, or another form of energy into movement or mechanical power.
senses.explanation_zomi: Fuel, meikhu, ahih keileh tha nam dang pen kihihna leh machine tha in a khe van.

examples.english: The car’s engine would not start.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw engine hong khang theilo hi.

examples.english: The mechanic repaired the damaged engine.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw siam in engine kisia puah hi.

senses.usage_en: An engine produces mechanical power. A motor often uses electricity, though everyday usage sometimes overlaps.
senses.usage_zomi: Engine in machine tha piangsak hi. Motor in meikhu zang zel napi, nisim zatdan ah tegel khiatna kikalpel thei hi.

senses.heading: A computer system used to perform a particular function
senses.definition_en: A computer program or system designed to perform a major task, such as searching, rendering, or processing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu zonna, lim bawlna, ahih keileh data khutzatna bang nasep thupi khat bawl ding computer program leh system.

examples.english: Use a search engine to find reliable information.
examples.zomi: Thu muanhuai zonna dingin search engine zang in.

examples.english: The game was built with a new graphics engine.
examples.zomi: Game pen graphics engine thak tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In technology, engine refers to the core system that performs important processing.
senses.usage_zomi: Technology ah engine in nasep khutzatna thupi a bawl system bulpi kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A professional who uses science and mathematics to design, build, test, or maintain machines, structures, systems, or technology.
senses.zomi_equivalents: engineer; van leh system bawl siam
senses.explanation_zomi: Science leh mathematics zang in machine, inn lamna, system, ahih keileh technology geel, bawl, sittel leh kem siamsa.

examples.english: The engineer designed a safer bridge.
examples.zomi: Engineer in lei bitzaw khat geel hi.

examples.english: She works as an electrical engineer.
examples.zomi: Ama meikhu engineer in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: An engineer uses technical knowledge to solve practical problems. A person who repairs engines may be called a mechanic, depending on the job.
senses.usage_zomi: Engineer in technical theihna tawh nisim buaina veng hi. Engine a puah mi pen a nasep dungzui in mechanic kici thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The study and professional practice of using science and mathematics to design, build, and maintain machines, structures, systems, and technology.
senses.explanation_zomi: Science leh mathematics zang in machine, inn lamna, system leh technology geel, bawl, leh kemna pilna leh siamsinna.

examples.english: She studied civil engineering at university.
examples.zomi: Ama university ah lampi leh inn lam engineering sin hi.

examples.english: Engineering can help solve practical problems.
examples.zomi: Engineering in nisim buaina-te veng thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Engineering is normally uncountable when it names the field. Particular branches include civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical, and software engineering.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna khen a kawk ciangin engineering pen simsawm theihloh min hi. A khen tuamtuamte lakah civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical leh software engineering kihel hi.

senses.definition_en: To improve the quality, value, appearance, or effectiveness of something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hoihzaw sak; khang sak; manpha sak
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a hoihna, manphatna, kilatdan, ahih keileh tangtunna khang sak.

examples.english: The new lighting enhances the appearance of the room.
examples.zomi: Khuavak thak in innkhan kilatdan hoihzaw sak hi.

examples.english: Training can enhance employees’ skills.
examples.zomi: Kisinsakna in nasemte’ siamna khang sak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Enhance means making something already present better, stronger, or more noticeable. It does not usually mean creating it from nothing.
senses.usage_zomi: Enhance in a om khin na khat hoihzaw, khauhzaw, ahih keileh kilangzaw sak cihna ahi hi. Bangmah omlo pan piangsak cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: To get pleasure from something
senses.definition_en: To receive pleasure, satisfaction, or happiness from an activity, experience, or object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, muhkhakna, ahih keileh na khat pan lungnopna leh lungdamna ngah.

examples.english: We enjoyed the concert very much.
examples.zomi: La pawi nuam sa mahmah ung.

examples.english: She enjoys reading historical books.
examples.zomi: Ama tangthu laibute sim nuam sa hi.

senses.usage_en: Use enjoy doing something, not enjoy to do something: I enjoy reading.
senses.usage_zomi: Enjoy doing something ci in kizang a, enjoy to do something ci in kizanglo hi: I enjoy reading.

senses.heading: To have a good time
senses.definition_en: To experience pleasure and have a pleasant time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nuam takin om; hun nuam zang
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun lungnuam zang ahih keileh nuam takin om.

examples.english: Did you enjoy yourself at the party?
examples.zomi: Pawi ah na nuam hiam?

examples.english: Enjoy your holiday!
examples.zomi: Na khawl hun nuam takin zang in!

senses.usage_en: Enjoy yourself means having a good time. It does not mean enjoying your own personality.
senses.usage_zomi: Enjoy yourself in hun nuam zang cihna ahi hi. Nangmah na pianzia nuam sa cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: To have the benefit of something
senses.definition_en: To possess or experience a favourable condition, right, reputation, or advantage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun hoih, thuneihna, minhoihna, ahih keileh phattuamna khat nei leh zang.

examples.english: The region enjoys a mild climate.
examples.zomi: Tua gamkee in khuahun nem nei hi.

examples.english: Every citizen should enjoy equal rights.
examples.zomi: Gammi khempeuh thuneihna kibang ngah ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense means have or benefit from, not necessarily feel pleasure.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna in nei ahih keileh phattuamna ngah cihna ahi a, lungnopna thuak teitei cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Extremely large in size, amount, number, degree, or importance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Liatna, zat, tamna, dinmun, ahih keileh thupina ah lian mahmah.

examples.english: The project requires an enormous amount of work.
examples.zomi: Geelna in nasep zat lian mahmah kisam hi.

examples.english: Technology has had an enormous effect on communication.
examples.zomi: Technology in kizopna tungah sukna lian mahmah nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Enormous is stronger than large or big and can describe physical or abstract things.
senses.usage_zomi: Enormous pen large ahih keileh big sangin khauh zaw a, van pumpi ahih keileh ngaihsutna tawh kisai na zong hilhcian thei hi.

senses.definition_en: As much or as many as needed for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna khat dingin a kisap zah, tawmlo tamlo in kicing.

examples.english: We have enough food for everyone.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh ding annek kicing i nei hi.

examples.english: There is not enough time to finish the work.
examples.zomi: Nasep zohna ding hun kicing omlo hi.

senses.usage_en: As a determiner, enough comes before a noun: enough time. After an adjective or adverb, it follows that word: old enough; quickly enough. Use enough of before a pronoun or determiner phrase: enough of them; enough of the food.
senses.usage_zomi: Determiner in enough pen noun ma ah om hi: enough time. Adjective ahih keileh adverb khit ah om hi: old enough; quickly enough. Pronoun ahih keileh determiner phrase ma ah enough of kizang hi: enough of them; enough of the food.

senses.heading: A request for information
senses.definition_en: A question or request made to obtain information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat theihna dingin a kibawl dotna ahih keileh thu ngetna.

examples.english: I sent an enquiry about the training program.
examples.zomi: Kisinsakna program tawh kisai thu dotna khat ka sawl hi.

examples.english: Please contact the office with any enquiries.
examples.zomi: Dotna na neih leh office hopih in.

senses.usage_en: Enquiry is the usual British spelling. American English normally uses inquiry for both questions and investigations.
senses.usage_zomi: Enquiry pen British spelling a kizang tam ahi hi. American English ah dotna leh thu kanna tegel dingin inquiry kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: An official investigation
senses.definition_en: An organized examination intended to discover the facts about an event or problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang ahih keileh buaina khat thu maan theihna dingin official takin a kibawl thu kanna.

common_phrases.zomi: mipite tawh kisai official thu kanna

examples.english: The government launched an enquiry into the accident.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in accident thu kanna kipan sak hi.

examples.english: The enquiry will examine the causes of the failure.
examples.zomi: Thu kanna in guallelhna a ziangte enkhol ding hi.

senses.usage_en: British English often prefers inquiry for a formal investigation and enquiry for a request for information, but actual usage overlaps.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah formal thu kanna dingin inquiry, thu dotna dingin enquiry teel zel napi, a zatdan kikalpel thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To make certain that something happens or that a condition exists.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat piang takpi ding ahih keileh dinmun khat om takpi ding kipsak.

examples.english: Check the door to ensure that it is locked.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak a kikal takpi cih kipsak dingin en in.

examples.english: Training helps ensure a safe workplace.
examples.zomi: Kisinsakna in nasepna mun bit om sakna huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Ensure means make certain. Insure usually means provide insurance against financial loss, especially in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Ensure in thu khat kipsak cihna ahi hi. Insure in sumlehpai siatna pan insurance piak cihna ahi zel a, a diakin American English ah.

senses.heading: To go or come into a place
senses.definition_en: To go or come inside a room, building, area, country, or other place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Innkhan, inn, gamkee, gam, ahih keileh mun khat sungah lut.

examples.english: She entered the room quietly.
examples.zomi: Ama innkhan sungah khawdai takin lut hi.

examples.english: Visitors must show identification before entering the building.
examples.zomi: Khualzinte inn sung a lut uh ma in kimawhna lai lak ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Enter normally takes a direct object: enter the building. Do not normally say enter into the building for physical movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Enter in direct object nei hi: enter the building. Pumpi tawh inn sung lutna gen leh ngeina in enter into the building kici lo hi.

senses.heading: To put information into a system
senses.definition_en: To type, write, or record information in a computer, form, list, or database.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer, form, list, ahih keileh database sungah thu gelh, type, ahih keileh ciapteh.

examples.english: Enter your email address in the form.
examples.zomi: Form sungah na email address gelh in.

examples.english: The employee entered the data into the system.
examples.zomi: Nasempa in data pen system sungah koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use enter something into a system when naming both the information and its destination.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu leh a koihna system tegel a gen ciangin enter something into a system kizang hi.

senses.heading: To join a competition, profession, or situation
senses.definition_en: To become a participant in a competition, activity, profession, or particular situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna, gamtatna, siamsinna nasep, ahih keileh dinmun khat sungah kihel.

examples.english: She entered the writing competition.
examples.zomi: Ama laigelh kidemna ah kihel hi.

examples.english: He entered the teaching profession after college.
examples.zomi: College khit ciangin sia nasep sungah lut hi.

senses.usage_en: Use enter a competition without in. However, enter into an agreement is a common formal expression.
senses.usage_zomi: Enter a competition ci in in omlo in kizang hi. Ahih hang enter into an agreement pen formal kammal kipsa ahi hi.

senses.heading: To amuse or interest people
senses.definition_en: To provide enjoyment through stories, music, performances, games, or conversation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu, la, limlakna, kimawlna, ahih keileh kiholimna tawh mite lungnuam leh nuam sak.

examples.english: The musicians entertained the guests during dinner.
examples.zomi: Tumging siamte in nitak an nek laitak zin mite lungnuam sak uh hi.

examples.english: The game entertained the children for hours.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna in naupangte nai tampi nuam sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Entertain someone means giving that person enjoyment or interest.
senses.usage_zomi: Entertain someone in tua mi lungnuam, nuam, ahih keileh lunglut sak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To receive guests socially
senses.definition_en: To invite people into one’s home and provide food, drink, or enjoyable company.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite inn ah sam in an leh dawnna pia a, lungnuam takin zin a bawl.

examples.english: They often entertain friends at home.
examples.zomi: Inn ah lawmte zin bawl tawntung uh hi.

examples.english: She enjoys entertaining guests.
examples.zomi: Ama zin mite sang nuam sa hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, entertain includes hospitality, not only performances.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah entertain in limlakna bek hilo a, zin sang leh zin bawlna huam hi.

senses.heading: To consider an idea or possibility
senses.definition_en: To consider or be willing to think about an idea, proposal, possibility, or request.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, thu piakna, piangtheihna, ahih keileh ngetna khat ngaihsun ding pawm.

examples.english: The committee agreed to entertain the proposal.
examples.zomi: Committee in thu piakna ngaihsun ding pawm hi.

examples.english: She would not entertain the idea of selling the house.
examples.zomi: Inn zuak ding ngaihsutna ngaihsun nuamlo hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a formal sense. It means considering something, not necessarily accepting it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen formal khiatna hi. Na khat ngaihsun cihna ahi a, sang takpi cihna hituanlo hi.

senses.heading: Activities that provide enjoyment
senses.definition_en: Films, music, performances, games, or other activities intended to amuse or interest people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite lungnuam, nuam, leh lunglut sak ding film, la, limlakna, kimawlna leh gamtatna dangte.

examples.english: The festival provides music and entertainment for families.
examples.zomi: Pawi in innkuante ding la leh lungnuamna pia hi.

examples.english: Online entertainment has become more popular.
examples.zomi: Internet tunga lungnuamna program hong minthangzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Entertainment is normally uncountable when referring generally to enjoyable activities.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungnuamna gamtatna a huam in gen ciangin entertainment pen simsawm theihloh min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: The act of entertaining guests
senses.definition_en: The activity of receiving and providing hospitality for guests.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zin mite sang, an leh dawnna pia, leh lungnuam sakna nasep.

examples.english: The company limited spending on business entertainment.
examples.zomi: Company in sum nasepna zin bawlna ding sum zatna ciangtan hi.

examples.english: Food is an important part of guest entertainment.
examples.zomi: Annek pen zin sangna khen thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense refers to hospitality provided to guests or business contacts.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna in zin ahih keileh sum nasepna kizop mite sangna kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Strong interest, excitement, and eagerness about something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tungah lunglutna, lunglawngna leh bawl nopna khauh.

examples.english: The students showed great enthusiasm for the project.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in geelna tungah lunglutna lian lak uh hi.

examples.english: Her enthusiasm encouraged the whole team.
examples.zomi: A lunglutna in pawl a vekpi tha pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Enthusiasm is normally uncountable. Use enthusiasm for/about something.
senses.usage_zomi: Enthusiasm pen simsawm theihloh min ahi zel hi. Enthusiasm for/about something ci in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Showing strong interest, excitement, and eagerness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tungah lunglut, lunglawng, leh bawl nuam mahmah.

examples.english: She is enthusiastic about learning Zomi.
examples.zomi: Ama Zomi sinna tungah lunglut mahmah hi.

examples.english: The audience gave an enthusiastic response.
examples.zomi: En mipite lunglawng takin dawng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use enthusiastic about something and enthusiastic to do something. Do not use enthusiastic of.
senses.usage_zomi: Enthusiastic about something leh enthusiastic to do something ci in kizang hi. Enthusiastic of ci in kizanglo hi.

senses.definition_en: Including every part of something; whole and complete.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khen khat zong nutsiatlo in a vekpi, a buppi leh a kicing.

examples.english: The entire family attended the celebration.
examples.zomi: Innkuan a vekpi pawi ah pai uh hi.

examples.english: The repair took the entire day.
examples.zomi: Puahna in ni a vekpi la hi.

senses.usage_en: Entire comes before a singular countable noun: the entire book. With plural or uncountable nouns, all is usually more natural: all the books; all the water.
senses.usage_zomi: Entire pen singular countable noun ma ah om hi: the entire book. Plural ahih keileh uncountable noun tawh all zat a ngeinazaw hi: all the books; all the water.

senses.definition_en: Completely, wholly, or in every respect.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a vekpi in; kicing takin; sitset
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi in, a buppi in, ahih keileh kicing takin.

common_phrases.zomi: a vekpi in a tungah kinga

examples.english: The two situations are entirely different.
examples.zomi: Dinmun tegel kibang hetlo hi.

examples.english: The decision depends entirely on the evidence.
examples.zomi: Khensatna pen a vekpi in teci tungah kinga hi.

senses.usage_en: Entirely is a strong adverb meaning completely. In negative sentences, not entirely means “not completely,” rather than “not at all.”
senses.usage_zomi: Entirely pen kicing sitset cihna adverb khauh ahi hi. Negative sentence ah not entirely in “kicing sitsetlo” cihna ahi a, “bangmah hilo” cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: A door, gate, or opening used to enter
senses.definition_en: A door, gate, passage, or opening through which people enter a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat sung lutna ding kongkhak, kongpi, lampi, ahih keileh hongna.

examples.english: The main entrance is on the east side of the building.
examples.zomi: Lutna kong thupi inn nisuahlam ah om hi.

examples.english: Do not block the entrance.
examples.zomi: Lutna kong khaktan kei in.

senses.usage_en: Entrance to a place means its entry point. Entry may refer to permission, the act of entering, or an item in a list.
senses.usage_zomi: Entrance to a place in a lutna mun kawk hi. Entry in luttheihna, lutna gamtat, ahih keileh list sunga thu khat kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: The act of entering
senses.definition_en: The act or manner of coming into a place, situation, or performance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, dinmun, ahih keileh limlakna sungah lutna gamtat leh lutdan.

examples.english: The actor made a dramatic entrance.
examples.zomi: Milimpa lamdang takin stage tungah hong lut hi.

examples.english: Her entrance into politics surprised many people.
examples.zomi: Gamvai sung a lutna in mi tampi lamdang sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, entrance focuses on the act or style of coming in.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah entrance in hong lutna gamtat ahih keileh hong lutdan bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Permission or ability to enter
senses.definition_en: Permission or the right to enter a place or institution.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih keileh pawlpi khat sung luttheihna phalna leh thuneihna.

examples.english: The entrance fee is ten dollars.
examples.zomi: Lutna man dollar sawm ahi hi.

examples.english: Visitors were refused entrance after closing time.
examples.zomi: Kikhak hun khit ciangin khualzinte lutna kiphal lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Entrance fee is the money paid to enter. Admission is another common word for permission or payment to enter.
senses.usage_zomi: Entrance fee pen lutna ding a kipiak sum ahi hi. Admission zong lutna phalna ahih keileh lutna man genna kammal khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: The act or right of entering
senses.definition_en: The act of entering or permission to enter a place, country, organization, or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, gam, pawlpi, ahih keileh kidemna sung lutna gamtat leh luttheihna phalna.

examples.english: A valid passport is required for entry into the country.
examples.zomi: Gam sung lutna dingin passport zangtheih kisam hi.

examples.english: The guard denied him entry to the building.
examples.zomi: Vengpa in inn sung lutna phal lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Entry to/into a place refers to the act or permission. Entrance more often names the physical doorway.
senses.usage_zomi: Entry to/into a place in lutna gamtat ahih keileh phalna kawk hi. Entrance in pumpi tawh a lutna kong kawk tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: An item written in a list, record, diary, or dictionary
senses.definition_en: One item of information recorded in a list, account, diary, database, or reference work.
senses.explanation_zomi: List, ciaptehna, diary, database, ahih keileh reference laibu sunga thu khat.

examples.english: Each dictionary entry includes a definition.
examples.zomi: Dictionary entry khat ciat in khiatna hilhcian na huam hi.

examples.english: She wrote a diary entry before bed.
examples.zomi: A ihma in diary sungah ni khat ciaptehna gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: An entry is one complete recorded item, even if it contains several fields or sentences.
senses.usage_zomi: Entry pen ciaptehna kicing khat ahi a, a sungah field ahih keileh sentence tampi om thei hi.

senses.heading: Something submitted for a competition
senses.definition_en: A work, performance, person, or team officially entered in a competition.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kidemna a kihel na; kidemna karya
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna ah official takin a kihel karya, limlakna, mi, ahih keileh pawl.

examples.english: Her photograph was the winning entry.
examples.zomi: A lim pen kidemna a gualzo karya ahi hi.

examples.english: The competition received more than one hundred entries.
examples.zomi: Kidemna in karya za khat sang tamzaw ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: In a competition, entry may mean the submitted work or the participant.
senses.usage_zomi: Kidemna ah entry in a ki-ap karya ahih keileh a kihel mi kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: The natural world
senses.definition_en: The natural world, including air, water, land, plants, animals, and the conditions affecting life.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huih, tui, lei, singkung, ganhing leh nuntakna a suk leitung pianzia khempeuh.

examples.english: We must protect the environment for future generations.
examples.zomi: Mailam khangte dingin leitung pianzia i kem ding ahi hi.

examples.english: Plastic waste harms the environment.
examples.zomi: Plastic ninsia in leitung pianzia susia hi.

senses.usage_en: When used with the, the environment often means the natural world as a whole.
senses.usage_zomi: The environment ci in the tawh kizang ciangin leitung pianzia a vekpi kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: The surrounding conditions
senses.definition_en: The physical, social, or working conditions in which a person, animal, or organization lives or operates.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing, ahih keileh pawlpi khat a nungta leh a nasemna kimkot pumpi, mihing khawlbawlna leh nasepna dinmun.

examples.english: Children learn best in a safe environment.
examples.zomi: Naupangte kimkot dinmun bit ah sin hoihpen uh hi.

examples.english: The company provides a supportive work environment.
examples.zomi: Company in nasemte panpih nasepna dinmun pia hi.

senses.usage_en: An environment may be natural, physical, social, educational, or professional.
senses.usage_zomi: Environment pen leitung pianzia, pumpi kimkot, mihing khawlbawlna, pilna, ahih keileh siamsinna nasep tawh kisai ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Connected with the natural environment
senses.definition_en: Relating to the natural world and the effects that human activity has on it.
senses.zomi_equivalents: leitung pianzia tawh kisai; kimkot leitung tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung pianzia leh mihing gamtatna in tua tunga a sukna tawh kisai.

examples.english: The project requires an environmental review.
examples.zomi: Geelna in leitung pianzia sukna enkholna kisam hi.

examples.english: The law aims to reduce environmental damage.
examples.zomi: Thukham in leitung pianzia siatna tawm sak ngiim hi.

senses.usage_en: Environmental commonly concerns pollution, climate, conservation, land, water, plants, and animals.
senses.usage_zomi: Environmental in ninsiatna, khuahun, kepcingna, lei, tui, singkung leh ganhingte tawh kisai thu kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Caused by surrounding conditions
senses.definition_en: Relating to or caused by the physical or social surroundings in which someone lives.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kimkot dinmun tawh kisai; kimkot in a piangsak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a nuntakna pumpi ahih keileh mihing khawlbawlna kimkot tawh kisai ahih keileh tua in a piangsak.

examples.english: Health is affected by genetic and environmental factors.
examples.zomi: Cidamna pen suahpih pianzia leh kimkot dinmun in suk hi.

examples.english: The study examines environmental influences on learning.
examples.zomi: Kholna in kimkot dinmun in kisinna a sukdan enkhol hi.

senses.usage_en: In health and social science, environmental may include housing, family, community, pollution, and access to resources.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna leh mihing khawlbawlna science ah environmental in inn, innkuan, khawlsung, ninsiatna leh van kisap ngahtheihna zong huam thei hi.

senses.heading: One part of a television, radio, or online series
senses.definition_en: One complete program or instalment in a continuing television, radio, podcast, or online series.
senses.explanation_zomi: Television, radio, podcast, ahih keileh online program kizom khat sunga program khen kicing khat.

examples.english: We watched the first episode of the series.
examples.zomi: Series episode masapen en ung.

examples.english: A new episode is released every Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday simin episode thak khat kikhah hi.

senses.usage_en: An episode is one part of a series. A season usually contains several episodes.
senses.usage_zomi: Episode pen series khen khat ahi hi. Season khat sungah episode tampi om zel hi.

senses.heading: A particular event or period
senses.definition_en: A particular event, experience, or period that is part of a longer series of events.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thu piang khat; hun khen khat
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang kizom sauzaw khat sunga thu piang, muhkhakna, ahih keileh hun khen khat.

examples.english: The argument was an unfortunate episode in their friendship.
examples.zomi: Thu kiselna pen amau’ lawm kizopna sunga thu piang hoihlo khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The book describes an important episode in national history.
examples.zomi: Laibu in gam tangthu sunga thu piang thupi khat pulak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense treats one event as a distinct part of a longer story or history.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in thu piang khat pen tangthu ahih keileh thu kizom sauzaw khat a khen tuam khat in en hi.

senses.heading: A period of illness or symptoms
senses.definition_en: A limited period during which someone experiences a medical or psychological condition.
senses.zomi_equivalents: natna hun khen; natna hong pianna khat
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in cidamna ahih keileh lungsim natna leh a limte a thuak hun khen khat.

examples.english: The patient experienced another episode of chest pain.
examples.zomi: Cinapa awm natna hong piang kik hi.

examples.english: She sought treatment after a severe depressive episode.
examples.zomi: Lungsim kiatna nasia khat a thuak khit ciangin cidamna zon hi.

senses.usage_en: In medicine, an episode is one occurrence or limited period of a condition; it does not necessarily describe a permanent state.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna thu ah episode in natna khatvei a pianna ahih keileh hun ciangtan khat kawk a, tawntung dinmun cihna hituanlo hi.

senses.heading: The same in amount, number, size, value, or level
senses.definition_en: Having the same amount, number, size, value, quality, or level as something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na dang khat tawh zat, number, liatna, man, hoihna, ahih keileh dinmun kibang.

examples.english: The two rooms are equal in size.
examples.zomi: Innkhan tegel a liatna kibang hi.

examples.english: One hundred centimetres is equal to one metre.
examples.zomi: Centimetre za khat pen metre khat tawh kibang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use equal to, not equal with, for amounts and values: Two plus two is equal to four.
senses.usage_zomi: Zat leh man tehkakna ah equal to ci in kizang a, equal with ci in kizanglo hi: Two plus two is equal to four.

senses.heading: Having the same rights, status, or opportunities
senses.definition_en: Having the same rights, value, treatment, status, or opportunities as others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte tawh thuneihna, manphatna, kibawldan, panmun, ahih keileh hunhoih kibang nei.

examples.english: Every citizen should have equal rights under the law.
examples.zomi: Gammi khempeuh thukham nuai ah thuneihna kibang nei ding uh hi.

examples.english: The policy promotes equal opportunity in employment.
examples.zomi: Thukhun in nasepna ah hunhoih kibang khang sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Equal does not always mean identical. Equal treatment may require removing barriers so that people have genuinely fair opportunities.
senses.usage_zomi: Equal in a kibat sitset cihna tawntung hilo hi. Kibawldan kibang in mite hunhoih thutang taktak ngahna ding dalna-te lakhia kul thei hi.

senses.heading: Able to deal with a task or situation
senses.definition_en: Having enough strength, skill, or ability to deal with a particular task or difficulty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih keileh haksatna khat khutzat ding tha, siamna, ahih keileh theihna kicing nei.

examples.english: She proved equal to the difficult task.
examples.zomi: Ama in nasep haksa zothei cih lak hi.

examples.english: The old system was no longer equal to the demand.
examples.zomi: System lui in kisapna zoh nawnlo hi.

senses.usage_en: The expression equal to the task means capable of handling it.
senses.usage_zomi: Equal to the task in tua nasep khutzat leh zothei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To the same degree or amount
senses.definition_en: In the same amount, number, degree, level, or proportion.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kibang in; khat ciat in
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, number, dinmun, ahih keileh khen zah kibang in.

examples.english: The money was divided equally among the children.
examples.zomi: Sum pen naupangte tungah a kibang in kihawm hi.

examples.english: Both options are equally important.
examples.zomi: Lampi tegel a kibang in thupi hi.

senses.usage_en: Equally compares degree or amount. It can modify adjectives and adverbs: equally useful; equally carefully.
senses.usage_zomi: Equally in dinmun ahih keileh zat tehkak hi. Adjective leh adverb a hilhcian thei hi: equally useful; equally carefully.

senses.heading: In a fair and equal manner
senses.definition_en: In a way that gives people the same rights, opportunities, or treatment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite tungah thuneihna, hunhoih, ahih keileh kibawldan kibang pia in thutang takin.

examples.english: The law should protect all citizens equally.
examples.zomi: Thukham in gammi khempeuh a kibang in kem ding hi.

examples.english: All applicants must be treated equally.
examples.zomi: Nasep nget mi khempeuh a kibang in kibawl ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Treating people equally does not always mean treating every person identically; relevant needs and barriers may differ.
senses.usage_zomi: Mite a kibang in bawl cih in mi khempeuh kibat sitset in bawl cihna tawntung hilo hi; kisapna leh dalna-te kibanglo thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The tools, machines, clothing, or other objects needed for a particular activity or purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih keileh ngiimna khat ding a kisam vanzat, machine, puan leh van dangte.

examples.english: The hospital needs new medical equipment.
examples.zomi: Zato inn in cidamna vanzat thak kisam hi.

examples.english: Wear the correct safety equipment while working.
examples.zomi: Nasep laitak in bitna vanzat maan zang in.

senses.usage_en: Equipment is uncountable. Say some equipment or a piece of equipment, not an equipment or equipments.
senses.usage_zomi: Equipment pen simsawm theihloh min hi. Some equipment ahih keileh a piece of equipment kici a, an equipment ahih keileh equipments kici lo hi.

senses.heading: A mistake or incorrect result
senses.definition_en: Something done, written, calculated, or believed incorrectly.
senses.explanation_zomi: A khial in a kibawl, a kigelh, a kisim, ahih keileh a ki-um thu.

examples.english: The report contains several factual errors.
examples.zomi: Report sungah thu maan tawh kisai khialhna pawlkhat om hi.

examples.english: The accident was caused by human error.
examples.zomi: Accident pen mihing khialhna in piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Error is often more formal or technical than mistake. A mistake may involve judgment or choice, while an error may involve incorrect data, calculation, or operation.
senses.usage_zomi: Error pen mistake sangin formal ahih keileh technical zaw hi. Mistake in khensatna ahih keileh teelna khial huam thei a, error in data, simna, ahih keileh nasepna khial kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: A computer or system problem
senses.definition_en: A fault that prevents a computer, program, or machine from working correctly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer, program, ahih keileh machine maan takin nasem theilo sak khialhna.

examples.english: An error message appeared on the screen.
examples.zomi: Screen tungah khialhna thupuak hong kilang hi.

examples.english: Restarting the program may fix the error.
examples.zomi: Program pankikna in khialhna puah thei hi.

senses.usage_en: An error message reports a problem; it does not always identify the true cause.
senses.usage_zomi: Error message in buaina om cih pulak napi, a ziang taktak pulak teitei tuanlo hi.

senses.heading: To get away from danger, control, or confinement
senses.definition_en: To get free from a dangerous place, prison, control, or someone trying to catch you.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun lauhuai, thong, ukna, ahih keileh hong man nuam mi kiang pan suahta.

examples.english: The family escaped from the burning house.
examples.zomi: Innkuan pen inn meikang sung pan suahta hi.

examples.english: The prisoner tried to escape.
examples.zomi: Thongkiapa suahta ding hanciam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use escape from a place: escape from prison. Before danger or injury, from may be omitted: escape danger; escape injury.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun khat pan suahtakna gen leh escape from a place kizang hi: escape from prison. Lauhuaina ahih keileh liamna ma ah from pelh thei hi: escape danger; escape injury.

senses.heading: To avoid an unpleasant result
senses.definition_en: To avoid experiencing punishment, injury, attention, or another unwanted result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gimpiakna, liamna, etna, ahih keileh result hoihlo thuakloh dingin pelh.

examples.english: He escaped serious injury in the crash.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw kituahna ah liamna nasia pelh hi.

examples.english: The problem escaped our attention.
examples.zomi: Buaina pen ka phawkloh uh in hong khengval hi.

senses.usage_en: Escape someone’s attention or notice means that the person failed to notice it.
senses.usage_zomi: Escape someone’s attention or notice in tua mi in a phawklohna ahih keileh a muhlohna cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To leak from a container or closed area
senses.definition_en: For gas, liquid, heat, or another substance to leak out.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gas, tui, a lum, ahih keileh zatui dang bawm ahih keileh mun kikhak pan luangkhia.

examples.english: Gas was escaping from the pipe.
examples.zomi: Pipe pan gas potkhia lai hi.

examples.english: Heat escapes through the open window.
examples.zomi: Limlang kihong pan a lum paikhia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the substance itself is the subject of escape.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah a luangkhia gas, tui, ahih keileh a lum mahmah sentence subject ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: More than usual, more than others, or particularly.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina sangin, midangte sangin, ahih keileh a tuamdiak in.

examples.english: Exercise is important, especially for office workers.
examples.zomi: Pumpi pattahna thupi a, a diakin office nasemte dingin thupi hi.

examples.english: The road is dangerous, especially at night.
examples.zomi: Lampi lauhuai a, a diakin zanin lauhuai hi.

senses.usage_en: Especially highlights one person, thing, or situation as more important or noticeable than others. Specially often means “for a particular purpose.”
senses.usage_zomi: Especially in mi, na, ahih keileh dinmun khat midangte sangin thupizaw ahih keileh kilangzaw sak hi. Specially in ngiimna tuam khat dingin cihna nei zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A short piece of writing that explains, examines, or argues a subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu khat hilhcian, enkhol, ahih keileh ngaihsutna teci tawh a kikum laigelh tom.

examples.english: The students wrote an essay about public service.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in mipite nasepna tawh kisai essay gelh uh hi.

examples.english: Her essay presents a clear argument.
examples.zomi: A essay in thu kikumna kician khat pulak hi.

senses.usage_en: An essay normally has an organized introduction, body, and conclusion. It is more developed than a short answer.
senses.usage_zomi: Essay in a ngeina in thuhonna, thu bulpi leh thu khupna a kizom in nei hi. Dawnna tom sangin kicingzaw hi.

senses.heading: Completely necessary
senses.definition_en: Absolutely necessary for a particular purpose, activity, or result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna, gamtatna, ahih keileh result khat dingin kisam taktak a, pelh theihlo.

examples.english: Clean water is essential for life.
examples.zomi: Tui siangtho nuntakna dingin kisam taktak hi.

examples.english: Clear communication is essential to the project’s success.
examples.zomi: Kizopna kician pen geelna gualzawhna dingin kisam taktak hi.

senses.usage_en: Essential is stronger than important. Something important has great value; something essential is necessary.
senses.usage_zomi: Essential pen important sangin khauh zaw hi. Na thupi khat in manphatna lian nei a, na essential khat pen om kul taktak hi.

senses.heading: Basic and central to the nature of something
senses.definition_en: Forming the basic or most important character of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pianzia bawl khen bulpi ahih keileh thupi pen.

examples.english: Trust is an essential feature of a healthy relationship.
examples.zomi: Muanna pen kizopna cidam khat a pianzia bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: The summary preserves the essential meaning of the report.
examples.zomi: Thu tomlakna in report khiatna bulpi kem hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, essential identifies the central nature or defining feature, not only a practical requirement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah essential in kisapna bek hilo a, na khat a pianzia leh a khen bulpi kawk hi.

senses.heading: To create an organization, system, or institution
senses.definition_en: To start and develop an organization, business, system, law, or institution intended to continue.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawlpi, sum nasepna, system, thukham, ahih keileh phuhna khat kizom toto dingin kipan sak leh phut.

examples.english: They established the organization in 2020.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi pen 2020 kum in phut uh hi.

examples.english: The city established a new training program.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in kisinsakna program thak khat kipan sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Establish often suggests creating something stable and intended to last, not merely beginning a temporary activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Establish in hun sawt om ding na kipsa khat phut cihna lak zel a, hun tom gamtatna khat kipan ziau cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: To prove or discover a fact
senses.definition_en: To prove, confirm, or determine that something is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat maan cih teci tawh lak, kipsak, ahih keileh theikhia.

examples.english: The investigation established the cause of the fire.
examples.zomi: Thu kanna in mei kangna a ziang theikhia hi.

examples.english: The evidence established that he was elsewhere.
examples.zomi: Teci in ama mun dang ah om cih kipsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, establish is formal and means reaching a reliable conclusion through evidence.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen formal hi a, teci tungtawnin thu khupna muanhuai khat ngah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To build a relationship, position, or reputation
senses.definition_en: To develop and secure a lasting relationship, role, position, or reputation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizopna, panmun, dinmun, ahih keileh minhoihna khat khang sak in kipsak.

examples.english: It takes time to establish trust.
examples.zomi: Muanna kipsakna in hun la hi.

examples.english: The company established a strong reputation for quality.
examples.zomi: Company in a van hoihna hangin minhoihna khauh nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes gradual development until something becomes recognized and stable.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in na khat tawm tawm in khang a, kithei leh kip hong suak cihna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: All the property and money owned by someone
senses.definition_en: All the money, property, land, and possessions belonging to a person, especially at death.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a sum, inn, lei, leh neihsa khempeuh, a diakin a sih khit a a neihsa.

examples.english: Her children inherited the estate.
examples.zomi: A tate in a neihsa gamh ngah uh hi.

examples.english: The lawyer helped him with estate planning.
examples.zomi: Thukham siam in a neihsa gamh ding geelkholhna ah huh hi.

senses.usage_en: A person’s estate includes assets and may also include debts and legal responsibilities after death.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat estate in neihsa-te huam a, a sih khit leiba leh thukham mawpuakna-te zong huam thei hi.

senses.heading: A large area of land with a substantial house
senses.definition_en: A large property consisting of land and usually a large house.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lei leh inn neihsa lian; estate
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei zaipi leh a ngeina in inn lian khat a huam neihsa mun.

examples.english: The family owns a large estate outside the city.
