examples.zomi: Innkuan in khuapi pualam ah lei leh inn neihsa lian khat nei hi.

examples.english: The estate includes a house, gardens, and farmland.
examples.zomi: Estate sungah inn, huan leh lo kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: An estate is larger than an ordinary house and yard and often includes extensive land.
senses.usage_zomi: Estate pen inn leh innkiim mun ngeina sangin lianzaw a, lei zaipi huam zel hi.

senses.heading: A planned area of housing or industry
senses.definition_en: An area developed for a group of houses, factories, or businesses.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn pawl, van bawlna innte, ahih keileh sum nasepna-te dingin a geelkhawl in a kibawl gamkee.

examples.english: They moved to a new housing estate.
examples.zomi: Inn gamkee thak khat ah a kisuan uh hi.

examples.english: The factory is located on an industrial estate.
examples.zomi: Van bawlna inn pen van bawlna gamkee ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: This planned-development sense is especially common in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih a geelkhawl gamkee khiatna pen British English ah kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: To calculate or judge the approximate amount, cost, size, number, value, or time of something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a zah ngaihsun; man ngaihsun; a kinai sim
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a zat, man, liatna, number, manphatna, ahih keileh hun a kinai pen sim ahih keileh ngaihsun.

examples.english: The builder estimated the repair cost at five thousand dollars.
examples.zomi: Inn lam mi in puahna sum pen dollar tul nga vel ding ci in ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: Experts estimate that the work will take six months.
examples.zomi: Siamna nei mite in nasep pen kha guk sawt ding ci in ngaihsun uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An estimate is approximate, not exact. Use estimate something at an amount or estimate that….
senses.usage_zomi: Estimate pen a kinai zat ahi a, zat kician hilo hi. Estimate something at an amount ahih keileh estimate that… ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Morally right and fair
senses.definition_en: Considered morally right, honest, and fair.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtat hoihna dungzui in maan, thumaan, leh thutang a kisa.

examples.english: Leaders must make ethical decisions.
examples.zomi: Makaite gamtat hoihna tawh khensatna bawl ding uh hi.

examples.english: The company promises to follow ethical business practices.
examples.zomi: Company in sum nasepna thumaan zui ding kamciam hi.

senses.usage_en: Something may be legal but still raise ethical concerns. Law and ethics overlap, but they are not identical.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat thukham in phal napi gamtat hoihna lamah lunghihmawhhuai ahi thei hi. Thukham leh ethics kizom napi kibang sitsetlo hi.

senses.heading: Connected with moral principles or professional standards
senses.definition_en: Relating to rules and principles about right conduct, especially in a profession.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ethics tawh kisai; gamtat thukhun tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtat maan leh hoih tawh kisai thukhun leh bulphuh, a diakin siamsinna nasep sungah.

examples.english: Doctors must follow strict ethical standards.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te gamtat hoihna tehna khauh zui ding uh hi.

examples.english: The research raises several ethical questions.
examples.zomi: Kholna in gamtat hoihna tawh kisai dotna pawlkhat piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Professional ethics guide conduct when duties, rights, risks, and competing interests must be balanced.
senses.usage_zomi: Siamsinna ethics in mawpuakna, thuneihna, lauhuaina leh phattuamna kilehbulhte a kibang in ngaihsutna ding lampi lak hi.

senses.definition_en: The unit of money used by many countries in the European Union.
senses.explanation_zomi: European Union sunga gam tampi in a zat sum unit.

examples.english: The ticket costs fifteen euros.
examples.zomi: Ticket man euro sawmlehnga ahi hi.

examples.english: She exchanged dollars for euros.
examples.zomi: Ama in dollar pen euro tawh laih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use singular euro after one and plural euros after most other numbers in ordinary English: one euro; ten euros. The symbol is €.
senses.usage_zomi: Khat khit ah singular euro, number dangte khit ah plural euros kizang hi: one euro; ten euros. A lim pen € ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To examine something carefully and judge its quality, value, effectiveness, condition, or importance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat pilvang takin enkhol a, a hoihna, manphatna, tangtunna, dinmun, ahih keileh thupina khen.

examples.english: The committee will evaluate every application.
examples.zomi: Committee in ngetna laikhak khempeuh enkhol in khen ding hi.

examples.english: We need to evaluate whether the program is effective.
examples.zomi: Program a tangtun leh tangtunloh i enkhol kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Evaluate involves judging according to evidence or standards. It is more systematic than simply giving an opinion.
senses.usage_zomi: Evaluate in teci ahih keileh tehna dungzui in khen cihna ahi hi. Ngaihsutna gen ziau sangin a geelkhawl leh a kicingzaw hi.

senses.heading: Used to emphasize something surprising or extreme
senses.definition_en: Used to show that something is surprising, unexpected, or more extreme than other possibilities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat lamdang, lam-etloh, ahih keileh a khauhzaw cih thupisakna dingin kizang.

examples.english: Even the experts could not explain the result.
examples.zomi: Siamna nei mite nangawn result hilhcian theilo uh hi.

examples.english: She did not even say goodbye.
examples.zomi: Ama in mangpha ci zong genlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Place even immediately before the word or phrase being emphasized whenever possible.
senses.usage_zomi: A thupisak kammal ahih keileh phrase ma tepat ah even koihna in khiatna kician sak hi.

senses.heading: Used to strengthen a comparison
senses.definition_en: Used before a comparative word to show a greater degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tehkakna kammal ma ah kizang in a dinmun khauhzaw cih lak.

examples.english: The second edition is even better than the first.
examples.zomi: Edition nihna pen a masapen sangin hoihzaw tham hi.

examples.english: The problem became even more serious.
examples.zomi: Buaina nasiazaw semsem hi.

senses.usage_en: Even commonly comes before comparative forms such as better, more, and less.
senses.usage_zomi: Even pen better, more, leh less bang comparative form-te ma ah om zel hi.

senses.heading: Used with conditions to emphasize an unexpected result
senses.definition_en: Used to show that a result remains true despite an unlikely or difficult condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun lam-etloh ahih keileh haksa om napi result kikhello cih lak.

examples.english: I will attend even if it rains.
examples.zomi: Gua a zuk hangin zong ka pai ding hi.

examples.english: She continued working even though she was tired.
examples.zomi: A gim napi zong nasep zomto hi.

senses.usage_en: In even if, even though, and even when, even strengthens the contrast or unexpected condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Even if, even though, leh even when ah even in kilehbulhna ahih keileh lam-etloh dinmun khauh sak hi.

senses.definition_en: The part of the day between late afternoon and night.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sun nitak lam leh zan kikal hun.

examples.english: We have a meeting this evening.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitak in kikhopna nei ung.

examples.english: She usually exercises in the evening.
examples.zomi: Ama ngeina in nitak in pumpi pattah hi.

senses.usage_en: Say this evening without in. For evenings generally, use in the evening.
senses.usage_zomi: This evening ci in in omlo in kizang hi. Nitak hun a huam in gen leh in the evening kizang hi.

senses.heading: Something that happens
senses.definition_en: Something that happens, especially something important, unusual, or noteworthy.
senses.explanation_zomi: A piang thu, a diakin a thupi, a lamdang, ahih keileh phawk taak thu.

examples.english: The election was an important historical event.
examples.zomi: Teelna pen tangthu sunga thu piang thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Police are investigating the events of that night.
examples.zomi: Police-te in tua zan a thu piangte kan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An event may be planned or unplanned. Context shows whether it means an occurrence or an organized occasion.
senses.usage_zomi: Event pen a geelkhawl ahih keileh a geelkhawl lo thu piang ahi thei hi. A kizop thu in thu piang maw, pawi maw cih lak hi.

senses.heading: An organized occasion or activity
senses.definition_en: A planned public, social, cultural, business, or sporting occasion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipite, khawlbawlna, ngeina, sum nasepna, ahih keileh kimawlna dingin a geelkhawl pawi leh gamtatna.

examples.english: The community event attracted hundreds of visitors.
examples.zomi: Khawlsung pawi in khualzin mi za tampi zo hi.

examples.english: The school is planning a fundraising event.
examples.zomi: Sang in sum kholna pawi khat geelkhol hi.

senses.usage_en: An organized event normally has a time, place, purpose, and participants.
senses.usage_zomi: A geelkhawl event in hun, mun, ngiimna leh kihel mite nei zel hi.

senses.heading: One competition within a sports program
senses.definition_en: One particular race, game, or competition within a larger sports meeting.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kimawlna nam khat; kidemna khen khat
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna pawi lianzaw khat sunga taitehna, kimawlna, ahih keileh kidemna nam khat.

examples.english: She won the swimming event.
examples.zomi: Ama tuisep kidemna ah gualzo hi.

examples.english: The final event begins at six.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna nunungpen nai guk ciangin kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: In sports, an event is one distinct competition, even when the overall meeting contains many events.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna ah event pen kidemna tuam khat ahi a, pawi a vekpi sungah event tampi om thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Finally, after a period of time, difficulty, or several earlier events.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tawpna ah; hun sawt khit ciangin
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat, haksatna, ahih keileh thu piang pawlkhat khit ciangin a tawpna ah.

examples.english: After several attempts, she eventually succeeded.
examples.zomi: Vei tampi a hanciam khit ciangin a tawpna ah gualzo hi.

examples.english: The missing documents were eventually found.
examples.zomi: Laikhak mangte hun sawt khit ciangin kimukik hi.

senses.usage_en: Eventually means finally after time or difficulty. It does not mean possibly. This is a common learner error.
senses.usage_zomi: Eventually in hun ahih keileh haksatna khit a tawpna ah cihna ahi hi. Possibly bang “piangthei” cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: At any time
senses.definition_en: At any time in the past, present, or future.
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa, tuhun, ahih keileh mailam hun khatpeuh ciangin.

common_phrases.zomi: huhna na kisap hun khatpeuh leh

examples.english: Have you ever visited New York?
examples.zomi: New York na hawh ngei hiam?

examples.english: If you ever need help, call me.
examples.zomi: Huhna na kisap hun khatpeuh leh hong phone in.

senses.usage_en: Ever is common in questions, conditions, and negative expressions. In affirmative statements about life experience, use it carefully: This is the best book I have ever read.
senses.usage_zomi: Ever pen dotna, condition leh negative kammal ah kizang tam hi. Nuntakna muhkhakna positive sentence ah pilvang takin kizang hi: This is the best book I have ever read.

senses.heading: Always or continually
senses.definition_en: Always, continually, or increasingly, especially in formal or fixed expressions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tawntung, a tawplo in, ahih keileh khang semsem.

examples.english: Demand for energy is ever increasing.
examples.zomi: Tha kisapna khang semsem hi.

examples.english: She has lived here ever since 2020.
examples.zomi: Ama 2020 kum pan kipan hih munah teng tawntung hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning appears mainly in compounds and fixed expressions such as ever-growing and ever since.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen compound leh kammal kipsa, ever-growing leh ever since bangte ah kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: Used before a singular noun to refer to all members of a group individually, without exception.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat sunga mi ahih keileh na khempeuh, khat zong pelhlo in, a tuamtuam in kawkna dingin singular noun ma ah kizang.

examples.english: Every student received a certificate.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang khempeuh certificate khat ciat ngah uh hi.

examples.english: The bus runs every thirty minutes.
examples.zomi: Bus dakika sawmthum simin pai hi.

senses.usage_en: Every is followed by a singular noun and normally a singular verb: Every student is ready. Use every one of before a plural determiner phrase: every one of the students.
senses.usage_zomi: Every khit ah singular noun om a, ngeina in singular verb zang hi: Every student is ready. Plural determiner phrase ma ah every one of kizang hi: every one of the students.

senses.definition_en: Every person; all people in a particular group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khempeuh; pawl khat sunga mi a vekpi.

examples.english: Everybody is welcome at the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ah mi khempeuh hong pai thei hi.

examples.english: I asked everybody to be quiet.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh gamdai ding ka ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: Everybody takes a singular verb: Everybody is ready. A later pronoun is often plural and gender-neutral: Everybody should bring their ID.
senses.usage_zomi: Everybody in singular verb zang hi: Everybody is ready. A nung pronoun pen gender khenlo plural in kizang tam hi: Everybody should bring their ID.

senses.definition_en: Ordinary, usual, or connected with normal daily life.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina, a tuamdiak hilo, ahih keileh nisim nuntakna tawh kisai.

examples.english: The dictionary uses simple everyday language.
examples.zomi: Dictionary in nisim kampau baihlam zang hi.

examples.english: Technology has become part of everyday life.
examples.zomi: Technology pen nisim nuntakna khen khat hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Everyday is one word and is an adjective meaning ordinary. Every day is two words and means each day: I exercise every day.
senses.usage_zomi: Everyday pen kammal khat leh adjective hi a, “nisim a ngeina” cihna ahi hi. Every day pen kammal nih hi a, “ni simin” cihna ahi hi: I exercise every day.

senses.definition_en: Every person; all the people in a particular group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khempeuh; pawl khat sunga mi a vekpi.

examples.english: Everyone deserves to be treated with respect.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh zahtakna tawh kibawl taak hi.

examples.english: Please make sure everyone has enough food.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh annek kicing nei cih kipsak in.

senses.usage_en: Everyone takes a singular verb: Everyone has arrived. It has the same meaning as everybody, though everyone may sound slightly more neutral in formal writing. Do not confuse everyone with every one, which emphasizes each individual member.
senses.usage_zomi: Everyone in singular verb zang hi: Everyone has arrived. Everybody tawh khiatna kibang napi, formal laigelh ah everyone a neutral deuh in ging thei hi. Mi khat ciat bulphuh every one tawh helkhawm loh ding hi.

senses.definition_en: All the objects, matters, events, or facts in a particular situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat tawh kisai na khempeuh, omzia khempeuh, a vekpi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Everything in this room belongs to the school.
examples.zomi: Hih khan sungah om na khempeuh sang neih ahi hi.

examples.english: She told me everything that happened.
examples.zomi: Tua a piang thu khempeuh amah in kei hong gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Everything takes a singular verb: say “Everything is ready,” not “Everything are ready.”
senses.usage_zomi: Everything pen na tampi a huam hangin singular verb tawh kizang hi. Tua ahih manin “Everything is ready” ci ding a, “Everything are ready” ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: In, at, or to every place.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun khempeuh ah; mun khempeuh lamah
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khempeuh ah, mun khempeuh tungah, ahih kei leh mun khempeuh lamah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We looked everywhere for the missing key.
examples.zomi: A mang tawh zong mun khempeuh ah ka zong uh hi.

examples.english: Mobile phones are used everywhere today.
examples.zomi: Tuni ciangin mun khempeuh ah khutphone zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Everywhere does not normally need to or at before it. Say “We went everywhere,” not “We went to everywhere.”
senses.usage_zomi: Everywhere maiah to ahih kei leh at koih kul selo hi. “We went everywhere” ci ding a, “We went to everywhere” ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Facts, information, or objects that help prove whether something is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a maan leh maan loh theihna dingin a kipsak thei teci, thu theihna, ahih kei leh kimuh theih na ahi hi.

examples.english: The police found evidence near the door.
examples.zomi: Police-te in kongkiang ah teci mu uh hi.

examples.english: There is no clear evidence that the medicine caused the illness.
examples.zomi: Tua zatui in natna piangsak cihna teci kician om lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Evidence is normally uncountable. Say “some evidence” or “a piece of evidence,” not “an evidence.”
senses.usage_zomi: Evidence pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi. Tua ahih manin “some evidence” ahih kei leh “a piece of evidence” ci ding a, “an evidence” ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Morally very wrong, cruel, or deliberately harmful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tatkhiatna lamah a sia mahmah, a gilo, mi tungah theihtawpna tawh siatna bawl nuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The story describes an evil ruler who harmed his people.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu in ama mite bawlsia kumpipa gilo khat gen hi.

examples.english: We must not repay evil actions with more evil.
examples.zomi: Gamta gilo pen gamtatna gilo mah tawh thuk lo ding hihang.

senses.usage_en: Evil is stronger than bad. It usually describes serious moral wrongdoing, not an ordinary mistake or poor quality.
senses.usage_zomi: Evil in bad sangin siatna thukzaw pulak hi. Khialhna neucik ahih kei leh hoih lohna mawk hilozaw a, gamtatna lam siatna lianpi genna in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Completely correct and precise, with no difference or uncertainty.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a dik sitset; a kician sitset
senses.explanation_zomi: A dik sitset, a kician sitset, a tawmkhat zong a kilamdang lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you tell me the exact time of the meeting?
examples.zomi: Meeting kipat hun dik sitset kei nong gen thei diam?

examples.english: This is the exact place where we found the bag.
examples.zomi: Hih mun mah kaikhawm dip ka muhna mun dik sitset ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use exact when even a small difference matters. Use approximate when the information is only close to the correct amount or position.
senses.usage_zomi: Kilamdanna tawmno khat zong thupi ciangin exact kizang hi. Thu theihna in a dik sitset lo napi a nai bek ahih ciangin approximate kizang hi.

senses.heading: Precisely
senses.definition_en: In a completely correct or precise way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a dik sitset in; a kician sitset in
senses.explanation_zomi: A dik sitset in, a kician sitset in, kilamdanna om het lo in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please follow the instructions exactly.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna om bangin a dik sitset in zui in.

examples.english: The two pictures look exactly the same.
examples.zomi: Tua lim nihte a kibang sitset in kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Exactly often emphasizes that there is no difference or uncertainty.
senses.usage_zomi: Exactly pen kilamdanna ahih kei leh lunghianna bangmah om lo cih khauhsakna in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Agreement or confirmation
senses.definition_en: Used to show that someone’s statement is completely correct.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a dik sitset hi; tua mah ahi hi
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat genna a dik sitset hi cihna leh amah tawh ngaihsutna kibang cihna pulakna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: That is exactly what I mean.
common_phrases.zomi: Ka cihnopna tua mah ahi hi.

examples.english: “So we need more time?” “Exactly.”
examples.zomi: “Tua ahih leh hun tampizaw kisam hiam?” “Tua mah ahi hi.”

examples.english: That is exactly why I called you.
examples.zomi: Tua mah hangin kong phone hi.

senses.usage_en: In conversation, Exactly! can be a strong way of agreeing with another person.
senses.usage_zomi: Kihoupihna sungah Exactly! cih pen midang genna tawh a ki thukim mahmah cih pulakna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A formal test of a person’s knowledge, skill, or ability.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pilna, siamna ahih kei leh hihtheihna tehna dingin a kibawl sittelna ahi hi.

examples.english: I have an English exam tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zingciang English sittelna ka nei hi.

examples.english: She studied hard and passed the exam.
examples.zomi: Amah kuhkal takin sinna nei a, sittelna paltawh hi.

senses.usage_en: Exam is the shortened form of examination. In American English, students usually take an exam; in British English, they may also sit an exam.
senses.usage_zomi: Exam pen examination a tomlakna ahi hi. American English ah sangnaupang in exam “take” ci uh a, British English ah “sit” zong ci thei uh hi.

senses.heading: Formal test
senses.definition_en: A formal test of someone’s knowledge, skill, or ability.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pilna, siamna ahih kei leh hihtheihna a kicing takin tehna sittelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The final examination will begin on Monday.
examples.zomi: A nunung sittelna Monday ni in kipan ding hi.

examples.english: Students are waiting for their examination results.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in amau sittelna ngahna ngak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In education, examination is more formal than its shortened form, exam.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna lamah examination pen a tomlakna exam sangin formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: Careful inspection
senses.definition_en: The act of looking at or testing someone or something carefully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat omzia theihna dingin kician takin enna leh sittelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor performed a careful examination of the patient.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in cina pa pilvang takin sittel hi.

examples.english: A closer examination revealed a small crack.
examples.zomi: A nai zawin kician takin en ciangin a kehna tawmno khat kimukha hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether examination means an academic test or a careful inspection.
senses.usage_zomi: Examination in sang sittelna maw, kician takin enna maw cih pen a kizangna thu tawh kithei hi.

senses.definition_en: To look at, consider, or test someone or something carefully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat omzia leh dinmun theihna dingin kician takin en, ngaihsun, ahih kei leh sittel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor examined my injured arm.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ka liam khut kician takin hong sittel hi.

examples.english: The committee will examine the proposal before making a decision.
examples.zomi: Committee in khentatna bawlma in tua geelna kician takin en ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Examine means looking carefully to learn facts or find a problem. It is more deliberate than simply look at.
senses.usage_zomi: Examine cih pen thu maan theihna ahih kei leh buaina zonna dingin pilvang takin en cihna ahi hi. Look at cih sangin deihna kician tawh a thukzaw in enna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Something that illustrates an idea
senses.definition_en: A person, object, or situation that helps explain what a group or idea is like.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat telcian zawhna dingin a kibang omzia pulakna in zat mi, na, ahih kei leh dinmun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave an example to explain the rule.
examples.zomi: Sia in tua thukhun telciansakna dingin etsakna khat pia hi.

examples.english: Many fruits contain vitamin C; oranges, for example, contain a lot.
examples.zomi: Theigah tampi in vitamin C nei a, gentehna in, sunkit sungah tampi om hi.

senses.usage_en: For example introduces one or more members of a larger group; it does not mean that the list is complete.
senses.usage_zomi: For example pen pawlkhat sungpan etsakna khat ahih kei leh tamlo khat pulakna ahi a, a vekpi list cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Model to follow
senses.definition_en: A person or action that other people should imitate.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte in zuih ding leh etteh ding a hoih mi ahih kei leh gamtatna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Parents should set a good example for their children.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pate in amau tate etteh ding hoih lak ding uh hi.

examples.english: Her courage is an example to us all.
examples.zomi: Ama hangsanna eite khempeuh etteh ding ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: When example refers to behavior, it can be positive or negative; the surrounding words show which meaning is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Example in gamtatna a gen ciangin hoihna zong, siatna zong hi thei hi. A kimkot thu in bangci etsakna hiam cih hong lak hi.

senses.definition_en: Extremely good or of very high quality.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a hoih mahmah; a hoihna sang
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoih mahmah, a pianzia leh a hoihna sang mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You did an excellent job on this report.
examples.zomi: Hih report na bawlna ah nasep hoih mahmah na sem hi.

examples.english: The restaurant provides excellent service.
examples.zomi: Tua ankuang inn in nasemna hoih mahmah pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Excellent is stronger than good and expresses very high approval.
senses.usage_zomi: Excellent in good sangin hoihna sangzaw pulak a, lungkimna lianpi genna in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Not including a particular person or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat huam lo in, tua bek koihkhia in cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: tui lo na dang om lo

examples.english: Everyone attended the meeting except John.
examples.zomi: John lo mi khempeuh meeting ah pai uh hi.

examples.english: The store is open every day except Sunday.
examples.zomi: Sunday lo ni khempeuh tua dawr kihong hi.

senses.usage_en: Except excludes someone or something. Do not confuse it with accept, which means receiving or agreeing to something.
senses.usage_zomi: Except in mi ahih kei leh na khat huam lo cihna ahi hi. Na khat sang ahih kei leh thukim cihna accept tawh khial lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Giving one thing and receiving another
senses.definition_en: The act of giving something and receiving something else in return.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat pia a, a thuk in na dang khat sangkikna ahih kei leh na nih khekna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two families had an exchange of gifts.
examples.zomi: Tua innkuan nihte letsong kikheng uh hi.

examples.english: He offered food in exchange for help.
examples.zomi: Panpihna a ngah thuk in an pia hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern in exchange for means receiving or giving one thing as the return for another.
senses.usage_zomi: In exchange for cih pen na khat piak thuk ah na dang khat ngah, ahih kei leh na khat ngah thuk ah na dang khat pia cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Communication between people
senses.definition_en: A conversation or series of messages between people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nih ahih kei leh mi tampi kikal ah thu kigenkhawmna, kikhakna, ahih kei leh ngaihsutna kikhenkhawmna ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting included a useful exchange of ideas.
examples.zomi: Tua meeting sungah phattuam ngaihsutna kikhenkhawmna om hi.

examples.english: They had a brief exchange before the class began.
examples.zomi: Class kipatma in amaute tomno kihoupih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, exchange describes information or words moving in both directions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah exchange in thu ahih kei leh kammal a langnih in kikheng cihna pulak hi.

senses.definition_en: Feeling very happy, interested, and eager because something good is happening or expected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu hoih khat a piang ahih kei leh piang ding cih lametna hangin lungdam, lunglawng, leh ngaklah mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children are excited about the school trip.
examples.zomi: Naupangte sang khualzinna ding lunglawng mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: I am excited to meet the new students.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang thakte muh ding ka ngaklah mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: A person is excited; an event or experience is exciting.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat lungsim omzia genin excited kizang a, tua lungsim piangsak na ahih kei leh thu genin exciting kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A strong feeling of happiness, interest, and eagerness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu hoih khat hangin a piang lungdamna, lunglawngna leh ngaklahna lianpi ahi hi.

examples.english: The children shouted with excitement when the bus arrived.
examples.zomi: Bus hong tun ciangin naupangte lunglawngna tawh kikou uh hi.

examples.english: There was great excitement before the final game.
examples.zomi: A nunung kimawhna ma in lunglawngna lianpi om hi.

senses.usage_en: Excitement is usually uncountable when it names the feeling itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Excitement in lungsim sung lunglawngna a gen ciangin simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Causing strong feelings of happiness, interest, or eagerness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lunglamsak, lunglawngsak, ahih kei leh ngaklahsak thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: It was an exciting game from beginning to end.
examples.zomi: A kipatna pan a tawp dong kimawhna lunglawnghuai khat ahi hi.

examples.english: We heard exciting news about the project.
examples.zomi: Tua project tawh kisai lunglawnghuai thuthak ka za uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use exciting for the person, event, or thing that causes excitement. Use excited for the person who feels it.
senses.usage_zomi: Lunglawngna piangsak mi, thu, ahih kei leh na genin exciting kizang hi. Tua lunglawngna a nei mi genin excited kizang hi.

senses.heading: Reason given to explain a fault
senses.definition_en: A reason given to explain why someone did something wrong or failed to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a khialhna ahih kei leh a sep lohna hang a hilhcian dingin a gen thu ahi hi.

examples.english: He made an excuse for arriving late.
examples.zomi: A hong tun manlate hang paulam bawl hi.

examples.english: There is no excuse for treating people cruelly.
examples.zomi: Mi ngongtat takin bawlna ding paulam om lo hi.

senses.usage_en: An excuse may be a genuine explanation, but the word often suggests that the reason is weak or dishonest.
senses.usage_zomi: Excuse pen hang maan khat zong hi thei napi, a tamzaw in paulam kicing lo ahih kei leh maan lo cih ngaihsutna nei hi.

senses.heading: Permission not to do something
senses.definition_en: Permission to be absent from a duty or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhpuakna ahih kei leh nasep khat pan omloh theihna ding phalna ahi hi.

examples.english: She received an excuse from physical education because of her injury.
examples.zomi: A liamna hangin pumpi kimawhna class pan omloh phalna ngah hi.

examples.english: Students need a written excuse for an absence.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte a om loh uh leh laikhak tawh omloh hang hilhcian kul hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, an excuse officially releases someone from an obligation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah excuse in mi khat a mawhpuakna pan hun tomno sung suahtakna phalna pia cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person with an important management position in a business or organization.
senses.zomi_equivalents: makai lian; ukna mawhpuakna nei mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Company ahih kei leh kipawlna khat sungah makaihna leh khentatna mawhpuakna lianpi nei mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The company hired a new executive to lead the department.
examples.zomi: Company in department makaih ding makai thak khat la hi.

examples.english: Senior executives approved the new plan.
examples.zomi: Makai liante in geelna thak pom uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An executive usually has authority to make important decisions. It does not refer to every office worker.
senses.usage_zomi: Executive in khentatna thupi bawltheihna nei makai khat gen hi. Office a nasem mi khempeuh genna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Physical activity
senses.definition_en: Physical activity done to improve health, strength, or fitness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cidamna, thahatna leh pumpi hoihna khangsak dingin pumpi tawh a kibawl kimawhna ahi hi.

examples.english: Regular exercise can improve your health.
examples.zomi: Tawntung pumpi kimawhna in na cidamna hoihsak thei hi.

examples.english: Walking is a simple form of exercise.
examples.zomi: Khe tawh paihna pen pumpi kimawhna baihlam khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, people commonly say exercise or get exercise. Do exercises often means performing particular repeated movements.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah pumpi kimawhna genin exercise ahih kei leh get exercise kici zel hi. Do exercises cih in a tamzaw in pumpi gamtatna tuamtuam a kibawl kikkik gen hi.

senses.heading: Learning activity
senses.definition_en: A task used to practice or test a skill.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siamna khat kizilsak, kibawlkhia, ahih kei leh kisittelna dingin a piak nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: Complete the exercise at the bottom of the page.
examples.zomi: Laimai nuaia zilna nasep zosiang in.

examples.english: The teacher gave us a vocabulary exercise.
examples.zomi: Sia in kammal zilna nasep hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A learning exercise is a task for practice; an exam formally measures knowledge or ability.
senses.usage_zomi: Zilna exercise pen kisinsakna ding nasep ahi a, exam ahih leh pilna ahih kei leh hihtheihna a thukhun tawh tehna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A public event at which works of art, products, skills, or other objects are displayed.
senses.zomi_equivalents: na lahna; mipi et ding lahna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi in en theihna dingin khutkhatna, sumlehpai tawh kisai na, siamtheihna, ahih kei leh na tuamtuam a kilahna hun leh mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The museum is holding an exhibition of local art.
examples.zomi: Museum in khuami khutkhatna lahna nei hi.

examples.english: Many companies displayed their products at the exhibition.
examples.zomi: Company tampi in lahna ah amau vanbawlte lak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An exhibition focuses on displaying things publicly. A show can have a broader meaning and may include a performance.
senses.usage_zomi: Exhibition pen mipi et dingin na-te lahna tungah a kinga hi. Show ahih leh khiatna zaizaw nei a, la, lam ahih kei leh gamtatna lakna zong huam thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To be real, to be present, or to continue living.
senses.explanation_zomi: A maan takin om, mun khat ah om, ahih kei leh nungta tawntung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Some ancient traditions still exist today.
examples.zomi: Tanglai ngeina pawlkhat tuni dong omlai hi.

examples.english: Scientists are studying whether life exists on other planets.
examples.zomi: Planet dangte ah nuntakna om hiam cih science siamte in sinna nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Exist does not normally take a direct object. Say “The problem exists,” not “They exist the problem.”
senses.usage_zomi: Exist pen direct object tawh kizang selo hi. “The problem exists” ci ding a, “They exist the problem” ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The state or fact of being real, present, or alive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a maan takin om, piangsa in om, ahih kei leh nungta cih dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: Scientists continue to search for evidence of life’s existence on other planets.
examples.zomi: Science siamte in planet dangte ah nuntakna om cih teci zong paisuak uh hi.

examples.english: The organization has been in existence for twenty years.
examples.zomi: Tua kipawlna kum sawmnih sung omta hi.

senses.usage_en: Existence is normally uncountable. The expression come into existence means to begin to exist.
senses.usage_zomi: Existence pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi. Come into existence cih in hong piang kipan ahih kei leh hong om kipan cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Become or make larger
senses.definition_en: To become larger, or to make something larger in size, amount, or range.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lianzaw, a tamzaw, ahih kei leh a zaizaw in khang; na khat tua bangin khangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company plans to expand its business next year.
examples.zomi: Company in kumkik ciangin ama sumdawnna khangsak dingin geel hi.

examples.english: Metal expands when it is heated.
examples.zomi: Sik a kisa ciangin a zai semsem hi.

senses.usage_en: Expand can be transitive or intransitive: a company can expand its services, or its services can simply expand.
senses.usage_zomi: Expand pen object tawh zong, object om lo in zong kizang thei hi. Company in ama nasemna “expand” thei a, nasemna amah zong “expand” thei hi.

senses.heading: Add more detail
senses.definition_en: To give more information or explain an idea more fully.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thu behlap; a kicingzaw in hilhcian
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat telcian zawhna dingin thu theihna behlap a, a kicingzaw in hilhcian cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Could you expand on your main argument?
examples.zomi: Na thu kicianpen tua a kicingzaw in nong hilhcian thei diam?

examples.english: The writer expanded the final section of the report.
examples.zomi: Laigelpa in report a nunung khen zaizaw in gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use expand on when asking someone to provide further details about a statement or idea.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat in a gen thu ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat thu behlap tawh hilhcian ding a deih ciangin expand on kizang hi.

senses.heading: Think something will happen
senses.definition_en: To believe that something will probably happen or that someone will probably do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat piang ding ahih kei leh mi khat in na khat bawl ding hi ci in um leh ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat hong tung dingin lam-en

examples.english: We expect the rain to stop this afternoon.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitaklam ciangin guah tawl dingin ka um uh hi.

examples.english: I expect her to arrive before noon.
examples.zomi: Sunma in amah hong tung dingin ka lam-en hi.

senses.usage_en: Use expect someone to do something, not expect that someone to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Expect tawh mi khat gamtatna gen ciangin expect someone to do something kici a, expect that someone to do something kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Require as normal or proper
senses.definition_en: To require someone to do what is considered necessary or reasonable.
senses.zomi_equivalents: bawl dingin ngen; bawl dingin lam-en
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a kul leh a kilawm bangin na khat bawl dingin ngen ahih kei leh lam-en cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Teachers expect students to complete their work on time.
examples.zomi: Siate in sangnaupangte amau nasep hun ciangin zosiang dingin lam-en uh hi.

examples.english: You cannot expect others to solve every problem for you.
examples.zomi: Midangte in nang adingin buaina khempeuh hong siansuah ding ci in na lam-en thei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, expect expresses a standard or requirement, not merely a prediction.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah expect in mailam thu guess mawkna hilo a, zuih ding thukhun ahih kei leh bawl ding a kilawm na pulak hi.

senses.heading: Belief about the future
senses.definition_en: A belief that something will happen or that someone will act in a particular way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat piang ding ahih kei leh mi khat tua bangin gamta ding hi ci in a lam-etna ahi hi.

examples.english: The results were better than our expectations.
examples.zomi: Ngahna pen ka lam-et uh sangin hoihzaw hi.

examples.english: She has high expectations for her children.
examples.zomi: Amah in ama tate tungah lam-etna sang nei hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural expectations often refers to standards that people believe should be met.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural expectations in mite in zuih ding ahih kei leh tangtun dingin a ngaihsut thukhun leh dinmunte gen zel hi.

senses.heading: State of expecting something good
senses.definition_en: A feeling of hope or eagerness about something that may happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu hoih khat hong piang ding cih lunggulhna leh ngaklahna ahi hi.

examples.english: The crowd waited in expectation for the winner’s name.
examples.zomi: Mipi in gualzo min zak ding lam-etna tawh ngak uh hi.

examples.english: There was a feeling of expectation before the announcement.
examples.zomi: Thupuak kipulakma in ngaklahna lungsim om hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether expectation means a belief, a required standard, or hopeful anticipation.
senses.usage_zomi: Expectation in upna, zuih ding dinmun, ahih kei leh lunggulhna gen hiam cih pen a kizangna thu tawh kithei hi.

senses.definition_en: Believed or considered likely to happen.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kilam-ensa; piang ding a ki-umsa
senses.explanation_zomi: Piang ding hi ci in a ki-umsa, a kilam-ensa ahih kei leh piang dingin a kilawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The package arrived earlier than expected.
examples.zomi: Van tuam pen ka lam-et sangin hong tung manlangzaw hi.

examples.english: The expected cost of the project is ten thousand dollars.
examples.zomi: Project ading ki-ngaihsutsa sum zat ding dollar tul sawm ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Expected describes something predicted or regarded as normal. It does not always mean that the event is certain.
senses.usage_zomi: Expected in thu khat piang dingin kilam-en ahih kei leh piang ding a kilawm cih pulak hi. Tua thu a piang taktak ding kipsakna ahih pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: An organized journey made for exploration, research, or a special purpose.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kancian khualzinna; ngiimna tuam nei khualzinna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat kancian, sinna nei, ahih kei leh ngiimna tuam khat tangtung dingin a kizem khualzinna ahi hi.

examples.english: The scientists joined an expedition to the Arctic.
examples.zomi: Science siamte Arctic gam kancian khualzinna ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: The expedition spent three weeks in the mountains.
examples.zomi: Khualzin pawl in mualte ah kal thum sung om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An expedition is normally carefully planned and has a clear purpose. It is more than an ordinary trip.
senses.usage_zomi: Expedition pen limtak a kigeel a, ngiimna kician nei khualzinna ahi hi. Khualzinna mawk khat sangin a thupi leh a kizek khualzinna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Money that is spent or must be spent for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna khat ading a kizang ahih kei leh zat kul sum ahi hi.

examples.english: The company paid all of her travel expenses.
examples.zomi: Company in ama khualzinna sum zat khempeuh pia hi.

examples.english: Rent is our largest monthly expense.
examples.zomi: Innluah pen kha sima ka sum zatna lianpen uh ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Expense is countable when it means a particular cost. Expenses often refers to several costs connected with work, travel, or daily living.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum zatna khat cimawh gen ciangin expense pen simtheih noun ahi hi. Expenses in nasep, khualzinna, ahih kei leh nisim nuntakna tawh kisai sum zat tuamtuam gen zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Costing a lot of money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei ding, luah ding, ahih kei leh zang dingin sum tampi kisam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: That restaurant is too expensive for us.
examples.zomi: Tua ankuang inn keiuh adingin man sang lua hi.

examples.english: Electric cars can be expensive to repair.
examples.zomi: Electric mawtawte bawlphatna manpha thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A thing is expensive, but its price is high. Do not normally say “an expensive price.”
senses.usage_zomi: Van khat expensive kici a, a man ahih leh high kici hi. “An expensive price” ci in kizang ngeilo zaw hi.

senses.heading: Knowledge gained through doing something
senses.definition_en: Knowledge or skill gained by doing, seeing, or feeling something over time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: theihsa; muhsa leh thuaksa pan siamna
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, muhsa, thuaksa, leh nuntakna sung gamtatna pan a kimu theihna leh siamna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has ten years of teaching experience.
examples.zomi: Amah kum sawm sung laihilhnasep theihsa nei hi.

examples.english: Young workers need opportunities to gain experience.
examples.zomi: Nasem thakte in nasep theihsa leh siamna khangtheihna hunhoih kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Experience is usually uncountable when it means accumulated knowledge or skill. Say “She has experience,” not “She has an experience.”
senses.usage_zomi: Theihsa leh siamna kikhawm gen ciangin experience pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi. “She has experience” ci ding a, “She has an experience” ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Event that happens to someone
senses.definition_en: An event or situation that someone lives through and remembers.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a kimakaihkhia, a thuak, ahih kei leh a muhkhak a phawkden nuntakna thu khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Visiting the village was an unforgettable experience.
examples.zomi: Tua khua vehna pen mangngilh theih loh thuakna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: He wrote about his experiences during the war.
examples.zomi: Amah in gal laitaka a thuaksa thu-te gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: Experience is countable when it means a particular event: an experience or several experiences.
senses.usage_zomi: Tunga a piang thu tuam khat gen ciangin experience pen simtheih noun ahi a, an experience ahih kei leh several experiences ci in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Having substantial knowledge or skill gained through practice over time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun saupi sung sem a, a muhsa leh a thuaksa pan theihna leh siamna tampi nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We need an experienced driver for this journey.
examples.zomi: Hih khualzinna ding mawtaw hawlna theihsa tampi nei mi ka kisam uh hi.

examples.english: She is experienced in caring for older people.
examples.zomi: Amah upate kemna lam theihsa tampi nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use experienced in before an activity or field, and experienced at before an activity expressed with an -ing form.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep lam ahih kei leh pilna lam khat ma in experienced in kizang hi. -ing tawh kipan gamtatna ma in experienced at zong kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A scientific test performed to discover, demonstrate, or examine something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat maan hiam, koibangin nasem hiam cih muhkhiatna dingin science thukhun tawh a kibawl sittelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The students conducted an experiment with water and salt.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in tui leh ci tawh science sittelna bawl uh hi.

examples.english: The experiment showed that plants need light.
examples.zomi: Tua sittelna in singkungte khuavak kisam cih lak hi.

senses.usage_en: An experiment tests an idea under planned conditions. An experience is something a person lives through or knowledge gained from doing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Experiment pen a kigeel dinmun sungah ngaihsutna khat sittelna ahi hi. Experience ahih leh mi khat thuaksa, muhsa, ahih kei leh tua pan a ngah theihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who has a high level of knowledge or skill in a particular subject or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna lam ahih kei leh nasep lam khat ah theihna leh siamna sang mahmah nei mi ahi hi.

examples.english: You should ask a financial expert before investing.
examples.zomi: Sum na koihma in sumlehpai siampa khat na dong ding hi.

examples.english: She is an expert in computer security.
examples.zomi: Amah computer bitna lam siampa khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an expert in/on a subject and an expert at an activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna thu khat gen ciangin an expert in ahih kei leh an expert on kizang hi. Gamtatna khat gen ciangin an expert at kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: To make something clear or easy to understand by giving information or reasons.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat telcian theihna dingin a khiatna, a hang, leh a kicing thu theihna pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher explained the rule clearly.
examples.zomi: Sia in tua thukhun kician takin hilhcian hi.

examples.english: Can you explain why the meeting was canceled?
examples.zomi: Banghangin meeting kikhawl hiam nong hilhcian thei diam?

senses.usage_en: Say explain something to someone, not explain someone something.
senses.usage_zomi: Explain tawh thu khat mi khat tungah hilhcian cih gen ciangin explain something to someone kici a, explain someone something kici lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A statement or account that makes something clear by describing its meaning, cause, or operation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat telciansakna dingin a khiatna, a hang, ahih kei leh koibangin nasem hiam cih a genna ahi hi.

examples.english: The guide gave a clear explanation of the process.
examples.zomi: Lampipa in tua nasepzia kician takin hilhcian hi.

examples.english: There may be a simple explanation for the mistake.
examples.zomi: Tua khialhna ading hilhcianna baihlam khat om thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an explanation of a subject, but an explanation for an event, action, or problem.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu khat khiatna gen ciangin an explanation of kizang hi. A piang thu, gamtatna, ahih kei leh buaina khat a hang gen ciangin an explanation for kizang hi.

senses.heading: Burst violently
senses.definition_en: To burst with great force, heat, noise, and rapidly expanding gas.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thahatna lianpi, sa, ging leh huih tawh puakkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The gas tank exploded during the fire.
examples.zomi: Meikuang laitakin gas thunbel puak hi.

examples.english: Police safely destroyed the device before it could explode.
examples.zomi: Tua van a puahma in police-te in bit takin susia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Explode may be intransitive (the bomb exploded) or transitive (the heat exploded the container), although the intransitive use is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Explode pen object om lo in zatzaw hi: the bomb exploded. Na khat in na dang puaksak cihna in object tawh zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Increase suddenly
senses.definition_en: To increase very quickly in number, size, or intensity.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thakhat in khang; manlang takin pung
senses.explanation_zomi: A zat, a lianzia, ahih kei leh a thahatzia thakhat in khang mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Demand for the product exploded after the advertisement.
examples.zomi: Advertisement khit ciangin tua van deihna manlang takin khang hi.

examples.english: The city’s population has exploded in recent years.
examples.zomi: Kum tawmno sungin khuapi mihing zat manlang takin pung hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes an unusually fast and dramatic increase.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in na khat a manlang leh a lian mahmah in khang cih pulak hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity of traveling through, examining, or studying an unfamiliar place or subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun theih ngeiloh khat vak a, en a, kancian; ahih kei leh thu theih ngeiloh khat sinna nei cih gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Space exploration has increased our knowledge of the universe.
examples.zomi: Vanlai kancianna in vannuai tawh kisai eite theihna khangsak hi.

examples.english: The team began its exploration of the cave.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl in lungkua kancianna kipan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Exploration can describe physical travel or a detailed study of an idea or subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Exploration in mun khat vakna bek hilo a, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh pilna thu khat a thuk takin sinna zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Travel through and examine a place
senses.definition_en: To travel through an unfamiliar place to learn about it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun theih ngeiloh ah pai a, tua mun tawh kisai theihna ngah dingin vak leh kancian cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We spent the afternoon exploring the old city.
examples.zomi: Nitaklam sung khuapi lui ka vak uh hi.

examples.english: Scientists use robots to explore distant planets.
examples.zomi: Science siamte in planet gamlaite kancian dingin robot zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Explore implies looking around carefully to discover or learn, not merely passing through a place.
senses.usage_zomi: Explore in mun khat kantan mawk hilo a, thu thak muh leh sinna dingin kician takin vak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Examine an idea or possibility
senses.definition_en: To consider or study a subject, idea, or possibility carefully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, ngaihsutna, ahih kei leh hihtheihna khat kician takin ngaihsun leh kancian cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee is exploring several possible solutions.
examples.zomi: Committee in siansuahna hihtheih tuamtuam kancian hi.

examples.english: The book explores the causes of poverty.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu in zawngkhalna pianna hangte kancian hi.

senses.usage_en: In academic and professional English, explore often means examining a subject without assuming the answer in advance.
senses.usage_zomi: Sangpilna leh nasep lam English ah explore cih pen dawnna khensat khol lo in thu khat kancian cihna in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Violent bursting
senses.definition_en: A sudden violent burst that produces heat, noise, pressure, and rapidly expanding gas.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sa, ging, thahatna leh huih tawh thakhat in a piang puahna ahi hi.

examples.english: The explosion damaged several buildings.
examples.zomi: Tua puahna in inn tampi susia hi.

examples.english: People heard a loud explosion near the factory.
examples.zomi: Mite in vanbawlna inn kiangah puah ging lian za uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Explosion names the event; explode is the corresponding verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Explosion pen a piang puahna min ahi a, explode pen tua gamtatna gen verb ahi hi.

senses.heading: Sudden rapid increase
senses.definition_en: A sudden and very large increase in something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thakhat in khanna; manlang takin pungna
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat zat ahih kei leh a lianzia thakhat in manlang takin a khanna ahi hi.

examples.english: The city experienced a population explosion.
examples.zomi: Tua khuapi ah mihing zat manlang takin pung hi.

examples.english: There has been an explosion in online shopping.
examples.zomi: Internet tung sumleina manlang takin khang hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense emphasizes both speed and large scale.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in manlang tak leh a lianpi in khang cih tegel khauhsak hi.

senses.heading: Product sold to another country
senses.definition_en: A product or service sold and sent to another country.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gam dangah zuak van; pusuah van
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam dangah zuak dingin a kikhak van ahih kei leh nasemna ahi hi.

examples.english: Rice is one of the country’s main exports.
examples.zomi: Buh pen tua gam pusuah van thupite lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The value of agricultural exports increased last year.
examples.zomi: Kumkhat in lousuah pusuah vante man khang hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun export is stressed on the first syllable: /ˈɛkspɔrt/. The verb is usually stressed on the second: /ɪkˈspɔrt/.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun export ah aw kikhauhsakna pen syllable masa tungah om hi: /ˈɛkspɔrt/. Verb ahih leh a nihna tungah om zel hi: /ɪkˈspɔrt/.

senses.heading: Business of selling abroad
senses.definition_en: The activity of selling and sending goods or services to another country.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van ahih kei leh nasemna gam dangah zuak leh khak cih sumdawnna ahi hi.

examples.english: These products are made for export.
examples.zomi: Hih vante gamdang zuak dingin kibawl hi.

examples.english: The economy depends heavily on export.
examples.zomi: Tua gam sumlehpai dinmun in gamdang zuakna tungah kinga mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring generally to the activity, export may be uncountable. Individual products sent abroad are commonly called exports.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna a gen ciangin export pen simtheih loh noun hi thei hi. Gam dangah a kikhak van tuamtuamte ahih leh exports kici zel hi.

senses.heading: Leave unprotected or subject to something
senses.definition_en: To leave someone or something without protection from danger, weather, or a harmful influence.
senses.zomi_equivalents: dalna om lo in koih; kimaihsak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat lauhuaina, nisa, guah, khuadap, ahih kei leh siatna pan dalna om lo in koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not expose the medicine to direct sunlight.
examples.zomi: Tua zatui nisa a kituhna ah koih kei in.

examples.english: The job exposed workers to dangerous chemicals.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep in nasemte chemical lauhuai tawh kituahsak hi.

senses.usage_en: The common pattern is expose someone or something to something.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizang ngeina pen expose someone or something to something ahi a, mi ahih kei leh na khat dinmun khat tawh kimaihsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Reveal something hidden or wrong
senses.definition_en: To make a hidden fact, secret, or wrongdoing publicly known.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kiseel thu, thusim, ahih kei leh gamtat khialhna mipi theih dingin lak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The investigation exposed serious corruption.
examples.zomi: Tua kancianna in sum zatkhialhna lianpi pholak hi.

examples.english: The report exposed weaknesses in the system.
examples.zomi: Tua report in system sung a thanemna-te pulak hi.

senses.usage_en: Expose often suggests revealing something that another person wanted to keep hidden.
senses.usage_zomi: Expose in mi khat in seel nuam thu a kihongkhia ahih kei leh a kipholak cih ngaihsutna nei zel hi.

senses.definition_en: To communicate a thought, feeling, or opinion through words, actions, art, or another form.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, lungsim omzia, ahih kei leh muhna kammal, gamtatna, khutkhatna, ahih kei leh lampi dang tawh pulak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She expressed her concerns during the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting laitakin ama lunghihmawhna pulak hi.

examples.english: Music can express feelings that are difficult to describe.
examples.zomi: La in genhak lungsim omzia-te pulak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Express focuses on communicating something that is inside a person’s mind or feelings.
senses.usage_zomi: Express in mi khat lungsim sung ngaihsutna ahih kei leh lungsim omzia a pualam ah pulak cihna tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: Communication of thoughts or feelings
senses.definition_en: The act or manner of communicating a thought, feeling, or opinion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, lungsim omzia, ahih kei leh muhna pulakna leh a pulakdan ahi hi.

examples.english: The painting is an expression of the artist’s grief.
examples.zomi: Tua lim pen khutkhat siampa dahna pulakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Freedom of expression is protected by law.
examples.zomi: Ngaihsutna suahtak takin pulaktheihna pen thukham in dal hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, expression refers to the act or form of communicating an inner thought or feeling.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah expression in lungsim sung thu ahih kei leh ngaihsutna pulakkhiatna gen hi.

senses.heading: Look on a person’s face
senses.definition_en: A look on someone’s face that shows a feeling or thought.
senses.zomi_equivalents: maitang meel; maitang ah lungsim kilahna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat maitang ah a lungsim omzia ahih kei leh ngaihsutna a kilahna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her expression changed when she heard the news.
examples.zomi: Tua thuthak a zak ciangin ama maitang meel kikhel hi.

examples.english: He had a confused expression on his face.
examples.zomi: Ama maitang ah telcianlohna kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: A facial expression may communicate emotion without words.
senses.usage_zomi: Mautang expression in kammal zang lo in lungsim omzia pulak thei hi.

senses.heading: Word or phrase
senses.definition_en: A word or phrase used to communicate a particular meaning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khiatna tuam khat pulakna dingin a kizang kammal ahih kei leh kammal pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: “Take care” is a common English expression.
examples.zomi: “Take care” pen English kammal zatdan kizang ngei khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The expression has a different meaning in this context.
examples.zomi: Hih thu sungah tua kammal in khiatna tuam nei hi.

senses.usage_en: An expression may contain one word or several words whose combined meaning is important.
senses.usage_zomi: Expression pen kammal khat bek zong hi thei a, a kigawm khiatna thupi kammal tampi zong hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Make longer or larger
senses.definition_en: To make something longer in distance, time, or range.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a sauzaw, a sawtzaw, ahih kei leh a zaizaw in bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The school extended the application deadline by one week.
examples.zomi: Sang in lai-ap hun ciangtan kal khat sawtsak hi.

examples.english: The city plans to extend the road to the airport.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in lampi vanleng ngakna mun dong sautsak dingin geel hi.

senses.usage_en: The kind of lengthening depends on context: distance may be made longer, time may be prolonged, and a service may be broadened.
senses.usage_zomi: Bang a kisawtsak hiam cih pen thu tawh kithei hi. Lampi sautsak theih a, hun sawtsak theih a, nasemna zong zaizaw sak theih hi.

senses.heading: Reach or continue over an area or period
senses.definition_en: To reach, continue, or stretch across a particular distance, area, or period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamla khat, mun khat, ahih kei leh hun khat dong pha ahih kei leh paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The forest extends across three states.
examples.zomi: Tua gamlak state thum sungah kizai hi.

examples.english: The project may extend into next year.
examples.zomi: Tua project kumkik dong paisuak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, extend is intransitive and describes how far something reaches.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah extend pen object om lo in kizang a, na khat koibang tan pha hiam cih gen hi.

senses.heading: Offer or give
senses.definition_en: To formally offer or give something to someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tungah panpihna, phalna, sapna, ahih kei leh thumanna kipiak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We extend our sincere thanks to all the volunteers.
examples.zomi: Volunteer khempeuh tungah lungsim takpi tawh lungdam ka ko uh hi.

examples.english: The organization extended help to the affected families.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in a thuak innkuante tungah panpihna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is formal and commonly appears with nouns such as help, thanks, welcome, and invitation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen formal zaw a, help, thanks, welcome, leh invitation bang noun-te tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: The size, degree, range, or importance of something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a pha tan; a lianzia; a zah
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bangzah lian, bangzah khauh, koibang tan pha, ahih kei leh bangzah thupi hiam cih a tehna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a tamzaw dong; a lianpi in

examples.english: I agree with you to some extent.
examples.zomi: Zah khat dong nang tawh ka thukim hi.

examples.english: We did not understand the full extent of the damage.
examples.zomi: Tua siatna bangzah lian hiam cih a kicingin ka tel kei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: To some extent means partly, while to a great extent means largely or mostly.
senses.usage_zomi: To some extent cih in khenkhat bek ahih kei leh zah khat dong cihna ahi hi. To a great extent cih in a lianpi in ahih kei leh a tamzaw cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: On or from the outside
senses.definition_en: Located on, connected with, or coming from the outside of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat pualam ah om, pualam tawh kisai, ahih kei leh pualam pan hong pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The building’s external walls need repair.
examples.zomi: Tua inn pualam kulhte bawlphat kul hi.

examples.english: The device was damaged by an external force.
examples.zomi: Tua van pen pualam pan thahatna khat in susia hi.

senses.usage_en: External is the opposite of internal.
senses.usage_zomi: External pen pualam tawh kisai cihna ahi a, a lehbulh internal in sunglam tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: From outside an organization or system
senses.definition_en: Coming from or involving people or organizations outside a particular group or system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl ahih kei leh system khat sungmi hilo, pualam pan hong pai ahih kei leh pualam mi tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee asked an external expert to review the report.
examples.zomi: Committee in report entel dingin pawl pualam siampa khat ngen hi.

examples.english: The project depends on external funding.
examples.zomi: Tua project in pualam pan sum panpihna kinga hi.

senses.usage_en: In organizations, external distinguishes outside people or resources from those belonging to the organization itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Kipawlna sungah external in pawl sungmi leh pawl neih na-te pan pualam mi ahih kei leh sumlehpai kikhen hi.

senses.definition_en: More than the usual, expected, or necessary amount.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngei, a kilam-et, ahih kei leh a kisap zah sangin a behlap cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We need extra time to finish the project.
examples.zomi: Tua project zosiang dingin hun behlap ka kisam uh hi.

examples.english: She brought an extra chair for the guest.
examples.zomi: Mikhual ading tokhum behlap khat hong paipih hi.

senses.usage_en: Extra normally comes before a noun. It indicates an additional amount, not necessarily something unusual.
senses.usage_zomi: Extra pen noun maiah kizang zel a, a omlai tungah na dang khat behlap cihna ahi hi. Lamdang cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Very unusual, remarkable, or much greater than normal.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina tawh a kibang lo, a lamdang mahmah, ahih kei leh a ngei sangin a lianzaw mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She showed extraordinary courage during the emergency.
examples.zomi: Emergency laitakin ama hangsanna lamdang mahmah lak hi.

examples.english: The team achieved extraordinary results with limited resources.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl in neihsa tawmno tawh ngahna lamdang mahmah ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Extraordinary is much stronger than unusual. It can describe something surprisingly good, serious, large, or strange.
senses.usage_zomi: Extraordinary in unusual sangin lamdanna khauhzaw pulak hi. A hoih lamdang, a thupi, a lian, ahih kei leh a ngeiloh thu gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Very great, severe, or far beyond what is normal or reasonable.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a khauh mahmah; a lian lua; ciangtan khengval
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina sangin a lian lua, a khauh lua, ahih kei leh ciangtan sawtpi khengval cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: People should avoid working outside in extreme heat.
examples.zomi: Khuasa mahmah ciangin mite pualam ah nasep lo ding uh hi.

examples.english: The family lives in extreme poverty.
examples.zomi: Tua innkuan zawngkhal mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Extreme describes the farthest or most severe degree. It should not be used merely to mean very in careful formal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Extreme in a khauhpen ahih kei leh a ciangtan khengval dinmun gen hi. Formal laigelhna ah very cihna mawk in zang lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: To a very great or unusually high degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lian mahmah in, a khauh mahmah in, ahih kei leh a ngeina sangin a sang mahmah in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The road becomes extremely dangerous during heavy rain.
examples.zomi: Guah tampi a zuah ciangin lampi lauhuai mahmah hi.

examples.english: This information is extremely important.
examples.zomi: Hih thu theihna thupi mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Extremely strongly increases the meaning of an adjective or adverb. It is stronger than very.
senses.usage_zomi: Extremely in adjective ahih kei leh adverb khiatna khauhsak mahmah hi. Very sangin a khauhzaw hi.

senses.heading: Organ of sight
senses.definition_en: Either of the two body organs used for seeing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing leh ganhing in muhna dingin a zat pumpi khen, mit nih lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Dust entered my left eye.
examples.zomi: Ka vei mit sungah leivui lut hi.

examples.english: You should have your eyes examined regularly.
examples.zomi: Hun ciangtan simin na mitte na sittel ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is eyes. English uses several expressions with eye, so learners should not always translate it literally.
senses.usage_zomi: A plural pen eyes ahi hi. English ah eye tawh gentehna kammal tampi om ahih manin kammal simbang in a khiatna khia pahpah lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Ability to notice or judge something
senses.definition_en: An ability to notice, recognize, or judge a particular quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hoihna, pianzia, ahih kei leh a tawmno dong muhkha leh tehsiamtheihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a good eye for color.
examples.zomi: Amah in color a kituak leh kituak lo tehsiam mahmah hi.

examples.english: Please keep an eye on my bag while I buy a ticket.
examples.zomi: Ticket ka lei sung ka dip hong kemcing in.

senses.usage_en: Have an eye for means having a natural ability to recognize quality. Keep an eye on means to watch or protect someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: Have an eye for in na khat hoihna leh pianzia tehsiamtheihna nei cihna ahi hi. Keep an eye on in mi ahih kei leh na khat en gige leh kemcing cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Front part of the head
senses.definition_en: The front part of a person’s head, including the eyes, nose, mouth, and cheeks.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lutang mai lam, mit, nak, kam leh biangte a omna khen ahi hi.

examples.english: She washed her face with cold water.
examples.zomi: Amah in tui vot tawh a maitang sil hi.

examples.english: A smile appeared on his face.
examples.zomi: Ama maitang ah nuihna hong kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Face usually means the physical front of the head. It can also describe the expression shown there.
senses.usage_zomi: Face in mihing lutang mai lam gen zel hi. Mi khat lungsim omzia a maitang ah a kilahna zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Front or outer surface
senses.definition_en: The front or main surface of an object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat mai lam ahih kei leh a pualam pan a kimuthei khen ahi hi.

examples.english: The clock has numbers around its face.
examples.zomi: Dakbi maitang kimkot ah nambatte om hi.

examples.english: Snow covered the northern face of the mountain.
examples.zomi: Mual saklam pang vuk in tuam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, face refers to the visible front or broad surface of something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah face in van khat a kimuthei mai lam ahih kei leh a zaizaw pualam meel gen hi.

senses.heading: Place or equipment provided for a purpose
senses.definition_en: A building, place, or equipment provided for a particular activity or service.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasemna mun; kisap vanzat nei mun
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih kei leh nasemna tuam khat ading a kibawl inn, mun, ahih kei leh vanzat ahi hi.

examples.english: The town needs a new medical facility.
examples.zomi: Tua khua in cidamna nasemna mun thak khat kisam hi.

examples.english: The hotel has excellent sports facilities.
examples.zomi: Tua hotel ah kimawhna mun leh vanzat hoih mahmah om hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural facilities often refers collectively to buildings, rooms, equipment, and services available at a place.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural facilities in mun khat ah kizangthei inn, khan, vanzat leh nasemna-te a vekin gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Special ability to do something easily
senses.definition_en: A natural or developed ability to do something skillfully and easily.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat baihlam leh siamna tawh bawltheihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a natural facility for learning languages.
examples.zomi: Amah pau sin baih mahmah hi.

examples.english: His facility with numbers makes him a strong accountant.
examples.zomi: Nambar zang siamna in amah accountant siam khat suaksak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is more formal and is commonly used in the pattern a facility for/with something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen formal zaw a, a facility for something ahih kei leh a facility with something ci in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Something that is known or proved to be true.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thu maan; a om taktak thu
senses.explanation_zomi: Maan hi ci in a kithei ahih kei leh teci tawh a kipsak thu ahi hi.

examples.english: It is a fact that water freezes at low temperatures.
examples.zomi: Khuavot mahmah ciangin tui khau cih thu maan ahi hi.

examples.english: Check the facts before sharing the story online.
examples.zomi: Internet tungah tua thu na hawpma in thu maante sittel in.

senses.usage_en: A fact can be checked and shown to be true. An opinion expresses what someone believes or thinks.
senses.usage_zomi: Fact pen kisittel thei a, maan hi ci in kipsak theih thu ahi hi. Opinion ahih leh mi khat upna ahih kei leh ngaihsutna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: One of several conditions, facts, or influences that help produce a result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngahna ahih kei leh piangna khat hong piangsak na-te lakah hang khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Cost was an important factor in our decision.
examples.zomi: Ka khentatna uh ah vanman pen hang thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Lack of sleep can be a factor in poor health.
examples.zomi: Ihmut kicing lohna in cidam lohna piangsakpih thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A factor usually works together with other conditions. It is not always the only cause of a result.
senses.usage_zomi: Factor pen hang dangte tawh nasemkhawm zel hi. Ngahna khat piangsak hang khatbek hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A building or group of buildings where goods are produced, usually with machines.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine leh vanzat tuamtuam zangin van a kibawlkhia inn ahih kei leh inn pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The factory produces electronic parts.
examples.zomi: Tua vanbawlna inn in electronic van khenneute bawl hi.

examples.english: Many local people work at the factory.
examples.zomi: Khuami tampi tua vanbawlna inn ah nasem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A factory normally produces physical goods. An office mainly provides administrative or professional services.
senses.usage_zomi: Factory ah van taktak kibawlkhia zel hi. Office ahih leh ukna, lai, ahih kei leh siamna nasep kisuakpih zaw hi.

senses.heading: Not succeed
senses.definition_en: To be unsuccessful in doing, achieving, or completing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl, tangtun, ahih kei leh zosiang zawlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The plan failed because there was not enough money.
examples.zomi: Sum kicing om lo ahih manin tua geelna tangtung lo hi.

examples.english: Do not be afraid to try again if you fail.
examples.zomi: Na gualleh zong kisin kik ding lau kei in.

senses.usage_en: Use fail to do something when someone does not perform an expected or necessary action.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat in a bawl ding na bawl lo ahih kei leh bawl zaw lo ciangin fail to do something kizang hi.

senses.heading: Not pass a test or course
senses.definition_en: To receive a result that is below the level required to pass a test, course, or assessment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sittelna ahih kei leh sinna khat paltawh na ding zah ngah lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He failed the driving test twice.
examples.zomi: Amah mawtaw hawlna sittelna nihvei lel hi.

examples.english: Students who fail the course may take it again.
examples.zomi: Tua sinna a paltawh lote kisin kik thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, a student fails a test. In British English, fails in a test may sometimes be heard, but the direct-object form is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah sangnaupang in fails a test kici hi. Direct object tawh zat pen a kizang ngeizaw ahi hi.

senses.heading: Stop working properly
senses.definition_en: To stop operating or performing as required.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine, pumpi khen, ahih kei leh system khat a kisam bangin nasem nawn lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The engine failed during the journey.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna laitakin engine nasem nawn lo hi.

examples.english: The backup system failed at the same time.
examples.zomi: Backup system zong tua hun mahin sia hi.

senses.usage_en: When equipment fails, it stops working correctly; this does not necessarily mean that it is permanently destroyed.
senses.usage_zomi: Van khat fails ciangin a kilawm bangin nasem nawn lo cihna ahi hi. A vekin sia a, bawlphat theih nawn lo cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Lack of success
senses.definition_en: The state or result of not succeeding in an attempt, plan, or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna, geelna, ahih kei leh nasep khat tangtung lohna leh guallelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The first attempt ended in failure.
examples.zomi: A masa hanciamna guallelna tawh tawp hi.

examples.english: Failure can teach us how to improve.
examples.zomi: Guallelna in koibangin hoihzaw thei ding hiam hong sinsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Failure may describe an unsuccessful result. Calling a person a failure is much stronger and can sound insulting.
senses.usage_zomi: Failure in ngahna tangtung lo gen thei hi. Mi khat a failure ci in sap pen a khauhzaw a, simmawhna bangin kithei thei hi.

senses.heading: Breakdown or loss of function
senses.definition_en: The stopping or serious weakening of a machine, system, or body organ.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine, system, ahih kei leh pumpi khen khat nasem nawn lohna ahih kei leh thanem mahmahna ahi hi.

examples.english: The flight was delayed because of engine failure.
examples.zomi: Engine siatna hangin vanleng manlate hi.

examples.english: The hospital has generators for use during a power failure.
examples.zomi: Electric mei a tawp ciangin zat ding generator damdawi inn ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: In medical terms such as heart failure, the organ may still work, but not well enough for the body’s needs.
senses.usage_zomi: Heart failure bang cidamna kammal ah pumpi khen pen nasem nailai thei napi, pumpi kisapna dingin kicing takin nasem zo lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Just and reasonable
senses.definition_en: Treating people equally and making decisions according to reasonable rules.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khempeuh kibang takin bawl a, thukhun kilawm bangin khentat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The judge must make a fair decision.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa in khentatna thutang bawl ding hi.

examples.english: Every employee deserves fair treatment.
examples.zomi: Nasem khempeuh kibang leh thutang takin kibawl ding kilawm hi.
