senses.usage_en: Fair does not always mean that everyone receives exactly the same thing. It means that the treatment is reasonable and just.
senses.usage_zomi: Fair cih in mi khempeuh na kibang sitset ngah cihna hi pahpah lo hi. Kibang, kilawm leh thutang takin kibawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Neither very good nor very bad
senses.definition_en: Acceptable or moderately good, but not excellent.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoih mahmah zong hilo, a sia zong hilo; pomtheih zah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The used car is still in fair condition.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw luipen dinmun pomtheih ah omlai hi.

examples.english: The team has a fair chance of winning.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl in gualzawh theihna hoih deuh nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In evaluations, fair is usually below good but above poor.
senses.usage_zomi: Tehna ah fair pen good sangin niamzaw a, poor sangin hoihzaw hi.

senses.heading: Light in color
senses.definition_en: Light in color, especially when describing skin or hair.
senses.explanation_zomi: A mel vam, a aap, ahih kei leh a taang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The child has fair skin and brown hair.
examples.zomi: Tua naupang vun vam a, sam kang nei hi.

examples.english: People with fair skin may burn quickly in strong sunlight.
examples.zomi: Vun vam mite nisa mahmah ah vun kang baih thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing appearance, fair commonly means light-colored. It does not mean beautiful in ordinary modern English.
senses.usage_zomi: Mimal pianzia gen ciangin fair in a vam ahih kei leh a taang cihna ahi hi. Tuhun English ngeina ah a melhoih cihna in kizang nawn tawm hi.

senses.heading: In a just and reasonable way
senses.definition_en: In a way that treats people equally and follows reasonable rules.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khempeuh kibang, kilawm leh thutang takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Managers should treat every employee fairly.
examples.zomi: Makaite in nasem khempeuh thutang takin bawl ding uh hi.

examples.english: The competition was conducted fairly.
examples.zomi: Tua kidemna thutang takin kinei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense of fairly is related to fair meaning just.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih fairly khiatna pen thutang leh kilawm cihna fair tawh kizom hi.

senses.heading: To a moderate degree
senses.definition_en: To a noticeable but not very great degree.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kician deuh in; tawmkhat val in
senses.explanation_zomi: A tam mahmah hilo napi, a om kician deuh in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The instructions are fairly easy to understand.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhnate tel baih deuh hi.

examples.english: I am fairly certain that she will come.
examples.zomi: Amah hong pai ding hi ci in ka kician deuh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, fairly usually means “quite” or “moderately,” but its strength depends on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah fairly in “quite” ahih kei leh “moderately” tawh kibang deuh a, a khauhzah pen thu kizangna tawh kithei hi.

senses.heading: Trust or confidence
senses.definition_en: Strong trust or confidence in a person, idea, or ability.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ngaihsutna, ahih kei leh hihtheihna khat tungah a kip upna leh muanna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her family had faith in her ability.
examples.zomi: Ama innkuan in ama hihtheihna muang uh hi.

examples.english: Do not lose faith in yourself after one mistake.
examples.zomi: Khatvei na khialh hangin nangmah na kimuanna mangsak kei in.

senses.usage_en: The common pattern is have faith in someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizang ngeina pen have faith in someone or something ahi a, mi ahih kei leh na khat muang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Religious belief and trust in God
senses.definition_en: Belief in and trust in God, or a system of religious belief.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pasian tungah upna leh muanna, ahih kei leh biakna khat up thukhun ahi hi.

examples.english: Her faith in God gave her strength during difficult times.
examples.zomi: Hun hak laitakin Pasian tungah a upna in thahatna pia hi.

examples.english: The book explains the central teachings of the Christian faith.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu in Khazih upna thuhilhna thupite hilhcian hi.

senses.usage_en: Faith may mean personal trust in God or an organized body of religious beliefs. Context shows which meaning is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Faith in Pasian tungah mimal upna zong gen thei a, biakna khat up thukhun pawl zong gen thei hi. A kizangna thu in khiatna hong lak hi.

senses.heading: Move downward accidentally or naturally
senses.definition_en: To move suddenly or naturally from a higher position to a lower one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun sangzaw pan mun niamzaw ah thakhat in ahih kei leh pianpih in kia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Be careful not to fall on the wet floor.
examples.zomi: Tua innpi a ciim ah na kiah lohna ding kidawm in.

examples.english: Several leaves fell from the tree.
examples.zomi: Singkung pan singte tampi kia hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is fell and the past participle is fallen.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen fell ahi a, past participle pen fallen ahi hi.

senses.heading: Become lower or smaller
senses.definition_en: To decrease in amount, level, price, temperature, or strength.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zah, a dinmun, a man, a sa leh vot tehna, ahih kei leh a thahatna kiam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Gas prices fell last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in gas man kiam hi.

examples.english: The temperature will fall below freezing tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zanin khuavot tehna tui khau theihna nuai ah niam ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, fall is intransitive. Someone may lower a price, but the price itself falls.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah fall pen object om lo in kizang hi. Mi khat in vanman lower thei a, vanman amah ahih leh falls hi.

senses.heading: Enter a particular state
senses.definition_en: To begin to be in a particular condition or state.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hong suak; dinmun khat ah lut
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun ahih kei leh omzia tuam khat ah hong lut cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The baby fell asleep in the car.
examples.zomi: Naungek mawtaw sungah ihmu hi.

examples.english: The room fell silent when the speaker entered.
examples.zomi: Thu genpa hong lut ciangin khan sung gamdai hi.

senses.usage_en: Fall combines with several adjectives to describe an unplanned or gradual change of state.
senses.usage_zomi: Fall pen adjective tuamtuam tawh kizom a, deihlohpi ahih kei leh tawm tawm in dinmun kikhel cih gen hi.

senses.heading: Not true or correct
senses.definition_en: Not true, accurate, or based on fact.
senses.explanation_zomi: A maan lo, a dik lo, ahih kei leh thu maan tungah a kinga lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The report contained false information.
examples.zomi: Tua report sungah thu maan lo om hi.

examples.english: He was arrested after making a false claim.
examples.zomi: Thu maan lo a gen khit ciangin amah kiman hi.

senses.usage_en: False describes information or a statement that is untrue. Wrong has a wider meaning and can also describe an incorrect answer, choice, or action.
senses.usage_zomi: False in thu theihna ahih kei leh genna maan lo gen hi. Wrong in khiatna zaizaw nei a, dawnna, teelna leh gamtatna khial zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Not genuine or natural
senses.definition_en: Made to look real but not genuine, natural, or original.
senses.explanation_zomi: A taktak bangin kibawl napi, a taktak, a pianpih, ahih kei leh a bulpi hilo cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: min leh mimal omzia maan lo

examples.english: She wears false eyelashes for performances.
examples.zomi: Amah in gamtatna lak ciangin mitmul bawltawm zang hi.

examples.english: The man entered the country using a false identity.
examples.zomi: Tua pa in mimal omzia maan lo zangin gam sung lut hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, false means artificial or pretending to be genuine.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah false in a bawltawm ahih kei leh a taktak bangin a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Known or easily recognized
senses.definition_en: Known from previous experience and therefore easy to recognize.
senses.explanation_zomi: A muhsa, a zaksa, ahih kei leh a theihsa ahih manin muhkik ciangin theih pah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I saw a familiar face in the crowd.
examples.zomi: Mipi lakah maitang theihsa khat ka mu hi.

examples.english: That song sounds familiar, but I cannot remember its name.
examples.zomi: Tua la a zaksa bang hi napi, a min ka phawk zo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: A person or thing may be familiar to you. You may also be familiar with a subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat nang adingin theihsa ahih ciangin familiar to you kici hi. Thu khat na theih ciangin familiar with a subject kici hi.

senses.heading: Having knowledge of something
senses.definition_en: Having knowledge or experience of a subject, situation, or method.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, dinmun, ahih kei leh sepzia khat tawh kisai theihna ahih kei leh muhsa nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Are you familiar with this computer program?
examples.zomi: Hih computer program na thei hiam?

examples.english: New employees should become familiar with the safety rules.
examples.zomi: Nasem thakte bitna thukhunte thei ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use familiar with when the subject is the person who has knowledge: “She is familiar with the system.”
senses.usage_zomi: Theihna nei mi pen subject ahih ciangin familiar with kizang hi: “She is familiar with the system.”

senses.heading: Parents, children, and close relatives
senses.definition_en: A group consisting of parents and children, sometimes including other close relatives.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nu, pa, ta-te, leh a kizom nai innkuanpihte a huam pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: Her family lives in Ohio.
examples.zomi: Ama innkuan Ohio ah teng hi.

examples.english: We spent the holiday with our family.
examples.zomi: Khawlni pen ka innkuanpihte uh tawh ka zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, family usually takes a singular verb when viewed as one group. British English may also use a plural verb when emphasizing individual members.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah family pen pawl khat bangin kingaihsun ciangin singular verb tawh kizang zel hi. British English ah mimal sim khauhsak ciangin plural verb zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: All people related by birth or marriage
senses.definition_en: All the people connected to someone through birth, marriage, or adoption.
senses.explanation_zomi: Suahpihna, kiteenna, ahih kei leh ta in lakna tawh mi khat tawh a kizom mite khempeuh ahi hi.

examples.english: The whole family gathered for the wedding.
examples.zomi: Kiteenna adingin tanaute khempeuh kikhawm uh hi.

examples.english: Diabetes is common in his family.
examples.zomi: Ama tanaute lakah cuknatna om ngei mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Immediate family normally means parents, children, and sometimes a spouse or siblings. Extended family includes more distant relatives.
senses.usage_zomi: Immediate family in nu, pa, ta-te leh khenkhat ciangin innkuanpih ahih kei leh sanggampa sanggamnu-te huam hi. Extended family in tanaute a zaizaw huam hi.

senses.definition_en: Known by many people because of an achievement, quality, place, or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzawhna, siamna, mun, ahih kei leh a piang thu khat hangin mi tampi in theih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The city is famous for its historic buildings.
examples.zomi: Tua khuapi pen tangthu nei innte hangin minthang hi.

examples.english: She became famous after winning the competition.
examples.zomi: Kidemna a gualzawh khit ciangin amah minthang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use famous for to give the reason for someone’s fame and famous as to identify the person’s role.
senses.usage_zomi: Minthanna hang genin famous for kizang a, mi khat bang nasep nei hiam cih genin famous as kizang hi.

senses.heading: Person who strongly likes or supports someone or something
senses.definition_en: A person who greatly enjoys or supports a sport, team, performer, activity, or subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawhna, pawl, laasakmi, gamtatna, ahih kei leh thu khat deih mahmah a, a panpih mi ahi hi.

examples.english: He is a lifelong fan of the team.
examples.zomi: Amah a nuntak sung tua pawl panpih den mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Thousands of fans attended the concert.
examples.zomi: Laasakna ah panpihmi tul tampi pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern a fan of means someone who strongly likes a person, activity, or subject.
senses.usage_zomi: A fan of cih in mi, gamtatna, ahih kei leh thu khat deih mahmah mi cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Device that moves air
senses.definition_en: A device with turning blades that moves air to cool or ventilate a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huih suk a, mun khat daihsak ahih kei leh huih luangsak dingin a kihei van ahi hi.

examples.english: Please turn on the fan; the room is hot.
examples.zomi: Khan sung a sa hi; fan hong in.

examples.english: The ceiling fan moves the air around the room.
examples.zomi: Innkhum fan in khan sung huih luangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Context usually makes it clear whether fan means a supporter or a cooling device.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangna thu in fan pen panpihmi maw, huihmutna van maw cih hong kician sak hi.

senses.heading: Want or feel like having something
senses.definition_en: To want something or feel interested in doing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat deih ahih kei leh gamtatna khat bawl nuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do you fancy a cup of tea?
examples.zomi: Tea hai khat na dawn nuam hiam?

examples.english: I do not fancy going out in this rain.
examples.zomi: Hih guah sungah pualam pai ka nuam lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This use of fancy is informal and much more common in British English than in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih fancy zatdan pen informal ahi a, American English sangin British English ah kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Be romantically attracted to someone
senses.definition_en: To feel romantic or physical attraction toward someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat itna lam lungsim tawh lunglut ahih kei leh deih cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat a simtham in lunglut

examples.english: Her friends think she fancies him.
examples.zomi: Ama lawmte in amah tua pa lunglut hi ci uh hi.

examples.english: He fancied her when they were at college.
examples.zomi: College a kaite uh laitakin amah in tua numei lunglut hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is informal and primarily British. In American English, like or be attracted to is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen informal leh British English lam a kizangzaw ahi hi. American English ah like ahih kei leh be attracted to kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: Imagine or believe without strong evidence
senses.definition_en: To imagine something or form an idea that may not be true.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsun; thu kician lo in um
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kician om lo napi ngaihsun ahih kei leh tua bang hi ding ci in um cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I fancied that I heard someone calling my name.
examples.zomi: Mi khat in ka min hong sam bangin ka ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: He fancies himself as an expert.
examples.zomi: Amah in amah siampa khat bangin kingaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning may sound literary or old-fashioned. The expression fancy yourself as often suggests that the belief is exaggerated.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen laigelhna lam ahih kei leh tanglai zatdan bangin ging thei hi. Fancy yourself as in nangmah na kisakna a khengval cih ngaihsutna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Extremely good or impressive
senses.definition_en: Extremely good, enjoyable, or impressive.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a hoih mahmah; a lungluthuai mahmah
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoih mahmah, a lungluthuai mahmah, ahih kei leh a lamdang takin hoih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We had a fantastic time at the concert.
examples.zomi: Laasakna ah nuam mahmah ka sa uh hi.

examples.english: She did a fantastic job on the presentation.
examples.zomi: Amah in presentation nasep hoih mahmah sem hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday English, fantastic is an enthusiastic and informal way to say excellent.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim English ah fantastic pen excellent cihna lungdamna lianpi tawh informal takin zatna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Imaginary or highly unusual
senses.definition_en: Existing only in imagination, or so strange that it seems unreal.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsutna sung bek; a lamdang mahmah
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna sungah bek om ahih kei leh a maan lo bang dongin a lamdang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The book describes fantastic creatures and distant worlds.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu in ganhing lamdangte leh leitung gamlaite gen hi.

examples.english: The child drew a fantastic city in the clouds.
examples.zomi: Tua naupang in meii sunga khuapi lamdang khat suai hi.

senses.usage_en: This older literal sense is related to fantasy. Context distinguishes it from the common meaning “excellent.”
senses.usage_zomi: Hih a bul khiatna pen fantasy tawh kizom hi. A kizangna thu in “a hoih mahmah” cihna tawh hong kikhen sak hi.

senses.heading: At or to a great distance
senses.definition_en: At, to, or from a place that is a great distance away.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun gamla ah, mun gamla lamah, ahih kei leh mun gamla pan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hospital is not far from our house.
examples.zomi: Damdawi inn ka inn uh pan gamla lo hi.

examples.english: They traveled far to attend the wedding.
examples.zomi: Kiteenna ah pai dingin gamla tak khualzin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In questions and negative statements, far is common: “Is it far?” and “It isn’t far.” In affirmative statements, a long way often sounds more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Dotna leh nialna thu ah far kizang ngei hi: “Is it far?” leh “It isn’t far.” Pomna thu ah a long way cih pen a ngeinazaw in ging hi.

senses.heading: To a great degree
senses.definition_en: By a large amount or to a great degree.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a lianpi in; a tamzaw in
senses.explanation_zomi: A zah lianpi in ahih kei leh a sang mahmah in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This solution is far better than the first one.
examples.zomi: Hih siansuahna pen a masa sangin hoihzaw mahmah hi.

examples.english: The work has been successful so far.
examples.zomi: Tu dong tua nasep gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: Before a comparative adjective, far emphasizes a large difference: far better, far more, or far less.
senses.usage_zomi: Comparative adjective maiah far in kilamdanna lianpi om cih khauhsak hi: far better, far more, ahih kei leh far less.

senses.definition_en: An area of land and its buildings used for growing crops or raising animals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Anlakna, theigah, singkung, ahih kei leh ganhing khawi dingin a kizang leitang leh tua muna innte ahi hi.

examples.english: Her family owns a small farm outside the town.
examples.zomi: Ama innkuan in khua pualam ah lo neu khat nei hi.

examples.english: The farm produces corn, beans, and eggs.
examples.zomi: Tua lo pan vaimim, be leh aktuite piangkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: A farm may produce crops, animals, or both. The person who operates it is a farmer.
senses.usage_zomi: Farm ah anlakna kisuah thei a, ganhing kikhawi thei a, tegel zong kibawlkhawm thei hi. Tua lo a sem mi pen farmer kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who owns, manages, or works on a farm, especially to grow crops or raise animals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lo nei, lo uk, ahih kei leh anlakna suah leh ganhing khawi dingin lo ah nasem mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The farmer grows rice and vegetables.
examples.zomi: Lopa in buh leh huan-an kho hi.

examples.english: Local farmers sell their produce at the market.
examples.zomi: Khuami loute in amau lousuah vante vanzual ah zuak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Farmer can refer to the owner of a farm or to someone whose main occupation is farming.
senses.usage_zomi: Farmer in lo neipa zong gen thei a, lo nasep a nasep bulpi in a nei mi zong gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The work or business of growing crops and raising animals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Anlakna suah leh ganhing khawi cih lo nasep leh sumdawnna ahi hi.

examples.english: Farming is the main source of income in the village.
examples.zomi: Tua khua ah loubawlna pen sum ngahna bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: Modern farming methods can increase food production.
examples.zomi: Tuhun loubawl dan in an suah zat khangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Farming refers to the activity or industry. Agriculture is broader and more formal, including the science and business of farming.
senses.usage_zomi: Farming in lo nasep ahih kei leh tua sumdawnna gen hi. Agriculture pen formal leh khiatna zaizaw a, loubawlna science leh sumdawnna zong huam hi.

senses.definition_en: Extremely interesting and able to hold someone’s attention.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunglut mahmah a, mi khat ngaihsutna leh lunglutna kaihcip thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The documentary gives a fascinating account of ocean life.
examples.zomi: Tua documentary in tuipi sunga nuntakna lungluthuai takin gen hi.

examples.english: I found the history of the city fascinating.
examples.zomi: Tua khuapi tangthu lungluthuai mahmah ka sa hi.

senses.usage_en: A subject or experience is fascinating; a person who feels strong interest is fascinated.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu ahih kei leh thuakna in lunglutna piangsak ciangin fascinating kici hi. Tua thu a lunglut mi pen fascinated kici hi.

senses.heading: Popular style of clothing or appearance
senses.definition_en: A style of clothing, hair, or appearance that is popular at a particular time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: puan silh ngeina; mel bawl ngeina
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat sunga mi tampi deih leh zui puan silhzia, sam bawldan, ahih kei leh pianzia ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi tampi deih leh zat ngei

examples.english: This style of jacket is now in fashion.
examples.zomi: Hih jacket pianzia tuhun in mi tampi silh ngei hi.

examples.english: Fashion changes quickly from year to year.
examples.zomi: Puan silh leh mel bawl ngeina kum simin kikhel manlang hi.

senses.usage_en: Something in fashion is currently popular. Something out of fashion is no longer popular.
senses.usage_zomi: In fashion cih in tuhun a mi tampi deih leh zat ngei cihna ahi hi. Out of fashion in mi tampi zat ngei nawn lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Particular way of doing something
senses.definition_en: A particular way or manner in which something is done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat koibang danin kibawl hiam cih sepzia ahih kei leh bawldan ahi hi.

examples.english: The files were arranged in an orderly fashion.
examples.zomi: File-te kizem takin kikoih hi.

examples.english: The second problem can be solved in a similar fashion.
examples.zomi: A nihna buaina zong a kibang danin kisiansuah thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning of fashion is more formal than way or manner.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih fashion khiatna pen way ahih kei leh manner sangin formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: Popular in style
senses.definition_en: Following a style of clothing, appearance, or behavior that is currently popular.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tuhun ngeina tawh kituak; mi tampi deih
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun a mi tampi deih leh zui puan silhzia, mel bawldan, ahih kei leh gamtatdan tawh kituak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: tuhun mi tampi deih sam bawldan
mi tampi deih leh zui suak

examples.english: This style of coat has become fashionable again.
examples.zomi: Hih puanlum pianzia pen tu in mi tampi deih leh silh kik uh hi.

examples.english: She enjoys wearing fashionable clothes.
examples.zomi: Amah in tuhun ngeina tawh kituak puante silh nuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Something fashionable is popular at the present time, but it may not remain popular for long.
senses.usage_zomi: Fashionable cih in tuhun a mi tampi deih leh zui cihna ahi hi. Ahih hang hun sawtpi mi tampi deih den ding cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Popular among wealthy or influential people
senses.definition_en: Popular with people who are wealthy, socially important, or highly influential.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hausate, mi thupite, ahih kei leh huzaapna nei mite lakah a minthang leh a kideih cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi thupite pai ngei ankuang inn

examples.english: They opened a restaurant in a fashionable part of the city.
examples.zomi: Khuapi sung mi thupite deih khuakhen ah ankuang inn khat hong uh hi.

examples.english: The hotel is popular with fashionable travelers.
examples.zomi: Tua hotel pen khualzin minthang leh hausate deih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, fashionable describes social popularity or prestige, not only clothing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah fashionable in puan silhzia bek hilo a, mi thupite lakah minthanna leh deihhuaina zong gen hi.

senses.heading: Moving or operating quickly
senses.definition_en: Moving, happening, or working at high speed.
senses.explanation_zomi: A manlang in kalsuan, piang, ahih kei leh nasem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This train is faster than the bus.
examples.zomi: Hih meileng pen bus sangin manlangzaw hi.

examples.english: We need a fast computer for this work.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep ading computer manlang khat ka kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The comparative form is faster and the superlative is fastest.
senses.usage_zomi: Comparative form pen faster ahi a, superlative form pen fastest ahi hi.

senses.heading: Taking a short amount of time
senses.definition_en: Done or happening within a short period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tomno sungin a kibawl ahih kei leh a piang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hospital gave him fast medical attention.
examples.zomi: Damdawi inn in amah cidamna manlang takin pia hi.

examples.english: She made a fast recovery after the operation.
examples.zomi: Zaina a neih khit ciangin manlang takin damkik hi.

senses.usage_en: Fast can describe speed or a short duration. Do not use fastly; fast itself is also the adverb.
senses.usage_zomi: Fast in manlangna ahih kei leh hun tomna gen thei hi. Fastly kici lo a, adverb in zong fast mah kizang hi.

senses.heading: Close or secure something
senses.definition_en: To close, join, or secure something so that it stays firmly in place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kihet kei dingin khak, hen, tawh, ahih kei leh kip takin koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please fasten your seat belt before the car moves.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw a kipatma in na tokna kawnggak khak in.

examples.english: She fastened the buttons on her coat.
examples.zomi: Amah in a puanlum mekte khak hi.

senses.usage_en: Fasten is more general than tie. Something may be fastened with a button, belt, clip, lock, or cord.
senses.usage_zomi: Fasten pen tie sangin khiatna zaizaw hi. Na khat mek, kawnggak, khehcipna, tawhtawh, ahih kei leh khau tawh kikhak thei hi.

senses.heading: Attach one thing to another
senses.definition_en: To attach one object firmly to another object or surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat van dang ahih kei leh mun khat tungah kip takin kizomsak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: fasten a sign to the wall

examples.english: Fasten the label firmly to the box.
examples.zomi: Minla tua bawm tungah kip takin tawhcip in.

examples.english: The shelf was fastened to the wall with screws.
examples.zomi: Tua van koihna pen screw tawh kulh ah kitawhcip hi.

senses.usage_en: The common patterns are fasten something to something and fasten things together.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizang ngeina pen fasten something to something leh fasten things together ahi hi.

senses.heading: Having a large amount of body fat
senses.definition_en: Having more body fat than is usual or considered healthy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi ah sautha tampi nei a, a ngeina ahih kei leh cidamna ading a kilawm zah sangin a thaang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The cat became fat because it ate too much.
examples.zomi: Tua zawl in an tampi nek hangin thaang hi.

examples.english: The doctor said the dog was becoming too fat.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in tua ui thaang lua ding ci hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling a person fat can sound rude or hurtful. In polite or medical contexts, use a more specific expression such as overweight when appropriate.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat fat ci in sap pen simmawhna ahih kei leh lungsim nasakna bangin kithei thei hi. Zaidam tak ahih kei leh cidamna thu gen ciangin a kituak leh overweight bang kammal kicianzaw zat hoih hi.

senses.heading: Thick or wide
senses.definition_en: Thick, broad, or larger around than usual.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina sangin a thah, a zai, ahih kei leh a gol cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He carried a fat book under his arm.
examples.zomi: Amah in laibu thah khat a khut nuai ah pom hi.

examples.english: A fat envelope arrived in the mail.
examples.zomi: Laikhak bawm gol khat mail tawh hong tung hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is informal and describes the thickness or fullness of an object.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan pen informal ahi a, van khat a thahna ahih kei leh a golna gen hi.

senses.heading: Male parent
senses.definition_en: A male parent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ta khat a pasal nu leh pa lakah pa ahi hi.

examples.english: Her father teaches at the local school.
examples.zomi: Ama pa khuami sang ah lai hilh hi.

examples.english: He became a father for the first time last year.
examples.zomi: Kumkhat in a masapen dingin ta nei pa suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Father is neutral or formal. Dad is more informal and personal.
senses.usage_zomi: Father pen neutral ahih kei leh formal zaw hi. Dad pen informal leh innkuan sung a kineihzaw hi.

senses.heading: Man who founded or developed something
senses.definition_en: A man who established, created, or greatly developed an organization, movement, or field.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kipawlna, gamtatna, ahih kei leh pilna lam khat a phuh, a piangsak, ahih kei leh a khangsak mahmah pa ahi hi.

examples.english: He is remembered as the father of the movement.
examples.zomi: Amah tua gamtatna phuhpa in kiphawk hi.

examples.english: Many people call him the father of modern computing.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi in amah tuhun computer pilna phuhpa ci uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use recognizes a man’s major role in beginning or developing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna zatdan in na khat kipatna ahih kei leh khanna ah pa khat in mawhpuakna lianpi a neihna pahtawi hi.

senses.heading: Responsibility for a mistake or problem
senses.definition_en: Responsibility for causing a mistake, accident, or problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna, siatna, ahih kei leh buaina khat a piangsak mawhpuakna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: through no fault of your own

examples.english: The accident was not your fault.
examples.zomi: Tua accident nang mawh hilo hi.

examples.english: It was my fault that we arrived late.
examples.zomi: Ka mawh hangin manlate takin ka tung uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern It is someone’s fault identifies who is responsible. Avoid using it before the cause is known.
senses.usage_zomi: It is someone’s fault cih in kua mawhpuakna hiam cih pulak hi. A hang kician nailo in mi khat mawhsak pah lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Defect or weakness
senses.definition_en: A defect, weakness, or something wrong in a person, object, or system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, ahih kei leh system khat sunga khialhna, thanemna, ahih kei leh hoih lohna ahi hi.

examples.english: The technician found a fault in the electrical system.
examples.zomi: Vanzat siampa in electric system sunga khialhna khat mu hi.

examples.english: Every person has strengths and faults.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in thahatna leh thanemna nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A mechanical or electrical fault is a problem that prevents equipment from working correctly.
senses.usage_zomi: Machine ahih kei leh electric fault pen vanzat a kilawm bangin nasemthei lo sak khialhna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Crack in the earth’s crust
senses.definition_en: A long break in the earth’s outer rock where movement can occur.
senses.zomi_equivalents: leitung suang kikhenna; lei kihihna mun
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung pualam suangpi a kikhenna saupi, lei kihih theihna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The city lies near a major fault line.
examples.zomi: Tua khuapi lei kikhenna lianpi khat kiangah om hi.

examples.english: Movement along the fault caused an earthquake.
examples.zomi: Lei kikhenna zui a kalsuanna in zinling piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a specialized geological meaning of fault.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen leitung omzia kancian pilna sunga fault khiatna tuam ahi hi.

senses.heading: Helpful or kind act
senses.definition_en: A kind or helpful act that someone does for another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in midang khat ading hehpihna leh panpihna tawh a bawl nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: Could you do me a favour and carry this box?
examples.zomi: Hong panpih in, hih bawm hong puak thei diam?

examples.english: She helped me, so I returned the favour.
examples.zomi: Amah in kei hong panpih ahih manin kei zong amah ka panpihkik hi.

senses.usage_en: The usual expression is do someone a favour. The American spelling is favor.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizang ngeina pen do someone a favour ahi hi. American English gelhdan pen favor ahi hi.

senses.heading: Approval or support
senses.definition_en: Approval, preference, or support for a person, plan, or proposal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, geelna, ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat pom, deihzaw, ahih kei leh panpih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Most members voted in favour of the proposal.
examples.zomi: Pawlpite a tamzaw in tua geelna pomna vote pia uh hi.

examples.english: The new policy found favour with local businesses.
examples.zomi: Tua thukhun thak khuami sumdawngte deihhuai suak hi.

senses.usage_en: In favour of means supporting or preferring someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: In favour of cih in mi ahih kei leh na khat panpih ahih kei leh deihzaw cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Liked more than all other people or things of the same kind.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibang pawl lakah a deihpen ahih kei leh a lunglutpen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Blue is her favourite color.
examples.zomi: Amah in a deihpen color pen a dum ahi hi.

examples.english: What is your favourite book?
examples.zomi: Nangma laibu deihpen bang laibu ahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: Favourite identifies the one liked most. The American spelling is favorite.
senses.usage_zomi: Favourite in a kibang pawl lakah a deihpen khat pulak hi. American English gelhdan pen favorite ahi hi.

senses.heading: Feeling caused by danger
senses.definition_en: An unpleasant feeling caused by danger or the possibility that something bad may happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina ahih kei leh thu sia khat piang ding cih ngaihsutna hangin a piang launa lungsim ahi hi.

examples.english: He has a strong fear of flying.
examples.zomi: Amah vanleng tuang lau mahmah hi.

examples.english: The child cried with fear during the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi laitakin naupang launa tawh kap hi.

senses.usage_en: Use fear of before the thing or situation that causes fear.
senses.usage_zomi: Launa piangsak na ahih kei leh dinmun maiah fear of kizang hi.

senses.heading: Worry that something may happen
senses.definition_en: A worry or concern that a particular bad event may occur.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu sia khat piang kha ding cih lunghihmawhna ahi hi.

examples.english: Parents expressed fears about their children’s safety.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pate in amau tate bitna tawh kisai lunghihmawhna pulak uh hi.

examples.english: Fear of failure stopped him from applying.
examples.zomi: Guallel ding launa in lai-ap lo sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Fear may describe immediate fright or a continuing worry about the future.
senses.usage_zomi: Fear in tu lamtaka launa zong gen thei a, mailam thu tawh kisai a omden lunghihmawhna zong gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: One of the light, soft structures that cover a bird’s body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vasa pumpi tuam a, a lengna zong panpih a nem leh vang na ahi hi.

examples.english: The bird has bright blue feathers.
examples.zomi: Tua vasa in vamul a dum leh a taang nei hi.

examples.english: I found a small feather on the ground.
examples.zomi: Leitung ah vamul neu khat ka mu hi.

senses.usage_en: A bird has many feathers. Feather is countable when referring to an individual piece.
senses.usage_zomi: Vasa khat in feathers tampi nei hi. Vamul khat ciimawh gen ciangin feather pen simtheih noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Important or noticeable quality
senses.definition_en: An important, interesting, or noticeable part or quality of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sunga a thupi, a lungluthuai, ahih kei leh a kimukhiat baih khen leh omzia ahi hi.

examples.english: The phone’s best feature is its camera.
examples.zomi: Tua phone omzia hoihpen pen a camera ahi hi.

examples.english: Safety is a key feature of the new design.
examples.zomi: Bitna pen design thak omzia thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A feature is a part or quality that helps describe or distinguish something.
senses.usage_zomi: Feature pen na khat pulak leh na dang pan khentelna ding a panpih khen ahih kei leh omzia ahi hi.

senses.heading: Part of a person’s face
senses.definition_en: A part of someone’s face, especially the eyes, nose, or mouth, or the general shape formed by them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat maitang khen, adiakin mit, nak, kam, ahih kei leh a kigawm maitang meel ahi hi.

examples.english: The sisters have similar facial features.
examples.zomi: Tua sanggamnute maitang omzia kibang deuh hi.

examples.english: His eyes are his most noticeable feature.
examples.zomi: Ama maitang ah a mit pen a kimukhiat baihpen ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural features often refers collectively to the parts and shape of a person’s face.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural features in mi khat maitang khen leh a kigawm meel a vekin gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Special article, program, or presentation
senses.definition_en: A detailed article, broadcast, or presentation about a particular subject.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thu tuam pulakna; a kicing report
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a kicing takin a gen lai, radio ahih kei leh television program, ahih kei leh pulakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The newspaper published a feature on local farmers.
examples.zomi: Thuthak lai in khuami loute tawh kisai thu a kicingin sua hi.

examples.english: Tonight’s program includes a special feature on education.
examples.zomi: Tuni zan program ah pilna tawh kisai pulakna tuam khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: A feature usually gives more detail and background than a short news report.
senses.usage_zomi: Feature in thuthak tomno sangin thu behlap leh a nunglam omzia kicingzaw pia zel hi.

senses.definition_en: The second month of the year, following January and preceding March.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sunga kha nihna, January khit leh March ma a om kha ahi hi.

examples.english: Her birthday is in February.
examples.zomi: Ama suahni February kha in ahi hi.

examples.english: February has twenty-eight days in most years.
examples.zomi: Kum a tamzaw in February ni sawmnih leh giat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: February normally has 28 days and has 29 days in a leap year. It is always capitalized in English.
senses.usage_zomi: February pen kum a tamzaw in ni 28 nei a, leap year ah ni 29 nei hi. English ah a lai-masa awlmawh in kigelh tawntung hi.

senses.definition_en: An amount of money paid for a professional service, membership, admission, or permission.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasemna man; lutna man; sum piak
senses.explanation_zomi: Siampa nasemna, pawl sung lutna, mun khat lutna, ahih kei leh phalna khat ading a kipiak sum ahi hi.

examples.english: There is a small fee to enter the museum.
examples.zomi: Museum lutna ading sum tawmno pia kul hi.

examples.english: The lawyer explained all the legal fees.
examples.zomi: Thukham siampa in thukham nasemna man khempeuh hilhcian hi.

senses.usage_en: A fee is usually payment for a service or permission. A price is what someone pays to buy a product.
senses.usage_zomi: Fee pen nasemna ahih kei leh phalna khat ading sum piak ahi hi. Price ahih leh van khat leina man ahi hi.

senses.heading: Give food to a person or animal
senses.definition_en: To give food to a person or animal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh ganhing khat nek ding an pia cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat hun ciangin an pia

examples.english: Please feed the dog before you leave.
examples.zomi: Na pai ma in ui an pia in.

examples.english: She feeds her baby every four hours.
examples.zomi: Amah in nai li kikal simin a naungek an pia hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are both fed.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense leh past participle tegel fed ahi hi.

senses.heading: Supply something needed for operation or growth
senses.definition_en: To supply a machine, system, process, or living thing with what it needs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine, system, nasepzia, ahih kei leh nungta na khat in a kisap na pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The operator fed the data into the computer.
examples.zomi: Machine zanga nasempa in data computer sungah thun hi.

examples.english: This pipe feeds water to the entire building.
examples.zomi: Hih pipe in inn bup ah tui pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This extended meaning describes supplying something continuously or directing it into a system.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in na khat tawntung piak ahih kei leh system sungah lutsak cih gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Comments or information about someone’s work or performance that can help improvement.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsut piakna; hoihzaw theihna ding thukik
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nasep ahih kei leh sepna koibang hiam cih ngaihsut piakna leh hoihzaw theihna ding thukik ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave helpful feedback on my essay.
examples.zomi: Sia in ka essay tungah phattuam ngaihsutna hong pia hi.

examples.english: Customer feedback helped the company improve its service.
examples.zomi: Vanleite ngaihsut piakna in company nasemna hoihzaw sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Feedback is normally uncountable. Say “some feedback” or “a piece of feedback,” not “a feedback.”
senses.usage_zomi: Feedback pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi. “Some feedback” ahih kei leh “a piece of feedback” ci ding a, “a feedback” ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Experience an emotion or physical condition
senses.definition_en: To experience an emotion, physical condition, or sensation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim in thei; pumpi in thei
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim omzia, pumpi dinmun, ahih kei leh pumpi a kitheihna khat nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I feel tired after the long journey.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna saupi khit ciangin ka gim hi.

examples.english: She felt nervous before the interview.
examples.zomi: Interview ma in ama lungsim om nuam lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Feel is commonly followed by an adjective: feel happy, feel cold, or feel sick.
senses.usage_zomi: Feel nungah adjective kizang ngei hi: feel happy, feel cold, ahih kei leh feel sick.

senses.heading: Touch something to learn about it
senses.definition_en: To touch something in order to discover its texture, temperature, shape, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a nem leh khauh, a sa leh vot, a pianzia, ahih kei leh a dinmun theihna dingin khut tawh lawng cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Feel the fabric and tell me whether it is soft.
examples.zomi: Tua puan lawng inla, a nem leh nem lo hong gen in.

examples.english: The nurse felt his forehead for a fever.
examples.zomi: Nurse in a khosak leh sak lo theihna dingin a tal lawng hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, feel is an intentional action involving touch.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah feel pen khut tawh deihna nei takin lawng leh sittel cih gamtatna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Believe or have an opinion
senses.definition_en: To believe, think, or have an opinion about something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat tawh kisai tua bang hi ci in um ahih kei leh ngaihsutna nei cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat khial ci in ngaihsun
thu khat tungah ngaihsutna khauh nei

examples.english: I feel that we need more time.
examples.zomi: Eite hun tampizaw kisam hi ci in ka ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: She feels strongly about protecting the environment.
examples.zomi: Amah in kimkot dalna tungah ngaihsutna khauh nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In formal writing, think or believe may be clearer when expressing a reasoned opinion.
senses.usage_zomi: Formal laigelhna ah ngaihsutna a hang tawh pulak ciangin think ahih kei leh believe pen kicianzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: Emotion
senses.definition_en: An emotional state such as happiness, anger, fear, or sadness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungdamna, lungthahna, launa, dahna bang lungsim omzia ahi hi.

examples.english: She found it difficult to express her feelings.
examples.zomi: Ama lungsim omzia pulak haksa sa hi.

examples.english: Please consider his feelings before you speak.
examples.zomi: Na pau ma in ama lungsim ngaihsun in.

senses.usage_en: The plural feelings commonly refers to a person’s emotions, especially emotions that may be helped or hurt by others.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural feelings in mi khat lungsim omzia-te gen zel a, adiakin midangte in nuamsak ahih kei leh nasaktheih lungsim gen hi.

senses.heading: Physical sensation
senses.definition_en: Something experienced through the body or sense of touch.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi ahih kei leh lawngna tungtawnin a kitheih sa, vot, na, nem leh khauh bang dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: I had a burning feeling in my throat.
examples.zomi: Ka aw sungah kang bangin ka thei hi.

examples.english: He lost feeling in two fingers.
examples.zomi: A khutme nihte in lawngna thei nawn lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning refers to a bodily sensation rather than an emotion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in lungsim omzia hilo a, pumpi in a theihna gen hi.

senses.heading: Opinion or belief
senses.definition_en: An opinion, belief, or general impression that may not be based on complete evidence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci kicing nei lo napi thu khat tua bang hi ding ci in a om ngaihsutna ahih kei leh lungsim theihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: tua bang hi ding ci in ngaihsun

examples.english: I have a feeling that he will accept the offer.
examples.zomi: Amah in tua piakna sang ding hi ci in ka ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: There is a general feeling that change is needed.
examples.zomi: Kikhelna kisam hi ci in mi tampi ngaihsun uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Have a feeling that often introduces an intuition rather than a conclusion based on firm evidence.
senses.usage_zomi: Have a feeling that in teci kipsa tungah thukhupna hilo a, lungsim theihna pan ngaihsutna khat pulak zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Belonging to the same group, occupation, situation, or community as another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh pawl, nasep, dinmun, ahih kei leh mipi pawl khat sungah a omkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She discussed the assignment with her fellow students.
examples.zomi: Amah in nasep piak thu sangnaupangpihte tawh kihoupih hi.

examples.english: We should respect our fellow citizens.
examples.zomi: Eite gammi pihte zahtak ding hihang.

senses.usage_en: As an adjective, fellow comes before a noun and shows shared membership or circumstances.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective in fellow pen noun maiah om a, pawl ahih kei leh dinmun khat kideelkhawm cih pulak hi.

senses.definition_en: Belonging to the sex that can produce eggs or bear young; relating to women or girls.
senses.explanation_zomi: Numei pianpihna nei ahih kei leh numei leh numeino tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hospital is hiring more female doctors.
examples.zomi: Damdawi inn in numei siavuan tampizaw la hi.

examples.english: The female bird lays in spring.
examples.zomi: Vasa nu in spring khuahun ciangin tui nei hi.

senses.usage_en: For people, female is usually most natural as an adjective in formal, medical, or statistical contexts. In ordinary conversation, woman or girl is often more natural as a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Mihing gen ciangin female pen formal, cidamna, ahih kei leh nambar tawh kisai thu ah adjective in kizang ngeizaw hi. Nisim kihoupihna ah noun in woman ahih kei leh girl zat pen a pianpihzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A structure made of wood, metal, wire, or another material that surrounds or separates an area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat um, dal, ahih kei leh mun nih kikhen dingin sing, sik, thirgui, ahih kei leh van dang tawh a kibawl kulh ahi hi.

examples.english: They built a fence around the garden.
examples.zomi: Huan kimkot ah kulh bawl uh hi.

examples.english: The dog escaped through a hole in the fence.
examples.zomi: Ui pen kulh a vang pan taikhia hi.

senses.usage_en: A fence usually marks a boundary or prevents people or animals from entering or leaving an area.
senses.usage_zomi: Fence in mun ciangtan lak ahih kei leh mi leh ganhingte lutkhia lo dingin dal zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A special event or series of events celebrating religion, culture, art, food, music, or another important subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna, ngeina, khutkhatna, an, la, ahih kei leh thu thupi khat lungdam kohna dingin a kinei pawi leh program pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The town holds a cultural festival every summer.
examples.zomi: Tua khua in nipi simin ngeina pawi nei hi.

examples.english: Thousands of people attended the music festival.
examples.zomi: Mi tul tampi la pawi ah pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A festival often continues for more than one day and may include several activities or performances.
senses.usage_zomi: Festival pen ni khat sangin sawtzaw om thei a, gamtatna leh lakna tuamtuam huam thei hi.

senses.heading: A small number; not many
senses.definition_en: A small number of people or things, often fewer than desired or expected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na zat tawmno, a kisap ahih kei leh a kilam-et sangin a tawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Few people understood the difficult question.
examples.zomi: Mi tawmno bek in tua dotna haksa tel uh hi.

examples.english: The village has few employment opportunities.
examples.zomi: Tua khua ah nasep ngahtheihna hunhoih tawmno bek om hi.

senses.usage_en: Few often has a negative meaning: the number is smaller than wanted. It is used with plural countable nouns.
senses.usage_zomi: Few in a tamzaw ciangin a deih zah sangin tawm cih khiatna nei hi. Plural countable noun-te tawh kizang hi.

senses.heading: A small number, but some
senses.definition_en: A small number of people or things, viewed positively as more than none.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tawmno bek napi om veve cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We stayed there for a few days.
examples.zomi: Tua ah ni tawmno ka om uh hi.

examples.english: I have a few questions about the report.
examples.zomi: Tua report tawh kisai dotna tawmno ka nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A few means some and is more positive than few. Compare: “Few people came” and “A few people came.”
senses.usage_zomi: A few in tawmno napi om cihna ahi a, few sangin khiatna hoihzaw nei hi. “Few people came” in hong pai mi tawm lua cihna a, “A few people came” in mi tawmno hong pai veve cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Stories created from imagination
senses.definition_en: Literature that describes imaginary people and events rather than only actual facts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi leh a piang thu maan bek gen lo a, laigelpa ngaihsutna pan a kibawl tangthu ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: tangthu lui tungah a kinga tangthu bawltawm

examples.english: She enjoys reading historical fiction.
examples.zomi: Amah tangthu lui tungah a kinga tangthu bawltawm sim nuam hi.

examples.english: This novel is a work of fiction.
examples.zomi: Hih tangthu sau pen ngaihsutna pan a kibawl ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Fiction is normally uncountable. An individual fictional book may be called a novel, story, or work of fiction.
senses.usage_zomi: Fiction pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi. Tangthu laibu khat cimawh pen novel, story, ahih kei leh work of fiction kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Something untrue or invented
senses.definition_en: An idea or statement that is invented and not true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a bawlkhia napi a maan lo thu ahih kei leh ngaihsutna ahi hi.

examples.english: The claim is fiction, not fact.
examples.zomi: Tua genna pen thu maan hilo a, thu bawltawm ahi hi.

examples.english: The story about the missing money was pure fiction.
examples.zomi: A mang sum tawh kisai tangthu pen thu bawltawm siangtak ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense contrasts directly with fact.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen fact ahi thu maan tawh kilehbulh hi.

senses.heading: Open land used for crops or animals
senses.definition_en: An area of open land, especially one used for growing crops or keeping animals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Anlakna suahna, ganhing vakna, ahih kei leh gamlak a kizang leitang zaipi ahi hi.

examples.english: The farmers are working in the rice fields.
examples.zomi: Loute buh lote ah nasem uh hi.

examples.english: The cows were eating grass in the field.
examples.zomi: Bawngte lo ah lopa ne uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A field may be part of a farm, but a farm normally includes all its land, buildings, crops, and animals.
senses.usage_zomi: Field pen lo khat khen hi thei hi. Farm ahih leh leitang, inn, anlakna leh ganhingte a vekin huam zel hi.

senses.heading: Area of study or work
senses.definition_en: A particular subject, profession, or area of activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sinlai, pilna, nasep, ahih kei leh gamtatna tuam khat ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: work in the field of education

examples.english: She works in the field of public health.
examples.zomi: Amah mipi cidamna lamah nasem hi.

examples.english: Technology is a rapidly changing field.
examples.zomi: Technology pen manlang takin a kikhel pilna leh nasep lam ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use in the field of before the name of a subject or profession.
senses.usage_zomi: Sinlai ahih kei leh nasep min maiah in the field of kizang hi.

senses.heading: Area where a sport is played
senses.definition_en: An outdoor area marked or prepared for a sport.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pualam a kimawhna dingin a kiginkholh leitang ahih kei leh mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The players ran onto the field.
examples.zomi: Kimawhte kimawhna zaang ah tai lut uh hi.

examples.english: The school is building a new sports field.
examples.zomi: Sang in kimawhna zaang thak khat bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: American English often uses field for football, soccer, and baseball. Other sports may use court, course, or track.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah football, soccer leh baseball ading field kizang zel hi. Kimawhna dangte ading court, course, ahih kei leh track kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 15.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambar sawm leh nga ahi hi.

examples.english: There are fifteen students in the class.
examples.zomi: Class sungah sangnaupang sawm leh nga om hi.

examples.english: The journey takes fifteen minutes.
examples.zomi: Tua khualzinna minute sawm leh nga sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: Stress the second syllable in fifteen. Compare it carefully with fifty, which is stressed on the first syllable.
senses.usage_zomi: Fifteen ah syllable nihna kikhauhsak hi. Syllable masa kikhauhsak fifty tawh telkhial lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Position number five
senses.definition_en: The person or thing in position number five in an order or series.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizuihna ah a ngana mun a om mi ahih kei leh na ahi hi.

examples.english: She finished fifth in the race.
examples.zomi: Taisiam kidemna ah amah mun ngana ngah hi.

examples.english: Today is the fifth of February.
examples.zomi: Tuni February ni ngana ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Fifth is the ordinal form of five. Notice that five changes spelling before -th is added.
senses.usage_zomi: Fifth pen five ordinal form ahi hi. -th behlapma in five gelhdan kikhel cih phawk ding hi.

senses.heading: One of five equal parts
senses.definition_en: One of five equal parts of a whole.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khen nga lakah khat; ngagih khat
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi khen kibang nga a kikhen ciangin khen khat ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a vekpi khen nga lakah khat

examples.english: One fifth of the students were absent.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang khen nga lakah khen khat om lo uh hi.

examples.english: The family spends a fifth of its income on rent.
examples.zomi: Tua innkuan in a sum ngah khen nga lakah khat innluahna ah zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use singular fifth after one and plural fifths after larger numbers.
senses.usage_zomi: One khitah singular fifth kizang a, nambar khat sang a tamzaw khitah plural fifths kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 50.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambar sawm nga ahi hi.

examples.english: The ticket costs fifty dollars.
examples.zomi: Ticket man dollar sawm nga ahi hi.

examples.english: About fifty people attended the meeting.
examples.zomi: Mi sawm nga kim meeting ah pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Stress the first syllable in fifty. Compare it carefully with fifteen, which is stressed on the second syllable.
senses.usage_zomi: Fifty ah syllable masa kikhauhsak hi. Syllable nihna kikhauhsak fifteen tawh telkhial lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Use physical force against someone
senses.definition_en: To use physical force or weapons against another person or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl dang khat tawh pumpi thahatna ahih kei leh galhiam zangin kidem, kiphual, ahih kei leh galdo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The soldiers fought bravely to defend the town.
examples.zomi: Galmangte in khua dal dingin hangsanna tawh galdo uh hi.

examples.english: The two boys were punished for fighting.
examples.zomi: Tua tangval nihte a kiphual manun gim kipa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Fight with someone may mean fighting against that person. Fight alongside someone means joining that person against a shared opponent.
senses.usage_zomi: Fight with someone in tua mi tawh kido cihna hi thei hi. Fight alongside someone in gal khat do dingin tua mi tawh kido khawm cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Struggle to stop or overcome something
senses.definition_en: To work hard to prevent, defeat, or overcome a disease, problem, or harmful condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Natna, buaina, ahih kei leh siatna khat khawl, zo, ahih kei leh susia dingin kuhkal takin hanciam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Doctors are working to fight the disease.
examples.zomi: Siavuante tua natna do dingin nasem uh hi.

examples.english: The organization fights for equal rights.
examples.zomi: Tua kipawlna in kibang dinmun ngahna dingin hanciam hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense does not necessarily involve physical violence.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in pumpi thahatna tawh ngongtatna huam pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Argue strongly
senses.definition_en: To argue angrily or repeatedly with someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh lungthahna tawh kinial ahih kei leh thu khat hangin kinial den cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children were fighting over a toy.
examples.zomi: Naupangte kimawhna van khat hangin kinial uh hi.

examples.english: They often fight about household expenses.
examples.zomi: Amaute innkuan sum zatna hangin kinial zel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday speech, fight may mean a serious argument even when no one uses physical force.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim kihoupihna ah fight in pumpi tawh kiphual lo napi, kinialna khauh gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Physical conflict, armed conflict, or violent struggle between people or groups.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl kikal a kiphualna, galhiam tawh kidona, ahih kei leh ngongtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Heavy fighting continued throughout the night.
examples.zomi: Zan khuahun sung galdo khauh paisuak hi.

examples.english: Many families left their homes because of the fighting.
examples.zomi: Kidona hangin innkuan tampi amau inn nusia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Fighting is normally uncountable when it refers generally to violent conflict.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngongtatna kidona a gen ciangin fighting pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Number or numerical information
senses.definition_en: A number, especially one used in calculations, reports, or statistics.
senses.explanation_zomi: Simna, report, ahih kei leh nambar tawh tehna ah a kizang nambar ahi hi.

examples.english: The latest figures show that unemployment has fallen.
examples.zomi: Nambar thakte in nasep neilo zat a kiam cih lak hi.

examples.english: Please check the figures before publishing the report.
examples.zomi: Report na sua ma in nambarte sittel in.

senses.usage_en: The plural figures often means numerical data rather than individual written digits.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural figures in nambar gelh khat cimawh sangin data nambar pawl gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Person, especially an important one
senses.definition_en: A person, especially someone important or well known in a particular area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, adiakin pilna, gam, biakna, ahih kei leh mipi lakah thupi leh minthang mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a respected public figure.
examples.zomi: Amah mipi in a zahtak uh mi thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: He became a leading figure in the movement.
examples.zomi: Amah tua gamtatna sungah makaipa thupi khat suak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, figure is more formal than person.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah figure pen person sangin formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: Shape, diagram, or illustration
senses.definition_en: A shape, drawing, diagram, or illustration used to show information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu theihna lakna dingin a kizang lim, suai, ahih kei leh diagram ahi hi.

examples.english: Figure 2 shows how the system works.
examples.zomi: Lim 2 in system koibangin nasem hiam cih lak hi.

examples.english: Copy the figure into your notebook.
examples.zomi: Tua lim na laigelhna laibu sungah suai in.

senses.usage_en: In academic writing, numbered illustrations and diagrams are commonly labeled Figure 1, Figure 2, and so on.
senses.usage_zomi: Sangpilna laigelhna ah nambar kipiak lim leh diagram-te Figure 1, Figure 2 cihbangin min kipiak zel hi.

senses.heading: Shape of a person’s body
senses.definition_en: The general shape or form of a person’s body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pumpi pianzia leh a mel ahi hi.

examples.english: A dark figure stood near the door.
examples.zomi: Kongkiang ah mi lim khuamial khat ding hi.

examples.english: Regular exercise helps her maintain her figure.
examples.zomi: Tawntung pumpi kimawhna in ama pumpi pianzia kemcing sak hi.

senses.usage_en: When discussing a person’s body, use figure carefully because comments about body shape can be sensitive.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat pumpi pianzia genna pen lungsim nasak theih thu ahih manin figure kidawm takin zat ding hi.

senses.heading: Collection of documents or information
senses.definition_en: A collection of papers or information kept together about a person or subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh thu khat tawh kisai lai leh thu theihna a kikholkhawm pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The office keeps a file for every employee.
examples.zomi: Office in nasem sim ading laikhol khat kem hi.

examples.english: The nurse added the test results to my medical file.
examples.zomi: Nurse in sittelna ngahna ka cidamna laikhol sungah behlap hi.

senses.usage_en: A physical file may be a folder or a collection of papers stored together.
senses.usage_zomi: A taktak file pen lai-omna bawm ahih kei leh lai a kikholkhawm pawl hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Stored computer document or data
senses.definition_en: A named collection of information stored on a computer or digital device.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer ahih kei leh digital van sungah min kipia a kikhol thu theihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Save the file before closing the program.
examples.zomi: Program na khak ma in file kem in.

examples.english: The email included a large video file.
examples.zomi: Email sungah video file lian khat kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: A computer file may contain text, images, audio, video, or other forms of data.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer file sungah lai, lim, aw, video, ahih kei leh data nam tuamtuam om thei hi.

senses.heading: Tool for smoothing a hard surface
senses.definition_en: A metal tool with a rough surface used to smooth or shape wood, metal, or another hard material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sing, sik, ahih kei leh van khauh khat a malmal sak leh a pianzia bawl dingin a kizang sik van ahi hi.

examples.english: He used a file to smooth the sharp edge.
examples.zomi: A hiam gei malmal sak dingin file zang hi.

examples.english: The toolmaker shaped the metal with a file.
examples.zomi: Vanzat bawlpa in sik pen file tawh a pianzia bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This tool meaning is unrelated to a document or computer file.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih vanzat khiatna pen lai ahih kei leh computer file tawh kizom lo hi.

senses.heading: Make something full
senses.definition_en: To put enough of something into a container or space so that no more, or little more, can fit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawm ahih kei leh mun khat sung dim dong na khat thun cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please fill the bottle with clean water.
examples.zomi: Thawl pen tui siangtho tawh dimsak in.

examples.english: Smoke quickly filled the room.
examples.zomi: Khu in khan sung manlang takin dimsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use fill something with something: “Fill the cup with water.” When the container becomes full by itself, use fill with: “The cup filled with water.”
senses.usage_zomi: Fill something with something ci in kizang hi: “Fill the cup with water.” Bawm amah a dim ciangin fill with kizang hi: “The cup filled with water.”

senses.heading: Occupy a position, need, or period
senses.definition_en: To occupy a job, satisfy a need, or use all of a period or space.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun la; kicing sak; hun zang
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep mun khat la, kisapna khat kicing sak, ahih kei leh hun leh mun khat a vekin zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company hopes to fill the position next month.
examples.zomi: Company in kha kik ciangin tua nasep mun ading nasem khat la dingin lam-en hi.

examples.english: Reading helped fill the long hours of waiting.
examples.zomi: Laibu simna in ngakna hun saupi zangsiak theihna panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense means supplying what is needed or occupying an available place or time.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in a kisap na kicing sak ahih kei leh a awng mun leh hun zang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Motion picture
senses.definition_en: A story or event recorded as moving images and shown in a cinema, on television, or on another screen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu ahih kei leh a piang thu lim kalsuan in lak a, cinema, television, ahih kei leh screen tungah a kilak ahi hi.

examples.english: We watched a film about the history of Myanmar.
examples.zomi: Myanmar tangthu tawh kisai lim kalsuan khat ka en uh hi.

examples.english: The film won several international awards.
examples.zomi: Tua lim kalsuan in leitung gam tuamtuam pan kipia award tampi ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Film is common in British English. American English more often uses movie for an entertainment motion picture.
senses.usage_zomi: Film pen British English ah kizang ngeizaw hi. American English ah lungnopna lim kalsuan ading movie kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: Material used for traditional photography
senses.definition_en: A thin strip of light-sensitive material used in a traditional camera to record photographs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tanglai camera sungah lim a kimanna dingin khuavak thei a kibawl lap nem leh zang ahi hi.

examples.english: This old camera still uses film.
examples.zomi: Hih camera lui in film zang lai hi.

examples.english: She took the film to a shop to be developed.
examples.zomi: Film pan lim suah dingin dawr ah paipih hi.

senses.usage_en: Digital cameras store images electronically and do not normally use photographic film.
senses.usage_zomi: Digital camera-te in lim electronic tawh kem a, photographic film zang ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Thin layer
senses.definition_en: A very thin layer covering a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tung tuam lap nem leh zang mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: A thin film of oil covered the water.
examples.zomi: Tui tungah sathau lap zang khat tuam hi.

examples.english: The furniture had a film of dust on it.
examples.zomi: Inn vante tungah leivui lap zang om hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes a very thin covering, not a movie.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in lim kalsuan hilo a, na khat tung a tuam lap zang mahmah gen hi.

senses.heading: Last in a series
senses.definition_en: Coming at the end of a series, process, event, or period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizuihna, nasepzia, pawi, ahih kei leh hun khat a tawpna ah a om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We are reading the final chapter of the book.
examples.zomi: Laibu a nunung chapter ka sim uh hi.

examples.english: The final exam will be held on Friday.
examples.zomi: A nunung sittelna Friday ni in kinei ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Final means last in order. It does not always mean best or most important.
senses.usage_zomi: Final in kizuihna ah a nunung cihna ahi hi. A hoihpen ahih kei leh a thupipen cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Decided and not open to change
senses.definition_en: Completely decided and not intended to be changed.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khentat khitsa; kikhel nawn lo ding
senses.explanation_zomi: A khensat khit, a kician khit a, kikhel nawn ding hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee will make its final decision tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Committee in zingciang khentatna nunung bawl ding hi.

examples.english: The judge’s decision is final.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa khentatna kikhel nawn lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: A final decision closes the matter unless a special review or appeal is allowed.
senses.usage_zomi: Final decision in thu tawpsak hi. Entelkikna ahih kei leh thukik ngenna tuam phal ahih keileh thu kikhel nawn lo ding hi.

senses.heading: After a long time or difficulty
senses.definition_en: At last, especially after a long wait, delay, or difficulty.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tawpna ah; hun sawt khit ciangin
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun sawt ngak, manlate, ahih kei leh haksatna tampi khit ciangin a tawpna ah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bus finally arrived after an hour.
examples.zomi: Nai khat khit ciangin bus a tawpna ah hong tung hi.

examples.english: After several attempts, she finally passed the exam.
examples.zomi: Vei tampi a hanciam khit ciangin a tawpna ah sittelna paltawh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense often expresses relief, satisfaction, or impatience after waiting.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in ngakna khit lungmuanna, lungkimna, ahih kei leh ngakzawhlohna pulak thei hi.

senses.heading: Introducing the last point
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce the last item, reason, or point in a sequence.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a nunungpen in; a tawpna ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizuihna khat sunga a nunung na, hang, ahih kei leh thu a pulakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Finally, check your answers before submitting the test.
examples.zomi: A nunungpen in, sittelna na piakma in na dawnnate sittel in.

examples.english: And finally, I would like to thank everyone who helped.
examples.zomi: A nunungpen in, hong panpih mi khempeuh lungdam ka ko nuam hi.

senses.usage_en: In organized speech or writing, finally marks the last point. It does not suggest a long delay in this use.
senses.usage_zomi: Kizem tak kihoupihna ahih kei leh laigelhna ah finally in thu nunungpen pulak hi. Hih zatdan ah hun sawt ngak cihna nei lo hi.

senses.heading: Management of money
senses.definition_en: The management of money, investments, credit, borrowing, and other financial matters.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, sum koihna, leiba, sum leitawi, leh sumlehpai thu dangte uk leh geel cih pilna leh nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: She studied finance at university.
examples.zomi: Amah university ah sumlehpai pilna sin hi.

examples.english: Good personal finance begins with a clear budget.
examples.zomi: Mimal sumlehpai ukna hoih pen budget kician tawh kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Finance is normally uncountable when it means the study or management of money.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumlehpai pilna ahih kei leh ukna a gen ciangin finance pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Money available for an activity
senses.definition_en: Money available to a person, organization, or government, especially for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, kipawlna, ahih kei leh ukna in nasep tuam khat ading a zat theih sum ahi hi.

examples.english: The project was delayed because of a lack of finance.
examples.zomi: Sum kicing lohna hangin project manlate hi.

examples.english: The report examines the company’s finances.
examples.zomi: Tua report in company sum dinmun kancian hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural finances usually means the financial condition or money resources of a person or organization.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural finances in mi ahih kei leh kipawlna khat sum dinmun leh sum neihsa gen zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Connected with money, banking, investment, or the management of funds.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, bank, sum koihna, ahih kei leh sum ukna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The family is experiencing financial difficulties.
examples.zomi: Tua innkuan sumlehpai lamah haksatna thuak hi.

examples.english: You should seek financial advice before investing.
examples.zomi: Sum na koihma in sumlehpai thuhilhna na zong ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Financial modifies a noun. The related noun is finance, and the adverb is financially.
senses.usage_zomi: Financial pen noun hilhcian adjective ahi hi. A kizom noun pen finance ahi a, adverb pen financially ahi hi.

senses.heading: Discover or locate someone or something
senses.definition_en: To discover or locate someone or something after looking, by chance, or through investigation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat zong khit, mawk mu, ahih kei leh kancianna tungtawnin mu cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I found my keys under the chair.
examples.zomi: Ka tawhte tokhum nuai ah ka mu hi.

examples.english: Police are trying to find the missing child.
examples.zomi: Police-te in naupang a mang zong mu dingin hanciam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are both found.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense leh past participle tegel found ahi hi.

senses.heading: Learn or discover that something is true
senses.definition_en: To discover through experience, study, testing, or investigation that something is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muhsa, sinna, sittelna, ahih kei leh kancianna pan thu khat maan hi ci in theikha cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: tua bang hi ci in theikha

examples.english: Researchers found that the treatment was effective.
examples.zomi: Kanciante in tua cidamna in nasem takpi cih theikha uh hi.

examples.english: The investigation found no evidence of wrongdoing.
examples.zomi: Kancianna in gamtat khialhna teci bangmah mu lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Academic reports often use find that to introduce the result of research or analysis.
senses.usage_zomi: Sangpilna report-te ah kancianna ahih kei leh sittelna ngahna pulak dingin find that kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Consider someone or something to have a quality
senses.definition_en: To experience or judge someone or something in a particular way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat omzia tua bang hi ci in sa ahih kei leh teh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I found the book easy to understand.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu tel baih ka sa hi.

examples.english: She finds her new job challenging.
examples.zomi: Amah in a nasep thak hanciamhuai sa hi.

senses.usage_en: The common patterns are find something + adjective and find it + adjective + to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizang ngeina pen find something + adjective leh find it + adjective + to do something ahi hi.

senses.heading: Result of research or investigation
senses.definition_en: A fact or conclusion discovered through study, research, examination, or investigation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sinna, kancianna, sittelna, ahih kei leh entelna pan a kimuh thu maan ahih kei leh thukhupna ahi hi.

examples.english: The researchers published their findings last month.
examples.zomi: Kanciante in kha beisa in amau kancianna ngahnate sua uh hi.

examples.english: One important finding was that the program reduced costs.
examples.zomi: Ngahna thupi khat pen program in sum zatna a kiam sak cih ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Finding commonly refers to an evidence-based result, not merely a personal opinion.
senses.usage_zomi: Finding in mimal ngaihsutna mawk hilo a, teci tungah a kinga kancianna ngahna gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Formal decision by a court or official body
senses.definition_en: A formal decision or conclusion reached by a court, committee, or other official body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhenna, committee, ahih kei leh ukna pawl khat in entel khit ciangin a bawl khentatna ahih kei leh thukhupna ahi hi.

examples.english: The court issued a finding in favor of the worker.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna in nasempa panpih khentatna pia hi.

examples.english: The committee’s findings will be announced tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Committee thukhupnate zingciang kipulak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In legal and official contexts, a finding is a conclusion based on reviewed evidence.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukham leh ukna thu ah finding pen teci entel khit cianga a kibawl thukhupna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Good, satisfactory, or acceptable
senses.definition_en: Good enough, satisfactory, or without serious problems.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoih, a lungkimhuai, ahih kei leh buaina lianpi om lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I felt sick yesterday, but I feel fine today.
examples.zomi: Zanni ka cina napi, tuni ka cidam hi.

examples.english: Your plan is fine with me.
examples.zomi: Na geelna kei adingin hoih hi.

senses.usage_en: In conversation, fine often means acceptable rather than excellent. Tone of voice may change its meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Kihoupihna ah fine in a hoihpen cihna sangin pomtheih cihna nei zel hi. Awging in a khiatna kikhelsak thei hi.

senses.heading: Very good or of high quality
senses.definition_en: Very good, skillful, beautiful, or of high quality.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a hoih mahmah; a hoihna sang
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoih mahmah, a siamna sang, a melhoih, ahih kei leh a hoihna sang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The museum contains many examples of fine art.
examples.zomi: Museum sungah khutkhatna sang etsakna tampi om hi.

examples.english: She gave a fine performance in the play.
