examples.zomi: Tua zatna ah gamtatna lak hoih mahmah nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Before some nouns, fine means excellent or refined, especially in expressions such as fine art and fine dining.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun pawlkhat maiah fine in a hoih mahmah ahih kei leh a sang cihna nei hi, gentehna in fine art leh fine dining.

senses.heading: Very thin, small, or delicate
senses.definition_en: Very thin, narrow, small, or made with delicate detail.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a zang; a neu; a nem
senses.explanation_zomi: A zang mahmah, a neu mahmah, ahih kei leh a kician leh a nem takin kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A layer of fine dust covered the table.
examples.zomi: Leivui neu mahmah lap khat in sabuai tuam hi.

examples.english: The artist painted the fine details carefully.
examples.zomi: Khutkhat siampa in thu tawmno kiciante pilvang takin suai hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes small size, thinness, or delicate detail rather than quality.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in hoihna gen lo a, a neuzia, a zangzia, ahih kei leh a kician tawmnote gen hi.

senses.heading: Bright and dry weather
senses.definition_en: Clear, pleasant, and not raining.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van a siang, khuahun a nuam a, guah zuah lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The weather will be fine tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zingciang khuapha ding hi.

examples.english: It was a fine day for a picnic.
examples.zomi: Tua ni pen pualam an-nekhopna ading ni hoih ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This weather meaning is especially common in British English and weather reports.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khuahun khiatna pen British English leh khuahun report-te ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.definition_en: One of the five long, movable parts at the end of each hand.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khut sim a a tawpa om a kikhinkhian thei khen nga lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She cut her finger while preparing food.
examples.zomi: An bawl laitakin ama khutme ki-at hi.

examples.english: Use your finger to press the button.
examples.zomi: Tua mek net dingin na khutme zang in.

senses.usage_en: The thumb is technically different from the four fingers, but in ordinary English it is often included when counting all five digits of the hand.
senses.usage_zomi: Khutme la in a dang khutme lite tawh a pianzia kibang kimlo napi, nisim English ah khut khen nga a sim ciangin kihel zel hi.

senses.heading: Complete an activity or task
senses.definition_en: To complete an activity, task, or piece of work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, gamtatna, ahih kei leh bawl ding khat zosiang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please finish your homework before dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak an na nekma in na inn nasep zosiang in.

examples.english: She finished writing the report this morning.
examples.zomi: Amah in tuni zingkaal report gelhna zosiang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use finish doing something, not finish to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Finish khitah gamtatna gen ciangin finish doing something kici a, finish to do something kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Come to an end
senses.definition_en: To reach the end of an event, period, journey, or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawi, hun, khualzinna, ahih kei leh kidemna khat a tawpna hong tung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting finished at three o’clock.
examples.zomi: Meeting dak thum in tawp hi.

examples.english: Our team finished second in the competition.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl un kidemna ah mun nihna ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When finish is intransitive, the activity or event itself reaches its end.
senses.usage_zomi: Finish pen object om lo in kizang ciangin gamtatna ahih kei leh pawi amah a tawp cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Heat, light, and flames from burning
senses.definition_en: The heat, light, and flames produced when something burns.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kuang ciangin a piang mei, khuavak leh khuasa ahi hi.

examples.english: We sat near the fire to keep warm.
examples.zomi: A lum theihna dingin mei kiangah ka tu uh hi.

examples.english: Always put out the fire before leaving the camp.
examples.zomi: Giahphual pan na pai ma in mei mit tawntung in.

senses.usage_en: Fire is uncountable when it means burning as a substance or process, but countable when referring to a particular destructive event.
senses.usage_zomi: Meikuang cih gamtatna gen ciangin fire pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi. Meikuang piang khat cimawh gen ciangin simtheih noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Destructive burning event
senses.definition_en: An event in which flames burn and damage a building, forest, vehicle, or other property.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn, gamlak, mawtaw, ahih kei leh van khat a kang a, a siatna piangsak meikuang ahi hi.

examples.english: The fire destroyed three houses.
examples.zomi: Meikuang in inn thum susia hi.

examples.english: Firefighters controlled the forest fire.
examples.zomi: Meimitte in gam kangmei ukzo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A particular fire is countable: a fire, two fires. Use firefighters for people trained to control fires.
senses.usage_zomi: Meikuang khat cimawh pen simtheih ahi a, a fire, two fires ci in kizang hi. Meikuang do dingin a kisinsak mite firefighters kici hi.

senses.heading: Shooting from weapons
senses.definition_en: Bullets or other weapons being discharged toward a target.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna khat lamah meithal ahih kei leh galhiam dang tawh kapna ahi hi.

examples.english: The soldiers came under fire near the village.
examples.zomi: Galmangte khua kiangah meithal kikhap hi.

examples.english: The order to open fire was not given.
examples.zomi: Meithal kap ding thupiakna kipiak lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is common in military and news contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen gal leh thuthak thu ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.definition_en: A business or company, especially one providing professional services.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumdawnna ahih kei leh siamna nasemna pia company khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She works for a large law firm.
examples.zomi: Amah thukham siampite company lian khat ading nasem hi.

examples.english: The firm hired twenty new employees.
examples.zomi: Tua company in nasem thak sawmnih la hi.

senses.usage_en: Firm is commonly used for professional businesses such as law, accounting, consulting, and investment companies.
senses.usage_zomi: Firm pen thukham, sum simna, thuhilhna leh sum koihna bang siamna nasemna pia company-te ading kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Before all others in order or time
senses.definition_en: Coming before all others in a sequence, order, or period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizuihna, hun, ahih kei leh a dinmun ah na dang khempeuh ma a om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This is my first visit to the city.
examples.zomi: Hih pen hih khuapi ka veh masakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The first bus leaves at six o’clock.
examples.zomi: Bus masapen dak guk in pusuak hi.

senses.usage_en: First is the ordinal form of one. It usually comes before a noun or follows the when the noun is understood.
senses.usage_zomi: First pen one ordinal form ahi hi. Noun maiah kizang zel a, noun telkhin ahih leh the khitah zong om thei hi.

senses.heading: Most important
senses.definition_en: More important than anything or anyone else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na ahih kei leh mi dang khempeuh sangin a thupizaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: In this workplace, safety comes first.
examples.zomi: Hih nasepna munah bitna pen a thupipen ahi hi.

examples.english: She always puts her children first.
examples.zomi: Amah in a tate thupipen in koih tawntung hi.

senses.usage_en: In expressions such as safety first, first refers to priority rather than time.
senses.usage_zomi: Safety first bang kammal ah first in hun masa gen lo a, a thupi sak masakpen cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to introduce the first point, reason, or item in an ordered explanation or list.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a masapen in; thu masa in
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizem takin thu gen ahih kei leh gelh ciangin thu, hang, ahih kei leh list a masapen pulakna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a masapen in, ka hilhcian ding

examples.english: Firstly, we need to identify the main problem.
examples.zomi: A masapen in, buaina thupipen ka theihkhia kul uh hi.

examples.english: Firstly, I will explain the purpose of the project.
examples.zomi: Thu masa in, project ngiimna ka hilhcian ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Firstly is common in organized speech and writing. First can be used in the same way and often sounds more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Firstly pen kizek kihoupihna leh laigelhna ah kizang ngei hi. First zong tua bangin kizang thei a, khenkhat ciangin a pianpihzaw in ging hi.

senses.heading: Animal that lives in water
senses.definition_en: A cold-blooded animal that lives in water, breathes through gills, and usually has fins and scales.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui sungah nungta, haksaan tawh hu nung, a tamzaw in kha leh nai nei ganhing ahi hi.

examples.english: The river contains many kinds of fish.
examples.zomi: Gun sungah nga nam tampi om hi.

examples.english: We saw a school of fish near the boat.
examples.zomi: Kuang kiangah nga pawl khat ka mu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is usually fish when referring to several individual fish. Fishes is sometimes used for several species.
senses.usage_zomi: Nga tampi gen ciangin plural pen fish mah kizang zel hi. Nga nam tuamtuam gen ciangin fishes zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Fish used as food
senses.definition_en: The flesh of fish eaten as food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An in a kinek nga sa ahi hi.

examples.english: We ate rice and fried fish for dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak an in ann leh nga kang ka ne uh hi.

examples.english: Fish is an important source of protein.
examples.zomi: Nga pen protein ngahna thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Fish is normally uncountable when it refers to food.
senses.usage_zomi: An in a kinek nga sa gen ciangin fish pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity or occupation of catching fish.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nga man cih gamtatna, nasep, ahih kei leh sumdawnna ahi hi.

examples.english: They went fishing early in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingkal matahin ngaman dingin pai uh hi.

examples.english: Fishing provides income for many families.
examples.zomi: Ngaman nasep in innkuan tampi sum ngahsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Say go fishing, not go to fishing.
senses.usage_zomi: Go fishing ci ding a, go to fishing ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Be the correct size or shape
senses.definition_en: To be the correct size or shape for a person, place, or object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun, ahih kei leh van khat tawh a size leh pianzia kituak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: kong pan lutthei zah in om

examples.english: These shoes fit me perfectly.
examples.zomi: Hih khedapte kei tawh kituak sitset hi.

examples.english: The table will not fit through the narrow door.
examples.zomi: Tua sabuai pen kongka nau pan lut zo lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: When clothing fits, its size and shape are correct. When clothing suits someone, it looks attractive or appropriate on that person.
senses.usage_zomi: Puan fits ciangin a size leh pianzia kituak hi. Puan in mi khat suits ciangin ama tungah a melhoih ahih kei leh a kituak kilawm cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Put or install something in position
senses.definition_en: To put, attach, or install something in the correct position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat a om ding munah koih, tawhcip, ahih kei leh bulh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The mechanic fitted a new battery in the car.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw siampa in mawtaw sungah battery thak khat bulh hi.

examples.english: Workers are fitting new windows in the building.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in inn ah thlalang thakte bulh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This transitive use is especially common in British English. American English often uses install.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih transitive zatdan pen British English ah kizang ngeizaw hi. American English ah install kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: Have enough space for someone or something
senses.definition_en: To have enough space to contain a particular number of people or objects.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van zah khat omtheihna ding mun kicing nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The car can fit seven people.
examples.zomi: Tua mawtaw sungah mi sagih omthei hi.

examples.english: Can you fit all the books into this box?
examples.zomi: Laibu khempeuh hih bawm sungah na koihzo diam?

senses.usage_en: In informal English, fit may mean “have room for” or “put successfully into a space.”
senses.usage_zomi: Informal English ah fit in “omtheihna mun nei” ahih kei leh “mun khat sungah koihzo” cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Physical health and strength
senses.definition_en: The condition of being physically healthy, strong, and able to exercise.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi cidam, thahat a, kimawh leh nasep thei dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: Regular exercise can improve your fitness.
examples.zomi: Tawntung pumpi kimawhna in na pumpi cidamna leh thahatna khangsak thei hi.

examples.english: The school introduced a new fitness program.
examples.zomi: Sang in pumpi kimawhna program thak khat kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Fitness describes general physical condition, not only body shape or weight.
senses.usage_zomi: Fitness in pumpi pianzia ahih kei leh gikzia bek hilo a, pumpi cidamna leh hihtheihna a vekin gen hi.

senses.heading: Suitability for a purpose
senses.definition_en: The quality of being suitable or capable for a particular purpose, position, or duty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna, dinmun, ahih kei leh mawhpuakna khat ading a kituak leh a hihthei cih omzia ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor assessed his fitness for work.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ama nasep semtheihna sittel hi.

examples.english: The committee questioned her fitness for the position.
examples.zomi: Committee in amah tua nasep mun ading kituak hiam ci in dong hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense concerns whether someone or something is suitable for a specific purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna in mi ahih kei leh na khat ngiimna tuam ading a kituak leh kituak loh gen hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 5.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambar nga ahi hi.

examples.english: There are five chairs in the room.
examples.zomi: Khan sungah tokhum nga om hi.

examples.english: The meeting begins in five minutes.
examples.zomi: Minute nga sungin meeting kipan ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The ordinal form of five is fifth, not fiveth.
senses.usage_zomi: Five ordinal form pen fifth ahi a, fiveth hilo hi.

senses.heading: Repair something
senses.definition_en: To repair something that is broken, damaged, or not working correctly.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sia, a keh, ahih kei leh a kilawm bangin nasem lo na khat bawlpha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The mechanic fixed the car’s engine.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw siampa in mawtaw engine bawlpha hi.

examples.english: Can you fix this broken chair?
examples.zomi: Hih tokhum a keh na bawlpha thei diam?

senses.usage_en: In American English, fix is a common general word for repair. In formal writing, repair may be more precise.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah fix pen bawlphatna genna kammal kizang ngei ahi hi. Formal laigelhna ah repair pen kicianzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: Solve or correct a problem
senses.definition_en: To solve a problem or correct something that is wrong.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina khat siansuah ahih kei leh na khial khat dik sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The update fixed several security problems.
examples.zomi: Tua update in bitna buaina tampi siansuah hi.

examples.english: We need to fix the mistake before publication.
examples.zomi: Ka sua ma un khialhna dik sak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Fix a problem is common in conversation. Depending on context, more precise verbs include solve, correct, and repair.
senses.usage_zomi: Kihoupihna ah fix a problem kizang ngei hi. Thu kizangna bangin solve, correct, leh repair pen kicianzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: Arrange or prepare something
senses.definition_en: To arrange, prepare, or establish something for a particular time or purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ahih kei leh ngiimna khat ading na khat geelkholh, bawlkholh, ahih kei leh kipsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We need to fix a date for the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting ading ni khat khensat kul hi.

examples.english: I will fix dinner while you rest.
examples.zomi: Nang na khawl sungin nitak an ka bawl ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Fix a meal is especially common in American English and means prepare it.
senses.usage_zomi: Fix a meal pen American English ah kizang ngei a, an bawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Repaired
senses.definition_en: Repaired and made to work correctly again.
senses.explanation_zomi: A siatna kibawlpha a, a kilawm bangin nasem kik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The fixed machine is working normally again.
examples.zomi: Machine bawlphat khit pen a ngeina bangin nasem kik hi.

examples.english: I will collect the phone after it is fixed.
examples.zomi: Phone kibawlphat khit ciangin ka la ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Fixed may be used after get or have: “I got my car fixed.”
senses.usage_zomi: Fixed pen get ahih kei leh have khitah kizang thei hi: “I got my car fixed.”

senses.heading: Firmly attached and unable to move
senses.definition_en: Firmly attached in one position and not movable.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun khat ah kip; kikhinkhian lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah kip takin kitawh a, kikhinkhian thei lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The table is fixed to the floor.
examples.zomi: Sabuai pen innpi ah kip takin kitawh hi.

examples.english: The camera remains fixed in one position.
examples.zomi: Camera pen mun khat ah kikhinkhian lo in om hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is the opposite of movable or adjustable.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen kikhinkhian thei ahih kei leh kibawl kituak thei cih tawh kilehbulh hi.

senses.heading: Decided or unchanging
senses.definition_en: Already decided, established, or not intended to change.
senses.explanation_zomi: A khensat khit, a kipsak khit, ahih kei leh kikhel ding hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The tickets are sold at a fixed price.
examples.zomi: Ticket-te man kipsa tawh kizual hi.

examples.english: The course has no fixed starting date.
examples.zomi: Tua sinna kipatna ni kipsa nei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: A fixed price does not normally change or allow bargaining.
senses.usage_zomi: Fixed price pen a ngeina in kikhel lo a, kiselna tawh man kiam sak theih lo hi.

senses.heading: Piece of cloth used as a symbol
senses.definition_en: A piece of cloth with a special design that represents a country, organization, or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam, kipawlna, ahih kei leh pawl khat aiawh ding lim tuam nei puan ahi hi.

examples.english: The national flag was raised before the ceremony.
examples.zomi: Pawi kipatma in gam payam kikahto hi.

examples.english: Children waved flags during the parade.
examples.zomi: Kalsuanna pawi laitakin naupangte payam zam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Flags may represent countries, states, organizations, causes, or warnings.
senses.usage_zomi: Payam in gam, state, kipawlna, ngiimna, ahih kei leh kidopna limgen thei hi.

senses.heading: Marker or warning sign
senses.definition_en: A visible sign or digital marker used to attract attention, identify a condition, or warn of a problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat ngaihsak ding, dinmun khat theih ding, ahih kei leh buaina kidopna ding lim ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: thu khat buaina hi ci in theihsak

examples.english: Repeated late payments are a red flag.
examples.zomi: Sum piak manlate kikkik pen kidopna lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The system placed a flag beside the suspicious account.
examples.zomi: System in account lunghiankai kiangah kidopna lim khat koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Red flag commonly means a warning sign that suggests possible danger or trouble.
senses.usage_zomi: Red flag in lauhuaina ahih kei leh buaina omtheihna kidopna lim cihna in kizang ngei hi.

senses.definition_en: The visible, hot, glowing part of a fire.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meikuang sunga khuavak leh sa tawh a kilang meilei ahi hi.

examples.english: A small flame burned at the end of the candle.
examples.zomi: Meivak a tawp ah meilei neu khat kuang hi.

examples.english: The dry grass quickly burst into flames.
examples.zomi: Lopa keu pen manlang takin meikuang hi.

senses.usage_en: Fire can refer to the whole burning event, while a flame is one visible tongue or area of burning gas.
senses.usage_zomi: Fire in meikuang piangna a vekin gen thei a, flame pen a kimuthei meilei khat ahih kei leh meilei khen khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Sudden brief light
senses.definition_en: A sudden bright light that appears for a very short time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tomno sung thakhat in a taang khuavak ahi hi.

examples.english: We saw a flash of lightning in the distance.
examples.zomi: Gamla ah khuaphia vakphialna ka mu uh hi.

examples.english: The camera flash was very bright.
examples.zomi: Camera khuavak taang mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: A flash lasts only a very short time.
senses.usage_zomi: Flash pen hun tomno bek sung om hi.

senses.heading: Very brief appearance or feeling
senses.definition_en: A sudden feeling, image, or event that lasts only a moment.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thakhat in piang; hun tomno thu
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tomno sung thakhat in a piang lungsim omzia, lim, ahih kei leh thu ahi hi.

examples.english: She felt a flash of anger when she heard the accusation.
examples.zomi: Mawhsakna a zak ciangin thakhat in lungthah hi.

examples.english: The answer came to him in a flash.
examples.zomi: Dawnna pen thakhat sungin a lungsim ah hong om hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense emphasizes that something appears suddenly and briefly.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in na khat thakhat in hong piang a, hun tomno bek om cih khauhsak hi.

senses.heading: Apartment
senses.definition_en: A set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a larger building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn lian khat sunga innkuan khat tenna ding khan pawl, a tamzaw in inn tầng khat tungah a om ahi hi.

examples.english: She rents a small flat near the university.
examples.zomi: Amah university kiangah apartment neu khat luah hi.

examples.english: Their flat is on the third floor.
examples.zomi: Amau apartment inn tầng thumna ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Flat is the usual British English word. American English normally uses apartment.
senses.usage_zomi: Flat pen British English a kizang ngei kammal ahi hi. American English ah apartment kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: Punctured tire
senses.definition_en: A tire that has lost its air because of damage or a hole.
senses.explanation_zomi: A vang ahih kei leh a siatna hangin huih a beita mawtaw khelem ahi hi.

examples.english: We had a flat on the way to work.
examples.zomi: Nasepna a ka paina lampi ah ka mawtaw khelem huih bei hi.

examples.english: He stopped to change the flat.
examples.zomi: Khelem huih bei khek dingin khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A flat is an informal shortened form of a flat tire in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah a flat pen a flat tire a tomlakna informal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Able to bend without breaking
senses.definition_en: Able to bend easily without breaking or becoming damaged.
senses.explanation_zomi: Baih takin kawihtheih napi keh ahih kei leh sia lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This plastic is strong but flexible.
examples.zomi: Hih plastic pen thahat napi kawih baih hi.

examples.english: The flexible pipe can bend around corners.
examples.zomi: Pipe nem pen king leh kawihtheih hi.

senses.usage_en: The opposite is rigid or inflexible.
senses.usage_zomi: A kilehbulh pen rigid ahih kei leh inflexible ahi hi.

senses.heading: Able or willing to change
senses.definition_en: Able or willing to change plans, methods, rules, or times when necessary.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisap bangin geelna, sepzia, thukhun, ahih kei leh hun kikhelthei leh kikhelnuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company offers flexible working hours.
examples.zomi: Company in kikheltheih nasep hun pia hi.

examples.english: We need to be flexible when plans change.
examples.zomi: Geelnate a kikhel ciangin eite zong ka kituaksak thei ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A flexible person can adapt to changing situations instead of insisting on only one plan.
senses.usage_zomi: Flexible person pen geelna khat bek lenkip lo a, dinmun kikhel bangin amah zong kituaksakthei mi ahi hi.

senses.heading: Journey by aircraft
senses.definition_en: A journey made in an aircraft, especially a scheduled trip between airports.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanleng tawh vanleng ngakna mun khat pan mun dang khat a kinei khualzinna ahi hi.

examples.english: Our flight leaves at seven tomorrow morning.
examples.zomi: Ka vanleng uh zingciang zing dak sagih in pusuak ding hi.

examples.english: The flight was delayed because of bad weather.
examples.zomi: Khuahun hoih lo hangin vanleng manlate hi.

senses.usage_en: A flight is the journey, while an airplane or aircraft is the vehicle.
senses.usage_zomi: Flight pen khualzinna ahi a, airplane ahih kei leh aircraft pen a kizang vanleng ahi hi.

senses.heading: Act or ability of flying
senses.definition_en: The act, process, or ability of moving through the air.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huihlak ah leng cih gamtatna, nasepzia, ahih kei leh hihtheihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The photographer captured the bird in flight.
examples.zomi: Limlakpa in vasa a leng laitak lim la hi.

examples.english: The young bird is not yet capable of flight.
examples.zomi: Vasa no pen lengthei nailo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, flight refers to flying itself rather than a commercial journey.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah flight in sum tawh vanleng khualzinna sangin lengna gamtatna mah gen hi.

senses.heading: Set of stairs between two levels
senses.definition_en: A continuous set of stairs between one floor or level and the next.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn tầng khat pan a dang khat dong a kizom kalbi pawl khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Her office is one flight of stairs above us.
examples.zomi: Ama office ka tung uh kalbi pawl khat khitah om hi.

examples.english: We climbed three flights of stairs.
examples.zomi: Kalbi pawl thum ka kahto uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The fixed expression is a flight of stairs.
senses.usage_zomi: A kipsa kammal kizopna pen a flight of stairs ahi hi.

senses.heading: Stay on the surface of a liquid
senses.definition_en: To remain on the surface of water or another liquid without sinking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui ahih kei leh tui bang a luang na tungah tum lo in taam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Wood usually floats on water.
examples.zomi: Sing a tamzaw tui tungah taam hi.

examples.english: The empty bottle floated down the river.
examples.zomi: Thawl awng pen gun tui luang zui in taam hi.

senses.usage_en: Float is the opposite of sink.
senses.usage_zomi: Float pen sink, tui sungah tum cih tawh kilehbulh hi.

senses.heading: Move gently through air or space
senses.definition_en: To move slowly and gently through the air or across a space.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nem takin leng; dam takin kalsuan
senses.explanation_zomi: Huihlak ahih kei leh mun khat tawnin dam tak leh nem takin kalsuan cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: a smell floats into the room

examples.english: White clouds floated across the sky.
examples.zomi: Meii kangte vanah nem takin kalsuan uh hi.

examples.english: The smell of food floated into the room.
examples.zomi: An gim khan sungah hong lut hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense suggests slow, light, and effortless movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in dam, vang leh hanciamna om lo bangin kalsuan cih pulak hi.

senses.heading: Overflow of water onto normally dry land
senses.definition_en: A large amount of water covering land that is normally dry.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui tampi hong khang a, a ngeina in a keu leitang tuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The flood damaged hundreds of homes.
examples.zomi: Tuikhang in inn za tampi susia hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain caused flooding along the river.
examples.zomi: Guah tampi in gun gei ah tuikhang piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: A flood is countable when referring to one event. Flooding is normally uncountable when describing the general condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Tuikhang piang khat cimawh pen a flood ci in simtheih hi. Tuikhang dinmun gen ciangin flooding pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Very large amount arriving suddenly
senses.definition_en: A very large number or amount of people, messages, requests, or other things arriving at once.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tampi takin hong lutna; thakhat in hong tam
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, thupuak, ngetna, ahih kei leh na dang tampi thakhat in hong lut cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The office received a flood of applications.
examples.zomi: Office in lai-apna tampi tak sang hi.

examples.english: The announcement caused a flood of questions.
examples.zomi: Tua thupuak in dotna tampi piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense emphasizes an unusually large amount arriving quickly.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in na tampi a hun tomno sung hong lut cih khauhsak hi.

senses.heading: Surface that people walk on inside a building
senses.definition_en: The lower surface of a room that people walk on.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khan ahih kei leh inn sungah mite a kalsuan uh nuailam zan ahi hi.

examples.english: The child was sitting on the floor.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen innpi ah tu hi.

examples.english: Please clean the kitchen floor.
examples.zomi: Anbawlna khan innpi siansuah in.

senses.usage_en: The floor is inside a building. The ground is normally the outdoor surface of the earth.
senses.usage_zomi: Floor pen inn sung a om hi. Ground ahih leh pualam leitang zan gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Level of a building
senses.definition_en: All the rooms on one level of a building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn lian khat sunga a sangna kibang a om khan pawl, tầng khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Her office is on the fourth floor.
examples.zomi: Ama office inn tầng lina ah om hi.

examples.english: The building has ten floors.
examples.zomi: Tua inn tầng sawm nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Floor numbering differs between American and British English. In American English, the entrance level is usually the first floor; in British English, it is the ground floor.
senses.usage_zomi: Inn tầng nambar zatdan American leh British English ah kibang lo hi. American English ah lutna tầng pen first floor kici zel a, British English ah ground floor kici hi.

senses.heading: Lowest permitted amount
senses.definition_en: A minimum level below which a price, wage, or quantity is not allowed to fall.
senses.explanation_zomi: Man, loh, ahih kei leh a zah in a niamzaw theih nawn lohna ciangtan ahi hi.

examples.english: The law establishes a wage floor for workers.
examples.zomi: Thukham in nasemte loh ciangtan niampen khensat hi.

examples.english: The agreement placed a floor under oil prices.
examples.zomi: Thukimna in sathau man ciangtan niampen koih hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a specialized economic and policy meaning. Its opposite is often ceiling, a maximum permitted level.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen sumlehpai leh thukhun lam khiatna tuam ahi hi. A kilehbulh pen ceiling, ciangtan sangpen, hi zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A fine powder made by grinding wheat or another grain and used for making bread, cakes, and other foods.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buhgawh, tangham, ahih kei leh anlakna dang kisukneem a, tanghou leh an nam tuamtuam bawlna ding a kizang vui ahi hi.

examples.english: Mix the flour with water and salt.
examples.zomi: Anvui pen tui leh ci tawh hel in.

examples.english: She bought a bag of flour to make bread.
examples.zomi: Tanghou bawl dingin anvui dip khat lei hi.

senses.usage_en: Flour and flower have the same pronunciation but different spellings and meanings. Flour is normally uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Flour leh flower awsuah kibang napi, gelhdan leh khiatna kibang lo hi. Flour pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Move continuously like a liquid
senses.definition_en: To move continuously in one direction, especially when describing water, another liquid, or gas.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui, tui bang na, ahih kei leh huih lampi khat zui in tawntung luang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The river flows toward the sea.
examples.zomi: Gun pen tuipi lamah luang hi.

examples.english: Blood flows through the body.
examples.zomi: Sisan pumpi sungah luang hi.

senses.usage_en: Flow describes smooth, continuous movement. Pour describes someone deliberately causing liquid to move from a container.
senses.usage_zomi: Flow in nem leh tawntung luangna gen hi. Pour in mi khat in bawm sung tui a luangsak cih gamtatna gen hi.

senses.heading: Move or continue smoothly
senses.definition_en: To move, spread, or continue smoothly and without interruption.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kizom takin paisuak; nem takin kalsuan
senses.explanation_zomi: Khawl kikal lo in nem tak leh kizom takin kalsuan ahih kei leh paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Traffic was flowing smoothly this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingkaal mawtawte khawl kikal lo in kalsuan uh hi.

examples.english: The conversation flowed naturally.
examples.zomi: Kihoupihna a pianpih takin paisuak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense compares smooth movement or progress to flowing water.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in nem leh kizom takin kalsuan cih pen tui luang tawh genteh hi.

senses.heading: Blooming part of a plant
senses.definition_en: The often colorful part of a plant that produces seeds.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung ahih kei leh lou kung khat a pang a, a tamzaw in melhoih leh a kit-om a, a ci suahna khen ahi hi.

examples.english: The garden is full of colorful flowers.
examples.zomi: Huan sung color tuamtuam nei pakte tawh kidim hi.

examples.english: He gave her a bunch of flowers.
examples.zomi: Amah in tua numei tungah pak bawk khat pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Flower is countable when referring to individual blooms. The collective material may also be described as flowers.
senses.usage_zomi: Pak khat cimawh gen ciangin flower pen simtheih noun ahi hi. Pak tampi a kigawm zong flowers ci in kici hi.

senses.heading: Plant grown for its flowers
senses.definition_en: A plant that is grown or valued for its colorful or attractive blooms.
senses.explanation_zomi: A pak melhoih hangin a kikhawi singkung ahih kei leh lou kung ahi hi.

examples.english: She planted flowers beside the house.
examples.zomi: Amah in inn geiah pak kungte phut hi.

examples.english: Remember to water the flowers every morning.
examples.zomi: Zing simin pak kungte tui pia ding phawk in.

senses.usage_en: Flour has the same pronunciation as flower but means a powder used in cooking.
senses.usage_zomi: Flour leh flower awsuah kibang hi. Ahih hang flour pen an bawlna a kizang vui ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A common infectious illness caused by an influenza virus, often producing fever, body pain, tiredness, coughing, and a sore throat.
senses.explanation_zomi: Influenza virus hangin a piang, khosak, pumpi na, gim, khuh leh awna bang a piangsak natna kizawh baih ahi hi.

examples.english: She stayed home because she had the flu.
examples.zomi: Flu a cinat manin inn ah om hi.

examples.english: A flu vaccine can reduce the risk of serious illness.
examples.zomi: Flu natna daalna zatui in natna khauhpi ngahtheihna kiam sak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Flu is different from the common cold and can be more serious. Flu is the shortened form of influenza.
senses.usage_zomi: Flu pen khukha natna tawh kibang lo a, natna khauhzaw hi thei hi. Flu pen influenza a tomlakna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Move through the air
senses.definition_en: To move through the air using wings or another means.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kha ahih kei leh lampi dang tawh huihlak ah kalsuan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Birds flew over the lake.
examples.zomi: Vasate dil tungah leng uh hi.

examples.english: Some insects can fly long distances.
examples.zomi: Pul natna pawlkhat gamla tak lengthei hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is flew and the past participle is flown.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen flew ahi a, past participle pen flown ahi hi.

senses.heading: Travel in or operate an aircraft
senses.definition_en: To travel by aircraft or control an aircraft in the air.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanleng tawh khualzin ahih kei leh vanleng hawl cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: vanleng tawh New York ah pai

examples.english: We are flying to Chicago tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zingciang vanleng tawh Chicago ah ka pai ding uh hi.

examples.english: She learned to fly a small plane.
examples.zomi: Amah vanleng neu khat hawl siam hi.

senses.usage_en: When fly has no object, it often means travel by air. When it has an aircraft as its object, it means operate that aircraft.
senses.usage_zomi: Fly in object nei lo ciangin vanleng tawh khualzin cihna nei zel hi. Vanleng object in a nei ciangin tua vanleng hawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Move very quickly
senses.definition_en: To move or pass very quickly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Manlang mahmah in kalsuan ahih kei leh paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Time flies when we are busy.
examples.zomi: Nasep tampi ka neih ciangin hun bei manlang hi.

examples.english: The ball flew across the field.
examples.zomi: Ball pen kimawhna zaang kantan in manlang takin pai hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense emphasizes unusually fast movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in kalsuanna manlang mahmah cih khauhsak hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity of traveling through the air or operating an aircraft.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huihlak ah leng, vanleng tawh khualzin, ahih kei leh vanleng hawl cih gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has always had a fear of flying.
examples.zomi: Amah vanleng tuang lau tawntung hi.

examples.english: Flying in bad weather requires great skill.
examples.zomi: Khuahun hoih lo sungah vanleng hawl ding siamna tampi kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Flying can mean traveling as a passenger or operating an aircraft; context shows which meaning is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Flying in vanleng tuang khualzin cihna zong, vanleng hawl cihna zong nei thei hi. A kizangna thu in khiatna hong kician sak hi.

senses.heading: Give attention to something
senses.definition_en: To direct and maintain attention, effort, or interest on a particular subject or task.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih kei leh nasep khat tungah lungsim, hanciamna, leh lunglutna koihcip cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please focus on the question.
examples.zomi: Tua dotna tungah na lungsim koih in.

examples.english: The report focuses on public health.
examples.zomi: Tua report in mipi cidamna thu ngaihsak pen hi.

senses.usage_en: Use focus on something, not normally focus in something.
senses.usage_zomi: Focus on something ci in kizang a, a ngeina in focus in something kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Adjust an image so it is clear
senses.definition_en: To adjust a camera, lens, or eyes so that an image appears clear.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim a kician theihna dingin camera, lens, ahih kei leh mit bawl kituak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Focus the camera before taking the picture.
examples.zomi: Lim na lakma in camera lim kiciansak in.

examples.english: My eyes could not focus in the darkness.
examples.zomi: Khuamial sungah ka mitte in lim kician takin mu zo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In photography, focus on may identify the subject that should appear clear.
senses.usage_zomi: Limlakna ah focus on in lim kician ding mi ahih kei leh na pulak thei hi.

senses.heading: Bend material over itself
senses.definition_en: To bend paper, cloth, or another flexible material so that one part lies over another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, puan, ahih kei leh van nem khat khen khat a dang tungah om dingin thuap cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Fold the paper in half.
examples.zomi: Lai pen a langnih in thuap in.

examples.english: She folded the clean clothes and put them away.
examples.zomi: Amah in puan siangthote zial a, a munah koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Fold normally means bending without cutting or separating the material.
senses.usage_zomi: Fold in van pen at ahih kei leh khenkhia lo in thuap cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Close something by bending its parts
senses.definition_en: To close or make something smaller by bending its movable parts together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat a kikhinkhian thei khente thuapkhawm a, khak ahih kei leh neusak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Fold the chairs after the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting khit ciangin tokhumte thuap in.

examples.english: This table folds for easy storage.
examples.zomi: Hih sabuai pen koih baihna dingin thuaptheih hi.

senses.usage_en: Objects designed this way are often described with the adjective folding.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih bangin a kibawl van-te adjective folding tawh kici zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Designed to be folded so that it becomes smaller and easier to carry or store.
senses.explanation_zomi: A neuzaw suak a, puak leh koih baihna dingin thuaptheih in a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We brought folding chairs to the outdoor event.
examples.zomi: Pualam pawi ah tokhum thuaptheihte ka paipih uh hi.

examples.english: A folding table is easy to store.
examples.zomi: Sabuai thuaptheih pen koih baih hi.

senses.usage_en: Folding describes an object’s design, while folded describes its condition after someone has folded it.
senses.usage_zomi: Folding in van khat a kibawldan gen hi. Folded ahih leh mi khat in a thuap khitsa dinmun gen hi.

senses.heading: People in general
senses.definition_en: People in general, or a particular group of people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite a diil in, ahih kei leh pawl tuam khat sunga mite genna ahi hi.

examples.english: The local folk welcomed the visitors warmly.
examples.zomi: Khuamite in mikhualte lungdam takin nawl uh hi.

examples.english: These stories were passed down by ordinary folk.
examples.zomi: Hih tangthute mi ngeinate in khang khat pan khang khat dong pia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Folk is informal and traditional in tone. Folks is also commonly used, especially in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Folk pen informal leh tang ngeina aw nei hi. Adiakin American English ah folks zong kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Family, especially parents
senses.definition_en: A person’s family, especially their parents.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat innkuanpihte, adiakin a nu leh a pa ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: ka nu leh pa; ka innkuanpihte

examples.english: I am visiting my folks this weekend.
examples.zomi: Hih weekend in ka nu leh pa ka veh ding hi.

examples.english: How are your folks?
examples.zomi: Na innkuanpihte dam uh hiam?

senses.usage_en: This family meaning normally appears as the plural folks and is informal.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih innkuan khiatna pen plural folks in kizang zel a, informal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Move behind someone or something
senses.definition_en: To move behind someone or something while going in the same direction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat nungah lampi khat zui in pai cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat inn dong nung zui

examples.english: Follow me, and I will show you the room.
examples.zomi: Kei hong zui in; khan kong lak ding hi.

examples.english: A small dog followed us home.
examples.zomi: Ui neu khat in inn dong hong zui hi.

senses.usage_en: Follow means moving after someone. Lead means going first and showing the way.
senses.usage_zomi: Follow in mi khat nungah pai cihna ahi hi. Lead in ma ah pai a lampi lak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Obey or act according to instructions
senses.definition_en: To obey or act according to a rule, instruction, plan, or example.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, thuhilhna, geelna, ahih kei leh etsakna bangin gamta cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Follow the instructions carefully.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhnate pilvang takin zui in.

examples.english: Every employee must follow the safety rules.
examples.zomi: Nasem khempeuh in bitna thukhunte zui ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, follow means doing what a rule or instruction requires.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah follow in thukhun ahih kei leh thuhilhna in a ngen bangin gamta cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Understand an explanation or discussion
senses.definition_en: To understand what someone is saying or explaining.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat gen ahih kei leh hilhcian thu tel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am sorry, but I do not follow your explanation.
examples.zomi: Hong maisak in, na hilhcianna ka tel lo hi.

examples.english: The lecture was clear and easy to follow.
examples.zomi: Laihilhna kician a, tel baih hi.

senses.usage_en: “I don’t follow” is a polite way to say that you do not understand.
senses.usage_zomi: “I don’t follow” cih pen thu na tel loh zaidam takin genna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Happen after something
senses.definition_en: To happen, come, or appear after another event or item.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih kei leh na khat khitah hong piang, hong pai, ahih kei leh hong om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain followed the strong winds.
examples.zomi: Huihpi khitah guah tampi zuah hi.

examples.english: A long discussion followed the presentation.
examples.zomi: Presentation khitah kihoupihna saupi om hi.

senses.usage_en: This use describes order in time rather than physical movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan in pumpi kalsuanna gen lo a, hun kizuihna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Coming next or happening after a particular time or event.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a zui; a nung hong pai
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, pawi, ahih kei leh hun khat khitah a hong zui cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She returned home the following morning.
examples.zomi: A zui zingkaal in inn ah ciah hi.

examples.english: Answer the following questions.
examples.zomi: A nuaia dotnate dawng in.

senses.usage_en: Before a list or example, the following means the items presented next.
senses.usage_zomi: List ahih kei leh etsakna maiah the following in a nuaiah hong pai ding na-te cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Substances that people or animals eat to obtain energy, nutrition, and growth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing leh ganhing in thahatna, pumpi kisapna leh khanna dingin a nek uh na ahi hi.

examples.english: The organization provides food to families in need.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in kisapna nei innkuante an pia hi.

examples.english: Fresh food should be stored safely.
examples.zomi: An thak pen bit takin kikoih ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Food is normally uncountable when referring generally to what people eat. Foods refers to different types of food.
senses.usage_zomi: Mite a nek uh na a diil in gen ciangin food pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi. An nam tuamtuam gen ciangin foods kizang hi.

senses.heading: Lowest part of the leg
senses.definition_en: The part at the end of a person’s or animal’s leg used for standing and walking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih kei leh ganhing khe a tawpa om, din leh kalsuan na ding a kizang khen ahi hi.

examples.english: He injured his foot while playing football.
examples.zomi: Football kimawh laitakin a khe liam hi.

examples.english: We went to the market on foot.
examples.zomi: Vanzual ah khe tawh ka pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural of foot is feet.
senses.usage_zomi: Foot plural form pen feet ahi hi.

senses.heading: Unit of length
senses.definition_en: A unit of length equal to 12 inches or approximately 30.48 centimeters.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inch sawm leh nih, ahih kei leh centimeter 30.48 tawh a kibang sau tehna ahi hi.

examples.english: The wall is eight feet high.
examples.zomi: Tua kulh a sang foot giat ahi hi.

examples.english: The table is six feet long.
examples.zomi: Tua sabuai a sau foot guk ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use feet after numbers other than one: one foot, two feet.
senses.usage_zomi: Nambar khat sangin a tamzaw khitah feet kizang hi: one foot, two feet.

senses.heading: Bottom or lower end
senses.definition_en: The bottom or lowest part of an object, structure, hill, or page.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, inn, mual, ahih kei leh laimai khat nuailam ahih kei leh a tawp niam ahi hi.

examples.english: A village lies at the foot of the mountain.
examples.zomi: Mualbul ah khua khat om hi.

examples.english: Leave your shoes at the foot of the stairs.
examples.zomi: Na khedapte kalbi bulah koih in.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense refers to the lowest part of something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in na khat a nuailam pen gen hi.

senses.heading: Soccer
senses.definition_en: A game in which two teams try to kick a round ball into the opposing team’s goal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl nih in ball kikhin a, langkhat goal sungah a lutsak ding uh kimawhna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children play football after school.
examples.zomi: Sangkhawl khit ciangin naupangte football kimaw uh hi.

examples.english: Our football team won the match.
examples.zomi: Ka football pawl un kidemna zo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In most of the world and in British English, football means the game called soccer in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Leitung gam a tamzaw leh British English ah football pen American English a soccer kici kimawhna ahi hi.

senses.heading: American football
senses.definition_en: A game played mainly in the United States in which two teams carry, throw, and kick an oval ball.
senses.explanation_zomi: Adiakin United States ah pawl nih in ball sawtno puak, lawn leh kikhin uh kimawhna ahi hi.

examples.english: American football is especially popular in the United States.
examples.zomi: American football pen United States ah mi tampi deih mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: They watched a football game on Sunday.
examples.zomi: Sunday ni in American football kimawhna en uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, football normally means American football. Context and region determine the intended sport.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah football in American football gen zel hi. Gam leh thu kizangna in bang kimawhna hiam cih hong kician sak hi.

senses.heading: Intended recipient or beneficiary
senses.definition_en: Intended to be given to, used by, or helpful to a particular person or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat tungah piak ding, ama zat ding, ahih kei leh ama ading phattuam ding cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat ading na khat bawl

examples.english: This letter is for you.
examples.zomi: Hih lai nang ading ahi hi.

examples.english: She cooked dinner for her family.
examples.zomi: Amah in a innkuanpihte ading nitak an bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: For often identifies who receives or benefits from something.
senses.usage_zomi: For in na khat kua in ngah ding ahih kei leh kua ading phattuam ding hiam cih pulak zel hi.

senses.heading: Purpose or intended use
senses.definition_en: Used to show the purpose or intended use of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bang ngiimna ahih kei leh bang zatna ding hiam cih a lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: This knife is for cutting bread.
examples.zomi: Hih namsau pen tanghou atna ding ahi hi.

examples.english: We need a larger room for the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting ading khan lianzaw ka kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use for + noun/-ing form to show purpose: for cooking. Use to + verb when describing what a person does: I went there to cook.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngiimna genin for + noun/-ing form kizang hi: for cooking. Mi khat bawl gamtatna genin to + verb kizang hi: I went there to cook.

senses.heading: Duration
senses.definition_en: Used to show how long an action or situation continues.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih kei leh dinmun khat bangtan sawt hiam cih a lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: We waited for two hours.
examples.zomi: Nai nih sung ka ngak uh hi.

examples.english: She has lived here for ten years.
examples.zomi: Amah hih munah kum sawm sung tengta hi.

senses.usage_en: Use for with a period of time and since with the starting point: for ten years; since 2016.
senses.usage_zomi: Hun sawtzah tawh for kizang a, hun kipatna tawh since kizang hi: for ten years; since 2016.

senses.heading: Support, reason, or exchange
senses.definition_en: Used to show support, a reason, or what is received in exchange.
senses.explanation_zomi: Panpihna, a hang, ahih kei leh na khat ngahna thuk a piak na genna ahi hi.

examples.english: Most members voted for the proposal.
examples.zomi: Pawlpite a tamzaw in tua geelna panpih vote pia uh hi.

examples.english: I bought the book for twenty dollars.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu dollar sawmnih man in ka lei hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning of for depends strongly on context; it should not always be translated with one fixed Zomi word.
senses.usage_zomi: For khiatna pen a kizangna thu tungah kinga mahmah hi. Zomi kammal khat bek tawh mun khempeuh ah let ding hilo hi.

senses.heading: Physical power or strength
senses.definition_en: Physical strength, energy, or pressure that causes movement, damage, or change.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat kalsuansak, susia, ahih kei leh kikhelsak thei pumpi thahatna, tha, ahih kei leh nenna ahi hi.

examples.english: The force of the wind damaged the roof.
examples.zomi: Huih thahatna in innkhum susia hi.

examples.english: Police used force to open the locked door.
examples.zomi: Police-te in kongkhak a kikha hong dingin tha zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In science, force has a precise meaning: a push or pull that can change an object’s motion.
senses.usage_zomi: Science ah force in khiatna kician nei a, van khat kalsuanna kikhelsak thei nawna ahih kei leh kaihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Power used to make someone act
senses.definition_en: Power, pressure, or violence used to make someone do something against their will.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ama deihloh na bawlsak dingin thahatna, nenna, ahih kei leh ngongtatna zat ahi hi.

examples.english: The soldiers entered the building by force.
examples.zomi: Galmangte thahatna tawh inn sungah lut uh hi.

examples.english: No one should be made to agree by force.
examples.zomi: Mi kuamah zawhna tawh thukimsak lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: By force means through physical power, threats, or pressure rather than free choice.
senses.usage_zomi: By force in suahtak teelna tawh hilo a, pumpi thahatna, lauhthawnna, ahih kei leh nenna tawh cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Organized group with authority or a purpose
senses.definition_en: An organized group of people trained or employed for a particular duty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhpuakna tuam khat sem dingin a kizem leh a kisinsak mi pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: She joined the police force after college.
examples.zomi: College khit ciangin police pawl sungah lut hi.

examples.english: The country increased the size of its armed forces.
examples.zomi: Tua gam in a galkap pawlte zat khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, force refers to people organized for a shared duty or function.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah force in mawhpuakna khat semkhawm dingin a kizem mi pawl gen hi.

senses.heading: Powerful influence
senses.definition_en: A person, organization, or influence that has a strong effect on events or society.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, mipi, ahih kei leh a piang nate tungah huzaapna lianpi nei mi, kipawlna, ahih kei leh thahatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Education can be a powerful force for change.
examples.zomi: Pilna pen kikhelna piangsak thahatna lian hi thei hi.

examples.english: The organization became a major force in local politics.
examples.zomi: Tua kipawlna khuami gamvai ah huzaapna lian khat suak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes strong influence rather than physical power.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in pumpi tha sangin huzaapna khauh gen hi.

senses.heading: From or connected with another country
senses.definition_en: Coming from, belonging to, or connected with a country other than one’s own.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mimal ama gam hilo, gam dang pan hong pai ahih kei leh gam dang tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has traveled to several foreign countries.
examples.zomi: Amah gamdang tampi ah khualzin hi.

examples.english: The university welcomes foreign students.
examples.zomi: University in gamdang sangnaupangte lungdam takin nawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Whether something is foreign depends on the speaker’s country or viewpoint.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat foreign hiam cih pen a paupa gam ahih kei leh a muhna mun tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: Unfamiliar or not naturally belonging
senses.definition_en: Unfamiliar, strange, or not naturally part of a particular body, place, or system.
senses.explanation_zomi: A theih ngeiloh, a ngeina tawh kibang lo, ahih kei leh pumpi, mun, leh system khat sungmi a pianpih hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor removed a foreign object from his eye.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ama mit sunga pualam pan hong lut van khat lakhia hi.

examples.english: The concept was completely foreign to me.
examples.zomi: Tua ngaihsutna kei adingin theih ngeiloh sitset ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In medicine, a foreign object is something that has entered the body but does not naturally belong there.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna thu ah foreign object in pumpi sungah hong lut napi, pumpi a pianpih khen hilo van khat gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A large area of land covered mainly with trees and other plants.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung leh lou kung tampi tawh a kidim leitang zaipi ahi hi.

examples.english: Many wild animals live in the forest.
examples.zomi: Gamlak ah gamgan tampi nungta hi.

examples.english: The government created a program to protect the forest.
examples.zomi: Ukna in gamlak dalna ding program khat bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A forest is generally larger and denser than a wood or woodland.
senses.usage_zomi: Forest pen a diil in wood ahih kei leh woodland sangin lianzaw leh singkung tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: For all future time
senses.definition_en: For all future time, without ever ending.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tawntung; a tawp ngei lo in
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam hun khempeuh sung a tawp ngei lo in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Nothing in this world lasts forever.
examples.zomi: Hih leitung ah tawntung om na bangmah om lo hi.

examples.english: The experience changed her life forever.
examples.zomi: Tua thuakna in ama nuntakna tawntung ading kikhelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Forever may be literal or used for emphasis when a change seems permanent.
senses.usage_zomi: Forever pen a taktak khiatna in zong, kikhelna khat a kikkhelkik ding bang om lo cih khauhsakna in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: For a very long or annoying time
senses.definition_en: For a very long time, especially longer than expected or desired.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kilam-et ahih kei leh a deih sangin hun sawt mahmah sung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We waited forever for the bus.
examples.zomi: Bus hun sawt mahmah ka ngak uh hi.

examples.english: This computer takes forever to start.
examples.zomi: Hih computer kipat ding hun sawt mahmah zang hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal use is an exaggeration and does not literally mean endless time.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih informal zatdan pen khengval genna ahi a, hun a tawp ngei lo cihna taktak hilo hi.

senses.heading: Fail to remember information
senses.definition_en: To be unable to remember a fact, name, event, or piece of information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, min, a piang thu, ahih kei leh thu theihna khat phawk zo lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I forgot his name.
examples.zomi: Ama min ka mangngilh hi.

examples.english: She will never forget that day.
examples.zomi: Amah tua ni mangngilh ngei lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are forgot and forgotten: I forgot; I have forgotten.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen forgot ahi a, past participle pen forgotten ahi hi: I forgot; I have forgotten.

senses.heading: Fail to do or bring something
senses.definition_en: To fail to remember to do something or to bring something needed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawl ding khat bawl ding phawk lo ahih kei leh paipih ding na khat paipih lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not forget to lock the door.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak khak ding mangngilh kei in.

examples.english: I forgot my phone at home.
examples.zomi: Ka phone inn ah ka mangngilh hi.

senses.usage_en: Forget to do something means the action was not done. Forget doing something means the action happened, but the person no longer remembers it.
senses.usage_zomi: Forget to do something in gamtatna bawl lo cihna ahi hi. Forget doing something in gamtatna bawl khin napi, tua a bawlna phawk nawn lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To stop feeling anger or resentment toward someone for a wrong, mistake, or injury.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a khialhna ahih kei leh hong bawlsiatna hang a lungthahna leh phuba lak nopna paisak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She forgave him for his mistake.
examples.zomi: Ama khialhna hangin amah maisak hi.

examples.english: Please forgive me for speaking harshly.
examples.zomi: Khauhtak ka pau manin hong maisak in.

senses.usage_en: Use forgive someone for something. Forgiveness does not necessarily mean approving the wrong action or removing every consequence.
senses.usage_zomi: Forgive someone for something ci in kizang hi. Maisakna in gamtat khialhna pom cihna ahih kei leh a ga khempeuh paisak cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Eating or serving tool
senses.definition_en: A tool with a handle and several pointed parts, used for lifting, holding, or eating food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An lamto, lenkip, ahih kei leh nekna ding a kizang, a tawp ah ha gol tawmno tampi nei van ahi hi.

examples.english: She ate the salad with a fork.
examples.zomi: Amah in salad pen fork tawh ne hi.

examples.english: Place the forks beside the plates.
examples.zomi: Fork-te ankuangte geiah koih in.

senses.usage_en: A fork usually has several pointed parts called prongs.
senses.usage_zomi: Fork khat a tawp ah ha gol tawmno tampi om a, English in prongs kici hi.

senses.heading: Place where something divides into branches
senses.definition_en: A place where a road, river, or other line divides into two or more directions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi, gun, ahih kei leh kalsuanna zui khat lampi nih ahih kei leh tamzaw in a kikhenna mun ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: the north fork of a river

examples.english: Turn left at the fork in the road.
examples.zomi: Lampikhen ah veilam hei in.

examples.english: The village lies near the fork of the river.
examples.zomi: Tua khua gun kikhenna kiangah om hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is based on the branching shape of an eating fork.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen an nekna fork a ha kikhen pianzia tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: Document with spaces for information
senses.definition_en: A printed or digital document with spaces where information must be entered.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu theihna gelh ahih kei leh thun ding mun awngte nei lai ahih kei leh digital document ahi hi.

examples.english: Please complete the application form.
examples.zomi: Lai-apna form pen a kicingin sung thun in.

examples.english: You must sign the form before submitting it.
examples.zomi: Form lai na piakma in na min gelh kul hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, people usually fill out a form. British English also commonly uses fill in a form.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah fill out a form kici zel hi. British English ah fill in a form zong kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Type or kind
senses.definition_en: A particular type or variety of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat nam, pianzia, ahih kei leh kibawldan tuam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Walking is a simple form of exercise.
examples.zomi: Khe tawh paihna pen pumpi kimawhna nam baihlam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The disease appears in several forms.
examples.zomi: Tua natna pianzia tuamtuam in kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern a form of something means a type or version of it.
senses.usage_zomi: A form of something cih in tua na nam ahih kei leh pianzia khat cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Shape or structure
senses.definition_en: The shape, arrangement, or physical structure of someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a pianzia, a kibawldan, ahih kei leh a kizemdan ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: in the form of a circle

examples.english: The sculpture has the form of a bird.
examples.zomi: Tua limbawl pen vasa pianzia nei hi.

examples.english: Water changes form when it freezes.
examples.zomi: Tui a khau ciangin a pianzia kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Form often refers to structure or overall shape rather than surface appearance alone.
senses.usage_zomi: Form in pualam meel bek sangin a kibawldan leh a pumpi pianzia gen zaw hi.

senses.heading: Level of performance or condition
senses.definition_en: The current level of someone’s performance, ability, or physical condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a sepna, siamna, ahih kei leh pumpi dinmun tuhun a hoih leh hoih loh zah ahi hi.

examples.english: The player is in excellent form this season.
examples.zomi: Hih season in kimawhpa sepna dinmun hoih mahmah hi.

examples.english: After the injury, she slowly returned to form.
examples.zomi: A liamna khit ciangin tawm tawm in a sepna hoihna ah ciahkik hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is common in sports and performance contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen kimawhna leh gamtatna lak thu ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Official or following established rules
senses.definition_en: Official, carefully organized, or following accepted rules and procedures.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ukna tawh kisai; thukhun zui; a kizek
senses.explanation_zomi: Ukna leh kipawlna in a pom, limtak a kizem, ahih kei leh a kipsa thukhun leh sepzia a zui cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two organizations signed a formal agreement.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna nihte in a kizek thukimna lai min gelh uh hi.

examples.english: She submitted a formal complaint to the manager.
examples.zomi: Amah in makaipa tungah complaint lai kizek takin pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Formal often describes something official and recorded, rather than casual or unofficial.
senses.usage_zomi: Formal in informal ahih kei leh ukna hilo sepna sangin ukna tawh kisai leh kipsak a kizek thu gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Serious and polite in style
senses.definition_en: Using careful, polite language or behavior suitable for an important occasion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawi ahih kei leh dinmun thupi tawh kituak, kammal leh gamtatna pilvang, zaidam leh kizek cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Use formal language in the business letter.
examples.zomi: Sumdawnna lai ah kammal kizek zang in.

examples.english: The ceremony had a formal atmosphere.
examples.zomi: Tua pawi in kizek leh thupi omzia nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Formal language avoids slang and casual expressions. Its opposite is informal.
senses.usage_zomi: Formal kammal in slang leh nisim kammal mawk zang lo hi. A kilehbulh pen informal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Suitable for an important social event
senses.definition_en: Designed or worn for an important ceremony or special social occasion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawi thupi, kiteenna, ahih kei leh mipi kimuhkhopna tuam ading a kibawl ahih kei leh a kisilh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Guests were asked to wear formal clothing.
examples.zomi: Mikhualte pawi puan silh dingin kingen uh hi.

examples.english: They attended a formal dinner at the hotel.
examples.zomi: Hotel ah nitak an-nekhopna kizek khat ah pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Dress requirements vary, so an invitation may specify the exact level of formality.
senses.usage_zomi: Puan silh ding zah pawi simin kibang lo ahih manin sapna lai in silh ding puan dinmun kician takin gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Having a position or role in the past
senses.definition_en: Having previously held a particular position, role, or condition but not holding it now.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nidangin dinmun, mawhpuakna, ahih kei leh omzia khat nei napi, tu in tua dinmun ah om nawn lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The former president spoke at the conference.
examples.zomi: Nidanga president in conference ah thu gen hi.

examples.english: She met several former classmates.
examples.zomi: Amah in nidanga a sangnaupangpih tampi mu hi.

senses.usage_en: Former comes before a noun. Do not use it after a linking verb: say “a former teacher,” not “the teacher is former.”
senses.usage_zomi: Former pen noun maiah kizang hi. Linking verb khitah zang lo in “a former teacher” ci ding a, “the teacher is former” ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: First of two people or things mentioned
senses.definition_en: Referring to the first of two people or things that have just been mentioned.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a masapen; a masa a kigen
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na nih kigenkhit lakah a masa a kigen pen genna ahi hi.

examples.english: We can travel by bus or train; the former is cheaper.
examples.zomi: Bus ahih kei leh meileng tawh ka pai thei uh a; a masa bus pen man olzaw hi.

examples.english: John and David applied, but only the former was accepted.
examples.zomi: John leh David lai-ap uh napi, a masa John bek kipom hi.

senses.usage_en: The former means the first of two; the latter means the second.
senses.usage_zomi: The former in nih lakah a masa cihna ahi a, the latter in a nihna cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to say that something happened in a lucky, helpful, or favorable way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat hampha takin, hoih takin, ahih kei leh siatna pan suakta in a piang cih pulakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Fortunately, no one was injured in the accident.
examples.zomi: Hampha takin, tua accident ah kuamah liam lo hi.

examples.english: The rain stopped, and fortunately we arrived on time.
examples.zomi: Guah tawl a, hampha takin hun ciangin ka tung uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Fortunately comments on the whole situation. A comma normally follows it when it begins a sentence.
senses.usage_zomi: Fortunately in thu a vekin hoih takin a piang cih pulak hi. Sentence kipatna ah kizang ciangin a nungah comma kikoih zel hi.

senses.heading: Luck or chance
senses.definition_en: Luck or chance, especially as it affects someone’s life or success.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nuntakna ahih kei leh gualzawhna tungah a huzaap hamphatna, mailam dinmun, ahih kei leh mawk piang thu ahi hi.

examples.english: By good fortune, they found shelter before the storm.
examples.zomi: Hampha takin, huihpi hong tunma in bukna mun mu uh hi.

examples.english: His fortunes changed after he found a new job.
examples.zomi: Nasep thak a muh khit ciangin ama nuntakna dinmun kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Fortune may mean luck generally or the way someone’s life develops over time.
senses.usage_zomi: Fortune in hamphatna a diil in gen thei a, mi khat nuntakna koibangin kikhel hiam cih zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Very large amount of money
senses.definition_en: A very large amount of money or wealth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum tampi mahmah ahih kei leh hauhna lianpi ahi hi.

examples.english: She made a fortune through her business.
examples.zomi: A sumdawnna tungtawnin sum tampi ngah hi.

examples.english: That house must have cost a fortune.
examples.zomi: Tua inn manpha mahmah ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The expression cost a fortune informally means cost a very large amount of money.
senses.usage_zomi: Informal kammal cost a fortune in sum tampi mahmah man cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 40.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambar sawm li ahi hi.

examples.english: The bus can carry forty passengers.
examples.zomi: Tua bus in khualzin mi sawm li puakthei hi.

examples.english: She worked there for forty years.
examples.zomi: Amah tua munah kum sawm li sung nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: The correct spelling is forty, not fourty.
senses.usage_zomi: Gelhdan dik pen forty ahi a, fourty hilo hi.

senses.heading: Toward the front
senses.definition_en: Toward the direction that someone or something is facing or moving.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat a maitangna ahih kei leh a kalsuanna mai lamah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please move forward so others can enter.
examples.zomi: Midangte luttheihna dingin ma lamah kalsuan in.

examples.english: She leaned forward to hear him clearly.
examples.zomi: Ama aw kician takin zak dingin ma lamah kun hi.

senses.usage_en: Forward describes direction. In American English, forwards is less common, though it is common in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Forward in kalsuanna lam pulak hi. American English ah forwards kizang tawmzaw a, British English ah kizang ngeizaw hi.

senses.heading: Toward progress or the future
senses.definition_en: Toward progress, development, or a more advanced stage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khanna, mainawtna, ahih kei leh dinmun hoihzaw lamah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee decided to move forward with the project.
examples.zomi: Committee in project tawh mainawt dingin khensat hi.

examples.english: This agreement is an important step forward.
examples.zomi: Hih thukimna pen mainawtna thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Look forward to means feel pleased or excited about a future event. It is followed by a noun or an -ing form.
senses.usage_zomi: Look forward to in mailama thu khat ngaklah cihna ahi hi. A nungah noun ahih kei leh -ing form kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: To establish or create an organization, institution, city, or system intended to continue.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kipawlna, sang, khuapi, ahih kei leh system khat a om paisuak dingin phuh ahih kei leh kipansak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They founded the organization in 2010.
examples.zomi: Amaute in 2010 kum in tua kipawlna phuh uh hi.

examples.english: The university was founded more than a century ago.
examples.zomi: Tua university kum za khat val beisa in kiphuh hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle of this verb are founded. Do not confuse it with found, the past tense and past participle of find.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih verb past tense leh past participle pen founded ahi hi. Find past tense leh past participle found tawh telkhial lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 4.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambar li ahi hi.

examples.english: The table has four legs.
examples.zomi: Tua sabuai in khe li nei hi.

examples.english: We stayed there for four days.
examples.zomi: Tua munah ni li sung ka om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The ordinal form of four is fourth.
senses.usage_zomi: Four ordinal form pen fourth ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 14.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambar sawm leh li ahi hi.

examples.english: There are fourteen chapters in the book.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu sungah chapter sawm leh li om hi.

examples.english: She was fourteen years old when her family moved.
examples.zomi: Ama innkuan a kikhiat ciangin amah kum sawm leh li ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Stress the second syllable in fourteen. Compare it with forty, which is stressed on the first syllable.
senses.usage_zomi: Fourteen ah syllable nihna kikhauhsak hi. Syllable masa kikhauhsak forty tawh telkhial lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Position number four
senses.definition_en: The person or thing in position number four in an order or series.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizuihna ah a lina mun a om mi ahih kei leh na ahi hi.

examples.english: Our team finished fourth in the competition.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl un kidemna ah mun lina ngah uh hi.

examples.english: Read the fourth chapter before class.
examples.zomi: Class ma in chapter lina sim in.

senses.usage_en: Fourth is the ordinal form of four. Keep the u in the spelling: fourth.
senses.usage_zomi: Fourth pen four ordinal form ahi hi. Gelh ciangin u ki-omden a, fourth kici hi.

senses.heading: One of four equal parts
senses.definition_en: One of four equal parts of a whole.
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi khen kibang li a kikhen ciangin khen khat ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a vekpi khen li lakah khat

examples.english: One fourth of the students were absent.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang khen li lakah khen khat om lo uh hi.

examples.english: She spent a fourth of her income on rent.
examples.zomi: Ama sum ngah khen li lakah khat innluahna ah zang hi.

senses.usage_en: One fourth and one quarter have the same mathematical meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: One fourth leh one quarter pen simna lamah khiatna kibang hi.

senses.heading: Structure surrounding or supporting something
senses.definition_en: A rigid structure that surrounds, holds, or supports something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat kimkot a um, lenkip, ahih kei leh a khoihna dingin a kibawl ngel ahi hi.

examples.english: The window frame is made of wood.
examples.zomi: Thlalang ngel sing tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Workers built the metal frame of the new building.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in inn thak sik ngel bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A frame may surround an object or provide the main supporting structure.
senses.usage_zomi: Frame in van khat kimkot um thei a, amah khoihna ding ngelpi zong hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Border that holds a picture
senses.definition_en: A decorative or protective border that holds and displays a picture, photograph, or mirror.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim, limlak, ahih kei leh liim enna lenkip leh melhoihsak ding kimkot ngel ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: put a photo in a frame

examples.english: She placed the family photo in a wooden frame.
examples.zomi: Amah in innkuan limlak sing ngel sungah koih hi.

examples.english: The mirror has a gold-colored frame.
examples.zomi: Liim enna in kham color nei ngel khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A frame is the border or holder; the picture is the image inside it.
senses.usage_zomi: Frame pen kimkot ngel ahi a, picture pen a sunga lim ahi hi.

senses.heading: Individual image in a film or video
senses.definition_en: One of the individual images that form a film, video, or animation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim kalsuan, video, ahih kei leh animation a bawl lim tuam sim ahi hi.

examples.english: The editor examined the video frame by frame.
examples.zomi: Video bawlphapa in video pen lim khat ciat in entel hi.

examples.english: One frame showed the car entering the street.
examples.zomi: Frame khat in mawtaw lampi ah a lutna lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Video frame rates are commonly measured in frames per second.
senses.usage_zomi: Video frame zat pen second khat sunga frame zat tawh kiteh zel hi.

senses.heading: General body shape
senses.definition_en: The basic size and shape of a person’s or animal’s body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih kei leh ganhing khat pumpi a bul pianzia leh a lianzia ahi hi.

examples.english: He has a tall, strong frame.
examples.zomi: Ama pumpi sang a, ngel thahat hi.

examples.english: The horse has a powerful frame.
