examples.zomi: Tua sakol pumpi ngel thahat hi.

senses.usage_en: Comments about a person’s body shape can be sensitive, so use this sense carefully.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat pumpi pianzia thu pen lungsim nasaktheih thu ahih manin kidawm takin zat ding hi.

senses.heading: Not costing money
senses.definition_en: Available without payment.
senses.zomi_equivalents: man lo; sum piak kul lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum piak kul lo in a ngah theih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Admission to the museum is free.
examples.zomi: Museum lutna man lo hi.

examples.english: The clinic offers free health checks.
examples.zomi: Tua cidamna mun in cidamna sittelna man lo in pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Free can mean without cost or without restriction. Context shows the intended meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Free in man lo cihna zong, khaktan lohna cihna zong nei thei hi. A kizangna thu in khiatna hong kician sak hi.

senses.heading: Not controlled, imprisoned, or restricted
senses.definition_en: Able to act, speak, or live without unfair control, imprisonment, or restriction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thutang lo ukna, thongkiatna, ahih kei leh khaktanna om lo in gamta, pau, leh nungta thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Everyone should be free to express an opinion.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in amau ngaihsutna suahtak takin pulakthei ding uh hi.

examples.english: The prisoner was finally set free.
examples.zomi: Thongkiapa pen a tawpna ah kisuaktasak hi.

senses.usage_en: Free to do something means having permission or liberty to do it.
senses.usage_zomi: Free to do something in tua gamtatna bawl ding phalna ahih kei leh suahtakna nei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Available and not busy
senses.definition_en: Available because no work, activity, or appointment is occupying the time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, program, ahih kei leh kimuh hun in a len lo ahih manin hun nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Are you free this evening?
examples.zomi: Tuni nitak hun na nei hiam?

examples.english: I read books in my free time.
examples.zomi: Ka hun awng in laibu ka sim hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, free describes time or a person who is available.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah free in hun awng ahih kei leh hun a nei mi gen hi.

senses.heading: Not containing something unwanted
senses.definition_en: Not containing or affected by a particular substance, problem, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na, buaina, ahih kei leh dinmun tuam khat a om lo ahih kei leh a huzaap lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This drink is sugar-free.
examples.zomi: Hih dawn ding sungah ci om lo hi.

examples.english: The final report should be free from errors.
examples.zomi: Report nunung ah khialhna om lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Use free from before a problem or harmful condition and -free in compounds such as tax-free or smoke-free.
senses.usage_zomi: Buaina ahih kei leh dinmun sia maiah free from kizang hi. Tax-free leh smoke-free bang compound-te ah -free kizang hi.

senses.heading: Liberty to act, speak, or choose
senses.definition_en: The right or ability to act, speak, think, or choose without unfair control.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thutang lo ukna om lo in gamta, pau, ngaihsun, ahih kei leh teel theihna dik ahi hi.

examples.english: The constitution protects freedom of speech.
examples.zomi: Gam thukhunpi in pau suahtakna dal hi.

examples.english: People should have the freedom to choose their leaders.
examples.zomi: Mite in amau makaite teeltheihna suahtak nei ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Freedom normally exists together with responsibility and respect for other people’s rights.
senses.usage_zomi: Suahtakna pen mawhpuakna leh midangte a dikna zahtakna tawh omkhawm zel hi.

senses.heading: State of not being imprisoned or controlled
senses.definition_en: The condition of not being held in prison, slavery, or another form of control.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thongkiatna, sal suahtaklohna, ahih kei leh midang ukna nuaiah om lo dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The prisoner regained his freedom after ten years.
examples.zomi: Thongkiapa in kum sawm khit ciangin suahtakna ngahkik hi.

examples.english: Many people sacrificed their lives for freedom.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi in suahtakna ading amau nuntakna pia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense focuses on release from physical or political control.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in pumpi ahih kei leh gamvai ukna pan suahtakna ngah cihna tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: Become ice or become solid from cold
senses.definition_en: To become ice or solid because the temperature is very low.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavot mahmah hangin tui ahih kei leh tui bang na khau cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
examples.zomi: Tui pen Celsius degree zero ah khau hi.

examples.english: The lake froze during the cold night.
examples.zomi: Zan vot sungin dil tui khau hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is froze and the past participle is frozen.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen froze ahi a, past participle pen frozen ahi hi.

senses.heading: Make food very cold for storage
senses.definition_en: To preserve food by lowering its temperature until it becomes frozen.
senses.explanation_zomi: An pen bei pah lo dingin a khau dong votna munah koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We froze the extra meat for later use.
examples.zomi: Sa behlap pen a nungciang zat dingin ka khauhsak uh hi.

examples.english: You can freeze the soup for one month.
examples.zomi: Tua anphong kha khat sung na khauhsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Freeze is the verb. Frozen describes food kept at a very low temperature.
senses.usage_zomi: Freeze pen verb ahi a, frozen in khuavot mahmah ah a kikhauh an gen hi.

senses.heading: Become unable to move or act
senses.definition_en: To stop moving or become unable to act, often because of fear, shock, or uncertainty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Launa, lamdang sakna, ahih kei leh kicianlohna hangin kalsuan ahih kei leh gamta zo lo in khawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He froze when he heard the sudden noise.
examples.zomi: Ging thakhat a zak ciangin amah khawlcip hi.

examples.english: My computer froze while I was working.
examples.zomi: Ka nasep laitakin ka computer khawlcip hi.

senses.usage_en: For a person, this sense may describe a fear response. For a computer, it means the system stops responding.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat ading hih khiatna in launa hang gamta zo lohna gen thei hi. Computer ading ahih leh system in thupiakna dawng nawn lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Keep a price, account, or activity unchanged or unavailable
senses.definition_en: To officially prevent a price from changing, an account from being used, or an activity from continuing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanman kikhelsak lo, account zangtheisak lo, ahih kei leh gamtatna khawl dingin ukna tawh khensat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bank froze the suspicious account.
examples.zomi: Bank in account lunghiankai zangtheisak lo hi.

examples.english: The company froze salaries for one year.
examples.zomi: Company in kum khat sung loh kikhelsak lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense is common in banking, economics, employment, and government policy.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna pen bank, sumlehpai, nasep leh ukna thukhun thu ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: How often something happens
senses.definition_en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated during a period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat sungin thu ahih kei leh gamtatna khat bangzah vei piang ahih kei leh kibawl hiam cih a zat ahi hi.

examples.english: The frequency of storms has increased.
examples.zomi: Huihpi piang vei zat khang hi.

examples.english: Exercise frequency is as important as intensity.
examples.zomi: Pumpi kimawh vei zat pen a khauhzah tawh a kibangin thupi hi.

senses.usage_en: Frequency describes how often something occurs, not how long it lasts.
senses.usage_zomi: Frequency in thu khat bangzah vei piang hiam cih gen a, bangtan sawt hiam cih gen lo hi.

senses.heading: Rate of waves or vibrations
senses.definition_en: The number of waves or vibrations occurring in a fixed period, usually measured in hertz.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun kipsa sungin wave ahih kei leh lingna bangzah vei piang hiam cih tehna, a tamzaw in hertz tawh a kiteh ahi hi.

examples.english: The radio operates on a different frequency.
examples.zomi: Tua radio pen frequency tuam khat tungah nasem hi.

examples.english: Humans cannot hear every sound frequency.
examples.zomi: Mihing in aw frequency khempeuh za zo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a scientific and technical meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen science leh technology lam khiatna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Often or many times.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vei tampi, hun tampi, ahih kei leh a kikkik in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The buses run frequently during the day.
examples.zomi: Sun laitakin bus-te vei tampi pai hi.

examples.english: This question is frequently asked by new employees.
examples.zomi: Hih dotna nasem thakte in kikkik in dong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Frequently is more formal than often, but their meanings are similar.
senses.usage_zomi: Frequently pen often sangin formal zaw napi, a khiatna kibang deuh hi.

senses.heading: Recently produced, gathered, or prepared
senses.definition_en: Recently produced, collected, caught, or prepared and not preserved for a long time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu nai a kisuah, a kilak, a kiman, ahih kei leh a kibawl a, hun sawt a kikhol hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
examples.zomi: Vanzual in zing simin huan-an thakte zuak hi.

examples.english: We bought fresh fish from the local fishermen.
examples.zomi: Khuami ngaman mite kiangpan nga thak ka lei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: For food, fresh often contrasts with frozen, canned, dried, or old.
senses.usage_zomi: An thu ah fresh pen a kikhauh, bawm sunga kikholh, a kikheh, ahih kei leh a lui tawh kilehbulh hi.

senses.heading: Clean, cool, or pleasant
senses.definition_en: Clean, cool, pure, or pleasant in a way that feels new and healthy.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a siang; a daih; a lim
senses.explanation_zomi: A siang, a daih, a lim, ahih kei leh cidamhuai leh nuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Open the window and let in some fresh air.
examples.zomi: Huih siangtho hong luttheihna dingin thlalang hong in.

examples.english: The mountain stream provides fresh water.
examples.zomi: Mual gun in tui lim leh thak pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Fresh water may mean clean drinkable water or water that is not salty, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Fresh water in a kizangna thu bangin tui siangtho dawn theih ahih kei leh ci al lo tui cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: New, recent, or different
senses.definition_en: New, recent, or providing a different beginning, idea, or approach.
senses.explanation_zomi: A thak, tu nai a piang, ahih kei leh kipatna leh ngaihsutdan tuam khat pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The new year gives us a fresh start.
examples.zomi: Kum thak in kipatna thak hong pia hi.

examples.english: The committee needs fresh ideas.
examples.zomi: Committee in ngaihsutna thakte kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense often emphasizes renewal or a new perspective.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in thaksuahna ahih kei leh muhna tuam khat khauhsak hi.

senses.heading: Rested and energetic
senses.definition_en: Rested, alert, and full of energy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khawl kicing a, gim lo, lungsim lim leh thahat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: After a good night’s sleep, I felt fresh.
examples.zomi: Zan khat ihmu hoih khit ciangin ka gim lo a, ka thahat hi.

examples.english: Take a short break so you can return fresh.
examples.zomi: Thahat takin na ciahkik theihna dingin hun tomno khawl in.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, fresh describes someone who is not tired.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah fresh in mi khat gim lo a, thahat cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The day of the week after Thursday and before Saturday.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thursday khit leh Saturday ma a om kal sunga ni khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The office closes early on Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ni in office khak manlang hi.

examples.english: We will meet next Friday morning.
examples.zomi: Friday hong tung ding zingkaal in ka kimu ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Days of the week are always capitalized in English. Use on before a named day: on Friday.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah kal sunga ni minte lai-masa awlmawh in kigelh tawntung hi. Ni min maiah on kizang hi: on Friday.

senses.definition_en: An electrical appliance that keeps food and drinks cold so that they remain fresh longer.
senses.explanation_zomi: An leh dawn dingte vot takin kem a, hun sawtzaw hoihsak dingin a kizang electric van ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat votna bawm sungah koih

examples.english: Put the milk back in the fridge.
examples.zomi: Nawi votna bawm sungah koihkik in.

examples.english: There is some food in the fridge.
examples.zomi: Votna bawm sungah an om hi.

senses.usage_en: Fridge is the common informal shortened form of refrigerator. Notice that fridge contains a d in its spelling.
senses.usage_zomi: Fridge pen refrigerator a tomlakna informal ahi hi. Fridge gelhdan sungah d om cih phawk ding hi.

senses.heading: Person you know, like, and trust
senses.definition_en: A person whom you know well, like, trust, and enjoy spending time with.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na theih hoih, na deih, na muan a, hun na zatkhop nuam mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She is one of my closest friends.
examples.zomi: Amah ka lawm naipente lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The children quickly made friends at school.
examples.zomi: Naupangte sang ah manlang takin lawm nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A friend is normally more than an acquaintance, who is someone you know but may not know closely.
senses.usage_zomi: Friend pen lawm ahi a, acquaintance bang mi theihsa mawk sangin kizopna naizaw nei hi.

senses.heading: Supporter of a person, organization, or cause
senses.definition_en: A person who supports, helps, or sympathizes with someone, an organization, or a cause.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, kipawlna, ahih kei leh ngiimna khat panpih, huh, ahih kei leh ama lam pang mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The organization thanked its friends and supporters.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in ama lawmte leh panpihmite lungdam ko hi.

examples.english: He has always been a friend of education.
examples.zomi: Amah pilna panpihmi in om tawntung hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense does not always imply a close personal relationship; it may simply mean active support.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mimal kizopna nai nei hi pahpah lo a, panpihna khauh nei cihna hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Contact on a social-media platform
senses.definition_en: A person connected to your account on a social-media service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Social media tungah na account tawh a kizom mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She sent me a friend request.
examples.zomi: Amah in kei tungah social media lawm kizopna nget hong khak hi.

examples.english: Not every online friend is someone you know personally.
examples.zomi: Internet tung lawm khempeuh mimal takin na theih uh hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: An online friend may be only a digital contact, so personal information should still be shared carefully.
senses.usage_zomi: Online friend pen digital kizopmi bek hi thei ahih manin mimal thu kidawm takin kihawm ding hi.

senses.heading: Kind and pleasant toward others
senses.definition_en: Behaving in a kind, pleasant, and welcoming way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lawmta; mi tawh kivawt baih; zaidam
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte tungah hoih, zaidam, nuam leh lawmpa bangin gamta cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel staff were friendly and helpful.
examples.zomi: Hotel nasemte zaidam a, panpihnuam uh hi.

examples.english: She gave us a friendly smile.
examples.zomi: Amah in keiuh zaidam takin hong nui hi.

senses.usage_en: A friendly person is pleasant and welcoming, but not necessarily a close friend.
senses.usage_zomi: Friendly mi pen mi tawh kivawt baih leh zaidam napi, lawm naipih hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Not harmful and easy to use or support
senses.definition_en: Designed to be helpful, easy to use, or less harmful to a particular group or the environment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi pawl khat ading zat baih leh phattuam, ahih kei leh kimkot ading siatna tawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The website is simple and user-friendly.
examples.zomi: Tua website baihlam a, zat baih hi.

examples.english: We should choose environmentally friendly products.
examples.zomi: Kimkot a susia lo vante teel ding hihang.

senses.usage_en: In compounds ending in -friendly, the first word identifies who or what benefits.
senses.usage_zomi: -friendly tawh a kikhen compound ah kammal masa in kua ahih kei leh bang phattuam hiam cih pulak hi.

senses.definition_en: A relationship between people who know, like, trust, and support one another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite khat leh khat kithei, kideih, kimuang leh kipanpihna tawh a kizopna ahi hi.

examples.english: Their friendship began at school.
examples.zomi: Amau lawmtakna sang ah kipan hi.

examples.english: Honesty and trust strengthen friendship.
examples.zomi: Thumaan leh kimuanna in lawmtakna khauhsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Friendship may be countable when referring to one relationship and uncountable when referring generally to friendly relations.
senses.usage_zomi: Lawm kizopna khat cimawh gen ciangin friendship pen simtheih hi. Lawmtakna a diil in gen ciangin simtheih loh noun hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To make a person or animal feel afraid.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh ganhing khat lausak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The sudden noise frightened the baby.
examples.zomi: Ging thakhat in naungek lausak hi.

examples.english: Loud machines can frighten animals.
examples.zomi: Machine ging liante in ganhingte lausak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Someone or something frightens a person; the person is frightened.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat in midang frightens a, a lau mi pen frightened kici hi.

senses.definition_en: Feeling afraid or worried because of possible danger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina omtheihna hangin lau ahih kei leh lungkham cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The child was frightened by the thunder.
examples.zomi: Naupang vanpi ging in lausak hi.

examples.english: She felt frightened when she heard footsteps outside.
examples.zomi: Pualam a kheging a zak ciangin lau hi.

senses.usage_en: A person is frightened; the person, event, or situation causing the fear is frightening.
senses.usage_zomi: A lau mi pen frightened kici a, tua launa piangsak mi, thu, ahih kei leh dinmun pen frightening kici hi.

senses.definition_en: Making someone feel afraid or seriously worried.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lausak ahih kei leh lungkham mahmah sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The storm was a frightening experience.
examples.zomi: Huihpi pen thuakna lauhuai khat ahi hi.

examples.english: We heard a frightening sound in the forest.
examples.zomi: Gamlak ah aw lauhuai khat ka za uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use frightening for what causes fear and frightened for the person or animal experiencing fear.
senses.usage_zomi: Launa piangsak na ading frightening kizang a, a lau mi ahih kei leh ganhing ading frightened kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A small animal with smooth skin, long back legs, and no tail that lives both in water and on land.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vun nal, nunglam khe sau leh mei nei lo, tui sung leh leitang tegel ah nungta ganhing neu ahi hi.

examples.english: A frog jumped into the pond.
examples.zomi: Uh-keng khat bual sungah diang hi.

examples.english: We heard frogs calling after the rain.
examples.zomi: Guahzuih khit teh uh-kengte aw ka za hi.

senses.usage_en: A young frog that still has a tail and lives only in water is called a tadpole.
senses.usage_zomi: Uh-keng a mei nei lai a, tui sung bekah a nungta pen English in tadpole kici hi.

senses.heading: Starting place or origin
senses.definition_en: Used to show where someone or something starts, comes, or originates.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat koi pan kipan, hong pai, ahih kei leh a pianna koi hiam cih a lakna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: travel from one city to another
common_phrases.zomi: khuapi khat pan a dang khat ah khualzin

examples.english: She came from the office.
examples.zomi: Amah office pan hong pai hi.

examples.english: This coffee comes from Colombia.
examples.zomi: Hih coffee Colombia pan hong pai hi.

senses.usage_en: From marks the starting point. To often marks the destination.
senses.usage_zomi: From in kipatna mun lak a, to in a paihna mun lak zel hi.

senses.heading: Starting time
senses.definition_en: Used to show the time when an activity or period begins.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih kei leh hun khat bang hun pan kipan hiam cih a lakna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: dak kua pan dak nga dong

examples.english: The office is open from nine to five.
examples.zomi: Office dak kua pan dak nga dong kihong hi.

examples.english: She has loved music from childhood.
examples.zomi: Amah naupan lai pan la deih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use from … to/until … to identify the beginning and end of a period.
senses.usage_zomi: Hun kipatna leh tawpna lak dingin from … to/until … kizang hi.

senses.heading: Cause, source, or material
senses.definition_en: Used to show the cause, source, or material from which something is made.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat pianna hang, thu theihna bul, ahih kei leh na khat kibawlna van bang hiam cih a lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: He is recovering from an illness.
examples.zomi: Amah natna pan damkik hi.

examples.english: Paper is made from wood.
examples.zomi: Lai pen sing pan kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use made from when the original material is transformed. Made of is common when the material remains recognizable.
senses.usage_zomi: Van bulpi a kikhel ciangin made from kizang hi. A kibawlna van muhkhiat theih lai ciangin made of kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Separation or protection
senses.definition_en: Used to show separation, removal, difference, or protection.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat pan kikhen, lakhia, kilamdang, ahih kei leh kidal cihna a lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: This medicine protects children from the disease.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui in naupangte tua natna pan dal hi.

examples.english: Your answer is different from mine.
examples.zomi: Na dawnna ka dawnna tawh kilamdang hi.

senses.usage_en: Different from is the most widely accepted form in formal English.
senses.usage_zomi: Formal English ah different from pen a pomzaw zatdan ahi hi.

senses.heading: Forward-facing part
senses.definition_en: The side or part of something that faces forward or is normally seen first.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van ahih kei leh inn khat mai lam, a kimuh masakna khen ahi hi.

examples.english: There is a garden in front of the house.
examples.zomi: Inn mai ah huan khat om hi.

examples.english: The driver checked the front of the car.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawlpa in mawtaw mai lam sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: In front of means ahead of or on the forward side of something. In the front of means inside the forward part.
senses.usage_zomi: In front of in na khat mai lam pualam cihna ahi hi. In the front of in na khat sung mai lam khen cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Leading position
senses.definition_en: The position nearest the beginning, audience, or direction of movement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, kalsuanna, ahih kei leh mi-etna mun khat a ma lam dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher stood at the front of the classroom.
examples.zomi: Sia pen laihilhna khan mai lamah ding hi.

examples.english: She moved to the front of the line.
examples.zomi: A kizom mite ma lamah kalsuan hi.

senses.usage_en: At the front describes a leading position within an area or group.
senses.usage_zomi: At the front in mun ahih kei leh pawl khat sunga ma lam dinmun gen hi.

senses.heading: Area where military forces are fighting
senses.definition_en: An area where opposing military forces are actively fighting.
senses.explanation_zomi: Langnih galkapte maituah a, gal a kidona mun ahi hi.

examples.english: Many soldiers were sent to the front.
examples.zomi: Galmang tampi galmai ah kisawl hi.

examples.english: News from the front was limited.
examples.zomi: Galmai pan thuthak tawmno bek ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: This military meaning is often used in the expressions the front and the front line.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gal khiatna pen the front leh the front line cih kammalte ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Turned into ice or made solid by cold
senses.definition_en: Changed into ice or made hard and solid because of very low temperature.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavot mahmah hangin tui khau ahih kei leh na khat khauh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children walked carefully across the frozen lake.
examples.zomi: Naupangte dil khau tungah pilvang takin kalsuan uh hi.

examples.english: The ground remained frozen all day.
examples.zomi: Leitang sun khuahun sung khau den hi.

senses.usage_en: Frozen is the past participle and adjective formed from freeze.
senses.usage_zomi: Frozen pen freeze past participle leh adjective form ahi hi.

senses.heading: Preserved at a very low temperature
senses.definition_en: Kept at a very low temperature so that food remains usable for a longer time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kikhauh an; votna bawm sunga kikem
senses.explanation_zomi: An bei pah lo dingin khuavot mahmah ah a kikhauh leh a kikem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We bought frozen vegetables.
examples.zomi: Huan-an kikhauhte ka lei uh hi.

examples.english: Keep the meat frozen until you are ready to cook it.
examples.zomi: Sa pen an na bawl ding ciang dong khauhsak den in.

senses.usage_en: Frozen food is different from fresh food, though both can be nutritious.
senses.usage_zomi: Frozen food leh fresh food kibang lo napi, tegel mah pumpi kisapna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Unable to move or operate
senses.definition_en: Unable to move, respond, or operate, often because of fear, cold, or a technical problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Launa, khuavot, ahih kei leh vanzat buaina hangin kalsuan, dawng, ahih kei leh nasem zo lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He stood frozen with fear.
examples.zomi: Amah launa tawh khawlcip in ding hi.

examples.english: The computer screen is frozen.
examples.zomi: Computer screen khawlcip a, dawng nawn lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This may describe a person’s fear response or a device that has stopped responding.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mi khat launa hang gamta zo lohna ahih kei leh vanzat in thupiakna a dawn lohna gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Edible part of a plant
senses.definition_en: The usually sweet or sour part of a plant that contains seeds and can be eaten.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in a lim ahih kei leh a thu, a sungah ci nei a, nek theih singkung gah ahi hi.

examples.english: Eating fresh fruit is good for your health.
examples.zomi: Theigah thak nek pen cidamna ading hoih hi.

examples.english: The tree produces small red fruit.
examples.zomi: Tua singkung in gah san neu suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Fruit is often uncountable when referring to it as food. Fruits can refer to different varieties or species.
senses.usage_zomi: An in a nek theigah a diil in gen ciangin fruit pen simtheih loh noun hi zel hi. Theigah nam tuamtuam gen ciangin fruits kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Result or product of work
senses.definition_en: A result, benefit, or product produced by effort, action, or development.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna, gamtatna, ahih kei leh khanna pan a piang ngahna ahih kei leh gah ahi hi.

examples.english: The project is beginning to bear fruit.
examples.zomi: Tua project ngahna hoih piangsak kipanta hi.

examples.english: They enjoyed the fruits of many years of work.
examples.zomi: Kum tampi nasep gah nuamsa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense uses plant growth as an image for results produced over time.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in hun sawt nasep pan ngahna piang cih pen singkung gah tawh genteh hi.

senses.definition_en: To cook food in hot oil or fat.
senses.explanation_zomi: An pen sathau ahih kei leh sautha sa sungah kang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She fried an egg for breakfast.
examples.zomi: Zing an ading aktui khat kang hi.

examples.english: Fry the onions until they become soft.
examples.zomi: Lothangte a nem dong sathau sungah kang in.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are fried. Deep-fry means cooking food completely under hot oil.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense leh past participle tegel fried ahi hi. Deep-fry in an pen sathau sa sungah keu sitset in kang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Substance used to produce energy
senses.definition_en: A substance burned or otherwise used to produce heat, power, or movement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuasa, thahatna, ahih kei leh kalsuanna piangsak dingin a kikang ahih kei leh a kizang na ahi hi.

examples.english: The truck ran out of fuel.
examples.zomi: Tua truck meiholh bei hi.

examples.english: The country imports most of its fuel.
examples.zomi: Tua gam in a meiholh a tamzaw gamdang pan lei hi.

senses.usage_en: Fuel is normally uncountable when referring generally to material used for energy. Fuels refers to different types.
senses.usage_zomi: Thahatna ading a kizang na a diil in gen ciangin fuel pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi. Meiholh nam tuamtuam gen ciangin fuels kizang hi.

senses.heading: Something that increases emotion or activity
senses.definition_en: Something that causes an emotion, argument, problem, or activity to become stronger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim omzia, kinialna, buaina, ahih kei leh gamtatna khauhzaw sak na ahi hi.

examples.english: The false report added fuel to the conflict.
examples.zomi: Thu maan lo report in kinialna khauhsak hi.

examples.english: New investment provided fuel for economic growth.
examples.zomi: Sum koihna thak in sumlehpai khanna ading thahatna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense compares increased activity or emotion to adding fuel to a fire.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in gamtatna ahih kei leh lungsim khauhzaw sak cih pen meikuang sung meiholh behlap tawh genteh hi.

senses.heading: Containing as much as possible
senses.definition_en: Containing as much as a container, place, or space can hold.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawm, mun, ahih kei leh awng khat sungah a leng zah khempeuh om a, na dang lut thei nawn lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bus was full of passengers.
examples.zomi: Bus pen khualzin mite tawh kidim hi.

examples.english: Fill the glass until it is full.
examples.zomi: Hai a dim dong tui thun in.

senses.usage_en: Use full of, not full with, in most ordinary constructions.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina kammal kizopna ah full of ci ding a, full with ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Complete and including everything necessary
senses.definition_en: Complete, whole, or including all the necessary details or parts.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kicing, a vekpi, ahih kei leh kisap khen khempeuh a huam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The police requested a full description of the vehicle.
examples.zomi: Police-te in mawtaw omzia kicing takin gen ding ngen uh hi.

examples.english: You must pay the full amount by Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ni ciangin sum a vekpi na pia ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, full means nothing important has been omitted.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah full in thu thupi bangmah pelh lo in a kicing cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Having eaten enough
senses.definition_en: Having eaten enough food and no longer feeling hungry.
senses.explanation_zomi: An kicing a nek khit hangin gilkial nawn lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I cannot eat any more because I am full.
examples.zomi: Ka gil a vah manin ka ne thei nawn lo hi.

examples.english: The meal left everyone feeling full.
examples.zomi: Tua an in mi khempeuh gilvah sak hi.

senses.usage_en: For hunger, the opposite of full is hungry.
senses.usage_zomi: Gil thu ah full a kilehbulh pen hungry ahi hi.

senses.heading: Busy or having no available time
senses.definition_en: Having many activities or appointments and little or no available time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasep dim; hun awng om lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep leh program tampi nei a, hun awng tawm ahih kei leh om lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I have a full schedule this week.
examples.zomi: Hih kal sung ka program dim hi.

examples.english: Her day was full of meetings.
examples.zomi: Ama ni pen meeting-te tawh kidim hi.

senses.usage_en: A full schedule has little or no room for additional appointments.
senses.usage_zomi: Full schedule ah kimuh hun behlapna ding mun tawm ahih kei leh om lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Completely, entirely, or to the greatest possible degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekin, a kicingin, ahih kei leh a hihtheih zah sangpen in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I fully understand your concern.
examples.zomi: Na lunghihmawhna a kicingin ka tel hi.

examples.english: The project is now fully funded.
examples.zomi: Tua project ading sum kisap a vekin kimu khinta hi.

senses.usage_en: Fully commonly modifies verbs and participial adjectives such as understand, prepared, developed, and funded.
senses.usage_zomi: Fully in understand, prepared, developed, leh funded bang verb leh participial adjective-te hilhcian zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Enjoyment, amusement, or an activity that gives pleasure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungnopna, nuamsakna, ahih kei leh mi khat nuamsak gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children had fun at the park.
examples.zomi: Naupangte park ah nuamsa uh hi.

examples.english: He plays the guitar for fun.
examples.zomi: Amah lungnopna dingin guitar tum hi.

senses.usage_en: Fun is normally uncountable. Say “We had fun,” not “We had a fun.” Informally, a fun day is also common.
senses.usage_zomi: Fun pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi. “We had fun” ci ding a, “We had a fun” ci lo ding hi. Informal English ah a fun day zong kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Purpose or job of something
senses.definition_en: The purpose of something or the work that it is designed to perform.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na, pumpi khen, ahih kei leh system khat a omna ngiimna leh a sep ding nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: The heart’s main function is to pump blood.
examples.zomi: Lung nasep thupipen pen sisan pump ahi hi.

examples.english: This button has several functions.
examples.zomi: Hih mek in zatna leh nasep tuamtuam nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A function explains what something does or what purpose it serves.
senses.usage_zomi: Function in na khat bang sem ahih kei leh bang ngiimna zang hiam cih hilhcian hi.

senses.heading: Official or organized event
senses.definition_en: An official, formal, or organized social event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ukna, kipawlna, ahih kei leh pawl khat in a kizek takin a nei pawi leh kimuhkhopna ahi hi.

examples.english: The mayor attended an official function.
examples.zomi: Khuapi makaipa ukna pawi khat ah pai hi.

examples.english: The hotel hosts many business functions.
examples.zomi: Hotel in sumdawnna pawi leh kimuhkhopna tampi nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is somewhat formal. In everyday English, event is often more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen formal deuh hi. Nisim English ah event kizang ngeizaw hi.

senses.heading: Mathematical relationship
senses.definition_en: A mathematical relationship in which each input has a particular output.
senses.explanation_zomi: Input sim in output khat nei dingin a kipsak simna kizopna ahi hi.

examples.english: Students learned how to graph a function.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte function graph suai dan sin uh hi.

examples.english: The function gives one output for each input.
examples.zomi: Tua function in input sim ading output khat pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a specialized mathematical meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen simna pilna sunga khiatna tuam ahi hi.

senses.heading: Money saved or provided for a purpose
senses.definition_en: An amount of money collected, saved, or provided for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna tuam khat ading a kikhol, a kipaikhawm, ahih kei leh a kipiak sum ahi hi.

examples.english: The organization created a fund for disaster victims.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in siatna thuakte ading sumkhol khat bawl hi.

examples.english: Every family should consider building an emergency fund.
examples.zomi: Innkuan simin emergency sumkhol bawl ding ngaihsun ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A fund has a defined purpose. General money available to an organization is often called funds.
senses.usage_zomi: Fund in ngiimna kician khat nei hi. Kipawlna khat sum neihsa a diil in gen ciangin funds kici zel hi.

senses.heading: Investment holding money from many investors
senses.definition_en: An investment arrangement that combines money from many investors and invests it in selected assets.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum koihmi tampi sum kigawm a, vanzatna tuamtuam sungah a kikoih sumlehpai geelna ahi hi.

examples.english: She invests monthly in an index fund.
examples.zomi: Amah kha simin index fund sungah sum koih hi.

examples.english: The retirement fund owns stocks and bonds.
examples.zomi: Pension sumkhol in stocks leh bonds nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Investment funds differ in risk, fees, strategy, and assets. The word alone does not indicate whether an investment is safe.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum koihna fund-te lauhuaina, fee, geelna leh van neihsa kibang lo hi. Fund cih kammal bek in sum koihna bit hi cih kipsak lo hi.

senses.heading: Basic and essential
senses.definition_en: Forming the basic foundation of something and necessary for it to exist or work properly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a bulpi, a kingakna, leh a omtheihna ahih kei leh nasemtheihna ding a kisam mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Trust is fundamental to a strong friendship.
examples.zomi: Kimuanna pen lawmtakna khauh ading bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: Education is a fundamental right.
examples.zomi: Pilna pen a dikna bulpi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Fundamental is stronger than merely important: it means basic and necessary.
senses.usage_zomi: Fundamental pen important sangin a khauhzaw hi. A bulpi leh a kisam taktak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Relating to the most basic rules or ideas
senses.definition_en: Connected with the simplest and most basic rules, facts, or ideas of a subject.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thukhun bulpi tawh kisai; a bul
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna thu khat sunga thukhun, thu maan, ahih kei leh ngaihsutna bulpite tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Students must learn fundamental math skills.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte simna siamna bulpite sin ding uh hi.

examples.english: The course introduces the fundamental concepts of economics.
examples.zomi: Tua course in sumlehpai pilna ngaihsutna bulpite hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is common in education, science, philosophy, and professional training.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen pilna, science, philosophy leh siamna sinna ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.definition_en: Money provided for a project, organization, service, or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Project, kipawlna, nasemna, ahih kei leh gamtatna khat semna dingin a kipiak sum ahi hi.

examples.english: The program received government funding.
examples.zomi: Tua program in ukna sum panpihna ngah hi.

examples.english: Construction stopped because of a lack of funding.
examples.zomi: Sum panpihna kicing lohna hangin inn bawlna khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Funding is normally uncountable. It refers to money provided, not necessarily to the act of investing for profit.
senses.usage_zomi: Funding pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi. A piak sum gen a, profit ngah dingin sum koihna bek gen lo hi.

senses.heading: Causing laughter or amusement
senses.definition_en: Making people laugh or feel amused.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite nuisak ahih kei leh nuamsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He told a funny story about his childhood.
examples.zomi: Amah in a naupan lai tawh kisai tangthu nuihuai khat gen hi.

examples.english: The children thought the movie was funny.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in tua movie nuihuai sa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Funny means amusing; fun means enjoyable. They are related but not interchangeable.
senses.usage_zomi: Funny in nuihuai cihna ahi a, fun in nuamsakna cihna ahi hi. Mun khempeuh ah khat tawh khat khek theih hilo hi.

senses.heading: Strange, unusual, or suspicious
senses.definition_en: Strange, unusual, or suggesting that something may be wrong.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lamdang, a ngeiloh, ahih kei leh na khat khial bang a kilang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: There is a funny smell in the kitchen.
examples.zomi: Anbawlna khan ah gim lamdang khat om hi.

examples.english: My computer is making a funny noise.
examples.zomi: Ka computer in ging ngeiloh khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Context and tone distinguish “amusing” from “strange.” A funny smell normally means an unusual smell, not an amusing one.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizangna leh awging in “nuihuai” leh “lamdang” kikhensak hi. A funny smell in gim nuihuai hilo a, gim lamdang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Thick soft hair covering an animal
senses.definition_en: The thick, soft hair that covers the body of some animals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ganhing pawlkhat pumpi tuam a, a tam leh a nem mul ahi hi.

examples.english: The rabbit has soft white fur.
examples.zomi: Tua sialin ganmul kang leh nem nei hi.

examples.english: Thick fur keeps the animal warm in winter.
examples.zomi: Ganmul tam in phalbi ciangin ganhing lumsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Fur is normally uncountable when referring to an animal’s coat.
senses.usage_zomi: Ganhing pumpi tuam mul a diil in gen ciangin fur pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Animal skin with fur used as material
senses.definition_en: Animal skin with its fur, used for making clothing or other products.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan ahih kei leh van dang bawlna ding a kizang, mul tawh ganhing vun ahi hi.

examples.english: The coat is made from artificial fur.
examples.zomi: Tua puanlum ganmul bawltawm tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Many people oppose the use of real fur in clothing.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi in puan bawlna ah ganmul vun taktak zat nial uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Faux fur or fake fur is artificial material made to look like animal fur.
senses.usage_zomi: Faux fur ahih kei leh fake fur pen ganmul bangin kilang ding a kibawl van bawltawm ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Large movable objects such as tables, chairs, beds, and cupboards used in a room or building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khan ahih kei leh inn sungah a kizang sabuai, tokhum, lupna leh van koihna bawm bang a kikhinkhian thei inn vante ahi hi.

examples.english: They bought new furniture for the living room.
examples.zomi: Innkuan omkhopna khan ading inn van thakte lei uh hi.

examples.english: The office furniture will arrive tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Office vante zingciang hong tung ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Furniture is uncountable. Say a piece of furniture or some furniture, not a furniture or furnitures.
senses.usage_zomi: Furniture pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi. A piece of furniture ahih kei leh some furniture ci ding a, a furniture leh furnitures ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Additional or more
senses.definition_en: Additional, extra, or more than what has already been provided.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kipiaksa ahih kei leh a om khitsa tungah a behlap cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please contact us if you need further information.
examples.zomi: Thu theihna behlap na kisap leh hong hopih in.

examples.english: The matter requires further discussion.
examples.zomi: Tua thu kihoupih behlai kul hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, further means additional and is used before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah further in behlap cihna nei a, noun maiah kizang hi.

senses.heading: More distant
senses.definition_en: Located at a greater distance or farther along a route.
senses.explanation_zomi: A gamla zaw ahih kei leh lampi zui in a malamzaw a om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The school is on the further side of the river.
examples.zomi: Sang pen gun a gamla zaw lamah om hi.

examples.english: We stopped before reaching the further village.
examples.zomi: A gamla zaw khua ka tunma un ka khawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Farther is often preferred for physical distance, while further is used for both physical and figurative extension.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi tawh kiteh gamla ading farther kizangzaw thei hi. Further pen gamla taktak leh gentehna tegel ading kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: In addition to what has already been said; moreover.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen khitsa tungah thu behlap dang khat om cih pulakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The plan is expensive; furthermore, it may not work.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna manpha hi; tua banah, nasem takpi lo thei hi.

examples.english: The course develops skills; furthermore, it provides work experience.
examples.zomi: Tua course in siamna khangsak hi; tua banah, nasep theihsa zong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Furthermore is formal and is mainly used in writing or prepared speech to add a supporting point.
senses.usage_zomi: Furthermore pen formal ahi a, thu panpih behlap dingin laigelhna leh kiginkholh thugenna ah kizang ber hi.

senses.heading: Time that has not yet happened
senses.definition_en: The period of time that will come after the present.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mailam hun; hong tung ding hun
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu hun khitah hong pai ding hun ahi hi.

examples.english: Technology will continue to change in the future.
examples.zomi: Mailam hun in technology kikhel paisuak ding hi.

examples.english: Save this document for future use.
examples.zomi: Hih document mailam zat dingin kem in.

senses.usage_en: Use in the future for time generally. In future in British English can mean “from now on.”
senses.usage_zomi: Mailam hun a diil in gen ciangin in the future kizang hi. British English ah in future in “tu pan kipan” cihna zong nei thei hi.

senses.heading: What is likely to happen to someone or something
senses.definition_en: The expected development, success, or condition of a person, organization, plan, or place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, kipawlna, geelna, ahih kei leh mun khat mailam dinmun koibang suak ding hiam cih ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a bright future in medicine.
examples.zomi: Cidamna lamah ama mailam dinmun hoih ding hi.

examples.english: The company faces an uncertain future.
examples.zomi: Company in mailam dinmun kician lo maituah hi.

senses.usage_en: A bright future means good prospects; an uncertain future means the likely outcome is unclear.
senses.usage_zomi: A bright future in mailam ngahna hoih om ding cihna ahi hi. An uncertain future in mailam bang piang ding hiam kician lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Future life or career prospects
senses.definition_en: A person’s opportunities, career, or life in the years ahead.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat mailam hun sunga hunhoih, nasep lam leh nuntakna dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: Education can help young people build a better future.
examples.zomi: Pilna in khangnote mailam nuntakna hoihzaw bawltheihna panpih thei hi.

examples.english: He is saving money to secure his family’s future.
examples.zomi: A innkuan mailam dinmun kipsak dingin sum khol hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, future includes long-term plans, opportunities, security, and well-being.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah future in hun sau geelna, hunhoihte, bitna leh nuntak hoihna huam hi.

senses.heading: Obtain something useful or valuable
senses.definition_en: To obtain, earn, or develop something useful or desirable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na phattuam ahih kei leh deihhuai khat ngah, loh, ahih kei leh khangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She gained valuable experience from the project.
examples.zomi: Amah in tua project pan nasep theihsa phattuam ngah hi.

examples.english: The training helped employees gain confidence.
examples.zomi: Tua sinna in nasemte kimuanna khangsak ding panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Gain often suggests obtaining something gradually through effort or experience.
senses.usage_zomi: Gain in kuhkalna ahih kei leh thuaksa tungtawnin na khat tawm tawm in ngah cihna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Increase in amount, strength, speed, or value
senses.definition_en: To increase in amount, weight, strength, speed, support, or value.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zah, a gikna, a thahatna, a manlangna, a panpihna, ahih kei leh a man khang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The car gained speed as it went downhill.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw mual kiasuk ah a pai ciangin a manlangna khang hi.

examples.english: The proposal is gaining public support.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna in mipi panpihna ngah semsem hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, gain describes an increase. Its opposite is often lose.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah gain in khanna gen a, a kilehbulh pen lose hi zel hi.

senses.heading: Reach a place after effort
senses.definition_en: To reach a place, position, or goal, especially after effort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna khit ciangin mun, dinmun, ahih kei leh ngiimna khat tung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hikers gained the summit before sunset.
examples.zomi: Mualkahte ni tumma in mualdawn tung uh hi.

examples.english: The key allowed them to gain access to the building.
examples.zomi: Tua tawh in amaute inn sung luttheihna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is more formal than simply reach.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen reach sangin formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: Place where art is displayed
senses.definition_en: A building or room where paintings, photographs, or other works of art are publicly displayed.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lim lahna khan; khutkhatna lahna inn
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim, limlak, ahih kei leh khutkhatna dangte mipi et dingin a kilahna inn ahih kei leh khan ahi hi.

examples.english: The gallery is displaying work by local artists.
examples.zomi: Lim lahna inn in khuami khutkhat siamte nasep lak hi.

examples.english: We visited an art gallery in the city center.
examples.zomi: Khuapi laizang ah khutkhatna lahna inn khat ka veh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A gallery mainly displays art. A museum may preserve and display historical, scientific, or cultural objects as well.
senses.usage_zomi: Gallery ah khutkhatna limte kilak ber hi. Museum ah tangthu, science, ahih kei leh ngeina vante zong kikem leh kilak thei hi.

senses.heading: Collection of digital images
senses.definition_en: A collection or display of photographs or images on a phone, computer, or website.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phone, computer, ahih kei leh website sunga a kikhol leh a kilak lim leh limlak pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The photos are saved in my phone’s gallery.
examples.zomi: Limlakte ka phone limkhol sungah kikem hi.

examples.english: The website has a gallery of student artwork.
examples.zomi: Website ah sangnaupang khutkhatna lim pawl khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: On digital devices, gallery commonly means the application or section where images are stored and viewed.
senses.usage_zomi: Digital vante ah gallery in limte a kikholhna leh etna application ahih kei leh khen gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Activity played for enjoyment or competition
senses.definition_en: An activity with rules that people play for enjoyment, skill, or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungnopna, siamna, ahih kei leh kidemna dingin thukhun tawh a kimawh ahi hi.

examples.english: The children played a game after dinner.
examples.zomi: Naupangte nitak an khit ciangin kimawhna khat kimaw uh hi.

examples.english: Our team won the final game.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl un kimawhna nunung zo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A game may be a complete contest, while sport often refers to the general physical activity or category.
senses.usage_zomi: Game in kidemna khat a kicing gen thei a, sport in pumpi kimawhna a diil ahih kei leh kimawhna nam gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Particular period of play
senses.definition_en: One complete period or contest within a sport or organized competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawhna ahih kei leh kidemna khat sunga kipat pan tawp dong a kicing kimawhna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The team has three games this week.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl hih kal sung kimawhna thum nei hi.

examples.english: They lost the first game but won the second.
examples.zomi: A masa kimawhna lel uh a, a nihna zo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In sports, a game can be counted as one complete contest.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawhna thu ah game pen kipat pan tawp dong kidemna khat in kisim hi.

senses.heading: Wild animals hunted for food or sport
senses.definition_en: Wild animals or birds hunted for food or sport.
senses.explanation_zomi: An ding ahih kei leh lungnopna kimawhna in a kiman gamgan leh gamvasa-te ahi hi.

examples.english: The law limits the hunting of game animals.
examples.zomi: Thukham in gamgan manna ciangtan koih hi.

examples.english: The restaurant serves wild game.
examples.zomi: Tua ankuang inn in gam sa zuak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is normally uncountable and appears mainly in hunting and food contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel a, gamgan manna leh an thu ah kizang ber hi.

senses.heading: Organized group involved in crime
senses.definition_en: An organized group of people involved in crime, violence, or illegal activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhna, ngongtatna, ahih kei leh thukhun palsat nasep a semkhawm mi pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: Police arrested several members of the gang.
examples.zomi: Police-te in tua mawhna pawl sungmi tampi man uh hi.

examples.english: The program helps young people avoid gang violence.
examples.zomi: Tua program in khangnote mawhna pawl ngongtatna pelh ding panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: In news and legal contexts, gang often suggests organized crime or violence.
senses.usage_zomi: Thuthak leh thukham thu ah gang in mawhna ahih kei leh ngongtatna semkhawm pawl cihna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Informal group of friends or workers
senses.definition_en: An informal group of friends or people who regularly work or spend time together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lawm ahih kei leh nasem khat tawh khat hun zangkhawm zel pawl khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The whole gang met for dinner.
examples.zomi: Lawm pawl a vekin nitak an nekhawm uh hi.

examples.english: A work gang repaired the road.
examples.zomi: Nasem pawl khat in lampi bawlpha uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This use can be friendly and informal, but context is important because gang may also suggest crime.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan pen lawmta leh informal hi thei napi, gang in mawhna pawl zong gen theih manin thu kizangna thupi hi.

senses.heading: Empty space or opening
senses.definition_en: An empty space or opening between two things or within something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na nih kikal ahih kei leh na khat sung a awngna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The dog escaped through a gap in the fence.
examples.zomi: Ui pen kulh a vang pan taikhia hi.

examples.english: Leave a small gap between the tables.
examples.zomi: Sabuai kikal ah mun awng tawmno koih in.

senses.usage_en: A gap is an unfilled space that separates things.
senses.usage_zomi: Gap pen na-te kikhen a, a kidim lo mun awng ahi hi.

senses.heading: Difference between groups, amounts, or conditions
senses.definition_en: A difference between two groups, amounts, levels, ideas, or conditions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, a zah, dinmun, ngaihsutna, ahih kei leh omzia nih kikal a kilamdanna ahi hi.

examples.english: The policy aims to reduce the income gap.
examples.zomi: Tua thukhun in sum ngah kilamdanna kiam sak ngiim hi.

examples.english: There is a large gap between the two estimates.
examples.zomi: Tua man ngaihsut nih kikal ah kilamdanna lianpi om hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, gap describes inequality, disagreement, or distance between levels.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in kibanglohna, thukimlohna, ahih kei leh dinmun kikal gamla gen hi.

senses.heading: Period when something is missing or interrupted
senses.definition_en: A period of time when an activity stops or something expected is absent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna khawl kikal ahih kei leh a om ding na khat om lohna hun ahi hi.

examples.english: She explained the gap in her employment history.
examples.zomi: A nasep tangthu sunga nasep neihlohna hun hilhcian hi.

examples.english: The temporary worker filled a gap in the schedule.
examples.zomi: Hun tawm nasempa in program a awngna kicing sak hi.

senses.usage_en: A gap year is usually a planned year away from formal education or work.
senses.usage_zomi: Gap year pen a tamzaw in sangpilna ahih kei leh nasep pan kum khat khawl ding a kigeel kholh ahi hi.

senses.heading: Building where a vehicle is kept
senses.definition_en: A building or enclosed space where a car or another vehicle is stored.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw ahih kei leh vanpuak dang koihna ding a kibawl inn ahih kei leh mun a kikhak ahi hi.

examples.english: The car is parked in the garage.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw garage sungah kikoih hi.

examples.english: He keeps his tools in the garage.
examples.zomi: A vanzatte garage sungah kem hi.

senses.usage_en: A garage may be attached to a house or stand as a separate building.
senses.usage_zomi: Garage pen inn tawh kizom thei a, inn tuam in zong om thei hi.

senses.heading: Business that repairs vehicles
senses.definition_en: A business or workshop where vehicles are repaired or serviced.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtawte a kibawlphatna ahih kei leh a kisittelna nasep mun ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: take a car to the garage

examples.english: I took the car to the garage for repair.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw bawlphat dingin mawtaw bawlphatna munah ka paipih hi.

examples.english: The garage replaced the battery.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw bawlphatna mun in battery khek hi.

senses.usage_en: This business meaning is especially common in British English. American English often uses repair shop or auto shop.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih sumdawnna khiatna pen British English ah kizang ngeizaw hi. American English ah repair shop ahih kei leh auto shop kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: Area where plants are grown
senses.definition_en: An area of land where flowers, vegetables, fruit, or other plants are grown.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pak, huan-an, theigah, ahih kei leh singkung dangte a kikhawina leitang ahi hi.

examples.english: She grows tomatoes in her garden.
examples.zomi: A huan ah tomato kho hi.

examples.english: The children planted flowers in the school garden.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in sang huan ah pak kungte phut uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, a garden usually grows plants. In British English, garden can also mean the yard around a house.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah garden in singkung leh huan-an a kikhawina gen ber hi. British English ah inn kimkot leitang zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Public area with plants
senses.definition_en: A public park or specially designed area containing plants, flowers, and paths.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi vak leh en dingin singkung, pak leh lampi tawh a kibawl huan zaipi ahi hi.

examples.english: We visited the botanical garden.
examples.zomi: Singkung kancian huan ka veh uh hi.

examples.english: The public garden is open every day.
examples.zomi: Mipi huan ni simin kihong hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural gardens may be part of the official name of a public attraction.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural gardens pen mipi vehna mun minpi khen khat hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Substance like air
senses.definition_en: A substance such as air that is neither solid nor liquid and spreads to fill its container.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sik bang a khauh lo, tui bang a luang lo a, huih bangin a bawm sung dimsak na ahi hi.

examples.english: Natural gas is used for heating and cooking.
examples.zomi: Leinuai gas inn lumsakna leh an bawlna ah kizang hi.

examples.english: The chemical released a dangerous gas.
examples.zomi: Chemical in gas lauhuai khat suah hi.

senses.usage_en: A gas spreads to fill the space available to it.
senses.usage_zomi: Gas pen a omna awng zah bangin kizai a, tua mun dimsak hi.

senses.heading: Gasoline used as vehicle fuel
senses.definition_en: Gasoline, a liquid fuel used in cars and other engines.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw leh engine dangte a hawlna dingin a kizang tui meiholh ahi hi.

examples.english: We stopped at a gas station.
examples.zomi: Meiholh zuakna munah ka khawl uh hi.

examples.english: The car ran out of gas.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw meiholh bei hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is standard in American English. British English normally uses petrol.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen American English ah kizang hi. British English ah petrol kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: Gas produced in the digestive system
senses.definition_en: Air or gas produced in the stomach or intestines.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gil sung ahih kei leh gilpi sungah a piang huih ahi hi.

examples.english: Some foods can cause gas.
examples.zomi: An pawlkhat in gil huih piangsak thei hi.

examples.english: The medicine may help reduce gas pain.
examples.zomi: Tua zatui in gil huih hang natna kiam sak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In health contexts, gas is normally uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna thu ah gas pen simtheih loh noun in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Movable barrier in a fence or wall
senses.definition_en: A movable barrier that opens and closes an entrance in a fence, wall, or boundary.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kulh ahih kei leh mun ciangtan a lutna ah hong leh khak theih kong ahi hi.

examples.english: Please close the gate behind you.
examples.zomi: Na lut khit ciangin kulh kong khak in.

examples.english: A guard stood beside the main gate.
examples.zomi: Kongpi geiah kempa khat ding hi.

senses.usage_en: A gate is usually part of a fence or boundary. A door normally gives entrance to a room or building.
senses.usage_zomi: Gate pen kulh ahih kei leh mun ciangtan khen khat hi zel hi. Door pen khan ahih kei leh inn lutna kong ahi hi.

senses.heading: Airport departure entrance
senses.definition_en: A numbered airport area where passengers wait and enter an aircraft.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanleng ngakna munah nambar kipiak, khualzinte ngak leh vanleng tungna ding a paikhiatna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: Our flight leaves from Gate 8.
examples.zomi: Ka vanleng uh Gate nambar giat pan pusuak ding hi.

examples.english: Passengers should proceed to the boarding gate.
examples.zomi: Khualzinte vanleng tungna kongah pai ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An airport gate is a departure area, not simply the building’s main entrance.
senses.usage_zomi: Airport gate pen vanleng paikhiatna ding mun ahi a, inn lutna kongpi mawk hilo hi.

senses.heading: Come together or bring people together
senses.definition_en: To come together in one place or bring people together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tampi mun khat ah kikhawm ahih kei leh mi tampi khawmsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The family gathered for dinner.
examples.zomi: Innkuan nitak an nek dingin kikhawm hi.

examples.english: The teacher gathered the students around the table.
examples.zomi: Sia in sangnaupangte sabuai kimkot ah khawmsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Gather may be intransitive (people gathered) or transitive (someone gathered the people).
senses.usage_zomi: Gather pen object om lo in “mite kikhawm” ci in kizang thei a, object tawh “mi khat in mite khawmsak” ci in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Collect things
senses.definition_en: To collect objects, materials, information, or evidence from different places.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun tuamtuam pan van, vanzat, thu theihna, ahih kei leh teci paikhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Researchers gathered information from several sources.
examples.zomi: Kanciante in mun tuamtuam pan thu theihna paikhawm uh hi.

examples.english: The children gathered dry wood for the fire.
examples.zomi: Naupangte mei ading sing keu khawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Gather information means collect it from one or more sources before analyzing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Gather information in thu theihna mun khat ahih kei leh tampi pan paikhawm a, tua khit sittel cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Understand or conclude indirectly
senses.definition_en: To understand or conclude something from what has been said or observed.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen ahih kei leh a kimuh thu pan thukhupna khat nei ahih kei leh telkhia cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: tua bang hi ci in ka tel

examples.english: I gather that the meeting has been canceled.
examples.zomi: Meeting kikhawlta hi ci in ka tel hi.

examples.english: From what I gather, they plan to move next year.
examples.zomi: Ka tel bangin, amaute kumkik ciangin kikhi dingin geel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This use often suggests that the information was learned indirectly rather than stated clearly.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan in thu pen kician takin kigen lo napi, thu tuamtuam pan kitelkhia cihna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Affecting or concerning most people or things
senses.definition_en: Relating to most people, things, or situations rather than a limited group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na, ahih kei leh dinmun a tamzaw a huam a, pawl tawmno bek tawh a kisai hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The library is open to the general public.
examples.zomi: Laibu inn mipi a diil ading kihong hi.

examples.english: The report provides general information about the program.
examples.zomi: Tua report in program tawh kisai thu theihna a diil pia hi.

senses.usage_en: General contrasts with specific, specialized, or limited.
senses.usage_zomi: General pen specific, specialized, ahih kei leh limited tawh kilehbulh hi.

senses.heading: Not detailed or exact
senses.definition_en: Describing the main idea or overall situation without including every detail.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu tawmno khempeuh huam lo a, a thupipen leh a diil bek gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave a general description of the problem.
examples.zomi: Amah in buaina pen a diil in hilhcian hi.

examples.english: I understand the general idea, but not every detail.
examples.zomi: Ngaihsutna a diil ka tel napi, thu tawmno khempeuh ka tel lo hi.

senses.usage_en: A general idea gives the main meaning without complete detail.
senses.usage_zomi: General idea in thu tawmno khempeuh nei lo napi, a khiatna thupipen pia hi.

senses.heading: Usual or common
senses.definition_en: Usual, common, or true in most cases.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina, a kizang tam, ahih kei leh dinmun a tamzaw ah maan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: As a general rule, children need more sleep than adults.
examples.zomi: Thukhun a diil in, naupangte in upate sangin ihmut tampizaw kisam uh hi.

examples.english: The doctor asked about her general health.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ama pumpi cidamna a diil dong hi.

senses.usage_en: A general rule may have exceptions.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhun a diil in a pelhna om thei hi.

senses.heading: In most cases or usually
senses.definition_en: In most situations or for most people; usually.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a ngeina in; a tamzaw in
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun a tamzaw ah, mi a tamzaw ading, ahih kei leh a ngeina in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The buses are generally on time.
examples.zomi: Bus-te a ngeina in hun ciangin hong tung hi.

examples.english: This medicine is generally safe for adults.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui pen upate ading a ngeina in bit hi.

senses.usage_en: Generally allows for exceptions; it does not mean always.
senses.usage_zomi: Generally in pelhna omtheihna huam a, tawntung cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Considering the whole situation
senses.definition_en: When considering something as a whole rather than focusing on details.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a diil in; a vekpi ngaihsun in
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu tawmnote bek en lo in, thu a vekpi ngaihsun ciangin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Generally speaking, the project was successful.
examples.zomi: A diil in gen leng, tua project gualzo hi.

examples.english: Customers were generally satisfied with the service.
examples.zomi: Vanleite a vekpi ngaihsun leng nasemna lungkim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Generally speaking introduces a broad statement that may not apply to every case.
senses.usage_zomi: Generally speaking in dinmun khempeuh ah maan pahpah lo napi, a zaizaw in maan thu pulak hi.

senses.heading: Produce energy or power
senses.definition_en: To produce electricity, heat, power, or another form of energy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Electric, khuasa, thahatna, ahih kei leh energy nam dang khat piangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The solar panels generate electricity.
examples.zomi: Nisa panel-te in electric piangsak hi.

examples.english: The engine generates a large amount of heat.
examples.zomi: Engine in khuasa tampi suah hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is common in energy, engineering, and science.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen energy, engineering leh science thu ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Produce a result, idea, income, or response
senses.definition_en: To produce, create, or cause something such as an idea, income, interest, or reaction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, sum ngahna, lunglutna, dawnkikna, ahih kei leh ngahna khat piangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The business generates income for many families.
examples.zomi: Tua sumdawnna in innkuan tampi sum ngahna piangsak hi.

examples.english: The discussion generated several new ideas.
examples.zomi: Tua kihoupihna in ngaihsutna thak tampi piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Generate is more formal than make or produce and often describes a process that creates a result.
senses.usage_zomi: Generate pen make ahih kei leh produce sangin formal zaw a, nasepzia khat pan ngahna piang cihna gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Produce automatically with a system
senses.definition_en: To create information, text, numbers, images, or other output automatically by using a system or program.
senses.explanation_zomi: System ahih kei leh program khat zangin thu theihna, lai, nambar, lim, ahih kei leh output amahin bawlkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The system generates a report every week.
examples.zomi: System in kal simin report khat bawlkhia hi.

examples.english: The website generated a secure password.
examples.zomi: Website in password bit khat bawlkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: In technology, generate often means that a program creates the output according to data or instructions.
senses.usage_zomi: Technology thu ah generate in program khat in data ahih kei leh thupiakna zui in output bawlkhia cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: People born around the same period
senses.definition_en: All the people born and living at about the same time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun nai kibangin a suak leh a nungta mi pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The younger generation uses technology differently.
examples.zomi: Khangnote in technology zatdan tuam nei uh hi.

examples.english: We should preserve the language for the next generation.
examples.zomi: A zui khang ading pau kem ding hihang.

senses.usage_en: A generation is often estimated as about 20–30 years, but its exact length varies by context.
senses.usage_zomi: Khang khat pen kum 20 pan 30 kim in kingaihsun zel napi, a sauzah thu kizangna bangin kibang lo thei hi.

senses.heading: Members of a family at one level of descent
senses.definition_en: One level in a family line, such as grandparents, parents, or children.
senses.explanation_zomi: Innkuan khangzui sungah pupa, nu leh pa, ahih kei leh ta-te bangin a kikhen dinmun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Three generations live in the same house.
examples.zomi: Inn khat sungah khang thum tengkhawm hi.

examples.english: The skill has passed from generation to generation.
examples.zomi: Tua siamna khang khat pan khang khat dong kipia hi.

senses.usage_en: In family history, each generation represents a different level of descent.
senses.usage_zomi: Innkuan tangthu ah khang simin khangzui dinmun tuam khat limgen hi.

senses.heading: Production of energy or something else
senses.definition_en: The production or creation of electricity, heat, ideas, income, or other output.
senses.explanation_zomi: Electric, khuasa, ngaihsutna, sum ngahna, ahih kei leh output dang piangsakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Solar power generation increased last year.
examples.zomi: Kumkhat in nisa electric piangsakna khang hi.

examples.english: The program supports income generation in rural areas.
examples.zomi: Tua program in khuaneu gamte ah sum ngahna piangsak ding panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: This technical sense is related to the verb generate.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih technology leh nasep khiatna pen verb generate tawh kizom hi.

senses.heading: Version of a product or technology
senses.definition_en: A stage or version in the development of a product, machine, or technology.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, machine, ahih kei leh technology khanna sunga version ahih kei leh dinmun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: This is the latest generation of the device.
examples.zomi: Hih pen tua vanzat khang thakpen ahi hi.

examples.english: Next-generation batteries may last longer.
examples.zomi: A zui khang battery-te sawtzaw zangtheih ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In technology, generation groups products by major stages of development.
senses.usage_zomi: Technology ah generation in vante a khanna dinmun lian bangin pawlsak hi.

senses.heading: Willing to give or share
senses.definition_en: Willing to give money, time, help, or possessions freely and kindly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, hun, panpihna, ahih kei leh neihsa midangte tungah lungnem takin pia nuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is generous with her time and money.
examples.zomi: Amah ama hun leh sum midangte tungah pia nuam hi.

examples.english: The community received a generous donation.
examples.zomi: Mipi in sum piak lian khat ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Use generous with for what someone shares and generous to/toward for the person receiving kindness.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat bang a kihawm hiam cih genin generous with kizang a, kua tungah lungnem hiam cih genin generous to/toward kizang hi.

senses.heading: Larger than usual or necessary
senses.definition_en: Larger or more plentiful than is usual or strictly necessary.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina ahih kei leh a kisapzah sangin a lianzaw ahih kei leh a tamzaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The restaurant serves generous portions.
examples.zomi: Tua ankuang inn in an khen liante pia hi.

examples.english: Allow a generous amount of time for the journey.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna ading hun kicing val koih in.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes an amount that is pleasantly large.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in a zah pen lungkimhuai takin tam cih pulak hi.

senses.definition_en: A recognized category of literature, music, film, art, or other creative work with shared features.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, la, lim kalsuan, khutkhatna, ahih kei leh bawlkhia nasep dangte a kibang omzia tawh a kipawl khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Comedy is her favorite film genre.
examples.zomi: Nuihuai lim kalsuan pen ama deihpen film nam ahi hi.

examples.english: The course examines several literary genres.
examples.zomi: Tua course in laibu nam tuamtuam kancian hi.

senses.usage_en: Genre classifies creative works by shared style, form, or subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Genre in bawlkhia nasepte a kibang style, pianzia, ahih kei leh thu bul tawh pawlsak hi.

senses.heading: Kind, calm, and not rough
senses.definition_en: Kind, calm, and careful, without harshness or violence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungnem, gamdai, pilvang a, khauh leh ngongtat lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The nurse spoke in a gentle voice.
examples.zomi: Nurse in aw nem tawh pau hi.

examples.english: Be gentle with the injured animal.
examples.zomi: Ganhing a liam pen nem takin bawl in.

senses.usage_en: A gentle person or action avoids unnecessary force and harm.
senses.usage_zomi: Gentle mi ahih kei leh gamtatna in tha khengval zang lo a, siatna piangsak lo hi.

senses.heading: Not strong, steep, or severe
senses.definition_en: Mild, gradual, or not strong, steep, or severe.
senses.explanation_zomi: A khauh lo, a khem lo, ahih kei leh a tung kang lua lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A gentle wind moved through the trees.
examples.zomi: Huih nem khat singkungte lakah nung hi.

examples.english: The path rises at a gentle slope.
examples.zomi: Lampi pen mualpang khem lo zui in kahto hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes something mild rather than powerful or sudden.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in na khat a khauh ahih kei leh thakhat a piang hilo a, a nem cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Polite and honorable man
senses.definition_en: A man who behaves politely, respectfully, and honorably.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zaidam, zahtakna nei leh thumaan takin gamta pasal khat ahi hi.

examples.english: He was always a gentleman toward his guests.
examples.zomi: Amah a mikhualte tungah zaidam tawntung hi.

examples.english: A gentleman treats others with respect.
examples.zomi: Pa zaidam in midangte zahtakna tawh bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning emphasizes behavior and character rather than wealth or social class.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in hauhna ahih kei leh mipi dinmun sangin gamtatna leh omzia khauhsak hi.

senses.heading: Polite or formal word for a man
senses.definition_en: A polite or formal term used to refer to a man.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pasal khat zaidam ahih kei leh formal takin a sapna kammal ahi hi.

examples.english: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the program.
examples.zomi: Numei leh pasalte aw, hih program ah lungdam takin kong nawl uh hi.

examples.english: An elderly gentleman asked for directions.
examples.zomi: Pa upa khat in lampi hong dong hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is gentlemen. In modern English, it is often used in formal announcements or polite descriptions.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural form pen gentlemen ahi hi. Tuhun English ah formal thupuak leh zaidam genna ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.definition_en: The study of the earth’s surface, places, physical features, climate, populations, and how people relate to their environment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung mai, munte, mual leh gun bang pianpih omzia, khuahun, mihing omna leh kimkot tawh amau kizopna sinna ahi hi.

examples.english: Students learn about rivers and mountains in geography.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte geography ah gun leh mualte thu sin uh hi.

examples.english: Geography influences where people live and work.
examples.zomi: Leitung omzia in mite a tenna leh nasepna mun huzaap hi.

senses.usage_en: Geography is the subject; geographical is the related adjective.
senses.usage_zomi: Geography pen sinlai min ahi a, a kizom adjective pen geographical ahi hi.

senses.heading: Obtain, receive, or buy something
