senses.definition_en: To obtain, receive, earn, or buy something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngah, sang, loh, ahih kei leh lei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She got a new job last month.
examples.zomi: Amah kha beisa in nasep thak ngah hi.

examples.english: Did you get my email?
examples.zomi: Ka email na sang hiam?

senses.usage_en: Get is very common in conversation. In formal writing, a more precise verb such as receive, obtain, or purchase may be better.
senses.usage_zomi: Get pen kihoupihna ah kizang mahmah hi. Formal laigelhna ah receive, obtain, ahih kei leh purchase bang kammal kicianzaw zat hoih thei hi.

senses.heading: Become or change into a condition
senses.definition_en: To become or begin to be in a particular condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun ahih kei leh omzia tuam khat hong suak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: It is getting dark outside.
examples.zomi: Pualam khuamial semsem hi.

examples.english: She got tired after the long walk.
examples.zomi: Amah gamla tak a kalsuan khit ciangin gim hi.

senses.usage_en: Get + adjective commonly describes a change of state: get angry, get old, or get ready.
senses.usage_zomi: Get + adjective in dinmun kikhelna gen zel hi: get angry, get old, ahih kei leh get ready.

senses.heading: Arrive at or reach a place
senses.definition_en: To arrive at or reach a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat tung ahih kei leh pha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: What time did you get home?
examples.zomi: Bang hun in inn na tung hiam?

examples.english: We need to get to the airport by six.
examples.zomi: Dak guk ciangin vanleng ngakna mun ka tung kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not normally use to before home: say get home, not get to home.
senses.usage_zomi: Home maiah to koih ngeilo hi. Get home ci ding a, get to home ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Understand something
senses.definition_en: To understand a statement, joke, explanation, or idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, kammal nuihuai, hilhcianna, ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat tel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I do not get the joke.
examples.zomi: Tua kammal nuihuai khiatna ka tel lo hi.

examples.english: Do you get what I am saying?
examples.zomi: Ka gen thu na tel hiam?

senses.usage_en: This sense is informal. In formal contexts, use understand.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen informal ahi hi. Formal thu ah understand kizang hi.

senses.heading: Bring, fetch, or cause someone to do something
senses.definition_en: To bring or fetch something, or to arrange for someone to perform an action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hong la, hong paipih, ahih kei leh mi khat na khat bawlsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Could you get me a glass of water?
examples.zomi: Tui hai khat hong la thei diam?

examples.english: We got a mechanic to check the engine.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw siampa khat in engine sitelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Get someone to do something means persuade or arrange for that person to do it. Get something done means arrange for the action to be completed.
senses.usage_zomi: Get someone to do something in mi khat tua nasep bawl dingin zol ahih kei leh geelsak cihna ahi hi. Get something done in tua nasep zosiang dingin bawlsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Experience or catch an illness
senses.definition_en: To experience something or become affected by an illness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat thuak ahih kei leh natna khat ngah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He got the flu during the winter.
examples.zomi: Phalbi laitakin flu cina hi.

examples.english: I sometimes get headaches after working late.
examples.zomi: Nasep ka sep manlat ciangin ka lutang na zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Get is informal but very common with illnesses and experiences.
senses.usage_zomi: Natna leh thuakna-te tawh get pen informal napi kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: Spirit of a dead person
senses.definition_en: The spirit of a dead person believed to appear to living people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Misi kha, a nungta mite tungah kilakthei ci in a ki-um kha ahi hi.

examples.english: The children told ghost stories at night.
examples.zomi: Naupangte zanin misi kha tangthute gen uh hi.

examples.english: Some people believe that the old house has a ghost.
examples.zomi: Mi pawlkhat in tua inn lui ah misi kha om hi ci in um uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Belief in ghosts differs across religions and cultures. A dictionary definition describes the concept without claiming that ghosts exist.
senses.usage_zomi: Misi kha tawh kisai updan biakna leh ngeina tuamtuam ah kibang lo hi. Dictionary khiatna in tua ngaihsutna bek hilhcian a, misi kha om taktak cih kipsak lo hi.

senses.heading: Faint remaining sign of something
senses.definition_en: A very faint trace, image, or memory of something that is no longer fully present.
senses.explanation_zomi: A om nawn lo na khat a lim, a phawkna, ahih kei leh a neucik a omlai ahi hi.

examples.english: A ghost of a smile appeared on her face.
examples.zomi: Ama maitang ah nuihna neucik hong kilang hi.

examples.english: The screen showed a faint ghost image.
examples.zomi: Screen tungah lim kia neucik khat kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes something very faint or incomplete.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in na khat kician lo leh a kicing lo in neucik om cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Extremely large compared with others of the same kind.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibang pawl dangte tawh etkak ciangin a lian mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A giant tree stands beside the river.
examples.zomi: Gun geiah singkung lian mahmah khat ding hi.

examples.english: The merger created a giant technology company.
examples.zomi: Company kigawmna in technology company lian mahmah khat piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Giant before a noun often emphasizes exceptional physical size, scale, or importance.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun maia giant in pumpi lianzia, nasep zaizia, ahih kei leh thupizia a ngeiloh zah khauhsak hi.

senses.heading: Something given without payment
senses.definition_en: Something voluntarily given to someone without expecting payment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum la ding ngaihsun lo in mi khat tungah deihna tawh a kipiak na ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave me a book as a birthday gift.
examples.zomi: Amahin ka suahni letsong in laibu khat hong pia hi.

examples.english: The children received gifts during the festival.
examples.zomi: Pawi laitakin naupangte letsong ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Gift and present have similar meanings. Gift is common in both formal and informal contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Gift leh present khiatna kibang deuh hi. Gift pen formal leh informal tegel ah kizang hi.

senses.heading: Natural ability
senses.definition_en: A natural ability or special talent for doing something well.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a pianpih in a nei na khat bawl siamna tuam ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a gift for learning languages.
examples.zomi: Amah pau sinna lamah pianpih siamna nei hi.

examples.english: His gift for teaching was clear from an early age.
examples.zomi: Ama laihilh pianpih siamna naupan lai pan kician hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a gift for + noun/-ing form to identify the activity in which someone has natural talent.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat bang lamah pianpih siamna nei hiam cih genin a gift for + noun/-ing form kizang hi.

senses.heading: Female child
senses.definition_en: A female child.
senses.explanation_zomi: Numei naupang ahi hi.

examples.english: The girl is reading a book.
examples.zomi: Numeino in laibu khat sim hi.

examples.english: They have two boys and one girl.
examples.zomi: Amaute in tangvalno nih leh numeino khat nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Girl normally refers to a female child or teenager.
senses.usage_zomi: Girl in numei naupang ahih kei leh khangno gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Young woman
senses.definition_en: A young woman, especially in informal speech.
senses.explanation_zomi: Numei khangno khat, adiakin informal kihoupihna ah a kisap ahi hi.

examples.english: The girls from college met for lunch.
examples.zomi: College a numei khangnote sun an ne dingin kimu uh hi.

examples.english: She was a young girl when she moved to the city.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah a kikhiat ciangin numei khangno ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling an adult woman a girl may sound informal, overly familiar, or disrespectful in some contexts. Use woman in formal or professional situations.
senses.usage_zomi: Numei upa khat girl ci in sap pen dinmun pawlkhat ah informal lua, naipih lua, ahih kei leh zahtaklohna bangin kithei thei hi. Formal leh nasep dinmun ah woman zat hoihzaw hi.

senses.heading: Female romantic partner
senses.definition_en: A woman or girl with whom someone has a romantic relationship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh itna lam kizopna nei numei ahih kei leh numeino ahi hi.

examples.english: He introduced his girlfriend to his family.
examples.zomi: Amah in a itnu a innkuanpihte tawh kimusak hi.

examples.english: She has been his girlfriend for two years.
examples.zomi: Amah kum nih sung ama itnu in omta hi.

senses.usage_en: Girlfriend usually means a female romantic partner. It does not necessarily mean that the couple is engaged or married.
senses.usage_zomi: Girlfriend in numei itpih gen zel hi. Kiteeng dingin kiciamsa ahih kei leh kiteeng khitsa cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Female friend
senses.definition_en: A female friend, especially when a woman is speaking informally about another woman.
senses.explanation_zomi: Numei lawm, adiakin numei khat in numei lawm dang khat informal takin a genna ahi hi.

examples.english: She went shopping with her girlfriends.
examples.zomi: Amah in a numei lawmte tawh van lei dingin pai hi.

examples.english: One of my girlfriends called me yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zanni in ka numei lawmte lakah khat in hong phone hi.

senses.usage_en: This friendship meaning can be ambiguous. Use female friend when it is important to make clear that the relationship is not romantic.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lawmtakna khiatna telkhial theih ahi hi. Itna lam kizopna hilo cih kician sak nuam leh female friend zat hoih hi.

senses.heading: Transfer something to someone
senses.definition_en: To hand, provide, or transfer something to another person without expecting to keep it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat midang khat tungah pia ahih kei leh a neih dingin khak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave me a book for my birthday.
examples.zomi: Amah in ka suahni ading laibu khat hong pia hi.

examples.english: Please give the key back when you finish.
examples.zomi: Na zat khit ciangin tawh hong piakik in.

senses.usage_en: Two common patterns are give someone something and give something to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizang ngeina nih pen give someone something leh give something to someone ahi hi.

senses.heading: Provide information, help, permission, or an opportunity
senses.definition_en: To provide something that is not a physical object, such as advice, help, permission, or an opportunity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thuhilhna, panpihna, phalna, hunhoih, ahih kei leh pumpi tawh len theih loh na khat pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor gave me useful advice.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in kei tungah thuhilhna phattuam hong pia hi.

examples.english: The manager gave us permission to leave early.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in manlang takin ciah ding phalna hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use pia as the Zomi verb “give”; use piak only where an adjectival or attributive construction requires it.
senses.usage_zomi: “Give” verb ading pia kizang hi. Adjectival ahih kei leh attributive construction ah kul ciangbekin piak kizang hi.

senses.heading: Perform or communicate something
senses.definition_en: To perform, present, communicate, or produce something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, lai, gamtatna, dawnna, ahih kei leh pulakna khat bawl ahih kei leh pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave a short speech at the ceremony.
examples.zomi: Amah in pawi ah thugen tomno khat nei hi.

examples.english: The student gave the correct answer.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang in dawnna dik pia hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses give in many fixed expressions where Zomi may naturally use a more specific verb.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah give pen kammal kizopna kipsa tampi sungah kizang hi. Zomi ah thu kizangna bangin verb kicianzaw zat kul thei hi.

senses.heading: Cause or produce an effect
senses.definition_en: To cause someone to experience a feeling, condition, or result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungsim omzia, pumpi dinmun, ahih kei leh ngahna khat nei sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The good news gave us hope.
examples.zomi: Thuthak hoih in lametna hong pia hi.

examples.english: This medicine may give you an upset stomach.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui in na gil sung om nuam lo sak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Context determines whether give means physically transfer something or cause an effect.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangna thu in give pen van pia cihna maw, ngahna khat piangsak cihna maw cih hong kician sak hi.

senses.definition_en: Pleased, happy, or thankful about a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat hangin lungdam, nuamsa, ahih kei leh lungkim cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am glad that you came.
examples.zomi: Na hong pai manin ka lungdam hi.

examples.english: We are glad to help your family.
examples.zomi: Na innkuan panpih theih ka lungdam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Common patterns are glad to do something, glad that, and glad about. Glad normally comes after a linking verb, not directly before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizang ngeina pen glad to do something, glad that, leh glad about ahi hi. Glad pen linking verb khitah om zel a, noun maiah kizang ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Hard transparent material
senses.definition_en: A hard, usually transparent material used for windows, bottles, screens, and many other products.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thlalang, thawl, screen leh van dang tampi bawlna a kizang, a khauh leh a tamzaw in a kimuhtheih van ahi hi.

examples.english: The window is made of glass.
examples.zomi: Thlalang kong pen glass tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Be careful of the broken glass.
examples.zomi: Thlalang a keh kidawm in.

senses.usage_en: Glass is normally uncountable when referring to the material.
senses.usage_zomi: A kibawlna van gen ciangin glass pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Drinking container
senses.definition_en: A small container, usually made of glass, used for drinking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawn ding thun leh dawnna ding a kizang, a tamzaw in thlalang tawh a kibawl hai ahi hi.

examples.english: Could I have a glass of water?
examples.zomi: Tui hai khat ka ngah thei diam?

examples.english: She placed the empty glass on the table.
examples.zomi: Amah in hai awng sabuai tungah koih hi.

senses.usage_en: A glass of water may refer to the container together with the water inside it.
senses.usage_zomi: A glass of water in dawnna hai leh a sunga tui tegel gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Pair of lenses worn on the face
senses.definition_en: Lenses in a frame worn to improve vision or protect the eyes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muhna hoihsak ahih kei leh mit dal dingin maitang ah a kibulh lens nei van ahi hi.

examples.english: He wears glasses for reading.
examples.zomi: Amah laisimna dingin mitkha bulh hi.

examples.english: I cannot find my glasses.
examples.zomi: Ka mitkha ka mu zo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning normally uses the plural glasses. Say a pair of glasses for one item.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah plural glasses kizang zel hi. Van khat genin a pair of glasses kici hi.

senses.heading: Relating to the whole world
senses.definition_en: Relating to, involving, or affecting the whole world.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung bup tawh kisai, leitung gam tampi huam, ahih kei leh leitung bup huzaap cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Climate change is a global problem.
examples.zomi: Khuahun kikhelna pen leitung bup buaina ahi hi.

examples.english: The company operates in the global market.
examples.zomi: Company in leitung bup vanzual ah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Global is broader than international: international involves two or more countries, while global suggests the world as a whole.
senses.usage_zomi: Global pen international sangin zaizaw hi. International in gam nih ahih kei leh tamzaw huam a, global in leitung bup huam cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Considering the whole of something
senses.definition_en: Considering or affecting an entire system, organization, or subject rather than one part.
senses.explanation_zomi: System, kipawlna, ahih kei leh thu khat a khen bek hilo a, a vekpi ngaihsun ahih kei leh huzaap cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The report provides a global view of the problem.
examples.zomi: Tua report in buaina a vekpi muhna pia hi.

examples.english: We need a global assessment of the system.
examples.zomi: System a vekpi sittelna ka kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This broader sense may refer to a whole system even when the topic is not worldwide.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in leitung bup hilo napi, system khat a vekpi gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A covering for the hand, usually with separate sections for the fingers, worn for warmth, protection, hygiene, or sport.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khut lumsak, dal, siangtho sak, ahih kei leh kimawhna ading a kibulh, a tamzaw in khutme khen ciat nei khut tuam ahi hi.

examples.english: Wear gloves when handling the chemicals.
examples.zomi: Chemical-te na lawng ciangin khutphaw bulh in.

examples.english: She put on warm gloves before going outside.
examples.zomi: Pualam a paima in khutphaw lum bulh hi.

senses.usage_en: A glove normally has separate finger sections. A mitten has one shared section for the four fingers.
senses.usage_zomi: Glove in khutme khen ciat nei zel hi. Mitten ahih leh khutme lite ading khen khat bek nei hi.

senses.heading: Move or travel to another place
senses.definition_en: To move, travel, or leave one place for another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat pan mun dang khat ah kalsuan, khualzin, ahih kei leh pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We go to work by bus.
examples.zomi: Nasepna ah bus tawh ka pai uh hi.

examples.english: She went home early.
examples.zomi: Amah inn ah ciah manlang hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is went and the past participle is gone. Do not use to before home: go home.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen went ahi a, past participle pen gone ahi hi. Home maiah to koih lo in go home ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Leave or depart
senses.definition_en: To leave a place or depart.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat pan pusuak ahih kei leh nusia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I have to go now.
examples.zomi: Tu in ka pai kul hi.

examples.english: The last bus has already gone.
examples.zomi: Bus nunung paita hi.

senses.usage_en: In conversation, I have to go commonly means “I must leave.”
senses.usage_zomi: Kihoupihna ah I have to go in “ka paikhiat kul hi” cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Attend or take part in an activity
senses.definition_en: To attend or take part in an activity, event, or regular place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, pawi, ahih kei leh mun khat ah pai leh kihel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They went shopping after lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun an khit ciangin van lei dingin pai uh hi.

examples.english: We go to church on Sunday.
examples.zomi: Sunday ni in biakinn ah ka pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use go + -ing for many leisure and outdoor activities: go fishing, go swimming, and go shopping.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungnopna leh pualam gamtatna tampi tawh go + -ing kizang hi: go fishing, go swimming, leh go shopping.

senses.heading: Become or change into a condition
senses.definition_en: To become or change into a particular state, often an undesirable one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun tuam khat, a tamzaw in deihhuai lo dinmun, hong suak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The milk has gone bad.
examples.zomi: Nawi siata hi.

examples.english: The room went silent when she entered.
examples.zomi: Amah hong lut ciangin khan sung gamdai hi.

senses.usage_en: Go + adjective often describes a change, especially one that is negative, sudden, or outside someone’s control.
senses.usage_zomi: Go + adjective in kikhelna gen zel a, adiakin a sia lam, thakhat, ahih kei leh mi ukzawhloh kikhelna gen hi.

senses.heading: Operate, fit, or belong in a place
senses.definition_en: To operate, be placed, fit, or belong in a particular location.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasem, mun khat ah kikoih ding, kituak, ahih kei leh tua mun ading ahi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Where does this file go?
examples.zomi: Hih file koi ah kikoih ding hiam?

examples.english: These two colors go well together.
examples.zomi: Hih color nihte kituak mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, go may describe correct placement, operation, or compatibility.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah go in mun dik, nasemna, ahih kei leh kituakna gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Continue or extend
senses.definition_en: To continue, extend, or reach to a particular point.
senses.explanation_zomi: Paisuak, kizai, ahih kei leh mun khat dong pha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting went on for three hours.
examples.zomi: Meeting nai thum sung paisuak hi.

examples.english: This road goes all the way to the border.
examples.zomi: Hih lampi gamgi dong pha hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether go means physical movement or continuation in time or distance.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangna thu in go pen kalsuanna maw, hun ahih kei leh gamla paisuakna maw cih hong kician sak hi.

senses.heading: Intended result or aim
senses.definition_en: Something that a person or organization is trying to achieve.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh kipawlna khat in tangtung dingin a hanciam ngahna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her goal is to become a doctor.
examples.zomi: Ama ngiimna pen siavuan suak ding ahi hi.

examples.english: The team achieved its sales goal.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl in van zuak ngiimna tangtung hi.

senses.usage_en: A goal is a desired result. A plan describes the actions intended to reach it.
senses.usage_zomi: Goal pen a deih ngahna ahi a, plan pen tua ngahna tangtun ding sepna-te ahi hi.

senses.heading: Scoring area in a sport
senses.definition_en: An area, net, or structure into which a ball must be sent to score in some sports.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawhna pawlkhat ah point ngahna dingin ball a kikhaklutna mun, len, ahih kei leh ngel ahi hi.

examples.english: She scored the winning goal.
examples.zomi: Amah in gualzawhna goal lut hi.

examples.english: The goalkeeper protected the goal.
examples.zomi: Goal kempa in goal dal hi.

senses.usage_en: Goal may mean the scoring structure or a successful score, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizangna bangin goal in ball lutna ngel ahih kei leh goal a lut ngahna gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A deity worshiped in a religion
senses.definition_en: A spiritual being believed to have supernatural power and worshiped in a religion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna khat ah mihing sangin thahatna tuam nei ci in a ki-um leh a kibia kha-mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The ancient people worshiped many gods.
examples.zomi: Tanglai mite pasian tampi bia uh hi.

examples.english: The statue represented a god of the sea.
examples.zomi: Tua milim in tuipi pasian khat limgen hi.

senses.usage_en: Lowercase god refers to a deity in general or one among multiple deities. In Standard Zomi, generic deities or idols use lowercase pasian where grammatically appropriate.
senses.usage_zomi: Lowercase god in pasian a diil ahih kei leh pasian tampi lakah khat gen hi. Standard Zomi ah pasian a diil leh milim biak pasian gen ciangin a kituakna munah lowercase pasian kizang hi.

senses.heading: God in monotheistic religions
senses.definition_en: The one supreme divine being worshiped in a monotheistic religion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pasian khatbek a um biaknate ah a sangpen leh na khempeuh a piangsak Pasian ahi hi.

examples.english: Christians believe in God.
examples.zomi: Khazih mite Pasian um uh hi.

examples.english: She prayed to God for strength.
examples.zomi: Amah in thahatna dingin Pasian tungah thungen hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to the proper name of the one God, capitalize God in English and Pasian in Zomi.
senses.usage_zomi: Pasian khatbek minpi in a zat ciangin English ah God, Zomi ah Pasian ci in lai-masa awlmawh tawh gelh ding hi.

senses.heading: Valuable yellow metal
senses.definition_en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewelry, money, electronics, and investment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kham van, sum, electronic leh sum koihna ah a kizang, a manpha leh a eng sik ahi hi.

examples.english: The ring is made of gold.
examples.zomi: Tua zung kham tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Some investors buy gold during uncertain times.
examples.zomi: Hun kician lo ciangin sum koihmi pawlkhat kham lei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Gold is normally uncountable when referring to the metal.
senses.usage_zomi: Sik kham a gen ciangin gold pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Gold color
senses.definition_en: A bright yellow color resembling the metal gold.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sik kham meel tawh a kibang color eng taang ahi hi.

examples.english: The cover has red and gold lettering.
examples.zomi: A tuam tungah lai san leh kham color om hi.

examples.english: The sky turned gold at sunset.
examples.zomi: Ni tum ciangin van kham color suak hi.

senses.usage_en: As a color, both gold and golden are used, but golden often sounds more descriptive.
senses.usage_zomi: Color in gold leh golden tegel kizang thei a, golden in a meel hilhcian zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A sport in which players use clubs to hit a small ball into a series of holes using as few strokes as possible.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawhte in ciang tawh ball neu khat lawn a, vei a tawm thei zahin kua tuamtuam sungah lutsak ding a kidemna ahi hi.

examples.english: They play golf every Saturday.
examples.zomi: Saturday simin golf kimaw uh hi.

examples.english: The hotel is beside a golf course.
examples.zomi: Hotel pen golf kimawhna gam geiah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Golf club can mean the stick used to hit the ball or an organization of golf players.
senses.usage_zomi: Golf club in ball lawnna ciang ahih kei leh golf kimawhte kipawlna cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: High quality or satisfactory
senses.definition_en: Of high quality, satisfactory, or producing the desired result.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoih, lungkimhuai, ahih kei leh a deih ngahna piangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This phone has a good camera.
examples.zomi: Hih phone in camera hoih nei hi.

examples.english: The project produced good results.
examples.zomi: Tua project in ngahna hoihte piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: The comparative is better and the superlative is best, not gooder and goodest.
senses.usage_zomi: Comparative form pen better ahi a, superlative pen best ahi hi. Gooder leh goodest kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Morally right or kind
senses.definition_en: Morally right, honest, kind, or helpful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tatkhiatna lamah a dik, thumaan, lungnem, ahih kei leh panpihhuai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a good and honest person.
examples.zomi: Amah mi hoih leh thumaan ahi hi.

examples.english: Parents should teach children good behavior.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pate in naupangte gamtatna hoih hilh ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, good evaluates character or behavior rather than quality alone.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah good in van hoihna bek hilo a, mi omzia leh gamtatna teh hi.

senses.heading: Suitable, useful, or beneficial
senses.definition_en: Suitable for a purpose or beneficial to a person’s health or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna khat ading kituak ahih kei leh mi khat cidamna leh dinmun ading phattuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Regular exercise is good for your health.
examples.zomi: Tawntung pumpi kimawhna na cidamna ading hoih hi.

examples.english: Morning is a good time to study.
examples.zomi: Zingkaal pen lai sinna ding hun hoih ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use good for to describe benefit or suitability and good at to describe skill.
senses.usage_zomi: Phattuamna leh kituakna genin good for kizang a, siamna genin good at kizang hi.

senses.heading: Skilled at something
senses.definition_en: Able to do a particular activity well.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih kei leh pilna lam khat siam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is good at solving problems.
examples.zomi: Amah buaina siansuah siam hi.

examples.english: He is good with computers.
examples.zomi: Amah computer zang siam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use good at + noun/-ing form: good at music; good at writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Good at + noun/-ing form ci in kizang hi: good at music; good at writing.

senses.heading: Healthy or well
senses.definition_en: Healthy, comfortable, or feeling well.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cidam, nuam, ahih kei leh pumpi hoih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I feel good after a full night’s sleep.
examples.zomi: Zan khat ihmu kicing khit ciangin ka nuam hi.

examples.english: Her grandfather is still in good health.
examples.zomi: Ama pu cidamna hoih ah omlai hi.

senses.usage_en: In formal grammar, feel good means feel happy or healthy. Feel well more specifically refers to health.
senses.usage_zomi: Formal grammar ah feel good in lungdam ahih kei leh cidam sa cihna ahi hi. Feel well in cidamna lam kicianzaw in gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Used when leaving someone or ending a conversation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nopsak in; dam takin om in
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat kiangpan pai, kikhen, ahih kei leh kihoupihna tawpsak ciangin a kigen khakna kammal ahi hi.

examples.english: We said goodbye at the airport.
examples.zomi: Vanleng ngakna munah khakna ka pau uh hi.

examples.english: Goodbye, and have a safe journey.
examples.zomi: Nopsak in, khualzinna bit nei in.

senses.usage_en: Goodbye is neutral. Bye is more informal, while farewell is more formal or emotional.
senses.usage_zomi: Goodbye pen neutral ahi hi. Bye pen informal zaw a, farewell pen formal ahih kei leh lungsim thuakna khauhzaw ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Physical products or items that are made, bought, sold, or transported.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibawl, a kilei, a kizual, ahih kei leh a kipuak vante ahi hi.

examples.english: The store sells household goods.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr in inn sunga zat vante zuak hi.

examples.english: The truck transports goods between the two cities.
examples.zomi: Truck in khuapi nih kikal ah vante puak hi.

senses.usage_en: Goods is always plural in this meaning. It does not normally have a singular form a good.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah goods pen plural in kizang tawntung hi. Singular a good ci in kizang ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Control and administer a country or organization
senses.definition_en: To control, lead, and administer a country, region, institution, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam, khuamun, sang, ahih kei leh kipawlna khat uk, makaih leh vaihawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The elected leaders govern the country.
examples.zomi: A kiteel makaite in gam uk uh hi.

examples.english: The organization is governed by a board.
examples.zomi: Tua kipawlna board khat in uk hi.

senses.usage_en: Govern describes exercising authority and managing public or organizational affairs.
senses.usage_zomi: Govern in ukna thuneihna zang a, gam ahih kei leh kipawlna vaihawm cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Control or determine how something works
senses.definition_en: To control, regulate, or determine the operation or behavior of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat koibangin nasem ahih kei leh gamta ding hiam cih uk, thukhun koih, ahih kei leh khensat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Strict rules govern the use of the equipment.
examples.zomi: Vanzat zatna pen thukhun khauhte in uk hi.

examples.english: Several laws govern financial institutions.
examples.zomi: Thukham tampi in sumlehpai kipawlnate uk hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense often has rules, laws, or principles as its subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah thukhun, dan, ahih kei leh thukhun bulpi pen subject in om zel hi.

senses.heading: System or group that governs a country
senses.definition_en: The system or group of people with authority to govern a country, state, or region.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam, state, ahih kei leh khuamun khat ukna thuneihna nei system leh makaite pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The government announced a new education policy.
examples.zomi: Ukna in pilna thukhun thak khat tangko hi.

examples.english: Local government maintains the roads.
examples.zomi: Khuami ukna in lampite kemcing hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, government usually takes a singular verb when viewed as one body.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah government pen pawl khat in kingaihsun ciangin singular verb tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Process or method of governing
senses.definition_en: The activity, system, or method by which a country or organization is governed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam ahih kei leh kipawlna khat a ki-ukna gamtatna, system, ahih kei leh ukdan ahi hi.

examples.english: The constitution defines the system of government.
examples.zomi: Gam thukhunpi in ukna system kipsak hi.

examples.english: Good government requires accountability.
examples.zomi: Ukna hoih in mawhpuakna nei kul hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning focuses on governing as a system or practice rather than on particular officials.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in ukna makaite khat cimawh sangin ukna system leh sepzia khauhsak hi.

senses.heading: Take or hold suddenly and firmly
senses.definition_en: To take or hold someone or something quickly and firmly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat thakhat in kip takin len ahih kei leh la cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She grabbed the child’s hand before he crossed the road.
examples.zomi: Naupang lampi a kantanma in a khut len hi.

examples.english: He grabbed his coat and ran outside.
examples.zomi: A puanlum la pah a, pualam ah tai hi.

senses.usage_en: Grab is informal and often suggests a quick or sudden action.
senses.usage_zomi: Grab pen informal ahi a, manlang leh thakhat a kibawl gamtatna gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Get something quickly, especially food or an opportunity
senses.definition_en: To get, eat, or use something quickly and informally.
senses.explanation_zomi: An, hunhoih, ahih kei leh na khat manlang leh informal takin la ahih kei leh zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Let’s grab some lunch before the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting ma in sun an manlang takin ne ni.

examples.english: She grabbed the opportunity to study abroad.
examples.zomi: Amah gamdang ah lai sintheihna hunhoih zang pah hi.

senses.usage_en: Grab a meal means eat quickly or casually; it does not mean physically seize the food.
senses.usage_zomi: Grab a meal in an pumpi tha tawh len cihna hilo a, manlang ahih kei leh informal takin ne cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Attract attention
senses.definition_en: To attract and hold someone’s attention or interest.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ngaihsakna ahih kei leh lunglutna kaihcip cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The headline grabbed my attention.
examples.zomi: Thuthak lutang in ka ngaihsakna kai hi.

examples.english: Bright colors help the advertisement grab attention.
examples.zomi: Color taangte in advertisement ngaihsakna kai ding panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense is common in advertising, media, and writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna pen advertisement, media leh laigelhna ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Mark showing the quality of schoolwork
senses.definition_en: A letter, number, or score showing the quality of a student’s work or performance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sangnaupang nasep ahih kei leh sittelna hoihna leh siamna lak nambar, lai, ahih kei leh score ahi hi.

examples.english: She received a good grade on the exam.
examples.zomi: Amah sittelna ah mark hoih ngah hi.

examples.english: Regular study helped him improve his grades.
examples.zomi: Tawntung lai sinna in a markte hoihzaw sak hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses grade. British English often uses mark for an individual piece of work.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah grade kizang ngei hi. British English ah nasep khat cimawh ngahna ading mark kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: School-year level
senses.definition_en: A level or year in school based mainly on a student’s age and progress.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sangnaupang kum leh sinna mainawtna tungah a kinga sang dinmun ahih kei leh class ahi hi.

examples.english: Her son is in fourth grade.
examples.zomi: Ama tapa grade lina ah om hi.

examples.english: I began learning English in third grade.
examples.zomi: Grade thumna ah English sin ka kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: American schools commonly use grade; British schools more often use year.
senses.usage_zomi: American sangte ah grade kizang ngei a, British sangte ah year kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: Level of quality, rank, or size
senses.definition_en: A level in a system that classifies quality, rank, condition, or size.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihna, dinmun, omzia, ahih kei leh lianzia tehna system sunga level khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The company uses high-grade steel.
examples.zomi: Company in sik hoihna sang zang hi.

examples.english: Employees are placed in different pay grades.
examples.zomi: Nasemte loh dinmun tuamtuam ah kikoih hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, grade places something within an ordered classification.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah grade in na khat tehna kizuihna sunga dinmun koih hi.

senses.heading: Slope of a road or land
senses.definition_en: The degree to which a road, railway, or area of land slopes upward or downward.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi, meileng lampi, ahih kei leh leitang khat a khemna leh a kahtona zah ahi hi.

examples.english: The truck slowed on the steep grade.
examples.zomi: Truck pen lampi khem mahmah ah khawl deuh hi.

examples.english: The railway climbs at a gentle grade.
examples.zomi: Meileng lampi pen khem lo takin kahto hi.

senses.usage_en: This technical use is especially common in American transportation and engineering.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih technology zatdan pen American lampi leh engineering thu ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.definition_en: Slowly and in small stages over a period, rather than suddenly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thakhat in hilo a, hun khat sung tawm tawm leh khen simin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her health gradually improved.
examples.zomi: Ama cidamna tawm tawm in hoihzaw hi.

examples.english: The town gradually developed into a city.
examples.zomi: Tua khua tawm tawm in khuapi suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Gradually contrasts with suddenly.
senses.usage_zomi: Gradually pen suddenly, thakhat in, cih tawh kilehbulh hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who has successfully completed a course of study at a school, college, or university.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sang, college, ahih kei leh university sinna khat a gualzo takin zosiang mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a recent university graduate.
examples.zomi: Amah tu nai a university zosiang mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The company hires many college graduates.
examples.zomi: Company in college zosiang mi tampi la hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun is pronounced /ˈɡrædʒuət/. The verb graduate is usually pronounced /ˈɡrædʒuˌeɪt/.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun awsuah pen /ˈɡrædʒuət/ ahi hi. Verb graduate pen a tamzaw in /ˈɡrædʒuˌeɪt/ ci in kisuah hi.

senses.heading: Seeds used as food
senses.definition_en: The small hard seeds of plants such as rice, wheat, corn, oats, and barley, used as food.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buh, buhgawh, tangham, oats leh barley bang anlakna a neektheih ci neu leh khau ahi hi.

examples.english: Rice is an important grain in many countries.
examples.zomi: Buh pen gam tampi ah anlakna thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The farm produces several kinds of grain.
examples.zomi: Tua lo in anlakna nam tuamtuam suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Grain may be uncountable for the crop generally and countable for one small seed or particle.
senses.usage_zomi: Anlakna a diil in gen ciangin grain pen simtheih loh noun hi thei a, ci neu khat gen ciangin simtheih hi.

senses.heading: Very small hard particle
senses.definition_en: A very small hard piece or particle of a substance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat a neu mahmah leh a khauh ci ahih kei leh vui khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: A grain of sand entered my eye.
examples.zomi: Sehnel ci khat ka mit sungah lut hi.

examples.english: Add a few grains of salt.
examples.zomi: Ci al ci tawmno behlap in.

senses.usage_en: This sense refers to one tiny particle, not necessarily food.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in an hilo napi, van khat a ci neu mahmah gen hi.

senses.heading: Natural pattern in wood or material
senses.definition_en: The natural lines or pattern visible in wood, stone, leather, or another material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sing, suang, savun, ahih kei leh van dang sunga a pianpih zui leh lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The table shows the natural grain of the wood.
examples.zomi: Tua sabuai ah sing a pianpih zui kilang hi.

examples.english: Cut the board along the grain.
examples.zomi: Tua singpek singzui bangin at in.

senses.usage_en: When working with wood, the grain direction affects how the material should be cut or finished.
senses.usage_zomi: Sing tawh nasep ciangin singzui in koibangin at leh bawl ding hiam cih huzaap hi.

senses.heading: Impressive, splendid, or important
senses.definition_en: Large, impressive, beautiful, or important in appearance or scale.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a lian leh thupi; a melhoih mahmah
senses.explanation_zomi: A lian, a melhoih, a lamdang, ahih kei leh a thupi mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They held a grand celebration for the anniversary.
examples.zomi: Kumcin lungdam kohna ading pawi lian khat nei uh hi.

examples.english: The hotel has a grand entrance.
examples.zomi: Tua hotel in lutna lian leh melhoih nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Grand is stronger and more expressive than simply large.
senses.usage_zomi: Grand in a lian bek hilo a, a melhoih, a thupi leh a lungluthuai cihna zong nei hi.

senses.heading: Involving a large and ambitious idea
senses.definition_en: Broad, ambitious, or intended to achieve something important.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zaipi, ngiimna sang nei, ahih kei leh thu thupi khat tangtung ding a kigeel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The project began with a grand plan.
examples.zomi: Tua project geelna lian khat tawh kipan hi.

examples.english: Not every grand idea is practical.
examples.zomi: Ngaihsutna lian khempeuh a takin zat theih hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: A grand plan may sound impressive but can also be difficult to achieve.
senses.usage_zomi: Grand plan pen lungluthuai mahmah in ging thei napi, tangtun haksa thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The father of a person’s mother or father.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nu ahih kei leh pa a pa ahi hi.

examples.english: My grandfather taught me how to farm.
examples.zomi: Ka pu in loubawl dan hong hilh hi.

examples.english: Her grandfather is eighty years old.
examples.zomi: Ama pu kum sawm giat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses grandfather for both the mother’s father and the father’s father. Add maternal or paternal when the distinction matters.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah nu a pa leh pa a pa tegel grandfather kici hi. Kikhenna thupi leh maternal grandfather ahih kei leh paternal grandfather ci in gen ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The mother of a person’s mother or father.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nu ahih kei leh pa a nu ahi hi.

examples.english: My grandmother taught me how to cook.
examples.zomi: Ka pi in an bawl dan hong hilh hi.

examples.english: Her grandmother lives with the family.
examples.zomi: Ama pi a innkuanpihte tawh teng hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses grandmother for both the mother’s mother and the father’s mother. Add maternal or paternal when the distinction matters.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah nu a nu leh pa a nu tegel grandmother kici hi. Kikhenna thupi leh maternal grandmother ahih kei leh paternal grandmother ci in gen ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The mother or father of one of a person’s parents.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pu ahih kei leh pi; pu leh pi
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nu ahih kei leh pa a nu leh a pa ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: pu ahih kei leh pi tawh teng

examples.english: Every grandparent has a story to share.
examples.zomi: Pu leh pi simin hawmsawn ding tangthu nei uh hi.

examples.english: The children visit their grandparents every weekend.
examples.zomi: Naupangte weekend simin amau pu leh pi veh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Grandparent is singular and does not specify gender. The plural grandparents often refers to both a grandfather and a grandmother.
senses.usage_zomi: Grandparent pen singular ahi a, pasal maw numei maw cih kician lo hi. Plural grandparents in pu leh pi tegel gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Officially give or allow something
senses.definition_en: To officially give, approve, or allow something that has been requested.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kingen sum, a dikna, phalna, ahih kei leh ngetna khat ukna tawh pia ahih kei leh pom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The court granted her request.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna in ama ngetna pom hi.

examples.english: The manager granted us permission to use the room.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in tua khan zat ding phalna hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Grant is more formal than give or allow and is common in legal, academic, and official contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Grant pen give leh allow sangin formal zaw a, thukham, sangpilna leh ukna thu ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Admit that something is true
senses.definition_en: To admit or accept that something is true, often before making a different point.
senses.zomi_equivalents: maan hi ci in pom; thukim
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat maan hi ci in pom napi, thu dang khat genbeh dingin thukim cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I grant that the plan is expensive, but it may still be necessary.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna manpha cih ka pom hi, ahih hang kisam veve thei hi.

examples.english: She granted that mistakes had been made.
examples.zomi: Khialhnate kibawl khin cih amah in pom hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is formal and often appears in arguments or careful discussion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen formal ahi a, kinialna ahih kei leh kician tak kihoupihna ah kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A common green plant with narrow leaves that covers lawns, fields, and much open land.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huan, lo, leh gam zaangte tuam a, a hing leh a lai nau singno nam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The children played on the grass.
examples.zomi: Naupangte lopa tungah kimaw uh hi.

examples.english: The farmer cut grass for the cattle.
examples.zomi: Lopa in bawngte an ding lopa at hi.

senses.usage_en: Grass is normally uncountable when referring to the plant covering an area. An individual piece may be called a blade of grass.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun khat a tuam lopa a diil in gen ciangin grass pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi. Lopa tang khat pen a blade of grass kici thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Feeling or showing thanks because someone has helped you or something good has happened.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat hong panpihna ahih kei leh thu hoih khat a piang manin lungdam ko cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am grateful for your help.
examples.zomi: Na hong panpihna hangin lungdam ka ko hi.

examples.english: We are deeply grateful to everyone who donated.
examples.zomi: Sum hong pia mi khempeuh tungah lungdam mahmah ka ko uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use grateful to someone and grateful for something.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi tungah lungdam kohna genin grateful to someone kizang a, a ngah na hangin lungdam kohna genin grateful for something kizang hi.

senses.heading: Very good or impressive
senses.definition_en: Very good, enjoyable, successful, or impressive.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoih mahmah, nuam mahmah, gualzo, ahih kei leh lungluthuai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You did a great job on the report.
examples.zomi: Tua report ah nasep hoih mahmah na sem hi.

examples.english: We had a great time at the festival.
examples.zomi: Pawi ah nuam mahmah ka sa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday English, great is a strong and enthusiastic form of good.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim English ah great pen good sangin lungdamna leh pahtawina khauhzaw tawh kizang hi.

senses.heading: Large in amount, degree, or importance
senses.definition_en: Very large in size, amount, degree, effect, or importance.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lian, a tam, a khauh, a huzaapna lian, ahih kei leh a thupi mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The decision is of great importance.
examples.zomi: Tua khentatna thupi mahmah hi.

examples.english: They traveled a great distance to attend the ceremony.
examples.zomi: Pawi ah pai dingin gamla tak khualzin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Before an abstract noun, great often means large in degree rather than physically big.
senses.usage_zomi: Abstract noun maiah great in pumpi lian cihna sangin a zah ahih kei leh a khauhzah lian cihna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Famous, powerful, or historically important
senses.definition_en: Famous, powerful, highly respected, or historically important.
senses.explanation_zomi: Minthang, thahat, zahtakhuai, ahih kei leh tangthu ah thupi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She became one of the country’s great leaders.
examples.zomi: Amah tua gam makaipa thupite lakah khat suak hi.

examples.english: The museum honors great artists from the past.
examples.zomi: Museum in tanglai khutkhat siam minthangte pahtawi hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense evaluates a person’s influence or historical importance, not simply personal goodness.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mi khat huzaapna ahih kei leh tangthu thupina teh a, ama omzia hoih cihna bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: Having the color of grass or leaves
senses.definition_en: Having the color commonly seen in healthy grass and leaves.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lopa leh singte a ngei color tawh a kibang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The trees are green in spring.
examples.zomi: Khuahun ciangin singte hing hi.

examples.english: She wore a green dress.
examples.zomi: Amah in puan hing silh hi.

senses.usage_en: Green can describe a wide range of shades between yellow and blue.
senses.usage_zomi: Green in eng leh a dum kikal color hing nam tuamtuam gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Connected with protecting the environment
senses.definition_en: Designed to protect the environment or reduce damage to nature.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kimkot dalna tawh kisai; kimkot a susia lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimkot dal, pianpih gam susia lo, ahih kei leh siatna kiam sak ding a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company is investing in green energy.
examples.zomi: Company in kimkot a susia lo energy sungah sum koih hi.

examples.english: The city introduced a green transportation plan.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in kimkot dalna mawtaw kalsuanna geelna khat kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: This environmental sense is common in business, politics, and technology.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kimkot khiatna pen sumdawnna, gamvai leh technology thu ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Inexperienced
senses.definition_en: Lacking experience or skill because someone is new to an activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih kei leh nasep khat ah a thak ahih manin theihsa leh siamna kicing nei lo cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: khangno leh nasep theihsa nei lo

examples.english: The new employee is talented but still green.
examples.zomi: Nasem thak pen siam napi, nasep theihsa kicing nei nailo hi.

examples.english: I was young and green when I started the job.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep ka kipat ciangin ka khangno a, nasep theihsa ka nei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is informal and may sound critical, so use it carefully.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen informal a, gensiatna bangin kithei thei ahih manin kidawm takin zat ding hi.

senses.definition_en: To welcome or acknowledge someone with words, a gesture, or an action when meeting them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat kimuh ciangin kammal, khut zamna, ahih kei leh gamtatna tawh nawl leh theihsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She greeted the guests at the door.
examples.zomi: Amah in mikhualte kongah nawl hi.

examples.english: The teacher greeted every student with a smile.
examples.zomi: Sia in sangnaupang sim nuihna tawh nawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Greet focuses on what someone says or does at the moment of meeting. Welcome may also express pleasure that the person has arrived.
senses.usage_zomi: Greet in kimuh laitaka kammal leh gamtatna tungah kinga hi. Welcome in mi khat hong tung manin lungdam cihna zong pulak hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a color between black and white.
senses.explanation_zomi: A vom leh a kang kikal color nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: His hair is turning grey.
examples.zomi: Ama sam vut semsem hi.

examples.english: Dark grey clouds covered the sky.
examples.zomi: Meii vut dumte in van tuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Grey is the usual British spelling. Gray is the usual American spelling; both have the same meaning and pronunciation.
senses.usage_zomi: Grey pen British English gelhdan ahi hi. Gray pen American English gelhdan ahi a, tegel khiatna leh awsuah kibang hi.

senses.heading: Surface of the earth
senses.definition_en: The solid surface of the earth, especially outdoors.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung pualam zan, adiakin pualam a mite kalsuanna ahi hi.

examples.english: The leaves fell to the ground.
examples.zomi: Singte leitung ah kia hi.

examples.english: The children sat on the ground.
examples.zomi: Naupangte leitang ah tu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Ground usually refers to the outdoor surface. Floor is the surface inside a building.
senses.usage_zomi: Ground in pualam leitang gen zel hi. Floor pen inn sunga kalsuanna zan ahi hi.

senses.heading: Soil or land
senses.definition_en: Soil or a particular area of land used for a purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei ahih kei leh ngiimna khat ading a kizang leitang mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The seed was planted in wet ground.
examples.zomi: Ci pen lei ciim ah kiphut hi.

examples.english: The field provides good training ground for the team.
examples.zomi: Tua kimawhna zaang in pawl ading sinna mun hoih pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Ground may mean soil itself or land designated for a particular use.
senses.usage_zomi: Ground in lei mah gen thei a, ngiimna tuam ading a khen leitang mun zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Reason or basis
senses.definition_en: A reason, basis, or justification for an action, belief, or decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, upna, ahih kei leh khentatna khat bawlna ding a hang leh a kingakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The court found no grounds for the claim.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna in tua genna ading hang kicing mu lo hi.

examples.english: He was dismissed on grounds of misconduct.
examples.zomi: Gamtat khialhna hangin nasep pan kihawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning commonly appears in the plural grounds, especially in legal and formal English.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen adiakin thukham leh formal English ah plural grounds in kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Area surrounding a building
senses.definition_en: The land and gardens surrounding a large building.
senses.zomi_equivalents: inn kimkot gam; huan leh leitang
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn lian khat kimkot leitang, huan leh pualam munte ahi hi.

examples.english: Smoking is not allowed on school grounds.
examples.zomi: Sang kimkot gamah zialmei zuk phal lo hi.

examples.english: We walked around the hotel grounds.
examples.zomi: Hotel kimkot gamah ka vak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is normally plural: the grounds.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan pen plural the grounds in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Number of people or things together
senses.definition_en: A number of people or things that are together, connected, or considered as one unit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na tampi a kikhawm, a kizom, ahih kei leh pawl khat in a kingaihsun ahi hi.

examples.english: A group of students entered the library.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang pawl khat laibu inn sungah lut hi.

examples.english: Divide the class into four groups.
examples.zomi: Class pen pawl li in khen in.

senses.usage_en: In American English, group normally takes a singular verb when regarded as one unit.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah group pen pawl khat in kingaihsun ciangin singular verb tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Organized association
senses.definition_en: An organized collection of people with a shared interest, purpose, identity, or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunglutna, ngiimna, omzia, ahih kei leh gamtatna kibang nei mite a kizem kipawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: The community group organized the event.
examples.zomi: Mipi kipawlna in tua pawi geel hi.

examples.english: She joined a support group for parents.
examples.zomi: Amah nu leh pate kipanpihna pawl sungah lut hi.

senses.usage_en: A group may be informal or formally organized, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Group pen kizek lo pawl zong hi thei a, formal tak a kiphuh kipawlna zong hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Become larger or develop naturally
senses.definition_en: To become larger, taller, older, stronger, or more developed over time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tawh a lian, a sang, a upa, a thahat, ahih kei leh a khang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Children grow quickly during their early years.
examples.zomi: Naupangte a naupan kumte uh sung manlang takin khang uh hi.

examples.english: The small business grew into a large company.
examples.zomi: Sumdawnna neu pen company lian khat suak hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is grew and the past participle is grown.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense pen grew ahi a, past participle pen grown ahi hi.

senses.heading: Cultivate plants or produce crops
senses.definition_en: To plant and care for plants so that they develop and produce food, flowers, or other material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung, huan-an, anlakna, ahih kei leh pak phut a, a khanna ding kem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The farmers grow rice and corn.
examples.zomi: Loute buh leh tangham kho uh hi.

examples.english: She grows flowers beside the house.
examples.zomi: Amah in inn geiah pak kho hi.

senses.usage_en: In this transitive sense, the person grows the plant; the plant itself also grows intransitively.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih transitive khiatna ah mi khat in singkung kho hi. Singkung amah zong object om lo in khang hi.

senses.heading: Begin to have a stronger quality or feeling
senses.definition_en: To gradually become or begin to feel a particular way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tawm tawm in hong suak; khang
senses.explanation_zomi: Tawm tawm in omzia tuam khat nei ahih kei leh lungsim khat nei suak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We grew tired as the journey continued.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna a paisuak ciangin ka gim semsem uh hi.

examples.english: Parents are growing concerned about safety.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pate bitna thu lunghihmawh semsem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Grow + adjective describes a gradual change, while become can describe either gradual or sudden change.
senses.usage_zomi: Grow + adjective in tawm tawm a kikhelna gen hi. Become in tawm tawm ahih kei leh thakhat a kikhelna tegel gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Increase in size, amount, or development
senses.definition_en: The process of becoming larger, greater, stronger, or more developed.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lian, a tam, a thahat, ahih kei leh a khang semsem cih nasepzia ahi hi.

examples.english: The city experienced rapid population growth.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah mihing zat manlang takin pung hi.

examples.english: Education supports economic growth.
examples.zomi: Pilna in sumlehpai khanna panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Growth is usually uncountable when describing the general process of increase.
senses.usage_zomi: Khanna nasepzia a diil in gen ciangin growth pen simtheih loh noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Physical development of a living thing
senses.definition_en: The natural development of a person, animal, or plant.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, ganhing, ahih kei leh singkung a pianpih in a khanna ahi hi.

examples.english: Good nutrition is important for a child’s growth.
examples.zomi: An-hoih neekna pen naupang khanna ading thupi hi.

examples.english: Sunlight encourages plant growth.
examples.zomi: Nisa in singkung khanna panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense focuses on biological development.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in nungta na-te pumpi leh pianpih khanna tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: Abnormal lump or mass
senses.definition_en: An unusual lump or mass of tissue growing in or on the body.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sa bawm; pumpi a khang na
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi sung ahih kei leh tungah a ngeiloh in a khang sa khen ahih kei leh bawm ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor examined a small growth on her skin.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ama vun tunga sa bawm neu khat sittel hi.

examples.english: The growth was removed for testing.
examples.zomi: Tua sa bawm sittelna dingin kilakhia hi.

senses.usage_en: A growth is not automatically cancer. Medical examination is needed to determine what it is.
senses.usage_zomi: Growth khat pen cancer hi pahpah lo hi. Bang ahi hiam cih theihna ding cidamna sittelna kisam hi.

senses.heading: Promise that something will happen or be true
senses.definition_en: To make a firm promise that something will happen, be true, or meet a stated standard.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat piang ding, maan ding, ahih kei leh a kigen dinmun tangtung ding hi ci in kamciam kip pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: No one can guarantee success.
examples.zomi: Kuamah in gualzawhna kipsak thei lo hi.

examples.english: The company guarantees the quality of its products.
examples.zomi: Company in ama vanbawlte hoihna kipsak hi.

senses.usage_en: A guarantee is stronger than an ordinary prediction because it expresses firm responsibility or assurance.
senses.usage_zomi: Guarantee pen mailam thu ngaihsutna mawk sangin khauhzaw a, mawhpuakna leh kipsakna pulak hi.

senses.heading: Make an outcome certain
senses.definition_en: To make sure that a result occurs or a condition exists.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngahna khat piang takpi ahih kei leh dinmun khat om takpi dingin bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The law guarantees equal rights.
examples.zomi: Thukham in kibang a dikna ngah ding kipsak hi.

examples.english: A reservation does not always guarantee a seat.
examples.zomi: Mun kholhna in tokna ngah takpi ding kipsak tawntung lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In negative statements, cannot guarantee means the result is possible but not certain.
senses.usage_zomi: Nialna thu ah cannot guarantee in ngahna piangthei napi, piang takpi ding kician lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Person who protects a place or people
senses.definition_en: A person whose job is to protect a place, person, or property.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, mi, ahih kei leh neihsa khat dal leh kem ding a nasep mi ahi hi.

examples.english: A security guard stood at the entrance.
examples.zomi: Lutna kongah bitna kempa khat ding hi.

examples.english: The guards checked every visitor’s identification.
examples.zomi: Kempate in mikhual sim a mimal theihsakna sittel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A guard protects people or property. A police officer has broader legal authority.
senses.usage_zomi: Guard in mi ahih kei leh neihsa kem hi. Police officer in thukham thuneihna zaizaw nei hi.

senses.heading: Protective device or covering
senses.definition_en: A device, covering, or barrier that protects someone or something from injury or damage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat liamna leh siatna pan dal ding van, tuam, ahih kei leh dalna ahi hi.

examples.english: Wear a mouth guard during the game.
examples.zomi: Kimawh laitakin kam dalna bulh in.

examples.english: Never remove the safety guard from the machine.
examples.zomi: Machine bitna dalna lakhia ngei kei in.

senses.usage_en: This sense refers to equipment rather than a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mi hilo a, bitna vanzat gen hi.

senses.heading: Give an answer without knowing for certain
senses.definition_en: To answer or form an opinion without having enough information to know for certain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu theihna kicing nei lo napi dawnna pia ahih kei leh tua bang hi ding ci in ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I do not know the answer, so I will guess.
examples.zomi: Dawnna ka thei lo ahih manin ka ngaihsun phawng ding hi.

examples.english: Can you guess her age?
examples.zomi: Ama kum bangzah hiam na ngaihsun thei diam?

senses.usage_en: A guess is not based on complete knowledge. It may be informed by some evidence, but it remains uncertain.
senses.usage_zomi: Guess pen theihna kicing tungah kinga lo hi. Teci tawmno nei thei napi, kician taktak lo lai hi.

senses.heading: Think or suppose informally
senses.definition_en: To think, suppose, or accept something with some uncertainty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kician tak lo napi tua bang hi ci in ngaihsun ahih kei leh pom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I guess we should leave now.
examples.zomi: Tu in ka paikhiat ding uh hihtuak hi.

examples.english: “Will she come?” “I guess so.”
examples.zomi: “Amah hong pai ding hiam?” “Hong pai dingin ka um hi.”

senses.usage_en: In conversation, I guess can soften an opinion or show uncertainty.
senses.usage_zomi: Kihoupihna ah I guess in ngaihsutna nemsak ahih kei leh kicianlohna pulak thei hi.

senses.heading: Person invited to a home or event
senses.definition_en: A person invited to visit someone’s home, attend an event, or take part in a program.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn veh, pawi ah pai, ahih kei leh program ah kihel dingin a kisap mi ahi hi.

examples.english: We welcomed the guests into our home.
examples.zomi: Mikhualte ka inn sungah lungdam takin ka nawl uh hi.

examples.english: She appeared as a guest on the program.
examples.zomi: Amah tua program ah mikhual tuam in kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: A guest is invited or welcomed. A visitor may arrive without a formal invitation.
senses.usage_zomi: Guest pen a kisap ahih kei leh a kinawl mi ahi hi. Visitor pen sapna kician om lo in zong hong pai thei hi.

senses.heading: Person staying at a hotel
senses.definition_en: A person paying to stay at a hotel or another place of accommodation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hotel ahih kei leh khualzin giahna munah sum pia in a om mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Hotel guests can use the swimming pool.
examples.zomi: Hotel mikhualte tui-lehna mun zangthei uh hi.

examples.english: The room is reserved for a guest.
examples.zomi: Tua khan mikhual khat ading kikhol hi.

senses.usage_en: Hotels use guest rather than customer for people staying there.
senses.usage_zomi: Hotel-te in a om mite genin customer sangin guest zang zaw uh hi.

senses.heading: Person who shows the way or explains a place
senses.definition_en: A person who leads others, shows them a route, or explains a place and its important features.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte makaih, lampi lak, ahih kei leh mun khat omzia hilhcian mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The guide showed us around the museum.
examples.zomi: Lampipa in museum sung hong lak hi.

examples.english: We hired a local guide for the mountain trip.
examples.zomi: Mual khualzinna ading khuami lampipa khat ka la uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A guide may lead people physically or provide expert information about a place or activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Guide in mite mun khat ah makaih thei a, tua mun ahih kei leh gamtatna tawh kisai theihna zong pia thei hi.

senses.heading: Book or document giving information and instructions
senses.definition_en: A book, document, or digital resource that gives practical information, directions, or advice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zatna thu, lampi, thuhilhna, ahih kei leh ngaihsut piakna a pia laibu, document, ahih kei leh digital thu ahi hi.

examples.english: Read the user guide before operating the machine.
examples.zomi: Machine na zatma in zatdan thuhilhna sim in.

examples.english: The travel guide lists affordable hotels.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna lampi lakna laibu in hotel man olte list bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A guide provides practical help, while a textbook usually teaches a subject systematically.
senses.usage_zomi: Guide in zatna ding panpihna pia a, textbook in sinlai khat kizek takin hilh zel hi.

senses.heading: Standard used to help make decisions
senses.definition_en: A principle, amount, or example used to help someone judge or decide something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tehna ahih kei leh khentatna bawlna ding a kizang thukhun, a zah, ahih kei leh etsakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Use these figures as a general guide.
examples.zomi: Hih nambarte lampi lakna a diil in zang in.

examples.english: The budget serves as a guide for spending.
examples.zomi: Budget in sum zatna ding lampi lakna sem hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a guide helps judgment but may not be a strict rule.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah guide in khentatna panpih napi, thukhun khauh hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Responsible for a crime or wrongdoing
senses.definition_en: Responsible for committing a crime, offense, or wrong action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhna, thukhun palsatna, ahih kei leh gamtat khialhna khat bawl takpi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The court found him guilty of theft.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna in amah gukna mawhnei in mu hi.

examples.english: She pleaded guilty to the offense.
examples.zomi: Amah in tua mawhna a bawl cih pom hi.

senses.usage_en: In law, a person is presumed innocent until proved guilty according to the legal process.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukham ah mi khat pen thukham sepzia tawh mawhnei hi ci in kipsak mateng mawhnei lo in kingaihsun hi.

senses.heading: Feeling ashamed because of wrongdoing
senses.definition_en: Feeling unhappy or ashamed because you believe you did something wrong.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mawh kithei; lungsim nuam lo; zum
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat khial takin ka bawl hi ci in lungsim nuam lo ahih kei leh zum cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I felt guilty about forgetting her birthday.
examples.zomi: Ama suahni ka mangngilh manin mawh ka kithei hi.

examples.english: He looked guilty when the teacher asked about the damage.
examples.zomi: Sia in siatna thu a dot ciangin amah mawhnei bangin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Someone may feel guilty even if no court or other authority has declared that person legally guilty.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhenna ahih kei leh ukna in mawhnei ci lo napi, mi khat ama lungsim in feel guilty thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A musical instrument with strings, a long neck, and a hollow or solid body, played mainly with the fingers or a pick.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khau awsuah nei, a ngawng sau leh pumpi awng ahih kei leh khauh nei a, khutme ahih kei leh pick tawh a kitum la van ahi hi.

examples.english: She is learning to play the guitar.
examples.zomi: Amah guitar tum sin hi.

examples.english: The musician played an electric guitar.
examples.zomi: La tum siam in electric guitar tum hi.

senses.usage_en: Say play the guitar, normally with the, when referring generally to the skill.
senses.usage_zomi: Guitar tum siamna a diil in gen ciangin play the guitar ci a, the kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A weapon that fires bullets or another projectile through a barrel.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngun sungtawnin bullet ahih kei leh kap ding dang a kikhak galhiam ahi hi.

examples.english: The police officer carried a gun.
examples.zomi: Policepa in meithal paipih hi.

examples.english: The law restricts who may own a gun.
examples.zomi: Thukham in kua in meithal neithei ding hiam cih ciangtan koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Gun is a general term. More specific types include pistol, rifle, and shotgun. Firearms require careful handling and compliance with applicable law.
senses.usage_zomi: Gun pen galhiam a diil genna ahi hi. Nam kicianzawte lakah pistol, rifle, leh shotgun om hi. Meithal kidawm takin len a, thukham zui kul hi.

senses.heading: Man
senses.definition_en: A man, especially in informal speech.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pasal khat, adiakin informal kihoupihna ah a kigen ahi hi.

examples.english: He seems like a friendly guy.
examples.zomi: Amah pa lawmgai khat bangin kilang hi.

examples.english: Who is the guy near the door?
examples.zomi: Kong geia tua pa kua ahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: Guy is informal. Use man or a specific title in formal or professional writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Guy pen informal ahi hi. Formal leh nasep laigelhna ah man ahih kei leh minluah kician khat zang in.

senses.heading: People of any gender, especially in the plural
senses.definition_en: People in general, especially when directly addressing a familiar group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizopna nai pawl khat, pasal leh numei a huam in informal takin a sapna ahi hi.

examples.english: Are you guys ready to leave?
examples.zomi: Note paikhiat dingin na kigingsa uh hiam?

examples.english: Thanks, guys, for helping me.
examples.zomi: Pawlte aw, nong panpihna uh lungdam ka ko hi.

senses.usage_en: Plural guys is widely used informally for mixed groups, but some people prefer gender-neutral alternatives such as everyone, folks, or team.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural guys pen informal takin pasal leh numei pawl ading kizang tam hi. Ahih hang mi pawlkhat in everyone, folks, ahih kei leh team bang gender-neutral kammal deihzaw uh hi.

senses.heading: Place for physical exercise
senses.definition_en: A building or room containing equipment for exercise, fitness, or physical training.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi kimawhna, cidamna leh thahatna sinna ding vanzatte nei inn ahih kei leh khan ahi hi.

examples.english: She goes to the gym three times a week.
examples.zomi: Amah kal khat in thumvei gym ah pai hi.

examples.english: The hotel has a small gym.
examples.zomi: Hotel in gym neu khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Gym is the common shortened form of gymnasium.
senses.usage_zomi: Gym pen gymnasium a tomlakna kizang ngei ahi hi.

senses.heading: Indoor room for sports at a school
senses.definition_en: A large indoor room used for sports and physical education, especially at a school.
senses.explanation_zomi: Adiakin sang ah pumpi kimawhna leh kimawhna ding a kizang inn sung khan zaipi ahi hi.

examples.english: The students played basketball in the gym.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte gym sungah basketball kimaw uh hi.

examples.english: The ceremony was held in the school gym.
examples.zomi: Tua pawi sang kimawhna khan ah kinei hi.

senses.usage_en: In American schools, gym may refer to both the room and physical-education class.
senses.usage_zomi: American sangte ah gym in kimawhna khan leh pumpi kimawhna class tegel gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Something that a person does regularly, often without consciously deciding to do it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in tawndan ngeina in a neih a, ngaihsut sese loin a sep zel ngeina.

examples.english: Reading every morning has become a habit for her.
examples.zomi: Zingsang simin laibu sim pen ama’ ngeina suak hi.

examples.english: He is trying to break the habit of going to bed late.
examples.zomi: Zan dah ciang ih ngeina nusia dingin amah a hanciam hi.

senses.usage_en: A habit is a repeated personal behavior. A custom is a traditional practice shared by a community or group.
senses.usage_zomi: Habit pen mimal in a sep zel tawndan ngeina ahi hi. Custom ahihleh, khuapi khat ahi a, pawlkhat ahi zongin ngeina tawh a zui uh tawndan ahi hi.

senses.heading: Hair on a person’s head
senses.definition_en: The strands that grow on a person’s head.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi’ lu tungah a po khaute.

examples.english: She has long black hair.
examples.zomi: Ama’n sam vom sau nei hi.

examples.english: I need to wash my hair tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zanin ka sam ka sil kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Hair is normally uncountable when referring collectively to the hair on someone’s head.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat’ lutung sam khempeuh a kawk ciangin hair pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: One strand
senses.definition_en: A single thin strand growing from the skin.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vun tung pan a po sam khau khat.

examples.english: I found a hair in my food.
examples.zomi: Ka an sungah sam khau khat ka mu hi.

examples.english: A few grey hairs appeared near his ears.
examples.zomi: Ama’ bil gei ah sam ngial tawmkhat po hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a hair or hairs when counting individual strands.
senses.usage_zomi: Sam khau khat ciat simna ah a hair leh hairs kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: One of two equal parts of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kikim in nih suah ciangin, tua a kim khat.

examples.english: She gave half of the bread to her brother.
examples.zomi: Ama’n anlum alang a sanggampa pia hi.

examples.english: Cut the apple in half.
examples.zomi: Apple gah pen alang-alang in sat in.

senses.usage_en: Half may be followed by of, especially before a pronoun: half of it. Before a noun, both half the time and half of the time are possible.
senses.usage_zomi: Half nungah of kizang thei a, pronoun ma ah zat ngeina ahi hi: half of it. Min ma ah half the time leh half of the time tegel kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: A large room
senses.definition_en: A large room used for meetings, performances, meals or public events.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhopna, pawi bawlna, an nekna ahih keileh mipi kizopna dingin a kizang inn sung pindan lian.

examples.english: The meeting will be held in the main hall.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna pen pindan lian sungah kibawl ding hi.

examples.english: Hundreds of people filled the concert hall.
examples.zomi: La sa kikhopna inn sungah mi za tampi kidim hi.

senses.usage_en: A hall may be a large public room or building, depending on the context.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizopna tawh kisai in hall in mipi zat pindan lian ahi a, inn khat zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: A passage inside a building
senses.definition_en: A passage inside a building that connects rooms.
senses.zomi_equivalents: inn sung lampi; pindan kizopna lampi
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn sungah pindan khat leh pindan dang a kizopna lampi.

examples.english: The bathroom is at the end of the hall.
examples.zomi: Tuisilna pindan pen inn sung lampi tawpna ah om hi.

examples.english: I heard footsteps in the hall.
examples.zomi: Inn sung lampi ah khekhap ging ka za hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, hall commonly means hallway when it refers to a passage inside a building.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah inn sung lampi a kawk ciangin hall pen hallway tawh khiatna kibang in kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: A body part
senses.definition_en: The part at the end of the arm, including the palm, fingers and thumb.
senses.explanation_zomi: Banza tawpna ah a om, khutpha, khutme leh khutpi a huam pumpi angsung.
