senses.usage_zomi: Go home leh come home bang paukam ah home ma in to kizang ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: A place where someone belongs
senses.definition_en: A place where someone feels that they belong, are safe or are emotionally connected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ama’ aa bang a kingaih, bitna leh lungsim kizopna a neihna mun.

common_phrases.zomi: mun khat na inn in bawl
inn pan gamla napi inn bang mun

examples.english: The community made us feel at home.
examples.zomi: Mipite’n amau lakah ka inn uh bangin hong nuamsak uh hi.

examples.english: For many years, this city was her home.
examples.zomi: Kum tampi sung hih khuapi pen ama’ inn leh tenna taktak ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: House usually means the physical building. Home emphasizes the place where someone lives and belongs.
senses.usage_zomi: House in inn bangpuak taktak kawk zaw a, home in mi khat’ tenna leh ama’ aa bang a kingaih mun kipsak zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Schoolwork that a student is expected to complete outside class.
senses.zomi_equivalents: inn ah sep sang nasep; homework
senses.explanation_zomi: Sangnaupang in class pualam ah ahih keileh innah a sep ding sang nasep.

common_phrases.zomi: inn ah sep ding sang nasep

examples.english: I finished my homework before dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak an nek ma in ka homework ka zo hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave us too much homework.
examples.zomi: Sia in homework tampi hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Homework is uncountable. Say some homework or a homework assignment, not a homework.
senses.usage_zomi: Homework pen simtheihlo min ahi hi. A homework ci loin some homework ahih keileh a homework assignment ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Truthful and not deceptive
senses.definition_en: Telling the truth and not cheating, stealing or deceiving people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu maan gen a, mi khem, guk ahih keileh zuauthu zang lo.

examples.english: Please be honest with me.
examples.zomi: Ka tungah thumaan takin hong gen in.

examples.english: Everyone trusted her because she was honest.
examples.zomi: Amah thumaan ahih manin mi khempeuh in muang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The initial h is silent, so English uses an honest person, not a honest person.
senses.usage_zomi: A kipatna h ging omlo ahih manin a honest person ci loin an honest person kici hi.

senses.heading: Sincere and direct
senses.definition_en: Expressing your real opinion or feelings sincerely.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na ngaihsutna leh lungsim omzia taktak khemna loin gen.

examples.english: She gave me her honest opinion.
examples.zomi: Ama’n a ngaihsutna thumaan hong gen hi.

examples.english: To be honest, I do not agree with the plan.
examples.zomi: Thumaan takin gen leng, tua geelna ka lungkim pihlo hi.

senses.usage_en: To be honest introduces a sincere statement, especially one that may be difficult or unexpected.
senses.usage_zomi: To be honest pen a maan taktak genna kipatna ah kizang a, a diakin za nuam kei zong a hi thei thu ma ah kizang hi.

senses.heading: Great respect
senses.definition_en: Great respect and admiration shown to a person because of their character or achievements.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ gamtatna hoih ahih keileh mawhpohna hangin zahtakna leh pahtawina lian a kipia.

examples.english: The ceremony was held in honour of the veterans.
examples.zomi: Galkap lui-te pahtawina dingin pawi kibawl hi.

examples.english: It is an honour to serve this community.
examples.zomi: Hih mipawl ading nasep pen pahtawihuai hi.

senses.usage_en: This is the British spelling. American English spells the word honor.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen British English gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah honor ci in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Good moral character and reputation
senses.definition_en: The quality of behaving according to strong moral principles and keeping a good reputation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna hoih thukhun zui a, min hoih kemkipna omzia.

examples.english: He was known as a man of honour.
examples.zomi: Amah mi thumaan leh pahtawihuai in kithei hi.

examples.english: She kept her promise as a matter of honour.
examples.zomi: A min hoih tawh kisai in ngai a, a kamciam len hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, honour concerns integrity and reputation, not merely public praise.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah honour in thumaan gamtatna leh min hoih kawk a, mipi phatna bek kawklo hi.

senses.definition_en: To want something to happen and believe that it may happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hong piang ding deih a, hong piang thei ding ci in lam-en.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat hong piang ding lam-en

examples.english: I hope you feel better soon.
examples.zomi: Na dam pah ding ka lam-en hi.

examples.english: They hope to finish the project this year.
examples.zomi: Amaute’n hih project tukum sungin zo dingin lam-en uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use hope for something considered possible. Wish often refers to something unreal, unlikely or different from the present situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hong piang thei ding na khat adingin hope kizang hi. Wish ahihleh piang theilo ding bang, piang ding haksa ahih keileh tuhun omzia tawh a kilamdang deihna genna ah kizang hi.

senses.heading: Extremely unpleasant or bad
senses.definition_en: Very unpleasant, bad or difficult to experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoihlo, a nuamlo ahih keileh thuak ding a haksa mahmah.

examples.english: We had horrible weather during the trip.
examples.zomi: Khualzin laitak in khuahun hoihlo mahmah ka tuak uh hi.

examples.english: The medicine tastes horrible.
examples.zomi: Damdawi pen limlo mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Horrible is a strong adjective. In casual English, it is often used for something very bad even when it is not frightening.
senses.usage_zomi: Horrible pen adjective khauh ahi hi. Nisim pau ah lauhuai sak vetlo napi a hoihlo mahmah na genna ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Causing horror or fear
senses.definition_en: Causing a strong feeling of fear, shock or disgust.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhna, lungmangna ahih keileh huatthu lian hong piangsak.

examples.english: The report described a horrible accident.
examples.zomi: Report in aksident lipkhaphuai khat gen hi.

examples.english: They heard a horrible scream outside.
examples.zomi: Amaute’n polam pan kikou ging lauhuai khat za uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Context determines whether horrible means simply “very bad” or genuinely frightening.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizopna in horrible pen “hoihlo mahmah” cihna maw, “lauhuai taktak” cihna maw khen hi.

senses.heading: Intense fear and shock
senses.definition_en: A very strong feeling of fear, shock or disgust.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhna, lungmangna ahih keileh huatthu nasa mahmah.

examples.english: She watched in horror as the fire spread.
examples.zomi: Mei a kizel laitak in ama’n lau leh lungmang takin en hi.

examples.english: To his horror, the child was missing.
examples.zomi: Ama’ lungmanna dingin naupang pen muhtheihlo in om hi.

senses.usage_en: Horror is stronger than ordinary fear and often includes shock or disgust.
senses.usage_zomi: Horror pen launa ngeina sangin khauhzaw a, lungmangna ahih keileh huatthu zong huam thei hi.

senses.heading: Entertainment intended to frighten
senses.definition_en: Stories, films or books designed to frighten people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi lausak dingin a kibawl tangthu, film leh laibu nam.

examples.english: I do not enjoy watching horror films.
examples.zomi: Launa film en ka nuamsalo hi.

examples.english: She writes horror stories for young adults.
examples.zomi: Ama’n khangnote adingin launa tangthu gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, horror names a genre and is normally used before another noun: horror film, horror story.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah horror in tangthu nam khat min a pia a, min dang ma ah kizang ngei hi: horror film, horror story.

senses.definition_en: A large animal with four legs that people ride or use for carrying loads and pulling vehicles.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe li nei a, mihing tuangna, van puakna leh mawtaw kaihna ding a kizang gan lian.

examples.english: She learned to ride a horse as a child.
examples.zomi: A naupan lai in sakol tuang ding sin hi.

examples.english: The horse pulled a heavy cart.
examples.zomi: Sakol in leng gik khat kai hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is horses. A young horse is called a foal.
senses.usage_zomi: A plural pen horses ahi hi. Sakolno pen English in foal kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A place where doctors and nurses examine and treat people who are ill or injured.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siavuan leh nurse-te’n cina leh liamte en a, a kepna leh a damsakna mun.

examples.english: The injured driver was taken to the hospital.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawlpa a liam pen zatui inn ah kipuak hi.

examples.english: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
examples.zomi: Ama’n tua khuapi zatui inn ah nurse in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly says in the hospital. British English may say in hospital when someone is receiving treatment.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah in the hospital kici ngei hi. British English ah cidamna ngah ding a ommi genna ah in hospital kici thei hi.

senses.heading: A person who receives guests
senses.definition_en: A person who invites and receives guests at a home, event or gathering.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn, pawi ahih keileh kikhopna ah lengte a sam a, a zintun mi.

examples.english: Our host welcomed us warmly.
examples.zomi: Hong zintunpa in lungdam takin hong sang hi.

examples.english: The host family prepared dinner for the visitors.
examples.zomi: Zintun innkuan in lengte adingin nitak an bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A male or female person may be called a host. Hostess exists, but gender-neutral host is now common.
senses.usage_zomi: Pasal leh numei tegel host kici thei hi. Hostess zong om napi, tuni in pasal-numei khenlo host kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: A presenter
senses.definition_en: A person who introduces guests and guides a television, radio or public program.
senses.explanation_zomi: Television, radio ahih keileh mipi program ah lengte pulaak a, program a makaih mi.

examples.english: The host introduced the first guest.
examples.zomi: Program makai in leng masapen pulaak hi.

examples.english: She is the host of a weekly radio program.
examples.zomi: Amah nipikal sim radio program khat’ makai ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The organization or country responsible for an event may also be called the host.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawi khat a bawl kipawlna ahih keileh gam zong host kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Having a high temperature
senses.definition_en: Having a high temperature or producing a strong feeling of heat.
senses.explanation_zomi: Satna sang nei a, lawng ciangin a sa.

examples.english: Be careful—the water is very hot.
examples.zomi: Kidawm in—tui pen sa mahmah hi.

examples.english: It was hot and humid yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zanni khuahun sa a, huih sung tui tampi hi.

senses.usage_en: Hot describes high temperature. Its opposite is cold.
senses.usage_zomi: Hot in satna sang gen hi. A langkhat pen cold ahi hi.

senses.heading: Spicy
senses.definition_en: Having a strong, burning taste caused by spices such as chili.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksi ahih keileh a kha mahmah paknamte hangin kam a kangsak an lim nei.

examples.english: This soup is too hot for me.
examples.zomi: Hih soup pen kei adingin haksih lua hi.

examples.english: Do you like hot food?
examples.zomi: An haksih na deih hiam?

senses.usage_en: Context distinguishes spicy hot from temperature hot. Food can be hot in either or both senses.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizopna in hot pen “sa” maw “haksih” maw khen hi. An khat a sa leh a haksih tegel hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Popular or attracting attention
senses.definition_en: Currently very popular, successful or strongly discussed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun in mi tampi’n a deih, a minthang ahih keileh a gen mahmah.

examples.english: Housing costs are a hot political topic.
examples.zomi: Inn neihna man pen gamvai thulu kikup mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: The company launched a hot new product.
examples.zomi: Company in van thak mi deih mahmah khat zuak kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use is common in informal speech, journalism and business.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna pen informal pau, news leh sum vai thu ah kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: A building where people pay to stay in rooms, usually for a short period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi in hun tomkhat sung pindan luah in om ding a man a piakna inn.

examples.english: We stayed at a small hotel near the airport.
examples.zomi: Vanleng tual gei hotel neu khat ah ka om uh hi.

examples.english: She booked a hotel room online.
examples.zomi: Ama’n online pan hotel pindan khol hi.

senses.usage_en: Use stay at a hotel, not normally stay in hotel, when referring to a particular hotel.
senses.usage_zomi: Hotel khat kician a gen ciangin stay in hotel ci loin stay at a hotel kici ngei hi.

senses.heading: A period of sixty minutes
senses.definition_en: A period of time equal to sixty minutes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Minute sawmguak tawh a kikim hun tehna.

examples.english: The journey takes about an hour.
examples.zomi: Khualzin hun nai khat bang sawt hi.

examples.english: I waited for two hours.
examples.zomi: Nai nih sung ka ngak hi.

senses.usage_en: The initial h is silent, so say an hour, not a hour.
senses.usage_zomi: A kipatna h ging omlo ahih manin a hour ci loin an hour kici hi.

senses.heading: A particular time
senses.definition_en: A particular time of day or a regular period for an activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni khat sung hun kician ahih keileh nasep khat ading a ciangtansa hun.

examples.english: The library is open during normal working hours.
examples.zomi: Laibu inn pen nasep hun ngeina sung kihong hi.

examples.english: Traffic is heavy during the morning rush hour.
examples.zomi: Zingsang mawtaw a tam pen hunin lampi ah mawtaw tam mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In plural expressions such as working hours, hours means scheduled periods of time rather than separate sixty-minute units.
senses.usage_zomi: Working hours bang plural paukam ah hours in minute sawmguak ciat bek kawklo a, ciangtansa nasep hun kawk hi.

senses.heading: A building used as a home
senses.definition_en: A building in which a person or family lives.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh innkuan khat a tenna inn bangpuak.

examples.english: They bought a house near the school.
examples.zomi: Amaute’n sang gei ah inn khat lei uh hi.

examples.english: The house has three bedrooms.
examples.zomi: Inn sungah ihmutna pindan thum om hi.

senses.usage_en: House emphasizes the physical building. Home emphasizes the place where someone lives and belongs.
senses.usage_zomi: House in inn bangpuak taktak kipsak a, home in mi khat’ tenna leh ama’ aa bang a kingaih mun kipsak hi.

senses.heading: An organization or institution
senses.definition_en: An organization, company or institution, especially one involved in publishing, business or government.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kipawlna, company ahih keileh kumpi ukna angsung khat.

examples.english: The book was released by a major publishing house.
examples.zomi: Laibu pen laibu bawl kipawlna lian khat in suahta hi.

examples.english: The bill passed the House of Representatives.
examples.zomi: Thukhun bawl ding lai pen Mipite Aiawh Inn in phal hi.

senses.usage_en: In institutional names, House may be capitalized as part of the official title.
senses.usage_zomi: Kipawlna min kician sungah House pen min angsung ahih manin lai lian tawh kigelh thei hi.

senses.definition_en: All the people who live together in one home and share its daily life.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn khat sungah tengkhawm a, nisim nuntakna a kikoppih mi khempeuh.

examples.english: Our household includes five people.
examples.zomi: Ka innkuan uh mi nga kihel hi.

examples.english: Food is the largest household expense.
examples.zomi: An man pen innkuan sumzatna lianpen ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A household includes everyone living together, whether or not they are related by blood or marriage.
senses.usage_zomi: Household sungah a tengkhawm mi khempeuh kihel a, sisan ahih keileh kitengna tawh kizom teitei kullo hi.

senses.definition_en: Houses, apartments and other places where people live, considered collectively.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing tenna inn, apartment leh tenna nam dangte a vekpi in ngaihna.

examples.english: The city needs more affordable housing.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in man piakzawh tenna inn tampizaw kisam hi.

examples.english: High housing costs affect many families.
examples.zomi: Inn neihna man sang in innkuan tampi sukha hi.

senses.usage_en: Housing is normally uncountable. Do not use a housing to mean one house.
senses.usage_zomi: Housing pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei hi. Inn khat genna dingin a housing kizanglo ding hi.

senses.heading: In what way
senses.definition_en: Used to ask about the way or method by which something happens or is done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bangci piang ahih keileh bangci sem cih dotna.

examples.english: How do you make this soup?
examples.zomi: Hih soup bangci bawl nahiam?

examples.english: She showed me how to use the machine.
examples.zomi: Ama’n machine zatdan hong lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In indirect statements, how to often means “the method for doing something”: I know how to cook.
senses.usage_zomi: Indirect statement sungah how to in na khat sepdan cihna nei zel hi: I know how to cook.

senses.heading: To what degree or amount
senses.definition_en: Used to ask about degree, amount, age, distance, frequency or measurement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, zat, kum, gamla, zahvei ahih keileh tehna bangzah cih dotna.

examples.english: How much does this cost?
examples.zomi: Hih bangzah man hiam?

examples.english: How far is the airport from here?
examples.zomi: Vanleng tual hiteng pan bangtan gamla hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use how many with countable nouns and how much with uncountable nouns.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtheih minte tawh how many kizang a, simtheihlo minte tawh how much kizang hi.

senses.heading: Used in exclamations
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize the degree of a quality or feeling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Omzia ahih keileh lungsim khat bangzah lian cih kipsakna.

examples.english: How beautiful the garden looks!
examples.zomi: Huan hoih lawmlawm!

examples.english: How quickly the children have grown!
examples.zomi: Naupangte khang man lawmlawm!

senses.usage_en: Exclamatory how is followed by an adjective or adverb, not directly by a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungmangna genna how nungah adjective ahih keileh adverb kizom a, min kizom pahlo hi.

senses.heading: Nevertheless
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or limits the previous statement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu masa tawh a kilehbulh ahih keileh a ciangtan thu dang khat pulakna.

common_phrases.zomi: ahihhang, ka zom paisuak uh hi

examples.english: The work was difficult. However, we finished it on time.
examples.zomi: Nasep haksa hi. Ahihhang, hun ciangtan sungin ka zo uh hi.

examples.english: She was tired; however, she continued working.
examples.zomi: Amah gim hi; himahleh, nasep zom paisuak hi.

senses.usage_en: When however joins two complete clauses, use a period or semicolon before it, not only a comma.
senses.usage_zomi: Complete clause nih however tawh a kizop ciangin, a ma ah full stop ahih keileh semicolon kizang ding a, comma bek kizanglo ding hi.

senses.heading: No matter how
senses.definition_en: To whatever degree or in whatever way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bangzah ahih zongin ahih keileh bangci hi zongin.

examples.english: However difficult the task is, we must continue.
examples.zomi: Nasep bangzah haksa zongin i zom paisuak kul hi.

examples.english: You may arrange the room however you like.
examples.zomi: Pindan pen na deih bangin bawl thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this construction, however does not mean “but”; it means “regardless of how.”
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gelhdan ah however in “ahihhang” cihna hilo a, “bangci hi zongin” cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Extremely large in size, amount, degree or importance.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lian, a tam ahih keileh a thupi mahmah.

examples.english: A huge crowd gathered outside the stadium.
examples.zomi: Stadium polam ah mipi tampi mahmah kikaikhawm hi.

examples.english: The new policy made a huge difference.
examples.zomi: Thukhun thak in kilamdanna lian mahmah piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Huge is stronger than large or big and is common in both literal and figurative descriptions.
senses.usage_zomi: Huge pen large leh big sangin khiatna khauhzaw a, pumpi lian leh tehpihna lian tegel genna ah kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to people rather than animals, machines or divine beings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gan, machine ahih keileh Pasian tawh kisai hilo in mihing tawh kisai.

examples.english: Clean water is essential for human life.
examples.zomi: Tui siangtho pen mihing nuntakna adingin kisam mahmah hi.

examples.english: The organization works to protect human rights.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in mihing’ thu-neihna dal dingin nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Human can also be a noun meaning a human being, but this entry focuses on its adjectival use.
senses.usage_zomi: Human pen “mihing khat” cihna min in zong kizang thei napi, hih entry in adjective zatna bek pulaak hi.

senses.definition_en: Funny or intended to make people laugh.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nuihsak a, nuaihna dingin a kibawl.

examples.english: He told a humorous story about his journey.
examples.zomi: Ama’n a khualzin thu tangthu nuihhuai khat gen hi.

examples.english: The article takes a humorous look at office life.
examples.zomi: Article in office nuntakna nuihhuai takin en hi.

senses.usage_en: Humorous means funny. Do not confuse it with humoral, a rare medical or historical term.
senses.usage_zomi: Humorous in nuihhuai cihna ahi hi. Siavuan leh tangthu lam kammal humoral tawh khialh loh ding hi.

senses.heading: The quality of being funny
senses.definition_en: The quality in speech, writing or situations that makes people laugh.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pau, laigelh ahih keileh omzia khat in mi a nuihsak theihna.

examples.english: Her sense of humour made the meeting enjoyable.
examples.zomi: Ama’ nuihhuai theihna in kikhopna nuamsak hi.

examples.english: The writer uses humour to discuss serious issues.
examples.zomi: Laigelhsia in thu thupi kikum dingin nuihhuaina zang hi.

senses.usage_en: This is the British spelling. American English spells the word humor.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen British English gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah humor ci in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: A person’s mood
senses.definition_en: A person’s temporary state of mind or mood.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ hun tomkhat sung lungsim omzia.

examples.english: He was in a good humour after hearing the news.
examples.zomi: Tua news thu a zak khit ciangin amah lungdam hi.

examples.english: Do not disturb her when she is in a bad humour.
examples.zomi: A lung nuamlo laitak in buai sak kei in.

senses.usage_en: The mood sense is more common in British English and may sound old-fashioned in some contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungsim omzia khiatna pen British English ah kizang tamzaw a, dinmun pawlkhat ah kammal lui bangin kizathei hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 100.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sawm sawmvei tawh a kikim simna; 100.

examples.english: The hall can hold one hundred people.
examples.zomi: Pindan in mi za khat la zo hi.

examples.english: Hundreds of families received help.
examples.zomi: Innkuan za tampi in huhna ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: After an exact number, hundred has no plural -s: two hundred. Use hundreds of for an indefinite large number.
senses.usage_zomi: Simna kician khat nungah hundred in plural -s nei lo hi: two hundred. Zat kicianlo tam mahmah genna ah hundreds of kizang hi.

senses.heading: Needing or wanting food
senses.definition_en: Feeling a need or strong desire to eat.
senses.explanation_zomi: An nek kisapna leh ne nuamna lungsim nei.

examples.english: I am hungry because I missed breakfast.
examples.zomi: Zingsang an ka nekloh manin ka gil kial hi.

examples.english: The children were hungry after playing outside.
examples.zomi: Polam ah a kimawl khit uh ciangin naupangte gil kial uh hi.

senses.usage_en: English says I am hungry, using be. Zomi naturally expresses this as “my stomach is hungry.”
senses.usage_zomi: English ah be zangin I am hungry kici hi. Zomi ah “ka gil kial hi” ci in a pianzia tawh kituak in kigen hi.

senses.heading: Strongly desiring something
senses.definition_en: Having a strong desire to achieve, receive or experience something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhpohna, pilna ahih keileh na khat ngah ding nakpi takin deih.

examples.english: The young athletes are hungry for success.
examples.zomi: Kimawl siam khangnote mawhpohna lunggulh mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: She is always hungry for new knowledge.
examples.zomi: Ama’n pilna thak a deih tawntung hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense often appears with for: hungry for knowledge, hungry for success.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna pen for tawh kizom zel hi: hungry for knowledge, hungry for success.

senses.heading: Chase and kill wild animals
senses.definition_en: To chase or search for wild animals in order to catch or kill them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamlak gan man ahih keileh thah dingin zong a, delh.

examples.english: The villagers hunted deer in the forest.
examples.zomi: Khuamite’n gamlak ah sakhi saa uh hi.

examples.english: It is illegal to hunt these animals.
examples.zomi: Hih gante saa ding thukhun in phallo hi.

senses.usage_en: Hunt may be transitive—hunt deer—or intransitive—go hunting.
senses.usage_zomi: Hunt in object tawh hunt deer ci in kizang thei a, object om loin go hunting ci in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Search carefully
senses.definition_en: To search carefully for someone or something that is difficult to find.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muh ding a haksa mi ahih keileh na khat limtak in zong.

examples.english: She is hunting for a new job.
examples.zomi: Ama’n nasep thak zong hi.

examples.english: The police hunted for clues near the building.
examples.zomi: Police-te’n inn gei ah teci lakna zong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When hunt means search, it is commonly followed by for before the thing sought.
senses.usage_zomi: Hunt in zonna khiatna a neih ciangin, a kizong na ma ah for kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Chasing wild animals
senses.definition_en: The activity of chasing or searching for wild animals in order to catch or kill them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamlak gan man ahih keileh thah dingin a zonna leh a delhna.

examples.english: Hunting is not allowed in this area.
examples.zomi: Hih munah saa phallo hi.

examples.english: They went hunting early in the morning.
examples.zomi: Amaute zingsang nai in saa dingin pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Hunting is normally uncountable when it names the activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Sepna min a hih ciangin hunting pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Searching for something
senses.definition_en: The activity of searching for something that is difficult to find.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muh ding a haksa na khat a zonna.

examples.english: Job hunting can take several months.
examples.zomi: Nasep zonna kha tampi sawt thei hi.

examples.english: We spent the weekend house hunting.
examples.zomi: Weekend sung inn zongin ka om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In compounds such as job hunting, the first word identifies what is being sought.
senses.usage_zomi: Job hunting bang compound ah kammal masa in bang kizong cih lak hi.

senses.definition_en: A violent tropical storm with extremely strong winds, especially in the Atlantic or eastern Pacific region.
senses.explanation_zomi: Atlantic ahih keileh Pacific nisuahna tuipi lamah a piang, huih hat mahmah tawh a nungta khualpi.

examples.english: The hurricane damaged thousands of homes.
examples.zomi: Hurricane in inn tul tampi susia hi.

examples.english: Residents were told to leave before the hurricane arrived.
examples.zomi: Hurricane hong tun ma in khuamite paikhiat dingin kihilh hi.

senses.usage_en: The same type of tropical storm may be called a hurricane, typhoon or cyclone, depending mainly on the region where it forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Khualpi nam kibang mah a pian tuipi gam bangin hurricane, typhoon ahih keileh cyclone kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A need or attempt to do something quickly because little time is available.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun a tawm manin na khat manlang takin sep kisapna ahih keileh sep zawhna hanciamna.

examples.english: I left my phone at home because I was in a hurry.
examples.zomi: Ka kipaih pah manin ka phone innah ka nusia hi.

examples.english: There is no hurry; take your time.
examples.zomi: Manlang kullo hi; dam takin sem in.

senses.usage_en: The common expression is in a hurry. Do not say on a hurry.
senses.usage_zomi: Paukam maan pen in a hurry ahi hi. On a hurry kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Cause physical pain or injury
senses.definition_en: To cause physical pain or injury to a person or part of the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh pumpi angsung khat nasak ahih keileh liamsak.

examples.english: She hurt her ankle while running.
examples.zomi: A tai laitak in ama’ khebul liam hi.

examples.english: The accident hurt several passengers.
examples.zomi: Aksident in khualzin mi tampi liamsak hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are also hurt: hurt–hurt–hurt.
senses.usage_zomi: Hurt’ past tense leh past participle tegel hurt mah ahi hi: hurt–hurt–hurt.

senses.heading: Feel physical pain
senses.definition_en: To feel pain in a part of the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi angsung khat na.

examples.english: My shoulder hurts when I lift my arm.
examples.zomi: Ka ban ka lamto ciangin ka liang na hi.

examples.english: Does your stomach still hurt?
examples.zomi: Na gil na lai hiam?

senses.usage_en: In English, the painful body part is often the subject: My knee hurts.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah a na pumpi angsung pen subject in kizang zel hi: My knee hurts.

senses.heading: Cause emotional pain
senses.definition_en: To make someone feel sad, offended or emotionally wounded.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungsim nasak, lungkiasak ahih keileh lungkham sak.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat’ kammal hangin lungsim na

examples.english: His careless words hurt her feelings.
examples.zomi: Ama’ kidawmlo kammalte’n ama’ lungsim nasak hi.

examples.english: I did not mean to hurt you.
examples.zomi: Na lungsim nasak ka tum hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Hurt someone’s feelings means causing emotional pain, not physical injury.
senses.usage_zomi: Hurt someone’s feelings in mi khat’ lungsim nasak cihna ahi a, pumpi liamsak cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A married man considered in relation to his wife or spouse.
senses.explanation_zomi: Numei khat tawh a kiteng pasal, a zi tawh a kizopna bangin kingai.

examples.english: Her husband works at the hospital.
examples.zomi: Ama’ pasal zatui inn ah nasem hi.

examples.english: The husband and wife started a business together.
examples.zomi: Pasal leh zi in business khat kipan khawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Traditionally, husband refers to a married man and wife to a married woman. Spouse is a gender-neutral term for either partner in a marriage.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina bangin husband in pasal kiteng khat kawk a, wife in numei kiteng khat kawk hi. Spouse pen kitengpih pasal maw numei maw khenlo in a kawk kammal ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Used by a speaker or writer to refer to himself or herself as the subject of a sentence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Paupa ahih keileh laigelhsia in amah leh amah sentence sung subject in a kizang pronoun.

examples.english: I live in Ohio with my family.
examples.zomi: Kei ka innkuante tawh Ohio ah ka teng hi.

examples.english: I think this is a good idea.
examples.zomi: Hih pen ngaihsutna hoih ahi hi ci in ka ngaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: The pronoun I is always written with a capital letter. Use me when the speaker is the object: She called me.
senses.usage_zomi: Pronoun I pen sentence sung mun khempeuh ah lai lian tawh kigelh hi. Paupa pen object a hih ciangin me kizang hi: She called me.

senses.definition_en: Water that has frozen and become solid.
senses.explanation_zomi: Votna hangin a khalta tui.

examples.english: The lake was covered with ice.
examples.zomi: Dil tung khempeuh gawlkhal in khuh hi.

examples.english: Please put some ice in my drink.
examples.zomi: Ka dawn ding sungah gawlkhal tawm hong koih in.

senses.usage_en: Ice is normally uncountable. Say some ice, a piece of ice or an ice cube, not usually an ice.
senses.usage_zomi: Ice pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei hi. An ice ci zaw loin some ice, a piece of ice ahih keileh an ice cube ci ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A sweet frozen food made mainly from milk or cream, sugar and flavoring.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nawi ahih keileh cream, khum leh limnam tuamtuam tawh a kibawl anlum vot.

examples.english: The children ate chocolate ice cream.
examples.zomi: Naupangte’n chocolate ice cream ne uh hi.

examples.english: Would you like a scoop of ice cream?
examples.zomi: Ice cream suah khat ne nuam ni?

senses.usage_en: Ice cream is usually uncountable when referring to the food generally. Use an ice cream informally for one serving, especially in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: An nam a kawk ciangin ice cream pen simtheihlo min ahi hi. British English informal zatna ah a zat khat genna dingin an ice cream kici thei hi.

senses.heading: A thought or suggestion
senses.definition_en: A thought, plan or suggestion about what to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bangci sep ding cih tawh kisai ngaihsutna, geelna ahih keileh thuhilhna.

examples.english: She had a good idea for the school event.
examples.zomi: Ama’n sang pawi adingin ngaihsutna hoih khat nei hi.

examples.english: I think your idea will work.
examples.zomi: Na ngaihsutna in nasem ding hi ci in ka ngaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: Have an idea means to think of something. Give someone an idea means to suggest or explain it.
senses.usage_zomi: Have an idea in ngaihsutna khat nei cihna ahi hi. Give someone an idea in mi khat tungah ngaihsutna khat pia ahih keileh hilhcian cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: An understanding or general knowledge
senses.definition_en: A general understanding or knowledge of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tawh kisai theihna ahih keileh telna a bupkimlo napi, a bulpi telna.

examples.english: I had no idea that the road was closed.
examples.zomi: Lampi kikhak cih ka thei hetlo hi.

examples.english: The diagram gives us a clear idea of how the system works.
examples.zomi: Diagram in system nasepzia telna kician hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: I have no idea is a common way to say “I do not know at all.”
senses.usage_zomi: I have no idea pen “ka thei hetlo hi” cihna genna ngeina ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Perfect or most suitable for a particular purpose or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna ahih keileh omzia kician khat adingin a hoihpen leh a kituakpen.

examples.english: This quiet room is ideal for studying.
examples.zomi: Hih pindan dai pen lai sinna adingin a kituakpen hi.

examples.english: The weather was ideal for a picnic.
examples.zomi: Khuahun pen polam an nekna adingin a hoihpen hi.

senses.usage_en: Ideal often describes the best possible choice, even when perfection cannot be fully achieved.
senses.usage_zomi: Ideal in a hoihpen leh a kituakpen teelna kawk ngei a, bupkim taktak hong piang zo keizong hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Recognize and name
senses.definition_en: To recognize someone or something and correctly say who or what they are.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat kuacih ahih keileh bang hiam cih theikha a, a min maan gen.

examples.english: The witness identified the driver.
examples.zomi: Tecipa in mawtaw hawlpa kuacih theikha hi.

examples.english: Doctors are trying to identify the cause of the illness.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te’n natna’ hang theikha dingin hanciam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Identify someone or something means recognize and name them, not merely notice that they exist.
senses.usage_zomi: Identify someone or something in om cih muh bek hilo a, kuacih ahih keileh bang hiam cih theikha a, kician sak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Find or establish
senses.definition_en: To discover, select or establish something important within a larger situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Omzia lianzaw sung pan na thupi khat zongkhia, teelkhia ahih keileh kician sak.

examples.english: The report identifies three major risks.
examples.zomi: Report in lauhuaina lian thum zongkhia hi.

examples.english: We must identify the communities that need help.
examples.zomi: Huhna a kisam mipawlte i kician sak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: In research and planning, identify often means finding and clearly defining something.
senses.usage_zomi: Zonna leh geelna ah identify in na khat zongkhia a, kician takin hilhcian cihna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Who a person is
senses.definition_en: The name and personal information that show who a person is.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat kuacih a kician sak min leh mimal thu khenkhat.

examples.english: You must prove your identity before opening an account.
examples.zomi: Account na hon ma in na mimal hina teci na lak kul hi.

examples.english: The witness asked the police to protect her identity.
examples.zomi: Tecinu in a kuacihna phualsak dingin police tungah ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: Identity is not the same as an identification card. A card is a document used to prove identity.
senses.usage_zomi: Identity leh mimal teci card kibanglo hi. Card pen mimal hina teci lakna ding lai ahi hi.

senses.heading: A person’s sense of who they are
senses.definition_en: The qualities, beliefs, culture and experiences that shape how a person or group understands itself.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh mipawl khat in amau kuate ahi uh hiam cih a kitelna a bawl gamtatna, upna, ngeina leh phutkhakna-te.

examples.english: Language is an important part of cultural identity.
examples.zomi: Pau pen ngeina tawh kisai hina’ angsung thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Living abroad changed his sense of identity.
examples.zomi: Gamdang ah a tenna in ama’ kuacihna kitelna khelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, identity may refer to an individual or to a community, culture or nation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah identity in mimal khat bek hilo in mipawl, ngeina ahih keileh minam khat’ hina zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Introducing a condition
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce a condition that must be true before something else can happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pian theihna dingin a masa in bang om kul cih a gen condition kipatna.

examples.english: If it rains, we will stay home.
examples.zomi: Guah zu leh innah i om ding hi.

examples.english: Call me if you need help.
examples.zomi: Huhna na kisap leh hong sam in.

senses.usage_en: For a real future possibility, English normally uses the present tense after if: If it rains, not if it will rain.
senses.usage_zomi: Mailam a piang thei condition khat genna ah if nungah present tense kizang ngei hi: If it rains kici a, if it will rain kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Introducing uncertainty or an indirect question
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce uncertainty about whether something is true or will happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat maan hiam, piang ding hiam cih lung kicianlohna ahih keileh dotna indirect kipatna.

examples.english: I do not know if the store is open.
examples.zomi: Dawr kihong hiam cih ka theilo hi.

examples.english: She asked if we needed help.
examples.zomi: Huhna ka kisam uh hiam ci in ama’n hong dong hi.

senses.usage_en: In many indirect yes-or-no questions, if and whether are both possible. Whether is often more formal.
senses.usage_zomi: Indirect yes-or-no dotna tampi ah if leh whether tegel kizang thei hi. Whether pen formal zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: To deliberately give no attention to someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat om cih thei napi, geelna tawh lunglutna pia lo.

examples.english: He ignored the doctor’s warning.
examples.zomi: Ama’n siavuan’ hilhkholhna ngaihsaklo hi.

examples.english: Do not ignore a serious problem.
examples.zomi: Buaina thupi khat awlmawh kei in.

senses.usage_en: Ignore usually involves choosing not to pay attention. Not notice means failing to become aware of something.
senses.usage_zomi: Ignore in thei napi geelna tawh ngaihsaklo cihna ahi hi. Not notice ahihleh om cih mahmah theikhalo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Sick
senses.definition_en: Not healthy; suffering from a disease or other medical condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cidamlo a, natna ahih keileh pumpi buaina khat nei.

examples.english: She became ill during the journey.
examples.zomi: Khualzin laitak in amah cina hi.

examples.english: His father is seriously ill in the hospital.
examples.zomi: Ama’ pa zatui inn ah cina mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, ill commonly follows a linking verb: She is ill. Before a noun, sick is often more natural: a sick child.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah ill pen linking verb nungah kizang tam hi: She is ill. Min ma ah a sick child cih bangin sick kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: Bad or harmful
senses.definition_en: Bad, harmful or unfavorable.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoihlo, a susia ahih keileh a phattuamlo.

examples.english: The policy had ill effects on poor families.
examples.zomi: Thukhun in innkuan zawngte tungah huzaap hoihlo nei hi.

examples.english: Years of ill health forced him to stop working.
examples.zomi: Kum tampi cidamna hoihlo in amah nasep khawlsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning mostly appears in fixed expressions such as ill effects, ill health and ill treatment.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen ill effects, ill health leh ill treatment bang paukam kipte sungah kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: Forbidden by law or against the law.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun in a phalloh ahih keileh thukhun tawh a kilehbulh.

examples.english: It is illegal to drive without a license.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawl phalna lai loin mawtaw hawl pen thukhun palsat ahi hi.

examples.english: The police investigated the illegal business.
examples.zomi: Police-te’n thukhun palsat business thu zong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Illegal describes something prohibited by law. It should describe an action or status, not be used as a noun labeling a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Illegal in thukhun in a phalloh gamtatna ahih keileh dinmun gen hi. Mihing khat min in zang loin, a gamtatna leh thukhun dinmun genna in zang ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A disease or a period in which a person is physically or mentally unwell.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi ahih keileh lungsim natna khat, ahih keileh mi khat cina in a om hun.

examples.english: He returned to work after a long illness.
examples.zomi: Hun sawtpi a cinat khit ciangin amah nasep ah ciahkik hi.

examples.english: The program supports people with mental illness.
examples.zomi: Program in lungsim natna a nei mite huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Illness may refer to a particular sickness or to the general condition of being unwell. Disease often refers more specifically to a medically recognized disorder.
senses.usage_zomi: Illness in natna khat ahih keileh cina in omna dinmun kawk thei hi. Disease ahihleh siavuan pilna in a theihkhiat natna kician khat kawk zaw hi.

senses.heading: Explain with an example
senses.definition_en: To make an idea or fact clear by giving an example, comparison or evidence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna ahih keileh thu maan khat tel baihna dingin entawnna, tehkakna ahih keileh teci tawh hilhcian.

examples.english: The teacher used a story to illustrate the lesson.
examples.zomi: Sia in sinna kician sak dingin tangthu khat zang hi.

examples.english: These figures illustrate the size of the problem.
examples.zomi: Hih simnate’n buaina bangzah lian cih kician sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, illustrate means explain clearly; it does not necessarily involve a picture.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah illustrate in kician takin hilhcian cihna ahi a, lim zang teitei kullo hi.

senses.heading: Add pictures to a book or text
senses.definition_en: To create or add pictures that explain or decorate a book, article or other text.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, article ahih keileh laigelh khat hilhcian leh zepsak dingin lim bawl a, behlap.

examples.english: She illustrated the children’s book herself.
examples.zomi: Ama’n naupang laibu pen amah mah in lim behlap hi.

examples.english: The guide is illustrated with color photographs.
examples.zomi: Lampi lakna laibu pen meel nei limte tawh kihilhcian hi.

senses.usage_en: A person who creates illustrations is an illustrator.
senses.usage_zomi: Hilhcian limte a bawl mi pen English in illustrator kici hi.

senses.heading: A picture
senses.definition_en: A picture, drawing or image used to explain or decorate a text.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laigelh khat hilhcian ahih keileh zepsak dingin a kizang lim, kigelh lim ahih keileh meel.

examples.english: The book contains several colorful illustrations.
examples.zomi: Laibu sungah meel nei hilhcian lim tampi om hi.

examples.english: This illustration shows the parts of the heart.
examples.zomi: Hih lim in lungsim’ angsungte lak hi.

senses.usage_en: An illustration may be a drawing, diagram, painting or other explanatory image.
senses.usage_zomi: Illustration pen kigelh lim, diagram, kisuut lim ahih keileh hilhcian meel nam tuamtuam hi thei hi.

senses.heading: An example
senses.definition_en: An example used to explain or prove an idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna khat hilhcian ahih keileh teci lak dingin a kizang entawnna.

examples.english: This case is a clear illustration of the problem.
examples.zomi: Hih thu pen buaina’ entawnna kician ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave an illustration from daily life.
examples.zomi: Sia in nisim nuntakna pan entawnna khat pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, an illustration may consist entirely of words and does not need to be a picture.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah illustration pen kammal tawh a kigen entawnna zong hi thei a, lim hi teitei kullo hi.

senses.heading: A picture or visual representation
senses.definition_en: A picture, photograph or visual representation of someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat a aiawh lim, photograph ahih keileh mitmuh meel.

examples.english: The camera produced a clear image.
examples.zomi: Camera in lim kician khat bawl hi.

examples.english: Click the image to make it larger.
examples.zomi: Lim lianzaw sak dingin lim tungah click in.

senses.usage_en: Image is broader than photograph. It may include drawings, computer graphics and reflected pictures.
senses.usage_zomi: Image in photograph sangin huamzaizaw hi. Kigelh lim, computer graphic leh limlang sung lim zong huam thei hi.

senses.heading: A public impression
senses.definition_en: The idea or impression that people have of a person, organization or product.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, kipawlna ahih keileh van khat’ omzia tawh kisai mipi ngaihsutna leh muhdan.

examples.english: The company is trying to improve its public image.
examples.zomi: Company in mipi’n amah a muhdan hoihzaw sak dingin hanciam hi.

examples.english: His actions damaged his image as an honest leader.
examples.zomi: Ama’ gamtatna in makai thumaan in a min muhdan susia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, image means reputation or public impression, not a physical picture.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah image in lim taktak kawklo a, minthanna ahih keileh mipi muhdan kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Existing only in the mind and not in reality.
senses.explanation_zomi: A taktak in omlo a, lungsim sung ngaihsutna bek ah a om.

common_phrases.zomi: ngaihsutna bek tawh a kisuai gual

examples.english: The child talked to an imaginary friend.
examples.zomi: Naupang in ama’ ngaihsutna sung lawm khat tawh kihou hi.

examples.english: The story takes place in an imaginary country.
examples.zomi: Tangthu pen a taktak omlo ngaihsutna sung gam khat ah piang hi.

senses.usage_en: Imaginary means unreal. Imaginative means creative and good at forming new ideas.
senses.usage_zomi: Imaginary in a taktak omlo cihna ahi hi. Imaginative ahihleh ngaihsutna thak leh pilna tawh na bawl siam cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The ability to form mental pictures and ideas
senses.definition_en: The ability to create pictures, situations or ideas in the mind.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim sungah lim, omzia ahih keileh ngaihsutna thak a bawltheihna.

examples.english: Children use their imagination when they play.
examples.zomi: Naupangte’n a kimawl ciangun amau ngaihsuttheihna zang uh hi.

examples.english: The novel captured the imagination of many readers.
examples.zomi: Novel in simtute tampi’ ngaihsutna kai hi.

senses.usage_en: Imagination is the mental ability. An idea is one particular thought produced by the mind.
senses.usage_zomi: Imagination pen lungsim tawh ngaihsutna bawltheihna ahi hi. Idea ahihleh tua lungsim pan a piang ngaihsutna khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Something imagined rather than real
senses.definition_en: An idea or experience created by the mind rather than by reality.
senses.explanation_zomi: A taktak piang hilo a, lungsim ngaihsutna pan a piang na.

examples.english: The noise was not real; it was only his imagination.
examples.zomi: Tua ging a taktak omlo a, ama’ ngaihsutna bek ahi hi.

examples.english: Was the figure real or a product of her imagination?
examples.zomi: Tua meel a taktak ahi hiam, ama’ ngaihsutna pan a piang ahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: It is only your imagination means that something seems real to you but does not actually exist.
senses.usage_zomi: It is only your imagination in nang adingin a taktak bang napi, a taktak in omlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Form a mental picture or idea
senses.definition_en: To form a picture, situation or idea in your mind.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim sungah lim, omzia ahih keileh ngaihsutna khat bawl.

common_phrases.zomi: mun khat ah na om bang ngaihsun

examples.english: Imagine living in a world without electricity.
examples.zomi: Meikhau omlo leitung ah na nungta ding ngaihsun in.

examples.english: I cannot imagine how she felt.
examples.zomi: Ama’ lungsim bangci om ding cih ka ngaihsun zo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Imagine may be followed by a noun, a clause or an -ing form: imagine a place, imagine that …, imagine living ….
senses.usage_zomi: Imagine nungah min, clause ahih keileh -ing form kizom thei hi: imagine a place, imagine that …, imagine living ….

senses.heading: Believe something without enough evidence
senses.definition_en: To suppose or think that something is probably true, sometimes without enough evidence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci kicinglo napi, na khat maan hi ding ci in ngaihsun.

common_phrases.zomi: tua bang hi dingin ka ngaihsun
mi khat heh hi dingin ngaihsun

examples.english: I imagine they have already arrived.
examples.zomi: Amaute hong tung khin dingin ka ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: Did you hear a sound, or did you imagine it?
examples.zomi: Ging khat na za hiam, na ngaihsut khialh bek hiam?

senses.usage_en: In this sense, I imagine expresses a belief or guess and is less certain than I know.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah I imagine in umna ahih keileh ngaihsutna gen a, I know zahin kicianlo hi.

senses.heading: Happening without delay
senses.definition_en: Happening or needed at once, without waiting.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngakna omlote in a piang ahih keileh a kisam pah.

examples.english: The patient needs immediate medical attention.
examples.zomi: Cinapa in siavuan’ kepna manlang kisam hi.

examples.english: The government called for immediate action.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in pahpah in nasem dingin ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: Immediate describes something that happens now or very soon, without avoidable delay.
senses.usage_zomi: Immediate in ngak hun pia loin tu mah ahih keileh tomno sungin a piang ding na gen hi.

senses.heading: Closest in relationship or position
senses.definition_en: Nearest in relationship, position or importance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizopna, mun ahih keileh thupitna ah a naipen.

examples.english: Only immediate family members may visit.
examples.zomi: Innkuanpih naipente bek hong veh thei ding uh hi.

examples.english: Police searched the immediate area.
examples.zomi: Police-te’n a kimnai pen mun zong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Immediate family usually means a person’s closest family members, but its exact legal meaning can vary.
senses.usage_zomi: Immediate family in innkuanpih naipente kawk ngei napi, thukhun bangin a huamzah kilamdang thei hi.

senses.heading: At once
senses.definition_en: At once, without delay.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngakna omlote in, pahpah.

examples.english: Call the police immediately.
examples.zomi: Police pahpah in sam in.

examples.english: She left immediately after the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna khitpah in amah paikhia hi.

senses.usage_en: Immediately is stronger than soon. It means without waiting.
senses.usage_zomi: Immediately pen soon sangin khauhzaw hi. Ngakna loin pahpah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Directly next to
senses.definition_en: Directly next to or very close to a place or time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih keileh hun khat tawh a kizom pah, a nai mahmah.

examples.english: The pharmacy is immediately beside the hospital.
examples.zomi: Damdawi dawr pen zatui inn geipah ah om hi.

examples.english: The announcement came immediately before the election.
examples.zomi: Teelna mapah in thu kiphong hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, immediately describes direct position or sequence rather than speed.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah immediately in manlangna genlo a, mun ahih keileh hun a kizom pahna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who moves to another country to live there, usually for a long period or permanently.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gamdang pan hong pemlut mi; pemlut mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamdang khat ah hun sawtpi ahih keileh a tawntung in teng dingin a lut mi.

examples.english: Her parents came to the United States as immigrants.
examples.zomi: Ama’ nu leh pa United States ah pemlut mi in hong pai uh hi.

examples.english: The organization helps immigrant families find housing.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in pemlut innkuante tenna inn zong ding huh hi.

senses.usage_en: An immigrant is described from the viewpoint of the country entered. An emigrant is described from the viewpoint of the country left. A refugee is someone forced to flee danger or persecution and has a distinct legal meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Immigrant pen a lutna gam’ muhna pan kici a, emigrant pen a nutsiat gam’ muhna pan kici hi. Refugee ahihleh lauhuaina ahih keileh bawlsiatna hangin gam a taisan mi ahi a, thukhun khiatna tuam nei hi.

senses.heading: A strong effect
senses.definition_en: A strong effect or influence that an event, action or situation has on someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang, gamtatna ahih keileh omzia khat in mi ahih keileh na dang tungah a neih huzaap khauh.

examples.english: The new law had a major impact on small businesses.
examples.zomi: Thukhun thak in business neute tungah huzaap lian nei hi.

examples.english: Social media can affect the mental health of young people.
examples.zomi: Social media in khangnote’ lungsim cidamna tungah huzaap nei thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use impact on: the impact on families. In formal writing, effect is sometimes preferred when no strong force is implied.
senses.usage_zomi: Impact nungah huzaap a thuak mi ahih keileh na ma in on kizang hi: the impact on families. Formal laigelh ah huzaap khauh kipsak nuamlo leh effect kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: A forceful collision
senses.definition_en: The force or moment when one object strikes another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat in van dang vangliat takin a suk hun ahih keileh tua sukna tha.

examples.english: The glass broke on impact.
examples.zomi: Limlang pen a kituah phetin kitam hi.

examples.english: The helmet reduced the force of the impact.
examples.zomi: Lukhu in kituahna tha kiam sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This physical meaning refers to collision; the figurative meaning refers to influence or effect.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi tawh kisai khiatna in kituahna kawk a, tehpihna khiatna in huzaap kawk hi.

senses.heading: Annoyed by waiting
senses.definition_en: Becoming annoyed because you must wait or because something is happening too slowly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngak kul ahih manin ahih keileh na khat a manloh manin lungnuamlo leh heh baih.

examples.english: The passengers became impatient after the long delay.
examples.zomi: Hun sawtpi a ngak khit ciangun khualzinte ngakzo lo ta uh hi.

examples.english: Do not be impatient with the children.
examples.zomi: Naupangte tungah ngakzo lo in om kei in.

senses.usage_en: Use impatient with a person and impatient about/at a delay or situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat tungah ngakzo lohna ah impatient with kizang a, ngakna ahih keileh omzia khat tawh kisai in impatient about/at kizang hi.

senses.heading: Eager for something to happen
senses.definition_en: Wanting something to happen very soon and finding it difficult to wait.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hong piang pah ding deih; ngakzolo
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hong piang pah ding deih mahmah a, ngak ding haksa sa.

common_phrases.zomi: news thu ngah pah ding deih

examples.english: The children were impatient to open their gifts.
examples.zomi: Naupangte’n amau letsongte hon pah ding deih mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: We are impatient for the results to be announced.
examples.zomi: Gahsuah kihilh pah ding ka deih mahmah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may express strong eagerness rather than anger.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in hehna gen teitei lo a, na khat hong piang pah ding deihna lian gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To communicate an idea indirectly without stating it clearly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna khat kician takin gen loin, a khiatna a kitheih theih dingin kawk.

examples.english: His question implied that he did not trust us.
examples.zomi: Ama’ dotna in kote hong muanglo cih kawk hi.

examples.english: I did not mean to imply that you were responsible.
examples.zomi: Nang mawpuak cih kawk ka tum hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: The speaker implies a meaning; the listener infers that meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Thugenpa in a khiatna imply a, thu-ngai-pa in tua khiatna infer hi.

senses.heading: A product brought into a country
senses.definition_en: A product brought into one country from another country for sale or use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zuak ahih keileh zat dingin gamdang pan gam sungah a kilut van.

examples.english: The country depends heavily on food imports.
examples.zomi: Tua gam in gamdang pan kilut an nakpi takin kinga hi.

examples.english: The government increased taxes on car imports.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in gamdang pan kilut mawtawte tungah sia khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun is stressed on the first syllable: IM-port. The verb import is usually stressed on the second syllable: im-PORT.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun zatna ah syllable masa IM-port tungah aw kisinei hi. Verb import ahihleh syllable nihna im-PORT tungah aw kisinei zel hi.

senses.heading: The act or process of bringing goods into a country
senses.definition_en: The act or business of bringing products into a country from abroad.
senses.zomi_equivalents: van lutna; gamdang pan van laklutna
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamdang pan vante gam sungah a lutna nasep ahih keileh sum vai.

examples.english: The government placed a ban on the import of certain goods.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in van pawlkhat gam sungah laklutna kham hi.

examples.english: New rules control the import of medical equipment.
examples.zomi: Thukhun thakte’n siavuan vanzat gam sung laklutna uk hi.

senses.usage_en: Import concerns goods entering a country. Export concerns goods leaving a country for sale elsewhere.
senses.usage_zomi: Import in gam sungah van hong lut cihna ahi hi. Export ahihleh gam pan van gamdang zuak dingin paikhiat cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The quality of being valuable, necessary or likely to have a strong effect.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat manpha, kisam ahih keileh huzaap lian a neihna omzia.

examples.english: The teacher explained the importance of regular reading.
examples.zomi: Sia in laibu sim zelna’ thupitna hilhcian hi.

examples.english: Public health is of great importance to every community.
examples.zomi: Mipi cidamna pen mipawl khempeuh adingin thupi mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: The common structure is the importance of something. Of great importance means “very important.”
senses.usage_zomi: Paukam ngeina pen the importance of something ahi hi. Of great importance in “thupi mahmah” cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Having great value, influence or effect and deserving special attention.
senses.explanation_zomi: Manpha, kisam ahih keileh huzaap lian nei a, limtak in ngaihsak kisam.

examples.english: Education plays an important role in national development.
examples.zomi: Pilna in gam khantohna ah dinmun thupi nei hi.

examples.english: It is important to read the instructions carefully.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna limtak in sim ding thupi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use important to someone when describing personal value and important for something when describing purpose or benefit.
senses.usage_zomi: Mimal ading bangzah manpha cih genna ah important to someone kizang a, ngiimna ahih keileh phattuamna genna ah important for something kizang hi.

senses.heading: Officially establish a rule, tax or punishment
senses.definition_en: To officially introduce and require a rule, tax, limit or punishment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, sia, ciangtan ahih keileh gimpiakna khat thuneihna tawh koih a, zuih ding sawl.

examples.english: The government imposed a new tax on imported goods.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in gamdang pan kilut vante tungah sia thak koih hi.

examples.english: The court imposed a heavy fine on the company.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi in company tungah sumgawh lian koih hi.

senses.usage_en: The structure is usually impose something on someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: Gelhdan ngeina pen impose something on someone or something ahi hi.

senses.heading: Force something unwanted on someone
senses.definition_en: To make someone accept a duty, burden, opinion or situation that they may not want.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a deihloh mawpuakna, vangik, ngaihsutna ahih keileh omzia sang dingin sawl.

common_phrases.zomi: na ngaihsutna midang tungah utlohpi in suang

examples.english: The new requirement imposes an extra burden on small businesses.
examples.zomi: Kisapna thak in business neute tungah vangik belap suang hi.

examples.english: Do not impose your beliefs on other people.
examples.zomi: Na upna midangte tungah utlohpi in sangsak kei in.

senses.usage_en: This sense usually has a negative meaning because the affected person has little choice.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen a thuak mi in teeltheihna tawmno bek a neih manin, a hoihlo khiatna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Unable to happen or be done
senses.definition_en: Not able to happen, exist or be done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piang, om ahih keileh sep zawh ding a hitheiloh.

examples.english: It is impossible to finish all this work today.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep khempeuh tuni in zo ding hitheilo hi.

examples.english: Without evidence, the claim is impossible to prove.
examples.zomi: Teci omlo leh tua thu teci lak ding hitheilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Impossible means that something cannot be done, not merely that it is very difficult.
senses.usage_zomi: Impossible in na khat sep zawh a hitheiloh cihna ahi a, a haksa mahmah bek cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Extremely difficult or unreasonable
senses.definition_en: So difficult, unreasonable or unpleasant that dealing with it seems nearly impossible.
senses.explanation_zomi: A haksa, a ngaihsut zawhloh ahih keileh a nuamlo lua ahih manin venzawhloh bang a hi.

examples.english: The manager gave us an impossible deadline.
examples.zomi: Manager in ka zuih zawhloh ding nasep zawh hun hong pia hi.

examples.english: He becomes impossible when he is angry.
examples.zomi: A heh ciangin amah hopih leh venzawh ding haksa lua hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal use may be an exaggeration meaning “extremely difficult,” not literally impossible.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih informal zatna pen “haksa mahmah” cih kipsakna hi thei a, a taktak in hitheilo cihna hi teitei lo hi.

senses.definition_en: To cause someone to admire, respect or remember you because of a good quality, skill or achievement.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lunglut sak; phatna ngah; lamdang sak
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihna, siamna ahih keileh mawhpohna hangin mi khat in hong phat, hong zahtak ahih keileh hong phawk paisuak sak.

examples.english: Her knowledge impressed the interview panel.
examples.zomi: Ama’ theihna in interview bawlte lunglut sak hi.

examples.english: He tried to impress his new manager.
examples.zomi: Ama’n a manager thak lunglut sak dingin hanciam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use impress someone with something: She impressed us with her skill.
senses.usage_zomi: Gelhdan ngeina pen impress someone with something ahi hi: She impressed us with her skill.

senses.definition_en: Feeling admiration or respect because someone or something is especially good.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat a hoih mahmah manin phatna, lunglutna leh zahtakna nei.

examples.english: I was impressed by the quality of her work.
examples.zomi: Ama’ nasep hoihna ka lunglut mahmah hi.

examples.english: The visitors were impressed with the new building.
examples.zomi: Lengte inn thak muh ciangin lamdang sa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use impressed by or impressed with. The active form is something impressed someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Impressed by leh impressed with tegel kizang thei hi. Active form pen something impressed someone ahi hi.

senses.heading: An opinion or feeling formed about someone or something
senses.definition_en: An idea or feeling you form about someone or something, often after limited experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat tawh tawlkhat a kimuh khit ciangin lungsim sungah a piang muhdan leh ngaihsutna.

examples.english: She made a good impression during the interview.
examples.zomi: Interview laitak in ama’n muhdan hoih piangsak hi.

examples.english: I got the impression that he was worried.
examples.zomi: Amah lungkham bangin ka mu hi.

senses.usage_en: A first impression may be strong, but it is not always accurate because it is based on limited experience.
senses.usage_zomi: Muh masakna pan ngaihsutna pen khauh thei napi, phutkhakna tawm bek tungah kinga ahih manin maan teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: An effect on the mind or emotions
senses.definition_en: A strong or lasting effect that someone or something has on a person’s mind.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat in lungsim tungah a suksiat theihloh huzaap leh phawkna a nutsiat.

examples.english: The speech left a lasting impression on the audience.
examples.zomi: Thugenna in thu-ngai-te’ lungsim ah phawk paisuakna nusia hi.

examples.english: The experience made a deep impression on her.
examples.zomi: Tua phutkhakna in ama’ lungsim nakpi takin sukha hi.

senses.usage_en: Be under the impression that … means to believe something, sometimes incorrectly.
senses.usage_zomi: Be under the impression that … in na khat maan hi ci in ngaihsun cihna ahi a, a hun ciangin ngaihsut khialhna zong hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Causing admiration because of exceptional size, quality, skill or achievement.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lian, a hoih, a siam ahih keileh a mawhpoh mahmah manin mi phatna leh lunglutna a ngah.

examples.english: The students made impressive progress.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte’n khantohna phathuai nei uh hi.

examples.english: The view from the mountain was impressive.
examples.zomi: Mualtung pan khuamuh pen lamdanghuai mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Impressive describes the person or thing causing admiration. Impressed describes the person feeling that admiration.
senses.usage_zomi: Impressive in phatna hong piangsak mi ahih keileh na gen hi. Impressed ahihleh tua phatna a nei mi’ lungsim omzia gen hi.

senses.heading: Make something better
senses.definition_en: To make something better in quality, condition or effectiveness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat’ hoihna, dinmun ahih keileh nasep theihna khangsak.

examples.english: The city plans to improve public transportation.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in mipi khualzinna hoihzaw sak dingin geel hi.

examples.english: Regular practice will improve your writing.
examples.zomi: Zingsak tawh kisai na kisinna in na laigelhtheihna hoihzaw sak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is transitive: someone improves something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna ah object kisam hi: mi khat in na khat hoihzaw sak hi.

senses.heading: Become better
senses.definition_en: To become better in quality, condition or health.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihzaw, cidamzaw ahih keileh dinmun sangzaw suak.

examples.english: Her health improved after the treatment.
examples.zomi: Cidamna ngah khit ciangin ama’ cidamna hoihzaw hi.

examples.english: The weather should improve tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zingciang khuahun hoihzaw ding hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is intransitive: the subject itself becomes better.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna ah object kisamlo a, subject amah mah hoihzaw suak hi.

senses.heading: The process of becoming better
senses.definition_en: The process or result of becoming better in quality, condition or performance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihna, dinmun ahih keileh nasep siamtheihna a khantohna leh a gahsuah.

examples.english: Her reading has shown great improvement.
examples.zomi: Ama’ laibu simna ah khantohna lian om hi.

examples.english: There is still room for improvement.
examples.zomi: Hoihzaw sak theihna om lai hi.

senses.usage_en: An improvement in something describes progress in an area. An improvement on something means a better version than the earlier one.
senses.usage_zomi: An improvement in something in lam khat a khantohna gen hi. An improvement on something in na lui sangin a hoihzaw cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A change that makes something better
senses.definition_en: A particular change or addition that makes something better.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hoihzaw sak dingin a kibawl kikhelna ahih keileh behlapna kician khat.

examples.english: The school made several improvements to the building.
examples.zomi: Sang in inn hoihzaw sakna tampi bawl hi.

examples.english: These improvements will reduce waiting times.
examples.zomi: Hih hoihzaw saknate’n ngak hun kiam sak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this countable sense, separate changes can be called improvements.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih simtheih khiatna ah kikhelna tuamtuamte improvements kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Inside a place or area
senses.definition_en: Inside or within a place, container or area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, van koihna ahih keileh gamgi khat sungah.

examples.english: The keys are in the bag.
examples.zomi: Tawhpite bawm sungah om hi.

examples.english: She lives in Columbus.
examples.zomi: Amah Columbus ah teng hi.

senses.usage_en: Use in for being inside an area. Use into for movement from outside to inside.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun sungah omna adingin in kizang hi. Polam pan sunglam ah a kiciingna adingin into kizang hi.

senses.heading: During a period of time
senses.definition_en: During a particular month, year, season or longer period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kha, kum, khuahun ahih keileh hun kician khat sungah.

examples.english: She was born in 2000.
examples.zomi: Amah kum 2000 in piang hi.

examples.english: The weather becomes cold in winter.
examples.zomi: Phalbi sungin khuahun vot hi.

senses.usage_en: Use in with months, years, seasons and long periods; on with days and dates; and at with exact clock times.
senses.usage_zomi: Kha, kum, khuahun leh hun sau tawh in kizang hi; ni leh date tawh on; nai kician tawh at kizang hi.

senses.heading: After a period of time
senses.definition_en: At the end of a stated period from now.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun pan hun kician khat bei khit ciangin.

examples.english: The meeting will begin in ten minutes.
examples.zomi: Minute sawm khit ciangin kikhopna kipan ding hi.

examples.english: I will return in two days.
examples.zomi: Ni nih khit ciangin ka hong ciah ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In two days usually means two days from now. For two days describes duration.
senses.usage_zomi: In two days in tuhun pan ni nih khit ciang cihna ahi hi. For two days ahihleh ni nih sung sawt cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: In a condition, situation or form
senses.definition_en: Experiencing or existing in a particular condition, situation, state or form.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, omzia, lim ahih keileh pumpi omdan kician khat sungah om.

examples.english: The family is in financial difficulty.
examples.zomi: Innkuan pen sum vai haksatna sungah om hi.

examples.english: Please give your answer in writing.
examples.zomi: Na dawnna lai tawh pia in.

senses.usage_en: Many expressions with in must be translated naturally according to the condition, not word for word.
senses.usage_zomi: In tawh a kibawl paukam tampi pen kammal khat ciat in leh loin, dinmun tawh kituak in kileh ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A unit of length equal to 2.54 centimeters or one-twelfth of a foot.
senses.explanation_zomi: Centimeter 2.54 ahih keileh foot khat’ sehkhen sawmlehnih sung khat tawh a kikim sau tehna.

examples.english: The shelf is twelve inches wide.
examples.zomi: Van koihna pen a zai inch sawmlehnih ahi hi.

examples.english: Move the chair a few inches to the left.
examples.zomi: Tutna pen veilam ah inch tawmkhat kisuansak in.

senses.usage_en: After an exact number, use the plural inches except in compound adjectives: six inches long but a six-inch ruler.
senses.usage_zomi: Simna kician nungah inches kici a, compound adjective sungah singular kizang hi: six inches long ahihhang a six-inch ruler.

senses.definition_en: An event, especially one that is unusual, unpleasant or potentially serious.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang khat, a diakin a ngeina hilo, a nuamlo ahih keileh a lauhuai thei thu.

examples.english: Police are investigating the incident.
examples.zomi: Police-te’n tua thu piang zong uh hi.

examples.english: No one was injured in the incident.
examples.zomi: Tua thu piang ah kuamah liamlo hi.

senses.usage_en: An incident may be minor or serious. An accident specifically refers to an unplanned event that causes or may cause harm.
senses.usage_zomi: Incident pen neu zong lian zong hi thei hi. Accident ahihleh geelkhollosa in piang a, liamna ahih keileh siatna a piangsak thei thu kawk hi.

senses.heading: Contain as part of a whole
senses.definition_en: To have someone or something as one part of a larger group, amount or whole.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat pawl, zat ahih keileh a bup khat’ angsung in nei.

examples.english: The price includes tax and delivery.
examples.zomi: Man sungah sia leh vanpuak man kihel hi.

examples.english: The course includes several practical exercises.
examples.zomi: Sinna sungah khut tawh sep sin na tampi kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: When the whole contains the listed parts, use include. The listed items do not necessarily form the entire whole.
senses.usage_zomi: Na bup khat in a kigen angsungte a huam ciangin include kizang hi. A kigen na-te in a bup khempeuh huam teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: Allow someone to take part
senses.definition_en: To make someone part of an activity, group or discussion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat gamtatna, pawl ahih keileh kihouna sungah kihel sak.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat kihouna ah kihel sak

examples.english: Please include Maria in the meeting.
examples.zomi: Maria zong kikhopna ah kihel sak in.

examples.english: The activity is designed to include every child.
examples.zomi: Gamtatna pen naupang khempeuh kihel theih dingin kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use include someone in something, not normally include someone to something.
senses.usage_zomi: Include someone in something kici ngei a, include someone to something kici lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Contained as part of a group, amount, price or package.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kihel; kibehlap khin; man sungah kihel
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, zat, man ahih keileh vanbawm khat sungah kihel khin.

examples.english: Breakfast is included in the room price.
examples.zomi: Pindan man sungah zingsang an kihel hi.

examples.english: All necessary materials are included.
examples.zomi: Kisap van khempeuh kihel khin hi.

senses.usage_en: Included often follows the noun in short notices: tax included. In a complete sentence, use be included in: Tax is included in the price.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu tom sungah included pen min nungah om zel hi: tax included. Sentence kicing ah be included in kizang hi: Tax is included in the price.

senses.definition_en: Used to introduce someone or something as one part of a larger group or total.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat pawl lianzaw ahih keileh zat bup khat sungah kihel cih pulakna.

examples.english: Ten people attended, including three children.
examples.zomi: Naupang thum zong kihel in mi sawm hong pai uh hi.

examples.english: The price is fifty dollars, including tax.
examples.zomi: Sia a huamin man dollar sawmnga ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The item after including is part of the larger group already mentioned. Use including, not included, before that item.
senses.usage_zomi: Including nungah a om na pen a kigen khol pawl lianzaw sungah kihel hi. Tua na ma ah included hilo in including kizang ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Money received regularly from work, business, investments or other sources.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, business, sum koihna ahih keileh mun dang pan hun ciangtan tawh a kilut sum.

examples.english: Her main income comes from her business.
examples.zomi: Ama’ sumlut bulpi pen a business pan hong pai hi.

examples.english: The program supports families with low incomes.
examples.zomi: Program in sumlut tawm innkuante huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Income is usually uncountable when discussing money generally. Incomes may be used when comparing the earnings of different people or groups.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumlut tangpi genna ah income pen simtheihlo min ahi hi. Mi leh pawl tuamtuamte’ sumlut tehkakna ah incomes kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Become greater
senses.definition_en: To become larger or greater in amount, number, level or degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, simna, dinmun ahih keileh huzaap ah a tamzaw leh a sangzaw suak.

examples.english: Food prices increased last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa an mante khang hi.

examples.english: The number of students is increasing.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang simna tam semsem hi.
