senses.usage_en: This use is intransitive: the subject itself becomes greater.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna ah object kisamlo a, subject amah mah khang hi.

senses.heading: Make something greater
senses.definition_en: To make an amount, number, level or degree larger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, simna, dinmun ahih keileh huzaap khangsak.

examples.english: The company increased workers’ pay.
examples.zomi: Company in nasemte’ thaman khangsak hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain increased the risk of flooding.
examples.zomi: Guah nasa in tui liim lauhuaina khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is transitive: someone or something increases another thing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna ah object kisam a, mi ahih keileh na khat in na dang khangsak hi.

senses.definition_en: More and more as time passes or as a situation develops.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun a bei semsem ahih keileh omzia a khangto semsem ciangin a tam semsem leh a sang semsem in.

examples.english: Online education is becoming increasingly common.
examples.zomi: Online pilna kizang tam semsem hi.

examples.english: Housing is increasingly difficult to afford.
examples.zomi: Inn man piakzawhna haksa semsem hi.

senses.usage_en: Increasingly normally comes before an adjective or adverb to show gradual growth in degree.
senses.usage_zomi: Increasingly pen adjective ahih keileh adverb ma ah om a, dinmun tawm tawm in a khantohna lak hi.

senses.heading: Extremely good, large or surprising
senses.definition_en: Extremely good, impressive or surprising.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoih, a lian ahih keileh a lamdang mahmah.

examples.english: She made incredible progress in one year.
examples.zomi: Kum khat sungin ama’n khantohna lamdanghuai nei hi.

examples.english: The view from the mountain was incredible.
examples.zomi: Mualtung pan khuamuh pen hoih mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday English, incredible often means “amazing,” even when the statement is completely believable.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim English ah incredible in “lamdanghuai mahmah” cihna nei tam a, tua thu umtheih ahi zongin kizang hi.

senses.heading: Difficult or impossible to believe
senses.definition_en: So unusual or unlikely that it is difficult to believe.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lamdang ahih keileh piang ding a hitheilo bang ahih manin um ding haksa.

examples.english: His story sounded incredible.
examples.zomi: Ama’ tangthu um ding haksa bang hi.

examples.english: It seems incredible that no one was injured.
examples.zomi: Kuamah a liamloh pen um ding haksa bang hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether incredible means “amazing” or “not believable.”
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizopna in incredible pen “lamdanghuai” maw, “umhuai lo” maw khen hi.

senses.heading: Extremely
senses.definition_en: To an extremely great degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: A dinmun sang mahmah in; mahmah.

examples.english: The exam was incredibly difficult.
examples.zomi: Sittelna haksa mahmah hi.

examples.english: The new computer is incredibly fast.
examples.zomi: Computer thak man mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, incredibly often functions as a strong intensifier similar to extremely.
senses.usage_zomi: Informal English ah incredibly pen extremely bangin adjective kipsakna adverb in kizang hi.

senses.heading: In an unbelievable or surprising way
senses.definition_en: In a way that is very difficult to believe or surprisingly remarkable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Um ding haksa ahih keileh lamdanghuai mahmah takin.

examples.english: Incredibly, everyone escaped safely.
examples.zomi: Lamdanghuai takin mi khempeuh bit takin suakta uh hi.

examples.english: The small team performed incredibly well.
examples.zomi: Pawl neu in lamdanghuai takin sem hoih hi.

senses.usage_en: At the beginning of a sentence, incredibly may comment on the surprising nature of the entire statement.
senses.usage_zomi: Sentence kipatna ah incredibly in thu bup a lamdanghuaina gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Emphasizing that something is true
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that a statement is certainly or actually true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a maan taktak ahihna kipsakna.

examples.english: The problem is serious indeed.
examples.zomi: Buaina pen thupi taktak hi.

examples.english: It was a very difficult decision indeed.
examples.zomi: Tua pen khensatna haksa taktak ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Indeed often follows an adjective or statement to add strong emphasis.
senses.usage_zomi: Indeed pen adjective ahih keileh thugen nungah om a, a khiatna nakpi takin kipsak hi.

senses.heading: Confirming or agreeing
senses.definition_en: Used to confirm, agree with or strengthen something that has just been said.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kigensa a maan cih kipsak ahih keileh lungkimna lakna.

common_phrases.zomi: maan hi, ka lungkim uh hi

examples.english: “Was the journey tiring?” “Yes, indeed.”
examples.zomi: “Khualzin gimhuai hiam?” “Ahi, gimhuai taktak hi.”

examples.english: The city is changing. Indeed, it has grown rapidly.
examples.zomi: Khuapi kikhel hi. A maan takin, manlang takin khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Indeed is somewhat formal. In everyday conversation, speakers may use really, certainly or yes instead.
senses.usage_zomi: Indeed pen formal tawm hi. Nisim kihouna ah really, certainly ahih keileh yes kizang zaw thei hi.

senses.heading: Free from another person’s control
senses.definition_en: Able to make decisions or act without being controlled or supported by another person or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh kipawlna dang’ ukna leh huhna tungah kinga loin khensat leh gamta thei.

examples.english: She became financially independent after starting her business.
examples.zomi: A business a kipat khit ciangin amah sum vai ah midang tungah kingalo suak hi.

examples.english: The program helps young adults live independently.
examples.zomi: Program in khangnote amau kizeek in nungta ding huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Independent of means not controlled, affected or supported by something: independent of government funding.
senses.usage_zomi: Independent of in na khat’ ukna, huzaap ahih keileh huhna tungah kingalo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Politically self-governing
senses.definition_en: Governing itself and not controlled by another country.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam dang in uklo a, ama’ gamvai amah in uk.

examples.english: The country became independent in 1948.
examples.zomi: Tua gam kum 1948 in gam suakta suak hi.

examples.english: An independent nation makes its own laws.
examples.zomi: Gam suakta khat in ama’ thukhun amah bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In political contexts, independent means having sovereignty rather than being governed by another state.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamvai thu ah independent in gam dang’ ukna nuaiah om loin, gam thuneihna nei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not connected with a larger organization
senses.definition_en: Not owned, controlled or managed by a larger organization.
senses.zomi_equivalents: amah kizeek; kipawlna dang tawh kizomlo
senses.explanation_zomi: Kipawlna lianzaw khat’ neih, uk ahih keileh kemna nuaiah omlo.

common_phrases.zomi: kipawlna dang in a ukloh newspaper

examples.english: They operate an independent bookstore.
examples.zomi: Amaute’n kipawlna lian dang in a ukloh laibu dawr kem uh hi.

examples.english: The government ordered an independent investigation.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in pawl dang huzaapna loin zonna bawl ding sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, independent emphasizes organizational or editorial freedom.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah independent in kipawlna dang’ ukna leh huzaapna pan suakta cihna kipsak hi.

senses.heading: Show or point to something
senses.definition_en: To show where something is or direct attention toward it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a omna lak ahih keileh tua na tungah lunglutna makaih.

examples.english: The arrow indicates the way to the exit.
examples.zomi: Thal in paikhiatna lampi kawk hi.

examples.english: Please indicate your answer on the form.
examples.zomi: Form tungah na dawnna ciamteh in.

senses.usage_en: Indicate is more formal than show or point to.
senses.usage_zomi: Indicate pen show leh point to sangin formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: Suggest or provide evidence
senses.definition_en: To suggest that something is true or provide evidence of a particular condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat maan hi ding cih kawk ahih keileh dinmun kician khat’ teci lak.

examples.english: The results indicate that the treatment is working.
examples.zomi: Gahsuahte’n cidamna piakna nasem hi cih kawk hi.

examples.english: A high temperature may indicate an infection.
examples.zomi: Pumpi satna sang in natna khai om thei cih kawk hi.

senses.usage_en: Indicate that introduces the conclusion suggested by evidence. It may be less certain than prove that.
senses.usage_zomi: Indicate that in teci pan a kilak ngaihsutna pulak hi. Prove that zahin a maan kician saklo thei hi.

senses.heading: Not stated or done directly
senses.definition_en: Communicated or achieved without being stated or done in a clear, direct way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngiatlo; lampi dang tawh; kammal kicianlo
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat kician leh ngiat takin gen ahih keileh sem loin, lampi dang zangin pulaak.

examples.english: She gave an indirect answer to the question.
examples.zomi: Ama’n dotna ngiat takin dawnglo hi.

examples.english: His comment was an indirect criticism of the policy.
examples.zomi: Ama’ paukam pen thukhun gensiatna ngiatlo ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: An indirect statement communicates a meaning without expressing it openly.
senses.usage_zomi: Indirect thugenna in a khiatna kician takin gen loin, thu-ngai-pa in a teltheih dingin kawk hi.

senses.heading: Not following the shortest or most direct route
senses.definition_en: Reaching a place, result or person through another route or stage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi a tompen leh a ngiatpen zui loin, lampi ahih keileh dinmun dang kantanin tung.

examples.english: We took an indirect route through the mountains.
examples.zomi: Mualte kankanin lampi ngiatlo ka zui uh hi.

examples.english: The plants need bright but indirect sunlight.
examples.zomi: Singte’n khuavak kicing kisam napi, ni khuavak ngiat kisamlo hi.

senses.usage_en: The opposite of indirect is direct.
senses.usage_zomi: Indirect’ langkhat pen direct ahi hi.

senses.heading: One person
senses.definition_en: One person considered separately from a group or society.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl ahih keileh mipite pan tuam in a kingai mi khat.

examples.english: Every individual has the right to be treated fairly.
examples.zomi: Mimal sim in kibang takin kibawl ding thu-neihna nei hi.

examples.english: The program can be adjusted to meet the needs of each individual.
examples.zomi: Program pen mimal sim’ kisapna tawh kituak in kikhel thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Individual is more formal than person and often emphasizes one member considered separately from a group.
senses.usage_zomi: Individual pen person sangin formal zaw a, pawl sung mi khat tuam a kingaih thu kipsak hi.

senses.heading: A separate living thing or item
senses.definition_en: One living thing or separate item within a larger class or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nam ahih keileh pawl lianzaw khat sungah nungta khat ahih keileh van khat tuam in a om.

examples.english: Each individual in the species has different markings.
examples.zomi: Hih gan nam sung khat ciat in ciamtehna kilamdang nei hi.

examples.english: The researcher examined every individual in the group.
examples.zomi: Thu-zongpa in pawl sung khat ciat en hi.

senses.usage_en: This scientific or formal sense may refer to a person, animal, plant or separate unit.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih science leh formal khiatna in mihing, gan, singkung ahih keileh unit khat ciat kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Existing, happening or used inside a building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn sungah a om, a piang ahih keileh a kizang.

examples.english: The school offers several indoor activities.
examples.zomi: Sang in inn sung gamtatna nam tampi nei hi.

examples.english: These shoes are designed for indoor use.
examples.zomi: Hih khedapte pen inn sungah zat dingin kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Indoor is an adjective used before a noun. Use the adverb indoors after a verb: indoor games, but play indoors.
senses.usage_zomi: Indoor pen min ma ah a kizang adjective ahi hi. Verb nungah adverb indoors kizang ding hi: indoor games, ahihhang play indoors.

senses.definition_en: In or into a building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn sungah ahih keileh inn sunglamah.

examples.english: The children stayed indoors because it was raining.
examples.zomi: Guah a zuk manin naupangte inn sungah om uh hi.

examples.english: Let us go indoors before it gets dark.
examples.zomi: Mial ma in inn sungah i lut ni.

senses.usage_en: Indoors is an adverb and is not normally used directly before a noun. Use indoor before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Indoors pen adverb ahi a, min ma ah kizang ngeilo hi. Min ma ah indoor zang in.

senses.definition_en: Relating to factories, manufacturing or large-scale production.
senses.zomi_equivalents: van bawlna tawh kisai; factory lam
senses.explanation_zomi: Factory, van bawlna ahih keileh van tampi bawlkhiatna tawh kisai.

examples.english: The town became an important industrial center.
examples.zomi: Tua khua pen van bawlna mun thupi khat suak hi.

examples.english: Industrial waste can damage the environment.
examples.zomi: Factory ninsia in kimlehpam susia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Industrial relates to industry. Industrious describes a person who works hard; the meanings are different.
senses.usage_zomi: Industrial in van bawlna tawh kisai hi. Industrious ahihleh a hahkat mi gen a, a khiatna kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: The production of goods and services
senses.definition_en: The economic activity of producing goods, materials or services.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, vanbawlna na leh nasepna-te bawlkhiatna sum vai gamtatna.

examples.english: Industry provides jobs for thousands of people.
examples.zomi: Van bawlna in mi tul tampi adingin nasep pia hi.

examples.english: The country is investing in modern industry.
examples.zomi: Gam in tuhun van bawlna ah sum koih hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to manufacturing and production generally, industry is usually uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Van bawlna leh van suahna tangpi a kawk ciangin industry pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: A particular kind of business
senses.definition_en: All the businesses involved in producing a particular product or providing a particular service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van nam khat bawl ahih keileh nasepna nam khat pia business khempeuh.

examples.english: She works in the banking industry.
examples.zomi: Ama’n bank business lamah nasem hi.

examples.english: The tourism industry employs many local people.
examples.zomi: Khualzin business in khuami tampi nasem sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this countable sense, different areas of business may be called industries.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih simtheih khiatna ah business lam tuamtuamte industries kici thei hi.

senses.definition_en: An illness or unhealthy condition caused by harmful bacteria, viruses, fungi or other microorganisms entering the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bacteria, virus, fungus ahih keileh natna khai neu dangte pumpi sungah a lut manin a piang natna.

examples.english: The wound developed an infection.
examples.zomi: Liampua ah natna khai hong piang hi.

examples.english: Washing your hands helps prevent infection.
examples.zomi: Khut silna in natna khai khaktan ding huh hi.

senses.usage_en: An infection is the invasion and growth of harmful microorganisms. Not every illness is an infection.
senses.usage_zomi: Infection pen natna khai neute pumpi sungah lut a, pung cihna ahi hi. Natna khempeuh natna khai hang hi lo hi.

senses.heading: The power to affect someone or something
senses.definition_en: The power to change or affect how someone thinks, behaves or develops.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ ngaihsutna, gamtatna ahih keileh khantohna a khelsak thei tha.

examples.english: Parents have a strong influence on their children.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pate’n amau tate tungah huzaap khauh nei uh hi.

examples.english: Social media has influenced the way people receive news.
examples.zomi: Social media in mite news a ngahdan khelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use influence on someone or something. Influence may be positive, negative or neutral.
senses.usage_zomi: Influence on someone or something cih gelhdan kizang hi. Influence pen hoih, hoihlo ahih keileh lamnih kibang in hi thei hi.

senses.heading: A person or thing that affects another
senses.definition_en: A person, experience or thing that strongly affects someone’s character, choices or work.
senses.zomi_equivalents: huzaap neipa; huzaap a pia na
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ gamtatna, teelna ahih keileh nasep tungah huzaap a nei mi, phutkhakna ahih keileh na.

examples.english: Her teacher was a positive influence on her life.
examples.zomi: Ama’ sia in ama’ nuntakna tungah huzaap hoih nei hi.

examples.english: Jazz was a major influence on his music.
examples.zomi: Jazz la in ama’ la tungah huzaap lian nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling someone an influence means that person helps shape another person’s behavior, ideas or work.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat an influence cihna in tua mi in midang khat’ gamtatna, ngaihsutna ahih keileh nasep a bawl pih cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To officially or clearly give someone information about something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tungah thu khat official ahih keileh kician takin theisak.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat thu thei paisuak sak

examples.english: Please inform us of any changes.
examples.zomi: Kikhelna khatpeuh om leh kote hong theisak in.

examples.english: The school informed parents about the new policy.
examples.zomi: Sang in thukhun thak thu nulehpate theisak hi.

senses.usage_en: Common patterns are inform someone of/about something and inform someone that …. Do not normally say inform to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Gelhdan ngeina pen inform someone of/about something leh inform someone that … ahi hi. Inform to someone kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Relaxed and not official
senses.definition_en: Relaxed, friendly and not governed by strict official rules or ceremony.
senses.explanation_zomi: Official leh ngeina khauh zui teitei loin, nuam leh lawmta takin a kibawl.

examples.english: We had an informal meeting over lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun an nek kawm in kikhopna official hilo ka nei uh hi.

examples.english: The office allows informal clothing on Fridays.
examples.zomi: Office in Friday ni in puansilh nisim silh phal hi.

senses.usage_en: Informal does not necessarily mean careless or impolite; it means less formal or official.
senses.usage_zomi: Informal in kidawmlo ahih keileh zahmawhlo cihna hi teitei lo a, formal leh official zawhloh cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Used in casual language
senses.definition_en: Used mainly in ordinary conversation rather than formal speech or writing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Formal pau leh laigelh sangin nisim kihouna ah a kizang kammal ahih keileh pauzia.

examples.english: “Hi” is more informal than “hello.”
examples.zomi: “Hi” pen “hello” sangin informal zaw hi.

examples.english: Avoid informal language in the official report.
examples.zomi: Official report sungah nisim pauzia zang kei in.

senses.usage_en: Learners should understand informal language but use it carefully in academic, professional and official settings.
senses.usage_zomi: Sintute’n informal pau tel ding hoih napi, sang pilna, nasep leh official dinmunah kidawm takin zang ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Facts, details or knowledge communicated or learned about someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat tawh kisai thu maan, thu kician leh theihna a kipia ahih keileh a kisin.

examples.english: The website provides information about the program.
examples.zomi: Website in program tawh kisai thu pia hi.

examples.english: Do not share your personal information with strangers.
examples.zomi: Na mimal thu na theihloh mite tungah pia kei in.

senses.usage_en: Information is uncountable. Say some information, a piece of information or several facts, not an information or informations.
senses.usage_zomi: Information pen simtheihlo min ahi hi. An information ahih keileh informations ci loin some information, a piece of information ahih keileh several facts ci ding hi.

senses.heading: A food item used in a recipe
senses.definition_en: One of the foods or substances combined to make a particular dish.
senses.explanation_zomi: An nam khat bawl dingin a kihal khawm an ahih keileh van khat.

examples.english: Flour is the main ingredient in this bread.
examples.zomi: Hih anlum sungah tangbeu pen an bawlna bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: Mix all the ingredients in a large bowl.
examples.zomi: An bawlna khempeuh hai lian khat sungah hal khawm in.

senses.usage_en: An ingredient is one component of a prepared food. The completed dish is not an ingredient.
senses.usage_zomi: Ingredient pen an khat bawlna ding angsung khat ahi hi. A kibawl khin an pen ingredient hilo hi.

senses.heading: An element needed for a result
senses.definition_en: One of the qualities or elements needed to produce a particular result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gahsuah kician khat ngahna dingin a kisam omzia ahih keileh angsung khat.

examples.english: Trust is an essential ingredient in a strong relationship.
examples.zomi: Kizopna kip adingin muanhuaina kisam mahmah hi.

examples.english: Patience is a key ingredient for success.
examples.zomi: Mawhpohna ngah dingin thuakzawhna pen angsung thupi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense treats a quality as one necessary part of a larger result.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in omzia khat pen gahsuah lianzaw ngahna ding a kisam angsung khat in ngai hi.

senses.definition_en: Existing or happening at the beginning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat’ kipatna ah a om ahih keileh a piang.

examples.english: The initial results were encouraging.
examples.zomi: Gahsuah masate lungmuansak huai hi.

examples.english: After some initial difficulty, the work became easier.
examples.zomi: Kipatna haksatna tawmkhat khit ciangin nasep baihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Initial means first or at the beginning. It does not necessarily mean the most important.
senses.usage_zomi: Initial in a masa ahih keileh kipatna ah cihna ahi hi. A thupipen cihna hi teitei lo hi.

senses.definition_en: At first or at the beginning.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kipatcil in; a masa in.

examples.english: I initially thought the project would be easy.
examples.zomi: A kipatcil in project baih ding ci in ka ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: She initially refused the offer but later accepted it.
examples.zomi: Ama’n thuhilhna a masa in nial napi, a nungciang in sang hi.

senses.usage_en: Initially often contrasts the first situation or opinion with what happened later.
senses.usage_zomi: Initially in kipatcil omzia ahih keileh ngaihsutna pen a nungciang thu tawh tehkakna ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: A new plan or program
senses.definition_en: A new plan, action or program intended to solve a problem or achieve a goal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina khat veng ahih keileh ngiimna khat ngah dingin a kipan geelna, gamtatna ahih keileh program thak.

examples.english: The city launched an initiative to reduce homelessness.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in inn neilo mite tawm sak ding geelna thak kipan hi.

examples.english: The initiative provides training for young workers.
examples.zomi: Geelna thak in nasem khangnote sinsakna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: An initiative is usually a planned effort with a defined purpose, not merely a general idea.
senses.usage_zomi: Initiative pen ngiimna kician nei hanciamna leh geelna ahi a, ngaihsutna bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: The ability to act without being told
senses.definition_en: The ability and willingness to recognize what needs to be done and begin doing it without being told.
senses.zomi_equivalents: amah in kipan theihna; sawllohpi in sepna
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisap na theikha a, mi dang in sawl masak kul loin sem kipat theihna leh utna.

common_phrases.zomi: amah in kipan theihna nei lo

examples.english: She showed initiative by solving the problem herself.
examples.zomi: Buaina amah mah in a veng manin amah in kipan theihna lak hi.

examples.english: Someone must take the initiative and organize the meeting.
examples.zomi: Mi khat in masa in kipan a, kikhopna geel kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Take the initiative means acting first instead of waiting for someone else.
senses.usage_zomi: Take the initiative in midangte ngak loin, masa in nasep kipan cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To cause physical harm or damage to a person or animal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih keileh gan pumpi nasak ahih keileh liamsak.

examples.english: The driver injured his shoulder in the crash.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw kituahna ah hawlpa’ liang liam hi.

examples.english: Falling objects may injure workers.
examples.zomi: A kia vante’n nasemte liamsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Injure is generally used for physical harm. For emotional pain, hurt is more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Injure pen pumpi liamna genna ah kizang ngei hi. Lungsim natna genna ah hurt kizang zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Physically hurt or damaged, especially in an accident or attack.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diakin aksident ahih keileh kisiatna khat hangin pumpi a liam.

examples.english: Two passengers were seriously injured.
examples.zomi: Khualzin mi nih nakpi takin liam uh hi.

examples.english: The injured bird could not fly.
examples.zomi: Vasa a liam pen leng zo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Injured describes the affected person or animal. The plural expression the injured means injured people collectively.
senses.usage_zomi: Injured in a liam mi ahih keileh gan gen hi. Plural paukam the injured in mi liamte a vekpi kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Physical harm or damage to a person’s or animal’s body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih keileh gan pumpi tungah a piang liamna leh siatna.

examples.english: She suffered a knee injury during the game.
examples.zomi: Kimawl laitak in ama’ khuk liam hi.

examples.english: Wearing a helmet can prevent serious injury.
examples.zomi: Lukhu khukna in liamna khauh khaktan thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Injury is the physical harm itself. Wound often refers to a specific cut or opening caused by a weapon or external force.
senses.usage_zomi: Injury in pumpi liamna tangpi kawk hi. Wound ahihleh galhiam ahih keileh pualam tha in a bawl tanliam kician khat kawk zaw hi.

senses.heading: On or near the inside
senses.definition_en: Located inside something or nearer its center.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat’ sunglam ah ahih keileh a laizang naizaw ah a om.

examples.english: The box has an inner layer of soft material.
examples.zomi: Bawm in a sunglam ah van nem pat khat nei hi.

examples.english: Only staff may enter the inner room.
examples.zomi: Nasemte bek pindan sungnung ah lut thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Inner contrasts with outer. It normally comes before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Inner’ langkhat pen outer ahi hi. Min ma ah kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Relating to private thoughts or feelings
senses.definition_en: Relating to a person’s private thoughts, feelings or character.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ sunglam ngaihsutna, lungsim omzia ahih keileh gamtatna tawh kisai.

examples.english: Prayer gave her inner peace.
examples.zomi: Thungetna in amah sunglam lungnopna pia hi.

examples.english: He rarely expresses his inner feelings.
examples.zomi: Ama’n a sunglam lungsim omzia genkhia ngei vetlo hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes what exists privately within a person rather than a physical location.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in pumpi sung mun kawklo a, mi khat’ lungsim sungah a om na kawk hi.

senses.heading: Not guilty of a crime or wrongdoing
senses.definition_en: Not responsible for a crime, offense or harmful action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhna, thukhun palsatna ahih keileh gamtatna hoihlo khat ading maw nei lo.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat maw neilo cih teci lak

examples.english: The court found him innocent of all charges.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi in mawhsakna khempeuh ah amah maw neilo ci in khensat hi.

examples.english: She insisted that she was innocent.
examples.zomi: Ama’n amah maw neilo cih kipsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In law, a person is usually described as guilty or not guilty. Innocent is the ordinary-language opposite of guilty.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhun lamah mi khat guilty ahih keileh not guilty kici ngei hi. Nisim pau ah innocent pen guilty’ langkhat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not intending harm
senses.definition_en: Not intended to cause harm, offense or trouble.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngiatna hoihlo nei lo; mawh neilo
senses.explanation_zomi: Siatna, lungnatna ahih keileh buaina piangsak ding ngiimna nei lo.

examples.english: It was an innocent mistake.
examples.zomi: Tua pen ngiimna hoihlo loin a piang khialhna ahi hi.

examples.english: She asked an innocent question.
examples.zomi: Ama’n kuamah sukha ding ngiimna loin dotna khat dong hi.

senses.usage_en: An innocent mistake is unintentional; it may still have consequences.
senses.usage_zomi: Innocent mistake pen geelna tawh a kibawl hilo napi, a gahsuah om veve thei hi.

senses.heading: Lacking experience of wrongdoing
senses.definition_en: Having little knowledge or experience of evil, dishonesty or adult behavior.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim siangtho; gamtatna hoihlo theih nailo
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhna, khemna ahih keileh gamtatna hoihlo tawh kisai theihna leh phutkhakna tawm.

examples.english: The child gave us an innocent smile.
examples.zomi: Naupang in kote tungah lungsim siangtho tawh nui hi.

examples.english: She was young and innocent at the time.
examples.zomi: Tua hunin amah khangno a, gamtatna hoihlo tawh kisai theihna tawm hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may suggest purity or lack of worldly experience, but it should not be used to belittle adults.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in lungsim siangthona leh leitung gamtatna phutkhak nailohna kawk thei napi, mihing picingte simmawhna dingin zat loh hoih hi.

senses.definition_en: A small animal with six legs and a body divided into three main parts, often with wings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe guk nei a, pumpi angsung bulpi thum in kikhen, a hun ciangin kha a nei gan neu.

examples.english: Bees, ants and butterflies are insects.
examples.zomi: Khuaizu, khuai leh lep lengte ganneu khe guk nei ahi uh hi.

examples.english: The light attracted many insects.
examples.zomi: Khuavak in ganneu tampi kai hi.

senses.usage_en: Spiders are not insects; they have eight legs and belong to a different animal group.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuai-lawm pen insect hilo hi; khe giat nei a, gan pawl dang sungah kihel hi.

senses.heading: Within a place or container
senses.definition_en: In the inner part of a place, container or object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, van koihna ahih keileh van khat’ sunglamah.

examples.english: The children are inside the house.
examples.zomi: Naupangte inn sungah om uh hi.

examples.english: She found the letter inside the book.
examples.zomi: Ama’n lai pen laibu sungah mu hi.

senses.usage_en: As a preposition, inside is followed by a noun. It emphasizes being within boundaries more strongly than in.
senses.usage_zomi: Preposition a hih ciangin inside nungah min kizom hi. In sangin gamgi sungah om cihna kipsak zaw hi.

senses.heading: Within a period of time
senses.definition_en: Before a stated period of time has ended.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ciangtansa khat a bei ma in; tua hun sungah.

examples.english: The doctor saw us inside an hour.
examples.zomi: Nai khat sungin siavuan in hong en hi.

examples.english: The repairs should be completed inside two weeks.
examples.zomi: Bawlhoihna pen nipikal nih sungin zawh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In time expressions, inside means “within” or “before the period ends.”
senses.usage_zomi: Hun tawh kisai zatna ah inside in “tua hun sungin” ahih keileh “a bei ma in” cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A clear and deep understanding
senses.definition_en: A clear and accurate understanding of a person, problem or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, buaina ahih keileh omzia khat’ a sunglam dong a kician leh maan takin telna.

examples.english: The study provides new insight into the causes of the disease.
examples.zomi: Thuzonna in natna’ hangte telna thak leh thuk pia hi.

examples.english: Her experience gave her insight into the needs of immigrants.
examples.zomi: Ama’ phutkhakna in pemlut mite’ kisapna telna thuk pia hi.

senses.usage_en: The usual pattern is insight into something, not insight of something.
senses.usage_zomi: Gelhdan ngeina pen insight into something ahi a, insight of something hilo hi.

senses.heading: A useful observation
senses.definition_en: A particular idea or observation that shows deep understanding.
senses.explanation_zomi: Telna thuk a lak ngaihsutna ahih keileh muhkhiatna phattuam khat.

examples.english: The speaker shared several useful insights.
examples.zomi: Thugenpa in ngaihsutna thuk leh phattuam tampi gen hi.

examples.english: The interviews produced important insights about the community.
examples.zomi: Interview-te pan mipawl tawh kisai muhkhiatna thupi ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Insight may be uncountable when it means general understanding and countable when it means one particular observation.
senses.usage_zomi: Telna tangpi a kawk ciangin insight pen simtheihlo hi thei a, muhkhiatna khat kician a kawk ciangin simtheih min hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Demand something firmly
senses.definition_en: To demand that something happen or be done and refuse to accept disagreement.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kiptak in ngen; hih ding teitei ci
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat piang ahih keileh kisem ding kiptak in ngen a, nialna sanglo.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat paikhiat ding kiptak in ngen

examples.english: She insisted on paying for the meal.
examples.zomi: Ama’n an man amah in pia ding teitei ci hi.

examples.english: The doctor insisted that he remain in the hospital.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in amah zatui inn ah om lai ding kiptak in ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: Use insist on followed by a noun or -ing form: insist on payment, insist on paying. Use insist that before a clause.
senses.usage_zomi: Insist on nungah min ahih keileh -ing form kizang hi: insist on payment, insist on paying. Clause ma ah insist that kizang hi.

senses.heading: State firmly that something is true
senses.definition_en: To say firmly that something is true, especially when other people doubt it.
senses.zomi_equivalents: maan hi ci in kipsak; kiptak in gen
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte’n umlo napi, thu khat maan hi ci in kiptak in gen.

examples.english: He insisted that he had told the truth.
examples.zomi: Ama’n thu maan gen khin hi ci in kipsak hi.

examples.english: She insists that the decision was fair.
examples.zomi: Ama’n khensatna man hi ci in kiptak in gen hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, insist expresses strong certainty, not necessarily a demand for action.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah insist in umna kiptak gen a, na khat sem ding sawl teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: Motivate someone
senses.definition_en: To make someone feel excited, confident or willing to do something worthwhile.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hanthawn; lungtho sak; sem nuam sak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungtho, lungmuang ahih keileh na phathuai khat sem nuam sak.

examples.english: Her courage inspired others to speak out.
examples.zomi: Ama’ hangsanna in midangte thu genkhia ding hanthawn hi.

examples.english: A good teacher inspires students to learn.
examples.zomi: Sia hoih in sangnaupangte sin nuam sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use inspire someone to do something. Do not normally use inspire someone doing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Inspire someone to do something cih gelhdan kizang hi. Inspire someone doing something kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Give someone a creative idea
senses.definition_en: To give someone an idea for a creative work or action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tungah la, lim, laigelh ahih keileh gamtatna thak bawlna ding ngaihsutna pia.

examples.english: The mountains inspired her paintings.
examples.zomi: Mualte’n ama’ limsuutna ding ngaihsutna pia hi.

examples.english: The story was inspired by real events.
examples.zomi: Tangthu pen a taktak thu piangte pan ngaihsutna ngah in kigelh hi.

senses.usage_en: Inspired by identifies the source of an idea, not necessarily something copied directly.
senses.usage_zomi: Inspired by in ngaihsutna a ngahna bul kawk a, tua na a kibang lian in copy cihna hi teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: Put equipment into position for use
senses.definition_en: To put equipment or a system in place and make it ready to use.
senses.zomi_equivalents: phut; koih a zat dingin bawl
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanzat ahih keileh system khat a mun dingah koih a, zat theih dingin bawl.

examples.english: Workers installed a new heating system.
examples.zomi: Nasemte’n inn lumsakna system thak phut uh hi.

examples.english: The company will install solar panels on the roof.
examples.zomi: Company in innkhum tungah ni khuavak meikhau bawlna panels phut ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Install means more than merely placing something somewhere; it includes preparing it to operate.
senses.usage_zomi: Install in van khat koih bek cihna hilo a, a nasep theih dingin kiging sakna zong huam hi.

senses.heading: Put software on a device
senses.definition_en: To copy software onto a computer or device and prepare it for use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Software khat computer ahih keileh device sungah koih a, zat theih dingin bawl.

examples.english: Install the app on your phone.
examples.zomi: App pen na phone sungah install in.

examples.english: The computer must restart after installing the update.
examples.zomi: Update a kiphut khit ciangin computer kipan kik kul hi.

senses.usage_en: In computing, download transfers a file to a device; install prepares the downloaded software to run.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer zatna ah download in file device sungah lakhia cihna ahi a, install in tua software nasep theih dingin bawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: An example or case
senses.definition_en: A particular example or case of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, gamtatna ahih keileh omzia khat’ entawnna kician khat.

examples.english: Some animals, for instance bears, sleep through much of the winter.
examples.zomi: Gan pawlkhat, entawnna in vomte, phalbi hun tampi ih uh hi.

examples.english: In this instance, the usual rule does not apply.
examples.zomi: Hih thu ah thukhun ngeina zangtheih hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: For instance means the same as for example.
senses.usage_zomi: For instance leh for example khiatna kibang hi.

senses.heading: A particular occurrence
senses.definition_en: One particular occasion when something happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pian tum khat kician.

common_phrases.zomi: a piang ngei vetlo tum khat

examples.english: There were several instances of equipment failure.
examples.zomi: Vanzat a nasep zawhlohna tum tampi om hi.

examples.english: This was the first known instance of the disease in the area.
examples.zomi: Hih pen tua munah natna a pian theihkhiat masakpen ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is formal and often appears in reports, research and legal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna pen formal a, report, thuzonna leh thukhun laigelh ah kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: In place of someone or something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na dang’ munah; tua sangin.

examples.english: The store was closed, so we went home instead.
examples.zomi: Dawr kikhak ahih manin a munah inn ka ciah uh hi.

examples.english: She drank water instead of coffee.
examples.zomi: Ama’n coffee dawn sangin tui dawn hi.

senses.usage_en: Instead can stand alone, usually at the end of a clause. Instead of must be followed by a noun, pronoun or -ing form.
senses.usage_zomi: Instead pen amah bek in ding thei a, clause tawpna ah om tam hi. Instead of nungah min, pronoun ahih keileh -ing form kizom kul hi.

senses.definition_en: An organization established for education, research, professional training or a particular public purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna, thuzonna, nghề sinna ahih keileh mipi ngiimna kician khat adingin a kipawlna.

examples.english: She works at a medical research institute.
examples.zomi: Ama’n siavuan pilna thuzonna kipawlna ah nasem hi.

examples.english: The institute provides technical training.
examples.zomi: Institute in khut siam pilna sinsakna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: An institute is usually an organization with a specialized educational, research or professional purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Institute pen pilna, thuzonna ahih keileh nghề sinna ngiimna kician a nei kipawlna hi ngei hi.

senses.heading: A large established organization
senses.definition_en: A large or important organization established for education, government, religion, health, finance or public service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna, kumpi ukna, biakna, cidamna, sum vai ahih keileh mipi nasep ading a kipsa kipawlna lian leh thupi.

examples.english: The college is a respected educational institution.
examples.zomi: College pen pilna kipawlna kizahtak khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Banks are financial institutions.
examples.zomi: Bank-te sum vai kipawlna ahi uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Institution is broader than institute. An institute usually has a specialized purpose, while an institution may be any major established organization.
senses.usage_zomi: Institution in institute sangin huamzaizaw hi. Institute in ngiimna kician nei zel a, institution in kipawlna kipsa lian nam tuamtuam huam thei hi.

senses.heading: An established social practice or system
senses.definition_en: A long-established custom, relationship or system that is important in society.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipawl sungah hun sawtpi a kipsa ngeina, kizopna ahih keileh system thupi.

examples.english: Marriage is an important social institution.
examples.zomi: Kitengna pen mipawl ngeina kipsa thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Independent courts are essential democratic institutions.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi suaktate democracy ading ukna kipsa kisam mahmah ahi uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, an institution is not necessarily a building or single organization; it may be an enduring part of society.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah institution pen inn ahih keileh kipawlna khat bek hi teitei lo a, mipawl sungah a kipsa system khat zong hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Directions explaining what to do
senses.definition_en: Information that explains how to do or use something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bangci sep ahih keileh zat ding cih a hilh thu.

examples.english: Read the instructions before using the machine.
examples.zomi: Machine na zat ma in thuhilhna sim in.

examples.english: The instructions explain how to install the app.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna in app install dan hilhcian hi.

senses.usage_en: When it means directions, instructions is often plural because several steps are given.
senses.usage_zomi: Sepdingdan a kawk ciangin kal tampi a om manin instructions ci in plural kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: An official order
senses.definition_en: An order telling someone what they must do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in bang sem ding cih thuneihna tawh a piak thupiak.

examples.english: The officer gave instructions to the team.
examples.zomi: Officer in pawl tungah thupiak pia hi.

examples.english: We acted according to the manager’s instructions.
examples.zomi: Manager’ thupiak bangin ka gamta uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A direction explains how to do something; an order requires someone to do it. Instruction can express either meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Sepdingdan in bangci sem ding hilhcian a, thupiak in sep ding sawl hi. Instruction in khiatna tegel nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Teaching
senses.definition_en: The act or process of teaching a subject or skill.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sinna ahih keileh siamna khat a hilhna leh a sinsakna.

examples.english: The course includes classroom instruction and practical training.
examples.zomi: Sinna sungah class thuhilhna leh khut tawh nasep sinna kihel hi.

examples.english: Students receive instruction in English and Zomi.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte’n English leh Zomi pau thuhilhna ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In the teaching sense, instruction is usually uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Sinsakna khiatna ah instruction pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who teaches a particular subject, skill or practical activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sinna, siamna ahih keileh khut tawh gamtatna kician khat a hilh mi.

examples.english: The instructor showed us how to operate the machine.
examples.zomi: Sinsakpa in machine hawldan hong lak hi.

examples.english: She works as a driving instructor.
examples.zomi: Ama’n mawtaw hawl sinsakpa in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Instructor often refers to someone teaching a skill or course. Teacher is broader and is especially common in schools.
senses.usage_zomi: Instructor in siamna ahih keileh course kician khat a hilh mi kawk tam hi. Teacher in huamzaizaw a, a diakin sangte ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: A tool used for a particular purpose
senses.definition_en: A tool or device designed for scientific, medical, technical or other precise work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Science, siavuan, khut siam ahih keileh nasep kician khat sem dingin a kibawl vanzat.

examples.english: The surgeon prepared the medical instruments.
examples.zomi: Ki-aatsia in siavuan vanzatte bawl khol hi.

examples.english: This instrument measures air pressure.
examples.zomi: Hih vanzat in huih pressure teh hi.

senses.usage_en: An instrument is often designed for skilled or precise work; a tool is a broader term.
senses.usage_zomi: Instrument pen siam leh kician takin nasepna ding a kibawl vanzat hi tam a, tool in huamzaizaw hi.

senses.heading: An object used to make music
senses.definition_en: An object designed to produce musical sounds.
senses.explanation_zomi: La ging suah dingin a kibawl van.

examples.english: The guitar is her favorite musical instrument.
examples.zomi: Guitar pen ama’ tumging van deihpen ahi hi.

examples.english: Every student learns to play an instrument.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang sim in tumging van khat tum ding sin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: English says play an instrument, but Standard Zomi naturally uses the verb appropriate to producing music, such as tum.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah play an instrument kici a, Standard Zomi ah la ging suahna tawh kituak verb tum kizang hi.

senses.heading: A means used to achieve something
senses.definition_en: A person, organization, law or method used to achieve a particular result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gahsuah kician khat ngahna dingin a kizang mi, kipawlna, thukhun ahih keileh lampi.

examples.english: Education can be an instrument of social change.
examples.zomi: Pilna pen mipawl kikhelna piangsakna hi thei hi.

examples.english: The law became an instrument of discrimination.
examples.zomi: Thukhun pen deidanna zatzia suak hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal figurative sense presents someone or something as a means to an end.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal tehpihna khiatna in mi ahih keileh na khat pen ngiimna khat ngahna ding zatzia in ngai hi.

senses.definition_en: A financial agreement in which a person or company pays regular amounts and receives money if specified loss, damage, illness or death occurs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh company in sum hun ciangtan tawh pia a, ciangtansa siatna, van kisiatna, natna ahih keileh sihna piang leh sum huhna a ngah sum vai thuciam.

examples.english: The job provides health insurance.
examples.zomi: Nasep in cidamna insurance pia hi.

examples.english: Car insurance covered the cost of the repairs.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw insurance in bawlhoihna man pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Insurance is normally uncountable. An individual written agreement is an insurance policy.
senses.usage_zomi: Insurance pen simtheihlo min ahi hi. Kammal tawh kigelh thuciam khat pen insurance policy kici hi.

senses.heading: The ability to learn and understand
senses.definition_en: The ability to learn, understand, reason and solve problems.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sin, tel, ngaihsun leh buaina vengtheihna lungsim pilna.

examples.english: The test measures several forms of intelligence.
examples.zomi: Sittelna in pilna nam tuamtuam teh hi.

examples.english: Artificial intelligence can analyze large amounts of data.
examples.zomi: Computer pilna bawltawm in data tampi kheel thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Intelligence includes several mental abilities and should not be treated as identical to education or factual knowledge.
senses.usage_zomi: Intelligence in lungsim siamtheihna nam tuamtuam huam a, pilna sinna ahih keileh thu theihna bek tawh kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: Secret or security information
senses.definition_en: Information collected about an enemy, threat or security issue.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gal, lauhuaina ahih keileh bitna buaina tawh kisai a kigawm thusuuk.

examples.english: The agency gathered intelligence about the planned attack.
examples.zomi: Agency in galzawhna geelna tawh kisai thusuuk kaikhawm hi.

examples.english: Military intelligence warned of a possible threat.
examples.zomi: Galkap thusuuk in lauhuaina om thei cih hilhkhol hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is usually uncountable and is common in military, government and security contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei a, galkap, kumpi leh bitna thu ah kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: Able to learn, understand, reason and solve problems well.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihtak in sin, tel, ngaihsun leh buaina veng thei.

examples.english: She is an intelligent and hardworking student.
examples.zomi: Amah sangnaupang pil leh hahkat khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The system is intelligent enough to recognize voices.
examples.zomi: System pen awte theikha zo dingzah in pil hi.

senses.usage_en: Intelligent describes mental ability. Intellectual often relates to serious thinking, study or academic interests.
senses.usage_zomi: Intelligent in lungsim siamtheihna gen hi. Intellectual ahihleh ngaihsutna thuk, pilna sinna ahih keileh academic lunglutna tawh kisai hi.

senses.heading: Plan or mean to do something
senses.definition_en: To plan or decide to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sem ding geel ahih keileh khensat.

examples.english: I intend to finish the report today.
examples.zomi: Report pen tuni in zo ding ka tum hi.

examples.english: They intend to build a new school.
examples.zomi: Amaute’n sang thak khat lam ding geel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use intend to do something, not normally intend doing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Intend to do something cih gelhdan kizang a, intend doing something kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Design something for a purpose or person
senses.definition_en: To design or mean something for a particular purpose, person or result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngiimna, mi ahih keileh gahsuah kician khat ading bawl ahih keileh geel.

examples.english: The book is intended for English learners.
examples.zomi: Laibu pen English sintute adingin kigelh hi.

examples.english: I did not intend any harm.
examples.zomi: Siatna piangsak ka tum hetlo hi.

senses.usage_en: The passive pattern be intended for describes the person or purpose for which something was designed.
senses.usage_zomi: Passive gelhdan be intended for in na khat kua ading ahih keileh bang ngiimna tawh kibawl cih gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Planned, designed or meant for a particular person, purpose or result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ngiimna ahih keileh gahsuah kician khat adingin kigeel leh kibawl.

examples.english: The message did not reach its intended audience.
examples.zomi: Thupuak pen a ngah ding a kingiim mipite kiang tunglo hi.

examples.english: The medicine had the intended effect.
examples.zomi: Damdawi in a kingiim huzaap nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Intended describes what was planned. The actual result may be different from the intended result.
senses.usage_zomi: Intended in kigeel leh kingiim thu gen hi. A taktak gahsuah pen kingiim gahsuah tawh kilamdang thei hi.

senses.heading: Very strong or extreme
senses.definition_en: Extremely strong in degree, force or feeling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, tha ahih keileh lungsim omzia ah a khauh leh a nasa mahmah.

examples.english: He felt intense pain in his back.
examples.zomi: Ama’ nung na nasa mahmah hi.

examples.english: The workers faced intense pressure to finish on time.
examples.zomi: Nasemte’n hun sungin zo ding nenniamna khauh thuak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Intense usually describes strength or degree, not physical size.
senses.usage_zomi: Intense in tha leh dinmun bangzah khauh cih gen a, pumpi lian-neu gen ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Showing very strong concentration or emotion
senses.definition_en: Showing powerful concentration, seriousness or emotion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunglutna, kiptakna ahih keileh lungsim omzia khauh mahmah lak.

examples.english: The team worked with intense concentration.
examples.zomi: Pawl in lunglutna khauh tawh nasem hi.

examples.english: They had an intense discussion about the policy.
examples.zomi: Amaute’n thukhun thu khauhtak in kikum uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Describing a person as intense may suggest that their emotions or focus feel unusually strong.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat intense cihna in ama’ lungsim omzia ahih keileh lunglutna a khauh ngeina kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Something that a person plans or means to do; the purpose behind an action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a sep ding a geel na ahih keileh gamtatna khat nungah a om ngiimna.

examples.english: I have no intention of leaving my job.
examples.zomi: Ka nasep nutsiat tumna ka nei lo hi.

examples.english: Her intention was to help, not to offend anyone.
examples.zomi: Ama’ ngiimna pen mi huh ding ahi a, kuamah lungsim nasak ding hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use intention of doing something or intention to do something. Good intentions do not always produce good results.
senses.usage_zomi: Intention of doing something leh intention to do something tegel kizang thei hi. Ngiimna hoih in gahsuah hoih pia teitei lo thei hi.

senses.heading: A desire to know or learn
senses.definition_en: A feeling of wanting to know, learn or pay attention to something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat thei, sin ahih keileh ngaihsak nuamna.

examples.english: She has a strong interest in history.
examples.zomi: Ama’n tangthu lunglut mahmah hi.

examples.english: The students showed interest in the experiment.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte experiment lunglut uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use interest in something, not interest on something.
senses.usage_zomi: Interest in something cih gelhdan kizang a, interest on something kici lo hi—sum lei ah a khiatna dang lobuang.

senses.heading: An activity or subject someone enjoys
senses.definition_en: An activity or subject that someone enjoys and wants to learn more about.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a nuam sak a, sinsiamzaw ding a deih gamtatna ahih keileh sinna.

examples.english: Music and photography are among his main interests.
examples.zomi: La leh limlaakna pen ama’ lunglutna bulpite lakah kihel hi.

examples.english: We discovered that we had similar interests.
examples.zomi: Ka lunglutna uh a kibang ka theikha uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In the plural, interests commonly means activities or subjects that attract someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural interests in mi khat a lunglut gamtatna leh sinna-te kawk tam hi.

senses.heading: Money charged or paid for the use of money
senses.definition_en: Money paid for borrowing money or earned from money kept in an account or investment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum a kikawm manin a kipia sum ahih keileh account leh sum koihna pan a kingah sum.

examples.english: The bank charges interest on the loan.
examples.zomi: Bank in sumkawm tungah sum pung la hi.

examples.english: This account earns three percent interest.
examples.zomi: Hih account in sum pung za-a-thum ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Financial interest on a loan is different from personal interest in a subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum vai interest on sumkawm pen sum pung ahi a, sinna khat tawh kisai mimal interest in pen lunglutna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A benefit or concern
senses.definition_en: An advantage, benefit or concern that matters to a person or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh pawl khat ading phattuamna, hamphatna ahih keileh ngaihsak ding thu.

examples.english: The decision should serve the public interest.
examples.zomi: Khensatna in mipi phattuamna sem ding hi.

examples.english: The lawyer protected her client’s interests.
examples.zomi: Siampipa in a client’ phattuamna dal hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, interests often means benefits or rights that someone wants protected.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah interests in mi khat in a dal nuam phattuamna leh thu-neihna-te kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Wanting to know, learn or take part in something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat thei, sin ahih keileh sungah kihel nuam.

examples.english: She is interested in learning Zomi.
examples.zomi: Ama’n Zomi pau sinna lunglut hi.

examples.english: Are you interested in joining the program?
examples.zomi: Program sungah kihel ding na lunglut hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use interested in, followed by a noun or -ing form. Interested describes the person who feels interest; interesting describes what creates the interest.
senses.usage_zomi: Interested in nungah min ahih keileh -ing form kizang hi. Interested in lunglutna a nei mi gen a, interesting in lunglutna a piangsak na gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Attracting attention and making someone want to know or learn more.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi’ lunglutna kai a, thu tampizaw thei leh sin nuam sak.

examples.english: The documentary was very interesting.
examples.zomi: Documentary pen lungluthuai mahmah hi.

examples.english: She asked an interesting question about the research.
examples.zomi: Ama’n thuzonna tawh kisai dotna theihnop huai khat dong hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not say I am interesting when you mean that you feel interest. Say I am interested.
senses.usage_zomi: “Ka lunglut hi” cihna dingin I am interesting ci kei in; I am interested ci in.

senses.heading: Located or happening inside something
senses.definition_en: Existing, happening or situated inside a body, building, organization or system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi, inn, kipawlna ahih keileh system khat’ sungah a om ahih keileh a piang.

examples.english: The scan showed no internal injuries.
examples.zomi: Scan in pumpi sung liamna omlo cih lak hi.

examples.english: The building’s internal walls were removed.
examples.zomi: Inn’ sunglam kulhte kipaikhia hi.

senses.usage_en: Internal contrasts with external.
senses.usage_zomi: Internal’ langkhat pen external ahi hi.

senses.heading: Existing within an organization or country
senses.definition_en: Involving only the members or parts of one organization, company or country.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kipawlna, company ahih keileh gam khat sung mite leh angsungte bek tawh kisai.

examples.english: The company began an internal investigation.
examples.zomi: Company in a sunglam zonna kipan hi.

examples.english: The country faced serious internal conflict.
examples.zomi: Gam in sunglam kinialna thupi tuak hi.

senses.usage_en: An internal matter is handled within the organization or country rather than by outsiders.
senses.usage_zomi: Internal thu pen pualam mite hilo in kipawlna ahih keileh gam sung mite in kem uh hi.

senses.heading: Existing in the mind
senses.definition_en: Relating to private thoughts, feelings or mental processes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mimal sunglam ngaihsutna, lungsim omzia leh lungsim nasepzia tawh kisai.

examples.english: He experienced an internal struggle before deciding.
examples.zomi: Khensat ma in ama’n sunglam lungsim kidona thuak hi.

examples.english: Her motivation came from an internal desire to help others.
examples.zomi: Ama’ hanthawnna pen midangte huh nuamna sunglam pan hong pai hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense concerns thoughts and feelings that may not be visible to other people.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in midangte’n a muhloh theih ngaihsutna leh lungsim omzia kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Involving, existing between or relating to two or more countries.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gam kikal; leitung gam tuamtuam tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam nih ahih keileh gam tampi a huam, amau kikal ah a om, ahih keileh amau tawh kisai.

examples.english: The conference attracted international experts.
examples.zomi: Conference in gam tuamtuam pan mipilte kai hi.

examples.english: The two countries signed an international agreement.
examples.zomi: Gam nih in gam kikal thuciam gelh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: International concerns more than one country. Global usually concerns the whole world.
senses.usage_zomi: International in gam khat sang a tamzaw tawh kisai hi. Global ahihleh leitung bup tawh kisai hi.

senses.definition_en: The worldwide computer network that connects people and devices and allows information and services to be shared.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung buppi ah mihing leh device-te a kizomsak a, thu leh nasepna khawmtuah theihna computer kizopna lian.

examples.english: Many students use the internet for research.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang tampi in thuzonna dingin internet zang uh hi.

examples.english: The village now has reliable internet access.
examples.zomi: Tua khua in tu in internet zat theihna muanhuai nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use on the internet, not normally in the internet. Modern English often writes internet with a lowercase i.
senses.usage_zomi: In the internet ci loin on the internet kici ngei hi. Tuni English ah internet pen lai neu i tawh kigelh tam hi.

senses.heading: Explain or understand meaning
senses.definition_en: To explain or decide what the meaning of words, actions, data or events is.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, gamtatna, data ahih keileh thu piang khat’ khiatna hilhcian ahih keileh tel.

examples.english: Experts interpreted the results in different ways.
examples.zomi: Mipilte’n gahsuah a tuamtuam in hilhcian uh hi.

examples.english: The court must interpret the meaning of the law.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi in thukhun’ khiatna hilhcian kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Interpret involves explaining meaning. Summarize means giving only the main points.
senses.usage_zomi: Interpret in khiatna hilhcian cihna ahi hi. Summarize ahihleh thulu bulpite bek tomin gen cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Translate spoken or signed language
senses.definition_en: To translate spoken or signed language into another language while communication is taking place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kihouna a piang laitak in pau ahih keileh khut lim pau khat pan pau dang khat in leh.

examples.english: She interpreted the speech from English into Zomi.
examples.zomi: Ama’n thugenna English pan Zomi in leh hi.

examples.english: An interpreter helped the patient speak with the doctor.
examples.zomi: Pau lehsia in cidamna kemmi leh siavuan kihoutheihna huh hi.

senses.usage_en: An interpreter usually works with spoken or signed language. A translator usually works with written text.
senses.usage_zomi: Interpreter in kam tawh kigen pau ahih keileh khut lim pau tawh nasem tam hi. Translator in laigelh tawh nasem tam hi.

senses.heading: Stop someone while speaking or working
senses.definition_en: To speak or act while someone else is speaking or working, causing them to stop.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang a pau ahih keileh nasem laitak in, amah khawlsak in thu gen ahih keileh gamta.

common_phrases.zomi: thu ka tan manin ngaihdam in

examples.english: Please do not interrupt while she is speaking.
examples.zomi: Amah a pau laitak in a thu tan kei in.

examples.english: I am sorry to interrupt, but this is urgent.
examples.zomi: Na thu ka tan manin ngaihdam in, ahihhang hih pen manlang kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Interrupt someone takes a direct object. Do not normally say interrupt to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Interrupt someone cihna ah mi pen direct object ahi hi. Interrupt to someone kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Temporarily stop a process or activity
senses.definition_en: To temporarily stop the continuous progress of an activity, service or process.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, nasepna ahih keileh process khat a zom paisuakna tomno khawlsak.

examples.english: The storm interrupted electricity service.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in meikhau nasepna khawlsak hi.

examples.english: A phone call interrupted our meeting.
examples.zomi: Phone sapna khat in ka kikhopna uh khawlsak hi.

senses.usage_en: An interruption may be temporary; it does not necessarily end the activity permanently.
senses.usage_zomi: Interruption pen tomno sung khawlsakna hi thei a, tua gamtatna tawp paisuak cihna hi teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: A meeting to assess a job applicant
senses.definition_en: A formal meeting in which someone is asked questions to decide whether they are suitable for a job, course or position.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasep dotna; interview; kam tawh sittelna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nasep, sinna ahih keileh dinmun khat ading a kituak hiam cih khensatna ding dotna tawh a kisittel formal kikhopna.

examples.english: She has a job interview tomorrow morning.
examples.zomi: Zingciang zingsangin ama’n nasep interview nei hi.

examples.english: The interview lasted about thirty minutes.
examples.zomi: Interview minute sawmthum bang sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an interview for a job and an interview with a company or interviewer.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep a kawk ciangin an interview for a job kizang a, company ahih keileh dotpa a kawk ciangin an interview with kizang hi.

senses.heading: A recorded or reported conversation
senses.definition_en: A conversation in which someone is asked questions for a news report, program or research study.
senses.explanation_zomi: News, program ahih keileh thuzonna dingin mi khat tungah dotna a kibawl kihouna.

examples.english: The actor gave an interview about his new film.
examples.zomi: Actor in a film thak thu interview pia hi.

examples.english: Researchers conducted interviews with local residents.
examples.zomi: Thu-zongte’n khuamite tawh interview bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The interviewer asks questions; the interviewee answers them.
senses.usage_zomi: Interviewer in dotna dong a, interviewee in dawnna pia hi.

senses.heading: Movement from outside to inside
senses.definition_en: Moving toward and entering the inside of a place or container.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pualam pan mun ahih keileh van koihna khat’ sunglamah a kiciingna.

examples.english: She walked into the room.
examples.zomi: Amah pindan sungah lut hi.

examples.english: Put the papers into the bag.
examples.zomi: Laite bawm sungah koih in.

senses.usage_en: In usually describes location; into describes movement from outside to inside.
senses.usage_zomi: In in mun sungah omna gen a, into in pualam pan sunglam a kiciingna gen hi.

senses.heading: A change from one state or form to another
senses.definition_en: Used to show that someone or something changes to a different state, form or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat dinmun, lim ahih keileh omzia dang khat suak cih lakna.

examples.english: The water turned into ice.
examples.zomi: Tui pen gawlkhal suak hi.

examples.english: The class was divided into four groups.
examples.zomi: Class pen pawl li in kikhen hi.

senses.usage_en: Change into emphasizes the new form. Change in usually refers to a change within an area or quality.
senses.usage_zomi: Change into in lim thak a suahna kipsak hi. Change in ahihleh lam khat sungah kikhelna gen zaw hi.

senses.heading: Strongly interested or involved
senses.definition_en: Informally used to show that someone is strongly interested in or actively involved with something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Informal in mi khat na khat lunglut mahmah ahih keileh sungah kihel taktak cih lakna.

examples.english: He is really into photography.
examples.zomi: Ama’n limlaakna lunglut mahmah hi.

examples.english: She got into politics after college.
examples.zomi: College a zawh khit ciangin amah gamvai sungah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is informal. In formal writing, use interested in or involved in.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen informal ahi hi. Formal laigelh ah interested in ahih keileh involved in zang in.

senses.heading: Tell people each other’s names
senses.definition_en: To tell two or more people each other’s names so that they can meet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nih ahih keileh a tamzaw kimuh theihna dingin amau min leh thu pulaak.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat mi dang tawh kimuhsak

examples.english: Let me introduce you to my sister.
examples.zomi: Ka sanggamnu tawh kong kimuhsak ni.

examples.english: She introduced herself to the group.
examples.zomi: Ama’n pawl tungah amah kipulaak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use introduce someone to someone else. Do not normally say introduce someone with someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Introduce someone to someone else cih gelhdan kizang hi. Introduce someone with someone kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Present a subject, speaker or program
senses.definition_en: To present a subject, person or program for the first time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu, mi ahih keileh program khat a masa in mipite theih dingin pulaak.

examples.english: The host introduced the first speaker.
examples.zomi: Program makai in thugenpa masapen pulaak hi.

examples.english: The teacher introduced a new topic.
examples.zomi: Sia in thulu thak khat pulaak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense means presenting someone or something to an audience, not creating it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mi ahih keileh na khat mipite theih dingin pulaak cihna ahi a, bawlthak cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Begin using or offering something new
senses.definition_en: To begin using, producing or making a new law, system, product or method available.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, system, van ahih keileh sepdan thak khat zat, bawl ahih keileh pia kipan.

examples.english: The government introduced new safety rules.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in bitna thukhun thak zang kipan hi.

examples.english: The company introduced a new phone.
examples.zomi: Company in phone thak khat zuak kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, introduce means bringing something into use for the first time.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah introduce in na khat a masa in zat kipat cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The act of introducing people
senses.definition_en: The act of telling people each other’s names so that they can meet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite kimuh theihna dingin amau min leh thu kipulaakna.

examples.english: After a brief introduction, the meeting began.
examples.zomi: Kipulaakna tomno khit ciangin kikhopna kipan hi.

examples.english: Thank you for the kind introduction.
examples.zomi: Kipulaakna hoih nong pia manin ka lungdam hi.

senses.usage_en: An introduction to someone may be a first meeting; an introduction of someone may refer to presenting that person to others.
senses.usage_zomi: An introduction to someone in mi khat tawh kimuh masakna hi thei a, an introduction of someone in tua mi midangte tungah pulaakna kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: The opening part of a book, speech or report
senses.definition_en: The first part of a book, speech or report that explains its subject and purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, thugenna ahih keileh report’ thulu leh ngiimna a hilhcian angsung masapen.

examples.english: The introduction explains the purpose of the study.
examples.zomi: Thumapui in thuzonna’ ngiimna hilhcian hi.

examples.english: Begin the report with a short introduction.
examples.zomi: Report pen thumapui tom khat tawh kipan in.

senses.usage_en: An introduction prepares readers or listeners for the main content; it should not contain every detail.
senses.usage_zomi: Thumapui in simte leh ngaite thulu ading kiging sak a, thu khempeuh kicing takin huam kullo hi.

senses.heading: The first experience or basic teaching of a subject
senses.definition_en: A first experience of a subject or a basic explanation for beginners.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sinna khat tawh a kimuh masakna ahih keileh a kipan sintute ading hilhcian bulpi.

examples.english: This course provides an introduction to economics.
examples.zomi: Hih course in sum vai pilna sinna kipatna pia hi.

examples.english: The workshop was my first introduction to digital design.
examples.zomi: Workshop pen digital design tawh ka kimuh masakna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: An introduction to a subject is basic material for beginners, not an advanced treatment.
senses.usage_zomi: An introduction to a subject pen a kipan sintute ading thu bulpi ahi a, pilna sangzaw hilo hi.

senses.heading: Create something new
senses.definition_en: To design or create a device, process or method that did not exist before.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ma in a om nailoh vanzat, process ahih keileh sepdan thak ngaihsun a, bawl.

examples.english: Who invented the telephone?
examples.zomi: Telephone kua in bawlthak hiam?

examples.english: The team invented a cheaper way to clean the water.
examples.zomi: Pawl in tui siansuahna sepdan man tawmzaw ngaihsutkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: Invent means creating something new. Discover means finding something that already existed.
senses.usage_zomi: Invent in na thak bawl cihna ahi hi. Discover ahihleh a om khinsa na khat zongkhia cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Make up an untrue story or explanation
senses.definition_en: To create a story, excuse or explanation that is not true.
senses.explanation_zomi: A maan hilo tangthu, paulam ahih keileh hilhcian dan khat ngaihsun bawl.

examples.english: He invented an excuse for being late.
examples.zomi: A manlohna ding paulam khat phuah hi.

examples.english: The report was not true; someone had invented the story.
examples.zomi: Report maanlo hi; mi khat in tua tangthu bawlkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense often has a negative meaning because the invented information is presented as true.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen a kiphuahtawm thu a maan bangin kipia ahih manin a hoihlo khiatna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: A newly created device, process or method
senses.definition_en: Something created for the first time, especially a useful device, process or method.
senses.explanation_zomi: A masa in a kibawl, a diakin vanzat, process ahih keileh sepdan thak leh phattuam.

examples.english: The internet is one of the most influential modern inventions.
examples.zomi: Internet pen tuhun van bawlthakte lakah huzaap lianpen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Her invention helps people save water.
examples.zomi: Ama’ van bawlthak in mite tui zuat tawm sak ding huh hi.

senses.usage_en: The created result is an invention. The act or process may be expressed as the invention of something.
senses.usage_zomi: A kibawlkhia na pen an invention ahi hi. A bawlna process pen the invention of something ci in kigen thei hi.

senses.heading: An untrue story or idea
senses.definition_en: A story, explanation or idea created in the imagination and presented as if it were true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna tawh a kiphuahtawm, a maan bangin a kipia tangthu ahih keileh hilhcian dan.

examples.english: His explanation was a complete invention.
examples.zomi: Ama’ hilhcian dan pen phuahtawm thu bup ahi hi.

examples.english: The rumor appears to be an invention.
examples.zomi: Thu kizak pen phuahtawm thu bang hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether invention refers to useful creation or fabricated information.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizopna in invention pen van bawlthak maw, phuahtawm thu maw cih khen hi.

senses.heading: Put money into something for future return
senses.definition_en: To put money into a business, property or financial product in the hope of earning profit or increasing its value.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sum koih; sum khangsak dingin koih
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam ah sum pung ahih keileh man khantoh ngah lametna tawh business, inn-leilo ahih keileh sum vai van sungah sum koih.

examples.english: She invests part of her income every month.
examples.zomi: Ama’n kha sim a sumlut pawlkhat sum koihna ah koih hi.

examples.english: They invested in a small technology company.
examples.zomi: Amaute’n technology company neu khat ah sum koih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Investing can produce gains or losses. It is different from saving money in a place where the principal is protected.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum koihna pan sum pung zong, sum loss zong piang thei hi. Sum bul a bitna munah sum kholna tawh kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: Give time, effort or resources
senses.definition_en: To give time, effort or resources to something because you expect a future benefit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam phattuamna ngah lametna tawh na khat ah hun, tha ahih keileh neihsa zang.

examples.english: Parents invest time and energy in their children.
examples.zomi: Nulehpate’n amau tate adingin hun leh tha zang uh hi.

examples.english: The company invests in employee training.
examples.zomi: Company in nasemte sinsakna ah sum leh tha koih hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, what is invested may be time, effort, trust or other resources rather than money.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna ah sum bek hilo in hun, tha, muanhuaina leh neihsa dangte zong kikoih thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To examine facts, events or claims carefully in order to discover the truth or cause.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu maan ahih keileh a hang theihkhiat dingin teci, thu piang leh thugen-te limtak in zong a, en.

examples.english: Police are investigating the cause of the fire.
examples.zomi: Police-te’n mei kuangna’ hang zong uh hi.

examples.english: The committee will investigate the complaint.
examples.zomi: Committee in mawhphutna thu sittel ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Investigate something takes a direct object. Do not normally say investigate into something, although conduct an investigation into something is correct.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb ah investigate something kici a, investigate into something kici ngeilo hi. Noun tawh ahihleh conduct an investigation into something cih gelhdan man hi.

senses.definition_en: A careful and official examination of facts, events or claims to discover the truth or cause.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu maan ahih keileh a hang zongkhia dingin teci, thu piang leh thugen-te limtak leh official in a sittelna.

examples.english: The police investigation continued for several months.
examples.zomi: Police thu zonna kha tampi sung zom paisuak hi.

examples.english: The company is under investigation for possible fraud.
examples.zomi: Company pen khemna bawl thei cih thu ah kisittel laitak hi.
