senses.usage_en: Use an investigation into something: an investigation into the accident.
senses.usage_zomi: Gelhdan ngeina pen an investigation into something ahi hi: an investigation into the accident.

senses.heading: The act of investing money
senses.definition_en: The act of putting money into something in the hope of receiving profit or greater value later.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam ah sum pung ahih keileh man khantoh ngah lametna tawh na khat sungah sum koihna.

examples.english: The city needs more investment in public transportation.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in mipi khualzinna ah sum koihna tampizaw kisam hi.

examples.english: Investment always involves some level of risk.
examples.zomi: Sum koihna ah lauhuaina dinmun khat om tawntung hi.

senses.usage_en: Investment in something refers to where money or resources are committed.
senses.usage_zomi: Investment in something in sum ahih keileh neihsa bang sungah kikoih cih gen hi.

senses.heading: Money or an asset invested
senses.definition_en: Money, property or another asset acquired or used with the expectation of future income or growth.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sum koihsa; sum khangsak ding neihsa
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam sumlut ahih keileh man khantoh ngah dingin a kilei ahih keileh a kikoih sum, inn-leilo leh neihsa.

examples.english: The property proved to be a good investment.
examples.zomi: Inn-leilo pen sum koihna hoih ahi cih hong kician hi.

examples.english: Her investments increased in value.
examples.zomi: Ama’ sum koihsate’ man khang hi.

senses.usage_en: An investment may rise or fall in value; profit is not guaranteed.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum koihsa’ man khang zong, kia zong thei a; sum pung ngah ding kipsakna omlo hi.

senses.heading: Time, effort or resources committed for future benefit
senses.definition_en: Time, effort or resources given to something in expectation of a useful future result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam phattuamna ngah dingin a kizang hun, tha ahih keileh neihsa.

examples.english: Education is an investment in the future.
examples.zomi: Pilna pen mailam ading neihsa koihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Learning a language requires a major investment of time.
examples.zomi: Pau khat sinna in hun tampi koih kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense extends the financial idea of investing to nonfinancial resources.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in sum koihna ngaihsutna pen sum hilo neihsa dangte tungah zang hi.

senses.heading: A request asking someone to attend or participate
senses.definition_en: A spoken or written request asking someone to come to an event, visit a place or take part in something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pawi ah hong pai, mun khat hong veh ahih keileh gamtatna khat sungah kihel ding a kam tawh ahih keileh lai tawh ngetna.

examples.english: Thank you for the invitation to your wedding.
examples.zomi: Na kitengna ah nong sap manin ka lungdam hi.

examples.english: She accepted the invitation to speak at the conference.
examples.zomi: Conference ah thu gen ding sapna ama’n sang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use an invitation to an event and an invitation to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawi ma ah an invitation to an event kizang a, gamtatna ma ah an invitation to do something kizang hi.

senses.heading: Something that encourages an unwanted result
senses.definition_en: An action or situation that makes a particular result, often an unwanted one, more likely.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hong piang sakna; a sam bang na
senses.explanation_zomi: Gahsuah kician khat, a diakin a hoihlo na, hong piang baihzaw sak gamtatna ahih keileh omzia.

examples.english: Leaving the door unlocked is an invitation to theft.
examples.zomi: Kong khakloh in gukna piang baih sak hi.

examples.english: Ignoring the warning was an invitation to disaster.
examples.zomi: Hilhkholhna ngaihsakloh in siatna lian sam bang hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use does not describe a real invitation; it means making an outcome easier or more likely.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna in sapna taktak genlo a, gahsuah khat hong piang baihzaw sak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Ask someone to attend or participate
senses.definition_en: To ask someone to come to an event or place, or to take part in something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pawi ah hong pai, mun khat hong veh ahih keileh gamtatna khat sungah kihel dingin sam.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat nitak an ne ding sam
mi khat thu gen ding sam

examples.english: We invited our neighbors to dinner.
examples.zomi: Ka innpa uh nitak an ne dingin ka sam uh hi.

examples.english: She was invited to speak at the conference.
examples.zomi: Amah conference ah thu gen dingin kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use invite someone to an event or invite someone to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Invite someone to an event ahih keileh invite someone to do something cih gelhdan kizang hi.

senses.heading: Encourage a reaction or result
senses.definition_en: To encourage or make a particular reaction, response or result likely.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawnna, gamtatna ahih keileh gahsuah kician khat hong piang ding hanthawn ahih keileh baih sak.

examples.english: The speaker invited questions from the audience.
examples.zomi: Thugenpa in thu-ngai-te dotna dong ding sam hi.

examples.english: The unclear policy may invite criticism.
examples.zomi: Thukhun kicianlo in gensiatna hong piangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, no social invitation is required; invite means encouraging a response.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah pawi sapna kullo a, dawnna khat hong piang ding hanthawn cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Include as a necessary part
senses.definition_en: To include something as a necessary part of an activity, situation or process.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat gamtatna, omzia ahih keileh process khat sungah kisam angsung in huam.

examples.english: The job involves working with children.
examples.zomi: Nasep sungah naupangte tawh nasem ding kihel hi.

examples.english: Moving abroad involves many difficult decisions.
examples.zomi: Gamdang pemna ah khensatna haksa tampi kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: Use involve doing something, not normally involve to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Involve doing something cih gelhdan kizang a, involve to do something kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Cause someone to participate or become connected
senses.definition_en: To cause or encourage someone to take part in an activity or become connected with a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat gamtatna sungah kihel sak ahih keileh omzia khat tawh kizomsak.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat project ah kihel sak

examples.english: The school involved parents in the planning process.
examples.zomi: Sang in geelna process ah nulehpate kihel sak hi.

examples.english: Do not involve me in your argument.
examples.zomi: Na kinialna sungah kei hong kihel sak kei in.

senses.usage_en: Use involve someone in something. This may describe either voluntary participation or unwanted connection.
senses.usage_zomi: Involve someone in something cih gelhdan kizang hi. Mimal utna tawh kihelna zong, utlohpi in kizopna zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Taking part or connected
senses.definition_en: Taking part in an activity or connected with a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna khat sungah kihel ahih keileh omzia khat tawh kizom.

examples.english: She is actively involved in community work.
examples.zomi: Ama’n mipawl nasep ah phatuamngai takin kihel hi.

examples.english: Police questioned everyone involved in the incident.
examples.zomi: Police-te’n thu piang tawh a kizom mi khempeuh dong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use involved in an activity and involved with a person, group or organization.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna khat tawh involved in kizang a, mi, pawl ahih keileh kipawlna tawh involved with kizang hi.

senses.heading: Complicated
senses.definition_en: Complicated and containing many connected parts or details.
senses.explanation_zomi: Angsung leh thu kician tampi a kizomkhawm manin a telhak.

examples.english: The application process is long and involved.
examples.zomi: Ngetna process pen sau a, telhak hi.

examples.english: He gave an involved explanation of the system.
examples.zomi: Ama’n system thu hilhcian dan buai leh telhak pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is less common than “participating” and usually appears before a noun or after a linking verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih “telhak” khiatna pen “kihel” khiatna sangin kizang tawmzaw hi.

senses.heading: A strong metal
senses.definition_en: A common strong metal used to make steel, tools, machines and many other products.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sik leh vanzat, machine leh van nam tampi bawlna ding a kizang metal khauh khat.

examples.english: The gate is made of iron.
examples.zomi: Kongpi pen sik tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Iron is used to make steel.
examples.zomi: Steel bawlna dingin sik kizang hi.

senses.usage_en: Iron is uncountable when referring to the metal.
senses.usage_zomi: Metal a kawk ciangin iron pen simtheihlo min ahi hi.

senses.heading: A mineral needed by the body
senses.definition_en: A mineral the body needs to make healthy blood and carry oxygen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sisan cidam bawl leh oxygen puakna ding pumpi in a kisap mineral.

examples.english: Beans and meat are good sources of iron.
examples.zomi: Be leh sa pen iron ngahna hoih ahi hi.

examples.english: Low iron levels may cause tiredness.
examples.zomi: Pumpi sung iron tawmna in gimna piangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Nutritional iron is the same chemical element as the metal, but it is present in food and the body in very small amounts.
senses.usage_zomi: An leh pumpi sung iron pen metal tawh chemical element kibang ahi napi, zat tawmno bek in om hi.

senses.heading: An electrical appliance for pressing clothes
senses.definition_en: An electrical appliance with a heated flat surface used to remove folds from clothes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan kidokte mal sak dingin a sa lebel tawh a kizang meikhau vanzat.

examples.english: The iron is too hot.
examples.zomi: Puan malna iron sa lua hi.

examples.english: She bought a new steam iron.
examples.zomi: Ama’n tuihu iron thak khat lei hi.

senses.usage_en: The appliance is countable: an iron. The metal and nutritional mineral are normally uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Meikhau vanzat pen simtheih hi: an iron. Metal leh an sung mineral pen simtheihlo hi.

senses.definition_en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kim khempeuh tui in a um lei mun.

examples.english: The family lives on a small island.
examples.zomi: Innkuan pen tuikulh neu khat tungah teng hi.

examples.english: The island is surrounded by clear blue water.
examples.zomi: Tuikulh pen tui siangtho nisaan in um hi.

senses.usage_en: English normally says on an island, not in an island. The letter s in island is silent.
senses.usage_zomi: In an island ci loin on an island kici ngei hi. Island sung s pen ging nei lo hi.

senses.heading: An important subject or problem
senses.definition_en: A subject or problem that people are discussing, considering or trying to solve.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite a kikum, a ngaihsun ahih keileh a veng ding a hanciam thu ahih keileh buaina.

examples.english: Housing costs are a major issue in the city.
examples.zomi: Inn man pen khuapi sungah thu thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee discussed several environmental issues.
examples.zomi: Committee in kimlehpam tawh kisai thu tampi kikum hi.

senses.usage_en: Issue may neutrally mean a subject, but in everyday speech it often means a problem.
senses.usage_zomi: Issue in thulu khat bek kawk thei napi, nisim pau ah buaina cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: One edition of a newspaper or magazine
senses.definition_en: One copy or edition of a newspaper, magazine or journal published at a particular time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lai edition khat; laibu suah tum khat
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun kician khat in a kisuah newspaper, magazine ahih keileh journal edition khat.

examples.english: Her article appears in the latest issue of the magazine.
examples.zomi: Ama’ article magazine edition thakpen sungah om hi.

examples.english: I bought the October issue yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zanni in October kha edition ka lei hi.

senses.usage_en: In publishing, an issue is one dated release; a volume commonly contains several issues.
senses.usage_zomi: Lai suahna ah issue pen date nei suah tum khat ahi a, volume khat sungah issue tampi kihel thei hi.

senses.heading: A personal difficulty
senses.definition_en: A personal, emotional, medical or practical problem affecting someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a sukha mimal, lungsim, cidamna ahih keileh nuntakna buaina.

examples.english: He missed work because of health issues.
examples.zomi: Cidamna buaina hangin amah nasep kai theilo hi.

examples.english: The counselor helps students with personal issues.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhpa in sangnaupangte mimal buaina veng ding huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Issue may sound less direct or less negative than problem, but it should not hide the seriousness of a real problem.
senses.usage_zomi: Issue pen problem sangin a nemzaw bangin kizathei napi, buaina taktak’ thupitna phualna dingin zat loh hoih hi.

senses.definition_en: Information technology: the use and management of computers, software, networks and digital information.
senses.zomi_equivalents: information technology; computer leh digital pilna
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer, software, kizopna system leh digital thu a zatna leh a kepna pilna.

examples.english: Call the IT department if your computer stops working.
examples.zomi: Na computer nasem nawnlo leh IT department sam in.

examples.english: She works as an IT specialist.
examples.zomi: Ama’n IT siampa in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: IT is an abbreviation of information technology and is written with capital letters. Do not confuse it with the pronoun it.
senses.usage_zomi: IT pen information technology’ tomlakna ahi a, lai lian tawh kigelh hi. Pronoun lai neu it tawh khialh loh ding hi.

senses.heading: One object or product
senses.definition_en: One individual object or product, especially one in a group, list or store.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, laigual ahih keileh dawr sungah a om van khat ciat.

examples.english: Each item has a price label.
examples.zomi: Van khat ciat in man ciamtehna nei hi.

examples.english: She placed three items in her shopping cart.
examples.zomi: Ama’n a vanlei leng sungah van thum koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Item is a general countable word used when the exact type of object is not important or is already understood.
senses.usage_zomi: Item pen van nam kician a thupitloh ahih keileh kitheisa ciangin a kizang simtheih min tangpi ahi hi.

senses.heading: One subject on a list, agenda or news program
senses.definition_en: One separate subject, entry or piece of information in a list, agenda or program.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laigual, kikhopna thulu ahih keileh program sung thu khat ciat.

common_phrases.english: the first item on the list

examples.english: The committee discussed the first item on the agenda.
examples.zomi: Committee in kikhopna thulu masapen kikum hi.

examples.english: The news program included an item about education.
examples.zomi: News program sungah pilna tawh kisai thu khat kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: In a list or agenda, every separately numbered or named entry may be called an item.
senses.usage_zomi: Laigual ahih keileh kikhopna thulu sungah simna ahih keileh min tuam a nei angsung khat ciat item kici thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Used before a noun to show that something belongs to or is connected with an animal, object, organization, place or idea already mentioned.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat gan, van, kipawlna, mun ahih keileh ngaihsutna khat’ neih leh kizopna ahi cih lak dingin min ma ah a kizang kammal.

examples.english: The company changed its policy.
examples.zomi: Company in a thukhun khel hi.

examples.english: The dog moved its tail.
examples.zomi: Ui in a mei kawi hi.

senses.usage_en: Its shows possession and has no apostrophe. It’s is the shortened form of it is or it has.
senses.usage_zomi: Its in neihna lak a, apostrophe nei lo hi. It’s ahihleh it is ahih keileh it has’ tomlakna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Reflexive use
senses.definition_en: Used when an animal, object, organization, place or idea is both the subject and the object of an action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gan, van, kipawlna, mun ahih keileh ngaihsutna khat mah sepna khat’ subject leh object tegel a hih ciangin a kizang pronoun.

examples.english: The system protects itself from harmful software.
examples.zomi: System in software siatna pia pan amah leh amah kidal hi.

examples.english: The door closed by itself.
examples.zomi: Kong amah leh amah kikhak hi.

senses.usage_en: By itself can mean “alone,” “without help” or “automatically,” depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: By itself in “amah bek,” “huhna loin” ahih keileh “amah leh amah” cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Emphatic use
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize the particular animal, object, organization, place or idea being discussed.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen gan, van, kipawlna, mun ahih keileh ngaihsutna amah mah kipsakna.

examples.english: The building itself was not damaged.
examples.zomi: Inn amah mah kisiatlo hi.

examples.english: The idea itself is not new.
examples.zomi: Ngaihsutna amah mah a thak hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: In itself means considered alone, without considering its effects or surrounding circumstances.
senses.usage_zomi: In itself in a huzaap leh a kimlehpam omzia ngaihsun loin, tua na amah bek en cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A short coat worn on the upper body, usually with sleeves and an opening at the front.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tunglamah a kisilh, ban nei a, a malamah kihong thei puan tung silh tom.

examples.english: Wear a jacket because it is cold outside.
examples.zomi: Polam a vot manin jacket silh in.

examples.english: She hung her jacket behind the door.
examples.zomi: Ama’n a jacket kong nungah khai hi.

senses.usage_en: A jacket is usually shorter and lighter than a coat, though the distinction is not always exact.
senses.usage_zomi: Jacket pen coat sangin tomzaw leh zangzaw ngei napi, amau khenna kician teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: A sweet fruit spread
senses.definition_en: A sweet food made by cooking fruit with sugar, usually spread on bread.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gah leh khum huanin a kibawl, anlum tungah a kinuh anlum lim.

examples.english: She spread strawberry jam on the bread.
examples.zomi: Ama’n anlum tungah strawberry jam nu hi.

examples.english: We made jam from fresh fruit.
examples.zomi: Gah thak pan jam ka bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Jam is usually uncountable when referring to the food. A particular type may be called a jam in specialized contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: An a kawk ciangin jam pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei hi. Nam khat tuam a kawk ciangin a jam kici thei hi.

senses.heading: A blockage or crowded situation
senses.definition_en: A situation in which movement is stopped or slowed because too many people, vehicles or objects are crowded together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, mawtaw ahih keileh van a tamlua manin kiciingthei lo ahih keileh a kiciing manlo dinmun.

examples.english: We were late because of a traffic jam.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw kitawtna hangin ka manlo uh hi.

examples.english: The printer stopped because of a paper jam.
examples.zomi: Lai a awk manin printer khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A traffic jam involves vehicles. A paper jam occurs when paper becomes stuck inside a machine.
senses.usage_zomi: Traffic jam in mawtaw kitawtna kawk a, paper jam in machine sungah lai awkna kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: The first month of the year, following December and preceding February.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum khat’ kha masapen, December khit leh February ma kha.

examples.english: The new semester begins in January.
examples.zomi: Semester thak January kha in kipan hi.

examples.english: January is often cold in Ohio.
examples.zomi: Ohio ah January kha khuahun vot zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Month names begin with a capital letter in English. Use in January for the month and on January 10 for a specific date.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah kha min lai lian tawh kipan hi. Kha bek genna ah in January kizang a, date kician genna ah on January 10 kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A style of music that developed largely in African American communities and often features improvisation, strong rhythms and instruments such as trumpets and saxophones.
senses.explanation_zomi: African American mipawl lakah a khangto, a tum laitak in la bawl pahna, gingciat khauh leh trumpet, saxophone bang tumging vante a zang la nam.

examples.english: My father enjoys listening to jazz.
examples.zomi: Ka pa in jazz la ngai nuam sa hi.

examples.english: The band played jazz at the festival.
examples.zomi: La pawl in pawi ah jazz tum uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Jazz is normally uncountable when naming the musical style.
senses.usage_zomi: La nam a kawk ciangin jazz pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei hi.

senses.definition_en: Trousers made from strong cotton cloth called denim.
senses.explanation_zomi: Denim kici puan khauh tawh a kibawl zungbun.

examples.english: He wore a T-shirt and blue jeans.
examples.zomi: Ama’n T-shirt leh jeans nisaan silh hi.

examples.english: I need a new pair of jeans.
examples.zomi: Jeans zung thak khat ka kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Jeans is grammatically plural. Say a pair of jeans for one garment and two pairs of jeans for two.
senses.usage_zomi: Jeans pen grammar ah plural ahi hi. Puan zung khat adingin a pair of jeans, zung nih adingin two pairs of jeans ci in.

senses.definition_en: Decorative objects worn on the body, such as rings, necklaces, bracelets and earrings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zung, ngawnggual, khutgual leh bilbah bang pumpi kizepna ding a kisilh vante.

examples.english: She wore silver jewellery to the ceremony.
examples.zomi: Ama’n pawi ah ngun kizepna van silh hi.

examples.english: The shop sells handmade jewellery.
examples.zomi: Dawr in khut tawh a kibawl kizepna vante zuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Jewellery is the British spelling and is uncountable. American English uses jewelry. Say a piece of jewellery, not a jewellery.
senses.usage_zomi: Jewellery pen British English gelhdan leh simtheihlo min ahi hi. American English ah jewelry kici hi. A jewellery ci loin a piece of jewellery ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Regular paid work
senses.definition_en: Regular work that a person does to earn money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum ngahna dingin mi khat in zingsak tawh kisai a sep nasep.

examples.english: She found a new job at a hospital.
examples.zomi: Ama’n zatui inn ah nasep thak khat ngah hi.

examples.english: He applied for three jobs last week.
examples.zomi: Nipikal beisa ama’n nasep thum ngetna bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A job is a particular paid position. Work is a broader, usually uncountable word for effort or employment.
senses.usage_zomi: Job in sum ngahna dinmun khat kician kawk hi. Work in huamzaizaw a, nasep leh hanciamna genna simtheihlo min hi tam hi.

senses.heading: A particular task
senses.definition_en: A particular piece of work or task that needs to be completed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zawh ding a kisam nasep ahih keileh mawpuakna khat kician.

examples.english: You did a good job repairing the table.
examples.zomi: Dohkan na bawlhoihna ah nasep hoih na sem hi.

examples.english: Cleaning the entire house is a big job.
examples.zomi: Inn bup siansuah pen nasep lian khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Do a good job evaluates how well a task was performed; it does not necessarily refer to paid employment.
senses.usage_zomi: Do a good job in nasep khat bangzah hoih in kisem cih gen a, sum ngahna nasep hi teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: Become a member or participant
senses.definition_en: To become a member of a group or begin taking part in an activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat’ angsung mi suak ahih keileh gamtatna khat sungah kihel.

examples.english: She joined the school music club.
examples.zomi: Amah sang la club sungah kihel hi.

examples.english: Would you like to join us for dinner?
examples.zomi: Kote tawh nitak an ne khawm ding hong kihel nuam ni?

senses.usage_en: Use join a group or activity without in. Use join in when entering an activity already in progress.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawl ahih keileh gamtatna min ngiat tawh join kizang a, in kisamlo hi. A kipan khin gamtatna sungah kihelna ah join in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Connect two things
senses.definition_en: To connect or fasten two or more things together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na nih ahih keileh a tamzaw kizom a, lenkhawm.

examples.english: Join the two pieces of wood with screws.
examples.zomi: Sing angsung nih sikul tawh zom in.

examples.english: The two rivers join near the village.
examples.zomi: Gun nih khua gei ah kizom hi.

senses.usage_en: When two things meet naturally, English may use join intransitively: The roads join here.
senses.usage_zomi: Na nih amau leh amau a kizop ciangin object loin join kizang thei hi: The roads join here.

senses.heading: Something said or done to make people laugh
senses.definition_en: A funny story, remark or action intended to make people laugh.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nuihsak dingin a kigen tangthu, paukam ahih keileh a kisem gamtatna.

examples.english: He told a joke that made everyone laugh.
examples.zomi: Ama’n mi khempeuh a nuihsak nuihzat khat gen hi.

examples.english: I did not understand the joke.
examples.zomi: Nuihzat’ khiatna ka tel lo hi.

senses.usage_en: English says tell a joke, not normally say a joke.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah say a joke ci loin tell a joke kici ngei hi.

senses.heading: Something not serious
senses.definition_en: A situation, statement or action that is not intended to be taken seriously.
senses.explanation_zomi: A thupi in ngai ding a kingiimlo omzia, thugen ahih keileh gamtatna.

examples.english: Do not be angry; it was only a joke.
examples.zomi: Heh kei in; nuihzat bek ahi hi.

examples.english: Losing your passport abroad is no joke.
examples.zomi: Gamdang ah passport mansuah pen nuihzat hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: No joke means that something is serious, difficult or dangerous.
senses.usage_zomi: No joke in na khat a thupi, a haksa ahih keileh a lauhuai cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A personal written record
senses.definition_en: A personal record in which someone regularly writes about experiences, thoughts or activities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a phutkhakna, ngaihsutna leh gamtatna-te zingsak tawh kisai in a gelhna mimal ciamtehna.

examples.english: She writes in her journal every evening.
examples.zomi: Ama’n nitak sim a nisim ciamtehna laibu sungah gelh hi.

examples.english: He kept a journal during his journey.
examples.zomi: A khualzin laitak in ama’n khualzin ciamtehna gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: A personal journal is similar to a diary, though a journal may contain longer reflections rather than only daily events.
senses.usage_zomi: Mimal journal leh diary kinai hi. Ahihhang journal sungah nisim thu bek hilo in ngaihsutna thukzawte kihel thei hi.

senses.heading: An academic or professional publication
senses.definition_en: A publication containing serious articles or research in a particular academic or professional field.
senses.explanation_zomi: Academic ahih keileh nghề lam kician khat’ article leh thuzonna-te a huam laisuah.

examples.english: The research was published in a medical journal.
examples.zomi: Thuzonna pen siavuan pilna laisuah sungah kisuah hi.

examples.english: Students can access the journal online.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte’n journal online pan sim thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An academic journal differs from a general magazine because its articles are usually written by specialists and may be reviewed by other experts.
senses.usage_zomi: Academic journal pen magazine tangpi tawh kibanglo hi; a article-te mipilte in gelh a, pil dangte in sittel kik thei uh hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who collects, investigates, writes or reports news for newspapers, television, radio or online media.
senses.explanation_zomi: Newspaper, television, radio ahih keileh online media adingin news zong, sittel, gelh ahih keileh gen mi.

examples.english: The journalist interviewed local residents.
examples.zomi: News laigelhsia in khuamite interview hi.

examples.english: Journalists should check facts before publishing a story.
examples.zomi: News laigelhsiate’n news a suah ma un thu maan sittel kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A journalist reports or investigates news. A reporter is a type of journalist who commonly gathers and presents news directly.
senses.usage_zomi: Journalist in news gelh ahih keileh zong hi. Reporter pen news a kaikhawm a, mipite tungah ngiat takin a pulak journalist nam khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Travel from one place to another
senses.definition_en: The act of traveling from one place to another, especially over a considerable distance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat pan mun dang khat, a diakin gamla tak, a khualzinna.

examples.english: The journey took six hours.
examples.zomi: Khualzin nai guk sawt hi.

examples.english: We began our journey early in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsang nai in ka khualzin uh ka kipan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A journey refers to the act of traveling. A trip often includes the journey, the stay and the return.
senses.usage_zomi: Journey in mun khat pan mun dang khualzin gamtatna kawk hi. Trip in khualzin, mun dangah omna leh ciahkikna huam thei hi.

senses.heading: A process of personal development
senses.definition_en: A long process of change, learning, recovery or personal development.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhelna, sinna, damkikna ahih keileh mimal khantohna process sau.

examples.english: Recovery from illness was a long journey.
examples.zomi: Natna pan damkikna pen khualzin sau khat bang ahi hi.

examples.english: Education is a lifelong journey.
examples.zomi: Pilna sinna pen nuntak sung khualzin ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense compares personal change or development to traveling along a path.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in mimal kikhelna leh khantohna pen lampi tungah khualzin tawh tehkak hi.

senses.heading: Great happiness
senses.definition_en: A strong feeling of happiness and pleasure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungdamna leh lungnopna lian mahmah.

examples.english: The good news filled the family with joy.
examples.zomi: News hoih in innkuan lungdamna tawh dimsak hi.

examples.english: She cried tears of joy when her son returned.
examples.zomi: A tapa a ciahkik ciangin lungdam mitkhitui luang hi.

senses.usage_en: Joy is usually stronger and deeper than ordinary pleasure or momentary happiness.
senses.usage_zomi: Joy pen nopna ngeina ahih keileh lungdamna tomno sangin a thuk leh a lianzaw hi.

senses.heading: Something that causes happiness
senses.definition_en: A person, activity or experience that brings great happiness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungdamna lian a tungsak mi, gamtatna ahih keileh phutkhakna.

examples.english: Her grandchildren are a great joy to her.
examples.zomi: Ama’ tute pen ama adingin lungdamna lian ahi uh hi.

examples.english: Teaching children brings him great joy.
examples.zomi: Naupangte hilhna in amah lungdamna lian tungsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this countable sense, different sources or experiences of happiness may be called joys.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih simtheih khiatna ah lungdamna tungsak na tuamtuamte joys kici thei hi.

senses.heading: A legal official
senses.definition_en: An official who leads court proceedings and makes legal decisions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhenna zumpi a makaih a, thukhun tawh kituak khensatna a bawl official.

examples.english: The judge listened to evidence from both sides.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa in lamnih tegel pan teci ngai hi.

examples.english: The judge sentenced him to five years in prison.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa in amah kum nga thongkiat ding khensat hi.

senses.usage_en: A judge decides legal questions or sentences in court. A jury, where used, may decide questions of fact or guilt.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhenpa in thukhun thu leh gimthuakna khensat hi. Jury a kizangna munah amaute’n thu maan leh maw neihna khensat thei uh hi.

senses.heading: A person who decides a competition
senses.definition_en: A person who evaluates competitors and decides who should win.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidem mite’ sepsiamna a en a, kua mawhpoh ding cih a khensat mi.

examples.english: The judges selected three finalists.
examples.zomi: Thukhente’n a tawp dong tung mi thum teel uh hi.

examples.english: She served as a judge in the singing competition.
examples.zomi: Amah la sak kidemna ah thukhenpa in pang hi.

senses.usage_en: The same word is used for legal judges and people who decide contests; context identifies the meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhun thukhenpa leh kidemna thukhenpa tegel adingin judge kizang a, thu kizopna in a khiatna khen hi.

senses.heading: The ability to make sensible decisions
senses.definition_en: The ability to consider facts carefully and make sensible decisions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu maan limtak in ngaihsun a, khensatna pil leh kituak bawltheihna.

examples.english: She showed good judgement in a difficult situation.
examples.zomi: Omzia haksa sungah ama’n khensat siamtheihna hoih lak hi.

examples.english: Driving while tired shows poor judgement.
examples.zomi: Gim laitak mawtaw hawl pen khensat siamtheihna hoihlo ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Judgement involves evaluating information, not merely having an opinion.
senses.usage_zomi: Judgement in thu ngaihsun a, khensatna bawl cihna ahi a, ngaihsutna nei bek cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: An official court decision
senses.definition_en: A formal decision made by a court or judge.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhenna zumpi ahih keileh thukhenpa in official in a bawl khensatna.

examples.english: The court will deliver its judgement next week.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi in nipikal hong tung ciangin a khensatna pia ding hi.

examples.english: The company appealed the judgement.
examples.zomi: Company in thukhenna a sangzaw zumpi ah zongkik hi.

senses.usage_en: Judgement is the common British spelling. American English usually uses judgment, especially in legal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Judgement pen British English gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah, a diakin thukhun laigelh sungah, judgment kici tam hi.

senses.heading: An opinion or conclusion
senses.definition_en: An opinion or conclusion formed after considering available information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu omte ngaihsun khit ciangin a kibawl ngaihsutna ahih keileh khensatna.

examples.english: In my judgement, the plan is too expensive.
examples.zomi: Ka ngaihsutna bangin, geelna pen sum tamlua hi.

examples.english: We should hear both sides before making a judgement.
examples.zomi: Khensatna i bawl ma in lamnih tegel thu i ngai ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Pass judgement on someone may mean criticizing or deciding that person’s behavior is wrong.
senses.usage_zomi: Pass judgement on someone in mi khat gensia ahih keileh ama’ gamtatna khial ci in khensat cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Liquid from fruit or vegetables
senses.definition_en: Liquid naturally contained in or extracted from fruit or vegetables.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gah ahih keileh ante sungah a om ahih keileh a kisuan tui.

examples.english: She drank a glass of orange juice.
examples.zomi: Ama’n orange gahtui limlang hai khat dawn hi.

examples.english: This juice contains no added sugar.
examples.zomi: Hih gahtui sungah khum kibehlaplo hi.

senses.usage_en: Juice is usually uncountable. Say some juice or a glass of juice, not normally a juice.
senses.usage_zomi: Juice pen simtheihlo min ahi hi. A juice ci zaw loin some juice ahih keileh a glass of juice ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Liquid from meat or other food
senses.definition_en: The natural liquid released from meat or other food during preparation or cooking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sa ahih keileh an dang a bawl leh a huan laitak in a sua tui.

examples.english: Let the meat rest so that it keeps its juices.
examples.zomi: Satui sungah a om paisuakna dingin sa khawl sak in.

examples.english: Pour the cooking juices over the rice.
examples.zomi: Anhuan tui pen tangbu tungah sung in.

senses.usage_en: When referring to liquids from cooked food, the plural juices is common.
senses.usage_zomi: Anhuan pan a sua tui nam tuamtuam a kawk ciangin plural juices kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: The seventh month of the year, following June and preceding August.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum khat’ kha sagihna, June khit leh August ma kha.

examples.english: The festival will be held in July.
examples.zomi: Pawi pen July kha in kibawl ding hi.

examples.english: July is usually warm in Ohio.
examples.zomi: Ohio ah July kha khuahun sa zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Month names begin with a capital letter. Use in July but on July 4.
senses.usage_zomi: Kha minte lai lian tawh kipan hi. In July kici a, date kician ah on July 4 kici hi.

senses.heading: Push yourself off the ground
senses.definition_en: To push your body suddenly upward or forward using your legs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe zangin pumpi thakhat in a tunglam ahih keileh malamah sik.

examples.english: The child jumped over the puddle.
examples.zomi: Naupang in tuikhuk kantan in sik hi.

examples.english: He jumped into the swimming pool.
examples.zomi: Ama’n tuikulh sungah siklut hi.

senses.usage_en: Use jump over when crossing above something and jump into when entering a place by jumping.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a tung pan kantanna ah jump over kizang a, mun khat sungah siklutna ah jump into kizang hi.

senses.heading: Move suddenly because of surprise or fear
senses.definition_en: To make a sudden movement because something surprises or frightens you.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lau in sik; thakhat in kiciing
senses.explanation_zomi: Lamdang sakna ahih keileh launa hangin pumpi thakhat in kiciing.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat lausak in sik sak

examples.english: The loud noise made me jump.
examples.zomi: Ging lian in kei hong lausak a, ka sik hi.

examples.english: She jumped when the door suddenly opened.
examples.zomi: Kong thakhat in a kihon ciangin amah lau in sik hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes an automatic physical reaction rather than a deliberate jump.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in geelna tawh sik cihna hilo a, launa leh lamdang sakna hangin pumpi amah leh amah kiciing cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Increase suddenly
senses.definition_en: To rise or increase suddenly by a large amount.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, man ahih keileh dinmun thakhat in nakpi takin khang.

examples.english: Gas prices jumped last week.
examples.zomi: Nipikal beisa gas man thakhat in khang hi.

examples.english: The number of applications jumped by thirty percent.
examples.zomi: Ngetna simna za-a-sawmthum in khang hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use is common in news, finance and reports about numerical changes.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna pen news, sum vai leh simna kikhelna report ah kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: The sixth month of the year, following May and preceding July.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum khat’ kha gukna, May khit leh July ma kha.

examples.english: The course begins in June.
examples.zomi: Course June kha in kipan hi.

examples.english: They were married on June 15.
examples.zomi: Amaute June ni 15 in kiteng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Write month names with a capital letter. Use in June for the month and on June 15 for a specific date.
senses.usage_zomi: Kha min lai lian tawh gelh in. Kha bek genna ah in June, date kician genna ah on June 15 zang in.

senses.heading: Lower in rank or experience
senses.definition_en: Having a lower rank, less responsibility or less experience than someone else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang sangin dinmun niamzaw, mawpuakna tawmzaw ahih keileh phutkhakna tawmzaw nei.

examples.english: She began as a junior employee.
examples.zomi: Ama’n nasem dinmun niamzaw pan kipan hi.

examples.english: The junior staff report to the manager.
examples.zomi: Nasem dinmun niamzawte manager tungah report pia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The opposite of junior in rank is usually senior.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun a kawk ciangin junior’ langkhat pen senior ahi hi.

senses.heading: For younger people
senses.definition_en: Intended for or consisting of younger people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khangno ahih keileh naupangte ading a kibawl, ahih keileh amau a huam.

examples.english: He plays for the junior team.
examples.zomi: Ama’n khangno pawl adingin kimawl hi.

examples.english: The junior competition is open to players under sixteen.
examples.zomi: Khangnote kidemna pen kum sawmlehguk nuai kimawlte ading kihong hi.

senses.usage_en: Age limits for junior categories vary among schools, sports and organizations.
senses.usage_zomi: Sang, kimawlna leh kipawlna tuamtuam ah junior kum ciangtan kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: Younger than another person with the same name
senses.definition_en: Used after a person’s name to show that he has the same name as an older family member, usually his father.
senses.explanation_zomi: Upazaw innkuanpih, a diakin a pa tawh min kibang a nei pasalno khentelna dingin min nungah a kizang kammal.

examples.english: Martin Luther King Jr. was a civil-rights leader.
examples.zomi: Martin Luther King Jr. pen mihing’ thu-neihna makai khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The son uses “Junior” because he has his father’s name.
examples.zomi: Tapa in a pa’ min a neih manin “Junior” zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In American names, this is commonly abbreviated Jr. and written after the full name.
senses.usage_zomi: American minte ah Junior pen Jr. ci in tomlak a, min bup nungah kigelh zel hi.

senses.heading: Only
senses.definition_en: Only, simply or no more than.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bek; tua zah bek.

examples.english: I need just one more day.
examples.zomi: Ni khat bek ka kisam beh hi.

examples.english: It was just a joke.
examples.zomi: Nuihzat bek ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Just meaning “only” often comes immediately before the word or phrase it limits.
senses.usage_zomi: “Bek” a khiatna just pen a ciangtan kammal ahih keileh paukam mapah ah om ngei hi.

senses.heading: A very short time ago
senses.definition_en: A very short time before now or before another past time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun mapah ahih keileh hun beisa kician khat mapah.

examples.english: She has just arrived.
examples.zomi: Amah tu a hong tung hi.

examples.english: I had just sat down when the phone rang.
examples.zomi: Ka tutkhak phetin phone ging hi.

senses.usage_en: With the present perfect, just commonly appears between have/has and the past participle.
senses.usage_zomi: Present perfect ah just pen have/has leh past participle kikal ah om ngei hi.

senses.heading: Exactly
senses.definition_en: Exactly or precisely.
senses.zomi_equivalents: taktak; a maan in; kicing takin
senses.explanation_zomi: A kicing leh a maan taktak in.

examples.english: This size is just right for me.
examples.zomi: Hih size pen kei adingin kituak taktak hi.

examples.english: The meeting began just at nine.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna nai kua taktak in kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Context distinguishes just meaning “exactly” from just meaning “only.”
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizopna in just pen “taktak” maw “bek” maw cih khen hi.

senses.heading: Used to soften a request or statement
senses.definition_en: Used to make a request, question or statement sound less forceful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngetna, dotna ahih keileh thugenna khauh saklo dingin a kizang kammal.

examples.english: Could you just wait here for a moment?
examples.zomi: Hiteng tawlkhat hong ngak thei diam?

examples.english: I just wanted to ask one question.
examples.zomi: Dotna khat ka dong nuam bek hi.

senses.usage_en: This use can make speech sound polite, but tone still matters.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna in paukam nemzaw sak thei napi, aw ging leh pauzia zong thupi lai hi.

senses.heading: Fair and equal treatment
senses.definition_en: Fair treatment in which people receive their rights and are treated according to reasonable and equal standards.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite’n amau’ thu-neihna ngah a, a man leh a kibang thukhun tawh a kibawlna.

examples.english: The community demanded justice for the victims.
examples.zomi: Mipawl in thuakte ading thutang ngen hi.

examples.english: Justice requires that everyone be treated fairly.
examples.zomi: Thutang in mi khempeuh kibang takin kibawl ding kisam sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Justice concerns fairness, rights and accountability; it does not always mean treating every situation identically.
senses.usage_zomi: Justice in thuman, thu-neihna leh mawpuakna kawk hi. Omzia khempeuh kibang lian in bawl cihna hi teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: The legal system
senses.definition_en: The system of laws, courts and officials used to judge crimes and resolve legal disputes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhna thukhen leh thukhun kinialna vengna ding thukhun, zumpi leh official-te’ system.

examples.english: People must be able to trust the justice system.
examples.zomi: Mite’n thukhenna system muan thei ding uh hi.

examples.english: She works in criminal justice.
examples.zomi: Ama’n mawhna thukhenna lamah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: In legal contexts, justice may refer to courts, law enforcement, punishment and protection of rights.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhun lamah justice in zumpi, thukhun kemna, gimpiakna leh thu-neihna dalna huam thei hi.

senses.heading: Show that something is reasonable or right
senses.definition_en: To provide a good reason or evidence showing that an action, decision or belief is reasonable or right.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hang hilhcian; a man cih teci lak
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, khensatna ahih keileh upna khat a man leh a kituak ahihna lak dingin hang hoih ahih keileh teci pia.

common_phrases.zomi: a man cih hilhcian ding haksa

examples.english: The manager must justify the decision.
examples.zomi: Manager in khensatna’ hang hoih hilhcian kul hi.

examples.english: The benefits do not justify the high cost.
examples.zomi: Phattuamnate’n sumzat sang a kituak cih lak zo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Explaining why something happened does not always justify it. To justify means showing that it was reasonable, necessary or right.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat banghang piang cih hilhcian bek in tua na a man sak pahlo hi. Justify in a kituak, a kisam ahih keileh a man cih lak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Defend your own behavior
senses.definition_en: To give reasons intended to defend your own action or make it seem acceptable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na gamtatna dal ahih keileh sangtheih bangin musak dingin hangte gen.

examples.english: He tried to justify himself by blaming others.
examples.zomi: Ama’n midangte mawhsak in amah kimawhpaih ding hanciam hi.

examples.english: You do not need to justify your personal choice to everyone.
examples.zomi: Na mimal teelna mi khempeuh tungah kimawhpaih kullo hi.

senses.usage_en: Justify yourself can sound critical because it suggests that the person’s behavior needs defending.
senses.usage_zomi: Justify yourself pen mi khat’ gamtatna dal kisam bang a kawk manin, gensiatna bangin kizathei hi.

senses.heading: Very interested or eager
senses.definition_en: Very interested, enthusiastic or eager to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat lunglut mahmah a, sem ding lunggulh.

examples.english: She is keen to learn Zomi.
examples.zomi: Ama’n Zomi pau sin ding lunggulh hi.

examples.english: He is very keen on football.
examples.zomi: Ama’n football lunglut mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Use keen to do something or keen on something. This use is especially common in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Keen to do something ahih keileh keen on something cih gelhdan kizang hi. Hih zatna pen British English ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Sharp or highly developed
senses.definition_en: Very sharp, strong or able to notice small details.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hiam mahmah, a khauh ahih keileh thu neu dong theikha thei.

examples.english: The eagle has keen eyesight.
examples.zomi: Mupi in mitmu siam mahmah hi.

examples.english: She has a keen understanding of human behavior.
examples.zomi: Ama’n mihing gamtatna telna thuk leh hiam nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes senses or mental abilities that are unusually sharp and effective.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in pumpi theihna ahih keileh lungsim siamtheihna a hiam leh a hoih mahmah cih gen hi.

senses.heading: Continue to have or possess
senses.definition_en: To continue having something and not give, sell, return or throw it away.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat nei paisuak a, pia, zuak, ciahkik ahih keileh paikhia lo.

examples.english: Keep this document in a safe place.
examples.zomi: Hih lai mun bit ah kem in.

examples.english: You may keep the book for another week.
examples.zomi: Laibu nipikal khat na kem lai thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Keep often means continuing possession; hold usually means physically having something in the hand or arms.
senses.usage_zomi: Keep in na khat nei paisuak cihna nei tam a, hold in khut ahih keileh ban tawh len cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: Continue doing something
senses.definition_en: To continue doing something or do it repeatedly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sem paisuak ahih keileh sem zel.

examples.english: Keep practicing until you can do it well.
examples.zomi: Hoihtak na sep theih dong kisinna zom paisuak in.

examples.english: He kept asking the same question.
examples.zomi: Ama’n dotna kibang mah dong zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Use keep doing something, with an -ing form—not keep to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Keep doing something cih gelhdan tawh -ing form kizang hi. Keep to do something kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Maintain a condition
senses.definition_en: To cause someone or something to remain in a particular condition or position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat dinmun ahih keileh omzia kician khat ah omsak paisuak.

examples.english: Keep the windows closed during the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi laitak in limte kikhak in omsak in.

examples.english: This container keeps food fresh.
examples.zomi: Hih bawm in an thak in kem hi.

senses.usage_en: This pattern is keep + object + adjective or position phrase: keep the room clean.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gelhdan pen keep + object + adjective ahih keileh mun paukam ahi hi: keep the room clean.

senses.heading: Obey or honor something
senses.definition_en: To obey a promise, agreement, law or appointment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kamciam, thuciam, thukhun ahih keileh hun ciangtansa zui.

examples.english: She always keeps her promises.
examples.zomi: Ama’n a kamciam len tawntung hi.

examples.english: I could not keep my appointment with the doctor.
examples.zomi: Siavuan tawh ka ciangtansa hun ka zui zo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In these fixed expressions, keep means fulfill, obey or honor rather than physically retain.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih paukam kipte ah keep in van khat kem cihna hilo a, zui ahih keileh lenkip cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: An object used to open or lock something
senses.definition_en: A shaped piece of metal or an electronic device used to open or lock a door, vehicle or container.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kong, mawtaw ahih keileh bawm hon leh khakna ding a kizang sikvan ahih keileh electronic device.

examples.english: I cannot find my house key.
examples.zomi: Ka inn tawhpi ka mu theilo hi.

examples.english: She locked the door and put the key in her bag.
examples.zomi: Ama’n kong khak a, tawhpi a bawm sungah koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Key is countable: a key, two keys. A password or code may function as a digital key.
senses.usage_zomi: Key pen simtheih min ahi hi: a key, two keys. Password ahih keileh code zong digital tawhpi bangin kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: The answer or means of success
senses.definition_en: The most important means of understanding, solving or achieving something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tel, veng ahih keileh mawhpohna ngahna ding lampi thupipen.

examples.english: Regular practice is the key to improvement.
examples.zomi: Zingsak tawh kisai kisinna pen khantohna tawhpi ahi hi.

examples.english: Trust is the key to a strong relationship.
examples.zomi: Muanhuaina pen kizopna kip tawhpi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the key to something, not the key of something, when referring to a solution or means of success.
senses.usage_zomi: Dawnna ahih keileh mawhpohna lampi a kawk ciangin the key to something kizang a, the key of something kici lo hi.

senses.heading: A button on a keyboard or musical instrument
senses.definition_en: One of the buttons pressed on a computer keyboard, piano or similar device.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer keyboard, piano ahih keileh device dang tungah a kinil button khat.

examples.english: Press any key to continue.
examples.zomi: Zom paisuak dingin key khatpeuh nil in.

examples.english: The child learned the names of the piano keys.
examples.zomi: Naupang in piano key-te’ min sin hi.

senses.usage_en: Context distinguishes a locking key from a keyboard or piano key.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizopna in kong tawhpi leh keyboard ahih keileh piano key khen hi.

senses.heading: Computer keyboard
senses.definition_en: A set of keys used to type information or control a computer or other electronic device.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer ahih keileh electronic device tungah lai gelh leh thu pia ding a kizang key pawl.

examples.english: The keyboard is connected to the computer.
examples.zomi: Keyboard pen computer tawh kizom hi.

examples.english: She typed the report on her keyboard.
examples.zomi: Ama’n keyboard tawh report gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: A keyboard is used for typing; a mouse or touchpad is commonly used to move the pointer.
senses.usage_zomi: Keyboard pen lai gelhna dingin kizang a, mouse ahih keileh touchpad pen pointer kawi dingin kizang hi.

senses.heading: An electronic musical instrument
senses.definition_en: An electronic musical instrument played by pressing keys like those of a piano.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piano key bang key-te nil in a kitum electronic tumging van.

examples.english: He plays the keyboard in the church band.
examples.zomi: Ama’n pawlpi la pawl sungah keyboard tum hi.

examples.english: The keyboard can produce many different sounds.
examples.zomi: Keyboard in la ging nam tampi suah thei hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to the musical instrument, English commonly uses play the keyboard.
senses.usage_zomi: Tumging van a kawk ciangin English ah play the keyboard kici ngei hi.

senses.heading: Strike with the foot
senses.definition_en: To hit someone or something with the foot.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat khe tawh sat.

examples.english: She kicked the ball into the goal.
examples.zomi: Ama’n kawl pen goal sungah khe tawh satlut hi.

examples.english: The horse kicked the fence.
examples.zomi: Sakol in kulh khe tawh sat hi.

senses.usage_en: Kick describes striking with the foot. Hit is the broader verb for striking with a hand, object or body part.
senses.usage_zomi: Kick in khe tawh sat cihna ahi hi. Hit in khut, van ahih keileh pumpi angsung tawh sukna a huamzaizaw hi.

senses.heading: Move your legs suddenly or repeatedly
senses.definition_en: To move one or both legs suddenly or repeatedly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe khat ahih keileh tegel thakhat in ahih keileh munmun in kawi.

examples.english: The swimmer kicked his legs strongly.
examples.zomi: Tuiusia in a khe hat takin sep hi.

examples.english: The baby laughed and kicked.
examples.zomi: Naungek nui a, a khe kawi hi.

senses.usage_en: In swimming, kick means using the legs to move through the water.
senses.usage_zomi: Tuiusuahna ah kick in tui sungah kiciing dingin khe sep cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A child
senses.definition_en: A child or young person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Naupang ahih keileh khangno.

examples.english: The kids are playing in the garden.
examples.zomi: Naupangte huan sungah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: I loved reading when I was a kid.
examples.zomi: Ka naupan lai in laibu sim ka nuam sa mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Kid is informal. Use child in more formal writing or situations.
senses.usage_zomi: Kid pen informal ahi hi. Formal laigelh leh dinmunah child zang in.

senses.heading: A young goat
senses.definition_en: A young goat.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kelno.

examples.english: The goat stayed close to its kid.
examples.zomi: Kel pen a kelno gei ah om hi.

examples.english: Two kids were born on the farm.
examples.zomi: Loubuk ah kelno nih piang hi.

senses.usage_en: Context distinguishes informal kid meaning a child from the animal term meaning a young goat.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizopna in naupang a kawk kid leh kelno a kawk kid khen hi.

senses.heading: Cause death
senses.definition_en: To cause a person, animal or plant to die.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, gan ahih keileh singkung sisak.

examples.english: The disease killed thousands of people.
examples.zomi: Natna in mi tul tampi that hi.

examples.english: The accident killed two passengers.
examples.zomi: Aksident in khualzin mi nih sisak hi.

senses.usage_en: Kill states that an action or event caused death. Murder specifically means unlawfully and intentionally killing a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Kill in gamtatna ahih keileh thu piang khat in sihna piangsak cihna ahi hi. Murder ahihleh mi khat geelna tawh thukhun palsat in that cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Destroy or stop something completely
senses.definition_en: To destroy, end or stop something completely.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat susia, tawpsak ahih keileh nasep theilo sak.

examples.english: The cold weather killed the plants.
examples.zomi: Khuahun vot in singte sisak hi.

examples.english: One careless comment killed the friendly conversation.
examples.zomi: Kidawmlo paukam khat in kihouna lawmta tawpsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense may describe ending an activity, feeling, plan or machine operation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in gamtatna, lungsim omzia, geelna ahih keileh machine nasepna tawpsak cihna gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The act of causing a person or animal to die.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih keileh gan khat a thahna gamtatna.

examples.english: The court investigated the unlawful killing.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi in thukhun palsat thahna thu zong hi.

examples.english: Community leaders called for an end to the killing.
examples.zomi: Mipawl makaite’n thahna tawpsak ding ngen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Killing is a general term for causing death. More precise words such as murder, execution or slaughter depend on the circumstances.
senses.usage_zomi: Killing pen thahna a huamzaipen kammal ahi hi. Omzia bangin murder, execution ahih keileh slaughter bang kammal kicianzaw kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A metric unit of distance equal to 1,000 meters.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meter tul khat tawh a kikim gamla tehna metric unit.

examples.english: The school is two kilometres from our house.
examples.zomi: Sang pen ka inn uh pan kilometre nih gamla hi.

examples.english: We walked five kilometres this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsang kilometre nga ka pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Kilometre is the British spelling; American English uses kilometer. The abbreviation is km and does not take a plural -s.
senses.usage_zomi: Kilometre pen British English gelhdan ahi a, American English ah kilometer kici hi. A tomlakna km ahi a, plural -s kibehlaplo hi.

senses.definition_en: Caring about other people and willing to help or treat them gently.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte ngaihsak a, huh nuam leh nem takin bawl nuam.

examples.english: She was kind to the new student.
examples.zomi: Ama’n sangnaupang thak pen lungsim hoih takin bawl hi.

examples.english: Thank you for your kind words.
examples.zomi: Na kammal hoihte hangin ka lungdam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use kind to someone: She is kind to children. Kind of has a different meaning and belongs to the noun kind.
senses.usage_zomi: Kind to someone cih gelhdan kizang hi: She is kind to children. Kind of in khiatna dang nei a, noun kind tawh kisai hi.

senses.definition_en: A group or type of people or things that share similar qualities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Omzia kibang a nei mi ahih keileh na-te’ nam leh pawl.

examples.english: What kind of music do you like?
examples.zomi: La bang nam na deih hiam?

examples.english: The store sells many kinds of fruit.
examples.zomi: Dawr in gah nam tampi zuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use this kind of book but these kinds of books. In careful English, match singular and plural forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Singular ah this kind of book kici a, plural ah these kinds of books kici hi. Gelhdan kidawm ah singular leh plural kituak sak in.

senses.definition_en: A male ruler of a kingdom, usually receiving the position through a royal family.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi innkuan pan dinmun a ngah ngei, kumpigam khat a uk pasal.

examples.english: The king addressed the nation.
examples.zomi: Kumpipa in minam tungah thu gen hi.

examples.english: His son later became king.
examples.zomi: A tapa a nungciang in kumpipa suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a capital letter in an official title before a name: King Charles. Use lowercase for the general noun: the king.
senses.usage_zomi: Min ma official minpuan in a kizang ciangin lai lian zang in: King Charles. Min tangpi ah lai neu zang in: the king.

senses.definition_en: To touch someone or something with the lips as a sign of love, affection, greeting or respect.
senses.explanation_zomi: Itna, lainatna, chibai bukna ahih keileh zahtakna lak dingin mi ahih keileh na khat muk tawh suk.

examples.english: She kissed her child on the forehead.
examples.zomi: Ama’n a naupang tal tungah nam hi.

examples.english: He kissed his wife goodbye before leaving.
examples.zomi: A paikhiat ma in ama’n a zi paikhiatna in nam hi.

senses.usage_en: Cultural rules about kissing as a greeting differ. In some communities, it is intimate; in others, a cheek kiss is a common greeting.
senses.usage_zomi: Chibai bukna in kinamna ngeina mite’ ngeina bangin kilamdang hi. Mipawl pawlkhat ah itna ngiat tawh kisai a, pawlkhat ah biang tung kinamna ngeina ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A room or area where food is prepared and cooked.
senses.explanation_zomi: An a kibawl leh a kihuan na pindan ahih keileh mun.

examples.english: She is cooking dinner in the kitchen.
examples.zomi: Ama’n anhuan sungah nitak an huan hi.

examples.english: Please put the dishes in the kitchen.
examples.zomi: Ankuangte anhuan sungah koih in.

senses.usage_en: A kitchen is the place where food is prepared. A dining room is the room where meals are eaten.
senses.usage_zomi: Kitchen pen an bawl leh huanna mun ahi hi. Dining room ahihleh an nekna pindan ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The joint in the middle of the leg where the upper and lower parts meet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe tunglam leh khe nuailam a kizopna khe laizang khuah.

examples.english: He injured his knee while playing football.
examples.zomi: Football a kimawl laitak in ama’ khuk liam hi.

examples.english: Bend your knees when you lift the box.
examples.zomi: Bawm na dom ciangin na khukte kawisak in.

senses.usage_en: The initial k in knee is silent. The plural is knees.
senses.usage_zomi: Knee sung a kipatna k ging omlo hi. A plural pen knees ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A tool with a sharp blade and a handle, used for cutting food or other materials.
senses.explanation_zomi: An ahih keileh van dang satna ding a kizang, a hiam kam leh lenna a nei vanzat.

examples.english: Use a sharp knife to cut the vegetables.
examples.zomi: Ante sat dingin namta hiam zang in.

examples.english: Keep knives away from children.
examples.zomi: Namtate naupangte’ khut zawhlohna ah koih in.

senses.usage_en: The initial k is silent. The plural changes f to v: knife–knives.
senses.usage_zomi: Knife sung a kipatna k ging omlo hi. Plural ah f pen v in kikhel hi: knife–knives.

senses.heading: Hit a door to attract attention
senses.definition_en: To strike a door or surface with the hand so that someone notices or opens it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat theisak ahih keileh kong honsak dingin kong ahih keileh na tung khut tawh kiu.

examples.english: Someone is knocking on the door.
examples.zomi: Mi khat kong kiu hi.

examples.english: Please knock before entering.
examples.zomi: Na lut ma in kong kiu in.

senses.usage_en: English normally uses knock on/at the door, not knock the door, for attracting attention.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi theisakna ding kong kiu cihna ah knock on/at the door kici ngei a, knock the door kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Hit something accidentally or forcefully
senses.definition_en: To hit or strike someone or something, often accidentally.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat, a hun ciangin geelkhollosa in, suk.

examples.english: I knocked my knee against the table.
examples.zomi: Ka khuk dohkan tawh kituak hi.

examples.english: The dog knocked over the chair.
examples.zomi: Ui in tutna sutkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: Knock over means cause something or someone to fall. Knock down may mean make something fall or demolish it.
senses.usage_zomi: Knock over in na khat ahih keileh mi khat puk sak cihna ahi hi. Knock down in puk sak ahih keileh phiat cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Have information or understanding
senses.definition_en: To have information, understanding or certainty about someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat tawh kisai thu, telna ahih keileh kician theihna nei.

examples.english: Do you know the answer?
examples.zomi: Dawnna na thei hiam?

examples.english: I know that she is telling the truth.
examples.zomi: Ama’n thu maan gen cih ka thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Know describes a state of knowledge and is not normally used in continuous forms. Say I know, not I am knowing.
senses.usage_zomi: Know in theihna dinmun gen a, continuous form in kizang ngeilo hi. I am knowing ci loin I know ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Be familiar with a person or place
senses.definition_en: To be familiar with someone or something through experience or previous contact.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phutkhakna ahih keileh kimuhkhakna hangin mi ahih keileh mun khat thei.

examples.english: I have known her for ten years.
examples.zomi: Amah kum sawm sung ka thei khin hi.

examples.english: He knows the city very well.
examples.zomi: Ama’n khuapi hoihtak in thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Know someone means being familiar with the person. Know about someone means having information about the person without necessarily having met them.
senses.usage_zomi: Know someone in tua mi tawh kimeltheih cihna ahi hi. Know about someone in a thu thei napi, kimuh ngeilo zong hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Have learned how to do something
senses.definition_en: To have the knowledge or skill needed to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sep theihna ding theihna leh siamna nei.

examples.english: She knows how to use the software.
examples.zomi: Ama’n software zatdan thei hi.

examples.english: Do you know how to swim?
examples.zomi: Tui na usuah siam hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use know how to do something. Do not omit how before an infinitive in this structure.
senses.usage_zomi: Know how to do something cih gelhdan zang in. Hih gelhdan ah infinitive ma pan how pai sak kei in.

senses.heading: Information and understanding
senses.definition_en: Information, understanding and skills gained through education or experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna sinna ahih keileh phutkhakna pan a kingah thu theihna, telna leh siamna.

examples.english: Reading increases our knowledge of the world.
examples.zomi: Laibu simna in leitung tawh kisai i theihna khangsak hi.

examples.english: She shared her knowledge with younger workers.
examples.zomi: Ama’n a theihna nasem khangnote tawh khawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Knowledge is uncountable. Say some knowledge or a piece of information, not a knowledge in ordinary use.
senses.usage_zomi: Knowledge pen simtheihlo min ahi hi. Nisim zatna ah a knowledge ci loin some knowledge ahih keileh a piece of information ci ding hi.

senses.heading: Awareness of a particular fact or situation
senses.definition_en: Awareness that a particular fact, event or situation exists.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu maan, thu piang ahih keileh omzia kician khat om cih theihna.

examples.english: The decision was made without my knowledge.
examples.zomi: Khensatna pen ka theihloh in kibawl hi.

examples.english: To my knowledge, no one has complained.
examples.zomi: Ka theihzah in kuamah in mawhphutna nei nai lo hi.

senses.usage_en: To my knowledge means “as far as I know” and allows for the possibility that the speaker lacks some information.
senses.usage_zomi: To my knowledge in “ka theihzah in” cihna ahi a, paupa in thu pawlkhat theilo thei cihna a hawmsak hi.

senses.definition_en: A laboratory; a room or building equipped for scientific experiments, research, testing or practical study.
senses.explanation_zomi: Science sittelna, thuzonna, tehna ahih keileh khut tawh pilna sinna ding vanzat a kidim pindan leh inn.

examples.english: The students conducted an experiment in the science lab.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte’n science sittelna innah experiment bawl uh hi.

examples.english: The doctor sent the blood sample to the lab.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in sisan entawnna laboratory ah sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Lab is the common shortened form of laboratory. It is acceptable in ordinary conversation and much professional writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Lab pen laboratory’ tomlakna kizang tampen ahi hi. Nisim kihouna leh nghề laigelh tampi ah zat theih hi.

senses.heading: A piece of material giving information
senses.definition_en: A piece of paper, cloth or other material attached to something to give its name, contents, price or instructions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat’ min, a sungah a omte, man ahih keileh thuhilhna a kigelh, tua na tungah a kibehlap lai ahih keileh puan.

examples.english: Read the label before taking the medicine.
examples.zomi: Damdawi na dawn ma in label sim in.

examples.english: The price is printed on the label.
examples.zomi: Man pen ciamtehna lai tungah kigelh hi.

senses.usage_en: A label provides brief identifying or instructional information. Detailed directions may appear elsewhere.
senses.usage_zomi: Label in theihkhiatna leh thuhilhna tom pia hi. Thuhilhna kicing pen mun dangah om thei hi.

senses.heading: A word used to classify someone or something
senses.definition_en: A name or expression used to place someone or something into a particular category.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat pawl ahih keileh nam kician khat sungah koihna ding a kizang min leh paukam.

examples.english: He rejected the political label others gave him.
examples.zomi: Midangte’n amah a gamvai minsakna ama’n sanglo hi.

examples.english: Labels can oversimplify a person’s identity.
examples.zomi: Minsaknate’n mi khat’ hina baih lua in lak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Labels may be useful for classification, but they can be unfair when they ignore individual differences.
senses.usage_zomi: Minsaknate pawl khentelna ah phattuam thei napi, mimal kilamdanna ngaihsaklo leh thumanlo thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A room or building equipped for scientific experiments, research, testing or practical study.
senses.explanation_zomi: Science experiment, thuzonna, sittelna leh khut tawh pilna sinna ding vanzat a kidim pindan ahih keileh inn.

examples.english: The samples were examined in a laboratory.
examples.zomi: Entawnna-te laboratory sungah kisittel hi.

examples.english: Only trained staff may enter the laboratory.
examples.zomi: Sinsaksa nasemte bek laboratory sungah lut thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Laboratory is often shortened to lab. Different laboratories may specialize in science, medicine, computers or language learning.
senses.usage_zomi: Laboratory pen lab ci in kitomlak zel hi. Laboratory-te science, siavuan pilna, computer ahih keileh pau sinna lamah siam tuam thei uh hi.

senses.heading: Physical or mental work
senses.definition_en: Work, especially work requiring considerable physical or mental effort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi ahih keileh lungsim tha tampi a kisam nasep.

examples.english: Building the road required months of hard labour.
examples.zomi: Lampi bawlna in kha tampi sung nasep haksa kisam hi.

examples.english: The total cost includes materials and labour.
examples.zomi: Sumzat bup sungah van leh nasem thaman kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: Labour is the British spelling. American English uses labor.
senses.usage_zomi: Labour pen British English gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah labor kici hi.

senses.heading: Workers as a group
senses.definition_en: Workers considered as a group, especially those doing physical or industrial work.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diakin khut nasep leh factory nasep a sem nasemte a vekpi in ngaihna.

examples.english: The industry needs more skilled labour.
examples.zomi: Van bawlna in nasem siam tampizaw kisam hi.

examples.english: The country’s labour force is growing.
examples.zomi: Gam’ nasem pawl bup khang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this collective sense, labour refers to workers or their work capacity, not one individual worker.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pawl a huam khiatna ah labour in nasemte ahih keileh amau nasep tha kawk a, nasem khat bek kawklo hi.

senses.heading: Childbirth
senses.definition_en: The physical process in which a woman gives birth to a baby.
senses.zomi_equivalents: naungek neihna; nau nei ding natna
senses.explanation_zomi: Numei khat in naungek a neih laitak pumpi process leh na thuakna.

examples.english: She went into labour early in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsang nai in ama’ nau nei ding natna kipan hi.

examples.english: A nurse stayed with her throughout labour.
examples.zomi: Nau neihna hun sung nurse khat ama tawh om hi.

senses.usage_en: This medical sense is normally uncountable: in labour, not in a labour.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih siavuan lam khiatna pen simtheihlo ahi hi: in labour kici a, in a labour kici lo hi.

senses.definition_en: The absence of something needed or the condition of not having enough of it.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisam na khat omlo ahih keileh kicinglo dinmun.

examples.english: The project stopped because of a lack of funding.
examples.zomi: Sum huhna kicinglo manin project khawl hi.

examples.english: A lack of sleep can affect your health.
examples.zomi: Ihmut kicinglohna in na cidamna sukha thei hi.

senses.usage_en: The normal pattern is a lack of something. As a verb, use lack something without of: The report lacks evidence.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun gelhdan pen a lack of something ahi hi. Verb ahihleh of loin lack something kici hi: The report lacks evidence.

senses.heading: A woman
senses.definition_en: A woman, especially when referred to politely or respectfully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Numei khat, a diakin zahmawh leh zahtak takin a kigen.

examples.english: An elderly lady asked me for directions.
examples.zomi: Numei upa khat in lampi hong dong hi.

examples.english: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the program.
examples.zomi: Numeite leh pasalte, program ah hong pai uh.

senses.usage_en: Lady may sound polite, but woman is usually the neutral adult term. Tone and context matter.
senses.usage_zomi: Lady pen zahmawh bangin kizathei napi, numei picing a kawk kammal neutral pen woman ahi hi. Pauzia leh thu kizopna thupi hi.

senses.heading: A woman of polite or refined behavior
senses.definition_en: A woman regarded as polite, well-mannered or socially respectable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zahmawh, ngeina hoih nei ahih keileh mipite lakah kizahtak numei.

examples.english: She was known as a kind and generous lady.
examples.zomi: Amah numei lungsim hoih leh piakhia nuam in kithei hi.

examples.english: The lady welcomed every guest warmly.
examples.zomi: Numeinu in leng khempeuh lungdam takin sang hi.

senses.usage_en: This traditional sense can reflect cultural expectations about women, so use it thoughtfully.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih ngeina lui khiatna in numeite tungah mipawl’ lam-etna kawk thei ahih manin kidawm takin zat ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A large area of water surrounded by land.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kim khempeuh lei in a um tui lian.

examples.english: They built a cabin beside the lake.
examples.zomi: Amaute’n dil gei ah innneu khat lam uh hi.

examples.english: The lake freezes during winter.
examples.zomi: Phalbi sungin dil tui khal hi.

senses.usage_en: A lake is surrounded by land. An island is land surrounded by water.
senses.usage_zomi: Dil pen lei in a um tui ahi hi. Tuikulh ahihleh tui in a um lei ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A device that produces light, usually by electricity, oil or gas.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meikhau, situi ahih keileh gas zangin khuavak a piangsak vanzat.

examples.english: She turned on the lamp beside the bed.
examples.zomi: Ama’n lupna gei meivak taan hi.

examples.english: The oil lamp gave us enough light to read.
examples.zomi: Situi meivak in lai simna ding khuavak kicing hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A lamp is a light-producing device. In everyday American English, a fixed ceiling light is usually called a light, not a lamp.
senses.usage_zomi: Lamp pen khuavak piangsak vanzat ahi hi. American English nisim pau ah innkhum tawh a kiphut khuavak pen light kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: The solid surface of the earth
senses.definition_en: The solid part of the earth’s surface, as opposed to water.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui hilo leitung’ lei khauh angsung.

examples.english: The boat finally reached land.
examples.zomi: Tembaw a tawpna ah lei tung hi.

examples.english: Some animals live both on land and in water.
examples.zomi: Gan pawlkhat lei tung leh tui sung tegel ah nungta uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this general meaning, land is usually uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Lei pumpi a kawk hih khiatna ah land pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: Ground owned or used for a purpose
senses.definition_en: An area of ground, especially one that is owned, farmed or used for building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ neih, lou bawlna ahih keileh inn lamna ding a kizang lei mun.

examples.english: The family owns ten acres of farmland.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in loubawlna lei acre sawm nei hi.

examples.english: The city bought land for a new school.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in sang thak lamna ding lei mun lei hi.

senses.usage_en: Land remains uncountable here. Say a piece of land, not normally a land.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah zong land simtheihlo hi. A land ci loin a piece of land ci ding hi.

senses.heading: A country or region
senses.definition_en: A country, region or territory, especially when described emotionally or in literature.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam, gamhuam ahih keileh leigam khat, a diakin lungsim leh laigelh pauzia tawh a kigen.

examples.english: They dreamed of returning to their native land.
