examples.zomi: Amaute’n amau pianpih gam ciahkik ding ngimang uh hi.

examples.english: The story takes place in a distant land.
examples.zomi: Tangthu pen gam gamla khat ah piang hi.

senses.usage_en: This literary sense is more emotional or poetic than the ordinary word country.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih laigelh leh lawngpau khiatna pen country kammal ngeina sangin lungsim kizopna nei zaw hi.

senses.heading: The visible features of an area
senses.definition_en: Everything visible across a wide area of land, including hills, fields, water, buildings and vegetation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamzaipi khat ah a kimu mual, lou, tui, inn leh singkungte a vekpi.

examples.english: The mountain landscape was beautiful.
examples.zomi: Mual gam khuamuh hoih mahmah hi.

examples.english: New buildings changed the city’s landscape.
examples.zomi: Inn thakte’n khuapi gammel khelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Landscape refers to the overall appearance of an area, not one single object within it.
senses.usage_zomi: Landscape in gamzaipi khat’ khuamuh bup kawk a, a sung van khat bek kawklo hi.

senses.heading: A picture of natural scenery
senses.definition_en: A painting, photograph or drawing showing a wide view of natural scenery.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piansaksa gam khuamuh zaipi a lak kisuut lim, photograph ahih keileh kigelh lim.

examples.english: The artist painted a peaceful landscape.
examples.zomi: Limsuutpa in gam khuamuh dai khat suut hi.

examples.english: She specializes in landscape photography.
examples.zomi: Ama’n gam khuamuh limlaakna siam tuam hi.

senses.usage_en: In document or screen layout, landscape may also mean a horizontal orientation wider than it is tall.
senses.usage_zomi: Document ahih keileh screen layout ah landscape in a zai sangin a sanna niamzaw horizontal lim zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: A system of communication
senses.definition_en: A system of spoken, written or signed words and rules used by a particular community for communication.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipawl khat in kihouna ding a zat kam tawh, lai tawh ahih keileh khut lim tawh a kibawl kammal leh grammar system.

examples.english: Zomi is the language spoken in her home.
examples.zomi: Ama’ inn sungah Zomi pau kizang hi.

examples.english: Learning another language takes time and practice.
examples.zomi: Pau dang khat sinna in hun leh kisinna kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Language names are capitalized in English: English, Zomi, Burmese.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah pau minte lai lian tawh kipan hi: English, Zomi, Burmese.

senses.heading: A particular style of words or expression
senses.definition_en: The words and style used in a particular situation, profession or piece of writing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, nghề ahih keileh laigelh khat sungah a kizang kammal leh pauzia.

examples.english: The report uses clear and simple language.
examples.zomi: Report in pau kician leh baih zang hi.

examples.english: Legal language can be difficult to understand.
examples.zomi: Thukhun pauzia tel ding haksa thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, language means wording or style, not a separate language such as English or Zomi.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah language in kammal zatdan leh pauzia kawk a, English leh Zomi bang pau tuam khat kawklo hi.

senses.definition_en: A small portable computer that folds closed and can be used on a person’s lap.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhup thei a, mun tuamtuam ah puak theih, mi’ phekuam tungah zong zat theih computer neu.

examples.english: She uses a laptop for her online classes.
examples.zomi: Ama’n online class-te adingin laptop zang hi.

examples.english: My laptop battery is almost empty.
examples.zomi: Ka laptop battery beikuan hi.

senses.usage_en: A laptop is portable and has a built-in screen and keyboard. A desktop computer is normally used in one fixed place.
senses.usage_zomi: Laptop pen puaktheih a, screen leh keyboard a sung mahah nei hi. Desktop computer pen mun khat ah koih kip in kizang ngei hi.

senses.definition_en: Greater than usual in size, amount, number or extent.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina sangin pumpi, zat, simna ahih keileh huam a lianzaw.

examples.english: A large crowd gathered outside.
examples.zomi: Polam ah mipi tampi kikaikhawm hi.

examples.english: The company owns a large building.
examples.zomi: Company in inn lian khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Large is slightly more formal than big. Both may describe size, but some fixed expressions use only one naturally.
senses.usage_zomi: Large pen big sangin formal tawm hi. Tegel in lian cihna gen napi, paukam kip pawlkhat ah khat bek kizang ngei hi.

senses.definition_en: Mainly, mostly or to a great extent.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tamzaw in; a bulpi in
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in; a bulpi in; a huamzaipi in.

examples.english: The town’s economy depends largely on tourism.
examples.zomi: Khua’ sum vai pen a tamzaw in khualzin business tungah kinga hi.

examples.english: The plan remained largely unchanged.
examples.zomi: Geelna pen a tamzaw kikhello in om hi.

senses.usage_en: Largely usually means “mostly”; it does not normally mean “in a physically large way.”
senses.usage_zomi: Largely in “a tamzaw in” cihna nei ngei a, pumpi lian takin cihna nei ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: After the expected or arranged time
senses.definition_en: Arriving, happening or being done after the expected, usual or agreed time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kilam-et, ngeina ahih keileh ciangtansa hun khit zaw in hong tung ahih keileh kisem.

examples.english: I was late for work this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsang nasep ah ka manlo hi.

examples.english: The train is twenty minutes late.
examples.zomi: Meileng minute sawmnih manlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use late for an event or activity and late to some meetings or classes: late for work, late to class.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawi leh gamtatna tawh late for kizang a, class leh kikhopna pawlkhat tawh late to kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Near the end of a period
senses.definition_en: Happening near the end of a day, period, season or stage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni, hun, khuahun ahih keileh dinmun khat’ tawpna lamah a piang.

examples.english: We arrived in the late afternoon.
examples.zomi: Nitaklam in ka hong tung uh hi.

examples.english: The law changed in the late twentieth century.
examples.zomi: Kum za sawmnihna tawplam in thukhun kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, late does not mean delayed; it means near the end of the stated period.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah late in manlo cihna hilo a, hun tawplam cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: No longer living
senses.definition_en: Used before a person’s name or description to show that the person has died.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat si khin cih lak dingin a min ahih keileh a dinmun ma ah a kizang.

examples.english: Her late husband was a teacher.
examples.zomi: Ama’ pasal sihsa pen sia ahi hi.

examples.english: The building was named after the late president.
examples.zomi: Inn pen president sihsa’ min tawh kiphua hi.

senses.usage_en: This respectful use appears before a name or relationship noun. It does not mean that the person was habitually unpunctual.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zahtakna zatna pen min ahih keileh kizopna min ma ah om hi. Tua mi hun manlo ngei cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: At a future time
senses.definition_en: At a time after now or after the time being discussed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun khit ahih keileh a kigen hun khit ciangin.

examples.english: I will call you later.
examples.zomi: A nungciang in kong sam ding hi.

examples.english: Two weeks later, the results arrived.
examples.zomi: Nipikal nih khit ciangin gahsuah hong tung hi.

senses.usage_en: Later means after a stated or understood time. Latter refers to the second of two people or things and has a different meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Later in hun khit ciang cihna ahi hi. Latter ahihleh mi ahih keileh na nih lakah a nihna kawk a, a khiatna kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: Toward the end of a period
senses.definition_en: At a more advanced point within a period or process.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tawplam ah; a nungzaw in
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ahih keileh process khat sungah a tawplam naizaw in.

examples.english: We discussed the problem later in the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna a nungzaw in buaina ka kikum uh hi.

examples.english: He became a writer later in life.
examples.zomi: A nuntakna nungzaw in laigelhsia suak hi.

senses.usage_en: This use places something within the later part of a larger period.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna in na khat hun lianzaw sung tawplam naizaw ah a om cih lak hi.

senses.heading: Most recent
senses.definition_en: Most recent or newest.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun tawh a naipen, a thakpen ahih keileh a nungpen.

examples.english: Have you heard the latest news?
examples.zomi: News thakpen na za hiam?

examples.english: Please install the latest version of the software.
examples.zomi: Software version thakpen install in.

senses.usage_en: Latest usually means most recent, not necessarily best or most advanced.
senses.usage_zomi: Latest in a thakpen cihna ahi a, a hoihpen ahih keileh a sangpen cihna hi teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: No later than a stated time
senses.definition_en: Used to identify the last acceptable time.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sangpen in hun ciangtansa khat ma ah; tua hun khit lo in.

examples.english: Please send the form by Friday at the latest.
examples.zomi: Form pen a sawtpen Friday ni in hong sawl in.

examples.english: The package should arrive tomorrow at the latest.
examples.zomi: Parcel pen a sawtpen zingciang hong tung ding hi.

senses.usage_en: At the latest sets the final deadline; an earlier time is acceptable.
senses.usage_zomi: At the latest in hun ciangtan nunungpen koih a, tua ma in zawh zong sangtheih hi.

senses.definition_en: To make sounds and facial movements that show amusement, happiness or sometimes nervousness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuam kisakna, lungdamna ahih keileh a hun ciangin lungbuaina lakin aw leh maitang tawh nui.

examples.english: Everyone laughed at his joke.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh ama’ nuihzat hangin nui uh hi.

examples.english: The children laughed and played together.
examples.zomi: Naupangte nui a, kimawl khawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Laugh at a joke means find it funny. Laugh at someone may mean mock that person and can be hurtful.
senses.usage_zomi: Laugh at a joke in nuihzat nuihhuai sa cihna ahi hi. Laugh at someone in mi khat simmawh in nui cihna hi thei a, a lungsim nasak thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The sound or act of laughing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuihna gamtatna ahih keileh nui ging.

examples.english: The room was filled with laughter.
examples.zomi: Pindan sung nui ging tawh kidim hi.

examples.english: Her story caused a burst of laughter.
examples.zomi: Ama’ tangthu in mi thakhat in nuihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Laughter is normally uncountable. The verb is laugh.
senses.usage_zomi: Laughter pen simtheihlo min ahi hi. A verb pen laugh ahi hi.

senses.heading: Introduce a new product, project or campaign
senses.definition_en: To officially start or make a new product, project, service or campaign available.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, project, nasepna ahih keileh campaign thak official in kipan sak ahih keileh mipite zat dingin pia.

examples.english: The company launched a new phone.
examples.zomi: Company in phone thak khat zuak kipan hi.

examples.english: The city launched a public-health campaign.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in mipi cidamna campaign kipan sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Launch emphasizes an official or public beginning.
senses.usage_zomi: Launch in official leh mipi theihna tawh kipatna kipsak hi.

senses.heading: Send a rocket, spacecraft or object into motion
senses.definition_en: To send a rocket, spacecraft, missile, ship or other object into the air, space, water or motion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Rocket, vanleng, missile, tembaw ahih keileh van khat huihlak, vantung, tui ahih keileh kiciingna ah sawlkhia.

examples.english: The agency launched a satellite into space.
examples.zomi: Agency in satellite vantung zaipi ah sawlkhia hi.

examples.english: They launched the boat from the beach.
examples.zomi: Amaute’n tembaw tuigei pan tui sungah khiasak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: What is launched depends on context: a product begins publicly, while a rocket is physically sent upward.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizopna bangin a kilaunch na kilamdang hi: van thak pen mipite lakah kipan a, rocket pen a tunglamah kithakhia hi.

senses.heading: Begin a strong action or attack
senses.definition_en: To begin a major action, investigation, protest or attack.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna lian, thu zonna, langdona ahih keileh galzawhna khat thahat takin kipan.

examples.english: Police launched an investigation into the incident.
examples.zomi: Police-te’n thu piang tawh kisai thu zonna kipan uh hi.

examples.english: The group launched a peaceful protest.
examples.zomi: Pawl in lungmuang takin langdona kipan sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal use is common in news and official reports.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal zatna pen news leh official report-te ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: A rule established by government
senses.definition_en: An official rule made and enforced by a government or legal authority.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi ahih keileh thukhun thuneipa in a bawl a, a zuih ding a kimawl official thukhun.

examples.english: The government passed a new safety law.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in bitna thukhun thak khat phal hi.

examples.english: No one is above the law.
examples.zomi: Kuamah thukhun sangah omlo hi.

senses.usage_en: A law is legally enforceable. A rule may apply only within a school, organization, game or household.
senses.usage_zomi: Law pen thukhun tha tawh kizuihsak hi. Rule ahihleh sang, kipawlna, kimawlna ahih keileh innkuan sung bekah kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: The legal system or subject
senses.definition_en: The system of rules and courts governing society, or the academic and professional study of that system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipawl a uk thukhunte leh thukhenna zumpite’ system, ahih keileh tua system tawh kisai pilna leh nghề.

examples.english: She is studying law at university.
examples.zomi: Ama’n university ah thukhun pilna sin hi.

examples.english: He has practiced law for twenty years.
examples.zomi: Ama’n kum sawmnih sung siampi nasep sem hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to the academic subject or profession, law is normally uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna leh nghề a kawk ciangin law pen simtheihlo min in kizang ngei hi.

senses.heading: A scientific principle
senses.definition_en: A general statement describing a consistent natural or scientific relationship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piansaksa ahih keileh science kizopna a kibang tawntung a hilhcian thu bulpi.

examples.english: Gravity follows consistent laws of nature.
examples.zomi: Leitung huupna in piansaksa thukhun kipte zui hi.

examples.english: Students learned Newton’s laws of motion.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte’n Newton’ kiciingna thukhunte sin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A scientific law describes a regular pattern; it is not a command made by government.
senses.usage_zomi: Science thukhun in omzia kip khat hilhcian a, kumpi in a bawl thupiak hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person trained and legally qualified to advise people about law or represent them in legal matters.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite thukhun thu a hilh a, thukhun tawh kisai thu ah amau aiawh dingin a kisinsak leh phalna a nei mi.

examples.english: She spoke to a lawyer before signing the agreement.
examples.zomi: Thuciam lai a gelh ma in ama’n siampi khat tawh kihou hi.

examples.english: The lawyer represented him in court.
examples.zomi: Siampi in thukhenna zumpi ah amah aiawh hi.

senses.usage_en: Legal job titles vary by country. Terms such as attorney, solicitor and barrister may have different legal meanings.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam tuamtuam ah thukhun nghề min kilamdang hi. Attorney, solicitor leh barrister in thukhun khiatna tuam nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Put something down carefully
senses.definition_en: To put someone or something down in a flat or careful position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat lei, dohkan ahih keileh mun khat tungah zanin ahih keileh kidawm takin koih.

common_phrases.english: lay the book on the table

examples.english: Lay the papers on my desk.
examples.zomi: Laite ka dohkan tungah koih in.

examples.english: She gently laid the baby in the bed.
examples.zomi: Ama’n naungek lupna tungah nem takin koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Lay requires an object: lay the book down. Its forms are lay–laid–laid. Lie meaning recline has no object: lie down; its forms are lie–lay–lain.
senses.usage_zomi: Lay in object kisam hi: lay the book down. A forms pen lay–laid–laid ahi hi. “Zan” a khiatna lie in object kisamlo hi: lie down; a forms pen lie–lay–lain ahi hi.

senses.heading: Produce eggs
senses.definition_en: For a bird, insect, fish or other animal to produce eggs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vasa, ganneu, ngasa ahih keileh gan dang in tui nei.

examples.english: The hen lays one egg each day.
examples.zomi: Aknu in ni khat tui khat nei hi.

examples.english: Sea turtles lay their eggs on beaches.
examples.zomi: Tuipi lai-te’n tuigei ah tui nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Animals lay eggs; they do not normally give birth to eggs.
senses.usage_zomi: Ganhingte’n lay eggs uh a, tui pen give birth kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Prepare or establish something
senses.definition_en: To prepare, establish or arrange something as a basis for future action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam gamtatna ding bulpi bawl, kiging sak ahih keileh geelkhia.

examples.english: Education lays the foundation for future success.
examples.zomi: Pilna in mailam mawhpohna ding a bulphuh hi.

examples.english: The agreement laid the groundwork for peace.
examples.zomi: Thuciam in kilemna ding bulpi bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use commonly appears in fixed expressions such as lay the foundation and lay the groundwork.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna pen lay the foundation leh lay the groundwork bang paukam kipte sungah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: One thickness of material
senses.definition_en: One level or thickness of material lying over, under or between other material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van dang tung, nua ahih keileh kikal ah a om van pat khat.

examples.english: A thin layer of ice covered the road.
examples.zomi: Gawlkhal pat neem in lampi khuh hi.

examples.english: Apply a second layer of paint.
examples.zomi: Meel pat nihna nuh in.

senses.usage_en: A layer is one level within a stack or covering. Multiple layers lie over or within one another.
senses.usage_zomi: Layer pen a kituankhawm ahih keileh a kikhuh na sung dinmun khat ahi hi. Pat tampi khat tung khat in om thei hi.

senses.heading: A level within a system or organization
senses.definition_en: One level within a complex system, structure or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: System, kibawlzia ahih keileh kipawlna telhak khat sung dinmun khat.

examples.english: The system uses several layers of security.
examples.zomi: System in bitna pat tampi zang hi.

examples.english: The company removed one layer of management.
examples.zomi: Company in ukna dinmun khat paikhia hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes separate levels that work together within a larger whole.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in na bup lianzaw sung a nasemkhawm dinmun tuamtuamte gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Unwilling to work, make an effort or be active.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasem, hanciam ahih keileh kiciing nuamlo.

examples.english: He is not lazy; he is exhausted.
examples.zomi: Amah thadah hilo a, gimlua ahi hi.

examples.english: I felt lazy and stayed home all day.
examples.zomi: Ka semnuamlo a, ni khitui innah ka om hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling someone lazy can be judgmental. Tiredness, illness, disability or lack of resources should not automatically be treated as laziness.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat lazy cih pen simmawhna hi thei hi. Gimna, natna, pumpi zawhlohna ahih keileh neihsa kicinglohna pen thadahna in ngaih pah loh ding hi.

senses.heading: Guide people toward a place
senses.definition_en: To guide or go in front of someone, showing the way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh pawl khat’ ma ah pai a, lampi lak.

examples.english: A guide led us through the forest.
examples.zomi: Lampi lakpa in gamlak kantanin hong makaih hi.

examples.english: She led the visitors to the meeting room.
examples.zomi: Ama’n lengte kikhopna pindan ah makaih hi.

senses.usage_en: The present tense is pronounced /lid/. The past tense and past participle are led, pronounced /lɛd/.
senses.usage_zomi: Present tense pen /lid/ ci in kipau hi. Past tense leh past participle pen led ahi a, /lɛd/ ci in kipau hi.

senses.heading: Direct or control a group or organization
senses.definition_en: To direct, manage or be in charge of a group, organization or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, kipawlna ahih keileh gamtatna khat makaih, uk ahih keileh mawpuak.

examples.english: She leads a team of twenty workers.
examples.zomi: Ama’n nasem sawmnih pawl makaih hi.

examples.english: The teacher led the classroom discussion.
examples.zomi: Sia in class kihouna makaih hi.

senses.usage_en: A person who leads may guide, manage or inspire others; the exact meaning depends on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Makai in midangte lampi lak, uk ahih keileh hanthawn thei a, thu kizopna in a khiatna khen hi.

senses.heading: Cause or result in something
senses.definition_en: To cause a particular result or make a person reach a conclusion or action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gahsuah khat piangsak ahih keileh mi khat khensatna leh gamtatna khat ah tun.

examples.english: Poor planning can lead to failure.
examples.zomi: Geelna hoihlo in mawhlohna piangsak thei hi.

examples.english: The evidence led police to the suspect.
examples.zomi: Teci in police-te mawhneihsak mi kiangah makaih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use lead to + noun or -ing form: lead to success, lead to losing money.
senses.usage_zomi: Lead to nungah min ahih keileh -ing form kizang hi: lead to success, lead to losing money.

senses.heading: Be ahead in a competition
senses.definition_en: To be winning or in the highest position in a competition, race or comparison.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna, taitehna ahih keileh tehkakna sungah a masapen leh a sangpen dinmunah om.

examples.english: Our team is leading by two goals.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl uh goal nih in ma om hi.

examples.english: She led the race from beginning to end.
examples.zomi: Ama’n taitehna kipatna pan tawpna dong makaih hi.

senses.usage_en: In sports, lead by introduces the amount of advantage: lead by five points.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna ah lead by nungah bangzah in ma om cih kizang hi: lead by five points.

senses.definition_en: A person who leads, directs or influences a group, organization, community or country.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, kipawlna, mipawl ahih keileh gam khat makaih, uk ahih keileh huzaap a nei mi.

examples.english: Community leaders met with city officials.
examples.zomi: Mipawl makaite khuapi official-te tawh kimu uh hi.

examples.english: A good leader listens to other people.
examples.zomi: Makai hoih in midangte’ thu ngai hi.

senses.usage_en: A leader may hold an official position, but someone may also lead through influence without a formal title.
senses.usage_zomi: Makai in official dinmun nei thei napi, minpuan nei loin huzaap tawh makaih zong thei hi.

senses.heading: The ability or activity of leading
senses.definition_en: The ability, skill or activity of guiding and directing people or organizations.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih keileh kipawlna makaih leh ukna ding siamtheihna leh gamtatna.

examples.english: The organization needs strong leadership.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in makaihna kip kisam hi.

examples.english: The course develops leadership skills.
examples.zomi: Course in makaih siamna khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Leadership is not identical to authority. A person may have authority without leading effectively.
senses.usage_zomi: Leadership leh thuneihna kibanglo hi. Mi khat in thuneihna nei napi, hoihtak in makaih zo tuanlo thei hi.

senses.heading: The people who lead an organization
senses.definition_en: The group of people responsible for leading an organization, community or country.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kipawlna, mipawl ahih keileh gam khat makaih ding mawpuak mite.

examples.english: The company leadership approved the plan.
examples.zomi: Company makaite’n geelna phal uh hi.

examples.english: The organization changed under new leadership.
examples.zomi: Makai thak nuaiah kipawlna kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: In this collective sense, leadership refers to leaders as a group.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pawl a huam khiatna ah leadership in makaite a vekpi kawk hi.

senses.heading: Most important or successful
senses.definition_en: Among the most important, successful or respected in a field.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a masapen; a thupipen; a minthangpen
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna leh nghề lam khat sungah a thupi, a mawhpoh ahih keileh a kizahtak pen lakah a kihel.

examples.english: She is a leading expert in public health.
examples.zomi: Amah mipi cidamna lam mipil minthang khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The company is a leading producer of medical equipment.
examples.zomi: Company pen siavuan vanzat bawl liante lakah khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Leading often means prominent or highly successful, not simply walking at the front.
senses.usage_zomi: Leading in minthang leh mawhpoh cihna nei tam a, malamah pai bek cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Coming first or showing the way
senses.definition_en: Coming first in order, position or importance, or guiding what follows.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kizuihzia, dinmun ahih keileh thupitna ah a masa, ahih keileh a zomte a makaih.

common_phrases.zomi: dawnna khat lam a makaih dotna

examples.english: She is the leading candidate in the election.
examples.zomi: Amah teelna ah candidate a ma ompen ahi hi.

examples.english: The lawyer was warned not to ask leading questions.
examples.zomi: Siampi pen dawnna khat lam a makaih dotna donglo dingin kihilh hi.

senses.usage_en: A leading question suggests the answer expected and may be restricted in court or research.
senses.usage_zomi: Leading question in a kilam-et dawnna kawk a, thukhenna zumpi ahih keileh thuzonna ah khaktan theih hi.

senses.heading: A flat green part of a plant
senses.definition_en: A usually flat and green part growing from a plant or tree that helps it make food.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung ahih keileh singgui pan a po, a ngeina in a neem leh a hing, sing kung in an a bawlna a huh angsung.

examples.english: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
examples.zomi: Singnate autumn hunin eng suak hi.

examples.english: A single leaf fell from the tree.
examples.zomi: Singkung pan singna khat kia hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural changes f to v: leaf–leaves.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural ah f pen v in kikhel hi: leaf–leaves.

senses.heading: A sheet in a book
senses.definition_en: One sheet of paper in a book, having a page on each side.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu sung lai khat, a mai leh a nung tegel page a hi.

examples.english: One leaf was missing from the old book.
examples.zomi: Laibu lui sung pan lai khat mang hi.

examples.english: He carefully turned each leaf of the manuscript.
examples.zomi: Ama’n khutgelh lai sung lai khat ciat kidawm takin leh hi.

senses.usage_en: In modern everyday English, page is more common. Technically, one leaf has two pages—one on each side.
senses.usage_zomi: Tuni nisim English ah page kizang tamzaw hi. A kician takin gen leng lai khat in a mai leh a nung page nih nei hi.

senses.heading: Sports organization
senses.definition_en: A group of sports teams or players that compete against one another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna nam khat sungah pawl tuamtuam a kipawlkhawm in, khat leh khat a kidemna uh kipawlna.

examples.english: Our team joined a local football league.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl un khuami football kidemna kipawlna sungah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: They won the league last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa in amaute kidemna kipawlna ah gualzo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In sports, a league usually organizes regular competition among several teams.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna ah league in pawl tampi kikal ah hunseh tawh kidemna a bawl kipawlna cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Association
senses.definition_en: An organized group of people or organizations with a shared purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna kibang nei mi ahih kei leh kipawlna tuamtuam in a kibawlkhawm uh kipawlna.

examples.english: Several organizations formed a league to protect the environment.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna pawlkhat in kimlehpam dalna ding kipawlna khat phut uh hi.

examples.english: The league represents small businesses.
examples.zomi: Tua kipawlna in sumlehna neute ai-awh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is more formal and refers to people or organizations united by a common aim.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen a thukhun zaw deuh hi a, ngimna kibang tawh a kipumkhat mihingte ahih kei leh kipawlna-te cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Bend or rest against something
senses.definition_en: To move your body away from an upright position or rest it against something.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ding man pan kipelh deuh in kunga, ahih kei leh na khat tungah pumpi nga in kinga cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She leaned forward to hear him better.
examples.zomi: A thu gen kician zaw in zak theihna dingin amah mai lamah kunga hi.

examples.english: Do not lean against the door.
examples.zomi: Kong tungah kinga kei in.

senses.usage_en: Lean describes a sloping body position; it does not necessarily mean that someone is falling.
senses.usage_zomi: Lean in pumpi kunga in om cihna hi a, mi puk ding cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Put something in a sloping position
senses.definition_en: To place an object so that it rests at an angle against something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a puklohna dingin na dang tungah kinga sak in a kunga koih cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: lean a ladder against a wall
lean a bicycle against a tree

common_phrases.zomi: singpek ding sak in kinga sak

examples.english: He leaned the ladder against the house.
examples.zomi: Ama in kailawn inn bang tungah kinga sak hi.

examples.english: She leaned her bicycle against a tree.
examples.zomi: A lengnih singkung tungah kinga sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this transitive use, the object placed at an angle comes immediately after lean.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan ah na kunga a koih ding pen lean nungah a pai pah hi.

senses.heading: Gain knowledge or skill
senses.definition_en: To gain knowledge or a skill through study, instruction, or experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Simna, kihilhna ahih kei leh phutkhakna tungtawn in pilna ahih kei leh siamna ngah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children are learning to read English.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in English sim ding sin uh hi.

examples.english: I learned how to cook from my mother.
examples.zomi: Ka nu kiang pan an huan ding ka sin hi.

senses.usage_en: Use learn to + verb for acquiring an ability: learn to swim. Do not say learn swimming in this meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Siamna khat ngah ding a kisinna ah learn to + verb kizang hi: learn to swim. Hih khiatna ah learn swimming ci in kizang lo hi.

senses.heading: Discover information
senses.definition_en: To find out or become aware of a fact.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat thei suak ahih kei leh thei pan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We later learned that the meeting had been cancelled.
examples.zomi: A nungciangin kikhopna phiat khin cih ka thei uh hi.

examples.english: She was shocked to learn the truth.
examples.zomi: Thuman a theih ciangin amah lamdangsa mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, learn means receiving or discovering information, not studying it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah learn in thu sim cihna hilo in, thu khat thei suak cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The process of gaining knowledge or skills through study, teaching, or experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Simna, kihilhna leh phutkhakna tungtawn in pilna leh siamna ngahna nasep leh a paihdan.

examples.english: Regular practice is important for language learning.
examples.zomi: Pau kisinna dingin tawntung kizohlhna thupi hi.

examples.english: Online learning gives students more flexibility.
examples.zomi: Internet tungtawn kisinna in sangnaupangte amau hun tawh kizui in a kisin theihna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Learning is generally uncountable when it means the process of acquiring knowledge. In formal use, it can also mean knowledge gained through study.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna ngahna paihdan a cihna ah learning simtheih lo noun in kizang hi. Thukhun zatzia ah simna hangin pilna a ngahsa cihna in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The smallest amount or number of something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tawm pen; a neu pen zat
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a tawm pen zat ahih kei leh a tawm pen sim cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This method requires the least effort.
examples.zomi: Hih zia in hahkatna a tawm pen kisam hi.

examples.english: That shop had the least rice available.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr ah bu a tawm pen om hi.

senses.usage_en: Least is the superlative form associated with little. Use it with amounts; use fewest with countable plural nouns when the distinction matters.
senses.usage_zomi: Least pen little tawh kizom a tawm pen a cihna ahi hi. Zat simtheih lo tawh kizang a; simtheih plural noun-te tawh a kician in gen ding ciangin fewest kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Material made from animal skin and used for clothing, shoes, bags, and other products.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gan savun bawlpha in puan, khedap, ip leh zat ding dangte a kibawlna van.

examples.english: He bought a pair of leather shoes.
examples.zomi: Ama in savun khedap khat lei hi.

examples.english: This bag is made of real leather.
examples.zomi: Hih ip pen savun taktak tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Leather is normally uncountable when referring to the material. It can also modify another noun, as in leather bag.
senses.usage_zomi: Van bawlna a cihna ah leather simtheih lo noun ahi hi. Leather bag cih bangin noun dang a hilhcian kammal in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Go away from a place
senses.definition_en: To go away from a place or person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ahih kei leh mi khat kiang pan paikhiat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She left the office at five o’clock.
examples.zomi: Amah nai nga in nasepna mun pan paikhia hi.

examples.english: We should leave before the storm begins.
examples.zomi: Huihpi hong kipatma in ka paikhia ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Leave a place takes no from: say leave the house, not leave from the house. However, leave for introduces the destination.
senses.usage_zomi: Leave a place a cih ciangin from kisam lo hi: leave the house ci ding a, leave from the house ci lo ding hi. Ahih hang leave for in a paihna ding mun kawk hi.

senses.heading: Allow something to remain
senses.definition_en: To put or keep someone or something in a particular place or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat mun khat ah om paisak, ahih kei leh omzia khat mahah om paisak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: leave the keys on the table

examples.english: Please leave the keys on the table.
examples.zomi: Tuih tawlngak tungah koih in.

examples.english: He left the door open.
examples.zomi: Ama in kong kihong in om paisak hi.

senses.usage_en: Leave + object + adjective describes the condition in which someone or something remains: leave the light on.
senses.usage_zomi: Leave + object + adjective in mi ahih kei leh na khat bang omzia tawh a om paisak cihna gen hi: leave the light on.

senses.heading: Stop or abandon something
senses.definition_en: To stop taking part in a job, group, course, or relationship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, kipawlna, kisinna ahih kei leh kizopna khat sung pan tawpsan in paikhiat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He left his job to start a business.
examples.zomi: Sumlehbawlna kipat dingin a nasep nusia hi.

examples.english: She decided to leave the organization.
examples.zomi: Amah kipawlna nusia dingin khensat hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, leave often means ending one’s participation, not merely going away temporarily.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah leave in tawmvei sung paikhiatbek hilo in, kihelna tawpsan cihna nei zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A formal educational talk given to a group, especially at a college or university.
senses.explanation_zomi: College ahih kei leh university ah mihon khat tungah pilna thu a kipiak thugenna.

examples.english: The professor gave a lecture on modern history.
examples.zomi: Professor in tulai tangthu thu ah pilna thugen pia hi.

examples.english: Many students attended the lecture.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang tampi pilna thugen ngai dingin pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A lecture is usually longer and more formal than an ordinary classroom explanation or talk.
senses.usage_zomi: Lecture pen sangkhan sung hilhcian pahpahna ahih kei leh thugen biasa sangin sauzaw leh thukhun zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Located on or relating to the side opposite the right side.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ziatlam tawh kikal, vei lamah om ahih kei leh vei lam tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her left arm was injured.
examples.zomi: A vei ban liam hi.

examples.english: The bank is on the left side of the road.
examples.zomi: Bank pen lampi vei lamah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Left can be an adjective, noun, or adverb. Here it is an adjective modifying a noun, as in left hand.
senses.usage_zomi: Left pen adjective, noun ahih kei leh adverb in kizang thei hi. Hih munah left hand cih bangin noun a hilhcian adjective ahi hi.

senses.heading: Limb used for standing and walking
senses.definition_en: One of the limbs that supports the body and is used for standing and walking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi a dom in dingna leh paina ding a kizang pumpi khehlel khat.

examples.english: He injured his leg while playing football.
examples.zomi: Football a kimawl laitakin a khe liam hi.

examples.english: The child stood on one leg.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen khe khat tawh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: A human leg extends from the hip to the foot, although everyday speech sometimes uses leg more generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Mihing khe pen kawngbul pan khetaw dong ahi a, nisim kammal ah bel khe khempeuh kawk in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Supporting part of furniture
senses.definition_en: One of the parts that supports a table, chair, or similar object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tawlngak, tutna leh a kibang nate a dom ding a nuai lamah om khe bang zatna.

examples.english: One leg of the chair is broken.
examples.zomi: Tutna khe khat kisiacip hi.

examples.english: The table has four wooden legs.
examples.zomi: Tawlngak in sing tawh kibawl khe li nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Furniture supports are called legs because their function resembles that of human or animal legs.
senses.usage_zomi: Innvan a dom nate pen mihing ahih kei leh gan khe tawh nasep kibang ahih manin legs kici hi.

senses.heading: Allowed by law
senses.definition_en: Permitted by law.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thukham in a phal; thukham tawh kituak
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham in a phalsak ahih kei leh thukham tawh a kituak.

examples.english: It is legal to park here.
examples.zomi: Hih munah mawtaw koih thukham in phal hi.

examples.english: They wanted to know whether the agreement was legal.
examples.zomi: Tua thukimna thukham tawh kituak leh kituak lo a theih nuam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Legal means permitted by law; it does not necessarily mean morally right or wise.
senses.usage_zomi: Legal in thukham in phal cihna hi a, lungsim hoihna tawh maan ahih kei leh pilna tawh kituak cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Connected with law
senses.definition_en: Relating to law, lawyers, or courts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham, thukham siamte ahih kei leh thukhenna zumpi tawh kisai.

examples.english: You should get legal advice before signing the contract.
examples.zomi: Thukimna lai na gelh ma in thukham lam ngaihsut piakna na ngah ding hi.

examples.english: She works in the legal profession.
examples.zomi: Amah thukham lam nasepna ah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Before a noun, legal may describe something connected with the law rather than something specifically permitted by it.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun ma ah legal kizang ciangin thukham in a phal cihna sangin thukham tawh kisai cihna a hih thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Time when you are not working or performing necessary duties and can relax or enjoy yourself.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih kei leh bawl kul nate a om loh ciangin khawlna leh lungdamna ding a kizang theih hun.

examples.english: She reads books in her leisure time.
examples.zomi: A hun awl ciangin laibu sim hi.

examples.english: Walking is one of his favourite leisure activities.
examples.zomi: Kalsuan pen a hun awl sung bawl nuam pen nate lakah khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Leisure is usually uncountable. In American English, it is commonly pronounced /ˈliːʒər/.
senses.usage_zomi: Leisure pen simtheih lo noun in kizang zel hi. American English ah /ˈliːʒər/ ci in kigen zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A yellow citrus fruit with a sour taste.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hi a thuai, khuaci tawh kibang singgah nam khat.

examples.english: She added lemon juice to the tea.
examples.zomi: A singpi sungah lemon tui hel hi.

examples.english: This lemon tastes very sour.
examples.zomi: Hih lemon pen thuai mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Lemon can refer to the whole fruit, its flavor, or something made with lemon.
senses.usage_zomi: Lemon in a gah pumpi, a lim ahih kei leh lemon tawh a kibawl na khat kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To give something to someone temporarily, expecting it to be returned.
senses.zomi_equivalents: laak pia; tawmvei sung zang ding pia
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hong piakkik ding lam-etna tawh tawmvei sung mi khat tungah zat ding pia cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: lend a book to a friend

examples.english: Could you lend me your pen?
examples.zomi: Na laigelh ka zang tawm ding hong pia thei diam?

examples.english: She lent some money to her brother.
examples.zomi: A sanggampa sum tawm laak pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Lend means to give temporarily; borrow means to receive temporarily. Say lend something to someone or lend someone something.
senses.usage_zomi: Lend in tawmvei sung zat ding pia cihna a, borrow in tawmvei sung zat ding la cihna ahi hi. Lend something to someone ahih kei leh lend someone something ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Measurement from end to end
senses.definition_en: The measurement of something from one end to the other.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a mong khat pan a mong dang dong a sauna tehna.

examples.english: We measured the length of the table.
examples.zomi: Tawlngak sauna ka teh uh hi.

examples.english: The bridge is 500 metres in length.
examples.zomi: Lei a sauna metre 500 ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Length is the noun related to the adjective long.
senses.usage_zomi: Length pen adjective long tawh kizom noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Amount of time
senses.definition_en: The amount of time that something continues.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a om paisuak hun sauzang.

examples.english: The length of the film is two hours.
examples.zomi: Film a sawtna nai nih ahi hi.

examples.english: They reduced the length of the lesson.
examples.zomi: Amaute in sinna hun sawtna kiam sak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When discussing time, length emphasizes duration rather than physical size.
senses.usage_zomi: Hun thu gen ciangin length in pumpi sauna hilo in hun sawtna kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A smaller amount of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a zat tawmzaw ahih kei leh tawm deuh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This job requires less time.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep in hun tawmzaw kisam hi.

examples.english: We should use less water.
examples.zomi: Tui tawmzaw ka zang ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use less mainly with uncountable nouns: less water. Traditionally, fewer is preferred with countable plural nouns: fewer cars.
senses.usage_zomi: Less pen simtheih lo noun tawh kizang phadiak hi: less water. Simtheih plural noun tawh bel ngeina bangin fewer kizangzaw hi: fewer cars.

senses.heading: Period of instruction
senses.definition_en: A period of time in which someone is taught a subject or skill.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih kei leh siamna khat a kihilhna ding hunseh.

examples.english: Our English lesson begins at nine.
examples.zomi: Ka English sinna uh nai kua in kipan hi.

examples.english: She takes piano lessons every Saturday.
examples.zomi: Saturday simin piano tumna sinna ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: A lesson may be one class period or a particular unit of material being taught.
senses.usage_zomi: Lesson in sangkhan sinna hun khat ahih kei leh a kihilh ding thu khen khat kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Knowledge gained from experience
senses.definition_en: Something useful that you learn from an experience, especially a mistake or difficulty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phutkhakna, khialhna ahih kei leh haksatna khat pan pilna a kisin.

examples.english: The mistake taught us an important lesson.
examples.zomi: Tua khialhna in thupi pilna khat hong sin sak hi.

examples.english: He learned a lesson from the experience.
examples.zomi: Ama in tua phutkhakna pan pilna khat sin hi.

senses.usage_en: Learn a lesson often means understanding how to avoid repeating a mistake.
senses.usage_zomi: Learn a lesson in khialhna khat a kibawl kiklohna ding telcian in pilna sin cihna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Allow
senses.definition_en: To allow someone to do something or allow something to happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat na khat bawl phalsak, ahih kei leh thu khat piang ding phal cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: My parents let me stay up late.
examples.zomi: Ka nu leh pa in zan dong ka om phal uh hi.

examples.english: Please let her explain the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaipihna amah hilhcian phal in.

senses.usage_en: Use let + object + base verb without to: let him speak, not let him to speak.
senses.usage_zomi: Let + object + base verb ci in to om lo in kizang hi: let him speak ci ding a, let him to speak ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Suggest an action with “let’s”
senses.definition_en: Used with us to suggest doing something together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dangte tawh na khat khawm bawl ding a kiciamna in let us ahih kei leh let’s kizang hi.

examples.english: Let’s meet after work.
examples.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin kimu ni.

examples.english: Let’s discuss the problem tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing ciangin buaipihna kiholim ni.

senses.usage_en: Let’s is the contraction of let us and is commonly used for suggestions.
senses.usage_zomi: Let’s pen let us a tomlak ahi a, khawm in na khat bawl ding a kiciamna in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Written message
senses.definition_en: A written message sent to a person or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh kipawlna khat tungah laigelh in a kipuak thupuak.

examples.english: She wrote a letter to her grandmother.
examples.zomi: A pi tungah lai khat gelh hi.

examples.english: We received a letter from the bank.
examples.zomi: Bank kiang pan lai khat ka ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A traditional letter may be written on paper, while an email is sent electronically.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina letter pen lai tungah kigelh thei a, email bel electronic tawh kikhak hi.

senses.heading: Alphabet symbol
senses.definition_en: A written symbol used in an alphabet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Alphabet sungah pau kammal gelhna ding a kizang lim khat.

examples.english: The word begins with the letter B.
examples.zomi: Tua kammal pen B laimal tawh kipan hi.

examples.english: Write your name in capital letters.
examples.zomi: Na min laimal lian tawh gelh in.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a letter is a symbol such as A, B, or C, not a complete written message.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah letter pen A, B, C cih bang laimal lim hi a, thupuak lai khat hilo hi.

senses.heading: Position on a scale
senses.definition_en: A particular amount, degree, or position on a scale.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tehna ah zat, dinmun ahih kei leh ciangtan khat.

examples.english: Her English is at an advanced level.
examples.zomi: A English siamna pen sangto ciangtan ah om hi.

examples.english: The water level rose after the rain.
examples.zomi: Guah zuah khit ciangin tui ciangtan sangto hi.

senses.usage_en: Level often describes a measurable degree of ability, quantity, quality, or intensity.
senses.usage_zomi: Level in siamna, zat, hoihna ahih kei leh hatna teh theih ciangtan khat gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Floor of a building
senses.definition_en: One of the floors or heights in a building or structure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn ahih kei leh lamdang khat sung a dawn khat.

examples.english: The restaurant is on the upper level.
examples.zomi: Annekna mun pen a tung zaw inn dawn ah om hi.

examples.english: Parking is available on two levels.
examples.zomi: Inn dawn nih ah mawtaw koih theih hi.

senses.usage_en: American English often uses floor for a building level, but level is common in descriptions of structures and parking areas.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah inn dawn a genna in floor kizang tamzaw a, inn lamdang leh mawtaw koihna munte genna ah level kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A place or collection from which people can read, use, or borrow books and other information resources.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu leh thu hilhna van dangte a kikoihna, mite in a sim, a zat ahih kei leh a laak theihna mun.

common_phrases.english: borrow a book from the library

examples.english: I borrowed this book from the library.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu laibu inn pan ka la hi.

examples.english: The students studied quietly in the library.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte laibu inn sungah dai takin sin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In careful American pronunciation, library has three syllables: /ˈlaɪ-brɛr-i/.
senses.usage_zomi: American English kician takin a pau ciangin library in awging khen thum nei hi: /ˈlaɪ-brɛr-i/.

senses.definition_en: An official document or permission allowing someone to do, own, or use something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl, neih ahih kei leh zat theihna ding ukna neite in a piak thukhun phalna lai.

examples.english: You need a licence to drive a car.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawl dingin phalna lai na kisam hi.

examples.english: The restaurant lost its licence.
examples.zomi: Annekna mun in a phalna lai nusia hi.

senses.usage_en: Licence is the British noun spelling. In American English, both the noun and verb are spelled license. British English uses license for the verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Licence pen British English noun gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah noun leh verb a nihmah license ci in kigelh hi. British English ah verb pen license ci in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Rest in a horizontal position
senses.definition_en: To put or have your body in a flat position on a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lupna ahih kei leh mun khat tungah pumpi zai takin lum cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He lay down because he was tired.
examples.zomi: A gim mahmah manin lum hi.

examples.english: The baby is lying on the bed.
examples.zomi: Naungek pen lupna tungah lum hi.

senses.usage_en: The forms are lie–lay–lain for this meaning: Today I lie down; yesterday I lay down; I have lain down. Do not confuse it with lay, which takes an object.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah a kammal khelna pen lie–lay–lain ahi hi: Today I lie down; yesterday I lay down; I have lain down. Object kisam lay tawh helkhawm lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Be situated somewhere
senses.definition_en: To be located or remain in a particular place or position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah om ahih kei leh mun khat ah kikoih in om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The village lies beyond the hills.
examples.zomi: Khua pen mualte gal ah om hi.

examples.english: A long road lies ahead of us.
examples.zomi: Ka mai un lampi saupi om hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a formal or descriptive way to say where a place or object is located.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen mun ahih kei leh na khat a omna thukhun leh limgenna tawh a gen zia ahi hi.

senses.heading: Say something untrue
senses.definition_en: To deliberately say something that is not true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thuman lo cih thei napi in mi khemna dingin thuzuau gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He lied about where he had been.
examples.zomi: A paina mun thu ah zuau hi.

examples.english: Do not lie to your parents.
examples.zomi: Na nu leh pa tungah zuau kei in.

senses.usage_en: The forms for this meaning are lie–lied–lied. They differ from lie–lay–lain, meaning to rest horizontally.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah a kammal khelna pen lie–lied–lied ahi hi. Lum cihna lie–lay–lain tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: State of being alive
senses.definition_en: The condition that separates living people, animals, and plants from things that are not alive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, gan leh singkungte a nungta lo nate tawh a kilamdanna nuntakna dinmun.

examples.english: The doctor saved the child’s life.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in naupang nuntakna hon hi.

examples.english: No signs of life were found.
examples.zomi: Nuntakna lim bangmah kimulo hi.

senses.usage_en: Life is uncountable when referring to the general state of being alive, but countable when referring to an individual person’s or animal’s life.
senses.usage_zomi: A nungta dinmun a gen ciangin life simtheih lo noun ahi a, mi khat ahih kei leh gan khat nuntakna a gen ciangin simtheih noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Period from birth to death
senses.definition_en: The period during which a person, animal, or plant is alive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing, gan ahih kei leh singkung khat pian pan sih dong a nuntak hun.

examples.english: She lived a long and happy life.
examples.zomi: Amah hun sawtpi nuam takin nungta hi.

examples.english: He spent most of his life in the village.
examples.zomi: A nuntak hun a tamzaw tua khua ah zang hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is lives /laɪvz/, not /laɪfs/.
senses.usage_zomi: Life a plural pen lives /laɪvz/ ahi a, /laɪfs/ hilo hi.

senses.heading: A person’s way of living and experiences
senses.definition_en: The activities, relationships, and experiences that form a person’s existence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nuntak sung a nasep, mi tawh kizopna leh phutkhakna khempeuh.

examples.english: Technology has changed our daily lives.
examples.zomi: Technology in ka nisim nuntakna uh khel hi.

examples.english: Family life is important to her.
examples.zomi: Innkuan nuntakna ama adingin thupi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, life refers broadly to how someone lives, not merely to being biologically alive.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah life in a nungta bek hilo in, mi khat nundan leh nuntakzia khempeuh kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: The way a person or group lives, including their habits, activities, work, and interests.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh mihon khat in amau nisim nuntakna ah a neih uh ngeina, nasep, kimawlna leh lunglutna-te tawh a nuntakzia uh.

examples.english: Regular exercise is part of a healthy lifestyle.
examples.zomi: Hunseh tawh pumpi kizohlhna pen cidamna tawh kituak nuntakzia sungah a kihel ahi hi.

examples.english: Moving to the city changed their lifestyle.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah a kikhin uh ciangin amau nuntakzia kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Lifestyle refers to a general pattern of living, not one isolated action or habit.
senses.usage_zomi: Lifestyle in nasep khatbek ahih kei leh ngeina khatbek kawk lo in, mi khat nuntakzia a pum in kawk hi.

senses.heading: Raise something
senses.definition_en: To move someone or something to a higher position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a omna pan a sangzaw munah domto cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you help me lift this box?
examples.zomi: Hih kuang domto dingin hong huh thei diam?

examples.english: She lifted the baby from the bed.
examples.zomi: Amah in naungek lupna tung pan domto hi.

senses.usage_en: Lift normally takes an object. Rise usually describes something moving upward by itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Lift in a domto na ding object kisam zel hi. Rise bel na khat amah leh amah a kahto a genna in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Remove a rule or restriction
senses.definition_en: To officially end a rule, limit, or restriction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham, ciangtan ahih kei leh khaamna khat ukna nei mite in a tawpsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The government lifted the travel ban.
examples.zomi: Ukna in khualzin khaamna phiat hi.

examples.english: The restrictions will be lifted next week.
examples.zomi: Ma kalsung ciangin ciangtan nate tawpsak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, nothing is physically raised; an official restriction is removed.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah pumpi tawh na khat domto cihna hilo in, ukna khaamna khat lakhia cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Not heavy and therefore easy to lift or carry.
senses.explanation_zomi: A gik lo ahih manin domto ahih kei leh puak baih na.

common_phrases.zomi: puak zawh ding zah a zang

examples.english: This bag is light enough for the child to carry.
examples.zomi: Hih ip pen naupang in a puak zawh ding zahin zang hi.

examples.english: I need a light laptop for travelling.
examples.zomi: Khualzin ciangin laptop zang khat ka kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense of light is the opposite of heavy. It is different from light meaning brightness.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih light khiatna pen heavy a kikal ahi hi. Khuavak a cihna light tawh a khiatna kibang lo hi.

senses.definition_en: To find someone or something pleasant, enjoyable, or satisfactory.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat hoihsa, lunglut ahih kei leh nuamsa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I like this song very much.
examples.zomi: Hih la ka lunglut mahmah hi.

examples.english: She likes reading before bed.
examples.zomi: A lupma in laibu sim nuamsa hi.

senses.usage_en: Like doing something often expresses general enjoyment. Would like to do something politely expresses a present wish.
senses.usage_zomi: Like doing something in na khat bawl nuamsa tawntung cihna nei zel hi. Would like to do something in tuhun deihna zahtakna tawh gen hi.

senses.heading: Similar to
senses.definition_en: Similar to someone or something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na dang khat tawh a kibang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The child looks like his father.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen a pa tawh kibang hi.

examples.english: This material feels like leather.
examples.zomi: Hih van a lawng ciangin savun bang hi.

senses.usage_en: Like is followed by a noun, pronoun, or noun phrase. In careful formal English, as is often preferred before a full clause.
senses.usage_zomi: Like nungah noun, pronoun ahih kei leh noun phrase om hi. Thukhun English ah sentence kicing khat ma ah bel as kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: For example
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce an example of a type of person or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na nam khat entawn khat lakna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: She enjoys outdoor activities like hiking and cycling.
examples.zomi: Amah gamlak ah kalsuan leh lengnih tuang bang polam kimawlna-te nuamsa hi.

examples.english: Large cities like New York can be expensive.
examples.zomi: New York bang khuapi liante ah nuntakna man lian thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this use, like gives examples and does not necessarily include every member of the group.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan ah like in entawn nate lak hi a, tua nam sungah a kihel khempeuh a cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Expected to happen or probably true.
senses.zomi_equivalents: piang ding a umhuai; lam-et huai
senses.explanation_zomi: Piang dingin lam-et huai ahih kei leh thuman ding a umhuai na.

common_phrases.zomi: a piang ding a umhuai thu

examples.english: Rain is likely this afternoon.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitaklam guah zuah ding a umhuai hi.

examples.english: She is likely to win the competition.
examples.zomi: Amah kidemna ah gualzo ding a umhuai hi.

senses.usage_en: Use be likely to + verb: They are likely to arrive early. Do not normally say They likely to arrive.
senses.usage_zomi: Be likely to + verb ci in kizang hi: They are likely to arrive early. They likely to arrive ci in kigen lo zel hi.

senses.heading: Greatest permitted amount
senses.definition_en: The greatest amount, number, speed, or level that is allowed or possible.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zat, sim, manlang ahih kei leh ciangtan ding a phal penna ahih kei leh phahtheih penna.

examples.english: The speed limit here is 35 miles per hour.
examples.zomi: Hih munah nai khat sung mile 35 pen mawtaw manlang ciangtan ahi hi.

examples.english: There is a limit to how much you can carry.
examples.zomi: Na puak theih zah ciangtan om hi.

senses.usage_en: A limit marks the point beyond which something must not or cannot go.
senses.usage_zomi: Limit in na khat a pai kheng theih lohna ahih kei leh pai kheng lo ding ciangtan kawk hi.

senses.heading: Boundary or restriction
senses.definition_en: A rule or condition that restricts what someone can do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a bawl theihna a ciangtan thukhun ahih kei leh dinmun.

examples.english: Parents should set limits for young children.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pate in naupang neute ading ciangtan koih ding uh hi.

examples.english: The law places limits on the use of personal data.
examples.zomi: Thukham in mimal thu zatna tungah ciangtan koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Depending on context, a limit may be a numerical maximum or a general restriction.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu omzia bangin limit pen sim tawh a kisai a tawppen ahih kei leh a kikhapna ciangtan khat hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Small in amount, number, range, or ability and not enough for every possible need.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a ciangtan om; a tawm; a kicing lo
senses.explanation_zomi: A zat, sim, huamzang ahih kei leh siamna a ciangtan om a, kisap khempeuh a kicing zo lo na.

examples.english: We have limited time to finish the work.
examples.zomi: Nasep khin dingin hun tawm bek ka nei uh hi.

examples.english: Only a limited number of tickets are available.
examples.zomi: Ticket a ciangtan om bek ngah theih hi.

senses.usage_en: Limited means restricted, not necessarily completely unavailable.
senses.usage_zomi: Limited in a ciangtan om cihna hi a, om vet lo ahih kei leh ngah vet lo cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Long narrow mark
senses.definition_en: A long, narrow mark drawn or formed on a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tungah a kigelh, a kisuah ahih kei leh a kibawl sau leh ciangkuang lim.

examples.english: Draw a straight line across the page.
examples.zomi: Laimai kantan in khi tawntung khat suai in.

examples.english: Write your name above the line.
examples.zomi: Khi tungah na min gelh in.

senses.usage_en: A line has length but very little width and may be straight or curved.
senses.usage_zomi: Line in sauna nei napi a vai nei tawm mahmah a, tawntung ahih kei leh kawi thei hi.

senses.heading: Row of people or objects
senses.definition_en: A row of people or things arranged one behind another or side by side.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite ahih kei leh nate khat nung khat ahih kei leh khat gei khat a kiciam bangin a om uh.

examples.english: We waited in line for thirty minutes.
examples.zomi: Minute sawmthum sung tangah ka ngak uh hi.

examples.english: A long line of cars formed outside the building.
examples.zomi: Inn pualam ah mawtaw tang sau khat kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses stand in line. British English also uses queue.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah stand in line kizang zel hi. British English ah queue zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: Telephone connection
senses.definition_en: A telephone connection or a particular telephone service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Telephone tawh kizopna ahih kei leh telephone nasepna lampi.

examples.english: Please stay on the line while I check.
examples.zomi: Ka sittel sung telephone kha kei in.

examples.english: The phone line was disconnected.
examples.zomi: Telephone kizopna kitansak hi.

senses.usage_en: In telephone contexts, line refers to the connection, not a visible mark.
senses.usage_zomi: Telephone tawh kisai munah line in khi muhtheih kawk lo in, telephone kizopna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Connection
senses.definition_en: A connection or relationship between two or more people, things, facts, or events.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na, thu ahih kei leh piangna nih leh a tamzaw kikal a kizopna.

examples.english: Researchers found a link between smoking and lung disease.
examples.zomi: Zongkhetnate in zial zukna leh lungsung natna kikal ah kizopna om cih mukhia uh hi.

examples.english: The road provides an important link between the two towns.
examples.zomi: Tua lampi in khuapi nih kikal ah thupi kizopna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A link shows that two things are connected, but it does not always prove that one caused the other.
senses.usage_zomi: Link in na nih kizom cih lak hi a, khat in a dang khat piangsak takpi cih a kipsak pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Clickable web connection
senses.definition_en: A word, image, or address that opens another webpage, file, or online location when selected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Internet ah a teek ciangin laimai, file ahih kei leh online mun dang a hongna kammal, lim ahih kei leh address.

examples.english: Click the link to open the document.
examples.zomi: Lai hong dingin link teek in.

examples.english: She sent me a link to the website.
examples.zomi: Amah in website link hong khak hi.

senses.usage_en: In digital contexts, link is often short for hyperlink.
senses.usage_zomi: Digital tawh kisai munah link pen hyperlink a tomlak in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A large wild cat with yellow-brown fur; adult males usually have long hair around the neck.
senses.explanation_zomi: A dumpi-eng savun nei gamlak ngiau lian khat; a pasalte in ngawng kimvel ah sam sau nei zel uh hi.

examples.english: The lion rested under a tree.
examples.zomi: Lion pen singkung nuai ah khawl hi.

examples.english: Lions usually hunt in groups.
examples.zomi: Lion-te hon in sa del zel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A female lion is called a lioness. A group of lions is called a pride.
senses.usage_zomi: Lion numei pen lioness kici a, lion hon khat pen pride kici hi.

senses.heading: Edge of the mouth
senses.definition_en: Either of the two soft outer edges of the mouth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kamsung pualam a kamkha tung leh nuai a nem nate lakah khat.

examples.english: She cut her lower lip when she fell.
examples.zomi: A puk ciangin a nuai kamkha ki-at hi.

examples.english: His lips were dry because of the cold weather.
examples.zomi: Khua vot manin a kamkhate kang hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural lips usually refers to the upper and lower lips together.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural lips in a tung leh a nuai kamkha a nihgel kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Raised edge of a container
senses.definition_en: The edge of a cup, bowl, or other open container.
senses.explanation_zomi: No, kuang ahih kei leh a kam kihong van khat a kam gei.

examples.english: The cup has a small crack near its lip.
examples.zomi: No a kam gei ah a kekna neu khat om hi.

examples.english: Water flowed over the lip of the container.
examples.zomi: Tui in kuang kam kantan in luang hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense extends the idea of a mouth’s edge to the edge of an open object.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in kamkha a gei bang mah van kihong khat a kam gei kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A substance such as water or oil that flows freely and is neither a solid nor a gas.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tui bang a luang na; a luangthei na
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui ahih kei leh sathau bangin a luangthei a, a khauhsa ahih kei leh huih a hilo na.

examples.english: Water is a liquid at room temperature.
examples.zomi: Innkhan lumdan ah tui pen a luangthei na ahi hi.

examples.english: Pour the liquid into the bottle.
examples.zomi: Tua a luangthei na bottle sungah sung in.

senses.usage_en: Liquid may be countable when referring to a type of liquid, but it is often uncountable when referring to liquid as a form of matter.
senses.usage_zomi: A luangthei na nam khat a gen ciangin liquid simtheih noun hi thei a, na omzia khat a gen ciangin simtheih lo noun in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A series of names, words, numbers, or other items written or presented one after another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Min, kammal, sim ahih kei leh na dangte khat khit khat a kigelh ahih kei leh a kilak khawmna.

examples.english: I made a list of the food we need.
examples.zomi: Ka kisap uh annek ding kiciamna ka gelh hi.

examples.english: Her name is at the top of the list.
examples.zomi: A min pen kiciamna tungpen ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a list of + plural noun to identify what the list contains: a list of books.
senses.usage_zomi: Kiciamna sungah bang om cih lak dingin a list of + plural noun kizang hi: a list of books.

senses.definition_en: To pay attention to a sound or to what someone is saying.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw khat ahih kei leh mi khat thugen kician takin zak ding lungsim pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please listen carefully to the instructions.
examples.zomi: Hilhna kidop takin ngai in.

examples.english: She listens to music while she works.
examples.zomi: Nasep laitakin la ngai hi.

senses.usage_en: Listen normally takes to before an object: listen to me. Hear means receiving sound and does not necessarily involve deliberate attention.
senses.usage_zomi: Listen nungah object om ciangin to kisam zel hi: listen to me. Hear in aw za cihna hi a, lungsim pia in ngai cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who listens to someone or something, especially a radio program, speech, or piece of music.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat thugen, radio hun, la ahih kei leh aw dang khat a ngai mi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi thugen a ngai siam mi

examples.english: A good listener gives other people time to speak.
examples.zomi: Mi thugen a ngai siam mi in midangte thu genna ding hun pia hi.

examples.english: The program has thousands of regular listeners.
examples.zomi: Tua radio hun in hunseh tawh a ngai mi tul tampi nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A good listener is someone who pays patient and careful attention to other people.
senses.usage_zomi: Good listener in midangte thugen lungduai leh kidop takin a ngai mi cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Written artistic works
senses.definition_en: Written works valued as art, especially novels, poems, and plays.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu laibu, la leh limlakna ding thugen bangin lai siam nate a kigelh manpha nasep.

examples.english: She studies English literature at college.
examples.zomi: Amah college ah English laisiamna sin hi.

examples.english: The course introduces students to modern literature.
examples.zomi: Tua sinna in sangnaupangte tulai laisiamna tawh kimuhsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Literature is generally uncountable when referring to artistic writing as a field.
senses.usage_zomi: Lai siam nate a khempeuh huam in a gen ciangin literature simtheih lo noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Published information about a subject
senses.definition_en: Printed or published material that gives information about a subject, product, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, van ahih kei leh kipawlna khat thu a hilhcian lai kisuahtak nate.

examples.english: The doctor reviewed the recent medical literature.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in cidamna lam lai thak kisuahtakte sittel hi.

examples.english: The company sent us literature about its products.
examples.zomi: Company in a van bawlte thu hilhcian lai hong khak hi.

senses.usage_en: In academic contexts, the literature often means the existing published research on a subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Sang pilna tawh kisai munah the literature in thu khat tungtang a zongkhiatna lai kisuahtaksa khempeuh kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Small in size
senses.definition_en: Small in size, amount, or degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: A pumpi, zat ahih kei leh ciangtan a neu na.

examples.english: They live in a little house near the lake.
examples.zomi: Amaute tuili gei inn neu khat ah teng uh hi.

examples.english: The little child held her mother’s hand.
examples.zomi: Naupang neu in a nu khut len hi.

senses.usage_en: As an adjective, little may describe physical size and can sometimes express affection, as in my little sister.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective in little in pumpi neu cihna gen a, my little sister cih bangin itna lungsim zong lak thei hi.

senses.heading: Young
senses.definition_en: Young, especially when describing a child.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum a nau, phadiak in naupang khat a genna.

examples.english: I lived there when I was little.
examples.zomi: Ka naupan lai in tua munah ka teng hi.

examples.english: The little girl is five years old.
examples.zomi: Tanu neu pen kum nga pha hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, little refers to age rather than physical size alone.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah little in pumpi neu bek hilo in, kum a nau cihna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Have your home somewhere
senses.definition_en: To have your home in a particular place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah inn nei in om tawntung ahih kei leh teng cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They live in a small town in Ohio.
examples.zomi: Amaute Ohio sung khuapi neu khat ah teng uh hi.

examples.english: She lives with her parents.
examples.zomi: Amah a nu leh pa tawh tengkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Use live in with a town, country, or building, and live with for the people sharing your home.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuapi, gam ahih kei leh inn tawh live in kizang a, a tengkhawm mite tawh live with kizang hi.

senses.heading: Remain alive
senses.definition_en: To be alive or continue being alive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nungta in om ahih kei leh nungta paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Some turtles live for more than one hundred years.
examples.zomi: Leisung vaang pawlkhat kum zakhat sangin nungta sawtzaw uh hi.

examples.english: The plant cannot live without water.
examples.zomi: Tui om lo in singkung nungta thei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: The verb live is pronounced /lɪv/. The adjective live, meaning happening now or not recorded, is pronounced /laɪv/.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb live pen /lɪv/ ci in kigen hi. Tuhun mah a piang ahih kei leh record hilo cihna adjective live pen /laɪv/ ci in kigen hi.

senses.heading: Experience life in a particular way
senses.definition_en: To spend your life in a particular condition or manner.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuntak hun pen dinmun ahih kei leh nundan khat tawh zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They want to live in peace.
examples.zomi: Amaute kilemna tawh nungta nuam uh hi.

examples.english: He lived a simple life.
examples.zomi: Ama nuntak hun baihlam takin zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In expressions such as live a good life, an adjective describes the manner or quality of one’s life.
senses.usage_zomi: Live a good life cih bang kammal ah adjective in mi khat nuntakzia leh a nuntakna hoihdan gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Full of energy, activity, interest, or excitement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tha nei, nasepna tampi om, lunglut huai ahih kei leh lungdamna tawh kidim na.

examples.english: The children were lively and cheerful.
examples.zomi: Naupangte phatuamngai leh lungdam uh hi.

examples.english: We had a lively discussion about the book.
examples.zomi: Laibu thu lunglut huai takin ka kiholim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Lively usually has a positive meaning. It describes active energy rather than disorderly behavior.
senses.usage_zomi: Lively in hoihna lam khiatna nei zel hi. Tua in kipumpulak lohna sangin tha nei leh phatuamngai cihna gen hi.

senses.heading: Alive now
senses.definition_en: Alive now and not dead or extinct.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun in a nungta lai a, a si ahih kei leh a bei khin lo na.

examples.english: She is the oldest living member of the family.
examples.zomi: Amah innkuan sungah a nungta lai upapen ahi hi.

examples.english: All living organisms need energy.
examples.zomi: A nungta khempeuh in tha kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Living describes something currently alive. Alive normally follows a linking verb and is not usually placed directly before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Living in tuhun a nungta na gen hi. Alive pen linking verb nungah om zel a, noun ma ah kikoih lo zel hi.

senses.heading: Still used or developing
senses.definition_en: Continuing to exist, be used, or develop in the present.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kizang lai; a nungta lai
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun dong a kizang lai, a om lai ahih kei leh a khangto lai na.

examples.english: Zomi is a living language used by communities today.
examples.zomi: Zomi pen tuni in Zomi khuamite in a zat lai uh pau ahi hi.

examples.english: The festival keeps the tradition living.
examples.zomi: Pawi in ngeina nungta paisuak sak hi.

senses.usage_en: A living language is currently spoken and can continue changing naturally.
senses.usage_zomi: Living language pen tuhun a kigen lai pau hi a, ngeina bangin kikhel leh khangto paisuak thei hi.

senses.heading: Something carried
senses.definition_en: An amount of goods or material carried by a person, animal, or vehicle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, gan ahih kei leh mawtaw in a puak van ahih kei leh van zat.

examples.english: The truck carried a heavy load.
examples.zomi: Truck in van gik tampi pua hi.

examples.english: He put the load on the ground.
examples.zomi: Ama in a puak leilung ah koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Load may refer to the goods themselves or to the amount that a vehicle or container can carry.
senses.usage_zomi: Load in van a kipuak mah ahih kei leh mawtaw leh kuang in a puak theih zah kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Amount of work or responsibility
senses.definition_en: The amount of work, responsibility, or demand placed on someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat tungah a kikoih nasep, mawhpuak ahih kei leh kisapna zat.

examples.english: The new employee helped reduce my workload.
examples.zomi: Nasepna mi thak in ka nasep puak kiam sak dingin hong huh hi.

examples.english: We shared the load equally.
examples.zomi: Mawhpuak kibangin ka kikhen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, load describes pressure or responsibility rather than physical goods.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lim tawh zatna ah load in pumpi tawh a kipuak van hilo in, nasep leh mawhpuak kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Money or property that someone borrows and must return, usually under agreed conditions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukimna bangin piakkik ding a mi ahih kei leh sum bawlna mun pan a kila sum ahih kei leh van.
