examples.english: They took out a loan to buy a house.
examples.zomi: Inn lei dingin sum la uh hi.

examples.english: She repaid the loan within three years.
examples.zomi: Amah in kum thum sungin a laak sum piakkik hi.

senses.usage_en: A loan is what is lent. The person receiving it borrows it, and the person or institution providing it lends it.
senses.usage_zomi: Loan pen laak a kipiak sum ahih kei leh van ahi hi. A sang mi in borrow a, a pia mi ahih kei leh sum bawlna mun in lend hi.

senses.heading: Belonging to a nearby area
senses.definition_en: Relating to the particular area where someone lives or where something happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a tenna ahih kei leh thu khat a pian mun kimvel tawh kisai.

examples.english: We buy vegetables from local farmers.
examples.zomi: Khuasung loubawlte kiang pan an-hing ka lei uh hi.

examples.english: The story appeared in the local newspaper.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu khuasung thuthang laikhak ah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: Local describes a limited nearby area rather than a whole country or the world.
senses.usage_zomi: Local in gam pumpi ahih kei leh leitung pumpi kawk lo in, mun naih kimvel khat kawk hi.

senses.heading: Affecting one part only
senses.definition_en: Limited to one particular part of the body or system.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun khat bek; khen khat bek
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi ahih kei leh zia khat a khen khat bek a huam na.

examples.english: The medicine provides local pain relief.
examples.zomi: Tua si in a natna mun bek damsak hi.

examples.english: The problem caused only local damage.
examples.zomi: Buaipihna in mun khat bek susia hi.

senses.usage_en: In medical and technical contexts, local means confined to one area rather than affecting the whole body or system.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna leh pilna lamah local in pumpi ahih kei leh zia khempeuh huam lo in, mun khat bek huam cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Find the position of something
senses.definition_en: To find the exact place or position of someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a omna mun kician takin zongkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The police located the missing child.
examples.zomi: Police-te in a mang naupang omna zongkhia uh hi.

examples.english: We could not locate the source of the sound.
examples.zomi: Aw a hong kipatna ka zongkhia zo kei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Locate is more formal than find and often emphasizes discovering an exact position.
senses.usage_zomi: Locate pen find sangin thukhun zaw a, a omna mun kician takin mu cihna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Put or establish something in a place
senses.definition_en: To place or establish something in a particular position or area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat mun sehsa ah koih ahih kei leh nasepna mun khat phut cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: locate a building near a road

examples.english: The company located its new office near the airport.
examples.zomi: Company in a office thak vanleng tual gei ah phut hi.

examples.english: The school is located away from the main road.
examples.zomi: Sang pen lampi lian pan gamla deuh ah kikoih hi.

senses.usage_en: This transitive sense focuses on choosing or establishing the place of something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih transitive khiatna in na khat a omna ding mun teel ahih kei leh tua munah phut cihna bulphuh hi.

senses.definition_en: Situated or existing in a particular place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah kikoih ahih kei leh om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel is located near the airport.
examples.zomi: Hotel pen vanleng tual gei ah om hi.

examples.english: Our office is centrally located.
examples.zomi: Ka office uh khuapi laizang ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Located normally follows be: The shop is located downtown. In everyday English, the shorter The shop is downtown is often sufficient.
senses.usage_zomi: Located pen be nungah om zel hi: The shop is located downtown. Nisim English ah The shop is downtown ci bek zong kicing hi.

senses.heading: Place or position
senses.definition_en: The particular place or position where someone or something is.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a omna mun kician.

examples.english: Please send me your exact location.
examples.zomi: Na omna mun kician tak hong khak in.

examples.english: The store has a convenient location near the station.
examples.zomi: Dawr pen station gei phahtheih baihna munah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Location identifies where something is; direction explains how to reach it.
senses.usage_zomi: Location in na khat a omna mun lak a, direction in tua mun koici paina ding hilh hi.

senses.heading: Place used for filming
senses.definition_en: A real place outside a studio where a film, television program, or photograph is made.
senses.zomi_equivalents: film lakna mun; lim lakna mun
senses.explanation_zomi: Studio sung hilo in film, television program ahih kei leh lim lakna ding a kizang mun taktak.

examples.english: The movie was filmed on location in New York.
examples.zomi: Tua movie New York mun taktak ah kilak hi.

examples.english: They are searching for a suitable filming location.
examples.zomi: Amaute film lakna ding a kituak mun zong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: On location means working in a real setting rather than inside a film studio.
senses.usage_zomi: On location in film studio sung hilo in, a mun taktak ah film ahih kei leh lim la cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Fasten with a lock
senses.definition_en: To fasten a door, container, or other object with a key, code, or locking device.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kong, kuang ahih kei leh na dang khat tawh, code ahih kei leh tawhkal van tawh honsak lo dingin kha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please lock the door before you leave.
examples.zomi: Na paikhiatma in kong kha in.

examples.english: She locked her bicycle to the fence.
examples.zomi: A lengnih kulh tungah tawh tawh kha hi.

senses.usage_en: Lock means to secure something so that it cannot be opened or moved easily. Close does not necessarily mean lock.
senses.usage_zomi: Lock in na khat hong baih lo ding ahih kei leh kisuang baih lo dingin kha cihna ahi hi. Close in kha cihna hi a, tawh tawh kha cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Prevent access to a device or account
senses.definition_en: To protect a phone, computer, file, or account so that it cannot be used without permission.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kha; zat theih loh dingin kha
senses.explanation_zomi: Phone, computer, file ahih kei leh account phalna om lo in kizang thei lo dingin code ahih kei leh password tawh kha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Always lock your computer when you leave your desk.
examples.zomi: Na tawlngak na nutsiat ciangin na computer kha tawntung in.

examples.english: The bank locked the account after several failed attempts.
examples.zomi: Zang ding a kizopna a mawkngal tampi om khit ciangin bank in account kha hi.

senses.usage_en: In computing, lock usually blocks access temporarily; it does not delete the information.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer zatna ah lock in tawmvei sung luttheihna kha cihna hi a, a thu omte phiat cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Based on clear and reasonable thinking, with ideas or events connected in a sensible order.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsutna tawh kituak; thu kizopna maan nei
senses.explanation_zomi: Kician leh a maan ngaihsutna tungah kinga a, ngaihsutna leh thu piangte kizopna hoih nei na.

examples.english: Her decision was based on logical thinking.
examples.zomi: A khensatna ngaihsutna kician leh maan tungah kinga hi.

examples.english: That is the most logical explanation.
examples.zomi: Tua pen ngaihsutna tawh a kituak pen hilhcian ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Logical describes reasoning that follows clear connections. A logical conclusion may still be wrong if its starting information is wrong.
senses.usage_zomi: Logical in thu kizopna kician a zui ngaihsutna gen hi. A kipatna thu khial leh, ngaihsutna tawh kituak thukhupna zong khial thei lai hi.

senses.definition_en: Unhappy because you are alone or do not have the companionship you want.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lawmngai; amah bek a om in lungkham
senses.explanation_zomi: Amah bek a om man ahih kei leh a lawm nuamzah a neih loh manin lungkham leh lungngai na.

examples.english: She felt lonely after moving to a new city.
examples.zomi: Khuapi thak ah a kikhin khit ciangin lawmngai hi.

examples.english: You can feel lonely even when other people are nearby.
examples.zomi: Midangte na gei ah om napi zong na lawmngai thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Lonely describes an unhappy feeling. Alone simply means that no other person is present and does not always imply unhappiness.
senses.usage_zomi: Lonely in lawm nei lo bangin lungkhamna gen hi. Alone in midang om lo in amah bek om cihna hi a, lungkham cihna hi tawntung lo hi.

senses.heading: Measuring a great distance
senses.definition_en: Measuring a great distance from one end to the other.
senses.explanation_zomi: A mong khat pan a mong dang dong a sauna lian na.

examples.english: They walked along a long road.
examples.zomi: Amaute lampi sau khat boyunca kalsuan uh hi.

examples.english: She has long black hair.
examples.zomi: Amah sam vom sau nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Long describes length. Use tall rather than long for the height of a person or an upright object.
senses.usage_zomi: Long in sauna gen hi. Mihing ahih kei leh a ding na khat a sanna gen dingin long sangin tall kizang hi.

senses.heading: Continuing for much time
senses.definition_en: Continuing for a large amount of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun sawtpi a om paisuak ahih kei leh sawt na.

examples.english: We had a long meeting yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zani in hun sawtpi ka kikhawm uh hi.

examples.english: It was a long and difficult journey.
examples.zomi: Tua khualzinna sau leh haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: For questions about duration, use How long?—not How much time? in many ordinary situations.
senses.usage_zomi: Hun sawtna dot dingin nisim zatna tampi ah How long? kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Continuing for or affecting a long period in the future.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hun sawt tawh kisai; hun sawtpi ding
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun sawtpi a om paisuak ding ahih kei leh mailam hun sawt sung huzaap nei ding na.

examples.english: We need a long-term plan for the project.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep geel ading hun sawtpi ding geelna ka kisam uh hi.

examples.english: Exercise has long-term health benefits.
examples.zomi: Pumpi kizohlhna in hun sawt sung cidamna phattuamna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Before a noun, long-term is usually hyphenated. After a linking verb, it may be written long term: Our plan is long term.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun ma ah long-term khenna khi tawh kigelh zel hi. Linking verb nungah Our plan is long term cih bangin khenna khi om lo in kigelh thei hi.

senses.heading: Direct your eyes
senses.definition_en: To direct your eyes toward someone or something in order to see them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat mu dingin tua lam en cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Look at the picture on the wall.
examples.zomi: Bang tung a lim en in.

examples.english: She looked out the window and saw snow.
examples.zomi: Amah kong-awk pan polam en a, vun mu hi.

senses.usage_en: Use look at before the object being viewed: look at me. See describes receiving a visual image; watch means looking at something for a period of time.
senses.usage_zomi: A ki-en object ma ah look at kizang hi: look at me. See in mu cihna a, watch in hun khat sung en cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Seem or appear
senses.definition_en: To seem to have a particular appearance or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muhtheihna ah omzia khat nei bang ahih kei leh bang hi ding cih a kilang.

examples.english: You look tired today.
examples.zomi: Tuni na gim bangin na kilang hi.

examples.english: The food looks delicious.
examples.zomi: An pen limtui ding bangin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: After look in this sense, use an adjective: look happy, not the adverb look happily.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah look nungah adjective kizang hi: look happy ci ding a, look happily ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Search
senses.definition_en: To try to find someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat mukhiat dingin zong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am looking for my keys.
examples.zomi: Ka tawhte ka zong hi.

examples.english: They are looking for a new house.
examples.zomi: Amaute inn thak khat zong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Look for means search. Find means successfully discovering the person or thing.
senses.usage_zomi: Look for in zong cihna a, find in zongkhia ahih kei leh mukhia cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not firmly fixed
senses.definition_en: Not firmly attached, held, or fastened in place.
senses.explanation_zomi: A munah kip takin a kicih, a kilen ahih kei leh a kikhih lo na.

examples.english: One of the chair’s legs is loose.
examples.zomi: Tutna khe khat khal hi.

examples.english: This screw has come loose.
examples.zomi: Hih screw khal suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Loose /luːs/ is an adjective. Do not confuse it with lose /luːz/, which is a verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Loose /luːs/ pen adjective ahi hi. Verb lose /luːz/ tawh helkhawm lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Not tight-fitting
senses.definition_en: Not fitting closely or tightly around the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi ah a ciat lo ahih kei leh a zawng lo na.

examples.english: Wear loose clothing in hot weather.
examples.zomi: Khua lum ciangin puan zawl silh in.

examples.english: These trousers are too loose around my waist.
examples.zomi: Hih ngawl kawngka ka kawngah zawl lua hi.

senses.usage_en: The opposite of loose in this sense is tight.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah loose a kikal pen tight ahi hi.

senses.heading: Free and not controlled
senses.definition_en: Free from a cage, chain, or other control.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kulh, khau ahih kei leh ukna pan suahtak in a om.

examples.english: A loose dog was running in the street.
examples.zomi: Ui khih lo khat lampi ah tai hi.

examples.english: The horse broke loose from the rope.
examples.zomi: Sakol khau pan kikhahtak hi.

senses.usage_en: Loose can describe something free to move, while free has several broader meanings.
senses.usage_zomi: Loose in khihna ahih kei leh lenna pan suahtak in kisuang thei cihna gen a, free in khiatna a zaizaw nei hi.

senses.heading: Man with authority or high rank
senses.definition_en: A man who has authority, power, land, or a high social rank.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ukna, vangliatna, leitang ahih kei leh mipi lakah dinmun sang a nei pasal.

examples.english: The lord controlled a large area of land.
examples.zomi: Topa in leitang zaipi uk hi.

examples.english: The villagers had to pay taxes to their lord.
examples.zomi: Khuamite in amau topa tungah sia pia ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This historical sense often refers to a male ruler or landowner. In modern Britain, Lord can also be an official title.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tangthu khiatna in pasal ukna nei ahih kei leh leitang nei kawk zel hi. Tulai Britain ah Lord pen min ma a kizang dinmun min zong ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Religious title
senses.definition_en: A title used for God or Jesus Christ in Christianity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Christian upna ah Pasian ahih kei leh Jesu Khazih kawhna dinmun min.

examples.english: Christians call Jesus Christ their Lord.
examples.zomi: Christian-te in Jesu Khazih amau Topa ci uh hi.

examples.english: They prayed to the Lord for guidance.
examples.zomi: Lamhilhna dingin Topa kiangah thungen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Lord when it is used as a title for God or Jesus Christ. In this project, God = Pasian, while Lord = Topa.
senses.usage_zomi: Pasian ahih kei leh Jesu Khazih min dinmun in kizang ciangin Lord laimal lian tawh kigelh hi. Hih nasep ah God = Pasian a, Lord = Topa ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van gik leh van tampi puakna ding a kizang mawtaw lian.

examples.english: The lorry delivered food to the supermarket.
examples.zomi: Truck in supermarket ah annek dingte pua hi.

examples.english: Several lorries were waiting outside the factory.
examples.zomi: Factory pualam ah truck pawlkhat ngak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Lorry is mainly British English. American English normally uses truck.
senses.usage_zomi: Lorry pen British English ah kizang phadiak hi. American English ah truck kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: No longer have something
senses.definition_en: To stop having something because you cannot find it or it has been taken away.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat mansuah ahih kei leh a kilak manin nei nawn lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I lost my phone on the bus.
examples.zomi: Bus tungah ka phone ka mansuah hi.

examples.english: Many people lost their jobs during the crisis.
examples.zomi: Buaipihna lian laitakin mi tampi in amau nasep taan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The forms are lose–lost–lost. Do not confuse lose /luːz/ with the adjective loose /luːs/.
senses.usage_zomi: A kammal khelna pen lose–lost–lost ahi hi. Adjective loose /luːs/ tawh helkhawm lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Be defeated
senses.definition_en: To fail to win a game, competition, argument, or battle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna, kidemna, kinialna ahih kei leh kidouna ah guallel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Our team lost the final game.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl un a nunung pen kimawlna ah guallel uh hi.

examples.english: She was disappointed when she lost the election.
examples.zomi: Teelna ah a guallelh ciangin lungkia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, lose may take the event as its object: lose the match. Use lose to before the winning opponent.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah lose the match cih bangin kidemna pen object ahi thei hi. A gualzo opponent ma ah lose to kizang hi.

senses.heading: Have less of a quality or condition
senses.definition_en: To gradually or suddenly have less of an ability, feeling, quality, or physical condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siamna, lungsim, omzia ahih kei leh pumpi dinmun khat a kiam ahih kei leh a bei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He lost confidence after the failure.
examples.zomi: A guallelh khit ciangin amah leh amah kimuanna taan hi.

examples.english: She is trying to lose weight.
examples.zomi: A pumpi gikna kiamsak dingin hanciam hi.

senses.usage_en: The correct translation of lose changes with its object; it does not always mean physically misplacing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Lose khiatna pen a object bangin kikhel a, na khat mansuah cihna bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: Losing someone or something
senses.definition_en: The act or experience of losing someone or something valuable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na manpha khat mansuah ahih kei leh taan phutkhakna.

examples.english: The loss of her job caused financial problems.
examples.zomi: A nasep taanna in sum lam buaipihna piangsak hi.

examples.english: The community mourned the loss of its leader.
examples.zomi: Khuamite in amau makai taan manin dah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring indirectly to someone’s death, loss is a gentle and respectful word.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat sihna a kician lo deuh in zahtakna tawh gen ciangin loss kizang hi.

senses.heading: Money lost in business
senses.definition_en: An amount of money lost when costs are greater than income.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumlehbawlna ah sumlut sang sumsen a tamzaw manin a kitan sum zat.

examples.english: The company reported a large loss last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa in company in sum tampi taan cih gen hi.

examples.english: The shop operated at a loss for several months.
examples.zomi: Dawr pen kha pawlkhat sung sum taan kawm in nasep hi.

senses.usage_en: In accounting, a loss is the opposite of a profit.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum tawh kisai ciamtehna ah loss a kikal pen profit ahi hi.

senses.heading: Defeat
senses.definition_en: A defeat in a game, competition, or battle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna, kidemna ahih kei leh kidouna ah guallelhna.

examples.english: The team suffered its first loss of the season.
examples.zomi: Pawl in hih kimawl hun sung amau guallelhna masapen thuak hi.

examples.english: They learned from the loss.
examples.zomi: Amau guallelhna pan pilna sin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In sports records, a loss is a game that a team or player did not win.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna ciamtehna ah loss in pawl ahih kei leh kimawlmi in a gualzawh lohna khat kawk hi.

senses.heading: Unable to find the way
senses.definition_en: Unable to find your way or know where you are.
senses.explanation_zomi: Paina lampi thei nawn lo ahih kei leh omna mun thei lo in vak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We got lost in the forest.
examples.zomi: Gam sungah ka lampial uh hi.

examples.english: The police helped the lost child find his parents.
examples.zomi: Police-te in naupang lampial a nu leh pa mu dingin huh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Get lost may mean becoming unable to find the way. As an angry command, it can also mean “Go away,” but that use is impolite.
senses.usage_zomi: Get lost in lampial cihna nei thei hi. Hehna tawh thu piakna in kizang leh “Paikhia in” cihna zong nei a, zahtakna om lo hi.

senses.heading: Missing or no longer possessed
senses.definition_en: Missing, misplaced, or no longer owned.
senses.explanation_zomi: A omna kimulo, a kiphawklo ahih kei leh kineih nawn lo na.

examples.english: She found her lost ring under the bed.
examples.zomi: A khutngun mang lupna nuai ah mukik hi.

examples.english: The program can recover lost data.
examples.zomi: Program in data mangte lakik thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Lost is the past participle of lose, but it also functions as an adjective.
senses.usage_zomi: Lost pen lose a past participle ahi a, adjective in zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: Confused and uncertain
senses.definition_en: Not knowing what to do or how to understand something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bang bawl ding ahih kei leh thu khat koibang tel ding thei lo in lungbuai na.

examples.english: I felt lost during the first week of my new job.
examples.zomi: Ka nasep thak kalsung masapen ah bang bawl ding thei lo in ka lungbuai hi.

examples.english: He looked lost during the discussion.
examples.zomi: Kiholimna sungah amah thu tel lo bangin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes confusion, not losing one’s physical location.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lim tawh zatna in omna mun mansuah cihna hilo in, bang bawl ding thei lo in lungbuai cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A large number or amount of people or things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na ahih kei leh zat khat a tam mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A lot has changed since last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa panin thu tampi kikhel hi.

examples.english: We learned a lot from the experience.
examples.zomi: Tua phutkhakna pan pilna tampi ka sin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A lot and lots are common in informal English. Before a noun, use a lot of or lots of: a lot of water; lots of books.
senses.usage_zomi: A lot leh lots nisim English ah kizang tam hi. Noun ma ah a lot of ahih kei leh lots of kizang hi: a lot of water; lots of books.

senses.definition_en: Producing a strong sound that is easy to hear and may be uncomfortable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw a ging mahmah a, zak baih napi bil a nuam lo sak thei na.

examples.english: A loud noise woke the baby.
examples.zomi: Aw ging khat in naungek phong hi.

examples.english: The music is too loud.
examples.zomi: La aw ngaih lua hi.

senses.usage_en: Loud describes the sound itself or something producing it. The usual adverb is loudly.
senses.usage_zomi: Loud in aw mah ahih kei leh aw ging a bawl na khat gen hi. A adverb ngeina pen loudly ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: With a strong or high level of sound.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw ging mahmah ahih kei leh aw ngaih takin.

examples.english: Please do not speak so loudly.
examples.zomi: Aw ngaih lua takin pau kei in.

examples.english: The children laughed loudly at the joke.
examples.zomi: Naupangte nuihzathu a zak uh ciangin ging takin nui uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Loudly modifies an action. Informal English sometimes uses loud as an adverb, especially after verbs such as talk or play.
senses.usage_zomi: Loudly in nasepna khat a bawldan hilhcian hi. Nisim English ah talk loud cih bangin loud zong adverb in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Deep affection
senses.definition_en: A strong feeling of affection and care for someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat it, deihsak leh kepna lungsim thuk.

examples.english: Parents show their love by caring for their children.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pate in a tate uh kepna tawh amau itna lak uh hi.

examples.english: Her love for her family is very strong.
examples.zomi: A innkuante a itna thuk mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Love is usually uncountable when it refers to affection. It can describe romantic, familial, spiritual, or compassionate affection.
senses.usage_zomi: Itna lungsim a gen ciangin love simtheih lo noun ahi zel hi. Nupa itna, innkuan itna, khalam itna ahih kei leh midang deihsakna kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Strong enjoyment or interest
senses.definition_en: A strong enjoyment of or interest in an activity or subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih kei leh thu khat tungah lunglutna leh nuamsakna lian nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He has a deep love of music.
examples.zomi: Ama in la lunglutna thuk nei hi.

examples.english: The teacher encouraged a love of reading.
examples.zomi: Sia in laibu simna lunglutna nei dingin thapia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use love of or love for before the activity or subject that someone strongly enjoys.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat in a lunglut mahmah nasep ahih kei leh thu ma ah love of ahih kei leh love for kizang hi.

senses.heading: Romantic affection
senses.definition_en: A strong romantic feeling for another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tungah nupa kizopna lam itna lungsim thuk nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They fell in love while they were at college.
examples.zomi: College a kai laitak un ki-it pan uh hi.

examples.english: The story is about love and sacrifice.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu pen itna leh kipiakkhiatna thu ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Fall in love describes beginning to love someone romantically; be in love describes the continuing condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Fall in love in nupa itna nei pan cihna a, be in love in ki-it in om paisuak cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Very pleasant, beautiful, or enjoyable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoih mahmah, nuam mahmah ahih kei leh lungdamhuai na.

examples.english: We had a lovely evening together.
examples.zomi: Nitaklam nuam mahmah ka zangkhawm uh hi.

examples.english: They live in a lovely house near the lake.
examples.zomi: Amaute tuili gei inn hoih mahmah khat ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Lovely is especially common in British English. It can describe appearance, character, weather, experiences, and many other pleasant things.
senses.usage_zomi: Lovely pen British English ah kizang tam phadiak hi. Mel, omzia, khuahun, phutkhakna leh na nuamhuai dang tampi gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Not high
senses.definition_en: Having a position, top, or height that is not far above the ground or another level.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leilung ahih kei leh tehna mun khat pan a sang nailo na.

examples.english: The plane was flying very low.
examples.zomi: Vanleng pen niam mahmah in leng hi.

examples.english: Be careful—the ceiling is low.
examples.zomi: Kidawm in—innkhum niam hi.

senses.usage_en: Low is the opposite of high. For a person’s height, use short, not usually low.
senses.usage_zomi: Low a kikal pen high ahi hi. Mihing a sanna gen dingin low sangin short kizang hi.

senses.heading: Small in amount, level, or degree
senses.definition_en: Small in amount, number, level, strength, or quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zat, sim, ciangtan, hatna ahih kei leh hoihna a tawm ahih kei leh niam na.

examples.english: The store sells food at low prices.
examples.zomi: Dawr in annek dingte man tawm tawh zuak hi.

examples.english: His energy level was low after the illness.
examples.zomi: A nat khit ciangin a tha ciangtan niam hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact Zomi equivalent changes with the noun: low price means a small price, while low temperature means a low degree of heat.
senses.usage_zomi: Zomi khiatna pen a noun bangin kikhel hi: low price in man tawm cihna a, low temperature in lumdan niam cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Quiet or deep in sound
senses.definition_en: Not loud, or produced at a deep musical pitch.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw ngaih lo ahih kei leh awging a niam na.

examples.english: She spoke in a low voice.
examples.zomi: Amah aw neem takin pau hi.

examples.english: The instrument produced a low sound.
examples.zomi: Tumging in awging niam khat suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Low may refer either to quiet volume or to a deep pitch; context shows which meaning is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Low in aw neem cihna ahih kei leh awging niam cihna nei thei a, thu omzia in a khiatna kilak hi.

senses.heading: Move something downward
senses.definition_en: To move someone or something to a lower position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a omna pan a niamzaw munah khiasuk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They lowered the box to the ground.
examples.zomi: Amaute in kuang leilung ah khiasuk uh hi.

examples.english: Please lower your hand.
examples.zomi: Na khut khiasuk in.

senses.usage_en: Lower normally takes an object. Fall or drop can describe something moving downward without a person deliberately moving it.
senses.usage_zomi: Lower in a khiasuk ding object kisam zel hi. Fall ahih kei leh drop in mi in tum neituam in khiasuk lo napi na khat a kiasuk gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Reduce an amount or level
senses.definition_en: To reduce the amount, level, price, strength, or intensity of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a zat, ciangtan, man, hatna ahih kei leh thahatna kiamsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The store lowered its prices.
examples.zomi: Dawr in a van mante kiamsak hi.

examples.english: Exercise can help lower blood pressure.
examples.zomi: Pumpi kizohlhna in sisan nawngna kiamsak dingin huh thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Lower is transitive: someone lowers something. Decrease can be either transitive or intransitive.
senses.usage_zomi: Lower pen transitive verb hi a, mi khat in na khat kiamsak hi. Decrease bel transitive ahih kei leh intransitive in kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Success or failure caused by chance rather than entirely by a person’s actions or ability.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nasep ahih kei leh siamna bek hang hilo in, mailam theih loh dinmun pan gualzawhna ahih kei leh guallelhna a pian.

examples.english: Good luck with your exam!
examples.zomi: Na sittelna ah hampha in!

examples.english: By good luck, nobody was injured.
examples.zomi: Hampha takin kuamah liam lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Luck is normally uncountable. Good luck! is a wish for success, not a statement that success requires no effort.
senses.usage_zomi: Luck pen simtheih lo noun in kizang zel hi. Good luck! in gualzawhna deihsakna ahi a, hahkat kul lo cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Having good results because of chance, or bringing good fortune.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam theih loh dinmun pan a hoih thu a ngah ahih kei leh hamphatna a nei na.

examples.english: We were lucky to find a hotel room.
examples.zomi: Hotel innkhan ka muh uh manin ka hampha uh hi.

examples.english: She was lucky that nobody was hurt.
examples.zomi: Kuamah a liam loh manin amah hampha hi.

senses.usage_en: Common patterns are be lucky to do something and be lucky that….
senses.usage_zomi: Be lucky to do something leh be lucky that… cih kammal zia-te kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: A meal eaten around the middle of the day.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sun laitak kimvel ah a kine nek.

examples.english: We usually have lunch at noon.
examples.zomi: Sun laitak in sun an ka ne zel uh hi.

examples.english: She brought her lunch to work.
examples.zomi: A nasepna ah a sun an keng hi.

senses.usage_en: Lunch is usually used without a when referring to the meal: We had lunch. Use a lunch when referring to a particular organized meal or type of lunch.
senses.usage_zomi: Nek hun a gen ciangin lunch ma ah a kikoih lo zel hi: We had lunch. Kithun nekna khat ahih kei leh sun an nam khat a gen ciangin a lunch kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Either of the two organs in the chest that take oxygen from the air and remove carbon dioxide from the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Awm sungah om a, huih sung pan oxygen la in pumpi sung pan carbon dioxide a paikhia sak pumpi sungthu a nihgel.

examples.english: Smoking can seriously damage the lungs.
examples.zomi: Zial zukna in phaphu nakpitakin susia thei hi.

examples.english: The doctor examined her lungs.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in a phaphu sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: Humans normally have two lungs. The plural is lungs.
senses.usage_zomi: Mihing in ngeina bangin phaphu nih nei hi. A plural pen lungs ahi hi.

senses.heading: Expensive comfort
senses.definition_en: Great comfort provided by expensive and beautiful things that are not necessary.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuntakna ding a kisam taktak hilo napi, na manpha leh hoihte hangin a kingah nuamna leh nopna lian.

common_phrases.zomi: van manpha leh nopna pia nate

examples.english: They lived in luxury during their stay at the hotel.
examples.zomi: Hotel ah a om sung un nopna lian tawh nungta uh hi.

examples.english: The house offers comfort and luxury.
examples.zomi: Tua inn in nuamna leh nopna lian pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Luxury is uncountable when it describes a general condition of expensive comfort.
senses.usage_zomi: Manpha nopna dinmun a gen ciangin luxury simtheih lo noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Something pleasant but unnecessary
senses.definition_en: Something enjoyable or comfortable that is not essential and may be expensive or difficult to obtain.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nopna pia na; kisam taktak lo van manpha
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuntakna ding a kisam taktak hilo napi, nuam leh lungdamhuai a, manpha ahih kei leh ngah haksa na khat.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat nopna van in ngaihsun

examples.english: For many families, overseas travel is a luxury.
examples.zomi: Innkuan tampi ading tuipi kan khualzin pen nopna van manpha khat ahi hi.

examples.english: A quiet afternoon alone is a rare luxury for her.
examples.zomi: Amah ading nitaklam amah bek dai takin omna pen ngah haksa nopna khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A countable luxury is a particular nonessential comfort. What counts as a luxury depends on a person’s circumstances.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtheih luxury in kisam taktak lo napi nopna a pia na tuam khat kawk hi. Bang pen luxury ahi diam cih mi khat dinmun tungah kinga hi.

senses.definition_en: A device with moving parts that uses power to perform a particular task.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tha a zang in nasep tuam khat a sem ding a kibawl, a sung a kisuangthei khen tuamtuam a nei van.

examples.english: This machine cuts metal into small pieces.
examples.zomi: Hih machine in sik a neu-neu in at hi.

examples.english: Turn off the machine before cleaning it.
examples.zomi: Machine na siansuah ma in mit in.

senses.usage_en: A machine usually uses mechanical or electrical power. A simple hand tool is not normally called a machine.
senses.usage_zomi: Machine in mechanical ahih kei leh electric tha zang zel hi. Khut tawh a kizang van baihlam khat pen machine kici lo zel hi.

senses.heading: Very angry
senses.definition_en: Very angry with someone or about something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tungah ahih kei leh thu khat hangin a heh mahmah.

examples.english: She was mad at me for arriving late.
examples.zomi: Ka tun man man loh manin ka tungah heh hi.

examples.english: Do not get mad over a small mistake.
examples.zomi: Khialhna neu khat hangin heh kei in.

senses.usage_en: In informal American English, mad commonly means angry. British English often uses angry for this meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim American English ah mad in heh cihna nei zel hi. British English ah hih khiatna dingin angry kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Mentally ill or behaving irrationally
senses.definition_en: Mentally ill, or behaving in a very unreasonable or uncontrolled way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim natna nei; ngaihsutna tawh kituak lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim natna nei ahih kei leh ngaihsutna tawh kituak lo leh ki-ukzo lo bangin gamta na.

examples.english: The constant noise was driving him mad.
examples.zomi: Awging tawntung in amah lungsim buaisak hi.

examples.english: It would be mad to travel in this storm.
examples.zomi: Hih huihpi sungah khualzin pen ngaihsutna tawh kituak lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling a person mad because of mental illness can sound disrespectful. Use a more precise expression such as mentally ill in careful or medical contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungsim natna hangin mi khat mad ci in kawh pen zahtakna om lo bangin ging thei hi. Kidop takin ahih kei leh cidamna lam thu ah mentally ill bang kammal kician kizangzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A publication containing articles, photographs, and advertisements that appears regularly in print or digital form.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hunseh tawh lai ahih kei leh digital in a kisua, thulu, lim leh van zuakna tangko nate a kihel laibu neem.

examples.english: She bought a travel magazine at the airport.
examples.zomi: Amah in vanleng tual ah khualzinna laibu neem khat lei hi.

examples.english: The article appeared in a science magazine.
examples.zomi: Tua thulu science laibu neem khat ah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: A magazine is published as a series of issues. It differs from a book, which is usually published as one complete work.
senses.usage_zomi: Magazine pen a khenkhen in hunseh tawh kisua hi. Laibu bel nasep kicing khat in khatvei a kisua zel hi.

senses.heading: Supernatural power
senses.definition_en: A supposed power that makes impossible things happen through supernatural forces.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ngeina tha tawh bawl theih lo nate khalam vangliatna tawh piangsak thei ding a ki-um tha.

examples.english: The story is about a king who uses magic.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu pen dawi siamna a zang kumpipa khat thu ahi hi.

examples.english: They believed the stone had magic.
examples.zomi: Tua suang in ngeina pualam vangliatna nei ci in um uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In stories, magic may be real within the fictional world. In ordinary life, the word may refer to beliefs about supernatural power.
senses.usage_zomi: Tangthu phuah sungah magic taktak bangin ki-en thei hi. Nisim nuntakna ah bel ngeina pualam vangliatna upna kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Entertainment using tricks
senses.definition_en: Entertainment in which a performer uses skill and hidden methods to make impossible things seem to happen.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mitkhem kimawlna; siamna tawh lamdang lakna
senses.explanation_zomi: Siamna leh a kiliah zia-te zang in piang thei lo bang nate piang bangin a lak kimawlna.

examples.english: The magician performed magic for the children.
examples.zomi: Mitkhem siam in naupangte ading mitkhem kimawlna lak hi.

examples.english: We could not understand how the magic trick worked.
examples.zomi: Tua mitkhem zia koici nasep cih ka tel kei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Stage magic uses skill and illusion; it does not claim to use real supernatural power.
senses.usage_zomi: Stage tung mitkhem kimawlna in siamna leh mit khemna zang a, ngeina pualam vangliatna taktak zang cih a gen lo hi.

senses.heading: Letters and packages
senses.definition_en: Letters and packages sent or delivered through a postal service.
senses.zomi_equivalents: post lai; laikhak leh van kikhak
senses.explanation_zomi: Post office tungtawn in a kikhak ahih kei leh a kipuak lai leh van tuamtuam.

examples.english: The letter came in the mail yesterday.
examples.zomi: Tua lai zani in post tawh hong tung hi.

examples.english: I will send the documents by mail.
examples.zomi: Laite post tawh ka khak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: American English uses mail for the postal system and delivered letters. British English commonly uses post.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah postal nasepna leh lai kikhakte dingin mail kizang hi. British English ah post kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Electronic mail
senses.definition_en: Messages sent electronically from one computer or device to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer, phone ahih kei leh digital van khat pan a dang khat ah internet tungtawn a kikhak thupuak.

examples.english: I received your mail this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsang in na email ka ngah hi.

examples.english: Please send the file by email.
examples.zomi: File email tawh hong khak in.

senses.usage_en: Email is clearer than mail when referring specifically to electronic messages.
senses.usage_zomi: Electronic thupuak bek a gen dingin mail sangin email a kicianzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: More important, larger, or more central than others of the same kind.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibang nate lakah a thupi pen, a lian pen ahih kei leh laizang pen na.

examples.english: The main reason for the delay was bad weather.
examples.zomi: A sawtna a thupi pen hang pen khuahun hoih lohna ahi hi.

examples.english: Meet me at the main entrance.
examples.zomi: Lutna kongpi ah hong mu in.

senses.usage_en: Main normally comes before a noun. Use major when emphasizing importance or size rather than identifying the single central one.
senses.usage_zomi: Main pen noun ma ah om zel hi. A thupi ahih kei leh a lian cih bulphuh dingin major kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: More than anything else; mostly or chiefly.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tamzaw in; a thupi zaw in
senses.explanation_zomi: A dangte sangin a tamzaw ahih kei leh a thupi zaw in.

examples.english: The village depends mainly on farming.
examples.zomi: Tua khua pen a tamzaw in loubawlna tungah kinga hi.

examples.english: I chose the course mainly because it was practical.
examples.zomi: A zat theih taktak ahih manin tua sinna ka teel phadiak hi.

senses.usage_en: Mainly means mostly, but not necessarily completely.
senses.usage_zomi: Mainly in a tamzaw cihna hi a, a vekpi cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Keep in good condition
senses.definition_en: To keep a building, machine, system, or other thing in good working condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn, machine, zia ahih kei leh na dang khat hoih takin nasem paisuak thei dingin kempha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The machine must be maintained regularly.
examples.zomi: Machine pen hunseh tawh kikempha ding hi.

examples.english: They maintain the building carefully.
examples.zomi: Amaute in inn kidop takin kempha uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Maintain includes inspection, cleaning, and repair needed to keep something working properly.
senses.usage_zomi: Maintain sungah sittelna, siansuahna leh na khat hoih takin nasem paisuak ding a bawlphatna kihel hi.

senses.heading: Keep something at the same level or condition
senses.definition_en: To continue something or keep it at a particular level or standard.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a omzia ahih kei leh ciangtan sehsa mahah omsak paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company wants to maintain high quality.
examples.zomi: Company in hoihna ciangtan sang kem paisuak nuam hi.

examples.english: She maintained control during the emergency.
examples.zomi: Lauhuai hun sungah amah ki-ukzo paisuak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes preventing an existing condition from changing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in a omkhin dinmun khat kikhel lo dingin kem paisuak cihna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: State firmly that something is true
senses.definition_en: To continue saying firmly that something is true, even when others disagree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte thukim lo napi thu khat thuman hi ci in kip takin gen paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He maintained that he had done nothing wrong.
examples.zomi: Ama in khialhna bangmah bawl lo cih kip takin gen hi.

examples.english: She has always maintained her innocence.
examples.zomi: Amah in mawh neilo cih kipsak tawntung hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense of maintain is common in news, legal writing, and formal discussion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih thukhun maintain zatna pen thuthang, thukham lai leh thukhun kiholimna ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Very important or serious
senses.definition_en: Very important, serious, or having a large effect.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a thupi; a lian; a nasia
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupi mahmah, nasia ahih kei leh huzaap lian nei na.

examples.english: Traffic is a major problem in the city.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah mawtaw paihna pen buaipihna lian khat ahi hi.

examples.english: This was a major decision for the company.
examples.zomi: Hih pen company ading khensatna thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Major is stronger than important in many contexts and often suggests a large effect.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu omzia tampi ah major pen important sangin thupizaw a, huzaap lian nei cihna gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Large in size or extent
senses.definition_en: Large in size, amount, or extent compared with others.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibang nate tawh tehkak ciangin a pumpi, zat ahih kei leh huamzang a lian na.

examples.english: Chicago is a major American city.
examples.zomi: Chicago pen America khuapi lian khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The river is a major source of water for the region.
examples.zomi: Tua gun pen gam khen ading tui a hong kipatna lian khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Before a noun, major may mean both large and important.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun ma ah major in a lian leh a thupi a nihgel in kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: More than half of a group or the larger part of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihon khat a kim sangin a tamzaw ahih kei leh na khat a khen tamzaw.

examples.english: The majority of students passed the exam.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte a tamzaw sittelna ong uh hi.

examples.english: The proposal received a clear majority of the votes.
examples.zomi: Tua thu puahna in vote a tamzaw kician takin ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the majority of + plural noun. The verb is often plural when referring to individuals: The majority of voters are…
senses.usage_zomi: The majority of + plural noun ci in kizang hi. Mimal tuamtuam kawk ciangin verb plural kizang tam hi: The majority of voters are…

senses.heading: Create or produce something
senses.definition_en: To create, build, prepare, or produce something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl, lam, bawlkhol ahih kei leh piangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She made a cake for her daughter.
examples.zomi: A tanu ading cake khat bawl hi.

examples.english: This factory makes car parts.
examples.zomi: Hih factory in mawtaw khen tuamtuam bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: The correct Zomi equivalent depends on what is made: food is prepared, a building is constructed, and a plan is formed.
senses.usage_zomi: Zomi khiatna pen a kibawl na bangin kikhel hi: an kibawl, inn kilam a, geelna kipuah hi.

senses.heading: Cause a result or condition
senses.definition_en: To cause someone or something to become a particular way or experience a particular result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat omzia tuam khat nei ding ahih kei leh thu tuam khat thuak dingin piangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The good news made everyone happy.
examples.zomi: Thuthang hoih in mi khempeuh lungdamsak hi.

examples.english: This tool makes the work easier.
examples.zomi: Hih vanzat in nasep baihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use make + object + adjective: make it easy. Do not add to be in this pattern.
senses.usage_zomi: Make + object + adjective ci in kizang hi: make it easy. Hih kammal zia ah to be kihel lo hi.

senses.heading: Force or strongly cause someone to act
senses.definition_en: To force or cause someone to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat na khat bawl kul sak ahih kei leh bawlsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher made the students rewrite the answers.
examples.zomi: Sia in sangnaupangte dawnna gelhkik sak hi.

examples.english: Do not make me wait outside.
examples.zomi: Pualam ah hong ngaksak kei in.

senses.usage_en: Use make + object + base verb without to: make him wait, not make him to wait.
senses.usage_zomi: Make + object + base verb ci in to om lo in kizang hi: make him wait ci ding a, make him to wait ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Earn or gain money
senses.definition_en: To earn or receive money through work or business.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih kei leh sumlehbawlna tungtawn in sum ngah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The business made a profit last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa in sumlehbawlna sum met ngah hi.

examples.english: She makes a living by selling clothes.
examples.zomi: Amah puan zuak in nuntakna ding sum ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Make money means earn or gain money; it does not usually mean physically producing currency.
senses.usage_zomi: Make money in sum ngah ahih kei leh sum met cihna hi a, sum lai pumpi bawl cihna hi lo zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Belonging to the sex that does not give birth to young or produces.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ta nei ahih kei leh chi anei numei ahilo, pasal suan tawh kisai na.

examples.english: The male bird has brighter feathers.
examples.zomi: Vasa-pa in ataangzaw kha-te nei hi.

examples.english: Most of the workers are male.
examples.zomi: Nasepmite a tamzaw pasal ahi uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Male is commonly used in biological, medical, or statistical descriptions. When referring to an adult human in ordinary speech, man is usually more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Male pen pianzia lam, cidamna lam ahih kei leh simna lam tawh kisai hilhcian ciangin kizang tam hi. Nisim pau tangzang ah mihing picing khat gen na in man kizang zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A large building or group of buildings containing many shops, restaurants, and other businesses.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawr, annekna mun leh sumlehbawlna tampi a omkhawm inn lian ahih kei leh inn hon.

examples.english: We went to the mall to buy clothes.
examples.zomi: Puan lei dingin dawr inn lian ah ka pai uh hi.

examples.english: The mall has more than one hundred stores.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr inn lian sungah dawr zakhat sangin tamzaw om hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, mall usually means a large shopping center.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah mall in dawr tampi a omkhawm dawr inn lian kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Adult male person
senses.definition_en: An adult male human being.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing pasal picing khat.

examples.english: A young man helped us carry the boxes.
examples.zomi: Tangval khat in kuangte puak dingin hong huh hi.

examples.english: The man standing by the door is my uncle.
examples.zomi: Kong gei a ding pasal pen ka pu ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use man for an adult male and boy for a male child. In formal contexts, male may be used for statistical or biological classification.
senses.usage_zomi: Pasal picing ading man kizang a, tapa naupang ading boy kizang hi. Thukhun simna ahih kei leh pianzia tawh kisai munah male kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Human beings generally
senses.definition_en: Human beings considered as a group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing khempeuh pawl khat in a kigente.

examples.english: Fire was one of man’s earliest discoveries.
examples.zomi: Mei pen mihingte muhkhia masapen nate lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The disease can spread from animals to man.
examples.zomi: Tua natna gan pan mihing tungah kizel thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This general use of man is traditional, but modern English often prefers humanity, humankind, or human beings because these forms clearly include everyone.
senses.usage_zomi: Mihing khempeuh kawk in man zatna pen ngeina ahi hi. Tulai English ah mi khempeuh kihel kician dingin humanity, humankind, ahih kei leh human beings kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Control or organize
senses.definition_en: To control, organize, or be responsible for a business, team, activity, or resource.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumlehbawlna, pawl, nasep ahih kei leh vanzat khat uk, vaihawm ahih kei leh mawhpuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She manages a small restaurant.
examples.zomi: Amah in annekna mun neu khat uk hi.

examples.english: You must learn to manage your time well.
examples.zomi: Na hun hoih takin zangsiam ding na sin kul hi.

senses.usage_en: A person who manages an organization or team is a manager.
senses.usage_zomi: Kipawlna ahih kei leh pawl a uk leh vaihawm mi pen manager kici hi.

senses.heading: Succeed in doing something difficult
senses.definition_en: To succeed in doing something, especially when it is difficult.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat haksa napi hanciam in bawl zo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We managed to finish the work on time.
examples.zomi: Nasep hun sungin ka khin zo uh hi.

examples.english: He managed to open the locked door.
examples.zomi: Ama in kong kha hong zo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use manage to + verb: manage to succeed. Do not normally use manage doing for this meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Manage to + verb ci in kizang hi: manage to succeed. Hih khiatna ah manage doing ci in kizang lo zel hi.

senses.heading: Deal with a situation
senses.definition_en: To deal successfully with a difficult situation, responsibility, or limited resource.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun haksa, mawhpuak ahih kei leh vanzat tawm khat hoih takin vaihawm zo cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: huhna om lo in vaihawm zo

examples.english: Can you manage without my help?
examples.zomi: Ka huhna om lo in na vaihawm zo diam?

examples.english: The family manages on a limited income.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in sumlut tawm tawh nuntak zo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, manage emphasizes coping successfully with what is available.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah manage in a omzah vanzat leh dinmun tawh haksatna kantan zo cihna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Process of controlling and organizing
senses.definition_en: The work or process of controlling, organizing, and directing a business, activity, or resource.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumlehbawlna, nasep ahih kei leh vanzat khat uk, vaihawm leh lamkaihna nasep.

examples.english: Good management helped the company grow.
examples.zomi: Vaihawmna hoih in company khangto dingin huh hi.

examples.english: Time management is important for students.
examples.zomi: Hun zat siam pen sangnaupangte ading thupi hi.

senses.usage_en: Management may describe either a field of study or the practical work of organizing people and resources.
senses.usage_zomi: Management in sinna lam khat ahih kei leh mite leh vanzatte vaihawmna nasep taktak kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: People who manage an organization
senses.definition_en: The group of people responsible for controlling and making decisions in an organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kipawlna khat uk leh khensatna bawl ding mawhpuak a nei mihon.

examples.english: Management approved the new policy.
examples.zomi: Vaihawmpite in thukhun thak phal uh hi.

examples.english: The workers met with management.
examples.zomi: Nasepmite vaihawmpite tawh kimu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When management means the managing group, it may take a singular or plural verb depending on whether the group is viewed as one unit or as individuals.
senses.usage_zomi: Management in vaihawmpite kawk ciangin pawl khat in ki-en leh singular verb a, mimal tuamtuam in ki-en leh plural verb zang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A person responsible for controlling, organizing, and directing a business, team, department, or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumlehbawlna, pawl, department ahih kei leh nasep khat uk, vaihawm leh makaih ding mawhpuak a nei mi.

examples.english: The manager hired two new workers.
examples.zomi: Vaihawmpa in nasepmi thak nih la hi.

examples.english: She is the manager of a local bank.
examples.zomi: Amah khuasung bank khat a vaihawmpa ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A manager usually has responsibility for people, work, money, or other resources. The exact duties differ among organizations.
senses.usage_zomi: Manager in mite, nasep, sum ahih kei leh vanzat dangte vaihawm ding mawhpuak nei zel hi. Nasep kician pen kipawlna khat leh khat ah kilamdang hi.

senses.heading: Way of doing something
senses.definition_en: The particular way in which someone does something or in which something happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in na khat a bawldan ahih kei leh thu khat a piandan tuam.

examples.english: She answered the question in a calm manner.
examples.zomi: Amah in dotna lungmuang takin dawng hi.

examples.english: The work must be completed in a careful manner.
examples.zomi: Nasep pen kidop takin kizo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Manner is more formal than way. In many ordinary sentences, way sounds more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Manner pen way sangin thukhun zaw hi. Nisim sentence tampi ah way a pianzia zaw hi.

senses.heading: Social behavior
senses.definition_en: A person’s way of behaving toward other people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in midangte tungah a gamtat leh a kizoppih dan.

examples.english: His friendly manner made people feel comfortable.
examples.zomi: A lawmdan nei omzia in mite nuamsak hi.

examples.english: She spoke in a polite manner.
examples.zomi: Amah zahtakna tawh pau hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural expression manners usually means socially polite behavior: good manners.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural manners in mihing kikal a zahtakna nei gamtatdan kawk zel hi: good manners.

senses.definition_en: A large number of people or countable things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh simtheih na a sim in a tam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Many students attended the meeting.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang tampi kikhopna ah pai uh hi.

examples.english: How many books did you buy?
examples.zomi: Laibu bangzah na lei hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use many with countable plural nouns: many books. Use much with uncountable nouns: much water. In affirmative informal speech, a lot of is often more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Many pen simtheih plural noun tawh kizang hi: many books. Simtheih lo noun tawh much kizang hi: much water. Nisim affirmative pau ah a lot of a pianzia zaw zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A drawing or digital image showing the position of places, roads, rivers, and other features of an area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam, khuapi ahih kei leh mun khat sung a khuate, lampite, gun leh mun tuamtuam a omna a lak lai ahih kei leh digital lim.

examples.english: We used a map to find the village.
examples.zomi: Khua zong dingin gam lim ka zang uh hi.

examples.english: The map shows all the main roads.
examples.zomi: Gam lim in lampi lian khempeuh lak hi.

senses.usage_en: A map represents a place from above and usually uses symbols, colors, and labels.
senses.usage_zomi: Map in mun khat tunglam pan en bangin lak a, lim, mel leh minte zang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: The third month of the year, after February and before April.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sung kha thumna, February khit leh April ma a kha.

examples.english: The course begins in March.
examples.zomi: Sinna March kha in kipan hi.

examples.english: Her birthday is on March 15.
examples.zomi: A pian ni March 15 ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Names of months begin with a capital letter in English. Use in with the month alone and on with a particular date.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah kha minte laimal lian tawh kipan hi. Kha bek tawh in kizang a, ni kician tawh on kizang hi.

senses.heading: Write or make a sign on something
senses.definition_en: To write, draw, cut, or place a sign on something so that it can be identified or noticed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat theihkhiat ahih kei leh muhtheih dingin laimal, khi, atna ahih kei leh lim khat koih cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: mark a place on a map

examples.english: Mark the correct answer with a check.
examples.zomi: Dawnna maan check lim tawh ciapteh in.

examples.english: She marked the location on the map.
examples.zomi: Amah in gam lim tungah omna mun ciapteh hi.

senses.usage_en: A mark may identify, select, warn, or draw attention to something.
senses.usage_zomi: Ciaptehna in na khat theihkhiat, teel, kidop ding hilh ahih kei leh lungsim ngahsak thei hi.

senses.heading: Grade schoolwork
senses.definition_en: To examine a student’s work and give it a score, grade, or correction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sangnaupang nasep sittel in score, grade ahih kei leh bawlphat ding ciamteh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher marked our exams last night.
examples.zomi: Sia in zankim in ka sittelna laite uh sittel hi.

examples.english: She has fifty papers to mark.
examples.zomi: Amah in sittel ding lai sawmnga nei hi.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses mark for grading schoolwork. American English often uses grade.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah sangnaupang nasep sittelna dingin mark kizang tam hi. American English ah grade kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Show or celebrate an event
senses.definition_en: To show that an event, change, or period is important, often by celebrating or remembering it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piangna, kikhelna ahih kei leh hun khat thupi cih lak dingin pawi bawl ahih kei leh phawkkik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The ceremony marked the opening of the new school.
examples.zomi: Pawi in sang thak kihonna ciamteh hi.

examples.english: They planted a tree to mark their anniversary.
examples.zomi: Amau kumcin phawkkikna in singkung khat phut uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, mark means recognize the importance of an event, not merely draw a visible sign.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah mark in lim muhtheih suai cihna bek hilo in, piangna khat thupina phawk leh ciamteh cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Place where goods are sold
senses.definition_en: A place where people buy and sell food, clothing, and other goods.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite in an, puan leh van tuamtuam a zuak leh a leina mun.

examples.english: She bought fresh vegetables at the market.
examples.zomi: Amah in khuak ah an-hing thak lei hi.

examples.english: The market opens early in the morning.
examples.zomi: Khuak zingsang in hong baih hi.

senses.usage_en: A market may be an open area, a building, or a regularly organized selling event.
senses.usage_zomi: Market pen mun kihong, inn khat ahih kei leh hunseh tawh a kibawl van zuakna hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Trade in a particular product
senses.definition_en: The buying and selling of a particular product or service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van ahih kei leh nasep tuam khat a kilei leh a kizuakna sumlehbawlna.

examples.english: House prices have risen in the local market.
examples.zomi: Khuasung inn khuak ah inn man kahto hi.

examples.english: She works in the financial market.
examples.zomi: Amah sum tawh kisai khuak ah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, market refers to an area of economic activity rather than a physical shopping place.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah market in van leina mun pumpi hilo in, sumlehbawlna khen khat kawk hi.

senses.heading: People who may buy something
senses.definition_en: The group of people or organizations that may want to buy a particular product or service.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lei ding mite; van deih ding mihon
senses.explanation_zomi: Van ahih kei leh nasep tuam khat lei nuam ding mi ahih kei leh kipawlna hon.

examples.english: Young adults are the main market for this product.
examples.zomi: Hih van ading tangval leh nungak picingte lei ding mihon thupi pen ahi uh hi.

examples.english: The company hopes to enter the Asian market.
examples.zomi: Company in Asia gamte ah a van zuak theih lam-en hi.

senses.usage_en: Businesses study a market to understand potential customers and their needs.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumlehbawlte in van lei thei ding mite leh amau kisapna tel dingin market zongkhe uh hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity of understanding customers and promoting, pricing, and selling products or services to them.
senses.zomi_equivalents: van tangko leh zuakna; khuak vaihawmna
senses.explanation_zomi: Van lei ding mite leh amau kisapna tel in, van ahih kei leh nasep a man seh, tangko leh zuakna nasep.

examples.english: The company uses social media for marketing.
examples.zomi: Company in a van tangko leh zuakna dingin social media zang hi.

examples.english: Good marketing can help a small business grow.
examples.zomi: Van tangko leh zuakna hoih in sumlehbawlna neu khangto dingin huh thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Marketing includes research, promotion, pricing, and customer communication. It is broader than advertising, which is mainly paid promotion.
senses.usage_zomi: Marketing sungah zongkhiatna, tangkona, man sehna leh van lei ding mite tawh kiholimna kihel hi. Sum pia in van tangko phadiak advertising sangin a huamzang zaizaw hi.

senses.heading: Legal or socially recognized union
senses.definition_en: A legally or socially recognized relationship between two people who are married.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nupa in khawsak khawm ding thukham ahih kei leh mipi ngeina in a phuksa kizopna.

examples.english: They have had a happy marriage for twenty years.
examples.zomi: Amaute kum sawmnih sung nupa kitenna nuam nei uh hi.

examples.english: Trust is important in a marriage.
examples.zomi: Nupa kitenna ah kimuanna thupi hi.

senses.usage_en: Marriage refers to the relationship or institution; wedding refers to the ceremony and celebration.
senses.usage_zomi: Marriage in nupa kizopna ahih kei leh kitenna zia kawk a, wedding in kitenna pawi kawk hi.

senses.heading: Act of getting married
senses.definition_en: The act or process of becoming married.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nupa in kitenna ahih kei leh nupa suakna.

examples.english: Their marriage took place in June.
examples.zomi: Amau kitenna June kha in om hi.

examples.english: Both families supported the marriage.
examples.zomi: Innkuan a nih un kitenna thukim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, marriage may refer to the formal act of marrying, although wedding is more usual for the event itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah marriage in kitenna nasep kawk thei napi, kitenna pawi mah a gen dingin wedding kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a husband or wife.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zi ahih kei leh pasal nei in nupa a kiten khin.

examples.english: They have been married for ten years.
examples.zomi: Amaute kum sawm kiten khin uh hi.

examples.english: She is married to a teacher.
examples.zomi: Amah sia khat tawh kiten hi.

senses.usage_en: Say married to someone, not married with someone. Get married describes the change; be married describes the condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Married to someone ci ding a, married with someone ci lo ding hi. Get married in kiten cihna a, be married in kiten khin in om cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Become someone’s husband or wife
senses.definition_en: To become legally or socially recognized as someone’s husband or wife.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh thukham ahih kei leh ngeina bangin nupa kiten cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She married her college friend.
examples.zomi: Amah college a lawm tawh kiten hi.

examples.english: They plan to marry next year.
examples.zomi: Kumkik ciangin kiten ding geel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Say marry someone without with or to. However, the passive form is be married to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Marry someone ci in with ahih kei leh to om lo in kizang hi. Ahih hang passive form pen be married to someone ahi hi.

senses.heading: Perform a marriage ceremony
senses.definition_en: To conduct the ceremony that makes two people married.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nih ading nupa kitenna pawi makaih in kiten sak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mite kiten sak ding thukham in phal

examples.english: The pastor married the couple at the church.
examples.zomi: Pastor in biakinn ah nupa kiten sak hi.

examples.english: Only an authorized person may marry them legally.
examples.zomi: Thukham in a phal mi bek in amaute kiten sak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this transitive sense, the officiant marries the couple; the two people marry each other.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih transitive khiatna ah pawi makai in nupa-te marries a, mi a nih in khat leh khat kiten uh hi.

senses.heading: Large amount or number
senses.definition_en: A large amount or number of something gathered together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na ahih kei leh mi tampi a omkhawm zat lian.

examples.english: A mass of people gathered outside the building.
examples.zomi: Inn pualam ah mihon lian khat kikhawm hi.

examples.english: The report contains a mass of information.
examples.zomi: Report sungah thu tampi om hi.

senses.usage_en: A mass of emphasizes a large quantity, often without focusing on separate individual parts.
senses.usage_zomi: A mass of in khen tuamtuam sangin a omkhawm zat a tamna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Physical matter
senses.definition_en: The amount of matter in an object, usually measured in grams or kilograms.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sungah a om pumpi bawlna zat, gram ahih kei leh kilogram tawh a kiteh.

examples.english: The object has a mass of two kilograms.
examples.zomi: Tua van a mass kilogram nih ahi hi.

examples.english: Scientists measured the mass of the rock.
examples.zomi: Science siamte in suang a mass teh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In science, mass and weight are different. Mass is the amount of matter; weight is the force of gravity on that mass.
senses.usage_zomi: Science ah mass leh weight kibang lo hi. Mass pen pumpi bawlna zat ahi a, weight pen tua mass tungah leitung hipna in a piak tha ahi hi.

senses.heading: Roman Catholic worship service
senses.definition_en: The main worship service of the Roman Catholic Church, including the Eucharist.
senses.zomi_equivalents: Mass biakna; Topa Ankuang biak kikhopna
senses.explanation_zomi: Roman Catholic biakinn a biakna thupi, Topa Ankuang kihelna biak kikhopna.

examples.english: The family attends Mass every Sunday.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in Sunday simin Mass biakna ah pai uh hi.

examples.english: The priest celebrated Mass in the morning.
examples.zomi: Siampipa in zingsang in Mass biakna makaih hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Mass when referring to the Roman Catholic worship service. It is normally used without the in expressions such as attend Mass.
senses.usage_zomi: Roman Catholic biakna a kawk ciangin Mass laimal lian tawh kigelh hi. Attend Mass cih bang kammal ah the om lo in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Extremely large, heavy, serious, or extensive.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a lian mahmah; a nasia mahmah
senses.explanation_zomi: A lian mahmah, a gik mahmah, a nasia mahmah ahih kei leh huamzang a zai mahmah na.

examples.english: The storm caused massive damage.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in siatna lian mahmah piangsak hi.

examples.english: They built a massive bridge across the river.
examples.zomi: Amaute in gun kantan lei lian mahmah khat lam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Massive is stronger than large and often emphasizes unusually great size or effect.
senses.usage_zomi: Massive pen large sangin thupizaw a, ngeina sang a lian lua pumpi ahih kei leh huzaap gen hi.

senses.heading: Person with very great skill
senses.definition_en: A person who has extremely high skill or knowledge in a particular activity or subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih kei leh pilna khen khat ah siamna leh theihna sang mahmah a nei mi.

examples.english: She is a master of traditional weaving.
examples.zomi: Amah ngeina puan khawng siam mahmah mi ahi hi.

examples.english: It takes years of practice to become a master.
examples.zomi: Siampa khat suak dingin kum tampi kizohlh kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Master suggests a very high level of skill, not merely basic competence.
senses.usage_zomi: Master in siamna neubek hilo in, siamna ciangtan sang mahmah nei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Person who controls another person or animal
senses.definition_en: A person who has control or authority over another person, animal, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, gan ahih kei leh dinmun khat tungah ukna leh thu nei mi.

examples.english: The servant obeyed his master.
examples.zomi: Sila in a topa thu mang hi.

examples.english: The dog followed its master home.
examples.zomi: Ui in a topa inn dong zui hi.

senses.usage_en: Referring to the owner of a person reflects historical slavery or servitude and may be sensitive. For animals, modern English often prefers owner.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat neitu a cihna in tanglai sila neihna kawk a, kidop huai hi. Gan thu ah tulai English in owner zang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Advanced university degree holder or student
senses.definition_en: A person who has completed, or is studying for, a master’s degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: University master’s degree a ngah khin ahih kei leh tua degree ading a sin mi.

examples.english: She is a master’s student in public administration.
examples.zomi: Amah public administration master’s degree a sin sangnaupang ahi hi.

examples.english: He completed his master’s degree last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa in a master’s degree zo hi.

senses.usage_en: The degree is called a master’s degree, with an apostrophe. Specific degree names such as Master of Arts use capital letters.
senses.usage_zomi: Degree pen apostrophe tawh master’s degree kici hi. Master of Arts bang degree min kician laimal lian tawh kigelh hi.

senses.definition_en: Having the same or a suitably similar color, design, appearance, or style.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mel, lim, muhdan ahih kei leh zia kibang ahih keileh kituak na.

examples.english: They wore matching shirts.
examples.zomi: Amaute puan-gi kibang silh uh hi.

examples.english: She bought a bag with matching shoes.
examples.zomi: Amah in khedap tawh a kituak ip khat lei hi.

senses.usage_en: Matching may mean exactly the same or simply suitable together.
senses.usage_zomi: Matching in a kibang lianliang ahih kei leh khat leh khat a kituak cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Substance used to make something
senses.definition_en: A substance from which something is made.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawlna ding a kizang a bul van.

examples.english: Wood is a common building material.
examples.zomi: Sing pen inn lamna van kizang tam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The bag is made from recycled material.
examples.zomi: Tua ip pen kizangkik bawlna van tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Material can be countable when referring to different kinds of substance and uncountable when speaking generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Bawlna van nam tuamtuam gen ciangin material simtheih noun hi thei a, a umum in a gen ciangin simtheih lo noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Cloth
senses.definition_en: Cloth used for making clothes, curtains, or similar products.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan, dalna puan leh a kibang nate bawlna ding puanlap.

examples.english: She bought material to make a dress.
examples.zomi: Numei puan bawl dingin puanlap lei hi.

examples.english: This material is soft and light.
examples.zomi: Hih puanlap nem leh zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, material is another word for fabric or cloth.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah material pen fabric ahih kei leh cloth tawh khiatna kibang hi.

senses.heading: Information used for study or work
senses.definition_en: Information, ideas, or documents used for study, teaching, writing, or another activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisinna, kihilhna, laigelhna ahih kei leh nasep dang khat a kizang thu, ngaihsutna leh lai-te.

examples.english: The teacher prepared new learning materials.
examples.zomi: Sia in kisinna van thak bawl hi.

examples.english: This book provides useful reference material.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu in zat theih muanna lai pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In education, the plural materials commonly refers to books, worksheets, videos, and other learning resources.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna lamah plural materials in laibu, nasep lai, video leh kisinna van dangte kawk zel hi.

senses.definition_en: The study of numbers, quantities, shapes, patterns, and their relationships.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim, zat, lim, omzia leh amau kikal kizopna a kisinna pilna.

examples.english: Mathematics is an important school subject.
examples.zomi: Simpilna pen sangkah a thupi sinna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She teaches mathematics at a high school.
examples.zomi: Amah high school ah simpilna hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: Mathematics ends in -s but is normally treated as singular: Mathematics is difficult.
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics pen -s tawh tawp napi singular in kizang zel hi: Mathematics is difficult.

senses.definition_en: Mathematics, especially as a school subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim, zat, lim leh amau kizopna a kisinna simpilna.

examples.english: Maths was my favorite subject at school.
examples.zomi: Sangkah ah simpilna ka lunglut pen sinna ahi hi.

examples.english: He is very good at maths.
examples.zomi: Ama simpilna siam mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Maths is the usual British abbreviation of mathematics. American English normally uses math. Both are treated as singular.
senses.usage_zomi: Maths pen British English a mathematics tomlak ahi hi. American English ah math kizang zel hi. A nihgel singular in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Subject or situation
senses.definition_en: A subject, situation, or problem that people are considering or dealing with.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite in a ngaihsut, a kiholim ahih kei leh a vaihawm uh thu, dinmun ahih kei leh buaipihna.

examples.english: We will discuss the matter tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing ciangin tua thu ka kiholim ding uh hi.

examples.english: This is a private family matter.
examples.zomi: Hih pen innkuan sung mimal thu ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Matter is a general and sometimes formal word for a subject, issue, or problem.
senses.usage_zomi: Matter pen thu, vai ahih kei leh buaipihna a umum in a genna kammal ahi a, thukhun bangin ging thei hi.

senses.heading: Physical substance
senses.definition_en: Any physical substance from which objects and living things are made.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van leh a nungta nate pumpi a kibawlna zat omthei khempeuh.

common_phrases.zomi: a nungta pan a hong piang na

examples.english: Matter can exist as a solid, liquid, or gas.
examples.zomi: Matter pen a khauhsa, a luangthei ahih kei leh huih in om thei hi.

examples.english: The soil contains organic matter.
examples.zomi: Leivui sungah a nungta nate pan a hong piang pumpi bawlna zat om hi.

senses.usage_en: In science, matter is uncountable and refers to physical substance generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Science ah matter simtheih lo noun ahi a, pumpi nei zat khempeuh a umum in kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: As great, high, large, or numerous as possible or permitted.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tawppen; a sang pen; a tam pen
senses.explanation_zomi: A piangthei ahih kei leh a kiphal ciangtan sungah a lian pen, a sang pen ahih kei leh a tam pen na.

examples.english: The maximum speed is 55 miles per hour.
examples.zomi: Manlang pen ciangtan nai khat sung mile 55 ahi hi.

examples.english: The room has a maximum capacity of two hundred people.
