examples.zomi: Innkhan sungah mi zahnih dong lutsak theih hi.

senses.usage_en: Maximum gives the highest permitted or possible point. Its opposite is minimum.
senses.usage_zomi: Maximum in a kiphal ahih kei leh a piangthei a tawppen lak hi. A kikal pen minimum ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The fifth month of the year, after April and before June.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sung kha ngana, April khit leh June ma a kha.

examples.english: The flowers usually open in May.
examples.zomi: Pante May kha in hong pak zel hi.

examples.english: The meeting is scheduled for May 10.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna May 10 dingin kigeel hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize May when it names the month. The modal verb may is written with a lowercase letter unless it begins a sentence.
senses.usage_zomi: Kha min a hih ciangin May laimal lian tawh kigelh hi. Modal verb may pen sentence kipatna hilo leh laimal neu tawh kigelh hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a hih kha ding; hi thei
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat piang thei napi kipsak theih nailo cihna lakna kammal.

common_phrases.zomi: a hih kha leh a nung ciangin
a hih kha leh hilo ding

examples.english: Maybe we can meet tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing a hih kha leh kimu thei ding hihang.

examples.english: “Will she come?” “Maybe.”
examples.zomi: “Amah hong pai ding hiam?” “Hong pai kha ding.”

senses.usage_en: Maybe is one word and means “perhaps.” May be is a two-word verb phrase: It may be true.
senses.usage_zomi: Maybe pen kammal khat ahi a, perhaps tawh khiatna kibang hi. May be pen kammal nih tawh verb phrase ahi hi: It may be true.

senses.definition_en: The object form of I, used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu a gen mi in amah mah kawkna ding a zang I a object form.

examples.english: Can you help me with this box?
examples.zomi: Hih kuang tawh kisai kei hong huh thei diam?

examples.english: She gave me a book.
examples.zomi: Amah in laibu khat hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use me as the object of a verb or preposition: She called me; come with me. Use I as the subject: My friend and I went.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb ahih kei leh preposition object in me kizang hi: She called me; come with me. Subject in I kizang hi: My friend and I went.

senses.definition_en: Food eaten at a regular time, such as breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zingsang an, sun an ahih kei leh nitak an bangin hunseh tawh a kine an.

examples.english: We shared a meal after the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna khit ciangin an ka nekhawm uh hi.

examples.english: She prepared a healthy meal for the family.
examples.zomi: Amah in innkuan ading cidamna tawh kituak an huan hi.

senses.usage_en: A meal is the whole eating occasion or the food served then. A dish is one particular prepared food within a meal.
senses.usage_zomi: Meal in annek hun pumpi ahih kei leh tua hun a an khempeuh kawk hi. Dish in annekna sung a an nam khat kawk hi.

senses.heading: Have a particular meaning
senses.definition_en: To express, represent, or refer to a particular idea or fact.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, lim ahih kei leh gamtatna khat in ngaihsutna ahih kei leh thu tuam khat kawk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: What does this word mean?
examples.zomi: Hih kammal in bang kawk hiam?

examples.english: A red light means that you must stop.
examples.zomi: Khuavak san in na tawl ding cih kawk hi.

senses.usage_en: In questions about definitions, use What does … mean?, not What means …?
senses.usage_zomi: Khiatna dot ciangin What does … mean? ci ding a, What means …? ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Intend
senses.definition_en: To intend or plan to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl ding lungsim ahih kei leh geelna nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I meant to call you yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zani in kong phone tum hi.

examples.english: She did not mean to offend anyone.
examples.zomi: Amah in kuamah lungnatsak tum lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Mean to do something expresses intention. Mean doing something describes a result or requirement.
senses.usage_zomi: Mean to do something in bawl ding tupna gen hi. Mean doing something in a result ahih kei leh kisapna gen hi.

senses.heading: Have a result or involve something
senses.definition_en: To have a particular result, consequence, or necessary condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat hangin result tuam khat piang ahih kei leh na khat bawl kul cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The change will mean more work for everyone.
examples.zomi: Tua kikhelna in mi khempeuh ading nasep tamzaw kisam sak ding hi.

examples.english: Taking this job means moving to another city.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep la leh khuapi dangah kikhin kul ding hi.

senses.usage_en: After mean in this sense, use the -ing form: This means waiting longer.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah mean nungah -ing form kizang hi: This means waiting longer.

senses.heading: Idea expressed by a word or sign
senses.definition_en: The idea or message expressed by a word, phrase, sign, or action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, kammal hon, lim ahih kei leh gamtatna khat in a kawk ngaihsutna ahih kei leh thupuak.

examples.english: I do not understand the meaning of this sentence.
examples.zomi: Hih sentence khiatna ka tel kei hi.

examples.english: The word has two different meanings.
examples.zomi: Tua kammal in khiatna tuam nih nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Meaning tells what something communicates. A definition is a statement that explains that meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Meaning in na khat in bang kawk cih gen a, definition in tua khiatna a hilhcian kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Importance or purpose
senses.definition_en: Importance, value, or purpose in someone’s life or in a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nuntakna ahih kei leh dinmun khat sung a thupina, manphatna ahih kei leh ngimna.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat khiatna leh manphatna pia

examples.english: Helping others gives meaning to her life.
examples.zomi: Midangte huhna in a nuntakna khiatna leh manphatna pia hi.

examples.english: He searched for meaning after the loss.
examples.zomi: A taanna khit ciangin nuntakna ngimna zong hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, meaning concerns purpose or significance rather than a dictionary definition.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah meaning in dictionary hilhcian hilo in, ngimna ahih kei leh manphatna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Method or way
senses.definition_en: A method, tool, or way used to achieve a result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Result khat ngahna ding a kizang zia, lampi ahih kei leh vanzat.

examples.english: Email is a useful means of communication.
examples.zomi: Email pen kiholimna ding zat theih lampi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: They crossed the river by means of a small boat.
examples.zomi: Amaute in tembaw neu khat zang in gun kantan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Means has the same form in the singular and plural: one means; several means.
senses.usage_zomi: Singular leh plural ah means a gelhdan kibang hi: one means; several means.

senses.heading: Money and resources
senses.definition_en: The money, property, or resources that a person has available.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a zat theih sum, neihlelam leh vanzat khempeuh.

examples.english: The family lives within its means.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in amau sum ngahzah sungin nungta uh hi.

examples.english: Private education was beyond their means.
examples.zomi: Private sang kaihna pen amau sum zawh loh ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this financial sense, means is plural in form and normally refers collectively to available resources.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum tawh kisai hih khiatna ah means plural bangin om a, a zat theih sum leh vanzat a vekpi kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: During the same period of time as another event; in the time before something else happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu dang khat a piang laitak mah ah, ahih kei leh thu dang khat a pian ngak sungin.

common_phrases.zomi: tua ngak sungin an bawl in

examples.english: I prepared dinner; meanwhile, she cleaned the room.
examples.zomi: Kei in nitak an ka bawl a, tua laitakin amah in innkhan siansuah hi.

examples.english: The doctor will arrive soon. Meanwhile, please wait here.
examples.zomi: Siavuan sawt lo in hong tung ding hi. Tua ngak sungin hih munah ngak in.

senses.usage_en: Meanwhile connects events happening at the same time or fills the waiting period before another event.
senses.usage_zomi: Meanwhile in hun khat sung a thu nih a piangkhawm kizomsak ahih kei leh thu khat ngak sung a bawl ding gen hi.

senses.heading: Find size, amount, or degree
senses.definition_en: To find the size, length, weight, amount, or degree of something using a standard unit or instrument.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tehna unit ahih kei leh vanzat zang in na khat a pumpi, sauna, gikna, zat ahih kei leh ciangtan thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Measure the width of the table.
examples.zomi: Tawlngak a vai teh in.

examples.english: The nurse measured his blood pressure.
examples.zomi: Nurse in a sisan nawngna teh hi.

senses.usage_en: The forms are measure–measured–measured. The instrument or unit depends on what is being measured.
senses.usage_zomi: A kammal khelna pen measure–measured–measured ahi hi. Tehna van leh unit pen a kiteh na bangin kilamdang hi.

senses.heading: Have a particular size
senses.definition_en: To be a particular size, length, width, height, or amount.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tehna … ahi; a ciangtan … ahi
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pumpi, sauna, vai, sanna ahih kei leh zat a kician ciangtan nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The room measures five metres by four metres.
examples.zomi: Innkhan a sauna metre nga leh a vai metre li ahi hi.

examples.english: The fish measured nearly one metre.
examples.zomi: Ngasa a sauna metre khat pha tawm hi.

senses.usage_en: In this intransitive use, measure states the result; it does not describe someone performing the measurement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih intransitive zatna ah measure in tehna result gen a, mi khat in a teh cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Judge importance or effect
senses.definition_en: To judge or calculate the quality, importance, success, or effect of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a hoihna, thupina, gualzawhna ahih kei leh huzaap sittel in ciangtan thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The test measures students’ reading ability.
examples.zomi: Sittelna in sangnaupangte laisim siamna teh hi.

examples.english: It is difficult to measure the program’s success.
examples.zomi: Program gualzawhna teh haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: Abstract qualities may be measured with scores, evidence, comparisons, or agreed standards.
senses.usage_zomi: Muhtheih lo hoihna-te pen score, teci, tehkakna ahih kei leh ciangtan thukimsa tawh kiteh thei hi.

senses.heading: Process of measuring
senses.definition_en: The process of finding the size, amount, or degree of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pumpi, zat ahih kei leh ciangtan theihna ding a tehna nasep.

examples.english: Accurate measurement is important in construction.
examples.zomi: Inn lamna ah tehna kician thupi hi.

examples.english: The nurse repeated the measurement.
examples.zomi: Nurse in tehna bawlkik hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense refers to the act or method of measuring.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in tehna nasep ahih kei leh tehna zia kawk hi.

senses.heading: Result obtained by measuring
senses.definition_en: A number that shows the size, amount, or degree of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tehna pan a kimu a pumpi, zat ahih kei leh ciangtan a lak sim.

examples.english: Write down each measurement carefully.
examples.zomi: Tehna result khatsim kidop takin gelh in.

examples.english: The two measurements were different.
examples.zomi: Tehna result a nih kilamdang hi.

senses.usage_en: A measurement should normally include both a number and a unit, such as five metres.
senses.usage_zomi: Tehna result ah sim leh unit a nihgel om ding ahi hi, entawn in five metres.

senses.definition_en: The flesh of an animal eaten as food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An in a kine gan sa.

examples.english: Keep the meat in the refrigerator.
examples.zomi: Sa fridge sungah koih in.

examples.english: They do not eat meat.
examples.zomi: Amaute sa ne lo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Meat is generally uncountable. Use expressions such as a piece of meat or specify the type, such as beef or chicken.
senses.usage_zomi: Meat pen simtheih lo noun ahi zel hi. A piece of meat ci in zat gen ahih kei leh beef, chicken cih bangin sa nam kician gen ding hi.

senses.heading: News and mass communication organizations
senses.definition_en: Television, radio, newspapers, websites, and other organizations or systems that provide news and information to large audiences.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi tampi tungah thuthang leh thu a pia television, radio, thuthang lai, website leh kipawlna ahih kei leh zia dangte.

examples.english: The event received wide media coverage.
examples.zomi: Tua piangna media in zaipi ah gen hi.

examples.english: The media reported the election results.
examples.zomi: Media in teelna result gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Media was originally the plural of medium. In modern usage referring to mass communication collectively, it may take either a plural or singular verb, depending on style.
senses.usage_zomi: Media pen a kipatcil in medium a plural ahi hi. Tulai ah mipi thuthang puakna a vekpi kawk ciangin gelhdan zia bangin plural ahih kei leh singular verb zang thei hi.

senses.heading: Methods or materials used to communicate or create art
senses.definition_en: The forms, materials, or channels used to communicate information or produce art.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thu puakna lampite; art bawlna vante
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu puakna ahih kei leh art bawlna ding a kizang zia, van leh lampi tuamtuam.

examples.english: Students learn through several types of digital media.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte digital thu puakna nam tuamtuam tungtawn in sin uh hi.

examples.english: The artist works in several media.
examples.zomi: Art siam in art bawlna van nam tuamtuam zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In art, a singular material or method is a medium; more than one are media.
senses.usage_zomi: Art ah van ahih kei leh zia nam khat pen medium kici a, khat sangin tamzaw pen media kici hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to medicine, illness, injury, or the treatment and prevention of disease.
senses.zomi_equivalents: cidamna lam; si lam tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Si lam, natna, liamna ahih kei leh natna kepna leh khamna tawh kisai na.

examples.english: You should seek medical advice immediately.
examples.zomi: Siavuan ngaihsut piakna na zong pah ding hi.

examples.english: The hospital provides medical care for children.
examples.zomi: Si-in in naupangte ading cidamna kepna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Medical relates broadly to medicine and health care. Medicinal usually describes something used for healing, such as a plant or substance.
senses.usage_zomi: Medical in si leh cidamna kepna a zaizaw in kawk hi. Medicinal bel singkung ahih kei leh zat khat damsakna ding a kizang na gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Substance used to treat illness
senses.definition_en: A substance taken or used to treat or prevent illness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Natna damsak ahih kei leh kham ding a nek, dawn ahih kei leh pumpi tungah a kizang si.

examples.english: Take this medicine twice a day.
examples.zomi: Hih si ni khat vei nih ne in.

examples.english: The medicine reduced her pain.
examples.zomi: Si in a natna kiamsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, medicine may be countable when referring to types, but it is often uncountable. Use take medicine, not normally eat medicine.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah si nam tuamtuam gen ciangin medicine simtheih noun hi thei napi, simtheih lo noun in kizang tam hi. Take medicine ci ding a, eat medicine ci lo zel hi.

senses.heading: Study and practice of treating illness
senses.definition_en: The science and professional practice of preventing, diagnosing, and treating illness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Natna kham, natna theihkhia leh damsakna a sin leh a sem pilna leh nasep.

examples.english: She studied medicine at university.
examples.zomi: Amah university ah si pilna sin hi.

examples.english: Modern medicine has saved many lives.
examples.zomi: Tulai si pilna in mi tampi nuntakna hon hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, medicine is uncountable and refers to the medical profession or field of study.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah medicine simtheih lo noun ahi a, siavuan nasep ahih kei leh si pilna kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: In the middle between two extremes of size, amount, strength, or degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi, zat, hatna ahih kei leh ciangtan ah a lian pen leh a neu pen kikal na.

examples.english: I would like a medium coffee.
examples.zomi: Coffee lawhkim khat ka deih hi.

examples.english: Cook the meat over medium heat.
examples.zomi: Sa meisa laitak tawh huan in.

senses.usage_en: Medium means neither small nor large, or neither low nor high. Clothing sizes often use the letter M for medium.
senses.usage_zomi: Medium in a neu zong hilo, a lian zong hilo; a niam zong hilo, a sang zong hilo cihna ahi hi. Puansilh pumpi ah medium dingin M kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Come together with someone
senses.definition_en: To come together with someone, either by arrangement or by chance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh kimu ding a kigeel ahih kei leh geel lo napi kimutuah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I will meet you at the library at three.
examples.zomi: Nai thum in laibu inn ah kong mu ding hi.

examples.english: We met by chance at the airport.
examples.zomi: Vanleng tual ah geel lo in ka kimutuah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Say meet someone without with when you simply come together. Meet with someone often emphasizes an arranged discussion.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimu cihna bek a gen ciangin meet someone ci in with om lo in kizang hi. Meet with someone in thu kiholim ding a kimu cihna bulphuh zel hi.

senses.heading: See someone for the first time
senses.definition_en: To be introduced to someone and see or speak to them for the first time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh a masapen in kimuthei in kiholim cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: kong muh manin ka lungdam hi

common_phrases.english: meet someone for the first time

examples.english: It was nice to meet you.
examples.zomi: Kong muh manin ka lungdam hi.

examples.english: She met her new manager this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsang in a vaihawmpa thak mu masak hi.

senses.usage_en: Meet may mean seeing someone for the first time, while know means having an established familiarity with the person.
senses.usage_zomi: Meet in mi khat mu masak cihna nei thei a, know in tua mi thei khin cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Satisfy a need or standard
senses.definition_en: To satisfy or achieve a requirement, need, condition, or standard.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisapna, thukhun, dinmun ahih kei leh ciangtan khat pha ahih kei leh tangtun cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The product meets all safety standards.
examples.zomi: Tua van in bitna ciangtan khempeuh pha hi.

examples.english: We worked late to meet the deadline.
examples.zomi: Hunseh sungin nasep zohna ding zan dong ka sem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, meet means fulfilling something, not physically encountering it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah meet in pumpi tawh kimu cihna hilo in, kisapna ahih kei leh ciangtan khat tangtung cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Organized gathering for discussion
senses.definition_en: An occasion when people gather to discuss, decide, or work on something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite in thu kiholim, khensat ahih kei leh nasemkhawm ding a kikhopna uh.

examples.english: The meeting begins at nine o’clock.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna nai kua in kipan hi.

examples.english: We discussed the budget at the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ah sum zat ding ka kiholim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use at a meeting for participation and in a meeting to say that someone is currently occupied by it.
senses.usage_zomi: Kikhopna ah kihel cihna dingin at a meeting kizang a, mi khat tuhun a kikhawm lai cihna dingin in a meeting kizang hi.

senses.heading: Act of encountering someone
senses.definition_en: An occasion when two or more people meet, especially for the first time or unexpectedly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nih ahih kei leh a tamzaw a kimuhkhopna, phadiak in a masapen kimuhna ahih kei leh geel lo kimuhna.

examples.english: Their first meeting took place at college.
examples.zomi: Amau kimuhna masapen college ah om hi.

examples.english: A chance meeting changed his life.
examples.zomi: Geel lo kimutuahna khat in a nuntakna khel hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense focuses on the encounter itself rather than a formal business discussion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in thukhun kikhopna sangin mite a kimuhna mah bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Become liquid
senses.definition_en: To change from a solid into a liquid because of heat.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khauhsa khat lumna hangin tui bangin a luangthei in kikhel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The ice melted in the sun.
examples.zomi: Ais ni lum ah tuikhang hi.

examples.english: Butter melts quickly in a hot pan.
examples.zomi: Butter beel lum sungah manlang takin tuikhang hi.

senses.usage_en: This is intransitive: the solid itself melts. No object is required.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen intransitive ahi a, na khauhsa amah leh amah tuikhang hi. Object kisam lo hi.

senses.heading: Cause something to become liquid
senses.definition_en: To heat a solid until it becomes liquid.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khauhsa khat tui suak dingin lum sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Melt the butter over low heat.
examples.zomi: Butter meisa tawm tawh tuikhang sak in.

examples.english: The workers melted the metal before shaping it.
examples.zomi: Nasepmite in sik a bawlma un tuikhang sak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This is transitive: someone or something melts an object.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen transitive ahi a, mi ahih kei leh na khat in object tuikhang sak hi.

senses.heading: Person belonging to a group
senses.definition_en: A person, organization, or country that belongs to a group, club, team, or institution.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, club, team ahih kei leh kipawlna sungah a kihel mi, kipawlna ahih kei leh gam.

examples.english: She is a member of the school committee.
examples.zomi: Amah sang committee sung mi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Every team member has a different responsibility.
examples.zomi: Pawl sung mi khatsim in mawhpuak tuam nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a member of, not a member in, before the group’s name.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawl min ma ah a member of ci ding a, a member in ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Part of a larger structure
senses.definition_en: One individual part of a larger group, class, or structure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, nam ahih kei leh bawlna lian khat sung a khen khat.

common_phrases.zomi: gan/sing nam khat sung a khat

examples.english: A whale is a member of the mammal group.
examples.zomi: Whale pen gan tate a noih tawh a vak pawl sung a khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Each member of the set has a number.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl sung a khatsim in sim khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is common in science, mathematics, and technical writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen science, simpilna leh technical laigelhna ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Ability to remember
senses.definition_en: The mental ability to store and remember information and past experiences.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu leh phutkhaksa nate lungsim sungah kem in phawkkik theihna.

examples.english: She has a good memory for names.
examples.zomi: Amah minte phawk siam hi.

examples.english: Lack of sleep can affect your memory.
examples.zomi: Ihmut kicing lohna in na phawk theihna susia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, memory may be countable when describing a particular type of ability, but it is often used generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah phawk siamna nam khat a gen ciangin memory simtheih noun hi thei napi, a umum in kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Something remembered
senses.definition_en: A remembered person, event, place, or experience from the past.
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa hun pan a kiphawkkik mi, piangna, mun ahih kei leh phutkhakna.

examples.english: I have happy memories of my childhood.
examples.zomi: Ka naupan lai lungdamhuai phawkkikna tampi ka nei hi.

examples.english: The song brought back memories of home.
examples.zomi: Tua la in inn thu phawkkikna hong piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: A countable memory is one particular recollection; uncountable memory is the general ability to remember.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtheih memory in phawkkikna tuam khat ahi a, simtheih lo memory in phawk theihna a umum ahi hi.

senses.heading: Computer storage
senses.definition_en: The part of a computer or electronic device that stores information and instructions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer ahih kei leh electronic van sungah thu leh hilhna a kemna khen.

examples.english: This computer has sixteen gigabytes of memory.
examples.zomi: Hih computer in memory gigabyte sawmlehguk nei hi.

examples.english: Close unused programs to free some memory.
examples.zomi: Memory a awl theihna ding program zat lohte kha in.

senses.usage_en: Computer memory often means temporary working memory, while storage usually holds files for longer periods.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer memory in tawmvei sung nasepna thu kemna kawk zel a, storage in file-te hun sawtzaw sung kem zel hi.

senses.heading: Relating to the mind
senses.definition_en: Relating to the mind, thinking, feelings, or intellectual activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim, ngaihsutna, lungsim puakna ahih kei leh pilna nasep tawh kisai na.

examples.english: Reading is good mental exercise.
examples.zomi: Laibu simna pen lungsim kizohlhna hoih ahi hi.

examples.english: The work requires strong mental concentration.
examples.zomi: Nasep in lungsim bulphuhna thahat kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Mental can refer neutrally to any activity of the mind; it does not always imply illness.
senses.usage_zomi: Mental in lungsim nasep khatpeuh a umum in kawk thei a, lungsim natna cihna hi tawntung lo hi.

senses.heading: Relating to mental health or illness
senses.definition_en: Relating to a person’s psychological health or to illnesses affecting the mind.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim cidamna lam; lungsim natna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungsim cidamna ahih kei leh lungsim a susia natna tawh kisai na.

examples.english: Mental health is as important as physical health.
examples.zomi: Lungsim cidamna pen pumpi cidamna mah bangin thupi hi.

examples.english: He received treatment for a mental illness.
examples.zomi: Ama in lungsim natna kepna ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: In careful English, avoid using mental alone as a label for a person; it may sound insulting. Use a precise and respectful expression.
senses.usage_zomi: Kidop takin a pau ciangin mi khat min in mental bek zang kei in; zahkona bangin ging thei hi. Kammal kician leh zahtakna nei kizang ding hi.

senses.definition_en: To speak or write briefly about someone or something without giving many details.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh thu khat a tom in gen ahih kei leh gelh a, thu kicing takin hilhcian lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She mentioned your name during the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna sungah na min gen hi.

examples.english: He did not mention the problem in his report.
examples.zomi: A report sungah tua buaipihna gen lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use mention something without about: say She mentioned the problem, not She mentioned about the problem.
senses.usage_zomi: Mention something ci in about om lo in kizang hi: She mentioned the problem ci ding a, She mentioned about the problem ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: List of food and drinks
senses.definition_en: A list of food and drinks available in a restaurant or for a particular meal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Annekna mun ahih kei leh ankuang khat ah ngah theih an leh dawn ding kiciamna.

examples.english: The waiter brought us the menu.
examples.zomi: Annekna nasempa in menu hong keng hi.

examples.english: There are several vegetarian dishes on the menu.
examples.zomi: Menu sungah sa kihel lo an nam pawlkhat om hi.

senses.usage_en: A menu lists available dishes. A recipe gives instructions for preparing a dish.
senses.usage_zomi: Menu in ngah theih an namte lak a, recipe in an nam khat koibang a huan ding hilh hi.

senses.heading: List of computer options
senses.definition_en: A list of commands or choices displayed on a computer, phone, or other electronic device.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer, phone ahih kei leh electronic van tungah a kilak thu piakna ahih kei leh teelna kiciamna.

examples.english: Choose “Settings” from the main menu.
examples.zomi: Menu thupi pan “Settings” teel in.

examples.english: Tap the menu icon at the top of the screen.
examples.zomi: Screen tunglam a menu lim teek in.

senses.usage_en: A digital menu organizes commands or options so users can select them.
senses.usage_zomi: Digital menu in a zang mite in a teel theihna ding thu piakna leh teelna-te kiciam hi.

senses.heading: Untidy or dirty condition
senses.definition_en: A dirty, untidy, or disorganized condition or collection of things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na-te a kithehthang, a nin ahih kei leh a kiciamlo in omna dinmun.

examples.english: The children made a mess in the kitchen.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in anhuan inn kithehthang sak uh hi.

examples.english: Please clean up this mess.
examples.zomi: Hih kithehthang nate siansuah in.

senses.usage_en: Mess may describe dirt, untidiness, or badly organized objects.
senses.usage_zomi: Mess in ninna, kithehthangna ahih kei leh na-te a kiciam hoih lohna kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Difficult or confused situation
senses.definition_en: A difficult, confused, or badly managed situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaipihna, lungbuaina ahih kei leh a kivaihawm hoih lo dinmun.

examples.english: The project is in a complete mess.
examples.zomi: Nasep geel pen a vekpi in buaipihna sungah om hi.

examples.english: Poor planning created a financial mess.
examples.zomi: Geelna hoih lo in sum lam buaipihna piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes disorder in a situation rather than physical dirt.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lim tawh zatna in pumpi tawh ninna hilo in, dinmun a kiciamlo leh a buaipihna gen hi.

senses.heading: Information sent to someone
senses.definition_en: Information sent or communicated to a person or group by speech, writing, phone, or another method.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh mihon khat tungah pau, lai, phone ahih kei leh lampi dang tawh a kipuak thu.

examples.english: I sent you a message this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsang in thupuak kong khak hi.

examples.english: Please leave a message after the sound.
examples.zomi: Awging khit ciangin thupuak nusia in.

senses.usage_en: A message may be spoken, written, or electronic. It does not have to be a text message.
senses.usage_zomi: Message pen pau, lai ahih kei leh electronic in a kipuak thei hi. Phone lai bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: Main idea or lesson
senses.definition_en: The main idea, lesson, or belief communicated by a speech, story, artwork, or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thugen, tangthu, art ahih kei leh piangna khat in a puak ngaihsutna, pilna ahih kei leh upna thupi.

examples.english: The main message of the story is forgiveness.
examples.zomi: Tangthu a thupuak thupi pen ngaihdamna ahi hi.

examples.english: The campaign sends a clear message about safety.
examples.zomi: Tangko nasep geel in bitna thu thupuak kician pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a message is what an audience is expected to understand or learn.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah message pen a ngaite in a tel ahih kei leh a sin ding thu ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A usually hard and shiny material, such as iron, gold, or aluminum, that conducts heat and electricity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sik, kham ahih kei leh aluminum bang, a khauh leh a taang zel, lumna leh electric a paikheh sak van nam.

examples.english: The gate is made of metal.
examples.zomi: Kongpi sik tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Some metals conduct electricity well.
examples.zomi: Metal pawlkhat in electric hoih takin paikheh sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Metal is uncountable when referring to the material generally, but countable when referring to different kinds of metal.
senses.usage_zomi: Metal van a umum in a gen ciangin metal simtheih lo noun ahi a, metal nam tuamtuam a gen ciangin simtheih noun hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A planned and organized way of doing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawlna ding a kigeel leh a kiciam zia ahih kei leh lampi.

examples.english: This method saves time and money.
examples.zomi: Hih zia in hun leh sum kem hi.

examples.english: The teacher tried a new teaching method.
examples.zomi: Sia in kihilhna zia thak khat ze-et hi.

senses.usage_en: A method is usually systematic. A way is more general and may be informal or unplanned.
senses.usage_zomi: Method pen a kiciam leh zia nei in kibawl zel hi. Way bel a umum zaw a, thukhun lo ahih kei leh geelna om lo zong hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A metric unit of length equal to 100 centimetres.
senses.explanation_zomi: Centimetre 100 tawh kikim metric sauna tehna unit.

examples.english: The table is two metres long.
examples.zomi: Tawlngak a sauna metre nih ahi hi.

examples.english: She can jump more than one metre.
examples.zomi: Amah metre khat sangin gamla zaw diak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Metre is the British spelling of the length unit. American English spells it meter. A measuring device is spelled meter in both varieties.
senses.usage_zomi: Sauna unit metre pen British gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah meter ci in kigelh hi. Tehna van pen English nam a nihgel ah meter ci in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Central point or part
senses.definition_en: The central point or part of a place, object, group, or period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, van, pawl ahih kei leh hun khat a laizang khen.

examples.english: A table stood in the middle of the room.
examples.zomi: Innkhan laizang ah tawlngak khat om hi.

examples.english: Do not stop in the middle of the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi laizang ah tawl kei in.

senses.usage_en: Use the middle of before a noun: the middle of the page.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun ma ah the middle of kizang hi: the middle of the page.

senses.heading: Period between beginning and end
senses.definition_en: The period between the beginning and end of an event, activity, or span of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piangna, nasep ahih kei leh hun khat a kipatna leh tawpna kikal hun.

common_phrases.english: in the middle of a meeting

examples.english: The phone rang in the middle of the night.
examples.zomi: Zan laizang in phone ging hi.

examples.english: She left in the middle of the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhop laitak in amah paikhia hi.

senses.usage_en: In the middle of doing something means that the action has begun but is not finished.
senses.usage_zomi: In the middle of doing something in nasep kipan khin napi a kizo nailo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Twelve o’clock at night, when one day ends and the next begins.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zan nai sawmlehnih, ni khat a tawp a ni thak a kipat hun.

examples.english: The train arrived at midnight.
examples.zomi: Tangka zanlaizang in hong tung hi.

examples.english: We stayed awake until midnight.
examples.zomi: Zanlaizang dong ka ih kei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use at midnight, not in midnight. Midnight is 12:00 a.m.; noon is 12:00 p.m.
senses.usage_zomi: At midnight ci ding a, in midnight ci lo ding hi. Midnight pen zan nai 12:00 a.m. ahi a, noon pen sun nai 12:00 p.m. ahi hi.

senses.heading: Express possibility
senses.definition_en: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat piang thei napi a kipsak theih lohna genna modal verb.

examples.english: It might rain this evening.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitak guah zuah kha ding hi.

examples.english: She might not attend the meeting.
examples.zomi: Amah kikhopna ah pai lo kha ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Use might + base verb without to: might come, not might to come. Might often suggests a weaker or more uncertain possibility than may, although the two frequently overlap.
senses.usage_zomi: Might + base verb ci in to om lo in kizang hi: might come ci ding a, might to come ci lo ding hi. Might in may sangin kipsak zaw lo thei napi, a nihgel zatna kitukal tam hi.

senses.heading: Make a polite suggestion
senses.definition_en: Used to make a careful, indirect, or polite suggestion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsut piakna khat kidop, thukhun ahih kei leh zahtakna tawh genna modal verb.

common_phrases.zomi: na ze-et leh hoih kha ding

examples.english: You might try restarting the computer.
examples.zomi: Computer na mitsak in na honsak kik leh hoih kha ding hi.

examples.english: We might consider a different method.
examples.zomi: Bawldan dang khat i ngaihsun thei ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In suggestions, might softens the advice and makes it sound less forceful.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngaihsut piakna ah might in thu kipsak lua lo in a neemzaw leh zahtakhuai zaw sak hi.

senses.heading: Not severe or strong
senses.definition_en: Not serious, severe, strong, or extreme.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a neem; a nasia lo; a tawmno
senses.explanation_zomi: A nasia lo, a hat lo ahih kei leh a khauh lua lo na.

examples.english: She had only mild symptoms.
examples.zomi: Amah natna lim tawmno bek nei hi.

examples.english: The medicine may cause mild headaches.
examples.zomi: Si in lutang natna tawmno piangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In medical contexts, mild means not severe, but the condition may still require attention.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna lamah mild in a nasia lo cihna hi napi, tua dinmun kep kisam lai thei hi.

senses.heading: Gentle in behavior
senses.definition_en: Gentle, calm, and not easily angered.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamta neem, lungmuang leh heh baih lo na.

examples.english: He is a quiet, mild man.
examples.zomi: Ama pen mi dai leh gamta neem ahi hi.

examples.english: She answered in a mild voice.
examples.zomi: Amah aw neem takin dawng hi.

senses.usage_en: A mild person is gentle rather than forceful or aggressive.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi mild pen mi ngongtat ahih kei leh thu kipsak lua hilo in, gamta neem mi ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not extreme in weather or flavor
senses.definition_en: Pleasantly moderate and not extremely hot, cold, or strongly flavored.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a lawhkim; a kha lua lo; a lum lua lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuahun ah a lum lua lo leh a vot lua lo, ahih kei leh an lim a khauh lua lo na.

examples.english: The region has mild winters.
examples.zomi: Tua gam khen ah phalbi vot lua lo hi.

examples.english: This sauce has a mild flavor.
examples.zomi: Hih sauce a lim khauh lua lo hi.

senses.usage_en: With weather, mild means comfortably moderate. With food, it means the flavor is not strong, hot, or sharp.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuahun thu ah mild in lum leh vot lawhkim cihna a, an thu ah a lim khauh, a kha ahih kei leh a ling lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A unit of distance equal to 1,760 yards, about 1.609 kilometres.
senses.explanation_zomi: Yard 1,760 ahih kei leh kilometre 1.609 tawh kikim gamla tehna unit.

examples.english: The school is two miles from our house.
examples.zomi: Sang pen ka inn uh pan mile nih gamla hi.

examples.english: The car was travelling at sixty miles per hour.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw pen nai khat sung mile sawmguk manlangin pai hi.

senses.usage_en: The abbreviation is mi in technical measurement, though road signs commonly write mile or miles. One mile is longer than one kilometre.
senses.usage_zomi: Technical tehna ah a tomlak mi ahi a, lampi limte ah mile ahih kei leh miles ci in kigelh tam hi. Mile khat pen kilometre khat sangin sauzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to soldiers, armed forces, war, or national defense.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepaih, galkap pawl, kidouna ahih kei leh gam dalna tawh kisai na.

examples.english: He received military training when he was young.
examples.zomi: A tangval lai in sepaih kisinna ngah hi.

examples.english: The government increased military spending.
examples.zomi: Ukna in galkap ading sum zatna behlap hi.

senses.usage_en: Military usually describes the army and armed forces. Martial is more formal and appears in expressions such as martial law and martial arts.
senses.usage_zomi: Military in sepaih leh galkap pawlte kawk zel hi. Martial pen thukhun zaw a, martial law leh martial arts bang kammalte ah kizang hi.

senses.heading: White liquid produced by female mammals
senses.definition_en: The white liquid produced by female mammals to feed their young.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gan numei in a note vakna ding a no pan a suah tui kang.

examples.english: The baby drinks its mother’s milk.
examples.zomi: Naungek in a nu noih dawn hi.

examples.english: Keep the milk in the refrigerator.
examples.zomi: Noih fridge sungah koih in.

senses.usage_en: Milk is normally uncountable. Use a glass of milk or two cartons of milk when counting servings or containers.
senses.usage_zomi: Milk pen simtheih lo noun ahi zel hi. A zat sim dingin a glass of milk ahih kei leh two cartons of milk kizang hi.

senses.heading: Plant-based drink
senses.definition_en: A drink made from plants, nuts, or grains and used as an alternative to animal milk.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sing pan noih bang dawn ding; plant milk
senses.explanation_zomi: Gan noih ai-ah singgah, singtang ahih kei leh mangbuh pan a kibawl dawn ding tui kang.

examples.english: She uses oat milk in her coffee.
examples.zomi: A coffee sungah oat noih zang hi.

examples.english: This café offers several kinds of plant milk.
examples.zomi: Hih café ah sing pan a kibawl noih nam tuamtuam ngah theih hi.

senses.usage_en: Plant-based products use milk because they resemble dairy milk in appearance or use, although they are made differently.
senses.usage_zomi: Sing pan a kibawl dawn dingte pen muhdan leh zatdan ah gan noih tawh kibang ahih manin milk kici napi, bawldan kibang lo hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 1,000,000.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim 1,000,000; tul tulkhat.

examples.english: The city has more than one million residents.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah teng mi million khat sangin tamzaw om hi.

examples.english: The project cost two million dollars.
examples.zomi: Nasep geel in dollar million nih man hi.

senses.usage_en: After an exact number, use singular million without of: three million people. For an inexact large number, use millions of people.
senses.usage_zomi: Sim kician khit ah singular million leh of om lo in kizang hi: three million people. Sim kician lo tampi a gen dingin millions of people kizang hi.

senses.heading: Part of a person that thinks and feels
senses.definition_en: The part of a person responsible for thinking, remembering, understanding, feeling, and deciding.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ngaihsutna, phawkna, telna, lungsim puakna leh khensatna a vaihawm lungsim lam.

examples.english: Learning keeps the mind active.
examples.zomi: Kisinna in lungsim phatuamngai sak hi.

examples.english: Fear can affect the mind and body.
examples.zomi: Lauhna in lungsim leh pumpi huzaap thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Mind refers to mental activity and experience, while brain refers to the physical organ.
senses.usage_zomi: Mind in ngaihsutna leh lungsim phutkhakna kawk a, brain in pumpi sung a lu khuak kawk hi.

senses.heading: Thoughts or attention
senses.definition_en: A person’s thoughts, attention, intention, or opinion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ngaihsutna, lungsim piakna, tupna ahih kei leh ngaihsutdan.

examples.english: She changed her mind about the job.
examples.zomi: Nasep thu ah a ngaihsutna khel hi.

examples.english: Keep the deadline in mind when planning.
examples.zomi: Na geel ciangin hun ciangtan lungsim sungah kem in.

senses.usage_en: Change your mind means change a decision or opinion. Lose your mind is an informal expression meaning to become unable to think or behave rationally.
senses.usage_zomi: Change your mind in khensatna ahih kei leh ngaihsutdan khel cihna ahi hi. Lose your mind in ngaihsutna tawh kituak in gamta zo nawn lo cihna nisim kammal ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to show that something belongs to the speaker.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat thu genpa a hi cih lakna possessive pronoun.

examples.english: That coat is mine.
examples.zomi: Tua puanbaang pen kei-a ahi hi.

examples.english: Your phone is newer than mine.
examples.zomi: Na phone pen kei-a sangin thakzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Mine replaces a noun: This is my book; this book is mine. Do not say mine book.
senses.usage_zomi: Mine in noun aiawh hi: This is my book; this book is mine. Mine book ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A deep hole, tunnel, or system of underground passages from which coal, metal, salt, or minerals are removed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leinuai pan coal, sik, ci ahih kei leh mineralte lakhiatna ding a kikuah khuam ahih kei leh leinuai lampi zia.

examples.english: His father worked in a coal mine.
examples.zomi: A pa coal khuam ah nasem hi.

examples.english: The mine closed after the minerals were exhausted.
examples.zomi: Mineralte a bei khit ciangin khuam khak hi.

senses.usage_en: This mine is a place where natural resources are extracted. It is different from the explosive weapon also called a mine.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih mine pen leinuai pan piansaksa van lakhiatna mun ahi hi. Mine kici a puakkham galhiam tawh a khiatna kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Natural solid substance
senses.definition_en: A naturally occurring solid substance in the earth with a particular chemical structure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leilung sungah amah leh amah a piang, chemical bawldan kician a nei zat khauhsa.

examples.english: The region is rich in valuable minerals.
examples.zomi: Tua gam khen ah mineral manpha tampi om hi.

examples.english: Iron and salt are minerals.
examples.zomi: Sik leh ci pen mineral ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Rocks are made from one or more minerals, but a rock and a mineral are not exactly the same.
senses.usage_zomi: Suang pen mineral nam khat ahih kei leh a tamzaw tawh kibawl a, suang leh mineral kibang lianliang lo hi.

senses.heading: Nutrient needed by the body
senses.definition_en: A natural chemical element needed in small amounts for the body to remain healthy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi cidamna ding a tawmno in a kisam piansaksa chemical zat.

examples.english: Milk contains important minerals such as calcium.
examples.zomi: Noih sungah calcium bang pumpi ading thupi mineral om hi.

examples.english: A balanced diet provides vitamins and minerals.
examples.zomi: Annek lawhkim in vitamin leh mineral pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Dietary minerals include calcium, iron, potassium, and other elements; they are different from vitamins.
senses.usage_zomi: An sung mineral-te lakah calcium, iron, potassium leh zat dangte kihel a, vitamin-te tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.definition_en: As small, low, or few as possible or permitted.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tawm pen; a niam pen; a neupen
senses.explanation_zomi: A piangthei ahih kei leh a kiphal ciangtan sungah a neu pen, a niam pen ahih kei leh a tawm pen na.

examples.english: The minimum age for entry is eighteen.
examples.zomi: Luttheihna ding kum a neupen ciangtan sawmlehguk ahi hi.

examples.english: Workers must receive the minimum wage.
examples.zomi: Nasepmite in thaman a tawm pen ciangtan ngah ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Minimum identifies the lowest permitted or possible point. Its opposite is maximum.
senses.usage_zomi: Minimum in a kiphal ahih kei leh a piangthei a nuai pen ciangtan lak hi. A kikal pen maximum ahi hi.

senses.heading: Senior government official
senses.definition_en: A senior member of a government who is responsible for a particular department or area of policy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ukna sungah department ahih kei leh thukhun khen khat a vaihawm ding mawhpuak a nei ukna makaipa.

examples.english: The health minister announced the new policy.
examples.zomi: Cidamna vai minister in thukhun thak tangko hi.

examples.english: She served as education minister for four years.
examples.zomi: Amah kum li sung pilna vai minister in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Minister when it forms part of an official title before a name; otherwise use lowercase.
senses.usage_zomi: Min ma ah ukna dinmun min kicing in kizang ciangin Minister laimal lian tawh kigelh a, a dang ciangin laimal neu tawh kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Christian religious leader
senses.definition_en: A person officially authorized to lead worship and perform pastoral duties in a Christian church.
senses.explanation_zomi: Christian biakinn ah biakna makaih leh pawlpite khalam kepna sem ding a phalna ngah biakna makaipa.

examples.english: The minister led the Sunday service.
examples.zomi: Pastor in Sunday biakna makaih hi.

examples.english: She spoke with the minister about the funeral.
examples.zomi: Amah in luivui pawi thu pastor tawh kiholim hi.

senses.usage_en: Christian traditions use titles such as minister, pastor, and priest differently. Use the title preferred by the particular church.
senses.usage_zomi: Christian pawl tuamtuam in minister, pastor, leh priest a zatdan uh kilamdang hi. Biakinn tuam in a deih dinmun min kizang ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Small, less important, or not serious when compared with others.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a neu; a thupi lo; a nasia lo
senses.explanation_zomi: A neu, a thupi zaw lo ahih kei leh a nasia lo na.

examples.english: The accident caused only minor injuries.
examples.zomi: Accident in liamna nasia lo bek piangsak hi.

examples.english: We made a few minor changes to the report.
examples.zomi: Report sungah kikhelna neu pawlkhat ka bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Minor is the opposite of major. A minor problem may still require attention even though it is not serious.
senses.usage_zomi: Minor a kikal pen major ahi hi. Buaipihna neu pen nasia lo napi kep kisam lai thei hi.

senses.heading: Smaller part of a group
senses.definition_en: Less than half of a group; the smaller number or part.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihon khat a kim sangin a tawmzaw ahih kei leh na khat a khen tawmzaw.

examples.english: Only a minority of students opposed the proposal.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte a tawmzaw bek in thu puahna nial uh hi.

examples.english: A small minority chose the second option.
examples.zomi: A tawmzaw mahmah in teelna nihna teel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Minority contrasts with majority, which means more than half or the larger part.
senses.usage_zomi: Minority a kikal pen majority ahi a, tua in a kim sang a tamzaw ahih kei leh a khen tamzaw kawk hi.

senses.heading: Smaller social or ethnic group
senses.definition_en: A group within a society that is smaller or has less social or political power than the larger population.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi lakah a sim tawmzaw ahih kei leh mipi a tamzaw sangin mipi leh ukna lam vangliatna a nei tawmzaw nam, pau ahih kei leh upna pawl.

examples.english: The law protects the rights of ethnic minorities.
examples.zomi: Thukham in nam tawmzawte dikna dal hi.

examples.english: The country has several linguistic minorities.
examples.zomi: Gam sungah pau pawl tawmzaw nam tuamtuam om hi.

senses.usage_en: A minority group is not defined only by numbers; social and political power may also matter.
senses.usage_zomi: Minority pawl pen a sim tawmna bek tawh kician lo a, mipi leh ukna lam vangliatna in zong thupi hi.

senses.heading: Unit of time
senses.definition_en: A unit of time equal to sixty seconds.
senses.explanation_zomi: Second sawmguk tawh kikim hun tehna unit.

examples.english: The meeting begins in ten minutes.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna minute sawm sungin kipan ding hi.

examples.english: Boil the water for five minutes.
examples.zomi: Tui minute nga sung so in.

senses.usage_en: Use minute after exact numbers: one minute; two minutes. One hour contains sixty minutes.
senses.usage_zomi: Sim kician khit ah minute kizang hi: one minute; two minutes. Nai khat sungah minute sawmguk om hi.

senses.heading: Very short period
senses.definition_en: A very short period of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tomno mahmah.

examples.english: Can I speak to you for a minute?
examples.zomi: Tawmvei kong hopih thei diam?

examples.english: She completed the work at the last minute.
examples.zomi: Hun tawp diak in nasep zo hi.

senses.usage_en: In expressions such as wait a minute, the word often means a short time rather than exactly sixty seconds.
senses.usage_zomi: Wait a minute cih bang kammal ah minute in second sawmguk kician sangin hun tomno kawk zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A smooth surface, usually made of glass, that reflects an image.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim a langkik sak, glass tawh a kibawl zel a maitang enna van.

examples.english: She looked at herself in the mirror.
examples.zomi: Amah limlang ah amah leh amah ki-en hi.

examples.english: The mirror hangs above the sink.
examples.zomi: Limlang tui-um tungah kikhaai hi.

senses.usage_en: In English, people normally say look in the mirror, although look at the mirror refers to looking at the object itself.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah limlang sung a kilang lim en cihna dingin look in the mirror kizang zel hi. Look at the mirror in limlang van mah en cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Fail to hit, catch, or reach
senses.definition_en: To fail to hit, catch, touch, or reach someone or something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khial; len zo lo; pha lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a tumna ah khial, len zo lo ahih kei leh pha lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He kicked the ball but missed the goal.
examples.zomi: Ama in ball khe tawh sut napi goal sung tun lo hi.

examples.english: We left late and missed the bus.
examples.zomi: Ka paikhia man uh ciangin bus ka man kei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: What is missed depends on context: you may miss a target, an opportunity, a bus, or a deadline.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu omzia bangin target, hunhoih, bus ahih kei leh hun ciangtan kiman lo thei hi.

senses.heading: Fail to attend or experience
senses.definition_en: To fail to attend, see, hear, or experience something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhopna, sinlai, piangna ahih kei leh hunhoih khat ah kihel lo, mu lo ahih kei leh za lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She missed class because she was ill.
examples.zomi: A cina manin sangkah pelh hi.

examples.english: Do not miss this opportunity.
examples.zomi: Hih hunhoih mansuah kei in.

senses.usage_en: Miss an event means not being present for it; it does not always mean forgetting it.
senses.usage_zomi: Miss an event in piangna ah kihel lo cihna hi a, mangngilh cihna hi tawntung lo hi.

senses.heading: Feel sad because someone or something is absent
senses.definition_en: To feel sad because someone or something you value is not present.
senses.explanation_zomi: A it mi ahih kei leh a manpha na khat kiangah a om loh manin ngai leh dah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I miss my family when I travel.
examples.zomi: Ka khualzin ciangin ka innkuante ka ngai hi.

examples.english: She misses her old friends.
examples.zomi: A lawm luihte ngai hi.

senses.usage_en: In I miss you, miss expresses affection and sadness caused by separation.
senses.usage_zomi: I miss you ah miss in kikhenna hang a itna leh ngaihna lungsim gen hi.

senses.heading: Fail to notice or understand
senses.definition_en: To fail to notice, hear, see, or understand something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat phawk lo, za lo, mu lo ahih kei leh tel lo in kheng cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I missed the last part of her explanation.
examples.zomi: A hilhcian a nunung khen ka za kei hi.

examples.english: You have missed the main point.
examples.zomi: A laigil thu na tel lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Miss the point means fail to understand the most important idea.
senses.usage_zomi: Miss the point in a thupi pen ngaihsutna tel lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Lost or not in the expected place
senses.definition_en: Lost, absent, or not found where someone or something is expected to be.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a mang; a om lo; a kimulo
senses.explanation_zomi: A omna ding munah om lo, mang ahih kei leh kimulo na.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat mang cih report pia

examples.english: Police are searching for a missing child.
examples.zomi: Police-te in naupang mang khat zong uh hi.

examples.english: One page is missing from the book.
examples.zomi: Laibu sung pan laimai khat om lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Missing does not necessarily mean dead or permanently lost; it means the person or thing cannot currently be found.
senses.usage_zomi: Missing in si khin ahih kei leh mansuah tawntung cihna hi pahpah lo a, tuhun in zong mu lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not included or present
senses.definition_en: Not included in something although it is needed or expected.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kihel lo; a kicing lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisam ahih kei leh om ding lam-et napi a kihel lo na.

examples.english: Some important information is missing from the report.
examples.zomi: Report sungah thu thupi pawlkhat kihel lo hi.

examples.english: The machine cannot work because a part is missing.
examples.zomi: Khen khat a om loh manin machine nasem thei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, missing identifies a gap or absence in something that should be complete.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah missing in kicing ding na khat sung a om lohna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Important assigned task
senses.definition_en: An important task given to a person or group, often involving travel, danger, or special responsibility.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat tungah a kipia, khualzinna, lauhuaina ahih kei leh mawhpuak tuam a kihel nasep thupi.

examples.english: The team completed its rescue mission successfully.
examples.zomi: Pawl in honkhia ding nasep gualzawhna tawh zo hi.

examples.english: The soldiers were sent on a dangerous mission.
examples.zomi: Sepaihte lauhuai nasep khat sem dingin kikhak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A mission usually has a clear goal and is assigned or undertaken for a special purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Mission in ngimna kician nei a, nasep tuam khat ading a kipia ahih kei leh a kilak mawhpuak ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Strong purpose in life or work
senses.definition_en: A purpose or goal that a person or organization considers extremely important.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh kipawlna khat in a thupi mahmah in a ngai ngimna leh nasep.

examples.english: The organization’s mission is to help refugees.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna ngimna thupi pen gam taisan mite huh ahi hi.

examples.english: She sees teaching as her life’s mission.
examples.zomi: Amah in kihilhna a nuntak sung nasep ngimna thupi in ngaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: A mission statement briefly explains an organization’s central purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Mission statement in kipawlna khat a ngimna laigil a tom in hilhcian hi.

senses.heading: Christian outreach work
senses.definition_en: Organized Christian work intended to share the gospel and serve people, often in another community or country.
senses.zomi_equivalents: Lungdamna Thu puak nasep; mission nasep
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungdamna Thu hawmsawn leh mite na sem ding a Christian-te in khua ahih kei leh gam dangah a bawl uh nasep.

examples.english: The church organized a mission trip.
examples.zomi: Biakinn in mission khualzinna khat vaihawm hi.

examples.english: They served on a medical mission in a rural community.
examples.zomi: Amaute khuapi pualam khuami lakah cidamna mission nasep sem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Christian traditions may distinguish evangelism, humanitarian service, and long-term missionary work within the broader idea of mission.
senses.usage_zomi: Christian pawl tuamtuam in mission huam sungah Lungdamna Thu genna, mihing huhna leh hun sawt missionary nasep kikhen thei uh hi.

senses.definition_en: Something done, believed, or understood incorrectly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kibawl, a ki-um ahih kei leh a kitel khialna.

examples.english: I made a mistake in the calculation.
examples.zomi: Ka simna ah khialhna khat ka bawl hi.

examples.english: Everyone can learn from their mistakes.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in amau khialhnate pan pilna sin thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses make a mistake, not do a mistake. A mistake is usually unintentional.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah make a mistake ci ding a, do a mistake ci lo ding hi. Khialhna pen tum neituam lo in kibawl zel hi.

senses.heading: Combine substances or things
senses.definition_en: To combine two or more substances or things so that they become joined or distributed together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat ahih kei leh na nih leh a tamzaw helkhawm in khat leh khat a kizawh sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Mix the flour with water.
examples.zomi: Vaimin vui tui tawh hel in.

examples.english: She mixed blue and yellow paint.
examples.zomi: Amah in ni mel leh eng mel helkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Use mix A with B or mix A and B together.
senses.usage_zomi: Mix A with B ahih kei leh mix A and B together ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Socialize with other people
senses.definition_en: To meet, talk, and spend time socially with other people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte tawh kimu, kiholim leh hun zangkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The event gave students a chance to mix with professionals.
examples.zomi: Pawi in sangnaupangte nasep siamte tawh kimuh leh kiholimna hun pia hi.

examples.english: He finds it difficult to mix with strangers.
examples.zomi: A theih loh mite tawh kihelkhawm haksak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense concerns social contact, not physically combining substances.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in zat-te pumpi tawh helkhawm cihna hilo in, mite tawh kipawlkhawm cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Consisting of different types combined
senses.definition_en: Made of different people, substances, qualities, or types combined together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, zat, omzia ahih kei leh nam tuamtuam helkhawm in a kibawl.

examples.english: The class contains a mixed group of students.
examples.zomi: Sangkhan sungah sangnaupang nam tuamtuam kihel hi.

examples.english: We ordered a plate of mixed vegetables.
examples.zomi: An-hing nam tuamtuam kihel beel khat ka ngen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Mixed means that different elements are present together; it does not necessarily mean they are blended completely.
senses.usage_zomi: Mixed in nam tuamtuam a omkhawm cihna hi a, a vekpi kigawm in a kibang khin cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Containing both positive and negative reactions
senses.definition_en: Including different or opposing feelings, opinions, results, or reactions.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsutna kikhen; hoih leh hoih lo kihel
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim, ngaihsutdan, result ahih kei leh dawnkikna hoih leh hoih lo a kihelkhawm.

examples.english: I have mixed feelings about moving away.
examples.zomi: Gamdang a kikhin thu ah ka lungsim kikhen hi.

examples.english: The new policy received mixed reactions.
examples.zomi: Thukhun thak in dawnkikna hoih leh hoih lo ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Mixed feelings means feeling both positive and negative about the same situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Mixed feelings in dinmun khat tungah hoihsakna leh hoihsak lohna lungsim a nihgel nei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Substances combined together
senses.definition_en: A substance made by combining two or more different substances without necessarily changing them chemically.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat nam nih leh a tamzaw helkhawm in a kibawl, chemical omzia kikhel pahpah lo na.

common_phrases.english: a mixture of flour and water

examples.english: Pour the mixture into the pan.
examples.zomi: A kihelkhawm nate beel sungah sung in.

examples.english: The drink is a mixture of fruit juice and water.
examples.zomi: Dawn ding pen singgah tui leh tui helkhawm ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In chemistry, a mixture differs from a compound because its substances are combined physically rather than chemically bonded.
senses.usage_zomi: Chemistry ah mixture leh compound kibang lo hi; mixture sung zat-te pumpi tawh kihelkhawm a, chemical tawh kizomkhawm lo hi.

senses.heading: Combination of different people or qualities
senses.definition_en: A combination of different people, qualities, ideas, feelings, or types.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, omzia, ngaihsutna, lungsim puakna ahih kei leh nam tuamtuam a kigawmkhawm.

examples.english: She felt a mixture of excitement and fear.
examples.zomi: Amah lungluthuaina leh lauhna a kigawm lungsim nei hi.

examples.english: The city has a mixture of old and modern architecture.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah inn lamdan lui leh tulai lamdan kigawmkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a mixture of before the different elements being combined.
senses.usage_zomi: A kihelkhawm nate ma ah a mixture of kizang hi.

senses.heading: Able to move freely
senses.definition_en: Able to move or be moved easily from one place to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat pan mun dangah kisuangthei ahih kei leh suan baih na.

common_phrases.zomi: mun tuamtuam a pai thei pawl

examples.english: The medical team uses a mobile clinic.
examples.zomi: Cidamna pawl in mun tuamtuam a pai thei si-in zang hi.

examples.english: Exercise helps older people remain mobile.
examples.zomi: Pumpi kizohlhna in upate kisuangthei paisuak dingin huh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes movement or portability rather than telephone technology.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in phone technology sangin, kisuangtheihna ahih kei leh mun tuamtuam a puaktheihna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Relating to portable phones and wireless technology
senses.definition_en: Relating to phones, computing, or communication that can be used while moving from place to place.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mobile phone tawh kisai; puaktheih technology
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun tuamtuam a puak in zat theih phone, computer ahih kei leh wireless kizopna tawh kisai na.

examples.english: Mobile technology has changed communication.
examples.zomi: Mobile technology in kiholimna zia khel hi.

examples.english: The service is available through a mobile app.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep mobile app tungtawn in ngah theih hi.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses mobile phone; American English usually uses cell phone.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah mobile phone kizang tam a, American English ah cell phone kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Small or simplified representation
senses.definition_en: A smaller or simplified copy of an object, system, or structure used to show how it looks or works.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, zia ahih kei leh lamdang khat koibang a kibawl leh a nasep cih lakna ding a kibawl a neu zaw ahih kei leh a baih zaw lim.

examples.english: The students built a model of the bridge.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in lei lim neu khat bawl uh hi.

examples.english: The model shows how the heart works.
examples.zomi: Lim in lungtang koibang a nasep cih lak hi.

senses.usage_en: A physical model represents something real but may differ in size or detail.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi nei model in na taktak khat aiawh napi, pumpi ahih kei leh a neu khenkhen ah kilamdang thei hi.

senses.heading: Example or pattern to follow
senses.definition_en: A person, system, or example considered suitable for others to copy or follow.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte in a zuih ahih kei leh a entawn dingin a hoihsak mi, zia ahih kei leh nasep.

examples.english: She is a positive role model for young people.
examples.zomi: Amah khangnote ading gamtat hoih entawn ahi hi.

examples.english: The program became a model for other schools.
examples.zomi: Program pen sang dangte zuih ding entawn suak hi.

senses.usage_en: A role model is a person whose behavior or achievements others admire and may imitate.
senses.usage_zomi: Role model pen a gamtatna ahih kei leh gualzawhna midangte in hoihsa a, entawn theih mi ahi hi.

senses.heading: Particular design or version of a product
senses.definition_en: A particular design or version of a vehicle, machine, device, or product.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw, machine, electronic van ahih kei leh van khat a kibawlna zia ahih kei leh version tuam.

examples.english: This is the latest model of the phone.
examples.zomi: Hih pen tua phone model thak pen ahi hi.

examples.english: The newer model uses less fuel.
examples.zomi: Model thakzaw in fuel tawmzaw zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Products with the same general purpose may have different models with different designs or features.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngimna kibang vante in bawldan ahih kei leh nasep tuamtuam a nei model tuamtuam nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Person who displays clothing or products
senses.definition_en: A person whose job is to wear clothing or display products for advertising, art, or photography.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van tangkona, art ahih kei leh lim lakna ding a puan silh ahih kei leh van lak nasep a sem mi.

examples.english: She works as a fashion model.
examples.zomi: Amah puansilh daan model in nasem hi.

examples.english: The model wore a new design on the stage.
examples.zomi: Model in stage tungah puan bawldan thak khat silh hi.

senses.usage_en: A model may display clothing, pose for photographs, or appear in advertisements.
senses.usage_zomi: Model in puan lak, lim lakna dingin omzia bawl ahih kei leh van tangkona ah kihel thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to the present or recent times and using current ideas, methods, or technology.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun ahih kei leh sawt nailo hun tawh kisai a, tulai ngaihsutna, zia ahih kei leh technology a zang.

examples.english: Modern technology has changed how we communicate.
examples.zomi: Tulai technology in ka kiholimdan uh khel hi.

examples.english: The museum combines traditional and modern design.
examples.zomi: Museum in ngeina leh tulai bawldan helkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Modern often contrasts with traditional, ancient, or old-fashioned. It does not always mean completely new.
senses.usage_zomi: Modern pen traditional, ancient, ahih kei leh old-fashioned tawh a kikal in kizang zel hi. Thak lianliang cihna hi tawntung lo hi.

senses.definition_en: To change something slightly in order to improve it or make it more suitable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hoihzaw ahih kei leh kisapna tawh kituakzaw dingin tawmno khel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We modified the plan after receiving feedback.
examples.zomi: Ngaihsut piakna ka ngah khit uh ciangin geelna tawmno ka khel uh hi.

examples.english: The vehicle was modified for wheelchair users.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw pen wheelchair zangte tawh kituak dingin kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Modify usually means making a limited change rather than replacing or completely transforming something.
senses.usage_zomi: Modify in na khat a vekpi a thak in bawl ahih kei leh khel cihna sangin, tawmno khel cihna ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Very short period
senses.definition_en: A very short period of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tomno mahmah.

examples.english: Please wait here for a moment.
examples.zomi: Hih munah tawmvei ngak in.

examples.english: She was silent for a moment.
examples.zomi: Amah tawmvei sung dai in om hi.

senses.usage_en: A moment is not an exact unit of time; it simply means a short time.
senses.usage_zomi: Moment pen hun tehna kician hilo a, hun tomno cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Particular time or occasion
senses.definition_en: A particular point in time or an important occasion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun kician khat ahih kei leh piangna thupi khat.

examples.english: At that moment, the phone rang.
examples.zomi: Tua hun lianin phone ging hi.

examples.english: Winning the award was a proud moment for her.
examples.zomi: Award ngahna pen ama ading kisaktheihna hun ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: At the moment commonly means “now,” while at that moment refers to a particular time in the past or story.
senses.usage_zomi: At the moment in “tuhun” cihna nei zel a, at that moment in a beisa ahih kei leh tangthu sung hun kician khat kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: The day of the week after Sunday and before Tuesday.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sunday khit leh Tuesday ma a kal ni.

examples.english: The office opens again on Monday.
examples.zomi: Office Monday ni in hong kik ding hi.

examples.english: We have a meeting every Monday morning.
examples.zomi: Monday zingsang simin ka kikhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Days of the week begin with capital letters. Use on before a particular day: on Monday.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah kal ni minte laimal lian tawh kipan hi. Ni kician ma ah on kizang hi: on Monday.

senses.definition_en: Coins, notes, or digital value used to buy things, pay people, and measure value.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van leina, mi thaman piakna leh man tehna ding a kizang sum pheek, sum lai ahih kei leh digital sum.

examples.english: She is saving money to buy a car.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw lei dingin sum khol hi.

examples.english: We should not spend more money than we earn.
examples.zomi: Ka sum ngahzah uh sangin tamzaw ka zang lo ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Money is uncountable: say much money or a lot of money, not many moneys. To count it, use units such as dollars or coins.
senses.usage_zomi: Money pen simtheih lo noun ahi hi: much money ahih kei leh a lot of money ci ding a, many moneys ci lo ding hi. Sim dingin dollars ahih kei leh coins bang unit kizang hi.

senses.heading: Computer screen
senses.definition_en: A screen used to display information and images from a computer or another device.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer ahih kei leh van dang khat pan thu leh lim a lak screen.

examples.english: The computer has two monitors.
examples.zomi: Computer in monitor nih nei hi.

examples.english: The image appeared clearly on the monitor.
examples.zomi: Monitor tungah lim kician takin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: A monitor displays information; the computer itself processes and stores that information.
senses.usage_zomi: Monitor in thu leh lim lak a, computer in tua thu sem leh kem hi.

senses.heading: Device that checks or records a condition
senses.definition_en: A device used to continuously check, measure, or record a condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat tawntung sittel, teh ahih kei leh ciamteh ding a kizang van.

examples.english: The nurse connected the patient to a heart monitor.
examples.zomi: Nurse in cina lungtang sittelna van tawh zomsak hi.

examples.english: The monitor records changes in temperature.
examples.zomi: Sittelna van in lumdan kikhelna ciamteh hi.

senses.usage_en: A monitor may display information, sound an alarm, or store measurements for later review.
senses.usage_zomi: Monitor in thu lak, kidopna aw pia ahih kei leh a nungciang sittel dingin tehna result kem thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A primate with a long tail in most species, hands that can hold things, and a body suited for climbing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nam a tamzaw in mei sau, na len thei khut leh sing kaai theih pumpi a nei gan.

examples.english: The monkey climbed the tree quickly.
examples.zomi: Zawng singkung tungah manlang takin kahto hi.

examples.english: The monkeys searched for fruit in the forest.
examples.zomi: Zawngte in gam sungah singgah zong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Monkeys and apes are both primates, but apes do not have tails and belong to different biological groups.
senses.usage_zomi: Zawng leh ape-te primate ahi uh napi, ape-te mei nei lo a, ganpianzia pawl tuam ahi uh hi.

senses.definition_en: One of the twelve named periods of a year, usually lasting twenty-eight to thirty-one days.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum khat sung a min nei hun khen sawmlehnihte lakah khat, ni sawmnihlehguk pan sawmthumleh khat dong a sawt zel.

examples.english: The course lasts six months.
examples.zomi: Sinna kha guk sung sawt hi.

examples.english: We visit our parents once a month.
examples.zomi: Kha khat vei khat ka nu leh pa uh ka veh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use in with a named month: in March. Use for to describe duration: for three months.
senses.usage_zomi: Kha min tawh in kizang hi: in March. Hun sawtna gen dingin for kizang hi: for three months.

senses.heading: Temporary emotional state
senses.definition_en: The way a person feels at a particular time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in hun kician khat ah a nei lungsim puakna.

examples.english: She is in a good mood today.
examples.zomi: Tuni amah lungnuam hi.

examples.english: The bad news changed his mood.
examples.zomi: Thuthang hoih lo in a lungsim puakna khel hi.

senses.usage_en: A mood is usually temporary. A person’s general and lasting pattern of behavior is their personality or temperament.
senses.usage_zomi: Mood pen tawmvei sung lungsim puakna ahi zel hi. Mi khat gamtatna leh lungsim omzia tawntung pen a personality ahih kei leh temperament ahi hi.

senses.heading: General feeling of a place or work
senses.definition_en: The general emotional feeling created by a place, event, story, or piece of art.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, piangna, tangthu ahih kei leh art khat in a piangsak lungsim dinmun a umum.

common_phrases.zomi: tangthu in a piak lungsim dinmun

examples.english: Soft music created a peaceful mood.
examples.zomi: La aw neem in lungsim nuamhuai dinmun piangsak hi.

examples.english: The lighting changed the mood of the room.
examples.zomi: Khuavak in innkhan a lungsim dinmun khel hi.

senses.usage_en: In art and literature, mood is the feeling experienced by the audience.
senses.usage_zomi: Art leh laisiamna ah mood pen a en ahih kei leh a sim mite in a phutkhak lungsim puakna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The natural object that travels around Earth and appears bright in the night sky.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung kiim a pai, zan van ah a taang bangin kilang piansaksa van.

examples.english: The full moon was bright last night.
examples.zomi: Zankim in kha pial taang mahmah hi.

examples.english: The moon travels around Earth.
examples.zomi: Kha in leitung kiim vel hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Moon in scientific writing when treating it as Earth’s specific natural satellite. In ordinary use, lowercase moon is common.
senses.usage_zomi: Science laigelhna ah leitung a kha kician in a gen ciangin Moon laimal lian tawh kigelh thei hi. Nisim zatna ah moon laimal neu kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Relating to right and wrong behavior
senses.definition_en: Relating to beliefs and principles about what behavior is right or wrong.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gamtat maan tawh kisai; lungsim siam leh sia theihna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna bang pen maan leh khial cih tawh kisai upna leh thukhun na.

examples.english: Parents help children develop moral values.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pate in naupangte gamtat maan manphatna nei dingin huh uh hi.

examples.english: She believed she had a moral duty to help.
