examples.zomi: Huhna pia pen a gamtat maan mawhpuak hi ci in um hi.

senses.usage_en: Moral concerns right and wrong. Legal concerns what the law permits; something can be legal but morally questionable.
senses.usage_zomi: Moral in maan leh khial gamtatna tawh kisai a, legal in thukham in a phal leh phal lo tawh kisai hi. Na khat thukham in phal napi gamtat maan lamah dot huai thei hi.

senses.heading: Behaving according to accepted principles of right
senses.definition_en: Behaving in a way considered good and right.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi in hoih leh maan a cih gamtatna thukhun zui in gamta na.

examples.english: He tried to make a moral decision.
examples.zomi: Gamtat maan tawh kituak khensatna bawl dingin hanciam hi.

examples.english: Honesty is part of moral behavior.
examples.zomi: Thuman genna pen gamtat maan sungah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling someone moral expresses approval of their ethical behavior; it does not mean that the person never makes mistakes.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat moral ci in genna in a gamtat maan hoihsakna ahi a, tua mi khial ngeilo cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A greater amount or number of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na ahih kei leh mi khat a zat ahih kei leh a sim a tamzaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We need more time to finish the work.
examples.zomi: Nasep zohna ding hun tamzaw ka kisam uh hi.

examples.english: More students joined the program this year.
examples.zomi: Tukum in sangnaupang tamzaw program ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: More is used with both countable and uncountable nouns: more books; more water. It is the comparative form associated with many and much.
senses.usage_zomi: More pen simtheih leh simtheih lo noun a nihgel tawh kizang hi: more books; more water. Many leh much tawh kisai comparative form ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The early part of the day, from around sunrise until noon.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni suah kimvel pan sun laitak dong ni a kipat lam hun.

examples.english: I exercise every morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsang simin pumpi ka zolh hi.

examples.english: The meeting starts at ten tomorrow morning.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna zing zingsang nai sawm in kipan ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Say in the morning, but use no preposition before this morning, tomorrow morning, or every morning.
senses.usage_zomi: In the morning ci in kizang hi. Ahih hang this morning, tomorrow morning, leh every morning ma ah preposition kikoih lo hi.

senses.definition_en: The largest number, amount, or part of something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tam pen; a tamzaw khempeuh
senses.explanation_zomi: Na ahih kei leh mi khat a sim, zat ahih kei leh khen a tam pen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Most students passed the exam.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte a tamzaw sittelna ong uh hi.

examples.english: She spent most of her time reading.
examples.zomi: A hun a tamzaw laibu sim in zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use most + noun for a general group: most people. Use most of + determiner/pronoun: most of the people; most of them.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawl a umum a gen ciangin most + noun kizang hi: most people. Determiner ahih kei leh pronoun tawh most of kizang hi: most of the people; most of them.

senses.definition_en: Mainly, generally, or for the greatest part.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tamzaw in; a umum in
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in, a umum in ahih kei leh a khen lian pen in.

examples.english: The audience was mostly young people.
examples.zomi: Ente a tamzaw khangno ahi uh hi.

examples.english: We stayed indoors mostly because of the rain.
examples.zomi: Guah hang phadiak in inn sungah ka om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Mostly means “for the greater part,” not completely. It is close in meaning to mainly.
senses.usage_zomi: Mostly in a khen lian pen cihna hi a, a vekpi cihna hilo hi. Mainly tawh khiatna kinai hi.

senses.definition_en: A female parent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Naungek khat a numei nu leh a kemkhia mi.

examples.english: Her mother works at a hospital.
examples.zomi: A nu si-in ah nasem hi.

examples.english: The mother held her baby carefully.
examples.zomi: Nu in a naungek kidop takin pua hi.

senses.usage_en: Mother is neutral or somewhat formal. Informal forms include mom in American English and mum in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Mother pen kammal ngeina ahih kei leh thukhun deuh ahi hi. Nisim kammal in American English ah mom a, British English ah mum kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A machine that changes electrical energy or fuel into movement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Electric tha ahih kei leh fuel tha kisuanna tha in a khelsak machine.

examples.english: An electric motor powers the fan.
examples.zomi: Electric motor in huihmutna a haisak hi.

examples.english: The motor stopped suddenly.
examples.zomi: Motor thakhatin tawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A motor produces movement. An engine often produces power by burning fuel, although everyday usage sometimes overlaps.
senses.usage_zomi: Motor in kisuanna tha piangsak hi. Engine in fuel hal in tha piangsak zel napi, nisim zatna ah a nih zatdan kitukal thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A two-wheeled motor vehicle that a rider sits on and controls.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuangmi in a tungah tu in a hawl, khe nih a nei motor mawtaw.

examples.english: He rides a motorcycle to work.
examples.zomi: Nasepna ah motorcycle tuang in pai hi.

examples.english: Always wear a helmet when riding a motorcycle.
examples.zomi: Motorcycle na tuang ciangin lukhu silh tawntung in.

senses.usage_en: Use ride a motorcycle, not normally drive a motorcycle. The person is a motorcyclist or rider.
senses.usage_zomi: Ride a motorcycle ci in kizang a, drive a motorcycle ci lo zel hi. A tuang mi pen motorcyclist ahih kei leh rider kici hi.

senses.heading: Get onto an animal or vehicle
senses.definition_en: To get onto a horse, bicycle, or similar thing in order to ride it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sakol, lengnih ahih kei leh a kibang na tungah tuang dingin kahto cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She mounted the horse carefully.
examples.zomi: Amah sakol kidop takin tuang hi.

examples.english: The riders mounted their bicycles.
examples.zomi: Tuangmite in amau lengnih tuang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Mount is more formal than get on. Its opposite is dismount.
senses.usage_zomi: Mount pen get on sangin thukhun zaw hi. A kikal pen dismount ahi hi.

senses.heading: Fix something in position
senses.definition_en: To attach or place something firmly on a wall, frame, support, or other surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bang, frame, a domna ahih kei leh maitang dang tungah kip takin khaai ahih kei leh koih cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: mount a television on the wall

examples.english: They mounted the television on the wall.
examples.zomi: Amaute in television bang tungah khaai uh hi.

examples.english: The camera was mounted on a metal frame.
examples.zomi: Camera sik frame tungah kikoih hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, mount means installing something securely, often in a raised position.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah mount in na khat kip takin phut a, a sang deuh munah koih cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Increase gradually
senses.definition_en: To increase in amount, seriousness, or intensity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, nasiahdan ahih kei leh hatna khangto paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Pressure on the government continued to mount.
examples.zomi: Ukna tung a nawngna khangto paisuak hi.

examples.english: The family’s debts were mounting.
examples.zomi: Innkuan leiba tam semsem hi.

senses.usage_en: This intransitive sense is common in formal news and writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih intransitive khiatna pen thukhun thuthang leh laigelhna ah kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: A very high natural area of land with steep sides, higher and usually larger than a hill.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mual sangin a sangzaw leh a lianzaw zel, a pangsteil piansaksa leitang sang.

examples.english: Snow covered the top of the mountain.
examples.zomi: Vun in tang dawn tuam hi.

examples.english: They climbed the mountain in two days.
examples.zomi: Amaute ni nih sungin tang kaaito uh hi.

senses.usage_en: There is no exact universal height separating a mountain from a hill; local geography and naming also matter.
senses.usage_zomi: Mountain leh hill kikhenna ding sanna ciangtan leitung pumpi ading khatbek om lo a, gam dinmun leh min piakdan zong thupi hi.

senses.heading: Small rodent
senses.definition_en: A small animal with fur, a pointed nose, and a long thin tail.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mul nei, nak kicaam leh mei sau neem a nei gan neu.

examples.english: A mouse ran across the kitchen floor.
examples.zomi: Zu khat anhuan inn leilak kantan in tai hi.

examples.english: The cat caught a mouse.
examples.zomi: Ngiau in zu khat man hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural of the animal is mice, not mouses.
senses.usage_zomi: Gan a plural pen mice ahi a, mouses hilo hi.

senses.heading: Computer control device
senses.definition_en: A small hand-operated device used to move a pointer and select items on a computer screen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer screen tung a pointer suan leh nate teel ding a khut tawh a kizang van neu.

examples.english: Click the icon with the mouse.
examples.zomi: Mouse tawh lim teek in.

examples.english: This wireless mouse needs a new battery.
examples.zomi: Hih khau om lo mouse in battery thak kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural for computer devices may be mice or, less commonly, mouses.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer van a plural dingin mice kizang tam a, mouses zong tawmno kizang uh hi.

senses.heading: Opening used for eating and speaking
senses.definition_en: The opening in the face through which a person or animal eats, breathes, and makes sounds.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih kei leh gan in an nek, huih lak leh aw suahtna maitang a kihong khen.

examples.english: Open your mouth so the doctor can examine your throat.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in na gaw sittel theihna ding na kam hong in.

examples.english: Cover your mouth when you cough.
examples.zomi: Na khuh ciangin na kam tuam in.

senses.usage_en: The plural is mouths /maʊðz/.
senses.usage_zomi: A plural pen mouths /maʊðz/ ahi hi.

senses.heading: Opening of a river, cave, or container
senses.definition_en: The open end or entrance of a river, cave, bottle, or similar thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gun a tuipi tawh a kizopna, khuam lutna ahih kei leh bottle bang van a kam kihong.

examples.english: The village lies near the mouth of the river.
examples.zomi: Khua pen gun kam gei ah om hi.

examples.english: They stood at the mouth of the cave.
examples.zomi: Amaute khuam kam ah ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense extends the idea of a body’s mouth to any opening or entrance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in pumpi kam tawh kibang kihonna ahih kei leh lutna khat kawk hi.

senses.heading: Change position or place
senses.definition_en: To change position or go from one place to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Omna khel ahih kei leh mun khat pan mun dangah pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not move until the doctor arrives.
examples.zomi: Siavuan hong tunma in kisuan kei in.

examples.english: The car moved slowly through traffic.
examples.zomi: Mawtawte lakah mawtaw dam takin kisuan hi.

senses.usage_en: Move may be intransitive, when something changes position itself, or transitive, when someone changes an object’s position.
senses.usage_zomi: Move pen na khat amah leh amah a kisuan in intransitive hi thei a, mi khat in na dang a suan in transitive hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Change your home or workplace
senses.definition_en: To leave one home, office, or area and begin living or working in another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn, office ahih kei leh gam khat nusia in mun dangah teng ahih kei leh nasem dingin kikhin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The family moved to Ohio last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa in innkuan Ohio ah kikhin uh hi.

examples.english: Our office is moving to a larger building.
examples.zomi: Ka office uh inn lianzaw khat ah kikhin ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Use move to before the destination and move from before the former place.
senses.usage_zomi: A kikhinna ding mun ma ah move to kizang a, a nutsiat mun ma ah move from kizang hi.

senses.heading: Cause a strong feeling
senses.definition_en: To cause someone to feel strong emotion, especially sympathy, sadness, or admiration.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat hehpihna, dahna ahih kei leh hoihsakna bang lungsim thuk nei sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The story moved her deeply.
examples.zomi: Tangthu in a lungsim thuk takin sukha hi.

examples.english: His kindness moved us to tears.
examples.zomi: A hehpihna in kei hong kap sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, move concerns emotion rather than physical movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah move in pumpi kisuanna hilo in, lungsim khoihna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Act of changing position
senses.definition_en: The act of moving or changing position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisuanna ahih kei leh omna kikhelna nasep.

examples.english: The camera detects movement.
examples.zomi: Camera in kisuanna theikha hi.

examples.english: The injury limited the movement of his arm.
examples.zomi: Liamna in a ban kisuanna ciangtan hi.

senses.usage_en: Movement may describe one action or motion generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Movement in kisuanna khat ahih kei leh kisuanna a umum in kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Organized effort for social or political change
senses.definition_en: An organized group or campaign working toward social, political, religious, or cultural change.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipi, ukna, biakna ahih kei leh ngeina lam kikhelna ding a nasemkhawm mihon leh nasep.

examples.english: The movement demanded equal rights.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in dikna kikim ngen hi.

examples.english: Young people played an important role in the movement.
examples.zomi: Khangnote in mipi tatna ah mawhpuak thupi sem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A movement is broader than one organization and may include many groups and individuals sharing a goal.
senses.usage_zomi: Movement pen kipawlna khatbek sangin zaizaw a, ngimna khat a nei pawl leh mimal tampi kihel thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A story or event recorded as moving images and shown in a cinema, on television, or on a device.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisuang lim in a kicianteh tangthu ahih kei leh piangna, cinema, television ahih kei leh van tungah a kilak.

examples.english: We watched a movie at home.
examples.zomi: Inn ah movie khat ka en uh hi.

examples.english: The movie is based on a true story.
examples.zomi: Movie pen tangthu taktak tungah kinga hi.

senses.usage_en: Movie is especially common in American English. British English often uses film.
senses.usage_zomi: Movie pen American English ah kizang tam phadiak hi. British English ah film kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A large amount of something uncountable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Simtheih lo na khat a zat a tam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We do not have much time.
examples.zomi: Hun tampi ka nei kei uh hi.

examples.english: How much money do you need?
examples.zomi: Sum bangzah na kisam hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use much with uncountable nouns and many with countable plural nouns. In affirmative informal sentences, a lot of often sounds more natural than much.
senses.usage_zomi: Much pen simtheih lo noun tawh kizang a, many pen simtheih plural noun tawh kizang hi. Nisim affirmative sentence ah much sangin a lot of a pianzia zaw zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Soft, wet earth formed when soil mixes with water.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei leh tui kihelkhawm in a nem leh a ciim lei.

examples.english: The road was covered in mud after the rain.
examples.zomi: Guah zuah khit ciangin lampi nawt tawh tuam hi.

examples.english: The children played in the mud.
examples.zomi: Naupangte nawt sungah kimawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Mud is uncountable. A small separate amount may be described as a patch of mud or a lump of mud.
senses.usage_zomi: Mud pen simtheih lo noun ahi hi. Mun neu khat a om nawt pen a patch of mud ci in gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Many in number, or involving more than one person, thing, part, or occasion.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sim a tam, ahih kei leh mi, na, khen leh hun khat sangin tamzaw a kihel.

examples.english: The problem has multiple causes.
examples.zomi: Buaipihna in a pianna hang tampi nei hi.

examples.english: You can select multiple files at once.
examples.zomi: Khatvei in file tampi na teel thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Multiple emphasizes that several separate elements are involved, not merely that the amount is large.
senses.usage_zomi: Multiple in zat a tam bek sangin khen tuamtuam pawlkhat kihel cihna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Perform multiplication
senses.definition_en: To calculate the total produced by adding one number to itself a stated number of times.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim khat pen sim kician khat vei a kipawlkhawm bangin result a simna.

examples.english: Multiply six by four.
examples.zomi: Guk pen li tawh puntam in.

examples.english: Six multiplied by four equals twenty-four.
examples.zomi: Guk leh li puntam in sawmnihlehli ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Say multiply A by B. The result is called the product.
senses.usage_zomi: Multiply A by B ci in kizang hi. A result pen product kici hi.

senses.heading: Increase greatly in number
senses.definition_en: To increase or cause something to increase rapidly in number or amount.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim ahih kei leh zat manlang takin pung ahih kei leh pungsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Bacteria multiply rapidly in warm conditions.
examples.zomi: Dinmun lum ah bacteria manlang takin pung hi.

examples.english: Small errors can multiply over time.
examples.zomi: Hun a sawt ciangin khialhna neute tam semsem thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may be transitive or intransitive: things multiply, or something multiplies them.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen transitive ahih kei leh intransitive hi thei hi: nate amaute pung thei a, na dang khat in pungsak zong thei hi.

senses.definition_en: An informal British word for mother.
senses.explanation_zomi: British English ah nu a nisim kammal tawh kawhna.

examples.english: My mum works at a school.
examples.zomi: Ka nu sang khat ah nasem hi.

examples.english: I called Mum last night.
examples.zomi: Zankim in ka nu ka phone hi.

senses.usage_en: Mum is common in British English. American English normally uses mom. Capitalize it when used as a name: I asked Mum.
senses.usage_zomi: Mum pen British English ah kizang tam hi. American English ah mom kizang zel hi. Min bangin kizang ciangin laimal lian tawh kigelh hi: I asked Mum.

senses.definition_en: The unlawful and intentional killing of another person.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mi thahna; tum neituam mi thahna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang khat thukham lang leh tum neituam in thahna.

examples.english: Police opened a murder investigation.
examples.zomi: Police-te in mi thahna zongkhiatna kipan uh hi.

examples.english: The court found him guilty of murder.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi in amah mi thahna mawh nei ci in thukhen hi.

senses.usage_en: Murder is a legal term requiring unlawful and intentional killing. Not every killing is legally classified as murder.
senses.usage_zomi: Murder pen thukham kammal ahi a, thukham lang leh tum neituam thahna kisam hi. Mihing sihna piangsak khempeuh thukham in murder kici lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Body tissue that tightens and relaxes to produce movement or control parts of the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi kisuang sak ahih kei leh pumpi khen tuamtuam uk dingin a kikhauh leh a kikha thei pumpi sa.

examples.english: Regular exercise strengthens the muscles.
examples.zomi: Hunseh tawh pumpi kizohlhna in pumpi sa thahatsak hi.

examples.english: He injured a muscle in his leg.
examples.zomi: A khe pumpi sa khat liam hi.

senses.usage_en: Muscles create movement by contracting. Muscle may be countable for one particular muscle or uncountable for muscular tissue generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi sa in a kikhauh ciangin kisuanna piangsak hi. Pumpi sa khat kician a gen ciangin simtheih noun a, pumpi sa a umum in a gen ciangin simtheih lo noun hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A building or institution that collects, preserves, studies, and displays objects of historical, scientific, artistic, or cultural importance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu, science, art ahih kei leh ngeina lam van manphate a khawm, a kem, a zongkhe leh mipi a ensak inn ahih kei leh kipawlna.

examples.english: The museum displays ancient tools.
examples.zomi: Museum in tanglai vanzatte lak hi.

examples.english: We visited the science museum on Saturday.
examples.zomi: Saturday ni in science museum ka veh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Museums may display original objects, copies, digital exhibits, or interactive materials.
senses.usage_zomi: Museum in van taktak, a kibawl lim, digital lakna ahih kei leh a en mite in a ze-et theih nate lak thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Organized sound made by voices or instruments, usually with rhythm, melody, or harmony.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw ahih kei leh tumgingte tawh a kiciam, awzui, la mel ahih kei leh aw kituakna a nei ging.

examples.english: She listens to music while working.
examples.zomi: A nasep laitakin la ngai hi.

examples.english: The students performed traditional music.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in ngeina la tum uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Music is uncountable. Say a piece of music or a song, not normally a music.
senses.usage_zomi: Music pen simtheih lo noun ahi hi. A piece of music ahih kei leh a song ci ding a, a music ci lo zel hi.

senses.heading: Relating to music
senses.definition_en: Relating to music, or containing music.
senses.zomi_equivalents: la tawh kisai; tumging tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: La, tumging ahih kei leh la bawlna tawh kisai na.

examples.english: She can play several musical instruments.
examples.zomi: Amah tumging nam tuamtuam tum thei hi.

examples.english: The school offers musical training.
examples.zomi: Sang in la lam kisinna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Musical before a noun usually means connected with music.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun ma a musical in la tawh kisai cihna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Naturally skilled in or sensitive to music
senses.definition_en: Having natural skill in music or a strong ability to recognize and produce musical sound.
senses.explanation_zomi: La leh tumging ah pianpih siamna ahih kei leh la aw tel siamna a nei.

examples.english: The child is very musical.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen la siam mahmah hi.

examples.english: She grew up in a musical family.
examples.zomi: Amah la siam innkuan sungah khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Describing a person as musical means that the person has musical ability, not that the person is a piece of music.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat musical ci in genna in la siamna nei cihna ahi a, tua mi pen la ahi cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who plays a musical instrument, sings, or writes music, especially professionally or with skill.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lasakmi; tumging tum mi; la siam
senses.explanation_zomi: Tumging a tum, la a sa ahih kei leh la a bawl mi, phadiak in nasep ahih kei leh siamna tawh a sem mi.

examples.english: Her father is a professional musician.
examples.zomi: A pa nasep siam la tum mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Several local musicians performed at the festival.
examples.zomi: Khuasung la siam pawlkhat pawi ah la tum uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A musician may perform, compose, arrange, or teach music. The word is not limited to instrumental players.
senses.usage_zomi: Musician in la tum, la bawl, la khenkham ahih kei leh la hilh thei hi. Tumging tum mite bek kawk lo hi.

senses.heading: Express necessity or obligation
senses.definition_en: Used to say that something is necessary, required, or strongly expected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl kul, bawl ding a kisam ahih kei leh kip ngen cihna genna modal verb.

examples.english: You must wear a seat belt.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw sung bitna khau na kikhih kul hi.

examples.english: We must finish the work today.
examples.zomi: Tuni nasep ka khin kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use must + base verb without to: must go, not must to go. Must not expresses prohibition, not lack of necessity.
senses.usage_zomi: Must + base verb ci in to om lo in kizang hi: must go ci ding a, must to go ci lo ding hi. Must not in bawl lo ding a kikhapna gen a, bawl kul lo cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Express a strong logical conclusion
senses.definition_en: Used to say that something is very likely or logically certain based on available evidence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci omte tungtawn in thu khat thuman ding a umhuai mahmah ahih kei leh ngaihsutna tawh kip cih genna modal verb.

examples.english: You worked all night; you must be tired.
examples.zomi: Zan khawng na nasem a; na gim takpi ding hi.

examples.english: The lights are on, so someone must be home.
examples.zomi: Khuavakte taang a, tua ahih manin innah mi khat om takpi ding hi.

senses.usage_en: This use of must gives a conclusion, not an order. For a negative conclusion, English often uses cannot: That cannot be true.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih must in thu piakna hilo in, teci pan thukhupna gen hi. Negative thukhupna dingin cannot kizang tam hi: That cannot be true.

senses.definition_en: Belonging to or connected with the speaker.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat thu genpa a neih ahih kei leh amah tawh a kizop cih lakna possessive determiner.

examples.english: My family lives in Ohio.
examples.zomi: Ka innkuan Ohio ah teng hi.

examples.english: I cannot find my phone.
examples.zomi: Ka phone ka mu zo kei hi.

senses.usage_en: My must come before a noun: my book. Mine replaces the noun: The book is mine.
senses.usage_zomi: My pen noun ma ah om ding hi: my book. Mine in noun aiawh hi: The book is mine.

senses.heading: Reflexive form of “I”
senses.definition_en: Used when the speaker is both the person doing an action and the person affected by it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu genpa in nasep a bawl mi leh tua nasep in a huzaap mi a nihgel a hih ciangin kizang I a reflexive form.

examples.english: I cut myself while cooking.
examples.zomi: An ka huan laitakin kei mah ki-at hi.

examples.english: I taught myself to use the program.
examples.zomi: Program zat ding kei leh kei ka kisin hi.

senses.usage_en: Use myself when it refers back to I. Do not use it merely as a more formal replacement for me or I.
senses.usage_zomi: Myself pen I mah a kawkkik ciangin kizang hi. Me ahih kei leh I aiawh thukhun zaw in zang lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Emphasis on the speaker
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that the speaker personally did something or is being referred to.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu genpa amah ngiat cih bulphuhna dingin kizang.

examples.english: I wrote the report myself.
examples.zomi: Report pen kei mah in ka gelh hi.

examples.english: I myself saw what happened.
examples.zomi: Bang piang cih kei ngiat in ka mu hi.

senses.usage_en: By myself may mean “alone” or “without help,” depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: By myself in kei bek om cihna ahih kei leh huhna om lo in kei mah in bawl cihna nei thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Difficult or impossible to explain, understand, or identify.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hilhcian, tel ahih kei leh theihkhiat haksa ahih kei leh theihzawh loh na.

examples.english: The police are investigating a mysterious disappearance.
examples.zomi: Police-te in mangthangna telhak khat zongkhe uh hi.

examples.english: A mysterious sound came from the forest.
examples.zomi: Gam sung pan aw lamdang khat hong ging hi.

senses.usage_en: Mysterious describes something that creates uncertainty or curiosity because it is not understood.
senses.usage_zomi: Mysterious in a kitel loh manin lunghihmawhna ahih kei leh theihnopna a piangsak na khat gen hi.

senses.heading: Something difficult to explain
senses.definition_en: Something whose cause, meaning, or identity is unknown or difficult to explain.
senses.explanation_zomi: A pianna hang, khiatna ahih kei leh bang ahi cih kithei lo ahih kei leh hilhcian haksa thu.

examples.english: The cause of the accident remains a mystery.
examples.zomi: Accident a pianna hang thuthuk in om lai hi.

examples.english: Scientists are trying to solve the mystery.
examples.zomi: Science siamte in thuthuk zongkhia dingin hanciam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A mystery may eventually be solved, but at present the explanation is unknown.
senses.usage_zomi: Mystery pen a nungciangin zongkhiat theih kha ding napi, tuhun in hilhcian theih nailo thu ahi hi.

senses.heading: Story about an unexplained event or crime
senses.definition_en: A story, film, or book in which characters investigate a crime or puzzling event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi gamtatkhialhna ahih kei leh piangna telhak khat zongkhiatna thu a kigelh laibu, tangthu ahih kei leh film.

examples.english: She enjoys reading mystery novels.
examples.zomi: Amah thuthuk zongkhiat tangthu laibute sim nuamsa hi.

examples.english: The movie is a mystery about a missing painting.
examples.zomi: Movie pen art lim mang khat thu thuthuk zongkhiat tangthu ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In fiction, the mystery usually creates questions that are answered near the end.
senses.usage_zomi: Tangthu phuah ah mystery in dotna-te piangsak a, a tawpna nai ciangin dawnna kimu zel hi.

senses.heading: Hard covering on a finger or toe
senses.definition_en: The thin, hard covering at the end of a finger or toe.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khutme leh kheme a mong a khauhsa tuam.

examples.english: She cut her fingernails carefully.
examples.zomi: A khutme kidop takin at hi.

examples.english: His toenail was injured during the game.
examples.zomi: A kimawl laitakin a kheme liam hi.

senses.usage_en: Fingernail refers specifically to a nail on the hand; toenail refers to one on the foot.
senses.usage_zomi: Fingernail in khutme kawk kician a, toenail in kheme kawk hi.

senses.heading: Small metal fastener
senses.definition_en: A small, thin piece of metal with a sharp point, driven into wood or another material to join or support things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sing ahih kei leh van dang khat sungah kisat in na-te zomkhawm ahih kei leh dom ding a kizang, a mong hiam sik tawm.

examples.english: He hammered a nail into the wall.
examples.zomi: Ama in bang sungah nail khat sik tawh sat hi.

examples.english: Be careful not to step on the nail.
examples.zomi: Nail tungah na tuansuk lohna ding kidawm in.

senses.usage_en: A nail is usually hammered into material. A screw is turned and normally has a spiral ridge.
senses.usage_zomi: Nail pen sik tawh kisat lut zel hi. Screw bel hei in kikhum a, a pumpi ah a kawi in lai nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Word used to identify someone or something
senses.definition_en: A word or set of words by which a person, place, organization, or thing is known.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun, kipawlna ahih kei leh na khat theihkhiatna ding a kizang kammal ahih kei leh kammal hon.

examples.english: Please write your full name here.
examples.zomi: Hih munah na min kicing gelh in.

examples.english: The village takes its name from the nearby river.
examples.zomi: Khua min pen a gei a gun min pan kila hi.

senses.usage_en: A person’s first name identifies the individual; a family name or surname identifies the family.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a first name in tua mimal theihkhiatna ahi a, family name ahih kei leh surname in innkuan theihkhiatna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Reputation
senses.definition_en: The reputation or public recognition that a person or organization has.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh kipawlna khat tungtang mipi in a theih leh a ngaihsutdan.

examples.english: The company has a good name for quality.
examples.zomi: Company in a van hoihna hangin minhoih nei hi.

examples.english: She made a name for herself as a writer.
examples.zomi: Laigelhsia in minthang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, name refers to reputation rather than the actual identifying word.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lim tawh zatna ah name in kawhna min taktak sangin minhoihna ahih kei leh minthanna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Story or account of events
senses.definition_en: A spoken or written account of connected events, told in a particular order.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piangna kizomte kiciam tawh pau ahih kei leh lai in a kigen tangthu.

examples.english: The book presents a narrative of the country’s history.
examples.zomi: Laibu in gam tangthu piangsa kiciam takin gen hi.

examples.english: Students wrote a personal narrative about childhood.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in amau naupan lai phutkhakna tangthu gelh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A narrative tells connected events. It may be factual, fictional, or a mixture of both.
senses.usage_zomi: Narrative in piangna kizomte gen hi. Thuman, tangthu phuah ahih kei leh a nih kihelkhawm hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Particular interpretation of events
senses.definition_en: A particular way of explaining events that supports an idea, position, or viewpoint.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piangna-te ngaihsutna, dinmun ahih kei leh muhdan khat tawh kituak ding a hilhciandan.

examples.english: The evidence does not support that narrative.
examples.zomi: Teci in tua thuhilhciandan kipsak lo hi.

examples.english: Different groups offered competing narratives of the event.
examples.zomi: Pawl tuamtuam in tua piangna hilhciandan kituak lo tuamtuam pia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In news and politics, narrative may imply that facts have been selected or arranged to promote a viewpoint.
senses.usage_zomi: Thuthang leh gamvai ah narrative in muhdan khat kipsak dingin thute teel leh kiciam cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Not wide
senses.definition_en: Having only a small distance from one side to the other.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lang khat pan a lang dang dong a vai tawm na.

examples.english: The car moved slowly along the narrow road.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw lampi zim tungah dam takin pai hi.

examples.english: We entered through a narrow opening.
examples.zomi: Kihonna zim khat pan ka lut uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Narrow is the opposite of wide or broad when describing physical width.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi vai a gen ciangin narrow a kikal pen wide ahih kei leh broad ahi hi.

senses.heading: Limited in range or variety
senses.definition_en: Limited to a small range of ideas, choices, interests, or possibilities.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a huamzang zim; a ciangtan tawm
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, teelna, lunglutna ahih kei leh piangtheihna huamzang a neu.

examples.english: The course focuses on a narrow area of history.
examples.zomi: Sinna in tangthu khen neu khat bek bulphuh hi.

examples.english: We should not take such a narrow view.
examples.zomi: Tua zahin muhdan zim ka nei lo ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense may criticize a lack of variety or openness.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lim tawh zatna in thu nam tawm bek enna ahih kei leh ngaihsutna kihong lohna dem thei hi.

senses.heading: Small in amount or difference
senses.definition_en: Small in amount, especially when describing a victory, escape, or difference.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat ahih kei leh kilamdanna a tawm mahmah.

examples.english: The team won a narrow victory.
examples.zomi: Pawl in point tawmno tawh gualzo hi.

examples.english: They had a narrow escape from the fire.
examples.zomi: Mei sung pan hampha takin suahtak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A narrow victory is a victory by only a small difference.
senses.usage_zomi: Narrow victory in kilamdanna tawmno bek tawh gualzawhna cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A large community of people united by a shared country, government, history, culture, or identity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam, ukna, tangthu, ngeina ahih kei leh minpuak kikim tawh a kipumkhat mihon lian.

examples.english: The whole nation followed the election results.
examples.zomi: Gam pumpi in teelna result zui hi.

examples.english: Many nations signed the agreement.
examples.zomi: Gam tampi in thukimna lai min gelh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Nation emphasizes a people and their shared identity. Country often emphasizes territory and political borders, although the words frequently overlap.
senses.usage_zomi: Nation in mipite leh amau minpuak kikim bulphuh a, country in leitang leh gamgi bulphuhzaw thei hi. Ahih hang a nih zatna kitukal tam hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to an entire nation rather than one local area, or belonging to a particular nation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khua ahih kei leh gam khen khat bek hilo in gam pumpi tawh kisai, ahih kei leh gam khat a neih na.

examples.english: The issue received national attention.
examples.zomi: Tua thu gam pumpi in ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: The flag is a symbol of national identity.
examples.zomi: Dial pen gam minpuak lim ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: National concerns a whole nation; international concerns two or more nations.
senses.usage_zomi: National in gam khat pumpi tawh kisai a, international in gam nih leh a tamzaw tawh kisai hi.

senses.heading: Born in a particular place
senses.definition_en: Born in a particular country or place and connected with it from birth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam ahih kei leh mun khat ah a piang a, pianpih in tua mun tawh kizom.

examples.english: She is a native of Myanmar.
examples.zomi: Amah Myanmar gam suak ahi hi.

examples.english: He returned to his native village.
examples.zomi: A pian khua ah ciahkik hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing Indigenous peoples, use the specific community name when known and follow the group’s preferred terminology.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam a pianpih mipite a gen ciangin, amau pawl min kician theih leh tua min leh amau deih kammal kizang ding hi.

senses.heading: Existing naturally in a place
senses.definition_en: Growing, living, or occurring naturally in a particular region.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pianpih; tua gam ah a piang
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam khen khat ah mihing in pua lut hilo in, pianpih in a khang, a nungta ahih kei leh a om.

examples.english: This tree is native to North America.
examples.zomi: Hih singkung North America gam pianpih ahi hi.

examples.english: The park protects native plants and animals.
examples.zomi: Park in tua gam pianpih singte leh gante dal hi.

senses.usage_en: A native species occurs naturally in an area; an introduced species was brought there by people or human activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Native species pen mun khat ah pianpih in om a, introduced species pen mihing ahih kei leh mihing nasep in a pua lut ahi hi.

senses.heading: First language
senses.definition_en: Learned naturally as a child in the home or community.
senses.explanation_zomi: Naupang lai pan inn ahih kei leh khuami lakah pianpih bangin a kisin pau.

examples.english: Zomi is her native language.
examples.zomi: Zomi pen a nu pau ahi hi.

examples.english: The text was reviewed by a native speaker.
examples.zomi: Lai pen pianpih Zomi pau zangmi in sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: A native speaker learned the language naturally from early childhood; the term does not automatically mean that every usage by that speaker is formally standard.
senses.usage_zomi: Native speaker in naupan lai pan pau pianpih in a kisin mi ahi hi. Ahih hang tua mi pau zat khempeuh Standard Zomi hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Existing in nature
senses.definition_en: Existing or produced in nature rather than made or greatly changed by people.
senses.zomi_equivalents: piansaksa; amah leh amah a piang
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing in a bawl ahih kei leh nakpitak a khel hilo in, piansakna sungah amah leh amah a om ahih kei leh a piang.

examples.english: The country has many natural resources.
examples.zomi: Gam in piansaksa vanzat tampi nei hi.

examples.english: This juice contains only natural ingredients.
examples.zomi: Hih singgah tui sungah piansaksa bawlna zat-te bek om hi.

senses.usage_en: Natural does not automatically mean safe, healthy, or environmentally harmless.
senses.usage_zomi: Natural in bit, cidamna pia ahih kei leh kimlehpam a susia lo cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Normal or expected
senses.definition_en: Normal, understandable, or expected in a particular situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat ah ngeina, teltheih ahih kei leh a piang ding lam-et huai.

common_phrases.zomi: amah leh amah a pai zia

examples.english: It is natural to feel nervous before an exam.
examples.zomi: Sittelna ma in lungmang pen ngeina ahi hi.

examples.english: Her reaction was completely natural.
examples.zomi: A dawnkikna pen pianzia mahmah ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, natural means ordinary or understandable, not necessarily connected with forests or the environment.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah natural in ngeina ahih kei leh teltheih cihna a, gam leh kimlehpam tawh kizom cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Having an inborn ability
senses.definition_en: Having an ability or quality from birth or without much training.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pianpih siamna ahih kei leh kisin tampi kul lo in a nei omzia.

examples.english: She is a natural leader.
examples.zomi: Amah pianpih makaipa ahi hi.

examples.english: He has a natural ability to learn languages.
examples.zomi: Pau sin ding pianpih siamna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A natural ability can still be improved through study and practice.
senses.usage_zomi: Pianpih siamna pen kisinna leh kizohlhna tawh hoihsak sem theih lai hi.

senses.heading: In a natural way
senses.definition_en: In a way that develops or happens without artificial control or unnecessary force.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing in bawl kisa lo ahih kei leh sawl tentan lo in, amah leh amah pianzia bangin.

examples.english: These flowers grow naturally in the region.
examples.zomi: Hih pate tua gam khen ah amah leh amah khang hi.

examples.english: Try to speak naturally during the interview.
examples.zomi: Interview sungah pianzia takin pau in.

senses.usage_en: Naturally may describe something occurring in nature or behavior that is relaxed and not forced.
senses.usage_zomi: Naturally in piansakna sungah amah leh amah a piang na ahih kei leh sawl tentan lo gamtatna kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: As expected or obviously
senses.definition_en: As is expected, understandable, or obvious in the situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam-et bangin, teltheih takin ahih kei leh a kician mah bangin.

common_phrases.zomi: lam-et bangin ka thukim uh hi

examples.english: Naturally, the parents were worried.
examples.zomi: Lam-et bangin nu leh pate lunghimawh uh hi.

examples.english: She was naturally disappointed by the result.
examples.zomi: Result hangin amah lungkia pen teltheih ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: At the beginning of a sentence, naturally often comments that the result is unsurprising.
senses.usage_zomi: Sentence kipatna ah naturally in result pen lamdang lo ahih kei leh lam-et mah ahi cih lak zel hi.

senses.heading: Natural world
senses.definition_en: The physical world and its plants, animals, landscapes, and processes, excluding things made by people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing bawl hilo leitung, singte, gante, gam leh amah leh amah a pai zia khempeuh.

examples.english: We must protect nature for future generations.
examples.zomi: Mailam khangte ading piansakna i dal ding hi.

examples.english: The children spent the day exploring nature.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in ni khat sung piansakna zong in hun zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Nature is uncountable when it means the natural world.
senses.usage_zomi: Piansakna leitung a kawk ciangin nature simtheih lo noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Essential character or type
senses.definition_en: The basic character, qualities, or type of a person, thing, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na ahih kei leh dinmun khat a bulpi omzia leh pianzia.

examples.english: We need to understand the nature of the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaipihna pianzia i tel kul hi.

examples.english: Curiosity is part of human nature.
examples.zomi: Theihnopna pen mihing pianzia sungah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: The nature of something means its fundamental type or character.
senses.usage_zomi: The nature of something in na khat a bulpi nam ahih kei leh omzia kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: At or to a short distance from someone or something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gei ah; kiangah; gamla lo ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat kiangah ahih kei leh gamla lo ah.

examples.english: The hotel is near the airport.
examples.zomi: Hotel pen vanleng tual gei ah om hi.

examples.english: She sat near the window.
examples.zomi: Amah kong-awk gei ah tu hi.

senses.usage_en: Near does not normally require to: say near the school. Near to is possible but less common.
senses.usage_zomi: Near nungah to kisam lo zel hi: near the school ci ding hi. Near to zong kizang thei napi kizang tawmzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Almost, but not completely or exactly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pha tawm, ahi tawm ahih kei leh kicing tawm napi a pha, ahi ahih kei leh kicing nailo.

examples.english: The work is nearly finished.
examples.zomi: Nasep khin tawm hi.

examples.english: Nearly everyone attended the meeting.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh pha tawm kikhopna ah pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Nearly means close to a point but not reaching it. It is similar to almost.
senses.usage_zomi: Nearly in ciangtan khat pha dektak napi pha nailo cihna ahi hi. Almost tawh khiatna kinai hi.

senses.heading: Tidy and well organized
senses.definition_en: Tidy, clean, and arranged in an orderly way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sian, kiciam hoih leh kithehthang lo na.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat kiciam hoih in kem

examples.english: Her desk is always neat.
examples.zomi: A tawlngak kiciam hoih tawntung hi.

examples.english: Please write in neat handwriting.
examples.zomi: Laimal kiciam hoih takin gelh in.

senses.usage_en: Neat emphasizes order and tidiness. Clean emphasizes the absence of dirt.
senses.usage_zomi: Neat in na-te kiciam hoihna bulphuh a, clean in ninna om lohna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Simple and effective
senses.definition_en: Simple, clever, and effective.
senses.zomi_equivalents: baihlam leh siam; hoih takin a nasep
senses.explanation_zomi: Baihlam, pilvang leh a nasep hoih na.

examples.english: They found a neat solution to the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaipihna ading dawnna baihlam leh siam khat mukhia uh hi.

examples.english: The app has a neat design.
examples.zomi: App in bawldan kiciam hoih nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal use of neat expresses approval of something clever or attractive.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim zatna ah neat in na khat siam tak leh lunglut huai cih hoihsakna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: In a way that must be true or must happen because of the circumstances.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun hangin thuman veve ahih kei leh piang kul veve bangin.

examples.english: Expensive products are not necessarily better.
examples.zomi: Van manpha pen hoihzaw hi pahpah lo hi.

examples.english: Success does not necessarily come quickly.
examples.zomi: Gualzawhna manlang takin hong tung veve lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Not necessarily means something may be true, but it is not always or automatically true.
senses.usage_zomi: Not necessarily in thu khat thuman thei napi, tawntung ahih kei leh amah leh amah thuman pahpah lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Needed in order to achieve a result, meet a requirement, or deal with a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Result khat ngah, kisapna tangtun ahih kei leh dinmun khat vaihawm ding a kisam.

examples.english: Bring all the necessary documents.
examples.zomi: Lai kisam khempeuh keng in.

examples.english: It is necessary to wear protective equipment.
examples.zomi: Kidalna van silh kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Common patterns are necessary for something and necessary to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Necessary for something leh necessary to do something cih kammal zia-te kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Part connecting the head and body
senses.definition_en: The part of the body between the head and shoulders.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lu leh liang kikal pumpi khen.

examples.english: He wore a scarf around his neck.
examples.zomi: A ngawng kimvel ah puan kikhih hi.

examples.english: She has pain in her neck.
examples.zomi: A ngawng na hi.

senses.usage_en: Neck may refer to the outside body part or the internal structures connecting the head and body.
senses.usage_zomi: Neck in pumpi pualam ngawng ahih kei leh lu leh pumpi a zom sung khen kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Narrow upper part of an object
senses.definition_en: A narrow part of an object, especially near its top.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat a tunglam gei a khen zim, phadiak in bottle a kam nuai.

examples.english: Hold the bottle by its neck.
examples.zomi: Bottle a ngawng ah len in.

examples.english: The vase has a long, narrow neck.
examples.zomi: Pankuang in ngawng sau leh zim nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is based on the object’s resemblance to a human neck.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen van a khen tua mihing ngawng tawh a kibat manin kizang hi.

senses.heading: Require something
senses.definition_en: To require something because it is necessary or important.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kul ahih kei leh a thupi manin kisam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We need more information before deciding.
examples.zomi: Ka khensatma un thu tamzaw ka kisam uh hi.

examples.english: The plant needs water and sunlight.
examples.zomi: Singkung in tui leh ni vak kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use need + noun: need help. Use need to + verb: need to leave.
senses.usage_zomi: Need + noun ci in kizang hi: need help. Verb tawh bel need to + verb kizang hi: need to leave.

senses.heading: Be required to do something
senses.definition_en: To have to do something because it is necessary.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl kul ahih kei leh bawl ding a kisam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You need to save your work before closing the program.
examples.zomi: Program na khakma in na nasep na kem kul hi.

examples.english: We need to leave early tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing zingsang tungin ka paikhia kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In ordinary affirmative sentences, need to behaves like a normal verb. In some negative and question forms, especially British English, need may behave like a modal: You needn’t wait.
senses.usage_zomi: Affirmative sentence ngeina ah need to verb ngeina bangin kizang hi. Negative leh dotna pawlkhat ah, phadiak in British English, modal bangin kizang thei hi: You needn’t wait.

senses.heading: Sewing needle
senses.definition_en: A very thin, pointed metal tool with a small hole for thread, used for sewing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan khitna ding a kizang, a hiam leh a tawm mahmah, lawh khihna ding khuam neu a nei sik.

examples.english: She threaded the needle and repaired the shirt.
examples.zomi: Phim sungah lawh lutsak in puan-gi bawlpha hi.

examples.english: Be careful—the needle is sharp.
examples.zomi: Kidawm in—phim hiam hi.

senses.usage_en: The small hole in a sewing needle is called its eye.
senses.usage_zomi: Puan khitna phim a lawh lutsakna khuam neu pen a eye kici hi.

senses.heading: Medical needle
senses.definition_en: A thin, hollow, pointed medical tool used to inject or remove liquid.
senses.explanation_zomi: Si pumpi sungah thun ahih kei leh pumpi sung pan tui lakhiatna ding a kizang khuam nei phim hiam.

examples.english: The nurse used a new sterile needle.
examples.zomi: Nurse in natna puakthei lo phim sian thak khat zang hi.

examples.english: The doctor inserted a needle into his arm.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in a banah phim lutsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Medical needles must be sterile and should never be shared.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna phim natna puakthei lo in sian ding a, mi khat leh khat kizangkhawm lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Expressing criticism or lack of hope
senses.definition_en: Expressing dislike, criticism, disagreement, or an expectation of a bad result.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hoihsak lo; a sia lam; lungkiahuai
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihsak lohna, demna, thukim lohna ahih kei leh result hoih lo ding lam-etna a lak.

examples.english: His negative attitude affected the whole team.
examples.zomi: A ngaihsutdan hoih lo in pawl pumpi huzaap hi.

examples.english: The proposal received several negative comments.
examples.zomi: Thu puahna in demna kammal pawlkhat ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Negative does not always mean factually wrong; it may describe an unfavorable attitude or result.
senses.usage_zomi: Negative in thu maan lo cihna hi tawntung lo a, hoihsak lohna ahih kei leh result hoih lo gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Showing that something is absent or not found
senses.definition_en: Showing that a disease, substance, condition, or result is not present.
senses.explanation_zomi: Natna, zat, dinmun ahih kei leh result khat a om lo cih a lak.

examples.english: Her test result was negative.
examples.zomi: A sittelna result negative ahi hi.

examples.english: He tested negative for the infection.
examples.zomi: Natna kizel a neih lo cih sittelna in lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In medical testing, negative often means the tested condition was not detected. It does not always mean bad news.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna sittelna ah negative in a kisittel natna kimulo cihna nei zel hi. Thuthang hoih lo cihna hi tawntung lo hi.

senses.heading: Less than zero
senses.definition_en: Having a mathematical value below zero.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim zero sangin a niamzaw man a nei.

examples.english: Negative numbers appear to the left of zero.
examples.zomi: Negative simte zero veilam ah om hi.

examples.english: The temperature fell to negative ten degrees.
examples.zomi: Lumdan minus degree sawm dong kiasuk hi.

senses.usage_en: A minus sign (−) before a number shows that the number is negative.
senses.usage_zomi: Sim ma a minus lim (−) in tua sim negative ahi cih lak hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who lives near or next to another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat inn gei ahih kei leh a kiang nai ah a teng mi.

examples.english: Our neighbour helped us move the furniture.
examples.zomi: Ka innpih un innvan suan dingin hong huh hi.

examples.english: She knows most of her neighbours.
examples.zomi: A innpihte a tamzaw thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Neighbour is the British spelling. American English spells it neighbor.
senses.usage_zomi: Neighbour pen British gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah neighbor ci in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Area around a home
senses.definition_en: The area of a town or city around where someone lives.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a tenna inn kimvel khuapi ahih kei leh khua khen.

examples.english: They live in a quiet neighbourhood.
examples.zomi: Amaute khua khen dai khat ah teng uh hi.

examples.english: The neighbourhood has a park and a library.
examples.zomi: Khua khen sungah park leh laibu inn om hi.

senses.usage_en: Neighbourhood is the British spelling. American English spells it neighborhood.
senses.usage_zomi: Neighbourhood pen British gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah neighborhood ci in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: People living in that area
senses.definition_en: The people who live in a particular local area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khua khen ahih kei leh inn kimvel khat ah a teng mipite.

examples.english: The whole neighbourhood attended the festival.
examples.zomi: Inn kimvel mipite khempeuh pawi ah pai uh hi.

examples.english: The fire shocked the neighbourhood.
examples.zomi: Mei kangna in khuamite linglawng sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether neighbourhood means the place or the people living there.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu omzia in neighbourhood pen mun kawk maw, tua mun a teng mite kawk cih lak hi.

senses.definition_en: Not one and not the other of two people or things.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a nihmah hilo; khat zong hilo
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na nih lakah khat zong hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Neither answer is correct.
examples.zomi: Dawnna a nihmah maan lo hi.

examples.english: Neither student completed the assignment.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang a nihmah in nasep pia kizo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Neither refers to two, not usually more than two. In careful English, it commonly takes a singular noun and verb: Neither option is suitable.
senses.usage_zomi: Neither in na nih kawk a, na nih sang a tamzaw kawk lo zel hi. Kidop English ah singular noun leh verb tawh kizang hi: Neither option is suitable.

senses.heading: Fiber carrying signals in the body
senses.definition_en: A thin fiber or bundle of fibers that carries messages between the brain, spinal cord, and parts of the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lu khuak, nunggu leh pumpi khen tuamtuam kikal ah thupuak a paikheh pumpi sung lawh neem.

examples.english: The injury damaged a nerve in his hand.
examples.zomi: Liamna in a khut sung nerve khat susia hi.

examples.english: Nerves carry signals throughout the body.
examples.zomi: Nerve-te in pumpi khempeuh ah thupuak paikheh hi.

senses.usage_en: Nerves carry sensory and movement signals; they are different from blood vessels and muscles.
senses.usage_zomi: Nerve-te in zaktheihna leh kisuanna thupuak paikheh a, sisan zung leh pumpi sa tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Courage or confidence
senses.definition_en: Courage or confidence needed to do something difficult or frightening.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na haksa ahih kei leh lauhuai khat bawlna ding hangsan leh kimuanna.

examples.english: She finally found the nerve to speak in public.
examples.zomi: A tawpna ah mipi mai ah pau ding hangsanna nei hi.

examples.english: He lost his nerve before the jump.
examples.zomi: A dihma in a hangsanna taan hi.

senses.usage_en: Have the nerve to do something may express admiration for courage or criticism of rude boldness, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Have the nerve to do something in thu omzia bangin hangsanna hoihsakna ahih kei leh zahtakna om lo in gam ngamna demna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Feeling of anxiety
senses.definition_en: A state of worry or tension before a difficult event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piangna haksa khat ma a lunghihmawh leh lungsim kikhauh dinmun.

examples.english: Her nerves made it difficult to speak.
examples.zomi: A lungmanna in pau haksak hi.

examples.english: He took a deep breath to calm his nerves.
examples.zomi: A lungsim nuamsak dingin huih thuk takin lakhia hi.

senses.usage_en: This emotional sense is commonly plural: nerves.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lungsim khiatna pen plural nerves in kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Worried or afraid
senses.definition_en: Worried, anxious, or slightly afraid about what may happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bang piang ding cih hangin lunghihmawh, lungmang ahih kei leh tawmno lau na.

examples.english: She felt nervous before the interview.
examples.zomi: Interview ma in lungmang hi.

examples.english: Do not be nervous about making small mistakes.
examples.zomi: Khialhna neute bawl ding lungmang kei in.

senses.usage_en: Nervous often describes temporary anxiety before an event. It does not necessarily mean that someone has a medical condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Nervous in piangna khat ma a tawmvei lungmanna gen zel hi. Mi khat lungsim natna nei cihna hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Relating to nerves
senses.definition_en: Relating to the nerves and the body system that controls sensation and movement.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nerve tawh kisai; thazang lawh tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Nerve-te leh pumpi zaktheihna leh kisuanna a uk zia tawh kisai na.

examples.english: The brain is part of the nervous system.
examples.zomi: Lu khuak pen nerve zia sungah kihel hi.

examples.english: The disease affects the nervous system.
examples.zomi: Natna in nerve zia huzaap hi.

senses.usage_en: In medical contexts, nervous may relate to nerves rather than emotional worry.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna lam thu ah nervous in lungmanna hilo in, nerve-te tawh kisai cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Material made of crossed threads or cords
senses.definition_en: Material made from threads, ropes, or wires woven with spaces between them, used for catching, holding, or protecting things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lawh, khau ahih kei leh sik khau-te khuam nei in a kikhai khawm, na man, len ahih kei leh dalna ding a kizang van.

examples.english: The fishermen pulled the net from the water.
examples.zomi: Ngasaman mite in tui sung pan leen dokto uh hi.

examples.english: A net protects the plants from birds.
examples.zomi: Leen in singte vasa pan dal hi.

senses.usage_en: A net has open spaces between its threads, unlike a solid sheet of cloth.
senses.usage_zomi: Leen a lawhte kikal ah khuam om a, puanlap kicing tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Net used in sports
senses.definition_en: A net used as part of a goal, court divider, or scoring area in a sport.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna ah goal, kimawlna mun khenna ahih kei leh score ngahna ding a kizang leen.

common_phrases.english: hit the ball into the net

examples.english: The ball went into the net.
examples.zomi: Ball goal leen sungah lut hi.

examples.english: They placed a net across the court.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna tual kantan in leen khat koih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The role of the net differs by sport: it may divide the playing area or receive the ball for a score.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna bangin leen nasep kilamdang hi: kimawlna tual khen thei ahih kei leh score ngahna ding ball sang thei hi.

senses.heading: The internet
senses.definition_en: An informal shortened form of the internet.
senses.explanation_zomi: The internet a nisim kammal tomlak.

examples.english: I found the information on the net.
examples.zomi: Tua thu internet tungah ka mu hi.

examples.english: You can search the net for more examples.
examples.zomi: Entawn tamzaw internet ah na zong thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal sense is often written the Net, though lowercase the net is also common. Internet is clearer in formal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim tomlak pen the Net ci in laimal lian tawh kigelh thei napi, the net zong kizang hi. Thukhun laigelhna ah internet a kicianzaw hi.

senses.heading: Connected system
senses.definition_en: A group of people, organizations, places, or services that are connected and work together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, kipawlna, mun ahih kei leh nasepna tuamtuam a kizomkhawm in a nasem uh zia.

examples.english: The city has a large public transport network.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in mipi khualzinna kizopna zia lian khat nei hi.

examples.english: She has a strong network of professional contacts.
examples.zomi: Amah in nasep lam kizopna thahat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A network consists of separate parts connected so they can share information, services, or support.
senses.usage_zomi: Network pen khen tuamtuam kizomkhawm in thu, nasep ahih kei leh huhna a kihawm theihna zia ahi hi.

senses.heading: Connected computers or devices
senses.definition_en: A group of computers or electronic devices connected so that they can share information and resources.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu leh vanzat a kihawm theihna ding a kizomsak computer ahih kei leh electronic van pawl.

examples.english: All the office computers are connected to one network.
examples.zomi: Office computer khempeuh network khat tawh kizom hi.

examples.english: The wireless network is not working.
examples.zomi: Khau om lo network nasem lo hi.

senses.usage_en: A local network connects nearby devices; the internet connects networks across the world.
senses.usage_zomi: Local network in van kiangnai-te zomsak a, internet in leitung mun tuamtuam a network-te zomsak hi.

senses.heading: Professional or social contacts
senses.definition_en: A group of people you know and can contact for information, advice, or opportunities.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kizopna nei mite; nasep lam lawmte
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, ngaihsut piakna ahih kei leh hunhoih ngahna ding a theih leh kizop theih mite.

examples.english: The conference helped her build a professional network.
examples.zomi: Conference in nasep lam kizopna pawl bawl dingin amah huh hi.

examples.english: A strong network can help you find work.
examples.zomi: Kizopna thahat in nasep zong dingin hong huh thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a network is based on relationships rather than electronic connections.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah network pen electronic kizopna hilo in, mihing kikal kizopna tungah kinga hi.

senses.definition_en: Not at any time; not ever.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat zong lo, ngeilo ahih kei leh bang hun in zong hilo.

examples.english: I have never visited that country.
examples.zomi: Tua gam ka veh ngeilo hi.

examples.english: She never arrives late for work.
examples.zomi: Amah nasepna ah man lo in tung ngeilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Never already has a negative meaning, so standard English does not normally add another negative: say I never go, not I don’t never go.
senses.usage_zomi: Never in negative khiatna nei khin ahih manin Standard English ah negative dang behlap lo ding hi: I never go ci ding a, I don’t never go ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Despite what has just been said; however.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ma a thu om napi, tua thu tawh kikal in ahih kei leh tua hang zongin.

common_phrases.zomi: tua hang zongin ka zom uh hi

examples.english: The journey was difficult; nevertheless, we continued.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna haksa hi; tua hang zongin ka zom uh hi.

examples.english: The evidence is limited but nevertheless useful.
examples.zomi: Teci a tawm napi zat theih lai hi.

senses.usage_en: Nevertheless is formal and often connects two contrasting statements. However and even so have similar uses.
senses.usage_zomi: Nevertheless pen thukhun kammal ahi a, thu kikal nih zomsak zel hi. However leh even so tawh zatna kinai hi.

senses.heading: Recently made or obtained
senses.definition_en: Recently made, created, bought, or obtained.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuma deuh a kibawl, a kisuak, a kilei ahih kei leh a kingah.

examples.english: She bought a new laptop.
examples.zomi: Amah laptop thak khat lei hi.

examples.english: The company introduced a new product.
examples.zomi: Company in van thak khat lak hi.

senses.usage_en: New may mean newly made or simply newly obtained by the owner. A “new car” may be used if it is new to that owner.
senses.usage_zomi: New in bawl thak cihna ahih kei leh neitu in ngah thak cihna nei thei hi. “New car” pen neitu ading a thak napi mawtaw zat khin zong hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Not previously known or experienced
senses.definition_en: Not known, used, experienced, or encountered before.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a theih thak; a phutkhak thak
senses.explanation_zomi: A ma in kithei, kizang, kiphutkhak ahih kei leh kimuh ngeilo.

examples.english: Living abroad was a new experience for him.
examples.zomi: Gamdang ah tenna pen ama ading phutkhakna thak ahi hi.

examples.english: I learned several new words today.
examples.zomi: Tuni kammal thak pawlkhat ka sin hi.

senses.usage_en: New to someone means unfamiliar to that person, even if it has existed for a long time.
senses.usage_zomi: New to someone in tua mi in a theih nailo cihna a, na pen hun sawtpi a omkhin zong hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: New information about recent events, reported through television, radio, newspapers, websites, or conversation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuma deuh a piang thu thak, television, radio, thuthang lai, website ahih kei leh kiholimna tungtawn a kipuak.

examples.english: We heard the news on the radio.
examples.zomi: Radio pan thuthang ka za uh hi.

examples.english: That is wonderful news.
examples.zomi: Tua pen thuthang hoih mahmah ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: News ends in -s but is uncountable and takes a singular verb: The news is surprising. Say a piece of news, not a news.
senses.usage_zomi: News pen -s tawh tawp napi simtheih lo noun ahi a, singular verb zang hi: The news is surprising. A piece of news ci ding a, a news ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A printed or digital publication containing news, articles, advertisements, and other information, usually issued regularly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thuthang, thulu, van tangkona leh thu dangte a kihel, hunseh tawh lai ahih kei leh digital in a kisua lai.

examples.english: My father reads the newspaper every morning.
examples.zomi: Ka pa zingsang simin thuthang lai sim hi.

examples.english: The story appeared in a local newspaper.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu khuasung thuthang lai ah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: Newspaper may refer to the entire publication, the organization producing it, or the physical paper.
senses.usage_zomi: Newspaper in lai kisua pumpi, a sua kipawlna ahih kei leh lai pumpi kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Immediately following
senses.definition_en: Coming immediately after the present or previous one in time, order, or position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun ahih kei leh a ma a om khit a zui pah hun, kiciamna ahih kei leh mun.

examples.english: Read the next chapter before class.
examples.zomi: Sangkah ma in a zui chapter sim in.

examples.english: The next bus arrives in twenty minutes.
examples.zomi: A zui bus minute sawmnih sungin hong tung ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The next identifies the immediately following one. Do not use the before expressions such as next week when counting from now.
senses.usage_zomi: The next in a zui pah khat kawk hi. Tuhun pan a sim next week bang kammal ma ah the kikoih lo hi.

senses.heading: Following in the future
senses.definition_en: Referring to the future period immediately after the current one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun a hun khen khit a hong zui pah mailam hun.

examples.english: We will travel next month.
examples.zomi: Ma kha ciangin ka khualzin ding uh hi.

examples.english: The course begins next Monday.
examples.zomi: Monday hong tung ding ciangin sinna kipan ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Next Monday can sometimes be ambiguous between the nearest Monday and the Monday of the following week. Give the date when precision matters.
senses.usage_zomi: Next Monday in Monday hong tung pah maw, a nung kalsung Monday maw cih kician lo thei hi. Kician kul ciangin date gen ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Beside or immediately adjacent to someone or something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gei lian ah; kiang lian ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat gei lian ah, a kikal a om lo dektak.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat kiang lian ah tu
ka inn uh gei lian a inn

examples.english: She sat next to me on the bus.
examples.zomi: Bus tungah ka kiang lian ah tu hi.

examples.english: The pharmacy is next to the bank.
examples.zomi: Si dawr bank gei lian ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Next to means directly beside. Near allows a greater distance.
senses.usage_zomi: Next to in gei lian a om cihna a, near in gamla lo napi kikal deuh om thei hi.

senses.heading: Pleasant or enjoyable
senses.definition_en: Pleasant, enjoyable, attractive, or satisfactory.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuam, lunglut huai, melhoih ahih kei leh lungkim huai na.

examples.english: We had a nice time at the park.
examples.zomi: Park ah nuam takin hun ka zang uh hi.

examples.english: That is a nice house.
examples.zomi: Tua pen inn hoih khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Nice is common but general. In careful writing, a more precise adjective may communicate the exact quality better.
senses.usage_zomi: Nice pen kizang tam napi khiatna a umum hi. Kidop laigelhna ah hoihna nam kician a lak adjective kizang leh kicianzaw hi.

senses.heading: Kind and friendly
senses.definition_en: Kind, friendly, and considerate toward other people.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mi hoih; lawmdan nei; deihsakna nei
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tungah hoih, lawmdan nei leh deihsakna nei na.

examples.english: She was very nice to the new student.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang thak tungah hoih mahmah hi.

examples.english: It was nice of you to help us.
examples.zomi: Kei hong huh na hoih mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Use nice to someone for kind behavior toward that person. Use nice of someone to evaluate a particular kind action.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat tung a gamtatna hoih dingin nice to someone kizang hi. Mi khat in a bawl gamtatna khat hoihsak dingin nice of someone kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: The period of darkness between evening and morning when the sun is below the horizon.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nitak leh zingsang kikal, ni a tum a khuamial hun.

examples.english: The temperature falls at night.
examples.zomi: Zan in lumdan kiasuk hi.

examples.english: We arrived home late last night.
examples.zomi: Zankim in inn ka tung uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Say at night, but use no preposition before last night, tonight, or every night.
senses.usage_zomi: At night ci in kizang hi. Ahih hang last night, tonight, leh every night ma ah preposition kikoih lo hi.

senses.heading: Frightening dream
senses.definition_en: A frightening or very unpleasant dream.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuai ahih kei leh nuam lo mahmah mang.

examples.english: The child woke after having a nightmare.
examples.zomi: Naupang mang lauhuai a man khit ciangin phong hi.

examples.english: She had a nightmare about being lost.
examples.zomi: A lampial thu mang lauhuai mang hi.

senses.usage_en: A nightmare happens during sleep and may cause fear after waking.
senses.usage_zomi: Nightmare pen ihmut sungah piang a, a phong khit zong lauhna piangsak thei hi.

senses.heading: Extremely difficult situation
senses.definition_en: A very difficult, frightening, or unpleasant situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksa, lauhuai ahih kei leh nuam lo mahmah dinmun.

examples.english: The journey became a complete nightmare.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna buaipihna nasia taktak suak hi.

examples.english: Finding parking downtown was a nightmare.
examples.zomi: Khuapi laizang ah mawtaw koihna zong haksa mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal figurative use emphasizes an experience that was extremely unpleasant or difficult.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim lim tawh zatna in phutkhakna khat nuam lo leh haksa mahmah cih bulphuh hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 9.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim 9; giat khit leh sawm ma a sim.

examples.english: There are nine students in the room.
examples.zomi: Innkhan sungah sangnaupang kua om hi.

examples.english: The meeting begins at nine.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna nai kua in kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: The ordinal form is ninth; the adverbial multiplication form is nine times.
senses.usage_zomi: A ordinal form pen ninth ahi a, vei simna pen nine times ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 19.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim 19; sawm leh kua.

examples.english: She is nineteen years old.
examples.zomi: Amah kum sawmleh kua pha hi.

examples.english: Nineteen people attended the workshop.
examples.zomi: Workshop ah mi sawmleh kua pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Stress the final syllable in nineteen. Do not confuse it with ninety /ˈnaɪnti/.
senses.usage_zomi: Nineteen ah a nunung syllable aw kipi zaw hi. Ninety /ˈnaɪnti/ tawh helkhawm lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 90.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim 90; sawmkua.

examples.english: Her grandfather lived to be ninety.
examples.zomi: A pu kum sawmkua pha dong nungta hi.

examples.english: Ninety percent of the students passed.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang za-ah sawmkua ong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Ninety is spelled without the e from nine. It differs in stress and meaning from nineteen.
senses.usage_zomi: Ninety gelh ciangin nine sung a e om lo hi. Aw kipi na leh khiatna ah nineteen tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Negative answer
senses.definition_en: Used to give a negative answer to a question or request.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dotna ahih kei leh ngenna khat nialna ding a kizang kammal.

examples.english: “Do you need help?” “No, thank you.”
examples.zomi: “Huhna na kisam hiam?” “Deih kei, lungdam.”

examples.english: “Did she call?” “No.”
examples.zomi: “Amah phone hiam?” “Phone lo.”

senses.usage_en: No answers negatively. Not is used within a clause: She is not ready.
senses.usage_zomi: No in dotna a nial dawnna pia a, not pen clause sungah kizang hi: She is not ready.

senses.heading: Strong refusal or warning
senses.definition_en: Used to refuse, forbid, object, or express strong disagreement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nial, khaam, deih lohna ahih kei leh thukim lohna kip takin genna kammal.

examples.english: “No! Do not touch that wire.”
examples.zomi: “Kei! Tua electric khau lawng kei in.”

examples.english: She said no to the proposal.
examples.zomi: Amah in thu puahna nial hi.

senses.usage_en: Tone strongly affects how polite or forceful no sounds.
senses.usage_zomi: Awging leh pauhdan in no zahtakhuai maw, a khauh maw cih huzaap hi.

senses.definition_en: No person; not anyone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat zong lo; kuamah lo.

examples.english: Nobody answered the door.
examples.zomi: Kong kuamah hong kei hi.

examples.english: Nobody knows exactly what happened.
examples.zomi: Bang piang taktak cih kuamah in theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Nobody is grammatically singular: Nobody is ready. Avoid a second negative in standard English: Nobody came, not Nobody didn’t come.
senses.usage_zomi: Nobody pen grammar ah singular ahi hi: Nobody is ready. Standard English ah negative nih zang lo ding hi: Nobody came ci ding a, Nobody didn’t come ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, unwanted, or difficult to identify.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw, phadiak in a ging, a nuam lo, a kisam lo ahih kei leh bang aw ahi cih theih haksa ging.

examples.english: A loud noise woke the baby.
examples.zomi: Awging ngaih khat in naungek phong hi.

examples.english: Please keep the noise down.
examples.zomi: Awging niamsak in.

senses.usage_en: Noise may be countable for a particular sound and uncountable for unwanted sound generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Awging kician khat a gen ciangin noise simtheih noun hi thei a, awging kisam lo a umum in a gen ciangin simtheih lo noun ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Making or filled with a lot of loud or unpleasant sound.
senses.explanation_zomi: Awging ngaih tampi a bawl ahih kei leh awging tawh kidim na.

examples.english: The restaurant was too noisy for conversation.
examples.zomi: Annekna mun ging lua ahih manin kiholim haksa hi.

examples.english: The children became noisy during the game.
examples.zomi: Naupangte kimawl laitakin awging mahmah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Noisy describes a place, person, animal, or machine producing much sound. Loud may describe one particular sound.
senses.usage_zomi: Noisy in mun, mi, gan ahih kei leh machine awging tampi bawl gen hi. Loud in aw kician khat a gingna gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Not any of a group or amount; no person or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl ahih kei leh zat khat sungah khat zong lo.

examples.english: None of the students were absent.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte lakah kuamah pelh lo hi.

examples.english: I offered her some food, but she wanted none.
examples.zomi: An tawm ka pia a, amah in bangmah deih lo hi.

senses.usage_en: None can take a singular or plural verb depending on meaning and style. With a plural group, a plural verb is common.
