senses.usage_zomi: None in khiatna leh gelhdan bangin singular ahih kei leh plural verb zang thei hi. Plural pawl kawk ciangin plural verb kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to add another negative statement or to connect two negative alternatives.
senses.explanation_zomi: Negative thu dang khat behlap ahih kei leh negative teelna nih zomna ding a kizang conjunction.

common_phrases.zomi: tuhun zong lo, a nung ciang zong lo

examples.english: Neither the manager nor the workers were ready.
examples.zomi: Vaihawmpa leh nasepmite a nihmah kigingsa lo uh hi.

examples.english: He did not call, nor did he send a message.
examples.zomi: Ama phone lo a, thupuak zong khak lo hi.

senses.usage_en: After nor begins a new clause, formal English often inverts the subject and auxiliary: nor did he call.
senses.usage_zomi: Nor khit in clause thak kipan ciangin thukhun English ah subject leh auxiliary kilaih zel hi: nor did he call.

senses.definition_en: Usual, expected, or typical for a particular person, group, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl ahih kei leh dinmun khat ading ngeina, lam-et huai ahih kei leh piang zel bang na.

examples.english: It is normal to feel tired after hard work.
examples.zomi: Nasep khauh khit in gim pen ngeina ahi hi.

examples.english: Traffic returned to normal after the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident khit ciangin mawtaw paihna ngeina dinmun ah ciahkik hi.

senses.usage_en: Normal depends on context and should not be used carelessly to suggest that people who differ are inferior or wrong.
senses.usage_zomi: Normal khiatna pen thu omzia tungah kinga a, mi kilamdangte niamzaw ahih kei leh khial bangin lakna ding a kidop lo in zat lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Usually, under ordinary conditions, or in the expected way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina in, dinmun ngeina ah ahih kei leh lam-et bangin.

examples.english: The office normally opens at eight.
examples.zomi: Office ngeina in nai giat in hong hi.

examples.english: I normally walk to work.
examples.zomi: Ka nasepna ah ngeina in ka kalsuan hi.

senses.usage_en: Normally describes what usually happens, but it allows exceptions.
senses.usage_zomi: Normally in a piang zel thu gen a, a tumtuam a kilamdangna om thei lai hi.

senses.definition_en: The direction to the left when facing east, opposite south, and toward the North Pole.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nisuahna lam en in i ding ciangin veilam, south tawh kikal leh North Pole lam a direction.

examples.english: The mountains lie in the north.
examples.zomi: Tangte saklam ah om hi.

examples.english: We travelled north for three hours.
examples.zomi: Nai thum sung saklamah ka khualzin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use lowercase north for a direction. Capitalize North when it is part of an official place name or a recognized region.
senses.usage_zomi: Direction a gen ciangin north laimal neu tawh kigelh hi. Mun min kicing ahih kei leh gam khen min in kizang ciangin North laimal lian tawh kigelh hi.

senses.definition_en: Located in, coming from, or relating to the north part of a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat saklam ah a om, saklam pan a hong pai ahih kei leh saklam tawh kisai na.

examples.english: The northern part of the country is mountainous.
examples.zomi: Gam saklam khen tang tampi om hi.

examples.english: Cold air moved in from the northern region.
examples.zomi: Saklam gam khen pan huih vot hong lut hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Northern when it forms part of an official name or a recognized region; otherwise use lowercase.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun min kicing ahih kei leh gam khen min in kizang ciangin Northern laimal lian tawh kigelh a, a dang ciangin laimal neu tawh kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Part used for smelling and breathing
senses.definition_en: The part of the face used for smelling and breathing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Maimitang ah om a, nam zak leh huih lakna ding a kizang pumpi khen.

examples.english: The cold made his nose run.
examples.zomi: Khuasik in a nak tui luangsak hi.

examples.english: She covered her nose because of the bad smell.
examples.zomi: Nam sia hangin a nak tuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Humans breathe through both the nose and mouth, but the nose also filters, warms, and moistens incoming air.
senses.usage_zomi: Mihing in nak leh kam pan huih la thei a, nak in huih a sia nate sepkhia, lumsak leh taisak hi.

senses.heading: Front part of an object
senses.definition_en: The front or projecting part of an aircraft, vehicle, or other object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanleng, mawtaw ahih kei leh van khat a mai lam a protruding khen.

examples.english: The nose of the aircraft was damaged.
examples.zomi: Vanleng nak kisiacip hi.

examples.english: The vehicle pointed its nose toward the road.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw mai lampi lamah kihei hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense is based on the object’s front resembling a face’s nose.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lim tawh zatna pen van a mai lam tua maitang nak tawh a kibat manin kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to make a word, phrase, or statement negative.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, kammal hon ahih kei leh thu genna khat negative suaksakna ding a kizang kammal.

examples.english: She is not ready to leave.
examples.zomi: Amah paikhia ding kigingsa nailo hi.

examples.english: I do not understand the question.
examples.zomi: Dotna ka tel kei hi.

senses.usage_en: With most verbs, English uses do/does/did + not: I do not know. With be and modal verbs, place not directly after the verb: is not; cannot.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb a tamzaw tawh English in do/does/did + not zang hi: I do not know. Be leh modal verb-te tawh not verb nungah kikoih pah hi: is not; cannot.

senses.heading: Short written message
senses.definition_en: A short written message for another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang khat ading a kigelh thupuak tomno.

examples.english: She left a note on the table.
examples.zomi: Amah in tawlngak tungah lai tom khat nusia hi.

examples.english: I wrote him a thank-you note.
examples.zomi: Ama tungah lungdam kohna lai khat ka gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: A note is usually shorter and less formal than a letter.
senses.usage_zomi: Note pen lai sangin tomzaw leh thukhun lo zaw zel hi.

senses.heading: Written record for study or reference
senses.definition_en: A short written record of information made to help someone remember or study it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat phawkkik ahih kei leh sinna ah zat ding a tom in kigelh ciamtehna.

examples.english: Students took notes during the lecture.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte thuhilhna sungah ciamtehna gelh uh hi.

examples.english: Review your notes before the exam.
examples.zomi: Sittelna ma in na ciamtehnate simkik in.

senses.usage_en: The plural notes commonly refers to study records. Take notes means write down important information.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural notes in sinna ciamtehnate kawk zel hi. Take notes in thu thupite gelh cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Musical sound
senses.definition_en: A single musical sound with a particular pitch and duration.
senses.explanation_zomi: Awging sanna leh sawtna kician a nei la aw khat.

examples.english: She sang the final note clearly.
examples.zomi: A nunung la aw kician takin sa hi.

examples.english: The piano produced a low note.
examples.zomi: Piano in la aw niam khat suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Written musical symbols are also called notes because they represent these sounds.
senses.usage_zomi: La aw a aiawh laigelh limte zong notes kici hi.

senses.heading: Paper money
senses.definition_en: A piece of paper money with a stated value.
senses.explanation_zomi: Man kician a kigelh sum lai khat.

examples.english: He paid with a twenty-dollar note.
examples.zomi: Dollar sawmnih sum lai tawh pia hi.

examples.english: The note was torn at one corner.
examples.zomi: Sum lai killi khat kikeek hi.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses note or banknote. American English usually uses bill.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah note ahih kei leh banknote kizang tam hi. American English ah bill kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Not anything; no single thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat zong lo; bangmah lo.

examples.english: Nothing happened during the night.
examples.zomi: Zan sungin bangmah piang lo hi.

examples.english: There is nothing in the box.
examples.zomi: Kuang sungah bangmah om lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Nothing is grammatically singular: Nothing is missing. Avoid a second negative in standard English: I saw nothing, not I didn’t see nothing.
senses.usage_zomi: Nothing pen grammar ah singular ahi hi: Nothing is missing. Standard English ah negative nih zang lo ding hi: I saw nothing ci ding a, I didn’t see nothing ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Become aware of something
senses.definition_en: To see, hear, or become aware of someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat mu, za ahih kei leh phawkkha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I noticed a small mistake in the report.
examples.zomi: Report sungah khialhna neu khat ka phawk hi.

examples.english: She did not notice him enter the room.
examples.zomi: Innkhan sungah a lut amah in phawk lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Notice often means becoming aware without deliberately searching. Look for means actively trying to find something.
senses.usage_zomi: Notice in zong lo napi phawkkha cihna nei zel a, look for in tum neituam in zong cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Pay attention to something
senses.definition_en: To give attention to someone or something and consider it important.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh thu khat lungsim pia in en a, thupi in ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please notice the safety instructions.
examples.zomi: Bitna hilhnate lungsim pia in.

examples.english: The government began to notice public concern.
examples.zomi: Ukna in mipi lunghihmawhna phawk pan hi.

senses.usage_en: Take notice of is stronger and more deliberate than simply notice.
senses.usage_zomi: Take notice of in notice bek sangin tum neituam leh lungsim pia zaw in phawk cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: An idea, belief, or general understanding of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat tungtang ngaihsutna, upna ahih kei leh telna a umum.

examples.english: She rejected the notion that success depends only on luck.
examples.zomi: Gualzawhna hamphatna bek tungah kinga cih ngaihsutna nial hi.

examples.english: Children develop a notion of fairness at an early age.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in kum nau lai pan mankikna telna nei pan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Notion often suggests an idea that is general, uncertain, or not fully developed.
senses.usage_zomi: Notion in ngaihsutna a umum, a kiplua lo ahih kei leh a khang kicing nailo kawk zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A long written fictional story, usually published as a book.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu phuah saupi a kigelh, laibu in a kisua zel tangthu.

common_phrases.zomi: tangthu piangsa tung a kinga novel

examples.english: She is reading a novel about village life.
examples.zomi: Amah khua nuntakna thu tangthu phuah laibu khat sim hi.

examples.english: The writer published his first novel last year.
examples.zomi: Laigelhsia in kum beisa in a novel masapen sua hi.

senses.usage_en: A novel is fiction, although it may be based on historical events or real experiences.
senses.usage_zomi: Novel pen tangthu phuah ahi napi, tangthu piangsa ahih kei leh phutkhakna taktak tungah kinga thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The eleventh month of the year, after October and before December.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sung kha sawmleh khatna, October khit leh December ma a kha.

examples.english: The election will be held in November.
examples.zomi: Teelna November kha in kibawl ding hi.

examples.english: Cold weather usually begins in November.
examples.zomi: Khua vot November kha in kipan zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Names of months begin with capital letters. Use in with the month and on with a particular date.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah kha minte laimal lian tawh kipan hi. Kha bek tawh in kizang a, ni kician tawh on kizang hi.

senses.heading: At the present time
senses.definition_en: At this moment or during the present period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun lian ah ahih kei leh tuhun hun khen sungah.

examples.english: I am busy right now.
examples.zomi: Tu mahmah in ka manlah hi.

examples.english: The service is now available online.
examples.zomi: Tuhun tua nasep internet tungah ngah theih hi.

senses.usage_en: Now may mean this exact moment or the broader present period, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu omzia bangin now in tu hun lian taktak ahih kei leh tuhun hun khen a zaizaw kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Used to move a discussion forward
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce a new point, attract attention, or show a change in a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu thak khat kipat, lungsim ngahsak ahih kei leh dinmun kikhelna lakna ding a kizang kammal.

examples.english: Now, let us consider the second question.
examples.zomi: Tu in dotna nihna ngaihsun ni.

examples.english: The road was dangerous, but now it is safe.
examples.zomi: Lampi lauhuai hi, ahih hang tu in bit hi.

senses.usage_en: At the beginning of a sentence, now may organize speech rather than give an exact time.
senses.usage_zomi: Sentence kipatna ah now in hun kician gen sangin thugenna kiciamsak thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Not in or to any place.
senses.zomi_equivalents: koimah ah lo; mun khat zong lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat zongah lo; koimah ah lo.

examples.english: There was nowhere to sit.
examples.zomi: Tutna ding koimah om lo hi.

examples.english: The missing file was nowhere to be found.
examples.zomi: File mang koimah ah kimulo hi.

senses.usage_en: Nowhere already has a negative meaning. Avoid another negative in standard English: It is nowhere, not It isn’t nowhere.
senses.usage_zomi: Nowhere in negative khiatna nei khin ahih manin Standard English ah negative dang behlap lo ding hi: It is nowhere ci ding a, It isn’t nowhere ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: No person; not anyone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat zong lo; kuamah lo.

examples.english: No one answered my question.
examples.zomi: Ka dotna kuamah in hong dawng lo hi.

examples.english: No one was injured in the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident ah kuamah liam lo hi.

senses.usage_en: No one is written as two words and takes a singular verb: No one is ready. It has the same basic meaning as nobody.
senses.usage_zomi: No one kammal nih in kigelh a, singular verb zang hi: No one is ready. Nobody tawh a bul khiatna kibang hi.

senses.heading: Relating to atomic energy or weapons
senses.definition_en: Relating to energy released from atomic nuclei or to weapons using that energy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Atom laizang pan a kisuak tha ahih kei leh tua tha a zang galhiam tawh kisai na.

examples.english: The country uses nuclear energy to produce electricity.
examples.zomi: Gam in electric tha bawl dingin nuclear tha zang hi.

examples.english: The agreement limits nuclear weapons.
examples.zomi: Thukimna in nuclear galhiam ciangtan hi.

senses.usage_en: The standard pronunciation is /ˈnuːkliər/, with three syllables. The form /ˈnuːkjələr/ (“nucular”) is considered nonstandard.
senses.usage_zomi: Standard pauhdan pen awging khen thum nei /ˈnuːkliər/ ahi hi. /ˈnuːkjələr/ (“nucular”) pen Standard hilo in ki-en hi.

senses.heading: Relating to the nucleus of a cell
senses.definition_en: Relating to the central part of a living cell that contains genetic material.
senses.zomi_equivalents: cell nucleus tawh kisai; cell laizang lam
senses.explanation_zomi: A nungta cell laizang ah genetic van a omna nucleus tawh kisai na.

examples.english: Nuclear DNA is stored inside the cell’s nucleus.
examples.zomi: Nuclear DNA pen cell nucleus sungah kikem hi.

examples.english: The scientist examined changes in nuclear material.
examples.zomi: Science siam in nucleus sung zat kikhelna sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: In biology, nuclear refers to a cell’s nucleus and does not imply atomic weapons.
senses.usage_zomi: Biology ah nuclear in cell nucleus tawh kisai cihna a, atom galhiam cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Relating to a nuclear family
senses.definition_en: Relating to a family consisting mainly of parents and their dependent children.
senses.zomi_equivalents: innkuan neu tawh kisai; nuclear family lam
senses.explanation_zomi: Nu leh pa leh amau tate a kinga innkuan neu tawh kisai na.

common_phrases.zomi: nu, pa leh tate innkuan pualam

examples.english: The household consists of one nuclear family.
examples.zomi: Innkuan pen nu, pa leh amau tate tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Grandparents are not usually included in the nuclear family.
examples.zomi: Pu leh pi nuclear family sungah kihel lo zel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A nuclear family differs from an extended family, which may include grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins, and others.
senses.usage_zomi: Nuclear family pen extended family tawh kibang lo hi; extended family sungah pu, pi, nu leh pa sanggamte, sanggam tate leh midangte kihel thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Existing in large numbers; many.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim a tam mahmah in a om.

examples.english: The report contains numerous errors.
examples.zomi: Report sungah khialhna tampi om hi.

examples.english: She has visited the city on numerous occasions.
examples.zomi: Khuapi vei tampi veh hi.

senses.usage_en: Numerous is more formal than many and is used only with countable plural nouns.
senses.usage_zomi: Numerous pen many sangin thukhun zaw a, simtheih plural noun tawh bek kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A trained health-care professional who cares for sick or injured people and supports medical treatment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cina leh liamte a kem a, cidamna kepna ah siavuan leh cina-te a huh ding kisinna ngah cidamna nasem.

examples.english: The nurse checked the patient’s blood pressure.
examples.zomi: Nurse in cina sisan nawngna sittel hi.

examples.english: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
examples.zomi: Amah khuasung si-in ah nurse in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Nurses do more than assist doctors; they assess patients, provide treatment, educate people, and coordinate care within their professional authority.
senses.usage_zomi: Nurse-te siavuan huh bek hilo uh hi; cina sittel, kepna pia, mite hilh leh amau nasep phalna sungah cidamna kepna vaihawm uh hi.

senses.heading: Edible seed in a hard shell
senses.definition_en: A fruit or seed with an edible inner part enclosed in a hard shell.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sung a kine thei a, a pualam khauh tawh a kituam singgah ahih kei leh singtang.

examples.english: The snack contains several kinds of nuts.
examples.zomi: Anneu sungah singtang nam tuamtuam om hi.

examples.english: She cannot eat nuts because of an allergy.
examples.zomi: Singtang tawh a pumpi kituak lo ahih manin singtang ne thei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In food labeling, nuts may include several botanical categories. People with allergies should check exact ingredients carefully.
senses.usage_zomi: An min gelhna ah nuts sungah singgah leh singtang pawl tuamtuam kihel thei hi. Pumpi kituak lohna nei mite in a bawlna zat kician takin sittel ding uh hi.

senses.heading: Metal fastener used with a bolt
senses.definition_en: A small metal piece with a threaded hole that turns onto a bolt to hold things together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bolt tungah a kihei lut, na-te zomkhawm ding a lai kawi khuam nei sik neu.

examples.english: Use a wrench to tighten the nut.
examples.zomi: Nut cih dingin wrench zang in.

examples.english: The nut fell off the bolt.
examples.zomi: Nut bolt tung pan kia hi.

senses.usage_en: A nut is turned onto a bolt. It is different from a metal nail, which is hammered into material.
senses.usage_zomi: Nut pen bolt tungah kihei a, nail bel van sungah sik tawh kisat lut hi.

senses.definition_en: To do what a person, rule, law, or instruction requires.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, thukhun, ukna lai ahih kei leh hilhna in a sawl bang bawl cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: na nu leh pa thu mang

examples.english: Everyone must obey the law.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in thukham zui ding uh hi.

examples.english: The soldiers obeyed the officer’s order.
examples.zomi: Sepaihte in a ukpa thu piak mang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Obey takes a direct object: say obey the rules, not obey to the rules.
senses.usage_zomi: Obey in direct object nei hi: obey the rules ci ding a, obey to the rules ci lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Physical thing
senses.definition_en: A material thing that can be seen or touched.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muhtheih leh lawngtheih pumpi nei na khat.

common_phrases.zomi: pumpi sungah a om ding hilo van

examples.english: A strange object was lying on the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi tungah van lamdang khat om hi.

examples.english: Do not place heavy objects on the shelf.
examples.zomi: Van koihna tungah van gik koih kei in.

senses.usage_en: Object is a general word for a physical thing when its exact name is unknown or unimportant.
senses.usage_zomi: Van khat a min kithei lo ahih kei leh a min thupi lo ciangin pumpi nei na a umum in object kici hi.

senses.heading: Grammar element affected by a verb
senses.definition_en: A noun, pronoun, or phrase affected by a verb or following a preposition.
senses.zomi_equivalents: verb in a huzaap kammal; grammar object
senses.explanation_zomi: Verb in a huzaap noun, pronoun ahih kei leh kammal hon; ahih kei leh preposition nung a kammal khen.

examples.english: In “She opened the door,” “the door” is the object.
examples.zomi: “She opened the door” sungah “the door” pen object ahi hi.

examples.english: The pronoun “me” can be used as an object.
examples.zomi: Pronoun “me” pen object in kizang thei hi.

senses.usage_en: The grammatical term is pronounced /ˈɑːbdʒɛkt/. The verb object, meaning protest, is pronounced /əbˈdʒɛkt/.
senses.usage_zomi: Grammar noun pen /ˈɑːbdʒɛkt/ ci in kigen hi. Nial ahih kei leh langdo cihna verb object pen /əbˈdʒɛkt/ ci in kigen hi.

senses.definition_en: A specific result or goal that a person or organization intends to achieve.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh kipawlna khat in a tangtun tum result ahih kei leh ngimna kician.

examples.english: Our main objective is to improve translation quality.
examples.zomi: Ka ngimna thupi pen uh leh lehkhiatna hoihna sangto sak ahi hi.

examples.english: The team achieved all its objectives.
examples.zomi: Pawl in a ngimna khempeuh tangtung hi.

senses.usage_en: An objective is often more specific and measurable than a broad aim or purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Objective pen a zaizaw aim ahih kei leh purpose sangin kician leh teh theihzaw zel hi.

senses.heading: Duty or requirement
senses.definition_en: Something that a person is morally, legally, or officially required to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtat maan, thukham ahih kei leh nasep thukhun hangin mi khat in a bawl kul mawhpuak.

examples.english: Employers have a legal obligation to provide a safe workplace.
examples.zomi: Nasep neite in bitna nei nasepna mun piak ding thukham mawhpuak nei uh hi.

examples.english: She felt an obligation to help her family.
examples.zomi: A innkuante huh pen a mawhpuak in ngaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: An obligation is stronger than a preference; it is something a person is expected or required to do.
senses.usage_zomi: Obligation pen deihna bek sangin khauhzaw a, mi khat in bawl ding a kilam-et ahih kei leh bawl kul na ahi hi.

senses.heading: Feeling of owing help or gratitude
senses.definition_en: A feeling that you should help or repay someone because of what they have done for you.
senses.zomi_equivalents: leibata lungsim; piakkik ding a kisa
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in hong bawlsakna hangin amah huh ahih kei leh lungdam kohna pia ding a kisa lungsim.

examples.english: You are under no obligation to accept the offer.
examples.zomi: Tua thu hong piak na sang kul lo hi.

examples.english: He helped from friendship, not obligation.
examples.zomi: Mawhpuak hang hilo in, lawmdan hangin huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Under an obligation to do something means feeling or being required to do it.
senses.usage_zomi: Under an obligation to do something in na khat bawl ding a kisa ahih kei leh bawl kul cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Careful watching or studying
senses.definition_en: The act of watching, examining, or studying someone or something carefully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat kidop takin en, sittel ahih kei leh zongkhehna nasep.

examples.english: The patient remained under observation overnight.
examples.zomi: Cina zan khat sung kisittel laitak in om hi.

examples.english: The conclusion was based on careful observation.
examples.zomi: Thukhupna pen kidop etna tungah kinga hi.

senses.usage_en: Observation may be informal, medical, scientific, or systematic, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu omzia bangin observation pen nisim etna, cidamna sittelna, science zongkhehna ahih kei leh zia nei sittelna hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Comment based on what was noticed
senses.definition_en: A statement or comment about something that someone has noticed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a phawk ahih kei leh a muh thu tungtang a gen kammal ahih kei leh ngaihsut piakna.

examples.english: She made an important observation about the data.
examples.zomi: Data tungtang phawkna thu thupi khat gen hi.

examples.english: His observation helped us understand the problem.
examples.zomi: A phawkna thu in buaipihna tel dingin hong huh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, an observation is a remark, not merely the act of looking.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah observation pen enna nasep bek hilo in, a kimuh thu a kigenna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Watch carefully
senses.definition_en: To watch, examine, or study someone or something carefully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat kidop takin en, sittel ahih kei leh zongkhe cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Scientists observed the animals in their natural habitat.
examples.zomi: Science siamte in gante amau pianpih tenna munah en uh hi.

examples.english: The nurse observed the patient throughout the night.
examples.zomi: Nurse in zan khovak cina sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: Observe is more formal than watch and often implies careful or systematic attention.
senses.usage_zomi: Observe pen watch sangin thukhun zaw a, kidop leh zia nei etna kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Notice something
senses.definition_en: To notice or become aware of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih kei leh na khat phawk ahih kei leh theikha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We observed a change in his behavior.
examples.zomi: A gamtatna kikhel cih ka phawk uh hi.

examples.english: She observed that the door was open.
examples.zomi: Kong kihong cih phawk hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense is close to notice, but it is common in reports and academic writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih thukhun khiatna pen notice tawh kinai a, report leh sang pilna laigelhna ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Follow a law, rule, or custom
senses.definition_en: To follow or respect a law, rule, ceremony, holiday, or custom.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham, thukhun, pawi, khawl ni ahih kei leh ngeina khat zui leh zahtak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: All drivers must observe the speed limit.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawlmi khempeuh in manlang ciangtan zui ding uh hi.

examples.english: The community observes the festival every year.
examples.zomi: Khuamite in kum simin pawi bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, observe means follow or formally recognize, not simply watch.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah observe in en cihna hilo in, zui ahih kei leh pawi bawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To get, receive, or gain something, often through effort or an official process.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hahkatna ahih kei leh thukhun zia tungtawn in ngah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You must obtain permission before entering.
examples.zomi: Na lutma in phalna na ngah kul hi.

examples.english: Researchers obtained the data from public records.
examples.zomi: Zongkhetnate in mipi ciamtehna pan data ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Obtain is more formal than get. It usually takes a direct object: obtain permission.
senses.usage_zomi: Obtain pen get sangin thukhun zaw hi. Direct object nei zel hi: obtain permission.

senses.definition_en: Easy to see, notice, understand, or recognize.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muh, phawk, tel ahih kei leh theihkhiat baih na.

examples.english: There is an obvious mistake in the calculation.
examples.zomi: Simna sungah khialhna kician khat om hi.

examples.english: It was obvious that she was tired.
examples.zomi: Amah gim cih kician hi.

senses.usage_en: Obvious describes something clear to understand, but what seems obvious to one person may not be obvious to another.
senses.usage_zomi: Obvious in telbaih cihna ahi napi, mi khat ading kician na pen midang ading kician lo thei hi.

senses.definition_en: In a way that is easy to see or understand; clearly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muh ahih kei leh tel baih takin; kician takin.

examples.english: The two designs are obviously different.
examples.zomi: Bawldan a nih kilamdang kician hi.

examples.english: He was obviously worried about the result.
examples.zomi: Result thu ah amah lunghihmawh kician hi.

senses.usage_en: Obviously can sound impatient or disrespectful if it suggests that another person should already understand something.
senses.usage_zomi: Midang in thu khat thei khin ding bangin obviously zat leh lungduai lo ahih kei leh zahtakna om lo bangin ging thei hi.

senses.heading: Particular time or event
senses.definition_en: A particular time when something happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a pian hun kician ahih kei leh piangna tuam khat.

examples.english: I met her on one occasion several years ago.
examples.zomi: Kum pawlkhat lai in hun khat amah ka mu hi.

examples.english: The system has failed on several occasions.
examples.zomi: System hun pawlkhat ah nasem zo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: On occasion means sometimes. On this occasion means at this particular event or time.
senses.usage_zomi: On occasion in a veivei cihna a, on this occasion in hih hun kician ah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Special event
senses.definition_en: A special event, ceremony, or celebration.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawi, kikhopna ahih kei leh phawkkikna tuam leh thupi.

examples.english: She wore traditional clothing for the special occasion.
examples.zomi: Hun thupi ading ngeina puan silh hi.

examples.english: The anniversary was a joyful occasion.
examples.zomi: Kumcin pen lungdamhuai hun thupi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: An occasion may be formal or informal, but it is usually notable or meaningful.
senses.usage_zomi: Occasion pen thukhun ahih kei leh nisim pawi hi thei napi, phawk huai leh khiatna nei zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Sometimes, but not regularly or often.
senses.explanation_zomi: A veivei in, ahih hang hunseh tawh ahih kei leh tamvei hilo.

examples.english: We occasionally eat at that restaurant.
examples.zomi: A veivei in tua annekna munah ka ne uh hi.

examples.english: The machine occasionally makes a strange noise.
examples.zomi: Machine khatveivei awging lamdang bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Occasionally means less often than often or frequently, but more than never.
senses.usage_zomi: Occasionally in often ahih kei leh frequently sangin a tawmveizaw a, never sangin a tamveizaw hi.

senses.heading: Happen
senses.definition_en: To happen or take place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piang ahih kei leh om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The accident occurred shortly after midnight.
examples.zomi: Accident zanlaizang khit sawt lo in piang hi.

examples.english: Earthquakes occur frequently in the region.
examples.zomi: Tua gam khen ah zinliing piang tam hi.

senses.usage_en: Occur is more formal than happen. It does not normally take a direct object.
senses.usage_zomi: Occur pen happen sangin thukhun zaw hi. Direct object nei lo zel hi.

senses.heading: Come into someone’s mind
senses.definition_en: To come into someone’s mind as an idea or realization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna ahih kei leh theihkhiatna khat mi khat lungsim sungah hong lut.

examples.english: It occurred to me that the door might be unlocked.
examples.zomi: Kong kha lo kha ding cih ka lungsim ah hong lut hi.

examples.english: The solution suddenly occurred to her.
examples.zomi: Dawnna thakhatin a phawkha hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the pattern It occurred to someone that…; do not say someone occurred that…
senses.usage_zomi: It occurred to someone that… cih kammal zia kizang hi; someone occurred that… ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: One of the enormous areas of salt water covering most of Earth, or the continuous body of salt water surrounding continents.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung a tamzaw tuam a, gam liante kikal leh kimvel a om ci-al tui zaipi.

examples.english: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean.
examples.zomi: Pacific Tuipi pen tuipi a lian pen ahi hi.

examples.english: Plastic waste harms ocean life.
examples.zomi: Plastic nusiatna-te in tuipi sung nuntakna susia hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Ocean when it forms part of a proper name such as Atlantic Ocean.
senses.usage_zomi: Atlantic Ocean bang min kicing sungah Ocean laimal lian tawh kigelh hi.

senses.definition_en: The tenth month of the year, after September and before November.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sung kha sawmna, September khit leh November ma a kha.

examples.english: The weather becomes cooler in October.
examples.zomi: October kha in khua vot deuh suak hi.

examples.english: Her birthday is on October 20.
examples.zomi: A pian ni October 20 ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Names of months begin with capital letters. Use in with the month and on with a particular date.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah kha minte laimal lian tawh kipan hi. Kha bek tawh in kizang a, ni kician tawh on kizang hi.

senses.heading: Strange or unusual
senses.definition_en: Strange, unusual, or difficult to explain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lamdang, ngeina hilo ahih kei leh hilhcian haksa na.

examples.english: The machine is making an odd noise.
examples.zomi: Machine awging lamdang khat bawl hi.

examples.english: It seemed odd that nobody answered.
examples.zomi: Kuamah in a dawn lohna lamdang hi.

senses.usage_en: Odd may describe something mildly strange rather than frightening or completely abnormal.
senses.usage_zomi: Odd in lauhuai ahih kei leh ngeina pualam lua sangin, tawmno lamdang cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Not divisible by two
senses.definition_en: Describing a whole number that cannot be divided exactly by two.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sim nih tawh kicing takin khen theih lo sim kicing.

examples.english: Three, five, and seven are odd numbers.
examples.zomi: Thum, nga leh sagih pen odd sim ahi hi.

examples.english: Write down all the odd numbers below twenty.
examples.zomi: Sawmnih nuai a odd sim khempeuh gelh in.

senses.usage_en: Odd numbers end in 1, 3, 5, 7, or 9. Their opposite is even numbers.
senses.usage_zomi: Odd simte 1, 3, 5, 7 ahih kei leh 9 tawh tawp hi. A kikal pen even numbers ahi hi.

senses.heading: Remaining or unmatched
senses.definition_en: Remaining after others have been paired, grouped, or used.
senses.explanation_zomi: A dangte kop, pawl bawl ahih kei leh zat khit ciangin a tang in a beisak.

examples.english: I found an odd sock under the bed.
examples.zomi: Lupna nuai ah a kop om lo khekhap khat ka mu hi.

examples.english: He earns money by doing odd jobs.
examples.zomi: Nasep neu tuamtuam sem in sum ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Odd jobs are small, separate, and usually temporary tasks.
senses.usage_zomi: Odd jobs pen nasep neu tuamtuam leh tawmvei sung nasep ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Showing possession or connection
senses.definition_en: Used to connect something with its owner, source, subject, or related person or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a neitu, a hong kipatna, a thu ahih kei leh a kizopna lakna ding a kizang preposition.

examples.english: What is the name of the school?
examples.zomi: Sang min bang ahi hiam?

examples.english: She is a member of the committee.
examples.zomi: Amah committee sung mi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Zomi often expresses an English of relationship through word order or possession rather than a separate translated word.
senses.usage_zomi: English of kizopna pen Zomi ah kammal tuam khat tawh lehkhiat sangin kammal kiciamna ahih kei leh neihna zia tawh kigen zel hi.

senses.heading: Showing part, amount, or contents
senses.definition_en: Used after a quantity, container, or part to identify what it contains or belongs to.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, kuang ahih kei leh khen khat in bang a huam cih lakna ding a kizang preposition.

examples.english: She drank a glass of water.
examples.zomi: Tui hai khat dawn hi.

examples.english: Most of the students passed.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte a tamzaw ong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses of frequently in measurement and partitive phrases; natural Zomi usually changes the word order.
senses.usage_zomi: English in zat leh khen lakna ah of zang tam a, natural Zomi in kammal kiciamna khel zel hi.

senses.heading: Showing material or cause
senses.definition_en: Used to identify what something is made from or what caused a condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bang tawh kibawl ahih kei leh dinmun khat bang hang a piang cih lakna ding a kizang preposition.

examples.english: The table is made of wood.
examples.zomi: Tawlngak sing tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Many people died of the disease.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi tua natna hangin si uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The correct Zomi translation of of depends strongly on its grammatical relationship; it should not be translated mechanically with one fixed word.
senses.usage_zomi: Of a Zomi khiatna pen grammar kizopna tungah kinga mahmah a, kammal khatbek tawh mun khempeuh ah lehkhiat lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Away from a place or surface
senses.definition_en: Away from or no longer touching a place, position, or surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, omna ahih kei leh maitang khat pan paikhiat ahih kei leh lawng nawn lo in.

examples.english: The cup fell off the table.
examples.zomi: No tawlngak tung pan kia hi.

examples.english: Please take your shoes off.
examples.zomi: Na khedap sutkhia in.

senses.usage_en: Off often works with a verb to form a phrasal verb, and its exact meaning changes with that verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Off in verb tawh phrasal verb bawl zel a, a khiatna pen tua verb bangin kikhel hi.

senses.heading: Not operating or connected
senses.definition_en: Not operating, not switched on, or disconnected from power or a supply.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mit; a nasep lo; kizom lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasem lo, kihong lo ahih kei leh tha leh kizopna pan kikhen.

examples.english: Turn off the light before leaving.
examples.zomi: Na paikhiatma in khuavak mitsak in.

examples.english: The internet was off for two hours.
examples.zomi: Internet nai nih sung nasem lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Off is the opposite of on for switches, devices, and services.
senses.usage_zomi: Switch, van leh nasepna-te ah off a kikal pen on ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not at work or not available
senses.definition_en: Away from work, duty, or a regular activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, mawhpuak ahih kei leh ngeina nasep pan a khawl.

examples.english: I have tomorrow off.
examples.zomi: Zing ka khawl ding hi.

examples.english: She is off work because she is ill.
examples.zomi: A cina manin nasep pan khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Be off work may mean an approved break, vacation, or absence because of illness.
senses.usage_zomi: Be off work in khawlna phal, vacation ahih kei leh natna hang nasep pelhna kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Illegal act
senses.definition_en: An act that breaks a law or rule.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham ahih kei leh thukhun a palsat gamtatna.

examples.english: Driving without a licence is an offence.
examples.zomi: Phalna lai om lo in mawtaw hawl pen thukham palsatna ahi hi.

examples.english: He was charged with a serious offence.
examples.zomi: Ama mawhna nasia khat tawh kimawhsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Offence is the British spelling. American English spells it offense.
senses.usage_zomi: Offence pen British gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah offense ci in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Hurt or insult
senses.definition_en: A feeling of anger or hurt caused by something insulting or disrespectful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zahkona ahih kei leh zahtakna om lo kammal hang a hehna ahih kei leh lungnatna.

examples.english: She took offence at his comment.
examples.zomi: A kammal hangin lungna hi.

examples.english: I meant no offence.
examples.zomi: Kong lungnatsak tum kei hi.

senses.usage_en: Take offence means feel insulted. Give offence or cause offence means upset or insult someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Take offence in zahkona bangin ngai in lungna cihna a, give/cause offence in mi khat lungnatsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Make someone feel insulted or upset
senses.definition_en: To make someone feel hurt, angry, or insulted by something said or done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal ahih kei leh gamtatna tawh mi khat lungna, heh ahih kei leh zakna suaksak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am sorry if my words offended you.
examples.zomi: Ka kammalte in kong lungnatsak leh hong ngaihdam in.

examples.english: The joke offended several people.
examples.zomi: Nuihzathu in mi pawlkhat lungnatsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Offend takes a direct object: offend someone. The adjective is offended for the person’s feeling and offensive for the cause.
senses.usage_zomi: Offend in direct object nei hi: offend someone. Mi lungsim genna pen offended ahi a, lungnatsak na genna pen offensive ahi hi.

senses.heading: Break a moral or legal standard
senses.definition_en: To act against a law, rule, moral principle, or accepted standard.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham, thukhun, gamtat maan thukhun ahih kei leh ciangtan kipsa langin gamta cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Anyone who offends against the law may be punished.
examples.zomi: Thukham a palsat mi kuapeuh gim kipia thei hi.

examples.english: The action offended accepted standards of conduct.
examples.zomi: Gamtatna in mipi pom gamtat ciangtan palsat hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense is common in legal or moral discussion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih thukhun khiatna pen thukham ahih kei leh gamtat maan kiholimna ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Insulting or unpleasant
senses.definition_en: Causing hurt, anger, disgust, or insult.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi lungna, heh, kihhuaina ahih kei leh zakona lungsim a piangsak.

examples.english: The website removed the offensive comment.
examples.zomi: Website in kammal lungnathuai lakhia hi.

examples.english: Some people found the advertisement offensive.
examples.zomi: Mi pawlkhat in van tangkona lungnathuai in ngaihsun uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Offensive describes the cause; offended describes the person’s reaction.
senses.usage_zomi: Offensive in lungnatsak na gen a, offended in a lungna mi lungsim gen hi.

senses.heading: Relating to attack
senses.definition_en: Relating to attacking rather than defending, especially in war or sports.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidalna sangin langpan tungah tatzia tawh kisai, phadiak in kidouna ahih kei leh kimawlna ah.

examples.english: The army began an offensive operation.
examples.zomi: Galkap in gal dona nasep kipan hi.

examples.english: The team improved its offensive strategy.
examples.zomi: Pawl in langdo kimawl geelna hoihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In military and sports contexts, offensive is the opposite of defensive.
senses.usage_zomi: Galkap leh kimawlna thu ah offensive a kikal pen defensive ahi hi.

senses.heading: Say that you are willing to give or do something
senses.definition_en: To say that you are willing to give something or do something for someone.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pia ding gen; huh ding kamciam
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tungah na khat pia ahih kei leh ama ading na khat bawl nuam cih gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She offered to help me with the work.
examples.zomi: Nasep ah kei hong huh ding gen hi.

examples.english: The company offered him a new position.
examples.zomi: Company in ama tungah nasep dinmun thak khat pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use offer to + verb: offer to help. Use offer someone something: offer her a job.
senses.usage_zomi: Offer to + verb ci in kizang hi: offer to help. Offer someone something cih kammal zia zong kizang hi: offer her a job.

senses.heading: Make something available
senses.definition_en: To provide a product, service, opportunity, or choice for people to use or accept.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite in a zat, a ngah ahih kei leh a sang theihna ding van, nasep, hunhoih ahih kei leh teelna pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The school offers evening classes.
examples.zomi: Sang in nitaklam sinna-te pia hi.

examples.english: This hotel offers free breakfast.
examples.zomi: Hih hotel in zingsang an man lo in pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, offer means make available; it does not guarantee that anyone will accept it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah offer in ngah theih dingin koih cihna a, mi in sang veve ding cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Suggest a price
senses.definition_en: To state the amount of money you are willing to pay for something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: man pia ding gen; sum man sawm
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat leina ding a piak nop sum zat gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They offered two hundred thousand dollars for the house.
examples.zomi: Inn ading dollar tul zaknih pia ding gen uh hi.

examples.english: She offered less than the asking price.
examples.zomi: A kingen man sangin tawmzaw pia ding gen hi.

senses.usage_en: An offered price may be accepted, rejected, or negotiated.
senses.usage_zomi: A kipiak sawm man pen kipom, kinial ahih kei leh kiholimkik thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A room or building where people do administrative or professional work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai gelhna, sumvai, makaihna leh nasep tuamtuam semna dingin kizang khaan ahih kei leh inn ahi hi.

examples.english: She works in an office near the city centre.
examples.zomi: Ama khuapi laizang nai office khat ah nasem hi.

examples.english: Please call me during office hours.
examples.zomi: Office nasep hun sungin hong sam in.

senses.usage_en: Office may refer to a workplace, a government department, or an important public position.
senses.usage_zomi: Office in nasepna mun, kumpi nasepna pawl, ahih kei leh mipi nasepna dinmun thupi khat zong a cihna thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who holds a position of authority in the police, military, government, or another organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Palik, galkap, kumpi nasepna ahih kei leh pawl khat sungah ukna leh mawpuakna nei mi ahi hi.

examples.english: A police officer asked to see my driving licence.
examples.zomi: Palik khat in ka mawtaw hawlna laipha en nuam hi.

examples.english: The officer gave clear instructions to the soldiers.
examples.zomi: Officer in galkapte tungah thuhilhna telcian pia hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning of officer depends on the organization. A police officer and a military officer have different duties.
senses.usage_zomi: Officer a cihna pen a nasepna pawl tungah kinga hi. Palik officer leh galkap officer-te in mawpuakna kibanglo nei uh hi.

senses.definition_en: Approved, announced, or authorized by a government or another responsible organization.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thuneite in kiphasak; kumpi tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi ahih kei leh mawpuakna nei pawl khat in a kiphasak, a tangko, ahih kei leh a phal ahi hi.

examples.english: The official results will be announced tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Thuneite in a kiphasak zotsakna zing ciang tangko ding uh hi.

examples.english: You need an official document to prove your identity.
examples.zomi: Nangma kua na hiam cih lakna ding thuneite in a kiphasak laipha kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Official describes something authorized by a responsible authority, not merely something believed or reported informally.
senses.usage_zomi: Official pen thuneihna nei pawl in a kiphasak hi a, mipau mawkmawk ahih kei leh kici mawk khat hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Many times or frequently.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat veitampi piang ahih kei leh kizang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We often eat dinner together.
examples.zomi: Kote nitak an mun tampi khawm nek hi.

examples.english: How often do you visit your parents?
examples.zomi: Na nu leh na pa bangzah vei va veh nahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: Often usually comes before the main verb but after the verb be: “I often go,” but “She is often late.”
senses.usage_zomi: Often pen main verb ma ah om zel a, be verb nungah om hi: “I often go,” ahihhang “She is often late” ci in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A word used to express surprise, understanding, disappointment, pain, or another sudden feeling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lamdang sakna, theihthakna, lungkimlohna, natna ahih kei leh lungsim sung thu thakhat in pulakna aw ahi hi.

examples.english: Oh, I understand what you mean now.
examples.zomi: Aw, na cihnopna tu in ka theita.

examples.english: Oh no! I left my phone at home.
examples.zomi: Aw, hilo! Ka phone inn ah ka nusia hi.

senses.usage_en: Oh is common in speech and informal writing. Its meaning depends greatly on the speaker’s tone.
senses.usage_zomi: Oh pen kam pau leh lai kigelh mawkmawk ah kizang zel hi. A cihnopna pen paupa’ aw gingzia tungah kinga mahmah hi.

senses.definition_en: A thick liquid used as fuel, for cooking, for machines, or in making other products.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meiholna, an huan-na, khawl nilhna ahih kei leh van dang bawlna dingin kizang tui bangin luang sathau ahi hi.

examples.english: Heat the oil before adding the vegetables.
examples.zomi: Ante koihma in sathau sa sak in.

examples.english: The mechanic checked the engine oil.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw siam in engine sathau sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: Oil is usually uncountable when referring to the substance. Use an oil when referring to a particular kind of oil.
senses.usage_zomi: Sathau a cihna in oil pen simtheihlo noun in kizang zel hi. Sathau nam tuam khat gen ciangin an oil ci in kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A word used to show agreement, acceptance, or understanding.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat kithukim, kipom, ahih kei leh kithei cih lakna pau ahi hi.

examples.english: “Can we meet at six?” “OK.”
examples.zomi: “Dak guk ciang kimuh thei ding hiam?” “Hoih.”

examples.english: OK, I will finish the work today.
examples.zomi: Hoih, tuni in nasep ka zo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: OK is common in informal speech and writing. It can express agreement or indicate that something is satisfactory.
senses.usage_zomi: OK pen niteng pau leh lai kigelh mawkmawk ah kizang hi. Kithukimna ahih kei leh na khat a hoih khin cihna in kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Having lived or existed for a long time; not young or new.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh gan khat kum tampi a nungta, van khat hun sawtpi a om khin, thak nawnlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: My grandfather is eighty years old.
examples.zomi: Ka pu kum sawmgiat pha hi.

examples.english: They live in an old house near the river.
examples.zomi: Amaute gun gei inn lui khat ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use old for age and for something that is not new. When referring politely to people, older or elderly may sound more respectful.
senses.usage_zomi: Old pen kum leh van thaklo genna in kizang hi. Mi tungah zahtakna tawh pau ciangin older ahih kei leh elderly zat hoihzaw thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Belonging to an earlier time and no longer considered modern.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nidang hun tawh kituak a, tuhun ngeina leh khantohna tawh kituak nawnlo ahi hi.

examples.english: Some people think this custom is old-fashioned.
examples.zomi: Mi pawlkhat in hih ngeina pen ngeina lui ahi ci in ngaihsun uh hi.

examples.english: The hotel has old-fashioned furniture.
examples.zomi: Hotel sungah inn van ngeina lui om hi.

senses.usage_en: Old-fashioned can be neutral or negative. It may describe something traditional, but it can also suggest that something is no longer suitable.
senses.usage_zomi: Old-fashioned pen hoih leh hoihlo lam nih in kizang thei hi. Ngeina lui a cihna hithei a, tuhun ading a kituak nawnlo cihna zong hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: In or into a position touching and supported by the surface of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a tunglam maitang tawh kituah in a tungah om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Your keys are on the table.
examples.zomi: Na tawhpite sabuai tungah om hi.

examples.english: She hung the picture on the wall.
examples.zomi: Aman lim kulh tungah khai hi.

senses.usage_en: On has many uses. It can show position, time, subject, travel or operation, as in on the table, on Monday, a book on history, on a bus and the light is on.
senses.usage_zomi: On in zatna tampi nei hi. Mun, hun, thu, khualzinna leh khawl a nasepna lakna in kizang a, on the table, on Monday, a book on history, on a bus leh the light is on cihbang ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: One time only.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khatvei bek cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I have visited New York only once.
examples.zomi: New York khatvei bek ka va hawh hi.

examples.english: Take this medicine once a day.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui ni khat khatvei ne in.

senses.usage_en: Once can mean “one time.” It can also mean “at some time in the past,” as in “I once lived there.”
senses.usage_zomi: Once in “khatvei” a cihna nei hi. “I once lived there” cihbangin nidanglai hun khat a cihna zong nei hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 1.
senses.explanation_zomi: Number 1, khat a cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: One plus one equals two.
examples.zomi: Khat beh khat pen nih ahi hi.

examples.english: I chose the blue one.
examples.zomi: A sanngo khat ka teel hi.

senses.usage_en: One is a number, but it can also replace a previously mentioned singular countable noun: “I need a pen. Do you have one?”
senses.usage_zomi: One pen number ahi a, genkhin simtheih noun khat aiawhin zong kizang thei hi: “I need a pen. Do you have one?”

senses.definition_en: A round vegetable with many layers and a strong smell and taste.
senses.explanation_zomi: A pum kual, a sunga a phel phel in kihawl, a nam leh a limna nasia an nam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Chop the onion into small pieces.
examples.zomi: Onion a neu neu in tan in.

examples.english: She added an onion to the soup.
examples.zomi: Aman huci sungah onion khat beh hi.

senses.usage_en: Onion is countable when referring to whole onions, but it can be uncountable when referring to onion used as a food ingredient.
senses.usage_zomi: Onion a pum sim ciangin onion pen simtheih noun ahi hi. An sungah kihel onion gen ciangin simtheihlo noun in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Connected to or available through the internet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Internet tawh kizom ahih kei leh internet tungtawnin muhtheih leh zat theih ahi hi.

examples.english: I enrolled in an online English course.
examples.zomi: Internet tunga English sinna ah ka min ka gelh hi.

examples.english: The application form is available online.
examples.zomi: Ngetna lai internet tungah muhtheih hi.

senses.usage_en: Online is normally written as one word. It can describe services, activities or material available through the internet.
senses.usage_zomi: Online pen pau khat in kigelh zel hi. Internet tungtawn nasepna, kalsuan dan ahih kei leh laigel omte genna in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Being the single person or thing of a particular kind; with no other one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nam khat sungah ama bek om a, a dang omlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is the only doctor in the village.
examples.zomi: Ama tua khua sunga siavuan neihsun ahi hi.

examples.english: This is the only key that opens the door.
examples.zomi: Hih tawhpi bek in kong hong thei hi.

senses.usage_en: As an adjective, only comes before the noun it limits. As an adverb, its position can change the meaning of a sentence.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective in kizang ciangin only pen a ciangtanh noun ma ah om hi. Adverb in kizang ciangin a omna mun in sentence a khiatna khelsak thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Moving to a position on the surface of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat panin na khat a maitang tungah a kalsuan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The cat jumped onto the table.
examples.zomi: Ngeu sabuai tungah kahto hi.

examples.english: He loaded the boxes onto the truck.
examples.zomi: Aman bawmte truck tungah suang hi.

senses.usage_en: Onto normally expresses movement to a surface. On usually describes an existing position.
senses.usage_zomi: Onto pen maitang khat tungah kalsuan cihna in kizang zel hi. On ahihleh mun khat tungah omkhin cihna in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Not closed, locked, blocked, or covered.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhaklo, kikhumlo, kidallo ahih kei leh a tung kiphawlo ahi hi.

examples.english: The door was open when I arrived.
examples.zomi: Ka tun ciangin kong hong hi.

examples.english: The museum is open to the public today.
examples.zomi: Museum tuni in mipi ading kihong hi.

senses.usage_en: Open can describe something not closed or a business that is operating and available to customers.
senses.usage_zomi: Open pen na khat kikhaklo cihna in kizang thei a, vanzuakna mun kihong a customer-te sang cihna in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A hole, space, or place through which someone or something can enter or pass.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat a luttheihna, a paikhawktheihna ding awng ahih kei leh mun ahi hi.

examples.english: Light entered through a small opening in the wall.
examples.zomi: Kulh sunga awng neu khat pan khuavak lut hi.

examples.english: The opening ceremony begins at nine.
examples.zomi: Kihonna pawi dak kua ciang kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Opening can mean a physical gap, the beginning of an event, or an available job or opportunity.
senses.usage_zomi: Opening pen awng khat, pawi ahih kei leh nasep kipatna, leh nasepna mun awng khat a cihna zong nei hi.

senses.definition_en: To control or use a machine, system, or piece of equipment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khawl, system ahih kei leh zat van khat a semtheihna dingin hawl leh zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Only trained workers may operate this machine.
examples.zomi: Kisinsak nasemte bek in hih khawl hawl thei uh hi.

examples.english: The company operates several hotels.
examples.zomi: Company in hotel tampi makaih hi.

senses.usage_en: Operate may mean controlling a machine, managing an organization, functioning, or performing surgery.
senses.usage_zomi: Operate pen khawl hawl, pawl khat makaih, na khat a sem, ahih kei leh pumpi ki-at cihna in kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The act or process of working, functioning, or carrying out an organized activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a nasepzia, a kalsuanzia, ahih kei leh geelna tawh nasep khat bawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: The rescue operation continued throughout the night.
examples.zomi: Hotkhiatna nasep zan khovak dong kizom hi.

examples.english: She had an operation on her knee.
examples.zomi: Ama’ khuk ki-at hi.

senses.usage_en: Operation can refer to an organized activity, the working of a system, a business activity, or surgery.
senses.usage_zomi: Operation pen geelna tawh nasepna, system khat a nasepzia, sumdawnna nasep, ahih kei leh pumpi ki-atna a cihna nei hi.

senses.definition_en: A belief or judgment about someone or something that may not be based on complete facts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh thu khat tungah thuman kicing tawh kipsak nailo ngaihsutna leh muhna ahi hi.

examples.english: In my opinion, the plan is too expensive.
examples.zomi: Ka ngaihsutdan in, tua geelna sum tampi kisam lua hi.

examples.english: Everyone was invited to express an opinion.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh amau ngaihsutna pulak dingin kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: An opinion is what someone thinks or believes. It is not necessarily a proven fact.
senses.usage_zomi: Opinion pen mi khat in a ngaihsut leh a upna ahi hi. Thuman in kipsak khin pahpahlo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person or group that competes against or opposes another person or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kituhna ah mi dang tawh a kituh, ahih kei leh mi khat leh pawl khat a langdo mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She defeated her opponent in the final match.
examples.zomi: A nunungpen kimawlna ah ama’ kituhpih zogawp hi.

examples.english: The candidate criticized his political opponent.
examples.zomi: Teelna a lutpa in ama’ gamvai ukna langdopa dem hi.

senses.usage_en: Opponent can refer to someone in a sport, competition, argument or political contest.
senses.usage_zomi: Opponent pen kimawlna, kituhna, kinialna ahih kei leh gamvai ukna kituhna sunga langdopa a cihna in kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A situation that makes it possible to do something useful, important, or desired.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na hoih, thupi ahih kei leh deihhuai khat a bawltheihna ding hun leh dinmun hoih ahi hi.

examples.english: This course gives students an opportunity to improve their English.
examples.zomi: Hih sinna in sangnaupangte amau English khantohsakna ding hunhoih pia hi.

examples.english: Do not miss the opportunity to apply for the job.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep ngetna ding hunhoih sukhia kei in.

senses.usage_en: Opportunity is usually followed by to plus a verb or by for plus a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Opportunity nungah to leh verb, ahih kei leh for leh noun kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: To disagree with and try to prevent a plan, policy, action, or person from succeeding.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna, thukhun, nasep ahih kei leh mi khat tawh kithukimlo in a tangtunlohna ding langdo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Many residents opposed the new road project.
examples.zomi: Khuami tampi in lampi thak bawlna geelna langdo uh hi.

examples.english: She opposed the proposal because it was unfair.
examples.zomi: Tua ngaihsut piakna a thutanglo manin aman langdo hi.

senses.usage_en: Oppose is a transitive verb and normally takes a direct object. Say “oppose the plan,” not “oppose against the plan.”
senses.usage_zomi: Oppose pen transitive verb ahi a, a nungah object hong pai hi. “Oppose the plan” ci ding a, “oppose against the plan” ci lo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Disagreeing with or unwilling to support a plan, idea, or action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh nasep khat tawh kithukimlo a, a panpih nuamlo ahi hi.

examples.english: Most residents are opposed to the new tax.
examples.zomi: Khuami a tamzawte sia thak tawh kithukimlo uh hi.

examples.english: He was strongly opposed to closing the school.
examples.zomi: Aman sanginn khakna nakpitak in langdo hi.

senses.usage_en: Opposed is normally followed by to, and to is followed by a noun or an -ing form: “opposed to the change” or “opposed to closing it.”
senses.usage_zomi: Opposed nungah to kizang zel a, to nungah noun ahih kei leh -ing form hong pai hi: “opposed to the change” ahih kei leh “opposed to closing it.”

senses.definition_en: Completely different in nature, direction, position, or meaning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Omzia, paizia, dinmun ahih kei leh khiatna lamah a kikalh ahi hi.

examples.english: The two cars were travelling in opposite directions.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw nih lampi kikalh in pai uh hi.

examples.english: “Hot” and “cold” have opposite meanings.
examples.zomi: “Sa” leh “vot” in khiatna kikalh nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Opposite may describe two completely different qualities or positions. As a noun, it can mean a person or thing that is completely different.
senses.usage_zomi: Opposite pen omzia ahih kei leh dinmun kikalh nih genna in kizang hi. Noun in kizang ciangin mi ahih kei leh na kikalh a cihna nei hi.

senses.definition_en: Disagreement with, or resistance to, a person, plan, or idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, geelna khat, ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat langdona leh nialna.

examples.english: The proposal faced strong opposition from local residents.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna in tua khuami-te’ langdona lian thuak hi.

examples.english: The opposition criticized the new law.
examples.zomi: Ukna langdo pawl in thukham thak dem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Opposition can mean resistance to something or the political parties that oppose a government.
senses.usage_zomi: Opposition in na khat langdona a cihna ahi a, kumpi ukna a langdo gamvai pawl-te zong a cihna hi.

senses.definition_en: One of the choices that a person can make.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a teeltheih ding lampi ahih kei leh teeltheihna lakpan khat.

examples.english: Taking the bus is the cheapest option.
examples.zomi: Bus tuanna pen a man tawm pen teeltheihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We have several options to consider.
examples.zomi: Ngaihsut ding teeltheihna pawlkhat kineih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use option for an available choice, especially when several possible actions exist.
senses.usage_zomi: Lam tuamtuam tawh nasep theih ciangin, tua teeltheihna khatciat genna dingin option kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to connect alternatives or different possibilities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teeltheihna nih ahih kei leh a tamzaw lakah khat teel ding a kizopna.

common_phrases.zomi: tu in maw a nung ciangin

examples.english: Would you like tea or coffee?
examples.zomi: Ningsa maw coffee na deih hiam?

examples.english: We can go today or wait until tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Tuni in pai ding maw, zingciang dong ngak ding cih teeltheih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use or to present alternatives. In questions, Zomi commonly uses maw between the alternatives.
senses.usage_zomi: Teeltheihna tuamtuam genkhawm dingin or kizang hi. Dotna ah Zomi pau in teeltheihna-te kikal ah maw kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Fruit
senses.definition_en: A round citrus fruit with a thick orange-colored skin and juicy flesh.
senses.explanation_zomi: A vun hawng, a sung tui tampi nei, a um limlim citrus gah khat.

examples.english: She peeled an orange for the child.
examples.zomi: Nau pang ading orange gah khat hawh hi.

examples.english: I drink orange juice with breakfast.
examples.zomi: Zing an ka nek ciangin orange gahzu ka dawn hi.

senses.usage_en: Orange is countable when it means the fruit.
senses.usage_zomi: Orange in gah a cihna ciangin simtheih min ahi hi.

senses.heading: Color
senses.definition_en: A color between red and yellow.
senses.explanation_zomi: San leh eng kikal a om puan dial khat.

examples.english: The sky turned orange at sunset.
examples.zomi: Ni tum laitakin van orange pian suak hi.

examples.english: Orange is her favorite color.
examples.zomi: Orange pian pen ama’ deihpen puan dial ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The same word names both the fruit and the color.
senses.usage_zomi: Tua kammal mah gah min leh puan dial min in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Request for goods or food
senses.definition_en: A request to buy or receive food, goods, or a service.
senses.explanation_zomi: An, van ahih kei leh nasepna khat ngah dingin ngenna kipia.

examples.english: We placed an order for three chairs.
examples.zomi: Tutna thum ngenna kapia uh hi.

examples.english: Your order will arrive tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Na van ngen pen zingciang hong tung ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In a restaurant, an order is the food or drink requested by a customer.
senses.usage_zomi: An nekna mun ah order pen vanlei mi in a ngen an ahih kei leh dawnna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Arrangement or condition
senses.definition_en: A condition in which people or things are arranged correctly and properly controlled.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi leh nate a kilawm bangbang leh a geel kizui in a kizemzia.

examples.english: The names are listed in alphabetical order.
examples.zomi: Min-te laimal kizui in kigelh hi.

examples.english: The teacher restored order in the classroom.
examples.zomi: Sia in sanginn sung omzia hoihkik sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In order can mean “properly arranged”; out of order often means that a machine is not working.
senses.usage_zomi: In order in a geel kizui in kizek cihna hi a, out of order in van khat a na seplo cihna in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Normal or usual, without anything special or unusual.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuamvilvel lo, a ngeina bang leh a poimaw tuam omlo.

common_phrases.zomi: a ngeina tawh a tuam omlo

examples.english: It began as an ordinary day.
examples.zomi: Ni ngeina khat bangin kipan hi.

examples.english: The building looks ordinary from the outside.
examples.zomi: Tua inn pen pualam pan en leng inn ngeina khat bang hi.

senses.usage_en: Ordinary is usually neutral, but it can suggest that something is not especially impressive.
senses.usage_zomi: Ordinary in a ngeina cihna ahi hi. Ahihhang khatveivei a hoih tuamlo ahihna zong a kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Body part
senses.definition_en: A part of the body that performs a particular function, such as the heart or lungs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim ahih kei leh lungsung bangin, pumpi sungah nasep tuam khat sem pumpi hiang khat.

common_phrases.zomi: nuntakna ading a poimaw pumpi hiang

examples.english: The heart is a vital organ.
examples.zomi: Lungsim pen nuntakna ading a poimaw pumpi hiang ahi hi.

examples.english: The disease can damage several organs.
examples.zomi: Tua natna in pumpi hiang pawlkhat a susia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use organ for a body structure with a specific function; do not confuse it with organization.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi hiang in nasep tuam khat a sep ciangin organ kizang hi; organization tawh kitelkhial sak kei in.

senses.heading: Musical instrument
senses.definition_en: A large keyboard instrument that produces sound through pipes or electronically.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khutme tawh tum, kua sung pan aw suaksak ahih kei leh electric tawh aw bawl tumging khat.

examples.english: She plays the organ at church.
examples.zomi: Biakinn ah organ tum hi.

examples.english: The old organ has hundreds of pipes.
examples.zomi: Tua organ lui in kua za tampi nei hi.

senses.usage_en: The musical meaning usually appears with a context such as a church or music.
senses.usage_zomi: Tumging a cihna pen biakinn ahih kei leh la leh tumging thu tawh kizom in kimu zel hi.

senses.heading: Organized group
senses.definition_en: A group of people who work together for a shared purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna khat nei in nasemkhawm mi pawl khat.

examples.english: She works for an international organization.
examples.zomi: Leitung bup kipawlna khat ah nasem hi.

examples.english: The organization helps homeless families.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl in inn neilo innkuan-te huh hi.

senses.usage_en: This countable meaning refers to a particular group or institution.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih simtheih khiatna in pawl ahih kei leh ukna mun khat a kawk hi.

senses.heading: Arrangement
senses.definition_en: The act or quality of arranging people or things in an orderly way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi leh nate geelna kizui in kizekna ahih kei leh kikhawlna.

examples.english: Good organization saved us a great deal of time.
examples.zomi: Kizekna hoih in hun tampi hong zeisak hi.

examples.english: She is responsible for the organization of the event.
examples.zomi: Tua vaipuak kizekna ama’ vaipuak ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is generally uncountable and describes arranging or managing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen a tamzaw in simtheih lo min ahi a, na khat kizekna leh ukna a gen hi.

senses.heading: Arrange
senses.definition_en: To arrange people or things systematically so that they work or can be used effectively.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi leh nate a geel kizui leh manpha takin zat theih dingin kizek.

examples.english: Please organize these documents by date.
examples.zomi: Hih lai-te a ni kizui in kizek in.

examples.english: He organized his work carefully.
examples.zomi: Ama’ nasep kidop takin kizek hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning focuses on putting existing people, information, or objects into a useful order.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in a omkhin mi, thu ahih kei leh van-te kizangthei dingin hoih takin kizekna a bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Plan an activity
senses.definition_en: To plan and make arrangements for an event or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vaipuak ahih kei leh nasepna khat piangthei dingin geelna bawl in vaihawm.

examples.english: They organized a meeting for Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ni dingin kikhopna khat vaihawm uh hi.

examples.english: Our school will organize a sports competition.
examples.zomi: Ka sang uh in kimawlna kidemna vaihawm ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Organize takes a direct object: organize a meeting, a team, or a collection.
senses.usage_zomi: Organize nungah a kizek na min hong pai hi: kikhopna, pawl ahih kei leh na kholkhawmte kizek cihbang ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Arranged or managed in an orderly and effective way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hoih takin kizek; a geel kizui
senses.explanation_zomi: A geel kizui leh kizangthei dingin hoih takin kizek.

examples.english: The conference was well organized.
examples.zomi: Tua kikhop lian hoih takin kizek hi.

examples.english: She is organized and always finishes her work on time.
examples.zomi: Ama omzia kizek a, ama’ nasep hun tawh kizui in zo zel hi.

senses.usage_en: For a person, organized means able to plan and manage tasks well.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat tungah organized kici leh, geelna bawl leh nasep hoih takin ukzo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who plans and arranges an event or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vaipuak ahih kei leh nasepna khat geel in kizek mi.

examples.english: Ask the organizer where the meeting will be held.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna koi ah kibawl ding cih vaihawmpa dong in.

examples.english: The organizers prepared everything in advance.
examples.zomi: Vaihawmpa-te in a kisap khempeuh a ma-in bawlkhol uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use organizer for a person or group responsible for planning and coordinating something.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat geel leh a vaihawm ding vaipuak nei mi ahih kei leh pawl genna dingin organizer kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: The place, time, or cause from which someone or something begins or develops.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a kipatna mun, hun, bulpi ahih kei leh pianna hang.

examples.english: Scientists are studying the origin of the disease.
examples.zomi: Pilna nei mite in tua natna kipatna kancian uh hi.

examples.english: The word is Latin in origin.
examples.zomi: Tua kammal pen Latin pau pan kipan ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Origin concerns where something began; source often concerns where it currently comes from.
senses.usage_zomi: Origin in na khat a kipatna a gen a, source in tua na a hong pianna mun a gen thei hi.

senses.heading: First or earliest
senses.definition_en: Existing at the beginning, before any changes, copies, or later versions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhel, kilawmkik ahih kei leh a nung version omma a kipatcil pan a om.

examples.english: We returned to the original plan.
examples.zomi: A kipatcil geelna ah kikik uh hi.

examples.english: The original building was destroyed by fire.
examples.zomi: A kipatcil inn pen mei in kangtum sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning contrasts the first form with a later or changed form.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in a masapen omzia leh a nung ciangin kikhel omzia a kilehbulh sak hi.

senses.heading: New and independently created
senses.definition_en: Created independently rather than copied from something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang’ nasep etteh lo in, ama’ ngaihsutna tawh thak in kibawl.

examples.english: Her design is simple but original.
examples.zomi: Ama’ lim bawldan baihlam napi ngaihsutna thak tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Students must submit original work.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in amau’ nasep etteh lo pia ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An original idea is new; an original document may mean the first document rather than a copy.
senses.usage_zomi: Original idea pen ngaihsutna thak ahi a, original document pen a letkhiat ahih kei leh copy hilo a bulpi lai a cihna hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: At first or at the beginning, before a later change.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kipatcil in; a bulpi in
senses.explanation_zomi: A kipatcil in, a nung ciangin kikhelma in.

examples.english: The building was originally a school.
examples.zomi: Tua inn pen a kipatcil in sanginn ahi hi.

examples.english: She is originally from Myanmar but now lives in Canada.
examples.zomi: Ama a kipatcil in Myanmar gam pan hi napi, tu in Canada gam ah teng hi.

senses.usage_en: Originally explains an earlier condition, purpose, or source that may have changed.
senses.usage_zomi: Originally in a nung ciangin kikhelthei kipatcil dinmun, ngimna ahih kei leh a hong pianna a gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Different from, additional to, or remaining after the person or thing already mentioned.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kigenkhin mi ahih kei leh na hilo; a dang ahih kei leh a la omte.

examples.english: Do you have any other questions?
examples.zomi: Dotna dang na nei lai hiam?

examples.english: One door is open, but the other door is locked.
examples.zomi: Kongkha khat kihong a, kongkha dang khat kikhak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use another with one additional singular item, but use other before plural or uncountable nouns.
senses.usage_zomi: Khat bek a behlap ding ciangin another kizang a, a tam min ahih kei leh simtheih lo min ma-ah other kizang hi.

senses.heading: If not
senses.definition_en: Used to state what will happen if something else does not happen.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tua bang hikei leh; tua lo ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Tua bang hikei leh a piang ding a genna.

common_phrases.zomi: manlang in, tua bang hikei leh …
tua bang hikei leh na ngahlo ding

examples.english: Leave now; otherwise, you will be late.
examples.zomi: Tu in pai in; tua bang hikei leh na zek ding hi.

examples.english: Save the file, otherwise your work may be lost.
examples.zomi: File kem in; tua bang hikei leh na nasep a mangthei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this meaning, otherwise introduces the result of not following the preceding statement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah otherwise in a ma thu zuih lohna pan a piang ding a pulak hi.

senses.heading: In other respects
senses.definition_en: In a different way or in all other respects.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a dang lamah; a dang bangin
senses.explanation_zomi: A dang lamah ahih kei leh a dang bangin.

examples.english: The room is small but otherwise comfortable.
examples.zomi: Tua inndei neu napi, a dang lamah om nuam hi.

examples.english: I believed he was honest, but the evidence suggests otherwise.
examples.zomi: A thumaan mi ka sak napi, teci in a dang bang hong lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether otherwise means “if not” or “in another way.”
senses.usage_zomi: Otherwise in “tua bang hikei leh” maw “a dang bangin” cihna maw cih thu kigenna pan kitel hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to say that something is advisable, morally right, or expected.
