senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sep hoih, sep kilawm ahih kei leh a piang dingin kinem a hihna genna.

examples.english: You ought to apologize to her.
examples.zomi: Ama kiangah ngaihdam ngen ding nahi hi.

examples.english: The bus ought to arrive soon.
examples.zomi: Bus sawtlo in hong tung ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Ought is normally followed by to and a base verb. It is similar to should, though it can sound slightly more formal.
senses.usage_zomi: Ought nungah to leh verb bulpi kizang zel hi. Should tawh khiatna kibang a, a pauzia pen tawmkhat ukna deuh hi.

senses.definition_en: Belonging to or connected with the speaker and one or more other people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Apaute leh amah tawh a omkhawm midangte’ neih ahih kei leh amau tawh kizom.

examples.english: Our children attend the same school.
examples.zomi: Ei tate sanginn khat ah kai uh hi.

examples.english: We must protect our language.
examples.zomi: Ei pau keem ding hihang.

senses.usage_en: Our comes before a noun. Use ours when no noun follows.
senses.usage_zomi: Our pen min ma-ah kizang hi. A nungah min omlo ciangin ours kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: The one or ones belonging to the speaker and one or more other people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Apaute leh amah tawh a omkhawm midangte’ neihna.

examples.english: Their car is new, but ours is old.
examples.zomi: Amau’ mawtaw thak a, ei a pen lui hi.

examples.english: This responsibility is ours.
examples.zomi: Hih vaipuak ei a ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Ours replaces a possessive phrase and is never followed directly by a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Ours in neihna genna khel a, a nungah min kizom pah ngeilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Used when “we” refers back to the same people as the object, or to emphasize “we.”
senses.explanation_zomi: We tawh kigen mite mah a nasepna ngahte a hih ciang ahih kei leh we thupi sakna dingin kizang.

examples.english: We introduced ourselves to the new teacher.
examples.zomi: Sia thak kiangah eimah kimatelsak uh hi.

examples.english: We built the table ourselves.
examples.zomi: Tua sabuai eimahmah in kabawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use ourselves when the subject is we. Do not use it simply as a formal replacement for us.
senses.usage_zomi: Subject pen we ahih ciangin ourselves kizang hi. Us khelna pau ukna khat bangin zang mawk kei in.

senses.heading: Away from inside
senses.definition_en: From inside a place to the outside.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat sung pan pualam ah.

examples.english: She went out to buy some food.
examples.zomi: Annek lei dingin pusuak hi.

examples.english: Please take these boxes out.
examples.zomi: Hih bawm-te pualam ah paipih in.

senses.usage_en: Out often combines with a verb to show movement from an enclosed place.
senses.usage_zomi: Out pen mun kikhak sung pan pualam ah pusuakna lak dingin verb tawh kizom zel hi.

senses.heading: Not at home or work
senses.definition_en: Away from one’s usual place, especially home or work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn ahih kei leh nasepna munah omlo.

examples.english: The manager is out at the moment.
examples.zomi: Tu laitakin manager pusuak hi.

examples.english: We were out all evening.
examples.zomi: Nitak sung khempeuh pualam ah ka om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Be out can also mean that something is unavailable, no longer burning, or no longer functioning; context determines the meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Be out in na khat omlo, mei mit, ahih kei leh na sep nawnlo cihna hithei a; thu kigenna pan khiatna kitel hi.

senses.definition_en: The final result of an action, process, or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna, piangna ahih kei leh kihelna khat tawpna ah a piang thusuak.

examples.english: We were pleased with the outcome of the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna thusuak tungah ka lungkim uh hi.

examples.english: No one can predict the outcome of the election.
examples.zomi: Teelna thusuak kua mah in genkhol theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Outcome refers to what finally happens, especially after a process or uncertain situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Outcome in nasepna khat ahih kei leh a kithei nailo dinmun khat khit a tawpna ah a piang a gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Existing, happening, or used outside rather than inside a building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn sung hilo pualam ah om, kibawl ahih kei leh kizang.

examples.english: The school offers several outdoor activities.
examples.zomi: Sanginn in pualam nasepna pawlkhat bawlsak hi.

examples.english: We bought outdoor furniture for the garden.
examples.zomi: Huansung a koih ding pualam vante kalei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Outdoor is an adjective before a noun. Use outdoors as an adverb.
senses.usage_zomi: Outdoor pen min ma-ah adjective in kizang hi. Adverb dingin outdoors kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Outside a building, in the open air.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn pualam ah, hui lak ah.

examples.english: The children played outdoors all afternoon.
examples.zomi: Nau pangte sun nung sung pualam ah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: I prefer to exercise outdoors.
examples.zomi: Pualam ah pumpi sawlna bawl ka deihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Outdoors describes where an action happens. Do not place it directly before a noun; use outdoor there.
senses.usage_zomi: Outdoors in nasepna a pianna mun a gen hi. Min ma-ah zang kei in; tua munah outdoor zang in.

senses.definition_en: Located on or near the outside of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat pualam ah ahih kei leh pualam tawh nai in om.

examples.english: Remove the outer layer of the onion.
examples.zomi: Vuntek pualam tuam hawhkhia in.

examples.english: The outer wall was damaged in the storm.
examples.zomi: Huipi in pualam kulh susia hi.

senses.usage_en: Outer contrasts with inner. It usually appears directly before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Outer leh inner a kilehbulh hi. A tamzaw in min ma-ah om hi.

senses.heading: General plan or summary
senses.definition_en: A short description of the main ideas or parts of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a thu bulpi leh a khenpite tomkim in a pulaakna.

examples.english: The teacher gave us an outline of the course.
examples.zomi: Sia in sinna geelna tomkim hong pia hi.

examples.english: Write an outline before you begin the essay.
examples.zomi: Essay na gelh ma-in thu bulpi geelmasa in.

senses.usage_en: An outline gives the main structure without including every detail.
senses.usage_zomi: Outline in a kicingin a neute genlo a, thu bulpi leh a khenpite bek a lak hi.

senses.heading: Outer shape
senses.definition_en: The line that shows the outer shape of a person or object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat pualam melmuanna lak lai.

examples.english: We could see the outline of the mountain.
examples.zomi: Mual pualam lim ka mu thei uh hi.

examples.english: Trace the outline of your hand on the paper.
examples.zomi: Lai tungah na khut pualam lim zui in lai suai in.

senses.usage_en: This meaning concerns visible shape, not detailed appearance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in a kicing mel hilo, pualam melmuanna bek a gen hi.

senses.definition_en: On or to the outer side of a building or enclosed place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn ahih kei leh mun kikhak khat pualam ah.

examples.english: The children are playing outside.
examples.zomi: Nau pangte pualam ah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: Please wait outside for a few minutes.
examples.zomi: Minute tawmkhat pualam ah ngak in.

senses.usage_en: As an adverb, outside needs no following noun. Before a noun, it can also function as a preposition: outside the house.
senses.usage_zomi: Adverb a hih ciangin outside nungah min kisamlo hi. Min khat ma-ah preposition in zong kizangthei hi: outside the house.

senses.definition_en: An enclosed appliance used for baking, roasting, or heating food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An um, ankang ahih kei leh an satna dingin mei lum tawh kizang van khak khat.

examples.english: Bake the bread in the oven for thirty minutes.
examples.zomi: Tanghou oven sungah minute sawmthum sung um in.

examples.english: The oven is still hot.
examples.zomi: Oven a lum lai hi.

senses.usage_en: An oven encloses food while heating it. A stove or cooker may include both an oven and cooking surfaces.
senses.usage_zomi: Oven in an a umsungin khak hi. Stove ahih kei leh cooker in oven leh a tunga anhuan theihna a neithei hi.

senses.heading: Above
senses.definition_en: In or to a position higher than something, sometimes covering or crossing it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sangzaw ah, a tunga ah, ahih kei leh a tunga kantan in.

examples.english: A lamp hangs over the table.
examples.zomi: Sabuai tungah khuavak khat kingai hi.

examples.english: The plane flew over the mountains.
examples.zomi: Vanleng mualte tunga leng hi.

senses.usage_en: Over often suggests a higher position, movement across, or coverage. Above mainly indicates a higher position.
senses.usage_zomi: Over in a tungzaw mun, tunga kantanna ahih kei leh a tuamcipna a kawk zel hi. Above in a tungzaw mun bek a kawkzaw hi.

senses.heading: More than
senses.definition_en: More than a stated number, amount, age, or period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kigen zah sangin tamzaw ahih kei leh sawtzaw.

examples.english: Over two hundred people attended the event.
examples.zomi: Tua vaipuak ah mi zahnih val hong pai uh hi.

examples.english: The journey took over three hours.
examples.zomi: Tua khualzinna nai thum val sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: Before a number, over commonly means “more than.”
senses.usage_zomi: Number ma-ah over kizang ciangin “tua zah sang tamzaw” cihna ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: During
senses.definition_en: During a particular period of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ciangtan khat sungin.

examples.english: We discussed the plan over lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun an ka nek laitak un tua geelna ka kikup uh hi.

examples.english: The town has changed greatly over the years.
examples.zomi: Kum tampi sungin tua khua nakpitakin kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: This use of over presents an event as happening within or throughout a period.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih over zatna in piangna khat hun ciangtan sung ahih kei leh tua hun sung khempeuh a piang cih a lak hi.

senses.definition_en: Considering everything or including all parts.
senses.explanation_zomi: A khen khempeuh helkhawm in ahih kei leh thu khempeuh ngaihsun khawm in.

examples.english: The overall result was satisfactory.
examples.zomi: A vekpi thusuak lungkimhuai hi.

examples.english: Our overall costs increased this year.
examples.zomi: Tukum in a vekpi ka sumzat uh kibehlap hi.

senses.usage_en: Overall gives a general judgment after considering every part, even when individual parts differ.
senses.usage_zomi: A khen khat leh khat a kibanglo hang, a khen khempeuh ngaihsun khit a thu kimkhat genna dingin overall kizang hi.

senses.heading: Have to repay
senses.definition_en: To have a duty to pay money or return something received from another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang tung pan sum ahih kei leh na khat laksa a kilehkik dingin leiba nei.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat tungah dollar sawm leiba nei

examples.english: I owe my brother fifty dollars.
examples.zomi: Ka sanggampa tungah dollar sawmnga leiba ka nei hi.

examples.english: How much do we owe you?
examples.zomi: Nang tungah sum bangzah leiba ka nei uh hiam?

senses.usage_en: The usual pattern is owe someone something: “I owe her ten dollars.”
senses.usage_zomi: A ngeina zatdan pen owe someone something ahi hi: “Ama tungah dollar sawm leiba ka nei hi.”

senses.heading: Be grateful or responsible
senses.definition_en: To recognize that someone or something is responsible for a benefit or result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihna ahih kei leh thusuak khat midang hangin kingah cih thei in, ama tungah lungdam leiba nei.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat tungah lungdam leiba nei

examples.english: I owe my success to my teachers.
examples.zomi: Ka gualzawhna ka sia-te hangin ka ngah hi.

examples.english: You owe her an apology.
examples.zomi: Ama kiangah ngaihdam na ngen ding hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense does not always involve money; it can express gratitude, credit, or a duty.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in sum bek huamlo a, lungdamna, minpuakna ahih kei leh sep ding vaipuak zong a huam hi.

senses.definition_en: Belonging specifically to the person or thing mentioned, rather than to anyone else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang a hilo in, kigen mi amah’ neih taktak.

examples.english: Every child has their own bed.
examples.zomi: Nau pang khatciat in ama’ lupna ciat nei hi.

examples.english: She started her own business.
examples.zomi: Ama’ sumleina nasep amah in kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Own follows a possessive word such as my, your, or their to add emphasis.
senses.usage_zomi: Own pen my, your, ahih kei leh their bang neihna kammal nungah om in neihna thupi sak hi.

senses.definition_en: A person or organization that legally possesses something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, inn, sumleina ahih kei leh na khat thukham tawh a nei mi ahih kei leh pawl.

examples.english: The owner of the shop lives nearby.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr neipa nai ah teng hi.

examples.english: Please return the wallet to its owner.
examples.zomi: Sum-ip a neipa kiangah piakkik in.

senses.usage_en: Owner identifies who possesses something; it does not necessarily identify who uses or manages it.
senses.usage_zomi: Owner in na khat a neipa a kawk hi; a zangpa ahih kei leh a ukpa mah ahi kullo hi.

senses.definition_en: Used after a number from one to twelve to state an exact hour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nai khat pan sawmlehnih dong exact hun genna dingin number nungah kizang.

examples.english: The meeting begins at nine o’clock.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna nai kua ciangin kipan ding hi.

examples.english: I usually go to bed at eleven o’clock.
examples.zomi: A ngeina in nai sawmlehkhat ciangin ka lup hi.

senses.usage_en: Use o’clock only for an exact hour, not with minutes: say “six o’clock,” but “six thirty,” not “six thirty o’clock.”
senses.usage_zomi: Nai tak genna bek ah o’clock kizang hi; minute tawh zang kei in: “six o’clock” kici a, “six thirty o’clock” kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Speed of movement or activity
senses.definition_en: The speed at which someone or something moves, works, or develops.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, van khat ahih kei leh nasepna khat a paih manlangna zah.

examples.english: The course allows students to learn at their own pace.
examples.zomi: Hih sinna in sangnaupang-te amau’ sintheih zah ciat tawh sinsak hi.

examples.english: The pace of technological change is increasing.
examples.zomi: Technology kikhelhna manlang semsem hi.

senses.usage_en: At your own pace means at a speed that is comfortable and suitable for you.
senses.usage_zomi: At your own pace cih in nangma ading a nuam leh a kituak manlangna tawh cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A single step
senses.definition_en: One step taken while walking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe tawh paih ciangin kalsuan khat.

examples.english: The gate was only a few paces away.
examples.zomi: Kongpi kalsuan tawmkhat gamla bek ah om hi.

examples.english: He walked three paces forward.
examples.zomi: Mailam ah kalsuan thum pai hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is commonly used to give an approximate short distance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen gamla nailo khat a zat ding ngaihsutna tawh gen ciangin kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Put things into a container
senses.definition_en: To put clothes or other belongings into a bag, box, or container, especially for a journey.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ip sungah koih; bawm sungah kikhum
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzinna ahih kei leh puak dingin puan leh neihsa-te ip, bawm ahih kei leh kuang sungah koih.

examples.english: I packed my clothes the night before the journey.
examples.zomi: Khual ka zinna ding zanma in ka puante ip sungah ka koih hi.

examples.english: Please pack these books in a box.
examples.zomi: Hih laibute bawm sungah koih in.

senses.usage_en: Pack may take the container or its contents as the object: pack a suitcase or pack your clothes.
senses.usage_zomi: Pack tawh van koihna ip ahih kei leh sungah a kikoih nate object in kizangthei hi: pack a suitcase leh pack your clothes.

senses.heading: Fill tightly
senses.definition_en: To fill a place or container with as much as it can hold.
senses.zomi_equivalents: dimtak in khum; cipcip in koih
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih kei leh kuang khat sung dimtak leh cipcip in khum.

examples.english: Fans packed the stadium.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna en mite in kimawlna inn dimsak uh hi.

examples.english: The shelves were packed with books.
examples.zomi: Laibu koihna-te laibu tawh kidim hi.

senses.usage_en: The adjective packed often means extremely full or crowded.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective packed in a tamzaw in na tawh kidim ahih kei leh mi tawh kician cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Wrapped object
senses.definition_en: An object or group of objects wrapped in paper or placed in a box for delivery.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang kiangah paisak dingin lai tawh kituam ahih kei leh bawm sungah kikoih van khat.

examples.english: A package arrived for you this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingin nang ading van tuam khat hong tung hi.

examples.english: She sent the books in a small package.
examples.zomi: Laibute van tuam neu khat tawh paisak hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, package is common for an item sent by mail; British English also commonly uses parcel.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah mail tawh kipaisak van pen package kici zel a, British English ah parcel zong kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Combined set
senses.definition_en: A group of related products, services, or benefits offered together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, nasepna ahih kei leh phattuamna kizomkhawm in a pumkhat bangin kipia.

examples.english: The hotel offers a weekend package.
examples.zomi: Hotel in weekend khualzinna nasepna kigawm khat pia hi.

examples.english: The job includes a good benefits package.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep in phattuamna kigawm hoih huam hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense treats several related items as one complete offer.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in na kizom pawlkhat a pumkhat in kipia cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: One side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, or document.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, magazine ahih kei leh lai sung a lai khat langkhat.

examples.english: The answer is on page twenty.
examples.zomi: Dawhna laimai sawmnih ah om hi.

examples.english: She turned the page and continued reading.
examples.zomi: Laimai leh in sim zom hi.

senses.usage_en: A sheet of paper usually has two pages—one on each side.
senses.usage_zomi: Lai khat in a langnih nei ahih manin, laimai nih nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Physical suffering
senses.definition_en: An unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lianna ahih kei leh natna hangin pumpi ah a kisa natna.

examples.english: She felt a sharp pain in her back.
examples.zomi: A nungah natna hiam mahmah khat sa hi.

examples.english: This medicine may reduce the pain.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui in natna a tawm sakthei hi.

senses.usage_en: Pain can be countable for a particular pain but is often uncountable when discussing suffering generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Natna tuam khat gen ciangin pain simtheih ahi a, pumpi natna a vekpi gen ciangin simtheih lo min in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Emotional suffering
senses.definition_en: Strong sadness or emotional suffering.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungkiatna, dahna ahih kei leh lungsim natna lian.

examples.english: Losing her friend caused her great pain.
examples.zomi: A lawm a sihna in ama’ lungsim nakpitak nasak hi.

examples.english: He tried to hide his pain.
examples.zomi: Ama’ lungsim natna seel ding hahkat hi.

senses.usage_en: Pain may refer to either the body or the emotions; context identifies which one is meant.
senses.usage_zomi: Pain in pumpi natna leh lungsim natna a kawkthei a, thu kigenna pan a khiatna kitel hi.

senses.heading: Causing physical pain
senses.definition_en: Causing or involving physical pain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi nasak ahih kei leh natna nei.

examples.english: The injury was painful for several days.
examples.zomi: Tua liamna ni pawlkhat sung na hi.

examples.english: My knee is painful when I walk.
examples.zomi: Ka pai ciangin ka khuk na hi.

senses.usage_en: Painful describes what causes pain; in pain describes the person who feels it.
senses.usage_zomi: Painful in natna a piangsak na a gen a, in pain in natna a sa mi a gen hi.

senses.heading: Emotionally difficult
senses.definition_en: Causing sadness, embarrassment, or emotional suffering.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dahna, zumna ahih kei leh lungsim natna piangsak.

examples.english: It was a painful decision for the family.
examples.zomi: Tua pen innkuan ading khensat haksa mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: She spoke about her painful childhood.
examples.zomi: Ama’ naupanlai thuak haksatna thu gen hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, painful describes an emotionally distressing experience rather than bodily pain.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah painful in pumpi natna hilo, lungsim a nasak thuakna a gen hi.

senses.heading: Apply color
senses.definition_en: To cover a surface with paint to protect it or change its color.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat a bit ding ahih kei leh a pian khelsak dingin si khut.

common_phrases.zomi: inndei a blue pianin si khut

examples.english: We painted the kitchen white.
examples.zomi: Anhuanna inndei a kang pianin si ka khut uh hi.

examples.english: He is painting the front door.
examples.zomi: Mai kongkha si khut hi.

senses.usage_en: The usual pattern is paint something or paint something a color.
senses.usage_zomi: A ngeina zatdan pen paint something ahih kei leh paint something a color ahi hi.

senses.heading: Create a picture with paint
senses.definition_en: To make a picture by applying paint to a surface.
senses.zomi_equivalents: si tawh lim suai; lim bawl
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai ahih kei leh na khat tungah si zangin lim suai.

examples.english: She painted a picture of the mountains.
examples.zomi: Mualte lim si tawh suai hi.

examples.english: The artist painted him sitting beside a window.
examples.zomi: Limsiampa in ama pen tohlet gei a tutna tawh lim suai hi.

senses.usage_en: Paint uses wet color; draw usually uses a pencil, pen, or similar tool.
senses.usage_zomi: Paint in si tui kizang a, draw in pencil, pen ahih kei leh a kibang van khat kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Artist
senses.definition_en: An artist who creates pictures using paint.
senses.explanation_zomi: Si tawh lim a suai siam mi.

examples.english: She became a successful painter.
examples.zomi: Gualzo limsiampa khat suak hi.

examples.english: The painter showed us his newest work.
examples.zomi: Limsiampa in ama’ lim thakpen hong lak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning refers to an artist who paints pictures.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in si tawh lim a bawl pilna nei mi a gen hi.

senses.heading: Person who paints buildings
senses.definition_en: A worker whose job is to paint walls, buildings, or other surfaces.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kulh, inn leh van dangte si khutna tawh nasem mi.

examples.english: We hired a painter to paint the house.
examples.zomi: Inn si khut dingin si khutpa khat ka guan uh hi.

examples.english: The painter finished the bedroom walls today.
examples.zomi: Si khutpa in tuni in ihmutna inndei kulhte si khut zo hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether a painter is an artist or a building worker.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kigenna pan painter pen limsiampa maw, inn si khutpa maw cih kitel hi.

senses.heading: Picture made with paint
senses.definition_en: A picture created by applying paint to a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai ahih kei leh na khat tungah si tawh kisuai lim.

examples.english: The museum owns several valuable paintings.
examples.zomi: Museum in a manpha si-lim pawlkhat nei hi.

examples.english: This painting shows a village near the river.
examples.zomi: Hih si-lim in gun gei a om khuano khat lak hi.

senses.usage_en: A painting is the finished picture; paint is the colored substance used to make it.
senses.usage_zomi: Painting pen lim bawlkhit ahi a, paint pen lim bawlna a kizang si ahi hi.

senses.heading: Activity of applying paint
senses.definition_en: The activity or work of applying paint to pictures, walls, or other surfaces.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim ahih kei leh van tungah si khutna nasep.

examples.english: Painting the house took three days.
examples.zomi: Inn si khutna ni thum sawt hi.

examples.english: She enjoys painting in her free time.
examples.zomi: Hun awl ciangin si tawh lim suai nuamsa hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning refers to the activity, not the completed picture.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in lim bawlkhit a genlo a, si khutna nasep a gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Two people or things that belong together or are used together.
senses.explanation_zomi: A nihgel in kizang ahih kei leh a nihgel in a kituak mi ahih kei leh na.

examples.english: I bought a new pair of shoes.
examples.zomi: Khedap nihgel thak khat kalei hi.

examples.english: The students worked in pairs.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te nihnih in nasem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Some plural objects, such as trousers, scissors, and glasses, are counted with a pair of.
senses.usage_zomi: Trousers, scissors, leh glasses bang a nihgel na-te sim dingin a pair of kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A large and impressive official home of a king, queen, or other ruler.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpipa, kumpinu ahih kei leh ukpite a tenna inn lian leh hoih mahmah.

examples.english: The king welcomed the visitors at the palace.
examples.zomi: Kumpipa in kumpi inn ah khualliante na sam hi.

examples.english: Thousands of tourists visit the palace each year.
examples.zomi: Kumkhat ciangin khuallian mi tul tampi in kumpi inn veh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A palace is an official grand residence; it is not simply any large house.
senses.usage_zomi: Palace pen kumpi ahih kei leh ukpite’ innpi ahi a, inn lian peuhmah a cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Light in color
senses.definition_en: Having a light or weak color.
senses.explanation_zomi: A pian thuklo leh a taang deuh.

examples.english: She wore a pale blue dress.
examples.zomi: Blue taang puan silh hi.

examples.english: The walls were painted pale yellow.
examples.zomi: Kulhte eng taang pianin si kikhut hi.

senses.usage_en: Pale before a color name means a lighter, less intense form of that color.
senses.usage_zomi: Puan dial min ma-ah pale kizang ciangin tua puan dial a taangzaw leh a thuklo a cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Having little color in the face
senses.definition_en: Having unusually light-colored skin, often because of illness, fear, or shock.
senses.explanation_zomi: Natna, launa ahih kei leh lamdang sakna hangin maitang a kangtaang.

examples.english: You look pale—are you feeling ill?
examples.zomi: Na maitang a kang hi—na cina hiam?

examples.english: He turned pale when he heard the news.
examples.zomi: Tua thu a zak ciangin a maitang kang pah hi.

senses.usage_en: For a person, pale commonly describes an temporary loss of normal facial color.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi tungah pale kizang ciangin maitang pian ngeina a tawmkhat hun sung mang cihna ahi zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A shallow metal container with a handle, used for cooking food.
senses.explanation_zomi: Anhuan dingin kizang, a thuklo leh khut tawh a kipaai theih sum kuang.

examples.english: Heat the oil in a large pan.
examples.zomi: Beel lian khat sungah sathau lum sak in.

examples.english: She fried the eggs in a pan.
examples.zomi: Beel sungah aktui-te kang hi.

senses.usage_en: A pan is usually shallower than a pot and often has a long handle.
senses.usage_zomi: Pan pen pot sangin thuklo zaw a, a tamzaw in khut tawh kipaai theihna sau khat nei hi.

senses.heading: Group of people
senses.definition_en: A small group of people chosen to discuss, judge, or advise on a subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat kikup, thukhen ahih kei leh ngaihsutna pia dingin kiteel mi pawl neu khat.

examples.english: A panel of experts reviewed the proposal.
examples.zomi: Siamna nei pawl khat in tua geelna encian uh hi.

examples.english: She answered questions during the panel discussion.
examples.zomi: Pawl kikupna laitakin dotnate dawng hi.

senses.usage_en: A panel acts as a group, though its members may have different opinions.
senses.usage_zomi: Panel in pawl khat bangin nasem uh a, a sung mite ngaihsutna kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: Flat section of a surface or device
senses.definition_en: A flat or distinct section forming part of a wall, door, machine, or screen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kulh, kongkha, van ahih kei leh screen khat sung a phei leh a khen tuam khat.

examples.english: Use the control panel to start the machine.
examples.zomi: Machine kipat sak dingin ukna panel zang in.

examples.english: Solar panels were installed on the roof.
examples.zomi: Innkhum tungah ni khuavak sumsuahna panel-te kikoih hi.

senses.usage_en: In technology, panel often means a surface containing controls, information, or electronic components.
senses.usage_zomi: Technology ah panel in ukna, thukawng ahih kei leh electronic nate a omna phei a kawk zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A piece of clothing covering the body from the waist to the ankles, with a separate part for each leg.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kawng pan khephah dong tuam a, khe gel ading khen tuam nei puan.

examples.english: He wore a white shirt and black pants.
examples.zomi: Angki kang leh bawngbi vom silh hi.

examples.english: These pants are too tight for me.
examples.zomi: Hih bawngbi keima ading a cip lua hi.

senses.usage_en: Pants is plural in form. In American English it means trousers; in British English, pants can mean underwear.
senses.usage_zomi: Pants pen plural pian nei hi. American English ah bawngbi a cihna ahi a, British English ah sungpuanzong a cihna hithei hi.

senses.heading: Material
senses.definition_en: A thin material made mainly from wood, used for writing, printing, wrapping, and other purposes.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in sing pan kibawl, gelhna, lai khehna leh van tuam na ding a kizang na phei.

examples.english: Write your name on a piece of paper.
examples.zomi: Lai khat tungah na min gelh in.

examples.english: The gift was wrapped in colorful paper.
examples.zomi: Letsong pen lai pian tuamtuam tawh kituam hi.

senses.usage_en: Paper is uncountable for the material. Say a sheet/piece of paper, not normally a paper.
senses.usage_zomi: Lai van a cihna ah paper simtheih lo min ahi hi. A paper sangin a sheet of paper ahih kei leh a piece of paper kici hi.

senses.heading: Written work or publication
senses.definition_en: A written document, academic work, examination, or newspaper.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai kigelh, pilna kancian lai, sittelna lai ahih kei leh daily newspaper.

examples.english: She submitted her research paper yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zani in ama’ kancian lai pia hi.

examples.english: I read about the event in the morning paper.
examples.zomi: Tua piangna thu zing newspaper sungah ka sim hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether paper means an academic document, an exam, or a newspaper.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kigenna pan paper pen kancian lai maw, sittelna lai maw, newspaper maw cih kitel hi.

senses.definition_en: A section of writing containing one or more related sentences about a main idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna bulpi khat gen, sentence khat ahih kei leh a tamzaw kigawm lai khen khat.

examples.english: Each paragraph should have one main idea.
examples.zomi: Lai khen khatciat in ngaihsutna bulpi khat ciat nei ding hi.

examples.english: Read the final paragraph carefully.
examples.zomi: Lai khen nunung kidop takin sim in.

senses.usage_en: Begin a new paragraph when the main idea, speaker, time, or focus changes.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngaihsutna bulpi, apaute, hun ahih kei leh a bulphuh thu a kikhel ciangin lai khen thak kipan ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A mother or father, or a person who has the responsibility of raising a child.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nu ahih kei leh pa, ahih kei leh nau pang khat a khangsak ding vaipuak nei mi.

common_phrases.zomi: nau a khangsak nu ahih kei leh pa khat
nasem nu ahih kei leh pa

examples.english: Every parent wants their child to be safe.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pa khempeuh in amau’ ta bit ding deih uh hi.

examples.english: The school invited parents to the meeting.
examples.zomi: Sanginn in kikhopna ah nu leh pate sam hi.

senses.usage_en: Parent is gender-neutral and may refer to either a mother or a father.
senses.usage_zomi: Parent in numei pasal khenlo a, nu ahih kei leh pa a kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A public area of land with grass, trees, and facilities for recreation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipite khawl, pai, kimawl leh tawldamna dingin sing leh lopa tawh kizek mun.

examples.english: The children played in the park after school.
examples.zomi: Sang khawl khit ciangin nau pangte park sungah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: We had lunch under a tree in the park.
examples.zomi: Park sung singkha nuai ah sun an kane uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A park is generally an open public space. A small private area beside a house is usually called a garden or yard.
senses.usage_zomi: Park pen a tamzaw in mipite zat ding mun zaang ahi hi. Inn gei a om huan neu pen garden ahih kei leh yard kici zel hi.

senses.definition_en: The act of leaving a vehicle in a place for a period, or the space provided for vehicles.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw hun tawmkhat koihna ahih kei leh mawtaw koih ding mun.

examples.english: The hotel provides free parking.
examples.zomi: Hotel in manlo mawtaw koihna pia hi.

examples.english: It is difficult to find parking downtown.
examples.zomi: Khuapi laizang ah mawtaw koihna zon haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: Parking is normally uncountable. Say a parking space for one place where a vehicle can be left.
senses.usage_zomi: Parking pen simtheih lo min ahi zel hi. Mawtaw khat koihna mun gen dingin a parking space kici hi.

senses.definition_en: The national lawmaking body in some countries, made up of elected representatives.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam pawlkhat ah mipite in a teel aiawhte tawh thukham bawl gam ukna pawlpi.

examples.english: Parliament approved the new law.
examples.zomi: Parliament in thukham thak phal hi.

examples.english: She was elected as a member of parliament.
examples.zomi: Parliament member dingin kiteel hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Parliament when it is part of the official name of a particular institution.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam khat ukna pawlpi min taktak a hih ciangin Parliament laimal lian tawh kipan ding hi.

senses.heading: Piece or section
senses.definition_en: One of the pieces, sections, or elements that together form a whole.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na pumkhat a bawlkhawm a khen, a peng ahih kei leh a hiang khat.

examples.english: This chapter is the most difficult part of the book.
examples.zomi: Hih chapter pen laibu sung a khen haksapen ahi hi.

examples.english: The mechanic replaced a broken engine part.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw siammi in engine hiang a kisia khat khelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use part of before the larger whole: part of the book, not normally a part from the book.
senses.usage_zomi: A pum a gen dingin part of kizang hi: part of the book kici a, a part from the book kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Role in an activity or performance
senses.definition_en: A role or share that someone has in an activity, event, or performance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna, vaipuak ahih kei leh limlakna khat sungah mi khat a sep ding mun leh vaipuak.

examples.english: Everyone played a part in the project’s success.
examples.zomi: Tua project gualzawhna ah mi khempeuh in vaipuak nei uh hi.

examples.english: She took part in the school play.
examples.zomi: Sanginn limlakna ah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: Take part in means to participate. Play a part in means to contribute to a result or have a role.
senses.usage_zomi: Take part in in kihel cihna ahi a, play a part in in thusuak khat piansakna ah panlak ahih kei leh vaipuak nei cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who takes part in an activity, event, or study.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna, vaipuak ahih kei leh kancian na khat sungah a kihel mi.

examples.english: Each participant received a certificate.
examples.zomi: Kihel mi khatciat in teci lai khat ciat ngah uh hi.

examples.english: The study included two hundred participants.
examples.zomi: Tua kancian na sungah mi zahnih kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A participant actively takes part in something, rather than merely watching it.
senses.usage_zomi: Participant pen a en bek hilo in, nasepna khat sungah a kihel taktak mi ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To take part in an activity, event, or discussion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna, vaipuak ahih kei leh kikupna khat sungah kihel in panla.

examples.english: All students are encouraged to participate in the discussion.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang khempeuh kikupna ah kihel dingin kihanthawn hi.

examples.english: Thirty countries participated in the competition.
examples.zomi: Tua kidemna ah gam sawmthum kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Participate is normally followed by in: participate in an activity, not participate an activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Participate nungah in kizang zel hi: participate in an activity kici a, participate an activity kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Specific
senses.definition_en: Referring to one specific person, thing, place, or time rather than others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na, mun ahih kei leh hun dangte lakpan khat bek a gen.

examples.english: Is there any particular reason for your decision?
examples.zomi: Na khensatna ading hang tuam khat a om hiam?

examples.english: She was looking for a particular book.
examples.zomi: Laibu tuam khat zong hi.

senses.usage_en: Particular often narrows a general group to one specific member or case.
senses.usage_zomi: Particular in pawlpi khat sungpan mi ahih kei leh na tuam khat bek a kawk hi.

senses.heading: Careful about preferences
senses.definition_en: Having strong preferences and wanting things to be done in a certain way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hihdan ding a kician nei a, a ut bang hilo peuhmah tawh lungkimlo.

common_phrases.zomi: an nek thu ah teel mahmah

examples.english: He is very particular about his clothes.
examples.zomi: Ama silh puan thu ah teel mahmah hi.

examples.english: Our manager is particular about accuracy.
examples.zomi: Ka manager uh in a maan taktak ding thupi ngaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: Particular about can suggest careful standards or difficulty in being satisfied.
senses.usage_zomi: Particular about in kician takin deihna a neihna ahih kei leh lungkim baihlo a hihna a kawkthei hi.

senses.definition_en: Especially or more than usual.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a diak in; a kician in
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in ahih kei leh a dangte sangin deihzaw deuh.

examples.english: This chapter is particularly important.
examples.zomi: Hih chapter a diak in poimaw hi.

examples.english: I particularly enjoyed the final song.
examples.zomi: La nunungpen ka nuamsak diak hi.

senses.usage_en: Particularly emphasizes one person or thing within a wider group.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawl khat sungpan mi ahih kei leh na khat a thupizaw ahihna lak dingin particularly kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: To some degree but not completely, or in part rather than as a whole.
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi hilo, a khenkhat bek ahih kei leh tawmkhat ciang bek.

examples.english: The road was partly blocked by snow.
examples.zomi: Vuk in lampi a khenkhat dal hi.

examples.english: I accepted the job partly because of the salary.
examples.zomi: Lohman hang tawmkhat tawh tua nasep ka sang hi.

senses.usage_en: Partly means “not completely.” Do not confuse it with particularly, which means “especially.”
senses.usage_zomi: Partly in “a vekpi hilo” cihna ahi hi. “A diak in” a cihna particularly tawh kitelkhial sak kei in.

senses.heading: Person who works with another
senses.definition_en: A person or organization that works with another toward a shared goal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna khat nei in midang ahih kei leh pawl dang tawh nasemkhawm mi ahih kei leh pawl.

examples.english: She started the company with a business partner.
examples.zomi: Sumleina nasemkhawmpa khat tawh company kipan hi.

examples.english: Our organization works with several local partners.
examples.zomi: Ka kipawlna un khuami pawl pawlkhat tawh nasemkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A business partner may share ownership, responsibility, and profit.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumleina partner in neihna, vaipuak leh metna a kikhenpih thei hi.

senses.heading: Person in a relationship
senses.definition_en: A person’s spouse or the person with whom they have a close romantic relationship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ zi ahih kei leh pasal, ahih kei leh itna tawh a kizom khat.

examples.english: You should discuss the decision with your partner.
examples.zomi: Tua khensatna na nuntakpih tawh kikup ding nahi hi.

examples.english: Her partner attended the ceremony with her.
examples.zomi: Ama’ nuntakpih in ama tawh pawi ah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: Partner is a gender-neutral word and may refer to a spouse or an unmarried romantic partner.
senses.usage_zomi: Partner in numei pasal a khenlo kammal ahi a, nupa ahih kei leh kiteng nailo itna tawh kizom mi a kawkthei hi.

senses.heading: Social event
senses.definition_en: A social gathering where people eat, drink, talk, dance, or celebrate.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi kikhawm in an ne, dawn, kikup, laam ahih kei leh pawi bawlna.

examples.english: We held a party for her birthday.
examples.zomi: Ama’ suahni ading pawi ka bawl uh hi.

examples.english: Everyone enjoyed the party.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in pawi nuamsa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Have a party means to organize or attend a social celebration.
senses.usage_zomi: Have a party in nopbawlna pawi khat bawl ahih kei leh tua pawi ah kihel cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Political organization
senses.definition_en: An organized political group whose members share aims and seek governmental power.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam ukna ngaihsutna leh ngimna kibang nei in kumpi ukna ngah ding a pang gamvai pawl.

examples.english: She joined a political party in college.
examples.zomi: College ah a sin laitakin gamvai pawl khat sungah lut hi.

examples.english: The ruling party won the election.
examples.zomi: Ukna a nei pawl in teelna zaw hi.

senses.usage_en: When party means a political organization, context usually includes elections, government, or politics.
senses.usage_zomi: Party in gamvai pawl a cihna ciangin teelna, kumpi ukna ahih kei leh gamvai thu tawh kizom zel hi.

senses.heading: Move past or through
senses.definition_en: To move past a person or place, or to go through an area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh mun khat kantan, a gei pan pai ahih kei leh sungah pai.

examples.english: The bus passes our house every morning.
examples.zomi: Zing khempeuh in bus ka inn uh kantan hi.

examples.english: We passed through several villages.
examples.zomi: Khuano pawlkhat sung ka kantan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Pass can describe movement beside, beyond, or through something.
senses.usage_zomi: Pass in na khat gei pan, a pualam ahih kei leh a sung kantan in paihna a gen hi.

senses.heading: Succeed in a test
senses.definition_en: To achieve the required standard in an examination, test, or course.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sittelna ahih kei leh sinna khat ah kisap zah ciang tangzo.

examples.english: She studied hard and passed the exam.
examples.zomi: Hanciam takin sin a, sittelna tang hi.

examples.english: You need seventy percent to pass.
examples.zomi: Na tan dingin za-ah sawmsagih na kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Pass an exam means succeed in it. Take an exam means sit and complete it.
senses.usage_zomi: Pass an exam in sittelna tang cihna ahi a, take an exam in sittelna bawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Give something to another person
senses.definition_en: To hand or move something to another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat mi dang kiangah pia ahih kei leh khutsawn.

examples.english: Please pass me the salt.
examples.zomi: Ci hong pia in.

examples.english: He passed the ball to his teammate.
examples.zomi: Ama’ kimawlpih kiangah go khutsawn hi.

senses.usage_en: The common pattern is pass someone something or pass something to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: A ngeina zatdan pen pass someone something ahih kei leh pass something to someone ahi hi.

senses.heading: Time goes by
senses.definition_en: To go by or elapse.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun a bei in a khin.

examples.english: Time passes quickly when we are busy.
examples.zomi: Nasem tampi ciangin hun manlang takin bei hi.

examples.english: Several weeks passed before she replied.
examples.zomi: Ama’ dawnma in kaal pawlkhat khin hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, time is normally the subject of pass.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah hun pen pass a sem subject ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Section of writing
senses.definition_en: A short section taken from a book, article, speech, or other text.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, article, thugen ahih kei leh lai dang sungpan lai khen tom khat.

examples.english: Read the passage and answer the questions.
examples.zomi: Lai khen sim inla, dotnate dawng in.

examples.english: The teacher explained a difficult passage.
examples.zomi: Sia in lai khen haksa khat hilhcian hi.

senses.usage_en: A passage is usually longer than a sentence but shorter than a complete work.
senses.usage_zomi: Passage pen sentence khat sangin sauzaw a, lai kigelh buppi sangin tomzaw hi.

senses.heading: Way through or movement
senses.definition_en: A narrow way through a place, or the act of moving through it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat sung kantanna lampi neu ahih kei leh tua mun kantanna.

examples.english: A narrow passage led to the back room.
examples.zomi: Kantanna lampi cik khat in nunglam inndei zuan hi.

examples.english: The agreement guaranteed safe passage across the border.
examples.zomi: Kilemna in gamgi kantanna bit hong kipsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether passage means written text, a physical route, or movement through somewhere.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kigenna pan passage pen lai khen maw, kantanna lampi maw, mun khat kantanna maw cih kitel hi.

senses.definition_en: A person traveling in a vehicle who is not driving or operating it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw, bus, vanleng ahih kei leh tembaw tawh khualzin a, tua van a hawl hilo mi.

examples.english: The bus was carrying forty passengers.
examples.zomi: Bus in tuangmi sawmli pua hi.

examples.english: All passengers must wear seat belts.
examples.zomi: Tuangmi khempeuh in seat belt khih ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A driver or crew member is not normally called a passenger while working.
senses.usage_zomi: Mawtaw hawlpa ahih kei leh van tung a nasem mite nasep laitakin passenger kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Strong enthusiasm
senses.definition_en: A very strong interest in or enthusiasm for an activity, subject, or cause.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna, pilna thu ahih kei leh ngimna khat tungah lungsim takpi tawh deihna leh phatuamngaihna lian.

examples.english: She has a passion for teaching children.
examples.zomi: Nau pangte hilhna tungah lunggulhna lian nei hi.

examples.english: His passion for music began in childhood.
examples.zomi: La tung a ama’ lunggulhna naupanlai pan kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: A passion for something means an intense, lasting enthusiasm, not merely a temporary preference.
senses.usage_zomi: A passion for something in hun tawmkhat sung deihna bek hilo, lungsim sungpan lunggulhna lian leh sawt a kawk hi.

senses.heading: Powerful emotion
senses.definition_en: A strong feeling such as love, anger, or desire.
senses.explanation_zomi: Itna, hehna ahih kei leh deihna bang lungsim sukna thahat.

examples.english: His voice was filled with passion.
examples.zomi: Ama’ aw lungsim sukna lian tawh kidim hi.

examples.english: Strong passion can sometimes affect judgment.
examples.zomi: Lungsim sukna lian in khensiamna khatveivei huzaap thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is broader than romantic love and may describe several powerful emotions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in nulehpa itna bek hilo, lungsim sukna thahat tuamtuam a huam hi.

senses.definition_en: An official document that identifies a person and permits international travel.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat kua ahih cih kipsak a, gam khat pan gam dangah khualzin theihna a pia ukna lai.

common_phrases.zomi: a zat hun bei nailo passport

examples.english: You need a valid passport to enter the country.
examples.zomi: Tua gam na lut dingin a zat hun bei nailo passport na kisam hi.

examples.english: She applied for a new passport.
examples.zomi: Passport thak ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: A passport proves identity and nationality; a visa gives permission to enter or stay in a particular country.
senses.usage_zomi: Passport in mi khat kua leh bang gammi ahih cih kipsak a, visa in gam tuam khat sung lut ahih kei leh omtheihna pia hi.

senses.definition_en: Belonging to an earlier time or having happened before now.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu hunma a om, a piangkhinta ahih kei leh a beisa.

examples.english: We can learn from past mistakes.
examples.zomi: Khialhna beisate pan pilna lahtheih hi.

examples.english: Past experience helped her make the decision.
examples.zomi: Ama’ thuakna beisa in khensatna bawl ding huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Past as an adjective comes before a noun. Last year means the year immediately before this one; past years may refer to several earlier years.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective past pen min ma-ah om hi. Last year in kum khat beisa bek a kawk a, past years in kum beisa pawlkhat a kawkthei hi.

senses.heading: Track for walking
senses.definition_en: A narrow track or way for people to walk along.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi paihna ding lampi neu.

examples.english: A narrow path leads through the forest.
examples.zomi: Lampi neu khat gam sungah pai hi.

examples.english: Stay on the path for your safety.
examples.zomi: Na bitna dingin lampi pan pial kei in.

senses.usage_en: A path is usually narrower and less developed than a road.
senses.usage_zomi: Path pen lampi lian sangin cikzaw a, a tamzaw in mawtaw paihna dingin kibawl lo hi.

senses.heading: Direction toward a result
senses.definition_en: A course of action or development leading toward a particular result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna ahih kei leh thusuak tuam khat zuan a paipih nasepna lampi.

examples.english: Education can provide a path out of poverty.
examples.zomi: Pilna in zawngkhalna pan suahtakna lampi hong pia thei hi.

examples.english: She chose a different career path.
examples.zomi: Nasepna maipanna dang khat teel hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes progress through life, work, or a process.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkakna khiatna in nuntakna, nasep ahih kei leh nasep kalsuan ah maipanna a gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A person receiving medical care or treatment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siavuan, zatui siam ahih kei leh cidamna mun pan cidamna huhna ngah mi.

examples.english: The doctor examined the patient carefully.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in cinapa kidop takin sittel hi.

examples.english: The hospital can care for fifty patients.
examples.zomi: Hospital in cinapa sawmnga kemthei hi.

senses.usage_en: As a noun, patient means someone receiving medical care. As an adjective, patient means able to wait calmly.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun a hih ciangin patient pen cidamna huhna ngah mi ahi hi. Adjective a hih ciangin lungduai takin ngakthei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Repeated design
senses.definition_en: A repeated arrangement of lines, shapes, colors, or other decorative elements.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, lim, puan dial ahih kei leh zeetna-te kibang tawntung in a kizuihzia.

examples.english: The cloth has a red and black pattern.
examples.zomi: Tua puan in san leh vom lim kizui nei hi.

examples.english: She drew a simple pattern on the wall.
examples.zomi: Kulh tungah lim kizui baihlam khat suai hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense refers to a visible design formed by repeated elements.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in lim ahih kei leh puan dial a kizui thupitak a kimu zeetdan a gen hi.

senses.heading: Regular way something happens
senses.definition_en: A regular or repeated way in which something happens or is done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a piang ahih kei leh a kibawl kikkik ngeina dan.

examples.english: The researchers noticed a clear pattern in the data.
examples.zomi: Kanciante in data sungah piang ngeina kician khat mu uh hi.

examples.english: Stress can change your sleep pattern.
examples.zomi: Lungsim gimna in na ihmut ngeina a khelsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A pattern helps people recognize or predict repeated behavior or events.
senses.usage_zomi: Pattern in gamtatna ahih kei leh piangna kikkik muhkhiat leh genkhol theihna hong pia hi.

senses.heading: Give money for something
senses.definition_en: To give money for goods, services, work, or a debt.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, nasepna, nasempa loh ahih kei leh leiba ading sum pia.

examples.english: I paid the electricity bill online.
examples.zomi: Meivak man online tawh kapia hi.

examples.english: Who will pay for the meal?
examples.zomi: An man kua in pia ding hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use pay for something, but pay someone: “pay for the meal” and “pay the waiter.”
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat man piak ciangin pay for something kici a, mi khat sum piak ciangin pay someone kici hi.

senses.heading: Give a benefit or result
senses.definition_en: To produce a worthwhile result or benefit in return for effort, time, or money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna, hun ahih kei leh sum zatna hangin phattuamna ahih kei leh thusuak hoih ngah.

examples.english: Her years of hard work finally paid off.
examples.zomi: Ama’ kum tampi hanciamna in a tawpna ah gahpha suah hi.

examples.english: It pays to compare prices before buying.
examples.zomi: Na lei ma-in a man etkakna phattuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Pay off may mean producing a good result or completely repaying a debt.
senses.usage_zomi: Pay off in thusuak hoih ngah cihna hithei a, leiba vekpi piak zo cihna zong hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: Money paid or the act of paying for something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, nasepna ahih kei leh leiba ading sum kipia, ahih kei leh sum piakna.

examples.english: Your monthly payment is due tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Na kha sum piak ding pen zingciang a hun ahi hi.

examples.english: The store accepts payment by card.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr in card tawh sum piakna sang hi.

senses.usage_en: Payment may mean the money itself or the action of paying it.
senses.usage_zomi: Payment in sum kipia amah ahih kei leh sum piakna nasep a cihna hithei hi.

senses.heading: Freedom from war or violence
senses.definition_en: A condition in which there is no war, fighting, or serious violence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gal, kidouna ahih kei leh ngongtatna lian omlo dinmun.

examples.english: The two countries signed a peace agreement.
examples.zomi: Tua gam nih in nopna kilemna lai min gelh uh hi.

examples.english: The community hopes for lasting peace.
examples.zomi: Khuamite in a kip nopna lamen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Peace is normally uncountable when it means the absence of war or violence.
senses.usage_zomi: Gal leh ngongtatna omlona a cihna ah peace simtheih lo min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Calm and quiet
senses.definition_en: A state of calm, quiet, and freedom from worry or disturbance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungbuaina leh buaina omlo in lungnop leh dai takin omna.

examples.english: The quiet garden gave her a sense of peace.
examples.zomi: Huan dai in ama’ lungsim nopsak hi.

examples.english: I need a little peace and quiet to work.
examples.zomi: Ka nasep theihna ding dai leh lungnopna tawmkhat ka kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Peace of mind means freedom from anxiety or worry.
senses.usage_zomi: Peace of mind in lungkhamna leh lungbuaina pan suahtak lungsim nopna a cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Without war or violence
senses.definition_en: Free from war, fighting, or violence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gal, kidouna leh ngongtatna omlo.

examples.english: The groups are seeking a peaceful solution.
examples.zomi: Pawlte in kidouna omlo dawnna zong uh hi.

examples.english: The protest remained peaceful.
examples.zomi: Deihna pulakna pen ngongtatna omlo in om hi.

senses.usage_en: A peaceful protest expresses disagreement without violence.
senses.usage_zomi: Peaceful protest in ngongtatna zanglo in deihna leh nialna pulak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Calm and quiet
senses.definition_en: Calm, quiet, and not disturbed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dai, lungnop leh buaina omlo.

examples.english: We spent a peaceful evening at home.
examples.zomi: Inn ah nitak lungnop huai takin hun ka zang uh hi.

examples.english: The lake is peaceful early in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zing matahin dil dai mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday descriptions, peaceful often means pleasantly calm and quiet.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim pau ah peaceful in nuam takin dai leh lungnop huai cihna ahi zel hi.

senses.definition_en: An instrument containing ink, used for writing or drawing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai gelh ahih kei leh lim suai dingin a sungah lai-aat tui nei gelhna van.

examples.english: Please sign the form with a black pen.
examples.zomi: Form tungah pen vom tawh min gelh in.

examples.english: My pen has run out of ink.
examples.zomi: Ka pen lai-aat tui bei hi.

senses.usage_en: Writing done in pen is usually harder to erase than writing done in pencil.
senses.usage_zomi: Pen tawh kigelh lai pen pencil tawh kigelh lai sangin nulkik haksa zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: An instrument containing graphite or colored material, used for writing or drawing and usually erasable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai gelh leh lim suai dingin a sungah graphite ahih kei leh puan dial nei, nulkik theih gelhna van.

examples.english: Draw the diagram with a pencil.
examples.zomi: Diagram pencil tawh suai in.

examples.english: The child sharpened her pencil.
examples.zomi: Nau pang in ama’ pencil hiamsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use in pencil to describe writing or drawing made with a pencil.
senses.usage_zomi: Pencil tawh kigelh ahih kei leh kisuai a gen dingin in pencil kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A coin worth one cent in the United States, or one hundredth of a pound in the United Kingdom.
senses.explanation_zomi: United States ah cent khat man, ahih kei leh United Kingdom ah pound khat a za-a-khen-khat man sum tang.

examples.english: He found a penny on the floor.
examples.zomi: Lei ah penny khat mu hi.

examples.english: She saved every penny she earned.
examples.zomi: Ama’ sum muh khempeuh khol hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is pennies for individual coins. In British currency, pence is used when stating an amount.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum tang khatciat sim ciangin plural pen pennies ahi hi. British sum zatna ah sumzah gen ciangin pence kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Regular money paid to someone after retirement, or sometimes because of age, disability, or previous service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep pan khawlkhit, kum upat, pumpi cinglo ahih kei leh nasepna beisa hangin hun ciangtan khatciat a kipia sum.

examples.english: She receives a pension every month.
examples.zomi: Kha khat ciangin pension ngah hi.

examples.english: He contributed to the pension plan for thirty years.
examples.zomi: Kum sawmthum sung pension geelna ah sum pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A pension generally provides income after retirement. It differs from personal savings, although both may support retirement.
senses.usage_zomi: Pension in a tamzaw in nasep khawlkhit nuntakna sum hong pia hi. Mimal sumkhol tawh kibanglo napi, a nihgel in nasep khawlkhit nuntakna a panpih thei hi.

senses.heading: Persons in general
senses.definition_en: Human beings considered as a group, or the men, women, and children in a particular place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihingte a vekpi, ahih kei leh mun tuam khat ah a om pasal, numei leh nau pangte.

examples.english: Many people use the internet every day.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi in ni simin internet zang uh hi.

examples.english: The local people welcomed the visitors warmly.
examples.zomi: Khuamite in khualliante lungdam takin na sam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: People is the usual plural of person. Say one person but two people.
senses.usage_zomi: People pen person a ngeina plural ahi hi. Mi khat dingin one person kici a, mi nih dingin two people kici hi.

senses.heading: Nation or ethnic community
senses.definition_en: A community whose members share a country, culture, history, or ethnic identity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam, ngeina, tangthu ahih kei leh nam kibang a neikhawm mihing pawl.

examples.english: The Zomi people have a rich cultural heritage.
examples.zomi: Zomi nam in ngeina gamtatna neihsa manpha nei hi.

examples.english: The museum presents the history of several Indigenous peoples.
examples.zomi: Museum in gamnei nam pawlkhat tangthu lak hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural peoples is used mainly for several distinct nations or ethnic communities.
senses.usage_zomi: Nam tuamtuam pawlkhat genkhawm ciangin plural peoples kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Seasoning
senses.definition_en: A hot-tasting powder made from dried peppercorns and used to season food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An limsak dingin a kizang, pepper gah vuahsa pan kibawl a kha deuh khuamna.

examples.english: Add a little salt and pepper to the soup.
examples.zomi: Thuh sungah ci leh pepper tawmkhat behlap in.

examples.english: This sauce contains black pepper.
examples.zomi: Hih saws sungah pepper vom om hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, pepper is normally uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuamna vuah a cihna ah pepper simtheih lo min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Vegetable
senses.definition_en: A hollow vegetable with seeds inside, available in sweet or hot varieties.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sung awng leh a sungah ci nei, a lim ahih kei leh a kha nam tuamtuam a om singgah.

examples.english: She sliced a red pepper for the salad.
examples.zomi: Salad dingin pepper san khat aat hi.

examples.english: These peppers are very hot.
examples.zomi: Hih pepper-te a kha mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly calls the mild vegetable a bell pepper. Hot pepper refers to spicy varieties.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah a lim deuh pen bell pepper kici zel a, a kha namte hot pepper kici hi.

senses.definition_en: For each person, thing, unit, or period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na, tehna ahih kei leh hun khatciat ading.

examples.english: The tickets cost twenty dollars per person.
examples.zomi: Ticket man mi khatciat in dollar sawmnih ahi hi.

examples.english: The machine produces one hundred bottles per hour.
examples.zomi: Machine in nai khat ciangin bottle za khat bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Per is common with rates and measurements. It has a more formal tone than a in expressions such as twice a week.
senses.usage_zomi: Zah ciangciang leh tehna genna ah per kizang zel hi. Twice a week bang zatdan a a sangin ukna deuh hi.

senses.definition_en: An amount expressed as a number out of one hundred.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat za-a-khen bangzah ahih cih tawh kilak zah.

examples.english: A high percentage of students passed the examination.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang za-a-khen sang tak in sittelna tang uh hi.

examples.english: The percentage increased from forty to fifty.
examples.zomi: Za-a-khen sawmli pan sawmnga ah khang hi.

senses.usage_en: A percentage is the proportion itself; per cent follows a number: a high percentage but fifty per cent.
senses.usage_zomi: Percentage pen za-a-khen zah a cihna ahi a, per cent pen number nungah kizang hi: a high percentage leh fifty per cent.

senses.heading: Without faults
senses.definition_en: Completely correct or free from faults and weaknesses.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna, puudahna ahih kei leh thanemna bangmah omlo in a kicing.

examples.english: The machine is still in perfect condition.
examples.zomi: Machine a kicing dinmun ah om lai hi.

examples.english: No translation is perfect without careful review.
examples.zomi: Kidop takin encian lo leh letkhiatna bangmah a kicing theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Perfect expresses the highest possible standard, so words such as very perfect are generally avoided.
senses.usage_zomi: Perfect in a sangpen dinmun a kawk khin ahih manin, very perfect bang kammal kigawm a tamzaw in kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: Exactly suitable
senses.definition_en: Exactly right or especially suitable for a person, purpose, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ngimna ahih kei leh dinmun khat ading kituak taktak.

examples.english: This room is perfect for a small meeting.
examples.zomi: Hih inndei pen kikhopna neu khat ading kituak taktak hi.

examples.english: She is the perfect person for the position.
examples.zomi: Tua mun ading amah a kituakpen mi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday speech, perfect often means “exactly suitable,” not literally without any fault.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim pau ah perfect in puudahna bangmah omlo cih sangin, “kituak taktak” cihna in kizang pha zaw hi.

senses.heading: Without error
senses.definition_en: In a completely correct or faultless way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kicing takin; khialhna omlo in
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna bangmah omlo leh a kicing takin.

examples.english: The new system is working perfectly.
examples.zomi: System thak a kicing takin nasem hi.

examples.english: The key fits the lock perfectly.
examples.zomi: Tawh a khakna tawh a kituak kicing hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes an action or condition with no noticeable fault.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in nasepna ahih kei leh dinmun khat puudahna kimu omlo cih a gen hi.

senses.heading: Completely
senses.definition_en: Completely or in every way, often used for emphasis.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a vekpi in; a taktak in
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi in ahih kei leh a taktak in.

examples.english: Your question is perfectly reasonable.
examples.zomi: Na dotna pen a kilawm taktak hi.

examples.english: It is perfectly normal to feel nervous.
examples.zomi: Lungkham tawmkhat pen a ngeina taktak ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Before some adjectives, perfectly acts as an intensifier meaning “completely.”
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective pawlkhat ma-ah perfectly kizang ciangin “a vekpi in” ahih kei leh “a taktak in” cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Entertain an audience
senses.definition_en: To sing, act, dance, or play music for an audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: En mite ma-ah la sa, lim lak, laam ahih kei leh tumging tum.

examples.english: The band will perform tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zan in la pawl la sa ding hi.

examples.english: She performed the leading role in the play.
examples.zomi: Limlakna ah meelpuak lianpen tawh lim lak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may be used transitively (perform a song) or without an object (perform tonight).
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen object tawh perform a song kici thei a, object omlo in perform tonight zong kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Carry out a task
senses.definition_en: To carry out a task, action, duty, or procedure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, gamtatna, vaipuak ahih kei leh sep kalsuan khat sem.

examples.english: The surgeon performed the operation successfully.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in zatui lamna gualzo takin bawl hi.

examples.english: The computer can perform several tasks at once.
examples.zomi: Computer in nasep pawlkhat khatvei in semthei hi.

senses.usage_en: Perform is more formal than do and commonly appears with duties, tests, operations, and procedures.
senses.usage_zomi: Perform pen do sangin ukna deuh a, vaipuak, sittelna, zatui lamna leh sep kalsuan tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Function
senses.definition_en: To work or achieve results at a particular level.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na sem ahih kei leh dinmun tuam khat ciang thusuak nei.

examples.english: The team performed well under pressure.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl in haksatna nuai ah zong nasem hoih hi.

examples.english: The engine did not perform as expected.
examples.zomi: Engine in kilamen bangin na semlo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, perform describes how successfully a person, team, machine, or investment functions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mi, pawl, machine ahih kei leh sum koihna khat bangzah in gualzo takin na sem cih a gen hi.

senses.heading: Entertainment presented to an audience
senses.definition_en: An act of singing, acting, dancing, or playing music for an audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: En mite ma-ah la sak, lim lak, laam ahih kei leh tumging tumna.

examples.english: The evening performance begins at seven.
examples.zomi: Nitak limlakna nai sagih ciangin kipan hi.

examples.english: Her performance received loud applause.
examples.zomi: Ama’ limlakna pen khutbetna lian tawh kipha hi.

senses.usage_en: This countable sense refers to one show or presentation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih simtheih khiatna in pawi ahih kei leh limlakna khat a kawk hi.

senses.heading: Quality of work or functioning
senses.definition_en: How well or badly a person, organization, machine, or investment works.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, machine ahih kei leh sum koihna khat’ nasep hoihna leh thusuahna dinmun.

examples.english: The manager reviewed each employee’s performance.
examples.zomi: Manager in nasem khatciat nasepzia encian hi.

examples.english: Regular maintenance improves engine performance.
examples.zomi: Hun ciangtan kizui a etkolna in engine nasepzia hoih sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is often uncountable when discussing general quality or efficiency.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep hoihna ahih kei leh siamzawhna a vekpi gen ciangin hih khiatna simtheih lo min in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Possibly, but not certainly.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a hi kha ding; hileh kha ding
senses.explanation_zomi: A hi kha ding, ahihhang kician takin kithei nailo.

common_phrases.zomi: a nung ciang hileh kha ding
a hang pen … hi kha ding

examples.english: Perhaps we should wait until tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zingciang dong kingak leng hoih kha ding hi.

examples.english: She is perhaps the most experienced person here.
examples.zomi: Hih munah amah thuakna neipen mi hi kha ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Perhaps is similar to maybe. Perhaps can sound slightly more formal.
senses.usage_zomi: Perhaps leh maybe khiatna kibang hi. Perhaps pen ukna tawmkhat deuh in gingthei hi.

senses.heading: Length of time
senses.definition_en: A particular length or section of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ciangtan ahih kei leh hun khen tuam khat.

examples.english: The museum will close for a short period.
examples.zomi: Museum hun tom sung khak ding hi.

examples.english: The economy grew rapidly during this period.
examples.zomi: Hih hun sungin sumvai manlang takin khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use for a period of before a stated length of time: for a period of six months.
senses.usage_zomi: Hun sawtzah genma in for a period of kizangthei hi: for a period of six months.

senses.heading: Stage in history or life
senses.definition_en: A distinct stage in history, development, or a person’s life.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu, khantohna ahih kei leh mimal nuntakna sung a hun khen tuam khat.

examples.english: The book describes an important period in history.
examples.zomi: Laibu in tangthu sung a hun khen poimaw khat gen hi.

examples.english: Teenage years can be a difficult period.
examples.zomi: Khangnote hun pen hun haksa khat hithei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense treats time as a recognizable stage with particular characteristics.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in hun khat pen a meltheih ngeina leh omzia nei khang hun tuam khat bangin lak hi.

senses.heading: Punctuation mark
senses.definition_en: The mark (.) used at the end of a statement or in some abbreviations and numbers.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu genkhitna leh kammal tomgelhna pawlkhat ah a kizang lai-ciam (.).

examples.english: Put a period at the end of the sentence.
examples.zomi: Sentence tawpna ah period koih in.

examples.english: Every statement should end with a period.
examples.zomi: Thu kigen sentence khatciat period tawh tawp ding hi.

senses.usage_en: British English usually calls this punctuation mark a full stop.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah hih lai-ciam pen full stop kici zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Intended to last indefinitely and not expected to change or end.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tom sung bek hilo, sawtpi a om ding leh bei dingin kilamen lo.

examples.english: She is looking for a permanent job.
examples.zomi: Nasep kip khat zong hi.

examples.english: The accident caused permanent damage to his eye.
examples.zomi: Tua accident in ama’ mit damsak kiktheih lo liamsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Permanent contrasts with temporary. It does not always mean literally forever, but it suggests no planned ending.
senses.usage_zomi: Permanent leh temporary a kilehbulh hi. Tawntung taktak cihna ahi pahpah lo napi, tawp hun kigeel lo cihna a nei hi.

senses.definition_en: Approval that allows someone to do, use, or enter something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in na khat sem, zang ahih kei leh mun khat lut thei dingin phalna kipia.

examples.english: You need permission to use this photograph.
examples.zomi: Hih lim na zat dingin phalna na kisam hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave us permission to leave early.
examples.zomi: Sia in ka tawmma in ka paikhiat theihna ding uh phalna hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Permission is normally uncountable. Say ask for permission, not ask a permission.
senses.usage_zomi: Permission pen simtheih lo min ahi zel hi. Ask a permission sangin ask for permission kici hi.

senses.definition_en: To officially allow someone to do something or allow something to happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat na khat sem ding ahih kei leh na khat piang ding thuneihna tawh phal.

examples.english: The rules do not permit smoking inside the building.
examples.zomi: Thukhun in inn sungah khuak zu phallo hi.

examples.english: Visitors are permitted to take photographs.
examples.zomi: Khualliante limla phal hi.

senses.usage_en: The usual pattern is permit someone to do something. Permit is more formal than allow.
senses.usage_zomi: A ngeina zatdan pen permit someone to do something ahi hi. Permit pen allow sangin ukna deuh hi.

senses.definition_en: One individual human being.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing mimal khat.

examples.english: Only one person knew the answer.
examples.zomi: Mi khat bek in dawnna thei hi.

examples.english: You must apply in person.
examples.zomi: Nangmah mimal takin na ngen ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The normal plural is people. Persons is used mainly in formal, legal, or official language.
senses.usage_zomi: A ngeina plural pen people ahi hi. Persons pen thukham, ukna leh official pau ah kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Belonging to one person
senses.definition_en: Belonging or relating to a particular individual rather than to a group or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawlpi khat a hilo in mimal tuam khat a neih ahih kei leh ama tawh kizom.

examples.english: Do not share your personal information online.
examples.zomi: Online ah na mimal thu hawmsawn kei in.

examples.english: This computer is for personal use only.
examples.zomi: Hih computer pen mimal zat ding bek ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Personal often marks something as private or connected to an individual.
senses.usage_zomi: Personal in a tamzaw in na khat mimal a ahihna ahih kei leh midang tawh kihawm ding hilo a gammi thu ahihna a lak hi.

senses.heading: Concerning private life or feelings
senses.definition_en: Relating to someone’s private life, relationships, opinions, or feelings.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mimal nuntakna tawh kisai; ama’ thu
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ ama’ nuntakna, kizopna, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh lungsim thu tawh kizom.

examples.english: That is a personal decision.
examples.zomi: Tua pen mimal khensatna ahi hi.

examples.english: She did not want to discuss her personal problems.
examples.zomi: Ama’ mimal buainate kikup nuamlo hi.

senses.usage_en: A personal question may be inappropriate if it concerns private matters that someone does not wish to discuss.
senses.usage_zomi: Personal question in mi khat a gen nuamlo mimal thu a dong ahih leh a kilawmlo hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: The combination of qualities, feelings, and behaviors that makes a person distinct from others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat midangte tawh a kibatlohna piangsak, ama’ omzia, lungsim putzia leh gamtatnate kigawm.

examples.english: Her warm personality makes people feel welcome.
examples.zomi: Ama’ mi kiit omzia in mite lungdam sak hi.

examples.english: The two brothers have very different personalities.
examples.zomi: Tua unau nih omzia kibanglo mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Personality describes a person’s characteristic way of thinking, feeling, and behaving; it does not refer only to mood.
senses.usage_zomi: Personality in mi khat’ ngaihsut, lungsim put leh gamtat ngeina a gen a, hun tom sung lungsim dinmun bek a genlo hi.

senses.heading: In one’s own opinion
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that a statement expresses the speaker’s own opinion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu gen pen apaute ama’ ngaihsutna ahihna thupisakna.

examples.english: Personally, I think the first plan is better.
examples.zomi: Keima ngaihsutna in geelna masapen hoihzaw ka sa hi.

examples.english: I personally prefer the smaller room.
examples.zomi: Keima deihna in inndei neu zaw ka deih hi.

senses.usage_en: Personally can soften an opinion by presenting it as the speaker’s own view rather than an absolute fact.
senses.usage_zomi: Personally in thu khat a kician thumaan bangin genlo in, apaute ama’ ngaihsutna bek ahihna hong lak hi.

senses.heading: Directly by oneself
senses.definition_en: By a particular person directly, rather than through someone else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang tungtawn hilo in, amah tektek in.

examples.english: The director personally answered my email.
examples.zomi: Director amah tektek in ka email hong dawng hi.

examples.english: I do not know the author personally.
examples.zomi: Laigelpa mimal takin ka thei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes direct involvement without an assistant or intermediary.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in huhpa ahih kei leh palai tungtawn lo, amah tektek in a sem cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Way of viewing something
senses.definition_en: A particular way of understanding, judging, or thinking about something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a khiat, a teh ahih kei leh a ngaihsut dan tuam khat.

examples.english: Try to see the problem from her perspective.
examples.zomi: Tua buaina ama’ ngaihsutdan pan muh sawm in.

examples.english: Travel gave him a broader perspective on life.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna in ama kiangah nuntakna ngaihsutdan zaangzaw pia hi.
