senses.usage_en: From someone’s perspective means from that person’s position, experience, or point of view.
senses.usage_zomi: From someone’s perspective in tua mi dinmun, thuakna ahih kei leh ngaihsutdan pan cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Correct sense of importance
senses.definition_en: The ability to judge the true importance of things and see them in a balanced way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thute a ciangtan tawh muhna; ngaihsutna kituak
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu tuamtuam a poimawna taktak kician takin teh in, a kituak ciangin muh theihna.

common_phrases.zomi: thu a ciangtan tawh muhsak lo

examples.english: The report puts the problem into perspective.
examples.zomi: Tua report in buaina a poimawna taktak hong musak hi.

examples.english: Try to keep the situation in perspective.
examples.zomi: Tua dinmun a ciangtan tawh ngaihsut sawm in.

senses.usage_en: Keep something in perspective means not treating it as more or less important than it truly is.
senses.usage_zomi: Keep something in perspective in na khat a poimawna taktak sangin thupizaw ahih kei leh neuzaw in ngaihsunlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To cause someone to believe something or agree to do something through reasons or encouragement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hangte gen ahih kei leh hanthawn in mi khat thu khat umsak ahih kei leh na khat sem ding lungkim sak.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat huh ding lungkim sak

examples.english: She persuaded him to see a doctor.
examples.zomi: Siavuan va mu dingin ama lungkim sak hi.

examples.english: The evidence persuaded us that the report was accurate.
examples.zomi: Teci in tua report maan cih hong umthei sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use persuade someone to do something. Persuade focuses on successfully changing someone’s belief or action.
senses.usage_zomi: Persuade someone to do something cih zatdan kizang hi. Persuade in mi khat’ upna ahih kei leh gamtatna khelsak zo cih bulphuh hi.

senses.definition_en: For every hundred, shown by the symbol % and used after a number.
senses.explanation_zomi: Za khat lakpan bangzah cih a lak tehna, number nungah a kizang.

examples.english: Twenty per cent of the students were absent.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang za-a-khen sawmnih sang kai lo uh hi.

examples.english: Prices increased by five per cent.
examples.zomi: Vanman za-a-khen nga khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Per cent follows a number. Percentage is used without a specific number or when discussing the proportion generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Per cent pen number nungah kizang hi. Number kician omlo ahih kei leh za-a-khen zah a vekpi gen ciangin percentage kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: An animal kept at home for companionship or enjoyment rather than mainly for work or food.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna ahih kei leh nek ding a kep hilo in, lawm leh lungnopna dingin inn ah kikep ganhing.

examples.english: The family keeps two dogs as pets.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in ui nih inn gan in kem uh hi.

examples.english: Children should learn how to care for a pet.
examples.zomi: Nau pangte inn gan kepdan sin ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A farm or working animal is not usually called a pet unless it is also kept for companionship.
senses.usage_zomi: Lo nasepna ahih kei leh nasep ding a kikep gan pen lawm dingin zong kikep kei leh pet kici ngeilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A liquid fuel used mainly in the engines of cars and other vehicles.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw leh van dangte engine hawlna dingin a kizang sathau tui.

examples.english: We stopped at a petrol station to fill the tank.
examples.zomi: Petrol kuang dimsak dingin petrol zuakna ah ka khawl uh hi.

examples.english: Petrol prices increased last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in petrol man khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Petrol is the usual British term. American English uses gas or gasoline.
senses.usage_zomi: Petrol pen British English zatdan ahi hi. American English ah gas ahih kei leh gasoline kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A particular stage in the development of a process, situation, or person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep kalsuan, dinmun ahih kei leh mi khantohna sung a khen tuam khat.

examples.english: The project has entered its final phase.
examples.zomi: Project pen a kalsuan khen nunung ah tungta hi.

examples.english: Children pass through several phases as they grow.
examples.zomi: Nau pangte a khan laitakun khang hun tuamtuam kantan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A phase is one temporary stage within a longer process and is expected eventually to change.
senses.usage_zomi: Phase pen nasep kalsuan sauzaw sung a hun tawmkhat bek om khen khat ahi a, a nung ciangin kikhel dingin kilamen hi.

senses.definition_en: An event, fact, or situation that exists or can be observed, especially one that is unusual or important.
senses.explanation_zomi: A om taktak ahih kei leh ettheih piangna, thumaan dinmun; a diak in lamdang ahih kei leh poimaw khat.

examples.english: A solar eclipse is a natural phenomenon.
examples.zomi: Ni khuamial pen piansakna piangna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Researchers are studying this social phenomenon.
examples.zomi: Kanciante in hih mihing kipawlna sung piangna kancian uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is phenomena, not phenomenons.
senses.usage_zomi: Phenomenon a plural pen phenomena ahi a, phenomenons hilo hi.

senses.heading: Study of fundamental questions
senses.definition_en: The study of basic questions about knowledge, reality, existence, morality, and reasoning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna, a om taktak nate, nuntakna, gamtat hoih leh ngaihsut siamzia tawh kisai dotna bulpite kancian pilna.

examples.english: She studied philosophy at university.
examples.zomi: University ah philosophy sin hi.

examples.english: Philosophy teaches us to examine our assumptions.
examples.zomi: Philosophy in ei ngaihsut masakna-te encian ding hong hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: Academic philosophy uses reasoned arguments to examine fundamental questions; it is not simply a personal opinion.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna lam philosophy in dotna bulpite hang neitak ngaihsutna tawh kancian a, mimal ngaihsutna maimai hilo hi.

senses.heading: Guiding beliefs or principles
senses.definition_en: A set of beliefs or principles that guides a person or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat’ khensatna leh gamtatna a makaih upna leh thukhun kigawm.

examples.english: Our business philosophy puts customers first.
examples.zomi: Ka sumleina makaih thukhun un vanlei mite masuan hi.

examples.english: His personal philosophy is to treat everyone fairly.
examples.zomi: Ama’ ngaihsutna bulpi pen mi khempeuh thutang takin kizoppih ding cih ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, philosophy means a general system of guiding ideas.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah philosophy in mimal ahih kei leh pawlpi khat a makaih ngaihsutna bulpite a cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A device used to speak with people at a distance and, especially in modern forms, to send messages and access information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamla a om mite tawh paukhawmna ding leh thupuak paisak, thu zonna ding a kizang van.

examples.english: I left my phone at home.
examples.zomi: Ka phone inn ah ka nusia hi.

examples.english: She spoke to her mother on the phone.
examples.zomi: A nu tawh phone tungtawn in paukhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: In modern English, phone commonly means a mobile phone unless the context indicates a landline.
senses.usage_zomi: Tulai English ah phone in a tamzaw in khutphone a kawk a, thu kigenna in innphone a kawkna zong hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: A picture produced with a camera.
senses.explanation_zomi: Camera tawh kilak lim.

examples.english: We took a photo in front of the museum.
examples.zomi: Museum ma-ah lim kala uh hi.

examples.english: She shared the photo with her family.
examples.zomi: Tua lim a innkuanpihte kiangah hawmsawn hi.

senses.usage_en: Photo is the common shortened form of photograph. Say take a photo, not make a photo in ordinary English.
senses.usage_zomi: Photo pen photograph a tomgen ahi hi. Ngeina English ah make a photo sangin take a photo kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A picture made by a camera that records the appearance of a person, place, or scene.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun ahih kei leh piangna mel camera tawh kiciamteh lim.

examples.english: The book contains several historical photographs.
examples.zomi: Laibu sungah tangthu camera lim pawlkhat om hi.

examples.english: This photograph was taken in 1985.
examples.zomi: Hih camera lim 1985 kum in kilak hi.

senses.usage_en: Photograph and photo have the same basic meaning, but photograph is slightly more formal.
senses.usage_zomi: Photograph leh photo khiatna bulpi kibang a, photograph pen ukna tawmkhat deuh hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who takes photographs, especially as a job or skilled activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Camera tawh lim a la mi, a diak in limla siam ahih kei leh tua nasep tawh a nungta mi.

examples.english: They hired a photographer for the wedding.
examples.zomi: Mopawi ading limlapa khat guan uh hi.

examples.english: The photographer captured the bird in flight.
examples.zomi: Limlapa in vasa a leng laitak lim la hi.

senses.usage_en: A photographer may take artistic, commercial, scientific, personal, or news photographs.
senses.usage_zomi: Photographer in pilna lim, sumleina lim, science lim, mimal lim ahih kei leh news lim lathei hi.

senses.definition_en: The art, skill, or activity of taking and producing photographs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Camera tawh lim lak leh lim bawl pilna, siamzia ahih kei leh nasepna.

examples.english: Photography is both her hobby and her profession.
examples.zomi: Limlakna pen ama’ nuamsak nasep leh ama’ nuntakpih nasep a nihgel ahi hi.

examples.english: This course teaches basic photography.
examples.zomi: Hih sinna in limlak pilna bulpi hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: Photography names the field or activity; a photograph is one finished image.
senses.usage_zomi: Photography in pilna ahih kei leh nasepna a gen a, photograph in lim khat a gen hi.

senses.heading: Group of words
senses.definition_en: A small group of words that functions together but does not usually form a complete sentence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal pawlkhat a kizomkhawm a, sentence kicing khat a hi nailo kammal kigawm.

examples.english: “In the morning” is a prepositional phrase.
examples.zomi: “In the morning” pen preposition tawh kipan kammal kigawm ahi hi.

examples.english: The students learned several useful phrases.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte kammal kigawm phatuam pawlkhat sin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A phrase usually lacks a complete subject–verb structure, while a clause contains one.
senses.usage_zomi: Phrase in a tamzaw in subject leh verb kicing nei lo a, clause in subject leh verb nei hi.

senses.heading: Particular expression
senses.definition_en: A particular expression or short form of words used to communicate an idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna khat pulak dingin a kizang kammal kigawm tom khat.

examples.english: I do not understand that phrase.
examples.zomi: Tua kammal kigawm ka tel lo hi.

examples.english: The phrase has a different meaning in this context.
examples.zomi: Hih thu kigenna sungah tua kammal kigawm khiatna dang nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A phrase may have a meaning that cannot be understood by translating each word separately.
senses.usage_zomi: Phrase khat pen kammal khatciat tuamtuam a letkhiatna bek tawh a khiatna kitel khalo thei hi.

senses.heading: Relating to the body
senses.definition_en: Relating to the body rather than the mind or emotions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim leh lungkhuatna lam hilo in pumpi tawh kisai.

examples.english: Regular exercise improves physical health.
examples.zomi: Hun ciangtan kizui a pumpi sawlna in pumpi cidamna hoih sak hi.

examples.english: The job requires considerable physical strength.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep in pumpi thahatna tampi kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Physical contrasts with mental or emotional when discussing health or experience.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna ahih kei leh thuakna thu ah physical pen mental ahih kei leh emotional tawh kilehbulh hi.

senses.heading: Existing in material form
senses.definition_en: Existing as a real object that can be seen or touched, rather than digitally or as an idea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Digital ahih kei leh ngaihsutna bek hilo in, muh leh lawng theih dinmun tawh om.

examples.english: The library keeps both digital and physical copies.
examples.zomi: Laibu inn in digital leh lai copy taktak a nihgel kem hi.

examples.english: Investigators found physical evidence at the scene.
examples.zomi: Kanciante in piangna munah van tawh kimu teci mu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A physical copy is a printed or material copy, not an electronic file.
senses.usage_zomi: Physical copy pen lai ahih kei leh van tawh kibawl copy ahi a, electronic file hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: The science that studies matter, energy, forces, motion, space, and time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van a kibawlna, tha, thahatna, kalsuan, mun zaang leh hun a kancian science pilna.

examples.english: She studies physics at university.
examples.zomi: University ah physics sin hi.

examples.english: Physics explains how objects move and interact.
examples.zomi: Physics in vante bangci kalsuan leh khat leh khat bangci kizom cih hilhcian hi.

senses.usage_en: Physics ends in -s but is normally treated as a singular noun: Physics is difficult.
senses.usage_zomi: Physics pen -s tawh tawp napi singular min in kizang zel hi: Physics is difficult.

senses.definition_en: A large musical instrument with black and white keys that are pressed to produce notes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw tuamtuam suah dingin meisan leh kang tawh kibawl key-te a kicip lian tumging khat.

examples.english: She began learning the piano at age six.
examples.zomi: Kum guk a pha ciangin piano tum sin kipan hi.

examples.english: A piano stood in the corner of the room.
examples.zomi: Inndei kiu ah piano khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: Say play the piano when referring generally to the skill or activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Piano tum siamzia ahih kei leh tua nasep a gen ciangin play the piano kici hi.

senses.heading: Choose
senses.definition_en: To choose someone or something from several possibilities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teeltheihna pawlkhat lakpan mi ahih kei leh na khat teel.

examples.english: Pick a number between one and ten.
examples.zomi: Khat leh sawm kikalpan number khat teel in.

examples.english: They picked her for the team.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl sungah ama teel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Pick is common and informal. Choose can be used in both informal and formal contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Pick pen nisim pau leh ukna lo deuh pau ah kizangpha a, choose pen nisim pau leh ukna pau a nihgel ah kizangthei hi.

senses.heading: Remove flowers or fruit by hand
senses.definition_en: To take a flower, fruit, or crop from the plant where it grows.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pak, singgah ahih kei leh lo gah a kung pan khut tawh lo.

examples.english: We picked apples at the farm.
examples.zomi: Lo ah apple gah ka lo uh hi.

examples.english: Do not pick the flowers in the park.
examples.zomi: Park sung a pakte lo kei in.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, pick means removing something that is growing, not merely choosing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah pick in teel cihna hilo a, a kungah a khang gah ahih kei leh pak lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Lift or collect something small
senses.definition_en: To remove or take up a small object, often with the fingers.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na neu khat khutme tawh lakhia ahih kei leh dom.

examples.english: She picked up the coin from the floor.
examples.zomi: Lei pan sumtang dom hi.

examples.english: He carefully picked the glass from the wound.
examples.zomi: Liampan limlang khen kidop takin lakhia hi.

senses.usage_en: The phrasal verb pick up has several additional meanings, including collect, learn informally, and improve.
senses.usage_zomi: Phrasal verb pick up in na khat va la, sinlohpi in thei suak leh hoih sem cihbang khiatna dang tampi nei hi.

senses.heading: Image
senses.definition_en: An image made by drawing, painting, photographing, or another visual method.
senses.explanation_zomi: Suai, si khut, camera tawh la ahih kei leh muh theih dan dang tawh kibawl lim.

examples.english: The child drew a picture of her house.
examples.zomi: Nau pang in ama’ inn lim suai hi.

examples.english: We took a picture beside the lake.
examples.zomi: Dil gei ah lim kala uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Picture is broader than photograph and may include drawings, paintings, and digital images.
senses.usage_zomi: Picture in photograph sangin khiatna zaangzaw a, limsuai, si-lim leh digital limte huam hi.

senses.heading: Understanding of a situation
senses.definition_en: A general understanding or description of a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat a vekpi bangci om cih telhna ahih kei leh a pulakna.

examples.english: The report gives a clear picture of the economy.
examples.zomi: Report in sumvai dinmun kician takin hong lak hi.

examples.english: We need more information to understand the full picture.
examples.zomi: Dinmun a vekpi ka teltheihna ding un thu behlap ka kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this figurative sense, picture means a mental view or understanding, not a visible image.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkakna khiatna ah picture in lim kimu a kawklo a, lungsim tawh dinmun telhna a kawk hi.

senses.heading: Part of something
senses.definition_en: A portion or part separated from or forming part of a larger whole.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na lianzaw khat pan a kikhenkhia ahih kei leh a sung a om khen khat.

examples.english: She gave me a piece of cake.
examples.zomi: Cake khen khat hong pia hi.

examples.english: A small piece of glass was on the floor.
examples.zomi: Lei ah limlang khen neu khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: Piece of is used to count many uncountable nouns: a piece of advice, furniture, or information.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtheih lo min tampi sim dingin piece of kizang hi: a piece of advice, furniture, ahih kei leh information.

senses.heading: Individual work or item
senses.definition_en: One individual work of writing, music, art, news, or equipment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, la, limsiam, news ahih kei leh van nam khat sungpan a tuam khat.

examples.english: The pianist performed a difficult piece of music.
examples.zomi: Piano tumpa in la tum haksa khat tum hi.

examples.english: She wrote a short piece for the newspaper.
examples.zomi: Newspaper ading lai tom khat gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning of piece depends on the noun or context that follows it.
senses.usage_zomi: Piece a khiatna pen a nung a kizom min ahih kei leh thu kigenna tungah kinga hi.

senses.definition_en: A farm animal with a broad nose and short legs, commonly raised for meat.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nak zaang leh khe tom nei, sa dingin a tamzaw a kikep inn gan khat.

examples.english: The farmer raises pigs and chickens.
examples.zomi: Lopa in vok leh ak vulh hi.

examples.english: The pigs were sleeping in the shade.
examples.zomi: Vokte lim nuai ah ihmu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: An adult female pig is a sow, an adult male is a boar, and a young pig is a piglet.
senses.usage_zomi: Vok numei picing pen sow, vok pasal picing pen boar, vok no pen piglet kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A collection of things placed untidily or one on top of another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na tampi a kikhawlkhawm ahih kei leh khat tunga khat kibanglo takin kikoih.

examples.english: A pile of clothes lay on the chair.
examples.zomi: Tutna tungah puan khol khat om hi.

examples.english: He placed the papers in a neat pile.
examples.zomi: Lai-te a kizek khol khat in koih hi.

senses.usage_en: A pile of can describe objects collected together, whether they are neat or untidy.
senses.usage_zomi: A pile of in na tampi mun khat ah a kikhawlkhawmna a gen a, a kizek hithei a, a kizemlo zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: Aircraft operator
senses.definition_en: A person trained and qualified to control an aircraft.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanleng hawl dingin kisin leh a phalna nei mi.

examples.english: The pilot landed the plane safely.
examples.zomi: Pilot in vanleng bit takin tuaksak hi.

examples.english: She hopes to become an airline pilot.
examples.zomi: Vanleng company pilot suak ding lamen hi.

senses.usage_en: A pilot controls an aircraft; other workers serving passengers are members of the cabin crew.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilot in vanleng hawl a, tuangmite a kem nasem dangte cabin crew kici hi.

senses.heading: Small-scale test
senses.definition_en: A test of a plan, project, or system before it is introduced more widely.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna, project ahih kei leh system khat mun zaangzaw ah zatma a tawmkhat tawh kisin etna.

examples.english: The city launched a pilot program in three schools.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in sanginn thum ah sittel masakna program kipan hi.

examples.english: The pilot project will run for six months.
examples.zomi: Sittel masakna project kha guk sung kizang ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, pilot is often used before another noun to mean experimental or introductory.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah pilot pen min dang ma-ah kizang in sittel masakna ahihna a kawk hi.

senses.heading: Small pointed fastener
senses.definition_en: A thin, pointed piece of metal used for fastening cloth or attaching things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan kizop ahih kei leh na khat a tun dingin a kizang, a neu leh a hiam sum.

examples.english: She fastened the cloth with a pin.
examples.zomi: Puan pen phiu tawh bulh hi.

examples.english: Be careful—the pin is sharp.
examples.zomi: Kidop in—phiu a hiam hi.

senses.usage_en: A pin usually pierces material; a clip normally holds things without piercing them.
senses.usage_zomi: Pin in a tamzaw in na vuk in bulh a, clip in vuklo in na len hi.

senses.heading: Secret identification number
senses.definition_en: A personal identification number used to access an account, card, or device.
senses.explanation_zomi: Account, card ahih kei leh vanzat hon dingin a kizang mimal kiciamna nambat.

examples.english: Enter your PIN to complete the payment.
examples.zomi: Sum piakna zo dingin na PIN gelh in.

examples.english: Never share your PIN with anyone.
examples.zomi: Na PIN kua kiangah zong gen kei in.

senses.usage_en: PIN already means “personal identification number,” so PIN number is common but logically repeats the word number.
senses.usage_zomi: PIN amah in “personal identification number” a cihna khin ahi hi. Tua ahih manin PIN number kici zel napi number nihvei gen bang ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a pale red color.
senses.explanation_zomi: San taang ahih kei leh pak san taang pian nei.

examples.english: She wore a pink dress to the party.
examples.zomi: Pawi ah puan san taang silh hi.

examples.english: The sky turned pink before sunrise.
examples.zomi: Ni suahma in van pink pian suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Pink is also a noun naming the color, but this entry describes its adjective use before a noun or after a linking verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Pink pen puan dial min in zong kizangthei napi, hih entry in min ma-ah ahih kei leh linking verb nungah adjective a zatna gen hi.

senses.heading: Tube carrying liquid or gas
senses.definition_en: A long hollow tube through which water, gas, or another substance flows.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui, gas ahih kei leh na dang luanna ding a sung awng kua sau.

examples.english: Water was leaking from a broken pipe.
examples.zomi: Kua a kek pan tui luangkhia hi.

examples.english: The workers installed new gas pipes.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in gas kua thakte koih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A pipe is usually rigid; a flexible tube is often called a hose.
senses.usage_zomi: Pipe pen a tamzaw in a khauh kua ahi a, a zaang leh kotkawi theih kua pen hose kici zel hi.

senses.heading: Smoking device
senses.definition_en: A small tube-shaped object with a bowl at one end, used for smoking tobacco.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuak zu dingin a khatlam ah sabeng koihna nei kua neu.

examples.english: The old man smoked a pipe.
examples.zomi: Tua upa in pipe tawh khuak zu hi.

examples.english: The pipe was made of wood.
examples.zomi: Tua pipe sing tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Context normally makes clear whether pipe means a transport tube or a smoking device.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kigenna pan pipe pen tui leh gas luanna kua maw, khuakzukna pipe maw cih kitel hi.

senses.heading: Playing field
senses.definition_en: An outdoor area of ground prepared for a sport such as football or cricket.
senses.explanation_zomi: Football, cricket ahih kei leh kimawlna dangte ading pualam a kizek kimawlna mun.

examples.english: The players ran onto the pitch.
examples.zomi: Kimawlte kimawlna lo tungah tai uh hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain damaged the football pitch.
examples.zomi: Guahpi in football kimawlna lo susia hi.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses football pitch. American English normally uses soccer field or football field.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah football pitch kizangpha a, American English ah soccer field ahih kei leh football field kizang hi.

senses.heading: Highness or lowness of sound
senses.definition_en: How high or low a musical note, voice, or other sound is.
senses.explanation_zomi: La aw, mi aw ahih kei leh ging khat a sang leh a niam zah.

examples.english: The singer can control the pitch of her voice.
examples.zomi: Lasanu in ama’ aw sanna ukzo hi.

examples.english: The machine produced a high-pitched sound.
examples.zomi: Machine in aw sang mahmah khat suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Pitch concerns how high or low a sound is; volume concerns how loud or quiet it is.
senses.usage_zomi: Pitch in aw a sang leh a niam zah a gen a, volume in aw a ging leh a neem zah a gen hi.

senses.heading: Persuasive presentation
senses.definition_en: A short presentation intended to persuade someone to buy, support, or accept something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat van leisak, panpihsak ahih kei leh geelna sanga dingin a kibawl thugen tom.

examples.english: They prepared a pitch for potential investors.
examples.zomi: Sum koih ding mite ading lungkim sakna thugen bawl uh hi.

examples.english: Her sales pitch was clear and convincing.
examples.zomi: Ama’ van zuakna thugen kician leh lungkimhuai hi.

senses.usage_en: A pitch is brief and persuasive; a general presentation may simply provide information.
senses.usage_zomi: Pitch pen tom leh mi lungkim sakna ding ahi a, presentation ngeina khat in thu piak bek a ngim thei hi.

senses.heading: Location or area
senses.definition_en: A particular point, area, building, town, or other location.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, inn, khua ahih kei leh koi ah a om cih lakna tuam khat.

examples.english: This is a quiet place to study.
examples.zomi: Hih mun lai sinna dingin a dai hi.

examples.english: We visited several interesting places.
examples.zomi: Mun lunglut huai pawlkhat ka veh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Place is a general word for a location. More exact words include building, town, room, and area.
senses.usage_zomi: Place pen mun genna zaang kammal ahi hi. Building, town, room, leh area in mun kicianzaw a gen hi.

senses.heading: Position or space for someone or something
senses.definition_en: A particular position, space, or seat intended for someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a om ding mun, dinmun ahih kei leh tutna.

common_phrases.english: put it back in its place

examples.english: Please put every book back in its proper place.
examples.zomi: Laibu khatciat a mun maan ah koihkik in.

examples.english: Someone was sitting in my place.
examples.zomi: Mi khat ka tutna munah tu hi.

senses.usage_en: In place can mean in the correct position or already arranged and ready.
senses.usage_zomi: In place in a mun maan ah om ahih kei leh kizek khin leh zat dingin kigingsa cihna hithei hi.

senses.heading: Rank or position in a competition
senses.definition_en: A finishing position in a race or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Taidemna ahih kei leh kidemna khat a gualzawhna dinmun.

examples.english: She won first place in the competition.
examples.zomi: Kidemna ah mun masapen ngah hi.

examples.english: Our team finished in second place.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl un mun nihna ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use in first place for position in a competition. The first place may also mean the first location mentioned.
senses.usage_zomi: Kidemna dinmun gen dingin in first place kici hi. The first place in kigen masapen mun zong a cihna hithei hi.

senses.heading: Simple and undecorated
senses.definition_en: Simple in appearance and without decoration, pattern, or added detail.
senses.explanation_zomi: A mel baihlam, zeetna, lim ahih kei leh a behlap omlo.

examples.english: She wore a plain black dress.
examples.zomi: Puan vom kizeemlo khat silh hi.

examples.english: The room was clean but very plain.
examples.zomi: Inndei siang napi kizeemlo mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Plain can describe something simple without suggesting that it is poor in quality.
senses.usage_zomi: Plain in na khat baihlam leh kizeemlo a cihna ahi a, a hoihlo a cihna ahi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Clear and easy to understand
senses.definition_en: Clear, direct, and easy to understand.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kician, a tang leh tel baih.

examples.english: The instructions are written in plain language.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna-te pau kician tawh kigelh hi.

examples.english: She made it plain that she disagreed.
examples.zomi: A nialna kician takin gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Plain language uses familiar words and straightforward sentences.
senses.usage_zomi: Plain language in kammal kizangpha leh sentence tangtak tawh thu genna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not having a special flavor
senses.definition_en: Having no added flavor, sauce, or other ingredient.
senses.explanation_zomi: Limna, saws ahih kei leh an dang behlap omlo.

examples.english: He ate plain rice with vegetables.
examples.zomi: Antam tawh buh bek ne hi.

examples.english: I prefer plain yogurt without sugar.
examples.zomi: Sucih behlap lo yogurt ka deihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: With food, plain means that nothing strongly flavored or decorative has been added.
senses.usage_zomi: Annek thu ah plain in limna thahat ahih kei leh zeetna bangmah behlap lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Intended course of action
senses.definition_en: A set of decisions about what someone will do and how or when it will be done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bang sem, bangci sem leh bang hunin sem ding cih khensatna kizomkhawm.

examples.english: We made a plan for the next six months.
examples.zomi: Kha guk hong tung ding ading geelna khat ka bawl uh hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain forced us to change our plans.
examples.zomi: Guahpi hangin ka geelna uh khel kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Use plan to do something when expressing an intended action.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat sep ding ngiimna gen ciangin plan to do something kizang hi.

senses.heading: Drawing showing arrangement
senses.definition_en: A detailed drawing that shows how a building, machine, or area will be made or arranged.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn, machine ahih kei leh mun khat bangci kibawl leh kizek ding cih a lak lim kician.

examples.english: The architect showed us the building plans.
examples.zomi: Inn bawl siammi in inn bawldan limte hong lak hi.

examples.english: The floor plan includes three bedrooms.
examples.zomi: Innsung kizekna lim in ihmutna inndei thum huam hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning refers to a visual design, not merely an intention.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in ngiimna bek hilo, muh theih bawldan lim a kawk hi.

senses.heading: Aircraft
senses.definition_en: A vehicle with wings and engines that flies through the air.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khal nei a, engine tawh vanah a leng van.

examples.english: Our plane leaves at six tomorrow morning.
examples.zomi: Ka vanleng uh zing zingkal nai guk ciangin ding hi.

examples.english: They traveled to Canada by plane.
examples.zomi: Vanleng tawh Canada gamah khualzin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Plane is the common shortened form of airplane in American English and aeroplane in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Plane pen American English airplane leh British English aeroplane a tomgen ahi hi.

senses.heading: Flat level surface
senses.definition_en: A completely flat surface extending in all directions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam khempeuh ah a phei leh a kibang ciangtan nei mun zaang.

examples.english: The points lie on the same plane.
examples.zomi: Tua ciamtehnate mun phei khat tungah om uh hi.

examples.english: Cut the object along a horizontal plane.
examples.zomi: Tua van lei tawh a phei kizui in aat in.

senses.usage_en: This technical meaning is common in mathematics, geometry, and engineering.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pilna kammal pen mathematics, geometry leh engineering ah kizangpha hi.

senses.definition_en: A large round object in space that moves around a star.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van zaang sungah aksi khat kiim a vei, a um limlim van khat.

examples.english: Earth is the third planet from the Sun.
examples.zomi: Leitung pen Ni pan planet thumna ahi hi.

examples.english: Scientists are searching for life on other planets.
examples.zomi: Scientists in planet dangte tungah nuntakna zong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Planets orbit stars, while moons orbit planets or similar bodies.
senses.usage_zomi: Planet-te aksi kiim a vei uh a, kha-te planet ahih kei leh a kibang van kiim a vei uh hi.

senses.definition_en: The process of deciding in advance what to do and how to do it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat semma a, bang sem leh bangci sem ding cih khensatna kalsuan.

examples.english: Good planning can prevent many problems.
examples.zomi: Geelna hoih in buaina tampi a khaktan thei hi.

examples.english: The event required several months of planning.
examples.zomi: Tua vaipuak in kha pawlkhat sung geelna kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Planning is usually uncountable when it means the general process of making plans.
senses.usage_zomi: Geelna bawl kalsuan a vekpi gen ciangin planning simtheih lo min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Living organism
senses.definition_en: A living organism such as a tree, flower, or grass that usually grows in soil and obtains energy from light.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in leivui ah khang a, khuavak pan tha a ngah sing, pak ahih kei leh lo bang nuntakna.

examples.english: These plants need plenty of sunlight.
examples.zomi: Hih singte ni khuavak tampi kisam uh hi.

examples.english: She watered the plants every morning.
examples.zomi: Zing khempeuh in singte tui buak hi.

senses.usage_en: Plant is a broad scientific and everyday term that includes trees, grasses, flowers, and many other forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Plant pen science leh nisim pau a kammal zaang ahi a, singkung, lopa, pak leh a dang tampi huam hi.

senses.heading: Factory
senses.definition_en: A large industrial building or group of buildings where goods, energy, or materials are produced.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, tha ahih kei leh van kibawlna raw material piangsak innpi ahih kei leh inn pawl.

examples.english: The company opened a new manufacturing plant.
examples.zomi: Company in van bawlna factory thak khat hon hi.

examples.english: The power plant supplies electricity to the city.
examples.zomi: Meitha bawlna in khuapi ading meivak tha pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether plant means a living organism or an industrial facility.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kigenna pan plant pen singkung pawl maw, factory maw cih kitel hi.

senses.definition_en: A light, strong material that can be shaped when made and is used to produce many kinds of objects.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawllaitak a lim tuamtuam suaksak theih, a zaang leh a khauh van kibawlna material.

examples.english: The bottle is made of recycled plastic.
examples.zomi: Tua bottle zatkik plastic tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: The store no longer provides plastic bags.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr in plastic ip pia nawnlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Plastic is normally uncountable when referring to the material. It can be plural as plastics when discussing different types.
senses.usage_zomi: Material a cihna ah plastic simtheih lo min ahi hi. Plastic nam tuamtuam gen ciangin plastics kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Flat dish
senses.definition_en: A flat or slightly curved dish used for serving or eating food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An koih leh an nekna ding a kizang, a phei ahih kei leh a kuam tawm ankuang.

examples.english: She placed the food on a large plate.
examples.zomi: An pen ankuang lian khat tungah koih hi.

examples.english: Please put your plate in the sink.
examples.zomi: Na ankuang tui sawpna kuang sungah koih in.

senses.usage_en: A plate is flatter than a bowl and is commonly used for solid food.
senses.usage_zomi: Plate pen beelno sangin pheizaw a, an khauh koih leh nekna dingin kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Flat sheet of hard material
senses.definition_en: A flat piece of metal, glass, or another hard material used as part of an object or structure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, limlang ahih kei leh material khauh dang tawh kibawl a phei khen khat.

examples.english: A metal plate covered the opening.
examples.zomi: Sum pheek khat in kua tuam hi.

examples.english: The police recorded the car’s number plate.
examples.zomi: Police in mawtaw nambat pheek ciamteh hi.

senses.usage_en: British English uses number plate; American English normally uses license plate.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah number plate kici a, American English ah license plate kici zel hi.

senses.heading: Raised surface
senses.definition_en: A raised flat surface where people stand, perform, speak, or enter a train.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi din, lim lak, thu gen ahih kei leh train tuanna ding a sangzaw phei mun.

examples.english: Passengers waited on the station platform.
examples.zomi: Tuangmite station platform tungah ngak uh hi.

examples.english: The speaker walked onto the platform.
examples.zomi: Thugensiam platform tungah kahto hi.

senses.usage_en: At a railway station, the platform is the area beside the tracks where passengers enter or leave trains.
senses.usage_zomi: Train station ah platform pen rail gei a tuangmite train tung kahtoh leh tuahna mun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Digital service or system
senses.definition_en: A digital system or service through which people communicate, share content, or perform activities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite kizoppih, thu hawmsawn ahih kei leh nasep tuamtuam semtheihna digital system.

examples.english: The course is available through an online platform.
examples.zomi: Tua sinna online platform tungtawn in ngah theih hi.

examples.english: The company developed a new payment platform.
examples.zomi: Company in sum piakna platform thak khat bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In technology, a platform supports other services, applications, content, or interactions.
senses.usage_zomi: Technology ah platform in nasepna, app, thu omte ahih kei leh kizopna dangte panpih hi.

senses.heading: Stated policies or principles
senses.definition_en: The set of policies and beliefs publicly supported by a political party or candidate.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamvai pawl ahih kei leh teel ding mi in a panpih thukhun leh geelna a mipite kiang a pulak.

examples.english: The party published its election platform.
examples.zomi: Gamvai pawl in ama’ teelna thukhun kigawm suah hi.

examples.english: Education reform is central to her platform.
examples.zomi: Pilna puahphatna pen ama’ gamvai geelna laigil ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This political meaning is especially common in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gamvai khiatna pen American English ah a diak in kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Enjoy games or recreation
senses.definition_en: To take part in games or enjoyable activities, especially for amusement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuamsa dingin kimawl ahih kei leh nopbawlna khat sem.

examples.english: The children are playing in the garden.
examples.zomi: Nau pangte huan sungah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: We used to play together after school.
examples.zomi: Sang khawl khit ciangin kimawlkhawm zel ung.

senses.usage_en: When children play without naming a particular game, no object is needed.
senses.usage_zomi: Nau pangte kimawlna nam tuam khat genlo ciangin play nungah object kisamlo hi.

senses.heading: Take part in a sport or game
senses.definition_en: To participate in a sport, game, or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna, game ahih kei leh kidemna khat sungah kihel.

examples.english: She plays basketball every weekend.
examples.zomi: Weekend khempeuh in basketball kimawl hi.

examples.english: Our team will play against the champions.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl un gualzote tawh kidem ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Sports normally take no article after play: play football, not play the football.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna min pen play nungah article omlo in kizang zel hi: play football kici a, play the football kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Produce music
senses.definition_en: To perform music using an instrument or recording.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tumging tum ahih kei leh la ging sak.

examples.english: He can play the guitar very well.
examples.zomi: Guitar tum siammahmah hi.

examples.english: Please play that song again.
examples.zomi: Tua la gingkik in.

senses.usage_en: Use the with most musical instruments: play the piano or play the guitar.
senses.usage_zomi: Tumging min a tamzaw tawh the kizang hi: play the piano leh play the guitar.

senses.heading: Act a role
senses.definition_en: To perform the role of a character in a play, film, or television program.
senses.explanation_zomi: Limlakna, film ahih kei leh television program ah mi khat meelpuak sem.

examples.english: She plays a doctor in the film.
examples.zomi: Tua film ah siavuan meelpuak sem hi.

examples.english: He was chosen to play the leading role.
examples.zomi: Meelpuak lianpen sem dingin kiteel hi.

senses.usage_en: Play a role can also mean contributing to a real event or result.
senses.usage_zomi: Play a role in limlakna meelpuak bek hilo, piangna ahih kei leh thusuak taktak khat ah vaipuak nei cihna zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: Sports or game participant
senses.definition_en: A person who takes part in a sport or game.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna ahih kei leh game khat sungah a kihel mi.

examples.english: Each team has eleven players.
examples.zomi: Pawl khatciat in kimawlpa sawmlehkhat ciat nei uh hi.

examples.english: She is the youngest player on the team.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl sungah amah kimawlpa naupen ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The sport or game commonly comes before player: tennis player, chess player.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna ahih kei leh game min pen player ma-ah om zel hi: tennis player, chess player.

senses.heading: Person who plays an instrument
senses.definition_en: A person who plays a particular musical instrument.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tumging nam khat a tum mi.

examples.english: He is an excellent piano player.
examples.zomi: Piano tumpa siam mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: The band needs a new guitar player.
examples.zomi: La pawl in guitar tumpa thak kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: For professional musicians, forms such as pianist and guitarist may sound more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Tumging tawh nasem mite ading pianist leh guitarist bang kammalte a ngeinazaw hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: Enjoyable, attractive, friendly, or giving a feeling of comfort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuam, deihhuai, mi kiit ahih kei leh lungsim nopsak.

examples.english: We had a pleasant evening together.
examples.zomi: Nitak nuam takin ka omkhawm uh hi.

examples.english: The hotel staff were friendly and pleasant.
examples.zomi: Hotel nasemte mi kiit leh kizoppih nuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Pleasant is positive but usually less enthusiastic than wonderful or excellent.
senses.usage_zomi: Pleasant in hoihna a gen napi, wonderful ahih kei leh excellent zahin thupi saklo hi.

senses.heading: Polite request
senses.definition_en: Used to make a request more polite.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngenna khat zia-etna leh zahtakna tawh genna dingin kizang.

examples.english: Please close the door.
examples.zomi: Hehpih in kongkha khak in.

examples.english: Could you please speak more slowly?
examples.zomi: Hehpih in tawmkhat neemzaw in na pau thei diam?

senses.usage_en: Please can appear at the beginning or end of a request. Tone still affects how polite the request sounds.
senses.usage_zomi: Please pen ngenna kipatna ahih kei leh tawpna ah omthei hi. Pau aw in zia-etna a huzaap lai hi.

senses.heading: Accepting an offer
senses.definition_en: Used to accept something that has been offered.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in na khat a hong piak ciangin lungdam takin sangna dingin kizang.

examples.english: “Would you like some coffee?” “Yes, please.”
examples.zomi: “Coffee tawmkhat na deih hiam?” “Ahi, pia in.”

examples.english: Two tickets, please.
examples.zomi: Ticket nih hong pia in.

senses.usage_en: Yes, please accepts an offer; no, thank you politely refuses it.
senses.usage_zomi: Yes, please in piak sawmna sang a, no, thank you in zia-et takin nial hi.

senses.definition_en: Happy or satisfied about something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat hangin lungdam ahih kei leh lungkim.

examples.english: We are pleased with the results.
examples.zomi: Tua thusuakte tawh ka lungkim uh hi.

examples.english: I am pleased to meet you.
examples.zomi: Nang tawh kimuh ka lungdam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use pleased with before a thing or result, and pleased to before an action.
senses.usage_zomi: Na ahih kei leh thusuak ma-ah pleased with kizang a, gamtatna ma-ah pleased to kizang hi.

senses.heading: Enjoyment
senses.definition_en: A feeling of happiness, enjoyment, or satisfaction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungdamna, nuamsakna ahih kei leh lungkimna lungsim sukna.

examples.english: Music gives her great pleasure.
examples.zomi: La in ama nuamsak mahmah hi.

examples.english: He takes pleasure in helping others.
examples.zomi: Midangte huhna ah nuamsa hi.

senses.usage_en: Take pleasure in doing something means to enjoy doing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Take pleasure in doing something in tua nasepna nuamsa cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Polite expression of willingness
senses.definition_en: Used in polite expressions to say that one is happy or willing to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sep lungkim leh nuam a hihna zia-et takin genna.

examples.english: “Thank you for your help.” “My pleasure.”
examples.zomi: “Hong huh manin lungdam.” “Ka lungdam zaw hi.”

examples.english: It was a pleasure to work with you.
examples.zomi: Nang tawh nasepkhawm nuam ka sa hi.

senses.usage_en: My pleasure is a polite response to thanks and means that one was happy to help.
senses.usage_zomi: My pleasure pen lungdam kohna a zia-et takin dawnna ahi a, huhna hangin amah zong lungdam cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: More than enough of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisap zah sangin tamzaw leh kicing val.

examples.english: We have plenty of time before the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ma-in hun tampi kineih hi.

examples.english: There is plenty for everyone.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh ading kicing val om hi.

senses.usage_en: Use plenty of before both countable and uncountable nouns: plenty of books and plenty of water.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtheih leh simtheih lo min a nihgel ma-ah plenty of kizangthei hi: plenty of books leh plenty of water.

senses.heading: Story events
senses.definition_en: The connected series of events that forms the story of a book, film, or play.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, film ahih kei leh limlakna tangthu a bawl piangna kizomte.

examples.english: The film has a complicated plot.
examples.zomi: Tua film tangthu kalsuan telhaksa hi.

examples.english: I enjoyed the characters but not the plot.
examples.zomi: Meelpuakte ka nuamsak napi tangthu kalsuan ka nuamsak lo hi.

senses.usage_en: The plot is what happens in a story and how its events are connected.
senses.usage_zomi: Plot pen tangthu sungah bang piang leh piangnate bangci kizom cih ahi hi.

senses.heading: Small piece of land
senses.definition_en: A small area of land used for a particular purpose, especially building or gardening.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn lamna, lo bawlna ahih kei leh ngimna tuam khat ading lei mun neu.

examples.english: They bought a plot of land to build a house.
examples.zomi: Inn lamna ding lei mun khat lei uh hi.

examples.english: She grows vegetables on a small plot.
examples.zomi: Lei mun neu khat ah antamte khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, plot refers to a clearly marked or separately used area of land.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah plot in lei mun a kigamgi kician ahih kei leh tuam a kizang khat a gen hi.

senses.heading: Secret plan
senses.definition_en: A secret plan, especially one intended to harm someone or act illegally.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat susia ahih kei leh thukhial bawl ding a seel geelna.

examples.english: Police discovered a plot to attack the building.
examples.zomi: Police in innpi sim ding geelgukna mukhia hi.

examples.english: The men were accused of taking part in the plot.
examples.zomi: Tua mite geelgukna sungah kihel ci in kimawhsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense usually implies secrecy and harmful or unlawful intentions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in seelna leh mi suksiatna ahih kei leh thukhial bawl ngiimna a huam zel hi.

senses.definition_en: With the addition of, together with, or in addition to.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat behlap in ahih kei leh na dang khat tawh kigawm in.

examples.english: The meal costs twenty dollars plus tax.
examples.zomi: An man dollar sawmnih leh tax behlap ahi hi.

examples.english: We need five chairs plus one extra.
examples.zomi: Tutna nga leh a behlap khat ka kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In mathematics, plus shows addition. In ordinary language, it means “with the addition of.”
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics ah plus in behlapna a lak a, nisim pau ah “na khat behlap tawh” cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Small cloth container in clothing
senses.definition_en: A small cloth container sewn into or onto clothing for carrying small objects.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, tawh ahih kei leh van neu koih dingin puan sung ahih kei leh a tungah kithui ip neu.

examples.english: He put the keys in his pocket.
examples.zomi: Tawhte a puan-ip sungah koih hi.

examples.english: My phone fell out of my pocket.
examples.zomi: Ka phone ka puan-ip sungpan kia hi.

senses.usage_en: Clothing may have pockets, but a separate container carried by hand is a bag or purse.
senses.usage_zomi: Puan in pocket nei thei a, khut tawh a kipua ip tuam pen bag ahih kei leh purse kici hi.

senses.heading: Small area with a particular condition
senses.definition_en: A small area or group surrounded by a different condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun tuam dangte in a umcip mun ahih kei leh pawl neu khat.

examples.english: Small pockets of poverty remain in the region.
examples.zomi: Tua gam khen sungah zawngkhalna mun neute om lai hi.

examples.english: The forest contains pockets of open grassland.
examples.zomi: Gam sungah lopa zaang mun neute om hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use describes a small isolated concentration of something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkakna zatdan in na khat mun neu khat ah a kikhawl ahih kei leh a tuam om cih gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A piece of writing arranged in lines, often using rhythm, imagery, or carefully chosen language to express ideas and feelings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna leh lungsim sukna pulak dingin laigual, aw-kizuihna, lim-etna leh kammal teel tawh kigelh lai.

examples.english: She wrote a poem about her childhood.
examples.zomi: Ama’ naupanlai thu poem khat gelh hi.

examples.english: The students read the poem aloud.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in poem aw ngaihtak in sim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A poem is one individual work; poetry is the literary form or collection of poems generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Poem pen lai kigelh khat ahi a, poetry pen tua lai-gelh pilna ahih kei leh poemte a vekpi a cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who writes poems.
senses.explanation_zomi: Poem a gelh mi.

examples.english: The poet wrote about nature and human life.
examples.zomi: Poem gelhpa in piansakna leh mihing nuntakna thu gelh hi.

examples.english: She became a respected poet.
examples.zomi: Zahtakna ngah poem gelhpa khat suak hi.

senses.usage_en: A poet may write in traditional forms, free verse, or spoken-word styles.
senses.usage_zomi: Poet in ngeina form, laigual suahtak ahih kei leh kam tawh kigen poem gelhthei hi.

senses.definition_en: Poems considered as a form of literature, or the art of writing poems.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai-gelh pilna nam khat bang a poem-te, ahih kei leh poem gelh siamzia.

examples.english: She enjoys reading modern poetry.
examples.zomi: Tulai poem-te sim nuamsa hi.

examples.english: Poetry can express complex emotions in a few words.
examples.zomi: Poem in lungsim sukna telhaksa kammal tawm tawh pulaak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Poetry is normally uncountable. Use a poem for one individual work.
senses.usage_zomi: Poetry pen simtheih lo min ahi zel hi. Lai kigelh khat gen dingin a poem kici hi.

senses.heading: Main idea or purpose
senses.definition_en: The main idea, meaning, purpose, or reason for saying or doing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu gen ahih kei leh nasep khat’ ngaihsutna bulpi, khiatna, ngimna ahih kei leh hang.

examples.english: I understand your main point.
examples.zomi: Na thu bulpi ka tel hi.

examples.english: What is the point of repeating the same argument?
examples.zomi: Nialna kibang gentawn in bang ngimna a nei hiam?

senses.usage_en: The point is that … introduces the most important idea or conclusion.
senses.usage_zomi: The point is that … in ngaihsutna ahih kei leh thukhupna poimawpen hong pulak hi.

senses.heading: Exact place or moment
senses.definition_en: A particular place, position, stage, or moment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, dinmun, kalsuan khen ahih kei leh hun kician khat.

examples.english: This road is dangerous at several points.
examples.zomi: Hih lampi mun pawlkhat ah lauhuai hi.

examples.english: At that point, we decided to return home.
examples.zomi: Tua hun ciangin inn ciah ding ka khensat uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may refer to a physical location or a particular stage in time or development.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mun taktak ahih kei leh hun leh khantohna kalsuan khen kician a kawkthei hi.

senses.heading: Unit in a score or measurement
senses.definition_en: One unit used in scoring, rating, measuring, or comparing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mark, tehna ahih kei leh etkakna a kizang simna khat.

examples.english: Our team won by three points.
examples.zomi: Ka pawl un mark thum tawh zaw uh hi.

examples.english: Interest rates rose by one percentage point.
examples.zomi: Sumtan pha za-a-khen point khat khang hi.

senses.usage_en: A percentage point is the numerical difference between two percentages, not a percentage increase.
senses.usage_zomi: Percentage point pen za-a-khen nih kikal a number kilamdangna ahi a, za-a-khen tawh khantohna a cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Sharp end
senses.definition_en: The thin, sharp end of an object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat’ a neu leh a hiam tawpna.

examples.english: The point of the pencil broke.
examples.zomi: Pencil a zum kek hi.

examples.english: Be careful with the sharp point of the pin.
examples.zomi: Phiu a hiam kidop in.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, point describes the narrow or sharp end, not the entire object.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in van buppi hilo, a tawpna neu leh hiam bek a gen hi.

senses.heading: Having a sharp end
senses.definition_en: Having a thin, sharp, or narrow end.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tawp a neu, a hiam ahih kei leh a zum.

examples.english: The fence was made from pointed sticks.
examples.zomi: Kulh pen sing zumte tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Be careful with the pointed end.
examples.zomi: A tawp a hiam kidop in.

senses.usage_en: Pointed describes the shape of an object; sharp may describe either its shape or its ability to cut.
senses.usage_zomi: Pointed in van khat a lim a gen a, sharp in a lim ahih kei leh na aat theihna a gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Clearly critical or direct
senses.definition_en: Expressed in a direct and often critical way.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tangtak leh khatveivei demna nei takin kigen.

examples.english: The reporter asked a pointed question.
examples.zomi: News la mi in dotna tangtak khat dong hi.

examples.english: She made a pointed remark about the delay.
examples.zomi: Zekna thu demna nei takin gen hi.

senses.usage_en: A pointed comment is deliberately clear and may be intended to criticize or embarrass someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Pointed thugen pen ngiimna tawh kician takin kigen a, mi khat dem ahih kei leh zumsak ding hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: A substance that can cause illness, injury, or death if it enters the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi sungah lut leh natna, liamna ahih kei leh sihna piangsakthei na.

common_phrases.zomi: gu ne ahih kei leh dawn

examples.english: Keep the poison away from children.
examples.zomi: Gu pen nau pangte’ phahtheihna pualam ah koih in.

examples.english: The laboratory tested the substance for poison.
examples.zomi: Laboratory in tua na sungah gu om hiam cih sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: If poisoning is suspected, seek emergency medical help immediately rather than waiting for symptoms.
senses.usage_zomi: Gu lut kha ding kici leh natna lim hong kilak dong ngaklo in, manlang takin emergency cidamna huhna zong in.

senses.definition_en: Containing poison or capable of causing illness or death if eaten, touched, or absorbed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gu nei ahih kei leh nek, lawng ahih kei leh pumpi sung lut ciangin natna leh sihna piangsakthei.

examples.english: Some wild mushrooms are poisonous.
examples.zomi: Gam kau pawlkhat gu nei hi.

examples.english: Do not touch that poisonous plant.
examples.zomi: Tua gu nei sing lawng kei in.

senses.usage_en: Poisonous harms something that touches or consumes it. Venomous animals inject venom by biting or stinging.
senses.usage_zomi: Poisonous na pen lawng ahih kei leh ne ciangin gu suak a, venomous ganhing in a tuk ahih kei leh a sun ciangin gu sung hi.

senses.definition_en: The public organization responsible for enforcing laws, preventing crime, and protecting people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham zuihsak, mawhna khaktan leh mipite kem ding vaipuak nei ukna pawl.

examples.english: Someone called the police after the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident khit ciangin mi khat in police sam hi.

examples.english: The police are investigating the crime.
examples.zomi: Police in tua mawhna kancian uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Police takes a plural verb in standard English: The police are investigating, not the police is investigating.
senses.usage_zomi: Standard English ah police pen plural verb tawh kizang hi: The police are investigating kici a, the police is investigating kici lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A male police officer.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham zuihsak leh mipite kem ding vaipuak nei police pasal.

examples.english: A policeman directed traffic at the crossing.
examples.zomi: Lampi kisuahna ah police pasal khat in mawtawte makaih hi.

examples.english: The boy asked the policeman for help.
examples.zomi: Tua tapa in police pasal kiangah huhna ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: Police officer is now more common because it includes officers of any gender.
senses.usage_zomi: Police officer pen numei leh pasal a huam ahih manin tulai ah kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Official course of action
senses.definition_en: An agreed set of principles or actions used by a government, organization, or business.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi, kipawlna ahih kei leh company khat’ khensatna leh nasepna a makaih thukhun leh geelna.

examples.english: The government announced a new education policy.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in pilna nasep thukhun thak khat tangko hi.

examples.english: Company policy requires employees to protect customer data.
examples.zomi: Company thukhun in nasemte vanlei mite’ data kem ding kal hi.

senses.usage_en: A policy guides repeated decisions and actions; a law creates legally enforceable requirements.
senses.usage_zomi: Policy in khensatna leh nasepna makaih a, thukham in thukhial ciangin thukhen theih kalhna piangsak hi.

senses.heading: Insurance contract
senses.definition_en: A contract stating what protection an insurance company will provide.
senses.explanation_zomi: Insurance company in bang lauhuaina ading bangzah huhna pia ding cih a pulak thuciam lai.

examples.english: Read the insurance policy carefully before signing it.
examples.zomi: Insurance thuciam lai min na gelhma in kidop takin sim in.

examples.english: The policy covers damage caused by fire.
examples.zomi: Tua policy in mei hang siatna huam hi.

senses.usage_en: An insurance policy explains coverage, limits, exclusions, and the customer’s obligations.
senses.usage_zomi: Insurance policy in bangte huam, bangzah ciangtan, bangte huamlo leh vanleipa’ vaipuakte pulak hi.

senses.definition_en: Showing respect and good manners toward other people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte zahtak in, zia-et leh gamtat hoih a lak.

examples.english: It is polite to thank someone who helps you.
examples.zomi: Nang hong huh mi lungdam koh pen zia-etna ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave a polite but firm reply.
examples.zomi: Zia-et napi kiptak dawnna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Polite concerns respectful behavior; it does not necessarily mean friendly or affectionate.
senses.usage_zomi: Polite in zahtakna nei gamtatna a gen a, lawmta leh itna lak pahpah a cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to government, public power, elections, or the activities and beliefs of political parties.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gamvai tawh kisai; kumpi ukna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi ukna, mipite ukna thuneihna, teelna ahih kei leh gamvai pawlte’ nasep leh upna tawh kisai.

examples.english: The country is experiencing political change.
examples.zomi: Tua gam in gamvai kikhelhna thuak hi.

examples.english: They discussed the political situation before the election.
examples.zomi: Teelna ma-in gamvai dinmun kikup uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Political concerns government and power; politicized means that something has been turned into a political issue.
senses.usage_zomi: Political in kumpi ukna leh thuneihna tawh kisai a, politicized in thu khat gamvai thu suaksak cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person involved professionally in politics, especially someone elected to public office.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamvai tawh nasem mi, a diak in mipite in ukna mun ding a teel mi.

examples.english: The politician promised to improve public transportation.
examples.zomi: Gamvai mi in mipite mawtaw kizopna hoih sak ding ciam hi.

examples.english: Many politicians attended the public meeting.
examples.zomi: Gamvai mi tampi mipite kikhopna ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Politician identifies a person working in politics; politics names the activity or field.
senses.usage_zomi: Politician in gamvai tawh nasem mi a gen a, politics in gamvai nasepna leh pilna a gen hi.

senses.heading: Government and public power
senses.definition_en: The activities and processes through which societies make public decisions and exercise governmental power.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing kipawlna in mipite ading khensatna bawl leh kumpi ukna thuneihna zat kalsuan leh nasepna.

examples.english: She became interested in politics at university.
examples.zomi: University ah a sin laitakin gamvai lunglut hi.

examples.english: Economic problems often influence politics.
examples.zomi: Sumvai buainate in gamvai huzaap zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Politics ends in -s but is usually treated as singular when it means the field or activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Politics pen -s tawh tawp napi, gamvai pilna ahih kei leh nasepna a cihna ciangin singular verb tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Political beliefs or maneuvering
senses.definition_en: Political opinions or actions used to gain influence, advantage, or control.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamvai ngaihsutna ahih kei leh huzaapna, phattuamna leh ukna ngah dingin a kibawl gamtatna.

examples.english: Party politics delayed the decision.
examples.zomi: Gamvai pawl kikal thu in khensatna zek sak hi.

examples.english: He dislikes office politics.
examples.zomi: Nasepna mun a huzaapna zonna deihlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Office politics refers to informal efforts to gain influence at work, not government politics.
senses.usage_zomi: Office politics in kumpi gamvai hilo, nasepna munah huzaapna leh maipha zonna a cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Harmful substances or waste that make air, water, or land dirty and unsafe.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hui, tui ahih kei leh lei a niin leh lauhuai sak baal, khu, tui leh ninna.

examples.english: Traffic is a major cause of air pollution.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw tamna pen hui ninsakna hang lian khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The factory was fined for causing water pollution.
examples.zomi: Factory in tui a ninsak manin sum guk hi.

senses.usage_en: Pollution is normally uncountable. A specific contaminating substance may be called a pollutant.
senses.usage_zomi: Pollution pen simtheih lo min ahi zel hi. Tui, hui ahih kei leh lei a ninsak na tuam khat pen pollutant kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Swimming pool
senses.definition_en: A specially built area filled with water for swimming.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui leuhna dingin kibawl leh tui tawh kidim kuangpi ahih kei leh mun.

examples.english: The hotel has an indoor swimming pool.
examples.zomi: Hotel in inn sung tui leuhna nei hi.

examples.english: Children must not enter the pool alone.
examples.zomi: Nau pangte amau bek in tui leuhna sung lutlo ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A swimming pool is built for recreation or exercise and differs from a natural pond or lake.
senses.usage_zomi: Swimming pool pen kimawl leh pumpi sawlna dingin kibawl a, piansakna dilno ahih kei leh dil tawh kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: Small amount of collected liquid
senses.definition_en: A small area of liquid collected on a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun phei khat tungah a kikhawl tui ahih kei leh tui bang na neu khat.

examples.english: A pool of water formed beneath the pipe.
examples.zomi: Kua nuai ah tui khol khat om hi.

examples.english: Rain collected in small pools on the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi tungah guahtui khol neute om hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes liquid that has gathered in one place.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in tui ahih kei leh tui bang na mun khat ah a kikhawl a gen hi.

senses.heading: Shared supply
senses.definition_en: A supply of people, money, information, or resources available for shared use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite in hawmkhawm a zat ding mi, sum, thu ahih kei leh neihsa kigawm.

examples.english: The city has a large pool of skilled workers.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in siamna nei nasem tampi nei hi.

examples.english: The organizations created a shared pool of resources.
examples.zomi: Kipawlnate in zatkhawm ding neihsa khol khat bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense treats available people or resources as one shared collection.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkakna khiatna in mi ahih kei leh neihsate zatkhawm ding khol khat bangin ngaihsun hi.

senses.heading: Having little money
senses.definition_en: Having very little money and lacking some basic needs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum neilo leh nuntakna kisap bulpite kicingtak a ngahlo.

examples.english: The organization provides food to poor families.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in innkuan zawngte an pia hi.

examples.english: He grew up in a poor village.
examples.zomi: Khuano zawng khat ah khangto hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to people, poor people is usually more respectful and natural than the poor.
senses.usage_zomi: Mite a gen ciangin the poor sangin poor people zia-et zaw leh ngeinazaw hi.

senses.heading: Low in quality
senses.definition_en: Below an acceptable standard or not done well.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisap ciangtan pha lo, a hoihlo ahih kei leh a kicinglo.

examples.english: The road is in poor condition.
examples.zomi: Lampi dinmun hoihlo hi.

examples.english: Poor planning caused several problems.
examples.zomi: Geelna hoihlo in buaina pawlkhat piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning may describe quality, performance, judgment, health, or condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in van hoihna, nasepzia, khensiamna, cidamna ahih kei leh dinmun a gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Deserving sympathy
senses.definition_en: Used to express sympathy for someone in an unfortunate situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun haksatna a thuak mi tungah khasiatna lakna.

examples.english: The poor child had lost his parents.
examples.zomi: Tua nau pang khasiat huai in a nu leh pa taan hi.

examples.english: You poor thing—you must be exhausted.
examples.zomi: Na khasiat huai mah—na gim mahmah ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this use, poor expresses sympathy and does not necessarily mean lacking money.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan ah poor in khasiatna a lak a, sum neilo a cihna ahi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Popular music
senses.definition_en: Modern popular music with short, memorable songs and a broad audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tampi in a ngaih nuamsak, a tamzaw in la tom leh phawk baih nei tulai la nam.

examples.english: She listens to pop music while exercising.
examples.zomi: Pumpi sawl laitakin pop la ngai hi.

examples.english: The pop singer released a new album.
examples.zomi: Pop lasakpa in album thak khat suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Pop is the shortened form of popular music.
senses.usage_zomi: Pop pen popular music a tomgen ahi hi.

senses.heading: Sweet carbonated drink
senses.definition_en: A sweet drink containing bubbles of carbon dioxide.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sucih leh gas tuam khat tawh kibawl, tui khuakte nei dawnna lim.

examples.english: He bought a can of pop with his lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun an tawh pop kuang khat lei hi.

examples.english: Too much pop can contain a great deal of sugar.
examples.zomi: Pop tampi sungah sucih tampi omthei hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is common in parts of the United States and Canada. Other regions use soda or soft drink.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen United States leh Canada mun pawlkhat ah kizangpha hi. Mun dangah soda ahih kei leh soft drink kici hi.

senses.heading: Liked by many people
senses.definition_en: Liked, enjoyed, or supported by many people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tampi in a deih, nuamsak ahih kei leh panpih.

examples.english: The program is popular with young people.
examples.zomi: Tua program khangnote lakah kilunglut hi.

examples.english: Football is one of the world’s most popular sports.
examples.zomi: Football pen leitung a kimawlna kizangphapen lakpan khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use popular with before the people who like something: popular with students.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a deih mite ma-ah popular with kizang hi: popular with students.

senses.heading: Intended for ordinary people
senses.definition_en: Intended for or connected with the general public rather than specialists or elites.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siamna neite ahih kei leh makaite bek hilo in, mipite a vekpi ading.

examples.english: The book explains science for a popular audience.
examples.zomi: Laibu in mipite teltheih dingin science hilhcian hi.

examples.english: The idea became part of popular culture.
examples.zomi: Tua ngaihsutna mipite ngeina sungah lut hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, popular concerns the general public, not necessarily something everyone likes.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah popular in mipite a vekpi tawh kisai cihna ahi a, mi khempeuh deih cihna ahi pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: The state of being liked, enjoyed, or supported by many people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tampi in a deih, nuamsak ahih kei leh panpih dinmun.

examples.english: The sport is growing in popularity.
examples.zomi: Tua kimawlna mi deihna khang semsem hi.

examples.english: The mayor’s popularity declined after the decision.
examples.zomi: Khensatna khit ciangin khuapi makai mi deihna kiam hi.

senses.usage_en: Popularity concerns how widely something or someone is liked, not necessarily its quality.
senses.usage_zomi: Popularity in mi bangzah in deih cih a gen a, a hoihna taktak a gen pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: All inhabitants of a place
senses.definition_en: All the people living in a particular country, city, or area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam, khuapi ahih kei leh mun tuam khat ah a teng mi khempeuh.

examples.english: The city has a population of one million.
examples.zomi: Tua khuapi ah mi awn khat teng hi.

examples.english: The country’s population is growing rapidly.
examples.zomi: Tua gam mi omzah manlang takin khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Say a population of ten thousand, not normally a population with ten thousand.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi omzah gen ciangin a population of ten thousand kici a, a population with ten thousand kici ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Particular group of living things
senses.definition_en: A particular group of people, animals, or plants living in one area or studied together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah a om ahih kei leh kancian khawm mi, ganhing ahih kei leh sing pawl tuam khat.

examples.english: The island has a large bird population.
examples.zomi: Tuikulh gam ah vasa tampi om hi.

examples.english: Older adults formed half of the study population.
examples.zomi: Kancian mite lak a langkhat upate ahi uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is common in science, medicine, statistics, and research.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen science, zatui pilna, statistics leh kancian na ah kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Harbor for ships
senses.definition_en: A town or sheltered area where ships load, unload, arrive, and depart.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tembawte van suah, van khum, hong tung leh paikhiatna tuigei khua ahih kei leh mun.

examples.english: The ship arrived at the port this morning.
examples.zomi: Tembaw tuni zingin tuikuan ah hong tung hi.

examples.english: The port handles thousands of containers each year.
examples.zomi: Tuikuan in kumkhat ciang van kuang tul tampi kem hi.

senses.usage_en: A port may include a harbor, docks, warehouses, and customs facilities.
senses.usage_zomi: Port in tembaw bitna tui mun, van suah leh khumna, van kholna leh customs munte huamthei hi.

senses.heading: Computer connection
senses.definition_en: A socket or digital connection through which a computer exchanges power, data, or signals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer in meitha, data ahih kei leh signal ngah leh paisakna kua ahih kei leh digital kizopna.

examples.english: Connect the cable to the USB port.
examples.zomi: Cable USB port ah zom in.

examples.english: The charging port is damaged.
examples.zomi: Meitha sungna kua sia hi.

senses.usage_en: A physical port is a socket; a network port is a numbered logical connection.
senses.usage_zomi: Physical port pen kua taktak ahi a, network port pen nambat tawh kiciamteh digital kizopna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Picture of a person
senses.definition_en: A painting, drawing, or photograph that mainly shows a person, especially the face.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, a diak in a maitang a bulphuh si-lim, limsuai ahih kei leh camera lim.

examples.english: The artist painted a portrait of the king.
examples.zomi: Limsiampa in kumpipa milim si tawh suai hi.

examples.english: A family portrait hung above the fireplace.
examples.zomi: Mei-umna tungah innkuan milim kingai hi.

senses.usage_en: A portrait usually emphasizes a person; a landscape emphasizes natural scenery.
senses.usage_zomi: Portrait in mi khat a bulphuh a, landscape in gam leh piansakna munmuh a bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Written description
senses.definition_en: A detailed written or spoken description of a person, place, or society.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun ahih kei leh mihing kipawlna khat kician takin a pulak lai ahih kei leh thugen.

examples.english: The novel presents a vivid portrait of village life.
examples.zomi: Novel in khuano nuntakna omzia kician takin pulak hi.

examples.english: The report offers an honest portrait of the community.
examples.zomi: Report in khuami dinmun thumaan takin lak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense creates a mental picture through words.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkakna khiatna in kammal zangin lungsim sungah lim bang a kimu omzia khat piangsak hi.

senses.heading: Sit or stand for a picture
senses.definition_en: To hold a particular position so that someone can photograph, paint, or draw you.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim kilak, si tawh kisuai ahih kei leh lim kisuai theihna dingin dinmun tuam khat ah om.

examples.english: The family posed for a photograph.
examples.zomi: Innkuan limlak dingin kizek uh hi.

examples.english: She posed beside the statue.
examples.zomi: Milim gei ah limlak dingin ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Pose for identifies the picture or artist; pose with identifies other people or objects in the picture.
senses.usage_zomi: Pose for in lim ahih kei leh limsiampa a lak a, pose with in lim sungah a ompih mite ahih kei leh vante a lak hi.

senses.heading: Cause or present a problem, danger, or question
senses.definition_en: To cause or present a problem, threat, risk, or question that must be considered.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsut leh dawn ding buaina, lauhuaina, risk ahih kei leh dotna piangsak.

examples.english: The storm poses a serious threat to coastal towns.
examples.zomi: Huipi in tuigei khuapite tungah lauhuaina lian piangsak hi.

examples.english: The findings pose an important question.
examples.zomi: Tua muhkhiatnate in dotna poimaw khat piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this formal use, common objects include problem, challenge, risk, threat, and question.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih ukna zatdan ah problem, challenge, risk, threat, leh question bangte object in kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Pretend to be someone
senses.definition_en: To pretend to be a person or type of person that you are not.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh dinmun khat nei bangin kineih.

examples.english: The man posed as a police officer.
examples.zomi: Tua pasal police officer kineih hi.

examples.english: Scammers may pose as bank employees.
examples.zomi: Mi khemte bank nasem kineih thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use pose as before the false identity.
senses.usage_zomi: Kineihna min ma-ah pose as kizang hi.

senses.heading: Location or arrangement
senses.definition_en: The exact place where someone or something is located or arranged.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a omna mun leh a koihdan kician.

examples.english: Move the chair into a better position.
examples.zomi: Tutna mun hoihzaw ah koih in.

examples.english: The patient changed her sleeping position.
examples.zomi: Cinanu in ihmutdan khel hi.
