senses.usage_en: Position may describe either location or the way someone’s body or an object is arranged.
senses.usage_zomi: Position in mun ahih kei leh pumpi leh van khat kizekdan a genthei hi.

senses.heading: Job or official role
senses.definition_en: A job or role in an organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kipawlna ahih kei leh company sung a nasep leh vaipuak mun khat.

examples.english: She applied for a management position.
examples.zomi: Ukna nasep mun khat ngen hi.

examples.english: The company created twenty new positions.
examples.zomi: Company in nasep mun thak sawmnih piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In employment, position is a formal synonym for job or role.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep thu ah position pen job ahih kei leh role a ukna deuh kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Opinion or policy
senses.definition_en: An opinion, attitude, or official policy concerning an issue.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat tung a ngaihsutna, dinmun ahih kei leh official thukhun.

examples.english: The organization explained its position on immigration.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in gamlut thu a ama’ ngaihsutna dinmun hilhcian hi.

examples.english: His position changed after he saw the evidence.
examples.zomi: Teci a muh khit ciangin ama’ ngaihsutna dinmun kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: A position on an issue is a view that someone is prepared to support or defend.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu khat tunga position pen mi khat in a panpih leh a dal dingin kigingsa ngaihsutna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Rank in relation to others
senses.definition_en: A person’s rank, status, or level within a group or society.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl ahih kei leh mihing kipawlna sung a mi khat’ dinmun, za ahih kei leh ciangtan.

examples.english: She holds a position of great responsibility.
examples.zomi: Vaipuak lian nei dinmun ah om hi.

examples.english: Education improved his social position.
examples.zomi: Pilna in ama’ mihing kipawlna dinmun hoih sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense concerns relative status rather than physical location.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in omna mun taktak hilo, midangte tawh a etkak dinmun a gen hi.

senses.heading: Hopeful or favorable
senses.definition_en: Hopeful, constructive, or focused on good possibilities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lametna nei, phattuam huai ahih kei leh hoihna lam a bulphuh.

examples.english: She maintained a positive attitude during treatment.
examples.zomi: Zatui kilam laitakin ngaihsutna hoih nei tawntung hi.

examples.english: The program had a positive effect on students.
examples.zomi: Tua program in sangnaupangte tungah huzaapna hoih nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Positive does not mean ignoring problems; it means approaching them constructively or recognizing favorable aspects.
senses.usage_zomi: Positive in buaina muhtheihloh sak cihna hilo a, hoihna piangsak dingin a dawnna zonna a cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Certain
senses.definition_en: Completely sure that something is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat maan cih kician takin thei leh muang.

examples.english: Are you positive that you locked the door?
examples.zomi: Kongkha na khak cih na kician hiam?

examples.english: I am not positive about the exact date.
examples.zomi: Ni taktak thu ka kician lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense commonly appears in the pattern positive that … or positive about ….
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen positive that … ahih kei leh positive about … cih zatdan tawh kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Showing presence in a medical test
senses.definition_en: Showing that a disease, condition, or substance is present.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a om cih a lak; positive
senses.explanation_zomi: Zatui sittelna in natna, dinmun ahih kei leh na khat om cih a lak.

examples.english: She tested positive for the infection.
examples.zomi: Sittelna ah tua natna gu nei cih kilang hi.

examples.english: A positive result does not always confirm the diagnosis.
examples.zomi: Positive thusuak in natna khensatna kipsak pahpah lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Medical test results require interpretation by a qualified professional; a positive result may sometimes be false.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatui sittelna thusuak pen siavuan ahih kei leh siamna nei mi in hilhcian kul a, positive thusuak khat a khial zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: Greater than zero
senses.definition_en: Greater than zero or marked with a plus sign in mathematics.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zero sangin lianzaw ahih kei leh mathematics ah plus ciamtehna nei.

examples.english: Five is a positive number.
examples.zomi: Nga pen zero sang lianzaw number ahi hi.

examples.english: The temperature remained positive throughout the day.
examples.zomi: Ni sung khempeuh in khuahun lumna zero tunga om hi.

senses.usage_en: In mathematics, positive numbers are greater than zero; zero itself is neither positive nor negative.
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics ah positive number pen zero sangin lianzaw a, zero amah positive zong hilo, negative zong hilo hi.

senses.heading: Own or have
senses.definition_en: To own or have something, especially a quality, object, or legal right.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat nei ahih kei leh thukham tawh a neitu hi.

examples.english: She possesses excellent communication skills.
examples.zomi: Kizopna leh thugenna siamna hoih mahmah nei hi.

examples.english: Only licensed people may possess this weapon.
examples.zomi: Phalna lai nei mite bek in hih galvan neithei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Possess is more formal than have. It is not normally used for ordinary family relationships.
senses.usage_zomi: Possess pen have sangin ukna deuh hi. Innkuan kizopna ngeina genna ah kizanglo hi.

senses.heading: Control someone’s mind or behavior
senses.definition_en: To control someone’s mind or behavior as if by a powerful force or spirit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tha ahih kei leh kha vang khat in mi khat’ lungsim leh gamtatna uk.

examples.english: He seemed possessed by anger.
examples.zomi: Hehna in ama ukcip bang kilang hi.

examples.english: The story describes a man possessed by an evil spirit.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu in kha sia in a neih pasal khat gen hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may be literal in religious contexts or figurative when describing a powerful emotion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen biakna thu ah a taktak in kizangthei a, lungsim sukna thahat genna ah tehkakna in zong kizangthei hi.

senses.heading: Ownership or control
senses.definition_en: The state of owning, having, or controlling something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat neih, khut sungah kem ahih kei leh uk dinmun.

examples.english: She is in possession of the original document.
examples.zomi: Lai bulpi amah in nei hi.

examples.english: The buyer took possession of the house in June.
examples.zomi: Leipa in June kha in inn neihna la hi.

senses.usage_en: In possession of is formal and means having or controlling something.
senses.usage_zomi: In possession of pen ukna pau ahi a, na khat nei ahih kei leh khut sungah kem cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Something owned
senses.definition_en: An object or other item that belongs to someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ neih van ahih kei leh neihsa.

examples.english: They packed their possessions into boxes.
examples.zomi: Amau’ neihsate bawmte sungah koih uh hi.

examples.english: This photograph is her most valuable possession.
examples.zomi: Hih camera lim pen ama’ neihsa manphapen ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is often plural because it commonly refers to several belongings.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen neihsa pawlkhat a kawk zel ahih manin plural in kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Control of a ball
senses.definition_en: Control of the ball by a player or team in a sport.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna ah kimawlpa ahih kei leh pawl khat in go a uk laitak.

examples.english: Our team kept possession for most of the match.
examples.zomi: Kidemna hun a tamzaw ka pawl un go uk uh hi.

examples.english: He lost possession near the goal.
examples.zomi: Goal gei ah go taan hi.

senses.usage_en: In sports, possession describes which player or team currently controls the ball.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna ah possession in tua hun a go a uk kimawlpa ahih kei leh pawl a gen hi.

senses.heading: Chance that something may happen
senses.definition_en: The chance that something may exist, happen, or be true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat om, piang ahih kei leh maan theihna.

examples.english: There is a possibility of rain tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zan guah zuhtheihna om hi.

examples.english: We cannot ignore the possibility that the plan may fail.
examples.zomi: Geelna guallel kha ding cih piangtheihna pampaih theilo hihang.

senses.usage_en: Use possibility of before a noun or possibility that before a clause.
senses.usage_zomi: Min ma-ah possibility of kizang a, clause ma-ah possibility that kizang hi.

senses.heading: Available choice or opportunity
senses.definition_en: One of the choices, opportunities, or courses of action that could be considered.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsut leh teel theih ding teelna, hunhoih ahih kei leh nasep lampi khat.

examples.english: Working from home is one possibility.
examples.zomi: Inn pan nasep pen teeltheihna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting allowed us to explore several possibilities.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna in teeltheihna pawlkhat kancian theisak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a possibility is an option that may be practical or worth considering.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah possibility pen bawltheih leh ngaihsut kilawm teeltheihna khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Able to happen or exist
senses.definition_en: Able to happen, exist, be done, or be true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piang, om, kibawl ahih kei leh maan thei.

examples.english: Is it possible to finish the work today?
examples.zomi: Tuni in nasep zohtheih ding ahi hiam?

examples.english: We will reply as soon as possible.
examples.zomi: A manlang theipen in ka dawng ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use possible to do something or possible that something will happen.
senses.usage_zomi: Possible to do something ahih kei leh possible that something will happen cih zatdan kizang hi.

senses.heading: Suitable for consideration
senses.definition_en: Worth considering as a choice, explanation, or solution.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teelna, hilhcian na ahih kei leh dawnna khat bangin ngaihsut kilawm.

examples.english: We discussed three possible solutions.
examples.zomi: Dawnna hithei thum ka kikup uh hi.

examples.english: She is a possible candidate for the position.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep mun ading teeltheih mi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, possible does not mean certain or even likely; it means not ruled out.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah possible in a kician ahih kei leh a piang ding mah cihna hilo a, hitheihna a om lai cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Perhaps; used when something may be true or may happen, but is not certain.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a hi kha ding; a piang kha ding
senses.explanation_zomi: A hi kha ding ahih kei leh a piang kha ding, ahihhang a kician nailo.

common_phrases.zomi: a hang pen … hi kha ding

examples.english: The train will possibly arrive late.
examples.zomi: Train zek in hong tung kha ding hi.

examples.english: Could you possibly help me tomorrow?
examples.zomi: Zingciang hong huh thei kha diam?

senses.usage_en: Possibly expresses uncertainty. In polite questions, it can make a request sound less direct.
senses.usage_zomi: Possibly in kicianlohna a lak hi. Zia-etna dotna ah ngenna tang lua lo dingin zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: Mail system
senses.definition_en: The system used to collect, carry, and deliver letters and packages.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai leh van tuamte la, pua leh a tunna ding munah pia system.

examples.english: I sent the documents by post.
examples.zomi: Lai-te mail tawh kapaisak hi.

examples.english: Your package is already in the post.
examples.zomi: Na van tuam mail tawh kipaisak khin hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is common in British English. American English usually uses mail.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna British English ah kizangpha hi. American English ah mail kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Job or official position
senses.definition_en: A job or position of responsibility, especially in an organization or public service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kipawlna ahih kei leh mipite nasepna sung a nasep mun leh vaipuak.

examples.english: She applied for a teaching post.
examples.zomi: Sia nasep mun khat ngen hi.

examples.english: He was appointed to a senior government post.
examples.zomi: Kumpi nasep vaipuak lian khat ah kiseh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is more common in British English; American English often uses position.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan British English ah kizangzaw a, American English ah position kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Online message
senses.definition_en: A message, picture, or other content published on a website or social-media platform.
senses.explanation_zomi: Website ahih kei leh social media platform tungah a kisuah thupuak, lim ahih kei leh thu dang.

examples.english: Her post received hundreds of comments.
examples.zomi: Ama’ post in comment za tampi ngah hi.

examples.english: I saw the announcement in an online post.
examples.zomi: Tangko thu online post khat sungah ka mu hi.

senses.usage_en: In digital contexts, post can be both a noun and a verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Digital thu ah post pen noun leh verb a nihgel in kizangthei hi.

senses.heading: Upright support
senses.definition_en: A strong upright piece of wood or metal used to support something or mark a boundary.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a tun ahih kei leh gamgi a ciamteh dingin a kiphut sing ahih kei leh sum tung.

examples.english: The fence posts were damaged by the storm.
examples.zomi: Huipi in kulh singtungte susia hi.

examples.english: The ball struck the goal post.
examples.zomi: Go in goal tung vaw hi.

senses.usage_en: This physical meaning refers to a fixed upright support, not a job or message.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in a kiphut tung taktak a gen a, nasep mun ahih kei leh thupuak a genlo hi.

senses.definition_en: A large printed sheet with words or pictures, displayed publicly to give information or advertise something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu pia, tangko ahih kei leh van khat advertise dingin mipite muhna ah a kikhai lai lian.

examples.english: The students made a poster about recycling.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in van zatkikna thu poster khat bawl uh hi.

examples.english: A concert poster hung on the wall.
examples.zomi: La pawi poster khat kulh tungah kingai hi.

senses.usage_en: A poster is designed to be viewed from a distance and usually combines brief text with strong visual elements.
senses.usage_zomi: Poster pen gamla pan zong muh theih dingin kibawl a, a tamzaw in lai tom leh lim kician kigawm hi.

senses.heading: Cooking container
senses.definition_en: A deep, usually round container used for cooking food.
senses.explanation_zomi: Anhuan dingin kizang, a thuk leh a tamzaw in a um beel.

examples.english: She cooked rice in a large pot.
examples.zomi: Beel lian khat sungah buh huan hi.

examples.english: The soup is still in the pot.
examples.zomi: Thuh beel sungah om lai hi.

senses.usage_en: A pot is usually deeper than a pan and often has two small handles.
senses.usage_zomi: Pot pen pan sangin thukzaw a, a tamzaw in a langnih ah paaina nei hi.

senses.heading: Plant container
senses.definition_en: A container used for growing a plant.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sing leh pak khangsakna ding lei kikhum kuang.

examples.english: The flowers are growing in clay pots.
examples.zomi: Pakte leibeel sungah khang uh hi.

examples.english: Move the plant into a larger pot.
examples.zomi: Tua sing beel lianzaw sungah suan in.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether pot is used for cooking or for growing plants.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kigenna pan pot pen anhuan beel maw, sing khanna kuang maw cih kitel hi.

senses.definition_en: A round or oval underground vegetable with pale flesh and brown, red, or yellow skin.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei nuaiah khang, a sung kangtaang leh a vun kawikawi, san ahih kei leh eng nei antam.

examples.english: She added potatoes to the soup.
examples.zomi: Thuh sungah alu behlap hi.

examples.english: The farmers harvested the potatoes in autumn.
examples.zomi: Lote in autumn hunah alu lakhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is potatoes, with -es.
senses.usage_zomi: Potato a plural pen potatoes ahi a, -es kibehlap hi.

senses.definition_en: Possible in the future, although not yet certain or fully developed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu in a kician nailo napi, mailam ah piang ahih kei leh suakthei.

examples.english: The report identifies several potential risks.
examples.zomi: Report in piangthei lauhuaina pawlkhat ciamteh hi.

examples.english: She met with potential investors.
examples.zomi: Sum koih ding hithei mite tawh kimu hi.

senses.usage_en: Potential describes something that may become real later; it does not mean that it will certainly happen.
senses.usage_zomi: Potential in mailam ah a taktak suakthei cihna ahi a, piang ding kician cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Unit of weight
senses.definition_en: A unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or about 0.454 kilograms.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ounce sawmlehguk ahih kei leh kilogram 0.454 tawh a kikhim gikna tehna.

examples.english: The bag weighs twenty pounds.
examples.zomi: Tua ip pound sawmnih gik hi.

examples.english: She bought one pound of beef.
examples.zomi: Sabil pound khat lei hi.

senses.usage_en: The abbreviation for this unit is lb, and the plural is pounds.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehna a tomgelh pen lb ahi a, a plural pen pounds ahi hi.

senses.heading: British currency
senses.definition_en: The main unit of money in the United Kingdom and some other countries.
senses.explanation_zomi: United Kingdom leh gam dang pawlkhat a sum tehna bulpi.

examples.english: The book costs fifteen pounds.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu pound sawmlehnga man hi.

examples.english: She paid with a twenty-pound note.
examples.zomi: Pound sawmnih sumlai tawh pia hi.

senses.usage_en: The currency symbol is £. Do not confuse the currency with the unit of weight.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum ciamtehna pen £ ahi hi. Gikna tehna pound tawh kitelkhial sak kei in.

senses.heading: Make liquid flow
senses.definition_en: To make a liquid or small loose material flow from one container into another place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui ahih kei leh a neu vutvut na khat kuang sungpan mun dangah luangsak.

examples.english: Please pour the tea into these cups.
examples.zomi: Ningsa hih hai-te sungah buak in.

examples.english: He poured the rice into a large container.
examples.zomi: Buh pen kuang lian khat sungah buak hi.

senses.usage_en: The common pattern is pour something into/from/over something.
senses.usage_zomi: A ngeina zatdan pen pour something into/from/over something ahi hi.

senses.heading: Rain heavily
senses.definition_en: To rain very heavily.
senses.explanation_zomi: Guah nasa takin zu.

examples.english: It began pouring just as we left.
examples.zomi: Ka paikhiat laitakun guahpi zu kipan hi.

examples.english: It poured throughout the night.
examples.zomi: Zan sung khempeuh guahpi zu hi.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, It’s pouring means that it is raining very heavily.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina English ah It’s pouring in guah nasa takin a zu cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The condition of having very little money and lacking basic needs such as food, housing, healthcare, or education.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum neilo leh an, inn, cidamna huhna ahih kei leh pilna bang nuntakna kisap bulpite a kicing a ngahlo dinmun.

examples.english: The program helps families escape poverty.
examples.zomi: Tua program in innkuante zawngkhalna pan suahtak ding huh hi.

examples.english: Poverty limits access to education and healthcare.
examples.zomi: Zawngkhalna in pilna leh cidamna huhna ngah theihna ciangtan hi.

senses.usage_en: Poverty is normally uncountable and describes a social and economic condition, not simply temporary shortage of cash.
senses.usage_zomi: Poverty pen simtheih lo min ahi a, hun tom sung sum tawmlua cih bek hilo, mihing leh sumvai dinmun a gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A dry substance consisting of very small, loose particles.
senses.explanation_zomi: A keu, a neu vutvut leh khat leh khat kizomlo na.

examples.english: Mix the powder with warm water.
examples.zomi: Powder tui lum tawh hel in.

examples.english: The medicine is available as a powder.
examples.zomi: Tua zatui powder pianin ngah theih hi.

senses.usage_en: Powder may be countable when referring to different types, but it is usually uncountable as a substance.
senses.usage_zomi: Powder nam tuamtuam gen ciangin simtheih hithei napi, material a cihna ah simtheih lo min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Control or authority
senses.definition_en: The ability or legal authority to control people, make decisions, or cause change.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite uk, khensatna bawl ahih kei leh kikhelhna piangsaktheihna leh thuneihna.

examples.english: The constitution limits the government’s power.
examples.zomi: Gam thukhunpi in kumpi’ thuneihna ciangtan hi.

examples.english: Power should be used responsibly.
examples.zomi: Thuneihna vaipuak nei takin kizang ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Power may be formal, such as legal authority, or informal, such as influence over others.
senses.usage_zomi: Power pen thukham tawh kipia thuneihna hithei a, midangte tunga huzaapna zong hithei hi.

senses.heading: Energy or electricity
senses.definition_en: Energy used to operate machines, devices, buildings, or vehicles.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine, vanzat, inn ahih kei leh mawtaw a nasem sak tha ahih kei leh meitha.

examples.english: The storm cut power to thousands of homes.
examples.zomi: Huipi in inn tul tampi meivak tha tansak hi.

examples.english: This device uses very little power.
examples.zomi: Hih vanzat meitha tawm mahmah zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In everyday contexts, power often means electricity, especially in expressions such as power cut or power supply.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim pau ah power in meitha a kawk zel a, a diak in power cut leh power supply bangah ahi hi.

senses.heading: Physical ability or force
senses.definition_en: Great strength, force, or ability to produce an effect.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thahatna, guulna ahih kei leh huzaapna piangsaktheihna.

examples.english: The engine has enough power to pull the load.
examples.zomi: Engine in van gik kai ding thahatna kicing nei hi.

examples.english: The storm showed the power of nature.
examples.zomi: Huipi in piansakna thahatna lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Context determines whether power means authority, energy, or strength.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kigenna pan power pen thuneihna maw, meitha maw, thahatna maw cih kitel hi.

senses.heading: Having great control or influence
senses.definition_en: Having great authority, control, or influence over people and events.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite leh piangnate tungah thuneihna ahih kei leh huzaapna lian nei.

examples.english: The organization became politically powerful.
examples.zomi: Tua kipawlna gamvai ah vanglian suak hi.

examples.english: Powerful leaders must be held accountable.
examples.zomi: Makaite vanglian amau’ nasepna dawng ding vaipuak koih kul hi.

senses.usage_en: A powerful person can strongly affect decisions or other people.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi vanglian in khensatna leh midangte nakpitakin huzaap thei hi.

senses.heading: Having great strength or effect
senses.definition_en: Having great physical strength, force, or effect.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi thahatna, guulna ahih kei leh huzaapna lian nei.

examples.english: The car has a powerful engine.
examples.zomi: Tua mawtaw in engine thahat nei hi.

examples.english: Her speech carried a powerful message.
examples.zomi: Ama’ thugen in thupuak huzaapna lian nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Powerful may describe physical force, emotional effect, medicine, machines, arguments, or language.
senses.usage_zomi: Powerful in pumpi guulna, lungsim huzaapna, zatui, machine, nialna ahih kei leh kammal a gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Useful and workable
senses.definition_en: Suitable for real situations and likely to work effectively.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun taktak ah zatphat leh hoih takin nasemthei.

examples.english: We need a practical solution to the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaina ading dawnna zatphat khat ka kisam uh hi.

examples.english: The guide provides practical advice for beginners.
examples.zomi: Makaihna lai in a kipan mite ading thuhilhna zatphat pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A practical idea can be carried out successfully, not merely discussed in theory.
senses.usage_zomi: Practical ngaihsutna pen pilna ngaihsutna bek hilo, a taktak in bawl leh zat theih ahi hi.

senses.heading: Based on doing
senses.definition_en: Involving actual experience or activity rather than only ideas or theory.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khut tawh bawl; a taktak nasep
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna leh pilna thu bek hilo, a taktak in bawl leh a thuakna tawh kisai.

examples.english: The course combines theory with practical training.
examples.zomi: Tua sinna in pilna thu leh khut tawh sinna kigawm hi.

examples.english: She has practical experience in accounting.
examples.zomi: Sum simna ah a taktak nasep thuakna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Practical training emphasizes learning by doing.
senses.usage_zomi: Practical training in na khat a taktak in bawl kawm a sinna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Sensible
senses.definition_en: Good at making sensible decisions and dealing with everyday problems.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nisim buainate kician takin dawng leh khensatna kilawm a bawl siam.

examples.english: She is practical and handles problems calmly.
examples.zomi: Ama mi khensiam a, buainate lungnem takin kem hi.

examples.english: Let us be practical about the cost.
examples.zomi: A man thu a bawltheihlam tawh kingaihsun ni.

senses.usage_en: A practical person focuses on workable facts and solutions.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi practical in a bawltheih thumaan leh dawnna-te a bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Repeated training
senses.definition_en: Regular repeated activity done to improve a skill.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siamna khat khangto sak dingin a kibawl kikkik sinna.

examples.english: Regular practice will improve your pronunciation.
examples.zomi: Hun ciangtan kizui a sinna in na pronunciation hoih sak ding hi.

examples.english: The team has football practice this evening.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitak in tua pawl football kisinsakna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Practice is the noun in both American and British English. The British verb is spelled practise.
senses.usage_zomi: American leh British English a nihgel ah noun pen practice kici hi. British English verb pen practise ci in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Usual way of doing something
senses.definition_en: A customary or established way of doing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kibawl zel ngeina ahih kei leh kip thukhun tawh a kisem dan.

examples.english: It is common practice to confirm appointments by email.
examples.zomi: Appointment email tawh kipsak pen ngeina kizangpha ahi hi.

examples.english: The company follows safe working practices.
examples.zomi: Company in bitna nei nasep ngeinate zui hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, practice means an established habit or procedure, not training.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah practice in sinna hilo, ngeina ahih kei leh nasep kalsuan kipsa a gen hi.

senses.heading: Professional business
senses.definition_en: The work or business of a doctor, lawyer, or similar professional.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siavuan, thukham siam ahih kei leh pilna nasep siam khat’ nasepna leh office.

examples.english: She joined a medical practice in Columbus.
examples.zomi: Columbus a siavuan nasepna khat ah nasem hi.

examples.english: He opened his own legal practice.
examples.zomi: Ama’ thukham nasepna office hon hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense refers to professional work or the organization through which it is provided.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in pilna nasep ahih kei leh tua nasep a piakna kipawlna a gen hi.

senses.heading: Train repeatedly
senses.definition_en: To do an activity repeatedly in order to improve a skill.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siamna khangto sak dingin nasepna khat bawl kikkik.

examples.english: She practises English pronunciation every day.
examples.zomi: Ni simin English pronunciation kisinsak hi.

examples.english: We practised the song before the performance.
examples.zomi: Limlakna ma-in la ka kisin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Practise is the British verb spelling. American English uses practice for both the noun and verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Practise pen British English verb gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah noun leh verb a nihgel practice ci in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Work in a profession
senses.definition_en: To work as a doctor, lawyer, or member of another skilled profession.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pilna nasep sem; nasep siam sem
senses.explanation_zomi: Siavuan, thukham siam ahih kei leh pilna nasep siam khat in nasem.

examples.english: She practises medicine in a rural community.
examples.zomi: Khuano gamah siavuan nasep sem hi.

examples.english: He is licensed to practise law in Ohio.
examples.zomi: Ohio ah thukham nasep sem ding phalna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This professional meaning is formal and commonly used with medicine or law.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pilna nasep khiatna pen ukna deuh a, medicine leh law tawh kizangpha hi.

senses.definition_en: Words or actions expressing approval, admiration, or respect.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungkimna, phatna ahih kei leh zahtakna a pulaak kammal leh gamtatna.

examples.english: The student received praise for her hard work.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang in a hanciamna hangin phatna ngah hi.

examples.english: The book earned high praise from critics.
examples.zomi: Laibu in entel siamte kiangpan phatna lian ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Praise is normally uncountable. To identify one statement, use a compliment or a word of praise.
senses.usage_zomi: Praise pen simtheih lo min ahi zel hi. Phatna kammal khat gen dingin a compliment ahih kei leh a word of praise kici hi.

senses.definition_en: To speak to Pasian in worship, thanks, confession, or a request for help.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pasian biak, lungdam koh, mawhna pulak ahih kei leh huhna ngen dingin Pasian kiangah thungen.

examples.english: The family prayed together before the meal.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in an nekma-in thungenkhawm uh hi.

examples.english: We prayed for those affected by the disaster.
examples.zomi: Tua siatna a thuakte ading ka thungen uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use pray to for the one addressed and pray for for the person or result requested.
senses.usage_zomi: Thungetna a kipiakpa ma-ah pray to kizang a, a thunget sak mi ahih kei leh thusuak ma-ah pray for kizang hi.

senses.heading: Act or words of praying
senses.definition_en: Words spoken or thought when communicating with Pasian.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pasian tawh kizopna ah kam tawh ahih kei leh lungsim sungah kigen thu.

examples.english: She said a short prayer before sleeping.
examples.zomi: A ihmutma-in thungetna tom khat bawl hi.

examples.english: The church held a prayer meeting.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi in thunget kikhopna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Prayer can be countable for particular words or requests and uncountable for the general activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Thungetna kician khat gen ciangin prayer simtheih ahi a, thungetna nasep a vekpi gen ciangin simtheih lo min ahi hi.

senses.heading: Strong hope or request
senses.definition_en: A strong hope or request, especially one directed to Pasian.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lamenna leh ngenna lian, a diak in Pasian kiangah kipia.

examples.english: Our prayer is that peace will return.
examples.zomi: Ka thungetna uh pen nopna hong omkik ding cih ahi hi.

examples.english: You are in our prayers.
examples.zomi: Ka thungetna sung un kong phawk uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In Christian usage, prayer includes worship and relationship with Pasian, not only asking for something.
senses.usage_zomi: Christian zatdan ah thungetna in Pasian biakna leh Pasian tawh kizopna huam a, na khat ngen bek hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: To state what is expected to happen in the future, based on information, evidence, or judgment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, teci ahih kei leh ngaihsut siamzia bulphuh in mailam a piang ding genkhol.

examples.english: Scientists cannot predict exactly when the earthquake will occur.
examples.zomi: Scientists in zinliing bang hun taktak a piang ding genkhol theilo uh hi.

examples.english: The report predicts slower economic growth.
examples.zomi: Report in sumvai khantohna neemzaw ding genkhol hi.

senses.usage_en: A prediction may be evidence-based but is not a guarantee.
senses.usage_zomi: Genkholna pen teci tungah kingathei napi, piang ding kipsakna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A statement about what someone expects to happen in the future.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in mailam ah bang piang dingin a lamet cih a genkholna.

examples.english: Her prediction proved correct.
examples.zomi: Ama’ genkholna maan hi.

examples.english: Economic predictions are often uncertain.
examples.zomi: Sumvai genkholnate a tamzaw in kicianlo hi.

senses.usage_en: A prediction concerns a future outcome; a forecast is especially common for weather, economics, and measurable trends.
senses.usage_zomi: Prediction in mailam thusuak a gen a, forecast pen khuahun, sumvai leh teh theih kalsuan genna ah kizangpha hi.

senses.definition_en: To like or choose one person or thing more than another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat midang ahih kei leh na dang sangin deihzaw ahih kei leh teelzaw.

examples.english: I prefer tea to coffee.
examples.zomi: Coffee sangin ningsa ka deihzaw hi.

examples.english: She prefers working in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingkal a nasep deihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Use prefer A to B, not normally prefer A than B. It may be followed by a noun, -ing form, or infinitive.
senses.usage_zomi: Prefer A to B kici a, prefer A than B kici ngeilo hi. A nungah min, -ing form ahih kei leh infinitive hong pai thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Carrying a developing baby inside the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Numei ahih kei leh ganhing numei sungah nau a khan laitak.

examples.english: She is six months pregnant.
examples.zomi: Naupai kha guk pha hi.

examples.english: Pregnant women need appropriate medical care.
examples.zomi: Naupai nute cidamna huhna kituak kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Say pregnant with twins or six months pregnant. Avoid using pregnant as a noun for a woman.
senses.usage_zomi: Pregnant with twins ahih kei leh six months pregnant kici hi. Numei khat min khelna noun in pregnant zang kei in.

senses.heading: Process of getting ready
senses.definition_en: The work or process of making someone or something ready.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a kigingsa dingin a kibawl nasep leh kalsuan.

examples.english: Good preparation reduced our stress.
examples.zomi: Kigingna hoih in ka lungsim gimna uh tawm sak hi.

examples.english: The team began preparation for the competition.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl kidemna ading kigingsa kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is usually uncountable when referring to the overall process.
senses.usage_zomi: Kigingna kalsuan a vekpi gen ciangin hih khiatna simtheih lo min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Something prepared
senses.definition_en: A substance, medicine, or food made for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna tuam khat ading a kibawl zatui, an ahih kei leh na kigawm.

examples.english: The cream is a preparation for dry skin.
examples.zomi: Tua cream pen vun keu ading zatui kigawm ahi hi.

examples.english: Follow the instructions for food preparation.
examples.zomi: An bawldan thuhilhna zui in.

senses.usage_en: This countable sense commonly refers to a specially made product or mixture.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih simtheih khiatna in ngimna tuam khat ading a kibawl van ahih kei leh na kigawm a gen hi.

senses.heading: Make ready
senses.definition_en: To make someone or something ready for an activity, event, or future situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna, vaipuak ahih kei leh mailam dinmun khat ading mi ahih kei leh na khat kigingsa sak.

examples.english: We prepared the room for the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ading inndei ka bawlkhol uh hi.

examples.english: She is preparing for her final examination.
examples.zomi: Ama’ sittelna nunung ading kigingsa hi.

senses.usage_en: Use prepare something but prepare for an event: prepare the meal and prepare for the meeting.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat bawlkhol ciangin prepare something kici a, vaipuak ading kiging ciangin prepare for an event kici hi.

senses.heading: Make food or medicine
senses.definition_en: To make food, drink, medicine, or another substance ready for use.
senses.explanation_zomi: An, dawnna, zatui ahih kei leh na khat zat dingin bawl.

examples.english: He prepared dinner for the family.
examples.zomi: Innkuan ading nitak an huan hi.

examples.english: The pharmacist prepared the medicine carefully.
examples.zomi: Zatui siampa in zatui kidop takin bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Prepare food is slightly more formal and broader than cook food, because preparation can include washing, cutting, and mixing.
senses.usage_zomi: Prepare food pen cook food sangin ukna leh zaangzaw a, sawp, aat, hel leh huan kalsuante huamthei hi.

senses.heading: Ready
senses.definition_en: Ready for an event, activity, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vaipuak, nasepna ahih kei leh dinmun khat ading kigingsa.

examples.english: We are prepared for the coming storm.
examples.zomi: Huipi hong tung ding ading ka kigingsa uh hi.

examples.english: She came to the meeting well prepared.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ah hoih takin kigingsa in hong pai hi.

senses.usage_en: Use prepared for before a situation and prepared to before an action.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun khat ma-ah prepared for kizang a, gamtatna khat ma-ah prepared to kizang hi.

senses.heading: Willing
senses.definition_en: Willing and ready to do something, especially something difficult.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat, a diak in na haksa khat sem ding lungkim leh kigingsa.

examples.english: I am prepared to wait for the right opportunity.
examples.zomi: Hunhoih maan ngah dong ngak ding ka kigingsa hi.

examples.english: They were not prepared to accept the proposal.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna sang ding lungkimlo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Prepared to often emphasizes willingness, not merely advance planning.
senses.usage_zomi: Prepared to in a tamzaw in bawlkholna bek hilo, sep ding lungkimna a thupisak hi.

senses.heading: State of being present
senses.definition_en: The state of being in a particular place or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih kei leh dinmun tuam khat ah mi khat a omna.

common_phrases.zomi: … ma-ah ahih kei leh ompihna ah

examples.english: Your presence at the meeting is important.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ah na omna poimaw hi.

examples.english: He signed the document in the presence of two witnesses.
examples.zomi: Teci nih ma-ah lai min gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: In the presence of someone means while that person is there.
senses.usage_zomi: In the presence of someone in tua mi a om laitak ahih kei leh ama’ ma-ah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Noticeable influence or quality
senses.definition_en: A noticeable quality, influence, or impression created by a person or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat pan a kimu thei huzaapna, omzia ahih kei leh gingna.

examples.english: The company has a strong online presence.
examples.zomi: Company in online ah huzaapna lian nei hi.

examples.english: Her calm presence reassured the children.
examples.zomi: Ama’ lungnem omzia in nau pangte lungmuangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative meaning describes how strongly someone or something is noticed or felt.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkakna khiatna in mi ahih kei leh na khat’ omzia leh huzaapna bangzah kicianin kisa cih a gen hi.

senses.heading: Existing or happening now
senses.definition_en: Existing, happening, or being considered now.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu in a om, a piang ahih kei leh a kingaihsut.

examples.english: The present situation requires careful planning.
examples.zomi: Tu dinmun in kidop taka geelna kisam hi.

examples.english: The building is too small for our present needs.
examples.zomi: Tua inn pen tu a ka kisapna uh ading neu lua hi.

senses.usage_en: Present before a noun usually means “current.” Do not confuse it with the noun present, meaning a gift.
senses.usage_zomi: Min ma-ah present kizang ciangin “tu a” cihna ahi zel hi. Letsong a cihna noun present tawh kitelkhial sak kei in.

senses.heading: Being in a place
senses.definition_en: Being in a particular place or attending an event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun tuam khat ah om ahih kei leh vaipuak khat ah kihel.

examples.english: All members were present at the meeting.
examples.zomi: Member khempeuh kikhopna ah om uh hi.

examples.english: Was the manager present when it happened?
examples.zomi: Tua a piang laitakin manager a om hiam?

senses.usage_en: In this sense, present usually follows a linking verb: She was present.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah present pen linking verb nungah om zel hi: She was present.

senses.heading: Formal talk
senses.definition_en: A talk in which information, ideas, or proposals are explained to an audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngai mite kiangah thu, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh geelna hilhcian in a kigen thugenna.

examples.english: She gave a presentation on public health.
examples.zomi: Mipite cidamna thu pulaakna khat bawl hi.

examples.english: The presentation lasted thirty minutes.
examples.zomi: Thu pulaakna minute sawmthum sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: A presentation often uses slides, charts, pictures, or demonstrations to support the spoken explanation.
senses.usage_zomi: Presentation in thugenna panpih dingin slide, chart, lim ahih kei leh etsakna zang zel hi.

senses.heading: Way something is shown or arranged
senses.definition_en: The way something is displayed, arranged, or offered to others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat midangte kiangah a kilak, kizek ahih kei leh kipia dan.

examples.english: The food tasted good, but its presentation was poor.
examples.zomi: An a lim napi a kizekdan hoihlo hi.

examples.english: Clear presentation makes the report easier to understand.
examples.zomi: Lakdan kician in report tel baih sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning concerns appearance and arrangement rather than the content alone.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in thu sung omte bek hilo, a kilak leh kizekdan a bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Protect and maintain
senses.definition_en: To protect something and keep it in its original or good condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat mang, sia ahih kei leh kikhel lo dingin kemcing.

examples.english: We must preserve the Zomi language for future generations.
examples.zomi: Mailam khangte ading Zomi pau kemcing ding hihang.

examples.english: The museum preserves important historical records.
examples.zomi: Museum in tangthu ciamtehna poimawte kemcing hi.

senses.usage_en: Preserve means protecting something so that its important qualities continue.
senses.usage_zomi: Preserve in na khat’ a poimaw omzia manglo in om paisuak ding a kepna a cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Keep food from spoiling
senses.definition_en: To treat food so that it remains safe and usable for a longer time.
senses.explanation_zomi: An a muihlo leh hun sawtzaw zat theih dingin bawl leh kem.

examples.english: The fruit is preserved in sugar.
examples.zomi: Singgah sucih tawh kikemcing hi.

examples.english: Drying is one way to preserve food.
examples.zomi: An keusakna pen an kemcingdan khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Food may be preserved by drying, freezing, salting, canning, or adding sugar.
senses.usage_zomi: An pen keusak, vuksak, ci tawh kem, kuang sung khak ahih kei leh sucih behlap in kikemcing thei hi.

senses.heading: Head of a country
senses.definition_en: The elected or appointed head of state in a republic.
senses.explanation_zomi: Republic gam khat a kiteel ahih kei leh kiseh gam makaipen.

examples.english: The president addressed the nation.
examples.zomi: President in gam mipite kiangah thu gen hi.

examples.english: Voters will elect a new president.
examples.zomi: Teelmi in president thak khat teel ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize President when it appears directly before a person’s name as an official title.
senses.usage_zomi: Official minpuak tawh mi min ma-ah kizang ciangin President laimal lian tawh kipan ding hi.

senses.heading: Head of an organization
senses.definition_en: The person who leads a company, university, association, or other organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Company, university, kipawlna ahih kei leh pawl dang a makai mi.

examples.english: She was elected president of the association.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna president dingin kiteel hi.

examples.english: The company president announced the decision.
examples.zomi: Company president in khensatna tangko hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact responsibilities of an organizational president vary among institutions.
senses.usage_zomi: Kipawlna tuamtuam ah president vaipuak kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: Push firmly
senses.definition_en: To push something firmly with a hand, finger, tool, or weight.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khut, khutme, vanzat ahih kei leh gikna tawh na khat kipsak takin nem.

examples.english: Press the green button to start the machine.
examples.zomi: Machine kipat sak dingin button hing nem in.

examples.english: She pressed the cloth against the wound.
examples.zomi: Liampan ah puan sik hi.

senses.usage_en: Press normally suggests steady or deliberate pressure, while push may involve moving something away.
senses.usage_zomi: Press in ngiatna kiptak leh ngiimna nei a lak a, push in na khat gamla deuh ah a suan thei hi.

senses.heading: Urge strongly
senses.definition_en: To strongly encourage someone to act, answer, or make a decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat na sem, dawn ahih kei leh khensat ding kipsak takin sawl.

examples.english: Residents pressed the council to repair the road.
examples.zomi: Khuamite in council lampi bawlho ding sawl kinken uh hi.

examples.english: The reporter pressed him for an answer.
examples.zomi: News la mi in dawnna pia ding ngen kinken hi.

senses.usage_en: Press someone to do something means applying strong verbal or social pressure.
senses.usage_zomi: Press someone to do something in kam tawh ahih kei leh mipite huzaapna tawh mi khat sawl kinken cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Force against a surface
senses.definition_en: Physical force applied to or against a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat’ a tung ahih kei leh a langah a kisik pumpi tha.

examples.english: Apply pressure to the wound to stop the bleeding.
examples.zomi: Sisan luanna khawl dingin liampan sik in.

examples.english: The building has low water pressure.
examples.zomi: Tua inn tui sikna tha niam hi.

senses.usage_en: Blood pressure should be measured and interpreted by qualified healthcare professionals.
senses.usage_zomi: Sisan sikna siamna nei cidamna nasem in teh leh hilhcian ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Demands or stress
senses.definition_en: Worry, difficulty, or influence caused by demands, expectations, or urgent circumstances.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisapna, lametna ahih kei leh hun manlang dinmun hang a piang lungsim gimna leh huzaapna.

examples.english: She remained calm under pressure.
examples.zomi: Sawlna nuai ah zong lungnem takin om hi.

examples.english: Employees face pressure to work longer hours.
examples.zomi: Nasemte nai sawtzaw nasem ding sawlna thuak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Under pressure means facing stress or strong demands, not necessarily physical force.
senses.usage_zomi: Under pressure in lungsim gimna ahih kei leh sawlna lian thuak cihna ahi a, pumpi sikna bek hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: To behave as if something is true when it is not, often in play or to deceive someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a maanlo napi a maan bangin kineih ahih kei leh gamta.

examples.english: The children pretended to be doctors.
examples.zomi: Nau pangte siavuan bangin kineih uh hi.

examples.english: He pretended that he did not hear the question.
examples.zomi: Dotna a zaklo bangin kineih hi.

senses.usage_en: Use pretend to be/do something or pretend that …. Pretending may be playful or dishonest depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Pretend to be/do something ahih kei leh pretend that … cih zatdan kizang hi. Kineihna pen kimawlna hithei a, khemna zong hithei hi.

senses.definition_en: Attractive in a delicate, pleasant, or graceful way.
senses.explanation_zomi: A mel hoih, deihhuai leh a kizek nuam.

examples.english: She wore a pretty blue dress.
examples.zomi: Puan blue hoih khat silh hi.

examples.english: They live in a pretty village near the lake.
examples.zomi: Dil gei a khuano deihhuai khat ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Pretty often describes women, children, small objects, or places. For an attractive adult man, handsome is more traditional.
senses.usage_zomi: Pretty in numei, nau pang, van neu leh munte genna ah kizangpha hi. Pasal picing melhoih genna ah handsome ngeinazaw hi.

senses.definition_en: To stop something from happening or stop someone from doing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat pianglo sak ahih kei leh mi khat na semtheilo sak.

examples.english: Regular exercise can help prevent disease.
examples.zomi: Hun ciangtan kizui a pumpi sawlna in natna khaktan thei hi.

examples.english: The locked door prevented us from entering.
examples.zomi: Kongkha kikhak in ka lut theihna uh khaktan hi.

senses.usage_en: Use prevent someone from doing something, not prevent someone to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Prevent someone from doing something kici a, prevent someone to do something kici lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Existing or happening before the present one or before the time being discussed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu a om ahih kei leh kigen hun ma a om, a piang khinta.

examples.english: She has previous experience in management.
examples.zomi: Ukna nasep ah thuakna masa nei hi.

examples.english: The previous owner renovated the kitchen.
examples.zomi: Neipa masa in anhuanna bawlho hi.

senses.usage_en: Previous means earlier than the one being discussed. Last often means the most recent one before now.
senses.usage_zomi: Previous in kigen na sangin a masa cihna ahi a, last in a tamzaw in tu hun ma a om nailopen a kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Before now or before a particular time or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu hun ma-in ahih kei leh hun leh piangna kigen khat ma-in.

examples.english: She previously worked at a hospital.
examples.zomi: Nidangin hospital ah nasem hi.

examples.english: The building was previously used as a school.
examples.zomi: Tua inn pen a ma-in sanginn in kizang hi.

senses.usage_en: Previously is more formal than before and is common in reports and explanations.
senses.usage_zomi: Previously pen before sangin ukna deuh a, report leh hilhcian na ah kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Money required to buy something
senses.definition_en: The amount of money for which something is sold.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van ahih kei leh nasepna khat lei dingin piak kul sumzah.

examples.english: The price includes tax and delivery.
examples.zomi: A man sungah tax leh van puakna man huam hi.

examples.english: Food prices have increased this year.
examples.zomi: Tukum in an man khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use price for the amount charged; cost can also include time, effort, or other resources used.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum piak kulzah gen dingin price kizang a, cost in hun, hanciamna leh neihsa dang zatna zong a huamthei hi.

senses.heading: Loss or sacrifice required
senses.definition_en: A loss, difficulty, or sacrifice required to obtain something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngah dingin a taan, a thuak ahih kei leh a piak kulna.

examples.english: The country paid a high price for the war.
examples.zomi: Tua gam in gal hangin taan tampi nei hi.

examples.english: Success should not come at the price of your health.
examples.zomi: Gualzawhna pen na cidamna taan in hong omlo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative meaning refers to a harmful consequence or sacrifice, not a selling price.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkakna khiatna in vanman a genlo a, siatna thusuak ahih kei leh kipiakna a gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A person authorized to perform religious ceremonies and provide spiritual leadership in certain religions or Christian traditions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna pawl ahih kei leh Christian ngeina pawlkhat sungah biakna pawi makaih leh kha lam makaihna pia ding thuneihna nei mi.

examples.english: The priest led the worship service.
examples.zomi: Siampi in biakna makaih hi.

examples.english: She spoke with the priest after the ceremony.
examples.zomi: Pawi khit ciangin siampi tawh paukhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Christian traditions use different leadership titles, including priest, pastor, and minister; they are not always interchangeable.
senses.usage_zomi: Christian ngeina tuamtuam in priest, pastor, leh minister bang minpuakte zang uh a, khiatna kibang veklo hi.

senses.heading: Main or most important
senses.definition_en: More important than anything else being considered; main.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kingaihsut na dang khempeuh sangin a poimawzaw; a bulpi.

examples.english: Safety is our primary concern.
examples.zomi: Bitna pen ka ngaihsut poimawpen uh ahi hi.

examples.english: The dictionary serves as a primary reference source.
examples.zomi: Tua dictionary pen thu bulpi lakna source in kizang hi.

senses.usage_en: Primary often means first in importance, not necessarily first in time.
senses.usage_zomi: Primary in a tamzaw in poimawna ah masapen cihna ahi a, hun ah masapen ahi pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: Earliest level
senses.definition_en: Relating to the first stage of education or development.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna ahih kei leh khantohna kalsuan masapen tawh kisai.

examples.english: She teaches at a primary school.
examples.zomi: Kipatna sanginn ah sia sem hi.

examples.english: Reading is a major part of primary education.
examples.zomi: Lai simna pen pilna kipatna a khen poimaw khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, elementary school is more common than primary school.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah primary school sangin elementary school kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Direct or original
senses.definition_en: Coming directly from an original source or first-hand evidence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu bulpi piakna ahih kei leh mimal teci pan a hong pai pah.

common_phrases.zomi: kancianpa in a lak data bulpi

examples.english: Letters and diaries can be primary historical sources.
examples.zomi: Lai leh diary-te tangthu source bulpi hithei hi.

examples.english: The researchers collected primary data through interviews.
examples.zomi: Kanciante in interview tawh data bulpi la uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A primary source provides original or first-hand information; a secondary source analyzes or summarizes it.
senses.usage_zomi: Primary source in thu bulpi ahih kei leh mimal taka kimu thu pia a, secondary source in tua thu entel ahih kei leh tomgen hi.

senses.heading: Main or most important
senses.definition_en: Main, most important, or of greatest concern.
senses.explanation_zomi: A bulpi, a poimawpen ahih kei leh ngaihsut masapen.

examples.english: Safety is the prime consideration.
examples.zomi: Bitna pen ngaihsut masakpen ding ahi hi.

examples.english: Police identified a prime suspect.
examples.zomi: Police in kimawhsak pen mi khat ciamteh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, prime is similar to primary but often emphasizes the highest importance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah prime leh primary kibang a, prime in a poimawpen ahihna thupisakzaw hi.

senses.heading: Best or highest quality
senses.definition_en: Of the best quality or in the most successful and active stage.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoihpen ciangtan nei ahih kei leh nuntakna a thahatpen hun a om.

examples.english: The shop is in a prime location.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr mun hoihpen khat ah om hi.

examples.english: She is in the prime of her career.
examples.zomi: Ama’ nasepna nuntak sung a gualzawhpen hunah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Prime before a noun often means excellent, especially desirable, or at the best stage.
senses.usage_zomi: Min ma-ah prime kizang ciangin a hoih mahmah, a deihhuai mahmah ahih kei leh a hoihpen hun a cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A male member of a royal family, especially a son or grandson of a king or queen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi innkuan sung a pasal, a diak in kumpipa ahih kei leh kumpinu’ tapa leh tupa.

examples.english: The prince attended the national ceremony.
examples.zomi: Prince in gam pawi ah kihel hi.

examples.english: The crown prince will succeed the king.
examples.zomi: Kumpi suak ding prince in kumpipa’ mun la ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Prince when it appears directly before a person’s name as a title.
senses.usage_zomi: Minpuak bangin mi min ma-ah kizang ciangin Prince laimal lian tawh kipan ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A female member of a royal family, especially a daughter or granddaughter of a king or queen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi innkuan sung a numei, a diak in kumpipa ahih kei leh kumpinu’ tanu leh tunu.

examples.english: The princess opened the new hospital.
examples.zomi: Princess in hospital thak hon hi.

examples.english: The story is about a brave princess.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu pen princess hangsanu khat thu ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Princess when it is used directly before a person’s name as an official title.
senses.usage_zomi: Official minpuak tawh mi min ma-ah kizang ciangin Princess laimal lian tawh kipan ding hi.

senses.heading: Moral rule or belief
senses.definition_en: A basic moral rule or belief that guides a person’s decisions and behavior.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ khensatna leh gamtatna a makaih gamtat hoih thukhun ahih kei leh upna bulpi.

examples.english: Honesty is one of her guiding principles.
examples.zomi: Thumaan pen ama makaih thukhun bulpi lakpan khat ahi hi.

examples.english: He refused to act against his principles.
examples.zomi: Ama’ thukhun bulpite langdo in gamta nuamlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse principle with principal. A principle is a rule; principal usually means main or a school leader.
senses.usage_zomi: Principle leh principal kitelkhial sak kei in. Principle pen thukhun ahi a, principal in a bulpi ahih kei leh sanginn makaipa a cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Basic scientific or working rule
senses.definition_en: A basic rule explaining how something works or why something happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bangci nasem ahih kei leh banghangin piang cih a hilhcian thukhun bulpi.

examples.english: The machine works on a simple mechanical principle.
examples.zomi: Machine pen mechanic thukhun baihlam khat tawh nasem hi.

examples.english: Students learned the basic principles of electricity.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte meitha thukhun bulpite sin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A principle is a general foundational rule, while a procedure gives particular steps to follow.
senses.usage_zomi: Principle pen thukhun bulpi zaang ahi a, procedure in zuih ding kalsuan kician pia hi.

senses.heading: Produce text or images on paper
senses.definition_en: To produce words or pictures on paper using a machine.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine zangin lai ahih kei leh lim laipheek tungah suah.

examples.english: Please print two copies of the report.
examples.zomi: Report copy nih print in.

examples.english: The photograph was printed in color.
examples.zomi: Camera lim puan dial tawh kiprint hi.

senses.usage_en: Use print out when emphasizing that a digital file is being produced on paper.
senses.usage_zomi: Digital file lai tungah a kisuahna thupisak dingin print out kizang hi.

senses.heading: Publish in a book or newspaper
senses.definition_en: To publish words or pictures in a book, magazine, or newspaper.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai leh lim laibu, magazine ahih kei leh newspaper sungah suah.

examples.english: The newspaper printed her letter.
examples.zomi: Newspaper in ama’ lai suah hi.

examples.english: The correction will be printed tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Thupuahna zingciang in kisuah ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In publishing, print may mean making content publicly available in a physical publication.
senses.usage_zomi: Laibu suahna ah print in thu khat lai tungtawn a mipite kiangah suah cihna hithei hi.

senses.heading: Printing machine
senses.definition_en: A machine that produces text or images on paper from a computer or another device.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer ahih kei leh vanzat dangpan lai leh lim laipheek tungah a suah machine.

examples.english: The printer has run out of paper.
examples.zomi: Printer lai bei hi.

examples.english: Connect the printer to the computer.
examples.zomi: Printer computer tawh zom in.

senses.usage_en: A printer produces paper copies; a scanner converts paper documents into digital images.
senses.usage_zomi: Printer in lai copy suah a, scanner in laipheek a thu digital lim suaksak hi.

senses.heading: Person or company that prints
senses.definition_en: A person or company whose business is producing books, documents, or other printed material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, lai leh print nate suahna tawh sumleina a sem mi ahih kei leh company.

examples.english: The publisher sent the book to the printer.
examples.zomi: Laibu suah company in laibu printer kiangah paisak hi.

examples.english: The printer produced five hundred copies.
examples.zomi: Lai suahpa in copy zanga suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether printer means a machine or a printing business.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kigenna pan printer pen machine maw, lai suah mi ahih kei leh company maw cih kitel hi.

senses.heading: Production of printed material
senses.definition_en: The process or business of producing books, documents, or images on paper.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, lai ahih kei leh lim laipheek tungah suahna kalsuan leh sumleina.

examples.english: Printing the book took three weeks.
examples.zomi: Laibu printing kaal thum sawt hi.

examples.english: Digital printing is useful for small quantities.
examples.zomi: Copy tawm bek suah dingin digital printing phatuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Printing refers to the process; a print may refer to one printed image or copy.
senses.usage_zomi: Printing in suahna kalsuan a gen a, a print in lim ahih kei leh copy khat a genthei hi.

senses.heading: Particular printed edition
senses.definition_en: A group of copies produced at the same time from the same edition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Edition khat mah pan hun khat sung a kisuah copy pawl.

examples.english: The first printing sold out quickly.
examples.zomi: Print masapen manlang takin ki zuakzo hi.

examples.english: Several errors were corrected in the second printing.
examples.zomi: Print nihna ah khialhna pawlkhat kipuah hi.

senses.usage_en: A new printing may reproduce the same edition, while a new edition normally contains revisions.
senses.usage_zomi: Printing thak in edition kibang copy suahkik thei a, edition thak in a tamzaw in puahna a huam hi.

senses.heading: Most important concern
senses.definition_en: Something considered more important than other matters and dealt with first.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu dangte sangin poimawzaw in kingaihsun a, masuan a kidawng na.

examples.english: Public safety is our top priority.
examples.zomi: Mipite bitna pen ka poimaw masakpen uh ahi hi.

examples.english: You should make your health a priority.
examples.zomi: Na cidamna na masuan ding hi.

senses.usage_en: A priority is something important enough to receive earlier attention, time, or resources.
senses.usage_zomi: Priority pen thu dangte sangin a ma-in ngaihsutna, hun ahih kei leh neihsa piak kilawm na ahi hi.

senses.heading: Right to be dealt with first
senses.definition_en: The right or condition of being treated, served, or considered before others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte ma-a kizoppih, kisem sak ahih kei leh kingaihsut theihna.

examples.english: Emergency patients receive priority.
examples.zomi: Emergency cinamate kizatui masak hi.

examples.english: Buses give priority seating to older adults.
examples.zomi: Bus ah upate tut masakna mun kipia hi.

senses.usage_en: Give priority to means deal with someone or something before others.
senses.usage_zomi: Give priority to in mi ahih kei leh na khat midangte ma-in sem ahih kei leh kem cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A secure institution where people are confined as punishment for crimes or while awaiting legal proceedings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhna hangin thukhenna kicing ngak laitak ahih kei leh thukhenna thuakna ding a mite kikhumcip ukna mun.

examples.english: The court sentenced him to five years in prison.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi in ama kum nga suangkul thukhen hi.

examples.english: She visited her brother in prison.
examples.zomi: Suangkul a om a sanggampa va veh hi.

senses.usage_en: In general English, go to prison means being confined as a prisoner; go to the prison means visiting or going to the building for another purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Go to prison in thongkiat cihna ahi a, go to the prison in suangkul inn va hawh ahih kei leh ngimna dang tawh va pai cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person kept in prison or held somewhere and not permitted to leave.
senses.explanation_zomi: Suangkul ah kikhum ahih kei leh mun khat pan paikhiat phalna neilo in kimat mi.

examples.english: The prisoner was released after five years.
examples.zomi: Tua suangkul tang kum nga khit ciangin kikhah hi.

examples.english: The soldiers took three enemy fighters prisoner.
examples.zomi: Sepaih in galmi thum man in khum uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A person awaiting trial may also be called a prisoner, although detainee may be more precise in some legal contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhenna ngak a kimat mi zong prisoner kici thei napi, thukham dinmun pawlkhat ah detainee kicianzaw thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The state of being free from unwanted observation, attention, or interference by others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte in deihlohpi a en, ngaihsak ahih kei leh va kihel lo in mimal takin omtheihna.

examples.english: The application collects data that may affect your privacy.
examples.zomi: Tua app in na mimal bitna huzaapthei data la hi.

examples.english: She closed the door because she wanted some privacy.
examples.zomi: Mimal takin om nuam ahih manin kongkha khak hi.

senses.usage_en: Privacy may concern personal space, private information, communications, or freedom from surveillance.
senses.usage_zomi: Privacy in mimal omna mun, mimal thu, kizopna leh seelguk taka etna pan suahtakna a huam hi.

senses.heading: Personal and not public
senses.definition_en: Intended for one person or group and not meant to be seen, known, or used by the public.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mimal ahih kei leh pawl tuam khat ading bek a, mipite muh, theih ahih kei leh zat ding hilo.

examples.english: This document contains private information.
examples.zomi: Hih lai sungah mimal thu om hi.

examples.english: They held a private meeting.
examples.zomi: Mipite ading hilo kikhopna khat nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Private often contrasts with public. Private information should not be shared without authorization.
senses.usage_zomi: Private leh public a kilehbulh zel hi. Mimal thu phalna lo in kihawmsawn lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Not controlled by government
senses.definition_en: Owned, managed, or provided by an individual or company rather than the government.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi neih leh uk hilo, mimal ahih kei leh company in a nei leh a uk.

examples.english: She works for a private company.
examples.zomi: Mimal neih company khat ah nasem hi.

examples.english: The town has both public and private schools.
examples.zomi: Tua khua ah kumpi leh mimal neih sanginn a nihgel om hi.

senses.usage_en: A private organization may still be regulated by government.
senses.usage_zomi: Mimal neih kipawlna zong kumpi thukhun in uk leh en gige thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Something given to a person who wins a competition or achieves something excellent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna a gualzo ahih kei leh na hoih mahmah a sem mi kiangah kipia letsong.

examples.english: She won first prize in the writing competition.
examples.zomi: Lai-gelh kidemna ah letsong masapen ngah hi.

examples.english: The winner received a cash prize.
examples.zomi: Gualzopa in sum letsong ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: A prize rewards success; an award may recognize achievement even when there is no competition.
senses.usage_zomi: Prize in kidemna gualzawhna hangin kipia zel a, award pen kidemna omlo zong achievement phatna dingin kipia thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Used when something is likely to be true or happen, although it is not certain.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a hi ding mah; a piang ding mah
senses.explanation_zomi: A maan ahih kei leh a piang dingin kilamen mahmah napi, a kician taktak nailo.

examples.english: It will probably rain this evening.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitak guah zu ding mah hi.

examples.english: She is probably already at home.
examples.zomi: Ama inn ah tung khin ding mah hi.

senses.usage_en: Probably expresses stronger likelihood than possibly or perhaps, but it does not express certainty.
senses.usage_zomi: Probably in possibly leh perhaps sangin piang ding lam a lianzaw lak napi, a kician taktak a cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Difficulty needing a solution
senses.definition_en: A difficult situation or matter that needs to be solved or dealt with.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawnna zong ahih kei leh puah kul dinmun leh thu haksa.

examples.english: We must find a solution to this problem.
examples.zomi: Hih buaina ading dawnna khat zong ding hihang.

examples.english: Traffic is a serious problem in the city.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah mawtaw kician pen buaina lian ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use have a problem with for a difficulty involving someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat tawh haksatna nei ciangin have a problem with kizang hi.

senses.heading: Question requiring an answer
senses.definition_en: A question or exercise in mathematics or another subject that must be solved.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mathematics ahih kei leh sinna dangah sim leh ngaihsun in dawn ding dotna.

examples.english: The students solved five math problems.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte mathematics dotna nga dawng uh hi.

examples.english: This problem has more than one solution.
examples.zomi: Hih dotna in dawnna khat sang tamzaw nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In education, a problem may be a planned exercise rather than an unwanted difficulty.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna ah problem pen haksatna deihloh a hi kullo a, kisin ding a kigeel dotna hithei hi.

senses.heading: Official series of steps
senses.definition_en: An established series of actions followed to complete a task correctly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep khat maan takin zo dingin zuih kul kalsuan kipsa.

examples.english: Employees must follow the safety procedures.
examples.zomi: Nasemte bitna kalsuante zui ding uh hi.

examples.english: The procedure is explained in the manual.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep kalsuan laibu sungah kihilhcian hi.

senses.usage_en: A procedure gives specific steps; a policy gives broader rules and principles.
senses.usage_zomi: Procedure in zuih ding kalsuan kician pia a, policy in thukhun leh makaih ngaihsutna zaangzaw pia hi.

senses.heading: Medical treatment
senses.definition_en: A medical operation, examination, or treatment carried out in a particular way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dan kician tawh a kibawl zatui lamna, sittelna ahih kei leh kilamna.

examples.english: The doctor explained the procedure before treatment.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in kilamna ma-in a kalsuan hilhcian hi.

examples.english: The procedure took less than an hour.
examples.zomi: Tua kilamna nai khat sangin tomzaw sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: A medical procedure may be diagnostic or therapeutic and does not always involve surgery.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatui lam procedure in natna zonna ahih kei leh cidamna ading hithei a, operation a hi pahpah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A connected series of actions or changes that leads to a result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thusuak khat a tunna ding a kizom nasep leh kikhelhna kalsuan.

examples.english: Learning a language is a gradual process.
examples.zomi: Pau khat sinna pen tawm tawm a pai kalsuan ahi hi.

examples.english: The application process takes several weeks.
examples.zomi: Ngenna kalsuan kaal pawlkhat sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: A process develops through related stages; a procedure is a prescribed set of steps.
senses.usage_zomi: Process pen khen kizomte tungtawn a khangto kalsuan ahi a, procedure pen zuih ding kalsuan kipsa ahi hi.

senses.heading: Make or create
senses.definition_en: To make, create, grow, or manufacture something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl, piangsak, khangsak ahih kei leh factory ah suah.

examples.english: The factory produces car parts.
examples.zomi: Factory in mawtaw hiangte suah hi.

examples.english: Local farms produce fresh vegetables.
examples.zomi: Khuami lote in antam thakte piangsak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Produce emphasizes bringing something into existence, often in quantity.
senses.usage_zomi: Produce in na khat piangsakna a bulphuh a, a tamzaw in tampi bawl ahih kei leh suahna ah kizang hi.

senses.heading: Cause a result
senses.definition_en: To cause a particular result, effect, or reaction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thusuak, huzaapna ahih kei leh dawnkikna tuam khat piangsak.

examples.english: The treatment produced good results.
examples.zomi: Tua kilamna in thusuak hoih piangsak hi.

examples.english: The witness produced new evidence.
examples.zomi: Teci in teci thak lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In formal contexts, produce evidence or documents means present or provide them.
senses.usage_zomi: Ukna pau ah produce evidence or documents in teci ahih kei leh lai pia ahih kei leh lak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Person or company that makes goods
senses.definition_en: A person, country, or company that grows, makes, or supplies something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat khangsak, bawl ahih kei leh suah mi, gam ahih kei leh company.

examples.english: The country is a major producer of rice.
examples.zomi: Tua gam pen buh suahna gam lian khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Local producers sell directly to customers.
examples.zomi: Khuami bawlpate in vanlei mite kiangah zuak pah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The product commonly follows producer of: a producer of coffee.
senses.usage_zomi: A kibawl van pen producer of nungah hong pai zel hi: a producer of coffee.

senses.heading: Person managing entertainment production
senses.definition_en: A person who manages the money, staff, and organization involved in making a film, program, play, or recording.
senses.explanation_zomi: Film, program, limlakna ahih kei leh la recording bawlna a sum, nasem leh kizekna uk mi.

examples.english: The producer approved the final version of the film.
examples.zomi: Film vaihawmpa in film version nunung phal hi.

examples.english: She works as a television producer.
examples.zomi: Television program vaihawmpa in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: A producer manages production; a director primarily guides the creative performance and filming.
senses.usage_zomi: Producer in bawlna vaite uk a, director in limlak leh film lak pilna lam makaih hi.

senses.heading: Something made or sold
senses.definition_en: Something made, grown, or developed for sale or use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zuak ahih kei leh zat dingin a kibawl, kikhangsak ahih kei leh kipatpih van.

examples.english: The company launched a new product.
examples.zomi: Company in van thak khat suah hi.

examples.english: Customers expect safe, reliable products.
examples.zomi: Vanlei mite in van bit leh muanhuai lam-en uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A physical item, digital service, or software application may all be called a product in business.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumleina ah van taktak, digital nasepna leh software application zong product kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Result
senses.definition_en: A result produced by a process, influence, or set of conditions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kalsuan, huzaapna ahih kei leh dinmunte pan a hong piang thusuak.

examples.english: The book is the product of years of research.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu pen kum tampi kancian na gah ahi hi.

examples.english: Culture is partly a product of history.
examples.zomi: Ngeina pen tangthu gah a khenkhat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense refers to what something has caused or developed.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkakna khiatna in na khat’ piangsak ahih kei leh khangsak thusuak a gen hi.

senses.heading: Making goods or materials
senses.definition_en: The process of making, growing, or creating goods, energy, or materials.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, an, tha ahih kei leh material bawl, khangsak leh suahna kalsuan.

examples.english: The factory increased production this year.
examples.zomi: Factory in tukum van suahna khangsak hi.

examples.english: Weather affects food production.
examples.zomi: Khuahun in an piangsakna huzaap hi.

senses.usage_en: Production is usually uncountable when it means the general process or quantity produced.
senses.usage_zomi: Van bawl kalsuan ahih kei leh van suahzah gen ciangin production simtheih lo min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Film, play, or program
senses.definition_en: A film, play, television program, or similar work that has been created for an audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: En mite ading a kibawl film, limlakna, television program ahih kei leh a kibang nasep.

examples.english: The school presented a new theater production.
examples.zomi: Sanginn in theater limlakna thak khat lak hi.

examples.english: Hundreds of people worked on the film production.
examples.zomi: Film bawlna ah mi za tampi nasem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This countable meaning may refer to the finished work or the organized effort that created it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih simtheih khiatna in film ahih kei leh limlakna bawlkhit, ahih kei leh a bawl nasep a kawkthei hi.

senses.definition_en: A type of skilled work that usually requires specialized education, training, and standards.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna leh sinna tuam kisam a, nasep thukhun nei siam nasep nam khat.

examples.english: Teaching is a demanding profession.
examples.zomi: Sia nasep pen a kisap tampi siam nasep khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She entered the legal profession after university.
examples.zomi: University khit ciangin thukham siam nasep sem kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: A profession normally requires specialized knowledge; job is a broader term for paid work.
