senses.usage_zomi: Profession in a tamzaw in pilna leh siamna tuam kisam a, job pen lohman ngah nasep khempeuh a huamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Relating to skilled paid work
senses.definition_en: Relating to a job that requires specialized training, skill, or qualifications.
senses.zomi_equivalents: siam nasep tawh kisai; nasep lam
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna, siamna ahih kei leh phalna tuam kisam lohman ngah nasep tawh kisai.

examples.english: You should seek professional medical advice.
examples.zomi: Cidamna siam mi kiangpan thuhilhna na zong ding hi.

examples.english: The course provides professional training.
examples.zomi: Tua course in siam nasep sinna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Professional advice comes from someone qualified in the relevant field.
senses.usage_zomi: Professional advice pen tua pilna lam a ciamtehna leh siamna nei mi kiangpan hong pai hi.

senses.heading: Showing proper workplace standards
senses.definition_en: Behaving or working in a skilled, responsible, and appropriate way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siam, vaipuak nei leh nasepna mun a kilawm bangin gamta ahih kei leh nasem.

examples.english: She handled the complaint in a professional manner.
examples.zomi: Tua complaint siam leh nasep kilawm takin kem hi.

examples.english: The report has a professional appearance.
examples.zomi: Report pen siam taka kibawl mel nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Someone may behave professionally even if the activity is unpaid.
senses.usage_zomi: Lohman ngahlo nasep zong mi khat siam leh vaipuak nei takin a sep leh professional takin gamta kici thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A senior teacher or academic at a college or university.
senses.explanation_zomi: College ahih kei leh university ah a sangzaw sia leh pilna kancian mi.

examples.english: She is a professor of political science.
examples.zomi: Gamvai pilna professor ahi hi.

examples.english: The professor published a new study.
examples.zomi: Professor in kancian na thak khat suah hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact rank of professor differs among countries. In the United States, it may appear in several academic ranks.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam tuamtuam ah professor dinmun kibanglo hi. United States ah academic rank tuamtuam sungah kizangthei hi.

senses.heading: Description of a person or organization
senses.definition_en: A short description presenting important information about a person, organization, place, or subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, kipawlna, mun ahih kei leh thu khat a poimaw thu tomkim in a pulaakna.

examples.english: The website contains a profile of each employee.
examples.zomi: Website sungah nasem khatciat thu tomkim om hi.

examples.english: The report provides a profile of the community.
examples.zomi: Report in khuami omzia tomkim in pulaak hi.

senses.usage_en: A profile selects important characteristics rather than giving a complete history.
senses.usage_zomi: Profile in tangthu khempeuh genlo in, omzia poimawte teel in pulaak hi.

senses.heading: Online account page
senses.definition_en: A page or record containing information about a user on a website or application.
senses.explanation_zomi: Website ahih kei leh app sung a user khat’ min, lim leh mimal thu a omna lai.

examples.english: She updated her profile picture.
examples.zomi: Ama’ profile lim thaksak hi.

examples.english: Do not put sensitive information in your public profile.
examples.zomi: Mipite muh profile ah mimal thu seel koih kei in.

senses.usage_en: Check privacy settings before adding personal information to an online profile.
senses.usage_zomi: Online profile ah mimal thu na behlapma-in privacy setting sittel in.

senses.heading: Side view
senses.definition_en: The outline or view of a face or object seen from the side.
senses.explanation_zomi: Maitang ahih kei leh van khat a langpan a kimu pualam lim.

examples.english: The coin shows the king in profile.
examples.zomi: Sumtang tungah kumpipa langpan lim om hi.

examples.english: The artist drew her profile.
examples.zomi: Limsiampa in ama’ langpan lim suai hi.

senses.usage_en: In profile means viewed from the side rather than from the front.
senses.usage_zomi: In profile in mailam pan en hilo, langpan en cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Financial gain
senses.definition_en: Money remaining after a business subtracts its costs from the money it receives.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumleina in sumlut sungpan van leh nasepna mante a khiat khit a a la om sum.

examples.english: The company made a profit last year.
examples.zomi: Company in kum beisa sum met hi.

examples.english: Higher costs reduced the store’s profit.
examples.zomi: Man khantohna in dawr metna tawm sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Revenue is all money received; profit is what remains after costs are deducted.
senses.usage_zomi: Revenue pen sumlut khempeuh ahi a, profit pen man leh sumzat a kikhiat khit a la om sum ahi hi.

senses.heading: Benefit or advantage
senses.definition_en: A benefit or useful gain obtained from an activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna khat pan a kingah phattuamna ahih kei leh hamphatna.

examples.english: Students can profit from constructive feedback.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in puahphatna feedback pan phattuamna ngah thei uh hi.

examples.english: He used the information for personal profit.
examples.zomi: Tua thu mimal phattuamna dingin zang hi.

senses.usage_en: This broader sense does not necessarily involve money.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in sum bek a huamlo a, phattuamna nam tuamtuam a huam hi.

senses.heading: Organized series of activities
senses.definition_en: An organized series of activities, services, broadcasts, or performances designed for a purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna khat ading a kizek nasepna, huhna, radio leh television suahna ahih kei leh limlakna kigawm.

examples.english: The program provides meals to older adults.
examples.zomi: Tua program in upate an pia hi.

examples.english: She watched a television program about history.
examples.zomi: Tangthu tawh kisai television program en hi.

senses.usage_en: American English spells all senses program. British English normally uses programme except for computer programs.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah khiatna khempeuh program ci in kigelh hi. British English ah computer program lo pen programme ci in kigelh zel hi.

senses.heading: Computer instructions
senses.definition_en: A set of coded instructions that tells a computer to perform particular tasks.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer in nasep kician sem ding a hilh code tawh kigelh thuhilhna kigawm.

examples.english: The program checks documents for spelling errors.
examples.zomi: Tua program in lai-te spelling khialhna sittel hi.

examples.english: You must install the program before using it.
examples.zomi: Na zatma-in program na koih ding hi.

senses.usage_en: British and American English both use the spelling program for computing.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer thu ah British leh American English a nihgel in program ci in gelh uh hi.

senses.definition_en: A planned series of activities, services, broadcasts, or performances.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna khat ading a kizek nasepna, huhna, radio leh television suahna ahih kei leh limlakna kigawm.

examples.english: The programme supports young business owners.
examples.zomi: Tua programme in sumleina neipa khangnote panpih hi.

examples.english: What time does the programme begin?
examples.zomi: Tua programme bang hunin kipan hiam?

senses.usage_en: Programme is the usual British spelling for non-computing senses. American English uses program. Computing uses program in both varieties.
senses.usage_zomi: Programme pen British English a computer tawh kisai lo khiatna-te gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah program kizang a, computer thu ah a nihgel in program kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Movement or development toward a better, more complete, or more advanced condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun hoihzaw, kicingzaw ahih kei leh khangtozaw lam a maipanna.

examples.english: She is making good progress in English.
examples.zomi: English sinna ah maipanna hoih nei hi.

examples.english: The project has made little progress this month.
examples.zomi: Tua project hih kha sung maipanna tawm bek nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Progress is normally uncountable. Say make progress, not make a progress.
senses.usage_zomi: Progress pen simtheih lo min ahi zel hi. Make a progress sangin make progress kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A planned piece of work with a particular purpose, usually completed over a period of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna kician nei a, hun ciangtan khat sung a kibawl ding nasep kigeel.

examples.english: The students completed a science project.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte science project khat zo uh hi.

examples.english: The project will take two years to complete.
examples.zomi: Tua project zohna ding kum nih sawt ding hi.

senses.usage_en: A project normally has a defined goal, beginning, and end.
senses.usage_zomi: Project in a tamzaw in ngimna, kipat hun leh tawp hun kician nei hi.

senses.heading: Give a firm assurance
senses.definition_en: To state firmly that you will do something or that something will happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sem ding ahih kei leh na khat piang ding kiptak in kamciam.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat na khat pia ding kamciam

examples.english: She promised to return the book tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Laibu zingciang piakkik ding kamciam hi.

examples.english: I promise that I will not share your information.
examples.zomi: Na thu ka hawmsawnlo ding ci in ka kamciam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use promise to do something or promise someone that ….
senses.usage_zomi: Promise to do something ahih kei leh promise someone that … cih zatdan kizang hi.

senses.heading: Show signs of future success
senses.definition_en: To show signs that something will be successful, useful, or enjoyable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam ah gualzo, phatuam ahih kei leh nuam ding lim lak.

examples.english: The new treatment promises good results.
examples.zomi: Kilamna thak in thusuak hoih lam-et sak hi.

examples.english: The young player promises to become a star.
examples.zomi: Kimawlpa khangno mi minthang khat suak ding lim lak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense expresses hopeful signs, not a spoken commitment.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in kamciamna a genlo a, mailam hoih ding lim a gen hi.

senses.heading: Support or encourage
senses.definition_en: To support, encourage, or help something develop or become widely accepted.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat panpih, hanthawn ahih kei leh khangto leh mipite in sang dingin huh.

examples.english: The campaign promotes healthy eating.
examples.zomi: Kampai in annek cidamhuai hanthawn hi.

examples.english: Education can promote social progress.
examples.zomi: Pilna in mihing kipawlna maipanna khangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense concerns encouraging an idea, condition, activity, or cause.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in ngaihsutna, dinmun, nasepna ahih kei leh ngimna khat hanthawnna a gen hi.

senses.heading: Raise to a higher job
senses.definition_en: To move an employee to a more senior job or rank.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasep za khangsak; dinmun sangzaw pia
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasem khat nasep mun ahih kei leh za sangzaw ah koih.

examples.english: She was promoted to department manager.
examples.zomi: Department manager in kikhangsak hi.

examples.english: The company promotes employees based on performance.
examples.zomi: Company in nasepzia bulphuh in nasemte za khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use promote someone to a position: promote her to manager.
senses.usage_zomi: Promote someone to a position cih zatdan kizang hi: promote her to manager.

senses.heading: Advertise
senses.definition_en: To advertise a product, service, event, or public figure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, nasepna, vaipuak ahih kei leh mi khat mipite theih leh deih dingin tangko.

examples.english: The company uses social media to promote its products.
examples.zomi: Company in ama’ vante tangko dingin social media zang hi.

examples.english: Posters were used to promote the concert.
examples.zomi: La pawi tangko dingin poster-te kizang hi.

senses.usage_en: Advertising is one method of promotion, but promotion can include publicity, discounts, and public events.
senses.usage_zomi: Advertising pen promotion bawldan khat ahi a, promotion in news suahna, a man khiam sakna leh mipite vaipuak zong huamthei hi.

senses.heading: Say a word or sound
senses.definition_en: To make the sound of a word, name, letter, or language.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, min, laimal ahih kei leh pau khat aw tawh gen.

examples.english: How do you pronounce this word?
examples.zomi: Hih kammal bangci aw kisuah hiam?

examples.english: She pronounced my name correctly.
examples.zomi: Ka min aw maan takin suah hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun is pronunciation, not pronounciation.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun pen pronunciation ahi a, pronounciation hilo hi.

senses.heading: Officially declare
senses.definition_en: To formally declare a judgment, decision, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhenna, khensatna ahih kei leh dinmun khat official takin tangko.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat mawhnei ci in thukhen

examples.english: The judge pronounced him guilty.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa in ama mawhnei ci in thukhen hi.

examples.english: The doctor pronounced the patient dead.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in cinapa sita ci in kician sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a formal use and commonly appears in legal or medical contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih ukna zatdan pen thukham leh zatui lam thu ah kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Evidence establishing truth
senses.definition_en: Evidence or reasoning that shows that something is true or certain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat maan leh kician cih a lak teci ahih kei leh hangthu.

examples.english: You must provide proof of your address.
examples.zomi: Na omna mun teci na pia ding hi.

examples.english: There is no proof that he committed the crime.
examples.zomi: Ama in tua mawhna bawl cih teci omlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Proof is normally uncountable when referring to evidence generally. A particular item may be called a piece of evidence.
senses.usage_zomi: Teci a vekpi gen ciangin proof simtheih lo min ahi hi. Teci tuam khat pen a piece of evidence kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Mathematical demonstration
senses.definition_en: A logical argument showing that a mathematical statement must be true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mathematics thu khat maan ngei ding cih a lak ngaihsut kizui hangthu.

examples.english: The students studied a proof of the theorem.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte theorem kipsakna sin uh hi.

examples.english: Her proof was logically correct.
examples.zomi: Ama’ kipsakna ngaihsut kizui danin maan hi.

senses.usage_en: A mathematical proof establishes a conclusion through definitions, accepted facts, and logical steps.
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics proof in khiatna, thumaan kipsa leh ngaihsut kizui kalsuante tawh thukhupna kipsak hi.

senses.heading: Correct or suitable
senses.definition_en: Correct, suitable, or appropriate for a particular purpose or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna ahih kei leh dinmun khat ading a maan, a kituak leh a kilawm.

examples.english: The equipment must receive proper care.
examples.zomi: Vanzatte kepna kituak ngah ding hi.

examples.english: Use the proper tool for the job.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep ading vanzat maan zang in.

senses.usage_en: Proper often means meeting accepted rules, standards, or expectations.
senses.usage_zomi: Proper in a tamzaw in thukhun, ciangtan ahih kei leh lametna kipsa tawh kituak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Complete or real
senses.definition_en: Complete, real, or deserving the name being used.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kicing, a taktak ahih kei leh tua min tawh sap kilawm.

examples.english: I have not eaten a proper meal today.
examples.zomi: Tuni in an kicing ka ne nailo hi.

examples.english: You need a proper night’s sleep.
examples.zomi: Zan khua ihmutna kicing na kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal use emphasizes that something is complete or satisfactory rather than partial.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih ngeina zatdan in na khat a khen bek hilo, a kicing leh lungkimhuai ahihna thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Correctly
senses.definition_en: In the correct, suitable, or expected way.
senses.explanation_zomi: A maan, a kituak ahih kei leh lametna bangin.

examples.english: The machine is not working properly.
examples.zomi: Machine maan takin na semlo hi.

examples.english: Food must be stored properly.
examples.zomi: An maan takin kikem ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Properly may describe correct function, behavior, preparation, or use.
senses.usage_zomi: Properly in nasep maan, gamtat kilawm, bawlkhol hoih leh zatdan maan a gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Completely
senses.definition_en: Completely or thoroughly.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kicing takin; a vekpi in
senses.explanation_zomi: A kicing leh a vekpi in.

examples.english: I was too tired to think properly.
examples.zomi: Ka gim lua ahih manin a kicing takin ka ngaihsun theilo hi.

examples.english: Let the paint dry properly.
examples.zomi: Si a kicing takin keusak in.

senses.usage_en: In informal contexts, properly can emphasize completeness.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina pau ah properly in a kicing ahihna thupisakthei hi.

senses.heading: Things legally owned
senses.definition_en: Land, buildings, money, or objects legally owned by a person or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh kipawlna khat in thukham tawh a nei lei, inn, sum leh vante.

examples.english: Do not enter private property without permission.
examples.zomi: Phalna lo in mimal neihsa mun lut kei in.

examples.english: The storm damaged several properties.
examples.zomi: Huipi in inn leh neihsa pawlkhat susia hi.

senses.usage_en: Property is uncountable for possessions generally. A property often means a particular building or piece of land.
senses.usage_zomi: Neihsa a vekpi gen ciangin property simtheih lo min ahi hi. A property in inn ahih kei leh lei mun tuam khat a kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Characteristic or quality
senses.definition_en: A characteristic or quality belonging to a substance, object, or material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Material, van ahih kei leh na khat in a neih ngeina leh hoihna tuam.

examples.english: Scientists examined the material’s physical properties.
examples.zomi: Scientists in tua material pumpi lam omziate kancian uh hi.

examples.english: Copper has useful electrical properties.
examples.zomi: Sum-eng in meitha lam ngeina phatuam nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In science, a property is an observable or measurable characteristic.
senses.usage_zomi: Science ah property pen muh ahih kei leh teh theih ngeina khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Formal plan or suggestion
senses.definition_en: A plan or suggestion offered for other people to consider, discuss, or approve.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte in ngaihsun, kikup ahih kei leh phal dingin a kipia geelna leh ngaihsutna.

examples.english: The council approved the housing proposal.
examples.zomi: Council in innlam geelna phal hi.

examples.english: She submitted a proposal for a new community program.
examples.zomi: Khuami program thak ading geelna khat pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A proposal is not yet a final decision; it remains open to consideration or approval.
senses.usage_zomi: Proposal pen khensatna nunung hilo a, kingaihsut ahih kei leh kiphal ding lailai hi.

senses.heading: Offer of marriage
senses.definition_en: A request asking someone to marry you.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nang tawh kiteng ding a ngenna.

examples.english: She accepted his marriage proposal.
examples.zomi: Ama’ kiteng ding ngenna sang hi.

examples.english: He planned a surprise proposal.
examples.zomi: Lamdang sakna tawh kiteng ding ngenna geel hi.

senses.usage_en: Context normally makes clear whether proposal concerns a plan or marriage.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kigenna pan proposal pen geelna kipia maw, kiteng ding ngenna maw cih kitel hi.

senses.heading: Suggest a plan or idea
senses.definition_en: To formally suggest a plan, idea, or action for consideration.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh nasepna khat kingaihsut dingin official takin pia.

examples.english: The committee proposed several changes.
examples.zomi: Committee in kikhelhna pawlkhat pia hi.

examples.english: She proposed that the meeting be delayed.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna zek sak dingin ngaihsutna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use propose doing something or propose that something be done.
senses.usage_zomi: Propose doing something ahih kei leh propose that something be done cih zatdan kizang hi.

senses.heading: Intend
senses.definition_en: To intend or plan to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sem ding ngiim ahih kei leh geel.

common_phrases.zomi: bangci sem ding na geel hiam?

examples.english: How do you propose to solve the problem?
examples.zomi: Tua buaina bangci dawn ding na geel hiam?

examples.english: The company proposes to open another office.
examples.zomi: Company in office dang khat hon ding ngiim hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is formal; plan or intend is more common in everyday speech.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan ukna deuh a, nisim pau ah plan ahih kei leh intend kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Ask someone to marry
senses.definition_en: To ask someone to marry you.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nang tawh kiteng dingin ngen.

examples.english: He proposed to her during dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak an nek laitakin ama kiteng ding ngen hi.

examples.english: She was surprised when he proposed.
examples.zomi: Ama kiteng ding a ngen ciangin lamdang sa hi.

senses.usage_en: Say propose to someone, not propose someone, for a marriage request.
senses.usage_zomi: Kiteng ding ngenna ah propose to someone kici a, propose someone kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Possibility of a future event
senses.definition_en: The possibility that something will happen, especially something expected or hoped for.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam ah na khat piang ding hitheihna, a diak in kilamen ahih kei leh kideih khat.

examples.english: The prospect of a new job excited her.
examples.zomi: Nasep thak ngahtheihna in ama lunglutsak hi.

examples.english: Peace now seems a real prospect.
examples.zomi: Tu in nopna piangtheihna taktak a om bang kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Prospect of is followed by a noun or an -ing form: the prospect of employment or of finding work.
senses.usage_zomi: Prospect of nungah min ahih kei leh -ing form hong pai hi: the prospect of employment ahih kei leh of finding work.

senses.heading: Person likely to succeed or become a customer
senses.definition_en: A person considered likely to succeed, be selected, or become a customer.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzo, kiteel ahih kei leh vanlei mi suak dingin kingaihsut mi.

examples.english: The young player is a promising prospect.
examples.zomi: Tua kimawlpa khangno in gualzo ding lametna lian nei hi.

examples.english: The salesperson contacted several prospects.
examples.zomi: Van zuakpa in vanlei ding mi pawlkhat kizoppih hi.

senses.usage_en: In business, a prospect is a potential customer who has not yet bought anything.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumleina ah prospect pen van lei nailo napi, vanlei ding hithei mi ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, loss, or danger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat liamna, siatna, manna ahih kei leh lauhuaina pan kem.

examples.english: Wear a helmet to protect your head.
examples.zomi: Na lu kem dingin lukhu khau silh in.

examples.english: Strong passwords help protect personal information.
examples.zomi: Password khauhte in mimal thu kem ding huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use protect someone from/against something: protect children from harm.
senses.usage_zomi: Protect someone from/against something cih zatdan kizang hi: protect children from harm.

senses.definition_en: The act or means of keeping someone or something safe from harm, loss, or danger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat liamna, manna leh lauhuaina pan kepna ahih kei leh kemthei na.

examples.english: The law provides protection for workers.
examples.zomi: Thukham in nasemte ading kepna pia hi.

examples.english: This cream offers protection from the sun.
examples.zomi: Hih cream in ni khuavak pan vun kem hi.

senses.usage_en: Protection from names the danger; protection for names the person or thing being protected.
senses.usage_zomi: Protection from in lauhuaina a gen a, protection for in a kikem mi ahih kei leh na a gen hi.

senses.heading: Public expression of opposition
senses.definition_en: An organized public action showing strong disagreement with a policy, decision, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, khensatna ahih kei leh dinmun khat a nialna lak dingin mipite a kizek gamtatna.

examples.english: Thousands joined the peaceful protest.
examples.zomi: Mi tul tampi ngongtatna omlo nialna pulakna ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: The protest called for changes to the law.
examples.zomi: Langdona in thukham puah ding ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: A protest can be peaceful or violent, but peaceful protest specifically excludes violence.
senses.usage_zomi: Protest pen ngongtatna nei ahih kei leh neilo hithei a, peaceful protest in ngongtatna a omlo cih kician takin lak hi.

senses.heading: Statement of disagreement
senses.definition_en: A statement or action expressing objection or disagreement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a nial ahih kei leh a deihlohna a pulaak thugen leh gamtatna.

examples.english: The organization submitted a formal protest.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in official nialna lai pia hi.

examples.english: He accepted the decision without protest.
examples.zomi: Khensatna nialna omlo in sang hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may describe one formal objection rather than a public demonstration.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mipite pawi hilo, official nialna khat bek a genthei hi.

senses.heading: Pleased about achievement or connection
senses.definition_en: Feeling pleased and satisfied because of something you or someone connected with you has achieved.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nang ahih kei leh nang tawh a kizom mi khat’ gualzawhna hangin lungdam leh kilawm sa.

examples.english: Her parents are proud of her achievement.
examples.zomi: A nu leh pa in ama’ gualzawhna kipahpih uh hi.

examples.english: I am proud to be part of this community.
examples.zomi: Hih khuamite lak a ka om ka kipak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use proud of before a person or achievement and proud to before an action or identity.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh achievement ma-ah proud of kizang a, gamtatna ahih kei leh kua ahihna ma-ah proud to kizang hi.

senses.heading: Having too high an opinion of oneself
senses.definition_en: Believing too strongly in one’s own importance or refusing help because of pride.
senses.explanation_zomi: Amah a thupi kisak lua ahih kei leh kiphatna hangin huhna a nial.

examples.english: He was too proud to admit his mistake.
examples.zomi: Ama’ khialhna pulak dingin kiphat lua hi.

examples.english: Do not be too proud to ask for help.
examples.zomi: Huhna ngen dingin kiphat lua kei in.

senses.usage_en: Proud may be positive or negative. Context shows whether it means healthy satisfaction or excessive pride.
senses.usage_zomi: Proud pen a hoih khiatna leh a hoihlo khiatna a nihgel nei a, thu kigenna pan kitel hi.

senses.heading: Establish that something is true
senses.definition_en: To use evidence or reasoning to show that something is true or certain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci ahih kei leh hangthu zangin thu khat maan leh kician cih lak.

examples.english: The evidence proved that the document was false.
examples.zomi: Teci in tua lai maanlo cih kipsak hi.

examples.english: The prosecution must prove the charge in court.
examples.zomi: Mawhsakna lam in thukhenna zumpi ah mawhsakna kipsak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In criminal law, the prosecution generally carries the burden of proving guilt under the applicable legal standard.
senses.usage_zomi: Criminal thukham ah, thukham in a kal ciangtan kizui in mawhna kipsak ding vaipuak pen mawhsakna lam in nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Show by experience or result
senses.definition_en: To show through actions, experience, or results that someone or something has a particular quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, thuakna ahih kei leh thusuak tawh mi ahih kei leh na khat’ omzia lak.

examples.english: The new method proved effective.
examples.zomi: Nasepdan thak in a phatuam cih kilang hi.

examples.english: She proved herself capable of leading the team.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl makaih zo cih amah in lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In prove useful/successful, prove means “turn out to be.”
senses.usage_zomi: Prove useful/successful ah prove in “a tawpna ah tua bang ahi cih kilang” cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Supply something needed
senses.definition_en: To give, supply, or make something needed available.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisap na khat pia, khawl ahih kei leh ngah theihsak.

examples.english: The program provides meals to older adults.
examples.zomi: Tua program in upate an pia hi.

examples.english: Please provide your current address.
examples.zomi: Na tu a omna mun hong pia in.

senses.usage_en: Use provide someone with something or provide something for/to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Provide someone with something ahih kei leh provide something for/to someone cih zatdan kizang hi.

senses.heading: State a condition in a rule or agreement
senses.definition_en: To state or establish something in a law, rule, or agreement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukham, thukhun ahih kei leh kilemna sungah thu khat kician takin gelh leh kipsak.

examples.english: The law provides protection for personal data.
examples.zomi: Thukham in mimal data ading kepna kipsak hi.

examples.english: The agreement provides for annual reviews.
examples.zomi: Kilemna in kumkhat ciang encian ding koih hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense is common in legal and policy writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih ukna khiatna pen thukham leh policy gelhna ah kizangpha hi.

senses.definition_en: A specialist who studies the mind and behavior or helps people manage emotional and behavioral difficulties.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing lungsim leh gamtatna a kancian, ahih kei leh lungsim leh gamtat buainate kem ding a huh pilna siam.

examples.english: The psychologist helped him manage anxiety.
examples.zomi: Psychologist in ama’ lungkhamna kem siam ding huh hi.

examples.english: She works as a child psychologist.
examples.zomi: Nau pang lungsim pilna siam in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: A psychologist is not necessarily a medical doctor. Rules about diagnosis, treatment, and prescribing medicine differ by location and license.
senses.usage_zomi: Psychologist pen siavuan ahi pahpah lo hi. Natna khensat, kilam leh zatui gelh phalna pen mun leh license kizui in kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: Scientific study
senses.definition_en: The scientific study of the mind, emotions, and behavior.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing lungsim, lungsim sukna leh gamtatna a kancian science pilna.

examples.english: She studied psychology at university.
examples.zomi: University ah psychology sin hi.

examples.english: Psychology examines how people think and behave.
examples.zomi: Psychology in mite bangci ngaihsun leh gamta cih kancian hi.

senses.usage_en: Psychology is a broad scientific field with research and applied branches.
senses.usage_zomi: Psychology pen science pilna zaang khat ahi a, kancian na leh mimal huhna a khen tuamtuam nei hi.

senses.heading: Mental characteristics
senses.definition_en: The mental and emotional characteristics influencing a person or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat’ ngaihsutna leh gamtatna a huzaap lungsim omzia.

examples.english: The book explores the psychology of fear.
examples.zomi: Laibu in launa lungsim omzia kancian hi.

examples.english: Advertising often uses consumer psychology.
examples.zomi: Advertising in vanlei mite’ lungsim omzia zang zel hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense concerns the mental patterns behind behavior.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in gamtatna nung a lungsim ngaihsut ngeina-te a gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A place, especially in Britain and Ireland, where alcoholic drinks are sold and people gather socially, often with food available.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in Britain leh Ireland ah zu leh dawnna dang zuak a, mite kikup leh kikhopna mun; an zong zuakthei hi.

examples.english: They met at a local pub after work.
examples.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin khuami pub khat ah kimu uh hi.

examples.english: The pub serves meals in the evening.
examples.zomi: Pub in nitak ciangin an pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Pub is short for public house. It is culturally associated especially with Britain and Ireland.
senses.usage_zomi: Pub pen public house a tomgen ahi a, a diak in Britain leh Ireland ngeina tawh kizom hi.

senses.heading: Relating to everyone
senses.definition_en: Relating to, intended for, or available to all members of a community.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuami ahih kei leh mipite khempeuh tawh kisai, amau ading ahih kei leh amau zat theih.

examples.english: Smoking is prohibited in public places.
examples.zomi: Mipite munah khuak zuk kikham hi.

examples.english: The report is now available to the public.
examples.zomi: Tu in report pen mipite in ngah thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Public contrasts with private.
senses.usage_zomi: Public leh private a kilehbulh hi.

senses.heading: Provided or controlled by government
senses.definition_en: Provided, owned, funded, or controlled by government for community use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipite zat dingin kumpi in a pia, nei, sum a pia ahih kei leh a uk.

examples.english: The city is improving public transportation.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in mipite mawtaw nasepna hoih sak hi.

examples.english: Public schools receive government funding.
examples.zomi: Kumpi sanginnte in kumpi sum ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning of public school differs between American and British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Public school khiatna American leh British English ah kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: Known openly
senses.definition_en: Known or visible to many people rather than kept secret.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kiseel hilo in, mi tampi in a theih ahih kei leh a muh.

examples.english: The decision was made public yesterday.
examples.zomi: Khensatna zani in mipite theihsak hi.

examples.english: Some court records are public.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna ciamtehna pawlkhat mipite in muthei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Public information may still have rules governing how it is accessed or reused.
senses.usage_zomi: Mipite theih thu zong bangci ngah leh zat ding cih thukhun a nei thei lai hi.

senses.heading: Act of publishing
senses.definition_en: The process of preparing and making written or recorded content available to the public.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lai suahna; mipite kiang a suahna
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai ahih kei leh ciamtehna khat bawlkhol in mipite ngah theih ding a suah kalsuan.

examples.english: The report is ready for publication.
examples.zomi: Report kisuah dingin kigingsa hi.

examples.english: Several errors were corrected before publication.
examples.zomi: Lai kisuahma-in khialhna pawlkhat kipuah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, publication is usually uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lai suah kalsuan a cihna ah publication simtheih lo min ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Published work
senses.definition_en: A book, journal, magazine, report, or other work made publicly available.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipite ngah theih ding a kisuah laibu, journal, magazine, report ahih kei leh lai dang.

examples.english: The library holds thousands of publications.
examples.zomi: Laibu inn in lai kisuah tul tampi nei hi.

examples.english: This publication is available online.
examples.zomi: Hih lai kisuah online ah ngah theih hi.

senses.usage_en: This countable sense refers to one published work or title.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih simtheih khiatna in lai kisuah khat ahih kei leh laibu min khat a gen hi.

senses.heading: Issue written work publicly
senses.definition_en: To prepare and make a book, article, report, or other written work available to the public.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, article, report ahih kei leh lai dang bawlkhol in mipite ngah theih dingin suah.

examples.english: She plans to publish the dictionary next year.
examples.zomi: Kum hong tung in dictionary suah ding geel hi.

examples.english: The journal published his research.
examples.zomi: Journal in ama’ kancian na suah hi.

senses.usage_en: The writer creates the content; the publisher manages its production and release, although one person may do both.
senses.usage_zomi: Laigelpa in thu gelh a, publisher in bawl leh suahna kem hi; ahihhang mi khat in a nihgel semthei hi.

senses.heading: Make information public
senses.definition_en: To make information, data, or media publicly available, especially online.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, data ahih kei leh media mipite theih leh ngah theih dingin suah.

examples.english: The agency published the results online.
examples.zomi: Agency in thusuakte online ah suah hi.

examples.english: Do not publish private information without permission.
examples.zomi: Phalna lo in mimal thu suah kei in.

senses.usage_en: Publishing online can make material widely accessible and difficult to withdraw completely.
senses.usage_zomi: Online a thu suahna in mun tampi ah phasakthei a, a vekpi in lakhia kik haksa hithei hi.

senses.heading: Move something toward oneself
senses.definition_en: To use force to move something toward you or in the direction of the force.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat nang lam ahih kei leh tha piakna lamah hong kisuanto dingin kai.

examples.english: Pull the handle to open the door.
examples.zomi: Kongkha hon dingin a paaina kai in.

examples.english: They pulled the boat onto the shore.
examples.zomi: Tembaw tuigei tungah kai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Pull normally moves something toward the force; push moves it away.
senses.usage_zomi: Pull in na khat kai a, push in na khat nang pan gamla deuh ah nawng hi.

senses.heading: Remove something
senses.definition_en: To remove something by taking hold of it and applying force.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat len in tha tawh dokkhia ahih kei leh kaikhia.

examples.english: The dentist pulled the damaged tooth.
examples.zomi: Ha siampa in ha a sia dok hi.

examples.english: We pulled weeds from the garden.
examples.zomi: Huan sungpan lopa ka dok uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Pull out often emphasizes complete removal.
senses.usage_zomi: Pull out in na khat a vekpi in dokkhia cih thupisak hi.

senses.definition_en: To make someone experience a penalty because they broke a rule or committed an offense.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun a palsat ahih kei leh mawhna a bawl manin mi khat gim pia.

common_phrases.zomi: guksim manin mi khat gim pia

examples.english: The law punishes people who commit fraud.
examples.zomi: Thukham in khemna a bawl mite gim pia hi.

examples.english: Children should not be punished for honest mistakes.
examples.zomi: Nau pangte khialhna thumaan a bawl uh hangin gim kipia lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Use punish someone for something. Punishment should be lawful, proportionate, and should never become abuse.
senses.usage_zomi: Punish someone for something cih zatdan kizang hi. Gim piakna thukham tawh kituak leh mawhna tawh akim ding a, ngongtat bawlsiatna suaklo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: A penalty imposed because someone broke a rule or committed an offense.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat thukhun a palsat ahih kei leh mawhna a bawl manin a kipia gim.

examples.english: The court imposed a financial punishment.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna zumpi in sum gim pia hi.

examples.english: The punishment should fit the offense.
examples.zomi: Gim piakna pen mawhna tawh akim ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Punishment differs from discipline intended mainly to teach and correct behavior, although the ideas can overlap.
senses.usage_zomi: Punishment leh gamtatna puah ding a kipiak discipline kibanglo napi, pawlkhat ah kizomthei hi.

senses.heading: School student
senses.definition_en: A child or young person taught at school or by a particular teacher.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sanginn ah ahih kei leh sia khat kiangah a sin nau pang leh khangno.

examples.english: The teacher asked each pupil a question.
examples.zomi: Sia in sangnaupang khatciat dotna khat ciat dong hi.

examples.english: The school has six hundred pupils.
examples.zomi: Tua sanginn in sangnaupang za guk nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Pupil is common in British English for schoolchildren. American English usually uses student.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah sangnaupangte pupil kici zel a, American English ah student kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Dark center of the eye
senses.definition_en: The dark opening in the center of the eye that allows light to enter.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavak mit sungah lutna ding mit laizang a kua vom.

examples.english: Bright light makes the pupils smaller.
examples.zomi: Khuavak taang in mit laizang kuate neu sak hi.

examples.english: The doctor examined her pupils.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ama’ mit laizang kuate sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: The pupil is an opening, while the iris is the colored tissue surrounding it.
senses.usage_zomi: Pupil pen kua ahi a, iris pen tua kua a umcip puan dial nei mit hiang ahi hi.

senses.heading: Act of buying
senses.definition_en: The act of buying something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum tawh van khat leina.

examples.english: Keep the receipt as proof of purchase.
examples.zomi: Van leina teci in receipt kem in.

examples.english: The purchase was completed online.
examples.zomi: Van leina online ah kizo hi.

senses.usage_en: Purchase is more formal than buying.
senses.usage_zomi: Purchase pen buying sangin ukna deuh hi.

senses.heading: Thing bought
senses.definition_en: Something that has been bought.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum tawh a kilei van.

examples.english: The laptop was her largest purchase this year.
examples.zomi: Laptop pen tukum a ama’ van kilei manphapen ahi hi.

examples.english: Please inspect your purchase before leaving.
examples.zomi: Na paikhiatma-in na van kilei encian in.

senses.usage_en: This countable sense refers to one item or group of items bought in a transaction.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih simtheih khiatna in sum piakna khat tawh a kilei van khat ahih kei leh van pawl a gen hi.

senses.heading: Not mixed or contaminated
senses.definition_en: Not mixed with other substances and free from dirt or harmful material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na dang tawh kihel lo a, ninna leh lauhuai na omlo.

examples.english: The laboratory requires pure water.
examples.zomi: Laboratory in tui siangtho kisam hi.

examples.english: The ring is not made of pure gold.
examples.zomi: Tua khutbulh kham siangtho bek tawh kibawl lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In science, pure means containing only one substance; in everyday speech, it may simply mean very clean.
senses.usage_zomi: Science ah pure in na nam khat bek nei cihna ahi a, nisim pau ah siang mahmah cihna hithei hi.

senses.heading: Complete or absolute
senses.definition_en: Complete and not influenced by any other quality or purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kicing taktak leh omzia dang tawh kihel lo.

examples.english: The children shouted with pure joy.
examples.zomi: Nau pangte lungdamna bekbek tawh kikou uh hi.

examples.english: Meeting there was pure chance.
examples.zomi: Tua mun a kimuh uh pen vanlawng piang ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This use intensifies a noun by saying that nothing else is mixed with it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan in omzia dang kihello a, tua min khiatna bekbek ahihna thupisak hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a color made by combining red and blue.
senses.explanation_zomi: San leh blue kigawm puan dial nei.

examples.english: She wore a purple jacket.
examples.zomi: Jacket purple khat silh hi.

examples.english: Purple flowers grew beside the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi gei ah pak purple-te khang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Purple can also be a noun naming the color.
senses.usage_zomi: Purple pen puan dial min noun in zong kizangthei hi.

senses.heading: Reason or intended result
senses.definition_en: The reason for which something exists, is done, or is used.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat banghangin a om, a kibawl ahih kei leh a kizang cih ngimna leh hang.

examples.english: The purpose of this dictionary is to support Zomi learners.
examples.zomi: Hih dictionary ngimna pen Zomi sinna mite panpih ding ahi hi.

examples.english: This tool serves several purposes.
examples.zomi: Hih vanzat in ngimna pawlkhat tangtung hi.

senses.usage_en: Ask What is the purpose of …? when asking why something exists or is done.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat banghangin a om ahih kei leh a kibawl cih dot dingin What is the purpose of …? kici hi.

senses.heading: Determination or meaning in life
senses.definition_en: A strong sense of direction, determination, or meaningful aim.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuntakna ahih kei leh nasepna makaih ngimna kician leh lungkipna.

examples.english: Volunteering gave him a sense of purpose.
examples.zomi: Mipi huhna manlo nasep in ama kiangah nuntakna ngimna pia hi.

examples.english: She approached the task with clear purpose.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep ngimna kician tawh sem hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense refers to meaningful direction rather than one specific function.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in zatna tuam khat bek hilo, nuntak leh nasepna a makaih khiatna nei ngimna a gen hi.

senses.heading: Work toward a goal
senses.definition_en: To continue trying to achieve a goal, career, interest, or course of action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna, nasepna, lunglutna ahih kei leh lampi khat ngah leh tangtung dingin zui in hanciam.

examples.english: She plans to pursue a career in medicine.
examples.zomi: Siavuan nasepna zui ding geel hi.

examples.english: They continued to pursue their goals.
examples.zomi: Amau’ ngimnate zui in hanciam zom uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Pursue suggests continued, active effort over time.
senses.usage_zomi: Pursue in hun khat sung ngimna zui in a hanciam zomna a lak hi.

senses.heading: Follow or chase
senses.definition_en: To follow or chase a person, animal, or vehicle in order to catch them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing ahih kei leh mawtaw khat man dingin nungzui in delh.

examples.english: Police pursued the stolen car.
examples.zomi: Police in mawtaw kiguk nungzui uh hi.

examples.english: The dog pursued the rabbit into the forest.
examples.zomi: Ui in saza gam sung dong delh hi.

senses.usage_en: This is more formal than chase and is common in police and news reports.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kammal pen chase sangin ukna deuh a, police leh news report ah kizangpha hi.

senses.heading: Investigate or discuss further
senses.definition_en: To continue examining, investigating, or discussing a matter.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat encian, kancian ahih kei leh kikup zom.

examples.english: The agency decided to pursue the complaint.
examples.zomi: Agency in complaint zui encian ding khensat hi.

examples.english: She may pursue legal action against the company.
examples.zomi: Company langah thukham lampi zui kha ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, pursue means continuing a formal effort until a result is reached.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in thusuak khat ngah dong official nasep zui zom cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Move something away by force
senses.definition_en: To use force to move someone or something away from you or in a particular direction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat nang pan gamla deuh ahih kei leh lam tuam khat ah kisuanto dingin nawng.

examples.english: Push the door to open it.
examples.zomi: Kongkha hon dingin nawng in.

examples.english: She pushed the shopping cart through the store.
examples.zomi: Dawr sungah vanlei leng nawng hi.

senses.usage_en: Push moves something away from the force; pull moves it toward the force.
senses.usage_zomi: Push in na khat nawng a, pull in na khat kai hi.

senses.heading: Urge or pressure
senses.definition_en: To strongly encourage or pressure someone to act, improve, or make a decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat gamta, khangto ahih kei leh khensat ding kipsak takin hasuan.

examples.english: Her teacher pushed her to do her best.
examples.zomi: A sia in a hoihpen sem ding hasuan hi.

examples.english: Residents are pushing for safer roads.
examples.zomi: Khuamite lampi bitzaw ding ngen kinken uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Pushing someone may be encouraging, but excessive pressure can be harmful.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat hasuan pen phatuamthei napi, sawl lua leh a susia thei hi.

senses.heading: Make an effort to advance
senses.definition_en: To make a determined effort to move forward or complete something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam ah pai ahih kei leh na khat zo ding lungkip takin hanciam.

examples.english: The team pushed ahead despite the difficulties.
examples.zomi: Haksatna om napi tua pawl mainawt hi.

examples.english: We must push to finish the project on time.
examples.zomi: Project a hunin zo dingin hanciam kul hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense emphasizes determined effort rather than physical force.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkakna khiatna in pumpi tha hilo, lungkip tak hanciamna a thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Move something to a place
senses.definition_en: To move or place someone or something in a particular position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat mun tuam khat ah koih ahih kei leh koihsak.

examples.english: Put the keys on the table.
examples.zomi: Tawhte sabuai tungah koih in.

examples.english: She put the food in the refrigerator.
examples.zomi: An fridge sungah koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Put requires both an object and information about where or in what state it is placed: put the book on the desk.
senses.usage_zomi: Put in object leh koi ah ahih kei leh bang dinmun ah kikoih cih kisam hi: put the book on the desk.

senses.heading: Express something in words
senses.definition_en: To express an idea, question, or statement in a particular way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, dotna ahih kei leh thugen khat kammal tawh dan tuam khat in gen.

examples.english: She put her ideas clearly and simply.
examples.zomi: Ama’ ngaihsutnate kician leh baihlam takin gen hi.

examples.english: It is difficult to put this feeling into words.
examples.zomi: Hih lungsim sukna kammal tawh gen haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: Put something into words means expressing a thought or feeling verbally.
senses.usage_zomi: Put something into words in ngaihsutna ahih kei leh lungsim sukna kammal tawh pulaak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Cause someone or something to enter a condition
senses.definition_en: To cause someone or something to be in a particular state or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat dinmun tuam khat ah omsak.

examples.english: The delay put the project at risk.
examples.zomi: Zekna in project lauhuaina ah koih hi.

examples.english: We must put the plan into practice.
examples.zomi: Geelna a taktak in zang ding hihang.

senses.usage_en: Put forms many fixed expressions and phrasal verbs whose meanings must be learned in context.
senses.usage_zomi: Put in kammal kigawm kipsa leh phrasal verb tampi bawl a, amau’ khiatna thu kigenna tawh kisin kul hi.

senses.heading: An official skill or achievement
senses.definition_en: An examination, course, or training that a person has successfully completed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in sinna, siamna sinna, ahih keileh sittelna khat a zo khit ciangin a ngah siamna teci ahi hi.

examples.english: She gained a teaching qualification last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa in sia nasepna siamna teci ngah hi.

examples.english: This job requires a professional qualification.
examples.zomi: Hih nasepna in nasep lam siamna teci kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: A qualification is usually proved by a certificate, degree, or other official record.
senses.usage_zomi: Qualification pen teci laimai, degree, ahih keileh thuneihna tawh kipia lai khat in a kician sak siamna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A condition that must be met
senses.definition_en: A skill, quality, or condition that is needed for a particular job or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna ahih keileh sepkhiatna khat a dingin kisam siamna, omzia, ahih keileh dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: Experience is an important qualification for this position.
examples.zomi: Hih dinmun a dingin nasep pilna pen kisam mahmah hi.

examples.english: He does not meet the qualifications for the job.
examples.zomi: Ama in tua nasepna a kisapna teng picing lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In job advertisements, qualifications may include education, skills, experience, and legal requirements.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep sapna sungah qualifications cih in sang pilna, siamna, nasep pilna leh dan in a phut kisapna-te huam thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Having the education, skills, or official approval needed to do a particular job.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna khat semthei dingin kisam sang pilna, siamna, ahih keileh thuneihna tawh phalna a nei ahi hi.

examples.english: We need a qualified electrician.
examples.zomi: Meivak lam siamna teci nei mi khat kisam hihang.

examples.english: She is qualified to teach English.
examples.zomi: Ama pen English hilh dingin siamna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Qualified is commonly followed by to plus a verb or by for plus a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Qualified nungah sepna khat a gen to leh verb kizang zel a, nasepna ahih keileh dinmun khat a gen for leh noun zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: To gain the necessary skill or approval
senses.definition_en: To complete the training or meet the conditions needed for a job or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna ahih keileh sepkhiatna khat a dingin kisam sinna zo in siamna ahih keileh phalna ngah cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: zatui lam sem dingin phalna ngah

examples.english: He qualified as a nurse in 2024.
examples.zomi: Kum 2024 in nurse dingin siamna ngah hi.

examples.english: You must complete the course to qualify for this work.
examples.zomi: Hih nasepna a dingin kisapna picing nadingin sinna na zo kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Use qualify as before a profession, qualify for before an opportunity, and qualify to before an action.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep min mai ah qualify as, hamphatna ahih keileh dinmun mai ah qualify for, sepna mai ah qualify to kizang hi.

senses.heading: To earn the right to enter a competition
senses.definition_en: To perform well enough to enter the next stage of a competition.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a zomna tung; lut dingin picing
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna khat ah a zom laitak lutthei ding zahin na sem hoih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The team qualified for the final.
examples.zomi: Pawl in a nunungpen kidemna tung hi.

examples.english: Only the fastest runners will qualify.
examples.zomi: A taipen mite bekmah a zomna ah lutthei ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In sports, qualify does not mean winning the whole competition; it means earning a place in its next stage.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlnate ah qualify cih pen kidemna buppi zawh cihna hilo a, a zom laitak luttheihna ngah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: How good something is
senses.definition_en: The level of excellence of a product, service, or piece of work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, nasepna, ahih keileh sepkhiatna khat bangzah in a hoih cih a lak dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: This shop sells high-quality furniture.
examples.zomi: Hih dawr in a hoih mahmah inn van zuak hi.

examples.english: We must improve the quality of our work.
examples.zomi: Ei nasep hoihna i khangsak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Quality is usually uncountable when it means how good something is.
senses.usage_zomi: Van ahih keileh nasep khat bangzah in a hoih cih a gen ciangin quality pen simtheih lo noun bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: A feature of a person or thing
senses.definition_en: A characteristic that someone or something has.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh van khat in a neih omzia ahi hi.

examples.english: Patience is an important quality in a teacher.
examples.zomi: Sia khat a dingin thuakzawhna pen kisam mahmah omzia khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Her best quality is her honesty.
examples.zomi: Ama’ omzia hoihpen pen a thuman gamtatna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, quality is countable: a person may have several good qualities.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah quality pen simtheih noun ahi a, mi khat in omzia hoih tampi nei thei hi.

senses.definition_en: An amount or number of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, annek, tui, sum, ahih keileh mundang khat bangzah om cih a lak zat ahi hi.

examples.english: They bought a large quantity of rice.
examples.zomi: Amaute in buh tampi lei uh hi.

examples.english: Use only a small quantity of salt.
examples.zomi: Ci tawmkhat bek zang in.

senses.usage_en: Use quantity especially for an amount that can be measured. In ordinary speech, amount or number is often more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Quantity pen teh theih zat a genna ah kizang mahmah hi. Nisim pau in simtheih lo nate a dingin amount, simtheih nate a dingin number cihte a kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: One of four equal parts
senses.definition_en: One of four equal parts of something; 25 percent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khat peuhmah khen li in kikhen ciangin a khen khat, za-ah sawmnih leh nga ahi hi.

examples.english: A quarter of the students were absent.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang li-a-khen-khat bang om lo uh hi.

examples.english: Cut the cake into quarters.
examples.zomi: Cake pen a khen li in khen in.

senses.usage_en: A quarter is written as ¼ or 25%.
senses.usage_zomi: Quarter pen ¼ ahih keileh 25% ci in kigelh thei hi.

senses.heading: A period of fifteen minutes
senses.definition_en: A period of fifteen minutes, equal to one fourth of an hour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nai khat sung a khen li-a-khen-khat, a sawmlehnga-minute sung ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: nai sagih ding sawmlehnga minute kisam

examples.english: The meeting lasted a quarter of an hour.
examples.zomi: Meeting pen sawmlehnga minute sung sawt hi.

examples.english: It is a quarter past nine.
examples.zomi: Tu in nai kua leh sawmlehnga minute ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A quarter past nine means 9:15; a quarter to ten means 9:45.
senses.usage_zomi: A quarter past nine cih pen 9:15 ahi a, a quarter to ten cih pen 9:45 ahi hi.

senses.heading: One of four three-month periods
senses.definition_en: A three-month period used for dividing a business or financial year.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi khat a sum leh sumvai nasepna enkikna dingin khasum khatin kikhen hun ahi hi.

examples.english: Sales increased in the first quarter.
examples.zomi: Kum khen masapen sungin van zuakna hong khang hi.

examples.english: The company publishes a report every quarter.
examples.zomi: Kampani in khasum khat simin laporan khat hawm hi.

senses.usage_en: In business, a year is commonly divided into four quarters.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum leh sumvai nasepna ah kumpi khat pen khasum khat simin khen li in kikhen zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A female ruler of a country, or the wife of a king.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam uk numei kumpi, ahih keileh kumpipa’ zi ahi hi.

examples.english: The queen addressed the nation.
examples.zomi: Kumpinu in gam mite tungah thu gen hi.

examples.english: She became queen after her father died.
examples.zomi: A pa si khit ciangin ama kumpinu suak hi.

senses.usage_en: A queen may rule in her own right, or she may be the wife of a ruling king.
senses.usage_zomi: Kumpinu khat in ama’ thuneihna tawh gam uk thei a, ahih keileh gam a uk kumpipa’ zi zong hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Something asked to obtain information
senses.definition_en: A sentence or expression used to ask for information or an answer.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu theihna ahih keileh dawnna ngah nadingin mi tungah a kidot dotna ahi hi.

examples.english: The student asked an important question.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang in dotna thupi khat dong hi.

examples.english: Please answer the final question.
examples.zomi: A nunungpen dotna dawng in.

senses.usage_en: We ask a question and answer a question; we do not normally make a question.
senses.usage_zomi: English pau in dotna khat pen ask kici a, dotna dawnna pen answer kici hi; make a question ci in pau ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: A matter that needs discussion or a decision
senses.definition_en: A subject or problem that people need to consider, discuss, or decide.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsut ding thu; khensat ding thu
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi-te in ngaihsun, kikum, ahih keileh khensat kul thu ahih keileh buaina khat ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: sum zat ding tawh kisai thu

examples.english: The question of funding remains unresolved.
examples.zomi: Sum vai tawh kisai thu ki khensat nailo hi.

examples.english: This raises an important question about safety.
examples.zomi: Hihthu in bitna tawh kisai ngaihsut ding thu thupi khat hong piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, question may refer to an issue rather than a direct request for an answer.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah question pen dawnna a kisam dotna bek hilo a, ngaihsut ding ahih keileh khensat ding thu zong hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A line of people or vehicles waiting for something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a banin a ding mite; ngakna a ban
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi-te ahih keileh mawtaw-te in amau’ hun a ngak kawmin a banbanin a din uh ahi hi.

examples.english: We waited in a long queue for tickets.
examples.zomi: Ticket ngah nadingin ngakna a ban sau ah ngak hihang.

examples.english: Please join the queue at the entrance.
examples.zomi: Lutna kong ah ngakna a ban ah kihel in.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses queue. American English usually uses line.
senses.usage_zomi: British English in queue a zang zel a, American English in tua khiatna a dingin line a zang zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Done, happening, or moving in a short time or at high speed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tom sungin a kipan, a kizawh, ahih keileh manlang takin a kalsuan ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave me a quick answer.
examples.zomi: Ama in kei dawnna manlang takin hong pia hi.

examples.english: Let us take a quick look at the report.
examples.zomi: Laporan pen tomkhat i en phot ni.

senses.usage_en: Quick is an adjective and usually describes a noun. Use quickly to describe most actions.
senses.usage_zomi: Quick pen adjective ahi a, noun khat a gen hi. Sepna bawldan a gen nadingin quickly a kizang zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: At a fast speed or within a short time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Manlang takin ahih keileh hun tom sungin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor arrived quickly.
examples.zomi: Siavuan manlang takin hong tung hi.

examples.english: Please finish the work quickly.
examples.zomi: Nasep pen manlang takin zo in.

senses.usage_en: Quickly describes an action. In informal speech, quick is sometimes used as an adverb, but quickly is safer in formal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Quickly in sepna khat koibangin kibawl cih gen hi. Nisim pau in quick zong adverb bangin kizang kha napi, laigelna ah quickly zatna a hoihzaw hi.

senses.heading: Making little or no noise
senses.definition_en: Making very little sound or having little noise.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw neilo ahih keileh aw tawm bek a om ahi hi.

examples.english: Please be quiet in the library.
examples.zomi: Lai laakna inn sungah dai takin om in.

examples.english: The room became quiet when the teacher entered.
examples.zomi: Sia hong lut ciangin pindan sung dai pah hi.

senses.usage_en: Quiet means making little noise. Do not confuse it with quite, which usually means “fairly” or “completely.”
senses.usage_zomi: Quiet cih pen aw tawm ahih keileh aw neilo cihna ahi hi. “A tawmkhat” ahih keileh “a vekpi takin” a cihna quite tawh helkhawm lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Calm and without much activity
senses.definition_en: Peaceful and not busy or full of activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buai lo, mi tampi om lo, gamtangna tampi om lo in lungnop huai a om ahi hi.

examples.english: They live in a quiet village.
examples.zomi: Amaute khuadai khat ah teng uh hi.

examples.english: We had a quiet evening at home.
examples.zomi: Inn ah nitak dai leh lungnop huai takin om hihang.

senses.usage_en: A quiet place may have little noise, little activity, or both.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun dai khat ah aw tawm bek om thei a, gamtangna zong tawm thei a, nihgel zong hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: With little noise, or in a calm and gentle way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw tawm takin, dai takin, ahih keileh lungnem takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children sat quietly and listened.
examples.zomi: Naupangte dai takin tu in ngai uh hi.

examples.english: She quietly closed the door.
examples.zomi: Ama in kongkha pen aw neilo takin kha hi.

senses.usage_en: Quietly can describe either a low level of sound or calm, unobtrusive behaviour.
senses.usage_zomi: Quietly in aw a tawm cihna ahih keileh midang lungkham sak lo in dai takin gamtatna a gen thei hi.

senses.heading: To stop doing something
senses.definition_en: To stop an activity or habit, especially permanently.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna ahih keileh ngeina khat, a diak in paisuak nawnlo dingin, tawpsan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He quit smoking two years ago.
examples.zomi: Kum nih beisa in kuakzu dawn tawpsan hi.

examples.english: Do not quit when the work becomes difficult.
examples.zomi: Nasep haksat hong suak ciangin hanciamna tawpsan kei in.

senses.usage_en: Quit is followed directly by a noun or an -ing form: quit work, quit smoking. Do not use quit to smoke for this meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah quit nungah noun ahih keileh -ing form kizang hi: quit work, quit smoking. Quit to smoke ci in zat lo ding hi.

senses.heading: To leave a job, school, or organization
senses.definition_en: To leave a job, course, school, or organization permanently.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna, sinna, sang, ahih keileh pawl khat sungpan paisuak in a tawpsan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She quit her job to care for her mother.
examples.zomi: A nu kem dingin a nasep tawpsan hi.

examples.english: Two players quit the team last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in kimawlmi nih in pawl nusia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Quit is less formal than resign when referring to leaving a job.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasepna nusia cih a gen ciangin quit pen resign sangin nisim pau zaw hi.

senses.heading: Fairly or to a noticeable degree
senses.definition_en: To a considerable degree, but not necessarily completely.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kicing sitset loin, a phazah takin ahih keileh a tawmkhat sangin a tamzaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The exam was quite difficult.
examples.zomi: Sittelna pen a haksa lawmlawm hi.

examples.english: She speaks English quite well.
examples.zomi: Ama in English a pau siam lawmlawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Before gradable adjectives such as good, cold, or difficult, quite often means “fairly.”
senses.usage_zomi: Good, cold, leh difficult bangin a dinmun kikhelthei adjective-te mai ah quite in “a phazah takin” cihna nei zel hi.

senses.heading: Completely
senses.definition_en: Completely or entirely, especially before adjectives expressing an absolute state.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a vekpi takin; a kicing takin
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi takin ahih keileh a kicing takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You are quite right.
examples.zomi: Nang na gen pen a man taktak hi.

examples.english: The two situations are quite different.
examples.zomi: Tua dinmun nih a kibang hetlo hi.

senses.usage_en: The strength of quite depends on the following word and sometimes differs between British and American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Quite khiatna a thahatna pen a nung a kammal tungah kinga a, British English leh American English ah zong zatdan kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: Words repeated from another source
senses.definition_en: A group of words taken from what another person has said or written and repeated exactly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang in a gen ahih keileh a gelh kammalte a kibang lianin kilak in kigelhkik thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The article begins with a quotation from the president.
examples.zomi: Laigelh pen president’ kammal lakna khat tawh kipan hi.

examples.english: Put quotation marks around her exact words.
examples.zomi: Ama’ kammal kibang lian kimkotah kam lakna ciaptehna koih in.

senses.usage_en: A quotation repeats the original words. A paraphrase expresses the same idea in different words.
senses.usage_zomi: Quotation in a bul kammalte kibang lianin lak hi. Paraphrase ahihleh ngaihsutna kibang pen kammal dang tawh kigen hi.

senses.heading: A stated price for work or goods
senses.definition_en: A written statement showing how much particular work or goods will cost.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep khat ahih keileh van khat a man ding bangzah cih a lak laigelh ahi hi.

examples.english: The builder gave us a written quotation.
examples.zomi: Inn lam siam in kote laigelh man cianna hong pia hi.

examples.english: We requested quotations from three companies.
examples.zomi: Kampani thum tungpan man cianna ngen hihang.

senses.usage_en: In business, quotation is often shortened to quote.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum leh sumvai nasepna ah quotation pen quote ci in tomgen zel hi.

senses.heading: To repeat someone’s exact words
senses.definition_en: To repeat or write the exact words that another person has said or written.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang in a gen ahih keileh a gelh kammalte a kibang lianin genkik ahih keileh gelhkik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She quoted a sentence from the Bible.
examples.zomi: Ama in Laisiangtho sungpan sentence khat kammal lak hi.

examples.english: Please quote the author’s exact words.
examples.zomi: Laigelpa’ kammal kibang lianin lak in.

senses.usage_en: When quoting directly, keep the original wording and use quotation marks where appropriate.
senses.usage_zomi: Kammal kibang lianin a kilak ciangin a bul kammalte kikhel lo ding a, kisapna munah kam lakna ciaptehna kizang ding hi.

senses.heading: To state a price
senses.definition_en: To tell someone the price that will be charged for particular work or goods.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep khat ahih keileh van khat a dingin bangzah man ngen ding cih gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The mechanic quoted a price of two hundred dollars.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw siam in dollar zahnih ci in man gen hi.

examples.english: Can you quote me a price for the repair?
examples.zomi: A kibawlpha ding man bangzah hiam kei nong gen thei diam?

senses.usage_en: In this sense, quote can take both a person and a price: They quoted me $500.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah quote tawh man a kigentung mi leh a man tegel kizangkhawm thei hi: They quoted me $500.

senses.definition_en: A competition to discover which person, animal, or vehicle can move the fastest.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing, ahih keileh mawtaw lakah kua a manlangpen cih theih nadingin ki taisakna ahi hi.

examples.english: She won the five-kilometre race.
examples.zomi: Ama in kilometre nga tai kidemna zo hi.

examples.english: Several horses took part in the race.
examples.zomi: Sakol tampi ki taisakna ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning of race refers to a competition involving speed. It is different from race referring to a social classification of people.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih race khiatna pen manlangna tawh kidemna ahi hi. Mi-te minam leh pianzia tawh a kikhenna race tawh a kibang lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A broad social category into which people have historically been placed according to physical features, ancestry, or geographic origin.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mi nam kikhenna; pianzia tawh mi kikhenna
senses.explanation_zomi: Tanglai panin mi-te a pumpi pianzia, pupate, ahih keileh a hong pianna gam tawh kizui in pawl lian takin a kikhenna ahi hi.

examples.english: The law must protect people of every race.
examples.zomi: Dan in mi nam tuamtuam kem ding hi.

examples.english: People should not be judged by their race.
examples.zomi: Mi-te amau’ minam ahih keileh pianzia hangin thukhen lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Race is a sensitive social term, not a precise biological division. Use a more specific word such as ethnicity, nationality, or community when that is the intended meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Race pen pilvang takin zat ding mihing kikhenna kammal ahi a, mihing pen pianzia bek tawh a kicianin kikhen theih hilo hi. Khiatna tawh kituak leh ethnicity, nationality, ahih keileh community bang kammal a kicianzaw zat ding hi.

senses.definition_en: The sport or activity of competing to move faster than other people, animals, or vehicles.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing, ahih keileh mawtaw dangte sangin manlangzaw dingin ki taisak kimawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: Motor racing can be dangerous.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw ki taisakna lauhuai thei hi.

examples.english: Horse racing is popular in that country.
examples.zomi: Tua gamah sakol ki taisakna mi tampi in deih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Racing refers to the general sport or activity; a single competition is a race.
senses.usage_zomi: Racing in ki taisak kimawlna buppi gen a, ki taisakna khat bek pen race kici hi.

senses.heading: Broadcasting sound
senses.definition_en: A system of sending sound programmes through electronic signals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Electronic signal tungtawnin thu, la, kihona leh aw tuamtuam hawmkhia theihna system ahi hi.

examples.english: I heard the news on the radio.
examples.zomi: Radio tungpan thuthak za ing.

examples.english: The station broadcasts a daily radio programme.
examples.zomi: Radio zung in nisim thuhawm khat hawmkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use on the radio, not normally in the radio, when referring to something that is broadcast.
senses.usage_zomi: Radio tawh a kihawm thu khat a gen ciangin on the radio kici a, in the radio ci in pau ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: A device that receives broadcasts
senses.definition_en: A device used for receiving and playing radio programmes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Radio signal sang in thuhawmte ngaih theihna khawl ahi hi.

examples.english: He turned on the radio in the kitchen.
examples.zomi: Ama in ankuang sung radio hon hi.

examples.english: This radio uses batteries.
examples.zomi: Hih radio in battery zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Radio may mean either the broadcasting system or the physical device.
senses.usage_zomi: Radio in thuhawmna system ahih keileh radio a sang khawl cihna tegel nei thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A system of tracks and trains used to carry passengers or goods.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meileng in khualzin mite leh vante pua dingin a kizang leeng sik lampi leh meileng system ahi hi.

examples.english: The railway connects the two cities.
examples.zomi: Meileng lampi in khuapi nih kizomsak hi.

examples.english: We waited at the railway station.
examples.zomi: Meileng dinna ah ngak hihang.

senses.usage_en: Railway is common in British English. American English usually uses railroad.
senses.usage_zomi: British English in railway kizang a, American English in railroad a kizang zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Water that falls from clouds in drops.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mei sungpan tui khuak bangin leitungah a hong kia ahi hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain caused flooding in the village.
examples.zomi: Guah tampi hangin khuapi sung tui liim hi.

examples.english: The children played in the rain.
examples.zomi: Naupangte guah sungah kimawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Rain is normally uncountable. Say some rain or a lot of rain, not a rain, except in certain descriptive expressions.
senses.usage_zomi: Rain pen simtheih lo noun bangin kizang zel hi. A rain sangin some rain ahih keileh a lot of rain kici hi.

senses.heading: To move something upward
senses.definition_en: To lift or move someone or something to a higher position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh van khat a sangzaw munah domto ahih keileh koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please raise your hand if you know the answer.
examples.zomi: Dawnna na theih leh na khut domto in.

examples.english: They raised the flag at sunrise.
examples.zomi: Ni hong sua ciangin puanzam domto uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Raise normally takes an object: you raise something. Compare rise, which normally has no object: prices rise.
senses.usage_zomi: Raise in a domto ahih keileh a sangto sak na khat nei kul hi. Rise ahihleh object kisam lo a, amah sangto cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To increase an amount or level
senses.definition_en: To increase the amount, level, price, or rate of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, dinmun, man, ahih keileh rate khat khangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company raised its prices.
examples.zomi: Kampani in a vanman-te khangsak hi.

examples.english: The government plans to raise the minimum wage.
examples.zomi: Ukna in a tawmpen thaman khangsak ding geel hi.

senses.usage_en: Raise is transitive: someone raises a price. Rise is intransitive: the price rises.
senses.usage_zomi: Raise ah mi khat in man khangsak a, rise ah man amah sangto hi.

senses.heading: To care for a child or animal
senses.definition_en: To care for children or young animals until they grow.
senses.explanation_zomi: Naupang ahih keileh ganhing note khangto dong kem in vak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They raised four children.
examples.zomi: Amaute in naupang li kemkhia uh hi.

examples.english: Her family raises cattle on the farm.
examples.zomi: Ama’ innkuan in lo sungah bawng vulh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses raise children. British English also commonly uses bring up children.
senses.usage_zomi: American English in raise children kici zel a, British English in bring up children zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: To collect money or introduce a subject
senses.definition_en: To collect money for a purpose, or to bring a question or issue to people’s attention.
senses.explanation_zomi: Deihna khat a dingin sum kaikhawm, ahih keileh mi-te ngaihsut dingin dotna leh thu khat hong gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The event raised money for the hospital.
examples.zomi: Tua pawi in zatui inn a dingin sum kaikhawm hi.

examples.english: She raised an important question during the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting sungah ama in dotna thupi khat hong koih hi.

senses.usage_en: The meaning of raise depends strongly on its object: raise a hand, raise prices, raise children, or raise a question.
senses.usage_zomi: Raise khiatna pen a nung a object tungah kinga hi: khut domto, man khangsak, naupang kemkhia, ahih keileh dotna hong koih cih bang ahi hi.

senses.heading: A variety of different things
senses.definition_en: A group of different but related products, choices, abilities, or ideas.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizopna nei napi nam tuamtuam van, teeltheihna, siamna, ahih keileh ngaihsutna pawl khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The shop sells a wide range of books.
examples.zomi: Dawr in laibu nam tuamtuam tampi zuak hi.
