examples.english: The course develops a range of skills.
examples.zomi: Hih sinna in siamna nam tuamtuam khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: A range of is followed by a plural countable noun or an uncountable noun describing a field.
senses.usage_zomi: A range of nungah nam tuamtuam a lak plural noun ahih keileh lam khat a gen uncountable noun kizang hi.

senses.heading: The limits within which something varies
senses.definition_en: The distance or set of values between the lowest and highest points.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tawmpen leh a tampen kikal; ciangtan zat
senses.explanation_zomi: A tawmpen leh a tampen, ahih keileh a niam pen leh a sangpen kikal a zat ahi hi.

examples.english: The price range is twenty to fifty dollars.
examples.zomi: Vanman pen dollar sawmnih pan sawmnga kikal ahi hi.

examples.english: The temperature stayed within a safe range.
examples.zomi: Lumna pen bitna ciangtan sungah om hi.

senses.usage_en: When giving a range, use from … to … or between … and ….
senses.usage_zomi: Zat kikal a gen ciangin from … to … ahih keileh between … and … kizang hi.

senses.heading: The distance something can travel or reach
senses.definition_en: The maximum distance over which a vehicle, weapon, voice, or signal can travel or be effective.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw, galvan, aw, ahih keileh signal in a tunzawhpen gamla ahi hi.

examples.english: The village is outside the phone signal’s range.
examples.zomi: Tua khua pen phone signal tunzawhna pualam ah om hi.

examples.english: This electric car has a range of 300 kilometres.
examples.zomi: Hih electric mawtaw in kilometre zathum pai zo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, range refers to a limit of distance, not a variety of choices.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah range pen nam tuamtuam cihna hilo a, tunzawhna gamla ciangtan ahi hi.

senses.heading: A position in an organization
senses.definition_en: An official position or level within an organization, especially the military or police.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, galkap, ahih keileh palik sungah thuneihna leh mawhpuakna tawh kizui in a om dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: He holds a high rank in the army.
examples.zomi: Ama galkap sungah dinmun sang nei hi.

examples.english: Officers wear marks that show their rank.
examples.zomi: Galkap makaite in amau’ dinmun a lak ciaptehna silh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Rank describes a person’s official level, not necessarily that person’s ability or value.
senses.usage_zomi: Rank in mi khat’ thuneihna dinmun gen a, ama’ siamna ahih keileh manpha dan gen pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: A position in an ordered list
senses.definition_en: A position in a list arranged according to quality, success, importance, or score.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihna, gualzawhna, thupina, ahih keileh score tawh kizui in a kikoi a ban dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The team moved up to second rank.
examples.zomi: Pawl pen a nihna dinmunah sangto hi.

examples.english: The university has a high international rank.
examples.zomi: University pen leitung bup tehna ah dinmun sang nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In many contexts, ranking is more natural than rank when referring to a published ordered list.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih keileh pawl-te a banin a kigelh list a gen ciangin rank sangin ranking a kizang zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Happening or moving very quickly.
senses.zomi_equivalents: manlang mahmah; manlang takin a piang
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tom sungin manlang mahmah in a piang ahih keileh a kalsuan ahi hi.

examples.english: The city experienced rapid growth.
examples.zomi: Khuapi pen manlang takin khang hi.

examples.english: Rapid technological change affects many jobs.
examples.zomi: Technology kikhelna manlang in nasepna tampi huzaap hi.

senses.usage_en: Rapid is more formal than quick or fast and commonly describes change, growth, development, or movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Rapid pen quick leh fast sangin formal zaw a, kikhelna, khantohna leh kalsuanna a genna ah kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Very quickly or at a fast rate.
senses.explanation_zomi: Manlang mahmah takin ahih keileh khantohna manlang tawh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The disease spread rapidly.
examples.zomi: Natna pen manlang takin kizel hi.

examples.english: Technology is developing rapidly.
examples.zomi: Technology manlang mahmah in khangto hi.

senses.usage_en: Rapidly often describes measurable change over a short period.
senses.usage_zomi: Rapidly in hun tom sungah a teh theih khantohna ahih keileh kikhelna manlang gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Not common
senses.definition_en: Not happening, existing, or being found very often.
senses.explanation_zomi: A piang ngei lomi, a om tawm mahmah, ahih keileh muh haksa ahi hi.

examples.english: This bird is rare in our region.
examples.zomi: Hih vasa pen eima gam sungah muh haksa hi.

examples.english: Such opportunities are rare.
examples.zomi: Tuabang hamphatna om tawm mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Rare means uncommon. It does not necessarily mean valuable, although rare objects may be valuable.
senses.usage_zomi: Rare cih pen om tawm cihna ahi hi. Manpha cihna pahpah hilo napi, van om tawmte manpha thei hi.

senses.heading: Lightly cooked
senses.definition_en: Cooked for only a short time so that the inside of meat remains red.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a hel nalai; hun tom bek kihuan
senses.explanation_zomi: Sa sunglam a san nalai dingin hun tomkhat bek a kihuan ahi hi.

examples.english: He ordered his steak rare.
examples.zomi: Ama in steak a sung san nalai dingin ngen hi.

examples.english: I do not like meat cooked rare.
examples.zomi: Sa a hel nalai in kihuan ka deih lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This food meaning is mainly used for beef and steak.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen bawngsa leh steak a genna ah a kizang mahmah hi.

senses.definition_en: Not often; only on a few occasions.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tawmvei bek; piang ngei lo
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamveipi hilo in, a tawmvei bek cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: It rarely snows here.
examples.zomi: Hih munah vuk kia ngei lo hi.

examples.english: She rarely watches television.
examples.zomi: Ama television en ngei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Rarely has a negative meaning, so do not normally add not: say I rarely go, not I do not rarely go.
senses.usage_zomi: Rarely sungah “a tamveipi hilo” cih khiatna om khin ahih manin not tawh kizangkhawm ngeilo hi: I rarely go kici hi.

senses.heading: The speed or frequency at which something happens
senses.definition_en: The speed, frequency, or level at which something happens or changes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna ahih keileh kikhelna khat bangzah manlang, bangzah tamvei, ahih keileh bang dinmunin a piang cih a lak zat ahi hi.

examples.english: The population is growing at a rapid rate.
examples.zomi: Mihing zat manlang takin khang hi.

examples.english: The unemployment rate fell last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa in nasep neilo zat kiam hi.

senses.usage_en: Rate often expresses a relationship between an amount and a period, group, or total.
senses.usage_zomi: Rate in zat khat leh hun, pawl, ahih keileh a vekpi zat kikal a kizopna gen zel hi.

senses.heading: A fixed amount charged or paid
senses.definition_en: The amount of money charged or paid for a service, period, or unit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna, hun, ahih keileh unit khat a dingin a kipiak ahih keileh a kikhia sum zat ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel offers a lower weekend rate.
examples.zomi: Hotel in weekend sung man niamzaw pia hi.

examples.english: The bank increased its interest rate.
examples.zomi: Bank in sum pung zat khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning depends on what is being measured or charged: tax rate, interest rate, hourly rate, or exchange rate.
senses.usage_zomi: Rate khiatna pen bang a kiteh ahih keileh bang a kimanlak cih tungah kinga hi: sia zat, sum pung zat, nai khat thaman, ahih keileh sum kikhelna man cih bang ahi hi.

senses.heading: Fairly or to some degree
senses.definition_en: To a fairly large or noticeable degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: A phazah takin ahih keileh lamdang saktheih zahin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The instructions were rather confusing.
examples.zomi: Hilhna pen telhaksa lawmlawm hi.

examples.english: It is rather cold today.
examples.zomi: Tuni a vot lawmlawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Rather may sound stronger or more negative than quite, depending on the context.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangna tawh kizui in rather pen quite sangin a thahatzaw ahih keileh deihlohna a nei zaw bangin zak thei hi.

senses.heading: Preferably
senses.definition_en: Used with would to show that someone prefers one choice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in teeltheihna dang sangin khat a deihzaw cih lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: I would rather stay home tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuni zan inn ah omzaw nuam ing.

examples.english: She would rather walk than wait for the bus.
examples.zomi: Bus ngak sangin ama lampai zaw nuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use would rather + base verb: I would rather go. For a comparison, use rather … than ….
senses.usage_zomi: Would rather nungah verb bulpi kizang hi: I would rather go. Teeltheihna nih a etkak ciangin rather … than … kizang hi.

senses.heading: Not cooked
senses.definition_en: Not cooked or heated for eating.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nek dingin a kihuan ahih keileh a kilum sak nailo ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: huanloh in ne, asial in ne

examples.english: Do not put raw meat beside cooked food.
examples.zomi: Sa sial pen an kihuansa kiangah koih kei in.

examples.english: Some vegetables can be eaten raw.
examples.zomi: Anteh pawlkhat huanlo in nek theih hi.

senses.usage_en: Raw food has not been cooked. Rare meat has been cooked briefly but remains red inside.
senses.usage_zomi: Raw an pen kihuan nailo hi. Rare sa ahihleh hun tomkhat kihuan napi a sung san lai hi.

senses.heading: Not processed or prepared
senses.definition_en: In its natural state before being processed, refined, or made into a finished product.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van suak dingin a kibawl, a kisianthosak, ahih keileh a kiging nailo a pianzia bangin a om ahi hi.

examples.english: The factory imports raw materials.
examples.zomi: Factory in van bawlna ding vanpua gamdang pan hong lak hi.

examples.english: The researchers examined the raw data.
examples.zomi: Zongkhol mite in bawlpha nailo data entel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Raw materials are substances used to manufacture finished products. Raw data has not yet been organized or analysed.
senses.usage_zomi: Raw materials pen van kicing bawlna ding a kizang vanpua-te ahi hi. Raw data pen kigualsak ahih keileh kician takin kikhensia nailo data ahi hi.

senses.heading: To arrive at a place
senses.definition_en: To arrive at a place after travelling or moving.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzin ahih keileh kalsuan khit ciangin mun khat tung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We reached the village before sunset.
examples.zomi: Ni tum ma in khua tung hihang.

examples.english: The climbers reached the top of the mountain.
examples.zomi: Mual kahtote mual dawn tung uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Reach normally takes a place directly: reach the airport. Do not normally say reach to the airport.
senses.usage_zomi: Reach nungah mun min kipahpah hi: reach the airport. Reach to the airport ci in pau ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: To achieve a level, age, or agreement
senses.definition_en: To arrive at a particular level, number, age, decision, or agreement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, zat, kum, khensatna, ahih keileh thukimna khat tung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two sides reached an agreement.
examples.zomi: Lam nihgel thukimna khat ngah uh hi.

examples.english: Sales reached one million dollars.
examples.zomi: Van zuakna dollar maktaduai khat tung hi.

senses.usage_en: Common abstract combinations include reach a decision, reach an agreement, and reach a conclusion.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngaihsutna lamah reach a decision, reach an agreement, leh reach a conclusion cihte kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: To stretch out and touch or take something
senses.definition_en: To stretch your hand or body so that you can touch or take something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat lawk ahih keileh la dingin khut ahih keileh pumpi zan cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: van khat la dingin khut zan

examples.english: She reached for the cup.
examples.zomi: Ama in hai la dingin khut zan hi.

examples.english: Keep the medicine out of children’s reach.
examples.zomi: Zatui pen naupangte khut phaklohna ah koih in.

senses.usage_en: Reach for means stretching towards something; it does not always mean that you successfully take it.
senses.usage_zomi: Reach for cih pen van khat lamah la dingin khut zan cihna ahi a, tua van ngah taktak cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: To respond to something
senses.definition_en: To behave, feel, or act in a particular way because something has happened or been said.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat piang ahih keileh kigen hangin lam khat tawh gamta, lungsim neih, ahih keileh dawng cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She reacted calmly to the bad news.
examples.zomi: Ama in thuthak hoihlo pen lungduai takin dawng hi.

examples.english: How did he react when you told him?
examples.zomi: Nang in na gen ciangin ama koibangin gamta hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use react to, not react on, for the event or information that causes the response.
senses.usage_zomi: Dawnkikna a piangsak thu a gen ciangin react to kizang a, react on kizang lo hi.

senses.heading: To change because of contact with another substance
senses.definition_en: To undergo a chemical change when combined with another substance.
senses.zomi_equivalents: chemical tawh kikhel; kituahna tawh kikhel
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanpua khat leh khat kituah ciangin chemical lamah kikhel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Iron reacts with oxygen and forms rust.
examples.zomi: Sik in oxygen tawh kituah a, tuaciangin eek hong suak hi.

examples.english: These chemicals react strongly when mixed.
examples.zomi: Hih chemical-te kihel ciangin thahat takin kituah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In science, react with identifies the other substance involved in the chemical change.
senses.usage_zomi: Science ah react with in chemical kikhelna sungah a kihel vanpua dang gen hi.

senses.heading: A response to an event or situation
senses.definition_en: Something that someone says, feels, or does in response to an event or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat piang ahih keileh dinmun khat hangin mi khat in a gen, a lungsim neih, ahih keileh a gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her first reaction was surprise.
examples.zomi: Ama’ dawnkikna masapen pen lamdang sakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The decision caused a strong public reaction.
examples.zomi: Tua khensatna in mipite dawnkikna thahat piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use reaction to before the event, decision, or substance that causes the response.
senses.usage_zomi: Dawnkikna a piangsak thu, khensatna, ahih keileh vanpua mai ah reaction to kizang hi.

senses.heading: A chemical change
senses.definition_en: A process in which substances interact and form different substances.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanpua-te kituah in vanpua thak hong pianna chemical sepzia ahi hi.

examples.english: Heat can speed up a chemical reaction.
examples.zomi: Lumna in chemical kikhelna mansak thei hi.

examples.english: The reaction produced a gas.
examples.zomi: Chemical kikhelna in gas khat piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In chemistry, a reaction changes the substances involved rather than merely mixing them.
senses.usage_zomi: Chemistry ah reaction in vanpua-te helkhawm bek hilo in, vanpua tuam hong suaksak hi.

senses.heading: To understand written words
senses.definition_en: To look at and understand written or printed words.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kigelh ahih keileh kisuah kammalte en in a khiatna tel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She reads the newspaper every morning.
examples.zomi: Ama in zing simin thuthak laibu sim hi.

examples.english: Please read the instructions carefully.
examples.zomi: Hilhna-te pilvang takin sim in.

senses.usage_en: The present form is pronounced /riːd/. The past form is spelled read but pronounced /red/.
senses.usage_zomi: Tu hun a gen read pen /riːd/ ci in kisim hi. A beisa hun read pen gelhdan kibang napi /red/ ci in kisim hi.

senses.heading: To study or obtain information from signs or data
senses.definition_en: To examine and understand information shown by signs, instruments, maps, or data.
senses.zomi_equivalents: en in tel; sim in thei
senses.explanation_zomi: Ciaptehna, tehna khawl, gamlim, ahih keileh data in a lak thu en in tel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you read this map?
examples.zomi: Hih gamlim na en in na tel thei diam?

examples.english: The nurse read the patient’s temperature.
examples.zomi: Nurse in cina pa’ pumpi lumna tehna sim hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, read means interpreting information, not only reading sentences.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah read pen sentence sim bek hilo a, a kilak thu let in tel cihna zong ahi hi.

senses.heading: A person who reads
senses.definition_en: A person who reads, especially someone who reads a particular book, publication, or type of writing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai a sim mi, a diak in laibu, thuthak laibu, ahih keileh laigelh nam khat a sim mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The book is suitable for young readers.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu pen laisimmi naupangte a dingin kilawm hi.

examples.english: The magazine has thousands of readers.
examples.zomi: Magazine in laisimmi tul tampi nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Reader may refer to any person who reads or to the intended audience of a text.
senses.usage_zomi: Reader in lai a sim mi peuhmah ahih keileh laigelh khat a dingin a ngiim laisim mite gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A device or program that reads information
senses.definition_en: A device or computer program that receives or interprets stored information.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kikem thu la, sim, ahih keileh let thei khawl ahih keileh computer program ahi hi.

examples.english: Insert the card into the reader.
examples.zomi: Card pen simna khawl sungah khum in.

examples.english: A screen reader helps users who cannot see the display.
examples.zomi: Screen thu simkhia program in screen mu theilo zangte huh hi.

senses.usage_en: The word before reader usually identifies what the device or program reads.
senses.usage_zomi: Reader mai a kammal in khawl ahih keileh program in bang a sim cih gen hi.

senses.heading: The activity or skill of reading
senses.definition_en: The activity of looking at and understanding written words.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kigelh kammalte en in a khiatna telna sepkhiatna ahih keileh siamna ahi hi.

examples.english: Reading helps children develop language skills.
examples.zomi: Laisimna in naupangte pau siamna khangsak hi.

examples.english: She spends an hour a day on reading.
examples.zomi: Ama in nisim nai khat laisimna ah zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Reading is normally uncountable when it refers to the general activity or skill.
senses.usage_zomi: Laisimna sepkhiatna ahih keileh siamna buppi a gen ciangin reading pen simtheih lo noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: A particular interpretation or measurement
senses.definition_en: A particular interpretation of a text or situation, or a number shown by a measuring instrument.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laigelh ahih keileh dinmun khat khiatna letdan, ahih keileh tehna khawl in a lak zat ahi hi.

examples.english: My reading of the poem differs from yours.
examples.zomi: Kei in tua la phuak khiatna ka letdan leh nangma letdan kibang lo hi.

examples.english: The temperature reading was unusually high.
examples.zomi: Lumna tehna zat ngeina sangin sang mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: A countable reading can mean one interpretation, one measurement, or one occasion on which a text is read aloud.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtheih reading in khiatna letdan khat, tehna khat, ahih keileh lai aw ngaihtheih in simna khat gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Prepared for an action or event
senses.definition_en: Prepared and able to do something or deal with an event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna ahih keileh thu piang khat a dingin kigingsa in semthei ding a om ahi hi.

examples.english: We are ready to begin the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting kipan dingin kiging khin hihang.

examples.english: Are you ready for the exam?
examples.zomi: Sittelna a dingin na kiging khin hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use ready to + verb for an action and ready for + noun for an event or situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Sepna khat mai ah ready to + verb kizang a, pawi ahih keileh dinmun khat mai ah ready for + noun kizang hi.

senses.heading: Available for immediate use
senses.definition_en: Completed, prepared, or available so that it can be used immediately.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawlkhinsa, kigingkhinsa, ahih keileh tu lianin zat theih ding a om ahi hi.

examples.english: Dinner is ready.
examples.zomi: Zan an kiging khin hi.

examples.english: The report will be ready tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Laporan zingt ciangin kiging ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Ready may describe either a prepared person or something prepared for use.
senses.usage_zomi: Ready in mi khat kiging khin cih ahih keileh na khat zat dingin kiging khin cih gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Existing and not imaginary
senses.definition_en: Actually existing or happening, rather than being imaginary, invented, or false.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsut suak, phuah, ahih keileh manlo hilo in a om taktak ahih keileh a piang taktak ahi hi.

examples.english: The story is based on a real event.
examples.zomi: Tangthu pen thu piang taktak tungah kinga hi.

examples.english: The danger is real, not imaginary.
examples.zomi: Lauhuaina pen a taktak ahi a, ngaihsut suak hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Real contrasts with imaginary, artificial, or false, depending on the context.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangna tawh kizui in real pen imaginary, artificial, ahih keileh false tawh kilehbulh hi.

senses.heading: Genuine and not an imitation
senses.definition_en: Made from the stated material or being the true type, not a copy or imitation.
senses.explanation_zomi: A genteh vanpua tawh kibawl taktak ahih keileh etton suak hilo in a mantak ahi hi.

examples.english: The ring is made of real gold.
examples.zomi: Khutsial pen kham taktak tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: He did not use his real name online.
examples.zomi: Ama in online ah a min taktak zang lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Real means genuine. Really is the related adverb: It is really expensive.
senses.usage_zomi: Real cih pen a mantak cihna ahi hi. A tawh kizop adverb pen really ahi hi: It is really expensive.

senses.heading: Important, serious, or significant
senses.definition_en: Serious, important, or having a noticeable effect.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupi, ngaihsut ding taktak, ahih keileh huzaap kician a nei ahi hi.

examples.english: Lack of clean water is a real problem.
examples.zomi: Tui siangtho a kimuhlohna pen buaina taktak ahi hi.

examples.english: The new policy made a real difference.
examples.zomi: Policy thak in kikhelna kician piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Before nouns such as problem, danger, or difference, real emphasizes seriousness or importance.
senses.usage_zomi: Problem, danger, leh difference bang noun-te mai ah real in tua thu a thupina ahih keileh a kicianna thangsak hi.

senses.heading: Accepting what is actually possible
senses.definition_en: Understanding a situation as it really is and making sensible judgments about what can be achieved.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a taktak dinmun tawh kituak; a sepzawh ding ngaihsun
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun a om taktak bangin tel a, bang sepzawh ding leh bang sepzawh lo ding cih kilawm takin ngaihsun ahi hi.

examples.english: We need to set a realistic goal.
examples.zomi: Tangtun theih ding ngiimna khat i koih kul hi.

examples.english: It is not realistic to finish all the work today.
examples.zomi: Nasep teng tuni a zawh ding pen sepzawh ding hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Realistic does not mean negative or without hope. It means judging a situation according to facts and actual possibilities.
senses.usage_zomi: Realistic cih pen lungkia ahih keileh lametna nei lo cihna hilo hi. Thu kician leh a piangthei dinmun tawh kizui in thukhen cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Looking like real life
senses.definition_en: Representing people, objects, or events in a way that looks true to life.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a taktak bang; nuntakna tawh a kibang
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, ahih keileh thu piangte nuntakna taktak bangin a kibang takin lak ahi hi.

examples.english: The painting gives a realistic picture of village life.
examples.zomi: Lim in khuami nuntakna a taktak bangin lak hi.

examples.english: The characters in the story feel realistic.
examples.zomi: Tangthu sung mite pen mi taktak bangin kilang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In art and writing, realistic means closely resembling real people, places, or experiences.
senses.usage_zomi: Lim suai leh laigelhna ah realistic cih pen mi, mun leh thu phutkhakte tawh a kinai takin kibang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The true situation
senses.definition_en: The actual state of a situation, rather than what is imagined, expected, or claimed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsut suak, lamet, ahih keileh mi’ gen bang hilo in dinmun a om taktak ahi hi.

examples.english: We must face the reality of the situation.
examples.zomi: Dinmun a om taktak i maingat kul hi.

examples.english: The job looked easy, but in reality it was difficult.
examples.zomi: Nasep pen baih bangin kilang napi, a taktak ah haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: Reality is normally uncountable when it means the true state of a situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun a om taktak a gen ciangin reality pen simtheih lo noun bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: Something that actually exists or happens
senses.definition_en: Something that exists or has become true rather than remaining an idea or dream.
senses.zomi_equivalents: na om taktak; thu piang taktak
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna ahih keileh mang bek hilo in a om ahih keileh a piang taktak na khat ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: computer tawh a kibawl nuntakna bang dinmun

examples.english: Their plan finally became a reality.
examples.zomi: Amau’ geelna a nunungin a taktak in hong piang hi.

examples.english: New technology turned the idea into reality.
examples.zomi: Technology thak in tua ngaihsutna pen a taktak suaksak hi.

senses.usage_en: A plan, hope, or dream becomes a reality when it is achieved or actually happens.
senses.usage_zomi: Geelna, lametna, ahih keileh mang khat a tangtun taktak ciangin becomes a reality kici hi.

senses.heading: To become aware of something
senses.definition_en: To begin to understand or become aware of a fact or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kician ahih keileh dinmun khat thei nailo napi, nungciangin hong thei in hong tel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I suddenly realized that I had the wrong key.
examples.zomi: A khial tawhtang ka nei cih thakhatin theikha ing.

examples.english: She realized how serious the problem was.
examples.zomi: Buaina bangzah in a thupi cih ama hong thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Realize describes a change in understanding. Do not normally use it for information that someone has always known.
senses.usage_zomi: Realize in thu khat a telna hong kikhel cih gen hi. Mi khat in a theihsa thu tawh kizang ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: To achieve something hoped for
senses.definition_en: To achieve a hope, ambition, plan, or possibility.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lametna, deihna, ngiimna, ahih keileh geelna khat tangtung sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She worked hard to realize her dream.
examples.zomi: A mang tangtung sak dingin hahkat takin sem hi.

examples.english: The project could realize its full potential.
examples.zomi: Project in a sepzawhna a picingin tangtung sak thei ding hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is more formal. In everyday English, achieve a dream is also common.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen formal zaw hi. Nisim English pau in achieve a dream zong kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Very
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize an adjective or adverb.
senses.explanation_zomi: Adjective ahih keileh adverb khat’ khiatna thangsak in “mahmah” cihna a pia ahi hi.

examples.english: The food was really delicious.
examples.zomi: Annek pen a lim mahmah hi.

examples.english: She completed the work really quickly.
examples.zomi: Ama in nasep pen manlang mahmah takin zo hi.

senses.usage_en: Really is common in conversation. In formal writing, a more precise word such as extremely or highly may sometimes be better.
senses.usage_zomi: Really pen kihona ah kizang mahmah hi. Formal laigelhna ah extremely ahih keileh highly bang kammal a kicianzaw zat theih hi.

senses.heading: Actually or in fact
senses.definition_en: Used to refer to the true facts of a situation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a taktak ah; thu maan takin
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun a om taktak ahih keileh thu maan a genna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a taktak in tua khiatna nei

examples.english: What really happened at the meeting?
examples.zomi: Meeting ah bang a piang taktak hiam?

examples.english: I thought he was angry, but he was really tired.
examples.zomi: Ama he ci in ngaihsun ing, ahihhang a taktak ah ama gim hi.

senses.usage_en: Really? can also be used alone to show surprise or to ask whether something is true.
senses.usage_zomi: Really? pen lamdang sakna lakna ahih keileh thu khat a maan taktak hiam ci in dongna ah amah bek kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: A cause or explanation
senses.definition_en: A fact, situation, or explanation that shows why something happened or why someone did something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat banghangin a piang ahih keileh mi khat banghangin tuabang a gamta cih a hilhcian hangthu ahi hi.

examples.english: What was the reason for the delay?
examples.zomi: Banghangin a zek hiam?

examples.english: She left early for a personal reason.
examples.zomi: Mimal hangthu khat hangin ama zingsangin paikhiat hi.

senses.usage_en: Use reason for + noun and reason why + clause: the reason for the delay; the reason why we were late.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun mai ah reason for kizang a, thu kicing mai ah reason why kizang hi: the reason for the delay; the reason why we were late.

senses.heading: The ability to think logically
senses.definition_en: The human ability to think, understand, and form judgments logically.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsut siamna; kilawm takin thukhen theihna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing in ngaihsun, tel leh thu kician tungah kinga in kilawm takin thukhen theihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We should use reason rather than fear.
examples.zomi: Lauhna sangin ngaihsut siamna i zangzaw ding hi.

examples.english: Her decision was based on reason and evidence.
examples.zomi: Ama’ khensatna pen ngaihsut siamna leh teci tungah kinga hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, reason contrasts with uncontrolled emotion, instinct, or unsupported belief.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah reason pen kikem zo lo lungsim, pianpih gamtatna, ahih keileh teci neilo upna tawh kilehbulh hi.

senses.heading: Fair and sensible
senses.definition_en: Fair, practical, and based on good judgment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thuman, zat theih leh ngaihsutna hoih tungah kinga ahi hi.

examples.english: Her request seems reasonable.
examples.zomi: Ama’ ngenna pen kilawm bangin kilang hi.

examples.english: We need to find a reasonable solution.
examples.zomi: Kithukim theih ding leh zat theih ding dawngna khat i zong kul hi.

senses.usage_en: A reasonable person considers facts and other people’s needs before deciding.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngaihsutna kilawm nei mi in thukhen ma in thu kician leh midangte’ kisapna ngaihsun hi.

senses.heading: Not too expensive or excessive
senses.definition_en: Acceptable and not too high in price, amount, or demand.
senses.explanation_zomi: Man, zat, ahih keileh ngenna a sangluat lo in sangtheih ding a om ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel offers rooms at a reasonable price.
examples.zomi: Hotel in man kilawm tawh lupna pindan pia hi.

examples.english: Please give us a reasonable amount of time.
examples.zomi: Hun zat kilawm hong pia in.

senses.usage_en: Reasonable often means acceptable rather than especially cheap or perfect.
senses.usage_zomi: Reasonable cih pen a man ol mahmah ahih keileh a picingpen cihna hilo a, sangtheih dingin a kilawm cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To remember something
senses.definition_en: To remember a fact, event, person, or experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, thu piang, mi, ahih keileh phutkhak khat phawk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I cannot recall his name.
examples.zomi: Ama’ min phawk zo lo ing.

examples.english: She clearly recalled what happened that night.
examples.zomi: Tua zan a thu piang ama kician takin phawk hi.

senses.usage_en: Recall is slightly more formal than remember. It can be followed by a noun or an -ing form.
senses.usage_zomi: Recall pen remember sangin formal tawm hi. A nungah noun ahih keileh -ing form kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: To order someone or something to return
senses.definition_en: To officially order a person to return, or to remove an unsafe product from sale or use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat hong ciahkik dingin thupiak, ahih keileh bitlo van khat zuakna leh zatna pan lakik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company recalled the unsafe toys.
examples.zomi: Kampani in bitlo kimawlna van-te lakik hi.

examples.english: The government recalled its ambassador.
examples.zomi: Ukna in a palai ciahkik sak hi.

senses.usage_en: A product is recalled when its maker asks customers to return it because it may be unsafe or defective.
senses.usage_zomi: Van khat bitlo ahih keileh a kisiat theih manin van bawlpa in a leite hong puakkik ding a ngen ciangin tua van recalled kici hi.

senses.heading: Written proof of payment
senses.definition_en: A printed or electronic record showing that goods or services have been paid for.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sum piakna teci; man piak ciaptehna
senses.explanation_zomi: Van ahih keileh nasepna man kipiak khin cih a lak lai ahih keileh electronic ciaptehna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please keep the receipt in case you return the shirt.
examples.zomi: Angki na puakkik kha leh kisam ding ahih manin sum piakna teci kem in.

examples.english: The cashier gave me a receipt.
examples.zomi: Sum sangpa in sum piakna teci hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: The spelling is receipt, but the p is silent: /rɪˈsiːt/.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kammal receipt ci in kigelh napi, p aw suak lo a, /rɪˈsiːt/ ci in kisim hi.

senses.heading: The act of receiving something
senses.definition_en: The act of receiving money, goods, a message, or a document.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, van, thupuak, ahih keileh lai khat ngahna ahi hi.

examples.english: We will send the goods on receipt of payment.
examples.zomi: Sum i ngah ciangin van-te i sawl ding hi.

examples.english: Please confirm receipt of this email.
examples.zomi: Hih email na ngah khin cih hong kipsak in.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is formal and is common in business writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen formal ahi a, sum leh sumvai laigelhna ah kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: To get or be given something
senses.definition_en: To get something that someone sends, gives, or pays to you.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a hong sawl, a hong pia, ahih keileh a hong piakna khat ngah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I received your email this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zing na email ngah ing.

examples.english: Each worker receives a weekly payment.
examples.zomi: Nasem khat ciangin kal sim thaman ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Receive is more formal than get. Remember the spelling: i comes after e in receive.
senses.usage_zomi: Receive pen get sangin formal zaw hi. Gelhdan ah receive sungin e nungah i hong pai hi.

senses.heading: To welcome or accept a person
senses.definition_en: To welcome, admit, or formally accept a visitor, guest, or new member.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khual, hong pai mi, ahih keileh member thak khat na’ng in sang ahih keileh makaih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The president received the foreign visitors.
examples.zomi: President in gamdang pan hong pai khualte sang hi.

examples.english: Her speech was well received by the audience.
examples.zomi: Ama’ thugen mipite in deih takin sang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When an idea, performance, or speech is well received, people respond positively to it.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngaihsutna, lakna, ahih keileh thugen khat well received kici leh mi-te in a deih takin sang uh cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Happening, beginning, or existing only a short time ago.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu hun pan a sawt nailo lai in a piang, a kipan, ahih keileh a om ahi hi.

examples.english: Recent research supports this conclusion.
examples.zomi: Tulai zongkholna in hih thukhupna panpih hi.

examples.english: The building has undergone recent repairs.
examples.zomi: Inn pen sawt nailo in kibawlpha hi.

senses.usage_en: Recent describes a noun. Use recently when describing when an action happened.
senses.usage_zomi: Recent in noun khat gen hi. Sepna khat bang hunin a piang cih gen nadingin recently kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A short time ago or during the period near the present.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sawt nailo in ahih keileh tulaitak sungin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She recently started a new job.
examples.zomi: Ama sawt nailo in nasep thak khat kipan hi.

examples.english: Have you seen him recently?
examples.zomi: Sawt nailo sungin ama na mu hiam?

senses.usage_en: Recently is commonly used with the present perfect or simple past, depending on the variety of English and the context.
senses.usage_zomi: English nam leh a kizangna dinmun tawh kizui in recently pen present perfect ahih keileh simple past tawh kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: The place where visitors are welcomed
senses.definition_en: The area in a hotel, office, or hospital where visitors go for information or assistance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hotel, zung, ahih keileh zatui inn ah hong pai mite in thu dong leh huhna ngah nading a paina mun ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: khual sangna munah pai in min pia

examples.english: Please leave the key at reception.
examples.zomi: Tawhtang pen khual sangna munah koih in.

examples.english: Ask at the reception desk for more information.
examples.zomi: Thu behlap theih nadingin khual sangna sabuai ah dong in.

senses.usage_en: British English often uses at reception. American English commonly uses at the front desk.
senses.usage_zomi: British English in at reception kizang zel a, American English in at the front desk a kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: A formal social event
senses.definition_en: A formal gathering held to welcome, honour, or celebrate people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualte sang, mi khat pahtawi, ahih keileh pawi bawl nadingin a kibawl mipawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: The wedding reception was held at a hotel.
examples.zomi: Mopawi khual vakna hotel ah kibawl hi.

examples.english: The embassy held a reception for the visitors.
examples.zomi: Palai zung in khualte a dingin khual sang pawi bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A wedding reception is the celebration held after the marriage ceremony.
senses.usage_zomi: Wedding reception pen kiteenna zehtan khit ciang a kibawl khual vakna leh lungdam pawi ahi hi.

senses.heading: The quality of a signal
senses.definition_en: The quality with which radio, television, or phone signals are received.
senses.explanation_zomi: Radio, television, ahih keileh phone signal bangzah kicianin a kingah cih ahi hi.

examples.english: Phone reception is poor in the mountains.
examples.zomi: Mualtung ah phone signal hoih lo hi.

examples.english: Move closer to the window for better reception.
examples.zomi: Signal kicianzaw dingin thlalang kong kiangah kineizaw in.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, reception refers to signal quality, not the device receiving it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah reception pen signal ngahdan hoihna gen a, signal a sang khawl gen lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A set of instructions that explains how to prepare and cook a particular kind of food.
senses.explanation_zomi: Annek nam khat koibangin bawl leh huan ding cih a hilh anhuan dan ahi hi.

examples.english: This recipe uses fresh vegetables.
examples.zomi: Hih anhuan dan in anthang thak zang hi.

examples.english: Follow the recipe carefully.
examples.zomi: Anhuan dan pilvang takin zui in.

senses.usage_en: A recipe lists ingredients and gives cooking instructions. Do not confuse recipe with receipt.
senses.usage_zomi: Recipe in an bawlna van kisamte leh huandan hilh hi. Sum piakna teci a cihna receipt tawh helkhawm lo ding hi.

senses.heading: To know someone or something from before
senses.definition_en: To know who someone is or what something is because you have seen, heard, or experienced it before.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat nidangin mu, za, ahih keileh phutkhak khin ahih manin theikha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I recognized her voice immediately.
examples.zomi: Ama’ aw pahpah in theikha ing.

examples.english: He had changed so much that I hardly recognized him.
examples.zomi: Ama kikhel mahmah ahih manin theikha nailo deuh ing.

senses.usage_en: Recognize means identifying someone or something already known. Know has a broader meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Recognize cih pen nidang a kitheihsa mi ahih keileh na khat theikha cihna ahi hi. Know ahihleh khiatna a zaizaw hi.

senses.heading: To accept that something is true or important
senses.definition_en: To accept or acknowledge that a fact, problem, right, or achievement exists or is important.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kician, buaina, hamphatna, ahih keileh gualzawhna khat a om taktak ahih keileh a thupi cih sang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The government recognized the need for reform.
examples.zomi: Ukna in puahphatna kisam cih sang hi.

examples.english: Her contribution was officially recognized.
examples.zomi: Ama’ panpihna thuneihna tawh kipsak in kipahtawi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, recognize means openly accepting or formally acknowledging something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah recognize pen thu khat a om taktak cih langtang takin sang ahih keileh thuneihna tawh kipsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To suggest that someone or something is good
senses.definition_en: To say that a person, product, place, or action is good or suitable.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hoih ci in gen; teel dingin han
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, mun, ahih keileh sepkhiatna khat a hoih ahih keileh a kilawm cih gen in teel dingin han cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: annek dawr khat hoih ci in gen

examples.english: I highly recommend this book.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu sim dingin hong han mahmah ing.

examples.english: Can you recommend a good doctor?
examples.zomi: Siavuan hoih khat nong hilh thei diam?

senses.usage_en: Use recommend something to someone: I recommended the book to her.
senses.usage_zomi: Recommend something to someone cihdan kizang hi: I recommended the book to her.

senses.heading: To advise a particular action
senses.definition_en: To advise someone that a particular action is the best or most suitable choice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna khat pen a hoihpen ahih keileh a kilawmpen hi ci in mi khat thuhilh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor recommended more rest.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in tawldam tamzaw dingin thuhilh hi.

examples.english: I recommend that you speak to your manager.
examples.zomi: Na makai tawh na kihona ding hong han ing.

senses.usage_en: Use recommend + -ing or recommend that + clause. Do not normally say recommend someone to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Recommend + -ing ahih keileh recommend that + clause kizang hi. Recommend someone to do something ci in pau ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Advice about the best action
senses.definition_en: A suggestion or piece of advice about what someone should do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat bang sem ding cih tawh kisai in a kilawm pen ci in a kipiak ngaihsutna ahih keileh thuhilhna ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee made three recommendations.
examples.zomi: Committee in thuhilhna thum pia hi.

examples.english: We followed the doctor’s recommendation.
examples.zomi: Siavuan’ thuhilhna zui hihang.

senses.usage_en: Recommendation is countable when it means one specific suggestion.
senses.usage_zomi: Thuhilhna khat kician takin a gen ciangin recommendation pen simtheih noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: A statement that someone or something is suitable
senses.definition_en: A statement saying that a person, product, or service is good and suitable.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hoihna kipsakna; mi tawh kisai kipsakna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, ahih keileh nasepna khat a hoih leh a kilawm cih a kipsak thu ahi hi.

examples.english: She applied with a letter of recommendation.
examples.zomi: Ama in a hoihna kipsak lai tawh nasep ngen hi.

examples.english: We chose the hotel on a friend’s recommendation.
examples.zomi: Lawmpa’ kihan bangin tua hotel teel hihang.

senses.usage_en: A letter of recommendation describes a person’s abilities and suitability, often for education or employment.
senses.usage_zomi: Letter of recommendation in mi khat’ siamna leh sinna ahih keileh nasepna a dingin a kilawmna gen hi.

senses.heading: Stored information
senses.definition_en: Information kept in writing, electronically, or in another permanent form.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, electronic file, ahih keileh a omden thei forma dang tawh a kikem thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The hospital keeps a record of every patient.
examples.zomi: Zatui inn in cina khat ciang thu ciaptehna kem hi.

examples.english: Please check the financial records.
examples.zomi: Sumvai ciaptehna-te en in.

senses.usage_en: A record may be written, printed, audio, visual, or digital.
senses.usage_zomi: Record pen laigelh, laisuah, aw, lim, ahih keileh digital forma in om thei hi.

senses.heading: The best result ever achieved
senses.definition_en: The best or highest result that has been officially achieved in a particular activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna ahih keileh kimawlna khat ah thuneihna tawh a kiciapteh gualzawhna sangpen ahi hi.

examples.english: She broke the world record.
examples.zomi: Ama in leitung ciaptehsa sangpen kheng hi.

examples.english: The athlete set a new national record.
examples.zomi: Kimawlmi in gam ciaptehsa sangpen thak koih hi.

senses.usage_en: We set or establish a new record and break an existing record.
senses.usage_zomi: Ciaptehsa sangpen thak pen set a record kici a, a omkhin ciaptehna zawhna pen break a record kici hi.

senses.heading: A person’s known history
senses.definition_en: The known history of a person’s actions, achievements, employment, or crimes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ gamtatna, gualzawhna, nasepna, ahih keileh mawhna tawh kisai a kitheihsa thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The applicant has a strong employment record.
examples.zomi: Nasep ngenpa in nasepna ciaptehna hoih nei hi.

examples.english: He has no criminal record.
examples.zomi: Ama mawhna ciaptehna nei lo hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun is pronounced /ˈrekərd/. The verb record is usually pronounced /rɪˈkɔːrd/.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun record pen /ˈrekərd/ ci in kisim a, verb record pen /rɪˈkɔːrd/ ci in kisim zel hi.

senses.heading: Stored sound or video
senses.definition_en: Sound or video that has been captured and stored so that it can be played again.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nungkik in ngaih ahih keileh et theih dingin aw ahih keileh video a kilak in a kikem ahi hi.

examples.english: I listened to a recording of the speech.
examples.zomi: Thugen aw laksa ngai ing.

examples.english: The video recording clearly showed the incident.
examples.zomi: Video laksa in thu piang kician takin lak hi.

senses.usage_en: A recording is the stored sound or video. The process of making it is also called recording.
senses.usage_zomi: Recording pen aw ahih keileh video a kilaksa ahi a, tua lakna sepkhiatna zong recording kici hi.

senses.heading: The process of capturing sound or video
senses.definition_en: The activity or process of capturing sound, music, speech, or video.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw, la, thugen, ahih keileh video la in kemna sepkhiatna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: aw ahih keileh video lak kipan

examples.english: The recording took three hours.
examples.zomi: Aw lakna nai thum sawt hi.

examples.english: Please remain quiet during the recording.
examples.zomi: Aw lak laitakin dai takin om in.

senses.usage_en: Context normally shows whether recording means the process or the finished audio or video.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangna dinmun in recording pen lakna sepkhiatna maw, laksa aw ahih keileh video maw cih lak hi.

senses.heading: To become healthy or normal again
senses.definition_en: To become healthy, strong, or normal again after illness, injury, shock, or difficulty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Natna, liamna, lauhtakna, ahih keileh haksatna khit ciangin cidamkik, thahatkik, ahih keileh ngeina bangin omkik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is recovering from surgery.
examples.zomi: Ama zatui tawh ki-atna pan cidamkik laitak hi.

examples.english: The economy slowly recovered after the crisis.
examples.zomi: Buaina khit ciangin sumvai dinmun damtak in hoihkik hi.

senses.usage_en: Use recover from before the illness, injury, or difficult event.
senses.usage_zomi: Natna, liamna, ahih keileh haksatna thu mai ah recover from kizang hi.

senses.heading: To get back something lost or stolen
senses.definition_en: To find, regain, or obtain something again after it was lost, stolen, or unavailable.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kimang, a kiguk, ahih keileh zat theihlo na khat zongkik in ngahlawh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The police recovered the stolen car.
examples.zomi: Palikte in mawtaw kiguk ngahkik uh hi.

examples.english: The technician recovered most of the lost files.
examples.zomi: Technology siam in file mang a tamzaw ngahkik hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, recover is transitive and takes an object: recover data, money, or property.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah recover in object nei a, data, sum, ahih keileh van ngahkik cihdanin kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: To process used materials so that they can be used again instead of being thrown away.
senses.zomi_equivalents: puah in zatkik; zatkhit van bawlkik
senses.explanation_zomi: Zatkhit vanpua-te paai loin puahkik in zatkik theih dingin bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We recycle paper, glass, and plastic.
examples.zomi: Lai, thlalang leh plastic-te puah in zatkik hihang.

examples.english: These bottles can be recycled.
examples.zomi: Hih thawl-te puahkik in zatkik theih hi.

senses.usage_en: Recycle means processing material for reuse. Reuse means using the same object again without necessarily processing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Recycle cih pen vanpua puahkik in zatkik cihna ahi hi. Reuse ahihleh tua van mah puahkik kul loin zatkik cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Having the colour of blood or ripe tomatoes
senses.definition_en: Having the colour of blood, fire, or a ripe tomato.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sisan, meikuang, ahih keileh tomato min bang a san pianzia nei ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore a red dress.
examples.zomi: Ama puansilhsan silh hi.

examples.english: Stop when the traffic light turns red.
examples.zomi: Lampi meivak san hong suak ciangin khawl in.

senses.usage_en: Colour adjectives normally come before a noun or after a linking verb: a red car; the car is red.
senses.usage_zomi: Color adjective-te noun mai ah ahih keileh linking verb nungah om zel hi: a red car; the car is red.

senses.heading: Red because of heat, anger, embarrassment, or injury
senses.definition_en: Having skin that has become red because of heat, emotion, pressure, or physical irritation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lumna, hehna, zumna, nengna, ahih keileh pumpi natna hangin vun hong san ahi hi.

examples.english: His face turned red with embarrassment.
examples.zomi: Zumna hangin a maitang hong san hi.

examples.english: My eyes became red from the smoke.
examples.zomi: Khu hangin ka mitte hong san hi.

senses.usage_en: When a person turns red, context shows whether the cause is embarrassment, anger, heat, or another physical condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat turns red kici ciangin zumna, hehna, lumna, ahih keileh pumpi dinmun dang hang hiam cih a kizangna thu in lak hi.

senses.heading: To make something smaller or less
senses.definition_en: To make an amount, number, size, price, or level smaller.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, sim, size, man, ahih keileh dinmun khat tawmzaw ahih keileh niamzaw suaksak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company is trying to reduce its costs.
examples.zomi: Kampani in sum zat kiamsak dingin hanciam hi.

examples.english: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of disease.
examples.zomi: Ngeina tawh kizui a pumpi kisinsakna in natna lauhuaina kiamsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Reduce takes an object: reduce costs. Decrease can be transitive or intransitive: decrease costs; costs decreased.
senses.usage_zomi: Reduce in object nei hi: reduce costs. Decrease ahihleh object tawh zong, object lo in zong kizang thei hi: decrease costs; costs decreased.

senses.heading: To bring something down to a particular level
senses.definition_en: To make something reach a lower amount, size, or level.
senses.zomi_equivalents: zat khat dong kiamsak; dinmun niamsak
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a niamzaw zat ahih keileh dinmun ciang dong kiamsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The price was reduced by twenty percent.
examples.zomi: Vanman za-ah sawmnih kiamsak hi.

examples.english: They reduced the number of workers to fifty.
examples.zomi: Nasem zat sawmnga dong kiamsak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Reduce by gives the amount of change; reduce to gives the final amount.
senses.usage_zomi: Reduce by in bangzah a kiam cih gen a, reduce to in a nunungpen zat bangzah a suak cih gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A decrease in the amount, number, size, price, or level of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat’ zat, sim, size, man, ahih keileh dinmun a kiamna ahi hi.

examples.english: The new system produced a reduction in costs.
examples.zomi: System thak in sum zat kiamna piangsak hi.

examples.english: Customers received a ten-percent price reduction.
examples.zomi: Vanleite in vanman za-ah sawm kiamna ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a reduction in before the thing that decreases and a reduction of before the amount: a reduction in prices of ten percent.
senses.usage_zomi: A kiam na mai ah a reduction in kizang a, a kiamna zat mai ah a reduction of kizang hi: vanman ah za-ah sawm kiamna cih bang ahi hi.

senses.heading: To mention or describe someone or something
senses.definition_en: To speak or write about someone or something, often briefly or indirectly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat thu pau ahih keileh gelh, a diak in tomkim ahih keileh langkhat tawh gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The report refers to several serious problems.
examples.zomi: Laporan in buaina thupi pawlkhat thu gen hi.

examples.english: She referred to the incident during her speech.
examples.zomi: Ama in thugen laitakin tua thu piang gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Use refer to, not simply refer, before the person or subject mentioned.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih keileh thu a kigen mai ah refer to kizang a, refer bek kizang lo hi.

senses.heading: To direct someone to another source or specialist
senses.definition_en: To send someone to another person, place, or source for information, advice, or treatment.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tungah sawl; va en dingin hilh
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, thuhilhna, ahih keileh zatui kepna ngah nadingin mi khat pen mi, mun, ahih keileh thubul dang khat tungah sawl cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: refer a patient to a specialist
common_phrases.zomi: cina mi pen siavuan siam tuam tungah sawl
mi khat website en dingin hilh

common_phrases.english: refer the matter to a manager

examples.english: The doctor referred her to a specialist.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ama siavuan siam tuam khat tungah sawl hi.

examples.english: Please refer to the guide for more information.
examples.zomi: Thu behlap a dingin lamhilh lai en in.

senses.usage_en: The structure is refer someone to someone or something. When you consult a source yourself, use refer to the source.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a kisawl ciangin refer someone to someone or something kizang hi. Thubul khat nangmah in na et ciangin refer to the source kizang hi.

senses.heading: A mention of someone or something
senses.definition_en: A spoken or written mention of a person, subject, event, or source.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, thu, thu piang, ahih keileh thubul khat pau ahih keileh laigelhna sungah a kigenna ahi hi.

examples.english: The book contains several references to Zomi history.
examples.zomi: Laibu sungah Zomi tangthu genna pawlkhat om hi.

examples.english: He made no reference to the earlier disagreement.
examples.zomi: Ama in a beisa thukimlohna gen lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Make reference to is a formal way of saying mention or refer to.
senses.usage_zomi: Make reference to pen mention ahih keileh refer to cihna formal zaw ahi hi.

senses.heading: A source of information
senses.definition_en: A book, document, website, or other source used to find or verify information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu zonna ahih keileh thu a maan hiam cih kipsakna a kizang laibu, lai, website, ahih keileh thubul dang ahi hi.

examples.english: Keep this document for future reference.
examples.zomi: Mailam thu etna dingin hih lai kem in.

examples.english: The dictionary is a useful reference source.
examples.zomi: Dictionary pen thu etna thubul phatuam khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A reference source helps users find facts; it is not usually read continuously from beginning to end.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu etna thubul pen thu kician zonna a kizang a, a kipatna pan a tawp dong sim suksuk dingin kibawl pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: A statement supporting a person’s application
senses.definition_en: A statement describing someone’s character or ability, usually for a job or course application.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mi kipsakna; nasep ngenna kipsak lai
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih keileh sinna a ngen mi khat’ omzia leh siamna a kipsak lai ahih keileh thu ahi hi.

examples.english: Her former manager provided a reference.
examples.zomi: Ama’ makai lui in a hoihna kipsak lai pia hi.

examples.english: The employer asked for two references.
examples.zomi: Nasep pia dingpa in mi nih’ kipsakna ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: A reference may mean either the written statement or the person who provides it.
senses.usage_zomi: Reference in kipsak lai ahih keileh tua lai a gelh mi gen thei hi.

senses.heading: To send back light, heat, sound, or an image
senses.definition_en: To send back light, heat, sound, or an image from a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat tung a hong tung khuavak, lumna, aw, ahih keileh lim a nunglamah kilasak kik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The mirror reflected her face.
examples.zomi: Liim-etna sungah ama’ maitang kilang hi.

examples.english: White surfaces reflect more light.
examples.zomi: A kang van tungte in khuavak tampi kiklet hi.

senses.usage_en: A surface reflects light or an image; the image is reflected in the surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun khat in khuavak ahih keileh lim reflects a, lim pen tua mun sungah is reflected in kici hi.

senses.heading: To show or represent something
senses.definition_en: To show, express, or be a sign of a particular situation, quality, or belief.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, omzia, ahih keileh upna khat lak, pulaak, ahih keileh tua thu’ ciaptehna suak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The results reflect recent changes in society.
examples.zomi: Phattuamna in tulai mihing lak a kikhelna-te lak hi.

examples.english: Her work reflects her strong values.
examples.zomi: Ama’ nasep in a thukhun thahat lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, reflect means making a quality or situation visible or understandable.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah reflect pen omzia ahih keileh dinmun khat muhtheih leh teltheih dingin lak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To think carefully
senses.definition_en: To think carefully and seriously about something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat kician leh thuk takin ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She reflected on what she had learned.
examples.zomi: Ama in a sinna-te ngaihsunkik hi.

examples.english: Take time to reflect before making a decision.
examples.zomi: Thukhen ma in ngaihsut nading hun la in.

senses.usage_en: Use reflect on or reflect upon before the subject being considered.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngaihsut ding thu mai ah reflect on ahih keileh reflect upon kizang hi.

senses.heading: To say that you will not do something
senses.definition_en: To state or show that you are not willing to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna khat sem nuam lo cih gen ahih keileh gamtatna tawh lak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He refused to answer the question.
examples.zomi: Ama in dotna dawn ding nial hi.

examples.english: The workers refused to continue without proper safety equipment.
examples.zomi: Bitna van kicing lo in nasemte in nasep zom ding nial uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use refuse to + verb: refuse to go. Do not normally use refuse doing.
senses.usage_zomi: Refuse to + verb cihdan kizang hi: refuse to go. Refuse doing ci in pau ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: To decline something offered or requested
senses.definition_en: To say that you will not accept, give, or allow something.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kipia, a kingen, ahih keileh a kiphut na khat sang, pia, ahih keileh phal nuam lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She refused their offer of help.
examples.zomi: Ama in amau’ huhna kipiak nial hi.

examples.english: The guard refused him entry.
examples.zomi: Vengpa in ama lut ding phal lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Refuse can take a noun directly: refuse an offer. Reject is also possible but is often more formal or impersonal.
senses.usage_zomi: Refuse nungah noun kipahpah thei hi: refuse an offer. Reject zong kizang thei napi, formal zaw ahih keileh mimal lungsim a tawmzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: To consider or think of someone or something in a particular way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat pen koibang mi ahih keileh bang na hi ci in ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi tampi in ci in ngaihsun

examples.english: Many people regard her as an excellent leader.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi in ama makai hoih mahmah hi ci in ngaihsun uh hi.

examples.english: Education is regarded as essential for development.
examples.zomi: Khantohna a dingin sang pilna kisam mahmah hi ci in kingaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: Use regard someone or something as + noun or adjective: regard him as a friend; regard the matter as serious.
senses.usage_zomi: Regard someone or something as + noun or adjective cihdan kizang hi: ama lawm khat bangin ngaihsun; tua thu a thupi ci in ngaihsun.

senses.definition_en: A large area of a country or the world that has particular geographic, political, cultural, or economic features.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam khat ahih keileh leitung khen khat sungah gam pianzia, ukna, ngeina, ahih keileh sumvai tawh a tuamdiak mun lian khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Rice is widely grown in this region.
examples.zomi: Hih gam khenah buh tampi kiling hi.

examples.english: The storm affected the entire region.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in gam khen buppi huzaap hi.

senses.usage_en: A region is normally larger than a district or neighbourhood but may be smaller than a country.
senses.usage_zomi: Region pen district ahih keileh veng sangin lianzaw a, gam khat sangin neu zaw thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to a particular region or to several regions rather than an entire country.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gam khen tawh kisai; mun khen lam
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam khen khat ahih keileh gam khen pawlkhat tawh kisai a, gam buppi huam lo ahi hi.

examples.english: The company opened a regional office.
examples.zomi: Kampani in gam khen zung khat hon hi.

examples.english: Leaders discussed regional economic development.
examples.zomi: Makaite in gam khen sumvai khantohna kikum uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Regional concerns one part of a country or world; national concerns the whole country.
senses.usage_zomi: Regional in gam khen khat tawh kisai thu gen a, national in gam buppi tawh kisai thu gen hi.

senses.heading: To put a name or information on an official list
senses.definition_en: To record someone’s name or details on an official list or system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ min leh thu kician-te thuneihna list ahih keileh system sungah ciapteh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You must register the vehicle with the state.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw pen state ukna ah na ciapteh kul hi.

examples.english: The parents registered their baby’s birth.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pa in amau’ naungek pian thu ciapteh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a person or object is officially entered into a recognized system.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah mi ahih keileh van khat thuneihna tawh a kiphut system sungah kiciapteh hi.

senses.heading: To sign up for a course, event, or service
senses.definition_en: To give your details so that you can join, attend, or use something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sinna, pawi, ahih keileh nasepna khat sungah kihel ahih keileh zat theih nadingin na thu kician-te pia cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: sinna khat a dingin min pia

examples.english: I registered for the training course.
examples.zomi: Siamsinna a dingin ka min pia ing.

examples.english: You can register online before Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ma in online tungah na min na pia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use register for before a course, event, or service. Use register with before an organization or authority.
senses.usage_zomi: Sinna, pawi, ahih keileh nasepna mai ah register for kizang hi. Pawl ahih keileh thuneihna mai ah register with kizang hi.

senses.heading: To show a measurement or reaction
senses.definition_en: To show a particular amount on an instrument or to make a feeling or fact noticeable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tehna khawl in zat khat lak, ahih keileh lungsim leh thu khat kilangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The thermometer registered thirty degrees.
examples.zomi: Lumna tehna in degree sawmthum lak hi.

examples.english: His face registered surprise.
examples.zomi: Ama’ maitangah lamdang sakna kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a more formal use of register, meaning to record, show, or make something noticeable.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih register zatna pen formal zaw a, na khat ciapteh, lak, ahih keileh kilangsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To feel sorry about something you did or failed to do
senses.definition_en: To feel sad or sorry because of a past action, decision, or missed opportunity.
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa gamtatna, khensatna, ahih keileh hamphatna a kimansuah hangin dah ahih keileh kisik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I regret speaking to her so harshly.
examples.zomi: Ama tungah khauh takin ka kihona kisik ing.

examples.english: He later regretted his decision.
examples.zomi: Nungciangin ama a khensatna kisik hi.

senses.usage_en: Regret doing something refers to an action already completed. Regret to say or inform introduces bad news formally.
senses.usage_zomi: Regret doing something in a bawlkhitsa kisik cih gen hi. Regret to say ahih keileh regret to inform in thuthak hoihlo formal takin gen ding cih lak hi.

senses.heading: To be sorry to give bad news
senses.definition_en: Used formally to say that you are sorry about something you must announce or do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gen ahih keileh bawl kul thu hoihlo khat hangin na dah cih formal takin pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: We regret to inform you that your application was unsuccessful.
examples.zomi: Na ngenna gualzo lo cih dah takin kong theisak uh hi.

examples.english: I regret to say that the event has been cancelled.
examples.zomi: Pawi kisuksiat cih dah takin gen ing.

senses.usage_en: This formal structure uses regret to + verb because the unpleasant statement or action is happening now.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal zatdan ah thu hoihlo genna ahih keileh sepkhiatna tu in a piang ahih manin regret to + verb kizang hi.

senses.heading: Happening repeatedly at fixed or usual times
senses.definition_en: Happening, appearing, or being done at the same or usual intervals.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngeina tawh kizui; hun ciangtansa sim
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ciangtansa ahih keileh ngeina hun simin a piang, a kilang, ahih keileh a kibawl ahi hi.

examples.english: Regular exercise improves health.
examples.zomi: Ngeina tawh pumpi kisinsakna in cidamna hoihsak hi.

examples.english: The committee holds regular meetings.
examples.zomi: Committee in hun ciangtansa simin meeting bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Regular describes a repeated pattern. It does not always mean that something happens frequently.
senses.usage_zomi: Regular in ngeina tawh a kizui piandan gen hi. A tamveipi a piang cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: Normal or usual
senses.definition_en: Normal, ordinary, or of the usual type, size, or quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina bang, a kilawm bang, ahih keileh nam, size leh hoihna dinmun a kitel ngei bang ahi hi.

examples.english: He is a regular customer at this café.
examples.zomi: Ama hih cafe ah a hong pai zel vanlei khat ahi hi.

examples.english: I ordered a regular cup of coffee.
examples.zomi: Coffee hai ngeina size khat ngen ing.

senses.usage_en: In informal American English, regular may mean ordinary, medium-sized, or usual, depending on the context.
senses.usage_zomi: Informal American English ah regular pen a biasa, size laizang, ahih keileh ngeina bang cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Following a standard pattern or rule
senses.definition_en: Following the usual rule or pattern without an exception.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina thukhun ahih keileh piandan zui a, tuamna nei lo ahi hi.

examples.english: “Walk” is a regular English verb.
examples.zomi: Walk pen English ngeina thukhun a zui verb ahi hi.

examples.english: The tiles form a regular pattern.
examples.zomi: Lei kiphahna-te in piandan ngeina bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In grammar, a regular word changes according to the standard rule; an irregular word does not.
senses.usage_zomi: Grammar ah regular kammal pen ngeina thukhun bangin kikhel a, irregular kammal ahihleh tua thukhun zui lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Repeatedly and at usual or fixed intervals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina tawh kizui in, hun ciangtansa simin, ahih keileh kip tawntungin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You should exercise regularly.
examples.zomi: Ngeina tawh na pumpi na sinsak ding hi.

examples.english: The equipment is checked regularly.
examples.zomi: Van-te hun ciangtansa simin kienkik hi.

senses.usage_en: Regularly refers to a consistent pattern, not necessarily to something happening every day.
senses.usage_zomi: Regularly in ngeina tawh a kizui piandan gen a, nisim a piang cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: An official rule
senses.definition_en: An official rule made by a government, authority, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ukna, thuneihna nei pawl, ahih keileh kipawlna in a bawl zuih ding thukhun ahi hi.

examples.english: The factory must follow safety regulations.
examples.zomi: Factory in bitna thukhun-te zui kul hi.

examples.english: New regulations protect consumers.
examples.zomi: Thukhun thakte in vanleite kem hi.

senses.usage_en: Regulation is countable when it means one rule. The plural regulations often refers to a complete set of official rules.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhun khat a gen ciangin regulation pen simtheih noun ahi hi. Regulations in thukhun pawl kicing gen zel hi.

senses.heading: The control of an activity or system
senses.definition_en: The process of controlling an activity or industry through rules and official supervision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna ahih keileh sumvai lam khat thukhun leh thuneihna enkolna tawh kem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Effective regulation can prevent unsafe practices.
examples.zomi: Thukhun tawh enkolna hoih in bitlo gamtatna khaktan thei hi.

examples.english: The industry requires stronger regulation.
examples.zomi: Hih van bawlna lam in thukhun tawh enkolna thahatzaw kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, regulation is usually uncountable because it refers to the general system of control.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah regulation in enkolna system buppi gen ahih manin simtheih lo noun bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: To refuse to accept or approve something
senses.definition_en: To decide not to accept, approve, or agree to an offer, idea, request, or application.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kipia, ngaihsutna, ngenna, ahih keileh application khat sang, kipsak, ahih keileh thukim ding nial cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee rejected the proposal.
examples.zomi: Committee in geelna nial hi.

examples.english: Her job application was rejected.
examples.zomi: Ama’ nasep ngenna kisang lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Reject is often more formal and final than refuse. We normally reject a proposal but refuse to perform an action.
senses.usage_zomi: Reject pen refuse sangin formal zaw leh khensatna a kicingzaw hi. Geelna khat i nial ciangin reject a, sepna khat sem ding i nial ciangin refuse a kizang hi.

senses.heading: To decide that something is unsuitable or defective
senses.definition_en: To refuse to use or keep something because it is unsuitable, damaged, or below the required standard.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hoih lo ci in paai; zat ding nial
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kilawm lo, a siat, ahih keileh kisam dinmun a picing lo ahih manin zat ahih keileh kep ding nial cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a kilawm lo ci in nial

examples.english: The inspector rejected the damaged products.
examples.zomi: Enkholpa in van kisiate nial hi.

examples.english: Several photographs were rejected because they were unclear.
examples.zomi: Lim pawlkhat a kician lo ahih manin kisang lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In quality control, a rejected item does not meet the required standard.
senses.usage_zomi: Van hoihna enkholna ah a kinial van pen kisam hoihna dinmun a picing lo ahi hi.

senses.heading: To show or make a connection
senses.definition_en: To connect two or more people, subjects, events, or ideas.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, thu, thu piang, ahih keileh ngaihsutna nih leh a dangte kizomsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The study relates diet to heart disease.
examples.zomi: Zongkholna in annek ngeina leh lungsim natna kizomsak hi.

examples.english: Try to relate the lesson to everyday life.
examples.zomi: Sinna pen nisim nuntakna tawh kizomsak in.

senses.usage_en: Use relate something to something when actively making or explaining a connection.
senses.usage_zomi: Kizopna bawl ahih keileh hilhcian ciangin relate something to something kizang hi.

senses.heading: To understand and identify with someone’s experience
senses.definition_en: To understand someone’s feelings or experience because they are similar to your own.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ lungsim leh phutkhak pen nangma phutkhak tawh a kibat manin telthei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Many parents can relate to her experience.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pa tampi in ama’ phutkhak telpih thei uh hi.

examples.english: The character is easy for young people to relate to.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu sung mi pen khangnote in telpih baih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, relate to someone means understanding that person’s feelings or situation personally.
senses.usage_zomi: Informal English ah relate to someone cih pen tua mi’ lungsim ahih keileh dinmun mimal takin telpih cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To tell a story or describe an event
senses.definition_en: To tell someone about an event, experience, or series of events.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang ahih keileh phutkhak khat mi tungah tangthu bangin gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She related what had happened during the journey.
examples.zomi: Khualzin laitak a thu piang ama gen hi.

examples.english: The witness related the events clearly.
examples.zomi: Tecipa in thu piangte kician takin gen hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning of relate is formal. In ordinary conversation, tell is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih relate khiatna pen formal zaw hi. Nisim kihona ah tell a kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: Connected with something
senses.definition_en: Connected with or belonging to the same subject, cause, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, hangthu, ahih keileh dinmun kibang tawh kizom ahi hi.

examples.english: The two problems are closely related.
examples.zomi: Buaina nih a nai takin kizom hi.

examples.english: She studies health-related subjects.
examples.zomi: Ama cidamna tawh kisai thute sin hi.

senses.usage_en: Use related to, not normally related with: the problem is related to cost.
senses.usage_zomi: Kizopna a gen ciangin related to kizang a, related with a kizang ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Belonging to the same family
senses.definition_en: Connected by birth, marriage, or family membership.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pianpih, kiteenna, ahih keileh innkuan member ahihna tawh kizom ahi hi.

examples.english: Are you related to her?
examples.zomi: Ama tawh innkuan na hi hiam?

examples.english: The two families are related by marriage.
examples.zomi: Innkuan nih kiteenna tawh kisai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: People can be related by blood, marriage, or adoption.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi-te sisan, kiteenna, ahih keileh ta in lakna tawh innkuan hi thei uh hi.

senses.heading: A connection between people, events, ideas, or facts
senses.definition_en: A connection or association between two or more people, events, ideas, or facts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, thu piang, ngaihsutna, ahih keileh thu kician nih leh a dangte kikal a kizopna ahi hi.

examples.english: Researchers examined the relation between diet and health.
examples.zomi: Zongkhol mite in annek ngeina leh cidamna kikal kizopna entel uh hi.

examples.english: His comments were made in relation to the new policy.
examples.zomi: Ama’ thu gente pen policy thak tawh kisai in kigen hi.

senses.usage_en: Relationship is now often more natural than relation for a continuing connection. In relation to remains common in formal English.
senses.usage_zomi: Kizopna a omden a gen ciangin relation sangin relationship a kizangzaw hi. Formal English ah in relation to kizang mahmah lai hi.

senses.heading: A member of one’s family
senses.definition_en: A person who belongs to the same family.
senses.explanation_zomi: Innkuan khat sungah sisan, kiteenna, ahih keileh ta in lakna tawh a kihel mi ahi hi.

examples.english: A close relation attended the ceremony.
examples.zomi: Innkuan nai khat pawi ah hong pai hi.

examples.english: He is a distant relation of mine.
examples.zomi: Ama ka sai gamla khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Relative is more common than relation when referring to a family member.
senses.usage_zomi: Innkuanpih a gen ciangin relation sangin relative a kizangzaw hi.
