senses.heading: The way people are connected and behave toward one another
senses.definition_en: The connection between people and the way they feel about and behave toward one another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi-te kikal a kizopna leh khat leh khat a lungsim neihdan leh a kigohtdan ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a close relationship with her sister.
examples.zomi: Ama leh a sanggamnu kizopna nai mahmah hi.

examples.english: Trust is important in every relationship.
examples.zomi: Kizopna khempeuh ah muanna thupi hi.

senses.usage_en: Relationship can describe family, friendship, work, business, or romantic connections.
senses.usage_zomi: Relationship in innkuan, lawmta, nasep, sumvai, ahih keileh itna kikal kizopna gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A connection between things
senses.definition_en: The way in which two or more facts, ideas, or conditions are connected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kician, ngaihsutna, ahih keileh dinmun nih leh a dangte koibangin a kizop uh cih ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: hang leh a gah kikal kizopna

examples.english: The study explores the relationship between income and health.
examples.zomi: Zongkholna in sum lutna leh cidamna kikal kizopna zong hi.

examples.english: There is a direct relationship between effort and improvement.
examples.zomi: Hanciamna leh hoih semsemna kikalah kizopna kician om hi.

senses.usage_en: In academic writing, relationship between A and B is commonly used to describe an association that may not be a direct cause.
senses.usage_zomi: Sang lam laigelhna ah relationship between A and B in thu nih kizom cih gen a, khat in khat piangsak cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: Considered by comparison with something else
senses.definition_en: Judged or measured in comparison with another thing rather than by a fixed standard.
senses.zomi_equivalents: etkakna tawh; na dang tawh teh
senses.explanation_zomi: Ciangtan kipsa khat tawh kiteh loin na dang khat tawh etkak in a kiteh ahih keileh a kikhensat ahi hi.

examples.english: The relative importance of each issue may change.
examples.zomi: Thu khat ciangin etkakna tawh a thupina kikhel thei hi.

examples.english: The map shows the relative sizes of the countries.
examples.zomi: Gamlim in gamte’ size khat leh khat etkakna tawh lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Relative means dependent on comparison or circumstances. Absolute means fixed or considered independently.
senses.usage_zomi: Relative cih pen etkakna ahih keileh dinmun tungah kinga cihna ahi hi. Absolute ahihleh etkakna lo in a kip ciangtan ahi hi.

senses.heading: Existing only to a limited degree
senses.definition_en: True or existing to some degree, but not completely.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a phazah khat dong; a kicing takin hilo
senses.explanation_zomi: A kicing takin hilo napi a phazah khat dong a maan ahih keileh a om ahi hi.

examples.english: The region entered a period of relative peace.
examples.zomi: Gam khen pen a phazah khat dong lungnopna hunah lut hi.

examples.english: They lived in relative comfort.
examples.zomi: Amaute nuamna a phazah khat dongin nungta uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Here, relative limits the following noun: relative peace is peaceful compared with another time, but not completely peaceful.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih munah relative in a nung noun ciangtan sak hi. Relative peace pen hun dang sangin lungnop huai zaw napi, lungnopna picing hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: To a certain degree, especially when compared with something else.
senses.zomi_equivalents: etkakna tawh a phazah khat dong; lawmlawm
senses.explanation_zomi: Na dang khat tawh etkak ciangin a phazah khat dong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The test was relatively easy.
examples.zomi: Sittelna pen etkakna tawh a baih lawmlawm hi.

examples.english: This is a relatively small city.
examples.zomi: Hih khuapi pen khuapi dangte tawh etkak ciangin a neu lawmlawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Relatively implies a comparison, even when the thing being compared is not directly stated.
senses.usage_zomi: A kietkak na pen kician takin kigen lo olsa zong, relatively sungah etkakna khiatna om hi.

senses.heading: To rest and become less worried or tense
senses.definition_en: To rest and become calmer after work, effort, worry, or stress.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, hanciamna, lungkhamna, ahih keileh lungsim hahsatna khit ciangin tawldam in lungdai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I like to relax after work.
examples.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin tawldam nuam ing.

examples.english: Take a deep breath and try to relax.
examples.zomi: Hu thuk takin lakh in lungdai dingin hanciam in.

senses.usage_en: Relax describes becoming calm. Rest focuses more directly on stopping activity to recover energy.
senses.usage_zomi: Relax in lungsim dai hong suak cih gen a, rest in thahatna ngahkik dingin gamtatna tawpsan cih thupi sakzaw hi.

senses.heading: To make a rule or control less strict
senses.definition_en: To make a rule, law, restriction, or control less strict.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, dan, khaktan, ahih keileh enkolna khauh luat lo dingin namsau sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The government relaxed the travel restrictions.
examples.zomi: Ukna in khualzinna khaktan nate namsau sak hi.

examples.english: The school will not relax its safety rules.
examples.zomi: Sang in a bitna thukhun namsau sak lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, relax does not mean removing a rule completely; it means making it less strict.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah relax cih pen thukhun hemkhia cihna hilo a, a khauh luat lo dingin namsau sak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Calm and free from worry
senses.definition_en: Calm, comfortable, and not worried or tense.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungdai, nuam leh lungkhamna ahih keileh lungsim hahsatna a nei lo ahi hi.

examples.english: I felt relaxed after the walk.
examples.zomi: Lampai khit ciangin lungdai ing.

examples.english: The meeting had a relaxed atmosphere.
examples.zomi: Meeting pen lungnop huai takin kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Relaxed describes how a person feels or the calm quality of a situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Relaxed in mi khat’ lungsim omdan ahih keileh dinmun khat’ lungnop huai dan gen hi.

senses.heading: Not strict or formal
senses.definition_en: Not controlled by strict rules or formal behaviour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun khauh takin ki-uk lo ahih keileh formal takin gamtat kul lo ahi hi.

examples.english: The office has a relaxed dress code.
examples.zomi: Zung in puansilh thukhun khauh tak nei lo hi.

examples.english: The teacher uses a relaxed teaching style.
examples.zomi: Sia in a khauh lo hilhdan zang hi.

senses.usage_en: A relaxed rule or style allows more freedom, but it does not necessarily mean that no rules exist.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhun ahih keileh gamtatdan relaxed kici leh suahtakna tamzaw om cihna ahi a, thukhun om hetlo cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: Helping someone become calm, comfortable, and less tired or worried.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungdai, nuam leh gimloh zaw dingin a huh ahi hi.

examples.english: We listened to relaxing music.
examples.zomi: Lungdai sak la ngai hihang.

examples.english: A warm bath can be relaxing.
examples.zomi: Tui lum tawh kisilna pen tawldam huai thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Relaxed describes the person who feels calm; relaxing describes the activity or situation that produces that feeling.
senses.usage_zomi: Relaxed in lungdai a om mi gen a, relaxing in tua lungdaina a piangsak sepkhiatna ahih keileh dinmun gen hi.

senses.heading: To allow someone or something to become free
senses.definition_en: To allow a person, animal, or controlled object to leave or become free.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing, ahih keileh a kikem na khat paikhiat ahih keileh suahtak dingin phal cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The prisoner was released yesterday.
examples.zomi: Thongkiapa zani in suakta hi.

examples.english: They released the bird into the forest.
examples.zomi: Amaute in vasa gamlakah khah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Release often implies that someone or something was previously held, controlled, or restricted.
senses.usage_zomi: Release in mi ahih keileh na khat a beisa hunin kikem, ki-uk, ahih keileh kikhaktan cih lak hi.

senses.heading: To make something available to the public
senses.definition_en: To publish or make a film, song, product, report, or information available to the public.
senses.explanation_zomi: Film, la, van, laporan, ahih keileh thu khat mipite ngah theih dingin hawmkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company released a new product.
examples.zomi: Kampani in van thak khat hawmkhia hi.

examples.english: The report will be released next week.
examples.zomi: Laporan kal hong tung hawmkhia ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In publishing and entertainment, release means making content officially available for people to obtain, hear, or watch.
senses.usage_zomi: Laigelhna leh lungdamnate ah release cih pen mipite in ngah, ngai, ahih keileh en theih dingin thuneihna tawh hawmkhia cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To let a substance, force, or emotion come out
senses.definition_en: To allow a substance, energy, pressure, or emotion to escape or become active.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanpua, thahatna, nengna, ahih keileh lungsim khat pusuak ahih keileh gamta dingin khah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The process releases heat.
examples.zomi: Hih sepzia in lumna pusuak sak hi.

examples.english: Open the valve slowly to release the pressure.
examples.zomi: Nengna khah nadingin valve damtak in hon in.

senses.usage_en: This sense is common in science, engineering, and descriptions of emotions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen science, engineering leh lungsim omdan hilhcian na ah kizang mahmah hi.

senses.definition_en: Directly connected with and important to the subject or situation being considered.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kingaihsut thu ahih keileh dinmun tawh a kicianin kizom a, tua thu a dingin a thupi ahi hi.

examples.english: Please include only relevant information.
examples.zomi: Thu tawh kisai theihna bek hel in.

examples.english: Her experience is relevant to this position.
examples.zomi: Ama’ phutkhak hih dinmun tawh kisai hi.

senses.usage_en: Use relevant to, not normally relevant for: this information is relevant to the discussion.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu khat tawh kisaina a gen ciangin relevant to kizang hi: hih theihna kikumna tawh kisai hi.

senses.definition_en: Able to be trusted to work properly, provide correct information, or behave consistently.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hoih takin sem, thu maan pia, ahih keileh a pau bangin gamta ding ci in muan theih ahi hi.

examples.english: We need information from a reliable source.
examples.zomi: Thubul muanhuai pan thu i kisam hi.

examples.english: She is a reliable employee who always arrives on time.
examples.zomi: Ama hun maan takin a hong tung tawntung nasem muanhuai khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Reliable means consistently dependable. It does not mean merely that something worked correctly once.
senses.usage_zomi: Reliable cih pen a kipsak in muantheih cihna ahi hi. Khatvei bek a hoih takin sem cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: The feeling produced when worry or pain ends
senses.definition_en: A pleasant feeling of comfort and calm when fear, worry, pain, or difficulty becomes less or ends.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhna, lungkhamna, natna, ahih keileh haksatna a kiam ahih keileh a tawp ciang a kingah lungnopna ahi hi.

examples.english: I felt great relief when I heard that she was safe.
examples.zomi: Ama bit hi cih ka zak ciangin lungdam leh lungnop mahmah ing.

examples.english: It was a relief to finish the examination.
examples.zomi: Sittelna zawh pen lungnop huai mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Relief is the feeling that follows the reduction or removal of something unpleasant.
senses.usage_zomi: Relief pen a nuam lo na khat a kiam ahih keileh a tawp khit a lungsim omdan ahi hi.

senses.heading: Help for people in serious need
senses.definition_en: Food, money, medicine, or other help given to people affected by poverty, war, or disaster.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zawngkhalna, gal, ahih keileh siatna lian a tuakte tungah a kipiak annek, sum, zatui leh huhna dangte ahi hi.

examples.english: Relief supplies were sent to the flooded villages.
examples.zomi: Tui liim khuate ah huhna van kisawl hi.

examples.english: The organization provides emergency relief.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in thu lauhuai laitak huhna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, relief is normally uncountable and refers collectively to emergency assistance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah relief pen simtheih lo noun ahi a, thu lauhuai laitak a kipiak huhna-te a vekin gen hi.

senses.heading: A reduction in pain or discomfort
senses.definition_en: A reduction or removal of physical pain or another unpleasant condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi natna ahih keileh dinmun nuamlo khat a kiamna ahih keileh a mangna ahi hi.

examples.english: The medicine provided relief from the pain.
examples.zomi: Zatui in natna kiamsak hi.

examples.english: A cold cloth may bring temporary relief.
examples.zomi: Puannem vot in hun tom sung damna pia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Relief from identifies the pain or condition that becomes less severe.
senses.usage_zomi: Relief from nungah natna ahih keileh dinmun a kiam thu gen hi.

senses.heading: Belief in and worship of God or gods
senses.definition_en: Belief in God, gods, or a sacred reality, together with worship, teachings, and practices connected with that belief.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pasian, pasian-te, ahih keileh siangtho taktak khat upna leh tua upna tawh kizom biakna, thuhilhna leh gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: The law protects freedom of religion.
examples.zomi: Dan in biakna suahtakna kem hi.

examples.english: Religion influences many cultures.
examples.zomi: Biakna in ngeina tampi huzaap hi.

senses.usage_en: Religion may refer to belief and worship generally or to one organized system such as Christianity, Buddhism, Islam, or Hinduism.
senses.usage_zomi: Religion in biakna upna buppi ahih keileh Christian, Buddhist, Islam leh Hindu bangin biakna system khat gen thei hi.

senses.heading: A particular organized system of belief
senses.definition_en: A particular organized system of beliefs, worship, moral teaching, and community practices.
senses.explanation_zomi: Upna, biakna, gamtat thukhun leh pawlpi ngeina a kikhelkhawm biakna system tuam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Students learn about several world religions.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in leitung biakna pawlkhat thu sin uh hi.

examples.english: People of different religions live in the city.
examples.zomi: Biakna tuamtuam nei mite khuapi ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to people, avoid assuming that every member of a religious group holds exactly the same beliefs or practices.
senses.usage_zomi: Biakna pawl khat a gen ciangin tua pawl sung mi khempeuh in upna leh gamtatdan kibang lian nei uh ci in ngaihsun lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Connected with religion
senses.definition_en: Relating to religion, worship, sacred beliefs, or a religious organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna, biakpiakna, upna siangtho, ahih keileh biakna pawl tawh kisai ahi hi.

examples.english: The building is used for religious ceremonies.
examples.zomi: Inn pen biakna zehtan a dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: The country has several religious communities.
examples.zomi: Gam sungah biakna pawl tuamtuam om hi.

senses.usage_en: Religious can describe beliefs, activities, objects, institutions, or communities connected with religion.
senses.usage_zomi: Religious in biakna tawh kizom upna, gamtatna, van, pawl leh mihingte gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Strongly committed to religious belief and practice
senses.definition_en: Having strong religious beliefs and regularly practising them.
senses.zomi_equivalents: biakna upna nei; biakna a zui
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna upna thahat tak nei a, tua upna ngeina tawh kizui in a zui mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She grew up in a deeply religious family.
examples.zomi: Ama biakna upna thuk tak nei innkuan sungah khang hi.

examples.english: He is religious but respects people of other faiths.
examples.zomi: Ama biakna a zui mi ahi napi, upna dang nei mite zong zahtak hi.

senses.usage_en: A person can be interested in religion without personally being religious.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat biakna thu lunglut thei napi, amah biakna a zui mi ahi pahpah lo thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To trust or depend on someone or something for help, support, or successful operation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huhna, panpihna, ahih keileh nasepna hoih ngah dingin mi ahih keileh na khat muang in kinga cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You can rely on her to keep her promise.
examples.zomi: Ama in a kamciam zui ding cih na muang thei hi.

examples.english: The community relies on farming for income.
examples.zomi: Khuamite in sum lutna a dingin lo neihna tungah kinga uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Rely is followed by on or upon: rely on someone; rely upon evidence.
senses.usage_zomi: Rely nungah on ahih keileh upon kizang hi: mi khat tungah kinga; teci muang.

senses.heading: To continue to be in the same state
senses.definition_en: To continue to be in a particular condition without changing.
senses.zomi_equivalents: om paisuak; kikhel lo in om
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhel loin dinmun ahih keileh omzia khat mahah om paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please remain calm during the emergency.
examples.zomi: Thu lauhuai laitakin lungdai in om paisuak in.

examples.english: The rules remain unchanged.
examples.zomi: Thukhun-te kikhel loin om lai hi.

senses.usage_en: Remain is followed directly by an adjective or noun phrase: remain calm; remain a mystery.
senses.usage_zomi: Remain nungah adjective ahih keileh noun phrase kipahpah hi: remain calm; remain a mystery.

senses.heading: To stay in a place
senses.definition_en: To stay in the same place instead of leaving.
senses.zomi_equivalents: om lai; paikhiat lo in om
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat pan paikhiat loin tua mun mahah om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Two workers remained in the office.
examples.zomi: Nasem nih zung sungah om lai uh hi.

examples.english: She remained at home to care for the child.
examples.zomi: Naupang kem dingin ama inn ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Remain is more formal than stay.
senses.usage_zomi: Remain pen stay sangin formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: To be left after the rest is gone
senses.definition_en: To continue to exist after other people or things have gone, been used, or been removed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na dangte paikhia, kizang, ahih keileh kihemkhia khit zong a omlai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Only two pieces of bread remained.
examples.zomi: Tanghou khen nih bek omlai hi.

examples.english: Several important questions remain unanswered.
examples.zomi: Dotna thupi pawlkhat dawn nailo in omlai hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, remain means that something is still present or unresolved.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah remain pen na khat om lai ahih keileh kikhensat nailo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Something that someone says or writes, especially a brief comment or observation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a gen ahih keileh a gelh thu, a diak in thu tom ahih keileh a muhdan genna ahi hi.

examples.english: He made a brief remark about the report.
examples.zomi: Ama in laporan tawh kisai thu tom khat gen hi.

examples.english: Her remark offended several people.
examples.zomi: Ama’ thu gen in mi pawlkhat lungsim nasak hi.

senses.usage_en: A remark is usually shorter and less formal than a speech or detailed statement.
senses.usage_zomi: Remark pen thugen ahih keileh thu hilhcian sau sangin tomzaw leh formal lo zaw hi.

senses.heading: To keep or bring something back to mind
senses.definition_en: To retain information in your mind or bring a past person, event, or fact back into your thoughts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat lungsim sungah kem ahih keileh mi, thu piang leh thu kician a beisa phawkkik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I clearly remember my first day at school.
examples.zomi: Sang ka kah ni masapen kician takin phawk ing.

examples.english: Do you remember her name?
examples.zomi: Ama’ min na phawk hiam?

senses.usage_en: Remember doing something means recalling a completed action: I remember meeting her.
senses.usage_zomi: Remember doing something cih pen a bawlkhitsa phawkkik cihna ahi hi: ama tawh ka kimuh phawk ing.

senses.heading: To not forget to do something
senses.definition_en: To keep a future duty or action in mind and perform it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam a bawl ding mawhpuakna ahih keileh sepna mangngilh loin bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Remember to lock the door.
examples.zomi: Kongkha khak ding mangngilh kei in.

examples.english: She remembered to send the email.
examples.zomi: Ama email sawl ding phawk hi.

senses.usage_en: Remember to do concerns an action that must still be done. Remember doing concerns a past action.
senses.usage_zomi: Remember to do in bawl nailo napi bawl ding sepna gen hi. Remember doing in a bawlkhitsa sepna phawk cih gen hi.

senses.heading: To help someone remember something
senses.definition_en: To make someone remember a duty, fact, event, or planned action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in mawhpuakna, thu kician, thu piang, ahih keileh geelna khat a phawk nadingin phawkkik sak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat phone ding phawkkik sak
mi khat meeting thu phawkkik sak

examples.english: Please remind me to call the doctor.
examples.zomi: Siavuan phone ding hong phawkkik sak in.

examples.english: The message reminded us about tomorrow’s meeting.
examples.zomi: Thupuak in zingt meeting thu hong phawkkik sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use remind someone to do something or remind someone about/of something.
senses.usage_zomi: Remind someone to do something ahih keileh remind someone about/of something cihdan kizang hi.

senses.heading: To cause someone to think of a similar person or thing
senses.definition_en: To make someone think of another person, place, event, or experience because of a similarity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kibatna khat hangin mi khat in mi, mun, thu piang, ahih keileh phutkhak dang khat phawk sak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat a lawmpa phawk sak

examples.english: This song reminds me of my childhood.
examples.zomi: Hih la in ka naupan hun hong phawk sak hi.

examples.english: You remind me of your father.
examples.zomi: Nang in na pa hong phawk sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use remind someone of when one person or thing causes a memory of another.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat in midang ahih keileh na dang phawk sak ciangin remind someone of kizang hi.

senses.heading: Far from towns or other populated places
senses.definition_en: Far away from cities, towns, or places where many people live.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuapi, khua, ahih keileh mi tampi teenna mun pan a gamla mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: They provide medical care in remote villages.
examples.zomi: Amaute in khua gamla-te ah zatui kepna pia uh hi.

examples.english: The family lives in a remote mountain area.
examples.zomi: Innkuan pen mualgam gamla khat ah teng hi.

senses.usage_en: A remote place is difficult to reach because it is far from major population centres.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun remote khat pen mi tampi teenna mun liante pan gamla ahih manin tun haksa hi.

senses.heading: Done from another place using technology
senses.definition_en: Done, controlled, or accessed from a different place by using electronic technology.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun dang pan kibawl; gamla pan ki-uk
senses.explanation_zomi: Electronic technology zang in mun dang khat pan a kibawl, ki-uk, ahih keileh kizang ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mun dang pan system zat theihna

examples.english: She has a remote job and works from home.
examples.zomi: Ama inn pan a semtheih nasep khat nei hi.

examples.english: The technician repaired the system through remote access.
examples.zomi: Technology siam in mun dang pan system lut in bawlpha hi.

senses.usage_en: Remote work means working away from the employer’s usual office, often from home.
senses.usage_zomi: Remote work cih pen nasep pia zung ngeina ah hilo in, a tamzaw inn pan nasep cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To take something away
senses.definition_en: To take someone or something away from a place or position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat mun ahih keileh dinmun khat pan lakhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please remove your shoes before entering.
examples.zomi: Lut ma in na khedap suah in.

examples.english: This cleaner can remove the stain.
examples.zomi: Hih siansuahna in ninsia hemkhia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Remove is more formal than take off or take away.
senses.usage_zomi: Remove pen take off ahih keileh take away sangin formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: To dismiss someone from a position
senses.definition_en: To officially make someone leave a job, position, committee, or office.
senses.zomi_equivalents: dinmun pan hemkhia; nasep pan khawl sak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nasep, dinmun, committee, ahih keileh zung khat pan thuneihna tawh paikhiat sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The board removed him from his position.
examples.zomi: Makaipawl in ama a dinmun pan hemkhia hi.

examples.english: A member may be removed for breaking the rules.
examples.zomi: Thukhun a palsat hangin member khat kihemkhia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, remove means ending someone’s official role, not physically carrying the person away.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah remove pen mi khat’ thuneihna dinmun khawlsak cihna ahi a, pumpi tawh pua in paikhiat sak cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Money paid for using property
senses.definition_en: Money paid regularly for the use of a house, apartment, room, land, vehicle, or equipment owned by someone else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang’ inn, apartment, pindan, lei, mawtaw, ahih keileh van a zat manin hun ciangtansa sim a kipiak sum ahi hi.

examples.english: We pay the rent at the beginning of each month.
examples.zomi: Kha khat kipat ciangin luahman pia hihang.

examples.english: The landlord increased the rent.
examples.zomi: Inn neipa in luahman khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, rent is normally uncountable: pay rent, not pay a rent.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah rent pen simtheih lo noun bangin kizang hi: pay rent kici a, pay a rent ci in pau ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: The act or arrangement of renting something
senses.definition_en: An arrangement in which someone pays to use property or equipment temporarily.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn, mawtaw, ahih keileh van khat hun tom sung zang dingin sum piakna tawh kithukimna ahi hi.

examples.english: Several apartments are available for rent.
examples.zomi: Apartment pawlkhat luah theih dingin om hi.

examples.english: The cost includes the rent of the equipment.
examples.zomi: Sum zat sungah van luahman kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: For the service or business, English more commonly uses rental: car rental, equipment rental.
senses.usage_zomi: Luahna nasep ahih keileh sumvai gen nadingin English ah rental a kizang zaw hi: car rental, equipment rental.

senses.definition_en: To fix something that is damaged, broken, or not working properly.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisiat, a kitam, ahih keileh a hoih takin semlo na khat semkik thei dingin bawlpha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The mechanic repaired the car.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw siam in mawtaw bawlpha hi.

examples.english: They are repairing the damaged roof.
examples.zomi: Innkhum kisiat bawlpha laitak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: We repair damaged objects or structures. For correcting text, data, or mistakes, correct or fix is often more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Van ahih keileh inn kisiat i repair hi. Laigelh, data, ahih keileh khialhna puahphatna ah correct ahih keileh fix a kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: To say or do something again
senses.definition_en: To say, write, or perform something again.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat genkik, gelhkik, ahih keileh gamtakik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Could you repeat the question?
examples.zomi: Dotna nong dongkik thei diam?

examples.english: Repeat the exercise ten times.
examples.zomi: Pumpi kisinsakna sawmvei bawlkik in.

senses.usage_en: Repeat again is often unnecessary because repeat already means “do or say again.”
senses.usage_zomi: Repeat sungah “bawlkik” cih khiatna om khin ahih manin repeat again cih pen a tamzaw kisam lo hi.

senses.heading: To happen again
senses.definition_en: To occur again in the same or a similar way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a kibang ahih keileh a kibang deuh in piangkik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We must prevent the mistake from being repeated.
examples.zomi: Khialhna bawlkik lo dingin i khaktan kul hi.

examples.english: The pattern repeats every four years.
examples.zomi: Hih piandan kum li simin piangkik hi.

senses.usage_en: When no person deliberately causes it, repeat can describe an event or pattern happening again.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat in deihna tawh a bawl hilo zong, thu piang ahih keileh piandan khat hong omkik ciangin repeat kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Happening, said, or done many times.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat tampi vei a piang, a kigen, ahih keileh a kibawl ahi hi.

examples.english: Repeated attempts to contact him failed.
examples.zomi: Ama tawh kizom ding hanciamkik zel napi gualzo lo hi.

examples.english: The machine stopped after repeated problems.
examples.zomi: Buaina hong piangkik zel khit ciangin khawl khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Repeated normally means occurring more than once, often several times. Repetitive emphasizes that repetition is boring or unnecessary.
senses.usage_zomi: Repeated cih pen khatvei sangin tamzaw, a tamzaw tampi vei a piang cihna ahi hi. Repetitive in tua kikupkikna lungduaihuai ahih keileh kisamlo cih thupi sak hi.

senses.heading: To put something new in place of something old or damaged
senses.definition_en: To remove something and put another thing in its place because the original is old, damaged, lost, or unsuitable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na lui, a kisiat, a kimang, ahih keileh a kilawm lo pen hemkhia in na dang khat koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The mechanic replaced the damaged part.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw siam in van khen kisiat khek hi.

examples.english: We need to replace the old computer.
examples.zomi: Computer lui pen i khek kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Use replace A with B: replace the old battery with a new one.
senses.usage_zomi: Replace A with B cihdan kizang hi: battery lui hemkhia in battery thak koih.

senses.heading: To take the position or function of someone or something
senses.definition_en: To take over the job, position, purpose, or function of another person or thing.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a mun la; a dinmun khek
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na dang khat’ nasep, dinmun, deihna, ahih keileh sepkhiatna la cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat khek in makai suak

examples.english: A new manager replaced him last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in makai thak khat in ama khek hi.

examples.english: Machines cannot completely replace human judgment.
examples.zomi: Khawl in mihing thukhen siamna a vekin khek zo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Replace someone means take that person’s position. It does not necessarily mean that the person was dismissed for poor performance.
senses.usage_zomi: Replace someone cih pen tua mi’ dinmun la cihna ahi hi. Tua mi nasep hoihlo hangin kihemkhia cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: To answer someone in speech, writing, or another form of communication.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ dotna, thupuak, lai, ahih keileh thu genna pau, gelh, ahih keileh kizopna dang tawh dawng cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She replied to my email this morning.
examples.zomi: Ama in tuni zing ka email hong dawng hi.

examples.english: He did not reply when I asked his name.
examples.zomi: A min ka dot ciangin ama dawng lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use reply to someone or something: reply to her; reply to the message. Do not normally say reply her.
senses.usage_zomi: Reply to someone or something cihdan kizang hi: ama dawng; thupuak dawng. Reply her ci in pau ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: An official or detailed account
senses.definition_en: A written or spoken account that presents facts, findings, or information about a subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat tawh kisai thu kician, muhdan, ahih keileh muhkhiatna a pulaak laigelh ahih keileh thugen ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee published its final report.
examples.zomi: Committee in a nunungpen laporan hawmkhia hi.

examples.english: Students must write a report about the experiment.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in ettohna tawh kisai laporan gelh kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A report normally organizes factual information for a particular reader or purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Report in laisim ding mi ahih keileh deihna khat a dingin thu kician-te a kizomsak in pulaak hi.

senses.heading: A news account
senses.definition_en: A news story describing an event or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang ahih keileh dinmun khat a hilhcian thuthak ahi hi.

examples.english: I watched a news report about the election.
examples.zomi: Teelna tawh kisai thuthak laporan en ing.

examples.english: According to the weather report, heavy rain is expected.
examples.zomi: Huihlak laporan bangin guah tampi zu dingin kilamen hi.

senses.usage_en: A news report should distinguish verified facts from opinions or unconfirmed claims.
senses.usage_zomi: Thuthak laporan in a kipsa thu kician, ngaihsutna leh kipsak nailo thu genna khen ding hi.

senses.heading: A statement made to an authority
senses.definition_en: Information formally given to the police, an employer, or another authority about an incident or problem.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thuneihna tung thu piakna; mawhna laporan
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang ahih keileh buaina khat palik, nasep pia, ahih keileh thuneihna nei mi tungah formal takin a kipiak thu ahi hi.

examples.english: She filed a report with the police.
examples.zomi: Ama in palik tungah laporan pia hi.

examples.english: The manager read the incident report.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in thu piang laporan sim hi.

senses.usage_en: To file a report means to officially submit it to the appropriate authority.
senses.usage_zomi: File a report cih pen a kisam thuneihna tungah laporan thuneihna tawh pia cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person whose job is to investigate events and present news through newspapers, television, radio, or digital media.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piangte zongkhia in thuthak laibu, television, radio, ahih keileh digital media tungtawnin thuthak a pulaak mi ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: thuk takin thu zong thuthak genmi

examples.english: A reporter interviewed the mayor.
examples.zomi: Thuthak genmi khat in khuapi makaipa tawh kihona nei hi.

examples.english: Reporters gathered outside the courthouse.
examples.zomi: Thuthak genmite thukhenna inn pualam ah kikhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A reporter gathers and presents news. A journalist may also research, edit, analyse, or write commentary.
senses.usage_zomi: Reporter in thuthak zong leh pulaak hi. Journalist in zongkhol, bawlpha, thukhensia ahih keileh ngaihsutna laigelh zong sem thei hi.

senses.heading: To act or speak for someone or a group
senses.definition_en: To act, speak, vote, or make decisions on behalf of another person, group, organization, or country.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, kipawlna, ahih keileh gam khat aiawh in gamta, pau, vote pia, ahih keileh thukhen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She represents our district in parliament.
examples.zomi: Ama in parliament ah eima district aiawh hi.

examples.english: The lawyer represented the family in court.
examples.zomi: Dan siam in thukhenna inn ah innkuan aiawh hi.

senses.usage_en: A person who represents others should communicate or defend their interests, not merely express a private opinion.
senses.usage_zomi: Midangte aiawh mi in ama’ mimal ngaihsutna bek gen loin, a aiawh mite’ deihna leh hamphatna pulaak ahih keileh kem ding hi.

senses.heading: To be a sign, example, or symbol of something
senses.definition_en: To stand for, symbolize, or serve as an example of an idea, group, amount, or quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, pawl, zat, ahih keileh omzia khat’ ciaptehna ahih keileh lim suak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The white dove represents peace.
examples.zomi: Vakhu kang in lungnopna lim hi.

examples.english: Each symbol represents a different sound.
examples.zomi: Ciaptehna khat ciangin aw tuam khat aiawh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, represent means that one visible form carries another meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah represent pen a kimuh forma khat in khiatna dang khat nei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To show or describe something
senses.definition_en: To show or describe a person, event, situation, or set of information in art, language, or data.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, thu piang, dinmun, ahih keileh thu kician pawl lim, pau, laigelh, ahih keileh data tawh lak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The chart represents changes in population.
examples.zomi: Chart in mihing zat kikhelna lak hi.

examples.english: The film does not accurately represent village life.
examples.zomi: Film in khuami nuntakna a maan takin lak lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Ask whether a representation is accurate, balanced, and complete, especially when it describes people or communities.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih keileh khuamite a kilak ciangin tua lakna a maan, a kikim leh a kicing hiam cih ngaihsut ding hi.

senses.heading: A person chosen to act for others
senses.definition_en: A person chosen or authorized to speak, act, or make decisions for another person, group, organization, or area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, kipawlna, ahih keileh gam khen khat aiawh in pau, gamta, ahih keileh thukhen dingin kiteel ahih keileh thuneihna kipiak mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Each district elects a representative.
examples.zomi: District khat ciangin aiawh khat teel hi.

examples.english: Community representatives attended the meeting.
examples.zomi: Khuamite aiawhte meeting ah pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A representative may be elected, appointed, employed, or otherwise formally authorized.
senses.usage_zomi: Representative pen kiteel, kikoih, nasep kipiak, ahih keileh thuneihna tawh aiawh dingin kipsak theih hi.

senses.heading: A person who sells or promotes a company’s products
senses.definition_en: A person whose job is to sell, explain, or support a company’s products or services.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kampani’ van ahih keileh nasepna zuak, hilhcian, ahih keileh a zangte panpih ding nasem ahi hi.

examples.english: A sales representative explained the product.
examples.zomi: Van zuak aiawh in van tawh kisai thu hilhcian hi.

examples.english: Please contact a customer-service representative.
examples.zomi: Vanlei huhna aiawh khat tawh kizom in.

senses.usage_en: In business, representative is often shortened informally to rep.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumvai nasepna ah representative pen informal takin rep ci in tomgen zel hi.

senses.definition_en: The general opinion that people have about a person, organization, place, or product based on past behaviour or quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, kipawlna, mun, ahih keileh van khat’ a beisa gamtatna leh hoihna tungah kinga in mipite in a ngaihsutna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hospital has a good reputation for patient care.
examples.zomi: Zatui inn pen cina kemna ah minthanna hoih nei hi.

examples.english: One dishonest act can damage a person’s reputation.
examples.zomi: Gamtatna maanlo khat in mi khat’ minthanna susia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Reputation is what other people generally believe about someone or something; it may or may not be completely accurate.
senses.usage_zomi: Reputation pen mi dangte in mi ahih keileh na khat tawh kisai a ngaihsutna ahi a, tua ngaihsutna a maan kicing pahpah lo thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A polite or formal act of asking for something or asking someone to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngah ding ahih keileh mi khat in na khat hong bawl dingin zahtakna ahih keileh formal takin a kidotna ahi hi.

examples.english: The manager approved my request for leave.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in ka khawl ngenna kipsak hi.

examples.english: We received a request for more information.
examples.zomi: Thu behlap ngenna khat ngah hihang.

senses.usage_en: Use a request for + noun and a request to + verb: a request for help; a request to speak.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun mai ah a request for kizang a, sepna mai ah a request to + verb kizang hi: huhna ngenna; pau ding ngenna.

senses.heading: To need something
senses.definition_en: To need something because it is necessary for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Deihna khat tangtung ahih keileh nasep khat sem nadingin na khat a kisam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This work requires patience and skill.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep in thuakzawhna leh siamna kisam hi.

examples.english: The repair will require more time.
examples.zomi: Bawlphatna in hun tamzaw kisam ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Require is more formal than need and is common in instructions, rules, and official writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Require pen need sangin formal zaw a, hilhna, thukhun leh thuneihna laigelhna ah kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: To officially demand something
senses.definition_en: To state that someone must do or provide something according to a rule, law, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, dan, ahih keileh kisapna tawh kizui in mi khat na khat bawl ahih keileh pia dingin a kiphut cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat min pia kul sak

examples.english: The law requires drivers to carry insurance.
examples.zomi: Dan in mawtaw hawl mite insurance nei dingin phut hi.

examples.english: Applicants are required to provide identification.
examples.zomi: Ngenna bawlte kua hi cih lakna pia kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use require someone to do something: the school requires students to wear uniforms.
senses.usage_zomi: Require someone to do something cihdan kizang hi: sang in sangnaupangte sang puan silh dingin phut hi.

senses.heading: Something officially required
senses.definition_en: A rule, condition, skill, or document that someone must satisfy or provide.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in picing sak ahih keileh pia kul thukhun, dinmun, siamna, ahih keileh lai ahi hi.

examples.english: Experience is a requirement for this job.
examples.zomi: Hih nasepna a dingin nasep pilna kisap hi.

examples.english: All applicants must meet the entry requirements.
examples.zomi: Ngenna bawl khempeuh in lutna kisapna-te picing sak kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: To meet or satisfy a requirement means to do or possess what the rule demands.
senses.usage_zomi: Kisapna meet ahih keileh satisfy cih pen thukhun in a phut bang bawl ahih keileh nei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Something that is needed
senses.definition_en: Something necessary for a person, activity, system, or purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, sepkhiatna, system, ahih keileh deihna khat a dingin a kisam na ahi hi.

examples.english: Clean water is a basic human requirement.
examples.zomi: Tui siangtho pen mihing’ a bulpi kisapna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The system has several technical requirements.
examples.zomi: System in technology lam kisapna pawlkhat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A requirement may come from an official rule or from practical necessity.
senses.usage_zomi: Requirement pen thuneihna thukhun pan ahih keileh a taktak kisapna pan hong piang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To save someone or something from danger, injury, loss, or a difficult situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat lauhuaina, liamna, mangna, ahih keileh dinmun haksat pan honkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Firefighters rescued two people from the building.
examples.zomi: Meithalh mite in inn sungpan mi nih honkhia uh hi.

examples.english: The sailors rescued the injured man from the sea.
examples.zomi: Tembaw nasemte in tuipi sungpan mi liam honkhia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use rescue someone from a dangerous place or situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat lauhuai mun ahih keileh dinmun pan kihonkhia ciangin rescue someone from kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Careful and organized study intended to discover facts, test ideas, or develop new knowledge.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kician muhkhiat, ngaihsutna etto, ahih keileh theihna thak khangsak nadingin pilvang leh ngeina tawh kizui a kibawl sinna ahi hi.

examples.english: The university conducts medical research.
examples.zomi: University in zatui lam zongkholna bawl hi.

examples.english: Recent research supports this treatment.
examples.zomi: Tulai zongkholna in hih zatui kepdan panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Research is normally uncountable in general English. Say some research or a research study, not usually a research.
senses.usage_zomi: General English ah research pen simtheih lo noun ahi hi. Some research ahih keileh a research study kici a, a research ci in pau ngeilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who carries out careful study to discover or verify information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu thak muhkhiat ahih keileh thu a maan hiam cih kipsak nadingin zongkholna a bawl mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Researchers interviewed five hundred residents.
examples.zomi: Zongkhol mite in khuami zanga tawh kihona nei uh hi.

examples.english: She works as a cancer researcher.
examples.zomi: Ama cancer natna zongkholmi in sem hi.

senses.usage_en: A researcher may work in science, medicine, education, history, business, or many other fields.
senses.usage_zomi: Zongkholmi khat science, zatui, sang pilna, tangthu, sumvai leh lam tuamtuam ah sem thei hi.

senses.heading: An arrangement to keep something for later use
senses.definition_en: An arrangement in which a seat, room, table, or service is kept for a particular person and time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tutna, pindan, sabuai, ahih keileh nasepna khat mi leh hun ciangtansa khat a dingin kikoihkhol kithukimna ahi hi.

examples.english: I made a hotel reservation for two nights.
examples.zomi: Zan nih a dingin hotel pindan khol ing.

examples.english: Do you have a reservation?
examples.zomi: Mun na kholsa hiam?

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses reservation. British English also commonly uses booking.
senses.usage_zomi: American English in reservation kizang mahmah a, British English in booking zong kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: A doubt or concern
senses.definition_en: A doubt or worry that prevents someone from completely accepting or supporting something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a picingin sang ahih keileh panpih zawhlohna a piangsak lunghianna ahih keileh lungkhamna ahi hi.

examples.english: I have reservations about the plan’s cost.
examples.zomi: Geelna a sum zat ding tawh kisai lunghianna ka nei hi.

examples.english: She supported the proposal without reservation.
examples.zomi: Ama in lunghianna lo in geelna panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is commonly used in the plural: have reservations about something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen plural in kizang mahmah hi: have reservations about something—thu khat tawh kisai lunghianna nei.

senses.heading: A supply kept for future need
senses.definition_en: An amount of money, food, fuel, or another resource kept for future use or emergencies.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam kisapna ahih keileh thu lauhuai laitak zat dingin a kikoihkhol sum, annek, meihol, ahih keileh neihsa ahi hi.

examples.english: The family keeps a small cash reserve.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in sum tawmkhat mailam dingin khol hi.

examples.english: The country increased its fuel reserves.
examples.zomi: Gam in meihol kholsa khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Something held in reserve is kept available but is not being used now.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat in reserve kici leh kisap ciang a zat dingin kikoih a, tu in kizang nailo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A protected area for animals or nature
senses.definition_en: An area of land or water protected for wildlife, plants, or the natural environment.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gam pianzia kepna mun; ganhing kepna gam
senses.explanation_zomi: Ganhing, singkung leh gam pianzia kem nadingin thukhun tawh a kikem lei ahih keileh tui mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The elephants live in a protected reserve.
examples.zomi: Sai-te thukhun tawh a kikem gam sungah teng uh hi.

examples.english: Visitors must follow the rules of the nature reserve.
examples.zomi: Khualte in gam pianzia kepna mun thukhun zui kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A reserve protects land, water, plants, or animals from harmful use or development.
senses.usage_zomi: Reserve in lei, tui, singkung leh ganhingte zatkhialhna ahih keileh susia khantohna pan kem hi.

senses.heading: A person or group available as a substitute
senses.definition_en: A person, player, or group kept available to replace or support others when needed.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khekna ding mi; panpih ding pawl
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisap ciangin midang a khek ahih keileh a panpih dingin a kiging mi ahih keileh pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: A reserve player entered the game.
examples.zomi: Khekna ding kimawlmi khat kimawlna sungah lut hi.

examples.english: The army called up its reserves.
examples.zomi: Galkap in panpih ding pawlte sam hi.

senses.usage_en: A reserve person or force is prepared for use but is not usually active at the present time.
senses.usage_zomi: Reserve mi ahih keileh pawl pen kisap ciang zat dingin kiging a, tu laitak in nasepna sungah a kihel pahpah lo ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who lives in a particular place, building, district, or country.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, inn, district, ahih keileh gam khat sungah a teng mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Local residents opposed the construction plan.
examples.zomi: Tua mun khuamite in inn lamna geelna nial uh hi.

examples.english: She is a permanent resident of the United States.
examples.zomi: Ama United States ah omden ding phalna nei tengmi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A resident lives in a place. A citizen has a particular legal membership in a country; the two are not always the same.
senses.usage_zomi: Resident pen mun khat ah teng hi. Citizen pen gam khat’ dan tawh gammi ahi hi; tua nih a kibang pahpah lo hi.

senses.heading: To oppose or fight against something
senses.definition_en: To oppose, fight against, or refuse to accept control, pressure, or change.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ukna, zawhna, sawlna, ahih keileh kikhelna khat langpang, nial, ahih keileh do cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The community resisted the plan to remove their homes.
examples.zomi: Khuamite in amau’ innte hem ding geelna langpang uh hi.

examples.english: Some employees resist changes in the workplace.
examples.zomi: Nasem pawlkhat in nasepna mun kikhelna nial uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Resist takes a direct object: resist pressure. Do not normally say resist against pressure.
senses.usage_zomi: Resist nungah object kipahpah hi: resist pressure. Resist against pressure ci in pau ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: To stop yourself from doing something
senses.definition_en: To control yourself so that you do not do something you want or feel tempted to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na bawl nuam ahih keileh zia-etna na tuak khat bawl lo dingin nangmah kikem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I could not resist eating another piece of cake.
examples.zomi: Cake khen khat dang ne nuamna kikem zo lo ing.

examples.english: She resisted the urge to reply angrily.
examples.zomi: He takin dawn nuamna ama zawh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use resist + noun or resist + -ing: resist temptation; resist answering.
senses.usage_zomi: Resist + noun ahih keileh resist + -ing cihdan kizang hi: zia-etna do; dawn ding zawhzawhna do.

senses.heading: To solve a problem or disagreement
senses.definition_en: To find an acceptable solution to a problem, difficulty, or disagreement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina, haksatna, ahih keileh thukimlohna khat a tawp nading dawnna kilawm mu cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two sides met to resolve the conflict.
examples.zomi: Lam nihgel kitukalhna veng dingin kimu uh hi.

examples.english: We need to resolve this problem quickly.
examples.zomi: Hih buaina manlang takin i dawng kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Resolve is more formal than solve and is especially common with conflicts, disputes, complaints, and issues.
senses.usage_zomi: Resolve pen solve sangin formal zaw a, kitukalhna, kinialna, complaint leh buaina a genna ah kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: To make a firm decision
senses.definition_en: To decide firmly that you will do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl taktak dingin lungsim kipsak in khensat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She resolved to complete her education.
examples.zomi: Ama a sinna zo taktak dingin lungsim kipsak hi.

examples.english: They resolved that the mistake would not happen again.
examples.zomi: Khialhna piangkik lo dingin khensat uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use resolve to + verb or resolve that + clause for a firm personal or group decision.
senses.usage_zomi: Mimal ahih keileh pawl khat’ khensatna kiptak a gen ciangin resolve to + verb ahih keileh resolve that + clause kizang hi.

senses.heading: A place where people go for holidays
senses.definition_en: A place where many people go for holidays, recreation, or special activities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tampi in khawl, tawldam, kimawl, ahih keileh sepkhiatna tuam bawl dingin a paina mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The family stayed at a beach resort.
examples.zomi: Innkuan pen tuipi gei khawlna munah om hi.

examples.english: The resort offers several outdoor activities.
examples.zomi: Khawlna mun in pualam sepkhiatna tuamtuam pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A resort often includes accommodation, food, and recreational facilities in one location.
senses.usage_zomi: Resort khat ah lupna, annek leh kimawlna vante mun khat sungah omkhawm zel hi.

senses.heading: Something used only when other choices fail
senses.definition_en: A course of action used when better or more usual choices are unavailable or have failed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teeltheihna hoihzaw omlo ahih keileh teeltheihna dangte guallel khit ciang bek a kizang lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: They used legal action only as a last resort.
examples.zomi: Lampi dang omlo ciang bek dan lampi zang uh hi.

examples.english: Violence should never be the first resort.
examples.zomi: Ngongtatna pen lampi masa in kizang lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: As a last resort means only after all better choices have been tried.
senses.usage_zomi: As a last resort cih pen teeltheihna hoihzaw khempeuh etto khit ciang bek a kizang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Something useful for achieving a purpose
senses.definition_en: Money, materials, equipment, information, time, or people available for achieving a purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Deihna khat tangtung nadingin zat theih sum, vanpua, van, thu, hun, ahih keileh mihingte ahi hi.

examples.english: The school lacks teaching resources.
examples.zomi: Sang in hilhna panpihna van kicing nei lo hi.

examples.english: We must use our limited resources carefully.
examples.zomi: Eima neihsa ciangtansa pilvang takin i zang kul hi.

senses.usage_en: A resource is useful because it helps someone perform an activity or achieve a goal.
senses.usage_zomi: Resource pen sepkhiatna khat bawl ahih keileh ngiimna khat tangtung nadingin phattuam hi.

senses.heading: A natural supply that people can use
senses.definition_en: A natural substance or feature, such as water, forests, land, minerals, or energy, that people can use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui, gam, lei, suangman, ahih keileh thahatna bangin mihing in a zat theih gam pianpih neihsa ahi hi.

examples.english: The country has rich natural resources.
examples.zomi: Gam in gam pianpih neihsa tampi nei hi.

examples.english: Clean water is a valuable resource.
examples.zomi: Tui siangtho pen gam pianpih neihsa manpha ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Natural resources may be renewable, such as sunlight, or non-renewable, such as coal and oil.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam pianpih neihsa pawlkhat ni khuavak bangin ngahkik theih ahi a, coal leh sathau bang pawlkhat ngahkik theih hilo hi.

senses.heading: A source of helpful information
senses.definition_en: A book, website, person, or tool that provides useful information or support.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu phatuam ahih keileh panpihna a pia laibu, website, mi, ahih keileh van ahi hi.

examples.english: This dictionary is a useful language resource.
examples.zomi: Hih dictionary pen pau sinna thubul phatuam ahi hi.

examples.english: The website provides free educational resources.
examples.zomi: Website in man lo sinna panpihna-te pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In education and research, resource often means a source that helps people learn or complete work.
senses.usage_zomi: Sang pilna leh zongkholna ah resource in mi-te sin ahih keileh nasep zo ding a huh thubul gen zel hi.

senses.heading: Admiration for someone’s qualities or achievements
senses.definition_en: A feeling of admiration for someone because of their character, abilities, or achievements.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ omzia, siamna, ahih keileh gualzawhna hangin a tungah zatna leh pahtawina a neihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She earned the respect of her colleagues.
examples.zomi: Ama in a naseppihte’ zahtakna ngah hi.

examples.english: I have great respect for his honesty.
examples.zomi: Ama’ thuman gamtatna zahtak mahmah ing.

senses.usage_en: Use respect for before the person or quality admired: respect for teachers; respect for honesty.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizahtak mi ahih keileh omzia mai ah respect for kizang hi: siate zahtakna; thuman gamtatna zahtakna.

senses.heading: Care for someone’s rights, wishes, or property
senses.definition_en: Careful consideration for another person’s feelings, rights, wishes, privacy, or property.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang’ lungsim, hamphatna, deihna, mimal thu leh neihsa pilvang takin ngaihsut leh kemna ahi hi.

examples.english: Healthy relationships require mutual respect.
examples.zomi: Kizopna hoih in khat leh khat ki-zahtakna kisam hi.

examples.english: The policy shows respect for personal privacy.
examples.zomi: Policy in mimal thu zahtakna lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Respect involves behaviour as well as feelings; it includes treating others fairly and honouring appropriate boundaries.
senses.usage_zomi: Zahtakna pen lungsim bek hilo in gamtatna zong huam hi; midang tungah thuman takin gamtat leh ciangtan kilawm zahtak cih kihel hi.

senses.heading: A particular point or aspect
senses.definition_en: A particular feature, detail, or way in which something is considered.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kingaihsutna omzia, khen, ahih keileh lam tuam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The two plans are similar in several respects.
examples.zomi: Geelna nih lam pawlkhat ah kibang hi.

examples.english: In this respect, the new system is better.
examples.zomi: Hih lamah system thak a hoihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal meaning appears mainly in phrases such as in this respect and in many respects.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna pen in this respect leh in many respects bang kammal kipawlna ah kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: To answer someone
senses.definition_en: To answer a question, message, request, statement, or action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dotna, thupuak, ngenna, thu genna, ahih keileh gamtatna khat dawng cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She responded to my message within an hour.
examples.zomi: Ama in nai khat sungin ka thupuak hong dawng hi.

examples.english: The company did not respond to the complaint.
examples.zomi: Kampani in complaint dawng lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use respond to someone or something. Respond is more formal than reply or answer.
senses.usage_zomi: Respond to someone or something cihdan kizang hi. Respond pen reply ahih keileh answer sangin formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: To react to an event, treatment, or situation
senses.definition_en: To behave or change in a particular way because of an event, influence, or treatment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang, huzaapna, ahih keileh zatui kepna khat hangin lam khat tawh gamta ahih keileh kikhel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The patient responded well to the treatment.
examples.zomi: Cina pa zatui kepna hangin hoih takin cidamkik hi.

examples.english: Plants respond to changes in light.
examples.zomi: Singkungte khuavak kikhelna tawh kizui in kikhel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In medicine, respond to treatment means showing improvement or another measurable change after treatment.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatui lamah respond to treatment cih pen zatui kepna khit ciangin cidamna ahih keileh a teh theih kikhelna lak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: An answer or reply
senses.definition_en: Something said, written, or done as an answer to a question, request, message, or action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dotna, ngenna, thupuak, ahih keileh gamtatna khat a dawnna in a kigen, kigelh, ahih keileh kibawl na ahi hi.

examples.english: We received no response to our request.
examples.zomi: Kote’ ngenna dawnna bangmah ngah lo hihang.

examples.english: Her response was clear and polite.
examples.zomi: Ama’ dawnna kician leh zahtakhuai hi.

senses.usage_en: Use response to before the question, request, or event being answered.
senses.usage_zomi: A kidawn dotna, ngenna, ahih keileh thu piang mai ah response to kizang hi.

senses.heading: A reaction to an event or influence
senses.definition_en: A physical, emotional, social, or organizational reaction to a situation or influence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun ahih keileh huzaapna khat hangin pumpi, lungsim, mihing pawl, ahih keileh kipawlna in a lak dawnkikna ahi hi.

examples.english: Fear is a natural response to danger.
examples.zomi: Lauhna pen lauhuaina tungah pianpih dawnkikna ahi hi.

examples.english: The city improved its emergency response.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in thu lauhuai dawnkikna hoihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Response is broader than a spoken answer and may include physical or emotional changes.
senses.usage_zomi: Response pen pau tawh dawnna bek sangin zaizaw a, pumpi ahih keileh lungsim kikhelna zong huam hi.

senses.heading: A duty to deal with something
senses.definition_en: A duty to take care of someone or something, complete a task, or deal with a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat kem, nasep khat zo, ahih keileh dinmun khat vaihawm ding mawhpuakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Parents have responsibility for their children’s safety.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pa in amau’ tate bitna kep mawhpuakna nei uh hi.

examples.english: She took responsibility for completing the project.
examples.zomi: Ama in project zo ding mawhpuakna la hi.

senses.usage_en: Use responsibility for + noun or -ing: responsibility for safety; responsibility for managing the team.
senses.usage_zomi: Responsibility for + noun or -ing cihdan kizang hi: bitna kep mawhpuakna; pawl uk mawhpuakna.

senses.heading: Blame or accountability for an action or result
senses.definition_en: The state of being the person who caused something or must answer for its result.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mawh neihna; a gah dawn mawhpuakna
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a piangsak mi ahihna ahih keileh a gah hangin dawnkik ding mawhpuakna neihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company accepted responsibility for the error.
examples.zomi: Kampani in khialhna mawhpuakna sang hi.

examples.english: Drivers must take responsibility for their actions.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawlte in amau’ gamtatna mawhpuakna la kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Taking responsibility means honestly accepting one’s duty or role in what happened.
senses.usage_zomi: Mawhpuakna lak cih pen na’ sep ding ahih keileh thu piang sungah na kihelna thuman takin sang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Having a duty to care for or control something
senses.definition_en: Having the duty to take care of someone or something, complete work, or make decisions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat kem, nasep khat zo, ahih keileh thukhen ding mawhpuakna a nei ahi hi.

examples.english: She is responsible for training new employees.
examples.zomi: Ama nasem thakte sinsak ding mawhpuakna nei hi.

examples.english: Who is responsible for this department?
examples.zomi: Hih department kua in vaihawm hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use responsible for + noun or -ing: responsible for the budget; responsible for preparing the report.
senses.usage_zomi: Responsible for + noun or -ing cihdan kizang hi: sum geelna mawhpuakna nei; laporan bawl ding mawhpuakna nei.

senses.heading: Causing something
senses.definition_en: Being the cause of an event, result, problem, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang, a gah, buaina, ahih keileh dinmun khat a piangsak hang ahi hi.

examples.english: The storm was responsible for the damage.
examples.zomi: Huihpi pen kisiatna a piangsak ahi hi.

examples.english: He was held responsible for the mistake.
examples.zomi: Khialhna hangin ama mawhpuakna kipua sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Responsible for may describe either a duty or the cause of an outcome. Context shows which meaning is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Responsible for in mawhpuakna ahih keileh thu khat’ hangthu gen thei hi. A kizangna thu in khiatna lak hi.

senses.heading: Sensible, dependable, and trustworthy
senses.definition_en: Behaving carefully and sensibly so that other people can trust you.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte in muan theih dingin pilvang, ngaihsutna nei leh mawhpuakna tawh a gamta ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a responsible and reliable employee.
examples.zomi: Ama mawhpuakna nei leh muanhuai nasem khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Responsible drivers obey traffic laws.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawl mawhpuakna nei mite lampi dan zui uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A responsible person considers the likely effects of an action before acting.
senses.usage_zomi: Mawhpuakna nei mi in gamta ma in ama’ gamtatna in a piangsak ding a gah ngaihsun hi.

senses.definition_en: The part, amount, or people that remain after another part has been used, taken, mentioned, or separated.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khen khat kizang, kilak, kigen, ahih keileh kikhenkhia khit ciang a omlai khen, zat, ahih keileh mite ahi hi.

examples.english: I finished the work and rested for the rest of the day.
examples.zomi: Nasep ka zawh khit ciangin ni sung a omlai hun tawldam ing.

examples.english: Two students left, but the rest stayed.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang nih paikhia a, a dangte om lai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the rest of + noun: the rest of the food. When the noun is plural, the verb is usually plural: the rest of the students are here.
senses.usage_zomi: The rest of + noun cihdan kizang hi: annek a omlai. Noun plural ahihleh verb zong plural hi: sangnaupang a dangte hih munah om uh hi.

senses.heading: A period of relaxation
senses.definition_en: A period during which someone stops working or being active in order to relax and regain energy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawldam leh thahatna ngahkik nadingin nasep ahih keileh gamtatna a khawl hun ahi hi.

examples.english: You should take a short rest.
examples.zomi: Hun tomkhat na tawldam ding hi.

examples.english: After the journey, everyone needed some rest.
examples.zomi: Khualzin khit ciangin mi khempeuh tawldamna kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses have a rest. American English often uses get some rest or simply rest.
senses.usage_zomi: British English in have a rest kizang zel a, American English in get some rest ahih keileh rest a kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: Sleep
senses.definition_en: Sleep or a period of peaceful sleep.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ihmutna ahih keileh lungnop takin ihmut hun ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: zan khat sung tawldam takin ihmu

examples.english: The patient needs plenty of rest.
examples.zomi: Cina pa tawldamna tampi kisam hi.

examples.english: I felt better after a good night’s rest.
examples.zomi: Zan khat sung hoih takin ka ihmut khit ciangin ka hoihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: In health contexts, rest may include both sleep and quiet inactivity.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna tawh kisai in rest in ihmutna leh dai takin gamta loin tawldamna tegel huam thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A place where customers pay to sit and eat meals that are prepared and served there.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanleite in sum pia in tu a, tua munah a kihuan leh a kipiak annek a nekna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
examples.zomi: Annek dawr neu khat ah zan an ne hihang.

examples.english: This restaurant serves traditional Zomi food.
examples.zomi: Hih annek dawr in Zomi ngeina annek pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A restaurant serves prepared meals. A café is usually more informal and may focus on drinks and lighter food.
senses.usage_zomi: Restaurant in annek kicing a pia hi. Café pen informal zaw a, dawn ding leh annek neu deuh thupi sak zaw hi.

senses.heading: Something caused by an action or event
senses.definition_en: Something that happens or exists because of an action, decision, process, or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, khensatna, sepzia, ahih keileh thu piang khat hangin a hong piang na ahi hi.

examples.english: The accident was the result of careless driving.
examples.zomi: Accident pen pilvang lo a mawtaw hawlna gah ahi hi.

examples.english: Sales increased as a result of the campaign.
examples.zomi: Campaign hangin van zuakna hong khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the result of before a cause and result in when an action produces an outcome.
senses.usage_zomi: Hangthu mai ah the result of kizang a, gamtatna khat in a gah piangsak cih a gen ciangin result in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Information discovered by a test or investigation
senses.definition_en: Information or findings produced by an examination, experiment, calculation, test, or investigation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sittelna, ettohna, simna, tehna, ahih keileh zongkholna pan a kingah thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The test results will be available tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Sittelna a gah zingt ngah theih ding hi.

examples.english: The research produced unexpected results.
examples.zomi: Zongkholna in kilamen lo muhkhiatna piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Results is commonly plural when referring to findings, scores, or medical test information.
senses.usage_zomi: Muhkhiatna, score, ahih keileh zatui sittelna thu a gen ciangin results plural a kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: A score or outcome in a competition or election
senses.definition_en: The final score, decision, or outcome of a game, competition, or election.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna, kidemna, ahih keileh teelna khit a score, khensatna, ahih keileh a gualzo thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The election results were announced at midnight.
examples.zomi: Teelna a gah zankim in kitangko hi.

examples.english: What was the result of the match?
examples.zomi: Kimawlna a gah bang hi hiam?

senses.usage_en: In elections and competitions, result identifies who won, lost, or how many votes or points each side received.
senses.usage_zomi: Teelna leh kidemna ah result in kua gualzo, kua guallel, ahih keileh lam khat ciangin vote leh point bangzah ngah cih lak hi.

senses.heading: To keep something
senses.definition_en: To continue to have, use, or possess something instead of losing or removing it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat mansuah ahih keileh hemkhia loin neih, zat, ahih keileh kep paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company retained ownership of the building.
examples.zomi: Kampani in inn neihna kem paisuak hi.

examples.english: The revised document retains the original meaning.
examples.zomi: Lai kipuahkik in a bul khiatna kem paisuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Retain is more formal than keep and is common in legal, business, and academic writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Retain pen keep sangin formal zaw a, dan, sumvai leh sang lam laigelhna ah kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: To remember information
senses.definition_en: To keep information in your memory after learning or hearing it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat sin ahih keileh za khit ciangin lungsim sungah kem in phawk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Regular practice helps students retain information.
examples.zomi: Ngeina tawh kisinna in sangnaupangte thu phawk dingin huh hi.

examples.english: I read the chapter twice to retain its main ideas.
examples.zomi: A ngaihsutna liante phawk nadingin chapter nihvei sim ing.

senses.usage_en: In learning, retain means remembering information over time rather than understanding it only briefly.
senses.usage_zomi: Sinna ah retain cih pen thu tomkhat bek tel cihna hilo in, sawtpi phawk cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To continue employing someone
senses.definition_en: To continue to employ or use the professional services of a person.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasep paisuak sak; nasepna zat paisuak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nasep paisuak sak ahih keileh ama’ siam nasepna zat paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company wants to retain experienced employees.
examples.zomi: Kampani in nasep pilna nei nasemte kem paisuak nuam hi.

examples.english: They retained a lawyer to advise them.
examples.zomi: Amaute thuhilh dingin dan siam khat’ nasepna la uh hi.

senses.usage_en: To retain a lawyer means formally arranging and usually paying for the lawyer’s professional services.
senses.usage_zomi: Retain a lawyer cih pen dan siam’ nasepna thuneihna tawh la a, a tamzaw sum pia cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To stop working permanently
senses.definition_en: To leave a job or profession permanently, usually because of age.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasep tawpsan; pension la in khawl
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw kum upatna hangin nasep ahih keileh profession tawpsan in nasep nawnlo cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: kum sawmguk leh nga in nasep tawpsan

examples.english: She plans to retire next year.
examples.zomi: Ama kum hong tung nasep tawpsan ding geel hi.

examples.english: He retired from teaching after thirty years.
examples.zomi: Kum sawmthum sia in a sep khit ciangin nasep tawpsan hi.

senses.usage_en: Use retire from + job or profession: retire from teaching. Use retire at + age: retire at sixty-five.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep ahih keileh profession mai ah retire from kizang a, kum zat mai ah retire at kizang hi.

senses.heading: To stop competing in a sport
senses.definition_en: To stop taking part in a sport or competition, either permanently or during a particular event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna ahih keileh kidemna khat sungah kihelna tawpsan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The player retired from professional football.
examples.zomi: Kimawlmi in professional football kimawlna tawpsan hi.

examples.english: She was forced to retire from the race because of an injury.
examples.zomi: Liamna hangin tai kidemna pan paikhiat kul hi.

senses.usage_en: In sport, retire may mean ending a career or withdrawing from one competition before finishing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna ah retire in kimawlmi nuntakna buppi tawpsan ahih keileh kidemna khat a zo ma in paikhiat cihna nei thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Having permanently stopped working, usually because of age.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasep tawpsan khin; pension a la
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw kum upatna hangin nasep tawpsan khin a, nasep ngeina sem nawnlo ahi hi.

examples.english: He is a retired police officer.
examples.zomi: Ama nasep tawpsan khin palik ahi hi.

examples.english: The retired couple moved closer to their children.
examples.zomi: Nasep tawpsan khin nupa amau’ tate kiangah neizaw in kisuan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Retired describes a person who has stopped working. Do not use it simply for someone who is temporarily unemployed.
senses.usage_zomi: Retired in nasep ngeina tawpsan khin mi gen hi. Hun tom sung nasep neilo mi a dingin kizang lo hi.

senses.heading: To go or come back
senses.definition_en: To go or come back to a place, person, activity, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, mi, sepkhiatna, ahih keileh dinmun khat ah ciahkik ahih keileh hong paikik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She returned home before dark.
examples.zomi: Khuamial ma in ama inn ciahkik hi.

examples.english: The students will return to school on Monday.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte Monday ni in sangah paikik ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Return normally takes a place directly or uses to: return home; return to school. Do not say return back because return already means “go back.”
senses.usage_zomi: Return home ahih keileh return to school cihdan kizang hi. Return sungah “ciahkik” cih khiatna om khin ahih manin return back kisam lo hi.

senses.heading: To give, send, or put something back
senses.definition_en: To give, send, or put something back to its owner or former place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a neipa tungah ahih keileh a omlui munah piakik, sawlkik, ahih keileh koihkik cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: return an item to the shop

examples.english: Please return the library book by Friday.
examples.zomi: Friday ni dong lai laakna inn laibu piakik in.

examples.english: She returned the damaged product to the shop.
examples.zomi: Ama in van kisiat dawr ah puakkik hi.

senses.usage_en: Use return something to someone or somewhere: return the key to the receptionist.
senses.usage_zomi: Return something to someone or somewhere cihdan kizang hi: tawhtang khual sangmi tungah piakik.

senses.heading: To happen or exist again
senses.definition_en: To begin happening, existing, or being felt again after a period of absence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat sung a omloh khit ciangin thu khat piangkik, omkik, ahih keileh kingaihkik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The pain returned during the night.
examples.zomi: Zan sungin natna hong omkik hi.

examples.english: Life slowly returned to normal.
examples.zomi: Nuntakna damtak in ngeina dinmunah ciahkik hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, return can describe conditions, feelings, problems, or normal activity coming back.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah return in dinmun, lungsim, buaina, ahih keileh ngeina gamtatna hong omkik cih gen thei hi.

senses.heading: To make unknown or secret information known
senses.definition_en: To make a fact, secret, or piece of information known to other people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kician, thusim, ahih keileh theihna mi dangte in theih nadingin pulaak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The investigation revealed serious safety problems.
examples.zomi: Zongkholna in bitna buaina thupi-te pulaak hi.

examples.english: She refused to reveal his name.
examples.zomi: Ama’ min pulaak ding nial hi.

senses.usage_en: Reveal often suggests that the information was previously hidden, secret, or unknown.
senses.usage_zomi: Reveal in thu pen a beisa hunah kiphual, thusim, ahih keileh kithei nailo cih lak zel hi.

senses.heading: To uncover something so it can be seen
senses.definition_en: To remove a covering or obstruction so that something becomes visible.
