senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat muh theih nadingin a khuh ahih keileh a dal na hemkhia cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a nuai a om hong kilangsak

examples.english: The clouds moved away and revealed the mountain.
examples.zomi: Mei-te kiheemkhia a, mual hong kilang hi.

examples.english: She opened the box to reveal a gold ring.
examples.zomi: Ama in bawm hon a, kham khutsial khat hong kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes making a physical object or scene visible.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in van ahih keileh mun khat muh theih dingin hong kilangsak cih gen hi.

senses.heading: A careful examination
senses.definition_en: A careful examination of something to judge its condition, effectiveness, accuracy, or progress.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat’ dinmun, phattuamna, kicianna, ahih keileh khantohna thuk takin en in thukhensia na ahi hi.

examples.english: The policy is currently under review.
examples.zomi: Policy tu in kienkik laitak hi.

examples.english: The manager completed the employee’s annual review.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in nasempa’ kum sim enkikna zo hi.

senses.usage_en: A review may lead to confirmation, correction, improvement, or a new decision.
senses.usage_zomi: Review khit ciangin kipsakna, puahphatna, hoihsakna, ahih keileh khensatna thak hong piang thei hi.

senses.heading: An opinion about a book, film, product, or service
senses.definition_en: A written or spoken evaluation of a book, film, performance, product, or service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, film, lakna, van, ahih keileh nasepna khat’ hoihna leh hoihlohna tawh kisai laigelh ahih keileh thugen ahi hi.

examples.english: The newspaper published a review of the film.
examples.zomi: Thuthak laibu in film thukhensiana hawmkhia hi.

examples.english: I read several customer reviews before buying the phone.
examples.zomi: Phone ka lei ma in vanleite’ thukhensiana pawlkhat sim ing.

senses.usage_en: A review should explain reasons for its judgment rather than merely saying that something is good or bad.
senses.usage_zomi: Review in na khat a hoih ahih keileh a hoih lo bek gen loin, banghang hiam cih zong hilhcian ding hi.

senses.heading: Study of material already learned
senses.definition_en: Study of information again in order to remember it or prepare for a test.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kisin khin phawkkik ahih keileh sittelna a dingin kigingsak nading a kisin kikna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave us a review before the exam.
examples.zomi: Sittelna ma in sia in sinna hong enkik sak hi.

examples.english: This chapter provides a review of basic grammar.
examples.zomi: Hih chapter in a bulpi grammar enkikna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This educational meaning is especially common in American English. British English often uses revision.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih sang pilna khiatna pen American English ah kizang mahmah hi. British English in revision a kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: To change something in order to improve or correct it
senses.definition_en: To examine a document, plan, system, or opinion and make corrections or improvements.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, geelna, system, ahih keileh ngaihsutna en in khialhna puah leh hoihsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She revised the report before submitting it.
examples.zomi: Laporan a piak ma in ama puahkik hi.

examples.english: The committee revised its original plan.
examples.zomi: Committee in a bul geelna puahkik hi.

senses.usage_en: Revising involves reconsidering and improving content. Editing may focus more narrowly on wording, grammar, and presentation.
senses.usage_zomi: Revising in a sung thu ngaihsunkik leh hoihsakna huam hi. Editing ahihleh kammal, grammar leh kilatdan thupi sakzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: To study material again
senses.definition_en: To study information again in preparation for an examination.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sittelna a dingin kiging nading kisin khin thu simkik leh kisin kik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is revising for her mathematics exam.
examples.zomi: Ama mathematics sittelna a dingin kisin kik laitak hi.

examples.english: Review your notes before you revise the chapter.
examples.zomi: Chapter na kisin kik ma in na ciaptehna-te enkik in.

senses.usage_en: This educational meaning is common in British English. American English usually uses review or study.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih sang pilna khiatna pen British English ah kizang mahmah a, American English in review ahih keileh study a kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: A major political change
senses.definition_en: A forceful or fundamental change in a country’s government or political system, often involving public uprising.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ukna kikhelna lian; gam ukna kilehbulhna
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw mipite’ langpanna tawh gam khat’ ukna ahih keileh politics system bulpi pan a kikhelna lian ahi hi.

examples.english: The revolution changed the country’s political system.
examples.zomi: Ukna kikhelna lian in gam politics system khelsak hi.

examples.english: Many people joined the revolution.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi ukna kikhelna kampauhna ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A revolution is more fundamental than an ordinary change of government and may be peaceful or violent.
senses.usage_zomi: Revolution pen ukna a kikhel ngeina sangin a bulpi pan kikhelna lianzaw ahi a, lungnop takin ahih keileh ngongtatna tawh piang thei hi.

senses.heading: A very great change in an area of life or knowledge
senses.definition_en: A major change that transforms technology, society, science, industry, or another field.
senses.explanation_zomi: Technology, mihing nuntakna, science, van bawlna, ahih keileh lam dang khat a bulpi pan a khel kikhelna lian ahi hi.

examples.english: The internet created a revolution in communication.
examples.zomi: Internet in kizopna lamah kikhelna lian piangsak hi.

examples.english: The Industrial Revolution transformed production.
examples.zomi: Van bawlna kikhelna lian in van suahdan a bulpi pan khelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is often used for a widespread change that creates a new way of living or working.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen nuntakdan ahih keileh nasepdan thak khat a piangsak kikhelna zaipha tawh kizang hi.

senses.heading: One complete circular movement
senses.definition_en: One complete movement of an object around a central point or axis.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat a laizang ahih keileh a kiim kualna tungah a vekpi khatvei a kihei ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: leitung in ni a kim a velna

examples.english: The wheel makes several revolutions each second.
examples.zomi: Leeng in second khat sungin tampivei kihei hi.

examples.english: Earth completes one revolution around the Sun each year.
examples.zomi: Leitung in kum khat ciangin ni a kim a vekpi khatvei vel hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse revolution with rotation. Revolution is movement around another point; rotation is turning around one’s own axis.
senses.usage_zomi: Revolution leh rotation helkhawm lo ding hi. Revolution pen na dang khat a kim velna ahi a, rotation pen ama’ laizang tungah kihei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Something given for good work or behaviour
senses.definition_en: Money, a prize, praise, or another benefit given because someone did something well.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in na khat hoih takin a bawl hangin a kipiak sum, letsong, pahtawina, ahih keileh hamphatna ahi hi.

examples.english: The prize was a reward for her hard work.
examples.zomi: Letsong pen ama’ hahkat nasep thaman ahi hi.

examples.english: Employees received a financial reward for meeting the target.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in ngiimna tangtun manin sum thaman ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A reward is given after desirable work or behaviour. An award is usually an official prize or honour.
senses.usage_zomi: Reward pen nasep ahih keileh gamtatna hoih khit a kipiak hi. Award ahihleh a tamzaw thuneihna tawh a kipiak letsong ahih keileh pahtawina ahi hi.

senses.heading: Money offered for finding something or helping catch someone
senses.definition_en: Money offered to a person who finds something lost, provides important information, or helps find a wanted person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van mang a mu, thu thupi a pia, ahih keileh kizong mi a muhna a huh mi tungah piak ding a kiciam sum ahi hi.

examples.english: The family offered a reward for the lost dog.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in ui mang mu mi tungah thaman piak ding kamciam hi.

examples.english: Police announced a reward for useful information.
examples.zomi: Palikte in thu phatuam a pia mi tungah thaman om ding tangko uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A reward notice should clearly state what information or action qualifies for payment.
senses.usage_zomi: Thaman tangkona in bang thu ahih keileh bang gamtatna a bawl mi in sum ngah ding cih kician takin gen ding hi.

senses.heading: A regular pattern of sound or movement
senses.definition_en: A repeated pattern of beats, sounds, or movements in music, dance, or speech.
senses.explanation_zomi: La, lam, ahih keileh pau sungah aw, tum leh gamtatna a banbanin a kikupkik piandan ahi hi.

examples.english: The dancers moved to the rhythm of the drums.
examples.zomi: Lamla mite drum tumdan tawh kizui in gamta uh hi.

examples.english: The song has a slow rhythm.
examples.zomi: La in tumdan dam nei hi.

senses.usage_en: The first syllable is stressed, and the spelling has no vowel between th and m: rhythm.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kammal a syllable masapen aw kinga hi. Gelhdan rhythm sungah th leh m kikal vowel om lo hi.

senses.heading: A regular pattern in life or nature
senses.definition_en: A regular pattern in which activities, events, or natural processes happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, thu piang, ahih keileh gam pianzia sepzia ngeina tawh a kikupkik piandan ahi hi.

examples.english: The baby gradually developed a regular sleeping rhythm.
examples.zomi: Naungek in damtak in ihmut piandan ngeina khat nei hi.

examples.english: Travel disturbed my daily rhythm.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna in ka nisim nuntak piandan buaisak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, rhythm describes a repeated and often natural timing or pattern.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah rhythm in a kikupkik leh a tamzaw pianpih hun zui piandan gen hi.

senses.heading: Rice used as food
senses.definition_en: Small grains from a rice plant, prepared and eaten as food.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buhkung pan a kingah a, annek in a kihuan leh a kinek ci ahi hi.

examples.english: We eat rice with vegetables and meat.
examples.zomi: Anthang leh sa tawh an ne hihang.

examples.english: She cooked enough rice for the family.
examples.zomi: Ama in innkuan a dingin an kicing huan hi.

senses.usage_en: Rice is uncountable. Say some rice, a bowl of rice, or grains of rice, not normally rices.
senses.usage_zomi: Rice pen simtheih lo noun ahi hi. Some rice, a bowl of rice, ahih keileh grains of rice kici a, rices ci in pau ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: The crop or plant that produces rice
senses.definition_en: The grass-like plant grown in wet or dry fields for its edible grain.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ci nek ding a kiling, lo vot ahih keileh lo kang sungah a khang buhkung ahi hi.

examples.english: Farmers grow rice during the rainy season.
examples.zomi: Lo neite in guah hunin buh suan uh hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain damaged the rice fields.
examples.zomi: Guah tampi in buhlote susia hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether rice refers to the crop, uncooked grain, or cooked food.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangna thu in rice pen buhkung, buhci hel, ahih keileh an kihuan a gen hiam cih lak hi.

senses.heading: Having a lot of money or property
senses.definition_en: Having a large amount of money, valuable property, or other material wealth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, neihsa manpha, ahih keileh leitung hauhna tampi a nei ahi hi.

examples.english: He became rich through his business.
examples.zomi: Ama’ sumvai nasepna tungtawnin hau hong suak hi.

examples.english: The programme should help poor families, not only rich ones.
examples.zomi: Programme in innkuan hau bek hilo in innkuan gentheite zong huh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Rich commonly refers to wealth, but it can also describe something containing a large amount of a useful or noticeable quality.
senses.usage_zomi: Rich in hauhna gen mahmah napi, na khat sungah hoihna ahih keileh omzia kician tampi om cih zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Containing a large amount of something
senses.definition_en: Containing a large amount of a valuable, useful, strong, or noticeable substance or quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanpua manpha, phatuam, thahat, ahih keileh kician khat tampi a pai ahi hi.

examples.english: Green vegetables are rich in vitamins.
examples.zomi: Anthang hingte sungah vitamin tampi om hi.

examples.english: The region has rich soil for farming.
examples.zomi: Gam khen in lo neihna a dingin lei hoih nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use rich in before the substance or quality present in a large amount.
senses.usage_zomi: Tampi a om vanpua ahih keileh omzia mai ah rich in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Strong, full, or attractive in flavour, colour, or sound
senses.definition_en: Having a strong, full, deep, or pleasing flavour, colour, or sound.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim, color, ahih keileh aw thuk, thahat leh ngaihhuai tak nei ahi hi.

examples.english: The soup has a rich flavour.
examples.zomi: Thuk in lim thuk leh hoih nei hi.

examples.english: She has a rich and powerful voice.
examples.zomi: Ama aw thuk leh thahat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense of rich describes intensity and fullness, not financial wealth.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih rich khiatna in sumhauhna gen lo a, lim, color leh aw a thuk leh a thahat dan gen hi.

senses.definition_en: To remove or free a person, place, or situation from something unwanted.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun, ahih keileh dinmun khat sungpan a deihloh na hemkhia ahih keileh suakta sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We need to get rid of these broken chairs.
examples.zomi: Hih tokhom kisiate i hemkhia kul hi.

examples.english: The treatment helped rid the plants of insects.
examples.zomi: Zatui kepna in singkungte tungpan gamsekte hemkhia dingin huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Rid is rarely used alone. The most common form is get rid of, meaning remove, throw away, or escape from something unwanted.
senses.usage_zomi: Rid amah bek kizang ngei lo hi. Get rid of cihdan a kizang mahmah a, na deihloh khat hemkhia, paai, ahih keileh tua pan suakta cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To travel on a bicycle, motorcycle, or animal
senses.definition_en: To sit on and control a bicycle, motorcycle, horse, or another animal while travelling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bicycle, motorcycle, sakol, ahih keileh ganhing dang tungah tu in hawl ahih keileh khualzin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She rides her bicycle to work.
examples.zomi: Ama bicycle tuang in nasepna ah pai hi.

examples.english: The children learned to ride a horse.
examples.zomi: Naupangte sakol tuang ding sin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use ride for bicycles, motorcycles, and animals. Use drive when controlling a car, bus, or truck.
senses.usage_zomi: Bicycle, motorcycle leh ganhing tawh ride kizang hi. Mawtaw, bus leh lorry hawl ciangin drive kizang hi.

senses.heading: To travel as a passenger
senses.definition_en: To travel in a vehicle without necessarily controlling it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw ahih keileh van pua khawl khat sungah hawlmi hilo in khualzin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We rode the bus into the city.
examples.zomi: Khuapi sungah bus tuang hihang.

examples.english: He rode in the back seat of the car.
examples.zomi: Ama mawtaw nunglam tutna ah tu hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly says ride the bus. British English more often says travel by bus or take the bus.
senses.usage_zomi: American English in ride the bus kici zel a, British English in travel by bus ahih keileh take the bus a kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: Correct or true
senses.definition_en: Correct, accurate, or true.
senses.explanation_zomi: A khial lo, a maan, ahih keileh thu kician tawh a kituak ahi hi.

examples.english: Your answer is right.
examples.zomi: Na dawnna a maan hi.

examples.english: She was right about the cause of the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaina hangthu tawh kisai ama’ ngaihsutna a maan hi.

senses.usage_en: Right can mean factually correct. Its opposite in this sense is wrong.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah right pen thu kician tawh a maan cihna ahi a, a kilehbulh pen wrong ahi hi.

senses.heading: Morally good or acceptable
senses.definition_en: Morally fair, good, or acceptable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtat hoihna tawh kituak, thuman, ahih keileh sangtheih ahi hi.

examples.english: Telling the truth was the right thing to do.
examples.zomi: Thu maan gen pen bawl ding a maan ahi hi.

examples.english: We must decide what is fair and right.
examples.zomi: Bang pen thuman leh kilawm hiam cih i khensat kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Something may be legally permitted but still be debated as morally right or wrong.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat dan in phal napi, gamtat hoihna lamah maan hiam khial hiam cih kinial thei lai hi.

senses.heading: Suitable or best for a purpose
senses.definition_en: Most suitable, appropriate, or helpful for a particular person, purpose, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, deihna, ahih keileh dinmun khat a dingin a kilawmpen ahih keileh a hoihpen ahi hi.

examples.english: She is the right person for the job.
examples.zomi: Ama hih nasepna a dingin mi kilawm ahi hi.

examples.english: This is not the right time to discuss the problem.
examples.zomi: Hih hun pen buaina kikum nading hun kilawm hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, right means suitable rather than factually correct.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah right pen thu maan cihna hilo in, a kilawm cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: On or toward the side opposite the left
senses.definition_en: On or toward the side of the body that is opposite the left side.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi’ veilam tawh a kilehbulh taklam ah om ahih keileh tua lam zuan ahi hi.

examples.english: Raise your right hand.
examples.zomi: Na taklam khut domto in.

examples.english: The bank is on the right side of the road.
examples.zomi: Bank pen lampi taklamah om hi.

senses.usage_en: In directions, right is the opposite of left. It is unrelated to whether something is correct.
senses.usage_zomi: Lampi kawhna ah right pen left tawh kilehbulh hi. Thu maan ahihna tawh kisai lo hi.

senses.heading: A circular piece of jewellery
senses.definition_en: A small circular piece of jewellery worn around a finger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khutme tungah a kisut, a kim pianzia nei kizepna van ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore a gold ring on her finger.
examples.zomi: Ama a khutme tungah kham khutsial sut hi.

examples.english: They exchanged rings during the wedding ceremony.
examples.zomi: Kiteenna zehtan laitakin khutsial kikheng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A ring is worn on a finger, not in a finger.
senses.usage_zomi: Khutsial pen khutme tungah kisut a, khutme sungah kisut hilo hi.

senses.heading: A circular shape or mark
senses.definition_en: Something shaped like a circle or a circular mark.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kim pianzia nei na ahih keileh a kim ciaptehna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children stood in a ring.
examples.zomi: Naupangte a kimin ding uh hi.

examples.english: The cup left a wet ring on the table.
examples.zomi: Hai in sabuai tungah tui a kim ciaptehna nusia hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning describes any circular arrangement, object, or mark.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in a kim a kigualna, van, ahih keileh ciaptehna peuhmah gen hi.

senses.heading: An area where boxing or wrestling happens
senses.definition_en: A raised or marked area where boxing, wrestling, or a similar sport takes place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Boxing, kibuanna, ahih keileh kimawlna kibang a kibawlna a kiciamteh mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The two boxers entered the ring.
examples.zomi: Boxer nih kibuanna munah lut uh hi.

examples.english: The referee stood in the centre of the ring.
examples.zomi: Thukhensia pen kibuanna mun laizangah ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Despite its name, a modern boxing ring is usually square.
senses.usage_zomi: Ring kici napi, tulai boxing mun pen a tamzaw square pianzia ahi hi.

senses.heading: To move upward
senses.definition_en: To move from a lower position to a higher one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun niamzaw pan dinmun sangzaw ah kato cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Smoke rose from the fire.
examples.zomi: Mei sungpan khu kato hi.

examples.english: The sun rises in the east.
examples.zomi: Ni nisuahna lam pan suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Rise normally has no direct object. Raise takes an object: smoke rises; the wind raises the dust.
senses.usage_zomi: Rise in object nei lo hi. Raise in object nei hi: khu kato; huih in leivui domto hi.

senses.heading: To increase
senses.definition_en: To increase in amount, number, price, level, or strength.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, sim, man, dinmun, ahih keileh thahatna khang ahih keileh sangto cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Food prices rose last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in annek man sangto hi.

examples.english: The river may rise after heavy rain.
examples.zomi: Guah tampi khit ciangin gun tui sangto thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use rise by for the amount of increase and rise to for the final level.
senses.usage_zomi: Bangzah a khang cih gen nadingin rise by kizang a, a nunungpen zat mai ah rise to kizang hi.

senses.heading: To stand up
senses.definition_en: To move from sitting, kneeling, or lying to a standing position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tutna, khukdin, ahih keileh lumna pan dingto cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Everyone rose when the judge entered.
examples.zomi: Thukhensia hong lut ciangin mi khempeuh dingto uh hi.

examples.english: She rose from her chair to speak.
examples.zomi: Ama thu gen dingin tokhom pan dingto hi.

senses.usage_en: This use of rise is formal. In ordinary conversation, stand up or get up is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih rise zatna pen formal zaw hi. Nisim kihona ah stand up ahih keileh get up a kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: The possibility of harm or loss
senses.definition_en: The possibility that something harmful, unpleasant, or unsuccessful may happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siatna, nuamlohna, ahih keileh guallelhna khat piang thei cih lauhuaina ahi hi.

examples.english: Smoking increases the risk of heart disease.
examples.zomi: Kuakzu dawnna in lungsim natna ngah theihna khangsak hi.

examples.english: There is a risk of flooding after the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi khit ciangin tui liim theihna om hi.

senses.usage_en: Use risk of + noun or -ing: risk of injury; risk of losing money.
senses.usage_zomi: Risk of + noun or -ing cihdan kizang hi: liam theihna; sum mansuah theihna.

senses.heading: A person or thing that may cause harm or loss
senses.definition_en: A person, activity, or situation that may cause danger, damage, or financial loss.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina, kisiatna, ahih keileh sum mansuahna piangsak thei mi, sepkhiatna, ahih keileh dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The damaged wire is a serious safety risk.
examples.zomi: Meikhautaang kisiat pen bitna lauhuaina lian ahi hi.

examples.english: Investing all your money in one company is a financial risk.
examples.zomi: Na sum khempeuh kampani khat sungah koih pen sumvai lauhuaina ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A risk may refer either to the chance of harm or to the source of that possible harm.
senses.usage_zomi: Risk in siatna piang theihna ahih keileh tua siatna piangsak thei na gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A large natural flow of water that moves across land toward a lake, sea, ocean, or another river.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei tungah luang in tuipi, tuipi lian, tuidil, ahih keileh gun dang sungah a lut gam pianpih tui luang lian ahi hi.

examples.english: A bridge crosses the river.
examples.zomi: Lei khuk in gun kantan hi.

examples.english: The village lies beside a wide river.
examples.zomi: Khua pen gun zaipi khat gei ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Water in a river flows. The land beside it is a river bank.
senses.usage_zomi: Gun sung tui flows—luang hi. Gun gei lei pen river bank kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A prepared route with a firm surface used by vehicles, bicycles, and sometimes people travelling between places.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw, bicycle leh pawlkhat ciang mihingte mun khat pan mun dangah paina dingin a kibawl lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: The road connects the village to the city.
examples.zomi: Lampi in khua leh khuapi kizomsak hi.

examples.english: Look both ways before crossing the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi na kantan ma in lang nihgel en in.

senses.usage_en: A road connects places. A street is usually a road in a town or city with buildings along it.
senses.usage_zomi: Road in mun khat leh khat kizomsak hi. Street pen a tamzaw khua ahih keileh khuapi sung innte a gei a om lampi ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A programmable machine that can perform tasks automatically or with limited human control.
senses.zomi_equivalents: amah leh amah semthei khawl; programme tawh a sem khawl
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing in programme a bawl a, amah leh amah ahih keileh mihing ukna tawm tawh nasep semthei khawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The factory uses robots to build cars.
examples.zomi: Factory in mawtaw bawl nadingin robot-te zang hi.

examples.english: The students programmed the robot to move forward.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupangte in robot mainawt dingin programme bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Not every automatic machine is a robot. A robot is normally programmable and can perform physical or interactive tasks.
senses.usage_zomi: Amah leh amah a sem khawl khempeuh robot hilo hi. Robot pen a tamzaw programme bawltheih a, pumpi nasep ahih keileh mihing tawh kizopna nasep sem thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A style of popular music with a strong beat, usually played with electric guitars, bass, and drums.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tumdan thahat nei a, a tamzaw electric guitar, bass leh drum tawh a kitum popular la nam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: My brother plays guitar in a rock band.
examples.zomi: Ka sanggampa rock la tum pawl sungah guitar tum hi.

examples.english: Thousands of people attended the rock concert.
examples.zomi: Mi tul tampi rock la pawi ah pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Rock is the general music style. Many related styles, such as alternative rock and hard rock, developed from it.
senses.usage_zomi: Rock pen la nam buppi ahi hi. Alternative rock leh hard rock bang la nam tampi tua pan khangkhia hi.

senses.heading: Hard natural material
senses.definition_en: Hard natural material that forms part of the earth’s surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung puan a bawl gam pianpih vanpua khau ahi hi.

examples.english: The road was cut through solid rock.
examples.zomi: Lampi pen suang khau kantanin kibawl hi.

examples.english: The mountain contains several kinds of rock.
examples.zomi: Mual sungah suang nam tuamtuam om hi.

senses.usage_en: Rock is often uncountable when it means the natural material: the ground is solid rock.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam pianpih vanpua a gen ciangin rock pen simtheih lo noun bangin kizang zel hi: lei pen suang khau ahi hi.

senses.heading: A separate piece of stone
senses.definition_en: A piece of hard natural stone, especially one larger than a small pebble.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam pianpih suang khen khat, a diak in suangneu sangin a lianzaw ahi hi.

examples.english: A large rock blocked the road.
examples.zomi: Suangtum lian khat in lampi dal hi.

examples.english: The children collected smooth rocks beside the river.
examples.zomi: Naupangte in gungei ah suangtum nalte kaikhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A countable rock is one separate piece. A stone may be smaller or may have been cut or shaped for a purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtheih rock pen suangtum tuam khat ahi hi. Stone pen neu zaw thei a, deihna khat a dingin kitan ahih keileh kibawl thei hi.

senses.heading: A function or responsibility
senses.definition_en: The function, responsibility, or expected behaviour of a person or organization in a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat sungah mi ahih keileh kipawlna khat’ nasep, mawhpuakna, ahih keileh gamtat ding dan ahi hi.

examples.english: Parents play an important role in their children’s education.
examples.zomi: Nu leh pate in amau’ tate’ sang pilna ah mawhpuakna thupi nei uh hi.

examples.english: She accepted a new role in the organization.
examples.zomi: Ama kipawlna sungah nasep dinmun thak khat sang hi.

senses.usage_en: To play a role in something means to contribute to or influence it.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu khat sungah play a role cih pen tua thu a pianna ah kihel ahih keileh huzaap cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A character performed by an actor
senses.definition_en: A character that an actor performs in a play, film, or television programme.
senses.zomi_equivalents: actor’ dinmun; tangthu sung mi dinmun
senses.explanation_zomi: La in lakna, film, ahih keileh television programme sungah actor khat in a lak mi dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: She played the leading role in the film.
examples.zomi: Ama film sungah a lianpen dinmun lak hi.

examples.english: He accepted the role of a police officer.
examples.zomi: Ama palik dinmun lak ding sang hi.

senses.usage_en: An actor plays or performs a role.
senses.usage_zomi: Actor khat in role khat plays ahih keileh performs hi—dinmun khat lak hi.

senses.heading: To move by turning over repeatedly
senses.definition_en: To move along a surface by turning over and over.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei ahih keileh mun khat tungah kihei suksuk in kalsuan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The ball rolled across the floor.
examples.zomi: Bawl lei tungah kihei in pai hi.

examples.english: The stone rolled down the hill.
examples.zomi: Suangtum mualpang ah lum hi.

senses.usage_en: Roll describes circular movement along a surface, usually without lifting the object.
senses.usage_zomi: Roll in van khat domto loin mun tungah kihei suksuk in kalsuan cih gen hi.

senses.heading: To make something move by turning
senses.definition_en: To push or move something that has wheels or a round shape.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leeng nei ahih keileh a kim pianzia nei van khat kihei in kalsuan dingin nawt cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She rolled the ball toward me.
examples.zomi: Ama in bawl kei lamah lum sak hi.

examples.english: He rolled the wheelchair through the door.
examples.zomi: Ama in wheelchair kongkha kantanin nawt hi.

senses.usage_en: In this transitive sense, someone causes the object to roll.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih transitive khiatna ah mi khat in van a lum ahih keileh a kihei sak hi.

senses.heading: To form something into a cylinder or ball
senses.definition_en: To shape, wrap, or fold something into a tube, cylinder, or ball.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tube, a sau kim, ahih keileh bawl pianzia suak dingin zial, tuam, ahih keileh bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Roll the paper into a tube.
examples.zomi: Lai pen tube pianzia in zial in.

examples.english: We rolled up the sleeping mats.
examples.zomi: Ihphahte zial hihang.

senses.usage_en: Roll up often means forming something flat into a compact cylindrical shape.
senses.usage_zomi: Roll up cih pen a phei na khat a sau kim pianzia tawh neu takin zial cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Connected with love
senses.definition_en: Connected with love or a close emotional relationship between partners.
senses.zomi_equivalents: itna tawh kisai; itna lungsim nei
senses.explanation_zomi: Nupa ahih keileh itna tawh kizom lungsim nai kizopna tawh kisai ahi hi.

examples.english: They began a romantic relationship.
examples.zomi: Amaute itna kizopna kipan uh hi.

examples.english: He planned a romantic dinner for his wife.
examples.zomi: Ama in a zi a dingin itna tawh zan an nekna geel hi.

senses.usage_en: Romantic refers to partner-like love. It does not normally describe love between parents, children, or ordinary friends.
senses.usage_zomi: Romantic in nupa ahih keileh itna kizopna nei mite’ itna gen hi. Nu leh pa, tate, ahih keileh lawmta ngeina kikal itna gen lo hi.

senses.heading: Creating feelings of love
senses.definition_en: Pleasant or beautiful in a way that encourages feelings of love.
senses.explanation_zomi: Itna lungsim khangsak dingin nuam, kilawm, ahih keileh hoih ahi hi.

examples.english: The restaurant has a romantic atmosphere.
examples.zomi: Annek dawr in itna lungsim khangsak dinmun nei hi.

examples.english: They walked along the beach in the romantic moonlight.
examples.zomi: Amaute itna huai kha khuavak sungah tuipi gei ah lampai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Something romantic may create a loving mood even when it is not itself a relationship.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat kizopna ahi lo zong, itna lungsim a khangsak leh romantic kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Idealistic rather than practical
senses.definition_en: Based on attractive ideas or imagination rather than practical reality.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaihsut suak hoih; a taktak tawh kituaklo
senses.explanation_zomi: A taktak dinmun leh sepzawhna sangin ngaihsut suak hoih leh deihhuai tungah a kinga zaw ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a beisa hun hoih bek mu

examples.english: He had a romantic idea of life in the countryside.
examples.zomi: Ama in khuata nuntakna nuam bek hi ci in ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: The story gives a romantic view of the past.
examples.zomi: Tangthu in a beisa hun pen hoih leh deihhuai bek bangin lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, romantic may suggest that an idea is appealing but not fully realistic.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah romantic in ngaihsutna khat deihhuai napi a taktak dinmun tawh a kituak kicing lo thei cih lak hi.

senses.definition_en: The structure that covers the top of a building or vehicle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn ahih keileh mawtaw tunglam a khuh, guah, ni leh huih pan a dalna ahi hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain damaged the roof.
examples.zomi: Guah tampi in innkhum susia hi.

examples.english: Workers are repairing the school roof.
examples.zomi: Nasemte sang innkhum bawlpha laitak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is roofs, pronounced /ruːfs/, not rooves.
senses.usage_zomi: Roof plural pen roofs ahi a, /ruːfs/ ci in kisim hi; rooves hilo hi.

senses.heading: A separate part of a building
senses.definition_en: A part of a building enclosed by walls and usually entered through a door.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn sungah kulh tawh kikhen a, a tamzaw kongkha pan a kilut inn khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The children are playing in the living room.
examples.zomi: Naupangte innkuan tutkhawmna pindan sungah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: We booked a hotel room for two nights.
examples.zomi: Zan nih a dingin hotel pindan khol hihang.

senses.usage_en: A room is one enclosed part of a building. A bedroom is specifically designed for sleeping.
senses.usage_zomi: Room pen inn sung a kikhen khen khat ahi hi. Bedroom pen ihmutna a dingin a kibawl pindan ahi hi.

senses.heading: Available space
senses.definition_en: Empty or available space for a person, object, or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, ahih keileh sepkhiatna khat a dingin a om mun awng ahi hi.

examples.english: There is not enough room in the car for six people.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw sungah mi guk a dingin mun kicing lo hi.

examples.english: Please make room for the older man.
examples.zomi: Upa pa a dingin mun awng bawl in.

senses.usage_en: Room is uncountable when it means available space: there is enough room, not enough rooms.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun awng a gen ciangin room pen simtheih lo noun ahi hi: mun kicing om cihna ahi a, pindan tampi om cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Opportunity for change or development
senses.definition_en: The possibility or opportunity for improvement, choice, or movement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihsakna, teelna, ahih keileh khantohna a dingin a omlai hamphatna ahi hi.

examples.english: There is still room for improvement.
examples.zomi: Hoihsak theihna omlai hi.

examples.english: The agreement leaves little room for negotiation.
examples.zomi: Thukimna in kikumkik theihna tawm bek nusia hi.

senses.usage_en: This abstract meaning refers to possibility, not physical space.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih ngaihsutna khiatna in pumpi tawh a om mun gen lo a, na khat piangtheihna gen hi.

senses.heading: The underground part of a plant
senses.definition_en: The part of a plant that usually grows below the ground and absorbs water and nutrients.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw lei nuai ah a khang a, tui leh nek ding vanpua a zuup singkung khen ahi hi.

examples.english: The tree has deep roots.
examples.zomi: Singkung in zung thuk nei hi.

examples.english: Plant roots absorb water from the soil.
examples.zomi: Singzungte in lei sungpan tui zu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Roots hold a plant in the ground and absorb water and nutrients.
senses.usage_zomi: Zungte in singkung lei sungah lenkip sak a, tui leh anlakna vanpua zu uh hi.

senses.heading: The origin or basic cause of something
senses.definition_en: The origin, foundation, or main cause from which something develops.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a hong kipatna, a bulpi, ahih keileh a hong pianna hang lianpen ahi hi.

examples.english: We must identify the root cause of the problem.
examples.zomi: Buaina a bul hangthu i thei kul hi.

examples.english: The tradition has deep cultural roots.
examples.zomi: Ngeina pen mihing ngeina sungah zung thuk nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Root cause means the basic cause beneath more visible symptoms or immediate problems.
senses.usage_zomi: Root cause cih pen a langkhat a kilang ciaptehna ahih keileh buaina nai sangin a nuai a om a bul hangthu ahi hi.

senses.heading: A word’s basic form
senses.definition_en: The basic part of a word from which related words are formed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal dangte a kibawlkhia theihna kammal’ a bulpi khen ahi hi.

examples.english: These words come from the same Latin root.
examples.zomi: Hih kammalte Latin kammal bul kibang pan hong pai uh hi.

examples.english: Learning roots can help you understand new vocabulary.
examples.zomi: Kammal bul sinna in kammal thakte tel dingin hong huh thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A root may combine with prefixes or suffixes to form new words.
senses.usage_zomi: Kammal bul pen prefix ahih keileh suffix tawh kizom in kammal thak bawl thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A thick, strong cord made by twisting together many fibres, wires, or strands.
senses.explanation_zomi: Fiber, sik khau, ahih keileh khau neu tampi kihelkhawm in a kibawl khau lian leh thahat ahi hi.

examples.english: They tied the boat to a tree with a rope.
examples.zomi: Amaute in tembaw khau tawh singkungah hen uh hi.

examples.english: The climber checked the rope before climbing.
examples.zomi: Mual kahpa in kah ma in khau enkhol hi.

senses.usage_en: Rope is thicker and stronger than ordinary string.
senses.usage_zomi: Rope pen khau neu ngeina sangin lianzaw leh thahatzaw hi.

senses.heading: Not smooth
senses.definition_en: Having an uneven, hard, or irregular surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: A nal lo, a phei lo, ahih keileh a tung a kingawn leh a kibang lo ahi hi.

examples.english: The road is rough and difficult to drive on.
examples.zomi: Lampi a ngawn a, mawtaw hawl haksa hi.

examples.english: The rock has a rough surface.
examples.zomi: Suangtum tung a ngawn hi.

senses.usage_en: The opposite of rough in this physical sense is smooth.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pumpi tawh khiatna ah rough tawh a kilehbulh pen smooth—a nal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Difficult, unpleasant, or violent
senses.definition_en: Difficult, uncomfortable, stormy, or involving force and violence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksa, nuamlo, huihpi nei, ahih keileh zawhna leh ngongtatna a kihel ahi hi.

examples.english: We had a rough journey through the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi sungah khualzinna haksa tuak hihang.

examples.english: The prisoners received rough treatment.
examples.zomi: Thongkiate ngongtat takin kigo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether rough means physically uneven, difficult, or violent.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangna thu in rough pen a ngawn, a haksa, ahih keileh a ngongtat huai cihna hiam lak hi.

senses.heading: Approximate and not exact
senses.definition_en: Approximate, unfinished, or not calculated in exact detail.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kician kicing lo, a kizawh nailo, ahih keileh kicing takin kisim lo ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you give me a rough estimate of the cost?
examples.zomi: Sum zat ding a puaklam nong gen thei diam?

examples.english: She prepared a rough draft of the report.
examples.zomi: Ama laporan laigelh masapen bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A rough estimate or draft is useful for planning but should not be treated as final or exact.
senses.usage_zomi: Kicianlo tehna ahih keileh laigelh masapen geelna a dingin phatuam napi, a nunungpen ahih keileh a kician hi ci in kizat lo ding hi.

senses.heading: Shaped like a circle or ball
senses.definition_en: Having a circular shape or a curved surface like a ball.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kim pianzia ahih keileh bawl bangin a kual tung nei ahi hi.

examples.english: They sat around a round table.
examples.zomi: Amaute sabuai kim a kimah tu uh hi.

examples.english: The child drew a round shape.
examples.zomi: Naupang in a kim pianzia suai hi.

senses.usage_en: Round often describes ordinary three-dimensional or informal shapes. Circular is more precise and formal for a circle.
senses.usage_zomi: Round in a kim ahih keileh a kual pianzia ngeina gen hi. Circle pianzia kician tak a gen nadingin circular formal leh kicianzaw hi.

senses.heading: Expressed as a convenient whole number
senses.definition_en: Given as a complete, convenient number rather than an exact number containing fractions or small differences.
senses.explanation_zomi: Fraction ahih keileh zat neu tuamte tawh kician takin gen loin sim kicing leh zat baih tawh a kigen ahi hi.

examples.english: Give the answer as a round number.
examples.zomi: Dawnna sim kicing tawh pia in.

examples.english: In round figures, the project cost one million dollars.
examples.zomi: Sim kicing tawh gen leng project in dollar maktaduai khat bang pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A round number is convenient for general communication but may not be exact.
senses.usage_zomi: Sim kicing pen thu gen baihna a dingin phatuam napi, a zat maan taktak hi lo thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A particular way or path used to travel from one place to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat pan mun dangah tun nadingin a kizang lampi ahih keileh paina dan ahi hi.

examples.english: This bus follows a route through the city centre.
examples.zomi: Hih bus khuapi laizang kantan lampi zui hi.

examples.english: We took a different route to avoid traffic.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw kibuaihna pelh nadingin lampi dang zang hihang.

senses.usage_en: In American English, both /ruːt/ and /raʊt/ are used. In British English, /ruːt/ is usual.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah route pen /ruːt/ ahih keileh /raʊt/ ci in kisim thei hi. British English ah /ruːt/ a kizang ngeipen hi.

senses.heading: A regular way of doing things
senses.definition_en: The usual order and method in which someone regularly performs daily activities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in nisim sepkhiatna-te ngeina tawh a bawl a ban leh bawldan ahi hi.

examples.english: Exercise is part of my daily routine.
examples.zomi: Pumpi kisinsakna pen ka nisim ngeina khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The baby’s sleeping routine changed.
examples.zomi: Naungek’ ihmut ngeina kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: A routine creates a regular pattern. It may be helpful and efficient, or it may become boring.
senses.usage_zomi: Routine in ngeina piandan khat bawl hi. Phatuam leh manlang sak thei a, lungduaihuai zong suak thei hi.

senses.heading: A prepared sequence in a performance
senses.definition_en: A prepared series of movements, jokes, or actions performed for an audience or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipite mai ah lak ahih keileh kidemna a dingin kigingsa gamtatna, nuihna thu, ahih keileh sepna a ban ahi hi.

examples.english: The dancers practised their new routine.
examples.zomi: Lamla mite amau’ lam lakna a ban thak kisinsak uh hi.

examples.english: Her gymnastics routine received a high score.
examples.zomi: Ama’ pumpi kimawl lakna in score sang ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: In performance, a routine is a planned sequence, not merely an everyday habit.
senses.usage_zomi: Lakna ah routine pen kigingsa sepkhiatna a ban ahi a, nisim ngeina bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: A straight line of people or things — /roʊ/
senses.definition_en: A number of people or things arranged next to one another in a line.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh van tampi khat leh khat kiangah a ban kicianin a kigualna ahi hi.

examples.english: We sat in the front row.
examples.zomi: A mai gualah tu hihang.

examples.english: A row of trees stood beside the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi gei ah singkungte a banin ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is pronounced /roʊ/.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih a ban ahih keileh a gual khiatna pen /roʊ/ ci in kisim hi.

senses.heading: A noisy argument — /raʊ/
senses.definition_en: A loud and angry argument.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw ngai tak leh hehna tawh kinialna ahi hi.

examples.english: The couple had a row about money.
examples.zomi: Nupa in sum thu tawh kisai nakpi takin kinial uh hi.

examples.english: We heard a loud row next door.
examples.zomi: Inn kiangpan kikona aw ngai za hihang.

senses.usage_en: This British English meaning is pronounced /raʊ/. American English more commonly uses argument or fight.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih British English khiatna pen /raʊ/ ci in kisim hi. American English in argument ahih keileh fight a kizang zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kumpi tawh kisai; kumpi innkuan lam
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpipa, kumpinu, ahih keileh amau’ innkuan tawh kisai ahi hi.

examples.english: The royal family attended the ceremony.
examples.zomi: Kumpi innkuan pawi ah pai uh hi.

examples.english: Visitors toured the royal palace.
examples.zomi: Khualte kumpi innpi en kawikawi uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Royal describes things connected with a monarchy. It does not apply to every national leader.
senses.usage_zomi: Royal in kumpi ukna leh kumpi innkuan tawh kizom nate gen hi. Gam makaipa peuhmah tawh kizang lo hi.

senses.heading: To move something repeatedly against a surface
senses.definition_en: To press something against a surface and move it backwards and forwards.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat mun tungah neng in mainung in kawi suksuk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Rub your hands together to warm them.
examples.zomi: Na khutte lum sak nadingin khat leh khat nawi in.

examples.english: She rubbed the table with a cloth.
examples.zomi: Ama in sabuai puan tawh kawi hi.

senses.usage_en: Rub usually involves repeated movement while maintaining contact with a surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Rub in mun tung tawh kituah paisuak in mainung kawi suksuk cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To apply a substance by rubbing
senses.definition_en: To spread a substance over a surface by pressing and moving your hand or another object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanpua khat mun tungah khut ahih keileh van dang tawh nawi in zut cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Rub the cream gently onto the injured area.
examples.zomi: A liam munah cream nem takin zut in.

examples.english: He rubbed oil into the wood.
examples.zomi: Ama in sing tungah sathau nawi in hel hi.

senses.usage_en: Use rub something on/onto a surface or rub something into a material.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun tungah zut ciangin rub something on/onto kizang a, vanpua sungah a lut dingin nawi ciangin rub something into kizang hi.

senses.heading: A flexible material
senses.definition_en: A strong, flexible material made naturally from latex or artificially from chemicals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam pianpih latex pan ahih keileh chemical tawh kibawl, a kawi theih leh thahat vanpua ahi hi.

examples.english: The workers wore rubber gloves.
examples.zomi: Nasemte rubber khutluk silh uh hi.

examples.english: The seal is made of flexible rubber.
examples.zomi: Tui lutlohna pen a kawi theih rubber tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Rubber is normally uncountable when it refers to the material.
senses.usage_zomi: Vanpua a gen ciangin rubber pen simtheih lo noun bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: An object used to remove pencil marks
senses.definition_en: A small object used for removing marks made by a pencil.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pencil tawh kigelh ciaptehna nolaakna van neu ahi hi.

examples.english: Use a rubber to remove the pencil mark.
examples.zomi: Pencil ciaptehna hem dingin nolaakna zang in.

examples.english: The student borrowed my rubber.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang in ka pencil nolaakna hong la hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is British English. American English uses eraser. In American English, rubber can also have an unrelated informal meaning, so learners should use eraser in the United States.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen British English ahi hi. American English in eraser kizang hi. United States ah rubber in informal khiatna dang zong nei ahih manin eraser zat a hoihzaw hi.

senses.heading: Waste material
senses.definition_en: Unwanted material or objects that have been thrown away.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisam nawnlo ahih keileh zat nawnlo ahih manin a kipai van leh ninsia-te ahi hi.

examples.english: Put the rubbish in the bin.
examples.zomi: Ninsia pen ninsia bawm sungah koih in.

examples.english: The council collects household rubbish every week.
examples.zomi: Khuapi council in kal simin inn sung ninsia kaikhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Rubbish is mainly British English and is normally uncountable. American English commonly uses trash or garbage.
senses.usage_zomi: Rubbish pen British English ahi a, simtheih lo noun bangin kizang hi. American English in trash ahih keileh garbage a kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: Something of very poor quality or something untrue
senses.definition_en: Something considered useless, badly made, foolish, or untrue.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phattuamlo, kibawl hoihlo, haihuai, ahih keileh maanlo na khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The claim that no one was harmed is rubbish.
examples.zomi: Kuamah liam lo cih thu pen maanlo hi.

examples.english: I thought the film was complete rubbish.
examples.zomi: Film pen a hoih hetlo hi ci in ngaihsun ing.

senses.usage_en: This use is informal and can sound insulting. Use it carefully when criticizing someone’s work or opinion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatdan pen informal ahi a, mi simmawh bangin zak thei hi. Mi’ nasep ahih keileh ngaihsutna a kriticize ciangin pilvang takin zat ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Behaving or speaking in a way that is not polite and does not show respect for others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dangte zahtak loin, zahmawhhuai takin a gamta ahih keileh a pau ahi hi.

examples.english: It was rude to interrupt her.
examples.zomi: Ama’ thu khawlsak pen zahmawhhuai hi.

examples.english: The customer was rude to the waiter.
examples.zomi: Vanlei pen annek pia nasempa tungah zahmawhhuai takin gamta hi.

senses.usage_en: Use rude to someone and rude about something. Rude describes impolite behaviour, not merely direct or honest speech.
senses.usage_zomi: Rude to someone leh rude about something cihdan kizang hi. Rude pen zahmawhhuai gamtatna gen a, thu a kicianin ahih keileh thuman takin gen bek pen a gen hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A team sport in which players carry, pass, and kick an oval ball while trying to score points.
senses.zomi_equivalents: rugby kimawlna; bawl pua pawl kimawlna
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawl mite in a sau-kim bawl pua, khat leh khat pia leh khe tawh sut in point ngah ding a kidem pawl kimawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: He plays rugby for his school team.
examples.zomi: Ama a sang pawl a dingin rugby kimawl hi.

examples.english: The rugby match was physically demanding.
examples.zomi: Rugby kidemna in pumpi thahatna tampi kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Rugby differs from American football in its rules, protective equipment, and methods of passing the ball.
senses.usage_zomi: Rugby leh American football-te thukhun, pumpi kepna van leh bawl piakdan ah kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: An instruction that controls behaviour
senses.definition_en: An official or accepted instruction stating what people must, may, or must not do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi-te bang bawl kul, bang bawl thei, ahih keileh bang bawl lo ding cih a gen thuneihna ahih keileh kisang hilhna ahi hi.

examples.english: Every student must follow the school rules.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang khempeuh in sang thukhun-te zui kul uh hi.

examples.english: He was punished for breaking the rule.
examples.zomi: Thukhun palsat hangin gim kipia hi.

senses.usage_en: A rule may belong to a school, organization, game, or household. A law is formally made and enforced by government.
senses.usage_zomi: Rule pen sang, kipawlna, kimawlna, ahih keileh innkuan thukhun hi thei hi. Law pen ukna in formal takin a bawl leh a zuih sak dan ahi hi.

senses.heading: A general principle or usual pattern
senses.definition_en: A general principle, standard, or pattern explaining how something normally happens or should be done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngeina tawh koibangin a piang ahih keileh a kibawl ding cih a hilh thukhun bulpi ahih keileh piandan ahi hi.

examples.english: This grammar rule has several exceptions.
examples.zomi: Hih grammar thukhun tawh a kituaklo tuamna pawlkhat om hi.

examples.english: As a general rule, arrive ten minutes early.
examples.zomi: Thukhun ngeina in minute sawm manawh in tung in.

senses.usage_en: A general rule describes what is normally true; it may allow exceptions.
senses.usage_zomi: General rule in ngeina tawh a maan thu gen a, a tuam in kituaklo na om thei hi.

senses.heading: A period or system of governing
senses.definition_en: Control or government by a particular person, group, or political system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, ahih keileh politics system khat in gam ahih keileh mipite a ukna ahi hi.

examples.english: The country returned to civilian rule.
examples.zomi: Gam pen mipite ukna ah ciahkik hi.

examples.english: The region remained under military rule.
examples.zomi: Gam khen pen galkap ukna nuai ah om paisuak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this political sense, rule is usually uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih politics khiatna ah rule pen simtheih lo noun bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: To move quickly on foot
senses.definition_en: To move on foot faster than walking, with both feet sometimes off the ground.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampai sangin manlangzaw in khe tawh tai a, hun pawlkhat khe nihgel leitung a lawk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She runs five kilometres every morning.
examples.zomi: Ama zing simin kilometre nga tai hi.

examples.english: The child ran toward his mother.
examples.zomi: Naupang a nu lamah tai hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense of run is ran. The past participle is run: she ran yesterday; she has run today.
senses.usage_zomi: Run past tense pen ran ahi a, past participle pen run ahi hi: zani ama tai hi; tuni ama tai khin hi.

senses.heading: To operate or function
senses.definition_en: To operate or continue functioning, especially for a machine, engine, system, or programme.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khawl, engine, system, ahih keileh programme khat sem ahih keileh gamta paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The engine is running smoothly.
examples.zomi: Engine hoih takin gamta hi.

examples.english: This program will not run on my computer.
examples.zomi: Hih programme ka computer tungah gamta lo hi.

senses.usage_en: A machine runs when it operates. A person may run a program by starting or using it.
senses.usage_zomi: Khawl khat a gamtat ciangin runs kici hi. Mi khat in programme a hon ahih keileh a zat ciangin runs a program kici hi.

senses.heading: To manage an organization or activity
senses.definition_en: To manage, control, or organize a business, organization, project, or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumvai nasep, kipawlna, project, ahih keileh pawi khat uk, vaihawm, ahih keileh makaih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She runs a small restaurant.
examples.zomi: Ama annek dawr neu khat vaihawm hi.

examples.english: Volunteers run the community programme.
examples.zomi: Sumlo nasemte in khuamite programme makaih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: To run an organization means to manage its regular work, not physically move with it.
senses.usage_zomi: Kipawlna khat run cih pen a nisim nasep vaihawm cihna ahi a, tua kipawlna tawh tai cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: To continue or extend
senses.definition_en: To continue for a particular time or extend in a particular direction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ciangtansa sung om paisuak ahih keileh lam khat zuanin sau pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The course runs from January to June.
examples.zomi: Sinna January pan June dong om hi.

examples.english: The road runs along the river.
examples.zomi: Lampi gun gei zui in sau pai hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is used for schedules, roads, borders, lines, and other things that continue through time or space.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen hungeel, lampi, gamgi, line leh hun ahih keileh mun sungah a om paisuak nate tawh kizang hi.

senses.heading: To flow
senses.definition_en: To flow or move continuously like water, another liquid, or tears.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui, tui dang, ahih keileh mittui bangin tawl loin luang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Water was running down the wall.
examples.zomi: Kulh tungah tui luang hi.

examples.english: Tears ran down her face.
examples.zomi: Ama’ maitangah mittui luang hi.

senses.usage_en: When a tap is running, water is flowing from it.
senses.usage_zomi: Tui kong running kici leh tua pan tui luang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A person who runs
senses.definition_en: A person who runs for exercise, sport, or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi kisinsakna, kimawlna, ahih keileh kidemna a dingin a tai mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a long-distance runner.
examples.zomi: Ama gamla tai mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The fastest runner won the race.
examples.zomi: Taimi manlangpen in tai kidemna zo hi.

senses.usage_en: A runner may run professionally, competitively, or simply for health and enjoyment.
senses.usage_zomi: Runner pen profession, kidemna, ahih keileh cidamna leh nuamna a dingin tai thei hi.

senses.heading: A person who carries messages or goods
senses.definition_en: A person whose job is to carry messages, documents, food, or goods between places.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thupuak pua mi; van pua nasem
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat leh khat kikal ah thupuak, lai, annek, ahih keileh van a pua nasem ahi hi.

examples.english: The restaurant employs a runner to carry food to tables.
examples.zomi: Annek dawr in sabuaite tungah annek pua ding nasem khat nei hi.

examples.english: A runner delivered the documents to the office.
examples.zomi: Lai pua mi khat in laite zungah tun hi.

senses.usage_en: This occupational sense depends on context and does not necessarily mean that the person literally runs.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nasepna khiatna pen a kizangna dinmun tungah kinga a, tua mi a taktak in tai cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: The activity or sport of running
senses.definition_en: The activity or sport of moving quickly on foot.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe tawh manlang takin taihna sepkhiatna ahih keileh kimawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: Running is good exercise for many people.
examples.zomi: Taihna pen mi tampi a dingin pumpi kisinsakna hoih ahi hi.

examples.english: She goes running every morning.
examples.zomi: Ama zing simin tai dingin pai hi.

senses.usage_en: Running is normally uncountable when it refers to the general activity or sport.
senses.usage_zomi: Taihna sepkhiatna ahih keileh kimawlna buppi a gen ciangin running pen simtheih lo noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: The management or operation of something
senses.definition_en: The activity of managing or operating a business, organization, machine, or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumvai nasep, kipawlna, khawl, ahih keileh pawi khat vaihawm leh gamtasakna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is responsible for the daily running of the office.
examples.zomi: Ama zung nisim vaihawmna mawhpuakna nei hi.

examples.english: The running costs of the building are high.
examples.zomi: Inn zat paisuakna sum zat sang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, running refers to keeping something operating or managing its ordinary activities.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah running pen na khat gamta paisuak sak ahih keileh a ngeina nasep vaihawm cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to the countryside, farming areas, or places outside towns and cities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuapi leh khua lian pualam khuata, lo neihna gam, ahih keileh gamlak mun tawh kisai ahi hi.

examples.english: Many rural communities depend on farming.
examples.zomi: Khuata khuamite tampi lo neihna tungah kinga uh hi.

examples.english: The programme improves health care in rural areas.
examples.zomi: Programme in khuata munte ah zatui kepna hoihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Rural is the opposite of urban. Rural places have fewer buildings and lower population density than cities.
senses.usage_zomi: Rural tawh a kilehbulh pen urban ahi hi. Khuata munte khuapi sangin inn leh mihing tawmzaw hi.

senses.heading: To move or act very quickly
senses.definition_en: To move or do something with great speed, often because there is little time.
senses.zomi_equivalents: manlang takin pai; manlang takin sem
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun a tawm ahih manin a manlang mahmah in kalsuan ahih keileh sem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She rushed to the hospital after receiving the call.
examples.zomi: Phone a ngah khit ciangin zatui innah manlang takin pai hi.

examples.english: Do not rush while completing the form.
examples.zomi: Form na bawl laitakin manlangluat kei in.

senses.usage_en: Rushing may save time, but it can also cause mistakes or unsafe behaviour.
senses.usage_zomi: Manlang takin gamtat in hun ngahsak thei napi, khialhna ahih keileh bitlo gamtatna piangsak thei hi.

senses.heading: To take someone or something somewhere urgently
senses.definition_en: To carry or send someone or something somewhere very quickly because the situation is urgent.
senses.zomi_equivalents: manlang takin pua; kin takin sawl
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kin mahmah ahih manin mi ahih keileh na khat mun dangah manlang takin pua ahih keileh sawl cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat zatui innah manlang takin pua
huhna van mun khat ah kin takin sawl
zatui tawh ki-at dingin manlang takin kipua

examples.english: They rushed the injured man to hospital.
examples.zomi: Mi liam zatui innah manlang takin pua uh hi.

examples.english: Emergency supplies were rushed to the flooded area.
examples.zomi: Tui liim munah huhna van kin takin kisawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This transitive sense takes an object: rush someone to hospital; rush supplies to a disaster area.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih transitive khiatna ah object nei hi: mi khat zatui innah manlang takin pua; siatna munah huhna van kin takin sawl.

senses.heading: To do something without enough care or preparation
senses.definition_en: To make a decision or complete an action too quickly and without sufficient thought or preparation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: manlangluat in bawl; ngaihsun loin sem
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna ahih keileh kigingna kicing loin khensat ahih keileh sepna khat manlangluat in bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not rush the decision.
examples.zomi: Khensatna manlangluat in bawl kei in.

examples.english: He rushed into the agreement without reading it.
examples.zomi: Thukimna sim loin manlangluat in thukim hi.

senses.usage_en: Rush into something often warns that a person acted before fully considering the risks or consequences.
senses.usage_zomi: Rush into something in mi khat in lauhuaina leh a gah ngaihsun kicing ma in a gamta cih vauna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Feeling unhappy
senses.definition_en: Feeling unhappy, especially because something unpleasant has happened or someone has been lost.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu nuamlo khat a piang ahih keileh mi khat a kimansuah hangin lungkham leh dah a om ahi hi.

examples.english: She felt sad when her friend moved away.
examples.zomi: A lawmpa mun dangah a kisuan ciangin ama dah hi.

examples.english: The children were sad to hear the news.
examples.zomi: Naupangte thuthak a zak uh ciangin dah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Sad describes a person’s feeling or something that causes that feeling.
senses.usage_zomi: Sad in mi khat’ lungsim omdan ahih keileh tua lungsim a piangsak na khat gen hi.

senses.heading: Unfortunate or regrettable
senses.definition_en: Unfortunate, disappointing, or deserving sympathy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hamphat lo, lungkimhuai lo, ahih keileh lainat huai ahi hi.

examples.english: It is sad that many children cannot attend school.
examples.zomi: Naupang tampi sang kai theilo uh cih dahhuai hi.

examples.english: The story has a sad ending.
examples.zomi: Tangthu in a tawpna dahhuai nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, sad evaluates a situation rather than describing one person’s emotion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah sad in mi khat’ lungsim bek gen loin, dinmun khat dahhuai cih thukhensia hi.

senses.heading: In an unhappy way
senses.definition_en: In a way that shows unhappiness or sorrow.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dahna ahih keileh lungkhamna a kilang takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She smiled sadly and said goodbye.
examples.zomi: Ama dah takin nui in mangpha ci hi.

examples.english: He looked sadly at the empty house.
examples.zomi: Ama in inn awng dah takin en hi.

senses.usage_en: Sadly can describe how an action is performed.
senses.usage_zomi: Sadly in sepna khat dahna tawh koibangin kibawl cih gen hi.

senses.heading: Unfortunately
senses.definition_en: Used to show that the speaker considers a fact or situation unfortunate.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thugenpa in thu khat hamphat lo ahih keileh dahhuai a sakna lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Sadly, the programme had to be cancelled.
examples.zomi: Dahhuai takin programme susia kul hi.

examples.english: The old building is sadly no longer safe.
examples.zomi: Dahhuai takin inn lui pen bit nawnlo hi.

senses.usage_en: When sadly comments on a whole sentence, it is often placed at the beginning and followed by a comma.
senses.usage_zomi: Sadly in sentence buppi thukhensia leh a tamzaw sentence kipatna ah kikoih a, a nungah comma kizang hi.

senses.heading: Protected from danger
senses.definition_en: Protected from danger, harm, injury, loss, or attack.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina, siatna, liamna, mansuahna, ahih keileh gal dona pan a kikem ahi hi.

examples.english: The children are safe inside the building.
examples.zomi: Naupangte inn sungah bit uh hi.

examples.english: Wear a seat belt to keep yourself safe.
examples.zomi: Nangmah bit nadingin tokhom khau hen in.

senses.usage_en: Use safe from before a danger: safe from fire. Use safe for before the person who can use something without harm: safe for children.
senses.usage_zomi: Lauhuaina mai ah safe from kizang a, na khat bit takin zangthei mi mai ah safe for kizang hi.

senses.heading: Not likely to cause harm
senses.definition_en: Not dangerous and not likely to cause injury, damage, or illness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuai lo a, liamna, kisiatna, ahih keileh natna piangsak ding a kicing lo ahi hi.

examples.english: The water is safe to drink.
examples.zomi: Tui pen dawn dingin bit hi.

examples.english: This medicine is safe for most adults.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui pen picing mi a tamzaw a dingin bit hi.

senses.usage_en: Safe does not always mean completely free from risk; it may mean that the remaining risk is acceptably low.
senses.usage_zomi: Safe cih pen lauhuaina om hetlo cihna pahpah hilo a, a omlai lauhuaina sangtheih zahin niam cihna hi thei hi.

senses.heading: Certain not to be lost or defeated
senses.definition_en: In a position where success, possession, or survival is nearly certain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzawhna, neihna, ahih keileh kepkhitna mansuah ding a om nawnlo deuh dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The team has a safe lead.
examples.zomi: Pawl in makaihna kician nei hi.

examples.english: Your documents are safe in this cabinet.
examples.zomi: Na laite hih bawm sungah bit hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether safe refers to physical protection, secure possession, or likely success.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangna thu in safe pen pumpi bitna, neihsa kepbitna, ahih keileh gualzawhna kicianna hiam cih lak hi.

senses.definition_en: The condition of being protected from danger, injury, damage, or loss.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina, liamna, kisiatna, ahih keileh mansuahna pan a kikem dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: Workers must follow the safety rules.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in bitna thukhun zui kul uh hi.

examples.english: The road was closed for public safety.
examples.zomi: Mipite bitna a dingin lampi kikhak hi.

senses.usage_en: Safety is normally uncountable when it refers to protection generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Kepbitna buppi a gen ciangin safety pen simtheih lo noun bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: To travel by boat or ship
senses.definition_en: To travel across water in a boat or ship.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tembaw tawh pai; tui tungah khualzin
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui tungah tembaw ahih keileh tembaw lian tawh khualzin cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: tuipi lian kantan in tembaw tawh pai
tuigei zui in tembaw tawh pai

examples.english: The ship sailed across the Atlantic Ocean.
examples.zomi: Tembaw lian Atlantic Tuipi Lian kantan in pai hi.

examples.english: We sailed along the coast for two days.
examples.zomi: Ni nih sung tuigei zui in tembaw tawh pai hihang.

senses.usage_en: Sail can be used for travel on many kinds of ships, even when the ship does not use sails.
senses.usage_zomi: Tembaw in puanzam zang lo zong, tui tung a tembaw tawh khualzinna a gen ciangin sail kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: To control a sailing boat
senses.definition_en: To control a boat that is moved mainly by the wind acting on its sails.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huih in a puanzam a nawtna tawh a kalsuan tembaw uk leh hawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She learned to sail when she was young.
examples.zomi: Ama naupang lai in puanzam tembaw hawl ding sin hi.

examples.english: He sailed the boat safely into the harbour.
examples.zomi: Ama in tembaw bit takin tembaw dinna sungah hawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In this transitive sense, sail takes a boat or ship as its object.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih transitive khiatna ah tembaw ahih keileh tembaw lian pen sail object ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity or sport of travelling in or controlling a sailing boat.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puanzam tembaw tawh khualzin ahih keileh tua tembaw ukna sepkhiatna leh kimawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: They went sailing on the lake.
examples.zomi: Amaute tuidil tungah tembaw hawl dingin pai uh hi.

examples.english: Sailing requires knowledge of wind and weather.
examples.zomi: Tembaw hawlna in huih leh khuahun theihna kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Sailing may be a recreational activity, a competitive sport, or a way of travelling.
senses.usage_zomi: Sailing pen nuamna a ding sepkhiatna, kidem kimawlna, ahih keileh khualzinna hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who works on a ship or operates a sailing boat.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tembaw lian tungah a sem ahih keileh puanzam tembaw a hawl mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The sailors prepared the ship for the journey.
examples.zomi: Tembaw nasemte in khualzinna a dingin tembaw lian kigingsak uh hi.

examples.english: She is an experienced sailor.
examples.zomi: Ama tembaw hawl pilna nei mi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A sailor may be a professional ship worker, a naval service member, or someone who sails for sport.
senses.usage_zomi: Sailor pen tembaw tung professional nasem, tuipi galkap, ahih keileh kimawlna a dingin tembaw hawl mi hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A cold dish made mainly from raw or cooked vegetables, fruit, pasta, or other ingredients mixed together.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw anthang hel ahih keileh kihuan, gah, pasta, leh annek dang kihelkhawm in a kibawl an vot ahi hi.

examples.english: She made a salad with tomatoes and onions.
examples.zomi: Ama tomato leh purunsan tawh salad bawl hi.

examples.english: I ordered soup and a small salad.
examples.zomi: Thuk leh salad neu khat ngen ing.

senses.usage_en: Salad can be countable when referring to one prepared dish and uncountable when referring to it as food generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Salad kuang khat kician a gen ciangin simtheih noun ahi a, annek nam buppi a gen ciangin simtheih lo noun hi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A fixed amount of money regularly paid to an employee, usually expressed as a yearly amount.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasem khat tungah ngeina tawh a kipiak sum kipsa, a tamzaw kum khat a ngah zat in a kigen thaman ahi hi.

examples.english: Her annual salary is fifty thousand dollars.
examples.zomi: Ama’ kum khat thaman dollar tul sawmnga ahi hi.

examples.english: The company increased employee salaries.
examples.zomi: Kampani in nasemte’ thaman khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: A salary is usually fixed and calculated yearly or monthly. A wage is often calculated by the hour, day, or week.
senses.usage_zomi: Salary pen a tamzaw kipsa a, kum ahih keileh kha tawh kisim hi. Wage ahihleh nai, ni, ahih keileh kal tawh kisim zel hi.

senses.heading: The act of selling something
senses.definition_en: An occasion or process in which goods, property, or services are sold for money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, neihsa, ahih keileh nasepna sum tawh a kizukna ahih keileh zuakna sepzia ahi hi.

examples.english: The sale of the house was completed yesterday.
examples.zomi: Inn zuakna zani in kizawh hi.

examples.english: The company reported an increase in car sales.
examples.zomi: Kampani in mawtaw zuakna khang cih laporan pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Sale is the noun; sell is the verb: the sale of a car; they sell cars.
senses.usage_zomi: Sale pen noun ahi a, sell pen verb ahi hi: mawtaw zuakna; amaute mawtaw zuak uh hi.

senses.heading: A period when goods are sold at lower prices
senses.definition_en: A period or event during which a shop sells goods at reduced prices.
senses.zomi_equivalents: man kiam zuakna; vanman kiam pawi
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawr khat in vanman kiamsak in van a zuak hun ahih keileh pawi ahi hi.

examples.english: The shoes are on sale this week.
examples.zomi: Hih kal sungin khedapte man kiamsa in kizuk hi.

examples.english: I bought the coat at the winter sale.
examples.zomi: Khuahun vot man kiam zuakna ah puanlum lei ing.

senses.usage_en: In American English, on sale usually means offered at a reduced price. In British English, it may also mean simply available to buy.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah on sale in man kiamsa in kizuk cihna nei zel hi. British English ah leitheih dingin om cihna zong nei thei hi.

senses.heading: The number or value of goods sold
senses.definition_en: The number or total value of products or services sold by a business.
senses.zomi_equivalents: van zuak zat; van zuakna sum
senses.explanation_zomi: Sumvai nasep khat in a zuak van ahih keileh nasepna zat leh a man a vekpi ahi hi.

examples.english: Online sales increased last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa in online van zuakna khang hi.

examples.english: The company’s sales reached one million dollars.
examples.zomi: Kampani’ van zuakna dollar maktaduai khat tung hi.

senses.usage_en: This business meaning is commonly plural: sales increased; annual sales.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih sumvai khiatna pen plural sales in a kizang mahmah hi: van zuakna khang; kum khat van zuakna.

senses.definition_en: A white substance used to add flavour to food and preserve it, consisting mainly of sodium chloride.
senses.explanation_zomi: An limsak leh kem nading a kizang, a tamzaw sodium chloride tawh kibawl vanpua kang ahi hi.

examples.english: Add a little salt to the soup.
examples.zomi: Thuk sungah ci tawmkhat beh in.

examples.english: Too much salt may be harmful to health.
examples.zomi: Ci tamluat cidamna a dingin a hoih lo thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Salt is normally uncountable. Use expressions such as some salt, a little salt, or a spoonful of salt.
senses.usage_zomi: Salt pen simtheih lo noun ahi hi. Some salt, a little salt, ahih keileh a spoonful of salt cihdan kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Exactly alike, unchanged, or referring to one particular person or thing rather than different ones.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibang lian, kikhel lo, ahih keileh na dang hilo in tua mi ahih keileh tua na mah a gen ahi hi.

examples.english: We arrived at the same time.
examples.zomi: Hun kibangin tung hihang.

examples.english: The two answers are exactly the same.
examples.zomi: Dawnna nih a kibang lian hi.

senses.usage_en: Same is normally used with the: the same book, the same day. Use the same as, not the same with.
senses.usage_zomi: Same mai ah the kizang zel hi: the same book, the same day. Etkakna ah the same as kizang a, the same with a kizang lo hi.

senses.heading: A small amount showing what the whole is like
senses.definition_en: A small amount or example taken from a larger quantity so that it can be examined or tested.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na tampi sungpan a vekpi omdan theih nadingin et ahih keileh sittel ding a kilak khen neu khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The nurse collected a blood sample.
examples.zomi: Nurse in sisan sittelna ding lak hi.

examples.english: The company gave customers a free sample.
examples.zomi: Kampani in vanleite man lo ettonna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A sample should be representative if it is used to draw conclusions about a larger group or quantity.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawl ahih keileh zat lianzaw thu khensia nading a kizang leh sample in a vekpi omdan a laktheih dingin kilawm kul hi.

senses.heading: A group selected for research
senses.definition_en: A smaller group selected from a larger population for a study or survey.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zongkholna ahih keileh thudotna a dingin mihing pawl lianzaw sungpan a kiteel pawl neu khat ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a vekpi a lakthei etton pawl

examples.english: The study used a sample of five hundred adults.
examples.zomi: Zongkholna in picing mi zanga etton pawl in zang hi.

examples.english: The sample was too small to support a firm conclusion.
examples.zomi: Thukhupna kiptak panpih dingin etton pawl neu luat hi.

senses.usage_en: In research, the quality of the sample affects how confidently findings can be applied to the wider population.
senses.usage_zomi: Zongkholna ah sample hoihdan in muhkhiatna pen mihing pawl zaizaw tungah bangzah muan takin zat theih ding cih huzaap hi.

senses.heading: A short piece of music or sound reused in another recording
