senses.definition_en: A short section of recorded music or sound copied and used in a new recording.
senses.zomi_equivalents: aw laksa khen tom; la khen etton
senses.explanation_zomi: La ahih keileh aw laksa sungpan khen tom khat la in aw lakna thak sungah a kizat ahi hi.

examples.english: The song uses a sample from an older recording.
examples.zomi: La in aw laksa lui sungpan khen tom khat zang hi.

examples.english: The producer obtained permission to use the sample.
examples.zomi: La bawlpa in aw laksa khen zatna phalna ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Using a copyrighted sample may require permission from the rights holder.
senses.usage_zomi: Copyright nei aw laksa khen zat nadingin a neipa tungpan phalna kisam thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Very small grains of rock found on beaches, in deserts, and in some soil.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuigei, sehnelgam leh lei pawlkhat sungah a kimuh suangci neu mahmah-te ahi hi.

examples.english: The children played in the sand.
examples.zomi: Naupangte sehnel sungah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: Wind carried sand across the road.
examples.zomi: Huih in sehnel lampi kantanin pua hi.

senses.usage_en: Sand is normally uncountable. One tiny piece is a grain of sand.
senses.usage_zomi: Sand pen simtheih lo noun ahi hi. Sehnelci neu khat pen a grain of sand kici hi.

senses.definition_en: Food consisting of meat, cheese, vegetables, or another filling placed between two pieces of bread.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tanghou khen nih kikal ah sa, cheese, anthang, ahih keileh an dang a kikoih annek ahi hi.

examples.english: I made a chicken sandwich for lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun an a dingin aksa sandwich khat bawl ing.

examples.english: She put tomatoes and cheese in the sandwich.
examples.zomi: Ama in sandwich sungah tomato leh cheese koih hi.

senses.usage_en: The word is commonly pronounced /ˈsænwɪtʃ/ or /ˈsændwɪtʃ/; the first pronunciation is very common in American speech.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kammal /ˈsænwɪtʃ/ ahih keileh /ˈsændwɪtʃ/ ci in kisim thei a, American kihona ah /ˈsænwɪtʃ/ a kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: A natural object that moves around a planet
senses.definition_en: A natural object in space that travels around a planet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vannuai sungah leitung ahih keileh planet khat a kim a vel gam pianpih van ahi hi.

examples.english: The Moon is Earth’s natural satellite.
examples.zomi: Kha pen leitung’ gam pianpih satellite ahi hi.

examples.english: Some planets have many satellites.
examples.zomi: Planet pawlkhat in satellite tampi nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Earth has one natural satellite: the Moon.
senses.usage_zomi: Leitung in gam pianpih satellite khat nei a, tua pen Kha ahi hi.

senses.heading: A human-made object sent into space
senses.definition_en: A machine sent into space to travel around Earth or another body and collect or transmit information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung ahih keileh van dang a kim vel in thu kaikhawm ahih keileh sawl dingin mihing in vanlai a a sawl khawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The satellite sends weather data to Earth.
examples.zomi: Satellite in khuahun data leitungah hong sawl hi.

examples.english: Satellite images showed the path of the storm.
examples.zomi: Satellite limte in huihpi paina lampi lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Artificial satellites support communication, navigation, weather forecasting, mapping, and scientific research.
senses.usage_zomi: Mihing bawl satellite-te kizopna, lampi kawhna, khuahun theihkholhna, gamlim bawlna leh science zongkholna panpih uh hi.

senses.heading: Pleased because expectations were met
senses.definition_en: Pleased because something was as good as expected or because a need was met.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat kilamen bangin a hoih ahih keileh kisapna picing ahih manin lungkim ahi hi.

examples.english: The customer was satisfied with the service.
examples.zomi: Vanlei pen nasepna tawh lungkim hi.

examples.english: I am not completely satisfied with the result.
examples.zomi: A gah tawh a picingin lungkim lo ing.

senses.usage_en: Use satisfied with before the thing that meets expectations: satisfied with the service.
senses.usage_zomi: Kilamenna a picing sak na mai ah satisfied with kizang hi: nasepna tawh lungkim.

senses.heading: Convinced that something is true or acceptable
senses.definition_en: Convinced after examining evidence that something is true, correct, or acceptable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci enkhol khit ciangin thu khat maan, dik, ahih keileh sangtheih hi ci in kipsak ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: thukhenna inn in a maan ci in kipsak

examples.english: The inspector was satisfied that the building was safe.
examples.zomi: Enkholpa in inn bit hi ci in kipsak hi.

examples.english: The court was not satisfied with the evidence.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna inn teci tawh lungkim lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal meaning is common in legal, investigative, and official contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna pen dan, zongkholna leh thuneihna tawh kisai dinmunte ah kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: To please someone by meeting expectations
senses.definition_en: To please someone by providing what they wanted, needed, or expected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ deihna, kisapna, ahih keileh lametna picing sak in lungkim sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The product satisfied most customers.
examples.zomi: Van in vanlei a tamzaw lungkim sak hi.

examples.english: This meal should satisfy your hunger.
examples.zomi: Hih annek in na gilkialna picing sak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Satisfy means meeting a need or expectation; it does not always mean creating strong happiness.
senses.usage_zomi: Satisfy cih pen kisapna ahih keileh lametna picing sak cihna ahi a, lungdamna lian piangsak cihna pahpah hilo hi.

senses.heading: To meet a rule, condition, or standard
senses.definition_en: To meet or fulfil a requirement, condition, standard, or demand.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisapna, dinmun, tehna, ahih keileh phutna khat picing sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Applicants must satisfy all legal requirements.
examples.zomi: Ngenna bawlte dan kisapna khempeuh picing sak kul uh hi.

examples.english: The product satisfies international safety standards.
examples.zomi: Van in leitung bup bitna tehna-te picing sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal meaning is common in law, education, engineering, and official procedures.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna pen dan, sang pilna, engineering leh thuneihna sepzia-te ah kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: To remove doubt by giving evidence
senses.definition_en: To convince someone by giving enough evidence or explanation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci ahih keileh hilhcian kicing pia in mi khat’ lunghianna hemkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The evidence satisfied the committee that no law had been broken.
examples.zomi: Teci in dan palsatna omlo hi ci in committee kipsak hi.

examples.english: Her explanation did not satisfy me.
examples.zomi: Ama’ hilhcian in ka lunghianna hemkhia lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, satisfy means providing enough proof for someone to accept a conclusion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah satisfy pen thukhupna khat sangtheih nadingin teci kicing pia cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The day of the week after Friday and before Sunday.
senses.explanation_zomi: Friday ni nung leh Sunday ni ma a om kal sung ni khat ahi hi.

examples.english: We will meet on Saturday.
examples.zomi: Kiginni in kimu ding hihang.

examples.english: The library closes early on Saturdays.
examples.zomi: Lai laakna inn Kiginni simin manawh takin khak hi.

senses.usage_en: Days of the week begin with a capital letter in English: Saturday, not saturday.
senses.usage_zomi: English laigelhna ah kal sung nite capital letter tawh kipan hi: Saturday kici a, saturday hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A thick or liquid food served with another food to add flavour or moisture.
senses.explanation_zomi: An dang limsak ahih keileh a ta sak nadingin tawh a kinek tui bang ahih keileh a thuk anbeh ahi hi.

examples.english: The pasta is served with tomato sauce.
examples.zomi: Pasta pen tomato sauce tawh kipiak hi.

examples.english: This sauce is too spicy for me.
examples.zomi: Hih sauce kei a dingin a kha luat hi.

senses.usage_en: Sauce is usually uncountable when referring to one type generally, but countable when comparing different prepared sauces.
senses.usage_zomi: Sauce nam khat buppi a gen ciangin simtheih lo noun ahi a, sauce nam tuamtuam a kietkak ciangin simtheih noun hi thei hi.

senses.heading: To rescue or protect from danger
senses.definition_en: To prevent someone or something from dying, being injured, being damaged, or being lost.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat sihna, liamna, kisiatna, ahih keileh mangna pan gum cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The firefighter saved the child’s life.
examples.zomi: Meithalhpa in naupang’ nuntakna gum hi.

examples.english: Quick action saved the building from serious damage.
examples.zomi: Gamtatna manlang in inn kisiatna lian pan gum hi.

senses.usage_en: Save can mean rescuing from immediate danger or protecting against future harm.
senses.usage_zomi: Save in tu laitak lauhuaina pan gum ahih keileh mailam siatna pan kem cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: To keep money or resources for future use
senses.definition_en: To keep money, time, energy, food, or another resource instead of spending or using it now.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, hun, thahatna, annek, ahih keileh neihsa dang tu in zang loin mailam a dingin khol cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She saves part of her salary each month.
examples.zomi: Ama kha simin a thaman khen khat khol hi.

examples.english: Online banking can save time.
examples.zomi: Online bank zatna in hun khol thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Save money may mean keeping it for later or paying less for something. Context shows which meaning is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Save money in mailam dingin sum khol ahih keileh van khat a dingin sum tawmzaw pia cihna nei thei hi. A kizangna thu in khiatna lak hi.

senses.heading: To store digital information
senses.definition_en: To store a document, file, image, or other digital information so that it can be used later.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, file, lim, ahih keileh digital thu mailam a zat theih nadingin computer ahih keileh kholna munah kem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Remember to save the document.
examples.zomi: Lai kem ding mangngilh kei in.

examples.english: The program automatically saves your changes.
examples.zomi: Programme in na kikhelna-te amah leh amah kem hi.

senses.usage_en: Saving a file stores its current version. Creating a backup keeps an additional copy in case the original is lost or damaged.
senses.usage_zomi: File save in tu laitak version kem hi. Backup bawl cih pen a bul file mang ahih keileh sia khak leh zat ding copy dang khat kem cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To prevent a goal in sport
senses.definition_en: To stop a ball from entering the goal and prevent the other team from scoring.
senses.zomi_equivalents: goal lut ding khaktan; point ngah ding khaktan
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna ah pawl dang point ngah lo dingin bawl goal sung a lut ding khaktan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The goalkeeper saved the final shot.
examples.zomi: Goal vengpa in a nunungpen bawl sut goal lut ding khaktan hi.

examples.english: She saved three penalties during the match.
examples.zomi: Kidemna sungah penalty thum goal lut ding khaktan hi.

senses.usage_en: In football and similar sports, the goalkeeper saves a shot; the noun is a save.
senses.usage_zomi: Football leh kimawlna kibang ah goalkeeper in bawl sut saves a, noun pen a save kici hi.

senses.heading: A reduction in money, time, or resources used
senses.definition_en: An amount of money, time, energy, or another resource that is not spent or used because of a change or improvement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhelna ahih keileh hoihsakna khat hangin a kizanglo sum, hun, thahatna, ahih keileh neihsa zat ahi hi.

examples.english: The new system produced a significant cost saving.
examples.zomi: System thak in sum zat kiamna lian piangsak hi.

examples.english: Buying in bulk may result in a saving.
examples.zomi: Tamtak lei khawmna in sum khol zawhna piangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A countable saving is one reduction. The plural savings can mean several reductions or money kept for future use.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtheih saving pen kiamna khat ahi hi. Plural savings in kiamna tampi ahih keileh mailam ding sum kholsa gen thei hi.

senses.heading: The act of keeping money for the future
senses.definition_en: The practice or process of keeping money instead of spending it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum zangkhia loin mailam kisapna a dingin kholna ngeina ahih keileh sepzia ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: nasep tawpsan hun ding sum kholna

examples.english: Regular saving can improve financial security.
examples.zomi: Ngeina tawh sum kholna in sumvai bitna hoihsak thei hi.

examples.english: She began saving for a house.
examples.zomi: Inn khat a dingin sum khol kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: The activity is often expressed with the -ing form: saving money. Money already accumulated is normally called savings.
senses.usage_zomi: Sepkhiatna pen saving money ci in kigen zel hi. Kholkhawm khin sum pen a tamzaw savings kici hi.

senses.heading: To speak words
senses.definition_en: To speak words in order to express information, an opinion, a feeling, or a question.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, ngaihsutna, lungsim, ahih keileh dotna khat pulaak nadingin kammal pau cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She said that she was tired.
examples.zomi: Ama gim hi ci in gen hi.

examples.english: What did he say to you?
examples.zomi: Ama in nang tungah bang gen hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use say something to someone: she said hello to me. Use tell someone something: she told me the news.
senses.usage_zomi: Say something to someone cihdan kizang hi: ama in kei tungah salam pia hi. Tell someone something cihdan zong kizang hi: ama in kei thuthak hong hilh hi.

senses.heading: To give information in writing or symbols
senses.definition_en: To show or communicate information in writing, numbers, signs, or another non-spoken form.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laigelh, sim, ciaptehna, ahih keileh pau hilo forma dang tawh thu lak ahih keileh pulaak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The sign says “No Parking.”
examples.zomi: Ciaptehna tungah “Mawtaw koih lo ding” ci in kigelh hi.

examples.english: The report says that prices are rising.
examples.zomi: Laporan in vanman sangto ci in gen hi.

senses.usage_en: English allows documents, signs, clocks, and labels to say something even though they do not literally speak.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah lai, ciaptehna, nai tehna leh label-te in a taktak in pau lo napi thu khat say—gen ci in kigen thei hi.

senses.heading: To express an opinion or make a suggestion
senses.definition_en: To state an opinion, judgment, estimate, or suggestion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, thukhensiana, tehna, ahih keileh thuhilhna khat gen cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat a hoih ci in gen

examples.english: I would say the plan is realistic.
examples.zomi: Kei ngaihsutna in geelna pen sepzawh ding hi.

examples.english: Experts say the repair will take two weeks.
examples.zomi: Siamte in bawlphatna kal nih sawt ding ci uh hi.

senses.usage_en: I would say often softens an opinion, making it sound less absolute.
senses.usage_zomi: I would say in ngaihsutna khat a kipsa thu bangin gen loin, nemzaw takin pulaak hi.

senses.heading: Measuring system
senses.definition_en: A system of numbers or marks used for measuring or comparing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tehna ahih keileh na tuamtuam enkakna dingin nambat leh ciaptehna kizangzia ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: a scale of one to ten

examples.english: The pain is measured on a scale of one to ten.
examples.zomi: Natna pen khat pan sawm dong tehna tawh kiteh hi.

examples.english: This map uses a scale of one centimetre to ten kilometres.
examples.zomi: Hih gamlim in sentimita khat pen kilomita sawm tawh kikim tehna zang hi.

senses.usage_en: A scale shows how measurements, amounts or levels relate to one another.
senses.usage_zomi: Scale in tehna, zat leh dinmun kikal a kizopna hong lak hi.

senses.heading: Size or extent
senses.definition_en: The size or extent of an activity, event or problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna, thu piang ahih keileh haksatna khat bangzah in lian leh zaam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The damage occurred on a large scale.
examples.zomi: Siatna pen a lian mahmah in piang hi.

examples.english: We did not understand the scale of the problem at first.
examples.zomi: A kipatcil in haksatna liandan tel nailo ung.

senses.usage_en: Use on a large scale for something done extensively or involving many people or places.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a zaam mahmah in kisem ahih keileh mi leh mun tampi huam cihna ah on a large scale kizang hi.

senses.heading: Weighing instrument
senses.definition_en: An instrument used for measuring weight.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat gikdan tehna dingin kizang van ahi hi.

examples.english: She weighed the flour on the kitchen scales.
examples.zomi: Amahin ankuangsuung giktehna tawh buhphoh teh hi.

examples.english: I stepped on the scales to check my weight.
examples.zomi: Ka gikdan encik dingin giktehna tungah ka ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, the singular form scale is common for a weighing instrument; British English also commonly uses the plural scales.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah giktehna a cihna dingin scale kici tam a, British English ah scales cih a tamzaw kizang hi.

senses.heading: Examine quickly
senses.definition_en: To look through something quickly in order to find particular information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu khat, laibu khat ahih keileh lai khat sungpan deihna thu zong dingin manlang takin etna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: scan the list for a name

examples.english: She scanned the list for her name.
examples.zomi: Amahin a min zongin minzui manlang takin en hi.

examples.english: I scanned the report before the meeting began.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna kipat ma in lipkhapna ka en kawikawi hi.

senses.usage_en: Scan often means reading quickly for specific information, not reading every word carefully.
senses.usage_zomi: Scan pen kammal khempeuh limtak sim cih hilo a, kisap thu khat zongin manlang takin sim cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Make a digital copy or image
senses.definition_en: To use a machine to copy a document or picture into a computer.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laikhial ahih keileh lim khat pen khawl zangin computer sungah digital copy suahna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please scan the form and email it to me.
examples.zomi: Form pen scan bawlin email tawh hong sawl in.

examples.english: You can scan the QR code with your phone.
examples.zomi: Na phone tawh QR code scan bawl thei ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In computing, scan may mean digitizing a document or using a device to read a code.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer tawh kisai ah scan cihpen laikhial khat digital copy suahna ahih keileh device tawh code simna cihna ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Examine medically
senses.definition_en: To examine the inside of a person’s body by using special medical equipment.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pumpi sunglam en; scan tawh sit
senses.explanation_zomi: Siavuan zatna tuamvil zangin mi khat pumpi sunglam enkhia cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: liamna om leh omlo scan tawh sit

examples.english: The doctors scanned his brain after the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident khit ciangin siavuan-te in ama khuak scan tawh sit uh hi.

examples.english: The machine scans the body for signs of disease.
examples.zomi: Hih khawl in natna lim om leh omlo pumpi sunglam sit hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun scan can refer to both the examination and the image produced by it.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun scan in pumpi sitna leh tua sittelna pan a ngah lim gel huam thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Feeling frightened or worried because something seems dangerous or harmful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuai ahih keileh siatna piangsak thei ding bangin a kilang na khat hangin lau leh lungkham cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The child was scared of the loud noise.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen aw ngaih mahmah hangin lau hi.

examples.english: I was scared to walk home alone at night.
examples.zomi: Zankim in keimah bek inn zuan ding ka lau hi.

senses.usage_en: Use scared of before a noun and scared to before a verb: scared of snakes but scared to move.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun ma ah scared of kizang a, verb ma ah scared to kizang hi: scared of snakes ahih hangin scared to move kici hi.

senses.definition_en: Causing fear or making someone feel frightened.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lausak ahih keileh launa piangsak thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: That was a scary story.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu pen a lauhuai mahmah hi.

examples.english: The road looked scary in the dark.
examples.zomi: Mial sungah lampi pen lauhuai bangin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Scared describes how a person feels; scary describes the person or situation that causes fear.
senses.usage_zomi: Scared in mi khat a laudan gen a, scary in mi lausak mihing ahih keileh dinmun gen hi.

senses.heading: Place where something happens
senses.definition_en: The place where an event, accident or crime happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat, accident khat ahih keileh mawhna bawlna khat a pian mun ahi hi.

examples.english: Police arrived at the scene within minutes.
examples.zomi: Police-te pen tawmkhat sungin thu pianmun tung uh hi.

examples.english: Several people witnessed the scene of the accident.
examples.zomi: Mi pawlkhat in accident pianmun mu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, scene refers to the particular place connected with an event.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah scene in thu khat tawh kizom mun ciangtak kawk hi.

senses.heading: Part of a play or film
senses.definition_en: A part of a play or film in which the action happens in one place or during one period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zatna ahih keileh film khat sungah sepna khat mun khat leh hun khat sung a pianna khen ahi hi.

examples.english: The final scene made the audience cry.
examples.zomi: Tawpna scene in en mite khasak hi.

examples.english: They filmed the beach scene in California.
examples.zomi: Amaute in tuipi gei scene pen California ah limla uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A scene is one part of a film or play; an act is usually a larger division of a play.
senses.usage_zomi: Scene pen film ahih keileh zatna sung a khen khat hi a, act ahih leh zatna sung a khen lianzaw ahi hi.

senses.heading: View of a place
senses.definition_en: A view of a place, especially one that is attractive, unusual or memorable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat a kilatdan, adiakin a hoih, a lamdang ahih keileh mangngilh haksat kilatdan ahi hi.

examples.english: The lake and mountains formed a beautiful scene.
examples.zomi: Dil leh mualte in mun kilatdan hoih bawl uh hi.

examples.english: We stopped to photograph the peaceful scene.
examples.zomi: Mun kilatdan lungmuang limla dingin tawlnga ung.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, scene means everything visible in a particular place.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah scene in mun khat ah muh theih khempeuh huam hi.

senses.definition_en: A plan or list showing when activities, events or tasks will happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna, thu piang ding ahih keileh nasep ding-te bang hunin kiciang ding cih lak geelna ahih keileh laizui ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting is listed on tomorrow’s schedule.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna pen zingciang hun geelna ah kigelh hi.

examples.english: The project was completed ahead of schedule.
examples.zomi: Geelna hun tun ma in project zo khin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: General American pronunciation is /ˈskedʒuːl/. The pronunciation /ˈʃedjuːl/ is also common in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: General American ah /ˈskedʒuːl/ ci in kigen hi. British English ah /ˈʃedjuːl/ ci in zong kigen tam hi.

senses.heading: Organized plan
senses.definition_en: An organized plan for achieving a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna ciangtak khat tangtung dingin kizem geelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The city introduced a scheme to reduce waste.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in nusia zah tawmsem ding geelna khat bawl hi.

examples.english: She joined a training scheme for young workers.
examples.zomi: Amahin nasemno-te a ding pilna piak geelna ah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, scheme often means an official or organized programme. In American English, program or plan is often more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah scheme in kumpi ahih keileh pawl khat in a geelkhol nasep kawk tam hi. American English ah program ahih keileh plan kici tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Secret or dishonest plan
senses.definition_en: A secret plan, especially one intended to deceive people or gain an unfair advantage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khemna ahih keileh thutanglo in hamphatna ngahna ding a kiseel geelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The police uncovered a scheme to steal money.
examples.zomi: Police-te in sum gukna ding kiseel geelna pholak uh hi.

examples.english: He refused to take part in the dishonest scheme.
examples.zomi: Amahin thutanglo geelna ah kihel ding nial hi.

senses.usage_en: Context determines whether scheme is neutral or negative. In American English, it often suggests dishonesty.
senses.usage_zomi: Scheme pen hoihna maw siatna maw cih a kizang thu in khensat hi. American English ah khemna geelna cih khiatna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: Educational institution
senses.definition_en: A place where children or other students are taught.
senses.explanation_zomi: Naupang ahih keileh sangnaupang-te pilna a ngahna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The children walk to school every morning.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te zing khempeuh sanginn ah khe tawh pai uh hi.

examples.english: She teaches science at a local school.
examples.zomi: Amahin khuahun sung sang khat ah science hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: Say go to school without the when referring to attending classes. Use go to the school when referring to the building or a particular school.
senses.usage_zomi: Sangah pilna kahlawh cihna ah go to school ci in the omlo in kizang hi. Sanginn mun ahih keileh sanginn ciangtak khat kawk ciangin go to the school kici hi.

senses.heading: Students and staff
senses.definition_en: All the students and staff of a particular school.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sang khat sung a sangnaupang leh nasem khempeuh huam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The whole school attended the ceremony.
examples.zomi: Sang buppi in pawi ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: Our team represented the school in the competition.
examples.zomi: Ei team in kidemna ah sang aiawh hi.

senses.usage_en: A singular verb is normally used when school refers to the institution as one unit.
senses.usage_zomi: School in pawl pumkhat a kawk ciangin singular verb kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: The organized study of the natural and physical world through observation and experiments.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piansaksa leitung leh pumpi nei nate etkhia, sittel leh kisinna tawh a kizem pilna ahi hi.

examples.english: Science helps us understand the natural world.
examples.zomi: Science in piansaksa leitung i teltheihna ding hong huh hi.

examples.english: The students performed a science experiment.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in science sittelna khat bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Science is usually uncountable when referring to the general field of knowledge. It can be countable when referring to separate branches, as in the natural sciences.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna pumpi kawk ciangin science pen uncountable noun ahi hi. Pilna khen tuamtuam kawk ciangin the natural sciences bangin plural kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Connected with science or based on careful observation, testing and evidence.
senses.zomi_equivalents: science tawh kisai; sittelna tung a kinga
senses.explanation_zomi: Science tawh kisai ahih keileh limtak a etkhia, sittel leh teci tungtawn a kipsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The claim is not supported by scientific evidence.
examples.zomi: Tua kigenna pen science teci in kipsak lo hi.

examples.english: Researchers used a scientific method to test the idea.
examples.zomi: Khuakzang zongte in tua ngaihsutna sittel dingin science sittelzia zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Scientific describes something related to science or carried out according to systematic methods.
senses.usage_zomi: Scientific in science tawh a kisai na ahih keileh kizem sittelzia bang a kibawl na gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who studies or works professionally in science.
senses.explanation_zomi: Science a sin ahih keileh science lamah profession tawh a sem mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The scientists are studying climate change.
examples.zomi: Science siammi-te in khuahun kikhelna sin uh hi.

examples.english: She hopes to become a medical scientist.
examples.zomi: Amahin zatui science siammi suak ding lamen hi.

senses.usage_en: A scientist may specialize in a particular field, such as biology, chemistry or physics.
senses.usage_zomi: Scientist khat in biology, chemistry ahih keileh physics bang pilna khen khat ah siamtuamna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Gain points
senses.definition_en: To gain a point or goal in a game, competition or test.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawhna, kidemna ahih keileh sittelna khat ah point ahih keileh goal ngah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She scored the winning goal.
examples.zomi: Amahin zohtna piangsak goal bawl hi.

examples.english: He scored ninety per cent on the exam.
examples.zomi: Amahin sittelna ah za ah sawmkua ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Use score directly before the number of points or the goal gained: score twenty points or score a goal.
senses.usage_zomi: Point ahih keileh goal a ngahzah ma in score kizang hi: score twenty points ahih keileh score a goal kici hi.

senses.heading: Mark or grade a test
senses.definition_en: To examine answers and give points to a test or piece of work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sittelna dawnna ahih keileh nasep khat sitin point pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher scored the tests that evening.
examples.zomi: Tua nitak in siamah in sittelna-te point pia hi.

examples.english: The online quiz is scored automatically.
examples.zomi: Online sittelna pen khawl in amah point pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, mark is often used instead of score when a teacher evaluates students’ work.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah siamah in sangnaupang nasep a et ciangin score sangin mark kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: To make a very loud, high sound because of fear, pain, anger or excitement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lau, na, heh ahih keileh lungdam mahmah hangin aw sang leh ngaih mahmah suah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She screamed when she saw the snake.
examples.zomi: Amahin gul a muh ciangin kik hi.

examples.english: The injured man screamed for help.
examples.zomi: Mi liam in huhna ngenin aw ngaih takin kik hi.

senses.usage_en: Scream describes a loud, high voice. Shout is more general and is often used to make someone hear you.
senses.usage_zomi: Scream in aw sang leh ngaih mahmah suahna gen hi. Shout ahih leh mi khat in a zaktheihna ding aw ngaih takin pau cihna huamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Display surface
senses.definition_en: The flat surface on a television, computer or phone where pictures and information appear.
senses.explanation_zomi: Television, computer ahih keileh phone tungah lim leh thu a kilatna phel ahi hi.

examples.english: The message appeared on my phone screen.
examples.zomi: Thu pen ka phone screen tungah hong kilang hi.

examples.english: Do not sit too close to the television screen.
examples.zomi: Television screen naih lua in tu kei in.

senses.usage_en: Screen is used for the display surface itself, while monitor commonly means the complete display device connected to a computer.
senses.usage_zomi: Screen in lim kilatna phel mah kawk a, monitor in computer tawh kizom lim lak device pumpi kawk tam hi.

senses.heading: Cinema or film presentation
senses.definition_en: The large surface on which a film is shown in a cinema, or the cinema as a medium.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cinema ah film a kilatna phel lian ahih keileh film lakna tawh kisai dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The actor first appeared on screen in 2018.
examples.zomi: Tua actor pen 2018 kum in screen tungah a masapen in kilang hi.

examples.english: We watched the film on a large screen.
examples.zomi: Screen lian tungah film en ung.

senses.usage_en: On screen means visible in a film, television programme or digital display.
senses.usage_zomi: On screen cihpen film, television program ahih keileh digital display ah kilang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Written text for a performance
senses.definition_en: The written words and directions used by actors in a film, play or broadcast.
senses.zomi_equivalents: zatna lai; film pau ding lai
senses.explanation_zomi: Film, zatna ahih keileh broadcast sungah actor-te in a gen ding kammal leh zuih ding thuhilhna kigelhna ahi hi.

examples.english: The actors read the script before rehearsing.
examples.zomi: Actor-te in a kisinma un script sim uh hi.

examples.english: She is writing a script for a television drama.
examples.zomi: Amahin television drama ding zatna lai gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: A script contains the spoken words and often includes instructions about actions, setting and sound.
senses.usage_zomi: Script sungah gen ding kammal-te om a, khangkhat ciangin gamtatna, mun leh aw tawh kisai thuhilhna zong om hi.

senses.heading: Writing system
senses.definition_en: A set of written characters used for a particular language.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pau khat gelhna dingin kizang laimal leh ciaptehna pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: English is written in the Roman script.
examples.zomi: English pen Roman laimal tawh kigelh hi.

examples.english: The two languages use different scripts.
examples.zomi: Tua pau nihte in laimal tuamtuam zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, script means a writing system, not a language itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah script in gelhna laimal pawl kawk a, pau mah kawk lo hi.

senses.heading: Three-dimensional artwork
senses.definition_en: A work of art made by shaping or combining stone, wood, metal or another material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Suang, sing, sik ahih keileh van dang khat lim kibawl in a piangsak thalawh ahi hi.

examples.english: A large stone sculpture stands outside the museum.
examples.zomi: Museum pualam ah suang limdawn lian khat ding hi.

examples.english: The artist created a sculpture from metal.
examples.zomi: Artist in sik tawh limdawn khat bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A sculpture is usually three-dimensional; a painting or drawing is normally flat.
senses.usage_zomi: Sculpture pen a sau, a zai leh a sang nei lim ahi tam a; painting ahih keileh drawing pen a phel ahi hi.

senses.heading: Art of making sculptures
senses.definition_en: The art or practice of making three-dimensional works.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim dawn leh van tawh lim piangsak siamna ahih keileh sepna ahi hi.

examples.english: She studied sculpture at college.
examples.zomi: Amahin college ah limdawn siamna sin hi.

examples.english: The course teaches painting and sculpture.
examples.zomi: Tua course in limsuhna leh limdawn bawlna hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: Sculpture can be countable for an individual artwork and uncountable for the art form.
senses.usage_zomi: Limdawn khat ciangtak kawk ciangin sculpture pen countable noun ahi a, tua siamna pumpi kawk ciangin uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A large area of salt water, usually smaller than an ocean or partly surrounded by land.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ci tawh kidim tui zaam lian, tuipi lian sangin neuzaw ahih keileh lei in a kual kimkhat a um tui ahi hi.

examples.english: They live in a village near the sea.
examples.zomi: Amaute tuipi gei khuano khat ah teng uh hi.

examples.english: The sailors spent three months at sea.
examples.zomi: Tembaw nasem-te in kha thum sung tuipi tungah om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the sea for a particular body of salt water or for the sea generally. At sea means travelling or working on the sea.
senses.usage_zomi: Ci nei tui zaam khat ahih keileh tuipi a pum in kawk dingin the sea kizang hi. At sea cihpen tuipi tungah khualzin ahih keileh nasem cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Attempt to find someone or something
senses.definition_en: An organized or careful attempt to find a person or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh na khat muhna dingin kizem takin zonna ahi hi.

examples.english: The search for the missing child continued all night.
examples.zomi: Naupang mang zonna pen zan khat sung kizom hi.

examples.english: Police began a search of the building.
examples.zomi: Police-te in innpi sung zonna kipan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a search for before the person or thing being sought, and a search of before the place being examined.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizong mi ahih keileh na ma ah a search for kizang a, a kizonna mun ma ah a search of kizang hi.

senses.heading: Computerized lookup
senses.definition_en: An act of using a computer or online service to find information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat muhna dingin computer ahih keileh online service a zatna ahi hi.

examples.english: A quick online search gave me the answer.
examples.zomi: Online ah manlang tak a zonna in dawnna hong pia hi.

examples.english: The name appeared in several search results.
examples.zomi: Tua min pen zonna pan a ngah thu pawlkhat sungah kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: The verb is search: you can search the internet or search for information.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb pen search ahi hi: search the internet ahih keileh search for information ci in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Division of the year
senses.definition_en: One of the main periods of the year, such as spring, summer, autumn or winter.
senses.explanation_zomi: Spring, summer, autumn leh winter bangin kum khat sung a khuahun khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The roads are difficult to use during the rainy season.
examples.zomi: Guahzu hun in lampi-te zat haksa hi.

examples.english: This fruit is available only in one season.
examples.zomi: Hih gah pen khuahun khat sung bek ngah theih hi.

senses.usage_en: Season names such as summer and winter normally begin with a lowercase letter.
senses.usage_zomi: Summer leh winter bang khuahun min-te pen a tawntung in laimal neu tawh kipan hi.

senses.heading: Period of activities or events
senses.definition_en: A period during which a particular activity, sport or type of entertainment regularly takes place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna, kimawhna ahih keileh nopsakna nam khat tawntung a kiciang hun ahi hi.

examples.english: The football season begins next month.
examples.zomi: Football kimawh hun pen kha hong tung dingin kipan hi.

examples.english: The new season of the programme starts tonight.
examples.zomi: Tua program season thak pen tuni zan in kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: A television season is a group of episodes released as one series. British English also commonly uses series.
senses.usage_zomi: Television season cihpen pawl khat in a kisuah episode-te ahi hi. British English ah series zong kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Place for sitting
senses.definition_en: A place or object designed for one person to sit on.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tutna dingin kibawl mun ahih keileh van ahi hi.

examples.english: Please take a seat near the door.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak gei ah tu in.

examples.english: I booked a window seat on the plane.
examples.zomi: Vanleng sungah thlalang gei tutna ka kemkhol hi.

senses.usage_en: Take a seat is a polite way to tell or invite someone to sit down.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat tu ding a thugenna ah take a seat pen zualzang tak a kigenna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Position in an elected body
senses.definition_en: An official position held by a member of a parliament, council or similar organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Parliament, council ahih keileh pawl kibang khat sungah member khat in a ngah ukna dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The party won three seats in parliament.
examples.zomi: Party in parliament sung aiawh dinmun thum ngah hi.

examples.english: She lost her council seat in the election.
examples.zomi: Amahin teelna ah council aiawh dinmun taan hi.

senses.usage_en: In politics, seat means a position of membership, not the chair used for sitting.
senses.usage_zomi: Politics ah seat cihpen tutna tokhom hilo a, member dinmun cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Less important
senses.definition_en: Less important than something else or coming after it in importance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na dang sangin thupineuzaw ahih keileh thupidan ah a nihna a om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Cost is a secondary concern compared with safety.
examples.zomi: Bitna tawh etkak leng man pen ngaihsut ding thupineuzaw ahi hi.

examples.english: He played a secondary role in the project.
examples.zomi: Amahin project sungah mawng neuzaw khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Secondary often contrasts with primary, meaning first or most important.
senses.usage_zomi: Secondary pen amasapen ahih keileh a thupipen a cihna primary tawh a kilehbulh in kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Relating to education after primary school
senses.definition_en: Connected with the stage of education that follows primary school.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sanglai tawh kisai; sang naupang khit pilna
senses.explanation_zomi: Sang naupang khit a zom sang pilna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She teaches mathematics at a secondary school.
examples.zomi: Amahin sanglai khat ah mathematics hilh hi.

examples.english: Secondary education usually begins after primary school.
examples.zomi: Sanglai pilna pen sang naupang khit ciangin kipan ngei hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact ages covered by secondary school differ between education systems.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam tuamtuam pilna ngeina bangin secondary school a kah kum ciangtan kibang lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to introduce the second point, reason or item in a sequence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kizomte sungah thu a nihna, hangthu a nihna ahih keileh na a nihna gen kipatna dingin kizang hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a khatna in … a nihna in …

examples.english: Firstly, the plan is expensive; secondly, it will take too long.
examples.zomi: A khatna in geelna pen manpha lua hi; a nihna in hun sawt lua ding hi.

examples.english: Secondly, we need to consider the safety risks.
examples.zomi: A nihna in, bitlohna-te ngaihsut kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Secondly organizes a list of points. In less formal speech, second is also commonly used.
senses.usage_zomi: Secondly in thulu kizomte a kizemna dingin kizang hi. Pau ngeina ah second zong kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: Known by only a few people and deliberately kept hidden from others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tawmno bek in thei a, midang-te a theihlohna dingin deihna tawh kiseel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They held a secret meeting after work.
examples.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin kiseel kikhopna khat nei uh hi.

examples.english: The location was kept secret for safety reasons.
examples.zomi: Bitna hangin mun pen mi theihloh dingin kiseel hi.

senses.usage_en: Secret describes information or activity intentionally hidden. Private describes something personal or restricted, but it is not always deliberately concealed.
senses.usage_zomi: Secret in deihna tawh kiseel thu ahih keileh sepna gen hi. Private in mimal tawh kisai ahih keileh mi ciangtan bek a phal thu gen a, a tawntung in kiseel cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Office worker
senses.definition_en: A person whose job involves organizing appointments, preparing documents and communicating for another person or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh pawl khat a ding hun geelna bawl, laikhial bawl leh midang-te tawh kizopna a sem nasem ahi hi.

examples.english: The secretary arranged a meeting for Friday.
examples.zomi: Secretary in Friday ni ding kikhopna khat geelkhol hi.

examples.english: Please give these documents to the office secretary.
examples.zomi: Hih laikhial-te office secretary kiangah pia in.

senses.usage_en: A secretary commonly handles administrative and communication duties but may have different responsibilities in different organizations.
senses.usage_zomi: Secretary in ukna tawh kisai nasep leh kizopna nasep sem tam a, pawl tuamtuam ah a mawpuakna kibang lo thei hi.

senses.heading: Senior organization or government official
senses.definition_en: A person holding an important administrative position in an organization or government.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl ahih keileh kumpi sungah ukna lam dinmun thupi a nei mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The general secretary presented the annual report.
examples.zomi: General secretary in kumkhat lipkhapna pulak hi.

examples.english: She was elected secretary of the association.
examples.zomi: Ama pen kipawlna secretary dingin teel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning of an official title containing secretary depends on the organization or system of government.
senses.usage_zomi: Secretary a kihel ukna min khiatna pen pawl ahih keileh kumpi ukzia bangin kilamdang thei hi.

senses.heading: Part of something larger
senses.definition_en: One of the parts into which a document, building, organization or other whole is divided.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laikhial, innpi, pawl ahih keileh na pumpi khat a kikhenna khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Read the first section of the report.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna khen masa sim in.

examples.english: The hospital has a separate section for children.
examples.zomi: Hospital ah naupang-te a ding khen tuam khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: A section is a clearly identified part of a larger whole.
senses.usage_zomi: Section pen na pumpi khat sung a khen ciangtak khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Group within an organization
senses.definition_en: A particular group or department within a larger organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl lianzaw khat sung a pawlno ahih keileh department khat ahi hi.

examples.english: He works in the finance section.
examples.zomi: Ama sumvai khen sungah sem hi.

examples.english: Each section has its own manager.
examples.zomi: Khen ciat in ama manager ciat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Section can describe either a physical division or a group responsible for particular work.
senses.usage_zomi: Section in mun kikhenna ahih keileh nasep ciangtak khat a sem pawl kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Area of economic activity
senses.definition_en: A particular part of a country’s economy or business activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam khat sumlehpai ahih keileh sum bawlna sung a nasep khen tuam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She works in the public sector.
examples.zomi: Ama kumpi nasep khen ah sem hi.

examples.english: Tourism is an important sector of the economy.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna nasep pen sumlehpai sungah nasep khen thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Sector commonly groups businesses or services according to the kind of work they do.
senses.usage_zomi: Sector in business ahih keileh service-te pen a nasep nam bangin pawlkhen khat sungah koih hi.

senses.heading: Part of an area
senses.definition_en: A particular part of a larger area, especially one controlled or used for a specific purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamhuam lianzaw khat sung a, ngimna tuam khat a ding kizang ahih keileh kikem gamkhen ahi hi.

examples.english: The northern sector of the city is growing quickly.
examples.zomi: Khuapi saklam gamkhen manlang takin khang hi.

examples.english: Soldiers guarded the eastern sector.
examples.zomi: Galkap-te in nisuahlam gamkhen kem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, sector refers to a defined part of a geographical area.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah sector in gamhuam khat sung a ciangtan kipia gamkhen kawk hi.

senses.heading: Obtain something successfully
senses.definition_en: To obtain something, especially after making an effort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hanciamna khit ciangin deihna khat ngah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She secured a job at a local hospital.
examples.zomi: Ama khuahun sung hospital khat ah nasep ngah hi.

examples.english: The organization secured enough funding for the project.
examples.zomi: Pawl in project ding sum kicing ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Secure is more formal than get when it means obtaining something.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat ngah cihna ah secure pen get sangin formal zaw hi.

senses.heading: Make safe or protect
senses.definition_en: To make a place, object or system safe against danger, attack or unauthorized use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, van ahih keileh system khat lauhuaina, simmawhna ahih keileh phalna neilo zatna pan bit dingin bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Police secured the area after the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident khit ciangin police-te in mun bit dingin kem uh hi.

examples.english: Use a strong password to secure your account.
examples.zomi: Na account kemcing dingin password khauhzaw zang in.

senses.usage_en: When secure means “make safe,” its object is the person, place or system being protected.
senses.usage_zomi: Secure in “bit dingin bawl” cihna a neih ciangin, a nungah a kikem mi, mun ahih keileh system om hi.

senses.heading: Fasten firmly
senses.definition_en: To fasten something firmly so that it cannot move, fall or become loose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat kikhinkhian, puk ahih keileh khul lo dingin kip takin khih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Secure the boxes before driving.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw na hawlma in bawm-te kip takin khih in.

examples.english: He secured the ladder with a rope.
examples.zomi: Amahin kailawn pen khau tawh kip takin khih hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, secure emphasizes preventing movement or separation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah secure in kikhinkhian ahih keileh kikhen lo ding a kipsakna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Protection from danger
senses.definition_en: The state of being protected from danger, crime, attack or loss.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina, mawhna bawlna, simmawhna ahih keileh supna pan a bit dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The new lights improved security around the building.
examples.zomi: Meivak thak-te in innpi kiim bitna hoihsak hi.

examples.english: National security is a major responsibility of the government.
examples.zomi: Gam bitna pen kumpi mawpuakna thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Security is usually uncountable when it means general protection or safety.
senses.usage_zomi: Kemcingna ahih keileh bitna a pum in kawk ciangin security pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: People or systems that provide protection
senses.definition_en: The people, equipment or procedures used to protect a place or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih keileh pawl khat kem ding a kizang mite, van-te leh sepzia-te ahi hi.

examples.english: Security checked our bags at the entrance.
examples.zomi: Lutna ah bitna kemte in ka bawmte uh sit uh hi.

examples.english: The office has a modern security system.
examples.zomi: Office in tulai bitna system khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Security can refer collectively to the people responsible for guarding a place.
senses.usage_zomi: Security in mun khat a kemcing mite pawl a pum in zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Financial certainty
senses.definition_en: A condition in which a person has dependable income, housing or other necessary resources.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in muanhuai sumlut, inn leh a kisap van dangte a neih dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: A regular income gave the family financial security.
examples.zomi: Tawntung sumlutna in innkuan sumvai kepna pia hi.

examples.english: Workers are worried about job security.
examples.zomi: Nasem-te in a nasep kip leh kiplo lungkham uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Job security means confidence that a person’s employment will continue.
senses.usage_zomi: Job security cihpen mi khat in a nasep zom paisuak lai ding cih a muanna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Notice with the eyes
senses.definition_en: To become aware of someone or something by using your eyes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mit tawh mi khat ahih keileh na khat mu cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I could see a light in the distance.
examples.zomi: Gamla ah meivak khat mu thei ing.

examples.english: Did you see the bird in the tree?
examples.zomi: Singkung tung a vasate mu nahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: See often means noticing naturally, while look at means directing your eyes deliberately toward someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: See in pianzia bang a muhna gen tam a, look at in mi ahih keileh na khat lam deihna tawh etna gen hi.

senses.heading: Meet or visit
senses.definition_en: To meet, visit or spend time with someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh kimuh, va hawh ahih keileh hun kizangkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You should see a doctor about that pain.
examples.zomi: Tua natna hangin siavuan va mu ding nahi hi.

examples.english: I am seeing my parents this weekend.
examples.zomi: Hih kaal tawp in ka nulepa-te tawh kimuh ding ing.

senses.usage_en: See a doctor means consult or visit a doctor, not merely notice the doctor visually.
senses.usage_zomi: See a doctor cihpen siavuan mit tawh mu bek cihna hilo a, siavuan kiangah va kisit cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Understand
senses.definition_en: To understand an idea, explanation or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, hilhcianhna ahih keileh dinmun khat tel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I see what you mean now.
examples.zomi: Tu in na cihna ka tel ta hi.

examples.english: She could not see why the rule was necessary.
examples.zomi: Tua thukhun banghangin kisam cih amahin tel lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In conversation, I see commonly means “I understand.”
senses.usage_zomi: Kihoupihna ah I see cihpen “ka tel hi” cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Experience or witness
senses.definition_en: To experience an event or be present when it happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang khat phutkhak ahih keileh a pianna ah omkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The town has seen many changes in recent years.
examples.zomi: Tu nai kumte sungin khuapi in kikhelna tampi phut hi.

examples.english: This building has seen more than a century of history.
examples.zomi: Hih innpi in kum za khat val tangthu muhkha hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the subject can be a person, place or period that experiences change or events.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah thu piang ahih keileh kikhelna a phut mihing, mun ahih keileh hun pen subject suak thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The small part produced by a plant from which a new plant can grow.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung ahih keileh singno thak khangkhia thei dingin singkung in a piangsak a ci ahi hi.

examples.english: She planted tomato seeds in the garden.
examples.zomi: Amahin huan sungah tomato ci tuh hi.

examples.english: These flowers are easy to grow from seed.
examples.zomi: Hih pak-te pen ci pan khangsak baih hi.

senses.usage_en: Seed can be countable when referring to individual seeds and uncountable when referring to seed used for planting.
senses.usage_zomi: Ci khatciat kawk ciangin seed pen countable noun ahi a, tuh ding ci a pum in kawk ciangin uncountable noun ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Try to find or obtain
senses.definition_en: To try to find, obtain or achieve someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat zong, na khat ngah ahih keileh ngimna khat tangtung dingin hanciam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The family is seeking a safe place to live.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in bitna tawh a teenna ding mun zong hi.

examples.english: You should seek medical help immediately.
examples.zomi: Zatui lam huhna manlang takin zong ding nahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Seek is more formal than look for. It is commonly followed directly by its object: seek advice, not normally seek for advice.
senses.usage_zomi: Seek pen look for sangin formal zaw hi. A nungah object direct in zui hi: seek advice kici a, seek for advice ci ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Attempt to do something
senses.definition_en: To make a deliberate effort to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl dingin deihna tawh hanciam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The policy seeks to reduce pollution.
examples.zomi: Tua policy in niinna kiam dingin hanciam hi.

examples.english: We seek to serve the whole community.
examples.zomi: Khuamite khempeuh na sep dingin hanciam ung.

senses.usage_en: In formal writing, seek to + verb means “try deliberately to do something.”
senses.usage_zomi: Formal lai ah seek to + verb cihpen na khat bawl dingin deihna tawh hanciam cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To appear to be true or to give a particular impression.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a maan bang, a hih bang ahih keileh a kibang kilatdan pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She seems tired today.
examples.zomi: Ama tuni in gim bangin kilang hi.

examples.english: It seems that the meeting has been cancelled.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna kikhawlta bangin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use seem + adjective, seem to + verb, or it seems that + clause. Do not normally use seem in continuous forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Seem + adjective, seem to + verb ahih keileh it seems that + clause ci in kizang hi. Seem pen continuous form tawh kizang ngeilo hi.

senses.definition_en: To choose someone or something carefully from a group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat sungpan mi ahih keileh na khat limtak ngaihsun in teel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee selected three candidates for interview.
examples.zomi: Committee in interview ding candidate thum teel hi.

examples.english: Select the correct answer from the list.
examples.zomi: Minzui sungpan dawnna maan teel in.

senses.usage_en: Select is slightly more formal than choose and often suggests choosing carefully according to particular standards.
senses.usage_zomi: Select pen choose sangin formal tawmzaw a, ciangtan khat zui in limtak a teelna kawk tam hi.

senses.heading: Act of choosing
senses.definition_en: The process of choosing someone or something from a group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat sungpan mi ahih keileh na khat teelna sepzia ahi hi.

examples.english: The selection process took two weeks.
examples.zomi: Teelna sepzia in kaal nih sawt hi.

examples.english: Experience is important in the selection of a manager.
examples.zomi: Manager teelna ah phutkhak thupi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use selection of when referring to the act of choosing a particular person or item.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na ciangtak khat teelna kawk ciangin selection of kizang hi.

senses.heading: Group of available choices
senses.definition_en: A group of different things from which people can choose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi in a deih bang a teeltheihna ding na tuamtuam pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The shop has a wide selection of shoes.
examples.zomi: Dawr ah teeltheihna khembel tuamtuam tampi om hi.

examples.english: The library offers a good selection of children’s books.
examples.zomi: Laibuk inn in naupang laibu tuamtuam hoih tak nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, selection refers to the range of choices available, not the act of choosing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah selection in teelna gamtatna hilo a, teeltheih ding a om na tuamtuam kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A person’s own identity, character or complete being.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat amah a hihna, gamtatna leh ama pumpi a dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: She felt like her old self again after recovering.
examples.zomi: A damsuk khit ciangin a nidang hihna bangin ki ngaihsun kik hi.

examples.english: Children gradually develop a sense of self.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te in a mimal hihna uh tomtom in tel semsem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Self is used in compounds such as self-confidence and in pronouns such as myself and yourself. Its plural is selves.
senses.usage_zomi: Self pen self-confidence bang compound-te leh myself, yourself bang pronoun-te sungah kizang hi. A plural pen selves ahi hi.

senses.heading: Exchange for money
senses.definition_en: To give something to another person in exchange for money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat midang kiangah sum tawh zuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They sold their old car last week.
examples.zomi: A mawtaw lui uh kaal khit in zuak uh hi.

examples.english: This shop sells locally grown vegetables.
examples.zomi: Hih dawr in khuahun sung a kikhangsak singgah leh anlak zuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use sell something to someone and sell something for a price. Do not confuse sell with buy.
senses.usage_zomi: Sell something to someone leh sell something for a price ci in kizang hi. Sell pen buy tawh helkhawm kei in.

senses.heading: Be bought by customers
senses.definition_en: To be bought in a particular quantity or at a particular rate.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat pen mi in zah ciangtan khat ahih keileh khawng ciangtan khat in lei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The new book is selling well.
examples.zomi: Laibu thak pen kizuak thei mahmah hi.

examples.english: Fresh bread usually sells quickly.
examples.zomi: Tanghou thak pen manlang takin kizuak ngei hi.

senses.usage_en: In expressions such as sell well, the object being sold becomes the subject, but the meaning is not passive.
senses.usage_zomi: Sell well bang kammal zatna ah a kizuak van pen subject suak a, himahleh passive form hilo hi.

senses.heading: Cause something to go to a person or place
senses.definition_en: To arrange for a message, object or document to be delivered to someone or somewhere.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, van ahih keileh laikhial khat mi khat kiang ahih keileh mun khat ah tun dingin sawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please send me the document by email.
examples.zomi: Laikhial pen email tawh hong sawl in.

examples.english: She sent a package to her parents.
examples.zomi: Amahin a nulepa-te kiangah vanbawm khat sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use send someone something or send something to someone: send me the file or send the file to me.
senses.usage_zomi: Send someone something ahih keileh send something to someone ci in kizang hi: send me the file leh send the file to me a khiatna kibang hi.

senses.heading: Cause a person to go somewhere
senses.definition_en: To arrange or order for someone to go to a particular place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat mun ciangtak khat ah pai dingin geel ahih keileh sawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher sent the sick student home.
examples.zomi: Siamah in a cina sangnaupang innah sawl hi.

examples.english: The company sent her to Chicago for training.
examples.zomi: Company in pilna ngah dingin ama Chicago ah sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: After send, a destination can follow directly in some expressions, such as send someone home.
senses.usage_zomi: Send khit ciangin send someone home bangin mun kawk kammal direct in zui thei hi.

senses.heading: Higher in rank or experience
senses.definition_en: Having a higher position, greater responsibility or more experience than others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang sangin dinmun sangzaw, mawpuakna lianzaw ahih keileh phutkhak tampizaw nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She was promoted to a senior position.
examples.zomi: Ama dinmun sangzaw ah kaisang hi.

examples.english: Senior staff will review the proposal.
examples.zomi: Nasem dinmun sangzaw-te in geelna etkik ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Senior normally comes before the job title: senior engineer, not engineer senior.
senses.usage_zomi: Senior pen nasep min ma ah om hi: senior engineer kici a, engineer senior kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Older
senses.definition_en: Older than another person or belonging to an older age group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang khat sangin upazaw ahih keileh kum upate pawl sung a kihel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The centre provides meals for senior citizens.
examples.zomi: Tua centre in kum upa khuami-te an pia hi.

examples.english: My brother is three years senior to me.
examples.zomi: Ka sanggampa pen kei sang kum thum upazaw hi.

senses.usage_en: In formal British English, someone can be senior to another person. In everyday English, older than is usually more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Formal British English ah mi khat pen midang khat sang a upazaw cihna dingin senior to kizang thei hi. Nisim pau ah older than kici tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Physical ability to notice
senses.definition_en: One of the natural abilities through which the body receives information, such as sight, hearing, smell, taste or touch.
senses.explanation_zomi: Muhna, zakna, namtheihna, limna leh lawntheihna bangin pumpi in thu a ngahna pianpih siamna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Dogs have a strong sense of smell.
examples.zomi: Ui-te in namtheihna khauhtak nei uh hi.

examples.english: Illness affected his sense of taste.
examples.zomi: Natna in a limtheihna nawngkai hi.

senses.usage_en: English traditionally identifies five senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.
senses.usage_zomi: English pau ngeina in pumpi theihna nga ci a: muhna, zakna, namtheihna, limna leh lawntheihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Meaning
senses.definition_en: A particular meaning that a word, phrase or statement has.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, kammal pawl ahih keileh thugelh khat in a neih khiatna ciangtak ahi hi.

examples.english: The word has several different senses.
examples.zomi: Tua kammal in khiatna tuamtuam nei hi.

examples.english: In this sense, “light” means not heavy.
examples.zomi: Hih khiatna ah “light” cihpen giklo cihna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Dictionaries often number the different senses of a word separately.
senses.usage_zomi: Dictionary-te in kammal khat a khiatna tuamtuam nambat tawh khen uh hi.

senses.heading: Practical judgment
senses.definition_en: A reasonable ability to judge situations and make good decisions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun limtak a ngaihsun leh khensatna hoih a bawltheihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Use common sense when crossing the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi na kantan ciangin ngaihsutna hoih zang in.

examples.english: Her advice showed good sense.
examples.zomi: A thuhilhna in ngaihsutna hoih a neihna lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Make sense means to be understandable, reasonable or practical.
senses.usage_zomi: Make sense cihpen teltheih, a kilawm ahih keileh zat theih cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: General feeling or awareness
senses.definition_en: A feeling or awareness that something exists or is true, even without complete proof.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim theihna; a hih ding a theihna
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci kicing om nailo napi na khat om ahih keileh maan ding bang a lungsim tawh theihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: pawl sung a kihelna a theihna khauh

examples.english: I had a sense that something was wrong.
examples.zomi: Na khat khial ding bangin ka lungsim in thei hi.

examples.english: The team developed a strong sense of unity.
examples.zomi: Team in pumkhat hihna a theihna khauh nei hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern a sense of + noun describes a particular feeling or awareness.
senses.usage_zomi: A sense of + noun cih kammal zatna in lungsim theihna nam khat gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Showing good judgment and practical understanding.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna hoih leh zat theih pilna a neihna lak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Saving part of your income is a sensible decision.
examples.zomi: Na sumlutna pawlkhat kholhna pen khensatna hoih ahi hi.

examples.english: Wear sensible shoes for the long walk.
examples.zomi: Khe tawh gamlapi na pai ding ahih manin khembel kilawm silh in.

senses.usage_en: Sensible means practical and reasonable. Do not confuse it with sensitive, which means easily affected or responsive.
senses.usage_zomi: Sensible cihpen zat theih leh ngaihsutna tawh a kituak cihna ahi hi. A nawng baih ahih keileh a phawk baih cihna sensitive tawh helkhawm kei in.

senses.heading: Easily affected emotionally
senses.definition_en: Easily upset, offended or emotionally affected by what people say or do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi genna ahih keileh gamtatna hangin lungkham, lungkimlo ahih keileh lungsim nawng baih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He is sensitive to criticism about his work.
examples.zomi: Ama a nasep mawhsakna phawk baih hi.

examples.english: Be careful because she is sensitive about her appearance.
examples.zomi: Ama a lim tawh kisai lungsim nawng baih ahih manin pilvang in.

senses.usage_en: Use sensitive to for something that causes a reaction and sensitive about for a subject that may cause embarrassment or hurt.
senses.usage_zomi: Nawngkaihna a piangsak na ma ah sensitive to kizang a, zumna ahih keileh lungsim natna piangsak thei thulu ma ah sensitive about kizang hi.

senses.heading: Requiring careful treatment
senses.definition_en: Needing to be discussed or handled carefully because it may cause problems, anger or embarrassment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna, hehna ahih keileh zumna piangsak thei ahih manin pilvang tak a gen ahih keileh kep kul cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: pilvang tak a gen ding thulu

examples.english: The report contains sensitive personal information.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna sungah kemcing kul mimal thu om hi.

examples.english: Religion can be a sensitive subject.
examples.zomi: Biakna pen pilvang tak a gen kul thulu ahi thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Sensitive information should normally be shared only with authorized people.
senses.usage_zomi: Kemcing kul thu pen a theih ding phalna a nei mite kiangah bek kigen ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Able to detect small changes
senses.definition_en: Able to notice or react to very small changes, amounts or signals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhelna, zatna ahih keileh signal tawmno mah zong thei ahih keileh dawnkik thei cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: natna tawm zong mukhia thei sittelna

examples.english: This equipment is sensitive to changes in temperature.
examples.zomi: Hih van in khuahun kikhel tawm zong thei hi.

examples.english: Her eyes are sensitive to bright light.
examples.zomi: A mitte khuavak ngaih phawk baih hi.

senses.usage_en: In scientific and technical contexts, sensitive often means capable of detecting very small differences.
senses.usage_zomi: Science leh technology tawh kisai ah sensitive cihpen kilamdanna tawmno zong phawk thei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Group of words expressing a complete idea
senses.definition_en: A group of words that expresses a complete statement, question, command or exclamation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu genna, dotna, thupiakna ahih keileh lamdanna thu kicingtak a gen kammal pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: Write one sentence about your family.
examples.zomi: Na innkuan thu thugen khat gelh in.

examples.english: This paragraph contains five sentences.
examples.zomi: Hih laigelh khen sungah thugen nga om hi.

senses.usage_en: In writing, a sentence usually begins with a capital letter and ends with a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark.
senses.usage_zomi: Laigelh ah sentence pen laimal lian tawh kipan a, full stop, question mark ahih keileh exclamation mark tawh tawp ngei hi.

senses.heading: Court punishment
senses.definition_en: A punishment officially given by a court to a person found guilty of a crime.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhna a neihna kimu mi khat tungah thuukna in a thuk thuaksiatna ahi hi.

examples.english: The judge gave him a two-year prison sentence.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa in ama kum nih thongkiat dan pia hi.

examples.english: She received a lighter sentence because she admitted the crime.
examples.zomi: Mawhna a pulaak manin thuaksiatna neuzaw ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: The verb sentence means to officially give someone a legal punishment: The judge sentenced him to prison.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb sentence cihpen mi khat tungah thukhenna dan pia cihna ahi hi: The judge sentenced him to prison.

senses.definition_en: Existing, functioning or considered independently and not joined to something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na dang tawh kizomlo, kigawmlo ahih keileh ama tuam in om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children sleep in separate rooms.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te pindan tuamtuam ah ih uh hi.

examples.english: Keep raw meat separate from cooked food.
examples.zomi: Sa hueilo pen an huan khitsa tawh kigawmlo in tuam in koih in.

senses.usage_en: The adjective is pronounced /ˈsepərət/. The verb separate is pronounced /ˈsepəreɪt/.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective pen /ˈsepərət/ ci in kigen hi. Verb separate pen /ˈsepəreɪt/ ci in kigen hi.

senses.definition_en: The ninth month of the year, after August and before October.
senses.explanation_zomi: August khit leh October ma, kum khat sung a kha kuana ahi hi.

examples.english: Classes begin in September.
examples.zomi: Sang pen September kha in kipan hi.

examples.english: Her birthday is on September 18.
examples.zomi: A suahni pen September 18 ni ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: September begins with a capital letter. Use in September for the month and on September 18 for a particular date.
senses.usage_zomi: September pen laimal lian tawh kipan hi. Kha kawk dingin in September kizang a, ni ciangtak kawk dingin on September 18 kizang hi.

senses.heading: Particular order
senses.definition_en: The order in which related actions, events or objects follow one another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, thu piang ahih keileh na kizomte khat khit khat a kizuihzia ahi hi.

examples.english: Put the pictures in the correct sequence.
examples.zomi: Lim-te kizuihzia maan in koih in.

examples.english: The report describes the sequence of events.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna in thu piangte a kizuihzia hilhcian hi.

senses.usage_en: Sequence emphasizes that items or events occur in a particular order.
senses.usage_zomi: Sequence in na ahih keileh thu piangte kizuihzia ciangtak khat tawh a omna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Connected series
senses.definition_en: A group of related events, actions or numbers that follow one another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khat khit khat a zui thu piang, gamtatna ahih keileh nambat kizomte ahi hi.

examples.english: The students studied a sequence of numbers.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in nambat kizui pawl sin uh hi.

examples.english: The film begins with a dramatic action sequence.
examples.zomi: Film pen gamtatna lauhuai kizuihna khat tawh kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: A sequence normally has a meaningful or recognizable order, not merely a random group.
senses.usage_zomi: Sequence pen a tawntung in a khiatna nei kizuihzia khat nei a, bang hileh bangin kigawm pawl hilo hi.

senses.heading: Group of related things or events
senses.definition_en: A number of related things or events that happen or appear one after another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na ahih keileh thu piang kizom tampi khat khit khat a piang ahih keileh kilang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A series of storms damaged the coast.
examples.zomi: Huihpi kizom pawl in tuipi gei gam susia hi.

examples.english: The teacher asked a series of difficult questions.
examples.zomi: Siamah in dotna haksa kizom pawl dong hi.

senses.usage_en: Series has the same form in the singular and plural: one series, two series.
senses.usage_zomi: Series pen singular leh plural ah a lim kibang hi: one series, two series ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Television or radio programme
senses.definition_en: A set of television or radio programmes with the same title, characters or subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Min, actor-te ahih keileh thulu kibang tawh a kizom television ahih keileh radio program pawl ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: the final episode of the series

examples.english: We watched the entire series during the weekend.
examples.zomi: Kaal tawp sungin program kizom khempeuh en ung.

examples.english: The series follows the life of a young doctor.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu kizom in siavuanno khat nuntakzia zui hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, series may refer to one group of television episodes. American English often uses season for that particular group.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah series in television episode pawl khat kawk thei hi. American English ah tua pawl kawk dingin season kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Important or worrying
senses.definition_en: Important, dangerous or worrying enough to require careful attention.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupi, lauhuai ahih keileh lungkhamhuai ahih manin limtak ngaihsut kul cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The storm caused serious damage to several homes.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in inn pawlkhat tungah siatna lian piangsak hi.

examples.english: She is recovering from a serious illness.
examples.zomi: Ama natna lauhuai khat pan damsuk hi.

senses.usage_en: Serious describes something that should not be treated lightly or ignored.
senses.usage_zomi: Serious in neuzaw in ngaihsun ahih keileh awlmawh loh ding hilo na khat gen hi.

senses.heading: Sincere and not joking
senses.definition_en: Sincere about what you say or intend, rather than joking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kiamnuihna hilo in, a kigen ahih keileh a kiseh ding thu lungsim tak tawh a hih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Are you serious about leaving your job?
examples.zomi: Na nasep nusia ding lungsim takin na ngaihsun maw?

examples.english: I thought he was joking, but he was serious.
examples.zomi: Kiamnuihna in gen ka sa hi, himahleh lungsim takin gen ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The question Are you serious? asks whether someone truly means what they have said.
senses.usage_zomi: Are you serious? cih dotna in, mi khat in a gen thu a taktak in gen maw cih dotna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Thoughtful and unsmiling
senses.definition_en: Showing deep thought or concern and not appearing cheerful or playful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna thuk nei, lungkham ahih keileh nuihsakna omlo bangin kilang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor had a serious expression on her face.
examples.zomi: Siavuan nu maitang khauh hi.

examples.english: He suddenly became quiet and serious.
examples.zomi: Ama thakhat in gamdai a, maitang khauh pah hi.

senses.usage_en: A serious appearance does not necessarily mean that someone is angry.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat maitang khauh in a kilat hangin heh pah cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: To a severe or dangerous degree
senses.definition_en: To a degree that is dangerous, harmful or important.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuai, siatna lian piangsak thei ahih keileh a thupi mahmah dinmun dong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Two passengers were seriously injured in the crash.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw kituahna ah passenger nih nasatak in liam uh hi.

examples.english: The fire seriously damaged the building.
examples.zomi: Meikuang in innpi nasatak in susia hi.

senses.usage_en: Seriously commonly strengthens words connected with injury, illness, danger or damage.
senses.usage_zomi: Seriously pen liamna, natna, lauhuaina leh siatna tawh kisai kammal-te thahatsakna dingin kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: In a sincere or careful way
senses.definition_en: With sincere intention or careful thought, rather than as a joke.
