senses.explanation_zomi: Kiamnuihna hilo in, lungsim tak ahih keileh limtak a ngaihsun in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You should take this warning seriously.
examples.zomi: Hih vauna thupi in ngaihsun ding nahi hi.

examples.english: She is seriously considering the offer.
examples.zomi: Amahin tua piakna limtak ngaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: Take someone or something seriously means to consider that person or matter important and worthy of attention.
senses.usage_zomi: Take someone or something seriously cihpen tua mi ahih keileh thu pen thupi leh awlmawh taak in ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Used to show surprise or annoyance
senses.definition_en: Used informally to emphasize surprise, disbelief or annoyance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lamdanna, ummohna ahih keileh lungkimlohna thahatsakna dingin nisim pau ah kizang hi.

examples.english: Seriously? You finished all that work today?
examples.zomi: A taktak maw? Tuni in tua nasep khempeuh na zo maw?

examples.english: Seriously, please stop making that noise.
examples.zomi: A taktak in, tua aw bawlna khawl in.

senses.usage_en: This informal use is common in conversation but may sound unsuitable in formal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim pau zatna pen kihoupihna ah kizang tam a, formal laigelh ah a kilawm khollo thei hi.

senses.heading: Household worker
senses.definition_en: A person employed to perform domestic duties in another person’s home.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang inn sungah inn nasep sem dingin kikhawl nasem ahi hi.

examples.english: The historical novel describes the lives of household servants.
examples.zomi: Tangthu novel in inn sung nasem-te nuntakzia gen hi.

examples.english: The servant prepared meals and cleaned the house.
examples.zomi: Inn nasem in an bawl a, inn zong siangthosak hi.

senses.usage_en: In modern everyday English, domestic worker, housekeeper or a more specific job title is often preferred to servant.
senses.usage_zomi: Tulai nisim English ah servant sangin domestic worker, housekeeper ahih keileh nasep min ciangtak khat kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Person devoted to serving
senses.definition_en: A person who is devoted to serving another person, community or cause.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, khuamite ahih keileh ngimna khat a ding citak a nasem mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Public servants are responsible for serving the community.
examples.zomi: Mipite nasem-te in khuamite na sep mawpuakna nei uh hi.

examples.english: He considered himself a servant of God.
examples.zomi: Amahin amah Pasian nasem khat hi ci in kingaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: In religious or formal contexts, servant may express humility and commitment rather than low social status.
senses.usage_zomi: Biakna ahih keileh formal thugenna ah servant in dinmun niam cihna sangin kiniamkhiatna leh citakna lak hi.

senses.heading: Provide food or drink
senses.definition_en: To give food or drink to someone, especially as part of a meal.
senses.zomi_equivalents: an pia; nekding tawh na sem
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat kiangah an ahih keileh dawn ding pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The restaurant serves breakfast until ten.
examples.zomi: Annekna dawr in dak sawm dong zing an pia hi.

examples.english: Serve the soup with fresh bread.
examples.zomi: An tui pen tanghou thak tawh pia in.

senses.usage_en: Serve someone food and serve food to someone are both correct.
senses.usage_zomi: Serve someone food leh serve food to someone a nihgel in a maan ahi hi.

senses.heading: Work for or help people
senses.definition_en: To work for, help or provide a useful service to a person, organization or community.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, pawl khat ahih keileh khuamite a ding nasem leh huh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The clinic serves several rural communities.
examples.zomi: Siavuan inn in khuamite pawlkhat na sem hi.

examples.english: She has served the organization for twenty years.
examples.zomi: Amahin kum sawmnih sung tua pawl na sem hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, serve emphasizes meeting people’s needs or fulfilling a duty.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah serve in mite kisapna a pia ahih keileh mawpuakna a tangtun cihna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Perform a particular function
senses.definition_en: To be used for a particular purpose or perform a particular role.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna ahih keileh mawng ciangtak khat a ding kizang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This room serves as both an office and a library.
examples.zomi: Hih pindan pen office leh laibuk inn in kizang hi.

examples.english: The sign serves as a warning to drivers.
examples.zomi: Ciamtehna in mawtaw hawlte a ding vauna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use serve as + noun when something performs a particular role.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat in mawng ciangtak khat a neihna gen dingin serve as + noun kizang hi.

senses.heading: Hold an official position
senses.definition_en: To spend a period working in an official position, especially in government or the military.
senses.zomi_equivalents: dinmun tawh na sem; ukna ah sem
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumpi, galkap ahih keileh pawl khat sungah hun ciangtan khat ukna dinmun tawh nasem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He served in the army for six years.
examples.zomi: Ama kum guk sung galkap ah na sem hi.

examples.english: She served as chair of the committee.
examples.zomi: Ama committee makaipa in na sem hi.

senses.usage_en: Use serve as before a role and serve in before an organization or branch of service.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun ma ah serve as kizang a, pawl ahih keileh nasep khen ma ah serve in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Work done for customers or the public
senses.definition_en: Work performed to help customers, organizations or the public rather than to produce physical goods.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van a piangsak sangin customer, pawl ahih keileh mipite huhna ding a kibawl nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: The company provides internet services.
examples.zomi: Company in internet zatna pia hi.

examples.english: The hotel offers excellent customer service.
examples.zomi: Hotel in customer na sepna hoih mahmah pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Service can be countable for a particular type of help and uncountable for the general quality of assistance.
senses.usage_zomi: Huhna nasep nam khat kawk ciangin service pen countable noun ahi thei a, na sepna hoihdan a pum in kawk ciangin uncountable noun ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: System that provides transport or another facility
senses.definition_en: An organized system that regularly provides transport, communication or another facility.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzinna, kizopna ahih keileh zatna dang khat tawntung a pia kizem system ahi hi.

examples.english: The village has a daily bus service.
examples.zomi: Khuano ah ni sim bus pai hi.

examples.english: Phone service was interrupted by the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi hangin phone kizopna kikha hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a service is an organized facility available for people to use.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah service pen mite zat ding a kizem in a om zatna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Maintenance or repair
senses.definition_en: An examination and maintenance of a machine or vehicle to keep it working properly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khawl ahih keileh mawtaw hoih tak a naseppaisuakna dingin sit leh bawlphatna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: take a car in for service

examples.english: My car needs a service next month.
examples.zomi: Kha hong tung dingin ka mawtaw enkol kul hi.

examples.english: Regular service helps the engine last longer.
examples.zomi: Hun ciangtan a enkolna in engine sawtzaw zangtheihna hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, maintenance or servicing may be used when referring to work done on a vehicle.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah mawtaw enkolna gen dingin maintenance ahih keileh servicing zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: Religious ceremony
senses.definition_en: A formal period of worship, prayer or religious ceremony.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna, thungetna ahih keileh biakna ngeina a kibawl hun ahi hi.

examples.english: The Sunday service begins at ten.
examples.zomi: Sunday biakna dak sawm in kipan hi.

examples.english: Many families attended the memorial service.
examples.zomi: Innkuan tampi phawkna biakna ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In religious contexts, service refers to an organized act of worship, not work provided to a customer.
senses.usage_zomi: Biakna tawh kisai ah service in customer a ding nasep kawklo a, kizem biakna hun kawk hi.

senses.heading: Period devoted to an activity
senses.definition_en: A period of time arranged for a particular activity, meeting or lesson.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepna, kikhopna ahih keileh pilna ciangtak khat a ding kiguan hun ahi hi.

examples.english: The training session lasted two hours.
examples.zomi: Pilna piak hun in nai nih sawt hi.

examples.english: We will answer questions at the end of the session.
examples.zomi: Hun khen tawp ciangin dotna-te dawng ding ung.

senses.usage_en: A session has a clear beginning and end and is devoted to one activity or purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Session khat in kipatna leh tawpna ciangtak nei a, sepna ahih keileh ngimna khat a ding kizang hi.

senses.heading: Meeting period of an official body
senses.definition_en: A period during which a court, parliament or other official body meets to conduct business.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thuukna, parliament ahih keileh ukna pawl khat nasep ding a kikhop hun ahi hi.

examples.english: Parliament begins its new session next week.
examples.zomi: Parliament in kaal hong tung dingin kikhop hun thak kipan ding hi.

examples.english: The court is not in session today.
examples.zomi: Thuukna tuni in kikhop lo hi.

senses.usage_en: In session means that an official body is currently meeting or operating.
senses.usage_zomi: In session cihpen ukna pawl khat tuhun in kikhop ahih keileh nasem cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A group of similar or related things that belong together or are used together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kibang ahih keileh kizom a, pawlkhat in kizangkhawm na-te ahi hi.

examples.english: He bought a new set of tools.
examples.zomi: Amahin vanzat set thak khat lei hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave us a set of questions.
examples.zomi: Siamah in dotna pawl khat hong pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a set of + plural noun: a set of keys. The verb normally agrees with set: The set is complete.
senses.usage_zomi: A set of + plural noun ci in kizang hi: a set of keys. Verb pen set tawh kituak in kizang hi: The set is complete.

senses.heading: Put something in a position
senses.definition_en: To put someone or something in a particular place or position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat mun ahih keileh dinmun ciangtak khat ah koih cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: set the cup on the table
set the ladder against the wall

examples.english: She set the bag on the floor.
examples.zomi: Amahin bawm pen leitang ah koih hi.

examples.english: Set the box beside the door.
examples.zomi: Bawm pen kongkhak geiah koih in.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle of set are also set, not setted.
senses.usage_zomi: Set a past tense leh past participle zong set mah ahi a, setted hilo hi.

senses.heading: Establish a rule, level or standard
senses.definition_en: To decide or establish a rule, limit, price, standard or goal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, ciangtan, man, standard ahih keileh ngimna khensat leh kipsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The team set a goal of raising ten thousand dollars.
examples.zomi: Team in dollar tul sawm ngah ding ngimna koih hi.

examples.english: The government sets safety standards.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in bitna standard ciangtan hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, set means making something definite or official.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah set in na khat kician leh official a kipsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Adjust a device
senses.definition_en: To adjust a device so that it operates at a particular time, level or mode.
senses.explanation_zomi: Device khat hun, level ahih keileh zatdan ciangtak khat tawh nasep dingin bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I set the alarm for six o’clock.
examples.zomi: Alarm pen dak guk dingin ka koih hi.

examples.english: Set the oven to 180 degrees.
examples.zomi: Oven pen degree 180 ah koih in.

senses.usage_en: Use set something to for a level or mode and set something for a time.
senses.usage_zomi: Level ahih keileh mode ma ah set something to kizang a, hun ma ah set something for kizang hi.

senses.heading: Cause something to begin
senses.definition_en: To cause an event, process or action to begin.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang, sepzia ahih keileh gamtatna khat kipansak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The announcement set the process in motion.
examples.zomi: Thupulaakna in sepzia kipansak hi.

examples.english: Her courage set a good example for the children.
examples.zomi: A hangsanna in naupang-te a ding etteh ding hoih khat lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Many meanings of set occur in fixed expressions, so learners should study it together with its common phrases.
senses.usage_zomi: Set a khiatna tampi pen kammal kizomte sungah om ahih manin, a common phrase-te tawh kisin khawm ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Place and time of a story or event
senses.definition_en: The place, time and social conditions in which a story or event happens.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tangthu pianmun leh hun; thu pian dinmun
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu ahih keileh thu piang khat a pianna mun, hun leh khuahun dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The novel has a rural setting.
examples.zomi: Novel tangthu pen khuano dinmun ah piang hi.

examples.english: The story’s setting is Myanmar in the 1950s.
examples.zomi: Tangthu pianmun leh hun pen 1950 kumin Myanmar gam ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The setting of a story includes more than location; it may also include the historical period and social environment.
senses.usage_zomi: Tangthu setting in mun bek hilo a, tangthu hun leh khuahun nuntakzia zong huam hi.

senses.heading: Position or adjustment on a device
senses.definition_en: One of the positions or choices controlling how a machine or device operates.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khawl ahih keileh device khat a nasepzia uk ding teeltheihna ahih keileh level khat ahi hi.

examples.english: You can change the language in the phone settings.
examples.zomi: Phone setting sungah pau khelsak thei ding hi.

examples.english: Cook the food on a low setting.
examples.zomi: An pen mei nem setting tawh huan in.

senses.usage_en: The plural settings is common for the group of options used to control a computer, phone or application.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer, phone ahih keileh app ukna teeltheihna pawl kawk dingin plural settings kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Surroundings
senses.definition_en: The surroundings or environment in which someone or something is located.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat a omna kiim leh khuahun ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel stands in a beautiful mountain setting.
examples.zomi: Hotel pen mual lak omna mun hoih ah om hi.

examples.english: The meeting took place in an informal setting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna pen formal lo kiim khuahun ah kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, setting emphasizes the character and atmosphere of the surrounding place.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah setting in omna mun kiim a dinmun leh khuahun bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Resolve a disagreement or problem
senses.definition_en: To end a disagreement or solve a problem by reaching a decision or agreement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikalhna ahih keileh haksatna khat khensatna ahih keileh kilemna tawh tawpsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two sides agreed to settle the dispute peacefully.
examples.zomi: Lamnihte in kikalhna lungmuang takin bawlkhin ding lungkim uh hi.

examples.english: We need to settle this matter today.
examples.zomi: Hih thu tuni in khensat kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Settle suggests reaching a final decision so that a disagreement or uncertainty can end.
senses.usage_zomi: Settle in kikalhna ahih keileh kicianlohna tawp theihna ding khensatna nunung khat ngah cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: Begin living permanently in a place
senses.definition_en: To go to live in a place and make it your permanent home.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah pai in, tua mun pen tawntung teenna inn in bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The family settled in Ohio after moving to the United States.
examples.zomi: Innkuan pen United States ah a kisuan khit un Ohio ah teng uh hi.

examples.english: Many immigrants settled in the area.
examples.zomi: Gam dang pan hong pem mi tampi tua gamhuam ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Settle in can mean becoming comfortable in a new home, job or environment, even when the move is not permanent.
senses.usage_zomi: Settle in in inn thak, nasep thak ahih keileh khuahun thak ah om nuamta cihna zong nei thei hi, tawntung teenna a hih kullo hi.

senses.heading: Pay an amount owed
senses.definition_en: To pay a bill, debt or account completely.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bill, leiba ahih keileh account a bat khempeuh pia khin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We settled the hotel bill before leaving.
examples.zomi: Ka paikhiatma un hotel bill pia khin ung.

examples.english: He sold his car to settle his debts.
examples.zomi: A leiba-te pia khin dingin a mawtaw zuak hi.

senses.usage_en: In financial contexts, settle means completing payment so that nothing remains owed.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumvai tawh kisai ah settle cihpen batna a omlaihlohna ding sum pia khin cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Become calm or still
senses.definition_en: To become calm, quiet or stable after movement, excitement or worry.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhinna, lunglawpna ahih keileh lungkhamna khit ciangin lungdamai, gamdai ahih keileh kip suak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The baby settled after her mother picked her up.
examples.zomi: A nu in a kawh khit ciangin naungek gamdai hi.

examples.english: Wait for the dust to settle before opening the door.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak na honma in leivui gamdai dong ngak in.

senses.usage_en: Settle down can mean becoming calm or beginning a stable way of life.
senses.usage_zomi: Settle down in lungdamai cihna ahih keileh nuntakzia kip tawh nuntak kipan cihna nei thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 7.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat 7, guk khit leh giat ma a om nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: There are seven days in a week.
examples.zomi: Kaal khat sungah ni sagih om hi.

examples.english: The bus leaves at seven.
examples.zomi: Bus pen dak sagih in paikhiat hi.

senses.usage_en: As a number before a noun, seven functions as a determiner: seven books. As a name for the number, it functions as a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun ma ah nambat in kizang ciangin seven pen determiner ahi hi: seven books. Nambat min mah kawk ciangin noun ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 17.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sawm leh sagih; nambat sawm leh sagih
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat 17, sawm leh sagih ahi hi.

examples.english: Seventeen students attended the class.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang sawm leh sagih sang ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: She was seventeen when she finished school.
examples.zomi: Ama sang a zoh ciangin kum sawm leh sagih pha hi.

senses.usage_en: The main stress falls on the final syllable of seventeen. This helps distinguish it from seventy.
senses.usage_zomi: Seventeen ah aw thupisakna pen a tawp syllable tungah om hi. Tua in seventy tawh kikhen theihna hong pia hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 70.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat 70, sawm sagih ahi hi.

examples.english: About seventy people attended the meeting.
examples.zomi: Mi sawm sagih bang kikhopna ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: The battery is seventy per cent full.
examples.zomi: Battery pen za ah sawm sagih dim hi.

senses.usage_en: The main stress falls on the first syllable of seventy, unlike seventeen, which is stressed at the end.
senses.usage_zomi: Seventy ah aw thupisakna pen syllable masa tungah om a, a tawp a kithupisak seventeen tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.definition_en: More than two but not very many.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nih sang tamzaw napi tampi lua lo zah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Several students asked the same question.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang pawlkhat in dotna kibang dong uh hi.

examples.english: We stayed there for several days.
examples.zomi: Tua mun ah ni pawlkhat sung om ung.

senses.usage_en: Several is used before a plural countable noun. It normally suggests a small but noticeable number.
senses.usage_zomi: Several pen plural countable noun ma ah kizang hi. A tawntung in tampi lua lo napi phawkhuai zah nambat kawk hi.

senses.heading: Very serious or intense
senses.definition_en: Extremely serious, painful, harmful or difficult.
senses.explanation_zomi: A nasia mahmah, a lauhuai mahmah ahih keileh a haksa mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The patient was suffering from severe pain.
examples.zomi: Cina pen natna nasia thuak hi.

examples.english: Severe weather delayed the flight.
examples.zomi: Khuahun nasia hangin vanleng khuallam kikhal hi.

senses.usage_en: Severe is stronger than serious in many descriptions of pain, weather, damage and punishment.
senses.usage_zomi: Natna, khuahun, siatna leh thuaksiatna genna tampi ah severe pen serious sangin khauhzaw hi.

senses.heading: Strict or harsh
senses.definition_en: Very strict, harsh or demanding in manner, rules or punishment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, thukhun ahih keileh thuaksiatna ah khauh leh ngongtat mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The court imposed a severe punishment.
examples.zomi: Thuukna in thuaksiatna khauh pia hi.

examples.english: The old rules were unnecessarily severe.
examples.zomi: Thukhun lui-te kisaploh zahin khauh lua hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing a person, severe suggests an unfriendly, strict or unsmiling manner.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a gen ciangin severe in a lawmlolo, a khauh ahih keileh maitang khauh gamtatna nei cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: Biological category
senses.definition_en: The biological category of being male or female, especially as recorded at birth.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pasal leh numei hihna; pianken pumpi khen
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih keileh ganhing khat pasal maw numei maw cih a pianken pumpi tawh kisai khen ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: pianken pumpi tawh kisai pasal leh numei hihna
mi khat pasal maw numei maw ciapteh

examples.english: The form asks for the applicant’s age and sex.
examples.zomi: Form in lai a ngenpa kum leh pasal maw numei maw cih dong hi.

examples.english: Some diseases affect one sex more than the other.
examples.zomi: Natna pawlkhat in pasal ahih keileh numei lam khat nawngkai zaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Sex commonly refers to biological characteristics. Gender often refers to social identity and roles, though usage varies by context.
senses.usage_zomi: Sex in pianken pumpi tawh kisai pasal leh numei hihna kawk tam hi. Gender in khuahun sung mimal hihna leh mawng kawk tam napi, a zatna mun bangin khiatna kilamdang thei hi.

senses.heading: Sexual activity
senses.definition_en: Physical activity involving sexual relations between people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing kikal nupa kithuahna tawh kisai pumpi gamtatna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: nupa pumpi kizopna tawh kisai pilna

examples.english: Schools may provide age-appropriate sex education.
examples.zomi: Sangte in kum tawh a kituak nupa pumpi kizopna tawh kisai pilna pia thei uh hi.

examples.english: The doctor discussed safe sex with the patient.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in cina tawh bitna tawh nupa kithuahna thu kihoupih hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense concerns a private adult activity. Use clear, respectful and context-appropriate language when discussing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen picing mite mimal thu tawh kisai hi. Tua thu gen ciangin kician, zahtakhuai leh khuahun tawh kituak pau kizang ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Connected with sex or sexual activity
senses.definition_en: Connected with sexual feelings, attraction, behaviour or relations.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nupa kizopna tawh kisai; nupa deihna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Nupa lungsim deihna, ki-itna, gamtatna ahih keileh pumpi kizopna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The clinic provides information about sexual health.
examples.zomi: Siavuan inn in nupa pumpi kizopna cidamna thu pia hi.

examples.english: The course discusses respectful sexual behaviour.
examples.zomi: Tua course in zahtakna tawh nupa kizopna gamtatna thu gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Sexual is used for matters connected with sexual feelings or activity. It should be used precisely and respectfully.
senses.usage_zomi: Sexual pen nupa lungsim deihna ahih keileh pumpi kizopna tawh kisai thu genna dingin kizang hi. Kician leh zahtakna tawh kizang ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Connected with biological sex
senses.definition_en: Connected with the biological differences or reproduction of males and females.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pasal leh numei pumpi tawh kisai; suanlehkhakna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Pasal leh numei pumpi kilamdanna ahih keileh suanlehkhakna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The lesson explains sexual development during adolescence.
examples.zomi: Tua pilna in khangno hun a pasal leh numei pumpi khanna hilhcian hi.

examples.english: Many plants reproduce through sexual reproduction.
examples.zomi: Singkung tampi nupa kithuah suanlehkhakna tawh pung uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In biology, sexual can describe reproduction involving male and female reproductive cells.
senses.usage_zomi: Biology ah sexual in pasal leh numei suanlehkhakna cell a kihel suanlehkhakzia gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Area protected from direct light
senses.definition_en: An area that is cooler and darker because direct light, especially sunlight, is blocked.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavak, adiakin nisa, a lutloh manin a votzaw leh a mialzaw mun ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: under the shade of a tree

examples.english: We rested in the shade of a large tree.
examples.zomi: Singkung lian khat liim nuai ah tawlnga ung.

examples.english: The roof provides shade during the afternoon.
examples.zomi: Innkhum in nitaklam nisa liim pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Shade is the general darker area protected from light. A shadow is the particular dark shape made when an object blocks light.
senses.usage_zomi: Shade pen khuavak pan a bit mun mialzaw ahi hi. Shadow pen na khat in khuavak a daal ciang a kibawl a lim mial ahi hi.

senses.heading: Particular form of a colour
senses.definition_en: A particular variety of a colour that is lighter, darker or slightly different.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kulep khat a khuavakzaw, a mialzaw ahih keileh tawm kilamdang a lim khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She painted the wall a pale shade of blue.
examples.zomi: Amahin kulh pen blue kulep taang khat tawh su hi.

examples.english: The leaves show several shades of green.
examples.zomi: Singteh-te in green kulep nam tuamtuam lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a shade of + colour to describe a particular variety of that colour.
senses.usage_zomi: Kulep khat a nam tuam gen dingin a shade of + colour kizang hi.

senses.heading: Slight amount
senses.definition_en: A very small amount or degree of a quality or feeling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih keileh lungsim dinmun khat tawmno a omna ahi hi.

examples.english: The second design is a shade better.
examples.zomi: Design a nihna pen tawmzaw hoih hi.

examples.english: There was a shade of disappointment in her voice.
examples.zomi: A aw sungah lungkimlohna tawmno om hi.

senses.usage_en: This use of shade is figurative and usually means a very small difference or amount.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih shade zatna pen tehpihna ahi a, kilamdanna ahih keileh zat tawmno cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Dark shape made by blocked light
senses.definition_en: A dark shape formed on a surface when a person or object blocks light.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat in khuavak a daal ciangin leitang ahih keileh na phel tung a kilang lim mial ahi hi.

examples.english: The tree cast a long shadow across the road.
examples.zomi: Singkung in lampi tungah liim sau khat bawl hi.

examples.english: I saw a shadow move behind the curtain.
examples.zomi: Puanzam nungah liim khat a kikhih mu ing.

senses.usage_en: A shadow has the general shape of the person or object blocking the light. Shade means an area protected from direct light.
senses.usage_zomi: Shadow in khuavak a daal mi ahih keileh na lim zui hi. Shade in khuavak direct pan a bit mun kawk hi.

senses.heading: Influence that makes someone less noticeable
senses.definition_en: A situation in which someone receives less attention because another person is more successful or important.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang khat a minthanna ahih keileh thupina hangin mi khat a kilangzaw lohna dinmun ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat minthanna nuai ah nungta

examples.english: He grew up in the shadow of his famous brother.
examples.zomi: Ama a minthang sanggampa minthanna nuai ah khang hi.

examples.english: She finally stepped out of her manager’s shadow.
examples.zomi: A tawpna ah ama manager minthanna nuai pan amah a kilatna ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes being less recognized because of another person’s influence or success.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in midang khat thuneihna ahih keileh gualzawhna hangin a min kiphawk zawlo cihna gen hi.

senses.heading: Move quickly back and forth
senses.definition_en: To move something quickly and repeatedly from side to side or up and down.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat langkhat pan langkhat ahih keileh tung leh nuai ah manlang takin vei tampi kikhinsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Shake the bottle before opening it.
examples.zomi: Thawl na honma in sing in.

examples.english: She shook her head and said no.
examples.zomi: Amahin a lu sing a, “no” ci hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is shook, and the past participle is shaken.
senses.usage_zomi: Shake a past tense pen shook a, past participle pen shaken ahi hi.

senses.heading: Tremble
senses.definition_en: To make small uncontrolled movements because of fear, cold, weakness or strong emotion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lau, vot, thahatloh ahih keileh lungsim naa hangin pumpi amah a sing cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: His hands were shaking from the cold.
examples.zomi: Vot hangin a khutte sing hi.

examples.english: She shook with fear when she heard the noise.
examples.zomi: Aw a zak ciangin launa hangin liing hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the movement is usually involuntary and not deliberately produced.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah kikhihna pen deihna tawh kibawl hilo a, pumpi amah in kikhih ahi hi.

senses.heading: Shock or upset deeply
senses.definition_en: To shock, frighten or emotionally disturb someone strongly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungla, lausak ahih keileh lungsim nasatak in buaisak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The accident deeply shook the whole family.
examples.zomi: Accident in innkuan buppi lungsim nasatak in buaisak hi.

examples.english: The failure shook his confidence.
examples.zomi: Guallelna in ama kimuanna susia hi.

senses.usage_en: Be shaken by describes a strong emotional reaction to a disturbing event.
senses.usage_zomi: Be shaken by in lungbuaihuai thu khat hangin lungsim nasatak a kibuai cihna gen hi.

senses.heading: Offer or suggestion with “I” or “we”
senses.definition_en: Used with I or we to offer help or suggest what to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: I ahih keileh we tawh huhna pia ahih keileh bang hih ding cih ngaihsutna pia dingin kizang hi.

common_phrases.zomi: Bang hih ding i hi hiam?

examples.english: Shall I open the window?
examples.zomi: Thlalang kong ka hon ding maw?

examples.english: Shall we meet at ten?
examples.zomi: Dak sawm in kimuh ni maw?

senses.usage_en: In modern English, shall is most common in questions with I and we when making offers or suggestions.
senses.usage_zomi: Tulai English ah shall pen I leh we tawh huhna piakna ahih keileh ngaihsutna piakna dotna ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Formal future or requirement
senses.definition_en: Used in formal language to state what will happen or what is required.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bang piang ding ahih keileh bang hih kul ding cih formal pau tawh genna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: The agreement shall remain in effect for one year.
examples.zomi: Kilepna pen kum khat sung kizom paisuak ding hi.

examples.english: Members shall follow the rules.
examples.zomi: Member-te in thukhun zui kul ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In contracts and regulations, shall may express a legal duty. In ordinary future statements, will is now more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Contract leh thukhun ah shall in dan tawh a kisam mawpuakna kawk thei hi. Nisim future thugenna ah will kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Not deep
senses.definition_en: Having only a short distance from the surface to the bottom.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui ahih keileh kua khat a tung pan a taw dong gamla lo, thuk lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children played in the shallow water.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te tui thuklo sungah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: Dig a shallow hole for the seeds.
examples.zomi: Ci-te a ding kua thuklo khat lai in.

senses.usage_en: Shallow is the opposite of deep.
senses.usage_zomi: Shallow pen deep a kilehbulh ahi hi.

senses.heading: Lacking serious thought or understanding
senses.definition_en: Not showing deep thought, strong understanding or serious feeling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna thuk, telna kicing ahih keileh lungsim taktak a neilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The article gives only a shallow explanation of the problem.
examples.zomi: Article in haksatna thu hilhcianhna thuklo bek pia hi.

examples.english: It is unfair to judge someone by such a shallow standard.
examples.zomi: Tua bang standard puatham bek tawh mi khat a thukhenna thutang lo hi.

senses.usage_en: When used about a person or idea, shallow is negative and suggests a lack of depth or seriousness.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih keileh ngaihsutna khat a gen ciangin shallow pen hoihlo khiatna nei a, ngaihsutna thuk ahih keileh thupitak a omlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Painful feeling about wrongdoing or failure
senses.definition_en: A painful feeling caused by believing that you have done something wrong, foolish or dishonourable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khial, haihuai ahih keileh zahtaklohhuai gamtatna khat bawl cih a kiphawkna pan a hong piang zumna lungsim ahi hi.

examples.english: He felt deep shame about the way he had treated his friend.
examples.zomi: A lawm tungah a gamtatdan hangin nasatak in zum hi.

examples.english: She admitted her mistake without shame.
examples.zomi: Amahin a khialhna zumlo in pulak hi.

senses.usage_en: Shame concerns a painful judgment about yourself or your behaviour. Guilt more specifically concerns responsibility for wrongdoing.
senses.usage_zomi: Shame in nangmah ahih keileh na gamtatna tung a zumna lungsim kawk hi. Guilt in mawhna khat a ding mawpuakna nei cihna ciangtak kawk hi.

senses.heading: Unfortunate situation
senses.definition_en: A situation that causes disappointment or regret.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungkimlohna ahih keileh dahna piangsak dinmun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: It is a shame that you cannot attend the wedding.
examples.zomi: Mopawi ah na kihel theihlohna dahhuai hi.

examples.english: What a shame! We missed the final train.
examples.zomi: Dahhuai tak! Meileng nunung mansuah ung.

senses.usage_en: It’s a shame often expresses sympathy or disappointment; it does not necessarily mean that anyone has behaved badly.
senses.usage_zomi: It’s a shame in lainatna ahih keileh lungkimlohna lak tam a, mi khat in gamtat khial cihna a hih pah kullo hi.

senses.heading: Outer form
senses.definition_en: The outer form or appearance of someone or something, especially as shown by its edges.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat a pualam lim, adiakin a gei-te in a lak lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The table has a round shape.
examples.zomi: Sabuai pen lim bial ahi hi.

examples.english: Clouds constantly change their shape.
examples.zomi: Meiingo-te in a lim uh kikhel tawntung hi.

senses.usage_en: Shape describes the form of something, while size describes how large or small it is.
senses.usage_zomi: Shape in na khat a lim gen a, size in a liandan ahih keileh a neudan gen hi.

senses.heading: Physical condition
senses.definition_en: The physical condition of a person or object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pumpi dinmun ahih keileh van khat hoih leh hoihlo dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The old building is still in good shape.
examples.zomi: Innpi lui pen dinmun hoih ah om lai hi.

examples.english: She exercises every day to stay in shape.
examples.zomi: Pumpi thahat a om paisuakna dingin ni sim exercise bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: For people, in good shape often means physically healthy and fit. For objects, it means being in good condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Mihing tawh kisai ah in good shape cihpen pumpi cidam leh thahat cihna ahi hi. Van khat a gen ciangin dinmun hoih ah om cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Particular form or organization
senses.definition_en: The particular form, structure or condition that an idea, plan or situation takes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, geelna ahih keileh dinmun khat a kibawlzia leh a kipiandan ahi hi.

examples.english: The new project is beginning to take shape.
examples.zomi: Project thak pen lim nei kipan ta hi.

examples.english: Several people helped give shape to the proposal.
examples.zomi: Mi pawlkhat in geelna kipiandan bawl ding huh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Take shape means to become clearer, more organized or more fully developed.
senses.usage_zomi: Take shape cihpen thu khat kician semsem, kizem semsem ahih keileh khangto semsem cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Use or have together
senses.definition_en: To use, have or experience something together with another person or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat midang ahih keileh pawl khat tawh zatkhawm, neikhawm ahih keileh phutkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two students share a room.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang nihte in pindan khat zatkhawm uh hi.

examples.english: We share responsibility for completing the work.
examples.zomi: Nasep zohna ding mawpuakna neikhawm ung.

senses.usage_en: Use share something with someone: I share an office with two colleagues.
senses.usage_zomi: Share something with someone ci in kizang hi: I share an office with two colleagues.

senses.heading: Divide and give a part to others
senses.definition_en: To divide something so that other people receive or use part of it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat khen in midang-te zong a khen ngah ahih keileh zangthei dingin pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children shared the fruit equally.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te in gah pen a kikim in khenkhawm uh hi.

examples.english: She shared her lunch with a friend.
examples.zomi: Amahin a sun-an a lawm khat tawh khenkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Sharing does not always mean dividing something physically; people can also share access, responsibility or time.
senses.usage_zomi: Share cihpen na khat pumpi khen cihna bek hilo a, zattheihna, mawpuakna ahih keileh hun zong khenkhawm thei hi.

senses.heading: Tell or communicate
senses.definition_en: To tell someone about information, an idea, experience or feeling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, ngaihsutna, phutkhak ahih keileh lungsim dinmun midang kiangah gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please share your ideas with the group.
examples.zomi: Na ngaihsutna-te pawl kiangah pulak in.

examples.english: He shared his experience with the younger workers.
examples.zomi: Amahin a phutkhak thu nasemno-te kiangah gen hi.

senses.usage_en: In digital communication, share also means sending or making content available to other users.
senses.usage_zomi: Digital kizopna ah share in thu ahih keileh lai midang-te kiangah sawl ahih keileh amau muh theih ding a bawl cihna zong ahi hi.

senses.heading: Having a fine cutting edge or point
senses.definition_en: Having a thin edge or fine point that can cut or pierce easily.
senses.explanation_zomi: Baih takin tan ahih keileh sun thei a zum gei ahih keileh a hiam mong nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Be careful—the knife is very sharp.
examples.zomi: Pilvang in—tem pen a hiam mahmah hi.

examples.english: The plant has sharp points on its leaves.
examples.zomi: Sing kung singteh-te in a zum mong nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Sharp is the opposite of blunt when describing a cutting edge or point.
senses.usage_zomi: Tan gei ahih keileh mong a gen ciangin sharp pen blunt a kilehbulh ahi hi.

senses.heading: Sudden and severe
senses.definition_en: Sudden, strong or severe, especially when describing pain, sound or change.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thakhat a piang, khauh ahih keileh nasia, adiakin natna, aw leh kikhelna a gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She felt a sharp pain in her back.
examples.zomi: Ama a nung ah natna thakhat a nasia phawk hi.

examples.english: The price rose sharply last month.
examples.zomi: Kha khit in man manlang leh lian takin khang hi.

senses.usage_en: A sharp pain usually begins suddenly and feels intense in one particular area.
senses.usage_zomi: Sharp pain pen thakhat in kipan a, mun ciangtak khat ah nasatak in kina hi.

senses.heading: Quick to notice or understand
senses.definition_en: Able to notice, understand or think about things quickly and accurately.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na-te manlang leh maan takin phawk, tel ahih keileh ngaihsun thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a sharp mind and learns quickly.
examples.zomi: Ama lungsim phawk siang a, manlang takin sin hi.

examples.english: His sharp eyes noticed the small mistake.
examples.zomi: A mit phawk siang in khialhna tawmno mu hi.

senses.usage_en: When used about a person’s mind or senses, sharp is positive and means alert or quick.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat lungsim ahih keileh pumpi theihna a gen ciangin sharp pen hoihna khiatna nei a, phawk baih leh manlang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Exactly at a stated time
senses.definition_en: Exactly at the stated time, without being late.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nungta lo in hun kigen ciangtak ah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting begins at nine sharp.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna dak kua ciangtak in kipan hi.

examples.english: Please be here at seven sharp.
examples.zomi: Dak sagih ciangtak in hiah om in.

senses.usage_en: This meaning of sharp comes after a stated time.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih sharp khiatna pen hun kigen khit ciangin kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Used as the subject of a verb to refer to a female person or animal already mentioned or understood.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kigen khinsa ahih keileh kitelkhinsa numei mi ahih keileh ganhing numei khat pen verb subject in kawkna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: My sister is a teacher, and she works at a local school.
examples.zomi: Ka sanggaminu siamah ahi a, khuahun sung sang khat ah sem hi.

examples.english: She said that she would arrive tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Amahin zingciang tung ding ka hi ci hi.

senses.usage_en: She is a subject pronoun. Use her as the object: She called me, and I called her.
senses.usage_zomi: She pen subject pronoun ahi hi. Object dingin her kizang hi: She called me, and I called her.

senses.definition_en: A farm animal with thick wool, commonly kept for its wool, meat or milk.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mul tamtak nei a, a mul, sa ahih keileh susu a ding khawi ngei lo ganhing ahi hi.

examples.english: The farmer keeps fifty sheep.
examples.zomi: Loh neipa in tuu sawmnga khawi hi.

examples.english: The sheep were eating grass on the hill.
examples.zomi: Tuu-te mual tungah lopa ne uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The singular and plural forms are both sheep: one sheep, ten sheep. Do not use sheeps.
senses.usage_zomi: Singular leh plural lim a nihgel in sheep mah ahi hi: one sheep, ten sheep. Sheeps kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Large piece of cloth used on a bed
senses.definition_en: A large, thin piece of cloth used to cover a mattress or a person in bed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lupna tung a kiphah ahih keileh a ki-um puan neu leh lian ahi hi.

examples.english: She put clean sheets on the bed.
examples.zomi: Amahin lupna tungah lupna puan siangtho phah hi.

examples.english: We change the sheets every week.
examples.zomi: Kaal sim lupna puan khel ung.

senses.usage_en: A sheet is normally thinner and lighter than a blanket.
senses.usage_zomi: Sheet pen puanlum sangin a pan zaw leh a zang zaw hi.

senses.heading: Flat piece of paper or material
senses.definition_en: A large, thin, flat piece of paper, glass, metal or another material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, thlalang, sik ahih keileh van dang tawh kibawl a phel, a pan leh a zai na khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Write your name on a sheet of paper.
examples.zomi: Lai phel khat tungah na min gelh in.

examples.english: The roof is made from sheets of metal.
examples.zomi: Innkhum pen sik phel-te tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a sheet of to count paper and similar flat materials: three sheets of paper.
senses.usage_zomi: Lai leh van phel dangte sim dingin a sheet of kizang hi: three sheets of paper.

senses.heading: Page containing organized information
senses.definition_en: A page or document containing information, questions or instructions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, dotna ahih keileh thuhilhna kizem tak a kigelh lai phel ahih keileh laikhial ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave each student an answer sheet.
examples.zomi: Siamah in sangnaupang ciat dawnna gelhna lai pia hi.

examples.english: Read the information sheet before completing the form.
examples.zomi: Form na bawlzohma in thu pia lai sim in.

senses.usage_en: In compounds, sheet often names a document designed for a particular kind of information.
senses.usage_zomi: Compound sungah sheet in thu nam ciangtak khat a ding kibawl laikhial kawk tam hi.

senses.definition_en: A flat horizontal board used for holding books, food or other objects, usually fixed to a wall or inside a cupboard.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, an ahih keileh van dangte koihna ding a phel, kulh ahih keileh cupboard sung a kikoih van ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat van koihna tungah koih

examples.english: The books are on the top shelf.
examples.zomi: Laibu-te van koihna tungnung penah om hi.

examples.english: She put the cups back on the shelf.
examples.zomi: Amahin hai-te van koihna tungah koihkik hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural of shelf is shelves, not shelfs.
senses.usage_zomi: Shelf a plural pen shelves ahi a, shelfs hilo hi.

senses.heading: Hard outer covering of an animal or egg
senses.definition_en: The hard outer covering that protects an egg or the body of certain animals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aktui ahih keileh ganhing nam pawlkhat a pualam a dal leh a kem a khauh tuam, a hawng ahi hi.

examples.english: The chick broke through the eggshell.
examples.zomi: Aano in tui hawng kitam in hong pusuak khia hi.

examples.english: We found several shells on the beach.
examples.zomi: Tuipi geiah hawng pawlkhat mu ung.

senses.usage_en: Shell can refer to an animal’s protective covering or an empty shell left after the animal is gone.
senses.usage_zomi: Shell in ganhing vun khauh ahih keileh ganhing a piankhiat khit a a omlai hawng cih theih hi.

senses.heading: Hard outer case
senses.definition_en: A hard outer covering or case that protects something inside.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sung a om na kem ding a pualam tuam khauh ahi hi.

examples.english: The device has a strong plastic shell.
examples.zomi: Device in plastic tuam khauh nei hi.

examples.english: The building’s outer shell survived the fire.
examples.zomi: Innpi pualam tuam pen meikuang sungah sia lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is often used for machines, buildings and protective containers.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen khawl, innpi leh kemna bawm-te a genna dingin kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Explosive military object
senses.definition_en: A metal object containing explosives that is fired from a large gun.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuakpi sungpan a kihawl, puakkham a nei sik tuam ahi hi.

examples.english: An unexploded shell was found near the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi geiah a puah nailo shell khat kimu hi.

examples.english: The old shell was removed by a military team.
examples.zomi: Galkap pawl in shell lui pen laikhia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This military sense is different from the protective covering of an animal or egg.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih galkap tawh kisai khiatna pen ganhing ahih keileh artui tuam khiatna tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Protection from weather or danger
senses.definition_en: Protection from rain, wind, extreme weather or danger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Guah, huih, khuahun nasia ahih keileh lauhuaina pan a kidalna ahi hi.

examples.english: We took shelter from the storm under a bridge.
examples.zomi: Huihpi kidopna dingin lei kaam nuai ah lut ung.

examples.english: The trees provided shelter from the hot sun.
examples.zomi: Singkung-te in nisa ling pan kidopna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Take shelter means to move to a protected place because of weather or danger.
senses.usage_zomi: Take shelter cihpen khuahun ahih keileh lauhuaina hangin a bit munah pai cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Building for people or animals needing protection
senses.definition_en: A building that provides temporary protection or accommodation for people or animals in need.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huhna a kisam mite ahih keileh ganhing-te a ding tawlkhat bitna leh teenna a pia inn ahi hi.

examples.english: The city opened a shelter for homeless families.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in inn neilo innkuan-te a ding bitna inn khat hon hi.

examples.english: They adopted a dog from an animal shelter.
examples.zomi: Amaute in ganhing kemna inn pan ui khat la uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A shelter usually provides temporary safety rather than a permanent home.
senses.usage_zomi: Shelter in tawntung teenna inn sangin tawlkhat bitna mun pia tam hi.

senses.heading: Period of work
senses.definition_en: A scheduled period during which a person or group works.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih keileh pawl khat nasep dingin kiguan hun khen ahi hi.

examples.english: She works the night shift at the hospital.
examples.zomi: Ama hospital ah zan nasep hun sem hi.

examples.english: My shift ends at four thirty.
examples.zomi: Ka nasep hun dak li leh kim in tawp hi.

senses.usage_en: Workers may be on shift while working and off shift when their scheduled work period has ended.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasem-te nasem laitak un on shift kici a, a nasep hun a tawp ciangin off shift kici hi.

senses.heading: Change in position, direction or opinion
senses.definition_en: A noticeable change from one position, condition, direction or way of thinking to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, khuahun, lampi ahih keileh ngaihsutdan khat pan a dang khat ah kician tak a kikhelna ahi hi.

examples.english: There has been a major shift in public opinion.
examples.zomi: Mipite ngaihsutna ah kikhelna lian om hi.

examples.english: The wind changed after a sudden shift in direction.
examples.zomi: Huih lampi thakhat a kikhel khit ciangin huih kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a shift in before the condition or idea that changes.
senses.usage_zomi: A kikhel khuahun ahih keileh ngaihsutna ma ah a shift in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Produce or reflect light
senses.definition_en: To produce light or appear bright by reflecting light.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavak suah ahih keileh khuavak a lelkik manin taang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The sun was shining through the window.
examples.zomi: Thlalang kong pan ni taang lut hi.

examples.english: Her eyes shone with excitement.
examples.zomi: Lunglawpna hangin a mitte taang hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are normally shone when shine means producing light.
senses.usage_zomi: Shine in khuavak suah cihna a neih ciangin a past tense leh past participle pen shone ahi hi.

senses.heading: Polish a surface
senses.definition_en: To rub or polish something until its surface becomes bright.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pualam taang dong nul ahih keileh siansuah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He shined his shoes before the interview.
examples.zomi: Interview ma in a khembel-te taangsak hi.

examples.english: She used a cloth to shine the table.
examples.zomi: Sabuai taangsak dingin puan zang hi.

senses.usage_en: When shine means polishing something, the past tense shined is commonly used, especially in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Shine in na khat nul taangsak cihna a neih ciangin, adiakin American English ah, past tense shined kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Perform very well
senses.definition_en: To perform extremely well and be noticed for your ability.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoih mahmah in sem a, a siamna hangin mi phawkhuai suak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She really shone in the final performance.
examples.zomi: Tawpna performance ah ama siam takin sem hi.

examples.english: The project gave young artists a chance to shine.
examples.zomi: Project in artist no-te a siamna uh laktheihna hun pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative meaning is positive and describes outstanding performance or ability.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna pen hoihna ahi a, sepna ahih keileh siamna a hoih mahmah cihna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a smooth, bright surface that reflects light.
senses.explanation_zomi: A pualam neem leh taang a, khuavak lelkik thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He wore a pair of shiny black shoes.
examples.zomi: Ama khembel vom taang khat silh hi.

examples.english: The floor was clean and shiny.
examples.zomi: Innkuan pen siangtho leh taang hi.

senses.usage_en: Shiny describes a surface that reflects light. It does not necessarily mean that the object produces its own light.
senses.usage_zomi: Shiny in khuavak a lelkik na pualam gen hi. Tua van in amah khuavak suah cihna a hih kullo hi.

senses.definition_en: A large boat used for carrying people or goods across the sea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuipi tungah mi ahih keileh van-te puakna ding a kizang tembaw lian ahi hi.

examples.english: The cargo ship arrived at the port this morning.
examples.zomi: Vanpuak tembaw pen tuni zing in tuikhualgiah tung hi.

examples.english: They travelled across the ocean by ship.
examples.zomi: Amaute tuipi lian kantan in tembaw tawh khualzin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A ship is generally larger than a boat, although the exact distinction depends on context and use.
senses.usage_zomi: Ship pen boat sangin lianzaw ngei napi, a kilamdanna ciangtak pen a kizangna bangin om hi.

senses.definition_en: A piece of clothing worn on the upper body, usually with sleeves, a collar and buttons at the front.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tunglam a kisilh, a tawntung in ban, ngawng leh a maitang ah button a nei puan ahi hi.

examples.english: He wore a blue shirt to work.
examples.zomi: Ama nasep ah sangkhit blue silh hi.

examples.english: This shirt is too large for me.
examples.zomi: Hih sangkhit kei a ding lian lua hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, shirt may cover several kinds of upper-body clothing. In British English, a shirt commonly has a collar and front buttons.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah shirt in pumpi tunglam puan nam tuamtuam huam thei hi. British English ah shirt pen ngawng leh maitang button a nei puan ahi tam hi.

senses.heading: Strong emotional reaction
senses.definition_en: A sudden and powerful feeling of surprise, fear or distress caused by an unexpected event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngakloh thu khat hangin thakhat a hong piang lamdanna, launa ahih keileh lungsim natna lian ahi hi.

examples.english: The news of his death was a terrible shock.
examples.zomi: A sihna thu pen lungla mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: She was in shock after the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident khit ciangin ama lungsim kibuai dinmun ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Shock is stronger than ordinary surprise and often involves distress, fear or difficulty responding normally.
senses.usage_zomi: Shock pen lamdanna ngeina sangin khauhzaw a, lungkhamna, launa ahih keileh ngeina bang a gamtat theihlohna huam thei hi.

senses.heading: Dangerous medical condition
senses.definition_en: A dangerous medical condition in which the body does not receive enough blood and oxygen after injury, blood loss or severe illness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Liamna, sisan tamtak luanna ahih keileh natna nasia khit ciangin pumpi in sisan leh huangka kicing a ngahloh hang a piang cidamna lauhuai dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The injured driver showed signs of shock.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawlpa liam in shock natna lim lak hi.

examples.english: Keep the patient warm while waiting for help.
examples.zomi: Huhna na ngak laitak in cina lum in kem in.

senses.usage_en: Medical shock is an emergency and is different from merely feeling emotionally surprised.
senses.usage_zomi: Cidamna lam shock pen manlang tak a enkawl kul lauhuaina ahi a, lungsim lam a lamdang bek tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Electric current through the body
senses.definition_en: A painful or dangerous effect caused when electric current passes through the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meikang pumpi sung a luan ciangin a piang natna ahih keileh lauhuaina ahi hi.

examples.english: He received an electric shock from the damaged wire.
examples.zomi: Meikhaat a siat hangin meikang sat hi.

examples.english: Turn off the power to avoid electric shock.
examples.zomi: Meikang satlohna dingin mei khih in.

senses.usage_en: The full expression electric shock is clearest when referring to electricity.
senses.usage_zomi: Meikang tawh kisai khiatna kician dingin electric shock cih kammal kizom zat hoihpen hi.

senses.heading: Unexpected change or event
senses.definition_en: A sudden event or change that strongly affects people, an organization or an economy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite, pawl ahih keileh sumlehpai nasatak a nawngkai thakhat thu piang ahih keileh kikhelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The sudden price increase caused a shock to the economy.
examples.zomi: Man thakhat a khanna in sumlehpai nasatak in nawngkai hi.

examples.english: Small businesses struggled to recover from the shock.
examples.zomi: Business neu-te thakhat nawngkaina pan hoihkik dingin haksat uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense is common in economics, politics and public affairs.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna pen sumlehpai, politics leh mipite thu ah kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: Extremely surprised, upset or disturbed by something unexpected or unacceptable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngakloh ahih keileh sangtheihloh thu khat hangin lamdang, lungsim na ahih keileh lungbuai mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We were shocked by the news of the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident thu hangin lungla mahmah ung.

examples.english: She was shocked to discover that the money was missing.
examples.zomi: Sum a mang a muh ciangin ama lamdang mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Use shocked by/at before the cause and shocked to + verb before an action or discovery. Shocked describes the person’s feeling; shocking describes what causes it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hangthu ma ah shocked by/at kizang a, gamtatna ahih keileh muhkhia na ma ah shocked to + verb kizang hi. Shocked in mi lungsim gen a, shocking in tua lungsim a piangsak na gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A covering for the foot, usually with a firm sole and not extending far above the ankle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe a kidalna ding a kisilh, a nuai khauh a, khegu sung tunglam dong sawhlo khevan ahi hi.

examples.english: She bought a new pair of shoes.
examples.zomi: Amahin khembel thak khat lei hi.

examples.english: Please take off your shoes before entering.
examples.zomi: Na lutma in na khembel suut in.

senses.usage_en: Shoes normally come in pairs. Say a pair of shoes for two matching shoes.
senses.usage_zomi: Khembel pen a nih in kizangkhawm ngei hi. Khembel a nih a kituak kawk dingin a pair of shoes kici hi.

senses.heading: Fire a weapon
senses.definition_en: To fire a gun or another weapon, or to hit or kill someone or something with it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meithal ahih keileh galhiam dang khat kap, ahih keileh tua tawh mi ahih keileh ganhing khat liamsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hunter shot at the deer but missed.
examples.zomi: Sazongpa in sakhi kap napi man lo hi.

examples.english: Police warned the man not to shoot.
examples.zomi: Police-te in tua mipa kap lo ding va uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Shoot at means firing toward a target and does not necessarily mean hitting it. Shoot someone normally means the person was hit.
senses.usage_zomi: Shoot at cihpen ngimna lam kap cihna a, a man taktak kullo hi. Shoot someone cihpen tua mi meithal liam cihna ahi tam hi.

senses.heading: Take photographs or make a film
senses.definition_en: To take photographs or record a film or video.
senses.explanation_zomi: Limla ahih keileh film leh video record cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They shot the film in New York.
examples.zomi: Amaute in film pen New York ah la uh hi.

examples.english: She used her phone to shoot a short video.
examples.zomi: Amahin video tom khat la dingin a phone zang hi.

senses.usage_en: In film and photography, shoot is common informal professional language and does not involve a weapon.
senses.usage_zomi: Film leh limla nasep ah shoot pen nisim profession pau ahi a, galhiam tawh kisai lo hi.

senses.heading: Move suddenly and quickly
senses.definition_en: To move suddenly and very quickly in a particular direction.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thakhat in manlang takin pai; zuang
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi ciangtak khat ah thakhat leh manlang mahmah in pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The cat shot across the road.
examples.zomi: Ngiau lampi kantan in thakhat in zuang hi.

examples.english: Flames shot upward from the roof.
examples.zomi: Innkhum pan meikuang tunglam manlang takin kahto hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense emphasizes very fast, sudden movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in thakhat leh manlang mahmah a kikhihna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Kick, throw or hit toward a goal
senses.definition_en: To kick, throw or hit a ball toward a goal or basket in a sport.
senses.zomi_equivalents: goal lamah gol; basket lamah lawn
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawhna ah goal ahih keileh basket lamah gol tum, lawn ahih keileh sat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He shot the ball into the goal.
examples.zomi: Amahin ball pen goal sungah gol hi.

examples.english: She shot from outside the three-point line.
examples.zomi: Amahin point thum line pualam pan ball lawn hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact action described by shoot depends on the sport: kicking in football, throwing in basketball or striking in hockey.
senses.usage_zomi: Shoot in a gen gamtatna pen kimawhna nam bangin kilamdang hi: football ah golna, basketball ah lawnna, hockey ah satna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Firing a weapon
senses.definition_en: The act of firing a gun or using a gun to injure or kill someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meithal kapna ahih keileh meithal tawh mi liamsak ahih keileh thatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Police are investigating the shooting.
examples.zomi: Police-te in meithal kapna thu kantel uh hi.

examples.english: Two people were injured in the shooting.
examples.zomi: Meithal kapna ah mi nih liam hi.

senses.usage_en: In news reports, a shooting usually means an incident in which a gun was fired at one or more people.
senses.usage_zomi: News sungah a shooting cihpen mi khat ahih keileh mi tampi lam meithal kapna thu piang kawk tam hi.

senses.heading: Activity of hunting or target practice
senses.definition_en: The activity or sport of firing guns at targets or animals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna lim ahih keileh ganhing meithal tawh kapna gamtatna ahih keileh kimawhna ahi hi.

examples.english: The club organizes target-shooting competitions.
examples.zomi: Club in ngimna lim kap kidemna-te bawl hi.

examples.english: They wore ear protection during shooting practice.
examples.zomi: Meithal kap sinna laitak in bil dalna zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Context distinguishes sporting or hunting activity from a violent shooting incident.
senses.usage_zomi: Kizangna thu in kimawhna ahih keileh sazawhna kapna leh mi tung a meithal kapna thu piang kikhen hi.

senses.heading: Filming or photography
senses.definition_en: The process of recording a film, video or set of photographs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Film, video ahih keileh lim pawl record-na sepzia ahi hi.

examples.english: Shooting for the film begins next month.
examples.zomi: Film lakna pen kha hong tung dingin kipan hi.

examples.english: The street was closed during the shooting.
examples.zomi: Film lak laitak in lampi kikha hi.

senses.usage_en: In entertainment contexts, shooting commonly means filming, not firing a weapon.
senses.usage_zomi: Nopsakna leh film tawh kisai thu ah shooting pen meithal kapna hilo a, film lakna cihna ahi tam hi.

senses.heading: Place where goods or services are sold
senses.definition_en: A place where people can buy goods or obtain services.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite in van lei ahih keileh nasepna ngah theihna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: She works in a small clothes shop.
examples.zomi: Ama puan dawr neu khat ah sem hi.

examples.english: The shop closes at six o’clock.
examples.zomi: Dawr pen dak guk in kha hi.

senses.usage_en: Shop is especially common in British English. American English often uses store, although shop remains common for small or specialized businesses.
senses.usage_zomi: Shop pen British English ah kizang tam hi. American English ah store kici tamzaw napi, business neu ahih keileh van nam tuam zuakna dingin shop zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: Place where goods are made or repaired
senses.definition_en: A place where objects, machines or vehicles are made, maintained or repaired.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, khawl ahih keileh mawtaw bawl, enkol ahih keileh puahphatna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The car is at the repair shop.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw pen puahphatna dawr ah om hi.

examples.english: He works in a machine shop.
examples.zomi: Ama khawl bawlna inn khat ah sem hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, shop commonly appears in names for workplaces that make or repair things.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah van a bawl ahih keileh puahphatna nasep mun min sungah shop kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity of visiting shops or websites to look for and buy goods.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van-te en leh lei dingin dawr ahih keileh website-te a hawhna gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: We went shopping for school clothes.
examples.zomi: Sang puan lei dingin dawr kah ung.

examples.english: Online shopping is convenient for many people.
examples.zomi: Online pan van leina pen mi tampi a ding baih hi.

senses.usage_en: Shopping is uncountable. Say go shopping, not go to shopping.
senses.usage_zomi: Shopping pen uncountable noun ahi hi. Go shopping kici a, go to shopping kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Measuring a small distance or length
senses.definition_en: Measuring only a small distance from one end to the other.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mong khat pan mong khat dong gamla tawm bek nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has short black hair.
examples.zomi: Ama sam vom leh tom nei hi.

examples.english: The school is only a short distance from our house.
examples.zomi: Sanginn pen ka inn uh pan gamla tom bek hi.

senses.usage_en: Short is the opposite of long when describing length or distance.
senses.usage_zomi: Sauzaw leh gamla a gen ciangin short pen long a kilehbulh ahi hi.

senses.heading: Lasting a small amount of time
senses.definition_en: Lasting for only a small amount of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tawm bek sawt cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We had a short meeting after lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun-an khit ciangin kikhopna tom khat nei ung.

examples.english: She completed the work in a short time.
examples.zomi: Amahin hun tom sungin nasep zo hi.

senses.usage_en: A short time means a brief period; shortly often means soon.
senses.usage_zomi: A short time cihpen hun tawm cihna ahi a, shortly in nai takin cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: Not tall
senses.definition_en: Having less than average height.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat a sangdan ngeina sangin niamzaw cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a kum tawh tehkak leng niam

examples.english: He is short but very strong.
examples.zomi: Ama niam napi a thahat mahmah hi.

examples.english: The table is too short for this chair.
examples.zomi: Hih tokhom tawh tehkak leng sabuai pen niam lua hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing a person’s height, short is the opposite of tall.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a sangdan gen ciangin short pen tall a kilehbulh ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not having enough
senses.definition_en: Not having as much of something as is needed.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisap zah a om kicinglo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We are short of time, so let us begin.
examples.zomi: Hun kicinglo ihih manin kipan ni.

examples.english: The hospital is short of trained nurses.
examples.zomi: Hospital ah nurse sinna neite kicinglo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use short of + noun to show that there is not enough of something.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a kisap zah a omlona gen dingin short of + noun kizang hi.

senses.heading: Act of firing a weapon
senses.definition_en: An act of firing a gun or another weapon.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meithal ahih keileh galhiam dang khat vei khat kapna ahi hi.

examples.english: We heard three shots in the distance.
examples.zomi: Gamla ah meithal kap aw thum za ung.

examples.english: The officer fired a warning shot into the air.
examples.zomi: Police in huihlak ah vauna kapna khat kap hi.

senses.usage_en: Shot is both the past tense of shoot and a noun for one act of firing.
senses.usage_zomi: Shot pen shoot a past tense zong ahi a, vei khat kapna kawk noun zong ahi hi.

senses.heading: Attempt to score in a sport
senses.definition_en: An attempt to score by kicking, throwing or hitting a ball toward a goal or target.
senses.explanation_zomi: Goal ahih keileh ngimna lamah ball gol, lawn ahih keileh satna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her final shot won the game.
examples.zomi: Ama ball lawnna nunung in kimawhna zogawp hi.

examples.english: The player took a shot at goal.
examples.zomi: Kimawlpa in goal lamah ball gol hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact action in a shot depends on the sport.
senses.usage_zomi: Shot a gamtatna ciangtak pen kimawhna nam bangin kilamdang hi.

senses.heading: Injection
senses.definition_en: An amount of medicine given through a needle.
senses.zomi_equivalents: zatui phiu; phiu tawh zatui piakna
senses.explanation_zomi: Phiu tawh pumpi sung a kipia zatui ahi hi.

examples.english: The nurse gave me a flu shot.
examples.zomi: Nurse in flu daalna zatui phiu hong pia hi.

examples.english: The child was nervous about getting a shot.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen zatui phiu ngah ding lau hi.

senses.usage_en: Shot is common in American English. British English often uses injection or vaccination.
senses.usage_zomi: Shot pen American English ah kizang tam hi. British English ah injection ahih keileh vaccination kici tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Photograph
senses.definition_en: A photograph or a particular view recorded by a camera.
senses.explanation_zomi: Camera tawh kila lim ahih keileh film sung a muhna khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She took a beautiful shot of the mountains.
examples.zomi: Amahin mual-te lim hoih khat la hi.

examples.english: The opening shot shows the city at night.
examples.zomi: Kipatna shot in zan khuapi lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In photography and filmmaking, a shot is one photograph or one continuously recorded view.
senses.usage_zomi: Limla leh film ah shot pen lim khat ahih keileh khawllo a kila muhna khen khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Attempt or opportunity
senses.definition_en: An attempt to do or achieve something, or an opportunity to try.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl ahih keileh ngimna khat tangtung ding hanciamna ahih keileh hunhoih ahi hi.

examples.english: I have never tried skiing, but I will give it a shot.
examples.zomi: Vuktung suh ngei nailo ing, himahleh hanciam ding ing.

examples.english: The team still has a shot at winning.
examples.zomi: Team in zohna ding hunhoih nei lai hi.

senses.usage_en: Give it a shot is informal and means “try it.”
senses.usage_zomi: Give it a shot pen nisim pau ahi a, “hanciam dih” cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Advice or recommendation
senses.definition_en: Used to say that something is a good or sensible thing to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawlna pen hoih ahih keileh pilna tawh a kituak cih genna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: You should get more sleep.
examples.zomi: Ihmut hun tampizaw nei ding na hoih hi.

examples.english: We should check the facts before deciding.
examples.zomi: I khensatma in thu maan-te encik ding i hoih hi.

senses.usage_en: Should gives advice that is usually less forceful than must or have to.
senses.usage_zomi: Should in thuhilhna pia a, must ahih keileh have to sangin thupiakna khauhzaw lo hi.

senses.heading: Expectation or probability
senses.definition_en: Used to say that something is expected or probably true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat piang dingin kilamen ahih keileh a maan ding hi ci a ngaihsutna genna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: The bus should arrive in ten minutes.
examples.zomi: Bus pen minute sawm sungin tung ding hi.

examples.english: This amount should be enough for everyone.
examples.zomi: Hih zah pen mi khempeuh a ding kicing ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, should expresses a reasonable expectation, not complete certainty.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah should in kilawm tak a lametna gen a, a kipsakna bukim nei lo hi.

senses.heading: Duty or proper behaviour
senses.definition_en: Used to express what is right, proper or morally expected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bang hihna maan, kilawm ahih keileh gamtatna hoih ahi ding cih genna dingin kizang hi.

common_phrases.zomi: thu maan gen ding ahi hi

examples.english: People should respect one another.
examples.zomi: Mite khat leh khat kizahtak ding ahi hi.

examples.english: Drivers should obey traffic laws.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawlte in lampi dan zui ding ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Should can express a moral duty, but it is generally less absolute than must.
senses.usage_zomi: Should in gamtatna maan tawh kisai mawpuakna gen thei napi, must zahin khauh lo hi.

senses.heading: Conditional possibility
senses.definition_en: Used formally to talk about something that might happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat piang khak leh cihna formal takin genna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: Should you need help, call this number.
examples.zomi: Huhna na kisap khak leh hih nambat sam in.

examples.english: Should the weather worsen, the event will be cancelled.
examples.zomi: Khuahun hong sia khak leh pawi kikhawl ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Formal should + subject + verb can replace an if-clause.
senses.usage_zomi: Formal lai ah should + subject + verb pen if-clause aiawh in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Part of the body
senses.definition_en: Either of the two parts of the body where the arms join the upper body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ban nihte pumpi tunglam tawh a kizopna pumpi khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She carried the bag on her shoulder.
examples.zomi: Amahin bawm pen a liang tungah puak hi.

examples.english: He injured his left shoulder while playing football.
examples.zomi: Football kimawl laitak in a veilam liang liam hi.

senses.usage_en: A person has two shoulders, but shoulder is singular when referring to one side.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat in liang nih nei a, lam khat bek kawk ciangin singular shoulder kizang hi.

senses.heading: Side of a road
senses.definition_en: The strip of land along the side of a road where vehicles can stop in an emergency.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lampi gei; mawtaw tawlna lampi gei
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisapna hun in mawtaw tawlsak theihna ding lampi gei gam ahi hi.

examples.english: The driver pulled onto the shoulder after the warning light appeared.
examples.zomi: Vauna meivak a kilat ciangin mawtaw hawlpa lampi geiah tawl hi.

examples.english: Do not drive on the shoulder.
examples.zomi: Lampi gei tungah mawtaw hawl kei in.

senses.usage_en: This road meaning is especially common in American English. British English often uses hard shoulder.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lampi khiatna pen American English ah kizang tam hi. British English ah hard shoulder kici tam hi.

senses.definition_en: To speak or call in a very loud voice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw ngaih mahmah tawh pau ahih keileh sam cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat tungah aw ngaih takin pau

examples.english: She shouted for help when she saw the fire.
examples.zomi: Meikuang a muh ciangin huhna ngenin kik hi.

examples.english: Do not shout at the children.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te tungah aw ngaih takin pau kei in.

senses.usage_en: Shout to someone means speaking loudly so the person can hear. Shout at someone often suggests anger.
senses.usage_zomi: Shout to someone cihpen tua mi in a zaktheihna ding aw ngaih tak a pau cihna ahi hi. Shout at someone in hehna tawh aw ngaih tak a pau cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: Make visible or let someone see
senses.definition_en: To make someone able to see something or to hold something where it can be seen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in na khat a muh theihna dingin lak ahih keileh koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She showed me a photograph of her family.
examples.zomi: Amahin a innkuan lim hong lak hi.

examples.english: Please show your identification at the entrance.
examples.zomi: Lutna ah na identity lai lak in.

senses.usage_en: Use show someone something or show something to someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Show someone something ahih keileh show something to someone ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Demonstrate or explain
senses.definition_en: To teach or explain how to do something by demonstrating it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bangci bawl ding cih gamtat in lak ahih keileh hilhcian cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you show me how to use this app?
examples.zomi: Hih app zatdan hong lak thei ding nahi hiam?

examples.english: The instructor showed us the correct technique.
examples.zomi: Siahpa in sepzia maan hong lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use show someone how to + verb when teaching a procedure.
senses.usage_zomi: Sepzia khat hilh ciangin show someone how to + verb kizang hi.

senses.heading: Provide evidence or information
senses.definition_en: To provide evidence that something exists, is true or has happened.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat om, maan ahih keileh piang khin cih teci pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The results show that the treatment is effective.
examples.zomi: Ngahna-te in tua enkawlna na semtak ahihna lak hi.
