examples.english: Records show that the building is over a century old.
examples.zomi: Ciaptehna-te in innpi pen kum za khat val khin cih lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In academic writing, show often means demonstrate through evidence rather than display visually.
senses.usage_zomi: Academic laigelh ah show in mit tawh musakna sangin teci tawh kipsak cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: Express a feeling or quality
senses.definition_en: To make a feeling, attitude or quality noticeable through words or behaviour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim, ngaihsutdan ahih keileh gamtatna hoih khat kammal leh gamtatna tawh kilangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The students showed respect for their teacher.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in a siamah uh zahtakna lak uh hi.

examples.english: She showed great courage during the crisis.
examples.zomi: Haksatna hun in hangsanna lian lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, show is followed by the feeling or quality being expressed.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah show nungah a kilangsak lungsim ahih keileh gamtatna hoih min om hi.

senses.heading: Washing under falling water
senses.definition_en: An act of washing your body while standing under water that falls from a device.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tui zawnna tawh kisilna; shower kisilna
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui zawnna nuai ah dingin pumpi kisilna ahi hi.

examples.english: I took a shower before going to work.
examples.zomi: Nasep ah ka paima in shower ka kisil hi.

examples.english: A warm shower helped her relax.
examples.zomi: Tui lum tawh shower kisilna in ama lungdamsak hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses take a shower. British English commonly uses have a shower.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah take a shower kici tam a, British English ah have a shower kici tam hi.

senses.heading: Device or enclosed place for washing
senses.definition_en: The device or enclosed area from which water falls for washing the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi kisilna ding tui a hong luanna van ahih keileh a umna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The shower is not working properly.
examples.zomi: Shower pen hoih takin na sem lo hi.

examples.english: There is a shower beside the changing room.
examples.zomi: Puan kikhelna pindan geiah shower om hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether shower means the washing activity or the device itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Kizangna thu in shower pen kisilna gamtatna maw tui zawnna van maw cih lak hi.

senses.heading: Brief fall of rain
senses.definition_en: A short period of rain, often beginning and ending suddenly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thakhat a kipan leh tawp thei guahzu hun tom khat ahi hi.

examples.english: A brief shower cooled the air.
examples.zomi: Guah tom khat in huih vot sak hi.

examples.english: There may be scattered showers this afternoon.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitaklam mun tuamtuam ah guah tom zu thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A shower normally lasts for less time than continuous rain.
senses.usage_zomi: Guah a kizom a zu sangin shower pen hun tomzaw sawt ngei hi.

senses.heading: Party for someone expecting a baby or getting married
senses.definition_en: A party at which gifts are given to someone expecting a baby or preparing for marriage.
senses.zomi_equivalents: letsong piak pawi; naungek nei ding pawi
senses.explanation_zomi: Naungek nei ding ahih keileh kiteeng ding mi khat a ding letsong kipiak pawi ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: naungek nei ding letsong piak pawi

examples.english: Her friends organized a baby shower for her.
examples.zomi: A lawmte in ama a ding naungek nei ding letsong piak pawi bawl uh hi.

examples.english: They brought gifts to the bridal shower.
examples.zomi: Monu ding letsong piak pawi ah letsong-te hong paipih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This social meaning is especially common in North American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pawi khiatna pen North American English ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Close something
senses.definition_en: To move a door, window, lid or similar object so that it covers an opening.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kongkhak, thlalang kong, bawmkhum ahih keileh a kibang na khat in a awngna a daal dingin kha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please shut the door quietly.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak aw neilo in kha in.

examples.english: She shut the window because it was cold.
examples.zomi: Khuavot ahih manin thlalang kong kha hi.

senses.usage_en: Shut and close often have the same meaning. Shut can sometimes sound more forceful.
senses.usage_zomi: Shut leh close a khiatna kibang thei hi. Shut pen khauh deuh a kigen bangin za thei hi.

senses.heading: Stop operating or serving customers
senses.definition_en: To stop a business, organization or machine from operating, temporarily or permanently.
senses.explanation_zomi: Business, pawl ahih keileh khawl khat tawlkhat ahih keileh tawntung a naseploh dingin khawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The shop shuts at eight o’clock.
examples.zomi: Dawr pen dak giat in kha hi.

examples.english: They shut the factory for repairs.
examples.zomi: Puahphatna dingin factory khawlsak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Shut down is commonly used for machines, systems, factories and organizations that stop operating.
senses.usage_zomi: Khawl, system, factory leh pawl-te nasep a khawlna gen dingin shut down kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Prevent entry or escape
senses.definition_en: To put someone or something inside a place and prevent them from leaving.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh ganhing khat mun khat sungah koih in a pawtkhiatlohna dingin kha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not shut the cat in the room.
examples.zomi: Ngiau pindan sungah khum kei in.

examples.english: The locked gate shut visitors out.
examples.zomi: Kongpi kikhak in hawhte lut sak lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Shut in means keep inside; shut out means prevent from entering or exclude.
senses.usage_zomi: Shut in cihpen sungah khum cihna a, shut out cihpen lut sak lo ahih keileh kihelsak lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Nervous with other people
senses.definition_en: Nervous or uncomfortable about meeting and speaking to other people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang-te tawh kimuh leh kihoupihna ah lau, zum ahih keileh omnuamlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The child was too shy to answer the question.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen dawnna pia ding zum lua hi.

examples.english: She feels shy when meeting new people.
examples.zomi: Mi thak-te tawh a kimuh ciangin zum hi.

senses.usage_en: A shy person may want to communicate but feel nervous or lacking in confidence.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi zum khat in kihoupih nuam napi lau ahih keileh kimuang kicinglo thei hi.

senses.heading: Unwilling or hesitant
senses.definition_en: Unwilling or hesitant to do something, especially because of uncertainty or fear.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kicianlohna ahih keileh launa hangin na khat bawl ding lungkimlo ahih keileh ki-awng cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not be shy about asking for help.
examples.zomi: Huhna ngen ding ki-awng kei in.

examples.english: He is not shy about expressing his opinion.
examples.zomi: Ama a ngaihsutna gen ding ngam hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern shy about + -ing describes hesitation about an action.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna khat bawl ding a ki-awngna gen dingin shy about + -ing kizang hi.

senses.heading: Ill
senses.definition_en: Physically or mentally unwell.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi ahih keileh lungsim lamah cidamlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She stayed home because she was sick.
examples.zomi: Ama a cina manin innah om hi.

examples.english: The doctor examined the sick child.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in naupang cina sit hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, sick commonly means generally ill. British English often uses ill for this meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah sick in natna a pum in kawk tam hi. British English ah hih khiatna dingin ill kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Feeling likely to vomit
senses.definition_en: Feeling that you are likely to vomit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Luak ding bangin lungsim leh pumpi nuamlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The rough journey made me feel sick.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna kiling in luak nuam sak hi.

examples.english: He was sick after eating the spoiled food.
examples.zomi: An sia a nek khit ciangin luak hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, be sick often means vomit. In American English, it usually means be ill.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah be sick in luak cihna nei tam hi. American English ah a cina cihna nei tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Tired of or disgusted by something
senses.definition_en: Annoyed, bored or disgusted because something has continued too long or happened too often.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sawt lua ahih keileh vei tampi piang lua manin lungkimlo, nudawn ahih keileh muhnuamlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am sick of hearing the same excuse.
examples.zomi: Mawhpaih kibang ka zakzel tawh nudawn ing.

examples.english: She is sick and tired of the constant noise.
examples.zomi: Aw tawntung a om tawh nudawn mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Sick of + noun or -ing is informal and means very tired or annoyed by something.
senses.usage_zomi: Sick of + noun or -ing pen nisim pau ahi a, na khat tawh nudawn ahih keileh lungkimlo mahmah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Left or right part
senses.definition_en: The left or right part of a person, object, place or area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, mun ahih keileh gamhuam khat a veilam ahih keileh ziatlam khen ahi hi.

examples.english: The door is on the left side of the building.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak pen innpi veilam ah om hi.

examples.english: Trees grow on both sides of the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi lam nihgel ah singkung-te khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use on the side of for a surface or position beside something.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a pualam phel ahih keileh gei dinmun kawk dingin on the side of kizang hi.

senses.heading: One surface or edge
senses.definition_en: One of the outer surfaces, edges or boundaries of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pualam phel, gei ahih keileh ciangtan khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The name was written on the side of the box.
examples.zomi: Min pen bawm gei phel ah kigelh hi.

examples.english: A small village lies on the side of the mountain.
examples.zomi: Mual pang ah khuano neu khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: The intended surface or edge is normally identified by the surrounding context.
senses.usage_zomi: A kawk phel ahih keileh gei ciangtak pen a kimkot thu in kitelsak hi.

senses.heading: Group in a disagreement or competition
senses.definition_en: One of the people, groups or teams opposing another in a disagreement, conflict or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikalhna, kidona ahih keileh kidemna ah pawl dang khat tawh a kisaing pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: Both sides agreed to continue the talks.
examples.zomi: Lam nihgel in kihoupihna zom ding lungkim uh hi.

examples.english: I am not taking either side in the argument.
examples.zomi: Nialna ah lam khat zong panglo ing.

senses.usage_en: Take sides means support one person or group against another.
senses.usage_zomi: Take sides cihpen mi ahih keileh pawl khat lam pangin pawl dang khat tawh kikal cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Aspect of a situation or personality
senses.definition_en: One particular aspect of a situation, subject or person’s character.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, thulu ahih keileh mi khat gamtatna a khen khat ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat a gamtatna lam dang

examples.english: We need to consider the financial side of the plan.
examples.zomi: Geelna a sumvai lam ngaihsut kul hi.

examples.english: The interview showed a different side of her personality.
examples.zomi: Interview in ama gamtatna lam dang khat lak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense divides a complex subject into aspects that can be considered separately.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in thulu buai khat pen tuamtuam a ngaihsut theihna ding lam tuamtuam in khen hi.

senses.heading: Ability to see
senses.definition_en: The physical ability to see with the eyes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mit tawh muh theihna pumpi siamna ahi hi.

examples.english: His sight became weaker as he grew older.
examples.zomi: A upat semsem ciangin a mit muhna niam semsem hi.

examples.english: The disease can cause loss of sight.
examples.zomi: Natna in mit muhna taansak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Sight refers to the ability to see; vision can refer to both eyesight and an imagined future.
senses.usage_zomi: Sight in mit muh theihna kawk a, vision in mit muhna leh mailam ngaihsut kholhna zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Something seen
senses.definition_en: A person, object or scene that you see, especially one that produces a strong reaction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van ahih keileh mun kilatdan khat a muh ciangin lungsim nawngkaihna lian a piangsak na ahi hi.

examples.english: The mountains were a beautiful sight at sunrise.
examples.zomi: Nisuah laitak in mual-te muhhuai mahmah hi.

examples.english: After the long journey, home was a welcome sight.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna sau khit ciangin inn muh pen lungdamhuai mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, sight refers to the complete view or appearance that someone notices.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah sight in mi khat in a muh lim ahih keileh mun kilatdan pumpi kawk hi.

senses.heading: Interesting place visited by tourists
senses.definition_en: A famous or interesting place that visitors go to see.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzin mite in en ding a hawh mun minthang ahih keileh lungluthuai ahi hi.

examples.english: We spent the day seeing the sights of the city.
examples.zomi: Ni khat sung khuapi mun minthang-te hawh ung.

examples.english: The guide showed us several historic sights.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in tangthu mun minthang pawlkhat hong lak hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural sights is common when referring to the notable places in a city or country.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuapi ahih keileh gam khat a mun minthang-te kawk dingin plural sights kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: View or range of vision
senses.definition_en: The area that can be seen or the condition of being visible.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mit tawh muh theih gamhuam ahih keileh kilang dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The ship remained in sight for several minutes.
examples.zomi: Tembaw pen minute pawlkhat sung mitmuh ah om lai hi.

examples.english: The child disappeared from sight.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen mitmuh pan mang hi.

senses.usage_en: In sight means visible; out of sight means no longer visible.
senses.usage_zomi: In sight cihpen muh theih cihna a, out of sight cihpen muh theih nawnlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Notice containing information
senses.definition_en: A board, notice or image that gives information, directions or warnings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, lampi hilhna ahih keileh vauna a pia lai, lim ahih keileh board ahi hi.

examples.english: The sign says that parking is not allowed.
examples.zomi: Ciaptehna in mawtaw koih phallo cih lak hi.

examples.english: Follow the signs to the airport.
examples.zomi: Vanlenggiah tunna ding ciaptehna-te zui in.

senses.usage_en: A sign may use words, pictures, colours or symbols to communicate information.
senses.usage_zomi: Sign in thu a pia dingin kammal, lim, kulep ahih keileh symbol zang thei hi.

senses.heading: Evidence or indication
senses.definition_en: An event, action or condition showing that something exists, is happening or may happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat om, piang laitak ahih keileh piang thei ding cih a lak thu piang, gamtatna ahih keileh dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: A high temperature can be a sign of infection.
examples.zomi: Pumpi khang in natna lut lim ahi thei hi.

examples.english: The economy is showing signs of improvement.
examples.zomi: Sumlehpai in hoihna lim lak hi.

senses.usage_en: A sign suggests that something may be true; it is not always complete proof.
senses.usage_zomi: Sign in na khat maan thei ding cih lak napi, teci bukim a hih pah kullo hi.

senses.heading: Movement used to communicate
senses.definition_en: A movement or action used to communicate without speaking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pau lo in thu kigenna ding a kizang pumpi kikhihna ahih keileh gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave me a sign to remain quiet.
examples.zomi: Amahin gamdai a om ding khut lim hong pia hi.

examples.english: He nodded as a sign of agreement.
examples.zomi: Lungkimna ciaptehna in a lu ngawng hi.

senses.usage_en: A sign may be intentional, such as a hand signal, or naturally interpreted, such as a smile showing happiness.
senses.usage_zomi: Sign pen deihna tawh kibawl khut lim ahi thei a, lungdamna a lak nuihna bang amah a kitel lim zong ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Action, sound or light giving information
senses.definition_en: A movement, sound, light or other sign used to communicate information or instructions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih keileh thuhilhna pia ding a kizang kikhihna, aw, meivak ahih keileh ciaptehna dang ahi hi.

examples.english: The green light is the signal to go.
examples.zomi: Mei green pen pai ding signal ahi hi.

examples.english: The driver gave a signal before turning.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawlpa in a hei ma in signal pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A signal is normally intended to communicate a particular message or instruction.
senses.usage_zomi: Signal pen thu ahih keileh thuhilhna ciangtak khat pia dingin deihna tawh kizang hi.

senses.heading: Electrical or radio transmission
senses.definition_en: An electrical or radio wave that carries sound, pictures or data.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw, lim ahih keileh data a puak meikang ahih keileh radio huih kilawn ahi hi.

examples.english: My phone has a weak signal inside the building.
examples.zomi: Innpi sungah ka phone signal nem hi.

examples.english: The storm interrupted the television signal.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in television signal nawngkaisak hi.

senses.usage_en: In communication technology, signal strength affects the quality of a connection.
senses.usage_zomi: Kizopna technology ah signal khauh leh nem in kizopna hoihdan nawngkai hi.

senses.heading: Indication of a future event or change
senses.definition_en: An action or event that indicates what may happen next.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam ah bang piang thei ding cih a lak gamtatna ahih keileh thu piang ahi hi.

examples.english: The decision sent a clear signal to investors.
examples.zomi: Khensatna in sum suante kiangah ciaptehna kician pia hi.

examples.english: Falling prices may be a signal of weaker demand.
examples.zomi: Man a kiamna pen leinuamna a niamzawna lim ahi thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative meaning is common in business, economics and politics.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna pen business, sumlehpai leh politics ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Important or influential
senses.definition_en: Important enough to deserve attention or likely to have a noticeable effect.
senses.explanation_zomi: Awlmawh taak a thupi ahih keileh nawngkaina kician a piangsak thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Education plays a significant role in economic development.
examples.zomi: Pilna in sumlehpai khantohna ah mawng thupi nei hi.

examples.english: The policy produced significant changes.
examples.zomi: Policy in kikhelna thupi-te piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Significant often means important or large enough to be noticed, not merely present.
senses.usage_zomi: Significant in om bek cihna hilo a, phawkhuai zah a thupi ahih keileh lian cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: Large or noticeable in amount
senses.definition_en: Large enough in amount or degree to be clearly noticed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat ahih keileh dinmun ah phawkhuai zah a lian cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company reported a significant increase in sales.
examples.zomi: Company in zuakna phawkhuai takin khang ci in lipkhap hi.

examples.english: She made significant progress in English.
examples.zomi: Ama English sinnah khantohna phawkhuai nei hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact size implied by significant depends on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Significant in a kawk liandan ciangtak pen a kizangna thu bangin kilamdang hi.

senses.heading: Statistically meaningful
senses.definition_en: Showing a difference or relationship that is unlikely to have occurred only by chance.
senses.zomi_equivalents: statistics tawh thupi; bang hileh bangin a piang hilo
senses.explanation_zomi: Bang hileh bangin a piang bek hi lo ding, kilamdanna ahih keileh kizopna ngiat khat a om cih statistics tawh a kilakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The study found a statistically significant difference.
examples.zomi: Khuakzang zonna in statistics tawh kician kilamdanna khat mu hi.

examples.english: The result was not statistically significant.
examples.zomi: Ngahna pen statistics tawh thupi kicinglo hi.

senses.usage_en: In research, significant has a technical statistical meaning and does not automatically mean practically important.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuakzang zonna ah significant in statistics khiatna tuam nei a, nisim zatna ah a thupi ngiat cihna a hih pah kullo hi.

senses.heading: By a large or noticeable amount
senses.definition_en: By an amount or degree large enough to be clearly noticed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phawkhuai zah a lian in ahih keileh kician takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Housing costs have increased significantly.
examples.zomi: Inn tawh kisai man-te phawkhuai takin khang hi.

examples.english: The new machine works significantly faster.
examples.zomi: Khawl thak pen kician takin manlangzaw in na sem hi.

senses.usage_en: Significantly commonly modifies comparisons and verbs describing change.
senses.usage_zomi: Significantly pen etkakna kammal-te leh kikhelna a gen verb-te thahatsakna dingin kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: In an important or meaningful way
senses.definition_en: In a way that is important, influential or meaningful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupi, nawngkaina nei ahih keileh khiatna nei takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Volunteers contributed significantly to the project.
examples.zomi: Volunteer-te in project pen thupi takin huh uh hi.

examples.english: The decision significantly affected the community.
examples.zomi: Khensatna in khuamite nasatak in nawngkai hi.

senses.usage_en: In research, significantly may have a technical statistical meaning that should be distinguished from ordinary importance.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuakzang zonna ah significantly in statistics khiatna tuam nei thei a, nisim pau a thupi cihna tawh kikhen ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Complete absence of sound
senses.definition_en: A condition in which there is no sound or very little sound.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw omlo ahih keileh aw tawmno bek a om dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The room fell into complete silence.
examples.zomi: Pindan sung gamdai gawp hi.

examples.english: We stood in silence for one minute.
examples.zomi: Minute khat sung gamdai in ding ung.

senses.usage_en: In silence means without speaking or making sound.
senses.usage_zomi: In silence cihpen pau lo leh aw bawl lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Failure or refusal to speak
senses.definition_en: A condition in which someone does not speak, answer or provide information.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pau, dawn ahih keileh thu pia lo a om dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: His silence made us uncertain about his decision.
examples.zomi: A gamdaihna in a khensatna thu kicianlo sak hi.

examples.english: The organization broke its silence and issued a statement.
examples.zomi: Pawl in a gamdaihna khawl a, thupulaakna khat suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Silence can communicate agreement, disagreement, uncertainty or refusal; its meaning depends on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamlaihna in lungkimna, lungkimlohna, kicianlohna ahih keileh nialna lak thei a, a khiatna pen a kizangna thu in khensat hi.

senses.heading: Making no sound
senses.definition_en: Not speaking or making any sound.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pau lo ahih keileh aw suah lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The students remained silent during the announcement.
examples.zomi: Thupulaakna laitak in sangnaupang-te gamdai in om uh hi.

examples.english: The house was completely silent at night.
examples.zomi: Zan in inn sung gamdai gawp hi.

senses.usage_en: Silent describes a person, place or device that produces no sound. Quiet may still allow a small amount of sound.
senses.usage_zomi: Silent in aw a omlohna gen a, quiet ah aw tawmno omlai thei hi.

senses.heading: Not expressed in words
senses.definition_en: Understood or communicated without being spoken.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pau lo a kilak; kammal neilo
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal tawh kigenlo napi kitel ahih keileh kilak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave him silent support during the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna laitak in pau lo in ama thapia hi.

examples.english: They stood together in silent prayer.
examples.zomi: Amaute aw suahlo in thungetkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use describes feelings or messages shown without spoken words.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna in pau lo a kilak lungsim ahih keileh thu kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A fine, smooth and strong natural material produced by silkworms and used for making cloth.
senses.zomi_equivalents: silk puan; sikawlbuu pan a ngah puan van
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan bawlna ding a kizang, sikawlbuu in a piangsak a neem, a pan leh a khauh pianpih van ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore a beautiful silk dress.
examples.zomi: Ama silk puan hoih khat silh hi.

examples.english: This scarf is made of pure silk.
examples.zomi: Hih ngawng puan pen silk siangtho tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Silk is normally uncountable when referring to the material.
senses.usage_zomi: Van bawlna material a kawk ciangin silk pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Showing poor judgment
senses.definition_en: Showing a lack of good judgment or serious thought.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna hoih ahih keileh ngaihsutna thuk neilo a gamtat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I made a silly mistake in the calculation.
examples.zomi: Sum simna ah khialhna haihuai khat bawl ing.

examples.english: It was silly to go outside without a coat.
examples.zomi: Puantung silh lo a pualam a paina ngaihsutna hoihlo ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Silly is usually less harsh than stupid, but it may still sound insulting when used directly about a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Silly pen stupid sangin kammal nemzaw napi, mi khat tungah direct a zat ciangin simmawhna bangin za thei hi.

senses.heading: Playful or not serious
senses.definition_en: Behaving in a playful, amusing or deliberately foolish way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawl, nuihhuai ahih keileh deihna tawh haihuai bang a gamtat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children made silly faces for the camera.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te in camera a ding maitang nuihhuai bawl uh hi.

examples.english: We laughed at his silly joke.
examples.zomi: A kampauna nuihhuai hangin nui ung.

senses.usage_en: In friendly contexts, silly can describe harmless and playful behaviour.
senses.usage_zomi: Lawm leh innkuan kikal ah silly in siatna omlo kimawl gamtatna gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Precious metal
senses.definition_en: A valuable, shiny, grey-white metal used for jewellery, coins and many other products.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nungta, tangka leh van dangte bawlna ding a kizang, a manpha, a taang leh a ngo-vom sik ahi hi.

examples.english: The ring is made of silver.
examples.zomi: Zungbuh pen ngun tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Silver is softer than many other metals.
examples.zomi: Ngun pen sik dang tampi sangin a neemzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Silver is uncountable when referring to the metal itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Sik material mah kawk ciangin silver pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Silver colour
senses.definition_en: A shiny grey-white colour resembling the metal silver.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sik ngun tawh a kibang a taang leh a ngo-vom kulep ahi hi.

examples.english: They bought a silver car.
examples.zomi: Amaute mawtaw ngun kulep khat lei uh hi.

examples.english: His hair had turned silver with age.
examples.zomi: A upat manin a sam ngun kulep hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: When used before a noun to name the colour, silver functions like an adjective: a silver phone.
senses.usage_zomi: Kulep min in noun ma a kizang ciangin silver pen adjective bangin na sem hi: a silver phone.

senses.heading: Silver medal
senses.definition_en: A silver-coloured medal awarded for second place in a competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna ah dinmun a nihna a ngah mi tungah kipia ngun kulep medal ahi hi.

examples.english: She won silver in the 400-metre race.
examples.zomi: Ama metre 400 taihna ah ngun medal ngah hi.

examples.english: The team took silver in the final.
examples.zomi: Team in tawpna kidemna ah dinmun nihna ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: In sports reporting, silver can be used without medal: He won silver.
senses.usage_zomi: Sports news ah medal omlo in silver bek kizang thei hi: He won silver.

senses.definition_en: Almost the same as another person or thing, but not exactly the same.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na dang khat tawh a kibang mahmah napi a kibang sitset lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two designs are very similar.
examples.zomi: Design nihte a kibang mahmah hi.

examples.english: Her experience was similar to mine.
examples.zomi: A phutkhak pen kei phutkhak tawh kibang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use similar to, not normally similar with: This is similar to that.
senses.usage_zomi: Similar to ci in kizang a, similar with ci ngeilo hi: This is similar to that.

senses.definition_en: A way in which two or more people or things are alike.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na nih leh a val a kibangna lam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: There are several similarities between the two languages.
examples.zomi: Pau nihte kikal ah kibangna pawlkhat om hi.

examples.english: The study examined the similarities and differences between the groups.
examples.zomi: Khuakzang zonna in pawlte kikal a kibangna leh kilamdanna sit hi.

senses.usage_en: Use similarity between when comparing two or more things and similarity to when comparing one thing with another.
senses.usage_zomi: Na nih leh a val etkak ciangin similarity between kizang a, na khat pen na dang khat tawh etkak ciangin similarity to kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: In a similar way, or with a similar result.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibang deuh in ahih keileh a kibang ngahna tawh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two groups responded similarly to the questions.
examples.zomi: Pawl nihte in dotna-te a kibang in dawng uh hi.

examples.english: The northern region was similarly affected by the storm.
examples.zomi: Saklam gamhuam zong huihpi in a kibang in nawngkai hi.

senses.usage_en: Similarly can connect two sentences by showing that the second situation resembles the first.
senses.usage_zomi: Similarly in thugelh nih kizom sak a, dinmun a nihna pen a masa tawh kibang cih lak hi.

senses.heading: Easy to understand or do
senses.definition_en: Easy to understand, use or do because it is not complicated.
senses.explanation_zomi: A buai lo ahih manin tel, zat ahih keileh bawl baih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The instructions are simple and clear.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna-te baih leh kician hi.

examples.english: This app is simple to use.
examples.zomi: Hih app zat baih hi.

senses.usage_en: Simple can mean uncomplicated and easy. It does not always mean unimportant.
senses.usage_zomi: Simple in a buai lo leh a baih cihna nei hi. A thupi lo cihna a hih tawntung lo hi.

senses.heading: Basic and without extra decoration
senses.definition_en: Basic in design and without unnecessary details or decoration.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibawlzia bulpi bek nei a, kisaploh behlapna ahih keileh zepna a neilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore a simple black dress.
examples.zomi: Ama puan vom zepna neilo khat silh hi.

examples.english: We ate a simple meal of rice and vegetables.
examples.zomi: Buh leh anlak tawh annekna ngeina nek ung.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, simple may be positive, suggesting clarity, practicality or modesty.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah simple pen hoihna ahi thei a, kician, zat theih leh kiniamkhiat cihna lak thei hi.

senses.heading: Consisting of only a few parts
senses.definition_en: Made from only a few parts or involving only a small number of steps.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khen tawm bek tawh kibawl ahih keileh sep ding talsik tawm bek nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The device has a simple structure.
examples.zomi: Device in kibawlzia buai lo nei hi.

examples.english: Making the drink is a simple three-step process.
examples.zomi: Dawn ding bawlna pen sep ding talsik thum bek ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Something can be simple in structure even if it is useful or powerful.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat kibawlzia baih napi zat theih leh thahat mahmah thei hi.

senses.heading: Ordinary or humble
senses.definition_en: Ordinary, honest and without social pretence or luxury.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina bang, thumaan a, kineihna ahih keileh nuntakna manpha lua a neilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They prefer a simple life in the countryside.
examples.zomi: Amaute khuano lamah nuntakna ngeina deihzaw uh hi.

examples.english: He enjoys the simple pleasure of reading at home.
examples.zomi: Ama innah laibu simna nopsakna ngeina nuamsa hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing people, simple must be used carefully because it can sometimes suggest limited intelligence. A simple life is normally positive.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a gen ciangin simple pilvang takin zat ding ahi hi, banghang hiam cih leh khangkhat ciangin pil kicinglo cihna bangin za thei hi. A simple life ahih leh hoihna khiatna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: In an easy or uncomplicated way
senses.definition_en: In a way that is easy to understand or do because it is not complicated.
senses.explanation_zomi: A buai lo a, tel ahih keileh bawl baih takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher explained the idea simply and clearly.
examples.zomi: Siamah in ngaihsutna pen baih leh kician takin hilhcian hi.

examples.english: Put simply, we do not have enough money.
examples.zomi: Baih takin gen leng, sum kicing neilo ung.

senses.usage_en: Put simply introduces an explanation expressed in easier or more direct language.
senses.usage_zomi: Put simply in thu khat baihzaw leh direct zaw a hilhcianhna kipatna dingin kizang hi.

senses.heading: Only or merely
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that something is only what is stated and nothing more.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat pen a kigen mah bek hi a, behlapna dang omlo cih thahatsakna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: It was simply a misunderstanding.
examples.zomi: Tua pen kitelkhialhna khat bek ahi hi.

examples.english: I stayed home simply because I was tired.
examples.zomi: Ka gim hang bek tawh innah om ing.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, simply limits or emphasizes the statement rather than describing how an action is done.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah simply in gamtatna bawldan genlo a, thugelh ciangtan ahih keileh thahatsak hi.

senses.heading: Completely
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or extreme.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bukim takin maan ahih keileh dinmun sangpen a tung cih thahatsakna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: The performance was simply wonderful.
examples.zomi: Performance pen hoih taktak hi.

examples.english: Such behaviour is simply unacceptable.
examples.zomi: Tua bang gamtatna sangtheihloh taktak hi.

senses.usage_en: This emphatic use is common before strong adjectives.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih thahatsakna zatna pen adjective khauh-te ma ah kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: From a particular time in the past until the present or until another later time.
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa hun ciangtak khat pan tu dong ahih keileh hun khitkhat dong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has lived here since 2020.
examples.zomi: Ama 2020 kum pan kipan hiah teng hi.

examples.english: I have known him since childhood.
examples.zomi: Naupanglai pan kipan ama thei ing.

senses.usage_en: Use since with a starting point and for with a length of time: since Monday but for three days. The supplied entry is the preposition; since can also function as a conjunction or adverb.
senses.usage_zomi: Kipatna hun ma ah since kizang a, hun sawtdan ma ah for kizang hi: since Monday ahih hangin for three days kici hi. Hih entry pen preposition ahi a, since pen conjunction ahih keileh adverb in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Expressing genuine feelings or intentions honestly, without pretending.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kineihna omlo in lungsim tak leh thumaan takin lungsim ahih keileh ngimna a kilak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She offered a sincere apology for her mistake.
examples.zomi: Amahin a khialhna hangin lungsim takin mawh ngen hi.

examples.english: Please accept my sincere thanks for your help.
examples.zomi: Nong huhna hangin ka lungsim tak lungdam kohna sang in.

senses.usage_en: Sincere describes feelings, words or actions that are genuine rather than merely polite or performed for appearance.
senses.usage_zomi: Sincere in zualzangna bek ahih keileh mi musakna ding hilo a, lungsim taktak pan a hong piang lungsim, kammal leh gamtatna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: To produce musical sounds with the voice.
senses.zomi_equivalents: la sa; aw tawh la sa
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw tawh la aw neisak in sa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children sang a song together.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te la khat sak khawm uh hi.

examples.english: She sings in the church choir.
examples.zomi: Ama pawlpi lasak pawl sungah la sa hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is sang, and the past participle is sung: She sang yesterday; she has sung here before.
senses.usage_zomi: Sing a past tense pen sang a, past participle pen sung ahi hi: She sang yesterday; she has sung here before.

senses.definition_en: A person who sings, especially as a profession or in public performances.
senses.explanation_zomi: La a sa mi, adiakin profession in ahih keileh mipite ma a la a sa mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She hopes to become a professional singer.
examples.zomi: Ama profession lasa khat suak ding lamen hi.

examples.english: The lead singer introduced the next song.
examples.zomi: Lasa makaipa in la hong zom ding pulak hi.

senses.usage_en: A person who writes songs is a songwriter. A singer may perform songs written by someone else.
senses.usage_zomi: La a gelh mi pen songwriter kici hi. Singer khat in midang gelh la zong sa thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity or art of producing musical sounds with the voice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw tawh la sakna gamtatna ahih keileh siamna ahi hi.

examples.english: Singing is an important part of the celebration.
examples.zomi: La sakna pen pawi sungah khen thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She takes singing lessons every Saturday.
examples.zomi: Ama Saturday sim la sak pilna sin hi.

senses.usage_en: Singing is generally uncountable when it refers to the activity or skill.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna ahih keileh siamna a kawk ciangin singing pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Only one
senses.definition_en: Only one, rather than two or more.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nih ahih keileh a tamzaw hilo in khat bek cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Not a single person answered the question.
examples.zomi: Mi khat in zong dotna dawng lo hi.

examples.english: The document fits on a single page.
examples.zomi: Laikhial pumpi lai phel khat tungah kicing hi.

senses.usage_en: Every single adds emphasis: every single day means every day without exception.
senses.usage_zomi: Every single in thahatsak hi: every single day cihpen ni khat zong taisanlo in ni khempeuh cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not married or without a romantic partner
senses.definition_en: Not married or not currently having a romantic partner.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kiteeng nailo ahih keileh tuhun in lawmnu leh lawmpa neilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He remained single throughout his life.
examples.zomi: Ama a nuntak sung khempeuh kiteenglo in om hi.

examples.english: The programme supports single parents.
examples.zomi: Program in ta a kem miteenglo nulepa-te huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Single describes marital or relationship status. It does not explain why a person is unmarried.
senses.usage_zomi: Single in kiteenna ahih keileh lawm nei leh neilo dinmun gen a, banghangin kiteenglo cih gen lo hi.

senses.heading: Designed for one person
senses.definition_en: Designed, intended or sufficient for one person.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mi khat a ding; khatbek zat
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a ding a kibawl, kigawm ahih keileh kicing cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I booked a single room for two nights.
examples.zomi: Zan nih a ding mi khat pindan ka kemkhol hi.

examples.english: The room contains two single beds.
examples.zomi: Pindan sungah mi khat lupna nih om hi.

senses.usage_en: In British travel English, a single ticket is a one-way ticket, while a return ticket covers both directions.
senses.usage_zomi: British khualzinna English ah single ticket pen pai bek ticket a, return ticket pen pai leh ciah ticket ahi hi.

senses.heading: Go below the surface of water
senses.definition_en: To go down below the surface of water or another liquid.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui ahih keileh tui dang khat tung pan nuai ah tum cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The stone sank to the bottom of the river.
examples.zomi: Suang pen gun taw ah tum hi.

examples.english: The damaged boat began to sink.
examples.zomi: Tembaw sia pen tum kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense is sank, and the past participle is sunk: The boat sank; it has sunk.
senses.usage_zomi: Sink a past tense pen sank a, past participle pen sunk ahi hi: The boat sank; it has sunk.

senses.heading: Move downward or become lower
senses.definition_en: To move downward or fall to a lower level.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuailam ah kiasuk ahih keileh level niamzaw ah tung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The sun was sinking behind the hills.
examples.zomi: Mualte nungah ni tum hi.

examples.english: Temperatures sank below freezing during the night.
examples.zomi: Zan in khuahun pen tui khauh theihna level nuai ah niam hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning can describe physical downward movement or a decrease in a level, value or condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in nuailam a kikhihna ahih keileh level, man leh dinmun a kiamna gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Enter deeply into something soft
senses.definition_en: To move or fall deeply into a soft surface or material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na a neem khat sungah thuk takin lut ahih keileh tum cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: My boots sank into the wet mud.
examples.zomi: Ka boot-te nopeel a khu sungah tum hi.

examples.english: She sank into the soft chair and rested.
examples.zomi: Ama tokhom neem sungah ngawh in tawlnga hi.

senses.usage_en: Sink into emphasizes downward movement into a soft substance or comfortable surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Sink into in na a neem khat sung a nuailam kikhihna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Become overwhelmed by a feeling or condition
senses.definition_en: To gradually enter a worse emotional, financial or physical condition.
senses.zomi_equivalents: dinmun hoihlo ah lut; niam semsem
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim, sumvai ahih keileh pumpi dinmun hoihlo sungah tomtom in lut cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The business sank deeper into debt.
examples.zomi: Business pen leiba sungah thuk semsem in lut hi.

examples.english: My heart sank when I heard the news.
examples.zomi: Tua thu ka zak ciangin ka lungsim kia hi.

senses.usage_en: My heart sank means that you suddenly felt worried, disappointed or afraid.
senses.usage_zomi: My heart sank cihpen thakhat in lungkham, lungkia ahih keileh lau cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Polite form of address
senses.definition_en: A polite word used when speaking to a man whose name you do not know or in a formal situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Min kitheilo mipa khat kiang ahih keileh formal dinmun ah zahtakna tawh sapna kammal ahi hi.

examples.english: Excuse me, sir, you dropped your wallet.
examples.zomi: Hong maisak in, saya, na sum-ip kia hi.

examples.english: Yes, sir, I understand the instructions.
examples.zomi: Hi, saya, thuhilhna ka tel hi.

senses.usage_en: Sir is used alone, not normally before a surname. Say Mr Brown, not Sir Brown, unless the man holds a British knighthood.
senses.usage_zomi: Sir amah bek in kizang a, minnung ma ah kizang ngeilo hi. British knighthood dinmun a neih kei leh Sir Brown sangin Mr Brown kici hi.

senses.heading: Title of a knight
senses.definition_en: A British title placed before the first name of a man who has been given a knighthood.
senses.explanation_zomi: British kumpi in knight dinmun a pia mipa min masa ma ah kikoih minthupna ahi hi.

examples.english: He later received a knighthood and became Sir David.
examples.zomi: Ama khit ciangin knight dinmun ngah a, Sir David kici ta hi.

examples.english: The title Sir comes before the person’s first name.
examples.zomi: Sir minthupna pen mi khat min masa ma ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: The title is capitalized and used with the first name or full name: Sir David or Sir David Lee.
senses.usage_zomi: Minthupna pen laimal lian tawh kigelh a, min masa ahih keileh min kicing tawh kizang hi: Sir David ahih keileh Sir David Lee.

senses.heading: Female sibling
senses.definition_en: A girl or woman who has the same parent or parents as another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang khat tawh nu ahih keileh pa kibang a nei numei nau ahi hi.

examples.english: My younger sister is studying nursing.
examples.zomi: Ka sanggaminu nauzaw in nurse pilna sin hi.

examples.english: The two sisters run a business together.
examples.zomi: Sanggamnu nihte in business semkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses sister for both older and younger female siblings; the age relationship must be stated separately when important.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah sanggamnu upazaw leh nauzaw a nihgel sister kici a, kum kilamdanna thupi leh tuam in gen ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Female member of a religious community
senses.definition_en: A female member of a Christian religious community, especially a nun.
senses.explanation_zomi: Christian biakna pawl sung a numei biakna nasem, adiakin nun ahi hi.

examples.english: Sister Mary works at the hospital.
examples.zomi: Sister Mary hospital ah sem hi.

examples.english: The religious sisters care for children.
examples.zomi: Biakna nasemnu-te in naupang-te kem uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When used as a religious title before a name, Sister begins with a capital letter.
senses.usage_zomi: Biakna minthupna in min ma a kizang ciangin Sister laimal lian tawh kipan hi.

senses.heading: Rest with the body supported
senses.definition_en: To rest with the upper body upright and the body’s weight supported by the lower part of the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tunglam dingin, pumpi gikna a nuailam in a dom dingin tu cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please sit beside me.
examples.zomi: Ka geiah tu in.

examples.english: The children sat on the floor.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te innkuan ah tu uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are sat: She sat down; she has sat there before.
senses.usage_zomi: Sit a past tense leh past participle pen sat ahi hi: She sat down; she has sat there before.

senses.heading: Be positioned somewhere
senses.definition_en: To be placed or remain in a particular position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat mun ciangtak khat ah kikoih ahih keileh om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The box sat unopened on the table.
examples.zomi: Bawm pen kihonlo in sabuai tungah om hi.

examples.english: The old building has sat empty for years.
examples.zomi: Innpi lui pen kum tampi sung awng in om hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, sit describes position or continued presence rather than the posture of a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah sit in mi tutdan genlo a, na khat omna dinmun ahih keileh omlaihna gen hi.

senses.heading: Take an examination
senses.definition_en: To take a formal examination.
senses.explanation_zomi: Formal sittelna khat dawng cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She will sit her final exam next week.
examples.zomi: Ama kaal hong tung dingin tawpna sittelna dawng ding hi.

examples.english: Hundreds of students sat for the examination.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang za tampi sittelna ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Sit an exam is common in British English. American English usually says take an exam.
senses.usage_zomi: Sit an exam pen British English ah kizang tam hi. American English ah take an exam kici tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Place used for a particular purpose
senses.definition_en: A place where something exists, happens or is planned to be built.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a omna, a pianna ahih keileh inn khat lam ding a kiguan mun ahi hi.

examples.english: Workers are preparing the construction site.
examples.zomi: Nasem-te in inn lamna mun bawl uh hi.

examples.english: A school once stood on this site.
examples.zomi: Hih munah nidang in sanginn khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: Site refers to a physical location. Do not confuse it with sight, which relates to seeing.
senses.usage_zomi: Site in mun kawk hi. Muhna tawh kisai sight tawh helkhawm kei in.

senses.heading: Website
senses.definition_en: A collection of connected pages and information available at one address on the internet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Internet address khat nuai ah a kizom lai phel leh thu pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: You can download the form from the official site.
examples.zomi: Official website pan form download thei ding hi.

examples.english: The news site is updated every hour.
examples.zomi: News website pen nai sim in kithaksak hi.

senses.usage_en: Site is often used as a shortened form of website in informal and technical contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim leh technology pau ah site pen website a tomlakna in kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Set of conditions at a particular time
senses.definition_en: The conditions and circumstances existing at a particular time and place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun leh mun ciangtak khat ah a om khuahun leh kimkot thu-te ahi hi.

examples.english: The economic situation is slowly improving.
examples.zomi: Sumlehpai dinmun tomtom in hoih semsem hi.

examples.english: We need more information before judging the situation.
examples.zomi: Dinmun i thukhenma in thu tampizaw kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Situation refers to the complete set of relevant conditions, not just one isolated fact.
senses.usage_zomi: Situation in thu khat bek hilo a, tua hun a thu kisai khempeuh huam hi.

senses.heading: Difficult or unusual problem
senses.definition_en: A difficult, dangerous or unusual condition that requires action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtat kulna a piangsak haksatna, lauhuaina ahih keileh dinmun ngeilo ahi hi.

examples.english: The manager handled the situation calmly.
examples.zomi: Manager in dinmun lungdamai takin bawl hi.

examples.english: Call the police if the situation becomes dangerous.
examples.zomi: Dinmun lauhuai hong suak leh police sam in.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, we have a situation may imply that an unexpected problem has developed.
senses.usage_zomi: Nisim English ah we have a situation cihpen ngakloh haksatna khat hong piang cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Position or location
senses.definition_en: The position of a building or place in relation to its surroundings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Innpi ahih keileh mun khat a kiim khuahun tawh a kizop a omna dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel has a beautiful situation beside the lake.
examples.zomi: Hotel pen dil gei omna mun hoih ah om hi.

examples.english: The house’s situation makes travel convenient.
examples.zomi: Inn omna mun in khualzinna baihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This location meaning is formal and less common than location in everyday English.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih omna mun khiatna pen formal zaw a, nisim English ah location kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 6.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat 6, nga khit leh sagih ma a om nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: Six students joined the programme.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang guk program ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: The meeting begins at six.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna dak guk in kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Before a noun, six functions as a determiner: six books. As the name of the number, it functions as a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun ma ah six pen determiner in na sem hi: six books. Nambat min mah kawk ciangin noun ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 16.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sawm leh guk; nambat sawm leh guk
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat 16, sawm leh guk ahi hi.

examples.english: Sixteen teams entered the competition.
examples.zomi: Team sawm leh guk kidemna ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: She began working when she was sixteen.
examples.zomi: Ama kum sawm leh guk a phak ciangin nasem kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: The main stress falls on the final syllable of sixteen, helping distinguish it from sixty.
senses.usage_zomi: Sixteen ah aw thupisakna pen a tawp syllable tungah om a, tua in sixty tawh kikhen theihna pia hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 60.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat 60, sawm guk ahi hi.

examples.english: About sixty people attended the event.
examples.zomi: Mi sawm guk bang pawi ah kihel uh hi.

examples.english: The journey takes sixty minutes.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna in minute sawm guk sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: The main stress falls on the first syllable of sixty, unlike sixteen, which is stressed at the end.
senses.usage_zomi: Sixty ah aw thupisakna pen syllable masa tungah om a, a tawp a kithupisak sixteen tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Physical dimensions
senses.definition_en: How large or small a person or thing is.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat bangzah a lian ahih keileh a neu cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two rooms are similar in size.
examples.zomi: Pindan nihte liandan kibang hi.

examples.english: The plant can grow to a large size.
examples.zomi: Sing kung pen a lian mahmah in khang thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use in size when comparing dimensions: similar in size, small in size.
senses.usage_zomi: Liandan etkak ciangin in size kizang hi: similar in size, small in size.

senses.heading: Standard measurement for clothing or products
senses.definition_en: One of a series of standard measurements used for clothing, shoes or other products.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan, khembel ahih keileh van dangte a lian leh neudan genna ding a kizang standard tehna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Do you have this shirt in a larger size?
examples.zomi: Hih sangkhit size lianzaw na nei hiam?

examples.english: These shoes are the wrong size for me.
examples.zomi: Hih khembel-te kei a ding size maan lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Clothing sizes vary between countries and manufacturers, so checking measurements is often helpful.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam leh van bawl company tuamtuam ah puan size kibang lo thei ahih manin, tehna encikna hoih hi.

senses.definition_en: To travel or move over snow on a pair of long, narrow boards attached to the feet.
senses.zomi_equivalents: vuk tungah ski suh; ski kimawl
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe nihte ah sing phel sau leh ginal a kikhih in vuk tungah suh cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mual tung pan nuai ah ski suh

examples.english: We learned to ski during the winter.
examples.zomi: Phalbi hun in ski suh sin ung.

examples.english: She skied down the mountain safely.
examples.zomi: Ama mual tung pan bit takin ski suh hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are normally skied: They skied yesterday.
senses.usage_zomi: Ski a past tense leh past participle pen skied ahi hi: They skied yesterday.

senses.definition_en: The sport or activity of travelling over snow on skis.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ski kimawhna; vuk tung ski suhna
senses.explanation_zomi: Ski-te zangin vuk tungah khualzin ahih keileh kimawhna gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Skiing is popular in mountainous regions.
examples.zomi: Mual gamhuam-te ah ski kimawhna minthang hi.

examples.english: They went skiing during their winter holiday.
examples.zomi: Phalbi tawlngak hun in ski kimawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Skiing is generally uncountable. Say go skiing, not go to skiing.
senses.usage_zomi: Skiing pen uncountable noun ahi hi. Go skiing kici a, go to skiing kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Ability developed through learning and practice
senses.definition_en: An ability to do something well, developed through learning, training or practice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sinna, pilna ngahna ahih keileh kisinna tawh na khat hoih tak a bawltheihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Good writing is an important professional skill.
examples.zomi: Laigelh hoihna pen profession siamna thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The course helps students develop computer skills.
examples.zomi: Course in sangnaupang-te computer siamna khangsakna huh hi.

senses.usage_en: A skill is normally learned or developed; an ability may be natural or learned.
senses.usage_zomi: Skill pen sin leh khangsak ngei siamna ahi hi. Ability pen pianpih ahih keileh a kisinsa bawltheihna ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Great ability or expertise
senses.definition_en: The ability to perform an activity very well.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna khat siam mahmah tak a bawltheihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The surgeon performed the operation with great skill.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in operation pen siamna lian tawh bawl hi.

examples.english: Making this instrument requires patience and skill.
examples.zomi: Hih vanzat bawlna ah thuakzawhna leh siamna kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Skill is uncountable when referring generally to a high degree of expertise.
senses.usage_zomi: Siamna sangtak a pum in kawk ciangin skill pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Outer covering of a person or animal
senses.definition_en: The natural outer covering of a person’s or animal’s body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing ahih keileh ganhing pumpi a pualam a dal pianpih tuam ahi hi.

examples.english: The cream helps protect dry skin.
examples.zomi: Cream in vun keu kemna huh hi.

examples.english: Her skin became red in the sun.
examples.zomi: Nisa ah a vun san hi.

senses.usage_en: Skin is usually uncountable when referring generally to the body covering, but it can be countable for particular types or removed animal coverings.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi vum a pum in kawk ciangin skin pen uncountable noun ahi a, vun nam ahih keileh ganhing pan a kilakhia vun kawk ciangin countable noun ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Outer covering of fruit or vegetables
senses.definition_en: The thin outer layer of a fruit or vegetable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gah ahih keileh anlak a pualam tuam pan ahi hi.

examples.english: Remove the skin from the potatoes.
examples.zomi: Alu-te vun peelkhia in.

examples.english: You can eat the apple with its skin.
examples.zomi: Apple pen a vun tawh ne thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Peel is also used for the skin of some fruits and vegetables, especially when it is removed.
senses.usage_zomi: Gah leh anlak pawlkhat pualam tuam, adiakin peelkhia theihna, peel zong kici hi.

senses.heading: Outer layer or surface
senses.definition_en: A thin outer layer covering an object or substance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van ahih keileh tui khat a pualam a dal tuam pan ahi hi.

examples.english: A thin skin formed on the surface of the paint.
examples.zomi: Paint tungah tuam pan khat hong piang hi.

examples.english: The aircraft’s outer skin was damaged.
examples.zomi: Vanleng pualam tuam sia hi.

senses.usage_en: This technical or figurative sense extends the idea of a protective body covering to other objects.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih technical ahih keileh tehpihna khiatna in pumpi kem vun ngaihsutna pen van dangte tungah zatsawn hi.

senses.definition_en: A piece of clothing worn from the waist downward that hangs around the legs without separate sections for each leg.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kawng pan nuai ah kisilh a, khe nih a ding khen tuam neilo puan ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore a long black skirt.
examples.zomi: Ama puan nuai vom leh sau khat silh hi.

examples.english: The skirt has two pockets.
examples.zomi: Puan nuai ah ip nih om hi.

senses.usage_en: Unlike trousers, a skirt does not have separate leg sections.
senses.usage_zomi: Trousers tawh kibanglo in, skirt in khe nih a ding khen tuam neilo hi.

senses.definition_en: The space above the earth where the sun, moon, stars and clouds appear.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni, kha, aksi leh meiingo-te a kilatna leitung tunglam mun ahi hi.

examples.english: Dark clouds covered the sky.
examples.zomi: Meiingo vom-te in vantung tuam hi.

examples.english: We could see thousands of stars in the night sky.
examples.zomi: Zan vantung ah aksi tul tampi mu thei ung.

senses.usage_en: Use the sky when referring generally to the space above the earth.
senses.usage_zomi: Leitung tunglam mun a pum in kawk ciangin the sky kizang hi.

senses.heading: Enslaved person
senses.definition_en: A person who is legally or forcibly treated as another person’s property and made to work without freedom.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dan tawh ahih keileh thagum zangin midang neihsa bang a kibawl a, suahtakna neilo in nasem sak mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Millions of enslaved people were denied their freedom.
examples.zomi: Sal a kibawl mi awn tampi a suahtakna uh kipia lo hi.

examples.english: The law finally ended legal slavery.
examples.zomi: Dan in a tawpna ah dan tawh sal bawlna khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: When discussing real people, enslaved person is often preferred because it emphasizes that enslavement was imposed on the person rather than defining their identity.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi taktak-te thu a gen ciangin slave sangin enslaved person kizang zaw leng hoih hi, banghang hiam cih leh tua in sal dinmun pen mi tungah thagum tawh kikoih hi cih lak hi.

senses.heading: Person controlled by something
senses.definition_en: A person whose life or behaviour is strongly controlled by a habit, activity or system.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ukcip a om mi; sal bang a om mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina, gamtatna ahih keileh system khat in a nuntakzia leh gamtatna nasatak a uk mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not become a slave to your phone.
examples.zomi: Na phone in hong ukcip sak kei in.

examples.english: He was a slave to his daily routine.
examples.zomi: Ama nisim gamtat ngeina in a ukcip hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use can sound strong because it compares control by a habit with the loss of freedom under slavery.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna pen sal dinmun a suahtakna taan tawh a tehkak manin kammal khauh bangin za thei hi.

senses.heading: Rest in a natural unconscious state
senses.definition_en: To rest with the eyes closed and the mind and body largely inactive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mit khum a, lungsim leh pumpi a tawlnga dingin ih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The baby slept for six hours.
examples.zomi: Naungek nai guk sung ih hi.

examples.english: I could not sleep because of the noise.
examples.zomi: Aw hangin ih theilo ing.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are slept: She slept well; she has slept enough.
senses.usage_zomi: Sleep a past tense leh past participle pen slept ahi hi: She slept well; she has slept enough.

senses.heading: Have enough sleeping space
senses.definition_en: To have beds or sleeping space for a stated number of people.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ihna mun nei; mi … lumsak thei
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nambat ciangtan khat a ding ihna mun ahih keileh lupna nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The cottage sleeps six people.
examples.zomi: Inn neu in mi guk lumsak thei hi.

examples.english: This room can sleep two guests comfortably.
examples.zomi: Hih pindan ah hawhmi nih nuam takin ih thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In accommodation descriptions, the subject is the room or building, and the number indicates its sleeping capacity.
senses.usage_zomi: Teenna mun hilhna ah pindan ahih keileh inn pen subject suak a, nambat in mi bangzah ih thei cih lak hi.

senses.heading: Thin, flat piece cut from something
senses.definition_en: A thin, flat piece cut from a larger piece of food or another material.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tan phel; a pantak a kitan khen
senses.explanation_zomi: An ahih keileh van lianzaw khat pan a pantak leh a pheltak a kitan khen ahi hi.

examples.english: She ate two slices of bread for breakfast.
examples.zomi: Ama zing an in tanghou tan phel nih ne hi.

examples.english: Cut the tomato into thin slices.
examples.zomi: Tomato pen tan phel panpan in tan in.

senses.usage_en: Use a slice of to count thin, flat pieces of uncountable food: three slices of bread.
senses.usage_zomi: Uncountable an tan phel-te sim dingin a slice of kizang hi: three slices of bread.

senses.heading: Portion or share
senses.definition_en: A part or share of a larger amount, activity or market.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, nasep ahih keileh market lianzaw khat sung a khen ahih keileh ngahsa ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: a large slice of the market

examples.english: The company controls a large slice of the market.
examples.zomi: Company in market khen lian khat uk hi.

examples.english: Education receives a significant slice of the budget.
examples.zomi: Pilna in budget khen phawkhuai khat ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use compares a portion of something with a slice cut from food.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna in na khat a khen pen an pan a kitan phel khat tawh tehkak hi.

senses.heading: Move smoothly over a surface
senses.definition_en: To move smoothly and continuously across a surface while remaining in contact with it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na phel khat tawh kithuah paisuak in neem takin khinkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The glass slid across the wet table.
examples.zomi: Hai pen sabuai a khu tungah sul hi.

examples.english: She slid the box under the bed.
examples.zomi: Amahin bawm pen lupna nuai ah sul lut hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are slid: The box slid; it has slid under the table.
senses.usage_zomi: Slide a past tense leh past participle pen slid ahi hi: The box slid; it has slid under the table.

senses.heading: Move gradually into a worse condition
senses.definition_en: To move gradually and often unintentionally into a worse state or condition.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tomtom in niam; dinmun hoihlo ah lut
senses.explanation_zomi: Deihlohpi in dinmun hoihlo ah tomtom in lut cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The business slowly slid into debt.
examples.zomi: Business pen tomtom in leiba sungah lut hi.

examples.english: Sales continued to slide during the winter.
examples.zomi: Phalbi hun in zuakna niam paisuak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense suggests gradual change that is difficult to stop or may not be noticed immediately.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in khaktan haksa ahih keileh a kipatcil in kiphawk pahlo tomtom kikhelna gen hi.

senses.heading: Put something quietly or secretly somewhere
senses.definition_en: To put or pass something somewhere with a smooth, quiet or secret movement.
senses.zomi_equivalents: neem takin koih; kiseel in pia
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat aw neilo, neem tak ahih keileh kiseel in mun khat ah koih ahih keileh pia cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: slide a note across the table

common_phrases.zomi: na khat ip sungah sul lut

common_phrases.english: slide the key under the door
common_phrases.zomi: tawh kongkhak nuai ah sul lut

examples.english: He slid the note across the table to me.
examples.zomi: Amahin lai neu pen sabuai tung pan kei lamah sul hong pia hi.

examples.english: She slid the key into her pocket.
examples.zomi: Amahin tawh pen a ip sungah neem takin koih hi.

senses.usage_en: This use often suggests a smooth movement intended not to attract attention.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna in mi phawklohna ding a neem leh aw neilo kikhihna kawk tam hi.

senses.heading: Small in amount or degree
senses.definition_en: Small in amount, degree or importance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, dinmun ahih keileh thupidan ah tawmno cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: There is a slight difference between the two colours.
examples.zomi: Kulep nihte kikal ah kilamdanna tawmno om hi.

examples.english: She showed a slight improvement this week.
examples.zomi: Hih kaal in hoihna tawmno lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Slight emphasizes that something exists but is small or not severe.
senses.usage_zomi: Slight in na khat om taktak napi a tawm ahih keileh a nasia lo cih bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Thin or not strongly built
senses.definition_en: Small and thin in body, with a light physical build.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi neu leh ginal a, pumpi lian leh khauhlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She was slight but physically strong.
examples.zomi: Ama pumpi ginal napi pumpi thahat hi.

examples.english: The slight child carried the heavy bag carefully.
examples.zomi: Naupang pumpi ginal in bawm gik pilvang takin puak hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing body build, slight does not necessarily mean weak.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi kibawlzia a gen ciangin slight cihpen thahatlo cihna a hih pah kullo hi.

senses.definition_en: By a small amount or degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat ahih keileh dinmun tawmno in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The second room is slightly larger.
examples.zomi: Pindan a nihna pen tawmno lianzaw hi.

examples.english: Prices increased slightly last month.
examples.zomi: Kha khit in man tawmno khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Slightly softens an adjective, adverb or comparison by showing that the difference is small.
senses.usage_zomi: Slightly in adjective, adverb ahih keileh etkakna kammal nemsak a, kilamdanna tawmno bek cih lak hi.

senses.heading: Slide accidentally and lose balance
senses.definition_en: To slide accidentally on a wet, smooth or unstable surface, often losing your balance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui a khu, a neem ahih keileh a kiplo na phel tungah deihlohpi in nusul a, kiploh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He slipped on the wet floor and fell.
examples.zomi: Ama innkuan a khu tungah nusul in puk hi.

examples.english: Be careful not to slip on the ice.
examples.zomi: Vuk tungah na nusullohna ding pilvang in.

senses.usage_en: Slip may result in a fall, but it can also mean losing balance briefly without falling.
senses.usage_zomi: Slip hangin puk thei napi, puklo in tawlkhat kiplo bek zong ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Move quietly, quickly or unnoticed
senses.definition_en: To move quietly or without attracting attention.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kiseel in pai; aw neilo in lut
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw neilo ahih keileh mi phawklo dingin kikhih cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: pindan sungpan aw neilo in pawtkhia

examples.english: She slipped out before the meeting ended.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna a tawpma in mi phawklo in pawtkhia hi.

examples.english: The child slipped quietly into the room.
examples.zomi: Naupang aw neilo in pindan sungah lut hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense often suggests that the movement is intended to remain unnoticed.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in midang-te in a phawklohna ding deihna tawh kikhih cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: Put something somewhere quickly or secretly
senses.definition_en: To put something somewhere quickly, smoothly or secretly.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kiseel in koih; neem takin koih
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat manlang, neem tak ahih keileh kiseel in mun khat ah koih cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: slip a note into a bag

examples.english: He slipped the letter into his pocket.
examples.zomi: Amahin lai pen a ip sungah kiseel in koih hi.

examples.english: She slipped off her shoes at the door.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak ah a khembel manlang takin suut hi.

senses.usage_en: The phrasal verbs slip on and slip off can mean putting on or removing clothing quickly and easily.
senses.usage_zomi: Phrasal verb slip on leh slip off in puan manlang leh baih tak a silh ahih keileh suut cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Become worse or lower gradually
senses.definition_en: To gradually move to a worse condition, lower level or weaker standard.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun hoihlo, level niamzaw ahih keileh standard nemzaw ah tomtom in tung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The quality began to slip after production increased.
examples.zomi: Suahna a khan khit ciangin hoihdan niam kipan hi.

examples.english: Sales slipped slightly in September.
examples.zomi: September kha in zuakna tawmno kiam hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense usually describes an unwanted and often gradual decline.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in deihlohpi leh tomtom a kiamna gen hi.

senses.heading: Surface with one end higher than the other
senses.definition_en: A surface or piece of land that has one end higher than the other.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mong khat sangzaw a, mong dang khat niamzaw na phel ahih keileh lei ahi hi.

examples.english: The house stands on a gentle slope.
examples.zomi: Inn pen lei pang nem tungah om hi.

examples.english: The children ran down the grassy slope.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te lopa nei mual pang nuailam ah tai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A steep slope rises or falls sharply; a gentle slope changes height gradually.
senses.usage_zomi: Steep slope pen tung leh nuai kilamdanna khauh a, gentle slope pen tomtom in sang ahih keileh niam hi.

senses.heading: Skiing surface
senses.definition_en: A prepared area on a mountain or hill used for skiing.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ski suhna mual pang; ski slope
senses.explanation_zomi: Mual ahih keileh mualneu tungah ski suhna ding a kibawl lei pang ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: ski sinthakte a ding mual pang

examples.english: The beginner slope is open today.
examples.zomi: Ski sinthakte a ding mual pang tuni in kihong hi.

examples.english: They spent the morning on the ski slopes.
examples.zomi: Zinglam sung ski suhna mual pangte ah om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In skiing contexts, the slopes collectively means the prepared mountain areas used by skiers.
senses.usage_zomi: Ski kimawhna thu ah plural the slopes in ski suhna ding a kibawl mual pangte a pum in kawk hi.

senses.heading: Rate of change in mathematics
senses.definition_en: A measure of how steep a line is, calculated from its vertical and horizontal change.
senses.explanation_zomi: Line khat bangzah a pang cih, a tunglam leh a khonglam kikhelna tawh kisim tehna ahi hi.

examples.english: Students calculated the slope of the line.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in line a pangdan sim uh hi.

examples.english: A horizontal line has a slope of zero.
examples.zomi: Line khong tawh a pai in slope zero nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In mathematics, slope equals vertical change divided by horizontal change.
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics ah slope pen tunglam kikhelna pen khonglam kikhelna tawh khenin kisim hi.

senses.heading: Moving at a low speed
senses.definition_en: Moving, operating or happening at a low speed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhih, nasep ahih keileh thu piangna manlanglo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Traffic was slow because of the snow.
examples.zomi: Vuk hangin mawtaw paihna manlanglo hi.

examples.english: Recovery has been slow but steady.
examples.zomi: Damsukna neem napi tawntung in hoih semsem hi.

senses.usage_en: Slow describes a noun. The usual adverb is slowly: a slow train, but the train moved slowly.
senses.usage_zomi: Slow in noun gen hi. Adverb ngeina pen slowly ahi hi: a slow train, ahih hangin the train moved slowly kici hi.

senses.heading: Taking a long time
senses.definition_en: Taking longer than expected or longer than usual.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kilamen zah ahih keileh ngeina sangin hun sawtzaw zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The service at the restaurant was slow.
examples.zomi: Annekna dawr a na sepna sawt hi.

examples.english: The company was slow to respond to the complaint.
examples.zomi: Company in complaint dawngkik ding sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern slow to + verb means taking a long time before doing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Slow to + verb cih kammal zatna in na khat bawlma hun sawt zang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not quick to understand
senses.definition_en: Taking more time than usual to understand or learn something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tel ding sawt; sin ding sawt
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tel ahih keileh sin ding ngeina sangin hun sawtzaw zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He is slow at reading but understands the material well.
examples.zomi: Ama laisimna ah manlanglo napi, sinna thu limtak tel hi.

examples.english: Some students are slower to learn a new language.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang pawlkhat pau thak sin ding sawtzaw uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Describing a person simply as slow can sound insulting. State the particular activity instead, such as slow at reading.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat slow bek a cih simmawhna bangin za thei hi. Tua sangin slow at reading bangin a gamtatna ciangtak gen ding hoihzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: At a low speed or in a way that takes a long time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Manlanglo in ahih keileh hun sawt zangin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please speak slowly so that everyone can understand.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in a teltheihna dingin dam takin pau in.

examples.english: The patient is slowly recovering.
examples.zomi: Cina pen damdam in nuamtuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Slowly is the usual adverb formed from slow: a slow car but the car moved slowly.
senses.usage_zomi: Slowly pen slow pan a kibawl adverb ngeina ahi hi: a slow car ahih hangin the car moved slowly kici hi.

senses.heading: Little in size
senses.definition_en: Little in physical size and not large.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi liandan ah a neu a, lianlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They live in a small apartment.
examples.zomi: Amaute apartment neu khat ah teng uh hi.

examples.english: The box is small enough to carry by hand.
examples.zomi: Bawm pen khut tawh puaktheih zahin neu hi.

senses.usage_en: Small describes physical size. Little can also express affection or emphasize that something is unimportant.
senses.usage_zomi: Small in pumpi liandan gen hi. Little in itna lungsim zong lak thei a, na khat thupi lo cih zong bulphuh thei hi.

senses.heading: Limited in number or amount
senses.definition_en: Limited or low in number, amount or degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat, zat ahih keileh dinmun ah tawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Only a small number of students were absent.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang tawmno bek sang kai lo hi.

examples.english: Add a small amount of salt.
examples.zomi: Ci tawmno behlap in.

senses.usage_en: Use a small number of with countable nouns and a small amount of with uncountable nouns.
senses.usage_zomi: Countable noun tawh a small number of kizang a, uncountable noun tawh a small amount of kizang hi.
