senses.heading: Not important or serious
senses.definition_en: Not important, serious or influential.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupi, nasia ahih keileh nawngkaina lian neilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A small mistake caused a long delay.
examples.zomi: Khialhna neu khat in sawt tak a kikhalna piangsak hi.

examples.english: She played a small but important role.
examples.zomi: Ama mawng neu napi thupi khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A physically small thing is not necessarily unimportant; context determines the intended meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi liandan a neu na khat pen thupi lo ngiat cihna hilo hi; a khiatna pen a kizangna thu in khensat hi.

senses.heading: Intelligent
senses.definition_en: Able to learn, understand and make good decisions quickly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Manlang takin sin, tel leh khensatna hoih bawl thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is smart and learns new skills quickly.
examples.zomi: Ama pil a, siamna thak-te manlang takin sin hi.

examples.english: Saving part of the money was a smart decision.
examples.zomi: Sum pawlkhat kholhna pen khensatna pil ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, smart commonly means intelligent. In British English, clever is also very common.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah smart in pil cihna nei tam hi. British English ah clever zong kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Using advanced technology
senses.definition_en: Using computer technology to perform additional or automatic functions.
senses.zomi_equivalents: technology pil nei; smart technology zang
senses.explanation_zomi: Behlap ahih keileh amah a nasep theihna ding computer technology a zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The smart watch measures her heart rate.
examples.zomi: Smart watch in a lungtang khen sim hi.

examples.english: Smart lights can be controlled by a phone.
examples.zomi: Smart meivak-te phone tawh uk theih hi.

senses.usage_en: In technology compounds, smart means able to connect, process information or operate automatically.
senses.usage_zomi: Technology compound-te ah smart cihpen kizom, thu bawlkhia ahih keileh amah a na sem thei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Neat and well dressed
senses.definition_en: Neat, clean and attractively dressed or arranged.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siangtho, kizem leh et hoih takin puan silh ahih keileh kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You look smart in that suit.
examples.zomi: Tua suit tawh na lim kizem mahmah hi.

examples.english: Employees must wear smart clothes to the meeting.
examples.zomi: Nasem-te kikhopna ah puan hoih leh kizem silh kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is especially common in British English. It describes a neat and fairly formal appearance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen British English ah kizang tam a, a siangtho leh formal deuh kilatdan gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A mobile phone that connects to the internet and runs applications as well as making calls and sending messages.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phone sam leh thu sawltheih banah internet kizom leh application-te zangthei mobile phone ahi hi.

examples.english: She uses her smartphone to check email.
examples.zomi: Amahin email en dingin a smartphone zang hi.

examples.english: The app works on most smartphones.
examples.zomi: App pen smartphone tampi tungah na sem hi.

senses.usage_en: Smartphone is written as one word. It is a type of mobile phone with computing and internet functions.
senses.usage_zomi: Smartphone pen kammal khat in kigelh hi. Computer leh internet nasepna a nei mobile phone nam khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Notice an odour
senses.definition_en: To notice or recognize an odour through the nose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nak tawh na khat nam thei ahih keileh phawk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I can smell smoke in the kitchen.
examples.zomi: Ankuangsuung ah meikhu nam thei ing.

examples.english: She smelled the flowers in the garden.
examples.zomi: Amahin huan sung pak-te nam hi.

senses.usage_en: Smell something means notice its odour. Smell something carefully may mean intentionally putting your nose near it.
senses.usage_zomi: Smell something cihpen a nam phawk cihna ahi hi. Limtak a nam cih ciangin nak tawh deihna tak a namna zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Have a particular odour
senses.definition_en: To have or produce a particular odour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nam ciangtak khat nei ahih keileh suah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bread smells wonderful.
examples.zomi: Tanghou pen nam hoih mahmah hi.

examples.english: The room smelled of fresh paint.
examples.zomi: Pindan sung paint thak nam hi.

senses.usage_en: After smell, use an adjective to describe the odour: smells good, not smells well.
senses.usage_zomi: Nam a gen dingin smell khit ah adjective kizang hi: smells good kici a, smells well kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Detect or suspect something
senses.definition_en: To notice or suspect that something hidden, dishonest or unpleasant exists.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kiseel, thutanglo ahih keileh hoihlo khat om ding ci in phawk ahih keileh lunghiang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The dog seemed to smell danger.
examples.zomi: Ui in lauhuaina phawk bangin kilang hi.

examples.english: Investors smelled trouble and began selling.
examples.zomi: Sum suante in haksatna hong om ding phawk a, zuak kipan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense means detecting something through judgment or instinct, not through the nose.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in nak tawh nam cihna hilo a, ngaihsutna ahih keileh pianpih phawkna tawh thei cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To make a pleased, friendly or amused expression by turning up the corners of the mouth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungdamna, lawmtakna ahih keileh nuamna lak dingin muk gei lamto in nui deuh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She smiled warmly when she saw us.
examples.zomi: Amahin kote a hong muh ciangin lawmtak in nui hi.

examples.english: The child smiled at the camera.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen camera lamah nui hi.

senses.usage_en: Use smile at someone, not normally smile to someone. A smile is usually quieter than a laugh.
senses.usage_zomi: Smile at someone ci in kizang a, smile to someone ci ngeilo hi. Nuihna aw suah sangin smile pen aw neilo in om tam hi.

senses.heading: Gas and particles from burning
senses.definition_en: The grey, white or black mixture of gases and small particles produced when something burns.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kuang ciangin a hong suak huih leh vut neu a kigawm, ngo, vom ahih keileh ngo-vom meikhu ahi hi.

examples.english: Thick smoke filled the room.
examples.zomi: Meikhu sah in pindan sung dim hi.

examples.english: We saw black smoke rising from the building.
examples.zomi: Innpi pan meikhu vom a kahto mu ung.

senses.usage_en: Smoke is normally uncountable when referring to the substance produced by burning.
senses.usage_zomi: Kuangna pan a hong suak meikhu a kawk ciangin smoke pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Act of smoking a cigarette
senses.definition_en: An occasion when someone smokes a cigarette or similar product.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in cigarette ahih keileh a kibang na khat a zuk hun ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: cigarette zuk dingin pualam ah pai

examples.english: He went outside for a smoke.
examples.zomi: Ama cigarette zuk dingin pualam ah pai hi.

examples.english: The building has no place for a smoke.
examples.zomi: Innpi ah cigarette zukna ding mun om lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is informal. Smoking is harmful to health and is restricted in many public places.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna pen nisim pau ahi hi. Cigarette zukna cidamna susia a, mipite zat mun tampi ah kikhaktan hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity or habit of smoking cigarettes, tobacco or another substance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cigarette, zatui nam ahih keileh zuktheih na dang khat zukna gamtatna ahih keileh ngeina ahi hi.

examples.english: Smoking increases the risk of lung disease.
examples.zomi: Cigarette zukna in lungs natna ngah lauhuaina khangsak hi.

examples.english: Smoking is not allowed inside the building.
examples.zomi: Innpi sungah cigarette zuk phallo hi.

senses.usage_en: Smoking is generally uncountable. It refers to the activity, not to one cigarette.
senses.usage_zomi: Smoking pen uncountable noun ahi hi. Tua in zukna gamtatna kawk a, cigarette khat kawk lo hi.

senses.heading: Having an even surface
senses.definition_en: Having a flat, even surface without rough areas, points or holes.
senses.explanation_zomi: A phel kibang, a krough, a zum ahih keileh kua neilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The stone has a smooth surface.
examples.zomi: Suang pen a phel neem hi.

examples.english: Sand the wood until it is smooth.
examples.zomi: Sing pen a neem dong nul in.

senses.usage_en: Smooth is the opposite of rough when describing a surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a phel a gen ciangin smooth pen rough a kilehbulh ahi hi.

senses.heading: Happening without problems or interruptions
senses.definition_en: Happening or operating successfully without difficulty, delay or interruption.
senses.zomi_equivalents: haksatna neilo; hoih tak a pai
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna, kikhalna ahih keileh khawlna omlo in hoih tak a piang ahih keileh na sem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting was smooth and well organized.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna haksatna neilo leh kizem takin pai hi.

examples.english: Careful planning ensured a smooth transition.
examples.zomi: Limtak a geelkholna in kikhelna haksatna neilo piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes a process that proceeds easily and efficiently.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in sepzia khat baih leh hoih tak a paipaisuakna gen hi.

senses.heading: Calm and controlled
senses.definition_en: Calm, confident and pleasant in speech or behaviour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pau leh gamtatna ah lungdamai, kimuang leh nuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The presenter spoke in a smooth, confident voice.
examples.zomi: Pulakpa in aw nuam leh kimuang takin pau hi.

examples.english: His smooth manner made customers feel comfortable.
examples.zomi: A gamtatna nuam in customer-te omnuam sak hi.

senses.usage_en: When used about a person, smooth can be positive, but it may also suggest someone is charming in an insincere way.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a gen ciangin smooth pen hoihna ahi thei napi, lungsim tak hilo in kammal nuam a zang mi cihna zong nei thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A long, thin reptile without legs, some kinds of which are poisonous.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sau leh ginal, khe neilo, a nam pawlkhat in gui nei ganhing ahi hi.

examples.english: We saw a snake beside the path.
examples.zomi: Lampi geiah gul khat mu ung.

examples.english: Some snakes are poisonous, but many are harmless.
examples.zomi: Gul pawlkhat gu nei napi, tampi in lauhuaina neilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use venomous more precisely for an animal that injects venom by biting or stinging, although poisonous snake is common in everyday English.
senses.usage_zomi: Ganhing khat in seh ahih keileh sun in gu a lut sak ciangin venomous cih kammal kicianzaw hi, himahleh nisim English ah poisonous snake kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: Soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from clouds in cold weather and cover the ground.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuavot hun in meiingo pan a kia, leitang a tuam tui khauh ngo leh neem ahi hi.

examples.english: Heavy snow closed several roads.
examples.zomi: Vuk kia nasia in lampi pawlkhat khaksak hi.

examples.english: The children played in the snow.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te vuk sungah kimawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Snow is normally uncountable. To describe separate falling pieces, use snowflakes.
senses.usage_zomi: Snow pen uncountable noun ahi hi. A kia phel khatciat kawk dingin snowflakes kizang hi.

senses.heading: To such a great degree
senses.definition_en: To the degree stated or to a very great degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen dinmun zah ahih keileh nasatak mahmah in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The view was so beautiful that we stopped to take pictures.
examples.zomi: Mun kilatdan hoih mahmah ahih manin lim la dingin tawlnga ung.

examples.english: Why are you so tired today?
examples.zomi: Tuni banghangin na gim mahmah hiam?

senses.usage_en: The pattern so + adjective/adverb + that introduces a result: so tired that I fell asleep.
senses.usage_zomi: So + adjective/adverb + that cih kammal zatna in ngahna gen hi: so tired that I fell asleep.

senses.heading: In the way just mentioned
senses.definition_en: In the way that has just been described or mentioned.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuma a kigenzia ahih keileh kigen bangin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: “Will it rain?” “I think so.”
examples.zomi: “Guah zu ding hiam?” “Tua bangin ka ngaihsun hi.”

examples.english: If so, we should change the plan.
examples.zomi: Tua bang ahih leh, geelna khel ding i hoih hi.

senses.usage_en: So can replace a previously mentioned idea, preventing unnecessary repetition.
senses.usage_zomi: So in tuma a kigen ngaihsutna aiawh in na sem a, kammal a kibang thakik kul sak lo hi.

senses.heading: Used to emphasize an opinion
senses.definition_en: Used informally to strongly emphasize that a statement is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kigen pen maan taktak cih nisim pau tawh thahatsakna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: That is so true.
examples.zomi: Tua maan taktak hi.

examples.english: I am so ready for the weekend.
examples.zomi: Kaal tawp a ding kiging taktak ing.

senses.usage_en: This emphatic pattern is informal and may not be suitable for formal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih thahatsakna zatna pen nisim pau ahi a, formal laigelh ah a kilawm khollo thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A substance used with water for washing the body, clothes or other objects.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi, puan ahih keileh van dangte tui tawh silna ding a kizang van ahi hi.

examples.english: Wash your hands with soap and water.
examples.zomi: Na khutte sahbawn leh tui tawh sil in.

examples.english: The hotel provides soap and clean towels.
examples.zomi: Hotel in sahbawn leh khutnul puan siangtho pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Soap is usually uncountable. Say a bar of soap or a bottle of liquid soap when counting it.
senses.usage_zomi: Soap pen uncountable noun ahi hi. Sim dingin a bar of soap ahih keileh a bottle of liquid soap kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A team sport in which players mainly use their feet to move a round ball and try to score goals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlte in a khe uh zangin ball bial a gol uh a, goal bawl ding a kidem team kimawhna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children play soccer after school.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te sang khit ciangin football kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: Our soccer team won the final match.
examples.zomi: Ka football team un tawpna kidemna zo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Soccer is common in American English. In most other countries, the sport is called football.
senses.usage_zomi: Soccer pen American English ah kizang tam hi. Gam dang a tamzaw ah hih kimawhna pen football kici hi.

senses.heading: Connected with society
senses.definition_en: Connected with society, communities and the way people live together.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khuahun tawh kisai; mipite tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuahun, khuamite leh mite nuntakkhawmzia tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The report examines major social problems.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna in khuahun haksatna thupi-te sit hi.

examples.english: Education can create positive social change.
examples.zomi: Pilna in khuahun kikhelna hoih piangsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, social describes society as a whole rather than one person’s private life.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah social in mi khat mimal nuntakna sangin khuahun a pum in gen hi.

senses.heading: Connected with meeting and interacting with people
senses.definition_en: Connected with meeting, communicating and spending time with other people.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kipawlna tawh kisai; mihing kizopna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang-te tawh kimuh, kihoupih leh hun kizangkhawmna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The club organizes social activities for new members.
examples.zomi: Club in member thakte a ding kipawlna gamtatna-te bawl hi.

examples.english: She has an active social life.
examples.zomi: Ama midang-te tawh kipawlna ah manpha takin kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: A social event is organized mainly so that people can meet and enjoy one another’s company.
senses.usage_zomi: Social event pen mite kimuh leh hun nuam a zatkhawmna ding a kibawl pawi ahi hi.

senses.heading: Enjoying other people’s company
senses.definition_en: Enjoying meeting, talking and spending time with other people.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kipawl nuam; mi tawh om nuam
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang-te tawh kimuh, kihoupih leh hun kizangkhawm nuamsa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He is social and enjoys meeting new people.
examples.zomi: Ama kipawl nuam a, mi thak-te tawh kimuh nuamsa hi.

examples.english: Some animals are naturally social.
examples.zomi: Ganhing pawlkhat pianpih in pawl in om nuam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Social can describe someone who enjoys company; sociable is often more precise for this meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Social in midang-te tawh om nuam mi gen thei a, hih khiatna dingin sociable cih kammal kicianzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: People living together in an organized community
senses.definition_en: People living together in an organized community with shared laws, institutions and customs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dan, pawlpi leh ngeina pawlkhat a neikhawm, kizem tak a tengkhawm mite ahi hi.

examples.english: Education benefits society as a whole.
examples.zomi: Pilna in khuahun a pum in phattuamna pia hi.

examples.english: Technology is changing modern society.
examples.zomi: Technology in tulai khuahun khelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Society is usually uncountable when referring generally to people living together in a country or community.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam ahih keileh khuamite nuntakkhawmna a pum in kawk ciangin society pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Particular type of community
senses.definition_en: A particular community or civilization considered according to its culture or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina ahih keileh a kizemzia bang a kingaihsut khuamite ahih keileh mihing khuahun nam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Ancient societies developed different systems of government.
examples.zomi: Tanglai khuahun-te in kumpi ukzia tuamtuam khangsak uh hi.

examples.english: A fair society protects the rights of every person.
examples.zomi: Khuahun thutang in mi khempeuh a thu neihna kem hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is countable because it refers to one particular organized community or civilization.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna pen khuahun ahih keileh civilization nam khat ciangtak kawk ahih manin countable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Formal organization
senses.definition_en: An organization formed by people who share an interest, profession or purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lunglutna, profession ahih keileh ngimna kibang a neikhawm mite in a bawl pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: She joined the university’s debating society.
examples.zomi: Ama university nialna kipawlna ah kihel hi.

examples.english: The historical society protects old documents.
examples.zomi: Tangthu kipawlna in laikhial lui-te kem hi.

senses.usage_en: In the name of an organization, Society normally begins with a capital letter.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawl min sungah a om ciangin Society laimal lian tawh kipan ngei hi.

senses.heading: Wealthy and fashionable social group
senses.definition_en: The group of wealthy, influential or fashionable people in a community.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mi hau leh minthang pawl; khuahun dinmun sang mite
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuahun sung a hau, thuneihna nei ahih keileh fashion lam a minthang mite pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The wedding attracted members of high society.
examples.zomi: Mopawi in khuahun dinmun sang mite hong kaai hi.

examples.english: The event was widely reported in the society pages.
examples.zomi: Pawi thu pen mi hau leh minthang thu gelhna lai ah kizai takin kigelh hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is less common in everyday speech and often appears in journalism or historical writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen nisim pau ah kizang tawm a, news ahih keileh tangthu laigelh ah om tam hi.

senses.definition_en: A soft piece of clothing worn on the foot and lower part of the leg, usually inside a shoe.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe leh khegu nuailam a kisilh puan neem, a tawntung in khembel sung a kisilh ahi hi.

examples.english: He wore thick socks inside his boots.
examples.zomi: Ama boot sungah khe-ip sah silh hi.

examples.english: I cannot find the other sock.
examples.zomi: Khe-ip langkhat mu theilo ing.

senses.usage_en: Socks normally come in pairs. Say a pair of socks for two matching socks.
senses.usage_zomi: Khe-ip pen a nih in kizangkhawm ngei hi. Khe-ip a nih a kituak kawk dingin a pair of socks kici hi.

senses.heading: Not hard or firm
senses.definition_en: Easy to press, cut or bend and not hard or firm.
senses.explanation_zomi: Net, tan ahih keileh kawng baih a, khauhgawp lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bread is fresh and soft.
examples.zomi: Tanghou pen thak leh neem hi.

examples.english: She slept on a soft pillow.
examples.zomi: Ama lu-ngak neem khat tungah ih hi.

senses.usage_en: Soft is the opposite of hard when describing texture or firmness.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a khauhdan gen ciangin soft pen hard a kilehbulh ahi hi.

senses.heading: Quiet or gentle
senses.definition_en: Quiet, gentle and not harsh or loud.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw nem, damai leh khauhlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She spoke in a soft voice.
examples.zomi: Ama aw nem takin pau hi.

examples.english: Soft music was playing in the background.
examples.zomi: A nunglam ah la aw nem kiza hi.

senses.usage_en: Soft describes the sound; softly describes how someone speaks or how sound is produced.
senses.usage_zomi: Soft in aw gen a, softly in mi khat pauzia ahih keileh aw suahzia gen hi.

senses.heading: Kind and sympathetic
senses.definition_en: Kind, gentle or easily affected by other people’s needs and feelings.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hehpihna nei, nem leh midang-te kisapna leh lungsim phawk baih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He has a soft heart for animals.
examples.zomi: Ama ganhing-te tungah lungsim nem hi.

examples.english: The teacher is firm but also soft with young children.
examples.zomi: Siamah pen khauh napi naupang note tungah nem hi.

senses.usage_en: Soft-hearted means kind and easily moved by sympathy.
senses.usage_zomi: Soft-hearted cihpen hehpihna nei leh lainatna tawh lungsim nawng baih cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not strict or demanding
senses.definition_en: Not strict, forceful or demanding enough.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisap zahin khauh, thahat ahih keileh ngenlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Critics said the policy was too soft on crime.
examples.zomi: Mawhsakte in policy pen mawhna tungah khauhlo lua ci uh hi.

examples.english: The manager chose a softer approach.
examples.zomi: Manager in sepzia nemzaw teel hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, soft may express criticism that rules or responses are not strict enough.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah soft in thukhun ahih keileh dawnkikna pen kisap zahin khauhlo cih mawhsakna lak thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The programs and digital instructions that make a computer or electronic device perform tasks.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer ahih keileh electronic device khat in nasep-te a bawltheihna ding a uk program leh digital thuhilhna-te ahi hi.

examples.english: You need to install the software before using the printer.
examples.zomi: Printer na zatma in software koihlut kul hi.

examples.english: The company released an updated version of the software.
examples.zomi: Company in software version kithaksak suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Software is uncountable. Say a piece of software or a software program, not normally a software.
senses.usage_zomi: Software pen uncountable noun ahi hi. A piece of software ahih keileh a software program kici a, a software ci ngeilo hi.

senses.definition_en: The upper layer of earth in which plants grow.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung leh singnote a khanna, leitung tunglam lei ahi hi.

examples.english: These vegetables grow well in rich soil.
examples.zomi: Hih anlak-te lei hoih ah khang thei mahmah hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain washed away some of the soil.
examples.zomi: Guah nasia in lei pawlkhat nawtmang hi.

senses.usage_en: Soil is usually uncountable when referring generally to earth used for growing plants.
senses.usage_zomi: Singkung khanna lei a pum in kawk ciangin soil pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Connected with the sun
senses.definition_en: Connected with or relating to the sun.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni tawh kizom ahih keileh ni tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Earth is part of the solar system.
examples.zomi: Leitung pen nizung system sung a khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Scientists observed the solar eclipse.
examples.zomi: Science siammi-te in niim en uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The solar system includes the sun and the planets and other objects that move around it.
senses.usage_zomi: Solar system sungah ni leh tua ni a kiim a kihei planet leh van dangte kihel hi.

senses.heading: Using energy from sunlight
senses.definition_en: Using or producing energy obtained from sunlight.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nisa tha zang; nisa tha tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Nisa pan a ngah tha a zang ahih keileh a piangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The building uses solar energy for electricity.
examples.zomi: Innpi in meitha a ding nisa tha zang hi.

examples.english: They installed solar panels on the roof.
examples.zomi: Amaute in innkhum tungah nisa tha lakhawmna panel koih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Solar power converts energy from sunlight into electricity or usable heat.
senses.usage_zomi: Solar power in nisa tha pen meitha ahih keileh zat theih lumna in khelsak hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who serves in an army, especially one who is trained to fight on land.
senses.explanation_zomi: Galkap sungah nasem a, adiakin leitang tungah galdo ding a kisin mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The soldier returned home after completing his service.
examples.zomi: Galkap pen a nasep hun a zoh khit ciangin innah ciah hi.

examples.english: Soldiers helped rescue people after the flood.
examples.zomi: Tuilian khit ciangin galkap-te in mite hotkhiatna huh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Soldier normally refers to an army member. Members of a navy are sailors, and members of an air force may be called airmen or air force personnel.
senses.usage_zomi: Soldier in army galkap kawk tam hi. Navy sung nasem-te sailors kici a, air force sung nasem-te airmen ahih keileh air force personnel kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Firm and not liquid or gas
senses.definition_en: Having a firm shape and volume, rather than being a liquid or gas.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lim leh a zat kician a, tui ahih keileh huih hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Water becomes solid when it freezes.
examples.zomi: Tui a khauh ciangin van khauh hong suak hi.

examples.english: The baby is beginning to eat solid food.
examples.zomi: Naungek an khauh ne kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: In science, solid is one of the main states of matter, alongside liquid and gas.
senses.usage_zomi: Science ah solid pen van dinmun bulpi-te sung a khat hi a, liquid leh gas tawh kizom hi.

senses.heading: Made entirely from a firm material
senses.definition_en: Made completely from a firm material and not hollow inside.
senses.explanation_zomi: A sung awnglo in van khauh tawh bukim tak a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The table is made of solid wood.
examples.zomi: Sabuai pen sing khauh tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: A solid wall surrounds the property.
examples.zomi: Kulh khauh in gam neihsa um hi.

senses.usage_en: Solid wood means real wood throughout, not a hollow or thinly covered material.
senses.usage_zomi: Solid wood cihpen a sung dong sing taktak ahi a, a awng ahih keileh pualam sing pan bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: Strong, dependable or well supported
senses.definition_en: Strong, reliable and based on good evidence, preparation or judgment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khauh, muanhuai a, teci, kisakholna ahih keileh ngaihsutna hoih tungah kinga cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The claim is supported by solid evidence.
examples.zomi: Tua kigenna pen teci khauh in kipsak hi.

examples.english: We need a solid plan before beginning the project.
examples.zomi: Project i kipatma in geelna khauh khat kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense is positive and suggests that something can be trusted or depended on.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna pen hoihna ahi a, na khat muan ahih keileh kingak theih cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: Continuous and without interruption
senses.definition_en: Continuing for a stated period without stopping or interruption.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ciangtan khat sung khawlna ahih keileh kikhalna omlo in a kizom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She studied for three solid hours.
examples.zomi: Ama nai thum khawllo in sin hi.

examples.english: It rained for two solid days.
examples.zomi: Ni nih kizom guah zu hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal use emphasizes that the whole period was occupied by the activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim pau zatna in hun ciangtan pumpi tua gamtatna tawh kizang cih thahatsak hi.

senses.heading: Answer to a problem
senses.definition_en: A way of solving a problem or dealing successfully with a difficult situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna khat veng ahih keileh dinmun haksa khat gualzo tak a bawltheihna lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: We need a practical solution to the housing problem.
examples.zomi: Inn haksatna a ding dawnna zat theih khat kisam hi.

examples.english: The committee found a solution that both sides accepted.
examples.zomi: Committee in lam nihgel a sangtheih dawnna khat zongkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a solution to a problem, not normally a solution for a problem.
senses.usage_zomi: A solution to a problem ci in kizang a, a solution for a problem ci ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Answer to a question or calculation
senses.definition_en: The correct answer to a question, puzzle, equation or calculation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dotna, puzzle, equation ahih keileh sum simna a dawnna maan ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher explained the solution to the equation.
examples.zomi: Siamah in equation dawnna hilhcian hi.

examples.english: There may be more than one possible solution.
examples.zomi: Dawnna piangthei khat sang tamzaw om thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In mathematics, a solution is a value or answer that satisfies the stated conditions.
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics ah solution pen ciangtan kigen-te tawh a kituak value ahih keileh dawnna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Liquid mixture
senses.definition_en: A liquid in which another substance has been dissolved.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van dang khat tui sungah a ki-aai in a kigawm tui ahi hi.

examples.english: The scientist prepared a salt solution.
examples.zomi: Science siammi in ci tui bawl hi.

examples.english: Use the cleaning solution carefully.
examples.zomi: Silna tui pen pilvang takin zang in.

senses.usage_en: In chemistry, a solution is a uniform mixture formed when one substance dissolves in another.
senses.usage_zomi: Chemistry ah solution pen van khat van dang sungah a ki-aai ciang a kigawm kibang tak a hong pian tui ahi hi.

senses.heading: Find an answer to a problem
senses.definition_en: To find a successful answer or way of dealing with a problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna khat a dawnna zongkhia ahih keileh gualzo takin veng cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The new policy will not solve every problem.
examples.zomi: Policy thak in haksatna khempeuh veng theilo ding hi.

examples.english: We worked together to solve the issue.
examples.zomi: Thu buai veng dingin nasemkhawm ung.

senses.usage_en: Solve is used for problems that require an answer. Resolve is also common for disagreements and conflicts.
senses.usage_zomi: Dawnna a kisap haksatna-te tawh solve kizang hi. Kikalhna leh buaina-te a ding resolve zong kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Find the correct answer
senses.definition_en: To find the correct answer to a question, puzzle, equation or calculation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dotna, puzzle, equation ahih keileh sum simna a dawnna maan zongkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you solve this equation?
examples.zomi: Hih equation simkhia thei ding nahi hiam?

examples.english: The detective solved the mystery.
examples.zomi: Detective in thusim zongkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun is solution: solve a problem but find a solution to a problem.
senses.usage_zomi: Noun pen solution ahi hi: solve a problem kici a, find a solution to a problem zong kici hi.

senses.heading: An unspecified amount or number
senses.definition_en: An amount or number that is not stated exactly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat ahih keileh nambat ciangtak a kigenlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Some students stayed after class.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang pawlkhat sang khit ciangin omlai uh hi.

examples.english: Please add some water to the soup.
examples.zomi: An tui sungah tui tawmkhat behlap in.

senses.usage_en: Use some with plural countable nouns and uncountable nouns, especially in positive statements.
senses.usage_zomi: Some pen plural countable noun leh uncountable noun tawh, adiakin positive statement ah kizang hi.

senses.heading: A particular person or thing not identified
senses.definition_en: A particular person or thing whose exact identity is unknown or unimportant.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na ciangtak khat, a min ahih keileh a hihna kicianlo ahih keileh thupi lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Some person left this bag near the door.
examples.zomi: Mi khatpeuh in hih bawm kongkhak geiah nusia hi.

examples.english: For some reason, the computer stopped working.
examples.zomi: Hangthu khatpeuh tawh computer nasep khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, some often suggests that the speaker does not know or does not specify the exact identity.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah some in a paupa in a hihna ciangtak theilo ahih keileh genlo cih lak hi.

senses.heading: Quite a large or impressive amount
senses.definition_en: Used informally to emphasize that an amount, person or thing is considerable or impressive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat a lian ahih keileh mi leh na khat lamdanghuai cih nisim pau tawh thahatsakna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: We still have some distance to travel.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna ding gamla tampi neilai ung.

examples.english: That was some performance!
examples.zomi: Tua performance lamdanghuai tak ahi hi!

senses.usage_en: This emphatic use is informal and is understood through tone and context.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih thahatsakna zatna pen nisim pau ahi a, a khiatna pen pau aw leh a kizangna thu pan kitel hi.

senses.definition_en: A person whose identity is unknown, unstated or unimportant.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hihna kitheilo, kigenlo ahih keileh thupi lo mi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Somebody left a message for you.
examples.zomi: Mi khat in nang a ding thu nusia hi.

examples.english: We need somebody who can repair computers.
examples.zomi: Computer puah thei mi khat kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Somebody and someone normally have the same meaning. Somebody may sound slightly more informal.
senses.usage_zomi: Somebody leh someone a khiatna kibang hi. Somebody pen nisim pau deuh in za thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A person whose identity is unknown, unstated or not important.
senses.explanation_zomi: A hihna kitheilo, kigenlo ahih keileh thupi lo mi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Someone is waiting outside.
examples.zomi: Pualam ah mi khat ngak hi.

examples.english: You should talk to someone you trust.
examples.zomi: Na muan mi khat tawh kihoupih ding na hoih hi.

senses.usage_en: Someone is grammatically singular: Someone is here. Singular they is commonly used when the person’s gender is unknown.
senses.usage_zomi: Someone pen grammar ah singular ahi hi: Someone is here. Mi pasal maw numei maw kitheilo ciangin singular they kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: An unknown or unspecified thing
senses.definition_en: An object, action, event or idea that is unknown, unstated or not identified exactly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, gamtatna, thu piang ahih keileh ngaihsutna khat, a hihna kitheilo ahih keileh kigenlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I need something to write with.
examples.zomi: Laigelhna ding na khat kisam hi.

examples.english: Something unusual happened last night.
examples.zomi: Zan khit in na ngeilo khat piang hi.

senses.usage_en: An adjective normally follows something: something useful, not useful something.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective pen something nungah om hi: something useful kici a, useful something kici lo hi.

senses.heading: An important or impressive person or thing
senses.definition_en: A person, achievement or experience that is important, remarkable or impressive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, gualzawhna ahih keileh phutkhak thupi, lamdanghuai ahih keileh phawkhuai khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Winning the award was really something.
examples.zomi: Award a ngahna pen lamdanghuai tak ahi hi.

examples.english: Her final performance was something special.
examples.zomi: Ama tawpna performance pen na tuam leh thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal sense uses something to express admiration or importance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim pau khiatna in lamdanna ahih keileh thupina lak dingin something zang hi.

senses.definition_en: On some occasions but not always or regularly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun pawlkhat ah napi a tawntung ahih keileh ngeina bangin hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I sometimes walk to work.
examples.zomi: Khangkhat ciangin nasep ah khe tawh pai ing.

examples.english: Even simple decisions are sometimes difficult.
examples.zomi: Khensatna baih-te zong khangkhat ciangin haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: Sometimes is one word and means “occasionally.” Do not confuse it with sometime, meaning at an unspecified time.
senses.usage_zomi: Sometimes pen kammal khat in kigelh a, “khangkhat ciangin” cihna ahi hi. Hun ciangtak kigenlo sometime tawh helkhawm kei in.

senses.definition_en: To a limited or moderate degree; rather but not extremely.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun ciangtan tawmkhat dong, nasiatak hilo napi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The instructions were somewhat confusing.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna-te buai deuh hi.

examples.english: Her second proposal was somewhat better.
examples.zomi: Ama geelna a nihna pen tawmkhat hoihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Somewhat softens an adjective or adverb. It is more common in formal writing than in casual speech.
senses.usage_zomi: Somewhat in adjective ahih keileh adverb nemsak hi. Nisim pau sangin formal laigelh ah kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: In, at or to a place that is unknown, unstated or not exact.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun khatpeuh ah; mun khat ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun kitheilo, kigenlo ahih keileh kicianlo khat ah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
examples.zomi: Ka tawhte inn sung mun khatpeuh ah ka nusia hi.

examples.english: Let us find somewhere quiet to talk.
examples.zomi: Kihoupihna ding mun gamdai khat zong ni.

senses.usage_en: Do not normally use to before somewhere: say go somewhere, not go to somewhere.
senses.usage_zomi: Somewhere ma ah to kizang ngeilo hi: go somewhere kici a, go to somewhere kici lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person’s male child.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a ta pasal ahi hi.

examples.english: Their son is studying engineering.
examples.zomi: A tapa un engineering sin hi.

examples.english: He has two sons and one daughter.
examples.zomi: Ama tapa nih leh tanu khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Son refers to a male child of any age, including an adult.
senses.usage_zomi: Son in kum ciangtan neilo in ta pasal kawk a, picing ta pasal zong huam hi.

senses.definition_en: A short piece of music with words intended to be sung.
senses.explanation_zomi: La sak ding a kammal leh aw kizem tawh kibawl music tom khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The children learned a new song.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te la thak khat sin uh hi.

examples.english: She wrote a song about her hometown.
examples.zomi: Amahin a khua thu la khat gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: A song normally contains words. A piece of music without words may be called an instrumental or simply a piece of music.
senses.usage_zomi: Song in kammal nei ngei hi. Kammal neilo music pen instrumental ahih keileh a piece of music kici thei hi.

senses.heading: In a short time
senses.definition_en: After only a short amount of time; before long.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tom khit ciangin; sawtlo in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor will see you soon.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in nai takin hong mu ding hi.

examples.english: I hope you recover soon.
examples.zomi: Nai takin na damsuk ding ka lamen hi.

senses.usage_en: Soon refers to a short time from the present or from another stated time.
senses.usage_zomi: Soon in tuhun pan ahih keileh hun kigen dang khat pan sawtlo khit cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Early or earlier than expected
senses.definition_en: At an early time or earlier than expected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun masalam ah ahih keileh kilamen hun sangin maizaw in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We arrived sooner than expected.
examples.zomi: Kilamen sang maizaw in tung ung.

examples.english: It is too soon to make a final decision.
examples.zomi: Khensatna nunung bawl dingin hun ma lua hi.

senses.usage_en: The comparative form is sooner, and the superlative is soonest.
senses.usage_zomi: Comparative form pen sooner a, superlative form pen soonest ahi hi.

senses.heading: Feeling regret for wrongdoing
senses.definition_en: Feeling regret or sadness because you have done something wrong or caused a problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khialhna khat bawl ahih keileh haksatna piangsak manin kisik leh dah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am sorry for arriving late.
examples.zomi: Ka nungta manin kisik ing.

examples.english: She said she was sorry for hurting him.
examples.zomi: Ama a lungsim a naisak manin kisik hi ci hi.

senses.usage_en: Use sorry for + noun/-ing: sorry for the delay, sorry for interrupting.
senses.usage_zomi: Sorry for + noun/-ing ci in kizang hi: sorry for the delay, sorry for interrupting.

senses.heading: Feeling sympathy
senses.definition_en: Feeling sadness or sympathy because another person is suffering or facing difficulty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang khat in haksatna ahih keileh thuaksiatna a thuak manin dahpih leh lainat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am sorry to hear about your illness.
examples.zomi: Na natna thu ka zakna dahhuai hi.

examples.english: We felt sorry for the injured animal.
examples.zomi: Ganhing liam pen lainat ung.

senses.usage_en: Feel sorry for someone expresses sympathy, but it can sometimes imply pity and should be used thoughtfully.
senses.usage_zomi: Feel sorry for someone in dahpihna lak napi, khangkhat ciangin kiniamkhiat sak bangin za thei ahih manin pilvang takin zat ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Used politely when interrupting or asking
senses.definition_en: Used as a polite expression when interrupting, disagreeing, asking someone to repeat something or giving bad news.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hong maisak in; ka zaklo hi
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khaktan, lungkimlohna gen, thugen thaksak ding ngen ahih keileh thu hoihlo gen ciang a zualzang kammal ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: Thu ka khaktan hangin hong maisak in

examples.english: Sorry, could you repeat the question?
examples.zomi: Hong maisak in, dotna na genkik thei ding hiam?

examples.english: I’m sorry, but the office is closed.
examples.zomi: Hong maisak in, himahleh office kikhak hi.

senses.usage_en: A rising-tone Sorry? commonly asks someone to repeat what they said.
senses.usage_zomi: Aw lamto tawh Sorry? a cihpen thugen thaksak ding a ngenna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Type or kind
senses.definition_en: A group or type of people or things that share similar qualities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih keileh omdan kibang a neikhawm mi ahih keileh na pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: What sort of music do you enjoy?
examples.zomi: Music nam bang na nuamsa hiam?

examples.english: The shop sells all sorts of tools.
examples.zomi: Dawr in vanzat nam tuamtuam zuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Sort of and kind of normally have similar meanings when classifying things.
senses.usage_zomi: Na nam a khen ciangin sort of leh kind of a khiatna kibang hi.

senses.heading: Kind of person
senses.definition_en: A person having a particular character or nature.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih keileh pianzia ciangtak khat a nei mi ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: ka lawmtheih ding mi nam hilo

examples.english: He is the sort of person who always helps others.
examples.zomi: Ama midang-te a huh tawntung mi nam ahi hi.

examples.english: She is not the sort to give up easily.
examples.zomi: Ama baih tak a lungkia mi nam hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is informal and classifies a person by typical behaviour or character.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna pen nisim pau ahi a, mi khat a gamtat ngeina ahih keileh pianzia bangin khen hi.

senses.heading: Approximately or somewhat
senses.definition_en: Used informally in the phrase sort of to make a description less exact or forceful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kigen kicianlo sak ahih keileh kammal nemsak dingin nisim pau sort of sungah kizang hi.

examples.english: I was sort of nervous before the interview.
examples.zomi: Interview ma in lau deuh ing.

examples.english: The instructions are sort of confusing.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna-te buai deuh hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is informal. In formal writing, use a more precise expression such as somewhat.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna pen nisim pau ahi hi. Formal laigelh ah somewhat bang kammal kicianzaw kizang ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Spiritual part of a person
senses.definition_en: The spiritual or non-physical part of a person, often believed to continue after bodily death.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a pumpi hilo sunglam nuntakna, biakna ngaihsutna tampi ah pumpi a sih khit zong om paisuak dingin ki-um ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat kha a ding thungen

examples.english: Many religions teach that the soul continues after death.
examples.zomi: Biakna tampi in pumpi sih khit zong kha om paisuak hi ci in hilh uh hi.

examples.english: The book discusses the relationship between body and soul.
examples.zomi: Laibu in pumpi leh kha kizopna thu gen hi.

senses.usage_en: The meaning of soul differs among religions and philosophies. Translate it according to the intended theological or philosophical context.
senses.usage_zomi: Soul a khiatna pen biakna leh philosophy tuamtuam ah kibang lo hi. Biakna ahih keileh philosophy thu a kigen bangin let ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Inner character or emotional nature
senses.definition_en: A person’s deepest feelings, character or moral nature.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a lungsim thukpen, gamtatna leh hoih-sia khenna sunglam pianzia ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a kind and generous soul.
examples.zomi: Ama lungsim hoih leh piakkhiat nuam mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The experience affected him deeply in his soul.
examples.zomi: Tua phutkhak in a lungsim sunglam nasatak in nawngkai hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense often uses soul to refer warmly to a whole person: a gentle soul.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in mi pumpi itna tawh gen dingin soul zang tam hi: a gentle soul.

senses.heading: Essential spirit or character
senses.definition_en: The central character, energy or most important quality of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a pianzia laigil, tha ahih keileh a thupipen gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Traditional music is the soul of the festival.
examples.zomi: Pu le pate la pen pawi laigil ahi hi.

examples.english: The neighbourhood changed without losing its soul.
examples.zomi: Veng kikhel napi a laigil pianzia taan lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative meaning identifies the quality that gives something its distinctive life or character.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in na khat a nuntakna leh pianzia tuam pia gamtatna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Person
senses.definition_en: A person, especially when counting or emphasizing that nobody is present.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, adiakin mi simna ahih keileh mi kuamah omlo cih thahatsakna ah kizang hi.

common_phrases.english: a village of five hundred souls
common_phrases.zomi: mi za nga a om khua

examples.english: There was not a soul on the street.
examples.zomi: Lampi tungah mi khat zong om lo hi.

examples.english: The small village has fewer than two hundred souls.
examples.zomi: Khuano neu ah mi za nih sang tawmzaw om hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is literary or old-fashioned and is uncommon in ordinary conversation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna pen literature ahih keileh kammal lui deuh ahi a, nisim kihoupihna ah kizang tam lo hi.

senses.heading: Something heard
senses.definition_en: Something that can be heard, produced by movement or vibration.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhihna ahih keileh liingna in a piangsak bil tawh zaktheih na ahi hi.

examples.english: We heard a strange sound outside.
examples.zomi: Pualam ah aw lamdang khat za ung.

examples.english: The sound of rain helped me sleep.
examples.zomi: Guah aw in ka ihmutna hong huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Sound is countable for a particular noise and uncountable when referring generally to what can be heard.
senses.usage_zomi: Aw khat ciangtak kawk ciangin sound pen countable noun ahi a, zaktheih aw a pum in kawk ciangin uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Audio in a recording or device
senses.definition_en: Recorded, transmitted or produced audio, especially in films, broadcasts or electronic equipment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Film, broadcast ahih keileh electronic van tawh ki-record, kisawl ahih keileh kisuah aw ahi hi.

examples.english: The picture was clear, but the sound was poor.
examples.zomi: Lim kician napi aw hoih lo hi.

examples.english: Please turn down the sound on the television.
examples.zomi: Television aw niamsak in.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, sound refers to audio rather than visible images.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah sound in audio aw kawk a, mit tawh muh lim kawk lo hi.

senses.heading: Impression or character of spoken or written words
senses.definition_en: The impression created by the way words, music or an idea are expressed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, music ahih keileh ngaihsutna kigenzia in a piangsak ngaihdan ahi hi.

examples.english: I like the sound of that plan.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna zakdan ka deih hi.

examples.english: The band developed a new sound.
examples.zomi: Band in music aw pianzia thak khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: I like the sound of that means an idea seems attractive, not necessarily that its physical sound is pleasant.
senses.usage_zomi: I like the sound of that cihpen ngaihsutna lunglut huai cihna ahi a, a aw taktak nuam cihna a hih kullo hi.

senses.definition_en: A liquid food made by cooking meat, vegetables or other ingredients in water or stock.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sa, anlak ahih keileh an bawlna dangte tui sungah huan in a kibawl an tui ahi hi.

examples.english: She made chicken soup for dinner.
examples.zomi: Amahin zan an a ding aa sa an tui bawl hi.

examples.english: The soup is too hot to eat.
examples.zomi: An tui pen nek dingin a lum lua hi.

senses.usage_en: Soup can be countable when referring to different kinds or servings, but it is often uncountable as food.
senses.usage_zomi: An tui nam tuamtuam ahih keileh a hai ciat kawk ciangin soup pen countable noun ahi thei a, an a pum in kawk ciangin uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Place or person from which something comes
senses.definition_en: The place, person or thing from which something begins, comes or is obtained.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kipatna, a hong paina ahih keileh a ngahna mun, mi ahih keileh na ahi hi.

examples.english: Farming is the family’s main source of income.
examples.zomi: Loh neihna pen innkuan sumlutna bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: The internet is a useful source of information.
examples.zomi: Internet pen thu ngahna bul zat theih ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a source of + noun: a source of energy, a source of concern.
senses.usage_zomi: A source of + noun ci in kizang hi: a source of energy, a source of concern.

senses.heading: Person, document or work providing information
senses.definition_en: A person, document, book or record from which information or evidence is obtained.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih keileh teci a ngahna mi, laikhial, laibu ahih keileh ciaptehna ahi hi.

examples.english: The journalist protected the identity of her source.
examples.zomi: Journalist in a thu bulpa a hihna kem hi.

examples.english: Students must cite every source used in the essay.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in essay ah a zat thu bul khempeuh kawk kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A primary source comes directly from the period, event or person being studied. A secondary source analyzes or explains primary material.
senses.usage_zomi: Primary source pen a kisin hun, thu piang ahih keileh mi kiangpan direct in hong pai hi. Secondary source in primary material sit leh hilhcian hi.

senses.heading: Beginning of a river
senses.definition_en: The place where a river or stream begins.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gun ahih keileh luangtum khat a kipatna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The river’s source is high in the mountains.
examples.zomi: Gun bul pen mual tung sang ah om hi.

examples.english: They walked to the source of the stream.
examples.zomi: Amaute luangtum bul dong khe tawh pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The source is the starting point of a river, not the place where it enters the sea.
senses.usage_zomi: Source pen gun kipatna mun ahi a, tuipi sung a lutna mun hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: The direction to the right of a person facing east, opposite north.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nisuahlam a facing mi khat ziatlam, saklam a kilehbulh lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: The storm moved toward the south.
examples.zomi: Huihpi pen simlam zuan in pai hi.

examples.english: They live in the south of the country.
examples.zomi: Amaute gam simlam ah teng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the south for a region and south without the after verbs of movement: travel south.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamhuam kawk dingin the south kizang a, kikhihna verb khit ah the omlo in travel south kici hi.

senses.definition_en: Located in, coming from or connected with the south of a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat a simlam ah om, simlam pan hong pai ahih keileh simlam tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Heavy rain affected the southern region.
examples.zomi: Guah nasia in simlam gamhuam nawngkai hi.

examples.english: She grew up in the southern part of the country.
examples.zomi: Ama gam simlam khen ah khang hi.

senses.usage_en: The pronunciation begins with /sʌð-/, unlike the noun south /saʊθ/.
senses.usage_zomi: A pronunciation pen /sʌð-/ tawh kipan a, noun south /saʊθ/ tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: Empty or available area
senses.definition_en: An empty or available area in which something can be placed or an activity can happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat koih ahih keileh gamtatna khat bawl theihna ding mun awng ahi hi.

examples.english: There is not enough space for another table.
examples.zomi: Sabuai dang khat a ding mun kicing om lo hi.

examples.english: Please make space for the new equipment.
examples.zomi: Vanzat thak a ding mun awng bawl in.

senses.usage_en: Space is usually uncountable when it means available room or area.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun awng ahih keileh zat theih mun kawk ciangin space pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Outer space
senses.definition_en: The area beyond the earth’s atmosphere where the planets, stars and other objects exist.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung huihlak pualam a planet, aksi leh van dangte a omna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The spacecraft carried four astronauts into space.
examples.zomi: Vantung tembaw in astronaut li vantung gamla ah puak hi.

examples.english: Scientists study how humans can live in space.
examples.zomi: Science siammi-te in mihing vantung gamla ah bangci nungta thei ding cih sin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use space without the when referring generally to outer space: travel in space.
senses.usage_zomi: Outer space a pum in kawk ciangin the omlo in travel in space kici hi.

senses.heading: Distance between people or things
senses.definition_en: A distance or empty area separating people, objects, words or lines.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, kammal ahih keileh line-te a kikhenna gamla ahih keileh mun awng ahi hi.

examples.english: Leave a space between each paragraph.
examples.zomi: Laigelh khen ciat kikal ah mun awng nusia in.

examples.english: People need enough personal space to feel comfortable.
examples.zomi: Mite omnuam dingin mimal kiim mun kicing kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense can be countable when referring to one particular gap: leave two spaces.
senses.usage_zomi: Kikal mun ciangtak khat kawk ciangin hih khiatna countable noun ahi thei hi: leave two spaces.

senses.heading: Time or opportunity
senses.definition_en: Time, freedom or opportunity to think, develop or act independently.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsun, khangto ahih keileh amah deihdan a gamtatna ding hun, suahtakna ahih keileh hunhoih ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat amah omna hun pia

examples.english: She needs some space to think about the decision.
examples.zomi: Khensatna ngaihsutna ding amah omna hun tawmkhat kisam hi.

examples.english: Give the team space to develop its own ideas.
examples.zomi: Team in ama ngaihsutna uh khangsaktheihna ding suahtakna pia in.

senses.usage_en: Need some space often means needing privacy, distance or independent time.
senses.usage_zomi: Need some space cihpen mimal hun, gamla tawm ahih keileh amah a omna hun kisam cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: Say words or talk
senses.definition_en: To produce words with the voice or communicate by talking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw tawh kammal gen ahih keileh kihoupih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please speak slowly and clearly.
examples.zomi: Neem leh kician takin pau in.

examples.english: I need to speak to the manager.
examples.zomi: Manager tawh kihoupih kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Use speak to/with someone and speak about something. Speak is slightly more formal than talk.
senses.usage_zomi: Speak to/with someone leh speak about something ci in kizang hi. Speak pen talk sangin formal tawmzaw hi.

senses.heading: Know and use a language
senses.definition_en: To be able to communicate in a particular language.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pau nam ciangtak khat tawh kihoupih thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She speaks English and Zomi fluently.
examples.zomi: Ama English leh Zomi pau siam takin pau hi.

examples.english: Do you speak Burmese?
examples.zomi: Burmese pau thei nahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: Do not use in after speak when naming a language: speak English, not normally speak in English. Use speak in English when emphasizing the language chosen for a particular occasion.
senses.usage_zomi: Pau min a gen ciangin speak khit ah in kizanglo hi: speak English kici hi. Hun ciangtak khat a pau teelna thupisak ciangin speak in English kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Address an audience
senses.definition_en: To give a formal talk to an audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipawl ma ah formal takin thugen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She will speak at the conference tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Ama zingciang conference ah thugen ding hi.

examples.english: He is nervous about speaking in public.
examples.zomi: Ama mipite ma a pau ding lau hi.

senses.usage_en: Use speak at before an event and speak on/about before a subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawi ahih keileh kikhopna ma ah speak at kizang a, thulu ma ah speak on/about kizang hi.

senses.heading: Express or represent
senses.definition_en: To express an opinion, feeling or message, sometimes without words.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, lungsim ahih keileh thu khat, khangkhat ciangin kammal neilo in, lak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: gamtatna in kammal sang kicianzaw in gen
ngahna-te in amah kician in lak

examples.english: I can speak only for myself.
examples.zomi: Keimah aiawh in bek gen thei ing.

examples.english: The results speak for themselves.
examples.zomi: Ngahna-te in amah kician takin lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Speak for someone can mean represent that person’s views. Do not assume permission to speak for another person.
senses.usage_zomi: Speak for someone in tua mi ngaihsutna aiawh in gen cihna nei thei hi. Midang khat aiawh a pau ding phalna nei ci in ngaihsun pah kei in.

senses.heading: Person who speaks
senses.definition_en: A person who is speaking or who gives a formal talk to an audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: A pau mi ahih keileh mipawl ma ah formal tak a thugen mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The guest speaker discussed community development.
examples.zomi: Thugen ding hawhmi in khuahun khantohna thu gen hi.

examples.english: She is a confident public speaker.
examples.zomi: Ama mipite ma a thugenna ah kimuang hi.

senses.usage_en: A speaker may be anyone currently speaking or a person invited to give a prepared talk.
senses.usage_zomi: Speaker pen tuhun a pau mi ahih keileh kiginkhol thugenna pia ding a kisam mi ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Person who uses a language
senses.definition_en: A person who speaks a particular language.
senses.zomi_equivalents: paupa; tua pau a pau mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Pau nam ciangtak khat a pau mi ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: tua pau pianpih a pau mi

examples.english: The course is designed for non-native English speakers.
examples.zomi: Course pen English pianpih pau hilo mite a ding kibawl hi.

examples.english: Millions of people are speakers of this language.
examples.zomi: Mi awn tampi in hih pau pau uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Native speaker normally means someone who learned the language naturally from early childhood.
senses.usage_zomi: Native speaker cihpen naupanlai pan pianzia bangin tua pau a sin mi kawk hi.

senses.heading: Device that produces sound
senses.definition_en: A device that changes electrical signals into sound.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meikang signal pen zaktheih aw in a khelsak device ahi hi.

examples.english: Music was playing through the speakers.
examples.zomi: Speaker-te pan music aw hong ging hi.

examples.english: Connect your phone to the wireless speaker.
examples.zomi: Na phone pen wire neilo speaker tawh kizomsak in.

senses.usage_en: For the device, speaker is a shortened form of loudspeaker.
senses.usage_zomi: Aw suahna device a kawk ciangin speaker pen loudspeaker a tomlakna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Different from what is usual
senses.definition_en: Different from what is ordinary or usual, often for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina tawh kibanglo a, ngimna ciangtak khat a ding a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You need special equipment for this work.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep a ding vanzat tuam kisam hi.

examples.english: The school offers a special programme for new students.
examples.zomi: Sang in sangnaupang thakte a ding program tuam pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Special may describe something adapted or reserved for a particular need.
senses.usage_zomi: Special in kisapna ciangtak khat tawh a kituak ding a kibawl ahih keileh kikoih na gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Particularly important or valued
senses.definition_en: More important, meaningful or valued than ordinary people or things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na ngeina sangin thupizaw, khiatna neizaw ahih keileh manphazaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Today is a special day for our family.
examples.zomi: Tuni pen ka innkuan uh a ding ni thupi tuam ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a special place in my heart.
examples.zomi: Ama ka lungsim sungah dinmun tuam nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, special often expresses affection, personal value or emotional importance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah special in itna, mimal manphatna ahih keileh lungsim thupina lak tam hi.

senses.heading: Better or greater than usual
senses.definition_en: Greater, better or more noticeable than is usual.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina sangin lianzaw, hoihzaw ahih keileh phawkhuai zaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This patient needs special care.
examples.zomi: Hih cina in kemna tuam kisam hi.

examples.english: Please pay special attention to the safety instructions.
examples.zomi: Bitna thuhilhna-te limtak awlmawh in.

senses.usage_en: Here, special emphasizes an increased degree of care, attention or effort.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna ah special in kemna, awlmawhna ahih keileh hanciamna ngeina sangin a tamzaw cih thahatsak hi.

senses.definition_en: A person with advanced knowledge or skill in a particular subject, profession or area of work.
senses.zomi_equivalents: siamtuamna nei mi; lam tuam siammi
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu, profession ahih keileh nasep khen ciangtak khat ah pilna leh siamna sangtak a nei mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor referred her to a heart specialist.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ama lungtang lam siamtuamna nei siavuan kiangah sawl hi.

examples.english: We need a specialist to repair this equipment.
examples.zomi: Hih vanzat puahna ding siamtuamna nei mi khat kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: A specialist focuses deeply on one area. A generalist works across a broader range of subjects.
senses.usage_zomi: Specialist in lam khat thuk takin sem hi. Generalist in thulu ahih keileh nasep lam tuamtuam huamzaw in sem hi.

senses.definition_en: A group of living organisms that share important characteristics and can normally reproduce with one another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna leh pumpi dinmun thupi-te a kibang a, ngeina bangin khat leh khat suanlehkhak thei ganhing ahih keileh singkung pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: Scientists discovered a new species of frog.
examples.zomi: Science siammi-te in uk nam thak khat mu uh hi.

examples.english: The law protects endangered species.
examples.zomi: Dan in a beikhe ding ganhing leh singkung nam-te kem hi.

senses.usage_en: The singular and plural forms are both species: one species, many species. Do not confuse it with series.
senses.usage_zomi: Singular leh plural lim a nihgel in species mah ahi hi: one species, many species. Series tawh helkhawm kei in.

senses.heading: Exact and clearly identified
senses.definition_en: Exact, particular and clearly identified rather than general.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak, ciangtak leh kician a, a pum in a gen hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please give a specific example.
examples.zomi: Ettehna ciangtak khat pia in.

examples.english: The report does not name a specific date.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna in ni ciangtak gen lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Specific narrows attention to one clearly defined person, thing, place or detail.
senses.usage_zomi: Specific in awlmawhna pen mi, na, mun ahih keileh thu ciangtak khat tungah koih hi.

senses.heading: Intended for one purpose or condition
senses.definition_en: Designed, intended or suitable for one particular purpose, group or condition.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a ding tuam; ciangtan khat a ding
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna, pawl ahih keileh dinmun ciangtak khat a ding a kibawl ahih keileh a kituak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This medicine treats a specific infection.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui in natna lut nam ciangtak khat enkawl hi.

examples.english: The course was designed for the specific needs of beginners.
examples.zomi: Course pen a sinthakte kisapna tuam a ding kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use specific to when something belongs to or affects only one group or situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat pawl ahih keileh dinmun khat bek tawh kisai ciangin specific to kizang hi.

senses.heading: Exactly or particularly
senses.definition_en: In an exact and clearly identified way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ciangtak leh kician takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The programme was specifically designed for children.
examples.zomi: Program pen naupang-te a ding ciangtak in kibawl hi.

examples.english: The instructions specifically mention safety glasses.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna-te in bitna mitkhu ciangtak in gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Specifically often emphasizes that a statement applies to one clearly identified person, group or purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Specifically in thugen khat pen mi, pawl ahih keileh ngimna ciangtak khat tungah a kizang cih thahatsak hi.

senses.heading: Used to introduce exact details
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce a more exact explanation or identify one point in particular.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hilhcianhna kicianzaw ahih keileh thulu a diak khat pulakna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: We need more volunteers, specifically trained drivers.
examples.zomi: Volunteer tampizaw kisam hi, a diakin mawtaw hawl sinna nei mite kisam hi.

examples.english: What specifically concerns you about the plan?
examples.zomi: Geelna sungah bang thu ciangtak hong lungkham sak hiam?

senses.usage_en: Specifically introduces a narrower or more precise point than the statement before it.
senses.usage_zomi: Specifically in tuma thugen sangin a tawmzaw huam leh a kicianzaw thu khat hong pulak hi.

senses.heading: Formal talk
senses.definition_en: A formal talk given to an audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipawl ma ah a kiginkhol leh formal tak a kipia thugenna ahi hi.

examples.english: The president gave a speech about the economy.
examples.zomi: President in sumlehpai thu thugenna pia hi.

examples.english: Her speech lasted twenty minutes.
examples.zomi: A thugenna minute sawmnih sawt hi.

senses.usage_en: Use give/make a speech. A speech is usually prepared and delivered to an audience.
senses.usage_zomi: Give/make a speech ci in kizang hi. Speech pen kiginkhol a, mipawl ma a kipia thugenna ahi tam hi.

senses.heading: Ability or act of speaking
senses.definition_en: The human ability or act of expressing thoughts through spoken words.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing in pau kammal tawh ngaihsutna a genkhia theihna ahih keileh gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: The injury affected his speech.
examples.zomi: Liamna in a pauna nawngkai hi.

examples.english: Children develop speech at different rates.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te pau theihna a khanna uh manlangdan kibang lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Speech is generally uncountable when referring to the ability or manner of speaking.
senses.usage_zomi: Pau theihna ahih keileh paudan a kawk ciangin speech pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Style or manner of speaking
senses.definition_en: A particular way of speaking used by a person, group or community.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl ahih keileh khuamite in a zat paudan tuam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The expression is common in everyday speech.
examples.zomi: Tua kammal pen nisim paudan ah kizang tam hi.

examples.english: Formal speech differs from casual conversation.
examples.zomi: Formal paudan pen nisim kihoupihna tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning concerns spoken language style, not a prepared public address.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in pau kammal zatdan kawk a, kiginkhol mipite ma a thugenna kawk lo hi.

senses.heading: Rate of movement
senses.definition_en: The rate at which someone or something moves or travels.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat bangzah manlangin kikhih ahih keileh khualzin cih tehna ahi hi.

examples.english: The car was travelling at high speed.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw manlang mahmah in pai hi.

examples.english: Drivers must obey the speed limit.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawlte in manlangdan ciangtan zui kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Speed measures how much distance is covered in a particular amount of time.
senses.usage_zomi: Speed in hun ciangtan khat sung bangzah gamla kipaikhiat cih teh hi.

senses.heading: Rate at which something happens
senses.definition_en: The rate at which an activity, process or change happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, sepzia ahih keileh kikhelna khat bangzah manlangin piang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The update improved the computer’s speed.
examples.zomi: Kithaksakna in computer nasep manlangdan hoihsak hi.

examples.english: Reading speed usually improves with practice.
examples.zomi: Laisim manlangdan pen kisinna tawh hoih semsem ngei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, speed may describe work, communication, learning or any process, not only physical movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah speed in pumpi kikhihna bek hilo a, nasep, kizopna, sinna leh sepzia dangte manlangdan gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Say or write the letters of a word
senses.definition_en: To say, write or name the letters of a word in their correct order.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal khat a laimal-te kizuihzia maan in gen, gelh ahih keileh min pulak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you spell your surname for me?
examples.zomi: Na minnung laimal kizuihzia hong gen thei ding hiam?

examples.english: She spelled every word correctly.
examples.zomi: Amahin kammal khempeuh maan takin spell hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle may be spelled or spelt. Spelled is more common in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Past tense leh past participle pen spelled ahih keileh spelt ahi thei hi. American English ah spelled kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Result in or mean
senses.definition_en: To lead to, mean or be a clear sign of a particular result, often a bad one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngahna ciangtak khat, a tamzaw in hoihlo, piangsak ahih keileh tua ding cih kician takin lak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A long delay could spell trouble for the project.
examples.zomi: Sawt tak a kikhalna in project a ding haksatna piangsak thei hi.

examples.english: Losing the contract may spell the end of the business.
examples.zomi: Contract a suplohna in business tawpsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use is common with negative results such as trouble, danger and disaster.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna pen trouble, danger leh disaster bang ngahna hoihlo-te tawh kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Correct arrangement of letters
senses.definition_en: The correct order of letters used to write a word.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal khat gelhna ding a laimal kizuihzia maan ahi hi.

examples.english: Check the spelling of every name.
examples.zomi: Min khempeuh gelhdan encik in.

examples.english: The word has two accepted spellings.
examples.zomi: Tua kammal in kisang gelhdan nih nei hi.

senses.usage_en: British and American English sometimes use different spellings, such as colour and color.
senses.usage_zomi: British leh American English in khangkhat ciangin colour leh color bang gelhdan tuam zang uh hi.

senses.heading: Ability or activity of spelling words
senses.definition_en: The ability or activity of writing words with their letters in the correct order.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal-te laimal kizuihzia maan tawh gelh theihna ahih keileh tua gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: The students have a spelling test on Friday.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te Friday ni in kammal gelhdan sittelna nei uh hi.

examples.english: Reading regularly can improve your spelling.
examples.zomi: Tawntung a laisimna in na kammal gelhna hoihsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Spelling is generally uncountable when referring to the skill, but spellings can mean alternative written forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Siamna a kawk ciangin spelling pen uncountable noun ahi a, spellings in gelhdan tuamtuam kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Use money to pay for something
senses.definition_en: To use money to buy something or pay for a service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van lei ahih keileh nasepna man pia dingin sum zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We spent fifty dollars on groceries.
examples.zomi: Annek ding-te tungah dollar sawmnga zang ung.

examples.english: She does not want to spend too much money.
examples.zomi: Ama sum tampi lua zang nuam lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use spend money on something and spend money doing something.
senses.usage_zomi: Spend money on something leh spend money doing something ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Use time doing something
senses.definition_en: To use a period of time doing an activity or staying somewhere.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ciangtan khat gamtatna khat bawlna ahih keileh mun khat a omna dingin zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I spent the weekend with my family.
examples.zomi: Kaal tawp pen ka innkuan tawh zang ing.

examples.english: She spends an hour exercising every morning.
examples.zomi: Ama zing sim nai khat exercise bawl in zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use spend time doing something, not spend time to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Spend time doing something ci in kizang a, spend time to do something ci ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: Use energy or effort
senses.definition_en: To use energy, effort or another limited resource.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tha, hanciamna ahih keileh neihsa ciangtan khat zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not spend all your energy on one task.
examples.zomi: Nasep khat tungah na tha khempeuh zang kei in.

examples.english: A great deal of effort was spent preparing the report.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna bawl dingin hanciamna tampi kizang hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is less common than spending money or time, but it follows the same idea of using a limited resource.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna pen sum ahih keileh hun zatna sangin kizang tawmzaw napi, neihsa ciangtan khat zatna ngaihsutna kibang nei hi.

senses.definition_en: The amount of money spent, especially by a person, organization or government.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl ahih keileh kumpi in a zat sumzah ahi hi.

examples.english: Government spending on education increased.
examples.zomi: Pilna tung a kumpi sum zatna khang hi.

examples.english: The family is trying to reduce unnecessary spending.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in kisaploh sum zatna kiamsak ding hanciam hi.

senses.usage_en: Spending is normally uncountable. It refers to money used over a period or for a purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Spending pen uncountable noun ahi hi. Hun ciangtan ahih keileh ngimna khat a ding a kizang sum kawk hi.

senses.heading: Containing strong-flavoured spices
senses.definition_en: Containing spices that give food a strong and noticeable flavour.
senses.explanation_zomi: An a lim leh a nam khauhsak spice-te a nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This soup is spicy but delicious.
examples.zomi: Hih an tui spice nei napi a lim hoih hi.

examples.english: Do you enjoy spicy food?
examples.zomi: Spice nei an na nuamsa hiam?
