senses.usage_en: Spicy means strongly flavoured with spices. It does not always mean hot from chilli, although the meanings often overlap.
senses.usage_zomi: Spicy cihpen spice hangin a lim khauh cihna ahi hi. Chilli hang a kaa ling cihna bek hilo napi, khiatna nihte kizomkhawm tam hi.

senses.heading: Exciting, slightly shocking or controversial
senses.definition_en: Exciting or interesting because it contains slightly shocking or controversial details.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lamdang, ngaihnophuai ahih keileh nialhuai thu tawm a neih manin lungluthuai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The article included some spicy details about the dispute.
examples.zomi: Article sungah kikalhna tawh kisai thu nialhuai deuh pawlkhat om hi.

examples.english: The interview became spicy when politics was mentioned.
examples.zomi: Politics a kigen ciangin interview lungluthuai leh nialhuai deuh hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use is informal and may suggest material that is provocative or unsuitable for some audiences.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna pen nisim pau ahi a, mi lungsim kaitho ahih keileh mi pawlkhat a ding a kilawmlo thu kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A small creature with eight legs that often makes a web to catch insects.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe giat nei a, a tamzaw in khuai neu dang man dingin a lai a bawl ganhing neu ahi hi.

examples.english: A spider built a web in the corner.
examples.zomi: Khuai khat in innkawm ah a lai bawl hi.

examples.english: Most spiders do not harm people.
examples.zomi: Khuai a tamzaw in mihing liamsak lo hi.

senses.usage_en: A spider is not an insect. It has eight legs, while insects normally have six.
senses.usage_zomi: Spider pen insect hilo hi. Ama khe giat nei a, insect-te khe guk nei ngei uh hi.

senses.heading: Non-physical being or part
senses.definition_en: A non-physical being, or the non-physical part of a person believed to exist beyond the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi neilo nuntakna khat ahih keileh pumpi pualam ah om dingin ki-um mi khat sunglam nuntakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The story describes a spirit appearing at night.
examples.zomi: Tangthu in zan in kha khat a kilatna gen hi.

examples.english: Different traditions understand the human spirit differently.
examples.zomi: Ngeina tuamtuam in mihing kha a telzia uh kibang lo hi.

senses.usage_en: The meaning of spirit differs across religions and philosophies. Translate it according to its precise context.
senses.usage_zomi: Spirit a khiatna pen biakna leh philosophy tuamtuam ah kibang lo hi. A kigenna thu ciangtak bangin let ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Holy Spirit
senses.definition_en: In Christianity, God’s Spirit, understood as the Holy Spirit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Christian upna ah Pasian Kha, Kha Siangtho cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Christians pray for the guidance of the Holy Spirit.
examples.zomi: Christian-te in Kha Siangtho makaihna a ding thungen uh hi.

examples.english: The passage speaks about the work of the Spirit.
examples.zomi: Tua Laisiangtho mun in Kha Siangtho nasep thu gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Spirit when it specifically refers to the Holy Spirit. The approved Standard Zomi term is Kha Siangtho.
senses.usage_zomi: Kha Siangtho ciangtak a kawk ciangin Spirit laimal lian tawh kipan hi. Standard Zomi term kipsa pen Kha Siangtho ahi hi.

senses.heading: Attitude, courage or emotional energy
senses.definition_en: A person’s attitude, courage, enthusiasm or emotional energy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ngaihsutdan, hangsanna, lunglawpna ahih keileh lungsim tha ahi hi.

examples.english: The team showed strong spirit despite losing.
examples.zomi: Team in guallelh hangin lungsim tha khauh lak hi.

examples.english: She remained in good spirits during her recovery.
examples.zomi: A damsuk hun sung lungsim nuam in om hi.

senses.usage_en: In good spirits means cheerful and emotionally positive.
senses.usage_zomi: In good spirits cihpen lungdam leh lungsim hoih in om cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: General character or intention
senses.definition_en: The main character, attitude or intention behind a rule, agreement, period or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, kilepna, hun ahih keileh gamtatna khat a laigil pianzia, ngaihsutdan ahih keileh ngimna ahi hi.

examples.english: The decision followed the spirit of the agreement.
examples.zomi: Khensatna in kilepna laigil ngimna zui hi.

examples.english: They acted in a spirit of cooperation.
examples.zomi: Amaute nasemkhawmna lungsim tawh gamta uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The spirit of the law means its intended purpose, while the letter of the law means its exact wording.
senses.usage_zomi: The spirit of the law cihpen dan a laigil ngimna ahi a, the letter of the law cihpen dan kammal ciangtak ahi hi.

senses.heading: Connected with the human spirit or inner life
senses.definition_en: Connected with a person’s spirit, deepest values or search for meaning rather than material needs.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kha lam; sunglam nuntakna tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi neihsa sangin mi khat kha, lungsim sunglam, a manphatna thukpen ahih keileh nuntak khiatna zonna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Prayer is part of her spiritual life.
examples.zomi: Thungetna pen ama kha lam nuntakna sung a khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The retreat offered time for spiritual reflection.
examples.zomi: Tawlngakna program in kha lam ngaihsutna a ding hun pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Spiritual may be religious, but it can also refer more broadly to inner meaning, values and personal reflection.
senses.usage_zomi: Spiritual pen biakna tawh kisai thei napi, sunglam khiatna, manphatna leh mimal ngaihsutna zong huamzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: Connected with religion or sacred matters
senses.definition_en: Connected with religion, worship or sacred matters.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna, biakna hun ahih keileh siangtho in ki ngaihsut thu-te tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The community looked to its spiritual leaders for guidance.
examples.zomi: Khuamite in makaihna a ding a biakna makaite uh en uh hi.

examples.english: The book contains spiritual teachings.
examples.zomi: Laibu sungah kha lam thuhilhna-te om hi.

senses.usage_en: Context determines whether spiritual refers specifically to religion or more generally to inner life.
senses.usage_zomi: A kizangna thu in spiritual pen biakna ciangtak maw sunglam nuntakna a pum in maw cih khensat hi.

senses.heading: Divide into parts
senses.definition_en: To divide or break something into two or more parts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat khen nih ahih keileh a tamzaw in khen ahih keileh kheek cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat khen nih in khen

examples.english: The teacher split the class into four groups.
examples.zomi: Siamah in sang pen pawl li in khen hi.

examples.english: She split the apple in half.
examples.zomi: Amahin apple pen khen nih in khen hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are also split, not splitted.
senses.usage_zomi: Split a past tense leh past participle zong split mah ahi a, splitted hilo hi.

senses.heading: Share or divide something
senses.definition_en: To share money, work, costs or responsibilities between people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, nasep, man ahih keileh mawpuakna mite kikal ah khen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We agreed to split the cost equally.
examples.zomi: Man a kikim in khenkhawm ding lungkim ung.

examples.english: The two teams split the work between them.
examples.zomi: Team nihte in nasep khenkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Split something between/among people means divide it so each receives or does a portion.
senses.usage_zomi: Split something between/among people cihpen mi ciat in a khen a ngah ahih keileh a bawl dingin khen cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Separate or end a relationship
senses.definition_en: To separate into opposing groups or end a personal or organizational relationship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl kilehbulh-te in kikhen ahih keileh mimal leh pawl kizopna khawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee split over the proposal.
examples.zomi: Committee pen geelna hangin lam tuamtuam ah kikhen hi.

examples.english: The band split up after ten years.
examples.zomi: Band pen kum sawm khit ciangin kikhen hi.

senses.usage_en: Split up can mean that a couple ends a relationship or that a group separates.
senses.usage_zomi: Split up in miteeng khat a kizopna tawp ahih keileh pawl khat kikhen cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Tear or crack
senses.definition_en: To tear or crack along a line, often accidentally.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tawntung in deihlohpi in line khat zui in keek ahih keileh pawng cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: My bag split at the bottom.
examples.zomi: Ka bawm a nuai ah keek hi.

examples.english: The dry wood split easily.
examples.zomi: Sing keu pen baih takin keek hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may be transitive or intransitive: split the wood; the wood split.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna transitive ahih keileh intransitive ahi thei hi: split the wood; the wood split.

senses.heading: Expressed by speaking
senses.definition_en: Expressed through speech rather than writing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laigelh tawh hilo in pauna tawh kigen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Spoken English differs from formal written English.
examples.zomi: Kampau English pen formal laigelh English tawh kibang lo hi.

examples.english: The instructions were spoken, not written.
examples.zomi: Thuhilhna-te laigelh hilo in kam tawh kigen hi.

senses.usage_en: Spoken contrasts with written: spoken language and written language.
senses.usage_zomi: Spoken pen written tawh kilehbulh hi: spoken language leh written language.

senses.heading: Having a particular style of speaking
senses.definition_en: Speaking in the manner described.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kigen paudan ciangtak khat a nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is quiet and soft-spoken.
examples.zomi: Ama gamdai leh aw nem takin pau hi.

examples.english: The well-spoken student gave a clear answer.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang pau siamtak in dawnna kician pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In compounds such as soft-spoken, spoken describes a person’s habitual speaking style.
senses.usage_zomi: Soft-spoken bang compound-te ah spoken in mi khat a pau ngeidan gen hi.

senses.heading: Provide money or resources
senses.definition_en: To provide money, equipment or other support for an event, activity, person or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawi, gamtatna, mi ahih keileh pawl khat a ding sum, vanzat ahih keileh huhna dang pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A local company sponsored the sports event.
examples.zomi: Khuahun sung company khat in sports pawi sum tawh huh hi.

examples.english: The organization sponsors scholarships for students.
examples.zomi: Pawl in sangnaupang-te scholarship pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A sponsor normally receives recognition, publicity or another agreed benefit in return for support, though not always.
senses.usage_zomi: Sponsor khat in huhna a piak thuk in a min kitheihna, advertisement ahih keileh kilemsa phattuamna khat ngah ngei napi, a tawntung in hilo hi.

senses.heading: Officially support a proposal or person
senses.definition_en: To officially introduce, support or accept responsibility for a proposal, law or person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna, dan ahih keileh mi khat official takin pulak, thapia ahih keileh mawpuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The senator sponsored the new bill.
examples.zomi: Senator in dan geelna thak pulak leh thapia hi.

examples.english: The programme sponsors qualified applicants.
examples.zomi: Program in a kicing lai ngen mite mawpuak hi.

senses.usage_en: In law and government, sponsoring a bill means formally introducing or supporting it.
senses.usage_zomi: Dan leh kumpi thu ah bill sponsor cihpen dan geelna official takin pulak ahih keileh thapia cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: An eating or cooking tool with a small bowl-shaped end and a handle.
senses.explanation_zomi: An nek ahih keileh huan ding a kizang, a mong ah hai lim neu leh a khutna sau a nei van ahi hi.

examples.english: She stirred the soup with a wooden spoon.
examples.zomi: Amahin an tui pen sing spoon tawh hel hi.

examples.english: The child ate rice with a spoon.
examples.zomi: Naupang in buh spoon tawh ne hi.

senses.usage_en: A spoon is used for liquids and soft foods. A teaspoon and tablespoon are also standard units in recipes.
senses.usage_zomi: Spoon pen tui leh an neem-te a ding kizang hi. Recipe ah teaspoon leh tablespoon pen standard tehna zong ahi hi.

senses.heading: Physical game or activity
senses.definition_en: A physical game or activity performed for exercise, competition or enjoyment according to rules.
senses.explanation_zomi: Exercise, kidemna ahih keileh nopsakna a ding thukhun tawh kibawl pumpi kimawhna ahi hi.

examples.english: Football is the most popular sport in many countries.
examples.zomi: Gam tampi ah football pen kimawhna minthangpen ahi hi.

examples.english: Regular participation in sport can improve health.
examples.zomi: Tawntung a kimawhna ah kihelna in cidamna hoihsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: British English often uses sport as an uncountable general category. American English commonly uses the plural sports.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah kimawhna a pum in kawk dingin uncountable sport kizang tam hi. American English ah plural sports kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Particular type of sporting activity
senses.definition_en: One particular kind of physical game or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi kimawhna ahih keileh kidemna nam ciangtak khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Skiing is a popular winter sport.
examples.zomi: Skiing pen phalbi kimawhna minthang ahi hi.

examples.english: She has tried several different sports.
examples.zomi: Amahin kimawhna nam tuamtuam pawlkhat hanciam khin hi.

senses.usage_en: In this countable sense, use a sport or plural sports.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih countable khiatna ah a sport ahih keileh plural sports kizang hi.

senses.heading: Good-natured person
senses.definition_en: A person who behaves fairly and accepts success, failure or jokes in a good-natured way.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim hoih mi; thutang kimawl mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Thutang tak a gamta a, gualzawhna, guallelhna ahih keileh kampauna lungdamai tak a sang mi ahi hi.

examples.english: He was a good sport about losing the game.
examples.zomi: Kimawhna a guallelh hangin lungsim hoih takin sang hi.

examples.english: Be a sport and help us clean up.
examples.zomi: Lungsim hoih in hong huh in, siansuahkhawm ni.

senses.usage_en: This use is informal. A good sport accepts difficulty, teasing or defeat without complaining.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna pen nisim pau ahi hi. A good sport in haksatna, kampauna ahih keileh guallelhna complaint neilo in sang hi.

senses.heading: Small mark
senses.definition_en: A small round mark that differs in colour or appearance from the surface around it.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kiim a kulep ahih keileh kilatdan tawh a kibanglo, a bial deuh ciamtehna neu ahi hi.

examples.english: There is a dark spot on the wall.
examples.zomi: Kulh tungah ciap vom khat om hi.

examples.english: The dog has white spots on its back.
examples.zomi: Ui nungah ciap ngo-te om hi.

senses.usage_en: Spot may describe a natural marking, stain, mark or small affected area.
senses.usage_zomi: Spot in pianpih lim, niinna, ciaptehna ahih keileh nawngkaihna mun neu kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Particular place
senses.definition_en: A particular place or position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih keileh dinmun ciangtak khat ahi hi.

examples.english: We found a quiet spot beside the lake.
examples.zomi: Dil geiah mun gamdai khat mu ung.

examples.english: This is the exact spot where the accident happened.
examples.zomi: Hih mun mah accident a pian mun ciangtak ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Spot is often less formal and more specific than place.
senses.usage_zomi: Spot pen place sangin nisim pau deuh leh mun ciangtakzaw kawk tam hi.

senses.heading: Position in a group or competition
senses.definition_en: A position, opportunity or available place in a group, programme or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, program ahih keileh kidemna khat sung a dinmun, hunhoih ahih keileh mun awng ahi hi.

examples.english: She earned a spot on the national team.
examples.zomi: Ama gam team sung kihelna dinmun ngah hi.

examples.english: Only ten spots are available in the course.
examples.zomi: Course ah kihelna mun sawm bek om hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, a spot is one of a limited number of available positions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah spot pen dinmun ciangtan a omte sung a mun khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Short item in a broadcast or advertisement
senses.definition_en: A short section of a television or radio programme, especially an advertisement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Television ahih keileh radio program khen tom, adiakin advertisement ahi hi.

examples.english: The company bought a thirty-second advertising spot.
examples.zomi: Company in second sawmthum advertisement hun lei hi.

examples.english: Her interview appeared in a short news spot.
examples.zomi: Ama interview pen news khen tom khat sungah kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: This media meaning is common in advertising and broadcasting.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih media khiatna pen advertisement leh broadcast nasep ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Open or arrange over a wider area
senses.definition_en: To open, extend or arrange something so that it covers a wider area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hon, zaangsak ahih keileh mun zaizaw a tuam dingin koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She spread a cloth over the table.
examples.zomi: Amahin sabuai tungah puan khat phah hi.

examples.english: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
examples.zomi: Vasa in a kha-te zaang in lengkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are also spread, not spreaded.
senses.usage_zomi: Spread a past tense leh past participle zong spread mah ahi a, spreaded hilo hi.

senses.heading: Move or reach a wider area or more people
senses.definition_en: To move, grow or become known over a wider area or among more people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamhuam zaizaw ahih keileh mi tampizaw kiangah pai, khang ahih keileh kithei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The fire spread quickly through the building.
examples.zomi: Meikuang innpi sungah manlang takin kizel hi.

examples.english: The news spread across the community.
examples.zomi: Thu pen khuamite lakah kizai hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, spread can be intransitive: The disease spread rapidly.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah spread pen intransitive ahi thei hi: The disease spread rapidly.

senses.heading: Cause information, disease or influence to reach others
senses.definition_en: To cause information, ideas, disease or influence to reach more people or places.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, ngaihsutna, natna ahih keileh nawngkaina mi leh mun tampizaw dong tungsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Social media can spread information quickly.
examples.zomi: Social media in thu manlang takin hawm thei hi.

examples.english: Wash your hands to avoid spreading infection.
examples.zomi: Natna lut na zaisaklohna dingin na khutte sil in.

senses.usage_en: When an object follows, spread means causing something to become more widely distributed.
senses.usage_zomi: Object in a zui ciangin spread in na khat a kizai semsem ding piangsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Put a soft substance over a surface
senses.definition_en: To put a thin layer of a soft substance over a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na a neem khat na phel tungah pan takin nuh ahih keileh zut cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Spread the butter evenly on the bread.
examples.zomi: Tanghou tungah butter a kikim in nuh in.

examples.english: She spread cream over the cake.
examples.zomi: Amahin cake tungah cream zut hi.

senses.usage_en: Use spread something on/over a surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Spread something on/over a surface ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Season after winter
senses.definition_en: The season between winter and summer, when the weather becomes warmer and plants begin to grow.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phalbi leh khuaphal kikal, khuahun lum semsem a, singkung leh singnote khang kipatna khuahun ahi hi.

examples.english: Flowers begin to grow in spring.
examples.zomi: Spring khuahun in pak-te khang kipan hi.

examples.english: We plan to travel next spring.
examples.zomi: Spring hong tung dingin khualzin dingin geel ung.

senses.usage_en: Season names normally begin with lowercase letters: spring, summer, autumn and winter.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuahun min-te laimal neu tawh kipan ngei hi: spring, summer, autumn leh winter.

senses.heading: Natural flow of water from the ground
senses.definition_en: A place where water flows naturally out of the ground.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei sung pan tui pianzia bang a hong luankhiatna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The village gets drinking water from a natural spring.
examples.zomi: Khuano in dawn ding tui pianpih tuibul pan ngah hi.

examples.english: Tourists visit the hot springs.
examples.zomi: Khualzin mite tuibul lum-te hawh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A spring is the source of naturally flowing groundwater.
senses.usage_zomi: Spring pen lei sung tui pianzia bang a hong luankhiatna bul ahi hi.

senses.heading: Coiled piece of metal
senses.definition_en: A curved or coiled piece of metal that returns to its original shape after being pressed or pulled.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sik a kawng kawng in kibawl a, net ahih keileh kaai khit zong a lim masa a ciahkik sik ahi hi.

examples.english: The spring inside the machine is broken.
examples.zomi: Khawl sung a spring sik sia hi.

examples.english: The mattress contains metal springs.
examples.zomi: Lupna sungah spring sik-te om hi.

senses.usage_en: This type of spring stores mechanical energy when it is pressed, stretched or twisted.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih spring nam in a kinet, kikaaiahih keileh kihei ciangin khawl tha khol hi.

senses.heading: Sudden jump or movement
senses.definition_en: A sudden jump or quick movement forward or upward.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thakhat a dawh ahih keileh mailam leh tunglam manlang tak a kikhihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The cat reached the table in one spring.
examples.zomi: Ngiau pen vei khat a dawhna tawh sabuai tungah tung hi.

examples.english: With a quick spring, the athlete cleared the bar.
examples.zomi: Manlang tak a dawhna tawh kimawlpa in sik kham kan hi.

senses.usage_en: This noun sense is less common than the related verb spring, meaning jump or move suddenly.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih noun khiatna pen thakhat dawh ahih keileh kikhih cihna verb spring sangin kizang tawmzaw hi.

senses.heading: Having four equal sides and four right angles
senses.definition_en: Having four straight sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees.
senses.explanation_zomi: A gei li a sau kikim leh degree 90 a kiu li a nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The room is almost square.
examples.zomi: Pindan pen square lim deuh hi.

examples.english: Cut the paper into four square pieces.
examples.zomi: Lai pen square phel li in tan in.

senses.usage_en: A square has four equal sides. A rectangle also has four right angles, but its sides do not all need to be equal.
senses.usage_zomi: Square in gei li a sau kikim nei hi. Rectangle zong kiu degree 90 li nei napi, a gei khempeuh a sau kikim kullo hi.

senses.heading: Expressing area measurement
senses.definition_en: Used with a unit of length to measure area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamhuam ahih keileh na phel zaidan tehna dingin sau tehna unit tawh kizang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The apartment measures eighty square metres.
examples.zomi: Apartment pen square metre sawmgiat zai hi.

examples.english: The park covers five square kilometres.
examples.zomi: Park in square kilometre nga huam hi.

senses.usage_en: A square metre measures area, while a metre measures length.
senses.usage_zomi: Square metre in area teh a, metre in sau teh hi.

senses.heading: Direct and honest
senses.definition_en: Direct, fair and honest in an agreement or relationship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kilepna ahih keileh kizopna ah direct, thutang leh thumaan cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat tawh thumaan in gamta

examples.english: The workers asked for a square deal.
examples.zomi: Nasem-te in kilepna thutang ngen uh hi.

examples.english: He promised to be square with his business partners.
examples.zomi: Amahin a business lawmpite tawh thumaan in gamta ding kamciam hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is informal and somewhat old-fashioned. Fair is more common in modern English.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen nisim pau leh lui deuh ahi hi. Tulai English ah fair kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Firm and unlikely to fall or move
senses.definition_en: Firmly fixed or balanced and unlikely to fall, move or change position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kip takin kikoih ahih keileh kikim a, puk, kikhih ahih keileh dinmun kikhel baihlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Make sure the ladder is stable before climbing it.
examples.zomi: Kailawn na kahma in a kip mahmah cih encik in.

examples.english: The table is not stable on the uneven floor.
examples.zomi: Innkuan phel kibanglo tungah sabuai kip lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Stable describes something firmly supported. It is the opposite of unstable.
senses.usage_zomi: Stable in na khat kip tak a kidom cihna gen hi. Tua pen unstable a kilehbulh ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not changing suddenly
senses.definition_en: Remaining at a similar level or condition without sudden or extreme change.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thakhat ahih keileh nasatak a kikhel lo in level ahih keileh dinmun kibang deuh a omlai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Prices remained stable throughout the year.
examples.zomi: Kum khat sung man-te kip in om hi.

examples.english: The patient’s condition is now stable.
examples.zomi: Cina dinmun tu in kip hi.

senses.usage_en: In medicine, a stable condition means it is not becoming significantly worse or better; it does not necessarily mean the person has recovered.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatui lamah dinmun stable cihpen nasatak in siazaw ahih keileh hoihzaw lo cihna ahi a, cina damsuk khin cihna a hih pah kullo hi.

senses.heading: Emotionally calm and dependable
senses.definition_en: Emotionally calm, sensible and unlikely to behave unpredictably.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim damai, ngaihsutna hoih a, ngaklohpi a gamta ngeilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Children need a safe and stable home.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te in inn bit leh kip kisam uh hi.

examples.english: She remained emotionally stable during the crisis.
examples.zomi: Haksatna hun in ama lungsim kip in om hi.

senses.usage_en: When describing mental or emotional health, use stable carefully and avoid treating it as a complete diagnosis.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungsim cidamna a gen ciangin stable pilvang takin zat ding a, natna khensatna bukim bangin zat loh ding ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A large building or open area with rows of seats around a field or track, used for sports and large events.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawhna lo ahih keileh taihna lampi a kiim ah tutna tual kizom a om, sports leh pawi lian bawlna innpi ahih keileh mun ahi hi.

examples.english: Thousands of fans filled the stadium.
examples.zomi: Fan tul tampi in stadium dim uh hi.

examples.english: The final match will be played at the national stadium.
examples.zomi: Tawpna kidemna pen gam stadium ah kimawl ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural may be stadiums or stadia. Stadiums is more common in everyday English.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural pen stadiums ahih keileh stadia ahi thei hi. Nisim English ah stadiums kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Employees of an organization
senses.definition_en: The people who work for an organization, business, school or institution.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, business, sang ahih keileh institution khat a ding a nasem mite ahi hi.

examples.english: The hospital employs more than two hundred staff.
examples.zomi: Hospital in nasem za nih val khawl hi.

examples.english: All staff must attend the training.
examples.zomi: Nasem khempeuh pilna ah kihel kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Staff is a collective noun. British English often uses a plural verb when emphasizing the workers individually; American English often uses a singular verb for the group. Use staff members when individual people must be counted clearly.
senses.usage_zomi: Staff pen collective noun ahi hi. British English ah nasem khatciat thupisak ciangin plural verb kizang thei a, American English ah pawl khat in a ngaihsut ciangin singular verb kizang tam hi. Mi khatciat kician tak a sim dingin staff members kizang in.

senses.heading: Long stick used for support or as a symbol
senses.definition_en: A long stick carried for support, authority or ceremonial purposes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidopna, thuneihna lim ahih keileh pawi zatna ding a kipaipih ciang sau ahi hi.

examples.english: The old man walked with a wooden staff.
examples.zomi: Upa pa sing ciang tawh pai hi.

examples.english: The leader carried a ceremonial staff.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in pawi zatna ciang tawi hi.

senses.usage_en: The approved Standard Zomi form for a rod or staff is ciang, never ciangh.
senses.usage_zomi: Rod ahih keileh staff a ding Standard Zomi kipsa pen ciang ahi a, ciangh hilo hi.

senses.heading: Raised area for performances
senses.definition_en: A raised area where performers, speakers or musicians appear before an audience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Actor, thugenpa ahih keileh music tumte mipawl ma a dingna mun sang ahi hi.

examples.english: The singer walked onto the stage.
examples.zomi: Lasa pen stage tungah kahto hi.

examples.english: The students performed a play on stage.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te stage tungah zatna khat bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: On stage means performing or appearing before an audience.
senses.usage_zomi: On stage cihpen mipawl ma ah performance bawl ahih keileh kilang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Point in a process or development
senses.definition_en: One part or period in a process, development or series of events.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sepzia, khantohna ahih keileh thu piang kizom sung a khen ahih keileh hun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The project is still at an early stage.
examples.zomi: Project pen kipatcil talsik ah omlai hi.

examples.english: Testing is the final stage of production.
examples.zomi: Sittelna pen van suahna tawpna talsik ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use at a stage or at this stage when referring to a point in a process.
senses.usage_zomi: Sepzia khat sung a talsik kawk dingin at a stage ahih keileh at this stage kizang hi.

senses.heading: Period in a person’s life
senses.definition_en: A particular period in a person’s life, growth or career.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nuntakna, khantohna ahih keileh profession sung a hun khen ciangtak khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Children need different support at each stage of development.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te in khantoh talsik ciat ah huhna tuamtuam kisam uh hi.

examples.english: At this stage of her career, she manages a large team.
examples.zomi: A profession hih talsik ah team lian khat uk hi.

senses.usage_en: A life stage is a period characterized by particular needs, experiences or development.
senses.usage_zomi: Nuntak hun khen khat in kisapna, phutkhak ahih keileh khantohna tuam nei hi.

senses.definition_en: One of a series of steps used for walking from one level of a building to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Innpi level khat pan a dang khat ah kah leh tuakna ding a kizang kailawn talsik khat ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: at the top of the stairs

examples.english: The child sat on the bottom stair.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen kailawn talsik nuai penah tu hi.

examples.english: She walked slowly up the stairs.
examples.zomi: Ama kailawn tungah neem takin kah hi.

senses.usage_en: One level is a stair or step. The complete set is usually called stairs or a staircase.
senses.usage_zomi: Talsik khat pen stair ahih keileh step kici hi. Talsik a buppi pen stairs ahih keileh staircase kici hi.

senses.heading: Postage stamp
senses.definition_en: A small piece of paper bought and attached to a letter or package to pay for delivery by mail.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mail stamp; lai sawl man ciaptehna
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai ahih keileh vanbawm mail tawh sawl man pia cih lak ding a kilei leh tua tung a kibehlap lai neu ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: put a stamp on a letter

examples.english: Put a stamp on the envelope before mailing it.
examples.zomi: Lai-ip na sawlma in stamp beh in.

examples.english: He collects old postage stamps.
examples.zomi: Ama mail stamp lui-te khawm hi.

senses.usage_en: The price of the stamp normally pays for postal delivery according to weight, size and destination.
senses.usage_zomi: Stamp man in a gikdan, a liandan leh a tungna mun bangin mail sawl man pia hi.

senses.heading: Mark made by pressing a tool onto a surface
senses.definition_en: A mark, design or official impression made by pressing an inked or shaped tool onto a surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ink a nei ahih keileh lim ciangtak a nei van tawh na phel tungah net in a kibawl ciaptehna, design ahih keileh official lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The document needs an official stamp.
examples.zomi: Laikhial in official stamp kisam hi.

examples.english: She pressed the rubber stamp onto the form.
examples.zomi: Amahin rubber stamp pen form tungah net hi.

senses.usage_en: A stamp can mean both the tool used to make the mark and the mark itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Stamp in ciaptehna bawlna van leh tua van tawh a kibawl ciaptehna a nihgel kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Particular character or quality
senses.definition_en: A clear sign of a particular person’s character, style or influence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat gamtatna, style ahih keileh nawngkaina a kician tak a lak lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The new director put her stamp on the organization.
examples.zomi: Director thak in pawl tungah a ukzia leh pianzia ciaptehna koih hi.

examples.english: The design bears the stamp of careful planning.
examples.zomi: Design in limtak a geelkholna lim nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use means that a person’s distinctive influence is clearly visible.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna in mi khat a nawngkaina tuam kician takin kilang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Be upright on the feet
senses.definition_en: To be upright on your feet rather than sitting or lying down.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu ahih keileh lumlo in khe tungah pumpi ding cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please stand behind the line.
examples.zomi: Line nungah ding in.

examples.english: Everyone stood when the judge entered.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa a lut ciangin mi khempeuh dingto uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are stood: She stood up; she has stood there before.
senses.usage_zomi: Stand a past tense leh past participle pen stood ahi hi: She stood up; she has stood there before.

senses.heading: Be located somewhere
senses.definition_en: To be in a particular place or position, especially for a building or tall object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih keileh dinmun ciangtak khat ah om, adiakin innpi ahih keileh van sang a gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: An old church stands at the centre of the town.
examples.zomi: Khua laizang ah pawlpi inn lui khat om hi.

examples.english: The factory has stood empty for years.
examples.zomi: Factory pen kum tampi sung awng in om hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, stand describes position and does not mean that the object has feet.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah stand in omna dinmun gen a, tua van in khe nei cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Tolerate something unpleasant
senses.definition_en: To accept or tolerate an unpleasant person, thing or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na ahih keileh dinmun nuamlo khat thuakzo ahih keileh sangthei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I cannot stand the smell of smoke.
examples.zomi: Meikhu nam thuakzo lo ing.

examples.english: She cannot stand being treated unfairly.
examples.zomi: Thutanglo a kibawlna sangtheilo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, cannot stand means strongly dislike or be unable to tolerate.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah cannot stand cihpen deihlo mahmah ahih keileh thuakzo lo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Remain unchanged or valid
senses.definition_en: To remain true, valid, accepted or unchanged.
senses.explanation_zomi: Maan, a kizangthei, kisangsa ahih keileh kikhello in omlai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The court ruled that the original decision would stand.
examples.zomi: Thuukna in khensatna masa kip in omlai ding ci hi.

examples.english: Her world record still stands.
examples.zomi: Ama leitung record kip in omlai hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense means that something remains in force or has not been replaced.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna in thu khat thahatna tawh kizanglai ahih keileh a dang tawh kikhel nailo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Be a candidate in an election
senses.definition_en: To compete as a candidate in an election.
senses.zomi_equivalents: candidate in ding; teelna ah kihel
senses.explanation_zomi: Teelna ah candidate in kihel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She plans to stand for election next year.
examples.zomi: Ama kum hong tung dingin teelna ah candidate in dingin geel hi.

examples.english: Three candidates are standing for mayor.
examples.zomi: Candidate thum mayor dinmun a ding teelna ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is common in British English. American English normally uses run for office.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna pen British English ah kizang tam hi. American English ah run for office kici tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Accepted level of quality
senses.definition_en: An accepted level of quality, achievement or performance used for judgment or comparison.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihdan, gualzawhna ahih keileh nasepna thukhen leh etkakna ding a kisang level ahi hi.

examples.english: The product meets international safety standards.
examples.zomi: Van in leitung bitna standard tangtung hi.

examples.english: The school is working to improve teaching standards.
examples.zomi: Sang in thuhilhna standard hoihsak dingin sem hi.

senses.usage_en: A standard provides a level against which quality or performance can be measured.
senses.usage_zomi: Standard in hoihdan ahih keileh nasepna tehkakna ding level khat pia hi.

senses.heading: Rule or model used for consistency
senses.definition_en: An agreed rule, method, measurement or model used to make things consistent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na-te kibang leh kituak a omna ding a kilemsa thukhun, sepzia, tehna ahih keileh model ahi hi.

examples.english: The new standard defines how the data should be stored.
examples.zomi: Standard thak in data bangci kikhol ding cih kipsak hi.

examples.english: All parts must follow the same technical standard.
examples.zomi: Khen khempeuh technology standard kibang zui kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Standards allow different organizations, products or systems to work consistently or together.
senses.usage_zomi: Standard-te in pawl, van ahih keileh system tuamtuam kibang leh nasemkhawm thei sak hi.

senses.heading: Principle of acceptable behaviour
senses.definition_en: A moral or personal principle used to judge behaviour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna thukhenna ding a kizang hoih-sia khenna ahih keileh mimal thukhun ahi hi.

examples.english: Public officials must follow high ethical standards.
examples.zomi: Kumpi nasem-te in ethical standard sang zui kul uh hi.

examples.english: She refuses to lower her professional standards.
examples.zomi: Ama a profession standard niamsak ding nial hi.

senses.usage_en: Personal standards guide what someone considers acceptable or unacceptable behaviour.
senses.usage_zomi: Mimal standard in mi khat in gamtatna bang sangthei leh sangtheilo cih makaih hi.

senses.heading: Bright object in the night sky
senses.definition_en: A very large ball of hot gas in space that produces light and heat and appears as a point of light in the night sky.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vantung gamla ah khuavak leh lumna a piangsak huih lum gol lian mahmah, zan vantung ah meivak neu bang a kilang ahi hi.

examples.english: Thousands of stars were visible in the clear sky.
examples.zomi: Vantung a ciang manin aksi tul tampi kilang hi.

examples.english: The sun is the nearest star to Earth.
examples.zomi: Ni pen Leitung nai a om aksi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The sun is a star, although in everyday speech the stars usually means the other stars visible at night.
senses.usage_zomi: Ni pen aksi khat ahi hi. Himahleh nisim pau ah the stars cihpen zan in a kilang aksi dangte kawk tam hi.

senses.heading: Famous performer or athlete
senses.definition_en: A famous and highly successful performer, entertainer or athlete.
senses.explanation_zomi: Performance, nopsakna ahih keileh sports ah minthang leh gualzo mahmah mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She became an international film star.
examples.zomi: Ama leitung film minthang khat suak hi.

examples.english: The young player is a rising sports star.
examples.zomi: Kimawlpa no pen sports ah minthangto hi.

senses.usage_en: Star can refer to a famous person or to the most important performer in a particular production.
senses.usage_zomi: Star in mi minthang ahih keileh performance khat sung a actor thupipen kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Star-shaped symbol
senses.definition_en: A symbol with several pointed parts extending from a centre, commonly with five points.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laizang pan mong zum pawlkhat a pawtkhia, a tamzaw in mong nga a nei aksi lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The flag contains a white star.
examples.zomi: Puanzam sungah aksi lim ngo khat om hi.

examples.english: The hotel received a five-star rating.
examples.zomi: Hotel in star nga tehna ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Stars are often used as symbols for quality, achievement, countries or groups.
senses.usage_zomi: Star lim-te hoihdan, gualzawhna, gam ahih keileh pawl aiawhna lim in kizang tam hi.

senses.definition_en: To look at someone or something for a long time with the eyes wide open, often because of surprise, interest or rudeness.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lamdanna, lunglutna ahih keileh zahtaklohna hangin mi ahih keileh na khat sawt takin mit pha tak a en cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The child stared at the strange animal.
examples.zomi: Naupang in ganhing lamdang pen etcip hi.

examples.english: It is rude to stare at people.
examples.zomi: Mite etcipna zahtaklohna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use stare at someone or something. Look at is neutral, while stare at suggests a long, fixed look.
senses.usage_zomi: Stare at someone or something ci in kizang hi. Look at pen ngeina etna ahi a, stare at pen sawt tak a etcipna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Begin doing something
senses.definition_en: To begin an action, activity or process.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, sepna ahih keileh sepzia khat kipan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting starts at nine.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna dak kua in kipan hi.

examples.english: She started learning English last year.
examples.zomi: Ama kum khit in English sin kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Start doing and start to do are usually both correct with little difference in meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Start doing leh start to do a nihgel maan a, a khiatna kilamdanna tawmno bek nei hi.

senses.heading: Cause something to operate
senses.definition_en: To cause a machine, engine or device to begin operating.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khawl, engine ahih keileh device khat na sem kipansak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He started the engine and drove away.
examples.zomi: Ama engine hon a, mawtaw hawl in paikhiat hi.

examples.english: Press this button to start the machine.
examples.zomi: Khawl na sem kipansak dingin hih button net in.

senses.usage_en: Here, start is transitive: a person causes the machine to begin operating.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah start transitive ahi a, mi khat in khawl nasep kipansak hi.

senses.heading: Establish a business or organization
senses.definition_en: To create and begin operating a business, organization or planned activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Business, pawl ahih keileh geelna gamtatna khat bawl leh na sem kipansak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They started a small business from home.
examples.zomi: Amaute inn pan business neu khat phut uh hi.

examples.english: The students started a recycling campaign.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in van zatkikna campaign khat kipan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, start means both creating something and beginning its activities.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah start in na khat bawl leh a nasep kipansakna a nihgel huam hi.

senses.heading: Move suddenly because of surprise
senses.definition_en: To make a sudden movement because something surprises or frightens you.
senses.zomi_equivalents: phawklohpi in kikhih; thakhat in liing
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat in hong lamdang ahih keileh lausak manin thakhat in kikhih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She started when the door suddenly opened.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak thakhat a kihon ciangin ama kikhih pah hi.

examples.english: The loud noise made everyone start.
examples.zomi: Aw ngaih in mi khempeuh thakhat in kikhihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is less common in everyday speech. Jump is often used informally instead.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen nisim pau ah kizang tawm a, a aiawh in jump kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Condition at a particular time
senses.definition_en: The condition that someone or something is in at a particular time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ciangtak khat ah mi ahih keileh na khat a omdan ahi hi.

examples.english: The building is in a poor state of repair.
examples.zomi: Innpi puahphatna dinmun hoihlo ah om hi.

examples.english: The news affected his emotional state.
examples.zomi: Thu in a lungsim dinmun nawngkai hi.

senses.usage_en: Use in a state of + noun to describe a condition: in a state of confusion.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun khat gen dingin in a state of + noun kizang hi: in a state of confusion.

senses.heading: Organized political country
senses.definition_en: A politically organized country with its own government, territory and laws.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ama kumpi, gamhuam leh dan a nei, politics tawh kizem gam ahi hi.

examples.english: The country became an independent state.
examples.zomi: Tua gam pen gam suahtak khat suak hi.

examples.english: The president is the head of state.
examples.zomi: President pen gam makaipa ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In international relations, a state is a political entity; a nation often emphasizes a people with shared identity or culture.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamkhat leh gamkhat kizopna ah state pen politics gam ukna ahi a, nation in hihna ahih keileh ngeina a neikhawm mite bulphuh tam hi.

senses.heading: Major political division within a country
senses.definition_en: A major political and administrative division within certain countries, such as the United States.
senses.explanation_zomi: United States bang gam pawlkhat sung a politics leh ukna gamkhen lian khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Ohio is a state in the United States.
examples.zomi: Ohio pen United States sung a state khat ahi hi.

examples.english: State laws differ across the country.
examples.zomi: Gam sung state tuamtuam ah state dan-te kibang lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize State when it forms part of an official proper name, but use lowercase in general references.
senses.usage_zomi: Official min sung a kihel ciangin State laimal lian tawh kipan a, a pum in a gen ciangin laimal neu kizang hi.

senses.heading: Government and public authority
senses.definition_en: The government and public institutions of a country considered as one authority.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam khat kumpi leh mipite ukna institution-te thuneihna khat in kingaihsut ahi hi.

examples.english: The railway is owned by the state.
examples.zomi: Meileng lampi pen kumpi neihsa ahi hi.

examples.english: The constitution limits the power of the state.
examples.zomi: Constitution in kumpi thuneihna ciangtan hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the state means government authority rather than a geographical region.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah the state in gamhuam kawklo a, kumpi thuneihna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Spoken or written declaration
senses.definition_en: Something that a person or organization says or writes formally or clearly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh pawl khat in formal ahih keileh kician takin a gen ahih keileh a gelh thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The company issued a statement about the accident.
examples.zomi: Company in accident thu thupulaakna khat suah hi.

examples.english: Her written statement was read in court.
examples.zomi: Ama thugelh pen thuukna ah kisim hi.

senses.usage_en: A statement may express facts, opinions, decisions or explanations.
senses.usage_zomi: Statement in thu maan, ngaihsutna, khensatna ahih keileh hilhcianhna gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Sentence that states information
senses.definition_en: A sentence that gives information or expresses an idea rather than asking a question or giving a command.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dotna ahih keileh thupiakna hilo in thu pia ahih keileh ngaihsutna gen thugen ahi hi.

examples.english: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
examples.zomi: Thugen ciat maan maw maanlo maw khensat in.

examples.english: The sentence is a statement, not a question.
examples.zomi: Tua sentence pen thugenna ahi a, dotna hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: In grammar, a statement normally has subject–verb word order and ends with a full stop.
senses.usage_zomi: Grammar ah statement pen subject–verb kizuihzia nei ngei a, full stop tawh tawp hi.

senses.heading: Record of financial activity
senses.definition_en: A document showing money paid into and taken out of an account during a period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun ciangtan khat sung account ah sum lut leh pawtkhia a lak laikhial ahi hi.

examples.english: The bank sends a monthly statement.
examples.zomi: Bank in kha sim account statement sawl hi.

examples.english: Check your statement for unfamiliar payments.
examples.zomi: Na statement sungah na theihloh sum piakna om leh omlo encik in.

senses.usage_en: A bank statement summarizes account transactions over a stated period.
senses.usage_zomi: Bank statement in hun ciangtan khat sung account sum lut leh pawt a tomlak in lak hi.

senses.heading: Place where public transport stops
senses.definition_en: A place where trains, buses or other public transport regularly stop for passengers.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meileng, bus ahih keileh mipite khualzinna van passenger-te a ding tawntung a tawlna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The train leaves the station at seven.
examples.zomi: Meileng pen giah pan dak sagih in paikhiat hi.

examples.english: We waited for her outside the bus station.
examples.zomi: Bus giah pualam ah ama ngak ung.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses train station. British English also commonly uses railway station.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah train station kici tam hi. British English ah railway station zong kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Broadcasting organization or facility
senses.definition_en: An organization or building that broadcasts radio or television programmes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Radio ahih keileh television program a hawm pawl ahih keileh inn ahi hi.

examples.english: She works at a local radio station.
examples.zomi: Ama khuahun sung radio station ah sem hi.

examples.english: The television station broadcast the debate live.
examples.zomi: Television station in nialna live in hawm hi.

senses.usage_en: The word may refer to the broadcasting organization, its channel or its physical workplace.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kammal in broadcast pawl, a channel ahih keileh a nasepna inn kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Official workplace for a service
senses.definition_en: A building or place used as the base for police, firefighters or another public service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Police, meithal pawl ahih keileh mipite a ding nasep pawl khat a nasepna bulpi inn ahih keileh mun ahi hi.

examples.english: She reported the theft at the police station.
examples.zomi: Amahin gukna thu police station ah va pulak hi.

examples.english: The fire station is near the hospital.
examples.zomi: Meithal station pen hospital geiah om hi.

senses.usage_en: In compounds, the first word identifies the public service based at the station.
senses.usage_zomi: Compound sungah kammal masa in station ah a nasep pawl min lak hi.

senses.heading: Assigned position or place
senses.definition_en: A place where a person is assigned to work or remain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nasem ahih keileh om ding a kiguan mun ahi hi.

examples.english: Each worker returned to their station.
examples.zomi: Nasem ciat a nasepna mun uh ah ciah uh hi.

examples.english: The guard remained at his station.
examples.zomi: Kemmi pen a dinmun ah omlai hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense emphasizes an assigned position or duty location.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih formal khiatna in kiguan dinmun ahih keileh mawpuakna mun bulphuh hi.

senses.definition_en: A numerical fact or measurement collected and used to describe or analyze a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat gen ahih keileh sitna ding a kikhol leh kizang nambat thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The report includes a statistic on unemployment.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna sungah nasep neilo mite nambat thu khat om hi.

examples.english: One statistic alone cannot explain the whole situation.
examples.zomi: Nambat thu khat bek in dinmun pumpi hilhcian theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: A single numerical fact is a statistic. The plural statistics can mean multiple figures or the academic field of collecting and analyzing data.
senses.usage_zomi: Nambat thu khat pen a statistic ahi hi. Plural statistics in nambat thu tampi ahih keileh data khop leh sitna pilna kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A three-dimensional representation of a person, animal or imaginary figure, usually made from stone, metal or another hard material.
senses.zomi_equivalents: limdawn; suang ahih keileh sik lim
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing ahih keileh ngaihsutna sung lim khat a lianbang in suang, sik ahih keileh van khauh dang tawh kibawl limdawn ahi hi.

examples.english: A statue of the leader stands in the square.
examples.zomi: Khuapi tual ah makaipa limdawn khat om hi.

examples.english: The museum contains several ancient statues.
examples.zomi: Museum sungah tanglai limdawn pawlkhat om hi.

senses.usage_en: A statue is normally a complete or nearly complete three-dimensional figure. A sculpture is a broader category of three-dimensional art.
senses.usage_zomi: Statue pen mi ahih keileh ganhing lim kicing ahih keileh a kicing deuh ahi ngei hi. Sculpture in limdawn art nam zaizaw huam hi.

senses.heading: Social or professional position
senses.definition_en: A person’s social, professional or legal position in relation to others.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat khuahun, profession ahih keileh dan lamah midang-te tawh a kizopna dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: Education can influence a person’s social status.
examples.zomi: Pilna in mi khat khuahun dinmun nawngkai thei hi.

examples.english: The applicant’s legal status must be verified.
examples.zomi: Lai ngenpa dan dinmun encik kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Status describes a recognized position or classification, not necessarily personal worth.
senses.usage_zomi: Status in kisang dinmun ahih keileh khen khat kawk a, mi khat manphatna taktak kawk pahlo hi.

senses.heading: Current condition or progress
senses.definition_en: The current condition, position or progress of an activity, request or system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, lai ngenna ahih keileh system khat a tuhun dinmun leh khantohna ahi hi.

examples.english: You can check your application status online.
examples.zomi: Na lai ngenna dinmun online ah encik thei ding hi.

examples.english: The manager asked for a status report.
examples.zomi: Manager in tuhun nasep dinmun lipkhapna ngen hi.

senses.usage_en: In administrative and technical contexts, status tells whether something is pending, active, completed or unsuccessful.
senses.usage_zomi: Ukna leh technology thu ah status in na khat ngahlai, na semlai, zo khin ahih keileh guallel cih lak hi.

senses.heading: Short social-media update
senses.definition_en: A short message, image or update posted on a social-media account.
senses.explanation_zomi: Social media account tungah kisuah thu tom, lim ahih keileh kithaksakna ahi hi.

examples.english: She posted a new status this morning.
examples.zomi: Ama tuni zing in status thak khat suah hi.

examples.english: His status said that he was travelling.
examples.zomi: A status in khualzin hi ci in gen hi.

senses.usage_en: This digital sense is informal and depends on the terminology used by each platform.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih digital khiatna pen nisim pau ahi a, platform ciat kammal zatdan bangin kilamdang thei hi.

senses.heading: Remain in a place
senses.definition_en: To remain in a place instead of leaving it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat pan paikhiatlo in omlai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She stayed at home because she was ill.
examples.zomi: Ama a cina manin innah om hi.

examples.english: Please stay here until I return.
examples.zomi: Ka ciahkik dong hiah om in.

senses.usage_en: Use stay at before a particular place or address and stay in before a city, country or room.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun ahih keileh address ciangtak ma ah stay at kizang a, khuapi, gam ahih keileh pindan ma ah stay in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Live somewhere temporarily
senses.definition_en: To live or sleep somewhere for a limited period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah hun ciangtan bek teng ahih keileh ih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We stayed at a hotel near the airport.
examples.zomi: Vanlenggiah gei hotel khat ah om ung.

examples.english: She is staying with relatives this week.
examples.zomi: Hih kaal in a tanaute innah om hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, stay suggests temporary accommodation rather than a permanent home.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah stay in tawntung teenna hilo in tawlkhat omna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Continue in a condition
senses.definition_en: To continue to be in the same condition or state.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun ahih keileh omdan kibang ah om paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Stay calm and follow the instructions.
examples.zomi: Lungdamai in om a, thuhilhna-te zui in.

examples.english: Regular exercise helps you stay healthy.
examples.zomi: Tawntung exercise bawlna in cidam a omna hong huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use stay + adjective to describe continuing in a condition: stay quiet, stay awake.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun khat ah om paisuakna gen dingin stay + adjective kizang hi: stay quiet, stay awake.

senses.heading: Delay or prevent an action legally
senses.definition_en: To officially delay or temporarily stop a legal decision or action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dan tawh khensatna ahih keileh gamtatna khat official takin khalsak ahih keileh tawlkhat khawlsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The court stayed the order until the appeal was heard.
examples.zomi: Appeal thu kizak dong thuukna in thupiakna khalsak hi.

examples.english: The judge refused to stay the decision.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa in khensatna khalsak ding nial hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a formal legal meaning and is uncommon in everyday conversation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen formal dan kammal ahi a, nisim kihoupihna ah kizang tam lo hi.

senses.heading: Firm and not shaking
senses.definition_en: Firm, controlled and not shaking or moving unexpectedly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kip, ki-ukthei a, liing ahih keileh ngaklohpi a kikhihlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Keep the camera steady while taking the picture.
examples.zomi: Lim na lak laitak in camera kikhihlo in len in.

examples.english: The surgeon needs a steady hand.
examples.zomi: Operation siavuan in khut kip kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Steady describes controlled stability, especially during movement or physical work.
senses.usage_zomi: Steady in adiakin kikhihna ahih keileh pumpi nasep laitak a kip leh ki-uktheihna gen hi.

senses.heading: Regular and continuous
senses.definition_en: Continuing at a regular rate without sudden changes or interruptions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thakhat kikhelna ahih keileh khawlna omlo in rate kibang deuh tawh kizom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company has shown steady growth.
examples.zomi: Company in khantohna kizom lak hi.

examples.english: She earns a steady income from her job.
examples.zomi: Ama a nasep pan sumlutna kip ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Steady emphasizes consistency rather than high speed or rapid growth.
senses.usage_zomi: Steady in manlangna ahih keileh khantohna lian sangin tawntung leh kibang deuh a omna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Calm and dependable
senses.definition_en: Calm, sensible and dependable in behaviour or emotion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna leh lungsim ah damai, ngaihsutna hoih leh muanhuai cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: kisukna nuai ah lungsim kip in om

examples.english: Her voice remained steady during the interview.
examples.zomi: Interview laitak in a aw kip in omlai hi.

examples.english: The team needs a steady and dependable leader.
examples.zomi: Team in makaipa lungsim kip leh muanhuai khat kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: When used about a person, steady suggests emotional control and reliability.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat a gen ciangin steady in lungsim ki-uktheihna leh muanhuaina lak hi.

senses.heading: Take something dishonestly
senses.definition_en: To take something that belongs to another person without permission and with no intention of returning it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang neihsa phalna lo in lak a, ciahkik ding ngimna neilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Someone stole her phone on the bus.
examples.zomi: Bus tungah mi khat in a phone gu hi.

examples.english: He was arrested for stealing money.
examples.zomi: Sum a guk manin kiman hi.

senses.usage_en: Use steal something from someone. Use rob someone or a place: steal money from a bank, but rob a bank.
senses.usage_zomi: Steal something from someone ci in kizang hi. Rob someone or a place ci in kizang hi: steal money from a bank, ahih hangin rob a bank kici hi.

senses.heading: Move quietly or secretly
senses.definition_en: To move somewhere quietly and secretly so that others do not notice.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kiseel in pai; aw neilo in pai
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang-te in a phawklohna dingin aw neilo leh kiseel in pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She stole quietly out of the room.
examples.zomi: Ama pindan sungpan aw neilo in pawtkhia hi.

examples.english: He stole a glance at the document.
examples.zomi: Amahin laikhial pen mi phawklo in enpak hi.

senses.usage_en: This literary or figurative sense does not necessarily involve theft.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih literature ahih keileh tehpihna khiatna in van gukna huam pahlo hi.

senses.heading: Gain something unexpectedly or cheaply
senses.definition_en: To gain an advantage, victory or valuable item unexpectedly or at a very low cost.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ngaklohpi in ngah; man tawm takin ngah
senses.explanation_zomi: Hamphatna, gualzawhna ahih keileh van manpha ngaklohpi ahih keileh man tawm takin ngah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The team stole a victory in the final minute.
examples.zomi: Team in minute nunung ah ngaklohpi in gualzo hi.

examples.english: At twenty dollars, this coat is a steal.
examples.zomi: Dollar sawmnih tawh hih puantung pen manpha mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal figurative use emphasizes an unexpectedly good result or bargain.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim tehpihna zatna in ngaklohpi a ngahna hoih ahih keileh man tawm tak a leina phattuamna bulphuh hi.

senses.definition_en: A strong metal made mainly from iron and carbon, widely used in buildings, machines and tools.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in sik leh carbon tawh kibawl, innpi, khawl leh vanzat-te a ding kizang sik khauh ahi hi.

examples.english: The bridge is supported by steel beams.
examples.zomi: Lei kaam pen steel kuam-te in dom hi.

examples.english: This knife is made of stainless steel.
examples.zomi: Hih tem pen tui-eh neilo steel tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Steel is normally uncountable when referring to the material. Do not confuse it with steal, meaning take dishonestly.
senses.usage_zomi: Material a kawk ciangin steel pen uncountable noun ahi hi. Thutanglo a la cihna steal tawh helkhawm kei in.

senses.heading: Rising or falling sharply
senses.definition_en: Having a sharp slope and rising or falling quickly over a short horizontal distance.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pang khauh; sang leh niam manlang
senses.explanation_zomi: Khonglam gamla tom sungah tung leh nuai kilamdanna lian, a pang khauh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The road climbs a steep hill.
examples.zomi: Lampi pen mual pang khauh tungah kahto hi.

examples.english: Be careful on the steep stairs.
examples.zomi: Kailawn pang khauh tungah pilvang in.

senses.usage_en: Steep is the opposite of gentle when describing a slope.
senses.usage_zomi: Lei pang a gen ciangin steep pen gentle a kilehbulh ahi hi.

senses.heading: Very high or excessive
senses.definition_en: Very high, especially in price, cost, demand or increase.
senses.explanation_zomi: Adiakin man, sum senna, ngiatna ahih keileh khanna ah sang ahih keileh tam lua cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel charges a steep price during the holiday season.
examples.zomi: Pawi hun in hotel man sang mahmah hi.

examples.english: Families faced a steep increase in housing costs.
examples.zomi: Innkuan-te in inn tawh kisai man khanna lian mahmah tuak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense usually expresses criticism that an amount is unusually high.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in zat khat ngeina sangin a sang lua cih mawhsakna lak tam hi.

senses.heading: Difficult and demanding
senses.definition_en: Difficult and requiring a great deal of effort, learning or adjustment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksa a, hanciamna, sinna ahih keileh kituaksakna tampi kisam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The new job has a steep learning curve.
examples.zomi: Nasep thak sinna pen manlang leh haksa hi.

examples.english: Meeting the deadline will be a steep challenge.
examples.zomi: Hun ciangtan tangtunna pen tona haksa ahi ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The phrase a steep learning curve commonly means that much must be learned in a short time.
senses.usage_zomi: A steep learning curve cihpen hun tom sungah thu tampi sin kul cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: Movement made by lifting and placing a foot
senses.definition_en: One movement made by lifting one foot and putting it down in another position while walking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pai laitak in khe khat lamto a, mun dang khat ah koihna gamtatna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She took one step backward.
examples.zomi: Ama nunglam ah khe khat pai hi.

examples.english: The shop is only a few steps away.
examples.zomi: Dawr pen khe talsik tawmno gamla bek hi.

senses.usage_en: A few steps away means very near, not necessarily an exact measured distance.
senses.usage_zomi: A few steps away cihpen nai mahmah cihna ahi a, gamla ciangtak a kiteh cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Flat surface in a staircase
senses.definition_en: One of the flat surfaces on which you place your feet when going up or down stairs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kailawn kah leh tuak ciang a khe kikoihna phel khat ahi hi.

examples.english: He sat on the front step.
examples.zomi: Ama inn mai kailawn talsik tungah tu hi.

examples.english: Be careful on the wet steps.
examples.zomi: Kailawn talsik a khu-te tungah pilvang in.

senses.usage_en: Step can mean one stair, while steps can mean a short staircase, especially outside a building.
senses.usage_zomi: Step in kailawn talsik khat kawk thei a, steps in adiakin inn pualam a kailawn tom khat kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Action in a process
senses.definition_en: One action or stage in a process for achieving something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tangtunna sepzia sung a gamtatna ahih keileh talsik khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The first step is to collect accurate information.
examples.zomi: Talsik masa pen thu maan khopna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company took steps to improve safety.
examples.zomi: Company in bitna hoihsak ding talsik-te la hi.

senses.usage_en: Take steps to do something means begin practical actions to achieve it.
senses.usage_zomi: Take steps to do something cihpen tua na tangtunna ding gamtatna taktak kipan cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Change or progress by one level
senses.definition_en: One level of change, progress, rank or measurement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhelna, khantohna, dinmun ahih keileh tehna a level khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The agreement is an important step toward peace.
examples.zomi: Kilepna pen lungnopna zuan talsik thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Completing the course brought her one step closer to her goal.
examples.zomi: Course a zohna in a ngimna talsik khat naizaw sak hi.

senses.usage_en: A step forward describes progress, while a step backward describes loss of progress.
senses.usage_zomi: A step forward in ma khantohna gen a, a step backward in khantohna a nungtolhna gen hi.

senses.heading: Thin piece of wood
senses.definition_en: A thin piece of wood that has fallen or been cut from a tree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung pan a kia ahih keileh kitan singtang ginal khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The child drew a line in the sand with a stick.
examples.zomi: Naupang in singtang khat tawh vung tungah line khat gelh hi.

examples.english: We collected dry sticks for the fire.
examples.zomi: Meihalna ding singtang keu-te khawm ung.

senses.usage_en: A stick is normally thinner and smaller than a branch. The approved Standard Zomi form for a rod or staff is ciang, never ciangh.
senses.usage_zomi: Stick pen singhi sangin a ginalzaw leh a neuzaw ngei hi. Rod ahih keileh staff a ding Standard Zomi kipsa pen ciang ahi a, ciangh hilo hi.

senses.heading: Long narrow object
senses.definition_en: A long, narrow object used for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna ciangtak khat a ding a kizang van sau leh ginal ahi hi.

examples.english: He uses a walking stick for support.
examples.zomi: Ama kidopna ding paina ciang zang hi.

examples.english: The player lifted his hockey stick.
examples.zomi: Kimawlpa in a hockey ciang lamto hi.

senses.usage_en: The word before stick normally identifies its purpose: walking stick, hockey stick, drumstick.
senses.usage_zomi: Stick ma a kammal in a zatna ngimna lak hi: walking stick, hockey stick, drumstick.

senses.heading: Push something pointed into something
senses.definition_en: To push a pointed object into or through something.
senses.explanation_zomi: A zum van khat na dang sungah ahih keileh a kantan in sun cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: stick a pin in the board

examples.english: She stuck the needle into the cloth.
examples.zomi: Amahin phiu pen puan sungah sun hi.

examples.english: Stick the sign firmly into the ground.
examples.zomi: Ciaptehna pen lei sungah kip takin sun in.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are stuck: She stuck the pin in; it has stuck there.
senses.usage_zomi: Stick a past tense leh past participle pen stuck ahi hi: She stuck the pin in; it has stuck there.

senses.heading: Attach using a sticky substance
senses.definition_en: To attach something to a surface by using glue, tape or another sticky substance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Glue, tape ahih keileh na belthei dang khat tawh na khat na phel tungah beh cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: stick a notice on the wall

examples.english: Stick the label onto the box.
examples.zomi: Label pen bawm tungah beh in.

examples.english: She stuck the photograph to the card.
examples.zomi: Amahin lim pen card tungah beh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use stick something on/to something when attaching one object to another.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat na dang tungah a behna gen dingin stick something on/to something kizang hi.

senses.heading: Become attached or unable to move
senses.definition_en: To become firmly attached, caught or unable to move freely.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kip takin bel, kiman ahih keileh suahtak tak a kikhih theilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The rice stuck to the bottom of the pot.
examples.zomi: Buh pen beel taw ah bel hi.

examples.english: The door sticks in wet weather.
examples.zomi: Khuahun a khu ciangin kongkhak kihong haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: Stick describes the condition; get stuck emphasizes becoming trapped or unable to move.
senses.usage_zomi: Stick in bel ahih keileh kiman dinmun gen a, get stuck in tua dinmun sungah a lutna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Continue to follow or remain with something
senses.definition_en: To continue following a plan, rule, decision or activity without changing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna, thukhun, khensatna ahih keileh gamtatna khat kikhello in zui paisuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We should stick to the original plan.
examples.zomi: Geelna masa zui paisuak ding i hoih hi.

examples.english: She stuck with the course despite the difficulty.
examples.zomi: Haksatna om napi course lenkip hi.

senses.usage_en: Stick to means continue following something; stick with often means continue supporting or doing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Stick to in na khat zui paisuak cihna a, stick with in thapia ahih keileh bawl paisuak cihna nei tam hi.

senses.heading: Able to stick to surfaces
senses.definition_en: Able to attach to surfaces or covered with a substance that does so.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na phel tungah belthei ahih keileh na belthei tawh kizeu cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The table is sticky from the spilled drink.
examples.zomi: Dawn ding a kibua hangin sabuai tung bel hi.

examples.english: Use sticky tape to attach the paper.
examples.zomi: Lai behna ding tape belthei zang in.

senses.usage_en: Sticky may describe glue-like material or a surface covered by sugar, food or another substance.
senses.usage_zomi: Sticky in glue bang a belthei van ahih keileh ci, an leh van dang tawh a kizeu na phel gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Hot and uncomfortably humid
senses.definition_en: Uncomfortably hot and humid, making the skin feel damp.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuahot leh huih sung tuihu tampi manin vun a khu leh omnuamlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: It was a hot, sticky afternoon.
examples.zomi: Tua nitaklam khuahot leh khu hi.

examples.english: The room felt sticky without air conditioning.
examples.zomi: Air conditioning omlo in pindan sung hot leh khu hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal weather sense is common when high humidity makes the body feel sweaty.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim khuahun khiatna pen huih sung tuihu tampi hangin pumpi khua a om ciangin kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Difficult or sensitive
senses.definition_en: Difficult to deal with because it involves disagreement, risk or sensitive issues.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikalhna, lauhuaina ahih keileh pilvang kul thu a huam manin bawl haksa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The manager faced a sticky situation between two workers.
examples.zomi: Manager in nasem nih kikal a dinmun bawl haksa tuak hi.

examples.english: Privacy is a sticky issue for the company.
examples.zomi: Mimal thu kepna pen company a ding thu buai haksa ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense is informal and describes a problem that is awkward or difficult to resolve.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim tehpihna zatna in zumhuai ahih keileh dawnkhia haksa haksatna gen hi.

senses.heading: Hard to bend or move
senses.definition_en: Firm and difficult to bend, fold or move.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khauh a, kawng, fold ahih keileh kikhih haksa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The new shoes are still stiff.
examples.zomi: Khembel thak-te khauh lai hi.

examples.english: Use a stiff brush to clean the floor.
examples.zomi: Innkuan siansuah dingin brush mul khauh zang in.

senses.usage_en: Stiff describes material that resists bending but is not necessarily solid or unbreakable.
senses.usage_zomi: Stiff in kawng ding a nial van gen a, van khauh sitset ahih keileh kheektheihloh cihna a hih kullo hi.

senses.heading: Painful and difficult to move
senses.definition_en: Painful or uncomfortable to move, especially after exercise, injury or remaining still.
senses.explanation_zomi: Exercise, liamna ahih keileh sawt tak a omkhawl khit ciangin pumpi khen khat na leh kikhih haksa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I woke up with a stiff neck.
examples.zomi: Ngawng tang tawh khang ing.

examples.english: Her legs felt stiff after the long journey.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna sau khit ciangin a khete tang hi.

senses.usage_en: A stiff joint or muscle may be difficult to move even without severe pain.
senses.usage_zomi: Tang a kizopna ahih keileh pumpi sa pen nasia takin na lo zong kikhih haksa thei hi.

senses.heading: Formal and unfriendly
senses.definition_en: Very formal, controlled and not relaxed or friendly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Formal lua, ki-uklua a, omnuam leh lawmtaklo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting began in a stiff atmosphere.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna pen khuahun formal leh omnuamlo tawh kipan hi.

examples.english: He gave us a stiff, formal welcome.
examples.zomi: Amahin formal lua leh lawmtaklo in hong nawk hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense suggests tension, lack of warmth or excessive formality.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in lungkhamna, lawmtaklohna ahih keileh formal lua cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: Severe or difficult
senses.definition_en: Strong, severe or difficult to meet, especially a challenge, penalty or competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khauh, nasia ahih keileh tangtung haksa, adiakin tona, thuaksiatna leh kidemna a gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company faces stiff competition.
examples.zomi: Company in kidemna khauh tuak hi.

examples.english: The law carries a stiff penalty.
examples.zomi: Dan in thuaksiatna khauh nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes intensity or difficulty rather than physical firmness.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in pumpi khauhna genlo a, tona ahih keileh thuaksiatna khauhdan bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Continuing until now or then
senses.definition_en: Continuing to happen or remain true at the present time or at the time mentioned.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun dong ahih keileh hun kigen dong piang paisuak ahih keileh maanlai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is still waiting for a reply.
examples.zomi: Ama dawnkikna ngaklai hi.

examples.english: The old bridge is still in use.
examples.zomi: Lei kaam lui kizanglai hi.

senses.usage_en: Still usually comes before the main verb but after the verb be: still works, is still open.
