senses.usage_zomi: Still pen main verb ma ah om ngei a, verb be khit ah om hi: still works, is still open.

senses.heading: Despite that
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce a fact that contrasts with or does not change what was just stated.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuma a kigen thu tawh kilamdang ahih keileh tua thu in kikhelsaklo thu khat pulakna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: The journey was difficult; still, we completed it.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna haksa hi; himahleh, zocip ung.

examples.english: He apologized, but I was still upset.
examples.zomi: Ama mawh ngen napi, kei lungkimlo lai ing.

senses.usage_en: At the beginning of a clause, still can mean “nevertheless.”
senses.usage_zomi: Clause kipatna ah still in “tua bang napi zong” cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Even more
senses.definition_en: Used with a comparative to emphasize an additional increase or difference.
senses.explanation_zomi: Comparative tawh kizangin khanna ahih keileh kilamdanna behlap thahatsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The second version is still better.
examples.zomi: Version a nihna pen hoihzaw sem hi.

examples.english: Safety is still more important than speed.
examples.zomi: Bitna pen manlangna sangin thupizaw sem hi.

senses.usage_en: This use appears before comparative forms such as better, larger and more important.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih still zatna pen better, larger leh more important bang comparative form-te ma ah om hi.

senses.heading: Supply of goods
senses.definition_en: A supply of goods or materials kept by a business or organization for use or sale.
senses.explanation_zomi: Business ahih keileh pawl khat in zat ahih keileh zuak ding a khol van leh material-te ahi hi.

examples.english: The store has the shoes in stock.
examples.zomi: Dawr ah tua khembel van om hi.

examples.english: This product is currently out of stock.
examples.zomi: Hih van tuhun in bei hi.

senses.usage_en: In stock means available for sale; out of stock means temporarily unavailable.
senses.usage_zomi: In stock cihpen zuak ding a om cihna a, out of stock cihpen tuhun in a omlona ahi hi.

senses.heading: Ownership share in a company
senses.definition_en: A unit or collection of ownership shares in a company.
senses.explanation_zomi: Company khat neihna sung a khen ahih keileh neihsa share-te ahi hi.

examples.english: She bought stock in the company.
examples.zomi: Amahin company share lei hi.

examples.english: The stock price fell after the report.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna khit ciangin stock man kia hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, stock commonly refers to company ownership generally, while a share means one unit. British English often uses shares.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah stock in company neihna a pum in kawk tam a, a share in unit khat kawk hi. British English ah shares kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Basic liquid used in cooking
senses.definition_en: A liquid made by cooking meat, bones or vegetables in water and used as a base for soups and sauces.
senses.zomi_equivalents: an tui bul; sa ahih keileh anlak huan tui
senses.explanation_zomi: Sa, guh ahih keileh anlak tui sungah huan in an tui leh sauce bul a ding kizang tui ahi hi.

examples.english: Add two cups of chicken stock.
examples.zomi: Aa sa an tui bul hai nih behlap in.

examples.english: She made vegetable stock for the soup.
examples.zomi: Amahin an tui a ding anlak huan tui bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Stock is usually uncountable in cooking. It is often less seasoned than finished soup.
senses.usage_zomi: An huan thu ah stock pen uncountable noun ahi hi. Soup kicing sangin a lim behlapna tawmzaw ahi ngei hi.

senses.heading: Family line or origin
senses.definition_en: A family line, ancestry or group from which people, animals or plants come.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing ahih keileh singkung a hong pianna innkuan suan, bul ahih keileh pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The horses come from strong breeding stock.
examples.zomi: Sakol-te suanlehkhakna ganhing thahat pan hong pai uh hi.

examples.english: The plant was developed from local stock.
examples.zomi: Singkung pen khuahun sung singkung bul pan khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: When used about human ancestry, this sense can sound old-fashioned and should be used carefully.
senses.usage_zomi: Mihing suan tawh kisai a zat ciangin hih khiatna pen kammal lui deuh bangin za thei ahih manin pilvang takin zat ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Organ that digests food
senses.definition_en: The organ inside the body where food begins to be digested after it is swallowed.
senses.explanation_zomi: An valh khit ciangin a kisia leh pumpi in zat theih ding a kibawl kipatna pumpi sung organ ahi hi.

examples.english: The medicine should be taken on an empty stomach.
examples.zomi: Zatui pen gil awng in nek ding ahi hi.

examples.english: The stomach helps digest food.
examples.zomi: Gil in an siahsakna huh hi.

senses.usage_en: The stomach is an internal organ. In everyday speech, stomach may also refer generally to the front of the abdomen.
senses.usage_zomi: Stomach pen pumpi sung organ ahi hi. Nisim pau ah gil mai pumpi khen a pum in zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Front part of the body below the chest
senses.definition_en: The front part of the body between the chest and hips.
senses.explanation_zomi: Awmluang leh kawng kikal a pumpi maitang khen ahi hi.

examples.english: He lay on his stomach to look under the bed.
examples.zomi: Lupna nuai en dingin gil pe in lum hi.

examples.english: She held her stomach because it hurt.
examples.zomi: A gil a nat manin a gil len hi.

senses.usage_en: In anatomical writing, abdomen is more precise for this body region.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi pilna laigelh ah hih pumpi khen a ding abdomen cih kammal kicianzaw hi.

senses.heading: Desire or ability to tolerate something unpleasant
senses.definition_en: The courage, desire or ability to accept something unpleasant, violent or disgusting.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu nuamlo, thagum thu ahih keileh kihhuai na khat en, sang ahih keileh thuaktheihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has no stomach for violent films.
examples.zomi: Ama thagum film-te en ngamlo hi.

examples.english: I cannot stomach such dishonesty.
examples.zomi: Tua bang thutanglohna sangtheilo ing.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use is informal and usually appears in negative expressions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna zatna pen nisim pau ahi a, a tamzaw in negative thugenna ah om hi.

senses.heading: Hard natural material
senses.definition_en: Hard natural mineral material found in the ground and used for building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei sungah a om pianpih mineral khauh, inn leh van dang bawlna ding a kizang ahi hi.

examples.english: The old bridge is made of stone.
examples.zomi: Lei kaam lui pen suang tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Workers built a stone wall around the garden.
examples.zomi: Nasem-te in huan kiimah suang kulh lam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Stone is uncountable when referring generally to building material.
senses.usage_zomi: Inn lamna material a pum in kawk ciangin stone pen uncountable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Small piece of rock
senses.definition_en: A small individual piece of rock.
senses.explanation_zomi: Suangpi pan a kitan ahih keileh pianpih in a om suang neu khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The child threw a stone into the river.
examples.zomi: Naupang in gun sungah suang khat lawn hi.

examples.english: We found smooth stones on the beach.
examples.zomi: Tuipi geiah suang neem-te mu ung.

senses.usage_en: This sense is countable: a stone, several stones.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna countable ahi hi: a stone, several stones.

senses.heading: Hard mass formed in the body
senses.definition_en: A hard mass that forms abnormally inside a body organ.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi sung organ khat sungah ngeina hilo in a hong piang a khauh bu ahi hi.

examples.english: The scan showed a kidney stone.
examples.zomi: Scan in kal sung suang khat lak hi.

examples.english: Small stones may pass without surgery.
examples.zomi: Suang neu-te operation lo in pawtkhia thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Medical compounds such as kidney stone identify the organ in which the hard mass forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Kidney stone bang zatui compound-te in suang a pian organ min lak hi.

senses.heading: Seed inside certain fruits
senses.definition_en: The large, hard seed inside fruits such as peaches, plums and cherries.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gah ci khauh; gah sung suang
senses.explanation_zomi: Peach, plum leh cherry bang gah sung a om ci lian leh khauh ahi hi.

examples.english: Remove the stone before cutting the peach.
examples.zomi: Peach na tanma in a ci khauh lakhia in.

examples.english: Be careful not to bite the cherry stone.
examples.zomi: Cherry ci khauh na seplohna ding pilvang in.

senses.usage_en: American English often uses pit instead of stone for a fruit’s hard seed.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah gah ci khauh a ding stone sangin pit kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: End an activity or action
senses.definition_en: To end an activity or no longer continue doing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna khat tawpsak ahih keileh bawl paisuak nawnlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The machine stopped working suddenly.
examples.zomi: Khawl thakhat in nasep khawl hi.

examples.english: Please stop making that noise.
examples.zomi: Tua aw bawlna khawl in.

senses.usage_en: Use stop doing to end an activity: stop smoking. Stop to do means pause another activity in order to do something: stop to rest.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna khat tawpsak dingin stop doing kizang hi: stop smoking. Stop to do cihpen gamtatna dang khawl in na khat bawl cihna ahi hi: stop to rest.

senses.heading: Cause someone or something not to continue
senses.definition_en: To cause a person, object, action or process to no longer move or continue.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, gamtatna ahih keileh sepzia khat kikhih ahih keileh kizom nawnlo dingin khawlsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The police stopped the car.
examples.zomi: Police-te in mawtaw khawlsak uh hi.

examples.english: Nothing could stop the fire from spreading.
examples.zomi: Meikuang kizelna bangmah in khaktan theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use stop someone/something from doing something to describe prevention.
senses.usage_zomi: Khaktan thu gen dingin stop someone/something from doing something kizang hi.

senses.heading: Pause during a journey
senses.definition_en: To pause or stay briefly at a place during a journey.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzinna laitak in mun khat ah tawlkhat tawl ahih keileh om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We stopped for lunch beside the river.
examples.zomi: Gun geiah sun-an ne dingin tawl ung.

examples.english: The bus stops at every village.
examples.zomi: Bus pen khuano khempeuh ah tawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use stop at before a place and stop for before a purpose or activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun ma ah stop at kizang a, ngimna ahih keileh gamtatna ma ah stop for kizang hi.

senses.heading: Stay somewhere temporarily
senses.definition_en: To stay temporarily at a place, especially in British English.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah tawlkhat om cihna ahi hi, adiakin British English ah.

examples.english: We stopped at a small hotel for the night.
examples.zomi: Zan khat a ding hotel neu khat ah om ung.

examples.english: She is stopping with relatives this week.
examples.zomi: Hih kaal in a tanaute innah om hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is chiefly British. American English normally uses stay.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen British English ah kizang tam hi. American English ah stay kici tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Shop
senses.definition_en: A place where goods are sold to customers.
senses.explanation_zomi: Customer-te kiangah van kizuakna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: She bought milk at the grocery store.
examples.zomi: Amahin annek ding dawr ah susu lei hi.

examples.english: The store closes at nine o’clock.
examples.zomi: Dawr pen dak kua in kha hi.

senses.usage_en: Store is especially common in American English. British English commonly uses shop.
senses.usage_zomi: Store pen American English ah kizang tam hi. British English ah shop kici tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Supply kept for future use
senses.definition_en: A supply of something kept for use when it is needed.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisap hun a zat dingin kikhol na khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The village kept a store of food for emergencies.
examples.zomi: Khuano in kisapna manlang hun a ding an kholsa kem hi.

examples.english: The body uses its energy stores during exercise.
examples.zomi: Exercise laitak in pumpi in a tha kholsa zang hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is more formal and emphasizes something accumulated for future use.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen formal zaw a, mailam zatna ding a kholkhawm na khat bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Severe weather
senses.definition_en: A period of severe weather with strong winds and often rain, snow, thunder or lightning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Huih thahat leh a tamzaw in guah, vuk, vantampi ahih keileh khomul a kihel khuahun nasia ahi hi.

examples.english: The storm damaged several homes.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in inn pawlkhat susia hi.

examples.english: Flights were cancelled because of the winter storm.
examples.zomi: Phalbi huihpi hangin vanleng khuallam-te kikhawl hi.

senses.usage_en: More specific storm types include thunderstorm, snowstorm, hurricane and tornado.
senses.usage_zomi: Huihpi nam kicianzawte sungah thunderstorm, snowstorm, hurricane leh tornado kihel hi.

senses.heading: Sudden strong reaction or conflict
senses.definition_en: A sudden period of strong anger, protest, criticism or emotional conflict.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hehna, langpanna, mawhsakna ahih keileh lungsim kikalhna thakhat leh khauh tak a om hun ahi hi.

examples.english: The decision caused a political storm.
examples.zomi: Khensatna in politics buaina lian piangsak hi.

examples.english: The report produced a storm of criticism.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna in mawhsakna tampi piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense compares intense public or emotional conflict to violent weather.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in mipite lak ahih keileh lungsim kikalhna khauh pen khuahun nasia tawh tehkak hi.

senses.heading: Account of events
senses.definition_en: An account of real or imagined events told or written in an organized way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang taktak ahih keileh ngaihsutna sung thu-te kizem tak a kigen ahih keileh kigelh ahi hi.

examples.english: Grandmother told us a story about her childhood.
examples.zomi: Pite in a naupanlai thu tangthu hong gen hi.

examples.english: The film is based on a true story.
examples.zomi: Film pen tangthu maan khat tungah kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A story may be factual or fictional; context shows whether it describes real events.
senses.usage_zomi: Tangthu pen thu maan ahih keileh ngaihsutna sung thu ahi thei a, a kizangna thu in khensat hi.

senses.heading: News report
senses.definition_en: A report about an event or subject published or broadcast by a news organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: News pawl in thu piang ahih keileh thulu khat tawh kisai a suah lipkhapna ahi hi.

examples.english: The newspaper published a story about the election.
examples.zomi: Newspaper in teelna thu news khat suah hi.

examples.english: The reporter is covering the storm story.
examples.zomi: Reporter in huihpi thu news bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In journalism, story means a news report and does not imply that the information is invented.
senses.usage_zomi: Journalism ah story in news lipkhapna kawk a, thu phuah ahi cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Explanation given by someone
senses.definition_en: A person’s account or explanation of what happened.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in bang piang cih a genna ahih keileh a hilhcianhna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: tell your side of the story

examples.english: The witnesses told different stories.
examples.zomi: Teci-te in thu genna tuamtuam gen uh hi.

examples.english: We need to hear both sides of the story.
examples.zomi: Tangthu lam nihgel zak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Both sides of the story means the different accounts or viewpoints involved in a dispute.
senses.usage_zomi: Both sides of the story cihpen kikalhna khat sung a thugenna ahih keileh ngaihsutna lam tuamte kawk hi.

senses.heading: Level of a building
senses.definition_en: A complete level of a building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Innpi khat a tầng kicing khat ahi hi.

examples.english: They live in a three-story building.
examples.zomi: Amaute tầng thum innpi ah teng uh hi.

examples.english: Her office is on the top story.
examples.zomi: A office pen innpi tầng tungpen ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: This spelling is standard in American English. British English uses storey for a building level.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gelhdan pen American English ah standard ahi hi. British English ah innpi level a ding storey kizang hi.

senses.heading: In a direct line
senses.definition_en: In a direct line without turning or bending.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hei ahih keileh kawnglo in line tang in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Go straight for two kilometres, then turn left.
examples.zomi: Kilometre nih tang in pai a, tuakhit ciang veilam hei in.

examples.english: She looked straight ahead.
examples.zomi: Ama mai tang en hi.

senses.usage_en: As an adverb, straight has no -ly ending. Do not use straightly.
senses.usage_zomi: Adverb in a kizang ciangin straight in -ly neilo hi. Straightly kici lo hi.

senses.heading: Immediately or without interruption
senses.definition_en: Immediately, directly or without stopping somewhere else first.
senses.explanation_zomi: Manlang takin, direct takin ahih keileh mun dangah tawllo in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I went straight home after the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna khit ciangin inn ah direct takin pai ing.

examples.english: Call me straight away if there is a problem.
examples.zomi: Haksatna om leh pahpah in hong sam in.

senses.usage_en: Straight away means immediately. It is especially common in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Straight away cihpen pahpah in cihna ahi hi. British English ah kizang tam hi.

senses.heading: Continuously
senses.definition_en: Continuously for the stated period, without a break.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun kigen sung khawlna omlo in kizom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She worked for eight hours straight.
examples.zomi: Ama nai giat khawllo in sem hi.

examples.english: The team won six matches straight.
examples.zomi: Team in kidemna guk kizom in zo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, straight normally follows the time period or number of events.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah straight pen hun sawtdan ahih keileh thu piang nambat khit ah om ngei hi.

senses.heading: Honestly and clearly
senses.definition_en: Honestly, clearly and without trying to hide the truth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thumaan, kician tak a, thu maan seel ding hanciamlo in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Tell me straight whether you agree.
examples.zomi: Na lungkim maw lungkimlo maw thumaan takin hong gen in.

examples.english: He refused to answer the question straight.
examples.zomi: Ama dotna direct leh kician takin dawn ding nial hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal use emphasizes direct and honest communication.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih nisim zatna in direct leh thumaan kizopna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Unusual or unexpected
senses.definition_en: Unusual, unexpected or difficult to explain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina hilo, ngakloh ahih keileh hilhcian haksa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We heard a strange noise outside.
examples.zomi: Pualam ah aw lamdang khat za ung.

examples.english: The machine is making a strange sound.
examples.zomi: Khawl in aw ngeilo khat suah hi.

senses.usage_en: Strange can express surprise, uncertainty or mild concern; it does not always mean frightening.
senses.usage_zomi: Strange in lamdanna, kicianlohna ahih keileh lungkham tawm lak thei a, lauhuai ngiat cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Unfamiliar
senses.definition_en: Not known, recognized or previously experienced.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kitheilo, kiphawklo ahih keileh a vekpi a phut ngeilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children felt nervous in the strange city.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te khuapi kitheilo ah lau uh hi.

examples.english: It felt strange to return after twenty years.
examples.zomi: Kum sawmnih khit a ciahkikna ngeina hilo bangin phawk hi.

senses.usage_en: A strange person may simply be someone unknown, but modern English more often uses stranger for that meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Strange person cihpen mi kitheilo khat ahi thei napi, tulai English ah hih khiatna dingin stranger kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Person you do not know
senses.definition_en: A person whom you have never met or do not know.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na muh ngeiloh ahih keileh na theihloh mi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not give personal information to strangers online.
examples.zomi: Online ah mi kitheilo-te kiangah mimal thu pia kei in.

examples.english: A stranger helped us find the station.
examples.zomi: Mi kitheilo khat in station muhnading hong huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling someone a stranger describes the lack of a personal relationship; it does not mean the person is strange or dangerous.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat stranger a cihpen mimal kizopna neilo cihna ahi a, tua mi lamdang ahih keileh lauhuai ngiat cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Person new to a place or activity
senses.definition_en: A person who is new to a place, group, experience or subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, pawl, phutkhak ahih keileh thulu khat a ding mi thak ahi hi.

examples.english: I am a stranger to this city.
examples.zomi: Hih khuapi a ding mi thak ka hi hi.

examples.english: She is no stranger to hard work.
examples.zomi: Ama nasep haksa phut ngeilo mi hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: No stranger to something means familiar with it through experience.
senses.usage_zomi: No stranger to something cihpen phutkhak tungtawnin tua na thei cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A carefully designed plan for achieving a long-term or important goal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sawtpi ahih keileh ngimna thupi khat tangtunna ding a limtak a kiginkhol geelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company developed a strategy for entering new markets.
examples.zomi: Company in market thakte sung a lutna ding geelna khangsak hi.

examples.english: We need a clear strategy to achieve our goal.
examples.zomi: I ngimna tangtunna ding geelna kician khat kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: A strategy gives the overall approach to a goal. A plan may include the detailed actions and timetable.
senses.usage_zomi: Strategy in ngimna tangtunna lampi a pum in lak hi. Plan in gamtatna kician leh hun geelna huam thei hi.

senses.heading: Small natural flow of water
senses.definition_en: A small, narrow flow of water moving naturally through the land.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei lak pan pianzia bang a luang tui luangtom leh ginal ahi hi.

examples.english: A clear stream runs through the village.
examples.zomi: Khuano sung kantan in luangtum ciang khat luang hi.

examples.english: We crossed the stream on a wooden bridge.
examples.zomi: Sing lei kaam tung pan luangtum kantan ung.

senses.usage_en: A stream is normally smaller than a river, although naming varies by region.
senses.usage_zomi: Stream pen gun sangin neu zaw ngei napi, gamhuam bangin minpuakzia kilamdang thei hi.

senses.heading: Continuous flow of people or things
senses.definition_en: A continuous movement or supply of people, vehicles, words or other things.
senses.zomi_equivalents: luang bang a kizom; a kizom pawl
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mawtaw, kammal ahih keileh na dangte khawllo a kikhih ahih keileh hong omna ahi hi.

examples.english: A steady stream of visitors entered the museum.
examples.zomi: Hawhmi-te tawntung in museum sungah lut uh hi.

examples.english: The speaker received a stream of questions.
examples.zomi: Thugenpa in dotna kizom tampi ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense compares continuous movement or supply to flowing water.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in khawllo kikhihna ahih keileh piakna pen tui luang tawh tehkak hi.

senses.heading: Digital transmission of media
senses.definition_en: A continuous digital transmission of audio or video over the internet.
senses.zomi_equivalents: online aw leh video hawmna; digital stream
senses.explanation_zomi: Internet tungtawnin aw ahih keileh video khawllo a kisawl digital data ahi hi.

examples.english: The live stream begins at seven.
examples.zomi: Live online hawmna dak sagih in kipan hi.

examples.english: The video stream stopped because of a weak signal.
examples.zomi: Signal nem hangin video hawmna khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: A stream can be watched or heard while data is being transmitted, without first downloading the entire file.
senses.usage_zomi: Stream pen file pumpi download masa kullo in data kisawl laitak mah en ahih keileh za theih hi.

senses.heading: Group of students
senses.definition_en: A group of students taught together according to ability, subject or programme.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siamdan, thulu ahih keileh program bangin kikhawm a kihilh sangnaupang pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: She chose the science stream in secondary school.
examples.zomi: Ama sanglai ah science pilna khen teel hi.

examples.english: Students are placed in different streams.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te pilna pawl tuamtuam ah kikoih hi.

senses.usage_en: This educational sense is common in some countries but less common in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pilna khiatna pen gam pawlkhat ah kizang tam a, American English ah kizang tawmzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A public road in a town or city, usually with buildings along one or both sides.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khua ahih keileh khuapi sung a mipite lampi, a lam khat ahih keileh lam nihgel a inn-te a om ngei ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: lampi mi leh mawtaw a tam

examples.english: Their office is across the street from the bank.
examples.zomi: A office uh bank tawh lampi galkhat ah om hi.

examples.english: Children were playing in the street.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te lampi tungah kimawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, addresses commonly use on a street: She lives on Main Street. British English may also use in a street.
senses.usage_zomi: American English address ah on a street kizang tam hi: She lives on Main Street. British English ah in a street zong kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Physical power
senses.definition_en: The physical power that allows a person, animal or object to lift, resist or perform difficult actions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing ahih keileh van khat in van gik lamto, do ahih keileh gamtatna haksa bawltheihna pumpi tha ahi hi.

examples.english: Regular exercise builds physical strength.
examples.zomi: Tawntung exercise bawlna in pumpi tha khangsak hi.

examples.english: He lacked the strength to lift the box.
examples.zomi: Bawm lamto ding tha kicing neilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Strength is the noun; strong is the adjective.
senses.usage_zomi: Strength pen noun a, strong pen adjective ahi hi.

senses.heading: Ability to resist damage or pressure
senses.definition_en: The quality of being able to resist force, pressure or damage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thagum, kisukna ahih keileh siatna a do leh a thuaktheihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Steel gives the building additional strength.
examples.zomi: Steel in innpi khauhna behlap pia hi.

examples.english: Engineers tested the bridge’s strength.
examples.zomi: Engineer-te in lei kaam khauhdan sittel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may apply to buildings, materials, systems or natural structures.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna innpi, material, system ahih keileh pianpih kibawlzia tungah kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Emotional or mental power
senses.definition_en: The emotional or mental ability to deal with difficulty, pain or pressure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna, natna ahih keileh kisukna a bawl leh a thuaktheihna lungsim tha ahi hi.

examples.english: She found the strength to continue after the loss.
examples.zomi: Supna khit zong zompaisuak theihna ding lungsim tha ngah hi.

examples.english: The crisis tested their emotional strength.
examples.zomi: Haksatna in amau lungsim tha sittel hi.

senses.usage_en: Emotional strength does not mean never feeling sadness or fear; it means being able to respond and continue.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungsim tha cihpen dah ahih keileh lau ngeilo cihna hilo a, dawnkik leh zompaisuak thei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Strong point or advantage
senses.definition_en: A good quality, ability or advantage that makes a person, plan or organization effective.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, geelna ahih keileh pawl khat na semtak a bawl siamna, gamtatna hoih ahih keileh hamphatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Clear communication is one of her strengths.
examples.zomi: Kician tak a kizopna pen ama siamna hoihte sung a khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The report examines the plan’s strengths and weaknesses.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna in geelna thahatna leh thanemna-te sit hi.

senses.usage_en: In evaluation, a strength is a positive feature; a weakness is a limitation or disadvantage.
senses.usage_zomi: Etkikna ah strength pen gamtatna hoih ahi a, weakness pen ciangtan ahih keileh hamphatlohna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Degree of intensity or concentration
senses.definition_en: The degree of power, intensity or concentration in a substance, signal or feeling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, signal ahih keileh lungsim khat bangzah khauh ahih keileh tam cih dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The phone shows the signal strength.
examples.zomi: Phone in signal khauhdan lak hi.

examples.english: The medicine is available in two strengths.
examples.zomi: Zatui pen khauhdan nam nih tawh ngah theih hi.

senses.usage_en: For medicine, strength refers to the concentration or amount of an active ingredient.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatui ah strength in zatui sung a na semtak ingredient a tamdan kawk hi.

senses.heading: Mental or emotional pressure
senses.definition_en: Worry or mental pressure caused by difficult demands, problems or uncertainty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiatna haksa, haksatna ahih keileh kicianlohna hangin a piang lungkhamna leh lungsim kisukna ahi hi.

examples.english: Too much stress can affect your health.
examples.zomi: Lungsim kisukna tampi lua in na cidamna nawngkai thei hi.

examples.english: She exercises to reduce work-related stress.
examples.zomi: Nasep hang lungsim kisukna kiamsak dingin exercise bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Stress is not itself a medical diagnosis, but persistent or severe stress can contribute to health problems.
senses.usage_zomi: Stress amah natna khensatna hilo napi, sawtpi ahih keileh nasia lungsim kisukna in cidamna haksatna-te piangsak thei hi.

senses.heading: Physical force or pressure
senses.definition_en: Force or pressure placed on a material, structure or body part.
senses.explanation_zomi: Material, kibawlzia ahih keileh pumpi khen khat tung a kisuk thagum ahi hi.

examples.english: Heavy loads place stress on the bridge.
examples.zomi: Vanpuak gik-te in lei kaam tungah kisukna piangsak hi.

examples.english: The exercise puts less stress on the knees.
examples.zomi: Exercise in khuk-te tungah kisukna tawmzaw koih hi.

senses.usage_en: In engineering and medicine, stress can mean physical force rather than emotional pressure.
senses.usage_zomi: Engineering leh zatui lamah stress in lungsim kisukna hilo in pumpi ahih keileh van tung kisuk thagum kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Emphasis on a syllable or word
senses.definition_en: Extra force or emphasis given to a syllable or word when speaking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pau ciangin syllable ahih keileh kammal khat aw khauhzaw tawh kigenna ahi hi.

examples.english: The stress in “important” falls on the second syllable.
examples.zomi: “Important” ah aw thupisakna pen syllable a nihna tungah om hi.

examples.english: Incorrect stress can make a word difficult to understand.
examples.zomi: Aw thupisakna khial in kammal tel haksa sak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Stress is an important part of English pronunciation and may distinguish words or improve clarity.
senses.usage_zomi: Stress pen English pronunciation sung a khen thupi ahi a, kammal khen ahih keileh pau kician sak thei hi.

senses.heading: Special importance
senses.definition_en: Special importance or attention given to an idea, quality or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, gamtatna hoih ahih keileh sepna khat tung a kikoih thupina ahih keileh awlmawhna tuam ahi hi.

examples.english: The programme places strong stress on practical skills.
examples.zomi: Program in nasep siamna-te nasatak in thupisak hi.

examples.english: The policy gives greater stress to prevention.
examples.zomi: Policy in khaktan kholhna thupizaw sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Emphasis is now more common than stress for this meaning in many contexts.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna dingin tulai khuahun tampi ah stress sangin emphasis kizang tamzaw hi.

senses.heading: Make or become longer or wider
senses.definition_en: To pull something so that it becomes longer or wider, or to become longer or wider when pulled.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat kaai in a sauzaw ahih keileh zaizaw sak, ahih keileh a kikaaiciang a sau leh zai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not stretch the fabric too much.
examples.zomi: Puan pen kaai lua kei in.

examples.english: This material stretches easily.
examples.zomi: Hih puan van baih takin zaang hi.

senses.usage_en: Stretch can be transitive or intransitive: stretch the fabric; the fabric stretches.
senses.usage_zomi: Stretch transitive ahih keileh intransitive ahi thei hi: stretch the fabric; the fabric stretches.

senses.heading: Extend the body or limbs
senses.definition_en: To extend the body or a part of it fully, especially to loosen muscles or reach something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pumpi zaang; ban leh khe kaai
senses.explanation_zomi: Adiakin pumpi sa neem sak ahih keileh na khat pha dingin pumpi ahih keileh pumpi khen khat zaang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Stretch your legs after the long journey.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna sau khit ciangin na khe-te zaang in.

examples.english: She stretched to reach the top shelf.
examples.zomi: Van koihna tungpen pha dingin pumpi zaang hi.

senses.usage_en: Gentle stretching before or after activity may help improve movement, but painful stretching should be stopped.
senses.usage_zomi: Gamtatna ma ahih keileh khit a pumpi neem tak a zaangna in kikhihtheihna hoihsak thei napi, a na dong zaangna khawl ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Continue over an area or period
senses.definition_en: To extend over a particular distance, area or period of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamla, gamhuam ahih keileh hun ciangtan khat huam in kizom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The forest stretches for many kilometres.
examples.zomi: Gamngaw kilometre tampi huam in kizom hi.

examples.english: The project stretched over three years.
examples.zomi: Project in kum thum huam hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes spatial or temporal extent, not physical pulling.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in gamla ahih keileh hun sawtdan gen a, pumpi tawh kaai cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Use beyond normal limits
senses.definition_en: To use money, time, ability or resources close to or beyond their normal limits.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ciangtan dong zang; khengval in zang
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, hun, siamna ahih keileh neihsa ngeina ciangtan nai ahih keileh a khengval in zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Higher prices are stretching the family budget.
examples.zomi: Man sangte in innkuan budget ciangtan dong zang sak hi.

examples.english: The difficult assignment stretched her abilities.
examples.zomi: Assignment haksa in a siamna ciangtan dong hanciam sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense may suggest either efficient use or excessive pressure, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in a kizangna thu bangin, neihsa pil tak a zatna ahih keileh ciangtan khengval a kisukna kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Demanding exact obedience
senses.definition_en: Demanding that rules, orders or standards be obeyed exactly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhun, thupiakna ahih keileh standard ciangtak a zuih ding a ngen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher is strict but fair.
examples.zomi: Siamah khauh napi thutang hi.

examples.english: Her parents were strict about school attendance.
examples.zomi: A nulepate sang kaihna thu ah khauh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A strict person enforces rules firmly. This does not necessarily mean the person is unkind or unfair.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khauh khat in thukhun kip takin zuihsak hi. Tua in migi lo ahih keileh thutanglo cihna a hih pah kullo hi.

senses.heading: Exact and allowing no exception
senses.definition_en: Exact, precise and permitting no exception or variation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ciangtak, kician a, kihello ahih keileh a dang a zat phallo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The laboratory follows strict safety rules.
examples.zomi: Laboratory in bitna thukhun khauh zui hi.

examples.english: There is a strict limit on the number of participants.
examples.zomi: Kiheltheih mi nambat tungah ciangtan khauh om hi.

senses.usage_en: A strict rule or limit must be followed exactly and normally permits little flexibility.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhun ahih keileh ciangtan khauh pen ciangtak a zuih kul a, kheltheihna tawm bek nei ngei hi.

senses.heading: Using the narrowest exact meaning
senses.definition_en: Following the exact or narrow meaning of a word, rule or definition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, thukhun ahih keileh definition a khiatna ciangtak leh huam tawmpen zui cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: In the strict sense, a tomato is a fruit.
examples.zomi: Khiatna ciangtak ah tomato pen gah ahi hi.

examples.english: The word has a narrower meaning in strict legal usage.
examples.zomi: Dan zatna ciangtak ah tua kammal khiatna huam tawmzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: In the strict sense contrasts an exact technical meaning with broader everyday usage.
senses.usage_zomi: In the strict sense in technical khiatna ciangtak leh nisim a kizang khiatna zaizaw kikhen hi.

senses.heading: Hit someone or something
senses.definition_en: To hit a person or thing forcefully with the hand, a tool or another object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih keileh na khat khut, vanzat ahih keileh van dang tawh nasatak in sat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The player struck the ball toward the goal.
examples.zomi: Kimawlpa in ball pen goal lamah sat hi.

examples.english: Lightning struck the tree.
examples.zomi: Khomul in singkung sat hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are struck. The form stricken is used in some adjectives and particular expressions.
senses.usage_zomi: Strike a past tense leh past participle pen struck ahi hi. Adjective leh kammal kizom pawlkhat ah stricken kizang hi.

senses.heading: Attack suddenly
senses.definition_en: To attack a person, place or target suddenly and forcefully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun ahih keileh ngimna khat thakhat leh thahat takin sim cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The forces struck the target before dawn.
examples.zomi: Galkap-te in zingkhuavak ma in ngimna sim uh hi.

examples.english: The snake struck without warning.
examples.zomi: Gul in vauna omlo in thakhat in seh hi.

senses.usage_en: In military and animal contexts, strike suggests a fast, forceful attack.
senses.usage_zomi: Galkap leh ganhing thu ah strike in manlang leh thahat tak a simna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Affect suddenly
senses.definition_en: To affect a person, place or group suddenly, especially through disaster, illness or misfortune.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun ahih keileh pawl khat tungah siatna, natna ahih keileh hamphatlohna thakhat in tung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A severe storm struck the coast.
examples.zomi: Huihpi nasia in tuipi gei gam nawngkai hi.

examples.english: The illness can strike at any age.
examples.zomi: Natna pen kum ciangtan neilo in tung thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense often has a harmful event or condition as the subject.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah thu piang ahih keileh dinmun siatna pen subject suak tam hi.

senses.heading: Stop work as a protest
senses.definition_en: To stop working as an organized protest, usually to demand better pay or conditions.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasep khawl in langpang; nasemte strike
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw in loh leh nasepna dinmun hoihzaw ngen dingin kizem tak a nasem khawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The workers voted to strike.
examples.zomi: Nasem-te in nasep khawl in langpang ding vote pia uh hi.

examples.english: Nurses struck for safer working conditions.
examples.zomi: Nurse-te in nasepna bitzaw ngenin nasep khawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The related noun is strike: The workers went on strike.
senses.usage_zomi: A tawh kizom noun pen strike ahi hi: The workers went on strike.

senses.heading: Suddenly come to mind
senses.definition_en: To suddenly enter someone’s mind or cause a strong impression.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungsim sungah ngaihsutna thakhat in hong lut ahih keileh lungsim nawngkaina lian a piangsak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat a ding lamdang bangin kilang

examples.english: It struck me that we had forgotten the key.
examples.zomi: Tawh i mangngilh uh hi cih hong phawkpah hi.

examples.english: Her explanation struck me as reasonable.
examples.zomi: A hilhcianhna kei a ding kilawm bangin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: It struck me that … means “I suddenly realized or thought that …”
senses.usage_zomi: It struck me that … cihpen “… cih thakhat in hong phawkpah ahih keileh ka thei hi” cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Thin cord
senses.definition_en: A thin cord made from twisted threads, used for tying, fastening or hanging things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khau neu-te a kihei leh kigawm in kibawl, khihna, belna ahih keileh van khaikhaihna ding a kizang khau ginal ahi hi.

examples.english: Tie the package with string.
examples.zomi: Vanbawm pen khau neu tawh khih in.

examples.english: The child pulled a toy with a piece of string.
examples.zomi: Naupang in kimawlna van pen khau neu phel khat tawh kaai hi.

senses.usage_en: String is uncountable for the material and countable for individual pieces or types.
senses.usage_zomi: Material a kawk ciangin string pen uncountable noun ahi a, phel ahih keileh nam khatciat kawk ciangin countable noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Series of related things or events
senses.definition_en: A connected series of similar things, events or results.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na, thu piang ahih keileh ngahna kibang khat khit khat a kizom pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The team achieved a string of victories.
examples.zomi: Team in gualzawhna kizom pawl ngah hi.

examples.english: She asked a long string of questions.
examples.zomi: Amahin dotna kizom tampi dong hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense compares connected events with objects arranged along a string.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehpihna khiatna in thu piang kizomte pen khau tung a kizem van-te tawh tehkak hi.

senses.heading: Instrument cord that produces sound
senses.definition_en: One of the tightly stretched cords on a musical instrument that produces sound when struck, plucked or rubbed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Music van tung a kikaaicip khau, kisat, kikhul ahih keileh kinul ciangin aw a suah ahi hi.

examples.english: One of the guitar strings broke.
examples.zomi: Guitar khau-te sung a khat keek hi.

examples.english: The musician replaced the violin strings.
examples.zomi: Music tumpa in violin khau-te khel hi.

senses.usage_en: String instruments include guitars, violins, cellos and harps.
senses.usage_zomi: String music van-te sungah guitar, violin, cello leh harp kihel hi.

senses.heading: Sequence of computer characters
senses.definition_en: A sequence of letters, numbers or symbols treated as one unit in computing.
senses.zomi_equivalents: computer character kizui pawl; data string
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer nasep ah unit khat in kingaihsut laimal, nambat ahih keileh symbol kizui pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The program searches for a matching text string.
examples.zomi: Program in text character kizui pawl a kituak zong hi.

examples.english: Enter the date as a string of eight numbers.
examples.zomi: Ni pen nambat giat kizui pawl in koih in.

senses.usage_en: In computing, a string stores characters as text, even when some characters are numbers.
senses.usage_zomi: Computing ah string in character-te text in khol a, character pawlkhat nambat ahih zongin text mah in kingaihsut hi.

senses.heading: Physically powerful
senses.definition_en: Having great physical power and being able to lift, move or resist heavy force.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tha lian nei a, van gik lamto, kikhihsak ahih keileh thagum do thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is strong enough to lift the box.
examples.zomi: Ama bawm lamto theih zahin thahat hi.

examples.english: Regular exercise keeps the body strong.
examples.zomi: Tawntung exercise bawlna in pumpi thahat sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Strong is the adjective; strength is the noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Strong pen adjective a, strength pen noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: Difficult to damage or break
senses.definition_en: Firmly made and able to resist pressure, damage or breaking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kip tak a kibawl a, kisukna, siatna ahih keileh keekna do thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Steel is a strong building material.
examples.zomi: Steel pen inn lamna material khauh ahi hi.

examples.english: The rope is strong enough to hold the load.
examples.zomi: Khau pen vanpuak a lenzo dingin khauh hi.

senses.usage_en: For structures and materials, strong means able to carry force or resist damage.
senses.usage_zomi: Kibawlzia leh material a gen ciangin strong in thagum dom ahih keileh siatna do thei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Powerful or intense
senses.definition_en: Powerful, intense or clearly noticeable in effect, feeling, taste, smell or sound.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nawngkaina, lungsim, lim, nam ahih keileh aw ah thahat, khauh leh phawk baih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The room had a strong smell of paint.
examples.zomi: Pindan sungah paint nam khauh hi.

examples.english: She expressed strong support for the proposal.
examples.zomi: Amahin geelna thapia mahmah cih lak hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning depends on the noun: strong coffee has an intense flavour, while strong support is firm and enthusiastic.
senses.usage_zomi: A khiatna ciangtak pen noun bangin om hi: strong coffee in lim khauh nei a, strong support in kip leh lunglawp tak a thapia cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Effective and influential
senses.definition_en: Effective, influential and likely to succeed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na semtak, nawngkaina lian nei a, gualzo thei ding cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The report makes a strong argument for reform.
examples.zomi: Lipkhapna in puahphatna a ding nialna teci khauh pia hi.

examples.english: The country needs strong institutions.
examples.zomi: Gam in institution thahat-te kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes effectiveness, influence or convincing evidence rather than physical power.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in pumpi tha sangin nasepna, nawngkaina ahih keileh teci khauhna bulphuh hi.

senses.heading: Healthy and likely to succeed
senses.definition_en: Healthy, successful or in a good condition for future growth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cidam, gualzo a, mailam khantohna a ding dinmun hoih a om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The company reported strong growth.
examples.zomi: Company in khantohna lian ngah ci in lipkhap hi.

examples.english: She is a strong candidate for the position.
examples.zomi: Ama tua dinmun a ding candidate gualzo thei khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In business and politics, strong often means performing well or having a good chance of success.
senses.usage_zomi: Business leh politics ah strong in nasepna hoih ahih keileh gualzawhna ding hunhoih nei cihna ahi tam hi.

senses.definition_en: With great force, intensity, certainty, or determination.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hat mahmah, thahat tak, lungmuang tak, ahih kei leh khauhtak in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I strongly believe that education can change lives.
examples.zomi: Pilna in mihing nuntakna kikhel sakthei cih ka lungmuang takin um hi.

examples.english: The community strongly opposed the proposal.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna pen khuami-te in khauhtak in langpang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Strongly commonly modifies verbs that express opinions, feelings, recommendations, or opposition.
senses.usage_zomi: Strongly pen ngaihsutna, lungsim thu, sawlna leh langpanna a pulakna gamtat kammal tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: The way parts are arranged
senses.definition_en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged and connected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sungah a khen tuamtuamte koibang in kikhawm, kikhenkhia leh kizom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Students learned the basic structure of an English sentence.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in English sentence kibawlna bulpi sin uh hi.

examples.english: The company changed its management structure.
examples.zomi: Kampani in ama ukna kibawlna kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning describes the arrangement and relationship of parts within a whole.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in na khat a khen tuamtuamte koibang in kibawl in kizom cih hong gen hi.

senses.heading: A building or constructed object
senses.definition_en: A building or another large object made from several connected parts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khen tuamtuam kizomsak in kibawl innpi ahih kei leh van lian khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The old wooden structure is no longer safe.
examples.zomi: Tua sing tawh kibawl inn lui pen tu in bit nawnlo hi.

examples.english: Workers built a temporary structure beside the road.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in lampi geiah sawtlou sung ading inn khat lam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, structure is a countable noun referring to a physical construction.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah structure pen simtheih min kammal hi a, khut tawh kibawl na khat kawk hi.

senses.heading: Try very hard
senses.definition_en: To try very hard to do something difficult.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hahkat; haksatna thuak kawm in zuan
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna khat tungah na khat bawl zawh dingin hahkat mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Many students struggle to understand this lesson.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang tampi in hih sinna telh ding hahkat mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: The family struggled to survive after losing its home.
examples.zomi: Inn a taan khit uh ciangin tua innkuan nuntak suak dingin hahkat mahmah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Struggle to do something means that the action requires great effort and is not easy.
senses.usage_zomi: Struggle to do something cih pen tua nasep bawl ding haksat mahmah a, hahkatna lian kisam cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Fight physically
senses.definition_en: To fight or move forcefully in order to escape or gain control.
senses.explanation_zomi: Suakta ding ahih kei leh ukzawhna ngah dingin pumpi tha tawh kidona bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He struggled with the man who attacked him.
examples.zomi: Amah hong simpa tawh kidop hi.

examples.english: The animal struggled to escape from the net.
examples.zomi: Ganhing pen len sungpan suakta dingin kidop hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense involves physical resistance, not merely difficulty.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in haksatna bek hilo in, pumpi tha tawh langdo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who studies at a school, college, university, or another place of learning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sangsung, college, university ahih kei leh pilna sinna mun dangah a sin mi ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: hun kicing sinna a nei sangnaupang

examples.english: She is a medical student at the university.
examples.zomi: Amah university ah zatui pilna a sin sangnaupang ahi hi.

examples.english: The students asked their teacher several questions.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in a sia uh dotna pawlkhat dong uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Student can refer to learners of any age, although pupil is sometimes used for younger schoolchildren in British English.
senses.usage_zomi: Student pen kum tawh kisai loin a sin mi khempeuh kawk thei hi; British English ah naupangno zawte ading pupil zong kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A room or building where an artist works or where music, films, radio, or television programs are produced.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nasepna innkhan; la leh lim kibawlna mun
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim bawlmi in a nasepna, ahih kei leh la, film, radio leh television programte a bawlna innkhan maw inn ahi hi.

examples.english: The band recorded its new song in a studio.
examples.zomi: La pawl in a la thak uh studio sungah khum uh hi.

examples.english: The artist works in a small studio behind her house.
examples.zomi: Lim suaimi pen ama inn nung studio neu khat sungah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact meaning depends on the activity: art, music, photography, film, radio, or television.
senses.usage_zomi: A khiatna taktak pen tua munah lim, la, photo, film, radio ahih kei leh television nasep bang a kibawl cih tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: Learning
senses.definition_en: The activity of learning about a subject, especially through reading, instruction, or careful practice.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu simna, hilhna ngahna ahih kei leh pilvang takin kiilhna tawh pilna khat sin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Regular study will improve your English.
examples.zomi: Tawlngal loin sinna na neih leh na English hoih semsem ding hi.

examples.english: She went abroad for further study.
examples.zomi: A sinna zomto dingin gamdangah pai hi.

senses.usage_en: In this meaning, study is often uncountable when it refers generally to the activity of learning.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah study in sinna nasep a huamkim in a kawk ciangin simthamlo min kammal in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Research
senses.definition_en: A careful investigation of a subject in order to discover facts or gain knowledge.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thumaan theihna ahih kei leh pilna ngahna dingin thu khat kancian takin zong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The study examined the effects of air pollution.
examples.zomi: Tua kancian zonna in huih niinpa sulzui-et hi.

examples.english: Researchers published a new study on public health.
examples.zomi: Thuzongte in mipite cidamna tawh kisai kancian zonna thak khat suah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A countable study is a particular piece of research; research itself is normally uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtheih study pen kancian zonna khat ciang kawk hi; research ahihleh a tamzaw in simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Things, materials, activities, or information spoken about in a general way without naming each one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Min ciangciang lo in vante, zatlehte, sepnate ahih kei leh thute a huamkim in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please put your stuff in the cupboard.
examples.zomi: Na vante uh deihna sungah koih un.

examples.english: We learned a lot of useful stuff today.
examples.zomi: Tuni in a phattuam na tampi i sin hi.

senses.usage_en: Stuff is informal and uncountable. Do not normally say stuffs or a stuff when referring to possessions or miscellaneous things.
senses.usage_zomi: Stuff pen kikhawlhna kammal hi a, simthamlo min kammal ahi hi. Neihsa ahih kei leh na tuamtuam a cihna ah stuffs ahih kei leh a stuff ci ngeilo ding hi.

senses.definition_en: Showing poor judgment or little ability to understand something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsut siamlohna, pilvanglohna ahih kei leh theihsiamna tawmna a pulakna ahi hi.

examples.english: It was stupid to drive so fast in the rain.
examples.zomi: Guah sungah tua zahin mawtaw nawk luat pen ngolhuai mahmah hi.

examples.english: I felt stupid when I forgot his name.
examples.zomi: A min ka mangngilh ciangin ka kingolhuai sa hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling a person stupid can be insulting. It is often kinder to criticize the action or decision instead of the person.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat stupid cih pen zahkona hi thei hi. Mi pumpi mawhsak sangin a gamtatna ahih kei leh a khensatna khial cih gen zaw ding hoih hi.

senses.heading: A way of doing or presenting something
senses.definition_en: A particular way in which someone does, writes, designs, or presents something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in na a bawldan, lai a gelhdan, lim a bawldan ahih kei leh na a pulaakdan tuam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Her writing style is clear and simple.
examples.zomi: Ama laigelhdan a ciang a baih hi.

examples.english: Every teacher has a different teaching style.
examples.zomi: Sia khat ciangin hilhdan kibanglo nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense focuses on the characteristic way something is done, not merely its appearance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in a puatham bek hilo in, na khat koibang in kibawl cih a tuamvilvel dan kawk hi.

senses.heading: Fashion or design
senses.definition_en: A fashionable or distinctive appearance, especially in clothing, hair, or design.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puansilh, sam, ahih kei leh lim bawlna ah a kilawm, a minthang, a tuamvilvel puatham ahi hi.

examples.english: This jacket is still in style.
examples.zomi: Hih jacket pen tulai ngeina tawh kituak lai hi.

examples.english: She chose a simple style for her hair.
examples.zomi: A sam ading bawldan baih khat teel hi.

senses.usage_en: When style refers to fashion, it may change over time and differ between cultures.
senses.usage_zomi: Style in puatham a kawk ciangin hun tawh kikhel thei a, ngeina tuamtuam sungah zong kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: A topic
senses.definition_en: A person, idea, event, or issue that is being discussed, written about, or studied.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kihona, laigelhna ahih kei leh kancian zonna sungah a bulpi in a kiseh mi, ngaihsutna, thu piang ahih kei leh dotna ahi hi.

examples.english: Climate change was the main subject of the meeting.
examples.zomi: Tua meeting ah khuahun kikhelna pen thulu bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: He changed the subject when I asked about the money.
examples.zomi: Sum thu ka dot ciangin kihona thu khesak hi.

senses.usage_en: In conversation, change the subject means to begin talking about a different topic.
senses.usage_zomi: Kihona ah change the subject cih pen thulu dang khat pan kipan in kikum cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: An area of learning
senses.definition_en: An area of knowledge that is taught or studied at school, college, or university.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sangsung, college ahih kei leh university ah a kihilh leh a kisin pilna khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Mathematics is her favourite subject.
examples.zomi: Mathematics pen ama deihpen sinna thu ahi hi.

examples.english: Students must choose three subjects.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in sinna thu thum teel kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: School subjects include areas such as mathematics, history, science, and languages.
senses.usage_zomi: Sang sinna thute sungah mathematics, tangthu, science leh pau tuamtuam bangte kihel hi.

senses.heading: The grammatical subject
senses.definition_en: The word or group of words that performs the action or is described in a sentence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sentence khat sungah gamtatna a bawlpa ahih kei leh thu a kisehpa a lak kammal khat maw kammal pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: In “The child laughed,” “the child” is the subject.
examples.zomi: “The child laughed” sungah “the child” pen subject ahi hi.

examples.english: The subject and the verb must agree.
examples.zomi: Subject leh verb kituak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: A grammatical subject is not the same as the topic being discussed.
senses.usage_zomi: Grammar sung subject leh kihona thulu pen kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: Give something officially for consideration
senses.definition_en: To formally give a document, application, proposal, or piece of work to someone for a decision or assessment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Document, ngetna lai, geelna ahih kei leh nasep khat khensatna maw sittelna ading ukna nei mi tungah piaklut cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please submit your application by Friday.
examples.zomi: Na ngetna lai Friday ni tanin piaklut in.

examples.english: Every student submitted the assignment on time.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang khempeuh in a sang nasep uh hun ciangin piaklut uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Submit is more formal than give or send and is common in education, employment, and administration.
senses.usage_zomi: Submit pen give leh send sangin kammal picingzaw hi a, pilna, nasep leh ukna thu ah kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Accept another person’s authority
senses.definition_en: To accept the authority, control, or decision of another person or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh pawl khat ukzawhna, thuneihna maw khensatna sang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They refused to submit to unfair authority.
examples.zomi: Thutanglo thuneihna nuai thumang ding nial uh hi.

examples.english: Both sides agreed to submit to the court’s decision.
examples.zomi: Khat leh khatgel in thukhenzum khensatna sang dingin thukim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is usually followed by to.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah submit nungah to kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: A material
senses.definition_en: A particular kind of solid, liquid, or gas.
senses.explanation_zomi: A khau, a tui ahih kei leh huih bangin om zatleh nam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The bottle contained a dangerous substance.
examples.zomi: Tua thawl sungah zatleh lauhuai khat om hi.

examples.english: Scientists tested the unknown substance.
examples.zomi: Science siamte in tua a kithen lo zatleh sittel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Substance is often used when the exact material is unknown or when speaking scientifically.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatleh nam taktak theihloh ciang ahih kei leh science tawh kisai in kigen ciangin substance kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Important content or meaning
senses.definition_en: The most important ideas, meaning, or content of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat sungah a thupi pen ngaihsutna, khiatna ahih kei leh thu omte ahi hi.

examples.english: Her speech had both clarity and substance.
examples.zomi: Ama kampau a ciang a, thu bulpi zong nei hi.

examples.english: The report is long but lacks substance.
examples.zomi: Tua report a sau napi thu bulpi nei tawm hi.

senses.usage_en: In this abstract sense, substance means meaningful or important content, not physical material.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih muhtheihloh khiatna ah substance pen zatleh a cihna hilo in, khiatna nei thu thupi a cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Achieve what you want
senses.definition_en: To achieve a desired result after making an effort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hahkat khit ciangin a deih leh a ngiimsa ngahzo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She succeeded because she worked hard.
examples.zomi: Hahkatna tawh nasep ahih manin gualzo hi.

examples.english: We finally succeeded in solving the problem.
examples.zomi: A tawpna ah tua buaina vengzo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use succeed in followed by a noun or an -ing form: succeed in business; succeed in finding it.
senses.usage_zomi: Succeed in nungah min kammal ahih kei leh -ing tawpna kammal kizang hi: succeed in business; succeed in finding it.

senses.heading: Take a position after someone
senses.definition_en: To take a job, position, or title after another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dang khat khit ama nasepna, dinmun ahih kei leh minthanna a laak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She succeeded him as director.
examples.zomi: Amah nungin director dinmun luah hi.

examples.english: The prince will succeed to the throne.
examples.zomi: Kumpipa tapa in kumpi tokhom luah ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this formal sense, succeed someone takes no preposition, but succeed to the throne uses to.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kammal picingzaw zatna ah succeed someone kikal ah preposition kisamlo a, succeed to the throne ahihleh to kizang hi.

senses.heading: Achievement of a desired result
senses.definition_en: The achievement of something that you wanted or tried to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: A deihsa ahih kei leh a hahkatna tawh a ngiimsa a tangtun zawhna ahi hi.

examples.english: Hard work was the key to her success.
examples.zomi: Hahkatna pen ama gualzawhna tawhtang ahi hi.

examples.english: The event was a great success.
examples.zomi: Tua program gualzo mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Success is usually uncountable when it means achievement generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Success in gualzawhna a huamkim in a kawk ciangin simthamlo min kammal in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: A successful person or thing
senses.definition_en: A person, event, product, or plan that achieves very good results.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngalzawhna hoih a ngah mi, program, van kibawl ahih kei leh geelna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The new product was an immediate success.
examples.zomi: Van thak pen a kipat phetin gualzo hi.

examples.english: Her first book was a major success.
examples.zomi: Ama laibu masa pen gualzo mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, success is countable: a success or several successes.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah success pen simtheih hi a, a success ahih kei leh several successes ci in kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Achieving the result that was wanted, or having gained wealth, recognition, or progress.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngiimsa a tangtun, gualzawhna a ngah, ahih kei leh sum, minthanna maw ma khantohna a nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The campaign was successful.
examples.zomi: Tua kampan gualzo hi.

examples.english: She became a successful businesswoman.
examples.zomi: Amah gualzo sum nasep numei khat hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Successful describes a person or action that produces the intended good result.
senses.usage_zomi: Successful in a ngiimsa hoih a tangtun mi ahih kei leh nasep a pulak hi.

senses.definition_en: In a way that achieves the intended result.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngiimsa tangtun in ahih kei leh gualzawhna tawh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctors successfully completed the operation.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te in zatui tawh cina pumpi a vawhna uh gualzawhna tawh zota uh hi.

examples.english: She successfully passed the examination.
examples.zomi: Amah sittelna gualzawhna tawh paltan hi.

senses.usage_en: Successfully explains that an action reached its intended result; it does not merely mean that someone tried.
senses.usage_zomi: Successfully in hahkat bek hilo in, tua nasep in a ngiimsa taktak tangtun cih hong lak hi.

senses.heading: Of this or that kind
senses.definition_en: Of the kind or degree that has just been mentioned or is about to be described.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen khinsa ahih kei leh a kigen ding bang nam, bang dinmun maw bang zah cih a kawkna ahi hi.

examples.english: I have never seen such a beautiful place.
examples.zomi: Hibang mun hoih ka mu ngei kei hi.

examples.english: Such behavior is not acceptable.
examples.zomi: Tua bang gamtatna kisang theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use such a/an + adjective + singular noun: such a difficult question. With plural or uncountable nouns, do not use a/an: such difficult questions; such good advice.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kammal simtheih singular tawh such a/an + adjective + noun kizang hi: such a difficult question. Plural ahih kei leh simthamlo min kammal tawh a/an kizanglo hi: such difficult questions; such good advice.

senses.heading: So great or extreme
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that a quality or situation exists to a high degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihna, haksatna ahih kei leh dinmun khat a sang mahmah cih thupisakna in kizang hi.

examples.english: It was such a long journey.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna sawt mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: That was such good news.
examples.zomi: Tua pen lungdamhuai thu mahmah ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse such with so. Use such before noun phrases and so directly before an adjective or adverb.
senses.usage_zomi: Such leh so khial theilo ding hi. Such pen min kammal pawl mai ah kizang a, so pen adjective ahih kei leh adverb mai ah kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Happening quickly and unexpectedly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kigingkholna omlo in manlang takin lam-etlohpi a piang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A sudden storm damaged several houses.
examples.zomi: Lam-etlohpi huihpi in inn pawlkhat susia hi.

examples.english: There was a sudden change in the weather.
examples.zomi: Khuahun thakhat in kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Sudden is an adjective and normally comes before a noun. Use suddenly to modify a verb or a whole event.
senses.usage_zomi: Sudden pen adjective hi a, min kammal mai ah om zel hi. Gamtat kammal ahih kei leh thu piang khat a kician sak dingin suddenly zang in.

senses.definition_en: Quickly and unexpectedly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kigingkholna omlo in thakhat in lam-etlohpi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The car suddenly stopped in the road.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw pen lampi tungah thakhat in tawl hi.

examples.english: She suddenly realized that her bag was missing.
examples.zomi: A sum-ip a mang cih thakhat in phawk hi.

senses.usage_en: Suddenly often appears before the main verb or at the beginning of a sentence.
senses.usage_zomi: Suddenly pen a tamzaw in gamtat kammal mai ahih kei leh sentence kipatna ah om hi.

senses.heading: Experience pain or distress
senses.definition_en: To experience physical pain, emotional distress, illness, or another unpleasant condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi natna, lungsim gimna, cina ahih kei leh dinmun nuamlo khat thuak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He suffered severe pain after the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident a tuah khit ciangin natna na mahmah thuak hi.

examples.english: Many people suffer from anxiety.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi lungkhamna thuak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use suffer from with an illness or continuing condition, but suffer can take a direct object with words such as pain, loss, or damage.
senses.usage_zomi: Cina ahih kei leh sawtpi a om dinmun tawh suffer from kizang hi. Pain, loss leh damage bang tawh ahihleh suffer nungah tua min kammal ngiat omthei hi.

senses.heading: Be badly affected
senses.definition_en: To be harmed, damaged, or placed at a disadvantage.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sia sak, liamsak ahih kei leh dinmun hoihlo sungah tun cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Local businesses suffered during the crisis.
examples.zomi: Buaina hun sungah khuami sum nasepte gimna thuak uh hi.

examples.english: The crops suffered serious damage from the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi hangin loh sung nektheihte siasakna lian thuak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may describe people, organizations, economies, crops, or other affected subjects.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen mite, pawlte, sumvai, loh sung nektheihte leh a dangte tungah kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A sweet substance used in food and drinks.
senses.explanation_zomi: An leh dawnna a khum sakna dingin kizang a lim zatleh ahi hi.

examples.english: Do you take sugar in your coffee?
examples.zomi: Na coffee sungah sukha na beh hiam?

examples.english: This drink contains too much sugar.
examples.zomi: Hih dawnna sungah sukha tamlua hi.

senses.usage_en: Sugar is normally uncountable. Use measurements such as a spoonful of sugar or two bags of sugar.
senses.usage_zomi: Sugar pen simthamlo min kammal ahi hi. A zat kim tak gen dingin a spoonful of sugar ahih kei leh two bags of sugar bangin zatna tawh gen in.

senses.heading: Offer an idea or plan
senses.definition_en: To mention an idea, plan, or possible action for other people to consider.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi dangte ngaihsut dingin ngaihsutna, geelna ahih kei leh gamtat ding lampi khat genkhia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She suggested a different approach.
examples.zomi: Amah in bawldan dang khat sawl hi.

examples.english: I suggest taking the early bus.
examples.zomi: Bus a masapen tawh pai ding ka sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Say suggest doing something or suggest that someone do something. Do not normally say suggest someone to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Suggest doing something ahih kei leh suggest that someone do something ci in zang in. A tamzaw in suggest someone to do something ci ngeilo ding hi.

senses.heading: Indicate indirectly
senses.definition_en: To make an idea or fact seem likely without stating it directly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna ahih kei leh thu khat a kician in genlo napi tua thu hihtuak cih hong lak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: hih ding hihtuak cih khauhtak in lak

examples.english: The evidence suggests that he was not there.
examples.zomi: Teci omte in tua munah amah omlo hihtuak cih lak hi.

examples.english: The results suggest that the treatment is effective.
examples.zomi: A ngahna in tua zatui kizang pen phattuam hihtuak cih lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, suggest does not mean giving advice; it means providing an indirect sign.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah suggest in ngaihsutna pia cih hilo a, thu khat hihtuak cih kawkmuhna pia cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: An idea or proposal
senses.definition_en: An idea or plan offered for someone to consider.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ngaihsut dingin a kipia ngaihsutna ahih kei leh geelna ahi hi.

examples.english: Thank you for your helpful suggestion.
examples.zomi: Na phattuam ngaihsutna hangin lungdam ing.

examples.english: The committee accepted her suggestion.
examples.zomi: Komiti in ama ngaihsutna sang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use suggestion for/about with a noun and suggestion that before a clause.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kammal tawh suggestion for/about kizang a, sentence khen khat mai ah suggestion that kizang hi.

senses.heading: A slight indication
senses.definition_en: A small sign of a quality, feeling, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihna, lungsim thu ahih kei leh dinmun khat a om cih a tawm in hong lakna ahi hi.

examples.english: There was a suggestion of anger in his voice.
examples.zomi: Ama aw sungah hehna lim tawm om hi.

examples.english: She answered without any suggestion of fear.
examples.zomi: Launa lim tawm zong omlo in dawng hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a more formal use meaning a slight sign, not advice.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen kammal picingzaw zatna hi a, ngaihsutna pia cih hilo in lim tawm a cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A matching set of formal clothes
senses.definition_en: A jacket and matching pants or skirt worn together, often for formal occasions or work.
senses.zomi_equivalents: suit puan; jacket leh a kituak puan
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawi, meeting ahih kei leh nasepna ah a kikomtakin kisilh jacket leh pheikhawk puan ahih kei leh skirt ahi hi.

examples.english: He wore a dark suit to the interview.
examples.zomi: Interview ah suit puan vom silh hi.

examples.english: She bought a new suit for work.
examples.zomi: Nasepna ading suit puan thak khat lei hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, a suit commonly includes a jacket and matching pants or skirt. British English often uses trousers instead of pants.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah suit sungah jacket leh a kituak pants ahih kei leh skirt kihel zel hi. British English ah pants sangin trousers kizang zaw hi.

senses.heading: A set of playing cards
senses.definition_en: One of the four groups of cards in a standard pack: hearts, diamonds, clubs, or spades.
senses.zomi_equivalents: card nam khat; card khen khat
senses.explanation_zomi: Card kimawlna pawl khat sungah hearts, diamonds, clubs leh spades ci in khen li a omte lakah khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: These two cards belong to the same suit.
examples.zomi: Hih card nihte card nam kibang ahi hi.

examples.english: Players must follow suit if they can.
examples.zomi: Kimawl mite in a zawhtheih leh a kipat card nam zui kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is used specifically in card games.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen card kimawlna sung bekah kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Right or appropriate for a particular person, purpose, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, ngiimna khat ahih kei leh dinmun khat tawh a kituak a hoih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This book is suitable for young learners.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu pen a sin kipan naupangte ading a kituak hi.

examples.english: We need to find a suitable place for the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting ading mun kituak khat zong kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Suitable is commonly followed by for: suitable for beginners. It can also be followed by to + verb: suitable to use outdoors.
senses.usage_zomi: Suitable nungah for kizang zel hi: suitable for beginners. To + verb zong zui thei hi: suitable to use outdoors.

senses.heading: An amount of money
senses.definition_en: A particular amount of money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum zat kicing khat ahi hi.

examples.english: They donated a large sum of money to the hospital.
examples.zomi: Siiminn tungah sum tampi pia uh hi.

examples.english: The full sum must be paid by Friday.
examples.zomi: Sum khempeuh Friday ni tanin piak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Sum is more formal than amount when referring to money.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum thu a kigen ciangin sum pen amount sangin kammal picingzaw ahi hi.

senses.heading: The result of adding numbers
senses.definition_en: The number obtained by adding two or more numbers together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambatte nih ahih kei leh a tamzaw kigawm khit ciangin a ngah nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: The sum of five and seven is twelve.
examples.zomi: Nga leh sagih kigawm ngahna sawm leh nih ahi hi.

examples.english: Calculate the sum of these numbers.
examples.zomi: Hih nambatte kigawm ngahna sim in.

senses.usage_en: In mathematics, sum strictly means the result of addition, although it is sometimes used informally for a calculation or problem.
senses.usage_zomi: Mathematics ah sum in nambatte behlapna pan a ngahna ngiat kawk hi; kampau ngeina ah simna ahih kei leh dotna a cihna in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To give the main points of a longer text, speech, discussion, or event in a short form.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thu tomlak; a thupi pente tomgen
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, kampau, kihona ahih kei leh thu piang sau khat sungpan a thupi pente tom takin gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please summarize the article in three sentences.
examples.zomi: Hih article pen sentence thum tawh thu tomlak in.

examples.english: She summarized the main points of the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting sung thu thupi pente tom takin gen hi.

senses.usage_en: A summary should contain the central ideas without repeating every detail.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu tomlakna sungah a thu bulpite kihel kul a, a neucikneucik khempeuh genkik kullo hi.

senses.definition_en: A short statement that gives the main points of a longer text, speech, discussion, or event.
