senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, kampau, kihona ahih kei leh thu piang sau khat sung a thu thupi pente tom takin a pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The report begins with a short summary.
examples.zomi: Tua report pen thu tomlakna tom khat tawh kipan hi.

examples.english: Students wrote a summary of the chapter.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in tua chapter thu tomlakna gelh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A summary presents only the most important information; it is shorter than the original material.
senses.usage_zomi: Summary sungah a thupi pen thute bek kihel a, thu bulpi sangin tomzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: The warmest season of the year, between spring and autumn.
senses.explanation_zomi: Spring leh autumn kikal, kum sung a khuahun lum pen ahi hi.

examples.english: We usually visit our family during the summer.
examples.zomi: Khuakhal sungin ka innkuanpihte uh hawh zel ung.

examples.english: This summer has been unusually hot.
examples.zomi: Tukum khuakhal pen ngeina sangin lum mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In the Northern and Southern Hemispheres, summer occurs at different times of the year.
senses.usage_zomi: Leilung nisuahlam leh nitaklam khen liante ah khuakhal hun pen kum sung hun kibanglo ah hong tung hi.

senses.definition_en: The star that gives Earth light and heat and appears in the sky during the day.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leilung tungah khuavak leh a lum hong pia a, sun hunin van ah a kilang aksi ahi hi.

examples.english: The sun rises in the east.
examples.zomi: Ni nisuahna lam pan suak hi.

examples.english: Do not stay in the hot sun for too long.
examples.zomi: Ni a sat laitakin ni nuai ah sawtpi om kei in.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Sun mainly in scientific writing when treating it as the proper name of Earth’s star. Ordinary writing usually uses the sun.
senses.usage_zomi: Science laigelhna ah leilung a vakpia aksi min in kizang ciangin Sun ci in lai lian tawh kipan thei hi. Lai ngeina ah the sun ci in lai neu tawh kigelh zel hi.

senses.definition_en: The day of the week after Saturday and before Monday.
senses.explanation_zomi: Saturday ni khit leh Monday ni mai a om kal sung ni khat ahi hi.

examples.english: We will meet on Sunday afternoon.
examples.zomi: Sunday nitaklamin i kimu ding hi.

examples.english: The store is closed every Sunday.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr Sunday simin kikhak hi.

senses.usage_en: The names of days always begin with a capital letter in English.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah kal sung ni minte lai lian tawh kipan tawntung hi.

senses.definition_en: A large store where people buy food, drinks, and many household products.
senses.zomi_equivalents: dawr lian; an leh innzat van zuakna dawr
senses.explanation_zomi: Nek dawnte leh inn sung zat van tuamtuam a kizuak dawr lian ahi hi.

examples.english: I bought fruit and milk at the supermarket.
examples.zomi: Dawr lian ah gah leh bawngnawi ka lei hi.

examples.english: The supermarket stays open until ten o’clock.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr lian pen nai sawm dong kihong hi.

senses.usage_en: A supermarket mainly sells food and everyday household products, while a department store sells a broader range of goods in separate sections.
senses.usage_zomi: Supermarket ah nek dawn leh inn sung niteng zat vante kizuak a, department store ahihleh khen tuamtuam tawh van nam tamzaw kizuak hi.

senses.heading: An available amount
senses.definition_en: An amount of something that is available for people to use.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite zat dingin a om kholsa van ahih kei leh na zat ahi hi.

examples.english: The storm damaged the town’s water supply.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in khuapi tui omkholna susia hi.

examples.english: The medicine is available only in limited supply.
examples.zomi: Tua zatui pen tawm bek om hi.

senses.usage_en: Supply may be countable or uncountable. A supply of food means an available quantity; food supplies means stored amounts or provisions.
senses.usage_zomi: Supply pen simtheih leh simthamlo min kammal in kizang thei hi. A supply of food in an zat ding omzah kawk a, food supplies in an omkholte kawk hi.

senses.heading: Provision over time
senses.definition_en: The act or process of providing something that people need.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite kisap van ahih kei leh panpihna a kipia zel nasep leh lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: Heavy snow interrupted the supply of electricity.
examples.zomi: Vuk tampi kia in meivak piakzelsakna tawlsak hi.

examples.english: The company manages the supply of medical equipment.
examples.zomi: Kampani in zatui lam vante vaihawmna uk hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes the system or process by which necessary goods or services are provided.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in kisap van ahih kei leh nasepna a kipia zelna lampi leh kibawlna thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Give help or encouragement
senses.definition_en: To help, encourage, or provide what a person or organization needs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh pawl khat a kisapna pia, huh ahih kei leh hansawn cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her family supported her throughout her education.
examples.zomi: A pilna sinna tawntungin ama innkuan in panpih uh hi.

examples.english: Good teachers support students who need help.
examples.zomi: Sia hoihte in huhna a kisam sangnaupangte panpih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Support may mean giving emotional, practical, or financial help.
senses.usage_zomi: Support in lungsim lam hansawnna, nasep taktak tawh panpihna ahih kei leh sum tawh huhna kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Agree with or approve
senses.definition_en: To agree with and actively approve of an idea, plan, person, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, geelna, mi ahih kei leh pawl khat tawh thukim in a lamah ding cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Most members supported the proposal.
examples.zomi: Pawl sung mi a tamzaw in tua geelna thukimpih uh hi.

examples.english: I support the effort to improve public education.
examples.zomi: Mipite pilna hoihsakna ding hahkatna ka thukimpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Supporting an idea means more than understanding it; it means approving or favoring it.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngaihsutna khat support cih pen a telh bek hilo in, a thukimpih leh a lamah ding cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Hold something up
senses.definition_en: To carry the weight of something and prevent it from falling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a puklohna dingin a gikna pua in dom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: These posts support the roof.
examples.zomi: Hih khuamte in innkhum dom hi.

examples.english: The bridge can support heavy trucks.
examples.zomi: Tua lei in truck gikpite a gikna pua thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this physical sense, support means keeping something stable or preventing it from falling.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pumpi tawh kisai khiatna ah support in na khat kip tawh a omna ding ahih kei leh a puklohna dingin dom cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who agrees with, helps, or publicly encourages a person, team, organization, idea, or cause.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, kimawl pawl, pawlpi, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh nasep ngiimna khat thukimpih, panpih leh hansawn mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a strong supporter of public education.
examples.zomi: Amah mipite pilna a khauhtak in panpihmi ahi hi.

examples.english: Thousands of supporters attended the match.
examples.zomi: Panpihmi tul tampi in kimawlna va en uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A supporter may give practical help, express agreement, donate money, or cheer for a sports team.
senses.usage_zomi: Supporter in nasep taktak tawh panpih, thukimpihna pulak, sum pia ahih kei leh kimawl pawl hansawn thei hi.

senses.heading: Think something is probably true
senses.definition_en: To think or believe that something is probably true without being completely certain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat thumaan hihtuak ci in ngaihsun napi a kician takin theilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I suppose he has already left.
examples.zomi: Amah paikhinta hihtuak ci in ka ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: Do you suppose they know the answer?
examples.zomi: Amaute in a dawnna thei uh hihtuak ci na um hiam?

senses.usage_en: I suppose often expresses an uncertain or reluctant opinion and is weaker than I know.
senses.usage_zomi: I suppose in kician hetlo ahih kei leh deih taktaklo napi a hihtuak in ngaihsutna pulak a, I know sangin thudik kipsakna neuzaw hi.

senses.heading: Imagine a possible situation
senses.definition_en: To imagine a situation in order to consider what might happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bang hong piang thei diam cih ngaihsutna dingin dinmun piangthei khat lungsim sungah koih cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: tua munah na om peuhmah leh

examples.english: Suppose you lost your phone—what would you do?
examples.zomi: Na phone mang peuhmah leh bang na bawl ding hiam?

examples.english: Let us suppose that the cost increases next year.
examples.zomi: Kumkik ciangin a man hong khang ci in ngaihsun ni.

senses.usage_en: This use introduces a real or imaginary condition, much like if.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna in if bangin thu piangthei ahih kei leh ngaihsutna bek dinmun khat hong kipat sak hi.

senses.heading: Be expected or required
senses.definition_en: Used in the passive form be supposed to to say what is expected, required, or generally believed.
senses.zomi_equivalents: bawl ding kisawl; bawl ding kilawm
senses.explanation_zomi: Be supposed to cih tawh mi khat in bang bawl ding kisawl, kilawm ahih kei leh mite in bang hi ci in um uh cih pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: You are supposed to submit the form today.
examples.zomi: Tuni in tua form piaklut ding na kisawl hi.

examples.english: We are not supposed to park here.
examples.zomi: Hih munah mawtaw koih ding kiphal lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Be supposed to can express a rule, duty, plan, expectation, or commonly held belief.
senses.usage_zomi: Be supposed to in thukhun, mopohna, geelna, lametna ahih kei leh mite’ upna kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Certain
senses.definition_en: Certain that something is true or that something will happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat thumaan cih ahih kei leh thu khat hong piang ding cih lungsim sungah uplahna omlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am sure that she knows the answer.
examples.zomi: Amah in a dawnna thei cih ka lungmuang hi.

examples.english: Make sure that the door is locked.
examples.zomi: Kong kikhak cih kiciansak in.

senses.usage_en: Use sure of/about before a noun and sure that before a clause.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kammal mai ah sure of/about kizang a, sentence khen mai ah sure that kizang hi.

senses.heading: Certain to happen or succeed
senses.definition_en: Certain or very likely to happen, succeed, or produce a particular result.
senses.zomi_equivalents: piang takpi ding; gualzo takpi ding
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat hong piang, gualzo ahih kei leh a ngiimsa hong piang sak takpi ding cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Careful planning is a sure way to reduce mistakes.
examples.zomi: Pilvang takin geelna pen khialhna kiam sakna lampi kician ahi hi.

examples.english: The change is sure to affect everyone.
examples.zomi: Tua kikhelna in mi khempeuh sukha takpi ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern be sure to + verb can mean either “certain to happen” or a strong reminder: Be sure to call me.
senses.usage_zomi: Be sure to + verb in “piang takpi ding” cihna ahi thei a, sawlna khauhtak zong ahi thei hi: Be sure to call me.

senses.definition_en: Used to show that the speaker strongly believes something is true or expects another person to agree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kampaupa in thu khat thumaan takpi ci in a upna ahih kei leh midang thukimpih ding a lametna a pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Surely you understand why we must leave.
examples.zomi: Banghangin pai kul cih na tel takpi hi.

examples.english: This problem can surely be solved.
examples.zomi: Hih buaina pen kiveng thei takpi ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Surely often asks for agreement or expresses surprise that someone might think differently. It can sound forceful.
senses.usage_zomi: Surely in thukimpihna a tamzaw in ngen a, midang in a dangin ngaihsun thei cih lamdang sakna zong pulaak thei hi. A kammal khauhsak thei hi.

senses.heading: The outside or top layer
senses.definition_en: The outside or uppermost part of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a puatham ahih kei leh a tunglam pen ahi hi.

examples.english: Oil floated on the surface of the water.
examples.zomi: Tui tungah sathau lang hi.

examples.english: Clean the surface before you paint it.
examples.zomi: Na suahma in a puatham siang sak masa in.

senses.usage_en: Surface can refer to the outside of a solid object or the top of a liquid.
senses.usage_zomi: Surface in van khau khat a puatham ahih kei leh tui tunglam kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: An outward appearance
senses.definition_en: The part of a situation, feeling, or person’s character that is immediately visible.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, lungsim thu ahih kei leh mi omdan sungpan a puatham in a kilang pah khen ahi hi.

examples.english: On the surface, everything appeared normal.
examples.zomi: A puatham ah na khempeuh ngeina bangin kilang hi.

examples.english: The disagreement remained hidden beneath the surface.
examples.zomi: Thukimlohna pen a puatham nuai ah kiseel in om hi.

senses.usage_en: On the surface means according to outward appearances, which may not reveal the full truth.
senses.usage_zomi: On the surface cih pen a puatham kilatdan a cihna ahi a, thumaan khempeuh pulaak kimlo thei hi.

senses.heading: Medical treatment by operation
senses.definition_en: Medical treatment in which a doctor operates on a person’s body to repair, remove, or examine something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siavuan in mi pumpi sunga cina et, bawlhoih ahih kei leh paikhiat dingin aatna tawh a bawl zatui nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: She had surgery to repair her injured knee.
examples.zomi: A khuk a liam pen bawlhoih dingin pumpi aatna thuak hi.

examples.english: He is recovering well after the surgery.
examples.zomi: Aatna khit ciangin hoih takin damkik hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, surgery usually refers to the operation or the medical field. British English may also use it for a doctor’s office or consultation period.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah surgery in pumpi aatna ahih kei leh tua zatui pilna kawk zel hi. British English ah siavuan’ office ahih kei leh cina a et hun zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: The medical field
senses.definition_en: The branch of medicine concerned with treating conditions through operations.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi aatna tawh natna leh liamna a bawlhoih zatui pilna khen ahi hi.

examples.english: He specializes in heart surgery.
examples.zomi: Amah lungtang aatna zatui pilna ah siamna nei hi.

examples.english: Modern surgery has saved many lives.
examples.zomi: Tulai pumpi aatna pilna in mi tampi nuntakna honkhia hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is normally uncountable because it names a field of medicine.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in zatui pilna khen khat a kawk manin simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: An unexpected event or fact
senses.definition_en: An event, fact, or gift that is unexpected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam-etlohpi a piang thu, thumaan ahih kei leh letsong ahi hi.

examples.english: The gift was a wonderful surprise.
examples.zomi: Tua letsong pen lungdamhuai lam-etloh thu ahi hi.

examples.english: We organized a surprise party for her.
examples.zomi: Amah theihsaklo in pawi khat bawl sak ung.

senses.usage_en: An event may be a surprise, and someone may get or have a surprise.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu piang khat be a surprise hi thei a, mi khat in get/have a surprise zong hi thei hi.

senses.heading: The feeling caused by something unexpected
senses.definition_en: The feeling you have when something happens that you did not expect.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam-etloh thu khat hong piang ciangin lungsim sungah hong om lamdang sakna ahi hi.

examples.english: She opened her eyes wide in surprise.
examples.zomi: Lamdang sakna tawh a mitte hong hiang hi.

examples.english: To my surprise, everyone agreed.
examples.zomi: Ka lam-etlohpi in mi khempeuh thukim uh hi.

senses.usage_en: To my surprise introduces an outcome that was different from what the speaker expected.
senses.usage_zomi: To my surprise in kampaupa lametna tawh a kibanglo a ngahna hong kipat sak hi.

senses.definition_en: Feeling surprise because something unexpected has happened.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam-etloh thu khat a piang manin lamdang a sa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I was surprised to see him at the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting ah amah ka muh ciangin ka lamdangsa hi.

examples.english: She was pleasantly surprised by the result.
examples.zomi: A ngahna hangin lungdam kawm in lamdangsa hi.

senses.usage_en: A person is surprised; an event or fact is surprising.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat pen surprised hi a, thu piang ahih kei leh thumaan pen surprising ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Unexpected and causing surprise.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam-etlohpi a hi a, mite lamdang sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The team’s rapid improvement was surprising.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl manlang takin hoih semsem pen lamdanghuai hi.

examples.english: It is not surprising that she passed the exam.
examples.zomi: Amah sittelna a gualzawh pen lamdanghuai lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use surprising for the cause of the feeling and surprised for the person who experiences it.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungsim lamdang sakpa ading surprising zang a, tua lungsim a nei mi ading surprised zang in.

senses.definition_en: To be or form a circle around someone or something on every side.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat kimkot ah khempeuh pan kizung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Tall trees surround the house.
examples.zomi: Sing sangte in tua inn kimkot hi.

examples.english: Police surrounded the building.
examples.zomi: Police-te in tua inn kimkot uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The passive form be surrounded by is very common: The village is surrounded by mountains.
senses.usage_zomi: Passive be surrounded by kizang mahmah hi: The village is surrounded by mountains.

senses.definition_en: Existing or located in the area around a particular place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat kimkotna gam ah a om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: People came from the surrounding villages.
examples.zomi: Kimkot khuate pan mite hong pai uh hi.

examples.english: The fire spread into the surrounding forest.
examples.zomi: Mei in kimkot gamlak singkungte kang suk hi.

senses.usage_en: Surrounding normally comes before a noun. The plural noun surroundings means the environment or area around a person or place.
senses.usage_zomi: Surrounding pen min kammal mai ah om zel hi. Plural min kammal surroundings in mi ahih kei leh mun khat kimkotna gam kawk hi.

senses.heading: A set of questions
senses.definition_en: A set of questions used to collect information about people’s opinions, behavior, or circumstances.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite ngaihsutna, gamtatna ahih kei leh dinmunte theihna dingin a kibawl dotna pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The school conducted a survey of parents.
examples.zomi: Sang in nulehpate dotna tawh thuzonna bawl hi.

examples.english: Most people answered the online survey.
examples.zomi: Mi a tamzaw in internet tung dotna dawng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English the noun is pronounced /ˈsɝˌveɪ/, with stress on the first syllable. The verb survey is commonly pronounced /sərˈveɪ/.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah noun survey pen /ˈsɝˌveɪ/ ci in syllable masa tungah aw ki-ngah hi. Verb survey ahihleh /sərˈveɪ/ ci in a nunung tungah aw ki-ngah zel hi.

senses.heading: A careful examination
senses.definition_en: A careful examination of land, a building, an area, or a general situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam, inn, mun ahih kei leh dinmun khat pilvang takin etphat leh kancian cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The engineer completed a survey of the land.
examples.zomi: Engineer in tua gam kancian etna zosiang hi.

examples.english: A building survey found damage to the roof.
examples.zomi: Inn etphatna in innkhum siatna mu hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense concerns inspection or measurement rather than asking people questions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mite dotna hilo in, mun khat etphat ahih kei leh tehna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Remain alive
senses.definition_en: To remain alive after a dangerous event, serious illness, or difficult period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuai thu, cina na ahih kei leh hun haksa khit ciangin nuntak lai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: All the passengers survived the accident.
examples.zomi: Khualzin khempeuh accident sungpan nuntak suak uh hi.

examples.english: The plant cannot survive without water.
examples.zomi: Hih singkung pen tui lo in nungta theilo hi.

senses.usage_en: Survive something normally takes no preposition: survive the storm, not survive from the storm.
senses.usage_zomi: Survive something sungah preposition kisamlo hi: survive the storm ci a, survive from the storm ci lo hi.

senses.heading: Continue to exist or operate
senses.definition_en: To continue to exist, function, or remain successful despite difficulty or change.
senses.explanation_zomi: Haksatna ahih kei leh kikhelna om napi omzom, nasemzom ahih kei leh gualzo lai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The small business survived the economic crisis.
examples.zomi: Sum nasep neu pen sumvai buaina kantan in omzom hi.

examples.english: This tradition has survived for hundreds of years.
examples.zomi: Hih ngeina kum zalom tampi sung omzom hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is used for organizations, customs, languages, systems, and other things that continue to exist.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen pawlte, ngeinate, pau, system leh omzom thei na dangte tungah kizang hi.

senses.heading: Think something is probably true
senses.definition_en: To think that something is probably true, especially something bad, without having definite proof.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci kicing omlo napi thu hoihlo khat thumaan hihtuak ci in ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: gamtat khial om hihtuak in um

examples.english: I suspect that someone has opened this box.
examples.zomi: Mi khat in hih bawm hongkhinta hihtuak ci in ka um hi.

examples.english: Doctors suspected an infection.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te in natna khuak om hihtuak ci in um uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Suspect expresses doubt or belief based on limited evidence, not proven knowledge.
senses.usage_zomi: Suspect in teci tawm tungah kinga uplahna ahih kei leh upna kawk a, kipsaksa pilna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Believe someone committed an offence
senses.definition_en: To believe that a person may have committed a crime or done something wrong.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mawhbawl hihtuak in um; mawhsak lunghiang
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in mawhna bawl ahih kei leh gamtat khial hihtuak ci in um cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat guk hihtuak in um
police in mawhbawl hihtuak in um

examples.english: Police suspect him of stealing the car.
examples.zomi: Police-te in amah mawtaw guk hihtuak ci in um uh hi.

examples.english: She was suspected of providing false information.
examples.zomi: Amah in thudiklo pia hihtuak ci in kimawhsak lunghiang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use suspect someone of + noun or -ing form: suspect her of fraud; suspect her of lying.
senses.usage_zomi: Suspect someone of + noun/-ing ci in kizang hi: suspect her of fraud; suspect her of lying.

senses.heading: Make a serious promise
senses.definition_en: To make a very serious promise or state formally that something is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat bawl takpi ding kiciamna khauhtak bawl ahih kei leh thu khat thumaan cih thukip in gen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The witness swore to tell the truth.
examples.zomi: Teci in thumaan gen dingin kiciam hi.

examples.english: I swear that I did not take the money.
examples.zomi: Tua sum ka la kei cih ka kiciam hi.

senses.usage_en: In a court, a witness may swear an oath. In everyday speech, I swear can strongly emphasize that a statement is true.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukhenzum ah teci in kiciamna bawl thei hi. Niteng kampau ah I swear in thu khat thumaan takpi cih khauhtak in kipsak hi.

senses.heading: Use offensive language
senses.definition_en: To use rude or offensive words, especially when angry.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hehna hangin kamsia, zahkona ahih kei leh kammal hoihlo pau cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He swore when he dropped the heavy box.
examples.zomi: Bawm gik a khah ciangin kamsia pau hi.

examples.english: Do not swear at other people.
examples.zomi: Mi dangte kamsia tawh pau kei in.

senses.usage_en: Use swear at someone when offensive words are directed toward that person.
senses.usage_zomi: Kammal hoihlo mi khat tungah ngiat a kigen ciangin swear at someone ci in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A warm knitted piece of clothing worn on the upper body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tunglamah a kisilh, puankhui tawh a kikhui puan lum ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore a warm sweater in the cold weather.
examples.zomi: Khuahun vot laitakin sweater lum silh hi.

examples.english: This sweater was made from wool.
examples.zomi: Hih sweater pen tuumul tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, jumper is commonly used for this item. In American English, jumper usually means a different type of clothing.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah hih puan pen jumper ci in kizang zel hi. American English ah jumper in puan nam dang khat kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Clean with a broom
senses.definition_en: To clean a floor, path, or other surface by moving dirt away with a broom.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phiat tawh niin, leivui leh ninsakte paikhiat in innkuan, lampi ahih kei leh puatham khat siansuah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please sweep the kitchen floor.
examples.zomi: Ankuang innkuan phiat in.

examples.english: He swept the leaves from the path.
examples.zomi: Lampi tung singteh phiatsia hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle of sweep are both swept.
senses.usage_zomi: Sweep kammal past tense leh past participle a nihgelin swept ahi hi.

senses.heading: Move quickly and powerfully across an area
senses.definition_en: To move or spread quickly and powerfully across a place.
senses.zomi_equivalents: manlang takin kizel; thahat takin kantan
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat kantan in manlang leh thahat takin pai ahih kei leh kizel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A powerful storm swept across the region.
examples.zomi: Huihpi thahat khat in tua gam kantan hi.

examples.english: The fire swept through several buildings.
examples.zomi: Mei in inn pawlkhat manlang takin kang suk hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense is often used for fire, wind, storms, disease, emotions, or major social change.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna pen mei, huih, huihpi, cina, lungsim thu ahih kei leh mipite kikhelna lian tungah kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Having a sugary taste
senses.definition_en: Having a pleasant taste like sugar or honey.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sukha ahih kei leh khuaizu bangin a lim nop cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: These oranges are very sweet.
examples.zomi: Hih ser gahte lim mahmah hi.

examples.english: The tea is too sweet for me.
examples.zomi: Hih lakha pen kei ading limlua hi.

senses.usage_en: Sweet describes one of the basic tastes and is the opposite of bitter in many comparisons.
senses.usage_zomi: Sweet in a lim khuak a pulaak a, tehkakna tampi ah bitter tawh kikal hi.

senses.heading: Kind or pleasant
senses.definition_en: Kind, caring, attractive, or pleasant in a gentle way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tungah hoih, itna nei ahih kei leh lungsim nuamsak in kilawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: It was sweet of you to help her.
examples.zomi: Amah na panpih pen na hoih mahmah hi.

examples.english: The baby gave us a sweet smile.
examples.zomi: Naungek in nuihna nuam tawh hong nuihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: When used about a person or action, sweet is informal and expresses affection or approval.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh gamtatna tungah kizang ciangin sweet pen ngeina kampau hi a, itna ahih kei leh thukimpihna pulaak hi.

senses.definition_en: To move through water by moving the arms, legs, fins, or tail.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khut, khe, nga’ kha ahih kei leh mei zangu in tui sungah pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children swam across the pool.
examples.zomi: Naupangte tui kidopna kantan in kisu uh hi.

examples.english: I learned to swim when I was young.
examples.zomi: Ka naupan lai in tui kisu ka sin hi.

senses.usage_en: The forms are swim–swam–swum. Use swam for the simple past and swum after have, has, or had.
senses.usage_zomi: A kammal puakte swim–swam–swum ahi hi. Simple past ading swam zang a, have, has, ahih kei leh had nungah swum zang in.

senses.definition_en: The activity or sport of moving through water using the arms and legs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khut leh khe zangu in tui sungah pai kimawlna ahih kei leh gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Swimming is good exercise for the whole body.
examples.zomi: Tui kisuna pen pumpi khempeuh ading pumpi kimawlna hoih ahi hi.

examples.english: The children go swimming every Saturday.
examples.zomi: Naupangte Saturday simin tui kisu dingin pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Say go swimming, not normally play swimming. As an activity name, swimming is uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Go swimming ci in kizang a, ngeina ah play swimming ci lo hi. Gamtatna min in swimming pen simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Change from one thing to another
senses.definition_en: To stop using, doing, or choosing one thing and begin using, doing, or choosing another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat zat, bawl ahih kei leh teelna tawl in a dang khat zat, bawl ahih kei leh teel kipan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She switched to a different phone company.
examples.zomi: Phone kampani dang khat ah kikhel hi.

examples.english: Can we switch seats?
examples.zomi: Tutna i kikhel thei ding hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use switch from A to B when naming both the old and new choices.
senses.usage_zomi: A lui leh a thak a nihgel min a kigen ciangin switch from A to B ci in zang in.

senses.heading: Turn electrical equipment on or off
senses.definition_en: To start or stop an electrical device by operating its control.
senses.explanation_zomi: Meivak van khat a ukna suk in nasep kipan sak ahih kei leh khawl sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please switch off the lights before you leave.
examples.zomi: Na paima in meivakte khaksak in.

examples.english: He switched on the television.
examples.zomi: Television honsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Switch on/off is especially common in British English. American English also frequently uses turn on/off.
senses.usage_zomi: Switch on/off pen British English ah kizang mahmah hi. American English ah turn on/off zong kizang mahmah hi.

senses.definition_en: A sign, shape, object, or image that represents an idea, quality, organization, or something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, hoihna, pawl ahih kei leh na dang khat a aiawh lim, pianzia, van ahih kei leh lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The dove is often used as a symbol of peace.
examples.zomi: Vakhu pen kilemna lim in kizang zel hi.

examples.english: This symbol means that the material can be recycled.
examples.zomi: Hih lim in tua zatleh kizangkik thei cihna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A symbol represents something beyond its own physical form. A sign may also give direct information or instructions.
senses.usage_zomi: Symbol in ama puatham bek sangin a dang khat aiawh hi. Sign ahihleh thu ahih kei leh sawlna kician tak zong pia thei hi.

senses.heading: Care for someone who is suffering
senses.definition_en: A feeling of care and sadness for someone who is experiencing pain, loss, or difficulty.
senses.explanation_zomi: Natna, suplawhna ahih kei leh haksatna a thuak mi tungah veina leh khotuahna lungsim neihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We expressed our sympathy to the grieving family.
examples.zomi: A dah innkuan tungah ka khotuahna uh pulak ung.

examples.english: She felt great sympathy for the injured child.
examples.zomi: A liam naupang tungah khotuah mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Sympathy means caring about another person’s suffering. Empathy more specifically means understanding or sharing that person’s feelings.
senses.usage_zomi: Sympathy in midang’ thuakna tungah khotuahna neih cihna ahi hi. Empathy ahihleh tua mi lungsim bangin telh ahih kei leh thuakpih cihna kicianzaw ahi hi.

senses.heading: Agreement or support
senses.definition_en: Agreement with or support for an idea, cause, or group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, nasep ngiimna ahih kei leh pawl khat thukimpih leh panpihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The movement gained public sympathy.
examples.zomi: Tua kipawlna in mipite panpihna ngah hi.

examples.english: Many workers acted in sympathy with the protesters.
examples.zomi: Nasem tampi in langdona bawlte thukimpih in gamta uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, sympathy refers to shared views or support rather than sadness.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah sympathy in dahna hilo in, ngaihsutna kibang ahih kei leh panpihna kawk hi.

senses.heading: A sign of illness
senses.definition_en: A physical or mental change that may show that a person has an illness or medical condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in cina ahih kei leh zatui lam dinmun khat nei hihtuak cih a pulaak pumpi maw lungsim kikhelna ahi hi.

examples.english: A high fever can be a symptom of infection.
examples.zomi: Khua satna sang pen natna khuak omna lim ahi thei hi.

examples.english: Contact a doctor if the symptoms become severe.
examples.zomi: Cina limte hong na mahmah leh siavuan hopih in.

senses.usage_en: A symptom is experienced or noticed by the patient, while a medical sign can be observed or measured by another person.
senses.usage_zomi: Symptom pen cina in ama pumpi ah a theih ahih kei leh a phawk ahi a, zatui lam sign ahihleh midang in mu ahih kei leh teh thei hi.

senses.heading: An indication of a larger problem
senses.definition_en: A sign that a larger problem or undesirable condition exists.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina lianzaw ahih kei leh dinmun hoihlo khat om cih a kawkmuh lim ahi hi.

examples.english: Rising debt is a symptom of a deeper financial problem.
examples.zomi: Leiba khantohna pen sumvai buaina thukzaw khat omna lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The delays are symptoms of poor management.
examples.zomi: Hun sawtna te pen uksiamlohna lim ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes visible evidence of an underlying problem, not a medical condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in cina hilo in, buaina bulpi khat om cih a kilang teci kawk hi.

senses.heading: An organized set of connected parts
senses.definition_en: A group of connected parts that work together as a whole.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khen tuamtuam kizom in na khat bangin nasemkhawm pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The computer system stopped working.
examples.zomi: Computer kibawlna nasem nawnlo hi.

examples.english: The human body contains several complex systems.
examples.zomi: Mihing pumpi sungah kizopna pawl haksa tampi om hi.

senses.usage_en: A system consists of parts that interact; changing one part may affect the others.
senses.usage_zomi: System sungah khat leh khat kizom in a kizang khen tuamtuam om a, khen khat kikhelna in a dangte sukha thei hi.

senses.heading: An established method or set of rules
senses.definition_en: An organized method, procedure, or set of rules used to do or manage something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl ahih kei leh ukna dingin a kipsaksa lampi, kalsuan dan ahih kei leh thukhun pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The school introduced a new grading system.
examples.zomi: Sang in sangmat piakna bawldan thak khat zang kipan hi.

examples.english: We need a better system for keeping records.
examples.zomi: Record kemna ding bawldan hoihzaw kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, system refers to an organized way of doing something consistently.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah system in na khat kizui tawntung dingin a kipawlkhawm bawldan kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A light, casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, usually shaped like the letter T.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngawngkaw nei lo, a ban tom, T lai lim bang pianzia nei niteng silh puan zang ahi hi.

examples.english: He wore a white T-shirt and jeans.
examples.zomi: T-shirt kang leh jeans silh hi.

examples.english: The team’s name is printed on the T-shirt.
examples.zomi: T-shirt tungah tua pawl min kisuang hi.

senses.usage_en: T-shirt is normally written with a capital T and a hyphen.
senses.usage_zomi: T-shirt pen ngeina ah T lai lian leh hyphen tawh kigelh hi.

senses.heading: A piece of furniture
senses.definition_en: A piece of furniture with a flat top supported by legs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe nei a, van koihna ahih kei leh an nekna ding a tung nal nei inn sung van ahi hi.

examples.english: The family sat around the table for dinner.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in nitak an nek dingin dohkan kimah tu uh hi.

examples.english: She placed the books on the table.
examples.zomi: Laibute dohkan tungah koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Say at the table when someone is sitting there to eat or work, and on the table for something resting on its surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat dohkan ah tu in an ne ahih kei leh nasem cihna ah at the table zang in. Dohkan tungah van khat a om cihna ah on the table zang in.

senses.heading: Information arranged in rows and columns
senses.definition_en: Information or numbers arranged in horizontal rows and vertical columns.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thu kizemsakna; row leh column tawh gelhna
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih kei leh nambatte a pai phei leh a pai tung khen in kizemsakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The table shows the population of each region.
examples.zomi: Tua table in gam khen khat ciang mi omzah lak hi.

examples.english: Enter the results in the final column of the table.
examples.zomi: A ngahna pen table column nunung ah gelh in.

senses.usage_en: A table organizes exact information into cells. A chart usually presents information visually through lines, bars, or other shapes.
senses.usage_zomi: Table in thu kician cell sungah zem a, chart in line, bar ahih kei leh lim dangte tawh muhtheih dingin pulaak hi.

senses.heading: A portable touchscreen computer
senses.definition_en: A small, flat portable computer controlled mainly by touching its screen.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tablet computer; khutme tawh kizang computer
senses.explanation_zomi: A phei a, puahtheih, a screen khutme tawh suk in a kizang computer neu ahi hi.

examples.english: Students use tablets to read digital books.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in digital laibute sim dingin tablet zang uh hi.

examples.english: The tablet has a large touchscreen.
examples.zomi: Tua tablet in khutme tawh suk screen lian khat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A tablet is larger than most smartphones but generally smaller and lighter than a laptop.
senses.usage_zomi: Tablet pen smartphone a tamzaw sangin lianzaw a, laptop sangin neuzaw leh zangzaw hi.

senses.heading: A small piece of medicine
senses.definition_en: A small, firm piece of medicine that is swallowed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dolh in a kine zatui khau neu khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Take one tablet after each meal.
examples.zomi: An na nek khit simin zatui tang khat dolh in.

examples.english: The doctor prescribed these tablets for her infection.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ama natna khuak ading hih zatui tangte gelh hi.

senses.usage_en: Follow the medical instructions carefully; do not take more tablets than the stated amount.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatui zatdan sawlna pilvang takin zui in; a kigelh zah sangin zatui tang tamzaw dolh kei in.

senses.heading: An animal’s tail
senses.definition_en: The part that extends from the back end of an animal’s body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ganhing pumpi nunglam pan a hong zomkhia pumpi khen ahi hi.

examples.english: The dog wagged its tail when it saw us.
examples.zomi: Ui in kote hong muh ciangin a mei ling hi.

examples.english: The monkey used its tail to hold the branch.
examples.zomi: Zawng in singbak len dingin a mei zang hi.

senses.usage_en: Tail is also used for the rear part of an aircraft or another long object.
senses.usage_zomi: Tail pen vanleng nunglam ahih kei leh van sau khat a nunglam khen ading zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: The rear part of something
senses.definition_en: The back, rear, or narrow ending part of an object, group, or event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, pawl ahih kei leh thu piang khat a nunglam maw a tawpna neu zaw khen ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: at the tail of the group

examples.english: The aircraft’s tail was damaged.
examples.zomi: Vanleng nunglam a kisia hi.

examples.english: He walked at the tail of the group.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl nung tawp ah pai hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning develops from the idea of the rear end of an animal.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen ganhing pumpi nunglam a mei cih ngaihsutna pan hong piang hi.

senses.heading: Move or carry something somewhere
senses.definition_en: To carry or move someone or something from one place to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat mun khat pan mun dang khat ah pua cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please take these books to the library.
examples.zomi: Hih laibute library ah pua in.

examples.english: I will take the children home.
examples.zomi: Naupangte innah ka paipih ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Take usually describes movement away from the speaker’s present place. Bring normally describes movement toward the speaker or destination being emphasized.
senses.usage_zomi: Take in kampaupa omna pan na khat puakhia cihna a tamzaw in kawk hi. Bring in kampaupa ahih kei leh a kigen mun lamah pua hong cihna kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Receive, accept, or choose
senses.definition_en: To receive, accept, choose, or use something that is offered or available.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kipia ahih kei leh a om na khat sang, teel ahih kei leh zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She decided to take the new job.
examples.zomi: Nasep thak sang dingin khensat hi.

examples.english: You should take your doctor’s advice.
examples.zomi: Na siavuan ngaihsutna na zui ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact Zomi translation depends on what is being accepted, chosen, or received.
senses.usage_zomi: Zomi a khiatna taktak pen bang na kisang, kiteel ahih kei leh kila cih tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: Use transport or follow a route
senses.definition_en: To travel using a particular vehicle, road, or route.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw, bus, vanleng ahih kei leh lampi khat zang in khualzin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We took the bus to the city centre.
examples.zomi: Khuapi laizangah bus tawh pai ung.

examples.english: Take the next road on the left.
examples.zomi: Mailam vei lam lampi zui in.

senses.usage_en: English uses take with public transportation, while Zomi commonly expresses the idea as going by that vehicle.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah mipite khualzinna van tawh take kizang a, Zomi ah tua van tawh pai ci in kigen zel hi.

senses.heading: Require an amount of time
senses.definition_en: To require a particular amount of time, effort, or another resource.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat zohna dingin hun, hahkatna ahih kei leh a dang zat khat kisam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The journey takes about two hours.
examples.zomi: Tua khualzinna nai nih bang hun la hi.

examples.english: Learning a language takes time and practice.
examples.zomi: Pau khat sinna in hun leh kiilhna kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this pattern, the activity is usually the subject: The work takes three days.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih sentence pianzia ah nasep ahih kei leh gamtatna pen subject ahi zel hi: The work takes three days.

senses.definition_en: A story, especially one involving imaginary, traditional, or exciting events.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna bek, ngeina ahih kei leh lamdanghuai thu piangte tawh kisai tangthu khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Her grandfather told an old folk tale.
examples.zomi: A pupak in ngeina tangthu lui khat gen hi.

examples.english: The book contains tales of courage and adventure.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu sungah hangsanna leh khualzinna lamdang tangthute om hi.

senses.usage_en: Tale often suggests a traditional or imaginative story. Story is the broader and more common word.
senses.usage_zomi: Tale in ngeina ahih kei leh ngaihsutna tawh kibawl tangthu kawk zel hi. Story pen a huamzaw leh a kizangzaw kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Natural ability
senses.definition_en: A natural ability to do something well.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hoih takin bawl theihna pianpih siamna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a natural talent for music.
examples.zomi: Amah la lamah pianpih siamna nei hi.

examples.english: Practice helped him develop his talent.
examples.zomi: Kiilhna in a siamna khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use talent for + noun or -ing form: a talent for art; a talent for solving problems.
senses.usage_zomi: Talent for + noun/-ing ci in zang in: a talent for art; a talent for solving problems.

senses.heading: Talented people collectively
senses.definition_en: People who have valuable abilities, especially in an organization or industry.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl ahih kei leh nasepna khen khat sungah siamna thupi a nei mite ahi hi.

examples.english: The company is trying to attract new talent.
examples.zomi: Kampani in mi siam thakte kaikhawm ding hahkat hi.

examples.english: The show gives young talent an opportunity.
examples.zomi: Tua program in mi siam khangnote hunhoih pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this collective sense, talent refers to skilled people rather than an ability.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pawlkhatna khiatna ah talent in siamna hilo in, siamna a nei mite kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a natural ability to do something very well.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat hoih mahmah in bawl theihna pianpih siamna a nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a talented young artist.
examples.zomi: Amah lim suai siam khangno khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The team has several talented players.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl sungah kimawl siam pawlkhat om hi.

senses.usage_en: Use talented at/in for an area of skill and talented in doing something when describing an activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Siamsinna khen khat tawh talented at/in zang a, gamtatna a kigen ciangin talented in doing something zang in.

senses.heading: Speak or have a conversation
senses.definition_en: To speak to someone or exchange ideas and information through conversation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tawh paukhawm ahih kei leh kihona tawh ngaihsutna leh thu kikoppih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I need to talk to you about the project.
examples.zomi: Tua project thu nang tawh kikum kul hi.

examples.english: They talked for several hours.
examples.zomi: Amaute nai pawlkhat sung kikum uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Both talk to and talk with are correct. Talk with can emphasize a two-way conversation.
senses.usage_zomi: Talk to leh talk with a nihgel man hi. Talk with in khat leh khat kihona neihkhawmna thupisak thei hi.

senses.heading: Give information in a talk
senses.definition_en: To speak formally or informally to a group about a subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat mai ah thulu khat tawh kisai in kampau ahih kei leh hilh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor talked about healthy eating.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in cidamna tawh kituak annekdan thu gen hi.

examples.english: She talked to the students about career choices.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te tungah nasep nuntakna teelna thu gen hi.

senses.usage_en: For a formal presentation, English often uses give a talk rather than simply talk.
senses.usage_zomi: Picingzaw kampau khat ading English ah talk bek sangin give a talk kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a greater than average height.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina sangin a sangzaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her brother is very tall.
examples.zomi: A sanggampa sang mahmah hi.

examples.english: Tall trees surrounded the house.
examples.zomi: Sing sangte in tua inn kimkot hi.

senses.usage_en: Use tall mainly for people and things that are high and relatively narrow, such as trees or buildings. Use high for measurements or positions above the ground.
senses.usage_zomi: Tall pen mite leh singkung maw inn bang a tunglamah sau nate ading kizang zel hi. Tehna ahih kei leh leitung pan a sang munte ading high zang in.

senses.heading: A large container
senses.definition_en: A large container used to store liquid or gas.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui, sathau ahih kei leh gas koihna ding bawm lian ahi hi.

examples.english: The house has a large water tank.
examples.zomi: Tua inn in tui bawm lian khat nei hi.

examples.english: We filled the car’s fuel tank.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw meisi bawm dimsak ung.

senses.usage_en: The material stored is commonly placed before tank: water tank, fuel tank, or gas tank.
senses.usage_zomi: A sungah a kikoih zatleh min pen tank mai ah kician sak in kizang zel hi: water tank, fuel tank, leh gas tank.

senses.heading: An armoured military vehicle
senses.definition_en: A heavy armoured military vehicle with tracks and a large gun.
senses.explanation_zomi: A khauh tawh kidaal, khe-leeng sau nei a, meithal lian tawh a kithuam galkap mawtaw gik ahi hi.

examples.english: The army moved several tanks toward the border.
examples.zomi: Galkapte in tank pawlkhat gamgi lamah paipih uh hi.

examples.english: The old tank is displayed in the museum.
examples.zomi: Tank lui pen museum sungah kimuhsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Context normally makes it clear whether tank means a container or a military vehicle.
senses.usage_zomi: Sentence sung a thu kizomna in tank pen bawm maw galkap mawtaw cih kician sak zel hi.

senses.heading: A narrow strip of material
senses.definition_en: A long, narrow strip of material, often with a sticky side, used for joining, fastening, or covering things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van kizomsak, kipsak ahih kei leh khuhna ding a kizang, a phei a sau zatleh ahi hi.

examples.english: Use tape to close the box.
examples.zomi: Bawm khakna dingin kabeel zang in.

examples.english: She fixed the torn paper with tape.
examples.zomi: Lai a beek pen kabeel tawh bawlhoih hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses tape where British English may use the general term sticky tape.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah tape ci in kizang zel a, British English ah sticky tape ci in kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Material for recording sound or pictures
senses.definition_en: Magnetic material formerly used for recording sound or video, or a recording stored on it.
senses.zomi_equivalents: aw khumna tape; video khumna tape
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw ahih kei leh video khumkhumna ding a kizang magnetic zatleh ahih kei leh a tungah kikhumsa ahi hi.

examples.english: The interview was recorded on tape.
examples.zomi: Interview pen tape tungah kikhum hi.

examples.english: He found an old tape of his father singing.
examples.zomi: A pa la sakna kikhum tape lui khat mu hi.

senses.usage_en: Digital recording has replaced tape in many situations, but the word remains common in references to older recordings.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun tampi ah digital khumkhumna in tape laaksak khinta napi, khumsa lui a kigen ciangin hih kammal kizang lai hi.

senses.heading: A result you intend to achieve
senses.definition_en: A result, amount, or level that a person or organization plans to achieve.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat in a tangtun dingin a ngiimsa ngahna, zat ahih kei leh dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The company reached its annual sales target.
examples.zomi: Kampani in kum khat zuakna ngiimzah tangtun hi.

examples.english: Set a realistic target for your studies.
examples.zomi: Na sinna ading tangtun theih ngiimna khat koih in.

senses.usage_en: A target is a specific result to reach. A goal may be broader or longer-term.
senses.usage_zomi: Target pen tangtun ding ngahna kician khat ahi hi. Goal ahihleh a huamzaw ahih kei leh hun sauzaw ngiimna ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: A person or object selected for attack or attention
senses.definition_en: A person, place, or object that someone intends to attack, hit, criticize, or influence.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kap ding ngiimna; sim ding a kiteel
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in sim, kap, mawhsak ahih kei leh huzaap dingin a teel mi, mun ahih kei leh van ahi hi.

examples.english: The arrow hit the centre of the target.
examples.zomi: Thal in ngiimna laizang kapkha hi.

examples.english: The website became a target for criminals.
examples.zomi: Tua website pen mawhbawlte sim ding ngiimna hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Target can be literal, as in shooting, or figurative, as in criticism, crime, advertising, or political campaigning.
senses.usage_zomi: Target pen kapna ah taktak in kizang thei a, mawhsakna, mawhbawlna, advertise ahih kei leh gamvai kampan ah gentehna in zong kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A particular piece of work that must be done, especially as part of a job, duty, or course of study.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, mopohna ahih kei leh sinna sungah bawl ding a kipia nasep kician khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Each student was given a different task.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang khat ciangin nasep kibanglo kipia hi.

examples.english: We completed the task before noon.
examples.zomi: Sunlai ma in tua nasep zota ung.

senses.usage_en: A task is usually one specific piece of work. A job may mean either a particular duty or a person’s regular paid employment.
senses.usage_zomi: Task pen nasep kician khat ahi zel hi. Job ahihleh nasep kician khat kawk thei a, mi khat sum tawh a sem ngeina nasep zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: The flavour of food or drink
senses.definition_en: The quality or flavour that food or drink produces in the mouth.
senses.explanation_zomi: An ahih kei leh dawnna nek leh dawn ciangin kam sungah a kithei khuak ahi hi.

examples.english: The soup has a rich taste.
examples.zomi: Tua sup khuak nuam mahmah hi.

examples.english: I do not like the bitter taste of this medicine.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui a kha khuak ka deih kei hi.

senses.usage_en: Taste is the general experience of flavour. Words such as sweet, sour, salty, and bitter describe particular tastes.
senses.usage_zomi: Taste in an khuak a huamkim in kawk hi. Sweet, sour, salty, leh bitter bang kammalte in khuak tuamtuam pulaak hi.

senses.heading: A small amount tried
senses.definition_en: A small amount of food or drink taken to discover its flavour.
senses.explanation_zomi: An ahih kei leh dawnna khuak theihna dingin a tawmno nek ahih kei leh dawnna ahi hi.

examples.english: Would you like a taste of the cake?
examples.zomi: Tua cake tawmno na khuak nuam hiam?

examples.english: She gave me a taste of the sauce.
examples.zomi: Sauce tawmno hong khuak sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Have a taste means to try a small amount, not to eat the whole serving.
senses.usage_zomi: Have a taste cih pen a tawmno nek-et cihna ahi a, a vekpi nek cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Preference in art, clothing, or lifestyle
senses.definition_en: A person’s preference or judgment concerning style, art, music, clothing, or similar areas.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in puatham, lim, la, puansilh ahih kei leh nuntakdan sungah bang deihzaw cih a teelna lungsim ahi hi.

examples.english: She has excellent taste in clothes.
examples.zomi: Puansilh teelna ah siam mahmah hi.

examples.english: Our tastes in music are different.
examples.zomi: La deihdan kibanglo ung.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, taste refers to preferences, not the physical sense in the mouth.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah taste in kam sung khuakna hilo in, mi khat deihdan kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Money that people or businesses are legally required to pay to a government.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite ahih kei leh sum nasepte in thukhun bangin kumpi tungah piak ding sum ahi hi.

examples.english: Workers pay tax on their income.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in a sumlut uh tungah siah pia uh hi.

examples.english: The government increased the tax on cigarettes.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in cigarette tung siah khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Tax can be uncountable when referring generally to taxation, but it is countable when referring to a particular kind: an income tax; several taxes.
senses.usage_zomi: Siah thu a huamkim in a kigen ciangin tax simthamlo ahi thei hi. Siah nam kician a kigen ciangin simtheih hi: an income tax; several taxes.

senses.definition_en: A car with a driver that carries passengers for payment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum pia in khualzin mite a paipih, driver nei mawtaw ahi hi.

examples.english: We took a taxi to the airport.
examples.zomi: Vanleng tualah taxi tawh pai ung.

examples.english: The taxi driver helped us with our bags.
examples.zomi: Taxi hawlpa in ka sum-ipte uh hong pua sak hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, people may also say cab. In American English, both taxi and cab are common.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah cab zong kici thei hi. American English ah taxi leh cab a nihgel kizang hi.

senses.heading: A drink made from tea leaves
senses.definition_en: A hot or cold drink made by soaking dried tea leaves in water.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lakha tehkhaute tui sungah ciah in a kibawl dawnna lum ahih kei leh vot ahi hi.

examples.english: Would you like a cup of tea?
examples.zomi: Lakha hai khat na dawn nuam hiam?

examples.english: She drinks tea without sugar.
examples.zomi: Sukha beh loin lakha dawn hi.

senses.usage_en: Tea is uncountable when referring to the drink generally. Use a cup of tea for one serving.
senses.usage_zomi: Dawnna a huamkim in a kigen ciangin tea simthamlo min kammal ahi hi. Khatvei dawnzah ading a cup of tea zang in.

senses.heading: A light meal
senses.definition_en: A light meal eaten in the afternoon or evening, especially in British usage.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nitak an tawm; lakha tawh an nekna
senses.explanation_zomi: British kampau ngeina ah nitaklam ahih kei leh nitak an tawmin a kine an ahi hi.

examples.english: They served sandwiches for afternoon tea.
examples.zomi: Nitaklam lakha dawnna ah sandwich hong pia uh hi.

examples.english: The children had tea at five o’clock.
examples.zomi: Naupangte nai nga ciangin nitak an tawm ne uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This meal-related meaning is especially common in British English and varies by region.
senses.usage_zomi: An tawh kisai hih khiatna pen British English ah kizangzaw a, gam khen tuamtuam ah zatdan kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: Help someone learn
senses.definition_en: To help someone learn a subject, skill, or way of doing something by explaining or demonstrating it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, siamna ahih kei leh bawldan khat mi khat in a theihna dingin hilh leh lak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She teaches mathematics at a secondary school.
examples.zomi: Amah secondary school ah mathematics hilh hi.

examples.english: My father taught me how to drive.
examples.zomi: Ka pa in mawtaw hawldan hong sinsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use teach someone something or teach someone to do something. Do not confuse teach with learn: teachers teach; students learn.
senses.usage_zomi: Teach someone something ahih kei leh teach someone to do something ci in zang in. Teach leh learn khial kei in: sia in hilh a, sangnaupang in sin hi.

senses.heading: Cause someone to learn from experience
senses.definition_en: To make someone understand a lesson through experience or consequences.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang ahih kei leh a gamtatna sulzui tungtawnin mi khat pilna ngah sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The mistake taught him an important lesson.
examples.zomi: Tua khialhna in amah pilna thupi khat pia hi.

examples.english: Caring for children teaches patience.
examples.zomi: Naupang kemna in thuakzawhna hong sinsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the teacher may be an experience, mistake, or difficult situation rather than a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah sinsakpa pen mi hilo in, thu piang, khialhna ahih kei leh dinmun haksa ahi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A person whose job is to help students learn, especially in a school.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in sangsungah sangnaupang-te pilna leh siamna a hilh mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Our teacher explained the lesson clearly.
examples.zomi: Ka sia uh in tua sinna ciangtak in hong hilh hi.

examples.english: She wants to become a science teacher.
examples.zomi: Amah science sia suak nuam hi.

senses.usage_en: A teacher usually teaches regularly as a profession. An instructor often teaches a particular practical skill or course.
senses.usage_zomi: Teacher in ngeina nasep in sinna hilh zel hi. Instructor in siamna kician ahih kei leh course khat hilh zel hi.

senses.heading: The work or activity of teaching
senses.definition_en: The work, profession, or activity of helping people learn.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite pilna leh siamna ngahna dingin hilhna nasep, nghề ahih kei leh gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has ten years of teaching experience.
examples.zomi: Amah kum sawm sung hilhna phutkhak nei hi.

examples.english: Good teaching requires patience and preparation.
examples.zomi: Hilhna hoih in thuakzawhna leh kigingkholna kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to the profession or activity generally, teaching is uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Sia nasep ahih kei leh hilhna gamtatna a huamkim in a kigen ciangin teaching simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Ideas or principles taught by someone
senses.definition_en: An idea, belief, or set of principles taught by a person, religion, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, biakna ahih kei leh pawl khat in a hilh ngaihsutna, upna ahih kei leh thukhun pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: The teaching emphasizes love and forgiveness.
examples.zomi: Tua thuhilhna in itna leh mawh maisakna thupisak hi.

examples.english: Students discussed the philosopher’s teachings.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in tua pilosopa thuhilhnate kikum uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the plural teachings for a collection of doctrines or principles taught by a person or tradition.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh ngeina khat in a hilh upna leh thukhun pawl khempeuh ading plural teachings zang in.

senses.heading: A group that plays together
senses.definition_en: A group of people who play a sport or game together against another group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna ah pawl dang khat tawh a kidem in a kimawlkhawm mi pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: Our team won the final match.
examples.zomi: Ka kimawl pawl un nunungpen kidemna zo uh hi.

examples.english: She is the captain of the school basketball team.
examples.zomi: Amah sang basketball pawl makaipa ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, a team is usually treated as singular: The team is winning. British English may also treat it as plural: The team are winning.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah team pen singular in kizang zel hi: The team is winning. British English ah plural in The team are winning ci thei hi.

senses.heading: A group working together
senses.definition_en: A group of people who work together to achieve a shared purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna kibang khat tangtun dingin nasepkhawm mi pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: A medical team treated the injured passengers.
examples.zomi: Zatui pawl in a liam khualzinte bawl uh hi.

examples.english: We must work together as a team.
examples.zomi: Pawl khat bangin nasemkhawm kul hi.

senses.usage_en: A team normally has a shared task or goal, while a general group may simply consist of people gathered together.
senses.usage_zomi: Team in nasep ahih kei leh ngiimna khat nei khawm zel a, group ahihleh mi kikaikhawm bek zong ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Damage by pulling apart
senses.definition_en: To pull paper, cloth, or another material apart or damage it by making a split or hole.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, puan ahih kei leh zatleh dang khat kai in beek, keh ahih kei leh vangbawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Be careful not to tear the paper.
examples.zomi: Tua lai na beeklohna dingin pilvang in.

examples.english: He tore his shirt on a sharp branch.
examples.zomi: Singbak hiam in a puan a beek hi.

senses.usage_en: The forms are tear–tore–torn. This verb is pronounced /tɛr/, differently from the noun tear /tɪr/, meaning a drop from the eye.
senses.usage_zomi: A kammal puakte tear–tore–torn ahi hi. Hih verb pen /tɛr/ ci in kisuang a, mit pan a luang mittui tang a cihna noun tear /tɪr/ tawh aw kibanglo hi.

senses.heading: Move somewhere very quickly
senses.definition_en: To move or travel somewhere very quickly and without much care.
senses.zomi_equivalents: manlang takin tai; nawk takin pai
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilvang lua loin mun khat lamah manlang mahmah in tai ahih kei leh pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The car tore down the road at high speed.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw pen lampi tungah nawk mahmah in pai hi.

examples.english: The children tore across the field.
examples.zomi: Naupangte loh kantan in manlang takin tai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal sense emphasizes great speed and sometimes careless movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih ngeina kampau khiatna in manlang mahmah cih leh khatvei ciang pilvanglo takin gamta cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Relating to specialized knowledge or practical skills
senses.definition_en: Connected with the specialized knowledge, methods, or skills used in science, industry, or a particular activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Science, van bawlna ahih kei leh nasep kician khat sung a kisam pilna, bawldan leh siamna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The job requires technical knowledge.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep in siamna lam pilna kisam hi.

examples.english: Students receive technical training at the college.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in college ah siamna sinna ngah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Technical often describes specialized knowledge that may be difficult for people outside the field to understand.
senses.usage_zomi: Technical in a tamzaw in pilna khen khat sung mi hilo te telh ding haksat thei siamna tuamvilvel kawk hi.

senses.heading: Relating to equipment or its operation
senses.definition_en: Connected with machines, equipment, computer systems, or the practical operation of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine, vanzat, computer system ahih kei leh na khat koibang in nasem cih tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The broadcast stopped because of a technical problem.
examples.zomi: Vanzat lam buaina hangin broadcast tawl hi.

examples.english: Contact technical support if the computer fails.
examples.zomi: Computer nasemlo leh vanzat lam panpih pawl hopih in.

senses.usage_en: A technical problem concerns equipment or a system rather than the main content or purpose of an activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Technical problem in gamtatna khat a thu bulpi ahih kei leh ngiimna hilo in, vanzat maw system buaina kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A particular and often skilled way of doing an activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih kei leh gamtatna khat siam takin bawlna ding bawldan kician khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The coach taught us a new training technique.
examples.zomi: Coach in kiilhna bawldan thak khat hong sinsak hi.

examples.english: This painting technique requires careful practice.
examples.zomi: Hih lim suaihdan in pilvang takin kiilhna kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: A technique is a specific method of performing an activity, usually one that can be learned and improved through practice.
senses.usage_zomi: Technique pen gamtatna khat bawlna ding bawldan kician hi a, sinna leh kiilhna tawh hoih semsem saktheih hi.

senses.heading: Scientific knowledge used practically
senses.definition_en: Scientific knowledge and methods used to create tools, machines, systems, and practical solutions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanzat, machine, system leh buaina vengna lampite bawlna dingin a kizang science pilna leh bawldante ahi hi.

examples.english: Modern technology has changed how people communicate.
examples.zomi: Tulai technology in mite kizopna dan kikhel sak hi.

examples.english: Medical technology can help doctors detect disease early.
examples.zomi: Zatui technology in siavuan-te cina a masiah muh theihna panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Technology is usually uncountable when referring generally to a field or the practical use of science.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna khen ahih kei leh science a kizangna a huamkim in a kigen ciangin technology simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: A particular technological tool or system
senses.definition_en: A particular machine, system, method, or group of tools developed through scientific knowledge.
senses.zomi_equivalents: technology vanzat; pilna tawh kibawl system
senses.explanation_zomi: Science pilna tawh a kibawl machine, system, bawldan ahih kei leh vanzat pawl kician khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The company developed a new battery technology.
examples.zomi: Kampani in battery technology thak khat bawlkhia hi.

examples.english: Farmers are using technologies that save water.
examples.zomi: Lothote in tui a hawmsiam technology vanzatte zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to separate tools or systems, the plural technologies is possible.
senses.usage_zomi: Vanzat ahih kei leh system tuamtuam a kigen ciangin plural technologies ci thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to people who are between thirteen and nineteen years old.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khangno tawh kisai; kum sawmlethum pan sawmlekua kikal
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sawm leh thum pan kum sawm leh kua kikal khangnote tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He developed an interest in music during his teenage years.
examples.zomi: A khangno kumte sungin la deihna hong nei hi.

examples.english: The program provides support for teenage parents.
examples.zomi: Tua program in khangno nulehpate panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Teenage is an adjective. Use the noun teenager for a person aged thirteen to nineteen.
senses.usage_zomi: Teenage pen adjective ahi hi. Kum sawm leh thum pan sawm leh kua kikal mi khat ading noun teenager zang in.

senses.definition_en: A person who is between thirteen and nineteen years old.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khangno; kum sawmlethum pan sawmlekua kikal mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum sawm leh thum pan kum sawm leh kua kikal a pha mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Many teenagers use social media every day.
examples.zomi: Khangno tampi in social media niteng zang uh hi.

examples.english: She became interested in science as a teenager.
examples.zomi: Khangno a hih lai in science hong lunglut hi.

senses.usage_en: The word refers to ages ending in -teen, from thirteen through nineteen.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kammal in English nambat min -teen tawh a tawp, kum sawm leh thum pan sawm leh kua dong kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A device or communication system used for speaking to someone in another place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun dangah a om mi khat tawh kigamla pan kihona ding a kizang vanzat ahih kei leh kizopna system ahi hi.

examples.english: The telephone rang during dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak an ka nek laitakun telephone ging hi.

examples.english: Please give me your telephone number.
examples.zomi: Na telephone nambat hong pia in.

senses.usage_en: Phone is the more common word in everyday English. Telephone may sound more formal or refer to the communication system generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Niteng English kampau ah phone kizangzaw hi. Telephone pen picingzaw kammal bangin ging thei a, kizopna system a huamkim in zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: The system or medium
senses.definition_en: A system for broadcasting moving pictures and sound to people’s homes or devices.
senses.zomi_equivalents: television; lim leh aw puakna system
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim kalsuan leh aw mipite inn ahih kei leh vanzat tungah a puaksak broadcast system ahi hi.

examples.english: The ceremony was shown on television.
examples.zomi: Tua pawi television tungah kimuhsak hi.

examples.english: Television changed how people received news.
examples.zomi: Television in mite thuthang ngahdan kikhel sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use on television, not normally in television, when referring to a program being broadcast.
senses.usage_zomi: Program khat broadcast ah a ki-et cihna ah on television zang a, ngeina ah in television ci lo hi.

senses.heading: A device for watching programs
senses.definition_en: An electronic device with a screen used for watching programs, films, or other video.
senses.explanation_zomi: Program, film ahih kei leh video etna ding screen nei electronic vanzat ahi hi.

examples.english: They bought a new television for the living room.
examples.zomi: Inn sung omkhopna khaan ading television thak khat lei uh hi.

examples.english: Please turn off the television before you leave.
examples.zomi: Na paima in television khaksak in.

senses.usage_en: When referring to the activity, say watch television. When referring to the device, an article is normally used: a television or the television.
senses.usage_zomi: Etna gamtatna a kigen ciangin watch television ci in zang in. Vanzat a kigen ciangin a television ahih kei leh the television ci in article zang in.

senses.heading: Give information to someone
senses.definition_en: To give someone information by speaking or writing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kampau ahih kei leh laigelhna tawh mi khat tungah thu pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please tell me what happened.
examples.zomi: Bang piang cih hong gen in.

examples.english: She told her family the good news.
examples.zomi: A innkuan tungah lungdamhuai thu gen hi.

senses.usage_en: Use tell someone something: Tell me the answer. Use say something to someone: Say the answer to me.
senses.usage_zomi: Tell someone something ci in zang in: Tell me the answer. Say tawh ahihleh say something to someone ci in zang in: Say the answer to me.

senses.heading: Give an instruction or order
senses.definition_en: To instruct or order someone to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat na khat bawl dingin sawl ahih kei leh thupia cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat pai lo ding sawl

examples.english: The teacher told the students to sit down.
examples.zomi: Sia in sangnaupang-te tu dingin sawl hi.

examples.english: I told him not to open the door.
examples.zomi: Kong hong kei dingin ka sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use tell someone to do something. Do not use tell to do something without naming the person.
senses.usage_zomi: Tell someone to do something ci in zang in. Mi a kigenlo in tell to do something ci kei in.

senses.heading: Recognize or know the difference
senses.definition_en: To recognize, discover, or know something, especially a difference between similar things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na kibangte khen thei, phawk ahih kei leh theikha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you tell the difference between these two colours?
examples.zomi: Hih a puam nihte kibatlohna na khen thei hiam?

examples.english: It is difficult to tell whether he is serious.
examples.zomi: Amah thudik takin pau maw cih theih ding haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, tell means recognize or determine, not speak.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah tell in pau cih hilo in, theikha ahih kei leh khen thei cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A measure of heat or cold
senses.definition_en: The measured degree of how hot or cold something is.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lum leh vot tehna; khuahun lumzah
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bangzah lum ahih kei leh vot cih a tehna ahi hi.

examples.english: The temperature fell below freezing last night.
examples.zomi: Zan in khuahun lumzah tui a kikhal theih zah nuai ah tu hi.

examples.english: Store the medicine at room temperature.
examples.zomi: Tua zatui innkhan lumzah ah koih in.

senses.usage_en: Temperature may be measured in degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit.
senses.usage_zomi: Lum leh vot tehna pen Celsius ahih kei leh Fahrenheit degree tawh kiteh thei hi.

senses.heading: Body temperature
senses.definition_en: The measured heat of a person’s or animal’s body, especially as an indication of illness.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in cina lim etna ding, mihing ahih kei leh ganhing pumpi lumzah a kitehna ahi hi.

examples.english: The nurse took the child’s temperature.
examples.zomi: Nurse in naupang pumpi lumzah teh hi.

examples.english: He has a high temperature and needs to rest.
examples.zomi: A khua sat mahmah a, tawlngak kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, have a temperature commonly means to have a fever. American English more often uses have a fever.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah have a temperature in khua sat cihna ahi zel hi. American English ah have a fever kizangzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Existing, working, or lasting for only a limited period.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sawtlou sung; hun tom sung bek
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tom sung bek om, nasem ahih kei leh kizang ding cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She found a temporary job for the summer.
examples.zomi: Khuakhal sung ading sawtlou sung nasep khat mu hi.

examples.english: This repair is only a temporary solution.
examples.zomi: Hih bawlhoihna pen hun tom sung vengna bek ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Temporary is the opposite of permanent. It describes something intended to end or change.
senses.usage_zomi: Temporary pen permanent tawh kikal hi. Tua na pen a tawp ahih kei leh a kikhel dingin a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 10.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat sawm, kua khit leh sawm leh khat mai a om nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: Ten is an even number.
examples.zomi: Sawm pen nambat nih tawh khenkhia theih ahi hi.

examples.english: The judge gave her performance ten out of ten.
examples.zomi: Thukhenpa in ama bawlna sawm sung sawm pia hi.

senses.usage_en: As a number before a noun, ten functions as a determiner: ten books. It can function as a noun when referring to the number itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kammal mai ah nambat in a kizang ciangin ten pen determiner ahi hi: ten books. Nambat mahmah a kigen ciangin noun ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Usually behave or happen in a particular way
senses.definition_en: To usually behave in a certain way or be likely to happen in a particular manner.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatdan khat nei zel ahih kei leh thu khat tua bangin piang zel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Young children tend to ask many questions.
examples.zomi: Naupangno-te dotna tampi dong zel uh hi.

examples.english: Prices tend to rise during the holiday season.
examples.zomi: Pawi hun sungin vanman khang zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Use tend to + verb: tend to worry, tend to increase. It describes a general pattern, not something that happens every time.
senses.usage_zomi: Tend to + verb ci in zang in: tend to worry, tend to increase. Hih in a piang zel dan kawk a, khatvei simin piang takpi cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: Care for someone or something
