senses.definition_en: To care for a person, animal, plant, or place and give it the attention it needs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing, singkung ahih kei leh mun khat a kisapna bangin kem leh enkol cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She stayed home to tend her sick mother.
examples.zomi: A nu cina kem dingin innah om hi.

examples.english: Farmers tend their crops carefully.
examples.zomi: Lothote in a loh sung nektheihte pilvang takin enkol uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is more formal than care for or look after.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen care for ahih kei leh look after sangin kammal picingzaw ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A sport in which players use rackets to hit a ball over a net.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tennis kimawlna; racket leh ball kimawlna
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlte in racket tawh ball len tung kantan in a kibengkhia kimawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: We play tennis every Saturday morning.
examples.zomi: Saturday zingsang simin tennis kimawl ung.

examples.english: She won the tennis match in two sets.
examples.zomi: Tennis kidemna set nih sungin zo hi.

senses.usage_en: Say play tennis, without an article before the name of the sport.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna min mai ah article koih loin play tennis ci in zang in.

senses.definition_en: A portable shelter made of cloth or similar material stretched over poles and held by ropes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan ahih kei leh zatleh a kibang tawh khuam tungah zam a, khau tawh kipsak in puahtheih buk ahi hi.

examples.english: We put up our tent beside the lake.
examples.zomi: Tua dil geiah ka puanbuk uh lam ung.

examples.english: Four people can sleep in this tent.
examples.zomi: Hih buk sungah mi li ihmu thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use put up/pitch a tent for setting it up and take down a tent for removing it.
senses.usage_zomi: Buk lamna ading put up/pitch a tent zang a, buk phiatna ading take down a tent zang in.

senses.heading: A word or expression with a particular meaning
senses.definition_en: A word or phrase used to describe a particular idea, object, or subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, van ahih kei leh thulu kician khat minvawhna ding a kizang kammal maw kammal pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: “Climate” is a scientific term.
examples.zomi: “Climate” pen science lam kammal khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher explained the meaning of the new term.
examples.zomi: Sia in kammal thak a khiatna hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: A term often belongs to a particular field and may have a more precise meaning than an ordinary word.
senses.usage_zomi: Term pen pilna khen khat sungah kizang zel a, kammal ngeina sangin khiatna kicianzaw nei thei hi.

senses.heading: A period of time
senses.definition_en: A fixed or limited period during which something continues or a person holds a position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a omzomna ahih kei leh mi khat in dinmun a luahna hun ciangtansa ahi hi.

examples.english: The president began a second term in office.
examples.zomi: President in dinmun luah hun nihna kipan hi.

examples.english: We need both short-term and long-term solutions.
examples.zomi: Hun tom leh hun sau ading vengna a nihgel kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Short-term and long-term are hyphenated when used before a noun: a long-term plan.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kammal mai ah adjective in a kizang ciangin short-term leh long-term hyphen tawh kigelh hi: a long-term plan.

senses.heading: A division of the school year
senses.definition_en: One of the periods into which a school or university year is divided.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sang ahih kei leh university kum khat sung a kikhen sinna hun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The new school term begins in August.
examples.zomi: Sang term thak August kha in kipan hi.

examples.english: Students take examinations at the end of the term.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te term tawp ciangin sittelna nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: School systems divide the year differently, so a term may vary in length.
senses.usage_zomi: Sang system tuamtuam in kum khat kikhenna kibanglo ahih manin term khat a sau daih kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: A condition in an agreement
senses.definition_en: A rule or condition that forms part of an agreement or arrangement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukimna ahih kei leh geelkhopna khat sung a kihel thukhun maw zuih ding ahi hi.

examples.english: Please read the terms before signing the contract.
examples.zomi: Contract na min gelh ma in thukhunte sim in.

examples.english: Both sides agreed to the payment terms.
examples.zomi: Khat leh khatgel in sum piakdan thukhunte thukimpih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is commonly plural: terms and conditions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen plural in terms and conditions ci in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Extremely bad
senses.definition_en: Extremely bad, unpleasant, or of very poor quality.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihlo, nuamlo ahih kei leh a dinmun sia mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The food tasted terrible.
examples.zomi: Tua an khuak sia mahmah hi.

examples.english: I made a terrible mistake.
examples.zomi: Khialhna sia mahmah khat ka bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, terrible is a strong negative adjective and is often stronger than bad.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina English kampau ah terrible pen hoihlo mahmah cihna khauhtak hi a, bad sangin khauh zaw hi.

senses.heading: Causing fear, pain, or great suffering
senses.definition_en: Very serious and causing fear, pain, shock, or suffering.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuai, natna, lamdang sakna ahih kei leh thuakna lian a piangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A terrible accident occurred on the highway.
examples.zomi: Highway tungah accident lauhuai mahmah khat piang hi.

examples.english: She suffered terrible pain after the injury.
examples.zomi: A liam khit ciangin natna na mahmah thuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Context shows whether terrible means very poor in quality or extremely serious and distressing.
senses.usage_zomi: Sentence sung thu kizomna in terrible pen hoihlo mahmah maw, lauhuai leh lungkhamhuai mahmah cih kician sak hi.

senses.heading: An examination of knowledge or ability
senses.definition_en: A set of questions or activities used to measure someone’s knowledge, skill, or ability.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pilna, siamna ahih kei leh bawltheihna tehna ding dotna ahih kei leh gamtatna pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: We have an English test tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing ciangin English sittelna nei ding ung.

examples.english: She passed the driving test.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawltheihna sittelna gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, students commonly take a test. In British English, they may also sit a test.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah sangnaupang-te take a test ci uh hi. British English ah sit a test zong ci thei uh hi.

senses.heading: A medical or scientific examination
senses.definition_en: A procedure used to discover information about health, a material, a product, or a scientific question.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cidamna, zatleh, van kibawl ahih kei leh science dotna khat tawh kisai thu theihna ding a kibawl sittelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor ordered a blood test.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in sisan sittel ding sawl hi.

examples.english: Laboratory tests confirmed that the water was safe.
examples.zomi: Laboratory sittelnate in tua tui bit cih kipsak hi.

senses.usage_en: The type of test is normally named before test: blood test, safety test, or laboratory test.
senses.usage_zomi: Sittelna nam pen test mai ah kigen zel hi: blood test, safety test, leh laboratory test.

senses.heading: A difficult situation that proves quality or strength
senses.definition_en: A difficult situation that shows how good, strong, or effective someone or something is.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat bangzah hoih, thahat ahih kei leh phattuam cih a kilakna dinmun haksa ahi hi.

examples.english: The crisis was a real test of her leadership.
examples.zomi: Tua buaina pen ama makai siamna sittelna taktak ahi hi.

examples.english: Their friendship stood the test of time.
examples.zomi: Amaute lawmna hun sau sung kip tawh om hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative meaning describes experience that reveals true ability, character, or value.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in siamna, omdan ahih kei leh man taktak a kilakna phutkhak kawk hi.

senses.heading: Written words
senses.definition_en: Written words, especially the main written part of a book, document, or screen.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in laibu, document ahih kei leh screen tung a thu bulpi kigelh kammalte ahi hi.

examples.english: The text is too small to read.
examples.zomi: Lai thu a neu lua ahih manin sim ding haksa hi.

examples.english: Students answered questions about the text.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in tua lai thu tawh kisai dotnate dawng uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Text may be uncountable when referring generally to written language and countable when referring to a particular written work.
senses.usage_zomi: Laigelh thu a huamkim in a kigen ciangin text simthamlo ahi thei a, laigelh khat kician a kigen ciangin simtheih ahi hi.

senses.heading: A written phone message
senses.definition_en: A short written message sent between mobile phones or similar devices.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mobile phone ahih kei leh vanzat a kibangte kikal a kikhak lai thupuak tom ahi hi.

examples.english: I received a text from my sister.
examples.zomi: Ka sangnu kiangpan phone lai thupuak khat ka ngah hi.

examples.english: Send me a text when you arrive.
examples.zomi: Na tun ciangin phone lai thupuak hong khak in.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, text is commonly used as both a noun and a verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina English kampau ah text pen noun leh verb a nihgel in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to introduce the second part of a comparison.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na nih a kitehkak ciangin a nihna khen hong kipat sakna kammal ahi hi.

examples.english: This book is easier to understand than that one is.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu pen tua laibu sangin telh baihzaw hi.

examples.english: She works harder than I do.
examples.zomi: Amah kei sangin hahkat zawin nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse than, used in comparisons, with then, which relates to time or sequence.
senses.usage_zomi: Tehkakna ah a kizang than leh hun ahih kei leh kizuihna a kawk then khial kei in.

senses.definition_en: To tell someone that you are grateful for something they have done or given.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a bawl ahih kei leh a piak na khat hangin lungdamna gen cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat hangin mi khat lungdam koh

examples.english: I thanked her for helping me.
examples.zomi: Hong panpihna hangin amah ka lungdam koh hi.

examples.english: We would like to thank everyone who attended.
examples.zomi: Hong pai mi khempeuh lungdam ka ko nuam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use thank someone for + noun or -ing form: thank him for the gift; thank her for coming.
senses.usage_zomi: Thank someone for + noun/-ing ci in zang in: thank him for the gift; thank her for coming.

senses.definition_en: Used to express gratitude in an informal or neutral way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngeina ahih kei leh kikhawlhna kampau tawh lungdamna pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Thanks for carrying my bag.
examples.zomi: Ka sum-ip hong pua sak na hangin lungdam ing.

examples.english: “Would you like more tea?” “No, thanks.”
examples.zomi: “Lakha na dawn beh nuam hiam?” “Deih kei, lungdam.”

senses.usage_en: Thanks is less formal than thank you. Thanks a lot usually expresses strong gratitude, but tone can also make it sarcastic.
senses.usage_zomi: Thanks pen thank you sangin picing tawmzaw hi. Thanks a lot in lungdamna lian pulaak zel napi, aw zatdan tawh zahko gentehna zong ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: A particular person or thing farther away
senses.definition_en: Used before a singular noun to identify a particular person or thing that is farther from the speaker.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kampaupa kiangpan a gamla zaw mi ahih kei leh na khat kician tak a kawkna in singular min kammal mai ah kizang hi.

examples.english: Who lives in that house?
examples.zomi: Tua inn ah kua om hiam?

examples.english: Please give me that book on the table.
examples.zomi: Dohkan tung a tua laibu hong pia in.

senses.usage_en: That is singular. Use those before plural nouns: that book; those books.
senses.usage_zomi: That pen singular ading ahi hi. Plural min kammal mai ah those zang in: that book; those books.

senses.heading: Something already mentioned or known
senses.definition_en: Used to identify a person, thing, time, or idea already mentioned or understood from the context.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen khinsa ahih kei leh thu kizomna pan a kitel mi, na, hun ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat kawkna in kizang hi.

examples.english: That decision caused several problems.
examples.zomi: Tua khensatna in buaina pawlkhat piangsak hi.

examples.english: I still remember that day.
examples.zomi: Tua ni ka phawk lai hi.

senses.usage_en: That often refers back to information already given, while this commonly introduces or identifies something nearer or more immediate.
senses.usage_zomi: That in a kigen khinsa thu kawk zel a, this in a nai zaw ahih kei leh tu laitak tawh a kizom na khat kawk zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Used before a noun when the speaker and listener know which particular person or thing is meant, or when only one exists in the context.
senses.zomi_equivalents: Zomi ah kammal khat tawh kiletling pah theilo; thu kizomna tawh kitel
senses.explanation_zomi: Kampaupa leh ngaipa in kua ahih kei leh bang kawk cih a theih uh ciang, ahih kei leh thu kizomna sungah khat bek a om ciangin min kammal mai ah kizang definite article ahi hi.

examples.english: Please close the door.
examples.zomi: Kong khak in.

examples.english: The sun rises in the east.
examples.zomi: Ni nisuahna lam pan suak hi.

senses.usage_en: The is a definite article, not a noun. It is pronounced /ðə/ before a consonant sound and commonly /ði/ before a vowel sound or when strongly emphasized. Zomi often expresses definiteness through context rather than a separate article.
senses.usage_zomi: The pen noun hilo in definite article ahi hi. Consonant aw mai ah /ðə/ ci in kisuang a, vowel aw mai ah ahih kei leh thupisak in kisuang ciangin /ði/ kici zel hi. Zomi ah definite article tuam omlo a, kua ahih kei leh bang kawk cih thu kizomna tawh kitel zel hi.

senses.heading: A building for performances
senses.definition_en: A building or room where plays and other live performances are presented to an audience.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tangthu kimawlna inn; pawi lakna inn
senses.explanation_zomi: Mipite mai ah tangthu kimawl, la, lam ahih kei leh live programte a kilakna inn maw innkhan ahi hi.

examples.english: We watched a play at the theatre.
examples.zomi: Tangthu kimawlna inn ah tangthu kimawl khat en ung.

examples.english: The theatre can seat five hundred people.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu kimawlna inn ah mi za nga tu thei hi.

senses.usage_en: British English spells this word theatre. American English normally uses theater.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah theatre ci in kigelh a, American English ah theater ci in kigelh zel hi.

senses.heading: The art or profession of producing plays
senses.definition_en: The activity, art, or profession of writing, producing, or performing plays.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu kimawl gelh, bawlkhia ahih kei leh kimawlna nasep, siamna leh pilna ahi hi.

examples.english: She studied theatre at university.
examples.zomi: University ah tangthu kimawlna sin hi.

examples.english: He has worked in theatre for many years.
examples.zomi: Tangthu kimawlna ah kum tampi nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: In this meaning, theatre is often uncountable because it names an artistic field.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah theatre in pilna leh siamna khen khat a kawk manin simthamlo min kammal in kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Belonging to, relating to, or done by them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Amaute’ neih, amaute tawh kisai ahih kei leh amaute in a bawl cih a pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The students completed their assignments.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in amaute’ sang nasepte zosiang uh hi.

examples.english: Their house is near the school.
examples.zomi: Amaute’ inn pen sang kiangah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Their comes before a noun. Do not confuse it with there or they’re.
senses.usage_zomi: Their pen min kammal mai ah om hi. Mun a kawk there leh they are a tomlak they’re tawh khial kei in.

senses.definition_en: Used to refer to something that belongs to them without repeating the noun.
senses.explanation_zomi: Min kammal genkik loin na khat amaute’ neih ahi cih a pulaakna pronoun ahi hi.

examples.english: This table is ours, and that one is theirs.
examples.zomi: Hih dohkan eite’ ahi a, tua dohkan amaute’ ahi hi.

examples.english: The final decision is theirs.
examples.zomi: Khensatna nunung pen amaute’ ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Theirs stands alone and is never followed directly by a noun. Use their before a noun: their car, but the car is theirs.
senses.usage_zomi: Theirs pen amah bek in ding a, a nungah min kammal zui pahlo hi. Min kammal mai ah their zang in: their car, ahihhang the car is theirs.

senses.definition_en: The object form of they, used for people, animals, or things already mentioned or understood.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen khinsa ahih kei leh a kitel mite, ganhingte maw nate ading they a object form ahi hi.

examples.english: I saw them at the supermarket.
examples.zomi: Dawr lian ah amaute ka mu hi.

examples.english: Please give these books to them.
examples.zomi: Hih laibute amaute tungah pia in.

senses.usage_en: Use they as the subject and them as the object: They helped us; we helped them.
senses.usage_zomi: Subject ading they zang a, object ading them zang in: They helped us; we helped them.

senses.heading: A central idea
senses.definition_en: The main idea or subject explored in a book, film, speech, work of art, or discussion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, film, kampau, limsiamna nasep ahih kei leh kihona sungah a kancian thu bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: Freedom is a major theme of the novel.
examples.zomi: Suahtakna pen tua novel sung thulu lian khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The speaker returned to the theme of responsibility.
examples.zomi: Kampaupa in mopohna thulu genkik hi.

senses.usage_en: A theme is an underlying idea, while a topic is the general subject being discussed.
senses.usage_zomi: Theme pen thu sungah a thukpi ngaihsutna ahi a, topic pen a kikum thulu a huamkim ahi hi.

senses.heading: A unifying style or subject
senses.definition_en: A particular subject or style used to organize and decorate an event, room, website, or other creation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawi, innkhan, website ahih kei leh kibawl na dangte zemsak leh kipawlkhawm sakna ding a kiteel thulu maw puatham ahi hi.

examples.english: The party had a tropical theme.
examples.zomi: Tua pawi pen gam lum puatham tawh kizem hi.

examples.english: You can change the website’s colour theme.
examples.zomi: Website a puam zatdan na khelsak thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the theme helps different parts of a design or event appear connected.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah theme in pawi ahih kei leh design a khen tuamtuamte kizom in a kilakna panpih hi.

senses.heading: Referring back to they
senses.definition_en: Used when the people, animals, or things doing an action are also affected by that action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna a bawlte mah tua gamtatna in a sukha ciangin they tung a ciahkik pronoun ahi hi.

examples.english: The students introduced themselves.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in amau min kitheisak uh hi.

examples.english: They prepared themselves for the examination.
examples.zomi: Sittelna ading amau leh amau kiging uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use themselves, not themself, for a clearly plural subject. Singular they may take either themself or themselves, depending on style.
senses.usage_zomi: Plural subject kician ading themself hilo in themselves zang in. Singular they tawh laigelhdan dungzui in themself ahih kei leh themselves kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: For emphasis
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that people did something personally or without help.
senses.explanation_zomi: Amaute mah in a bawl uh cih ahih kei leh panpihna lo in a bawl uh cih thupisakna ahi hi.

examples.english: They built the house themselves.
examples.zomi: Tua inn amau ngiat in lam uh hi.

examples.english: The leaders themselves attended the meeting.
examples.zomi: Makaite mahmah meeting ah pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The emphatic pronoun can often be removed without changing the basic facts, but it adds contrast or emphasis.
senses.usage_zomi: Thupisakna pronoun paikhiat zong thu bulpi kikhello napi, ko in a bawl cih thupisakna kiam hi.

senses.heading: At that time
senses.definition_en: At a particular time in the past or future being discussed.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen hun masa ahih kei leh mailam hun khat laitak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I was living in Yangon then.
examples.zomi: Tua lai in Yangon ah ka om hi.

examples.english: The work will be finished by then.
examples.zomi: Tua hun ciangin nasep kizota ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Then refers to time. Do not confuse it with comparative than.
senses.usage_zomi: Then in hun kawk hi. Tehkakna a kizang than tawh khial kei in.

senses.heading: Next in a sequence
senses.definition_en: After that; next in a series of actions or events.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tua khit ciang ahih kei leh a zom in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: First wash the rice, then add water.
examples.zomi: Masa in buh sawpsiang in, tua zomin tui beh in.

examples.english: We ate dinner and then watched a film.
examples.zomi: Nitak an ne masa ung a, tua khit ciangin film en ung.

senses.usage_en: This sense organizes events or instructions into their order.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in thu piang ahih kei leh sawlna kalsuanzia kizui sak hi.

senses.heading: In that case
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce a result, conclusion, or consequence based on what has just been said.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen khinsa thu tungah kinga a ngahna, khensatna ahih kei leh sulzui thu hong kipat sakna ahi hi.

examples.english: If the road is closed, then we must take another route.
examples.zomi: Lampi kikhak leh lampi dang zui kul ding hi.

examples.english: You have finished the work, so you can leave then.
examples.zomi: Nasep na zota ahih manin tua ciangin na pai thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In many conditional sentences, then is optional because the relationship is already clear.
senses.usage_zomi: Condition sentence tampi ah thu kizomna a kician khin manin then koihlo zong khiatna kitel hi.

senses.heading: An explanation based on evidence
senses.definition_en: A carefully developed explanation of facts or events, especially one supported by scientific evidence.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in science teci tungah kinga, thumaan ahih kei leh thu piangte banghangin tua bang a hi cih a hilhcian ngaihsutna kip ahi hi.

examples.english: The theory explains how the disease spreads.
examples.zomi: Tua hilhcian ngaihsutna in cina koibangin kizel cih hilhcian hi.

examples.english: Scientists tested the theory using new evidence.
examples.zomi: Science siamte in teci thak zangin tua theory sittel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In science, a theory is not merely a guess; it is a broad explanation supported by substantial evidence.
senses.usage_zomi: Science ah theory pen muhdan bek hilo a, teci kicing tawh a kipanpih hilhcian ngaihsutna a huamzaw ahi hi.

senses.heading: An idea about what may be true
senses.definition_en: An idea or opinion intended to explain something but not yet proved.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat hilhcian dingin a kingaihsun napi a kipsak nailo ngaihsutna ahih kei leh muhdan ahi hi.

examples.english: Police have a theory about how the crime occurred.
examples.zomi: Police-te in tua mawhna koibangin piang cih muhdan khat nei uh hi.

examples.english: The plan sounds good in theory.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna pen ngaihsutna bangin hoih hi.

senses.usage_en: In theory means according to an idea or plan; actual results may be different.
senses.usage_zomi: In theory in ngaihsutna ahih kei leh geelna bangin cihna ahi a, a taktak ngahna kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: Treatment for illness or injury
senses.definition_en: Treatment intended to improve a physical illness, injury, or medical condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi cina, liamna ahih kei leh zatui lam dinmun khat hoihsakna ding a kibawl tuamvilvel bawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: He receives physical therapy twice a week.
examples.zomi: Kal khat vei nih pumpi liamna bawlna ngah hi.

examples.english: The therapy helped her walk again.
examples.zomi: Tua bawlna in amah lampai kik theihna panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Different therapies may involve medicine, exercise, equipment, conversation, or other professional treatment.
senses.usage_zomi: Therapy nam tuamtuam sungah zatui, pumpi kimawlna, vanzat, kihona ahih kei leh siammi bawlna dangte kihel thei hi.

senses.heading: Treatment for emotional or mental difficulties
senses.definition_en: Professional treatment, often through conversation, that helps people manage emotional or mental difficulties.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim leh ngaihsutna buainate ukzawhna dingin a tamzaw in siammi tawh kihona tungtawn a kipia bawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: Therapy helped him manage his anxiety.
examples.zomi: Lungsim bawlna in ama lungkhamna ukzawh ding panpih hi.

examples.english: They attended family therapy together.
examples.zomi: Amaute innkuan lungsim bawlna ah pai khawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Therapy is normally uncountable when referring generally to treatment, but therapies can refer to different kinds of treatment.
senses.usage_zomi: Bawlna a huamkim in a kigen ciangin therapy simthamlo min kammal ahi hi. Bawlna nam tuamtuam a kigen ciangin therapies ci thei hi.

senses.heading: In or at that place
senses.definition_en: In, at, or toward a place away from the speaker or already mentioned.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tua ah; tua munah; tua lamah
senses.explanation_zomi: Kampaupa pan a gamla zaw ahih kei leh a kigen khinsa munah, mun sungah ahih kei leh tua mun lamah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Put the chair over there.
examples.zomi: Tua lamah tokhom koih in.

examples.english: We stayed there for three days.
examples.zomi: Tua munah ni thum om ung.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse location word there with possessive their or shortened they’re meaning they are.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun a kawk there pen neihna a kawk their ahih kei leh they are a tomlak they’re tawh khial kei in.

senses.heading: Used to say something exists or happens
senses.definition_en: Used before be and certain other verbs to introduce the existence or occurrence of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat om ahih kei leh thu khat piang cih hong pulaakna dingin be leh gamtat kammal dang pawlkhat mai ah kizang hi.

examples.english: There is a book on the table.
examples.zomi: Dohkan tungah laibu khat om hi.

examples.english: There were several problems with the system.
examples.zomi: Tua system ah buaina pawlkhat om hi.

senses.usage_en: In there is/are, there does not name a place. It introduces the existence of the following noun.
senses.usage_zomi: There is/are sungah there in mun khat kawklo hi. A nung a min kammal om cih hong pulaak hi.

senses.definition_en: For that reason; as a result of what has just been stated.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tua thu hangin ahih kei leh a sulzui in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The road was closed; therefore, we took another route.
examples.zomi: Lampi kikhak hi; tua hangin lampi dang zui ung.

examples.english: The evidence was incomplete and therefore unreliable.
examples.zomi: Teci kicinglo a, tua hangin muanhuai lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Therefore is formal and commonly connects a reason with its logical result. In ordinary conversation, so is often more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Therefore pen kammal picing hi a, hang thu leh a ngahna kizom sak zel hi. Niteng kihona ah so kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Referring to several people, animals, or things
senses.definition_en: Used as the subject when referring to two or more people, animals, or things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing ahih kei leh na nih leh a tamzawte subject in a kawk pronoun ahi hi.

examples.english: They live near the school.
examples.zomi: Amaute sang kiangah om uh hi.

examples.english: The children said they were hungry.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te in a gilkial uh ci uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use they as a subject and them as an object.
senses.usage_zomi: Subject ading they zang a, object ading them zang in.

senses.heading: Referring to one person without specifying gender
senses.definition_en: Used for one person when the person’s gender is unknown, unimportant, or not stated.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat numei maw pasal cih theihloh, thupi lo ahih kei leh kigenloh ciangin tua mi khat kawkna in kizang hi.

examples.english: Someone left their phone, but I do not know who they are.
examples.zomi: Mi khat in a phone nusia a, kua ahi diam ka thei kei hi.

examples.english: Each student should check whether they have completed the form.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang khat ciangin form a cialkim maw cih kisittel ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Singular they is standard English and avoids unnecessarily identifying a person as male or female.
senses.usage_zomi: Singular they pen English man tak ahi a, mi khat pasal maw numei cih kisamlo in pulaakna dingin kizang hi.

senses.heading: Having a large distance between opposite sides
senses.definition_en: Measuring a large distance between two opposite surfaces.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puatham nih kikal a pheizah a lian cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The house has thick stone walls.
examples.zomi: Tua inn in suang kulh taang nei hi.

examples.english: She wore a thick coat in the snow.
examples.zomi: Vuk kia sungah puanlum taang silh hi.

senses.usage_en: Thick is the opposite of thin when describing the distance between surfaces.
senses.usage_zomi: Puatham nih kikal a pheizah a kigen ciangin thick pen thin tawh kikal hi.

senses.heading: Dense or difficult to see through
senses.definition_en: Containing many things close together or being difficult to see or move through.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na tampi a kinaikhat in a om manin muhkantan ahih kei leh kantan ding haksat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Thick fog covered the road.
examples.zomi: Meipi cing in lampi khuh hi.

examples.english: They walked through a thick forest.
examples.zomi: Gamlak singkung cing sungah pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense refers to density rather than physical width.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in na khat a pheizah hilo in, a cing leh a tamziah kawk hi.

senses.heading: Having a heavy consistency
senses.definition_en: Not flowing easily because a liquid or mixture is heavy or dense.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui ahih kei leh kigawmna khat a cing manin baih takin luang theilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Cook the sauce until it becomes thick.
examples.zomi: Sauce a cing dong huan in.

examples.english: The soup was too thick to pour easily.
examples.zomi: Sup a cing lua ahih manin buahtheih ding haksa hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is commonly used for liquids and mixtures such as soup, sauce, paint, or cream.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen sup, sauce, suah, cream bang tui leh kigawmnate ading kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who steals another person’s property.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang’ neihsa a guk mi ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: van guk nasep a nei mi

examples.english: The thief stole a bag from the car.
examples.zomi: Guk in mawtaw sungpan sum-ip khat guk hi.

examples.english: Police caught the thief near the station.
examples.zomi: Police-te in station kiangah tua guk man uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural of thief is thieves, not thiefs.
senses.usage_zomi: Thief a plural pen thiefs hilo in thieves ahi hi.

senses.heading: Having a small distance between opposite sides
senses.definition_en: Having only a small distance between two opposite surfaces.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puatham nih kikal a pheizah a neu cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Cut the bread into thin slices.
examples.zomi: Tanghou a pang in tan in.

examples.english: The ice is too thin to walk on.
examples.zomi: Vui a pang lua ahih manin a tungah pai ding lauhuai hi.

senses.usage_en: Thin is the opposite of thick when describing width between surfaces.
senses.usage_zomi: Puatham nih kikal a pheizah a kigen ciangin thin pen thick tawh kikal hi.

senses.heading: Having little fat on the body
senses.definition_en: Having little flesh or fat on the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi ah sa leh thau tawm a, pumpi a zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He became thin after being ill for several months.
examples.zomi: Kha pawlkhat cina khit ciangin hong zang hi.

examples.english: The dog looked weak and thin.
examples.zomi: Ui pen thahatlo a, zang in kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Describing someone as thin may be neutral or negative. Slim is often more positive when referring to an attractive body shape.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat thin cih pen ngeina ahih kei leh hoihlo lam a ging thei hi. Kilawm takin a zang pumpi a kigen ciangin slim hoih lamah kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Not dense or numerous
senses.definition_en: Containing only a small number of people or things, with much space between them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh nate tawm bek om a, a kikal zaang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: His hair is becoming thin.
examples.zomi: A sam hong tawm semsem hi.

examples.english: The crowd was thin early in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingsang nai in mihon tawm lai hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes low density, not physical narrowness.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in a pheizah neu cih hilo in, a omzah tawm leh a kikal zaang cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: An object or item
senses.definition_en: An object, item, or material whose exact name is unknown, unimportant, or not stated.
senses.explanation_zomi: A min taktak theihloh, thupi lo ahih kei leh kigenloh van, na ahih kei leh zatleh khat ahi hi.

examples.english: What is that thing on the table?
examples.zomi: Dohkan tung a tua na bang ahi hiam?

examples.english: Please put your things in the cupboard.
examples.zomi: Na vante deihna sungah koih in.

senses.usage_en: Thing is very general. In clear or formal writing, use a more exact noun whenever possible.
senses.usage_zomi: Thing pen khiatna a huam mahmah hi. Lai kician ahih kei leh picing a kigelh ciangin a theih nakleh min kicianzaw zang in.

senses.heading: A matter, fact, action, or situation
senses.definition_en: A matter, fact, action, idea, or situation being discussed.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kikum thu, thumaan, gamtatna, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh dinmun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The important thing is that everyone is safe.
examples.zomi: A thupi pen thu in mi khempeuh bit cih ahi hi.

examples.english: Apologizing was the right thing to do.
examples.zomi: Mawh maisak ngen pen gamtat ding a man ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Standard Zomi should translate thing according to its context—often as na, van, thu, gamtatna, or another precise expression—rather than forcing one generic equivalent everywhere.
senses.usage_zomi: Standard Zomi ah thing pen thu kizomna bangin na, van, thu, gamtatna ahih kei leh kammal kician dang tawh kilet ding hi; mun khempeuh ah kammal khat bek kipsak loin zat ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Use the mind to consider something
senses.definition_en: To use your mind to consider, examine, or form ideas about something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat lungsim sungah ngaihsun, kancian ahih kei leh ngaihsutna bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Think carefully before making a decision.
examples.zomi: Khensatna na bawl ma in pilvang takin ngaihsun in.

examples.english: I need time to think about your proposal.
examples.zomi: Na geelna ngaihsutna ding hun ka kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Use think about/of when considering a subject. Think of can also mean producing an idea or remembering someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Thulu khat ngaihsutna ah think about/of zang in. Think of in ngaihsutna khat piangsak ahih kei leh mi khat phawk cih zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Have an opinion or belief
senses.definition_en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or judgment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat tungah muhdan, upna ahih kei leh khensatna lungsim nei cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: a man hi ci in ngaihsun

examples.english: I think the plan will work.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna nasem ding hi ci in ka ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: What do you think about the proposal?
examples.zomi: Tua geelna tungah bang na ngaihsun hiam?

senses.usage_en: I think often softens an opinion. It does not always mean that the speaker is uncertain.
senses.usage_zomi: I think in ngaihsutna kammal a nemsak thei hi. Kampaupa a kicianlo cihna tawntung hilo hi.

senses.heading: Intend or plan
senses.definition_en: To intend or have a plan to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl dingin ngiim ahih kei leh geel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We are thinking of moving next year.
examples.zomi: Kumkik ciangin inn khek ding ngaihsun ung.

examples.english: She is thinking about applying for the job.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep ngetna bawl ding ngaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: Use think of/about + -ing for a possible plan: thinking of changing jobs.
senses.usage_zomi: Geelna piangthei khat ading think of/about + -ing zang in: thinking of changing jobs.

senses.heading: The process of using the mind
senses.definition_en: The mental activity of considering, understanding, reasoning, or forming ideas.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ngaihsut, telh, a hang leh a thu kizomna kancian ahih kei leh ngaihsutna piangsakna lungsim nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: The problem requires careful thinking.
examples.zomi: Hih buaina in pilvang ngaihsutna kisam hi.

examples.english: Education should develop critical thinking.
examples.zomi: Pilna in kancian takin ngaihsut siamna khangsak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: As a mental process, thinking is normally uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungsim nasep a huamkim in a kigen ciangin thinking simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Opinions or ideas
senses.definition_en: A person’s or group’s opinions, beliefs, or general way of considering a subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat’ ngaihsutna, upna ahih kei leh thu khat a enna dan ahi hi.

examples.english: This discovery changed scientific thinking.
examples.zomi: Hih muhkhiatna in science ngaihsutdan kikhel sak hi.

examples.english: We need a new way of thinking about the problem.
examples.zomi: Tua buaina tungah ngaihsutdan thak khat kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, thinking means a viewpoint or body of ideas, not merely the act of using the mind.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah thinking in lungsim zatna gamtatna bek hilo in, muhdan ahih kei leh ngaihsutna pawl kawk hi.

senses.heading: The number or person in position three
senses.definition_en: The person or thing in the third position of an order, competition, or series.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kizuihna, kidemna ahih kei leh thu pawl sungah mun thumna a om mi ahih kei leh na ahi hi.

examples.english: She finished third in the race.
examples.zomi: Taisiam kidemna ah mun thumna ngah hi.

examples.english: He was the third to arrive.
examples.zomi: Hong tung mite lakah amah a thumna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Third functions as an ordinal number. Before a noun, it commonly functions as a determiner or adjective: the third chapter.
senses.usage_zomi: Third pen ordinal number ahi hi. Min kammal mai ah the third chapter bangin determiner ahih kei leh adjective in kizang hi.

senses.heading: One of three equal parts
senses.definition_en: One of three equal parts of a whole.
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi khat khen thum kibang takin a kikhen ciang a khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: One third of the students were absent.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te thum khen khat hong pai lo uh hi.

examples.english: Add a third of a cup of water.
examples.zomi: Tui hai khat thum khen khat beh in.

senses.usage_en: Write the fraction as one third or ⅓. The plural is thirds: two thirds.
senses.usage_zomi: Fraction pen one third ahih kei leh ⅓ ci in kigelh hi. Plural pen thirds ahi a, two thirds ci in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Needing or wanting to drink something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui ahih kei leh dawnna dawn nuam a, dangtak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am thirsty after walking in the heat.
examples.zomi: Khuavak lum sungah ka pai khit ciangin ka dangtak hi.

examples.english: Give the thirsty child some water.
examples.zomi: A dangtak naupang tui pia in.

senses.usage_en: English uses be thirsty, not have thirsty. The noun is thirst.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah be thirsty ci in kizang a, have thirsty ci lo hi. A noun pen thirst ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 13.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sawm leh thum; nambat sawm leh thum
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat sawm leh thum, sawm leh nih khit leh sawm leh li mai a om nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: Thirteen is an odd number.
examples.zomi: Sawm leh thum pen nambat nih tawh khenkim theihlo ahi hi.

examples.english: The answer to the question is thirteen.
examples.zomi: Tua dotna a dawnna sawm leh thum ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Stress the final syllable in thirteen /ˌθɝˈtin/. Compare thirty /ˈθɝti/, which has first-syllable stress.
senses.usage_zomi: Thirteen /ˌθɝˈtin/ ah syllable nunung aw-ngah hi. Thirty /ˈθɝti/ ahihleh syllable masa aw-ngah hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 30.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat sawm thum, kul leh kua khit leh sawm thum leh khat mai a om nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: Thirty is three times ten.
examples.zomi: Sawm thum pen sawm veithum ahi hi.

examples.english: The bus can carry thirty passengers.
examples.zomi: Bus in khualzin mi sawm thum pua thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Thirty /ˈθɝti/ has stress on the first syllable. Do not confuse it with thirteen /ˌθɝˈtin/.
senses.usage_zomi: Thirty /ˈθɝti/ ah syllable masa aw-ngah hi. Thirteen /ˌθɝˈtin/ tawh khial kei in.

senses.heading: A particular person or thing nearby
senses.definition_en: Used before a singular noun to identify a person or thing close to the speaker.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kampaupa kiangah a nai mi ahih kei leh na khat kician kawkna in singular min kammal mai ah kizang hi.

examples.english: This chair is more comfortable than that one.
examples.zomi: Hih tokhom pen tua sangin tut nuamzaw hi.

examples.english: Please read this paragraph.
examples.zomi: Hih paragraph sim in.

senses.usage_en: This is singular. Use these before plural nouns: this book; these books.
senses.usage_zomi: This pen singular ading ahi hi. Plural min kammal mai ah these zang in: this book; these books.

senses.heading: The present time or current situation
senses.definition_en: Used before a time expression or situation connected with the present.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu laitak hun ahih kei leh tu a om dinmun tawh a kizom hun leh thu kawkna in kizang hi.

examples.english: I have been very busy this week.
examples.zomi: Hih kal sung ka buai mahmah hi.

examples.english: The company introduced a new policy this year.
examples.zomi: Kampani in tukum thukhun thak khat zang kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not normally use in before expressions such as this week, this month, or this year.
senses.usage_zomi: This week, this month, leh this year bang hun kammalte mai ah ngeina in in koihlo hi.

senses.heading: Although; despite the fact that
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement seem surprising or unexpected.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat om napi a thu bulpi pen lam-etdan tawh a kibanglo cih pulaakna in kizang hi.

examples.english: Though it was raining, we continued walking.
examples.zomi: Guah zu napi lampai zom lai ung.

examples.english: She passed the examination though she had been ill.
examples.zomi: Cina thuak napi sittelna gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: Though and although have similar meanings. Though is slightly less formal and can also appear at the end of a sentence.
senses.usage_zomi: Though leh although khiatna kibang hi. Though pen picing tawmzaw a, sentence tawpna ah zong om thei hi.

senses.heading: Introducing a contrasting point
senses.definition_en: Used to add a statement that contrasts with what was said before.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen khinsa thu tawh a kilangpang thu khat behlapna in kizang hi.

examples.english: The room is small. It is comfortable, though.
examples.zomi: Innkhan a neu hi. Ahihhang, tutnuam hi.

examples.english: The work was difficult, though not impossible.
examples.zomi: Nasep haksat napi bawltheihloh hilo hi.

senses.usage_en: At the end of a sentence, though functions much like however but sounds more conversational.
senses.usage_zomi: Sentence tawpna ah though pen however bangin kizang napi, kihona kampau bangin gingzaw hi.

senses.heading: An idea or opinion
senses.definition_en: An idea, opinion, or image that forms in the mind.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lungsim sungah a piang ngaihsutna, muhdan ahih kei leh lim ahi hi.

examples.english: She shared her thoughts about the proposal.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna tawh kisai a ngaihsutnate gen hi.

examples.english: A strange thought entered my mind.
examples.zomi: Ka lungsim sungah ngaihsutna lamdang khat hong piang hi.

senses.usage_en: Thought is countable when it means one particular idea: a thought; several thoughts.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngaihsutna kician khat a kawk ciangin thought simtheih hi: a thought; several thoughts.

senses.heading: Careful consideration
senses.definition_en: The process of considering something carefully.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat pilvang leh kancian takin ngaihsutna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please give the matter some thought.
examples.zomi: Tua thu ngaihsun in.

examples.english: After careful thought, she accepted the offer.
examples.zomi: Pilvang takin ngaihsut khit ciangin tua ki-aapna sang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, thought is often uncountable and refers to the mental process rather than one idea.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah thought pen simthamlo in kizang zel a, ngaihsutna khat bek hilo in lungsim tawh kancian nasep kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 1,000.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat tul khat, za sawm tawh a kibang nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: One thousand is ten times one hundred.
examples.zomi: Tul khat pen za khat veisawm ahi hi.

examples.english: Thousands of people attended the festival.
examples.zomi: Mi tul tampi in pawi ah pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: After an exact number, use singular thousand: three thousand, not three thousands. Use thousands of for a large, inexact number.
senses.usage_zomi: Nambat kician khitah singular thousand zang in: three thousand, three thousands ci kei in. A kicianlo mi ahih kei leh na tul tampi ading thousands of zang in.

senses.heading: A statement of intended harm
senses.definition_en: A statement that someone intends to hurt, punish, or cause damage if a demand is not met.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngetna khat zuihloh leh mi khat liamsak, gimpiak ahih kei leh siasak ding cih kammal ahi hi.

examples.english: The police took the threat seriously.
examples.zomi: Police-te in tua lauhthawnna thupi sak uh hi.

examples.english: He received a threat after reporting the crime.
examples.zomi: Mawhna thu a pulak khit ciangin lauhthawnna khat ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: A threat may be spoken, written, or communicated through actions.
senses.usage_zomi: Lauhthawnna pen kampau, laigelhna ahih kei leh gamtatna tawh kipia thei hi.

senses.heading: A possible source of danger
senses.definition_en: A person, condition, or event that may cause harm or danger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Siasakna ahih kei leh lauhuaina piangsak thei mi, dinmun maw thu piang ahi hi.

examples.english: Air pollution is a threat to public health.
examples.zomi: Huih niin pen mipite cidamna lauhuaina ahi hi.

examples.english: The storm poses a serious threat to coastal towns.
examples.zomi: Huihpi in tuipi gei khuate tungah lauhuaina lian piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a threat to before the person or thing that may be harmed.
senses.usage_zomi: Siasakna a thuak thei mi ahih kei leh na mai ah a threat to zang in.

senses.heading: Say that you will cause harm
senses.definition_en: To tell someone that you may hurt, punish, or cause damage if they do not do what you demand.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a kingen bang a bawlloh leh liamsak, gimpiak ahih kei leh siasak ding cih lauhthawn cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The man threatened to damage the car.
examples.zomi: Mipa in mawtaw susia ding ci in lauhthawn hi.

examples.english: Nobody should threaten another person.
examples.zomi: Kuamah in midang khat lauhthawn lo ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Use threaten to + verb: threaten to leave. Use threaten someone with + noun: threaten someone with violence.
senses.usage_zomi: Threaten to + verb ci in zang in: threaten to leave. Min kammal tawh threaten someone with + noun zang in: threaten someone with violence.

senses.heading: Put someone or something in danger
senses.definition_en: To create a risk of harm, damage, or loss.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat liamna, siatna ahih kei leh suplawhna lauhuaina sungah koih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The fire threatened several homes.
examples.zomi: Mei in inn pawlkhat kang ding lauhuai sak hi.

examples.english: Pollution threatens animals living in the river.
examples.zomi: Niinna in gun sung ganhingte lauhuai sak hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense does not require a spoken warning; the danger may come from a condition or event.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah lauhthawnna kammal kisamlo a, lauhuaina pen dinmun ahih kei leh thu piang pan hong piang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 3.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat thum, nih khit leh li mai a om nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: Three is an odd number.
examples.zomi: Thum pen nambat nih tawh khenkim theihlo ahi hi.

examples.english: The answer is three.
examples.zomi: A dawnna thum ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Before a noun, three functions as a determiner: three books. It functions as a noun when referring to the number itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kammal mai ah three pen determiner in kizang hi: three books. Nambat mahmah a kigen ciangin noun ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The passage inside the neck through which food and air travel.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngawng sungah an leh huih a kantan lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: I have a sore throat and a cough.
examples.zomi: Ka ngawng na a, ka khu hi.

examples.english: Drink warm water if your throat feels dry.
examples.zomi: Na ngawng a khawng leh tui lum dawn in.

senses.usage_en: Throat usually refers to the inside passage, while neck refers to the outer body part connecting the head and shoulders.
senses.usage_zomi: Throat in ngawng sung lampi kawk zel a, neck in lutang leh liang kizopna pumpi puatham kawk hi.

senses.heading: From one side or end to the other
senses.definition_en: Moving into, across, and out of the other side or end of a place or object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih kei leh van khat sung lut, kantan a, a langkhat pan suak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We walked through the forest.
examples.zomi: Gamlak kantan in pai ung.

examples.english: Sunlight came through the window.
examples.zomi: Nivak kong-ot pan hong lut hi.

senses.usage_en: Through describes movement within and across something. Across usually describes movement from one side to another over a surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Through in na khat sung kantan cihna kawk a, across in a puatham tungtawn in langkhat pan langkhat kantan cihna kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: During the whole process or period
senses.definition_en: Continuing within a process, experience, or period from its beginning to its end.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, phutkhak ahih kei leh hun khat kipatna pan a tawp dong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The nurse stayed with him through the night.
examples.zomi: Nurse pen zan sung tawntung ama kiangah om hi.

examples.english: Her family supported her through the difficult period.
examples.zomi: Hun haksa kantan laitakin ama innkuan in panpih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: When emphasizing every part of a place or period, throughout may be more explicit.
senses.usage_zomi: Mun ahih kei leh hun a khen khempeuh thupisakna dingin throughout kicianzaw ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: By means of
senses.definition_en: By using a particular method, process, person, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawldan, nasep kalsuan, mi ahih kei leh pawl khat tungtawn in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: People can improve their lives through education.
examples.zomi: Mite in pilna tungtawn in a nuntakna uh hoihsak thei uh hi.

examples.english: We booked the trip through a travel agency.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna agency khat tungtawn in ka khualzinna uh bawl ung.

senses.usage_en: This sense identifies the method or channel by which a result is achieved.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in ngahna khat bang lampi ahih kei leh kua tungtawn in a kimu cih pulaak hi.

senses.heading: In every part of a place
senses.definition_en: In or affecting every part of a particular place.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mun khempeuh ah; sung khempeuh ah
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat a khen khempeuh sungah ahih kei leh mun khempeuh a sukha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The news spread throughout the country.
examples.zomi: Thuthang pen gam sung khempeuh ah kizel hi.

examples.english: Smoke filled the building throughout its upper floors.
examples.zomi: Inn a tung khaan khempeuh meikhu in dim hi.

senses.usage_en: Throughout emphasizes complete coverage of an area.
senses.usage_zomi: Throughout in mun khat a khen khempeuh huam cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: During the whole period
senses.definition_en: During the whole of a particular period, from beginning to end.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hun sung tawntung; kipat pan tawp dong
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun khat kipatna pan a tawp dong, tua hun sung khempeuh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The museum is open throughout the year.
examples.zomi: Museum pen kum sung tawntung kihong hi.

examples.english: It rained throughout the night.
examples.zomi: Zan sung tawntung guah zu hi.

senses.usage_en: Throughout is stronger than during because it suggests that something continues across the entire period.
senses.usage_zomi: Throughout pen during sangin khauhzaw a, thu khat hun sung a vekpi a omzom cih kawk hi.

senses.heading: Send something through the air
senses.definition_en: To use the hand or arm to send an object through the air.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khut ahih kei leh ban zangin van khat huih sungah lawn cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat na khat tawh lawn

examples.english: She threw the ball to her brother.
examples.zomi: A sanggampa kiangah ball lawn hi.

examples.english: Do not throw stones at animals.
examples.zomi: Ganhingte suang tawh lawn kei in.

senses.usage_en: The forms are throw–threw–thrown. Use throw to when someone is meant to catch something and throw at when trying to hit a target.
senses.usage_zomi: A kammal puakte throw–threw–thrown ahi hi. Mi khat mansak dingin throw to zang a, ngiimna khat lawnkha dingin throw at zang in.

senses.heading: Put or move something quickly or carelessly
senses.definition_en: To put, move, or remove something suddenly, forcefully, or without much care.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat thakhat in, thahat takin ahih kei leh pilvang lua loin koih, khelsak maw paikhiat cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat sum-ip sungah koih pah

examples.english: He threw his coat onto the chair.
examples.zomi: A puanlum tokhom tungah paih hi.

examples.english: Please do not throw away these documents.
examples.zomi: Hih documentte paih kei in.

senses.usage_en: Phrasal verbs with throw often have distinct meanings, such as throw away for discard and throw out for remove.
senses.usage_zomi: Throw tawh phrasal verbte khiatna tuamtuam nei hi. Throw away in paih cihna a, throw out in paikhiat cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The day of the week after Wednesday and before Friday.
senses.explanation_zomi: Wednesday ni khit leh Friday ni mai a om kal sung ni khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting will be held on Thursday.
examples.zomi: Meeting pen Thursday ni in kinei ding hi.

examples.english: She works from Monday to Thursday.
examples.zomi: Monday pan Thursday dong nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: The names of days always begin with a capital letter in English.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah kal sung ni minte lai lian tawh kipan tawntung hi.

senses.heading: Therefore; as a result
senses.definition_en: For that reason or as a result of what has just been stated.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tua thu hangin ahih kei leh a sulzui in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The evidence was incomplete and thus unreliable.
examples.zomi: Teci kicinglo a, tua hangin muanhuai lo hi.

examples.english: Demand increased, thus causing prices to rise.
examples.zomi: Kisapna khang a, tua hangin vanman khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Thus is formal and common in academic or technical writing. In everyday conversation, so is more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Thus pen kammal picing hi a, pilna leh technical laigelhna ah kizang zel hi. Niteng kihona ah so ngeinazaw hi.

senses.heading: In this way
senses.definition_en: In the way just described or demonstrated.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen ahih kei leh a kilak bangin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The parts are joined thus to form a circle.
examples.zomi: Khen tuamtuamte hibangin kizomsak a, bial khat suaksak hi.

examples.english: Thus prepared, the team began its work.
examples.zomi: Tua bangin kiging khin a, tua pawl nasem kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is less common in conversation and often appears in formal explanations.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen niteng kihona ah kizang tawm a, picing takin hilhcian laigelhna ah omzaw hi.

senses.heading: Permission to travel or enter
senses.definition_en: A printed or electronic document that allows someone to travel, enter an event, or use a service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzin, pawi ah lut ahih kei leh nasepna khat zatna ding phalna a pia lai ahih kei leh electronic document ahi hi.

examples.english: I bought a train ticket online.
examples.zomi: Train ticket internet tungah ka lei hi.

examples.english: Show your ticket at the entrance.
examples.zomi: Lutna ah na ticket lak in.

senses.usage_en: A ticket may be printed on paper or stored electronically on a phone.
senses.usage_zomi: Ticket pen lai tungah kisuang ahi thei a, phone sungah electronic in zong kikem thei hi.

senses.heading: An official notice of an offence
senses.definition_en: An official notice requiring someone to pay a fine for breaking a traffic or parking rule.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gim piakna ticket; thukhun palsatna lai
senses.explanation_zomi: Traffic ahih kei leh mawtaw koihna thukhun a palsat manin sum gim piak ding cih ukna in a pia lai ahi hi.

examples.english: He received a ticket for speeding.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw nawk luatna hangin gim piakna ticket ngah hi.

examples.english: She paid the parking ticket online.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw koih khialna ticket sum internet tungah pia hi.

senses.usage_en: This use is especially common in American English. British English often uses fine or penalty notice.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna pen American English ah kizangzaw hi. British English ah fine ahih kei leh penalty notice kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: A list of political candidates
senses.definition_en: A group of candidates from the same political party who seek election together.
senses.zomi_equivalents: teel ding mite pawl; party candidate pawl
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamvai pawl khat pan khawm in teelna a tuah teel ding mite pawl ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: pawl khat min tawh teelna tuah

examples.english: Both candidates are running on the same party ticket.
examples.zomi: Candidate nihgel gamvai pawl khat min tawh teelna tuah uh hi.

examples.english: The party announced its election ticket.
examples.zomi: Gamvai pawl in teelna candidate pawl pulak hi.

senses.usage_en: This political meaning is especially common in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gamvai khiatna pen American English ah kizangzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Neat, clean, and arranged in an orderly way.
senses.explanation_zomi: A siang, a kizem a, vante mun kituak ciangah a kikoih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her desk is always tidy.
examples.zomi: Ama dohkan siang a kizem tawntung hi.

examples.english: Please keep your room tidy.
examples.zomi: Na innkhan siang a kizem in kem in.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses tidy. American English often uses neat for the same meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah tidy kizang mahmah hi. American English ah hih khiatna ading neat kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Fasten with string, rope, or similar material
senses.definition_en: To fasten something by making a knot in string, rope, or another narrow material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khau, khrui ahih kei leh zatleh sau pang khat khih in van khat kipsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Tie the rope firmly to the tree.
examples.zomi: Khau pen singkung ah kip takin khih in.

examples.english: The child learned to tie his shoes.
examples.zomi: Naupang in a khekhap khau khihdan sin hi.

senses.usage_en: The forms are tie–tied–tied. Before -ing, the final e changes: tying.
senses.usage_zomi: A kammal puakte tie–tied–tied ahi hi. -ing beh ciangin a tawp e kikhel a, tying kici hi.

senses.heading: Finish with equal scores
senses.definition_en: To finish a game, competition, or vote with the same score or number on each side.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna, kidemna ahih kei leh vote ah khat leh khat ngahzah kibang in zo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teams tied two to two.
examples.zomi: Pawl nih nih leh nih in ngahzah kibang uh hi.

examples.english: Two candidates tied for first place.
examples.zomi: Candidate nih in mun masa ngahkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses tie. British English often uses draw for an equal result in sport.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah tie kizang zel hi. British English ah kimawlna ngahzah kibang ading draw kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Connect closely
senses.definition_en: To connect a person, event, fact, or idea closely with another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, thu piang, thumaan ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat a dang khat tawh nai takin kizom sak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: na khat teci tawh kizom sak

examples.english: Police tied the suspect to the crime through evidence.
examples.zomi: Police-te in teci tungtawn in mawhbawl hihtuakpa leh tua mawhna kizom sak uh hi.

examples.english: Economic growth is closely tied to education.
examples.zomi: Sumvai khantohna pen pilna tawh nai takin kizom hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is often used in the passive form be tied to.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen passive be tied to tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Fitting closely
senses.definition_en: Fitting very closely around something and leaving little extra space.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat kimah a ben mahmah a, mun awng tawm bek a nutsiat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: These shoes are too tight.
examples.zomi: Hih khekhapte cip lua hi.

examples.english: He wore a tight shirt.
examples.zomi: Puan cip khat silh hi.

senses.usage_en: Tight clothing or shoes fit too closely. The opposite is loose.
senses.usage_zomi: Puan ahih kei leh khekhap tight in pumpi ah ben lua cihna ahi hi. A kikal pen loose ahi hi.

senses.heading: Firmly fixed or held
senses.definition_en: Firmly fastened, closed, stretched, or held so that it does not move easily.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kikhih, kikhak, kizam ahih kei leh kilet kip a, baih takin kilinglo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Make sure the lid is tight.
examples.zomi: A khuhna kikhak cip cih kiciansak in.

examples.english: She held the rope with a tight grip.
examples.zomi: Khau pen kip takin len hi.

senses.usage_en: Tight can describe something securely fixed or held, not only clothing.
senses.usage_zomi: Tight in puan bek hilo in, van khat kip takin kikhih ahih kei leh kilet zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Limited or difficult
senses.definition_en: Having very little extra time, money, or space available.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, sum ahih kei leh mun awng a tawm mahmah, a kicing zawhlohna ding dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: We are working with a tight budget.
examples.zomi: Sum zat ding tawmno tawh nasem ung.

examples.english: Her schedule is very tight this week.
examples.zomi: Hih kal sung ama hun geelna awnglo mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: A tight budget or tight schedule allows little freedom for additional spending or activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Tight budget ahih kei leh tight schedule in sum beh zatna ahih kei leh nasep beh bawlna ding awng tawm cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Up to the time when a particular event happens; until.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang khat a tun dong ahih kei leh hun khat ciang dong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Wait here till I return.
examples.zomi: Ka ciah dong hih munah ngak in.

examples.english: We continued working till the sun went down.
examples.zomi: Ni tum dong nasem zom ung.

senses.usage_en: Till and until have the same basic meaning. Till is not an incorrect shortened spelling of until; it is an older word. The form ’til is informal.
senses.usage_zomi: Till leh until khiatna bulpi kibang hi. Till pen until a kigelh tom khialna hilo a, kammal lui zaw ahi hi. ’Til pen ngeina kampau gelhdan ahi hi.

senses.heading: The passing measure of events
senses.definition_en: The continuous passage in which events happen and life progresses.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piangte kizui in a piangna leh nuntakna a ma khantohna tawntung hun ahi hi.

examples.english: Time passes quickly when we are busy.
examples.zomi: I buai ciangin hun manlang takin pai hi.

examples.english: The pain became less severe over time.
examples.zomi: Hun a sawt ciangin natna hong nem semsem hi.

senses.usage_en: In this general sense, time is uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Hun a huamkim in a kigen hih khiatna ah time simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: A measured point or period
senses.definition_en: A particular point or period shown in hours and minutes or identified by an event.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nai leh minute tawh a kilak hun kician ahih kei leh thu piang khat tawh a kitheih hun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: What time does the meeting begin?
examples.zomi: Meeting nai bangzah in kipan ding hiam?

examples.english: Please arrive at the correct time.
examples.zomi: Hun ciangin hong tung in.

senses.usage_en: Use at before a clock time: at three o’clock. Ask What time?, not normally Which time?
senses.usage_zomi: Nai tawh hun kician mai ah at zang in: at three o’clock. Hun dong dingin What time? ci a, ngeina ah Which time? ci lo hi.

senses.heading: An occasion
senses.definition_en: One occasion when something happens or is done.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a piang ahih kei leh na khat a kibawl khatvei ahi hi.

examples.english: This is my first time visiting the city.
examples.zomi: Hih pen khuapi ka hawh a masapen vei ahi hi.

examples.english: I called her three times.
examples.zomi: Amah veithum ka phone hi.

senses.usage_en: Time is countable when it means an occasion: one time, two times, many times.
senses.usage_zomi: Khatvei gamtatna a kawk ciangin time simtheih hi: one time, two times, many times.

senses.heading: An available period
senses.definition_en: A period available for doing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawlna ding a om hun awng ahi hi.

examples.english: I do not have time to finish the report today.
examples.zomi: Tuni in report zohna ding hun ka nei kei hi.

examples.english: She reads during her free time.
examples.zomi: A hun awng ciangin lai sim hi.

senses.usage_en: Say have time to do something. Do not normally use an article when time means available time.
senses.usage_zomi: Have time to do something ci in zang in. Time in hun awng a kawk ciangin article koihlo zel hi.

senses.heading: A chemical element and metal
senses.definition_en: A soft, silver-coloured metal used in coatings and mixtures with other metals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khuhna leh metal dangte tawh kigawmna ah a kizang, a nem a dangkang metal zatleh khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The metal was covered with a thin layer of tin.
examples.zomi: Tua metal pen tin pang khat tawh kikhuh hi.

examples.english: Tin is often mixed with other metals.
examples.zomi: Tin pen metal dangte tawh kigawm zel hi.

senses.usage_en: The chemical symbol for tin is Sn.
senses.usage_zomi: Tin a chemical lim pen Sn ahi hi.

senses.heading: A metal container
senses.definition_en: A metal container used for storing food, paint, or another substance.
senses.explanation_zomi: An, suah ahih kei leh zatleh dang koihna ding metal bawm ahi hi.

examples.english: She opened a tin of beans.
examples.zomi: Bean bawm khat hong hi.

examples.english: Keep the paint in a closed tin.
examples.zomi: Suah pen metal bawm kikhak sungah koih in.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses tin for a food container. American English usually uses can.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah an bawm ading tin kizang zel hi. American English ah can kizangzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Extremely small.
senses.explanation_zomi: Neu mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A tiny insect landed on the leaf.
examples.zomi: Khuai neu mahmah khat singteh tungah tu hi.

examples.english: They live in a tiny apartment.
examples.zomi: Apartment neu mahmah khat sungah om uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Tiny is stronger than small and emphasizes an extremely small size.
senses.usage_zomi: Tiny pen small sangin khauhzaw a, neu mahmah cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: The pointed or narrow end
senses.definition_en: The pointed, narrow, or outermost end of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat a hiam, a pang ahih kei leh a tawpna pen ahi hi.

examples.english: The tip of the pencil broke.
examples.zomi: Pencil a zim a kitam hi.

examples.english: Touch the screen with your fingertip.
examples.zomi: Screen pen na khutme zim tawh suk in.

senses.usage_en: This meaning refers to an end point, not the whole object.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in van a vekpi hilo in, a tawpna zim bek kawk hi.

senses.heading: A useful piece of advice
senses.definition_en: A short piece of practical advice that helps someone do something better.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat na khat hoihzaw in a bawl theihna ding ngaihsutna tom leh phattuam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave us some useful study tips.
examples.zomi: Sia in sinna ading ngaihsutna phattuam pawlkhat hong pia hi.

examples.english: Here is a tip for saving money.
examples.zomi: Hih pen sum hawmsiamna ding ngaihsutna khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A tip is usually brief and practical. Advice is broader and uncountable.
senses.usage_zomi: Tip pen a tamzaw in tom a, gamtatna ah phattuam hi. Advice pen a huamzaw a, simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Extra money for service
senses.definition_en: Extra money given to someone for providing a service, in addition to the required price.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasepna khat hong bawl sak manin a piak ding man banah sum beh a kipia ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: sum beh a man sungah kihel

examples.english: We left a tip for the waiter.
examples.zomi: An hong pia pa ading sum beh nusia ung.

examples.english: The bill does not include the tip.
examples.zomi: Bill sungah nasepman beh kihel lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Tipping customs vary by country. In the United States, tipping restaurant servers is normally expected.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum beh piak ngeina gam khat leh khat kibanglo hi. United States ah restaurant nasemte sum beh piak ding kilam-en zel hi.

senses.heading: Needing rest
senses.definition_en: Feeling that you need rest or sleep because you have worked, travelled, or stayed awake.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, khualzin ahih kei leh ihmu lohna hangin tawlngak ahih kei leh ihmut kisam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am tired after working all day.
examples.zomi: Ni khat sung nasem khit ciangin ka gim hi.

examples.english: She was too tired to continue walking.
examples.zomi: Lampai zomtheihloh zahin gim hi.

senses.usage_en: A person feels tired. An activity that causes this feeling is tiring.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat pen tired hi a, tua lungsim a piangsak gamtatna pen tiring ahi hi.

senses.heading: Bored or annoyed by something repeated
senses.definition_en: Bored, annoyed, or unwilling to continue experiencing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a piang zel manin lungkimlo, ning ahih kei leh zomnuamlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am tired of hearing the same excuse.
examples.zomi: Paulam kibang sim ka zak ka ning hi.

examples.english: They became tired of waiting for a decision.
examples.zomi: Khensatna ngakna hong ning uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use tired of + noun or -ing form: tired of the noise; tired of waiting.
senses.usage_zomi: Tired of + noun/-ing ci in zang in: tired of the noise; tired of waiting.

senses.heading: The name of a work
senses.definition_en: The name given to a book, film, song, article, artwork, or other created work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, film, la, article, limsiamna nasep ahih kei leh kibawl na dang khat a kipia min ahi hi.

examples.english: What is the title of the book?
examples.zomi: Tua laibu min bang ahi hiam?

examples.english: Write your name and the essay title at the top.
examples.zomi: A tungah na min leh essay min gelh in.

senses.usage_en: Capitalization rules for titles vary by language and publishing style.
senses.usage_zomi: Title sung lai lian leh lai neu zatdan pen pau leh laibu suah laigelhdan tawh kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: An official position or rank
senses.definition_en: A name that shows a person’s official position, professional status, social rank, or honour.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ ukna dinmun, nghề dinmun, mipite lak a dinmun ahih kei leh pahtawina a pulaak min ahi hi.

examples.english: Her official title is Director of Finance.
examples.zomi: Ama ukna dinmun min pen Director of Finance ahi hi.

examples.english: The prince received a new royal title.
examples.zomi: Kumpipa tapa in kumpi innkuan dinmun min thak khat ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Titles such as Doctor, President, or Professor may be capitalized when used directly before a person’s name.
senses.usage_zomi: Doctor, President, leh Professor bang dinmun minte mi min mai ah a kizang ciangin lai lian tawh kipan thei hi.

senses.heading: A championship
senses.definition_en: The position or award held by the winner of an important sports competition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna kidemna thupi khat a gualzopa in a ngah dinmun ahih kei leh pahtawina ahi hi.

examples.english: She won the national tennis title.
examples.zomi: Gam sung tennis champion dinmun ngah hi.

examples.english: The team successfully defended its title.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl in a gualzawhna min gualzawhna tawh kem hi.

senses.usage_en: In sport, title refers to championship status, not merely the name of an event.
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna ah title in pawi min bek hilo in, champion dinmun kawk hi.

senses.heading: Toward a place or destination
senses.definition_en: Used to show movement in the direction of a place, person, or destination.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, mi ahih kei leh tunna khat lamah gamtatna a pai cih a pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: She walked to the station.
examples.zomi: Station ah lampai hi.

examples.english: We sent the documents to the office.
examples.zomi: Documentte office ah khak ung.

senses.usage_en: Do not normally use to before home: say go home, not go to home.
senses.usage_zomi: Home mai ah ngeina in to koihlo hi: go home ci a, go to home ci lo hi.

senses.heading: Identifying a receiver or affected person
senses.definition_en: Used to show the person or organization that receives something or is affected by an action.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a ngah ahih kei leh gamtatna in a sukha mi maw pawl a pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: He gave the key to his sister.
examples.zomi: A sangnu tungah tawhtang pia hi.

examples.english: Please explain the problem to the manager.
examples.zomi: Tua buaina manager tungah hilhcian in.

senses.usage_en: Some verbs can place the receiver before the object without to: give her the key. Others normally require to: explain the problem to her.
senses.usage_zomi: Verb pawlkhat tawh ngahpa pen object mai ah to loin koih thei hi: give her the key. Verb dang pawlkhat tawh to kisam hi: explain the problem to her.

senses.heading: Showing a limit, range, or relationship
senses.definition_en: Used to connect two limits, amounts, times, people, or things in a relationship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, zat, ciangtan, mi ahih kei leh nate nih kikal kizopna a pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The office is open from nine to five.
examples.zomi: Office pen nai kua pan nai nga dong kihong hi.

examples.english: This road connects the village to the city.
examples.zomi: Hih lampi in khua leh khuapi kizom sak hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact Zomi equivalent changes with the relationship: destination, recipient, time limit, range, or connection.
senses.usage_zomi: Zomi a khiatna taktak pen tunna mun, ngahpa, hun ciangtan, zat kikal ahih kei leh kizopna a kawk cih tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: Before an infinitive verb
senses.definition_en: Used before the base form of a verb to form an infinitive, as in to learn or to help.
senses.zomi_equivalents: Zomi ah thu kizomna bangin kilet; preposition kiletna khat kipsa omlo
senses.explanation_zomi: To learn leh to help bangin verb a bulpi pianzia mai ah om in infinitive bawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: I want to learn English.
examples.zomi: English sin ka nuam hi.

examples.english: She needs to finish the report today.
examples.zomi: Tuni in report zosiang kul hi.

senses.usage_en: In this use, to is an infinitive marker rather than a preposition. The supplied label preposition applies to the earlier senses.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zatna ah to pen preposition hilo in infinitive marker ahi hi. A kipia preposition cih part of speech pen a tung a khiatnate ading ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: On or during the present day.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tu laitak ni in ahih kei leh hih ni sung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am working from home today.
examples.zomi: Tuni inn pan nasem ing.

examples.english: The weather is warmer today.
examples.zomi: Tuni khuahun a lumzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Today can also function as a noun: Today is Friday. Do not use a preposition before it in ordinary time expressions: I will go today, not on today.
