senses.usage_zomi: Today pen noun in zong kizang thei hi: Today is Friday. Hun a kawk ngeina sentence ah a mai ah preposition koihlo hi: I will go today ci a, on today ci lo hi.

senses.definition_en: One of the five separate parts at the end of a human foot.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing khe a tawpna ah a om khen nga lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: I injured my big toe while playing football.
examples.zomi: Football ka kimawl laitakin ka kheme lian liam hi.

examples.english: She stood on her toes to reach the shelf.
examples.zomi: Van koihna a phakna dingin a kheme zim tawh ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural of toe is toes. The corresponding parts on the hand are fingers.
senses.usage_zomi: Toe a plural pen toes ahi hi. Khut tung a tua bang pumpi khen pen fingers kici hi.

senses.heading: With one another
senses.definition_en: With another person or other people in the same place or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh mi dangte tawh mun khat ah omkhawm ahih kei leh nasepkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We worked together to solve the problem.
examples.zomi: Tua buaina veng dingin nasemkhawm ung.

examples.english: The family eats dinner together every evening.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in nitak sim nitak an nekhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Together emphasizes that people participate in the same activity or share the same place.
senses.usage_zomi: Together in mite gamtatna khat bawlkhawm ahih kei leh mun khat zangkhawm uh cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Joined or combined
senses.definition_en: Into one group, object, system, or relationship.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, van, system ahih kei leh kizopna khat suak dingin kizom ahih kei leh kigawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two parts fit together perfectly.
examples.zomi: Khen nihte a dik takin kituakkhawm hi.

examples.english: She put the pieces together.
examples.zomi: A khen neute gawpkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: Together may describe either people acting jointly or separate parts becoming one unit.
senses.usage_zomi: Together in mite nasepkhawm cih kawk thei a, khen tuamtuam na khat in kigawm cih zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: A fixture for receiving human waste
senses.definition_en: A bowl connected to a waste system that people use to pass urine or solid waste.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite zunsun ahih kei leh ekna ading ninsia luanna system tawh a kizom bawm ahi hi.

examples.english: Please flush the toilet after using it.
examples.zomi: Na zat khit ciangin ekna bawm tui luangsak in.

examples.english: The toilet needs to be cleaned.
examples.zomi: Ekna bawm siansuah kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, toilet often refers specifically to the fixture. Restroom or bathroom commonly refers politely to the room.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah toilet in ekna bawm ngiat kawk zel hi. Innkhan a vekpi kammal nem tawh gen dingin restroom ahih kei leh bathroom kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: A room containing a toilet
senses.definition_en: A room containing a toilet and sometimes a washbasin.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ekna bawm leh khatvei ciang khut sawpna bawm a om zun-ekkna innkhan ahi hi.

examples.english: Where is the nearest toilet?
examples.zomi: A nai pen zun-ekkna koiah om hiam?

examples.english: The public toilet is beside the station.
examples.zomi: Mipite zun-ekkna pen station geiah om hi.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses toilet for both the fixture and the room.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah toilet pen ekna bawm leh a innkhan a nihgel ading kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A soft, round fruit, usually red when ripe, that is commonly eaten as a vegetable.
senses.explanation_zomi: A min ciangin a san zel, a nem a bial, gah ahi napi meh leh an dangte sungah vegetable bangin a kizang gah ahi hi.

examples.english: She added tomatoes to the salad.
examples.zomi: Salad sungah tomato gah beh hi.

examples.english: These tomatoes are ready to eat.
examples.zomi: Hih tomato gahte nektheih dingin min khinta hi.

senses.usage_en: American English pronounces tomato /təˈmeɪtoʊ/. A common British pronunciation is /təˈmɑːtəʊ/.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah tomato pen /təˈmeɪtoʊ/ ci in kisuang hi. British English ah /təˈmɑːtəʊ/ ci in kisuang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: On or during the day after today.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuni khit ni in ahih kei leh zing ciang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We will finish the work tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing ciangin nasep zota ding ung.

examples.english: The meeting begins tomorrow morning.
examples.zomi: Meeting pen zing zingsangin kipan ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Tomorrow can also function as a noun: Tomorrow will be busy. Do not normally say on tomorrow.
senses.usage_zomi: Tomorrow pen noun in zong kizang thei hi: Tomorrow will be busy. Ngeina ah on tomorrow ci lo hi.

senses.heading: The quality of a voice
senses.definition_en: The quality of someone’s voice that expresses a feeling or attitude.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ aw zatdan tungtawn in lungsim thu ahih kei leh a omdan a kilakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her tone of voice sounded angry.
examples.zomi: Ama kampau aw pen a heh bangin ging hi.

examples.english: Speak in a calm tone.
examples.zomi: Aw nem leh lungdam takin pau in.

senses.usage_en: A speaker’s words may be polite while the tone sounds angry, impatient, humorous, or doubtful.
senses.usage_zomi: Kampaupa kammalte ziktat napi a aw zatdan in hehna, ngakzawhlohna, nuihzakna ahih kei leh lunghianna pulaak thei hi.

senses.heading: The general character of communication
senses.definition_en: The general feeling, style, or attitude expressed in a text, conversation, event, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, kihona, thu piang ahih kei leh dinmun khat sungah a kilang lungsim, laigelhdan ahih kei leh omdan ahi hi.

examples.english: The email has a professional tone.
examples.zomi: Tua email in nasep picing kampau dan nei hi.

examples.english: Her opening words set a friendly tone for the meeting.
examples.zomi: Ama kipatna kammalte in meeting lawmta in omsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In writing, tone is created through word choice, sentence structure, and level of formality.
senses.usage_zomi: Laigelhna ah tone pen kammal teelna, sentence kibawlna leh kampau picingdan tawh kibawl hi.

senses.heading: A musical sound
senses.definition_en: A sound with a particular pitch or quality, especially in music.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in la sungah aw a sang leh niam ahih kei leh a gingdan kician khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The instrument produces a warm tone.
examples.zomi: Tua la vanzat in aw nuam khat piangsak hi.

examples.english: She held the final tone for several seconds.
examples.zomi: Aw nunung pen second pawlkhat sung sau sak hi.

senses.usage_en: A tone is one musical sound; pitch describes how high or low that sound is.
senses.usage_zomi: Tone pen la aw khat ahi a, pitch in tua aw bangzah sang ahih kei leh niam cih pulaak hi.

senses.heading: The organ in the mouth
senses.definition_en: The soft, movable organ in the mouth used for tasting, swallowing, and speaking.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuakna, dolhna leh kampauhna ding a kizang kam sung pumpi khen nem leh kilingthei ahi hi.

examples.english: The hot soup burned my tongue.
examples.zomi: Sup lum in ka lei kangsak hi.

examples.english: The doctor asked her to stick out her tongue.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in a lei suah dingin sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse tongue with language, although tongue may be used figuratively to mean a language.
senses.usage_zomi: Tongue leh language khial kei in. Ahihhang tongue pen gentehna in pau khat a cihna zong ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: A language
senses.definition_en: A language, especially a person’s native or traditional language.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in mi khat’ ngeina ahih kei leh pianpih pau ahi hi.

examples.english: Zomi is her mother tongue.
examples.zomi: Zomi pau pen ama pianpih pau ahi hi.

examples.english: The children speak two tongues fluently.
examples.zomi: Naupangte pau nih siam takin pau thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is literary or formal. In ordinary English, language is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen laigelhna ahih kei leh picing kampau ah kizangzaw hi. Niteng English ah language kizangzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: During the evening or night of the present day.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuni nitak ahih kei leh hih zan sung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We are having dinner together tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuzan nitak an nekhawm ding ung.

examples.english: The temperature will fall tonight.
examples.zomi: Tuzan khuahun lumzah hong kiam ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Tonight can also function as a noun: Tonight will be cold. Do not normally say on tonight.
senses.usage_zomi: Tonight pen noun in zong kizang thei hi: Tonight will be cold. Ngeina ah on tonight ci lo hi.

senses.heading: More than is wanted or acceptable
senses.definition_en: More than is needed, wanted, possible, or acceptable.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisap, a kideih, a bawltheih ahih kei leh a kisangtheih zah sangin a tamzaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This bag is too heavy for me to carry.
examples.zomi: Hih sum-ip pen kei pua dingin giklua hi.

examples.english: The coffee is too hot to drink.
examples.zomi: Coffee a lumlua ahih manin dawn theih nailo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use too + adjective/adverb to show an excessive degree. Do not confuse it with very, which strengthens a description without necessarily indicating a problem.
senses.usage_zomi: A zah a khengval cihna ading too + adjective/adverb zang in. Very ahihleh dinmun khat khauhsak napi buaina om cihna tawntung hilo hi.

senses.heading: Also
senses.definition_en: In addition; also.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kigen khinsa banah zong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She speaks English, and she speaks Zomi too.
examples.zomi: English pau a, Zomi pau zong pau hi.

examples.english: “Have a good day.” “You too.”
examples.zomi: “Ni hoih zang in.” “Nang zong.”

senses.usage_en: In this meaning, too commonly appears at the end of a clause. Also often appears before the main verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah too pen sentence khen tawpna ah om zel hi. Also pen gamtat kammal bulpi mai ah om zel hi.

senses.heading: An instrument used for work
senses.definition_en: An object held or operated by hand and used to perform a particular kind of work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep nam kician khat bawlna ding khut tawh kilet ahih kei leh kizang van ahi hi.

examples.english: A hammer is a useful tool.
examples.zomi: Thuk pen vanzat phattuam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Keep the tools in a safe place.
examples.zomi: Vanzatte mun bit ah koih in.

senses.usage_en: A tool usually helps someone perform physical or practical work. A machine is generally more complex and may operate with power.
senses.usage_zomi: Tool in pumpi tawh nasep ahih kei leh nasep taktak khat panpih zel hi. Machine ahihleh a hakzaw a, tha tawh nasem thei hi.

senses.heading: Something used to achieve a purpose
senses.definition_en: A method, system, program, or resource used to achieve a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna kician khat tangtun na ding a kizang bawldan, system, program ahih kei leh panpihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A dictionary is an important learning tool.
examples.zomi: Dictionary pen sinna panpihna thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Email is a useful communication tool.
examples.zomi: Email pen kizopna panpihna phattuam khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense includes software, information, strategies, and systems—not only physical instruments.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna sungah software, thu, geelna lampi leh systemte zong kihel a, khut tawh kilet van bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: A hard structure in the mouth
senses.definition_en: One of the hard, white structures in the mouth used for biting and chewing food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An ket leh neksukna ding a kizang kam sung a khau a kang pumpi khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Brush your teeth twice a day.
examples.zomi: Ni khat na ha veihnih sik in.

examples.english: She went to the dentist because of tooth pain.
examples.zomi: A ha a nat manin ha siavuan kiangah pai hi.

senses.usage_en: The singular is tooth and the plural is teeth.
senses.usage_zomi: Singular pen tooth ahi a, plural pen teeth ahi hi.

senses.heading: A pointed part of a tool or machine
senses.definition_en: One of the pointed parts along the edge of a comb, saw, gear, or similar object.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ha bang a hiam; van a hiam khen
senses.explanation_zomi: Samkhau, singaatna, gear ahih kei leh van a kibangte a gei ah a om a hiam khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: One tooth of the saw is broken.
examples.zomi: Singaatna ha khat kitam hi.

examples.english: The gear has several damaged teeth.
examples.zomi: Tua gear in ha a kisia pawlkhat nei hi.

senses.usage_en: The word is extended to these objects because their pointed parts resemble teeth in the mouth.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih vante a hiam khen in kam sung ha tawh a kibat manin tooth kici hi.

senses.heading: The highest part or surface
senses.definition_en: The highest part, point, or surface of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a tungpen khen, mun ahih kei leh puatham ahi hi.

examples.english: Snow covered the top of the mountain.
examples.zomi: Vuk in mual tung khuh hi.

examples.english: Write your name at the top of the page.
examples.zomi: Laimai tungah na min gelh in.

senses.usage_en: Use on top of for something resting above another thing and at the top of for a position within a page, list, building, or mountain.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat a dang tungah a om ciangin on top of zang in. Laimai, laizom, inn ahih kei leh mual a tungpen mun ading at the top of zang in.

senses.heading: The highest rank or best position
senses.definition_en: The highest, most important, or most successful position in a group, list, or organization.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl, laizom ahih kei leh pawlpi sungah mun sangpen, thupipen ahih kei leh gualzo pen ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: at the top of the list

examples.english: Her name is at the top of the list.
examples.zomi: Ama min laizom tungpen ah om hi.

examples.english: The team returned to the top of the league.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl league sung mun sangpen ah ciahkik hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, top refers to status or performance rather than physical height.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah top in pumpi tawh a sang cih hilo in, dinmun ahih kei leh bawltheihna sangpen kawk hi.

senses.heading: A garment for the upper body
senses.definition_en: A piece of clothing worn on the upper part of the body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tunglamah a kisilh puan ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore a blue top with black pants.
examples.zomi: Tunglam puan a pawl leh pants vom silh hi.

examples.english: This top matches your skirt.
examples.zomi: Hih tunglam puan na skirt tawh kituak hi.

senses.usage_en: Top is a general clothing word and may refer to shirts, blouses, or similar upper-body garments.
senses.usage_zomi: Puansilh thu ah top pen kammal a huam hi a, shirt, blouse leh pumpi tunglam puan a kibangte kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A subject that people discuss, study, write about, or present.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite in a kikum, a sin, a gelh ahih kei leh a pulaak thulu ahi hi.

examples.english: Climate change was the main topic of the meeting.
examples.zomi: Khuahun kikhelna pen meeting thulu bulpi ahi hi.

examples.english: Students chose a topic for their essays.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in a essay uh ading thulu khat teel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A topic is the subject being discussed. A theme is often the deeper central idea developed through a work.
senses.usage_zomi: Topic pen a kikum thulu ahi hi. Theme ahihleh laigelh ahih kei leh nasep khat sung a thukpi ngaihsutna ahi zel hi.

senses.heading: Including everything
senses.definition_en: Including all parts or amounts; complete.
senses.explanation_zomi: A khen leh a zat khempeuh huamkim a, a vekpi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The total cost was one hundred dollars.
examples.zomi: A vekpi man dollar za khat ahi hi.

examples.english: What is the total number of students?
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang a vekpi bangzah om uh hiam?

senses.usage_en: Total before a noun means the complete amount after all parts are included.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kammal mai a total in a khen khempeuh kigawm khit a vekpi zat cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Complete or absolute
senses.definition_en: Complete and affecting the whole of something, often to an extreme degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kicingkim a, khen khat zong nutsiatlo in a vekpi a sukha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The project was a total failure.
examples.zomi: Tua project gualzo hetlo hi.

examples.english: The room fell into total silence.
examples.zomi: Innkhan sung a vekpi gamdai hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is often used for emphasis rather than a numerical calculation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in nambat simna sangin dinmun khat thupisakna ading kizangzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Completely; in every way or to the greatest possible degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi in, kicing takin ahih kei leh a khempeuh in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The two plans are totally different.
examples.zomi: Geelna nihte a vekpi in kibanglo hi.

examples.english: I totally agree with your decision.
examples.zomi: Na khensatna ka thukim mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Totally is common in informal English for strong emphasis. In formal writing, completely or a more precise expression may be preferable.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina English kampau ah totally thupisakna in kizang mahmah hi. Picing laigelhna ah completely ahih kei leh kammal kicianzaw hoihzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: Put a hand or body part against something
senses.definition_en: To put your hand, finger, or another body part lightly against someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khut, khutme ahih kei leh pumpi khen dang khat mi maw van khat tungah nem takin suk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Touch the screen to open the app.
examples.zomi: App honsak dingin screen suk in.

examples.english: Do not touch the hot pan.
examples.zomi: Belsem lum suk kei in.

senses.usage_en: Touch does not necessarily involve holding or moving an object; it may mean only making physical contact.
senses.usage_zomi: Touch in van khat len ahih kei leh khelsak cihna tawntung hilo a, pumpi tawh a lawn bek zong ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Come into contact
senses.definition_en: To be so close that two surfaces or objects make physical contact.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van nih a kinaizah in a puatham uh kilawn cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The branches touched the roof.
examples.zomi: Singbakte innkhum lawn hi.

examples.english: Her feet did not touch the ground.
examples.zomi: A khe leitung lawnlo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, no deliberate action is required; objects may simply be in contact.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah deihna tawh gamtat kullo a, vante kilawn bek ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Affect someone emotionally
senses.definition_en: To make someone feel sympathy, affection, sadness, or another strong emotion.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ lungsim sukha in khotuahna, itna, dahna ahih kei leh lungsim thu khauhtak khat piangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her kindness touched everyone.
examples.zomi: Ama hoihna in mi khempeuh lungsim sukha hi.

examples.english: I was deeply touched by their support.
examples.zomi: Amaute panpihna in ka lungsim hong sukha mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this emotional sense, touched commonly describes a warm, grateful, or sympathetic feeling.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih lungsim tawh kisai khiatna ah touched in lungdamna, khotuahna ahih kei leh lungsim nuam sukna kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Difficult
senses.definition_en: Difficult to do, deal with, understand, or endure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawl, veng, telh ahih kei leh thuak ding haksa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We had to make a tough decision.
examples.zomi: Khensatna haksa khat bawl kul hi.

examples.english: The family went through a tough period.
examples.zomi: Tua innkuan hun haksa khat kantan hi.

senses.usage_en: In informal English, tough frequently means difficult or challenging.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngeina English kampau ah tough in haksa ahih kei leh haksatna a pia cihna kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: Strong and able to endure difficulty
senses.definition_en: Physically or mentally strong enough to deal with hardship, pain, or difficult conditions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi ahih kei leh lungsim in thahat a, haksatna leh natna thuakzo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is tough enough to handle the pressure.
examples.zomi: Amah tua pressure thuakzo dingin lungsim thahat hi.

examples.english: The plant is tough and can survive cold weather.
examples.zomi: Hih singkung thahat a, khuahun vot sungah nungta thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling someone tough can praise that person’s strength or resilience.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat tough cih in ama thahatna ahih kei leh haksatna kantan theihna phatna ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Difficult to cut or chew
senses.definition_en: Difficult to cut, break, or chew because the material is strong or hard.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zatleh a khauh manin tan, kheh ahih kei leh neksuk ding haksa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The meat was dry and tough.
examples.zomi: Sa a khawng a, neksuk haksa hi.

examples.english: These bags are made from tough material.
examples.zomi: Hih sum-ipte zatleh khauh tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: For food, tough means difficult to chew and usually describes an undesirable texture.
senses.usage_zomi: An tawh kisai in tough in neksuk haksa a, ngeina in khuak leh pianzia hoihlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A journey visiting several places
senses.definition_en: A journey in which someone visits several places for pleasure, education, or a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nopna, pilna ahih kei leh ngiimna kician khat tawh mun tuamtuam hawh khualzinna ahi hi.

examples.english: We took a guided tour of the museum.
examples.zomi: Lampi lakmi tawh museum sung veh ung.

examples.english: They went on a tour of several Asian countries.
examples.zomi: Asia gam pawlkhat veh dingin khualzin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use go on a tour or take a tour. A tour normally includes planned visits to one or more places.
senses.usage_zomi: Go on a tour ahih kei leh take a tour ci in zang in. Tour sungah mun khat ahih kei leh a tamzaw vehna kigensa om zel hi.

senses.heading: A series of performances or competitions
senses.definition_en: A planned series of performances, games, or public appearances in different places.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun tuamtuam ah a kizui in la, kimawlna ahih kei leh mipite mai a kilakna geelkhitsa pawl ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mun tuamtuam ah program bawl dingin pai

examples.english: The band begins its world tour next month.
examples.zomi: La pawl in kha hong tung ciang leitung gam tuamtuam program kipan ding hi.

examples.english: The team returned home after a successful tour.
examples.zomi: Gualzo kimawlna khualzinna khit ciangin tua pawl innah ciah hi.

senses.usage_en: Musicians, theatre companies, and sports teams commonly go on tour.
senses.usage_zomi: Lasak pawl, tangthu kimawl pawl leh kimawl pawlte mun tuamtuam ah program bawl dingin go on tour ci uh hi.

senses.definition_en: The activity and business of travelling for pleasure and providing services for visitors.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nopna ding khualzinna leh khualzinte ading hotel, annekna, khualzinna leh nasepna dangte vaihawmna sum nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: Tourism provides jobs for many local people.
examples.zomi: Khualzin nasep in khuami tampi nasep pia hi.

examples.english: The region depends heavily on tourism.
examples.zomi: Tua gam khen in khualzin sum nasep tungah kinga mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Tourism is uncountable. A person travelling for pleasure is a tourist.
senses.usage_zomi: Tourism pen simthamlo min kammal ahi hi. Nopna ding a khualzin mi pen tourist kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who travels to another place for pleasure, interest, or sightseeing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nopna, lunglutna ahih kei leh mun etna dingin mun dangah a khualzin mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The city attracts many international tourists.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in gamdang khualzin tampi kaikhawm hi.

examples.english: Tourists visited the historic temple.
examples.zomi: Khualzinte in tangthu nei biakinn veh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A tourist travels mainly for pleasure. A traveller is a broader word for anyone making a journey.
senses.usage_zomi: Tourist in nopna dingin khualzin zel hi. Traveller ahihleh bang ngiimna tawh ahi zongin khualzin mi khempeuh huam hi.

senses.heading: In the direction of
senses.definition_en: In the direction of a person, place, or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun ahih kei leh na khat lamah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She walked towards the station.
examples.zomi: Station lamah lampai hi.

examples.english: The dog ran towards us.
examples.zomi: Ui pen kote lamah hong tai hi.

senses.usage_en: Towards shows direction but does not necessarily mean reaching the destination. To often implies arrival.
senses.usage_zomi: Towards in mun khat lamah pai cih kawk napi tua mun tung takpi cihna tawntung hilo hi. To in tunna kicianzaw kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: In relation to or for the purpose of
senses.definition_en: In relation to a person or subject, or as a contribution to a purpose or result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh thulu khat tungah a omdan, ahih kei leh ngiimna khat tangtun na ding panpihna cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her attitude towards learning is positive.
examples.zomi: Sinna tungah ama ngaihsutdan hoih hi.

examples.english: This payment will go towards the total cost.
examples.zomi: Hih sum in a vekpi man piakna panpih ding hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses toward without final s. British English more commonly uses towards. Both are correct.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah a tawp s tello toward kizangzaw hi. British English ah towards kizangzaw hi. A nihgel man hi.

senses.definition_en: A piece of absorbent cloth or paper used for drying a person, object, or surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi, van ahih kei leh puatham khat a tui tulhna dingin a kizang tui a hip puan maw lai ahi hi.

examples.english: Dry your hands with this towel.
examples.zomi: Hih puan tawh na khut tul in.

examples.english: She wrapped the wet towel around her hair.
examples.zomi: Tui a bua puan pen a sam kimah tuam hi.

senses.usage_en: A cloth towel can be reused after washing. A paper towel is normally used once and discarded.
senses.usage_zomi: Puan towel pen sawpsiang in kizangkik thei hi. Paper towel pen khatvei zat khit ciang paih zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A tall, narrow building or structure, often used for observation, communication, defence, or supporting equipment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Enna, kizopna, bitna ahih kei leh vanzat domna ding a kizang inn ahih kei leh khuam sang leh pang ahi hi.

examples.english: The old clock tower stands in the town centre.
examples.zomi: Nai khuam sang lui pen khuapi laizangah ding hi.

examples.english: Workers repaired the communication tower.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in kizopna khuam sang bawlhoih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A tower is usually taller than it is wide and may stand alone or form part of a larger building.
senses.usage_zomi: Tower pen a phei sangin a tunglam sauzaw zel a, amah bek in ding thei ahih kei leh inn lian khat khen zong ahi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A place where people live and work that is larger than a village but usually smaller than a city.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite om leh nasemna, khua neu sangin lianzaw napi khuapi sangin neuzaw mun ahi hi.

examples.english: She grew up in a small town.
examples.zomi: Khua neu khat ah khang hi.

examples.english: The hospital is near the town centre.
examples.zomi: Siiminn pen khua laizang kiangah om hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact legal difference between a town and a city varies by country. In everyday use, a city is generally larger and more urban.
senses.usage_zomi: Town leh city a thukhun bang kibatlohna pen gam khat leh khat kibanglo hi. Niteng kampau ah city pen lianzaw a, khuapi omdan nei zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: An object made for children to play with.
senses.explanation_zomi: Naupang-te kimawlna ding a kibawl van ahi hi.

examples.english: The child put his toys in a box.
examples.zomi: Naupang in a kimawlna vante bawm sungah koih hi.

examples.english: She bought a wooden toy for her daughter.
examples.zomi: A tanu ading sing tawh kibawl kimawlna van khat lei hi.

senses.usage_en: Toy can also be used before another noun to describe a small model: toy car, toy train, or toy animal.
senses.usage_zomi: Toy pen min kammal dang mai ah koih in van khat a lim neu a cihna in zong kizang thei hi: toy car, toy train, leh toy animal.

senses.heading: A path or rough road
senses.definition_en: A path or narrow, rough road made by people, animals, or vehicles.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite, ganhingte ahih kei leh mawtawte paihna pan a kibawl lampi neu leh sia ahi hi.

examples.english: We followed a narrow track through the forest.
examples.zomi: Gamlak sung lampi neu zui in pai ung.

examples.english: The farm is reached by a rough track.
examples.zomi: Tua loh pen lampi sia khat zui in kitung hi.

senses.usage_en: A track is often narrower and less developed than a road.
senses.usage_zomi: Track pen lampi sangin neu a, a kibawl kicinglo zaw zel hi.

senses.heading: A railway line
senses.definition_en: The two metal rails on which trains travel.
senses.explanation_zomi: Train a paina ding leitungah a kikoih metal line nih ahi hi.

examples.english: Workers repaired the railway track.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in train lampi bawlhoih uh hi.

examples.english: Never walk along the train tracks.
examples.zomi: Train lampi tungah lampai ngei kei in.

senses.usage_en: In American English, railroad tracks is common. British English often uses railway tracks.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah railroad tracks kizang mahmah hi. British English ah railway tracks kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: A course used for racing
senses.definition_en: A prepared course used for running, racing, or another sport.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tai, mawtaw kidem ahih kei leh kimawlna dangte ading a kibawl lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: The runners completed four laps of the track.
examples.zomi: Taimite in taihna lampi li vei vel uh hi.

examples.english: Students were practising on the running track.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te taihna lampi tungah kiilh uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Track also appears in track and field, the group of running, jumping, and throwing sports.
senses.usage_zomi: Track pen taihna, kiangna leh lawnna kimawlnate a huam track and field sungah zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: A recorded song
senses.definition_en: One individual song or piece of recorded music on an album or recording.
senses.explanation_zomi: Album ahih kei leh la kikhumna khat sung a la khat ahi hi.

examples.english: This is my favourite track on the album.
examples.zomi: Hih la pen album sung a ka deihpen la ahi hi.

examples.english: The album contains twelve tracks.
examples.zomi: Tua album sungah la sawm leh nih om hi.

senses.usage_en: In music, track refers to one recorded song or instrumental piece.
senses.usage_zomi: La thu ah track in la kikhumsa khat ahih kei leh la vanzat tumna khat kawk hi.

senses.heading: Buying and selling
senses.definition_en: The activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods and services.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vante leh nasepnate lei, zuak ahih kei leh khekna sum nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: Trade between the two countries has increased.
examples.zomi: Gam nih kikal sum kilehzuakna khang hi.

examples.english: The port is an important centre for international trade.
examples.zomi: Tua kongpi pen gam kikal sum kilehzuakna mun thupi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Trade is usually uncountable when referring generally to commercial exchange.
senses.usage_zomi: Sum kilehzuakna a huamkim in a kigen ciangin trade simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: A skilled occupation
senses.definition_en: A skilled practical occupation, especially one involving work with the hands.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in khut tawh a kibawl, sinna leh kiilhna a kisam nasep siamna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: He learned the trade of carpentry.
examples.zomi: Sing tawh van bawl siamna sin hi.

examples.english: Trade schools prepare students for practical careers.
examples.zomi: Nasep siamna sangte in sangnaupang-te khut nasep nuntakna ading kiging sak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Examples of trades include carpentry, plumbing, electrical work, and welding.
senses.usage_zomi: Trade sungah sing tawh van bawlna, tui pipe bawlna, meivak nasep leh metal zomna bangte kihel hi.

senses.heading: Business in a particular product
senses.definition_en: The business of buying and selling a particular kind of product.
senses.zomi_equivalents: van nam khat sum nasep; kilehzuakna
senses.explanation_zomi: Van nam kician khat lei leh zuakna sum nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: The region depends on the coffee trade.
examples.zomi: Tua gam khen in coffee kilehzuakna tungah kinga hi.

examples.english: She works in the book trade.
examples.zomi: Laibu sum nasep ah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the product or industry normally comes before trade.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah van ahih kei leh sum nasep khen min pen trade mai ah om zel hi.

senses.heading: A long-established custom
senses.definition_en: A belief, custom, or way of doing something that has been passed from one generation to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khang khat pan khang dangah a kipiakto upna, ngeina ahih kei leh bawldan ahi hi.

examples.english: The community preserves its traditional songs and dances.
examples.zomi: Tua khua in a ngeina late leh lamte kem hi.

examples.english: Eating together is a family tradition.
examples.zomi: An nekhawm pen innkuan ngeina khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A tradition is maintained over time and passed to later generations.
senses.usage_zomi: Tradition pen hun sawtpi kizui a, khang thakte tungah kipiahto hi.

senses.heading: A body of beliefs or practices
senses.definition_en: A connected set of beliefs, practices, or ideas belonging to a religion, culture, institution, or school of thought.
senses.explanation_zomi: Biakna, ngeina, pawlpi ahih kei leh ngaihsutna lampi khat tawh kisai upna, gamtatna leh ngaihsutna kizomkhawm ahi hi.

examples.english: The practice belongs to an ancient religious tradition.
examples.zomi: Tua gamtatna pen tanglai biakna ngeina khat sungah kihel hi.

examples.english: The university has a strong tradition of research.
examples.zomi: Tua university in thuzonna ngeina khauh nei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is broader than one individual custom and may include many teachings and practices.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in ngeina khat bek sangin a huamzaw a, thuhilhna leh gamtatna tampi kihel thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Following customs, beliefs, methods, or styles that have existed for a long time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun sawtpi a om khanggui ngeina, upna, bawldan ahih kei leh puatham a zui cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They wore traditional clothing at the festival.
examples.zomi: Pawi ah ngeina puan silh uh hi.

examples.english: The food is prepared using a traditional method.
examples.zomi: Tua an pen ngeina bawldan tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Traditional does not automatically mean old-fashioned or inferior; it simply relates to an established tradition.
senses.usage_zomi: Traditional in lui, tulai tawh kituaklo ahih kei leh hoihlo cihna pello hi; a kipsa ngeina tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Vehicles using roads
senses.definition_en: Vehicles moving along roads, especially when considered together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi tungah a pai mawtaw, bus, truck leh van dangte a huamkim in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: There was heavy traffic this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsangin lampi tungah mawtaw tampi om hi.

examples.english: We were delayed by a traffic jam.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw kikhawlna hangin hun sawt ung.

senses.usage_en: Traffic is uncountable. Do not normally say a traffic or traffics when referring to vehicles.
senses.usage_zomi: Traffic pen simthamlo min kammal ahi hi. Mawtawte a kawk ciangin ngeina ah a traffic ahih kei leh traffics ci lo hi.

senses.heading: Movement of people, goods, or information
senses.definition_en: The movement of people, goods, messages, or data through a particular route or system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, van, thupuak ahih kei leh data lampi maw system khat tungtawn in a paihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Air traffic increased during the holiday.
examples.zomi: Pawi hun sungin vanleng paihna khang hi.

examples.english: The website receives heavy traffic each morning.
examples.zomi: Tua website ah zingsang simin hawhmi leh data paihna tampi om hi.

senses.usage_en: The context shows whether traffic means road vehicles, aircraft, visitors, goods, or digital data.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kizomna in traffic pen mawtaw, vanleng, hawhmi, van ahih kei leh digital data kawk cih kician sak hi.

senses.heading: A railway vehicle
senses.definition_en: A connected series of railway vehicles that carries passengers or goods along tracks.
senses.explanation_zomi: Train lampi tungah khualzinte ahih kei leh vante a pua, leeng tuamtuam kizomkhawm ahi hi.

examples.english: We travelled to the city by train.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah train tawh khualzin ung.

examples.english: The train arrived ten minutes late.
examples.zomi: Train minute sawm a nung in hong tung hi.

senses.usage_en: Use by train for the method of travel and on the train when describing someone or something aboard it.
senses.usage_zomi: Khualzinna lampi a kigen ciangin by train zang a, train sung a om mi ahih kei leh van a kigen ciangin on the train zang in.

senses.heading: A connected series
senses.definition_en: A series of people, animals, objects, or events connected or following one another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing, van ahih kei leh thu piang khat leh khat kizom ahih kei leh kizui in a omte ahi hi.

examples.english: The interruption broke my train of thought.
examples.zomi: Hong daalna in ka ngaihsutna kizui tansak hi.

examples.english: A train of camels crossed the desert.
examples.zomi: Kala-u kizui pawl in sehnel gam kantan uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense develops from the image of railway cars joined in a line.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen train leengte a kizom in a kizuih lim pan hong piang hi.

senses.heading: A person who trains others
senses.definition_en: A person who teaches people or animals the skills needed for a job, sport, or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, kimawlna ahih kei leh gamtatna khat ading mite maw ganhingte a sinsak leh a kiilsak mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The trainer showed us how to use the equipment safely.
examples.zomi: Sinsakpa in vanzat bit takin zatdan hong lak hi.

examples.english: She works as a personal fitness trainer.
examples.zomi: Mimal pumpi cidamna kiilsakmi in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: A trainer normally teaches practical skills or prepares someone for a particular activity.
senses.usage_zomi: Trainer in nasep siamna a taktak hilh ahih kei leh gamtatna kician khat ading mi khat kiging sak zel hi.

senses.heading: A sports shoe
senses.definition_en: A soft shoe designed for sport or casual wear.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kimawlna ahih kei leh niteng silhna ding a kibawl khekhap nem ahi hi.

examples.english: He bought a new pair of trainers.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna khekhap thak khat lei hi.

examples.english: Wear comfortable trainers for the walk.
examples.zomi: Lampai ading khekhap nem leh tutnuam silh in.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is British English and is usually plural: trainers. American English commonly uses sneakers or athletic shoes.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen British English ahi a, plural trainers ci in kizang zel hi. American English ah sneakers ahih kei leh athletic shoes kici zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: The process of learning the skills and knowledge needed for a job, sport, or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep, kimawlna ahih kei leh gamtatna khat ading a kisam siamna leh pilna sinna kalsuan ahi hi.

examples.english: New employees receive two weeks of training.
examples.zomi: Nasem thakte kal nih sung siamna sinna ngah uh hi.

examples.english: Regular training improved her performance.
examples.zomi: Tawlngal loin kiilhna in ama bawltheihna hoihsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Training is normally uncountable. Use training course or training session for one organized program or meeting.
senses.usage_zomi: Training pen simthamlo min kammal ahi hi. Program ahih kei leh meeting khat kician ading training course maw training session zang in.

senses.heading: Move someone or something to another place
senses.definition_en: To move someone or something from one place, vehicle, department, or organization to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat mun, mawtaw, nasep khen ahih kei leh pawl khat pan a dangah khelsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The patient was transferred to another hospital.
examples.zomi: Cina pen siiminn dangah kikhelsak hi.

examples.english: She transferred to the finance department.
examples.zomi: Sumvai nasep khenah kikhel hi.

senses.usage_en: Transfer to names the new destination, while transfer from names the original place.
senses.usage_zomi: Transfer to in tunna mun thak kawk a, transfer from in kipatna mun lui kawk hi.

senses.heading: Move money, data, or ownership
senses.definition_en: To move money, information, digital files, rights, or ownership from one person, account, or system to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, thu, digital file, thuneihna ahih kei leh neihna mi, account maw system khat pan a dangah khelsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I transferred the money to her account.
examples.zomi: Sum pen ama account ah ka puaksawn hi.

examples.english: The files were transferred to the new computer.
examples.zomi: File-te computer thak ah kipuaksawn hi.

senses.usage_en: For electronic movement, transfer normally means copying or moving information between devices, accounts, or systems.
senses.usage_zomi: Electronic thu ah transfer in device, account ahih kei leh systemte kikal data khelsak maw puaksawn cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Change vehicles during a journey
senses.definition_en: To leave one vehicle or route and continue the journey on another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khualzinna sungah mawtaw ahih kei leh lampi khat pan tuaksuk in a dang tawh khualzin zom cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We transferred to another train at the station.
examples.zomi: Station ah train dang khat khel ung.

examples.english: Passengers must transfer between the two flights.
examples.zomi: Khualzinte vanleng nih kikal kikhel kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses transfer. British English may also use change: change trains.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah transfer kizang zel hi. British English ah change trains bangin change zong kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: To change someone or something completely or greatly in form, appearance, condition, or character.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a vekpi in khelsak; lim dang suaksak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a pianzia, puatham, dinmun ahih kei leh omdan a vekpi in ahih kei leh nasa takin khelsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Education can transform people’s lives.
examples.zomi: Pilna in mite nuntakna a vekpi in khelsak thei hi.

examples.english: The old building was transformed into a library.
examples.zomi: Inn lui pen library in kikhelsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use transform into for the new form and transform from A into B when naming both the original and final forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Pianzia thak ading transform into zang in. A lui leh a thak a nihgel gen dingin transform from A into B zang in.

senses.definition_en: The process or period of changing from one state, system, condition, or stage to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, system, omzia ahih kei leh khantohna khen khat pan a dangah kikhelna kalsuan maw hun ahi hi.

examples.english: The company is making a transition to digital records.
examples.zomi: Kampani pen digital record zatna lamah kikhel hi.

examples.english: Children need support during the transition to a new school.
examples.zomi: Sang thak a kikhelna hunin naupang-te panpihna kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use transition from A to B when naming the original and new states.
senses.usage_zomi: A lui leh a thak dinmunte gen dingin transition from A to B zang in.

senses.heading: Express meaning in another language
senses.definition_en: To express written or spoken words in another language while preserving their meaning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai ahih kei leh kampau kammalte a khiatna kem in pau dang khat tawh pulaak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please translate this paragraph into Zomi.
examples.zomi: Hih paragraph Zomi pau in let in.

examples.english: She translated the letter from English into Burmese.
examples.zomi: Tua lai English pan Burmese pau in let hi.

senses.usage_en: Use translate from for the source language and translate into for the target language.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu bul a kipatna pau ading translate from zang a, kiletna pau ading translate into zang in.

senses.heading: Change ideas into action or results
senses.definition_en: To change an idea, plan, feeling, or quality into a practical action or result.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gamtatna in suaksak; ngahna taktak piangsak
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna, geelna, lungsim thu ahih kei leh hoihna khat gamtatna taktak maw ngahna in suaksak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The team translated its ideas into action.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl in a ngaihsutnate uh gamtatna taktak in suaksak uh hi.

examples.english: Economic growth must translate into better jobs.
examples.zomi: Sumvai khantohna in nasep hoihzaw piangsak kul hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes turning something abstract into a practical effect.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in muhtheihloh ngaihsutna khat nasep ahih kei leh ngahna taktak in suaksak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The process of translating
senses.definition_en: The process of expressing written or spoken material in another language while preserving its meaning.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai ahih kei leh kampau thu a khiatna kem in pau dang khat tawh pulaakna kalsuan ahi hi.

examples.english: Accurate translation requires careful attention to context.
examples.zomi: Pau letna man ading thu kizomna pilvang takin en kul hi.

examples.english: Technology can assist the translation process.
examples.zomi: Technology in pau letna kalsuan panpih thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Translation should preserve meaning, purpose, and appropriate style rather than replace every word mechanically.
senses.usage_zomi: Pau letna in kammal khat ciang machine bangin khelsak sangin khiatna, ngiimna leh kampau dan kituak kem ding hi.

senses.heading: A translated text or speech
senses.definition_en: A text or speech that has been expressed in a language different from the original.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu bul a pau sangin pau dang khat tawh a kilet lai ahih kei leh kampau ahi hi.

examples.english: I compared the translation with the original text.
examples.zomi: Kiletna leh lai bul ka tehkak hi.

examples.english: The book is available in a Zomi translation.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu pen Zomi pau a kiletna om hi.

senses.usage_en: A particular translated version is countable: a translation; several translations.
senses.usage_zomi: Pau a kilet version kician khat pen simtheih hi: a translation; several translations.

senses.heading: A system or means of carrying people or goods
senses.definition_en: A system or method for moving people or goods from one place to another.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khualzinna vaihawmna; mi leh van puakna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite ahih kei leh vante mun khat pan mun dangah puakna system maw lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: The city needs a better public transport system.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in mipite khualzinna vaihawmna hoihzaw kisam hi.

examples.english: Most goods are moved by road transport.
examples.zomi: Van a tamzaw lampi tung puakna tawh kipua hi.

senses.usage_en: In British English, transport is the usual general word. American English commonly uses transportation.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah a huamkim kammal in transport kizang zel hi. American English ah transportation kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: A vehicle used for travel
senses.definition_en: A vehicle or other means used to carry people or goods.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite ahih kei leh vante puakna ding a kizang mawtaw ahih kei leh van ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel provided transport to the airport.
examples.zomi: Hotel in vanleng tual dong khualzinna van pia hi.

examples.english: We need transport for the equipment.
examples.zomi: Vanzatte puakna ding mawtaw kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, transport usually refers generally to available travel rather than one specifically named vehicle.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah transport in mawtaw khat kician min sangin khualzinna van a huamkim in kawk hi.

senses.heading: Make a journey
senses.definition_en: To go from one place to another, especially over a considerable distance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat pan mun dangah, a diak in gamla takah khualzin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She travels abroad for work.
examples.zomi: Nasep thu tawh gamdangah khualzin hi.

examples.english: We travelled by train from London to Paris.
examples.zomi: London pan Paris dong train tawh khualzin ung.

senses.usage_en: Use travel by before a method of transport: by car, by bus, by train. Say travel on foot for walking.
senses.usage_zomi: Khualzinna van mai ah travel by zang in: by car, by bus, by train. Lampai cihna ading travel on foot zang in.

senses.heading: Move or spread
senses.definition_en: To move, pass, or spread from one place or person to another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat mun ahih kei leh mi khat pan a dangah pai, kantan ahih kei leh kizel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Sound travels through air.
examples.zomi: Aw pen huih sungah kizel hi.

examples.english: The news travelled quickly through the community.
examples.zomi: Thuthang pen khua sungah manlang takin kizel hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense can describe the movement of sound, light, information, disease, or other effects.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen aw, khuavak, thu, cina leh a dangte kizelna ading kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who is travelling or who often makes journeys.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khual a zin lai ahih kei leh khual a zin zel mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Travellers must show their passports at the border.
examples.zomi: Khualzinte in gamgi ah a passport uh lak kul uh hi.

examples.english: She is an experienced traveller.
examples.zomi: Amah khualzinna phutkhak tampi a nei mi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: British English spells this word traveller with two ls. American English normally spells it traveler with one l.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah traveller ci in l nih tawh kigelh hi. American English ah traveler ci in l khat tawh kigelh zel hi.

senses.heading: Behave toward someone in a particular way
senses.definition_en: To behave toward or deal with a person, animal, or thing in a particular way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing ahih kei leh na khat tungah omdan kician khat tawh gamta cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat tungah hoih takin gamta

examples.english: Treat other people with respect.
examples.zomi: Mi dangte zahtakna tawh zong in.

examples.english: The workers complained that they were treated unfairly.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in thutanglo takin kizong uh ci in mawhsak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use treat someone with + noun and treat someone as + role or category.
senses.usage_zomi: Treat someone with + noun leh treat someone as + dinmun/nam ci in zang in.

senses.heading: Give medical care
senses.definition_en: To provide medical care for an illness, injury, or patient.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cina, liamna ahih kei leh cina mi khat zatui pilna tawh bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Doctors treated the injured passengers.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te in a liam khualzinte bawl uh hi.

examples.english: The infection can be treated with medicine.
examples.zomi: Tua natna khuak zatui tawh kibawl thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Doctors treat patients, illnesses, and injuries. Medicine or therapy may be used to treat a condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Siavuan-te in cina mite, cinate leh liamnate bawl uh hi. Zatui ahih kei leh therapy tawh cina kibawl thei hi.

senses.heading: Give someone something enjoyable
senses.definition_en: To buy or provide something enjoyable for someone as a special gift or experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tungah letsong ahih kei leh phutkhak nuam tuam khat lei sak maw pia cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I will treat you to lunch.
examples.zomi: Sun-an nang ka leemsak ding hi.

examples.english: She treated herself to a new dress.
examples.zomi: Ama ading puan thak khat ki-lei sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use treat someone to something. My treat means the speaker will pay.
senses.usage_zomi: Treat someone to something ci in zang in. My treat in kampaupa in sum pia ding cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Medical care
senses.definition_en: Medical care given to improve an illness, injury, or health condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Cina, liamna ahih kei leh cidamna dinmun khat hoihsakna ding a kipia zatui lam bawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: The patient is receiving treatment at the hospital.
examples.zomi: Cina pen siiminn ah zatui bawlna ngah hi.

examples.english: Early treatment can prevent serious complications.
examples.zomi: A masiah bawlna in cina nasemsem kikhelna khaktan thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Treatment may refer to one course of medical care or medical care generally.
senses.usage_zomi: Treatment in zatui bawlna kalsuan khat kician ahih kei leh zatui bawlna a huamkim in kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: The way someone or something is treated
senses.definition_en: The way a person, animal, subject, or object is dealt with.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, ganhing, thulu ahih kei leh van khat tungah bangci gamtat ahih kei leh bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: All employees deserve fair treatment.
examples.zomi: Nasem khempeuh thutang takin kizong ding kilawm hi.

examples.english: The animals received poor treatment.
examples.zomi: Ganhingte hoihlo takin kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, treatment describes behavior toward someone or something, not medical care.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah treatment in zatui bawlna hilo in, mi ahih kei leh na khat tung gamtatdan kawk hi.

senses.heading: A way of presenting a subject
senses.definition_en: The way a subject, story, or idea is discussed, presented, or developed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu, tangthu ahih kei leh ngaihsutna khat a kikum, a kipulaak ahih kei leh a kikhangsak dan ahi hi.

examples.english: The book provides a detailed treatment of the subject.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu in thulu pen kician takin pulaak hi.

examples.english: The film’s treatment of history was balanced.
examples.zomi: Tua film in tangthu a pulaakdan kilimbang hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense is common in academic, literary, and artistic discussion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih picing khiatna pen pilna, laibu leh limsiamna kihona ah kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A tall plant with a wooden trunk, branches, and usually leaves.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singtang khat nei a, singbak leh a tamzaw in singteh nei singkung sang ahi hi.

examples.english: They planted a tree beside the house.
examples.zomi: Inn geiah singkung khat phut uh hi.

examples.english: Birds built a nest in the tree.
examples.zomi: Vate in singkung tungah bu bawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A tree normally has one main wooden trunk and is larger than a bush or shrub.
senses.usage_zomi: Singkung in singtang bulpi khat nei zel a, singbuk ahih kei leh singkung neu sangin lianzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A general direction in which a situation, behavior, fashion, or set of data is changing or developing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, gamtatna, puatham ahih kei leh data khantohna a paihna lam a huamkim ahi hi.

examples.english: The data shows an upward trend in employment.
examples.zomi: Data in nasep ngahna khang semsem cih lak hi.

examples.english: This style has become a popular fashion trend.
examples.zomi: Hih puatham pen mite deih puatham kizuihzia khat hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: A trend describes an overall direction over time, not every individual change.
senses.usage_zomi: Trend in hun tawh a huamkim paihna lam kawk a, kikhelna neucik khat sim kawklo hi.

senses.heading: A court examination
senses.definition_en: A formal court process that examines evidence and decides whether someone is guilty or legally responsible.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teci sittel in mi khat mawhnei maw, thukhun bangin mopohna nei maw cih a khensat thukhenzum kalsuan ahi hi.

examples.english: The trial will begin next month.
examples.zomi: Thukhenna pen kha hong tung ciangin kipan ding hi.

examples.english: Everyone has the right to a fair trial.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh thutang thukhenna ngah theihna nei hi.

senses.usage_en: A trial determines legal responsibility. It is different from an investigation, which gathers information before or during legal proceedings.
senses.usage_zomi: Trial in thukhun bang mopohna khensat hi. Investigation ahihleh thukhenna ma ahih kei leh laitak thu leh teci zong hi.

senses.heading: A test of something
senses.definition_en: A test carried out to discover whether a product, method, or treatment is safe or effective.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, bawldan ahih kei leh zatui bawlna khat bit leh phattuam maw cih theihna ding a kibawl sittelna ahi hi.

examples.english: The medicine is being tested in a clinical trial.
examples.zomi: Tua zatui pen cina mite tung kancian sittelna ah kisittel hi.

examples.english: The company offered a free trial of the software.
examples.zomi: Kampani in software man loin zat-etna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: A trial gathers evidence before something is fully approved, adopted, or purchased.
senses.usage_zomi: Trial in na khat kiphatsak, kizangkipan ahih kei leh kilei ma in teci kaikhawm hi.

senses.heading: A difficult experience
senses.definition_en: A difficult experience that tests someone’s patience, strength, or character.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ thuakzawhna, thahatna ahih kei leh omdan a sittel phutkhak haksa ahi hi.

examples.english: The family faced many trials during the crisis.
examples.zomi: Buaina hun sungin tua innkuan haksatna tampi tuah hi.

examples.english: Her courage remained strong through every trial.
examples.zomi: Haksatna khempeuh kantan napi ama hangsanna kip tawh om hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a formal or literary use of trial meaning hardship.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen picing ahih kei leh laigelhna zatna hi a, haksatna cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A dishonest act
senses.definition_en: An action intended to deceive someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat a khemna dingin a kibawl gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: They played a trick on their friend.
examples.zomi: A lawm uh khem uh hi.

examples.english: The message was a trick designed to steal passwords.
examples.zomi: Tua thupuak pen password gukna ding khemna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A trick may be playful and harmless or dishonest and harmful; context shows which meaning is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Trick pen kimawlna leh siasakna omlo khemna ahi thei a, thumaanlo leh siasakna nei khemna zong ahi thei hi. Thu kizomna in khiatna kician sak hi.

senses.heading: A clever method
senses.definition_en: A clever or useful method that makes something easier to do.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl ding baih sak a, pilna tawh a kibawl lampi tom leh phattuam ahi hi.

examples.english: She taught me a useful trick for remembering names.
examples.zomi: Minte phawkna ding bawldan phattuam khat hong sinsak hi.

examples.english: This simple trick will save time.
examples.zomi: Hih bawldan baih in hun hong hawmsiam ding hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, trick means a helpful technique rather than deception.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah trick in khemna hilo in, panpih bawldan siam khat kawk hi.

senses.heading: A skilful or entertaining action
senses.definition_en: A skilful, surprising, or entertaining action performed for others to watch.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midangte etna ding a kibawl siamna nei, lamdanghuai ahih kei leh nuamsak gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: The magician performed a card trick.
examples.zomi: Dawi siam bang a gamta pa in card tawh lamdang lakna bawl hi.

examples.english: The dog learned a new trick.
examples.zomi: Ui in siamna lakna thak khat sin hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is common with magic, circus performances, sports, and trained animals.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen dawi bang lamdang lakna, circus, kimawlna leh a kisin ganhingte tungah kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: A journey or visit
senses.definition_en: A journey to a place and usually back again, especially for a short period or a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in hun tom sung ahih kei leh ngiimna kician khat tawh mun khat hawh a, a tamzaw in a kipatna munah ciahkik khualzinna ahi hi.

examples.english: She went on a business trip to Chicago.
examples.zomi: Chicago ah sum nasep khualzinna tawh pai hi.

examples.english: The school organized a trip to the museum.
examples.zomi: Sang in museum hawhna khualzinna khat vaihawm hi.

senses.usage_en: A trip usually describes the whole journey or visit. Travel refers more generally to the activity of going from place to place.
senses.usage_zomi: Trip in khualzinna khat leh hawhna a vekpi kawk zel hi. Travel in mun khat pan mun dangah paihna gamtatna a huamkim in kawk hi.

senses.heading: A stumble or fall
senses.definition_en: An occasion when someone catches a foot on something, loses balance, and nearly falls or falls.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ khe van khat ah a khaih manin a kimbangloh a, pukkuan ahih kei leh puk cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her trip on the stairs caused a minor injury.
examples.zomi: Kaltou ah a khe khaih pukna in liamna neu piangsak hi.

examples.english: Loose cables create a trip risk.
examples.zomi: Cable kikhihlo in khe khaih pukna lauhuaina piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: This noun sense is less common than the journey meaning. The related verb is trip: He tripped over a cable.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih noun khiatna pen khualzinna khiatna sangin kizang tawmzaw hi. A kizom verb pen trip ahi hi: He tripped over a cable.

senses.heading: Relating to hot regions near the equator
senses.definition_en: Relating to the hot parts of the world near the equator.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gam lum tawh kisai; equator kiang gam
senses.explanation_zomi: Leilung lai a equator kiang a gam lumte tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The country has a tropical climate.
examples.zomi: Tua gam in gam lum khuahun nei hi.

examples.english: Many tropical regions receive heavy rain.
examples.zomi: Gam lum khen tampi ah guah tampi zu hi.

senses.usage_en: Tropical describes regions between or near the Tropics, where the weather is generally warm throughout the year.
senses.usage_zomi: Tropical in Tropics kikal ahih kei leh a kiang gamte kawk a, tua munte kum sung a tamzaw lum hi.

senses.heading: Growing or living in tropical regions
senses.definition_en: Growing, living, or naturally occurring in hot regions near the equator.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gam lum a khang; gam lum ganhing
senses.explanation_zomi: Equator kiang gam lumte ah a khang, a nungta ahih kei leh pianpih in a om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Mangoes are tropical fruits.
examples.zomi: Mango gah pen gam lum gah ahi hi.

examples.english: The garden contains several tropical plants.
examples.zomi: Huan sungah gam lum singkung pawlkhat om hi.

senses.usage_en: A tropical plant or animal may also be kept in a colder country under controlled conditions.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam lum singkung ahih kei leh ganhing pen gam vot ah zong khuahun kithununna tawh kikem thei hi.

senses.heading: Problems or difficulty
senses.definition_en: Problems, difficulty, worry, or an unpleasant situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina, haksatna, lungkhamna ahih kei leh dinmun nuamlo ahi hi.

examples.english: We had trouble finding the address.
examples.zomi: Tua address zonna ah haksatna nei ung.

examples.english: The broken engine caused serious trouble.
examples.zomi: Engine a siatna in buaina lian piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Trouble is usually uncountable when it means difficulty: have trouble, not normally have a trouble.
senses.usage_zomi: Haksatna a kawk ciangin trouble pen simthamlo min kammal ahi hi: have trouble ci a, ngeina ah have a trouble ci lo hi.

senses.heading: A situation involving punishment or disapproval
senses.definition_en: A situation in which someone may be punished or strongly criticized for doing something wrong.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtat khialna hangin mi khat gim kipia ahih kei leh nasiatak in kimawhsak theih dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: He got into trouble at school.
examples.zomi: Sangah buaina sungah lut hi.

examples.english: She was in trouble for breaking the rule.
examples.zomi: Thukhun a palsat manin gim piakna dinmunah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Be in trouble often means being at risk of punishment, while have trouble doing something means experiencing difficulty.
senses.usage_zomi: Be in trouble in gim kipia theih dinmun kawk zel a, have trouble doing something in na khat bawl ding haksat cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Fighting or public disorder
senses.definition_en: Fighting, violence, or serious disorder involving a group of people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi pawl khat kidona, bawlsiatna ahih kei leh mipite lak buaina lian ahi hi.

examples.english: Trouble broke out after the match.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna khit ciangin kidona hong piang hi.

examples.english: Police were called to control the trouble.
examples.zomi: Buaina uk dingin police-te kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is uncountable and refers collectively to disorder or conflict.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen simthamlo hi a, kidona ahih kei leh buaina a huamkim in kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A piece of clothing covering the body from the waist to the ankles, with a separate part for each leg.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kawng pan khephah dong a khuh a, khe khat ciang ading khen tuam a nei puan ahi hi.

examples.english: He wore a white shirt and black trousers.
examples.zomi: Puan kang leh pheikhawk puan vom silh hi.

examples.english: These trousers are too long for me.
examples.zomi: Hih pheikhawk puan kei ading saulua hi.

senses.usage_en: Trousers is grammatically plural. Say a pair of trousers for one item. American English commonly uses pants.
senses.usage_zomi: Trousers pen grammar ah plural ahi hi. Puan khat ading a pair of trousers ci in zang in. American English ah pants kizangzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods, equipment, or materials.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, vanzat ahih kei leh zatleh pua ding a kizang lampi tung mawtaw lian ahi hi.

examples.english: A truck delivered the furniture this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsangin truck khat in inn sung vante hong pua hi.

examples.english: Heavy trucks use this road every day.
examples.zomi: Truck gikpite hih lampi niteng zang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Truck is the usual American English word. British English commonly uses lorry.
senses.usage_zomi: Truck pen American English kammal ngeina ahi hi. British English ah lorry kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Correct and based on facts
senses.definition_en: Correct and agreeing with facts or reality.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thumaan leh a taktak dinmun tawh a kituak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The report is based on a true story.
examples.zomi: Tua report pen tangthu taktak tungah kinga hi.

examples.english: Is it true that the road is closed?
examples.zomi: Lampi kikhak cih thumaan hiam?

senses.usage_en: True describes information that agrees with reality. Its opposite is false.
senses.usage_zomi: True in a taktak omzia tawh a kituak thu kawk hi. A kikal pen false ahi hi.

senses.heading: Real or genuine
senses.definition_en: Real, genuine, or having the qualities expected of a particular kind of person or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: A taktak, a lem hilo ahih kei leh mi maw na nam khat a hoihna diktak a nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A true friend supports you during difficult times.
examples.zomi: Lawm taktak in hun haksa sungah hong panpih hi.

examples.english: The test revealed the true value of the painting.
examples.zomi: Sittelna in tua lim a man diktak lak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, true emphasizes that someone or something is genuine rather than false, artificial, or merely apparent.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah true in mi ahih kei leh na khat a taktak hi a, lem, kibawl maw puatham bek hilo cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Loyal and faithful
senses.definition_en: Loyal, faithful, and continuing to support a person, belief, or cause.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, upna ahih kei leh nasep ngiimna khat tungah citak leh kip tawh om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She remained true to her principles.
examples.zomi: A thukhun upte tungah citak in omzom hi.

examples.english: He was true to his promise.
examples.zomi: A kiciamna tungah citak hi.

senses.usage_en: True to means loyal to or consistent with someone, something, or a stated principle.
senses.usage_zomi: True to in mi, na ahih kei leh thukhun kigen khat tawh kituak in citak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Really and genuinely
senses.definition_en: Really, genuinely, or in fact.
senses.explanation_zomi: Taktak in, a diktak in ahih kei leh thumaan in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The view from the mountain was truly beautiful.
examples.zomi: Mual tungpan a kilakna hoih taktak hi.

examples.english: She truly understands the needs of the community.
examples.zomi: Amah in khuami-te kisapna tel taktak hi.

senses.usage_en: Truly can strengthen an adjective or verb and emphasize that the description is genuine.
senses.usage_zomi: Truly in adjective ahih kei leh verb khauhsak a, a kigen omzia pen taktak hi cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Honestly or faithfully
senses.definition_en: In an honest, sincere, or faithful manner.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thumaan in; lungsim takin; citak in
senses.explanation_zomi: Thumaan, lungsim takpi ahih kei leh citak takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am truly grateful for your help.
examples.zomi: Na panpihna hangin lungsim takin ka lungdam hi.

examples.english: A good witness must speak truly.
examples.zomi: Teci hoih khat in thumaan in pau kul hi.

senses.usage_en: In formal letters, Yours truly is a conventional closing, especially in American English.
senses.usage_zomi: Picing lai tawpna ah, a diak in American English ah, Yours truly pen ngeina tawpna kammal khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: Confidence in someone or something
senses.definition_en: A strong belief that someone or something is honest, reliable, good, or safe.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat thumaan, muanhuai, hoih ahih kei leh bit hi cih a kip upna ahi hi.

examples.english: Honesty builds trust between people.
examples.zomi: Thumaan gamtatna in mite kikal muanngamna bawl hi.

examples.english: It takes time to regain lost trust.
examples.zomi: A mang muanngamna ngahkik dingin hun la hi.

senses.usage_en: Trust is normally uncountable when referring to confidence or belief in reliability.
senses.usage_zomi: Muanngamna a kawk ciangin trust pen simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: Legal control of property for another person
senses.definition_en: A legal arrangement in which money or property is managed by one person or organization for another person’s benefit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum ahih kei leh neihsa mi khat phattuamna dingin midang khat maw pawl khat in thukhun bangin a kem leh a uk vaihawmna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her parents placed the property in a family trust.
examples.zomi: A nulehpate in neihsa pen innkuan trust sungah koih uh hi.

examples.english: The trust fund will pay for the child’s education.
examples.zomi: Trust sum in naupang pilna man pia ding hi.

senses.usage_en: This legal and financial meaning requires specialized advice because trust law differs by jurisdiction.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih thukhun leh sumvai khiatna ah gam khen ciang thukhun kibanglo ahih manin siammi ngaihsutna kisam hi.

senses.heading: What is true
senses.definition_en: The actual facts about a situation, event, or person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun, thu piang ahih kei leh mi khat tawh kisai a taktak thumaan ahi hi.

examples.english: Witnesses must tell the truth in court.
examples.zomi: Tecite in thukhenzum ah thumaan gen kul uh hi.

examples.english: We may never know the full truth.
examples.zomi: Thumaan a vekpi i thei ngeilo thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Truth is normally uncountable when referring generally to reality or honesty.
senses.usage_zomi: Thumaan ahih kei leh a taktak dinmun a huamkim in a kigen ciangin truth simthamlo min kammal ahi hi.

senses.heading: A true fact or principle
senses.definition_en: A particular fact, belief, or principle accepted as true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thumaan in a kisang thumaan kician, upna ahih kei leh thukhun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The book contains several important truths.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu sungah thumaan thupi pawlkhat om hi.

examples.english: We must accept an uncomfortable truth.
examples.zomi: Sang ding haksat thumaan khat sang kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Truth becomes countable when it means one particular true fact or principle: a truth; several truths.
senses.usage_zomi: Thumaan kician khat ahih kei leh thukhun khat a kawk ciangin truth simtheih hi: a truth; several truths.

senses.heading: Make an effort
senses.definition_en: To make an effort to do or achieve something, especially when success is uncertain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzo ding kicianlo napi na khat bawl ahih kei leh tangtun dingin hahkat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I will try to finish the work today.
examples.zomi: Tuni in nasep zoh ding ka hahkat ding hi.

examples.english: She tried her best but did not win.
examples.zomi: A hatna tawpin hahkat napi gualzo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Try to do something emphasizes making an effort, whether or not the action succeeds.
senses.usage_zomi: Try to do something in na khat tangtun dingin hahkat cih thupisak a, gualzo maw gualzo lo cih kipsaklo hi.

senses.heading: Test or experience something
senses.definition_en: To use, taste, experience, or do something in order to discover whether it is suitable or enjoyable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a kituak, a hoih ahih kei leh a nuam maw cih theihna dingin zang-et, nek-et ahih kei leh bawl-et cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You should try this traditional dish.
examples.zomi: Hih ngeina an na nek-et ding hi.

examples.english: We tried a different method.
examples.zomi: Bawldan dang khat zang-et ung.

senses.usage_en: Try doing something often means testing a possible method. Try to do something means making an effort to accomplish it.
senses.usage_zomi: Try doing something in lampi piangthei khat zat-et cihna ahi zel hi. Try to do something in tua na tangtun dingin hahkat cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Examine a legal case
senses.definition_en: To examine evidence in court and decide whether someone is guilty or legally responsible.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhenzum ah teci sittel in mi khat mawhnei maw, thukhun bang mopohna nei maw cih khensat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The case will be tried next month.
examples.zomi: Tua thu pen kha hong tung ciangin thukhenzum ah kisittel ding hi.

examples.english: He was tried for theft.
examples.zomi: Gukna hangin thukhenna thuak hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a formal legal meaning. The noun for the court process is trial.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen picing thukhun khiatna ahi hi. Thukhenzum kalsuan a noun pen trial ahi hi.

senses.heading: A long hollow cylinder
senses.definition_en: A long, hollow object, usually round, through which liquid, gas, or another material can pass.
senses.zomi_equivalents: pipe; a sung awng van sau
senses.explanation_zomi: A sung awng, a sau a, a tamzaw in a bial, tui, gas ahih kei leh zatleh dang a luanna van ahi hi.

examples.english: Water flows through the plastic tube.
examples.zomi: Tui pen plastic pipe sungah luang hi.

examples.english: The doctor inserted a breathing tube.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in huih nawkna pipe khat koih hi.

senses.usage_en: A tube may be flexible or rigid. A pipe is often used specifically for carrying liquid or gas.
senses.usage_zomi: Tube pen a nem ahih kei leh a khauh ahi thei hi. Pipe pen tui ahih kei leh gas puakna ading kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: A soft container
senses.definition_en: A soft, narrow container that is pressed to force out toothpaste, cream, paint, or another substance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ha sihna, cream, suah ahih kei leh zatleh dang a sungpan suahna ding a nen bawm nem leh sau ahi hi.

examples.english: I bought a new tube of toothpaste.
examples.zomi: Ha sihna tube thak khat ka lei hi.

examples.english: Squeeze the cream from the tube.
examples.zomi: Cream pen tube sungpan nenkhia in.

senses.usage_en: Use a tube of before the substance: a tube of toothpaste or a tube of paint.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatleh min mai ah a tube of zang in: a tube of toothpaste ahih kei leh a tube of paint.

senses.heading: An underground railway
senses.definition_en: An underground urban railway system, especially in London.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in London khuapi ah leinuai a pai train system ahi hi.

examples.english: We took the Tube to central London.
examples.zomi: London laizangah leinuai train tawh pai ung.

examples.english: The nearest Tube station is across the street.
examples.zomi: A nai pen leinuai train station pen lampi langkhat ah om hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is British English and is commonly capitalized as the Tube when referring to London’s system.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen British English khiatna ahi a, London system a kawk ciangin the Tube ci in lai lian tawh kigelh zel hi.

senses.definition_en: The day of the week after Monday and before Wednesday.
senses.explanation_zomi: Monday ni khit leh Wednesday ni mai a om kal sung ni khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The class meets every Tuesday.
examples.zomi: Class pen Tuesday simin kikhawm hi.

examples.english: I have a medical appointment on Tuesday morning.
examples.zomi: Tuesday zingsangin siavuan tawh kimu ding hun ka nei hi.

senses.usage_en: The names of days always begin with a capital letter in English.
