senses.usage_zomi: English ah kal sung ni minte lai lian tawh kipan tawntung hi.

senses.heading: A melody
senses.definition_en: A series of musical notes that form a recognizable melody.
senses.explanation_zomi: Theihkik theih la mel khat a bawl la aw kizui ahi hi.

examples.english: She played a familiar tune on the piano.
examples.zomi: Piano tawh theihsa la mel khat tum hi.

examples.english: I cannot remember the words, but I know the tune.
examples.zomi: La kammalte ka phawk kei napi la mel ka thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A tune is the melody of a song, while the lyrics are its words.
senses.usage_zomi: Tune pen la mel ahi a, lyrics pen la kammalte ahi hi.

senses.heading: Correct musical pitch
senses.definition_en: The correct pitch relationship between musical notes or instruments.
senses.explanation_zomi: La awte ahih kei leh la vanzatte a sang leh niam a man takin a kituakna ahi hi.

examples.english: The guitar is out of tune.
examples.zomi: Guitar la aw kituaklo hi.

examples.english: The singers remained in tune throughout the song.
examples.zomi: Lasakte la sung tawntung aw kituak in sa uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In tune means at the correct musical pitch. Out of tune means that notes do not match properly.
senses.usage_zomi: In tune in la aw a manin kituak cihna ahi hi. Out of tune in la awte man takin kituaklo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A long underground or enclosed passage built through land, a mountain, or beneath water.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lei, mual ahih kei leh tui nuai kantan in a kibawl leinuai lampi sau ahi hi.

examples.english: The train passed through a long tunnel.
examples.zomi: Train in leinuai lampi sau khat kantan hi.

examples.english: Workers are building a tunnel beneath the river.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in gun nuai ah leinuai lampi lam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A tunnel is enclosed above and around its sides. A bridge passes over an obstacle rather than through or beneath it.
senses.usage_zomi: Tunnel pen a tung leh a geite kikhuh hi. Lei ahihleh daal khat tungtawn in kantan a, sung ahih kei leh nuai pan pai lo hi.

senses.heading: Change direction
senses.definition_en: To move or face in a different direction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Paihna ahih kei leh maitang a dang lamah hei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Turn left at the traffic lights.
examples.zomi: Traffic meivak ah vei lamah hei in.

examples.english: She turned to look behind her.
examples.zomi: A nung en dingin kihei hi.

senses.usage_en: Use turn left/right without to. Say turn to the left only when emphasizing the direction or position.
senses.usage_zomi: Turn left/right ci in to loin zang in. Lam ahih kei leh mun thupisakna ding bekah turn to the left ci in zang in.

senses.heading: Change into a different state
senses.definition_en: To become or cause someone or something to become different.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat dinmun, puam ahih kei leh pianzia dang suak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
examples.zomi: Autumn hunin singtehte hong eng hi.

examples.english: The water turned into ice.
examples.zomi: Tui pen vui suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use turn + adjective for a change of condition and turn into + noun for a change into another form.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun kikhelna ading turn + adjective zang a, pianzia dang khat suakna ading turn into + noun zang in.

senses.heading: Move something around a central point
senses.definition_en: To move or rotate something around a central point.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat a laizang khen kimah velhsak ahih kei leh hei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Turn the key to open the door.
examples.zomi: Kong honsak dingin tawhtang hei in.

examples.english: She turned the handle slowly.
examples.zomi: A khutlen dam takin hei hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning involves circular or rotating movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in bial in velh ahih kei leh a laizang kimah hei cihna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Switch equipment on or off
senses.definition_en: To start, stop, increase, or reduce equipment by operating its control.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanzat a ukna zangin honsak, khaksak, khangsak ahih kei leh kiamsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please turn off the computer.
examples.zomi: Computer khaksak in.

examples.english: He turned up the heat.
examples.zomi: A lumna khangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Phrasal verbs such as turn on, turn off, turn up, and turn down have different meanings and should be learned as units.
senses.usage_zomi: Turn on, turn off, turn up, leh turn down bang phrasal verbte khiatna kibanglo ahih manin kammal pawl khat bangin kisin ding hi.

senses.heading: Reach a particular age or time
senses.definition_en: To reach a particular age, date, or point in time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum, tarik ahih kei leh hun kician khat tung cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She turns eighteen next month.
examples.zomi: Kha hong tung ciangin kum sawm leh giat cing ding hi.

examples.english: The child turned five yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zani in naupang kum nga cing hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses turn + age without years old: turn sixteen, not normally turn sixteen years old.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah turn + age ci in years old loin kizang hi: turn sixteen ci a, ngeina ah turn sixteen years old ci lo hi.

senses.heading: Television as a medium
senses.definition_en: Television programs or the system used to broadcast them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Television programte ahih kei leh a puakna broadcast system ahi hi.

examples.english: We watched the news on TV.
examples.zomi: TV tungah thuthang en ung.

examples.english: The match will be shown live on TV.
examples.zomi: Kimawlna pen TV tungah a piang laitak in kimuhsak ding hi.

senses.usage_en: When referring to the activity, say watch TV without an article.
senses.usage_zomi: TV etna gamtatna a kigen ciangin article loin watch TV ci in zang in.

senses.heading: A television set
senses.definition_en: An electronic device with a screen used for watching television programs and videos.
senses.explanation_zomi: Television program leh video etna ding screen nei electronic vanzat ahi hi.

examples.english: They bought a new TV for the living room.
examples.zomi: Inn sung omkhopna khaan ading TV thak khat lei uh hi.

examples.english: Please turn down the TV.
examples.zomi: TV aw kiamsak in.

senses.usage_en: When referring to the device, an article is normally used: a TV or the TV.
senses.usage_zomi: Vanzat a kigen ciangin article kizang zel hi: a TV ahih kei leh the TV.

senses.definition_en: The number 12.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sawm leh nih; nambat sawm leh nih
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat sawm leh nih, sawm leh khat khit leh sawm leh thum mai a om nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: Twelve is an even number.
examples.zomi: Sawm leh nih pen nambat nih tawh khenkim theih ahi hi.

examples.english: The clock struck twelve.
examples.zomi: Nai in sawm leh nih tum hi.

senses.usage_en: A group of twelve is called a dozen.
senses.usage_zomi: Na sawm leh nih pawl khat pen dozen kici hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 20.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat sawm nih, sawm leh kua khit leh sawm nih leh khat mai a om nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: Twenty is twice ten.
examples.zomi: Sawm nih pen sawm veihnih ahi hi.

examples.english: The room can hold twenty people.
examples.zomi: Innkhan sungah mi sawm nih om thei hi.

senses.usage_en: The final t may sound soft in rapid American speech, but the standard careful pronunciation is /ˈtwɛnti/.
senses.usage_zomi: American English manlang kampau ah a laizang t aw nem thei napi, pilvang takin suang ciangin /ˈtwɛnti/ ahi hi.

senses.heading: Two times
senses.definition_en: On two occasions or two times.
senses.explanation_zomi: Veihnih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Take this medicine twice a day.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui ni khat veihnih dolh in.

examples.english: I called her twice yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zani in amah veihnih ka phone hi.

senses.usage_en: Use once for one time, twice for two times, and three times for three occasions.
senses.usage_zomi: Khatvei ading once, veihnih ading twice, veithum ading three times zang in.

senses.heading: Two times as much
senses.definition_en: By two times the amount, size, number, or degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, pianzia, omzah ahih kei leh dinmun a langnih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This room is twice as large as the other one.
examples.zomi: Hih innkhan pen tua innkhan sangin langnih a lian hi.

examples.english: The new phone costs twice the price of the old one.
examples.zomi: Phone thak pen phone lui sangin a man langnih ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use twice as + adjective + as: twice as long as or twice as expensive as.
senses.usage_zomi: Twice as + adjective + as ci in zang in: twice as long as ahih kei leh twice as expensive as.

senses.heading: One of two children born together
senses.definition_en: Either one of two children or young animals born to the same mother at the same time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nu khat in hun khat ah a neih naupang ahih kei leh ganhingno nih lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a twin brother.
examples.zomi: Amah in pasan sanggampa khat nei hi.

examples.english: The twins were born early.
examples.zomi: Pasante hun tun ma in hong piang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Twin refers to either individual; twins refers to both people or animals together.
senses.usage_zomi: Twin in pasan nih lak khat kawk a, twins in a nihgel kawk hi.

senses.heading: One of two very similar or closely connected things
senses.definition_en: One of two things that are extremely similar, matching, or closely connected.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a kibang nih lak khat; a kizom pih
senses.explanation_zomi: A kibang mahmah, a kituak ahih kei leh nai takin a kizom na nih lakah khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The bridge connects the twin cities.
examples.zomi: Lei in khuapi kizopih nih kizom sak hi.

examples.english: The hotel room has twin beds.
examples.zomi: Hotel innkhan sungah lupna khat ciang ading kibang nih om hi.

senses.usage_en: Before another noun, twin may describe two matching or closely related things.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kammal dang mai ah twin koih in na nih a kibang ahih kei leh nai takin a kizom cih pulaak thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The number 2.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat nih, khat khit leh thum mai a om nambat ahi hi.

examples.english: Two is an even number.
examples.zomi: Nih pen nambat nih tawh khenkim theih ahi hi.

examples.english: The answer is two.
examples.zomi: A dawnna nih ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Before a noun, two functions as a determiner: two books. It functions as a noun when referring to the number itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kammal mai ah two pen determiner in kizang hi: two books. Nambat mahmah a kigen ciangin noun ahi hi.

senses.heading: A kind or category
senses.definition_en: A group of people or things that share particular qualities or features.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoihna ahih kei leh pianzia kician a kibang mi maw nate pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: What type of music do you enjoy?
examples.zomi: Bang la nam na nuam hiam?

examples.english: The store sells several types of rice.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr in buh nam tuamtuam zuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Type, kind, and sort often have similar meanings. Type is common in technical and formal classification.
senses.usage_zomi: Type, kind, leh sort khiatna kibang thei hi. Type pen technical leh picing nam khenna ah kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Printed characters or a printing style
senses.definition_en: Printed letters and characters, or a particular design and size of printed lettering.
senses.explanation_zomi: A kisuang lai leh limte, ahih kei leh lai a pianzia leh a size kician khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The instructions are printed in small type.
examples.zomi: Sawlnate lai neu tawh kisuang hi.

examples.english: Headwords appear in bold type.
examples.zomi: Headwordte lai taang tawh kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: In printing, type is usually uncountable. Typeface names a particular letter design.
senses.usage_zomi: Lai suahna thu ah type simthamlo ahi zel hi. Typeface in lai pianzia kician khat minvawh hi.

senses.heading: Having the usual qualities
senses.definition_en: Having the qualities or features normally expected of a particular person, thing, group, or situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na, pawl ahih kei leh dinmun khat a ngeina hoihna leh pianzia nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This is a typical winter day in Ohio.
examples.zomi: Hih pen Ohio khuavot ni ngeina khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The building is typical of the region.
examples.zomi: Tua inn pen tua gam khen inn ngeina bang ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use typical of to connect something with the group whose normal features it represents.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat leh a ngeina a aiawh pawl kizom sak dingin typical of zang in.

senses.heading: Expected from a particular person, often annoyingly
senses.definition_en: Used to say that someone’s behavior is exactly what you expect, often because it is repeatedly inconvenient or annoying.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ama ngeina mah; ngeina bang mah
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat gamtatna pen ama gamtat ngeina mah ahi a, a tamzaw in lungkimhuai lo cih pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: It was typical of him to arrive late.
examples.zomi: Amah a nung in hong tung pen ama ngeina mah ahi hi.

examples.english: “She forgot again.” “That is typical.”
examples.zomi: “A mangngilh kik hi.” “Tua pen ama ngeina mah ahi hi.”

senses.usage_en: Tone determines whether this use sounds neutral, affectionate, humorous, or critical.
senses.usage_zomi: Aw zatdan in hih zatna pen ngeina, itna, nuihzakna ahih kei leh mawhsakna bangin a ging cih khensat hi.

senses.heading: Usually; in a normal case
senses.definition_en: In the way that normally or usually happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina in ahih kei leh piang zel bangin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The journey typically takes two hours.
examples.zomi: Tua khualzinna ngeina in nai nih hun la hi.

examples.english: This medicine is typically taken after meals.
examples.zomi: Hih zatui pen ngeina in annek khit ciangin kidolh hi.

senses.usage_en: Typically describes a general pattern; it does not mean that something happens in every case.
senses.usage_zomi: Typically in a piang zel dan kawk a, khatvei simin tua bang piang takpi cihna hilo hi.

senses.heading: In a characteristic way
senses.definition_en: In a way that shows the expected qualities of a particular person, group, place, or style.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, mun ahih kei leh puatham khat’ pianzia ngeina a pulaak in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The house is typically designed for a tropical climate.
examples.zomi: Tua inn pen gam lum khuahun tawh kituak ngeina puatham in kibawl hi.

examples.english: She was typically generous to her guests.
examples.zomi: A ngeina bangin a zin hawhte tungah piakhia hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense connects behavior or design with the characteristic qualities of a person, culture, or category.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in gamtatna ahih kei leh design pen mi, ngeina maw nam khat pianzia ngeina tawh kizom sak hi.

senses.definition_en: A thick rubber ring fitted around a vehicle’s wheel and filled with air or made from solid material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawtaw ahih kei leh leeng a wheel kimah a kikhum, huih a kidim ahih kei leh rubber khau tawh a kibawl bial ahi hi.

examples.english: We had to stop because of a flat tyre.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw khe huih a bei manin tawl kul hi.

examples.english: He changed the damaged tyre beside the road.
examples.zomi: Lampi geiah mawtaw khe a sia pen khel hi.

senses.usage_en: Tyre is the British English spelling. American English spells the word tire.
senses.usage_zomi: Tyre pen British English gelhdan ahi hi. American English ah tire ci in kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Unpleasant to look at
senses.definition_en: Unpleasant or unattractive in appearance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puatham et nuamlo ahih kei leh kilawmlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Many people considered the building ugly.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi in tua inn et nuamlo in ngaihsun uh hi.

examples.english: The wall became ugly after years without repair.
examples.zomi: Kum tampi kibawlhoihlo khit ciangin kulh et nuamlo hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: Calling a person ugly is usually insulting. Use more respectful and precise language when discussing someone’s appearance.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat ugly cih pen zahkona ahi zel hi. Mi khat puatham thu gen ciangin zahtakna nei leh kammal kicianzaw zang in.

senses.heading: Very unpleasant, dangerous, or violent
senses.definition_en: Extremely unpleasant, threatening, or involving serious conflict.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuamlo mahmah, lauhuai ahih kei leh kidona nasiatak a kihel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The peaceful protest suddenly turned ugly.
examples.zomi: Kilem tak a langdona pen thakhat in hong lauhuai hi.

examples.english: They became involved in an ugly argument.
examples.zomi: Thukalhna nuamlo mahmah sungah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes a situation or behavior, not physical appearance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in puatham hilo in, dinmun ahih kei leh gamtatna nuamlo kawk hi.

senses.heading: Finally, after a process
senses.definition_en: Finally, after a series of events, changes, or considerations.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a tawpna ah; a nunungpen in
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang, kikhelna ahih kei leh ngaihsutna kizui tampi khit a tawpna ah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: After months of discussion, they ultimately agreed.
examples.zomi: Kha tampi kikum khit ciangin a tawpna ah thukim uh hi.

examples.english: Her hard work ultimately led to success.
examples.zomi: Ama hahkatna in a tawpna ah gualzawhna tun hi.

senses.usage_en: Ultimately emphasizes the final result after a possibly long or complicated process.
senses.usage_zomi: Ultimately in sawt leh haksa thei kalsuan khit a ngahna nunung thupisak hi.

senses.heading: At the most basic or important level
senses.definition_en: When everything is considered, at the deepest or most important level.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a bulpi ah; a thupi pen in
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khempeuh ngaihsut khit ciang, a bulpi ahih kei leh a thupi pen dinmunah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The final decision is ultimately yours.
examples.zomi: Khensatna nunung pen a tawpna ah nangma ahi hi.

examples.english: Success ultimately depends on consistent effort.
examples.zomi: Gualzawhna pen a bulpi ah tawlngal lo hahkatna tungah kinga hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, ultimately identifies the fundamental responsibility, cause, or conclusion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah ultimately in mopohna, a hang ahih kei leh khensatna bulpi kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A folding device with a cloth cover and handle, used to protect someone from rain or sunlight.
senses.explanation_zomi: Guah ahih kei leh ni pan kidalna ding, puan tawh kikhuh a, khaih theih leh khutlen nei van ahi hi.

examples.english: Take an umbrella because it may rain.
examples.zomi: Guah zu thei ahih manin nili pua in.

examples.english: They stood together under the umbrella.
examples.zomi: Nili nuai ah dingkhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The first sound of umbrella is a vowel sound, so use an umbrella, not a umbrella.
senses.usage_zomi: Umbrella a kipatna aw pen vowel ahih manin an umbrella ci a, a umbrella ci lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Not having the ability, opportunity, or permission to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawltheihna, hunhoih ahih kei leh phalna nei lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She was unable to attend the meeting.
examples.zomi: Meeting ah pai theilo hi.

examples.english: The doctors were unable to identify the cause.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te in a hang theikha theilo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Unable is normally followed by to + verb: unable to walk. It is more formal than cannot.
senses.usage_zomi: Unable nungah to + verb zui zel hi: unable to walk. Cannot sangin kammal picingzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: The brother of someone’s mother or father, or the husband of an aunt.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat’ nu ahih kei leh pa sanggampa, ahih kei leh a nupi- or a papi’ pasal ahi hi.

examples.english: My uncle lives in another state.
examples.zomi: Ka pupa state dang khat ah om hi.

examples.english: Her uncle taught her how to drive.
examples.zomi: A pupa in mawtaw hawldan sinsak hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses the single word uncle for several family relationships that some languages distinguish more precisely.
senses.usage_zomi: English in innkuan kizopna tuamtuam ading uncle kammal khat bek zang a, pau dang pawlkhat in khen kicianzaw hi.

senses.heading: Not physically comfortable
senses.definition_en: Causing physical discomfort or making it difficult to relax.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi nuamlo sak ahih kei leh tawlngak nuam takin omtheilo sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: These shoes are uncomfortable.
examples.zomi: Hih khekhapte silhnuamlo hi.

examples.english: The chair became uncomfortable after an hour.
examples.zomi: Nai khat khit ciangin tokhom tutnuamlo hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: An object can be uncomfortable, while a person may feel uncomfortable.
senses.usage_zomi: Van khat pen uncomfortable ahi thei a, mi khat in feel uncomfortable ci thei hi.

senses.heading: Feeling embarrassed, worried, or uneasy
senses.definition_en: Feeling embarrassed, worried, nervous, or uncertain in a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat ah zumpi, lungkham, lungkial ahih kei leh lungsim nuamlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The personal question made her uncomfortable.
examples.zomi: Mimal thu dotna in amah lungsim nuamlo sak hi.

examples.english: There was an uncomfortable silence in the room.
examples.zomi: Innkhan sungah gamdai nuamlo khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense concerns emotional or social discomfort rather than physical pain.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in pumpi natna hilo in, lungsim ahih kei leh mihon sung nuamlohna kawk hi.

senses.heading: Not awake or aware
senses.definition_en: Not awake and not aware of what is happening, usually because of injury, illness, or medicine.
senses.explanation_zomi: Liamna, cina ahih kei leh zatui hangin khuaphawklo a, bang piang cih theilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The injured driver was unconscious.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw hawlpa a liam pen khuaphawklo hi.

examples.english: She remained unconscious for several minutes.
examples.zomi: Minute pawlkhat sung khuaphawklo in om hi.

senses.usage_en: An unconscious person cannot normally respond to people or surroundings. This may require urgent medical care.
senses.usage_zomi: Khuaphawklo mi in mite ahih kei leh kimkotna thu dawng theilo zel hi. Hih dinmun in zatui panpihna manlang kisam thei hi.

senses.heading: Done without awareness or intention
senses.definition_en: Done without realizing it or without making a deliberate decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Theikha loin ahih kei leh deihna tawh khensat loin a kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Biting his nails was an unconscious habit.
examples.zomi: A khutme a ket pen ama phawklo in a bawl ngeina ahi hi.

examples.english: Unconscious bias can affect decisions.
examples.zomi: Phawklo deihkhenna in khensatnate sukha thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense concerns mental processes or actions that happen without conscious awareness.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mi khat in a theih leh a phawk loin a lungsim ahih kei leh gamtatna sungah a piang na kawk hi.

senses.heading: Below something
senses.definition_en: In, to, or through a position lower than something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sangin a niamzaw munah, nuai ahih kei leh nuailam kantan in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The cat is sleeping under the table.
examples.zomi: Meng pen dohkan nuai ah ihmu hi.

examples.english: We walked under the bridge.
examples.zomi: Lei nuai pan lampai ung.

senses.usage_en: Under describes a lower position, often with something directly above it. Below does not always imply direct vertical alignment.
senses.usage_zomi: Under in na khat a tungah a om laitak nuailam mun kawk zel hi. Below ahihleh a tung leh nuai in kituak ngiat cihna tawntung hilo hi.

senses.heading: Covered or hidden by something
senses.definition_en: Covered, protected, or hidden beneath something.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nuai ah kikhuh; nuai ah kiseel
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat nuai ah a kikhuh, kidal ahih kei leh kiseel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The seeds were buried under the soil.
examples.zomi: Ci-te leinuai ah kivui hi.

examples.english: The village disappeared under the floodwater.
examples.zomi: Khua pen tuicin tui nuai ah mang hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense may be literal or figurative, as in under cover or under the surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen taktak ahih kei leh gentehna in under cover leh under the surface bangin kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Controlled or affected by something
senses.definition_en: Controlled, managed, governed, or affected by a person, rule, process, or condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, thukhun, nasep kalsuan ahih kei leh dinmun khat nuai ah ki-uk ahih kei leh kisukha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The case is under investigation.
examples.zomi: Tua thu thuzonna nuai ah om hi.

examples.english: The area remains under military control.
examples.zomi: Tua mun galkap ukna nuai ah om lai hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense is common in formal expressions describing control, examination, or difficult conditions.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna pen ukna, sittelna ahih kei leh dinmun haksa a pulaak picing kammal pawlah kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Less than a number, age, or limit
senses.definition_en: Less than a particular number, amount, age, time, or limit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nambat, zat, kum, hun ahih kei leh ciangtan kician khat sangin a tawmzaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Children under twelve enter free.
examples.zomi: Kum sawm leh nih nuai naupang-te man loin lut thei uh hi.

examples.english: The journey takes under an hour.
examples.zomi: Tua khualzinna nai khat sangin hun tomzaw la hi.

senses.usage_en: Here under means “less than,” not physically below.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih munah under in pumpi tawh a nuai cih hilo in, ciangtan khat sangin tawmzaw cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Below the ground
senses.definition_en: Located, built, or happening below the surface of the ground.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leilung puatham nuai ah a om, a kibawl ahih kei leh a piang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The city has an underground railway system.
examples.zomi: Khuapi in leinuai train system nei hi.

examples.english: Workers repaired an underground water pipe.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in leinuai tui pipe bawlhoih uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Underground before a noun is an adjective. It can also be an adverb: The cable runs underground.
senses.usage_zomi: Min kammal mai a underground pen adjective ahi hi. Adverb in zong kizang thei hi: The cable runs underground.

senses.heading: Secret and often illegal
senses.definition_en: Operating secretly, especially to oppose a government or avoid official control.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kiseel nasep; thukham pualam kiseel pawl
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in kumpi langpang ahih kei leh ukna pelh dingin a kiseel in nasem cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The underground movement opposed the government.
examples.zomi: Kiseel kipawlna in kumpi langpang hi.

examples.english: They published an underground newspaper.
examples.zomi: Kiseel thuthang lai khat suah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense is figurative and does not necessarily mean physically below the ground.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in leinuai ah taktak a om cihna pello hi.

senses.heading: Know the meaning
senses.definition_en: To know the meaning of words, information, an explanation, or a situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal, thu, hilhcianna ahih kei leh dinmun khat a khiatna thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I understand your question.
examples.zomi: Na dotna ka tel hi.

examples.english: The instructions were difficult to understand.
examples.zomi: Sawlnate telh ding haksat hi.

senses.usage_en: The forms are understand–understood–understood.
senses.usage_zomi: A kammal puakte understand–understood–understood ahi hi.

senses.heading: Know how or why something happens
senses.definition_en: To know how something works, why something happens, or what a situation involves.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat koibangin nasem, banghangin piang ahih kei leh dinmun khat sungah bang kihel cih thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Scientists are trying to understand how the disease spreads.
examples.zomi: Science siamte in cina koibangin kizel cih telh ding hahkat uh hi.

examples.english: She understands the difficulties facing the community.
examples.zomi: Amah in khua in a tuah haksatnate telcian hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense involves deeper knowledge than simply recognizing words.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in kammalte thei bek sangin thu bangci leh banghang a piang cih telna thukzaw kawk hi.

senses.heading: Recognize someone’s feelings or viewpoint
senses.definition_en: To recognize and sympathize with another person’s feelings, reasons, or point of view.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang khat’ lungsim, a hang ahih kei leh muhdan tel in thuakpih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I understand why you are worried.
examples.zomi: Banghangin na lungkham cih ka telpih hi.

examples.english: Good leaders try to understand other people.
examples.zomi: Makaipa hoihte in midangte telpih ding hahkat uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Saying I understand may express sympathy as well as knowledge.
senses.usage_zomi: I understand cih in theihna bek hilo in, telpihna leh khotuahna zong pulaak thei hi.

senses.heading: Knowledge of a subject or situation
senses.definition_en: Knowledge of how something works, what it means, or why it happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat koibangin nasem, bang khiatna nei ahih kei leh banghangin piang cih telna ahi hi.

examples.english: The course gave me a better understanding of history.
examples.zomi: Tua course in tangthu telna hoihzaw hong pia hi.

examples.english: Students need a clear understanding of the rules.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in thukhunte telcian kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Understanding of is used before the subject being understood.
senses.usage_zomi: A kitel thulu mai ah understanding of kizang hi.

senses.heading: A mutual agreement
senses.definition_en: An informal agreement or shared expectation between people or groups.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite ahih kei leh pawlte kikal a kician takin kigelhlo napi a thukimkhop uh thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The two sides reached an understanding.
examples.zomi: Khat leh khatgel thukimna khat tung uh hi.

examples.english: We accepted the plan on the understanding that costs would not increase.
examples.zomi: A man khanglo ding cih thukimna tawh tua geelna sang ung.

senses.usage_en: An understanding may be less formal than a written contract.
senses.usage_zomi: Understanding pen contract kigelh sangin picing tawmzaw thukimna ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Sympathy and patience
senses.definition_en: The ability to be sympathetic, patient, and accepting toward another person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang khat telpih, thuakzawh leh sangtheihna lungsim ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher showed understanding toward the student.
examples.zomi: Sia in sangnaupang tungah telpihna pulak hi.

examples.english: Children need patience and understanding.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te thuakzawhna leh telpihna kisam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, understanding is an attitude toward people rather than knowledge of facts.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah understanding pen thumaan theihna hilo in, mite tung a telpihna lungsim ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Clothing worn next to the skin beneath outer clothes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan pualam nuai, pumpi vun tawh a kilawn in a kisilh puan ahi hi.

examples.english: Pack enough clean underwear for the trip.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna ading puan sung siang kicing pua in.

examples.english: Thermal underwear helps keep the body warm.
examples.zomi: Puan sung lum in pumpi lum in kem hi.

senses.usage_en: Underwear is uncountable. Do not normally say an underwear; say a piece of underwear if necessary.
senses.usage_zomi: Underwear pen simthamlo min kammal ahi hi. Ngeina ah an underwear ci lo a, kisap leh a piece of underwear ci in zang in.

senses.definition_en: Without a paid job but available for or seeking work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum a kipia nasep nei lo napi nasemthei leh nasep a zong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He became unemployed when the factory closed.
examples.zomi: Factory a kikhak ciangin naseplo hong suak hi.

examples.english: The program helps unemployed people find work.
examples.zomi: Tua program in naseplo mite nasep zonna panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Unemployed usually refers to someone who lacks paid work and is able or willing to work, not every person without a job.
senses.usage_zomi: Unemployed in sum tawh nasep nei lo a, nasem thei ahih kei leh nasem nuam mi kawk zel hi; nasep nei lo mi khempeuh kawklo hi.

senses.heading: The state of having no paid job
senses.definition_en: The state of being without paid employment while available for or seeking work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum a kipia nasep nei lo napi nasemthei ahih kei leh nasep a zong dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The family struggled during his period of unemployment.
examples.zomi: Ama naseplohna hun sungin innkuan hahkat mahmah hi.

examples.english: Training helped her return to work after unemployment.
examples.zomi: Naseplohna khit nasep ah ciahkik dingin kiilhna in panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: This personal sense describes an individual’s state of not having paid work.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih mimal khiatna in mi khat sum tawh nasep nei lo dinmun kawk hi.

senses.heading: The number or rate of people without jobs
senses.definition_en: The condition in an economy where people who want and can work cannot find jobs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasem nuam leh nasemthei mite nasep a muhloh uh sumvai dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: Unemployment increased during the economic crisis.
examples.zomi: Sumvai buaina hunin naseplohna khang hi.

examples.english: The government introduced a plan to reduce unemployment.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in naseplohna kiamsakna ding geelna khat zang kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: In economic reports, unemployment is often measured as a percentage called the unemployment rate.
senses.usage_zomi: Sumvai reportte ah naseplohna pen percent tawh kiteh a, unemployment rate kici hi.

senses.definition_en: Not expected or predicted.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lam-etloh ahih kei leh piang dingin a kigenkhol lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We received an unexpected invitation.
examples.zomi: Lam-etloh sapna khat ngah ung.

examples.english: The test produced an unexpected result.
examples.zomi: Sittelna in lam-etloh ngahna khat piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: An unexpected event is not necessarily bad; it may be pleasant, unpleasant, or neutral.
senses.usage_zomi: Unexpected thu piang pen hoihlo cihna pello hi; lungdamhuai, nuamlo ahih kei leh a ngeina ahi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Not treating people equally, reasonably, or according to what is right.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mite kibang, a kiteltheih dan ahih kei leh a man bangin zonglo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The workers complained about unfair treatment.
examples.zomi: Nasemte in thutanglo zongdan hangin mawhsak uh hi.

examples.english: It is unfair to punish the whole class.
examples.zomi: Class a vekpi gimpiak pen thutanglo hi.

senses.usage_en: Unfair is the opposite of fair when fair means just and reasonable.
senses.usage_zomi: Fair in thutang leh a man a cihna a hih ciangin a kikal pen unfair ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to say that a situation or result is disappointing, unlucky, or undesirable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun ahih kei leh ngahna khat lungkhamhuai, hamphalo ahih kei leh kideihlo cih pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Unfortunately, the meeting had to be cancelled.
examples.zomi: Dahhuai takin meeting khawl kul hi.

examples.english: The treatment was unfortunately unsuccessful.
examples.zomi: Hamphatlohpi in tua bawlna gualzo lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Unfortunately often appears at the beginning of a sentence and comments on the whole situation.
senses.usage_zomi: Unfortunately pen sentence kipatna ah om zel a, dinmun a vekpi nuamlo cih pulaak hi.

senses.heading: Sad or not pleased
senses.definition_en: Sad, dissatisfied, or not pleased about something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dah, lungkimlo ahih kei leh lungdamlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She was unhappy with the decision.
examples.zomi: Tua khensatna lungkimlo hi.

examples.english: The child looked tired and unhappy.
examples.zomi: Naupang pen gim a, lungdamlo in kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Unhappy with/about identifies the cause of dissatisfaction.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungkimlohna a hang pulaak dingin unhappy with/about zang in.

senses.heading: Unfortunate or unsuitable
senses.definition_en: Having bad, unfortunate, or inappropriate results.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngahna hoihlo, hamphatlo ahih kei leh kituaklo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The story has an unhappy ending.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu in tawpna lungkhamhuai nei hi.

examples.english: His comment was an unhappy choice of words.
examples.zomi: Ama genna pen kammal teelna kituaklo ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal sense describes an unfortunate result or poor choice rather than a person’s emotion.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih picing khiatna in mi lungsim hilo in, ngahna hamphatlo ahih kei leh teelna hoihlo kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A special set of clothes worn by members of the same school, organization, profession, or service.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sang, pawlpi, nghề ahih kei leh nasepna khat sung mite in a kibangin a silh uh puan ahi hi.

examples.english: Students must wear their school uniform.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te sang puan silh kul uh hi.

examples.english: The officer was dressed in uniform.
examples.zomi: Ukna nasempa in nasep puan silh hi.

senses.usage_en: A uniform identifies membership or a particular role. The word may be countable: a uniform; several uniforms.
senses.usage_zomi: Uniform in pawl khat sung mi ahih kei leh dinmun kician khat nei cih theisak hi. Simtheih hi: a uniform; several uniforms.

senses.heading: An organization of workers
senses.definition_en: An organization that represents workers and protects their shared interests and employment rights.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasemte aiawh in a phattuamna uh leh nasep theihna uh a kem pawlpi ahi hi.

examples.english: The union negotiated higher wages for workers.
examples.zomi: Nasem pawlpi in nasemte’ thaman khangsakna ding kikum hi.

examples.english: She became a union member last year.
examples.zomi: Kum beisa in nasem pawlpi sung mi hong suak hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses labor union. British English commonly uses trade union.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah labor union kizangzaw hi. British English ah trade union kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: The act or state of joining
senses.definition_en: The act or state of joining two or more people, groups, places, or things into one.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, pawl, mun ahih kei leh nate nih leh a tamzaw na khat in kizomkhawmna ahi hi.

examples.english: The agreement created a union between the two regions.
examples.zomi: Thukimna in gam khen nih kikal kizopna bawl hi.

examples.english: The design represents the union of tradition and technology.
examples.zomi: Tua design in ngeina leh technology kizopna aiawh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense focuses on separate people or things becoming connected as one body or system.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mi ahih kei leh na tuamtuam pawl khat maw system khat in kizom cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Marriage
senses.definition_en: A marriage or the joining of two people as partners.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nih zi leh pasal in kiteenna ahih kei leh nuntakpih in kizopna ahi hi.

examples.english: Their union lasted for many years.
examples.zomi: Amaute kiteenna kum tampi kip tawh om hi.

examples.english: Family members gathered to celebrate the union.
examples.zomi: Kiteenna pawi bawl dingin innkuanpihte kikhawm uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This is a formal use. In ordinary speech, marriage is more common.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih pen kammal picing zatna ahi hi. Niteng kampau ah marriage kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: The only one of its kind
senses.definition_en: Being the only one of a particular kind.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ama nam sungah khat bek a om, a dang tawh kibanglo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Each fingerprint is unique.
examples.zomi: Khutme lim khat ciang a kibang neilo hi.

examples.english: The museum contains a unique historical document.
examples.zomi: Museum sungah a kibang neilo tangthu document khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: Strictly, something unique cannot be more unique or very unique because it is already the only one of its kind. Informal English sometimes uses these forms for emphasis.
senses.usage_zomi: Khiatna kician bangin khat bek a om na pen more unique ahih kei leh very unique kici theilo hi. Ahihhang ngeina English ah thupisakna dingin tua bang kizang thei hi.

senses.heading: Unusual and special
senses.definition_en: Very unusual, distinctive, or special.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina tawh kibanglo mahmah, a tuamvilvel ahih kei leh a thupi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The artist has a unique style.
examples.zomi: Lim suaimi in puatham tuamvilvel nei hi.

examples.english: Living abroad was a unique experience.
examples.zomi: Gamdang ah om pen phutkhak lamdang khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This broader everyday sense emphasizes distinctiveness, even when something is not literally the only example.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih niteng khiatna in na khat etteh dang omlo cih ngiat sangin a tuamvilvelna thupisak hi.

senses.heading: One individual part
senses.definition_en: One individual thing, person, or group considered as a single part of a larger whole.
senses.explanation_zomi: A lianzaw pawl ahih kei leh na khat sung a khen khat in kigelh van, mi maw pawl khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The building contains twenty housing units.
examples.zomi: Tua innpi sungah inn omna khen sawm nih om hi.

examples.english: Each unit operates independently.
examples.zomi: Khen khat ciang ama tuam in nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: A unit is treated as one complete part even when it contains several smaller parts.
senses.usage_zomi: Unit sungah khen neuzaw pawlkhat om zongin, amah khen kicing khat in kingaihsun hi.

senses.heading: A standard measure
senses.definition_en: A fixed standard quantity used for measurement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tehna ding a kipsaksa zat kician ahi hi.

examples.english: The metre is a unit of length.
examples.zomi: Metre pen a sau tehna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Use the same unit for every measurement.
examples.zomi: Tehna khempeuh ading tehna zat kibang zang in.

senses.usage_en: Examples of units include metres, kilograms, litres, seconds, and degrees.
senses.usage_zomi: Tehna ettehte sungah metre, kilogram, litre, second leh degree kihel hi.

senses.heading: A section in a course or book
senses.definition_en: One organized section of a course, textbook, or program of study.
senses.explanation_zomi: Course, laisimna laibu ahih kei leh sinna program khat sung a kipawlkhawm khen khat ahi hi.

examples.english: This unit introduces basic grammar.
examples.zomi: Hih sinna khen in grammar bulpi hong hilh kipan hi.

examples.english: Students completed three units this term.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te hih term sungin sinna khen thum zota uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In education, a unit brings related lessons or topics together.
senses.usage_zomi: Pilna ah unit in sinna ahih kei leh thulu a kizomte pawl khat in kigawm hi.

senses.heading: Joined as one group or country
senses.definition_en: Joined together politically, socially, or organizationally as one group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamvai, mihing kipawlna ahih kei leh pawlpi lamah pawl khat in kizomkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The regions formed a united country.
examples.zomi: Gam khen tuamtuam kizomkhawm in gam khat bawl uh hi.

examples.english: The organization remained united during the crisis.
examples.zomi: Buaina hun sungin pawlpi kigawm in omzom hi.

senses.usage_en: United often appears in official names, such as the United States or the United Nations.
senses.usage_zomi: United pen the United States leh the United Nations bang ukna minte sungah om zel hi.

senses.heading: Agreeing and working together
senses.definition_en: Sharing the same purpose, opinion, or determination and acting together.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh khensatna kibang nei in semkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The community was united in supporting the school.
examples.zomi: Khua in sang panpihna ah lungsim khat nei hi.

examples.english: The workers stood united against unfair treatment.
examples.zomi: Nasemte thutanglo zongdan langpang in lungsim khat in ding uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense emphasizes agreement, cooperation, or shared determination.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in thukimna, nasepkhawmna ahih kei leh khensatna khat neihkhawmna thupisak hi.

senses.definition_en: All of space, time, matter, energy, stars, planets, galaxies, and everything that exists.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van awng, hun, zatleh, tha, aksite, leilungte, galaxy-te leh a om khempeuh a huam ahi hi.

examples.english: Scientists study the origin of the universe.
examples.zomi: Science siamte in vannuai kipatna kancian uh hi.

examples.english: The universe contains billions of galaxies.
examples.zomi: Vannuai sungah galaxy billion tampi om hi.

senses.usage_en: In scientific use, the universe usually means everything that physically exists, not only Earth or our galaxy.
senses.usage_zomi: Science zatna ah the universe in leilung ahih kei leh ei galaxy bek hilo in, pumpi tawh a om khempeuh huam hi.

senses.definition_en: An institution of higher education and research that awards academic degrees.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pilna sangzaw leh thuzonna a pia a, academic degree a pia pilna pawlpi ahi hi.

examples.english: She studies engineering at university.
examples.zomi: University ah engineering sin hi.

examples.english: The university conducts medical research.
examples.zomi: University in zatui lam thuzonna bawl hi.

senses.usage_en: British English often says at university without an article when referring to university life or study. American English commonly says at a university or in college.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah university nuntakna ahih kei leh sinna a kigen ciangin article loin at university kici zel hi. American English ah at a university ahih kei leh in college kici zaw hi.

senses.heading: Not known or identified
senses.definition_en: Not known, recognized, identified, or understood.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kithei, kiphawk, kiciantheih ahih kei leh kitel lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The cause of the fire remains unknown.
examples.zomi: Mei a kanna hang kitheilo lai hi.

examples.english: The letter came from an unknown sender.
examples.zomi: Tua lai pen akhakpa kitheilo kiangpan hong pai hi.

senses.usage_en: Unknown does not mean that something cannot be known; it means that it is not known at present or to the relevant person.
senses.usage_zomi: Unknown in theih theihloh cihna hilo a, tu laitak ahih kei leh tua mi in theilo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Not famous or familiar
senses.definition_en: Not famous, widely recognized, or familiar to most people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Minthanglo, mi tampi in theihlo ahih kei leh a theih ngeiloh uh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The painting was created by an unknown artist.
examples.zomi: Tua lim pen minthanglo lim suaimi khat in bawl hi.

examples.english: The disease was previously unknown in the region.
examples.zomi: Tua cina pen tua gam khenah a beisa in kitheilo hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the person or thing may exist and be identifiable but is not widely known.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah mi ahih kei leh na pen om a, min zong theih ahi thei napi mi tampi in theihlo hi.

senses.definition_en: Except if; used to say that something will happen only if another thing does not happen.
senses.zomi_equivalents: loh peuhmah leh; ahih kei leh
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu dang khat a pialo peuhmah leh cihna ahih kei leh thu khat bek a pelhna in kizang hi.

common_phrases.zomi: guah a zu loh peuhmah leh

examples.english: We will go unless it rains.
examples.zomi: Guah a zu loh peuhmah leh pai ding ung.

examples.english: Do not open the door unless you know the person.
examples.zomi: Tua mi na theih kei leh kong hong kei in.

senses.usage_en: Unless usually means if not. Do not normally use another negative in the same clause: say unless it rains, not unless it does not rain, when you mean “if it does not rain.”
senses.usage_zomi: Unless in a tamzaw in if not cihna ahi hi. “Guah a zu loh leh” cihna ah unless it rains ci a, unless it does not rain ci kei in.

senses.heading: Different from
senses.definition_en: Different from a particular person or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat tawh kibanglo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This winter is unlike last winter.
examples.zomi: Tukum khuavot pen kum beisa khuavot tawh kibanglo hi.

examples.english: Her approach is unlike mine.
examples.zomi: Ama bawldan pen kei a tawh kibanglo hi.

senses.usage_en: Unlike introduces the person or thing used as the point of contrast.
senses.usage_zomi: Unlike nungah tehkakna ading a kizang mi ahih kei leh na om hi.

senses.heading: In contrast with
senses.definition_en: Used to show that a person or thing behaves differently from another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat a dang khat tawh a gamtatdan kibanglo cih lakna in kizang hi.

examples.english: Unlike his brother, he enjoys cooking.
examples.zomi: A sanggampa banglo in, amah anhuan nuam hi.

examples.english: Unlike most birds, penguins cannot fly.
examples.zomi: Va a tamzaw banglo in, penguin-te leng theilo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A comma commonly follows an introductory unlike phrase.
senses.usage_zomi: Sentence kipatna a unlike kammal pawl khitah comma koih zel hi.

senses.heading: Not likely to happen
senses.definition_en: Not expected or not likely to happen or be true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Piang ding ahih kei leh thumaan ding lam-etna tawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: It is unlikely that the road will open today.
examples.zomi: Tuni lampi hong ding hihtuaklo hi.

examples.english: Rain is unlikely this afternoon.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitaklam guah zu ding lam-et huailo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use it is unlikely that + clause or someone is unlikely to + verb.
senses.usage_zomi: It is unlikely that + clause ahih kei leh someone is unlikely to + verb ci in zang in.

senses.heading: Not expected to succeed or be chosen
senses.definition_en: Not expected to succeed, win, or be suitable for a particular role.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gualzo ding hihtuaklo; teel ding lam-et huailo
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzo, teelkhiak ahih kei leh dinmun khat ading kituak ding lam-et huailo cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: hangsapa suak ding lam-et huailo mi

examples.english: The small team became an unlikely winner.
examples.zomi: Pawl neu pen gualzo ding lam-et huailo napi gualzo hi.

examples.english: He was an unlikely candidate for leadership.
examples.zomi: Amah makaipa ading teel ding lam-et huailo mi ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense often describes a surprising person or outcome.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in lamdang sak mi ahih kei leh ngahna kawk zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Not needed or not required.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisamlo ahih kei leh bawl ding kullo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Avoid unnecessary spending.
examples.zomi: Kisamlo sumzatna pelh in.

examples.english: The extra meeting was unnecessary.
examples.zomi: Meeting beh pen kisamlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Something unnecessary may be possible or harmless, but it is not needed for the purpose.
senses.usage_zomi: Na kisamlo khat pen bawltheih ahih kei leh siasakna neilo ahi thei napi, ngiimna ading kullo hi.

senses.definition_en: Not enjoyable, comfortable, friendly, or agreeable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuamlo, lungkimhuai lo, lawmta lo ahih kei leh sang nuamlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The room had an unpleasant smell.
examples.zomi: Innkhan sungah gim nam nuamlo om hi.

examples.english: They had an unpleasant experience at the hotel.
examples.zomi: Hotel ah phutkhak nuamlo khat nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Unpleasant is less extreme than words such as terrible or horrible.
senses.usage_zomi: Unpleasant pen terrible ahih kei leh horrible sangin khauhlo zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Up to the time when a particular event happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang khat a tun dong ahih kei leh a piang ciang dong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Wait here until I return.
examples.zomi: Ka ciah dong hih munah ngak in.

examples.english: We continued working until the sun went down.
examples.zomi: Ni tum dong nasem zom ung.

senses.usage_en: Until and till have the same basic meaning. In future-time clauses after until, English normally uses the present tense: Wait until she arrives, not until she will arrive.
senses.usage_zomi: Until leh till khiatna bulpi kibang hi. Mailam hun a kawk zongin until khit sentence khenah present tense kizang zel hi: Wait until she arrives ci a, until she will arrive ci lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Different from what is normal, common, or expected.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngeina, a om zel ahih kei leh a kilam-et tawh kibanglo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: It is unusual to see snow here in May.
examples.zomi: Hih munah May kha in vuk muh pen ngeina hilo hi.

examples.english: The doctor noticed an unusual symptom.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in cina lim lamdang khat phawk hi.

senses.usage_en: Unusual does not necessarily mean bad. It means uncommon, unexpected, or different from the normal pattern.
senses.usage_zomi: Unusual in hoihlo cihna pello hi. A om zel lo, lam-etloh ahih kei leh ngeina tawh kibanglo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Toward a higher position
senses.definition_en: Toward a higher place, level, or position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, dinmun ahih kei leh a sangzaw lamah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She looked up at the sky.
examples.zomi: Van lamah a tung en hi.

examples.english: The children climbed up the hill.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te mual tungah kahto uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Up may describe movement to a physically higher position or movement to a higher level in a system.
senses.usage_zomi: Up in pumpi tawh mun sangzaw ah pai cih kawk thei a, system khat sung dinmun sangzaw ah pai cih zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: In an upright or awake position
senses.definition_en: In or into a standing, sitting, or awake position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ding, tu ahih kei leh ihmutna pan khang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please stand up when your name is called.
examples.zomi: Na min kisap ciangin dingto in.

examples.english: I woke up early this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingsangin zingtung takin ka khang hi.

senses.usage_en: In phrasal verbs such as stand up, sit up, and wake up, the full phrase should be learned as one unit.
senses.usage_zomi: Stand up, sit up, leh wake up bang phrasal verbte pen kammal pawl khat bangin kisin ding hi.

senses.heading: At a higher amount or level
senses.definition_en: At or toward a higher amount, price, temperature, speed, or level.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, man, lumzah, nawkzah ahih kei leh dinmun a sangzaw lamah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Food prices went up last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in an man khang hi.

examples.english: Please turn the volume up.
examples.zomi: Aw khangsak in.

senses.usage_en: The opposite of this meaning is usually down.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna a kikal pen a tamzaw in down ahi hi.

senses.heading: Completely or to an end
senses.definition_en: Completely, fully, or until none remains.
senses.explanation_zomi: A vekpi in, kicing takin ahih kei leh bangmah a omlona dong cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children ate up all the food.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te in an a vekpi ne uh hi.

examples.english: We used up the remaining fuel.
examples.zomi: Meisi a omlai a vekpi zangsiang ung.

senses.usage_en: In many phrasal verbs, up emphasizes completion rather than upward movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Phrasal verb tampi ah up in tunglam gamtatna hilo in, na khat zosiang cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Add the latest information
senses.definition_en: To add the newest information to a document, record, report, or account.
senses.explanation_zomi: Document, record, report ahih kei leh account khat sungah thu thak pen behlap cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please update your contact information.
examples.zomi: Na kizopna thu thaksak in.

examples.english: The team updated the report with new data.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl in data thak tawh report thaksak hi.

senses.usage_en: Update means bringing information into agreement with the newest known facts.
senses.usage_zomi: Update in thu pen a kithei thak pen thumaan tawh kituak sak cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Install a newer version
senses.definition_en: To replace or improve software, a system, or equipment with a newer version.
senses.explanation_zomi: Software, system ahih kei leh vanzat pen version thakzaw tawh khelsak ahih kei leh hoihsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: You should update the app before using it.
examples.zomi: App na zat ma in version thaksak ding hi.

examples.english: The computer updates its software automatically.
examples.zomi: Computer in ama software amahin thaksak hi.

senses.usage_en: Updating normally keeps the same program or system but installs newer files or features. Upgrading may involve a larger improvement or change.
senses.usage_zomi: Update bawl ciangin program ahih kei leh system mah kizang lai a, file leh feature thakte kibehlap hi. Upgrade ahihleh hoihsakna ahih kei leh kikhelna lianzaw kihel thei hi.

senses.heading: On
senses.definition_en: On or onto something, especially in formal or literary language.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat tungah ahih kei leh tunglamah cihna ahi a, picing leh laigelhna kampau ah kizangzaw hi.

examples.english: A small house stood upon the hill.
examples.zomi: Mual tungah inn neu khat ding hi.

examples.english: She placed the document upon the table.
examples.zomi: Document pen dohkan tungah koih hi.

senses.usage_en: In ordinary modern English, on is usually more natural than upon for physical position.
senses.usage_zomi: Tulai niteng English ah pumpi mun a kigen ciangin upon sangin on ngeinazaw hi.

senses.heading: Immediately after or when
senses.definition_en: Immediately after a particular event or at the moment it happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang khat khit pah ahih kei leh a piang laitak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Upon arrival, visitors must register.
examples.zomi: A tun phetin zin hawhte min kigelh kul hi.

examples.english: She called her family upon hearing the news.
examples.zomi: Thuthang a zak phetin a innkuan phone hi.

senses.usage_en: This formal pattern is often equivalent to when or immediately after.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih picing sentence pianzia pen when ahih kei leh immediately after tawh khiatna kibang zel hi.

senses.heading: Depending on or directed at
senses.definition_en: Used in formal expressions to show dependence, effect, or action directed toward someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat tungah kinga, a sukha ahih kei leh a lamah gamtatna a pai cih pulaakna ahi hi.

examples.english: Success depends upon careful preparation.
examples.zomi: Gualzawhna pen pilvang kigingkholna tungah kinga hi.

examples.english: The decision had a major effect upon the community.
examples.zomi: Tua khensatna in khua tungah huzaap lian nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In these expressions, upon is more formal than on but usually has the same meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kammal pawlah upon pen on sangin picingzaw napi khiatna kibang zel hi.

senses.heading: Located above another part
senses.definition_en: Situated above another part of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat a khen dang sangin a tungzaw munah a om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bedrooms are on the upper floor.
examples.zomi: Ihmutna innkhante inn tung khaan ah om hi.

examples.english: The exercise strengthens the upper body.
examples.zomi: Hih pumpi kimawlna in pumpi tunglam thahatsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Upper usually comes before a noun and compares one section with a lower section of the same object or area.
senses.usage_zomi: Upper pen min kammal mai ah om zel a, na khat sung a tung khen leh nuai khen a tehkakna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Higher in position, rank, or level
senses.definition_en: Higher in social, organizational, educational, or numerical level.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing dinmun, pawlpi, pilna ahih kei leh nambat dinmun ah a sangzaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The decision was made by upper management.
examples.zomi: Khensatna pen ukna dinmun sangte in bawl uh hi.

examples.english: She teaches upper-level courses.
examples.zomi: Pilna dinmun sangzaw course-te hilh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes rank or level rather than physical height.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in pumpi mun sang cih hilo in, dinmun ahih kei leh level sangzaw kawk hi.

senses.heading: Unhappy, worried, or angry
senses.definition_en: Unhappy, worried, disappointed, or angry because something unpleasant has happened.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu nuamlo khat a piang manin dah, lungkham, lungkia ahih kei leh heh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She was upset about the decision.
examples.zomi: Tua khensatna hangin lungsim nuamlo hi.

examples.english: The child looked upset after losing his toy.
examples.zomi: A kimawlna van a mang khit ciangin naupang dah in kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: A person is upset about/by something or upset with someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu khat hang a lungsim nuamlohna ading upset about/by something zang a, mi khat tung a lungkimlohna ading upset with someone zang in.

senses.heading: Having a disturbed stomach
senses.definition_en: Having pain, discomfort, or illness in the stomach, often involving nausea or diarrhoea.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gil sung na, nuamlo ahih kei leh luaaknuam maw ekhi nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The food gave me an upset stomach.
examples.zomi: Tua an in ka gil nuamlo sak hi.

examples.english: Avoid oily food if your stomach is upset.
examples.zomi: Na gil a nuamlo leh sathau tampi a om an pelh in.

senses.usage_en: The common phrase is an upset stomach. It describes digestive discomfort, not an emotional state.
senses.usage_zomi: Kammal ngeina pen an upset stomach ahi hi. Hih in lungsim nuamlohna hilo in, gil sung buaina kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: To or on a higher floor of a building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn a tung khaan ah ahih kei leh tung khaan lamah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The children ran upstairs.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te inn tungah tai in kahto uh hi.

examples.english: She is waiting upstairs.
examples.zomi: Amah tung khaan ah ngak hi.

senses.usage_en: As an adverb, upstairs needs no preposition: go upstairs, not go to upstairs. It can also be an adjective: an upstairs room.
senses.usage_zomi: Adverb in a kizang ciangin upstairs mai ah preposition kisamlo hi: go upstairs ci a, go to upstairs ci lo hi. Adjective in zong an upstairs room ci thei hi.

senses.heading: Toward a higher place
senses.definition_en: Toward a higher position, place, or point.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun ahih kei leh a sangzaw lamah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Smoke moved upwards through the building.
examples.zomi: Meikhu inn sungah tunglamah kahto hi.

examples.english: The path rises upwards toward the mountain.
examples.zomi: Lampi pen mual lamah a tungzaw in kahto hi.

senses.usage_en: American English more commonly uses upward as the adverb, while British English often uses upwards. Both are correct.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah adverb in upward kizangzaw a, British English ah upwards kizangzaw hi. A nihgel man hi.

senses.heading: Toward a higher amount or level
senses.definition_en: Toward an increasing amount, value, rank, or level.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat, man, dinmun ahih kei leh level a sangzaw lamah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Prices continued to move upwards.
examples.zomi: Vanman khang zom hi.

examples.english: The estimate was adjusted upwards.
examples.zomi: A man khensatna sangzaw in kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes increase or advancement rather than physical movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in pumpi tawh tunglam pai cih hilo in, khantohna ahih kei leh dinmun sangzaw kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Relating to a city or town rather than the countryside.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuapi ahih kei leh khua lian tawh kisai a, khuaphandle tawh kisai lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: More people are moving to urban areas.
examples.zomi: Mi tampi khuapi gamte ah kikhelsawn uh hi.

examples.english: The government announced a new urban development plan.
examples.zomi: Kumpi in khuapi khantohna geelna thak khat pulak hi.

senses.usage_en: Urban is the opposite of rural. It describes cities and densely populated towns.
senses.usage_zomi: Urban pen rural tawh kikal hi. Khuapi leh mi tam tak a om khua liante kawk hi.

senses.heading: Strongly advise or encourage
senses.definition_en: To strongly advise, persuade, or encourage someone to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat na khat bawl dingin khauhtak in sawl, zol ahih kei leh hansawn cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Doctors urged people to get medical help early.
examples.zomi: Siavuan-te in mite zatui panpihna a masiah zong dingin sawl uh hi.

examples.english: I strongly urge you to reconsider the decision.
examples.zomi: Tua khensatna ngaihsunkik dingin khauhtak in kong sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: Use urge someone to + verb: urge them to wait. Use urge that + clause in formal English.
senses.usage_zomi: Urge someone to + verb ci in zang in: urge them to wait. Picing English ah urge that + clause zong kizang hi.

senses.heading: Encourage a particular action or policy
senses.definition_en: To publicly or formally recommend that an action, policy, or change should happen.
senses.zomi_equivalents: bawl dingin sawl; thupisak in ngen
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna, thukhun ahih kei leh kikhelna khat piang dingin mipite mai ahih kei leh picing takin sawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Community leaders urged immediate action.
examples.zomi: Khuami makaite in manlang takin gamtat ding sawl uh hi.

examples.english: The report urges changes to the law.
examples.zomi: Report in thukham kikhel ding sawl hi.

senses.usage_en: In this pattern, the object may be an action noun rather than a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih sentence pianzia ah object pen mi hilo in gamtatna min ahi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The object form of we, referring to the speaker and one or more other people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kampaupa leh midang khat ahih kei leh a tamzawte kawk we a object form ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher gave us more time.
examples.zomi: Sia in kote hun beh hong pia hi.

examples.english: Please come with us.
examples.zomi: Kote tawh hong pai in.

senses.usage_en: Use we as the subject and us as the object: We helped them; they helped us.
senses.usage_zomi: Subject ading we zang a, object ading us zang in: We helped them; they helped us.

senses.heading: Employ something for a purpose
senses.definition_en: To do something with a tool, method, material, or resource in order to achieve a purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna khat tangtun dingin vanzat, bawldan, zatleh ahih kei leh panpihna khat zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Students use dictionaries to check meanings.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in khiatnate encian dingin dictionary zang uh hi.

examples.english: Use a clean cloth to dry the surface.
examples.zomi: Puatham tulhna dingin puan siang zang in.

senses.usage_en: Use use something for + noun/-ing or use something to + verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Use something for + noun/-ing ahih kei leh use something to + verb ci in zang in.

senses.heading: Consume an amount or resource
senses.definition_en: To consume or take an amount of energy, fuel, money, material, or another resource.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tha, meisi, sum, zatleh ahih kei leh panpihna dang khat zang bei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This machine uses less electricity.
examples.zomi: Hih machine in meivak tawmzaw zang hi.

examples.english: We used all the remaining fuel.
examples.zomi: Meisi a omlai a vekpi zangsiang ung.

senses.usage_en: Use up emphasizes that all or nearly all of a resource is consumed.
senses.usage_zomi: Use up in panpihna a vekpi ahih kei leh a tamzaw kizang bei cih thupisak hi.

senses.heading: Treat someone as a means to benefit yourself
senses.definition_en: To take unfair advantage of someone for your own benefit.
senses.zomi_equivalents: mi zangkhial; mimal phattuamna dingin zang
senses.explanation_zomi: Nangma phattuamna dingin mi khat thutanglo takin zang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He felt that his friends were using him.
examples.zomi: A lawmte in amah a phattuamna uh dingin zang uh ci in sa hi.

examples.english: Do not use people for personal gain.
examples.zomi: Mimal hamphatna dingin mite zang kei in.

senses.usage_en: This sense is negative because the person is treated as a tool rather than respected as a person.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna hoihlo hi, banghang hiam cihleh mi khat zahtak sangin vanzat bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: Previously owned or used
senses.definition_en: Having been owned, worn, or operated by someone before.
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa in mi khat in a neih, a silh ahih kei leh a zat khinsa cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She bought a used car.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw zatsa khat lei hi.

examples.english: The store sells new and used books.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr in laibu thak leh zatsa zuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Used is more neutral than second-hand, though both can mean previously owned.
senses.usage_zomi: Used pen second-hand sangin ngeina zaw kammal ahi napi, a nihgel in mi in a neih khinsa cih kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Familiar or accustomed
senses.definition_en: Familiar with something because it has been experienced repeatedly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat veitam tak phut khin ahih manin a ngei a, a omdan tawh a kihel thei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am used to cold weather.
examples.zomi: Khuahun vot ka ngei hi.

examples.english: She quickly got used to working from home.
examples.zomi: Inn pan nasep pen manlang takin hong ngei hi.

senses.usage_en: In be/get used to, to is a preposition. It is followed by a noun or -ing form: used to noise; used to working. This differs from past-habit used to + verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Be/get used to sungah to pen preposition ahi hi. A nungah noun ahih kei leh -ing form zui hi: used to noise; used to working. Hih pen a beisa ngeina used to + verb tawh kibanglo hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to describe a past state or repeated action that no longer exists or happens now.
senses.explanation_zomi: A beisa hunin dinmun khat om ahih kei leh gamtatna khat piang zel napi tu in om ahih kei leh piang nawnlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I used to live in New York.
examples.zomi: A beisa in New York ah ka om ngei hi.

examples.english: She used to walk to school, but now she takes the bus.
examples.zomi: A beisa in sangah lampai ngei napi tu in bus tawh pai hi.

senses.usage_en: Used to + base verb describes the past only. For something familiar now, use be used to + noun/-ing: I am used to driving.
senses.usage_zomi: Used to + base verb in a beisa hun bek kawk hi. Tu in na khat a ngeihna ading be used to + noun/-ing zang in: I am used to driving.

senses.definition_en: Helping someone do or achieve something; having a practical purpose or benefit.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat na khat bawl ahih kei leh tangtun theihna a panpih, zatna leh phattuamna a nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The guide contains useful information.
examples.zomi: Tua lamhilhna sungah thu phattuam om hi.

examples.english: A dictionary is a useful learning tool.
examples.zomi: Dictionary pen sinna vanzat phattuam khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Use useful for + noun/-ing and useful to + person: useful for studying; useful to students.
senses.usage_zomi: Useful for + noun/-ing leh useful to + person ci in zang in: useful for studying; useful to students.

senses.definition_en: A person who uses a product, service, system, machine, website, or substance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van kibawl, nasepna, system, machine, website ahih kei leh zatleh khat a zang mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The app has more than one million users.
examples.zomi: Tua app in zangmi million khat sangin tamzaw nei hi.

examples.english: Users must create a secure password.
examples.zomi: Zangmite in password bit khat bawl kul uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In technology, a user is anyone who interacts with a device, program, website, or service.
senses.usage_zomi: Technology ah user pen device, program, website ahih kei leh nasepna khat tawh a kizangkhawm mi khempeuh ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Normal, common, or regularly happening in a particular situation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat ah a ngeina, a om zel ahih kei leh a piang zel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bus arrived at its usual time.
examples.zomi: Bus pen a hun ngeina in hong tung hi.

examples.english: She sat in her usual place.
examples.zomi: A tutna mun ngeina ah tu hi.

senses.usage_en: As usual means in the same way that normally happens.
senses.usage_zomi: As usual in ngeina bangin ahih kei leh a piang zel bangin cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: In most situations or on most occasions; normally.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a ngeina in; a tamzaw in; zel
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun a tamzaw in, a ngeina in ahih kei leh khatvei a tamzaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I usually wake up at six o’clock.
examples.zomi: A ngeina in nai guk ciangin ka khang hi.

examples.english: The store is usually quiet in the morning.
examples.zomi: Tua dawr zingsangin gamdai zel hi.

senses.usage_en: Usually normally comes before the main verb but after the verb be: usually works; is usually busy.
senses.usage_zomi: Usually pen gamtat kammal bulpi mai ah om zel a, be khitah om hi: usually works; is usually busy.

senses.heading: A period away from work or school
senses.definition_en: A period when someone does not have to work or attend school and can rest or travel.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tawlngak hun; nasep leh sang tawlngak
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat nasep ahih kei leh sang kai kullo in tawlngak maw khualzin theih hun ahi hi.

examples.english: The children are on summer vacation.
examples.zomi: Naupang-te khuakhal tawlngak hun zang uh hi.

examples.english: She took a two-week vacation from work.
examples.zomi: Nasep pan kal nih tawlngak hun la hi.

senses.usage_en: American English commonly uses vacation. British English usually uses holiday for this meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah vacation kizangzaw hi. British English ah hih khiatna ading holiday kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: A journey taken for pleasure
senses.definition_en: A journey or stay away from home for rest and pleasure.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tawlngak leh nopna dingin inn pan mun dangah khualzin ahih kei leh omna ahi hi.

examples.english: Our family went on vacation near the beach.
examples.zomi: Ka innkuan un tuipi geiah tawlngak khualzin uh hi.

examples.english: They are planning a vacation in Europe.
examples.zomi: Europe ah tawlngak khualzinna ding geel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In American English, go on vacation means to travel or stop working for a period. British English commonly says go on holiday.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah go on vacation kici a, British English ah go on holiday kici zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: A low area of land between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mual ahih kei leh mualsangte kikal a gam niam, a tamzaw in gun a luanna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: A river flows through the valley.
examples.zomi: Kuam sungah gun khat luang hi.

examples.english: The village lies in a narrow valley.
examples.zomi: Khua pen kuam neu leh sau khat sungah om hi.

senses.usage_en: A valley is lower than the surrounding land. It may be broad and open or narrow and steep.
senses.usage_zomi: Kuam pen a kimkot gam sangin niamzaw hi. A zai a kihong ahi thei a, a neu a a gei sang zong ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Worth a lot of money
senses.definition_en: Worth a large amount of money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum tawh a man tampi cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The museum protects several valuable paintings.
examples.zomi: Museum in limsuah manpha pawlkhat kem hi.

examples.english: She kept the valuable documents in a safe.
examples.zomi: Document manphate bawm bit sungah koih hi.

senses.usage_en: Something valuable may be expensive because it is rare, useful, historic, or highly desired.
senses.usage_zomi: Na manpha khat pen a tawm bek om, a phattuam, tangthu nei ahih kei leh mite in a deih mahmah manin a man lian ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: Very useful or important
senses.definition_en: Very useful, helpful, or important.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phattuam, panpihna lian nei ahih kei leh thupi mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Your feedback gave us valuable information.
examples.zomi: Na dawnkikna in thu phattuam hong pia hi.

examples.english: She gained valuable experience from the project.
examples.zomi: Tua project pan phutkhak phattuam ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, valuable does not necessarily refer to money.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah valuable in sum man kawk ngiatlo hi.

senses.heading: Monetary worth
senses.definition_en: The amount of money that something is worth.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat sum tawh bangzah man cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The value of the house has increased.
examples.zomi: Tua inn man khang hi.

examples.english: Experts estimated the painting’s value.
examples.zomi: Siamte in tua lim man khensat uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The value of an item may differ from the price originally paid for it.
senses.usage_zomi: Van khat a tu man pen a kileih lai a man tawh kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: Usefulness or benefit compared with cost
senses.definition_en: The usefulness, quality, or benefit received in relation to the money, time, or effort spent.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, hun ahih kei leh hahkatna a kizatzah tawh tehkak in a ngah phattuamna leh hoihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: sum a kizatzah tawh kituak phattuamna

examples.english: This computer offers good value for the price.
