examples.zomi: Hih computer pen a man tawh kituak in hoih hi.

examples.english: The course has great practical value.
examples.zomi: Tua course in gamtatna ah phattuamna lian nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Good value means that the quality or benefit is satisfactory for the price paid.
senses.usage_zomi: Good value in a kipiak man tawh tehkak in hoihna ahih kei leh phattuamna lungkimhuai cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: An important belief or principle
senses.definition_en: A belief or principle that helps someone decide what is right, important, or desirable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in bang a man, a thupi ahih kei leh a deihhuai cih khensatna a makaih upna maw thukhun ahi hi.

examples.english: Honesty is one of her central values.
examples.zomi: Thumaan gamtatna pen ama upna thukhun thupi khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The organization is guided by shared values.
examples.zomi: Pawlpi pen a upkhawm thukhunte in makaih hi.

senses.usage_en: This meaning is often plural because people and organizations usually hold several values.
senses.usage_zomi: Mite leh pawlpite in upna thukhun tampi nei zel ahih manin hih khiatna pen plural in kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: The numerical amount represented by something
senses.definition_en: A number or quantity represented by a symbol, measurement, or calculation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim, tehna ahih kei leh simna khat in a aiawh nambat maw zat ahi hi.

examples.english: Enter the correct value in the table.
examples.zomi: Table sungah nambat man dik gelh in.

examples.english: The measured value was higher than expected.
examples.zomi: Tehna ngahna pen a kilam-et sangin sangzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: This technical sense is common in mathematics, science, computing, and statistics.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih technical khiatna pen mathematics, science, computer leh statistic ah kizang zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A medium-sized road vehicle used for carrying goods, equipment, or several people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, vanzat ahih kei leh mi pawlkhat puakna ding a kizang mawtaw a lianluatlo khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The company uses a van to deliver packages.
examples.zomi: Kampani in parcel-te puakna dingin van zang hi.

examples.english: Eight passengers travelled in the van.
examples.zomi: Khualzin mi giat van sungah khualzin uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A van is generally smaller than a truck but larger and more enclosed than an ordinary car.
senses.usage_zomi: Van pen truck sangin neuzaw zel a, mawtaw ngeina sangin lianzaw leh a sung kikhuhzaw hi.

senses.heading: A range of different things
senses.definition_en: A collection or range of different people or things.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na nam tuamtuam kikhawm ahi hi.

examples.english: The market sells a wide variety of vegetables.
examples.zomi: Dawr in meh nam tuamtuam mahmah zuak hi.

examples.english: Students can choose from a variety of courses.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te course nam tuamtuam lakpan teel thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a variety of + plural noun: a variety of books. The verb may be singular or plural depending on whether the group or its individual members are emphasized.
senses.usage_zomi: A variety of + plural noun ci in zang in: a variety of books. Verb singular maw plural cih pen pawl a vekpi maw a sung nate tuamtuam thupisak cih tungah kinga hi.

senses.heading: A particular kind
senses.definition_en: One particular kind within a larger group, especially of plants, foods, or products.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl lianzaw khat sung a nam kician khat, a diak in singkung, an ahih kei leh van kibawlte tawh kisai ahi hi.

examples.english: This is a local variety of rice.
examples.zomi: Hih pen khuadawng buh nam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Researchers developed a disease-resistant plant variety.
examples.zomi: Thuzongte in cina a do thei singkung nam khat bawlkhia uh hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, variety is countable: a variety; several varieties.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah variety simtheih hi: a variety; several varieties.

senses.definition_en: Several different people or things of more than one kind.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na pawlkhat nam kibanglo a om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: People attended for various reasons.
examples.zomi: Mite a hang tuamtuam tawh hong pai uh hi.

examples.english: The problem can be solved in various ways.
examples.zomi: Tua buaina lampi tuamtuam tawh kiveng thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Various normally comes before a plural countable noun. It means several different kinds, not simply a large number.
senses.usage_zomi: Various pen plural simtheih min kammal mai ah om zel hi. Na tampi bek hilo in, nam kibanglo pawlkhat cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Be different
senses.definition_en: To be different according to person, place, time, situation, or another condition.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, mun, hun, dinmun ahih kei leh thukhenna dang dungzui in kibanglo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Prices vary from store to store.
examples.zomi: Vanman dawr khat leh khat kibanglo hi.

examples.english: The symptoms vary according to age.
examples.zomi: Cina limte kum dungzui in kibanglo hi.

senses.usage_en: Use vary from A to B for a range and vary by/according to for the factor causing differences.
senses.usage_zomi: Ciangtan kikal ading vary from A to B zang a, kibatlohna a piangsak thu ading vary by/according to zang in.

senses.heading: Change or make something different
senses.definition_en: To change over time or to deliberately change something so it is not always the same.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tawh kikhel ahih kei leh na khat kibang tawntung lo dingin deihna tawh khelsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The temperature varies throughout the day.
examples.zomi: Ni khat sung tawntung khuahun lumzah kikhel hi.

examples.english: Teachers should vary their teaching methods.
examples.zomi: Sia-te in a hilhdan uh khelsak zel ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Vary may be intransitive when something changes itself or transitive when someone changes it.
senses.usage_zomi: Na khat amah kikhel ciangin vary object loin kizang a, mi khat in a khelsak ciangin object tawh kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Extremely large in area, amount, number, or extent.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lian mahmah; zai mahmah; tam mahmah
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam zau, zat, omzah ahih kei leh ciangtan ah lian mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The desert covers a vast area.
examples.zomi: Sehnel gam in gam zau mahmah khuh hi.

examples.english: The internet provides access to a vast amount of information.
examples.zomi: Internet in thu tampi mahmah muh theihna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Vast is stronger than large and often suggests something difficult to measure or fully explore.
senses.usage_zomi: Vast pen large sangin khauhzaw a, teh ahih kei leh kancian kim ding haksat zah a lian cih kawk zel hi.

senses.definition_en: A plant or part of a plant, such as a root, leaf, stem, or seed, that is eaten as food.
senses.explanation_zomi: An in a kine singkung ahih kei leh a zung, a teh, a tang, a ci bang singkung khen ahi hi.

examples.english: Fresh vegetables are sold at the market.
examples.zomi: Dawr ah meh thakte kizuak hi.

examples.english: We grow tomatoes and other vegetables in our garden.
examples.zomi: Ka huan uh sungah tomato leh meh dangte khangsak ung.

senses.usage_en: In everyday cooking, vegetable is a food category. Botanically, some foods called vegetables—such as tomatoes—are fruits.
senses.usage_zomi: Niteng anhuan ah vegetable pen an nam khat ahi hi. Singkung pilna bangin meh a kici pawlkhat—tomato bang—gah ahi hi.

senses.heading: Something used for transportation
senses.definition_en: A machine used for carrying people or goods, especially on land.
senses.explanation_zomi: A diak in leitungah mite ahih kei leh vante pua ding a kizang machine ahi hi.

examples.english: Only authorized vehicles may enter the area.
examples.zomi: Phalna a nei mawtawte bek tua munah lut thei hi.

examples.english: Electric vehicles produce no exhaust while driving.
examples.zomi: Meivak mawtawte hawl laitakin meikhu suahlo hi.

senses.usage_en: Vehicle is a broad word that includes cars, trucks, vans, buses, motorcycles, and similar forms of transport.
senses.usage_zomi: Vehicle pen mawtaw, truck, van, bus, motorcycle leh khualzinna van a kibangte huam hi.

senses.heading: A means of expressing or achieving something
senses.definition_en: Something used to communicate an idea or achieve a purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna khat pulaak ahih kei leh ngiimna khat tangtun na ding a kizang lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: Art can be a vehicle for social change.
examples.zomi: Limsiamna pen mihing kipawlna kikhelna lampi ahi thei hi.

examples.english: The internet is a powerful vehicle for communication.
examples.zomi: Internet pen kizopna lampi thahat khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense describes a method or channel, not a means of physical transportation.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih gentehna khiatna in pumpi khualzinna van hilo in, ngiimna khat tangtunna lampi kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: A place where an organized event, meeting, performance, or sports competition is held.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawi, meeting, program ahih kei leh kimawlna kidemna a kibawl mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The hotel was chosen as the conference venue.
examples.zomi: Hotel pen conference mun in kiteel hi.

examples.english: The venue can hold two thousand people.
examples.zomi: Tua pawi munah mi tul nih om thei hi.

senses.usage_en: A venue is the location of an organized event, not the event itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Venue pen pawi ahih kei leh program kibawlna mun ahi a, pawi mahmah hilo hi.

senses.heading: A particular form of something
senses.definition_en: One particular form of a product, document, story, program, or system that differs from other forms.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van kibawl, document, tangthu, program ahih kei leh system khat a dang pianziate tawh a kibanglo pianzia kician khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Install the latest version of the software.
examples.zomi: Software version thak pen koih in.

examples.english: This is a revised version of the report.
examples.zomi: Hih pen report kithaksak version ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Different versions may contain changes in wording, design, features, or content.
senses.usage_zomi: Version tuamtuam sungah kammal, design, feature ahih kei leh thu omte kikhel thei hi.

senses.heading: One person’s account of an event
senses.definition_en: One person’s description or explanation of what happened.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu piang khat tawh kisai mi khat in a gen ahih kei leh a hilhcian dan ahi hi.

examples.english: Her version of the accident differed from his.
examples.zomi: Ama accident genkhiatdan pen tua mipa genkhiatdan tawh kibanglo hi.

examples.english: Police listened to both versions of the story.
examples.zomi: Police-te in tangthu genkhiatdan a nihgel ngai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A version may reflect one person’s knowledge, memory, or point of view and is not automatically the complete truth.
senses.usage_zomi: Version khat pen mi khat’ theihna, phawkna ahih kei leh muhdan tungah kinga thei a, thumaan a vekpi cihna pello hi.

senses.heading: To a high degree
senses.definition_en: Used before an adjective or adverb to make its meaning stronger.
senses.explanation_zomi: Adjective ahih kei leh adverb a khiatna khauhsakna dingin kizang hi.

examples.english: The examination was very difficult.
examples.zomi: Sittelna haksa mahmah hi.

examples.english: She speaks English very clearly.
examples.zomi: Amah English ciang mahmah in pau hi.

senses.usage_en: Use very before ordinary adjectives and adverbs. With many strong adjectives, words such as absolutely may sound more natural: absolutely impossible.
senses.usage_zomi: Adjective leh adverb ngeinate mai ah very zang in. Adjective khauhte tawh absolutely impossible bangin absolutely ngeinazaw thei hi.

senses.heading: Exactly; precisely
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that a particular person, thing, place, or time is exactly the one meant.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, na, mun ahih kei leh hun a kigen pen mah ahi cih thupisakna in kizang hi.

examples.english: We met in this very room.
examples.zomi: Hih innkhan mahah kimu ung.

examples.english: She returned the very next day.
examples.zomi: A zing ni mahah ciahkik hi.

senses.usage_en: In this emphatic sense, very commonly appears before a noun phrase rather than before an adjective.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih thupisakna khiatna ah very pen adjective mai sangin min kammal pawl mai ah om zel hi.

senses.heading: Travelling through a place
senses.definition_en: Travelling through a particular place on the way to a destination.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tunsa mun lam a paina ah mun khat kantan in cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: Bangkok kantan in vanleng tawh pai

examples.english: We flew to India via Bangkok.
examples.zomi: Bangkok kantan in India ah vanleng tawh pai ung.

examples.english: The bus travels to the village via the main road.
examples.zomi: Bus pen lampi lian kantan in khua ah pai hi.

senses.usage_en: The place after via is an intermediate point, not necessarily the final destination.
senses.usage_zomi: Via khit a mun pen khualzinna a kantan mun ahi a, tunna nunung mun cihna tawntung hilo hi.

senses.heading: By means of
senses.definition_en: By using a particular method, person, service, or communication system.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bawldan, mi, nasepna ahih kei leh kizopna system khat tungtawn in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please send the document via email.
examples.zomi: Document pen email tungtawn in hong khak in.

examples.english: The payment was made via the mobile app.
examples.zomi: Sum pen mobile app zangin kipia hi.

senses.usage_en: Via is concise and somewhat formal. In ordinary speech, by, through, or using may sound more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Via pen tom leh picing kammal ahi hi. Niteng kihona ah by, through, ahih kei leh using ngeinazaw thei hi.

senses.heading: A person harmed by crime, violence, or an accident
senses.definition_en: A person who is harmed, injured, or killed by a crime, violent act, accident, or disaster.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mawhna, bawlsiatna, accident ahih kei leh siatna lian hangin siasak, liam ahih kei leh si a tuak mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The hospital treated the accident victims.
examples.zomi: Siiminn in accident thuakmite bawl hi.

examples.english: The program provides support for victims of violence.
examples.zomi: Tua program in bawlsiatna thuakmite panpih hi.

senses.usage_en: Person-centred language may be preferable in some contexts, especially when people do not want to be defined only by what happened to them.
senses.usage_zomi: Dinmun pawlkhat ah mite tungah thu piang khat bek tawh minvawh loin, amaute mihing ahihna thupisak kammal zat hoihzaw thei hi.

senses.heading: A person harmed by an illness or difficult situation
senses.definition_en: A person who suffers because of an illness, harmful condition, deception, or another misfortune.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thuakna a nei mi; siasakna thuakmi
senses.explanation_zomi: Cina, dinmun siasak, khemna ahih kei leh hamphatlohna dang khat hangin thuakna a nei mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Older people are often victims of online fraud.
examples.zomi: Upa zawte internet sum khemna thuakmi hong suak zel uh hi.

examples.english: The disease claimed thousands of victims.
examples.zomi: Tua cina hangin mi tul tampi si uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use victim of before the crime, event, illness, or condition that caused the harm.
senses.usage_zomi: Siasakna a piangsak mawhna, thu piang, cina ahih kei leh dinmun mai ah victim of zang in.

senses.definition_en: Success in defeating an opponent in a battle, competition, election, or struggle.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gal, kidemna, teelna ahih kei leh haksatna kidona ah langpangpa zo in gualzawhna ngah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The team celebrated its victory.
examples.zomi: Tua pawl in a gualzawhna uh pawi bawl uh hi.

examples.english: The candidate won a decisive election victory.
examples.zomi: Candidate in teelna gualzawhna kician ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: A victory is a successful result against an opponent or difficulty. Success is broader and does not always involve competition.
senses.usage_zomi: Victory in langpangpa ahih kei leh haksatna khat zawhna kawk hi. Success pen a huamzaw a, kidemna kihel tawntunglo hi.

senses.heading: A recording of moving pictures
senses.definition_en: A recording of moving pictures, usually with sound.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim kalsuan, a tamzaw in aw tawh a kikhum ahi hi.

examples.english: She recorded a short video on her phone.
examples.zomi: A phone tawh video tom khat khum hi.

examples.english: Students watched an educational video.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang-te in pilna video khat en uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A video may be recorded, streamed live, uploaded, downloaded, or shared electronically.
senses.usage_zomi: Video pen kikhum, live in kipuak, internet tungah kikoih, kilakhia ahih kei leh kikoppih thei hi.

senses.heading: The technology or format for moving pictures
senses.definition_en: The technology, signal, or format used to record, transmit, or display moving pictures.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim kalsuan khum, puak ahih kei leh lakna ding a kizang technology, signal ahih kei leh format ahi hi.

examples.english: The computer supports several video formats.
examples.zomi: Computer in video format tuamtuam zangthei hi.

examples.english: The video quality improved after the update.
examples.zomi: Update khit ciangin video hoihna hong khang hi.

senses.usage_en: In technical contexts, video may describe the visual part of a recording as distinct from its audio.
senses.usage_zomi: Technical thu ah video in kikhumna a lim khen kawk a, a aw khen audio tawh kikhen hi.

senses.heading: What can be seen from a place
senses.definition_en: The area, scene, or objects that can be seen from a particular position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun kician khat pan a muhtheih gam, kilakna ahih kei leh nate ahi hi.

examples.english: The room has a beautiful view of the lake.
examples.zomi: Innkhan pan dil kilakna hoih mahmah hi.

examples.english: We stopped to enjoy the mountain view.
examples.zomi: Mual kilakna nuam sa dingin tawl ung.

senses.usage_en: A view of something is the scene that can be seen. A view from somewhere identifies the position of the observer.
senses.usage_zomi: A view of in a kimuh na kawk a, a view from in a enpa omna mun kawk hi.

senses.heading: An opinion
senses.definition_en: A belief, opinion, or way of thinking about a subject.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thulu khat tung a upna, muhdan ahih kei leh ngaihsutdan ahi hi.

examples.english: She expressed her views on education.
examples.zomi: Pilna tung a muhdante pulak hi.

examples.english: The members held different views.
examples.zomi: Pawl sung mite muhdan kibanglo nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use view on/about before the subject of the opinion and in my view to introduce your own opinion.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngaihsutna thulu mai ah view on/about zang a, nangma muhdan kipatna dingin in my view zang in.

senses.heading: The ability or opportunity to see
senses.definition_en: The ability, position, or opportunity to see someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat muhtheihna, etna mun ahih kei leh hunhoih ahi hi.

examples.english: A tall building blocked our view.
examples.zomi: Inn sang khat in ka kilakna uh daal hi.

examples.english: The car disappeared from view.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw pen muhtheih mun pan mang hi.

senses.usage_en: In view means visible; out of view means no longer visible.
senses.usage_zomi: In view in muhtheih cihna a, out of view in muhtheih nawnlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A purpose or intention
senses.definition_en: A purpose, intention, or planned result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngiimna, deihna ahih kei leh ngah ding a kigensa ahi hi.

examples.english: They bought the land with a view to building houses.
examples.zomi: Innte lam ding ngiimna tawh gam lei uh hi.

examples.english: The policy was introduced with long-term growth in view.
examples.zomi: Hun sau khantohna ngiim in tua thukhun kizang kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: The formal phrase with a view to is followed by a noun or -ing form: with a view to improving services.
senses.usage_zomi: Picing kammal pawl with a view to nungah noun ahih kei leh -ing form zui hi: with a view to improving services.

senses.heading: A person who watches television or video
senses.definition_en: A person who watches a television program, film, online video, or other visual content.
senses.explanation_zomi: Television program, film, internet video ahih kei leh muhtheih thu a en mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The program attracted millions of viewers.
examples.zomi: Tua program in entu million tampi kaikhawm hi.

examples.english: Viewers can watch the video online.
examples.zomi: Entute video internet tungah en thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A viewer watches visual content. A listener hears audio, and a reader reads written material.
senses.usage_zomi: Viewer in muhtheih thu en hi. Listener in aw ngai a, reader in laigelh thu sim hi.

senses.heading: A device or program used for viewing
senses.definition_en: A device or software program used to display images, documents, or other visual material.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim, document ahih kei leh muhtheih thu lakna ding a kizang vanzat maw software program ahi hi.

examples.english: Open the file in a PDF viewer.
examples.zomi: File pen PDF etna program sungah hong in.

examples.english: The image viewer supports several formats.
examples.zomi: Lim etna program in format tuamtuam zangthei hi.

senses.usage_en: In computing, a viewer usually displays content but may offer limited editing features.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer thu ah viewer in thu lak hi a, edit bawltheihna tawm bek nei thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A small community in the countryside, usually smaller than a town.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khuaphandle ah a om, khua lian sangin neuzaw mihing omna mun ahi hi.

examples.english: She grew up in a small mountain village.
examples.zomi: Mual khuapi neu khat ah khang hi.

examples.english: The village has a school and a health centre.
examples.zomi: Khua sungah sang leh cidamna mun khat om hi.

senses.usage_en: The exact legal distinction between a village and a town varies by country. In ordinary use, a village is generally smaller and more rural.
senses.usage_zomi: Village leh town a thukhun bang kibatlohna pen gam khat leh khat kibanglo hi. Niteng kampau ah village pen neuzaw a, khuaphandle omzia nei zaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Behaviour that uses physical force to hurt people or damage property.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi liamsakna, sih sakna, ahih keileh neihlelam suksiatna dingin thagum kizang gamtatna ahi hi.

examples.english: The community is working together to prevent violence.
examples.zomi: Ngongtatna khaktan dingin khuami te kithuahkhawm uh hi.

examples.english: Several people were injured in the violence.
examples.zomi: Tua ngongtatna ah mi pawlkhat liam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Violence is an uncountable noun. Do not normally say “a violence”; say “an act of violence.”
senses.usage_zomi: Violence pen simtheih loh min ahi hi. “A violence” ci loin “an act of violence” ci ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Using physical force to hurt or damage
senses.definition_en: Using or involving physical force that can seriously hurt people or damage property.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nasa takin liamsakthei ahih kei leh neihlelam suksiatthei thagum zang gamtatna tawh kisai hi.

examples.english: The police arrested him for a violent attack.
examples.zomi: Ngongtat takin mi a sim manin police te in amah man uh hi.

examples.english: The film contains several violent scenes.
examples.zomi: Tua film sungah ngongtatna lakna pawlkhat om hi.

senses.usage_en: Violent describes a person, action or event that uses dangerous physical force.
senses.usage_zomi: Violent pen lauhuai thagum zang mi, gamtatna ahih kei leh thupiang khat genna ah kizang hi.

senses.heading: Extremely strong or sudden
senses.definition_en: Very strong, severe or sudden.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thahat, nasia ahih kei leh kipakhat in piang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A violent storm damaged many houses.
examples.zomi: Huihpi nasiat mahmah in inn tampi susia hi.

examples.english: The medicine caused a violent reaction.
examples.zomi: Tua zatui in a pumpi dawnkikna nasa mahmah piangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, violent does not always involve deliberate harm; it can describe extreme natural force or a severe bodily reaction.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah violent in mi khat in minthangin a suksiatna bek kawk lo hi; pianzia thahat mahmah ahih kei leh pumpi dawnkikna nasiat mahmah zong gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Existing or happening through computers or the internet
senses.definition_en: Created, experienced or carried out through a computer or the internet rather than in a physical place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat ah pumpi tawh kiangtuah loin computer ahih kei leh internet tungtawnin kibawl, kimuh ahih kei leh kizopna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: computer in a piangsak bangtak muhna

examples.english: We attended a virtual meeting from home.
examples.zomi: Inn panin internet tung kikhopna kah uh hi.

examples.english: Students can enter the virtual classroom at nine.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang te nai kua ciangin internet tung sanginn sungah lutthei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Virtual commonly describes an activity that happens online instead of face to face.
senses.usage_zomi: Virtual pen maitang kimu in kibawl loin internet tungah kibawl nasepna genna ah tamveipi kizang hi.

senses.heading: Almost complete or nearly true
senses.definition_en: Almost complete or true, although not officially or exactly so.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tua bang mah deuh; kimlai mah
senses.explanation_zomi: Minphuahna tawh thukip takin tua bang ahi nailo napi, a taktakin tua bang mah tawh kibanglua cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The town came to a virtual standstill during the storm.
examples.zomi: Huihpi sungin khuapi gamtatna khempeuh tawlnga kimlai hi.

examples.english: His victory is now a virtual certainty.
examples.zomi: Tu in ama gualzawhna kician mahbang hita hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, virtual means “almost” rather than “connected to computers.”
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah virtual in computer tawh kisai cihna hilo a, “kimlai” ahih kei leh “tua bang mah deuh” cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A tiny infectious agent
senses.definition_en: A very small infectious agent that enters living cells and can cause disease.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nungta cell sungah lut in natna piangsakthei, mit tawh muh zawhloh natna kha neu mahmah ahi hi.

examples.english: The virus spreads through close contact.
examples.zomi: Tua virus pen kinaizawh takin kizopna tungtawnin kizel hi.

examples.english: Scientists are studying how the virus enters human cells.
examples.zomi: Virus in mihing cell sung a lut dan scientist te in kencian uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Antibiotics kill bacteria, but they do not normally cure illnesses caused by viruses.
senses.usage_zomi: Antibiotic in bacteria that thei napi, virus in a piangsak natna pen a tawntungin damsak theilo hi.

senses.heading: A harmful computer program
senses.definition_en: A harmful program that can copy itself and damage computers or data.
senses.explanation_zomi: Amah leh amah kikopi in computer ahih kei leh data susiat thei program lauhuai ahi hi.

examples.english: A virus damaged several files on my computer.
examples.zomi: Virus khat in ka computer sunga file pawlkhat susia hi.

examples.english: This software protects your device from viruses.
examples.zomi: Hih software in na device pen virus te pan kem hi.

senses.usage_en: A computer virus is one kind of malicious software. Not every computer problem is caused by a virus.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer virus pen computer susia software nam khat ahi hi. Computer buaina khempeuh virus in a piangsak hilo hi.

senses.heading: The ability to see
senses.definition_en: The ability to see with the eyes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mit tawh muh theihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Her vision became clearer after the operation.
examples.zomi: Zatui tawh a kisem khit ciangin ama mitmuhna kicianzaw hi.

examples.english: This condition can affect your vision.
examples.zomi: Hih natna in na mitmuhna sukha thei hi.

senses.usage_en: Vision refers to the ability to see; sight can refer either to that ability or to something that is seen.
senses.usage_zomi: Vision in mit tawh muh theihna kawk hi; sight in mitmuh theihna ahih kei leh kimuh na khat zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: An idea of the future
senses.definition_en: A clear idea of what the future should be like or what someone hopes to achieve.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam hun a bangci ding cih ahih kei leh a tun nuam ngimna tungtang muhna kician ahi hi.

examples.english: The leader presented her vision for the country’s future.
examples.zomi: Makaipa in gam mailam hun ading ama muhna hong pulaak hi.

examples.english: We share a vision of a peaceful community.
examples.zomi: Lungnopna nei khuami kipawlna khat i deihna kibang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, vision is more than a simple plan; it expresses a broad and inspiring picture of the future.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah vision pen geelna maimai sangin lianzaw hi; mailam hun ading muhna zaizaw leh lungsim khangsakthei khat ahi hi.

senses.heading: To go and spend time with someone
senses.definition_en: To go and spend time with someone, usually for a limited period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun tomkhat sung kiangah omkhawm dingin mi khat va hawh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We visited our grandparents last weekend.
examples.zomi: Nipi tawp ni beisa in i pu leh i pi va hawh uh hi.

examples.english: She visits her friend in hospital every evening.
examples.zomi: Nitak simin hospital ah a lawm va hawh hi.

senses.usage_en: Visit is usually transitive: say “visit someone,” not “visit to someone.”
senses.usage_zomi: Visit pen a nungah object kisam thei hi. “Visit someone” ci in zang inla, “visit to someone” ci kei in.

senses.heading: To go to a place for a particular purpose
senses.definition_en: To go to a place to see it, use its services or do something there.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat en ding, tua muna nasepna zang ding ahih kei leh tua ah na khat bawl dingin va pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Thousands of tourists visit the city each year.
examples.zomi: Kum simin khualzin mi tul tampi khuapi ah hong pai uh hi.

examples.english: Visit our website for more information.
examples.zomi: Thu kicingzaw ngah dingin ka website uh sungah lut in.

senses.usage_en: For websites, visit means opening and viewing the site; it does not involve physical travel.
senses.usage_zomi: Website tawh kisai ah visit in tua website hon in en cihna ahi a, pumpi tawh khualzin cihna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who goes to see someone or spends time at a place for a limited period.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat va hawh ahih kei leh mun khat ah hun tomkhat va zang mi ahi hi.

examples.english: All visitors must sign in at the front desk.
examples.zomi: Khovak khempeuh maitang desk ah min gelh masa ding uh hi.

examples.english: We had several visitors this morning.
examples.zomi: Tuni zingin khovak pawlkhat nei ung.

senses.usage_en: A visitor stays temporarily. A person who lives permanently in a place is a resident, not a visitor.
senses.usage_zomi: Visitor pen hun tomkhat bek om mi ahi hi. Mun khat ah tawntung om mi pen khovak hilo a, tua muna teng mi ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Connected with seeing, or presented in a form that can be seen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mit tawh muhna tawh kisai ahih kei leh mit tawh muhtheih dingin kilak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The teacher used pictures as visual aids.
examples.zomi: Sia in mitmuh huhna dingin lim te zang hi.

examples.english: The film has impressive visual effects.
examples.zomi: Tua film in mitmuh sukna lamdang taktak nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Visual relates to seeing. Visible means that something can actually be seen.
senses.usage_zomi: Visual pen muhna tawh kisai cihna ahi hi. Visible ahih leh na khat pen a taktakin muhtheih cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Extremely important or necessary
senses.definition_en: Extremely important or necessary for success, safety or survival.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzawhna, bitna ahih kei leh nuntakzawhna dingin thupi mahmah leh kisam teitei ahi hi.

examples.english: Clean water is vital for human health.
examples.zomi: Tui siangtho pen mihing cidamna dingin kisam teitei hi.

examples.english: Communication plays a vital role in teamwork.
examples.zomi: Kipawlkhawm nasepna ah kizopna in panmun thupi mahmah nei hi.

senses.usage_en: Vital is stronger than important. It often means that success or survival would be impossible without it.
senses.usage_zomi: Vital pen important sangin thahat zaw khiatna nei hi. Tua om keileh gualzawhna ahih kei leh nuntakzawhna piangtheilo cihna tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Necessary for life
senses.definition_en: Connected with or necessary for keeping a living body alive.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nuntakna tawh kisai; nuntakna ding kisam
senses.explanation_zomi: Nungta pumpi nuntak paisuakna tawh kisai ahih kei leh nuntakna dingin kisam ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: nuntakna ding kisam pumpi sung omna-te

examples.english: The heart and lungs are vital organs.
examples.zomi: Lungtang leh lungs pen nuntakna dingin kisam pumpi sung omna-te ahi uh hi.

examples.english: The nurse checked the patient’s vital signs.
examples.zomi: Nurse in cina mi nuntakna limte enkik hi.

senses.usage_en: In medicine, vital often describes organs or signs directly connected with life.
senses.usage_zomi: Zatui lamah vital pen nuntakna tawh langsungin kizom pumpi sung omna-te ahih kei leh nuntakna limte genna ah kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A natural substance needed in small amounts to keep the body healthy and growing properly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi cidam in khang hoih dingin tawmno bek kisam, an sung pan ngah pumpi-in kisap zat ahi hi.

examples.english: Fruit and vegetables provide important vitamins.
examples.zomi: Singgah leh ante in pumpi ading vitamin thupi te hong pia hi.

examples.english: A lack of vitamin D can weaken the bones.
examples.zomi: Vitamin D kicinglo ahih leh guh te thanem sakthei hi.

senses.usage_en: Vitamins are needed only in small amounts. They support health but do not replace a balanced diet.
senses.usage_zomi: Vitamin pen tawmno bek kisam hi. Cidamna panpih napi, an namkim takin nekna mun la theilo hi.

senses.heading: The sound produced when a person speaks or sings
senses.definition_en: The sound that a person produces when speaking or singing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in pau ahih kei leh la a sak cianga a suah aw ahi hi.

examples.english: I recognized her voice on the phone.
examples.zomi: Phone tungah ama aw thei pah ing.

examples.english: Please lower your voice in the library.
examples.zomi: Laibu inn sungah na aw niam sak in.

senses.usage_en: Voice is the sound made by a person. Noise is any unwanted or unpleasant sound.
senses.usage_zomi: Voice pen mi khat in a suah aw ahi hi. Noise ahih leh deihhuai lo ahih kei leh zaknop lo aw ahi hi.

senses.heading: The right or ability to express an opinion
senses.definition_en: The right or opportunity to express an opinion and influence a decision.
senses.zomi_equivalents: thu gen theihna; ngaihsutna pulaak theihna
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngaihsutna gen in khensatna suktheih nading thu gen theihna ahih kei leh hamphatna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat thu gen theihna pia

examples.english: Young people should have a voice in the decision.
examples.zomi: Tua khensatna ah khangno te zong thu gen theihna nei ding uh hi.

examples.english: The organization gives poor families a voice.
examples.zomi: Tua kipawlna in innkuan genthei te thu gen theihna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, voice does not mean physical sound; it means having one’s opinions heard and considered.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah voice pen aw ging cihna hilo hi; mi khat ngaihsutna zak leh ngaihsak saktheih cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: The amount of space that something fills
senses.definition_en: The amount of three-dimensional space occupied by a substance or object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat ahih kei leh zat khat in a luahna mun a lian-le-neu zah ahi hi.

examples.english: We calculated the volume of the box.
examples.zomi: Kuang luahna zat simkhia ung.

examples.english: The gas increases in volume when it becomes warm.
examples.zomi: Gas a lum ciangin a luahna zat khang hi.

senses.usage_en: Volume measures three-dimensional space. Area measures a flat surface.
senses.usage_zomi: Volume in van khat a dung, a zai leh a san tawh a luahna mun teh hi. Area in a zaang pianzia a luahna mun teh hi.

senses.heading: The amount or level of sound
senses.definition_en: The level of loudness produced by a television, radio or other device.
senses.explanation_zomi: Television, radio ahih kei leh device dang khat pan a suah aw a ngaih-le-niam zah ahi hi.

examples.english: Please turn down the volume.
examples.zomi: Aw niam sak in.

examples.english: The volume was too high for the small room.
examples.zomi: Tua innkhaan neu ading aw ngaihlua hi.

senses.usage_en: Use turn up the volume to make the sound louder and turn down the volume to make it quieter.
senses.usage_zomi: Aw ngaihzaw sak dingin turn up the volume zang inla, aw niamzaw sak dingin turn down the volume zang in.

senses.heading: One book in a set
senses.definition_en: One book that forms part of a larger set of books.
senses.zomi_equivalents: laibu tom; laibu kipawl sung tom khat
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu pawlkhat tawh a kipawl laibu tom khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The second volume will be published next year.
examples.zomi: Laibu tom nihna kumkik ciangin kiphuah ding hi.

examples.english: This dictionary is divided into two volumes.
examples.zomi: Hih dictionary pen laibu tom nih suah in kikhen hi.

senses.usage_en: A volume may be one physical book in a multi-book work. It can also refer formally to a single book.
senses.usage_zomi: Volume pen laibu tam kipawlna sungah laibu tom khat ahi thei hi. Thu kician takin laibu khat bek zong kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who freely offers to do work or help without being forced, often without receiving pay.
senses.zomi_equivalents: utthu-a nasem mi; thamanlo huh mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Ki sawl loin ama ut thu-in nasep ahih kei leh huhna pia, tamveipi thaman ngahlo mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Volunteers distributed food to the families.
examples.zomi: Utthu-a nasem mi te in innkuan te tungah an hawm uh hi.

examples.english: The hospital needs more volunteers.
examples.zomi: Hospital in utthu-a nasem mi tamzaw kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: A volunteer chooses freely to help. The person may receive expenses, but normally does not receive a regular salary.
senses.usage_zomi: Volunteer pen ama ut thu-in huhna pia mi ahi hi. A zatkhiat sum ngahkik thei napi, a tawntung thaman ngah ngeilo hi.

senses.heading: A formal choice in an election or decision
senses.definition_en: A formal choice made by a person in an election or when a group makes a decision.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teelna ahih kei leh pawl khat khensatna ah mi khat in thukip takin a teelna ahi hi.

examples.english: Each member has one vote.
examples.zomi: Pawlmi khat ciang teelna aw khat nei hi.

examples.english: She won the election by only ten votes.
examples.zomi: Ama teelna aw sawm bek a tamzaw in teelna ah gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: Vote is countable when it means one person’s formal choice: “one vote,” “two votes.”
senses.usage_zomi: Mi khat teelna khensatna khat kawk ciangin vote simtheih min ahi hi: “one vote,” “two votes” ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: The act or process of voting
senses.definition_en: The act or organized process of making a decision by voting.
senses.explanation_zomi: Teelna aw piak tawh khensatna bawl nasepzia ahi hi.

examples.english: The committee will hold a vote tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Committee in zing ciangin teelna bawl ding hi.

examples.english: The proposal was approved after a public vote.
examples.zomi: Mipite teelna khit ciangin geelna kipom hi.

senses.usage_en: Vote can mean either an individual choice or the whole voting process. The context shows which meaning is intended.
senses.usage_zomi: Vote in mi khat teelna khensatna ahih kei leh teelna nasepzia pumbup kawk thei hi. A kizangna thu in a khiatna lak hi.

senses.definition_en: Money paid regularly to a worker, especially according to the number of hours or days worked.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasem mi khat tungah a nasep nai zah ahih kei leh a nasep ni zah dungzui-in kipia sum ahi hi.

examples.english: The company pays its workers a fair wage.
examples.zomi: Company in a nasem mite tungah a kilawm nasep thaman pia hi.

examples.english: Her hourly wage increased last month.
examples.zomi: Kha beisa in ama nai khat nasep thaman khang hi.

senses.usage_en: A wage is commonly calculated by the hour, day or week. A salary is usually a fixed amount paid monthly or yearly.
senses.usage_zomi: Wage pen nasep nai, ni ahih kei leh kal dungzui-in kisim zel hi. Salary ahih leh kha sim ahih kei leh kum simin kipia thaman kikhol khat ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To stay where you are or delay an action until someone arrives or something happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat hong tun ahih kei leh thu khat hong pian dong tua munah om, ahih kei leh nasep khat kipan nailo in ngak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please wait here until I return.
examples.zomi: Ka hong kik dong hiteng ah hong ngak in.

examples.english: We waited for the bus for thirty minutes.
examples.zomi: Bus pen minute sawmthum sung ngak ung.

senses.usage_en: Use wait for before a person or thing: “wait for the bus.” Do not normally say “wait the bus.”
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat ngakna ah wait for kizang hi: “wait for the bus.” “Wait the bus” ci in kizang ngeilo hi.

senses.definition_en: A man whose job is to serve food and drinks to customers in a restaurant.
senses.zomi_equivalents: annekna muna nasem pasal; an-le-tui hong pia mi
senses.explanation_zomi: Annekna munah nasem in, nek leh dawn ding customer te tungah hong pia pasal ahi hi.

examples.english: The waiter brought us the menu.
examples.zomi: Waiter in menu hong paipih hi.

examples.english: We asked the waiter for more water.
examples.zomi: Waiter tungah tui hong behlap ding ngen ung.

senses.usage_en: Waiter traditionally refers to a man. Server is a common gender-neutral term for someone who serves food and drinks.
senses.usage_zomi: Waiter pen pasal nasem mi genna ahi hi. Server ahih leh nek leh dawn ding hong pia pasal leh numei a vekpi kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: To stop sleeping
senses.definition_en: To stop sleeping and become conscious.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ihmutna pan khanglo in lungsim thei in omkik cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I usually wake at six in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingkal nai guk ciangin khanglo ngei ing.

examples.english: She woke suddenly when she heard the noise.
examples.zomi: Aw a zak ciangin thakhat in khanglo hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense of wake is woke, and its past participle is woken.
senses.usage_zomi: Wake a beisa hun pen woke ahi a, a past participle pen woken ahi hi.

senses.heading: To make someone stop sleeping
senses.definition_en: To cause someone to stop sleeping.
senses.zomi_equivalents: khanglo sak; ihmutna pan tho sak
senses.explanation_zomi: Ihmu mi khat khanglo sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please wake me at seven.
examples.zomi: Nai sagih ciangin kei hong khanglo sak in.

examples.english: The loud music woke the baby.
examples.zomi: La aw ngaih in naupang khanglo sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Wake up is very common for both senses. When an object is used, it may come between the words: “wake me up.”
senses.usage_zomi: Khiatna nihgel ading wake up kizang thei hi. Object a om ciangin kikal ah koih thei hi: “wake me up.”

senses.definition_en: To move forward on foot, placing one foot in front of the other.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe tawh pai in, khe khat khit khe khat suan cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We walk to work when the weather is good.
examples.zomi: Nilo hoih ciangin nasepna dong khe tawh pai ung.

examples.english: The child is learning to walk.
examples.zomi: Naupang in khe tawh paina sin hi.

senses.usage_en: Walk describes movement on foot at a normal speed. Use go for a walk when walking is the activity itself.
senses.usage_zomi: Walk pen khe tawh manlanglua loin paina gen hi. Khe tawh paikualna bek gen dingin go for a walk kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: A solid upright structure that forms the side of a building or separates one area from another.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn khat a gei khenna ahih kei leh mun khat leh mun khat khenna dingin a dingin kibawl bang ahi hi.

examples.english: She hung the picture on the wall.
examples.zomi: Ama in lim pen bang tungah khai hi.

examples.english: A high wall surrounds the garden.
examples.zomi: Bang sang khat in huan kimkot hi.

senses.usage_en: A wall is usually solid and permanent. A fence is often lighter and may be made of wood, wire or metal.
senses.usage_zomi: Wall pen a kiptak leh tawntung om dingin kibawl bang ahi zel hi. Fence ahih leh sing, thirkuang ahih kei leh thir tawh kibawl, a zangzaw khenna ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: To desire something
senses.definition_en: To wish to have, do or experience something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat nei, bawl ahih kei leh thu khat thuak nuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I want a glass of water.
examples.zomi: Tui hai khat deih ing.

examples.english: They want to study at university.
examples.zomi: University ah sinna nei nuam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use want to before a verb: “I want to go.” Do not say “I want go.”
senses.usage_zomi: Verb khat mai ah want to kizang hi: “I want to go.” “I want go” ci in zang kei in.

senses.heading: To need someone or something
senses.definition_en: To need someone or something for a particular purpose.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna khat ading mi ahih kei leh van khat kisam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This job wants careful planning.
examples.zomi: Hih nasep in geelna pilvan kisam hi.

examples.english: The manager wants you in her office.
examples.zomi: Manager in a office ah nang hong om ding deih hi.

senses.usage_en: In formal contexts, want can mean “need,” but need is often clearer.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu kician takin kigelhna ah want in “kisam” cihna nei thei napi, need a kizang ciangin kicianzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: Organized armed fighting between countries or groups.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam nih ahih kei leh mipawl nih kikal ah galhiam tawh kigawmkhawm in kidouna ahi hi.

examples.english: Thousands of families fled during the war.
examples.zomi: Kidouna sungin innkuan tul tampi tai uh hi.

examples.english: The two countries are trying to avoid war.
examples.zomi: Gam nihte in kidouna pelh ding hanciam uh hi.

senses.usage_en: War can be countable when referring to a particular conflict, but it is often uncountable in general expressions such as “at war.”
senses.usage_zomi: Kidouna tuam khat gen ciangin war simtheih min ahi thei hi. “At war” bang thuah kidouna omzia a gen ciangin simtheih loh min bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: Having a pleasantly high temperature
senses.definition_en: Having a temperature that is comfortably high but not hot.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lumlua loin nuam takin a lum cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Wash your hands with warm water.
examples.zomi: Tui lum tawh na khut sil in.

examples.english: The room is warm and comfortable.
examples.zomi: Innkhaan a lum a, nuam hi.

senses.usage_en: Warm is less hot than hot. It often suggests a comfortable temperature.
senses.usage_zomi: Warm pen hot sangin a lum zawlo hi. Nuam takin a lum cihna tawh kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: Friendly and affectionate
senses.definition_en: Friendly, kind and showing affection.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tungah itna, dikna leh lungdamna tawh kihel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The family gave us a warm welcome.
examples.zomi: Innkuan in lungdam takin hong nawl uh hi.

examples.english: She greeted the visitors with a warm smile.
examples.zomi: Ama in itna nei nuihna tawh khovak te paupih hi.

senses.usage_en: When warm describes a welcome, smile or relationship, it refers to friendliness rather than temperature.
senses.usage_zomi: Warm in nawlna, nuihna ahih kei leh kizopna a gen ciangin lum-le-kho cihna hilo a, lungdamna leh itna cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: To tell someone about a possible danger or problem so that the person can avoid it or prepare for it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in lauhuaina ahih kei leh buaina hong omthei cih thei khol in pelh ahih kei leh kigingsa theih nadingin hilh cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: warn someone not to do something
common_phrases.zomi: na khat bawl lo ding hilhkhol

examples.english: The police warned drivers about the icy road.
examples.zomi: Police te in lampi khua a om manin mawtaw hawlte hilhkhol uh hi.

examples.english: I warned him not to touch the wire.
examples.zomi: Thirkuang lawng lo dingin amah hilhkhol ing.

senses.usage_en: Common patterns are warn someone about something and warn someone not to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Kizang ngeina pen warn someone about something leh warn someone not to do something ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A statement, sign or event that tells people about a possible danger or problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhuaina ahih kei leh buaina hong omthei cih mite theisak thu, lim ahih kei leh thupiang ahi hi.

examples.english: The warning sign tells drivers to slow down.
examples.zomi: Hilhkholhna lim in mawtaw hawlte dam takin hawl ding hilh hi.

examples.english: The storm arrived without warning.
examples.zomi: Hilhkholhna om loin huihpi hong tung hi.

senses.usage_en: A warning gives information before or as danger appears. Advice tells someone what may be best but does not necessarily involve danger.
senses.usage_zomi: Warning in lauhuaina hong omma ahih kei leh a hong pian laitakin thu theisak hi. Advice in hoih pen ding thu hilh napi, lauhuaina tawh kisai teitei lo hi.

senses.definition_en: To clean someone or something with water and usually soap.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui leh tamveipi sabon zangin mi ahih kei leh van khat siangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Wash your hands before eating.
examples.zomi: An nekma-in na khut sil in.

examples.english: He washed the car on Saturday.
examples.zomi: Saturday ni-in ama in mawtaw sil hi.

senses.usage_en: Use wash for cleaning with water. Use clean more generally for removing dirt or making a place tidy.
senses.usage_zomi: Tui tawh siangsakna ah wash kizang hi. Nin paikhiatna ahih kei leh mun khat siangthosakna khempeuh ading clean kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: The activity of cleaning something with water
senses.definition_en: The activity of cleaning clothes, dishes or other things with water.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan, kuang tawl ahih kei leh van dang tui tawh silna nasep ahi hi.

examples.english: Regular hand washing helps prevent disease.
examples.zomi: Khut a tawntungin silna in natna khaktan thei hi.

examples.english: This shirt needs careful washing.
examples.zomi: Hih puan pen pilvan takin sil kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Washing may refer to the activity itself or, especially in British English, to clothes waiting to be washed or recently washed.
senses.usage_zomi: Washing in silna nasep gen thei hi. British English ah sil ding ahih kei leh sil khitsa puan te zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Clothes that are being washed or need washing
senses.definition_en: Clothes that are being washed, have been washed or are waiting to be washed.
senses.zomi_equivalents: sil ding puan; sil khinsa puan
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisil lai, kisil khinsa ahih kei leh sil dingin kingak puan te ahi hi.

examples.english: I need to do the washing this evening.
examples.zomi: Tuni nitak puan sil kul ing.

examples.english: She hung the washing outside to dry.
examples.zomi: Puan te kang dingin polam ah khai hi.

senses.usage_en: This clothing sense is especially common in British English. American English often uses laundry.
senses.usage_zomi: Puan kawkna hih khiatna pen British English ah kizang mahmah hi. American English ah laundry kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Unnecessary use of something valuable
senses.definition_en: The use of time, money, energy or materials without a useful result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, sum, tha ahih kei leh zat dingte phattuamna om loin a mawkna-in zatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Waiting there all day was a waste of time.
examples.zomi: Ni khat sung tua ah ngakna pen hun mawk zatna ahi hi.

examples.english: Buying food that nobody eats is a waste of money.
examples.zomi: Kuamah in a nek loh an lei pen sum mawk zatna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The pattern a waste of is followed by a noun: a waste of time, money or energy.
senses.usage_zomi: A waste of nungah min kizang hi: a waste of time, money ahih kei leh energy.

senses.heading: Unwanted material
senses.definition_en: Material that is no longer wanted or useful and is thrown away.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kisam nawnlo ahih kei leh phattuam nawnlo ahih manin kilawnkhia vante ahi hi.

examples.english: The factory must dispose of its waste safely.
examples.zomi: Factory in a nawnte bit takin paih ding ahi hi.

examples.english: We separate food waste from plastic.
examples.zomi: An nawn leh plastic te khen ung.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, waste is normally uncountable. Different kinds may be called types of waste.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah waste pen simtheih loh min ahi hi. Nam tuamtuam gen dingin types of waste ci thei hi.

senses.heading: To look at something for a period of time
senses.definition_en: To look at someone or something carefully or for a period of time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat pilvan takin ahih kei leh hun tomkhat sung en cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We watched a film after dinner.
examples.zomi: Nitak an nek khit ciangin film en ung.

examples.english: Watch carefully while I show you how to do it.
examples.zomi: A bawldan ka hong lak laitakin pilvan takin en in.

senses.usage_en: Use watch for something continuing or changing, such as a film or a game. Use look at for directing your eyes toward something.
senses.usage_zomi: Film ahih kei leh kimawlna bang kizom paisuak na enna ah watch kizang hi. Na khat lamah mit tunsakna bek ading look at kizang hi.

senses.heading: To take care of or guard someone or something
senses.definition_en: To stay with someone or something in order to care for, guard or observe them.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat kem, cing ahih kei leh ettuap dingin a kiangah om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you watch the children for an hour?
examples.zomi: Naupang te nai khat sung hong kemthei ding nahi hiam?

examples.english: The guard watched the entrance all night.
examples.zomi: Cingmi in zan khat sung lutna kong cing hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, watch may mean protecting someone, supervising them or observing what they do.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah watch in mi khat kepna, a nasep ettuapna ahih kei leh a gamtatna enna kawk thei hi.

senses.definition_en: The clear liquid that falls as rain and is necessary for people, animals and plants to live.
senses.explanation_zomi: Guah bangin a kia, mihing, ganhing leh singkung te nuntakna dingin kisam a siangh limlim tui ahi hi.

examples.english: Everyone needs clean water to stay healthy.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in cidam nading tui siangtho kisam hi.

examples.english: Please give the plants some water.
examples.zomi: Singkung te tui tawm pia in.

senses.usage_en: Water is normally uncountable. Say “some water” or “a glass of water,” not normally “a water.”
senses.usage_zomi: Water pen simtheih loh min ahi hi. “A water” ci loin “some water” ahih kei leh “a glass of water” ci ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: A raised movement of water
senses.definition_en: A moving ridge of water on the surface of the sea, a lake or another body of water.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuipi, dil ahih kei leh tui zaang tungah a kiciangin a khang leh a kikhia tui kilawnna ahi hi.

examples.english: Large waves struck the boat.
examples.zomi: Tuihual liante in tembaw suk hi.

examples.english: The children played in the waves.
examples.zomi: Naupang te tuihual sungah kimawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: A wave moves across the surface of water, but the water itself does not necessarily travel the same distance.
senses.usage_zomi: Wave pen tui zaang tungah kalsuan napi, tui pumbup in tua gamla zah pai teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: A movement of the hand as a signal or greeting
senses.definition_en: A movement of the hand from side to side as a greeting, farewell or signal.
senses.explanation_zomi: Paupihna, mangpha cihna ahih kei leh lim piakna dingin khut zak in a langkhat pan a langkhat lamah kiliingna ahi hi.

examples.english: She gave us a friendly wave.
examples.zomi: Ama in lungdam takin khut hong zak hi.

examples.english: With a final wave, he boarded the train.
examples.zomi: A nunung pen khut a zak khit ciangin train tung hi.

senses.usage_en: The noun is a wave. The corresponding verb is wave: “She waved goodbye.”
senses.usage_zomi: Min a hihna pen a wave ahi hi. A kibang verb pen wave ahi a: “She waved goodbye” ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: A method or manner of doing something
senses.definition_en: A particular method, style or manner of doing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bawl nading lampi, nasepzia ahih kei leh gamtatdan ahi hi.

examples.english: This is the easiest way to solve the problem.
examples.zomi: Hih pen buaina veng nading bawldan baih pen ahi hi.

examples.english: Everyone has a different way of learning.
examples.zomi: Mi khempeuh in sinna dan tuamkhat ciat nei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use way of doing something or way to do something. Both patterns are common.
senses.usage_zomi: Way of doing something ahih kei leh way to do something kizang thei hi. A nihgel in kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: A route or direction
senses.definition_en: A route, road or direction used to reach a place.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat tun nading lampi ahih kei leh paina ding lam ahi hi.

examples.english: Can you show me the way to the station?
examples.zomi: Station tun nading lampi hong lakthei ding nahi hiam?

examples.english: We lost our way in the forest.
examples.zomi: Gam sungah lampi mang ung.

senses.usage_en: Ask Which way? when choosing a direction. Ask How? when asking about a method.
senses.usage_zomi: Paina lam teelna dingin Which way? ci in dong in. Bawldan dotna dingin How? ci in dong in.

senses.heading: A distance or position
senses.definition_en: A distance between places or a particular position along a route.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun nih kikal gamla zah ahih kei leh lampi tunga mun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The hospital is a long way from here.
examples.zomi: Hospital pen hiteng pan gamla mahmah hi.

examples.english: We stopped halfway up the hill.
examples.zomi: Mual kahto lampi langkhat ah tawlnga ung.

senses.usage_en: Way appears in many fixed expressions, so its exact meaning depends strongly on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Way pen kammal kip tawh kizang tampi ahih manin, a khiatna pen a kimkot thu dungzui hi.

senses.definition_en: Used by a speaker to refer to the speaker together with one or more other people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu genpa in amah leh mi dang khat ahih kei leh tamzaw a kigawm in a genna pronoun ahi hi.

examples.english: We are working on the same project.
examples.zomi: Eite in project khat mah semkhawm i hi.

examples.english: We will visit them tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing ciangin amaute va hawh ding ung.

senses.usage_en: Standard Zomi distinguishes inclusive eite—including the listener—from exclusive kote—excluding the listener. English we can express either meaning.
senses.usage_zomi: Standard Zomi ah eite in thu ngai mi zong kihel a, kote in thu ngai mi kihel lo hi. English we in tua khiatna nihgel nei thei hi.

senses.heading: Lacking physical strength
senses.definition_en: Not physically strong or powerful.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tha nei tawm ahih kei leh thahat lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She felt weak after the illness.
examples.zomi: Natna khit ciangin ama thanem kisa hi.

examples.english: The patient was too weak to stand.
examples.zomi: Cina mi dingtheilo zahin thanem hi.

senses.usage_en: Weak can describe temporary loss of strength or a continuing lack of strength.
senses.usage_zomi: Weak in hun tomkhat sung tha neilo ahihna ahih kei leh a tawntungin thanemna gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Not effective, convincing or well supported
senses.definition_en: Not effective, convincing or strong enough to succeed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phattuam zolo, uphuai zolo ahih kei leh gualzo ding zahin thahat lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The evidence against him was weak.
examples.zomi: Ama tungah a kipia teci kicinglo hi.

examples.english: That is a weak argument.
examples.zomi: Tua pen thu kipsakna thanem ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, weak describes poor quality or insufficient support, not physical strength.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah weak in pumpi tha gen lo a, hoih kicinglo ahih kei leh panpihna kicinglo cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Lack of strength
senses.definition_en: The condition of not having enough physical strength.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tha kicing nei lo ahihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The illness caused weakness in his legs.
examples.zomi: Natna in ama khete thanem sak hi.

examples.english: Tell the doctor if the weakness continues.
examples.zomi: Thanemna a zom paisuak leh siavuan hilh in.

senses.usage_en: Physical weakness may be a symptom of illness, hunger or tiredness.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi weakness pen natna, gilkialna ahih kei leh tawlna lim khat ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: A fault or area in which someone or something is not strong
senses.definition_en: A fault or an area in which a person, plan or system is not effective.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi, geelna ahih kei leh kizopna khat a thahat lohna, kicing lohna ahih kei leh a hoihlo lang ahi hi.

examples.english: The report identifies several weaknesses in the system.
examples.zomi: Report in system sunga thanemna pawlkhat lak hi.

examples.english: We all have strengths and weaknesses.
examples.zomi: Eite khempeuh in thahatna leh thanemna nei ciat i hi.

senses.usage_en: A weakness may be a personal fault, a missing skill or a problem in a plan or system.
senses.usage_zomi: Weakness pen mikhat gamtatna hoihlo, siamlohna ahih kei leh geelna leh system sunga buaina ahi thei hi.

senses.heading: A large amount of money and valuable property
senses.definition_en: A large amount of money, property and other valuable possessions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, neihlelam leh manpha van tampi nei ahihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The family gained its wealth through business.
examples.zomi: Tua innkuan in sumkawlna tungtawnin hauhna ngah hi.

examples.english: Wealth does not always bring happiness.
examples.zomi: Hauhna in lungdamna hong tun tawntung lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Wealth is normally uncountable. A person who has great wealth is wealthy.
senses.usage_zomi: Wealth pen simtheih loh min ahi hi. Hauhna tampi nei mi pen wealthy kici hi.

senses.heading: A large amount of something useful or valuable
senses.definition_en: A large and valuable supply of information, knowledge or experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, theihna ahih kei leh phutkhak manpha tampi a omna ahi hi.

examples.english: The book contains a wealth of useful information.
examples.zomi: Tua laibu sungah phattuam thu tampi om hi.

examples.english: She brings a wealth of experience to the team.
examples.zomi: Ama in team ading phutkhak manpha tampi hong paipih hi.

senses.usage_en: The expression a wealth of means “a large and valuable amount of.”
senses.usage_zomi: A wealth of cih kammal in “manpha tak leh tampi” cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Having a large amount of money, property or valuable possessions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum, neihlelam ahih kei leh manpha van tampi nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She grew up in a wealthy family.
examples.zomi: Ama innkuan hau sungah khang hi.

examples.english: The area attracts wealthy visitors.
examples.zomi: Tua mun in khovak hau te hip hi.

senses.usage_en: Wealthy is stronger and often more formal than rich. Both describe having a great deal of money or property.
senses.usage_zomi: Wealthy leh rich in sum leh neihlelam tampi nei cihna kibang hi. Wealthy pen thahat zaw leh thukip taka kigelhna ah kizangzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: An object designed or used to injure, kill or defeat someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi liamsak, that ahih kei leh galzo nadingin kibawl ahih kei leh kizang van ahi hi.

examples.english: The police found a weapon in the car.
examples.zomi: Police te in mawtaw sungah galhiam khat mu uh hi.

examples.english: He was arrested for carrying a dangerous weapon.
examples.zomi: Galhiam lauhuai a ken manin kiman hi.

senses.usage_en: Weapon is a general term. A gun, knife or bomb can be a weapon when used or intended to cause harm.
senses.usage_zomi: Weapon pen galhiam khempeuh ading kammal ahi hi. Gun, tem ahih kei leh bomb in mi liamsak nading kizang ahih leh galhiam ahi hi.

senses.heading: To have clothes, jewellery or another item on your body
senses.definition_en: To have clothes, shoes, jewellery or another item on your body.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan, khedap, zeenna ahih kei leh van dang khat pumpi tungah silh ahih kei leh but cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore a blue dress to the wedding.
examples.zomi: Kiteenna ah puan dum silh hi.

examples.english: You must wear a helmet on the motorcycle.
examples.zomi: Motorcycle tungah lukhu bitna but teitei ding nahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense of wear is wore, and the past participle is worn. Use put on for the action of dressing and wear for the resulting state.
senses.usage_zomi: Wear a beisa hun pen wore ahi a, a past participle pen worn ahi hi. Puan silh kipatna ading put on zang inla, silhsa in omna ading wear zang in.

senses.heading: To become damaged through regular use
senses.definition_en: To become thinner, weaker or damaged as a result of continued use.
senses.explanation_zomi: A tawntungin kizang ahih manin a pan, a thanem ahih kei leh a kisiat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The carpet is beginning to wear near the door.
examples.zomi: Kongkhak kianga carpet pen zangin a sia kipan hi.

examples.english: These shoes wear well.
examples.zomi: Hih khedapte hun sau tak kizangthei hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense often appears with particles: wear out means becoming unusable, and wear away means gradually disappearing through use or rubbing.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna pen particle tawh kizang zel hi. Wear out in kizangthei nawnlo dingin sia cihna ahi a, wear away in kizang ahih kei leh kinai manin tawm tawm in mang cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The condition of the air and sky at a particular place and time, including temperature, rain, wind and sunshine.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun khat leh hun khat a huih, van, lum-le-kho, guah, huih nung leh nisa dinmun ahi hi.

examples.english: The weather will be warm and sunny tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing ciangin khuahun a lum a, nisa ding hi.

examples.english: Bad weather delayed the flight.
examples.zomi: Khuahun hoihlo in vanleng khualzinna sawlkha hi.

senses.usage_en: Weather is uncountable. Do not normally say “a weather.” Climate describes usual weather patterns over a long period.
senses.usage_zomi: Weather pen simtheih loh min ahi hi. “A weather” ci in kizang ngeilo hi. Climate in mun khat a hun sau sung khuahun ngeina gen hi.

senses.heading: A net made by a spider
senses.definition_en: A structure of thin threads made by a spider to catch insects.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pheek in huihsek te mat nadingin a bawl khau neu kigawm ahi hi.

examples.english: A spider built a web in the corner.
examples.zomi: Pheek khat in innkiu ah len siam hi.

examples.english: A fly was caught in the web.
examples.zomi: Huihsek khat pheek lenah kimang hi.

senses.usage_en: Web by itself may mean a spider’s web. Cobweb often refers to an old, dusty spider’s web.
senses.usage_zomi: Web in pheek len kawk thei hi. Cobweb ahih leh pheek len lui leh leivui kai kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: The World Wide Web
senses.definition_en: The system of connected pages and information that people use through the internet.
senses.explanation_zomi: Internet tungtawnin kizang, page leh thu tuamtuam kizomkhawmna system ahi hi.

examples.english: You can find the information on the web.
examples.zomi: Tua thu web tungah zongthei nahi hi.

examples.english: The company provides services through the web.
examples.zomi: Company in web tungtawnin nasepna pia hi.

senses.usage_en: The web is one service that uses the internet. The internet also supports email, file transfer and other services.
senses.usage_zomi: Web pen internet zang nasepna nam khat ahi hi. Internet in email, file kisuahkhawmna leh nasepna dangte zong panpih hi.

senses.definition_en: A collection of connected pages on the internet that belong to a person, organization or business.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat, kipawlna ahih kei leh sumkawlna khat in internet tungah a neih, web page kizomkhawm pawl ahi hi.

examples.english: More information is available on our website.
examples.zomi: Ka website uh tungah thu kicingzaw om hi.

examples.english: The school launched a new website.
examples.zomi: Sanginn in website thak khat kipan hi.

senses.usage_en: A website is the whole collection of pages. A web page is one individual page within a website.
senses.usage_zomi: Website pen web lai kizomkhawm pumbup ahi hi. Web page ahih leh website sunga lai khat ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A ceremony in which two people get married.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi nih zi-le-pasal ahihna uh thukip takin kipulaak in kiteenna bawlna ahi hi.

examples.english: Their wedding will take place in June.
examples.zomi: Amaute kiteenna June kha-in om ding hi.

examples.english: We attended our friend’s wedding last Saturday.
examples.zomi: Saturday beisa in i lawm kiteenna pawi ah pai ung.

senses.usage_en: A wedding is the ceremony or celebration. A marriage is the relationship or legal state that begins through marriage.
senses.usage_zomi: Wedding pen kiteenna kikhopna ahih kei leh pawi ahi hi. Marriage ahih leh kiteenna pan kipan zi-le-pasal kizopna ahih kei leh thukip dinmun ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: The day of the week after Tuesday and before Thursday.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuesday khit leh Thursday ma-a om kal sung ni ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting is on Wednesday afternoon.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna Wednesday sun nun ciangin om ding hi.

examples.english: I have a doctor’s appointment next Wednesday.
examples.zomi: Wednesday hong tung dingin siavuan mu ding hun sehsa nei ing.

senses.usage_en: Wednesday is written with a d, but in normal speech the d is silent.
senses.usage_zomi: Wednesday kammal sungah d kigelh napi, pau ciangin d aw kisuah lo hi.

senses.definition_en: A period of seven days.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ni sagih huam hun khat ahi hi.

examples.english: I work five days a week.
examples.zomi: Kal khat sung ni nga nasem ing.

examples.english: The package should arrive next week.
examples.zomi: Package pen kal hong tung ciangin hong tung ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Use this week, next week and last week without in or on.
senses.usage_zomi: This week, next week leh last week mai ah in ahih kei leh on koih kul lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Saturday and Sunday, or the period at the end of the working week.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep kal tawp, a tamzaw-in Saturday leh Sunday ni nih ahi hi.

examples.english: We usually visit our parents at the weekend.
examples.zomi: Kal tawp ciangin i nu-le-pate va hawh ngei ung.

examples.english: They are planning a weekend trip to the mountains.
examples.zomi: Amaute mual lamah kal tawp khualzinna geel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses at the weekend. American English normally uses on the weekend.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah at the weekend kizang mahmah a, American English ah on the weekend kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: To measure how heavy someone or something is
senses.definition_en: To measure the weight of a person or object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat a gik-le-zang zah teh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The nurse weighed the baby.
examples.zomi: Nurse in naupang gihna teh hi.

examples.english: Please weigh the package before sending it.
examples.zomi: Package a sawlma-in a gihna teh in.

senses.usage_en: Weigh is the verb; weight is the noun. Say “How much does it weigh?” rather than “How much is its weigh?”
senses.usage_zomi: Weigh pen verb ahi a, weight pen min ahi hi. “How much is its weigh?” ci loin “How much does it weigh?” ci ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: To have a particular weight
senses.definition_en: To have a particular heaviness when measured.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kiteh ciangin gikzah nam khat nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The bag weighs about twenty kilograms.
examples.zomi: Tua sakhau kilogram sawmnih bang gik hi.

examples.english: This box weighs less than the other one.
examples.zomi: Hih kuang pen kuang dang sangin zangzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, weigh is not normally used in the continuous form. Say “The box weighs ten kilograms,” not “is weighing.”
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah weigh pen continuous form tawh kizang ngeilo hi. “The box is weighing ten kilograms” ci loin “The box weighs ten kilograms” ci ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: How heavy someone or something is
senses.definition_en: The measurement of how heavy a person or object is.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat a gik-le-zang zah tehna ahi hi.

examples.english: Exercise can help you control your weight.
examples.zomi: Pumpi kisinsakna in na pumpi gihna uk ding hong huh thei hi.

examples.english: The doctor recorded the child’s weight.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in naupang gikzah ciamteh hi.

senses.usage_en: Say lose weight and gain weight without a. Weight is normally uncountable when referring to body heaviness.
senses.usage_zomi: Pumpi gihna gen ciangin lose weight leh gain weight ci a, a koih kul lo hi. Weight pen simtheih loh min bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: A heavy object used for exercise or measurement
senses.definition_en: A heavy object used in exercise, weighing or holding something in position.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi tha khangsakna, gihna tehna ahih kei leh van khat a munah om sakna dingin kizang van gik ahi hi.

examples.english: He lifts weights at the gym.
examples.zomi: Gym ah pumpi kisinsakna van gik te dom hi.

examples.english: Use a weight to hold the paper down.
examples.zomi: Lai a kiliing loh nadingin van gik khat tungah koih in.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, weight is countable: a weight, several weights.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah weight simtheih min ahi hi: a weight, several weights ci in kizang hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to greet someone warmly when the person arrives.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hong pai dam in; lungdam takin kong nawl uh hi
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat hong tun ciangin lungdam taka nawlna dingin kizang kammal ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: ka sanginn uh ah hong pai dam in

examples.english: Welcome to our community!
examples.zomi: Ka khuami kipawlna uh ah hong pai dam in!

examples.english: Welcome back! We missed you.
examples.zomi: Hong ciahkik dam in! Kong phawk mahmah uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Welcome! greets someone arriving. You’re welcome is a different expression used after someone says “thank you.”
senses.usage_zomi: Welcome! pen mi khat hong tun cianga nawlna ahi hi. You’re welcome ahih leh mi khat in “thank you” a cih khit cianga dawnkikna ahi hi.

senses.heading: In a good, successful or satisfactory way
senses.definition_en: In a way that is good, successful or satisfactory.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoih takin, gualzawhna tawh ahih kei leh lungkimhuai takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She speaks English very well.
examples.zomi: Ama English hoih mahmah in pau hi.

examples.english: The new system works well.
examples.zomi: System thak in hoih takin nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Well is usually the adverb corresponding to the adjective good: “a good singer” but “She sings well.”
senses.usage_zomi: Well pen adjective good tawh kizom adverb ahi hi: “a good singer” kici a, “She sings well” kici hi.

senses.heading: Thoroughly or completely
senses.definition_en: Thoroughly, carefully or to a great degree.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kicing takin, pilvan takin ahih kei leh nasa takin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The students were well prepared for the exam.
examples.zomi: Sangnaupang te exam ading kiging kicing uh hi.

examples.english: This writer is well known in our community.
examples.zomi: Hih laigelhpa ka khuami kikal ah kim theih mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: Well commonly comes before a past participle to form expressions such as well known, well prepared and well organized.
senses.usage_zomi: Well pen past participle mai ah kizang in well known, well prepared leh well organized bang kammal kizomte bawl hi.

senses.definition_en: The direction where the sun appears to go down.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nisa a tumna lam ahi hi.

examples.english: The sun sets in the west.
examples.zomi: Nisa nitumna lamah tum hi.

examples.english: Dark clouds were moving in from the west.
examples.zomi: Mei dumte nitumna lam pan hong pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Write the west for the direction or region. Capitalize the West when referring to Western countries or culture as a group.
senses.usage_zomi: Paina lam ahih kei leh gamkai khat gen dingin the west kigelh hi. Western gamte ahih kei leh ngeinate pawlkhat a gen ciangin the West ci in lai mal lian tawh kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Located in or directed toward the west
senses.definition_en: Located in, coming from or facing the west.
senses.zomi_equivalents: nitumna lama om; nitumna lam tawh kisai
senses.explanation_zomi: Nitumna lamah om, nitumna lam pan hong pai ahih kei leh nitumna lam nga cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Most of the rain fell in the western region.
examples.zomi: Guah a tamzaw nitumna gamkai ah zu hi.

examples.english: The house has a western entrance.
examples.zomi: Inn in nitumna lamah lutna kong nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this geographical sense, western is normally written with a lowercase w.
senses.usage_zomi: Gam omna lam a gen hih khiatna ah western pen lai mal neu w tawh kigelh hi.

senses.heading: Connected with Europe, North America or their cultures
senses.definition_en: Connected with the countries, societies or cultures of Europe and North America.
senses.zomi_equivalents: Western gam tawh kisai; nitumna gam ngeina
