senses.explanation_zomi: Europe leh North America gamte, mipawlna-te ahih kei leh ngeina-te tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The course examines Western philosophy.
examples.zomi: Tua course in Western philosophy kencian hi.

examples.english: Western music has influenced many local artists.
examples.zomi: Western la in khuami lasiam tampi sukha hi.

senses.usage_en: Capitalize Western when it refers broadly to Western countries, societies or culture.
senses.usage_zomi: Western gamte, mipawlna-te ahih kei leh ngeina-te a gen ciangin Western pen lai mal lian W tawh kigelh hi.

senses.definition_en: Covered or filled with water or another liquid.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tui ahih kei leh tui bang zat khat in a buaah ahih kei leh a dim cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: My clothes got wet in the rain.
examples.zomi: Guah sungah ka puan te buaah hi.

examples.english: Be careful—the floor is wet.
examples.zomi: Pilvan in—innphah a buaah hi.

senses.usage_en: Wet describes something containing or covered with liquid. Damp means slightly wet.
senses.usage_zomi: Wet in tui ahih kei leh tui bang zat tawh a buaah na gen hi. Damp in tawmno bek buaah cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Used to ask for information about someone or something
senses.definition_en: Used in a question to ask for the identity, nature or description of something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bang ahi hiam, bangci dan ahi hiam cih dotna ah kizang pronoun ahi hi.

examples.english: What happened after the meeting?
examples.zomi: Kikhopna khit ciangin bang piang hiam?

examples.english: What do you want for dinner?
examples.zomi: Nitak an ding bang na deih hiam?

senses.usage_en: What asks for open information. Which normally asks someone to choose from a limited group.
senses.usage_zomi: What in dawnna zaizaw nei dotna bawl hi. Which ahih leh a kicingin kibawlkhinsa pawl sung pan teel dingin kidong hi.

senses.heading: The thing or things that
senses.definition_en: The thing or things that someone says, does, needs or knows.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a gen, a bawl, a kisap ahih kei leh a theih na kawkna ahi hi.

examples.english: I understand what you mean.
examples.zomi: Na cihnop ka thei hi.

examples.english: Take what you need.
examples.zomi: Na kisap la in.

senses.usage_en: In this structure, what means “the thing that.” Do not add another noun immediately after it.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kizopna ah what in “a na” cihna ahi hi. A nungah min dang khat langsungin koih kul lo hi.

senses.heading: Any thing or amount that
senses.definition_en: Any thing, choice or amount, without restriction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhaktan lo in bang na, teelna ahih kei leh zat hizongleh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Choose whatever colour you like.
examples.zomi: Na deih bang color teel in.

examples.english: Take whatever help you need.
examples.zomi: Na kisap zah huhna la in.

senses.usage_en: As a determiner, whatever comes before a noun: whatever reason, whatever method.
senses.usage_zomi: Determiner a hihna ah whatever pen min mai ah om hi: whatever reason, whatever method ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Used to emphasize surprise or uncertainty
senses.definition_en: Used in questions to add emphasis, especially when the speaker is surprised or confused.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu dotna ah lamdang kisa ahih kei leh telcian lohna thahat zawin lak nadingin kizang hi.

common_phrases.zomi: bang in tua hong bawlsak hiam?

examples.english: Whatever made you change your mind?
examples.zomi: Bang in na ngaihsutna hong khel sak hiam?

examples.english: Whatever happened to the missing file?
examples.zomi: A mang file pen bangtak piang hiam?

senses.usage_en: This emphatic use is common in questions but may sound emotional or surprised.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih thahatsakna pen dotna ah kizang mahmah a, lungsim sukna ahih kei leh lamdang sakna aw tawh gingthei hi.

senses.definition_en: A round object that turns around a central point and helps a vehicle or machine move.
senses.explanation_zomi: A laizang kimpanin a kihei thei, mawtaw ahih kei leh machine khangthei sak nateek ahi hi.

examples.english: The bicycle has two wheels.
examples.zomi: Bicycle in nateek nih nei hi.

examples.english: He held the steering wheel with both hands.
examples.zomi: Ama in mawtaw hei nading nateek khut nih tawh len hi.

senses.usage_en: Wheel is the whole round part. A tyre is the rubber covering fitted around a vehicle’s wheel.
senses.usage_zomi: Wheel pen nateek pumbup ahi hi. Tyre ahih leh mawtaw nateek kimah kizui rubber ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to ask at what time something happens or happened.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat bang hunin piang hiam cih dotna ah kizang adverb ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: cikciang hong pai ding nahi hiam?

examples.english: When does the meeting begin?
examples.zomi: Kikhopna cikciang kipan ding hiam?

examples.english: When did you arrive home?
examples.zomi: Cikciang inn hong tung nahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: In questions about future time, English normally uses will in the main question: “When will you come?”
senses.usage_zomi: Mailam hun thu dotna ah English in dotna sungah will zang hi: “When will you come?”

senses.heading: Every time that
senses.definition_en: Every time a particular event happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat a pian simin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Call me whenever you need help.
examples.zomi: Huhna na kisap simin kei hong sam in.

examples.english: The road floods whenever it rains heavily.
examples.zomi: Guah nasia taka a zu simin lampi tui dim hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, whenever means “every time that,” not merely “at one unknown time.”
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah whenever in “a pian simin” cihna ahi a, “theih loh hun khat ciangin” cihna bek hilo hi.

senses.heading: At any time that
senses.definition_en: At any time that is suitable or possible.
senses.zomi_equivalents: bang hun ciang hitaleh; hun na ngah ciang
senses.explanation_zomi: A kilawm ahih kei leh a hitheih bang hun ciang hizongleh cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: na kigingsak khit bang hun ciang hitaleh
na hong pai theih hun ciang hong pai

examples.english: You may leave whenever you are ready.
examples.zomi: Na kigingsak khit hun ciang paikhiat thei nahi hi.

examples.english: Visit us whenever you are in town.
examples.zomi: Khuapi ah na om hun ciang hong hawh in.

senses.usage_en: Whenever can offer freedom to choose a time: “Come whenever you like.”
senses.usage_zomi: Whenever in hun teel theihna pia thei hi: “Come whenever you like.”

senses.definition_en: Used to ask in or to what place someone or something is located or moving.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat bang munah om hiam, bang munah pai hiam cih dotna ah kizang adverb ahi hi.

examples.english: Where did you put my keys?
examples.zomi: Ka tawhpite khuah na koih hiam?

examples.english: Where are they going after work?
examples.zomi: Nasep khit ciangin amaute khuah pai ding uh hiam?

senses.usage_en: Where asks about place. Do not use where when asking only about time or reason.
senses.usage_zomi: Where in mun thu dong hi. Hun ahih kei leh hangthu bek dotna ah where zang kei in.

senses.definition_en: Used to contrast two facts, people or situations.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu, mi ahih kei leh dinmun nih a kibanglohna lak nadingin kizang conjunction ahi hi.

examples.english: My brother enjoys city life, whereas I prefer the countryside.
examples.zomi: Ka sanggampa khuapi nuntakna nuam sa a, kei ahihhang khuata lam deihzaw ing.

examples.english: This room is warm, whereas the other one is cold.
examples.zomi: Hih innkhaan a lum a, adang ahihhang a vot hi.

senses.usage_en: Whereas introduces a clear contrast. It is more formal than but and often joins two complete clauses.
senses.usage_zomi: Whereas in kibanglohna kician takin lak hi. But sangin thukip zaw a, sentence phel nih kizom sak zel hi.

senses.heading: In or to any place that
senses.definition_en: In or to any place, without restriction.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kikhaktan lo in bang mun ahih kei leh bang munah hizongleh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I will support you wherever you go.
examples.zomi: Na paina mun khempeuh ah kong panpih ding hi.

examples.english: Take this book wherever you travel.
examples.zomi: Na khualzinna mun khuapeuh ah hih laibu keng in.

senses.usage_en: Wherever may mean “in any place” or “in every place where.”
senses.usage_zomi: Wherever in “bang mun hitaleh” ahih kei leh “a omna mun khempeuh ah” cihna nei thei hi.

senses.heading: In every place where
senses.definition_en: In every place in which a particular condition exists.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a omna mun khempeuh ah; mun simah
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat a omna mun khempeuh ah cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: kisapna a omna mun khempeuh ah

examples.english: The organization works wherever help is needed.
examples.zomi: Huhna a kisapna mun khempeuh ah tua kipawlna nasem hi.

examples.english: Flowers appeared wherever the rain had fallen.
examples.zomi: Guah a zukna mun khempeuh ah pak te po hi.

senses.usage_en: This use connects a place with a repeated or general condition.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kizangna in mun khat leh tua muna a piang zel dinmun khat kizom sak hi.

senses.definition_en: Used when considering two possibilities or expressing uncertainty about which possibility is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hih hiam ahih kei leh tua hiam cih teeltheihna nih ngaihsutna, ahih kei leh a taktak bang ahi hiam cih kician lohna genna ah kizang hi.

common_phrases.zomi: om ding hiam paikhiat ding hiam

examples.english: I do not know whether he will come.
examples.zomi: Ama hong pai ding hiam cih ka thei lo hi.

examples.english: We must decide whether to accept the offer.
examples.zomi: Tua kipia thu sang ding hiam sang lo ding hiam khensat kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Use whether, not if, directly before or not in formal writing and before an infinitive: whether to go.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukip taka kigelhna ah or not mai leh infinitive mai ah if sangin whether kizang hi: whether to go.

senses.heading: Used to ask someone to choose or identify one from a limited group
senses.definition_en: Used in a question to ask which person or thing is intended from a known group.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kim theihsa pawl sung pan koi ahih kei leh bang pen hiam cih teel dingin dotna ah kizang pronoun ahi hi.

examples.english: Which is your bag?
examples.zomi: Koi pen na sakhau ahi hiam?

examples.english: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
examples.zomi: Tea leh coffee sung pan koi na deihzaw hiam?

senses.usage_en: Which asks for a choice from a limited or known set. What asks a more open question.
senses.usage_zomi: Which in kim theihsa ahih kei leh kikhaktan pawl sung pan teel dingin dong hi. What in dawnna zaizaw nei dotna bawl hi.

senses.heading: Used to add information about something already mentioned
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce a clause that gives more information about a thing already mentioned.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gen khinsa na khat tungtang thu behlapna sentence phel kipatna ah kizang hi.

examples.english: The bus was late, which caused a problem.
examples.zomi: Bus nungta a, tua in buaina piangsak hi.

examples.english: She showed me the book which won the award.
examples.zomi: Award ngah laibu pen ama in hong lak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use a comma before which when the clause adds nonessential information. Do not use a comma when the clause identifies the exact thing meant.
senses.usage_zomi: Which clause in kisam teitei lo thu behlap ahih leh a mai ah comma koih in. A gen na taktak a ciamteh ahih leh comma koih kei in.

senses.heading: During the time that
senses.definition_en: During the same period in which another action or event happens.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih kei leh thupiang dang khat a pian laitak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please be quiet while the baby is sleeping.
examples.zomi: Naupang a ihmut laitakin aw neucik in om in.

examples.english: I listened to music while I was cooking.
examples.zomi: An ka huan laitakin la ngai ing.

senses.usage_en: Use while for two actions or situations that happen during the same period.
senses.usage_zomi: Hun kibang sungah nasep ahih kei leh dinmun nih a omkhawmna gen dingin while kizang hi.

senses.heading: Although or in contrast with
senses.definition_en: Used to show a contrast between two facts or opinions.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu ahih kei leh ngaihsutna nih a kibanglohna lak nadingin kizang hi.

examples.english: While the plan is expensive, it may save money later.
examples.zomi: Geelna man tam napi, nung ciangin sum hawlkhiatna tawm sakthei hi.

examples.english: Some people agreed, while others opposed the proposal.
examples.zomi: Mi pawlkhat thukim uh a, adangte ahihhang geelna nial uh hi.

senses.usage_en: At the beginning of a sentence, contrastive while is similar to although. Between two clauses, it can resemble whereas.
senses.usage_zomi: Sentence kipatna ah kibanglohna a lak while pen although tawh khiatna kinai hi. Sentence phel nih kikal ah whereas tawh kibang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: To speak very quietly, using the breath rather than the full voice.
senses.zomi_equivalents: aw neu in pau; a gam in pau
senses.explanation_zomi: Aw kicingin pau loin, huih tawh aw neu mahmah in pau cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat bil ah aw neu in pau

examples.english: She whispered the answer in my ear.
examples.zomi: Ama in dawnna ka bil ah aw neu in hong gen hi.

examples.english: The students whispered during the lesson.
examples.zomi: Sinsakna laitakin sangnaupang te aw neu in pau uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use whisper something to someone or whisper in someone’s ear. A whisper is quieter than ordinary speech.
senses.usage_zomi: Whisper something to someone ahih kei leh whisper in someone’s ear ci in kizang hi. Whisper pen pau ngeina sangin aw neu mahmah hi.

senses.heading: Having the colour of snow or milk
senses.definition_en: Having the lightest colour, like fresh snow or milk.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vuk thak ahih kei leh susu bang a kang pen color nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He wore a white shirt to the meeting.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ah ama puan kang silh hi.

examples.english: The walls are painted white.
examples.zomi: Bangte color kang tawh kinawh hi.

senses.usage_en: White describes colour. When it refers to racial or ethnic classification, capitalize it only according to the style guide being followed and use it carefully.
senses.usage_zomi: White in color gen hi. Minam ahih kei leh mihing pawl khat genna ah kizang leh, kizui laigelh dan dungzui-in lai mal lian zang inla, pilvan takin zang in.

senses.heading: Pale because of fear, illness or shock
senses.definition_en: Having a very pale face because of fear, illness or shock.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lauhna, natna ahih kei leh lungmangna hangin maitang a kangvat cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: His face went white when he heard the news.
examples.zomi: Tua thu a zak ciangin ama maitang kangvat hi.

examples.english: She was white with fear.
examples.zomi: Lauhna hangin ama maitang dal hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes an unusually pale appearance, not a person’s normal skin colour.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in mi pianpih vun color gen lo a, lauhna ahih kei leh natna hanga maitang a dalna gen hi.

senses.heading: Used to ask which person or people
senses.definition_en: Used in a question to ask about the identity of a person or people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ahih kei leh mi pawlkhat kua ahi uh hiam cih dotna ah kizang pronoun ahi hi.

examples.english: Who is standing near the door?
examples.zomi: Kongkhak kiangah kua ding hiam?

examples.english: Who told you the news?
examples.zomi: Tua thu kua in hong hilh hiam?

senses.usage_en: Who normally asks about people. Use what or which for things.
senses.usage_zomi: Who in mi thu dong hi. Van ahih kei leh na dangte ading what ahih kei leh which zang in.

senses.heading: Used to introduce information about a person
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce a clause that identifies a person or gives more information about that person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat ciamteh ahih kei leh ama tungtang thu behlapna sentence phel kipatna ah kizang hi.

examples.english: The woman who called you is my aunt.
examples.zomi: Nang hong sam numei pen ka ni ahi hi.

examples.english: People who work hard often improve their skills.
examples.zomi: Hanciam taka nasem mite in a siamna uh khangsak zel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Use who for people. In formal English, whom may be used when the person is the object, although who is common in everyday speech.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ading who kizang hi. Thukip English ah mi pen object a hih ciangin whom kizang thei napi, niteng pau ah who kizang mahmah hi.

senses.definition_en: Complete, including every part, and not divided or broken.
senses.zomi_equivalents: a pumbup; a vekpi; a kicing
senses.explanation_zomi: A khen khat beek a kimang lo, a kikhen lo ahih kei leh a kisiat lo, a pumbup cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The whole family attended the wedding.
examples.zomi: Innkuan pumbup kiteenna pawi ah pai uh hi.

examples.english: I spent the whole day reading.
examples.zomi: Ni khat pumbup laibu simin zang ing.

senses.usage_en: Whole normally comes after the, my, this or another determiner: the whole day. It is usually used with singular countable nouns.
senses.usage_zomi: Whole pen the, my, this ahih kei leh determiner dang khat nungah om zel hi: the whole day. Simtheih singular min tawh kizang mahmah hi.

senses.definition_en: Used instead of who as the object of a verb or preposition, especially in formal English.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat pen verb ahih kei leh preposition a object a hih ciangin, a diakdiakin thukip English ah who munah kizang pronoun ahi hi.

examples.english: Whom did you invite to the meeting?
examples.zomi: Kikhopna ah kua na cial hiam?

examples.english: To whom should I send this letter?
examples.zomi: Hih lai kua tungah ka sawl ding hiam?

senses.usage_en: Whom is formal and is used for the object. In everyday English, speakers often use who: “Who did you invite?”
senses.usage_zomi: Whom pen thukip pau ahi a, object a hih ciangin kizang hi. Niteng pau ah mi tampi in who zang uh hi: “Who did you invite?”

senses.definition_en: Used to ask or state which person owns or is connected with something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van khat kua-a ahi hiam, ahih kei leh mi khat tawh bangci kizom hiam cih dotna leh genna ah kizang determiner ahi hi.

examples.english: Whose phone is this?
examples.zomi: Hih phone kua-a ahi hiam?

examples.english: I met a student whose father is a doctor.
examples.zomi: A pa siavuan ahi sangnaupang khat mu ing.

senses.usage_en: Do not confuse whose with who’s. Whose shows possession; who’s means who is or who has.
senses.usage_zomi: Whose leh who’s helkhawm kei in. Whose in neihna lak a, who’s in who is ahih kei leh who has cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to ask or talk about the reason for something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat bang hangin piang ahih kei leh kibawl hiam cih dotna ahih kei leh genna ah kizang adverb ahi hi.

examples.english: Why were you late this morning?
examples.zomi: Tuni zingin bang hangin nungta nahi hiam?

examples.english: I do not understand why the door is locked.
examples.zomi: Bang hangin kongkhak kikhak hiam cih ka tel lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Why asks for a reason. Answers often begin with because.
senses.usage_zomi: Why in hangthu dong hi. Dawnna pen because tawh kipan zel hi.

senses.heading: Measuring a large distance from one side to the other
senses.definition_en: Having a large distance between two sides.
senses.zomi_equivalents: zai; a lang nih kikalah gamla
senses.explanation_zomi: A langkhat pan a langkhat dong a gamla, a zai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A wide river separates the two villages.
examples.zomi: Gun zai khat in khuata nih khen hi.

examples.english: The road is wide enough for two trucks.
examples.zomi: Tua lampi truck nih paikim theih zahin zai hi.

senses.usage_en: Wide describes width. Long describes distance from one end to the other.
senses.usage_zomi: Wide in a zai zah gen hi. Long in a tawp khat pan a tawp khat dong a sau zah gen hi.

senses.heading: Including many different people, things or possibilities
senses.definition_en: Covering or including many different kinds, subjects or choices.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nam, thu ahih kei leh teeltheihna tuamtuam tampi huam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The store offers a wide range of products.
examples.zomi: Dawr in van nam tuamtuam tampi nei hi.

examples.english: She has wide experience in education.
examples.zomi: Ama in education lamah phutkhak zaizaw nei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, wide refers to variety or broad coverage, not physical width.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah wide in van khat a zai zah gen lo a, nam tuamtuam tamna ahih kei leh thu zaizaw huamna gen hi.

senses.heading: By many people or in many places
senses.definition_en: By or among many people, or across a large area.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi tampi lakah ahih kei leh mun tampi ah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: English is widely used around the world.
examples.zomi: Leitung mun tampi ah English kizang hi.

examples.english: The story is widely known in our community.
examples.zomi: Tua tangthu ka khuami lakah mi tampi in thei uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Widely commonly comes before past participles such as used, known, accepted and available.
senses.usage_zomi: Widely pen used, known, accepted leh available bang past participle mai ah kizang zel hi.

senses.heading: By a large amount
senses.definition_en: By a large degree or with a great difference.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zat lian takin ahih kei leh kibanglohna lian tak nei in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Prices vary widely between stores.
examples.zomi: Dawr khat leh khat kikal ah vanman kilamdang mahmah hi.

examples.english: Opinions differ widely on this issue.
examples.zomi: Hih thu tungtang ngaihsutna kibanglo mahmah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, widely emphasizes a large difference, not a large physical distance.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah widely in mun gamla gen lo a, kibanglohna lian tak om cihna thahatsak hi.

senses.definition_en: A woman who is married to someone.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kiteeng khinsa numei, a zi ahi hi.

examples.english: He came to the event with his wife.
examples.zomi: Ama zi tawh pawi ah hong pai hi.

examples.english: My wife works at a hospital.
examples.zomi: Ka zi hospital ah nasem hi.

senses.usage_en: Wife refers to a married woman in relation to her spouse. Its plural is wives.
senses.usage_zomi: Wife pen kiteeng numei khat a zi ahihna gen hi. A plural pen wives ahi hi.

senses.heading: Living or growing naturally, not controlled by people
senses.definition_en: Living or growing in nature without being kept, planted or controlled by people.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gam; gamah a khang; kivulh lo
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing in a kem, a vulh ahih kei leh a suan hilo a, gam sungah amah leh amah a nungta ahih kei leh a khang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Wild animals should not be kept as pets.
examples.zomi: Gam sa te inn gan bangin kep loh ding ahi hi.

examples.english: This flower grows wild in the mountains.
examples.zomi: Hih pak mual tungah amah leh amah khang hi.

senses.usage_en: A wild animal lives naturally. A domestic animal is kept or bred by people.
senses.usage_zomi: Wild ganhing pen gamah amah leh amah nungta hi. Domestic ganhing pen mihing in kem ahih kei leh vulh hi.

senses.heading: Uncontrolled, extreme or excited
senses.definition_en: Not controlled, calm or reasonable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ki-uk zo lo, dai takin om lo ahih kei leh ngaihsutna tawh kituak lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The crowd became wild after the victory.
examples.zomi: Gualzawhna khit ciangin mihon lawp mahmah uh hi.

examples.english: That number is only a wild guess.
examples.zomi: Tua number pen teci om loin a ngaihsut maimai ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, wild may describe excitement, lack of control or an idea unsupported by evidence.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah wild in lawpna, ki-uk zolohna ahih kei leh teci nei lo ngaihsutna gen thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Animals and plants that live and grow naturally without being controlled by people.
senses.zomi_equivalents: gam sa leh gam singkungte; gam nuntakna
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing in a vulh ahih kei leh a suan hilo, gam sungah amah leh amah a nungta ganhing leh a khang singkungte ahi uh hi.

examples.english: The forest provides a home for many kinds of wildlife.
examples.zomi: Gam in gam sa leh singkung nam tuamtuam ading teenna pia hi.

examples.english: The law protects local wildlife.
examples.zomi: Thukham in khuami gam sa leh singkungte kem hi.

senses.usage_en: Wildlife is uncountable. It refers collectively to wild animals and sometimes wild plants.
senses.usage_zomi: Wildlife pen simtheih loh min ahi hi. Gam sa te leh, hun pawlkhat ah, gam singkungte a vekpi kawk hi.

senses.heading: Used to talk about the future
senses.definition_en: Used before another verb to state or predict what is expected to happen in the future.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mailam hunah thu khat piang ding cih genkholna ah verb dang khat mai ah kizang modal verb ahi hi.

examples.english: The meeting will begin at nine.
examples.zomi: Kikhopna nai kua ciangin kipan ding hi.

examples.english: I think it will rain tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing ciangin guah zu dingin ka um hi.

senses.usage_en: Will is followed by the base form of a verb: will go, will be, will happen.
senses.usage_zomi: Will nungah verb a bulpi om hi: will go, will be, will happen ci in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Used to express willingness, promises or decisions
senses.definition_en: Used to show that someone is willing, promises or decides to do something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in nasep khat bawl ut, kamciam ahih kei leh tuhunin khensat cih lak nadingin kizang hi.

common_phrases.zomi: cikmah hunin ka mangngilh lo ding hi

examples.english: I will help you with the work.
examples.zomi: Tua nasep ah kong huh ding hi.

examples.english: Will you open the window, please?
examples.zomi: Tawlet hong hon in.

senses.usage_en: In offers and promises, will expresses willingness rather than simply future time.
senses.usage_zomi: Huhna kipia ahih kei leh kamciamna ah will in mailam hun bek gen lo a, utna zong lak hi.

senses.definition_en: Ready and prepared to do something without being forced.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ki sawl lui loin nasep khat bawl dingin ut leh kiging cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is willing to help new students.
examples.zomi: Ama sangnaupang thakte huh nuam hi.

examples.english: Are you willing to work at the weekend?
examples.zomi: Kal tawp ciangin nasem nuam nahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: Use willing to followed by the base form of a verb: willing to help, willing to learn.
senses.usage_zomi: Willing to nungah verb a bulpi kizang hi: willing to help, willing to learn.

senses.heading: To be the most successful in a competition, game or election
senses.definition_en: To defeat others and be the most successful person or team in a competition, game or election.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna, kimawlna ahih kei leh teelna ah midangte zogawp in gualzo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Our team won the final match.
examples.zomi: Ka team uh a nunung kimawlna ah gualzo hi.

examples.english: She hopes to win the election.
examples.zomi: Ama teelna ah gualzo ding lam-en hi.

senses.usage_en: You win a game, competition or prize, but you beat an opponent: “We won the game” and “We beat the other team.”
senses.usage_zomi: Kimawlna, kidemna ahih kei leh letsong pen win kici a, a langkhat kidem mi ahih kei leh team pen beat kici hi: “We won the game” leh “We beat the other team.”

senses.heading: To receive something through success or chance
senses.definition_en: To receive a prize, money or support because of success or chance.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gualzawhna ahih kei leh hunhoih hangin letsong, sum ahih kei leh panpihna ngah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: He won first prize in the competition.
examples.zomi: Kidemna ah letsong masa ngah hi.

examples.english: The proposal won public support.
examples.zomi: Tua geelna in mipite panpihna ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, the object after win is the thing received, not the person defeated.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah win nunga object pen a kingah na ahi a, a kizaw mi hilo hi.

senses.heading: To wrap or twist something around something else
senses.definition_en: To wrap or twist a long, thin object around itself or around another object.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khau, thirzai ahih kei leh van sau leh zang khat amah leh amah ahih kei leh van dang khat kimah hel cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Wind the rope around the post.
examples.zomi: Khau pen singtung kimah hel in.

examples.english: She wound the thread into a ball.
examples.zomi: Ama in lai pen a lum in helkhawm hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense and past participle are wound, pronounced /waʊnd/. Do not confuse this with the noun wind /wɪnd/, meaning moving air.
senses.usage_zomi: A beisa hun leh past participle pen wound /waʊnd/ ahi hi. Huih cihna min wind /wɪnd/ tawh helkhawm kei in.

senses.heading: To follow a twisting or curving path
senses.definition_en: To move in a path that bends and changes direction many times.
senses.zomi_equivalents: kawi in pai; kual in pai
senses.explanation_zomi: Lampi ahih kei leh gun khat a kawi in lam tuamtuam zuan cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mual kikal ah kawi in pai
gun gei ah kawi in pai

examples.english: The road winds through the mountains.
examples.zomi: Lampi pen mual kikal ah kawi in pai hi.

examples.english: A narrow path winds along the river.
examples.zomi: Lampi neu khat gun gei ah kawi in pai hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense describes the shape or course of a road, river or path.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna in lampi, gun ahih kei leh paina lampi a kawi dan gen hi.

senses.heading: An opening in a wall fitted with glass
senses.definition_en: An opening in a wall or vehicle, usually fitted with glass, that lets in light and allows people to see outside.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn bang ahih kei leh mawtaw ah kibawl, khuavak lut sak leh polam muhtheih nading, a tamzaw-in lim tawh kikhak honna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please open the window to let in some fresh air.
examples.zomi: Huih siangtho lut nading tawlet hon in.

examples.english: She looked through the window at the garden.
examples.zomi: Ama in tawlet pan huan en hi.

senses.usage_en: Use through the window when looking or passing through it, and out of the window when looking from inside to outside.
senses.usage_zomi: Tawlet pan en ahih kei leh kantan gen dingin through the window zang in. Inn sung pan polam enna ah out of the window zang in.

senses.heading: A rectangular area on a computer screen
senses.definition_en: A separate area on a computer screen in which a program, file or website appears.
senses.explanation_zomi: Computer screen tungah program, file ahih kei leh website a kilakna mun tuam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The document opened in a new window.
examples.zomi: Document pen window thak khat sungah kihong hi.

examples.english: Close the window when you finish.
examples.zomi: Na zawh ciangin window khak in.

senses.usage_en: A computer window is part of the screen interface; it is not a physical opening.
senses.usage_zomi: Computer window pen screen kizangna system sunga mun khat ahi a, inn bang tunga tawlet bang pumpi tawh om honna hilo hi.

senses.definition_en: An alcoholic drink made mainly from fermented grapes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lenggah tui a kiimsak in a kibawl zu ahi hi.

examples.english: They served wine with the meal.
examples.zomi: An tawh lenggah zu pia uh hi.

examples.english: This region is known for producing wine.
examples.zomi: Hih gamkai pen lenggah zu bawlna tawh minthang hi.

senses.usage_en: Wine is normally uncountable when referring to the drink generally. A wine can mean one particular type of wine.
senses.usage_zomi: Dawn ding wine a gen ciangin wine pen simtheih loh min ahi hi. A wine ahih leh wine nam tuam khat kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: A body part used by a bird or insect for flying
senses.definition_en: One of the body parts that birds, insects and some other animals use to fly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vasa, huihsek leh ganhing dang pawlkhat in leng nadingin a zat pumpi phel ahi hi.

examples.english: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
examples.zomi: Vasa in a kha zak in lengkhia hi.

examples.english: The insect has two pairs of wings.
examples.zomi: Huihsek in kha kop nih nei hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural of wing is wings. Birds normally have two wings.
senses.usage_zomi: Wing a plural pen wings ahi hi. Vasa in kha nih nei ngei hi.

senses.heading: A part of an aircraft that provides lift
senses.definition_en: One of the large flat parts extending from the side of an aircraft that help it fly.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vanleng a lang nih ah a kizaang, a lengtheih nadingin a dom vanleng phel ahi hi.

examples.english: Ice had formed on the aircraft’s wings.
examples.zomi: Vanleng kha tungah vuk khang hi.

examples.english: We could see the wing from our seats.
examples.zomi: Ka tutna pan uh vanleng kha muthei ung.

senses.usage_en: Aircraft wings are named after their similarity in position and function to birds’ wings.
senses.usage_zomi: Vanleng kha pen vasa kha tawh a omna leh a nasep kizawitawn ahih manin wing kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A person, team or animal that wins a competition, game, election or prize.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kidemna, kimawlna, teelna ahih kei leh letsong ah gualzo mi, team ahih kei leh ganhing ahi hi.

examples.english: The judges announced the winner.
examples.zomi: Thukhen mite in gualzopa pulaak uh hi.

examples.english: Our team was the clear winner.
examples.zomi: Ka team uh gualzopa kician ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Winner refers to the person or group that wins. The successful result is a win or victory.
senses.usage_zomi: Winner pen gualzo mi ahih kei leh pawl ahi hi. Gualzawhna thu piang pen a win ahih kei leh victory kici hi.

senses.definition_en: The coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring.
senses.explanation_zomi: Autumn leh spring kikal a om, kum sung khuahun vot pen ahi hi.

examples.english: The mountains receive heavy snow in winter.
examples.zomi: Phalbi-in mual tungah vuk tampi kia hi.

examples.english: We use more electricity during the winter.
examples.zomi: Phalbi sungin electric tamzaw zang ung.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly says in winter. American English also commonly says in the winter.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah in winter kizang mahmah hi. American English ah in the winter zong kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: A thin, flexible piece of metal
senses.definition_en: A long, thin piece of metal that can bend easily.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sau, neu leh baih takin kawihtheih thir ahi hi.

examples.english: The fence is made of wire.
examples.zomi: Kulh pen thirzai tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: He tied the gate with a piece of wire.
examples.zomi: Ama in kongkhak thirzai phel khat tawh khit hi.

senses.usage_en: Wire may be countable when referring to separate pieces, but it is often uncountable as a material.
senses.usage_zomi: Thirzai phel tuamtuam a gen ciangin wire simtheih min ahi thei hi. A zat ahi thirzai a gen ciangin simtheih loh min bangin kizang hi.

senses.heading: A metal conductor carrying electricity or signals
senses.definition_en: A thin metal conductor used to carry electricity or electronic signals.
senses.explanation_zomi: Electric tha ahih kei leh electronic signal paipih nadingin kizang thirzai ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not touch the exposed wire.
examples.zomi: A puan tuamna pusuah thirzai lawng kei in.

examples.english: The technician connected the wires correctly.
examples.zomi: Technician in thirzai te man takin zom hi.

senses.usage_en: Electrical wire can be dangerous when its protective covering is damaged.
senses.usage_zomi: Electric thirzai tuamna a kisiat ciangin lawng ding lauhuai hi.

senses.definition_en: Able to make good decisions because of knowledge, experience and careful judgment.
senses.explanation_zomi: Theihna, phutkhak leh pilvan ngaihsutna hangin khensatna hoih bawlthei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: It was wise to save some money for emergencies.
examples.zomi: Kin ngiatna ading sum tawm khol pen pilna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a wise and experienced leader.
examples.zomi: Ama makaipa pil leh phutkhak nei ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Wise means having good judgment. Intelligent mainly means having a strong ability to learn and understand.
senses.usage_zomi: Wise in khensatna hoih bawltheihna kawk hi. Intelligent in sinna leh teltheihna thahat nei cihna kawkzaw hi.

senses.heading: To want something that may be difficult or impossible
senses.definition_en: To want a situation to be different or to desire something that may not happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat a tuam ding deih ahih kei leh hong piang khollo thei thu khat deih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I wish I had more time.
examples.zomi: Hun tamzaw ka neih ka ut hi.

examples.english: She wishes she could visit her family.
examples.zomi: Ama in a innkuan hawhtheih a ut hi.

senses.usage_en: To express an unreal present situation, use wish with a past form: “I wish I knew.” This does not refer to past time.
senses.usage_zomi: Tuhun a taktak hilo dinmun gen dingin wish leh past form kizang hi: “I wish I knew.” Hih in hun beisa kawk lo hi.

senses.heading: To express a hope that something good happens to someone
senses.definition_en: To say that you hope someone experiences something good.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat tungah hoihna khat hong piang ding lam-etna gen cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat suah ni lungdamhuai deihsak

examples.english: We wish you every success in your new job.
examples.zomi: Na nasep thak ah gualzawhna khempeuh kong deihsak uh hi.

examples.english: I wished her a happy birthday.
examples.zomi: Ama tungah suah ni lungdamhuai deihsak ing.

senses.usage_en: Use wish someone something: wish you luck, wish them success. Use hope before a full clause about a likely future event.
senses.usage_zomi: Wish someone something ci in kizang hi: wish you luck, wish them success. Mailam hunah piangthei thu khat lam-etna sentence kicing tawh gen dingin hope zang in.

senses.heading: Accompanied by someone or something
senses.definition_en: Together with or accompanied by another person or thing.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van dang khat tawh omkhawm cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She lives with her parents.
examples.zomi: Ama a nu-le-pate tawh tengkhawm hi.

examples.english: Would you like to come with us?
examples.zomi: Kote tawh hong pai nuam nahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: In this sense, with shows companionship, connection or something that is included.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah with in mi tawh omkhawmna, kizopna ahih kei leh na dang khat kihelna lak hi.

senses.heading: Using something
senses.definition_en: By using a particular object, material or method.
senses.explanation_zomi: Van, zat ahih kei leh bawldan khat zangin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Cut the bread with a sharp knife.
examples.zomi: Tanghou pen tem hiam tawh sat in.

examples.english: The table was made with local wood.
examples.zomi: Dohkan pen khuami sing tawh kibawl hi.

senses.usage_en: With introduces the tool or material. By may introduce the person who performs an action.
senses.usage_zomi: With in zatnate ahih kei leh bawlna zat lak hi. By ahih leh nasep bawl mi lak thei hi.

senses.heading: Having a particular feature or feeling
senses.definition_en: Having, showing or experiencing a particular feature, condition or feeling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lim, dinmun ahih kei leh lungsim sukna khat nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She answered with confidence.
examples.zomi: Ama lungmuanna tawh dawng hi.

examples.english: We rented a house with a small garden.
examples.zomi: Huan neu khat nei inn kivaang uh hi.

senses.usage_en: The precise Zomi translation of with changes according to whether it means accompaniment, instrument, possession or manner.
senses.usage_zomi: With pen omkhawmna, zatna, neihna ahih kei leh bawldan a kawk dungzui-in Zomi ah letkhiatna kilamdang hi.

senses.heading: Inside a place, area or limit
senses.definition_en: Inside or not beyond a particular place, area or boundary.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mun, gamkai ahih kei leh ciangtan khat sungah, tua kantan loin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Please remain within the marked area.
examples.zomi: Ciamtehsa mun sungah om in.

examples.english: The village lies within the national park.
examples.zomi: Khuata pen gam park sungah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Within emphasizes being inside a boundary or limit. In is more general.
senses.usage_zomi: Within in ciangtan khat sungah om cihna thahatsak hi. In ahih leh a zaizaw in kizang hi.

senses.heading: Before a particular period ends
senses.definition_en: Before a stated amount of time has passed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun sehkhol khat a bei ma-in cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We will reply within three working days.
examples.zomi: Nasep ni thum sungin kong dawngkik uh hi.

examples.english: The package should arrive within a week.
examples.zomi: Package pen kal khat sungin hong tung ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Within a week means before the end of one week. In a week can mean after one week or during that period, depending on context.
senses.usage_zomi: Within a week in kal khat a beima-in cihna ahi hi. In a week ahih leh thu kizopna dungzui-in kal khat khit ahih kei leh kal khat sung cihna ahi thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Not having, using or being accompanied by someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat nei loin, zang loin ahih kei leh tawh omkhawm loin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not enter without permission.
examples.zomi: Phalna om loin lut kei in.

examples.english: She completed the work without any help.
examples.zomi: Ama huhna nei loin nasep zosiang hi.

senses.usage_en: After without, use a noun, pronoun or an -ing form: without money, without him, without speaking.
senses.usage_zomi: Without nungah min, pronoun ahih kei leh -ing form kizang hi: without money, without him, without speaking.

senses.heading: A person who sees an event happen
senses.definition_en: A person who sees an event, accident or crime happen.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thupiang, accident ahih kei leh mawhna khat a pian laitakin a mu mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The police spoke to several witnesses.
examples.zomi: Police te in teci pawlkhat tawh pau uh hi.

examples.english: She was the only witness to the accident.
examples.zomi: Accident a mu teci ama bek ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: A witness sees or directly knows about an event. A person who merely hears about it from someone else is not an eyewitness.
senses.usage_zomi: Witness in thupiang mu ahih kei leh langsungin thei hi. Midang tung pan thu bek za mi pen mit tawh mu teci hilo hi.

senses.heading: A person who gives evidence or watches an official act
senses.definition_en: A person who gives evidence in court or watches and confirms an official act or signature.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thukhenna innah teci panna ahih kei leh thukip nasep leh min gelhna mu in a man cih kipsak mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The lawyer called the next witness.
examples.zomi: Lawyer in teci a zom ding sam hi.

examples.english: I signed the document as a witness.
examples.zomi: Document tungah teci in min gelh ing.

senses.usage_en: In legal contexts, a witness may give spoken evidence or confirm that a document was signed properly.
senses.usage_zomi: Thukham lamah teci in thukhenna innah thu gen ahih kei leh document man takin kisuai cih kipsak thei hi.

senses.definition_en: An adult female human being.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kumcing numei mihing ahi hi.

examples.english: A young woman helped us find the address.
examples.zomi: Numei khangno khat in address mu nading hong huh hi.

examples.english: She was the first woman to lead the organization.
examples.zomi: Tua kipawlna makaipa numei masa pen ama ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural of woman is women, pronounced /ˈwɪmɪn/. Use woman for an adult and girl for a female child.
senses.usage_zomi: Woman a plural pen women /ˈwɪmɪn/ ahi hi. Kumcing numei ading woman zang inla, numei naupang ading girl zang in.

senses.heading: To think about something because you want to know the answer
senses.definition_en: To think about a question or possibility because you are curious or uncertain.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawnna theih nuam ahih kei leh kician lo ahih manin thu khat ngaihsun cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: bang hang hiam cih theih nuam
ahi diam cih ka ngaihsun hi

examples.english: I wonder why the shop is closed.
examples.zomi: Bang hangin dawr kikhak hiam cih ka ngaihsun hi.

examples.english: She wondered whether he had received the message.
examples.zomi: Ama in tua message a ngah hiam cih ngaihsun hi.

senses.usage_en: I wonder if/whether is a polite and indirect way to ask or think about something.
senses.usage_zomi: I wonder if/whether pen thu khat zaknop ahih kei leh theihnopna zahtak leh langsung lo taka genna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To feel surprised and impressed
senses.definition_en: To feel great surprise or admiration because something is unusual or impressive.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat ngeina hilo ahih kei leh lamdang tak ahih manin lamdang sa leh phat cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: bangci hi hiam cih lamdang sa

examples.english: We wondered at the beauty of the mountains.
examples.zomi: Mualte hoihna lamdang sa mahmah ung.

examples.english: I often wonder how they built the bridge.
examples.zomi: Bangci-in tua bridge lam uh hiam cih lamdang sa zel ing.

senses.usage_en: Modern English more commonly uses be amazed at for strong surprise. Wonder often emphasizes curiosity.
senses.usage_zomi: Tuhun English ah lamdang sakna thahat gen dingin be amazed at kizangzaw hi. Wonder in theih nuamna thahatsak zel hi.

senses.definition_en: Extremely good, enjoyable, impressive or pleasing.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hoih mahmah; nuam mahmah; lamdang tak
senses.explanation_zomi: Hoih mahmah, nuam mahmah, lamdang tak ahih kei leh lungkimhuai mahmah cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We had a wonderful time at the festival.
examples.zomi: Pawi ah hun nuam mahmah zang ung.

examples.english: That is wonderful news!
examples.zomi: Tua pen thu lungdamhuai mahmah ahi hi!

senses.usage_en: Wonderful expresses strong approval or pleasure. In everyday speech, it is similar to excellent, fantastic or great.
senses.usage_zomi: Wonderful in phatna ahih kei leh lungdamna thahat tak lak hi. Niteng pau ah excellent, fantastic leh great tawh khiatna kinai hi.

senses.heading: The hard material inside a tree
senses.definition_en: The hard material that forms the trunk and branches of a tree and is used for building, furniture and fuel.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung a kung leh a bate a piangsak zat khauh, inn lamna, van bawlna leh meiholhna dingin kizang ahi hi.

examples.english: The table is made of wood.
examples.zomi: Dohkan pen sing tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: We collected dry wood for the fire.
examples.zomi: Meiholhna dingin sing kang kaikhawm ung.

senses.usage_en: Wood is normally uncountable when referring to the material. Say a piece of wood, not normally a wood.
senses.usage_zomi: Zat khat a gen ciangin wood pen simtheih loh min ahi hi. “A wood” ci loin a piece of wood ci ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: An area covered with trees
senses.definition_en: A small area of land covered with trees.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singkung tampi a khanna gam neu khat ahi hi.

examples.english: We walked through the wood before sunset.
examples.zomi: Nisa tumma-in gam sung kantan ung.

examples.english: A small stream runs along the edge of the wood.
examples.zomi: Gam gei ah gun neu khat luang hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, British English often uses the plural woods. American English commonly uses woods for a wooded area.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah British leh American English tegel in woods ci in plural zang mahmah uh hi.

senses.heading: Made of wood
senses.definition_en: Made from wood.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sing tawh kibawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: They crossed a narrow wooden bridge.
examples.zomi: Amaute sing bridge neu khat kantan uh hi.

examples.english: The room contains a wooden table and four chairs.
examples.zomi: Innkhaan sungah sing dohkan khat leh tokhom li om hi.

senses.usage_en: Use wooden before a noun to describe something made of wood. Use wood as the material noun: “The chair is made of wood.”
senses.usage_zomi: Sing tawh kibawl van min mai ah wooden zang in. A zat ahi sing gen dingin wood zang in: “The chair is made of wood.”

senses.heading: Stiff and not natural in movement or expression
senses.definition_en: Stiff, awkward or lacking natural feeling.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gamtatna ahih kei leh pauhna ah a khauh, a nuamlo leh pianzia bang hilo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: His acting seemed wooden and unnatural.
examples.zomi: Ama limpuakna a khauh a, pianzia bang hilo hi.

examples.english: She answered in a wooden voice.
examples.zomi: Ama aw nungta lo bangin dawng hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense is usually negative and describes behaviour that lacks warmth or natural movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkak khiatna pen hoihlo lamah kizang a, itna ahih kei leh pianzia gamtatna nei lo cihna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: The soft, thick hair of sheep and some other animals, used for making warm clothing and cloth.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tuu mul; tuu mul puan zat
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuu leh ganhing dang pawlkhat a mul nem leh sah, puan lum leh puan zat bawl nadingin kizang ahi hi.

examples.english: This sweater is made of wool.
examples.zomi: Hih sweater pen tuu mul tawh kibawl hi.

examples.english: Wool keeps the body warm in winter.
examples.zomi: Tuu mul puan in phalbi ciangin pumpi lum sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Wool is normally uncountable. The adjective woollen or woolen means made of wool.
senses.usage_zomi: Wool pen simtheih loh min ahi hi. Adjective woollen ahih kei leh woolen in tuu mul tawh kibawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A single unit of language
senses.definition_en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khiatna nei, pau ahih kei leh gelhtheih kampau phel khat ahi hi.

examples.english: I learned five new English words today.
examples.zomi: Tuni English kammal thak nga sin ing.

examples.english: What does this word mean?
examples.zomi: Hih kammal bang cihna ahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: A word is one language unit. A phrase contains two or more words but may not form a complete sentence.
senses.usage_zomi: Word pen kampau phel khat ahi hi. Phrase in kammal nih ahih kei leh tamzaw nei napi, sentence kicing hi teitei lo hi.

senses.heading: Something said, or a short message
senses.definition_en: Something that someone says, or a brief piece of information or news.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in a gen thu ahih kei leh thupuak tom khat ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat tawh thu tawm gen

examples.english: May I have a word with you?
examples.zomi: Nang tawh thu tawm ka gen thei diam?

examples.english: We received word that the road was open.
examples.zomi: Lampi kihong cih thu ngah ung.

senses.usage_en: Have a word with someone means to speak briefly, often privately. Give your word means to make a serious promise.
senses.usage_zomi: Have a word with someone in mi khat tawh tomno leh a tuam-in pau cihna ahi hi. Give your word in kamciam kiptak pia cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To do a job or perform duties
senses.definition_en: To do a job or carry out tasks that require effort.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep khat sem ahih kei leh hanciamna kisam mawpuakna bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She works at a hospital.
examples.zomi: Ama hospital ah nasem hi.

examples.english: We worked together to finish the project.
examples.zomi: Project zosiang dingin semkhawm ung.

senses.usage_en: Use work for before an employer and work at/in before a workplace: work for a company; work at a hospital.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep neitu mai ah work for zang inla, nasepna mun mai ah work at/in zang in: work for a company; work at a hospital.

senses.heading: To operate or function correctly
senses.definition_en: To operate or produce the intended result.
senses.explanation_zomi: Machine, system ahih kei leh geelna khat a sepsa ding bangin sem ahih kei leh phattuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: My computer is not working.
examples.zomi: Ka computer nasem lo hi.

examples.english: The new method worked well.
examples.zomi: Bawldan thak in hoih takin sem hi.

senses.usage_en: When a machine or plan works, it functions correctly or achieves the intended result.
senses.usage_zomi: Machine ahih kei leh geelna khat works kici leh, man takin nasem ahih kei leh a ngiimna tangtung cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: To have an effect on someone or something
senses.definition_en: To affect or influence someone or something in a particular way.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na khat tungah sukna nei in dinmun khat piangsak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The medicine began to work quickly.
examples.zomi: Zatui in manlang takin nasepna nei kipan hi.

examples.english: The delay worked in our favour.
examples.zomi: Nungta sakna pen kote ading phattuam hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, work means producing an effect, not performing employment.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah work in sum ngah nading nasep gen lo a, sukna ahih kei leh phattuamna piangsak cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A person who works, especially someone employed to do a particular job.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasem mi, a diakdiakin nasep tuam khat sem dingin kiguan mi ahi hi.

examples.english: The factory employs more than two hundred workers.
examples.zomi: Factory in nasem mi za nih sangin tamzaw guan hi.

examples.english: Health workers visited the village.
examples.zomi: Cidamna nasem mite khuata ah hong pai uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Worker is a general term. More specific terms include employee, labourer, office worker and health worker.
senses.usage_zomi: Worker pen nasem mi khempeuh ading kammal ahi hi. A kicianzaw-in employee, labourer, office worker leh health worker bangin kici thei hi.

senses.heading: Having a job
senses.definition_en: Having paid employment or relating to people who have jobs.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thaman ngah nasep nei ahih kei leh nasem mite tawh kisai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The programme supports working parents.
examples.zomi: Programme in nasep nei nu-le-pate panpih hi.

examples.english: Affordable housing is important for working families.
examples.zomi: Innkuan nasem te ading man tawm inn neihtheihna thupi hi.

senses.usage_en: Working before a person or group often means employed or earning a living through work.
senses.usage_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh pawl khat mai ah working a om ciangin nasep nei ahih kei leh nasep tawh nuntakna hawl cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: Operating or functioning correctly
senses.definition_en: Operating correctly and able to be used.
senses.explanation_zomi: Man takin nasem leh zat theih dinmunah om cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We need a working printer.
examples.zomi: Printer nasem khat kisam ung.

examples.english: The machine is now in working order.
examples.zomi: Machine pen tu-in zat theih dinmunah omta hi.

senses.usage_en: A working machine functions correctly. A working model may also be a model that can actually operate.
senses.usage_zomi: Working machine in man takin nasem hi. Working model in a taktakin semthei limpuak zong kawk thei hi.

senses.heading: Used temporarily while something is being developed
senses.definition_en: Used as a temporary version while plans, ideas or documents are still being developed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Geelna, ngaihsutna ahih kei leh document khat bawlzawh nailoh sungin tawmvei ading kizang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The book’s working title may change later.
examples.zomi: Laibu tawmvei min pen nung ciangin kikhel thei hi.

examples.english: We prepared a working draft of the policy.
examples.zomi: Policy laigelh masuan khat bawl ung.

senses.usage_en: A working title, draft or definition is useful for the present but is not necessarily final.
senses.usage_zomi: Working title, draft ahih kei leh definition pen tuhun ading phattuam napi, a nunung pen hithei nailo hi.

senses.heading: The Earth and all its people and places
senses.definition_en: The planet Earth, including all its countries, places and people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung pianpih, a sunga gamte, munte leh mihing khempeuh huam ahi hi.

examples.english: People around the world use the internet.
examples.zomi: Leitung mun khempeuh ah mite internet zang uh hi.

examples.english: This is one of the largest cities in the world.
examples.zomi: Hih khuapi pen leitung khuapi lian pen pawlkhat sungah kihel hi.

senses.usage_en: Use the world when referring to Earth and human society as a whole.
senses.usage_zomi: Leitung leh mihing mipawlna pumbup a gen ciangin the world kizang hi.

senses.heading: A particular area of activity or experience
senses.definition_en: A particular field, community or area of human activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mihing nasepna, mipawlna ahih kei leh phutkhakna mun tuam khat ahi hi.

examples.english: She is well known in the world of fashion.
examples.zomi: Fashion leitung ah ama kim theih mahmah hi.

examples.english: Technology has changed the business world.
examples.zomi: Technology in sumkawlna leitung khel hi.

senses.usage_en: In expressions such as the world of science, world means a particular field or community.
senses.usage_zomi: The world of science bang kammal kizom ah world in nasepna lam ahih kei leh mipawl tuam khat kawk hi.

senses.definition_en: Existing, happening or known throughout the world.
senses.explanation_zomi: Leitung mun khempeuh ah om, piang ahih kei leh kim theih cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The organization has a worldwide network.
examples.zomi: Kipawlna in leitung bup kizopna nei hi.

examples.english: Climate change is a worldwide concern.
examples.zomi: Khuahun kikhelna pen leitung bup ngaihsut ding thu ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Worldwide may also be an adverb: “The product is sold worldwide.”
senses.usage_zomi: Worldwide pen adverb in zong kizang thei hi: “The product is sold worldwide.”

senses.definition_en: Unhappy or anxious because you are thinking about a possible problem.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina khat hong piangthei cih ngaihsut manin lungkham ahih kei leh lungsim nuamlo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I am worried about my father’s health.
examples.zomi: Ka pa cidamna hangin ka lungkham hi.

examples.english: She looked worried when she read the message.
examples.zomi: Message a sim ciangin lungkham bangin kilang hi.

senses.usage_en: Use worried about before the cause of concern and worried that before a clause.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungkhamna hangthu mai ah worried about zang inla, sentence phel mai ah worried that zang in.

senses.heading: To feel anxious about a possible problem
senses.definition_en: To keep thinking about a possible problem and feel anxious or unhappy.
senses.explanation_zomi: Buaina khat hong piangthei cih ngaihsun niloh manin lungkham cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Do not worry about the exam.
examples.zomi: Exam hangin lungkham kei in.

examples.english: He worries too much about small problems.
examples.zomi: Ama buaina neu te hangin lungkham lua hi.

senses.usage_en: Worry about is followed by the subject causing anxiety. Do not worry is commonly used to reassure someone.
senses.usage_zomi: Lungkhamna hangthu mai ah worry about kizang hi. Mi khat lungmuangsak dingin Do not worry kizang mahmah hi.

senses.heading: To make someone feel anxious
senses.definition_en: To cause someone to feel anxious or concerned.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat lungkham ahih kei leh lunghiang sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The delay worried her family.
examples.zomi: A nungta manin ama innkuan lungkham uh hi.

examples.english: What worries me most is the lack of information.
examples.zomi: Kei hong lungkham sak pen thu kicing a omlohna ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Compare “I worry about him” with “He worries me.” The first describes your feeling; the second names its cause.
senses.usage_zomi: “I worry about him” leh “He worries me” tehkak in. A masa in nangma lungkhamna gen a, a nihna in lungkhamna hong piangsak mi gen hi.

senses.definition_en: More unpleasant, harmful, serious or poor in quality than someone or something else.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh na dang khat sangin hoihlo zaw, siazaw, lauhuai zaw ahih kei leh nasazaw cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The weather became worse in the afternoon.
examples.zomi: Sun nun ciangin khuahun siazaw hi.

examples.english: His condition is worse than yesterday.
examples.zomi: Ama dinmun zanin sangin siazaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Worse is the comparative form of bad and badly. Use worse than when making a comparison.
senses.usage_zomi: Worse pen bad leh badly a comparative form ahi hi. Tehkakna bawl dingin worse than zang in.

senses.definition_en: More unpleasant, harmful, serious or poor in quality than every other person or thing in a group.
senses.zomi_equivalents: hoihlo pen; sia pen; nasa pen
senses.explanation_zomi: Pawl khat sungah a vekpi sangin hoihlo pen, sia pen, lauhuai pen ahih kei leh nasa pen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This was the worst storm of the year.
examples.zomi: Hih pen tu kum huihpi sia pen ahi hi.

examples.english: We must prepare for the worst possible result.
examples.zomi: Hong piangthei result sia pen ading kiging kul hi.

senses.usage_en: Worst is the superlative form of bad and badly. It is normally used with the.
senses.usage_zomi: Worst pen bad leh badly a superlative form ahi hi. A tamzaw-in the tawh kizang hi.

senses.heading: Having a particular monetary value
senses.definition_en: Having a particular value in money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sum zat nam khat man cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The painting is worth several thousand dollars.
examples.zomi: Tua lim pen dollar tul pawlkhat man ahi hi.

examples.english: How much is this old coin worth?
examples.zomi: Hih sum lui bangzah man ahi hiam?

senses.usage_en: Worth is followed directly by an amount: worth fifty dollars. Do not normally use worth of in this structure.
senses.usage_zomi: Worth nungah sum zat langsungin om hi: worth fifty dollars. Hih sentence kizopna ah worth of zang kei in.

senses.heading: Deserving the time, effort or cost required
senses.definition_en: Important, useful or enjoyable enough to deserve the necessary time, effort or money.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, hanciamna ahih kei leh sum a kisap tawh kituak zahin phattuam ahih kei leh manpha cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: This book is worth reading.
examples.zomi: Hih laibu sim taak hi.

examples.english: The journey was difficult, but it was worth the effort.
examples.zomi: Khualzinna haksa napi, hanciam taak hi.

senses.usage_en: Use worth followed by a noun or an -ing form: worth the cost; worth visiting. Do not say worth to visit.
senses.usage_zomi: Worth nungah min ahih kei leh -ing form kizang hi: worth the cost; worth visiting. Worth to visit ci kei in.

senses.heading: Used to describe an imagined or conditional result
senses.definition_en: Used to say what might happen or be true if a particular condition existed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dinmun khat a om leh bang piang ding hiam cih ngaihsutna ahih kei leh condition nei thu genna ah kizang hi.

examples.english: I would travel more if I had enough money.
examples.zomi: Sum kicing ka neih leh khualzin tamzaw ding ing.

examples.english: It would be better to wait until tomorrow.
examples.zomi: Zing dong ngak leh hoihzaw ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Would commonly appears in conditional sentences with if. It describes an imagined result, not a certain future event.
senses.usage_zomi: Would pen if nei condition sentence ah kizang mahmah hi. Mailam hunah piang teitei ding thu hilo a, ngaihsutna result gen hi.

senses.heading: Used for polite requests, offers or preferences
senses.definition_en: Used to make a request, offer or statement of preference sound polite.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngetna, kipia thu ahih kei leh deihzawhna zahtak takin gen nadingin kizang hi.

examples.english: Would you like some coffee?
examples.zomi: Coffee tawm na deih diam?

examples.english: I would prefer to meet in the morning.
examples.zomi: Zingkal in kimu ka deihzaw hi.

senses.usage_en: Would you…? is usually more polite than Will you…? in requests.
senses.usage_zomi: Ngetna ah Would you…? pen Will you…? sangin zahtakna neizaw hi.

senses.heading: Used for repeated actions in the past
senses.definition_en: Used to describe something that happened regularly in the past.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun beisa ah nasep khat a tawntung ahih kei leh a vei tam takin kibawl ngei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: When we were children, we would play by the river.
examples.zomi: Naupang i hih lai-in gun gei ah kimawl ngei i hi.

examples.english: My grandfather would tell us stories in the evening.
examples.zomi: Nitak ciangin ka pu in tangthu hong gen ngei hi.

senses.usage_en: Past-habit would describes repeated actions, but it does not normally describe past states. Use used to for states: “We used to live there.”
senses.usage_zomi: Hun beisa ngeina would in kibawl zel nasep gen napi, dinmun a om ngeina gen ngeilo hi. Dinmun ading used to zang in: “We used to live there.”

senses.heading: An injury in which the skin or body is cut or damaged
senses.definition_en: An injury caused when the skin or another part of the body is cut, torn or damaged.
senses.explanation_zomi: Vun ahih kei leh pumpi phel khat a kikat, a kibal ahih kei leh a kisiatna liam ahi hi.

examples.english: The nurse cleaned the wound carefully.
examples.zomi: Nurse in liamna pilvan takin siangsak hi.

examples.english: He received a deep wound in his leg.
examples.zomi: Ama khe ah liamna thuk ngah hi.

senses.usage_en: Noun wound is pronounced /wuːnd/. Do not confuse it with wound /waʊnd/, the past form of verb wind.
senses.usage_zomi: Liamna cihna min wound pen /wuːnd/ ci in kiphawng hi. Verb wind a beisa hun wound /waʊnd/ tawh helkhawm kei in.

senses.heading: Deep emotional pain
senses.definition_en: A lasting feeling of emotional pain caused by a painful experience.
senses.explanation_zomi: Phutkhak nansia khat in a piangsak, hun sau tak lungsim sungah a om lungsim liamna ahi hi.

examples.english: The harsh words left a deep emotional wound.
examples.zomi: Kammal khauh te in lungsim liamna thuk nutsiat hi.

examples.english: It may take time for old wounds to heal.
examples.zomi: Lungsim liamna lui dam nading hun sawt thei hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative sense compares emotional pain with a physical injury.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkak khiatna in lungsim natna leh pumpi liamna tehkak hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to express strong surprise, admiration or excitement.
senses.zomi_equivalents: wow; lamdang tak e!; hoih mahmah e!
senses.explanation_zomi: Lamdang sakna, phatna ahih kei leh lunglawpna thahat tak lak nadingin kizang aw ahi hi.

examples.english: Wow! That view is beautiful.
examples.zomi: Wow! Tua khuamuh a hoih mahmah hi.

examples.english: Wow, you finished the work already!
examples.zomi: Wow, nasep na zosiang khinta maw!

senses.usage_en: Wow is informal. It is common in conversation but may not suit formal writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Wow pen niteng pau ah kizang kammal ahi hi. Kihona ah kizang mahmah napi, thukip laigelhna ah kilawm khollo thei hi.

senses.heading: To cover something by folding paper, cloth or another material around it
senses.definition_en: To cover or enclose something by putting paper, cloth or another material around it.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, puan ahih kei leh zat dang khat tawh van khat tuam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She wrapped the gift in coloured paper.
examples.zomi: Ama in letsong pen lai color tawh tuam hi.

examples.english: Wrap the food before putting it in the fridge.
examples.zomi: An pen fridge sunga koihma-in tuam in.

senses.usage_en: Use wrap something in a material and wrap a material around something.
senses.usage_zomi: Van khat zat khat tawh tuam dingin wrap something in zang in. Zat khat van kimah tuam dingin wrap a material around something zang in.

senses.heading: To put your arms, clothing or another long object around someone or something
senses.definition_en: To place your arms, clothing or another long object around someone or something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi ahih kei leh van khat kimah khut, puan ahih kei leh van sau khat kual sak cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: wrap a scarf around your neck

examples.english: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.
examples.zomi: Ama in a ngawng kimah puan tuam hi.

examples.english: The child wrapped his arms around his mother.
examples.zomi: Naupang in a nu khut tawh kual hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, wrap around emphasizes surrounding or encircling someone or something.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah wrap around in mi ahih kei leh van khat kimkotin tuam ahih kei leh kual cihna thahatsak hi.

senses.heading: To form letters, words or numbers on a surface
senses.definition_en: To make letters, words or numbers on paper, a screen or another surface.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lai, screen ahih kei leh zaang dang tungah laimal, kammal ahih kei leh number gelh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Write your name at the top of the page.
examples.zomi: Lai tunglamah na min gelh in.

examples.english: The child is learning to write.
examples.zomi: Naupang in lai gelhna sin hi.

senses.usage_en: The past tense of write is wrote, and the past participle is written.
senses.usage_zomi: Write a beisa hun pen wrote ahi a, a past participle pen written ahi hi.

senses.heading: To create a book, article, message or other text
senses.definition_en: To create a book, story, article, letter, message or other written work.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, tangthu, article, lai, message ahih kei leh laigelh dang khat bawl cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is writing a book about Zomi history.
examples.zomi: Ama Zomi tangthu tungtang laibu gelh hi.

examples.english: Please write to me when you arrive.
examples.zomi: Na tun ciangin lai hong gelh in.

senses.usage_en: Use write about for a subject, write to for the recipient, and write something for a particular purpose or audience.
senses.usage_zomi: Thu om ding ading write about, lai sang ding mi ading write to, ngiimna ahih kei leh sim ding mite ading write something for zang in.

senses.definition_en: A person who writes books, articles, stories or other texts, especially as a job or regular activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Laibu, article, tangthu ahih kei leh laigelh dangte a gelh mi, a diakdiakin nasep ahih kei leh ngeina tawh gelh mi ahi hi.

examples.english: She became a successful writer.
examples.zomi: Ama laigelhpa gualzo khat hita hi.

examples.english: The writer interviewed several community leaders.
examples.zomi: Laigelhpa in khuami makaipa pawlkhat hopih hi.

senses.usage_en: Writer is a broad term. An author is especially someone who creates a published book or other substantial work.
senses.usage_zomi: Writer pen laigelh mi khempeuh huam kammal ahi hi. Author ahih leh a diakdiakin laibu ahih kei leh laigelh lian khat bawl in phuahkhia mi ahi hi.

senses.heading: The activity or skill of producing written language
senses.definition_en: The activity or skill of forming words and creating written text.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kammal gelhna leh laigelh khat bawlna nasep ahih kei leh siamna ahi hi.

examples.english: Good writing requires careful thought.
examples.zomi: Laigelh hoih in ngaihsutna pilvan kisam hi.

examples.english: The course helps students improve their writing.
examples.zomi: Course in sangnaupang te laigelh siamna khangsak ding huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Writing is normally uncountable when it refers to the activity or skill.
senses.usage_zomi: Nasep ahih kei leh siamna a gen ciangin writing pen simtheih loh min ahi hi.

senses.heading: Written work or handwriting
senses.definition_en: Text that has been written, or the particular way someone forms letters by hand.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gelhsa thu ahih kei leh mi khat khut tawh laimal a gelh dan ahi hi.

examples.english: I could not read his writing.
examples.zomi: Ama khutgelh ka simthei lo hi.

examples.english: Her writing has appeared in several magazines.
examples.zomi: Ama laigelhte magazine pawlkhat sungah kisuah hi.

senses.usage_en: When writing means handwriting, it refers to the appearance of someone’s hand-formed letters.
senses.usage_zomi: Writing in khutgelh a kawk ciangin, mi khat in khut tawh laimal a bawl dan gen hi.

senses.definition_en: Expressed, recorded or communicated in writing rather than speech.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kam tawh gen hilo a, lai tungah kigelh in kipulaak ahih kei leh kiciamteh cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We need written permission from the owner.
examples.zomi: Neitu kiang pan kigelh phalna kisam ung.

examples.english: Follow the written instructions carefully.
examples.zomi: Kigelh hilhna pilvan takin zui in.

senses.usage_en: Written is also the past participle of write: “She has written a book.” As an adjective, it normally comes before a noun.
senses.usage_zomi: Written pen write a past participle zong ahi hi: “She has written a book.” Adjective a hihna ah min mai ah om zel hi.

senses.heading: Not correct or true
senses.definition_en: Not correct, accurate or true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Man lo, kician lo ahih kei leh thu tak hilo cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: mi khat a khial cih lak

examples.english: Your answer is wrong.
examples.zomi: Na dawnna khial hi.

examples.english: The report contains some wrong information.
examples.zomi: Report sungah thu manlo pawlkhat om hi.

senses.usage_en: Wrong is the opposite of right or correct. For a mistake in an answer or belief, wrong is more natural than false.
senses.usage_zomi: Wrong pen right ahih kei leh correct a langkhat ahi hi. Dawnna ahih kei leh upna sunga khialhna gen dingin false sangin wrong kizang ngeizaw hi.

senses.heading: Morally bad or unacceptable
senses.definition_en: Morally bad, unfair or unacceptable.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nuntakzia tawh kituak lo, thutang lo ahih kei leh pomtheih lo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: It is wrong to steal from other people.
examples.zomi: Midang van guk pen a hoihlo ahi hi.

examples.english: She knew that her decision was wrong.
examples.zomi: Ama khensatna a hoihlo cih thei hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, wrong judges an action or decision as morally or socially unacceptable.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah wrong in gamtatna ahih kei leh khensatna khat pen nuntakzia ahih kei leh mipawlna pomtheih hilo cih khensat hi.

senses.heading: Not suitable or intended for a particular purpose
senses.definition_en: Not the correct or intended person, place, thing or direction.
senses.explanation_zomi: A ngiimna tawh kituak lo mi, mun, van ahih kei leh paina lam cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I called the wrong number.
examples.zomi: Phone number a hilo sam ing.

examples.english: We took the wrong road and became lost.
examples.zomi: Lampi khial zui in lampi mang ung.

senses.usage_en: The wrong… often means something other than the one intended: the wrong bus, the wrong person, the wrong address.
senses.usage_zomi: The wrong… in a ngiim khol hilo cihna ahi zel hi: the wrong bus, the wrong person, the wrong address.

senses.heading: A medical image
senses.definition_en: A picture of the inside of the body made by using a special type of radiation.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pumpi sung, a diakdiakin guh leh sunglam omzia muhtheihna dingin khuavak tuam khat zangin kilak lim ahi hi.

examples.english: The doctor took an X-ray of my broken arm.
examples.zomi: Siavuan in ka ban kitan X-ray lim la hi.

examples.english: The X-ray showed that one of her ribs was broken.
examples.zomi: X-ray lim in ama’ nakguh khat kitan cih lak hi.

senses.usage_en: X-ray can mean either the medical image or the radiation used to produce it. As a verb, X-ray means to examine someone or something by using X-rays.
senses.usage_zomi: X-ray in zatna nih nei hi: pumpi sunglam kilak lim a cihna leh tua lim lakna ding khuavak a cihna ahi hi. Verb in kizang ciangin, X-ray zangin mi khat ahih kei leh van khat sittel cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: A musical instrument made of wooden bars that produce different notes when struck with small sticks.
senses.explanation_zomi: Singtang tom sau kibanglo tampi kizomin, ciang neu tawh sat ciangin aw tuamtuam gingkhia la-instrument khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The child learned to play a simple song on the xylophone.
examples.zomi: Naupang in xylophone tawh la baihlam khat tum ding sin hi.

examples.english: She struck the wooden bars of the xylophone with two small sticks.
examples.zomi: Aman xylophone singtangte ciang neu nih tawh sat hi.

senses.usage_en: A xylophone is played by striking its wooden bars. Do not confuse it with a glockenspiel, which has metal bars.
senses.usage_zomi: Xylophone pen a singtangte satin kitum hi. Siktang zangin kibawl glockenspiel tawh kitukalh lo ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: An outdoor area beside or around a building
senses.definition_en: An area of land beside or around a house, school or other building.
senses.explanation_zomi: Inn, sanginn ahih kei leh building dang khat gei ah a om polam mun ahi hi.

examples.english: The children are playing in the yard.
examples.zomi: Naupang te inn huangah kimawl uh hi.

examples.english: We planted flowers in the front yard.
examples.zomi: Inn mai huangah pak suan ung.

senses.usage_en: In American English, yard commonly means the land around a house. British English usually uses garden for this area.
senses.usage_zomi: American English ah yard in inn kimkot polam mun kawk zel hi. British English ah hih mun ading garden kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: A unit of length equal to three feet
senses.definition_en: A measurement of length equal to three feet or about 0.914 metres.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khe thum tawh kikim, metre 0.914 bang sau tehna khat ahi hi.

examples.english: The cloth is two yards long.
examples.zomi: Puan pen yard nih sau hi.

examples.english: The car stopped a few yards from the gate.
examples.zomi: Mawtaw pen kongpi pan yard tawmno gamla ah khawl hi.

senses.usage_en: One yard equals three feet or thirty-six inches. The abbreviation is yd.
senses.usage_zomi: Yard khat pen khe thum ahih kei leh inch sawmthum leh guk tawh kikim hi. A tomlakna pen yd ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: An informal way of saying yes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Yes cihna niteng kihona ahizaw pau in kizang kammal ahi hi.

examples.english: “Are you ready?” “Yeah, I’m ready.”
examples.zomi: “Na kiging hiam?” “Hi, ka kiging hi.”

examples.english: Yeah, that sounds like a good idea.
