examples.zomi: Hi, tua ngaihsutna hoih bangin ging hi.

senses.usage_en: Yeah is common in informal conversation. Use yes in formal speech and writing.
senses.usage_zomi: Yeah pen niteng kihona ah kizang mahmah hi. Thukip pau leh laigelhna ah yes zang in.

senses.definition_en: A period of twelve months or about 365 days.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kha sawmlehnih ahih kei leh ni 365 bang huam hun ahi hi.

examples.english: She started university last year.
examples.zomi: Ama kum beisa in university kipan hi.

examples.english: The project will take two years to complete.
examples.zomi: Project zosiang nading kum nih sawt ding hi.

senses.usage_en: Use this year, next year and last year without in. Use in 2026 with a numbered year.
senses.usage_zomi: This year, next year leh last year mai ah in koih kul lo hi. Kum number tawh ahih leh in 2026 ci in zang in.

senses.definition_en: Having the colour of ripe lemons, sunlight or gold.
senses.explanation_zomi: Lemon min, nisa ahih kei leh kham bang a eng color nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She wore a yellow dress.
examples.zomi: Ama puan eng silh hi.

examples.english: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
examples.zomi: Autumn ciangin singnate eng hi.

senses.usage_en: Yellow describes colour. A yellow traffic light usually warns drivers to slow down and prepare to stop.
senses.usage_zomi: Yellow in color eng gen hi. Traffic light eng in mawtaw hawlte dam sak leh khawl dingin kiging sak hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to give a positive answer, express agreement or confirm that something is true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Dawnna hoih pia, thukim ahih kei leh thu khat a man cih kipsak nadingin kizang kammal ahi hi.

examples.english: “Do you understand?” “Yes, I do.”
examples.zomi: “Na tel hiam?” “Hi, ka tel hi.”

examples.english: She said yes to the proposal.
examples.zomi: Ama in tua geelna thukim hi.

senses.usage_en: English uses yes for positive answers. Natural Zomi responses may change according to the verb and context rather than using one fixed equivalent every time.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah dawnna hoih ading yes kizang hi. Standard Zomi ahih leh verb leh thu kizopna dungzui-in hi, ing, e leh dawnna dangte kizang thei hi.

senses.definition_en: On the day before today.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuni mai ni, ni beisa khat ciangin cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: I received your message yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zanin na message ngah ing.

examples.english: It rained heavily yesterday afternoon.
examples.zomi: Zanin sun nunin guah nasia takin zu hi.

senses.usage_en: Do not use on before yesterday: say “I saw her yesterday,” not “on yesterday.”
senses.usage_zomi: Yesterday mai ah on koih kul lo hi. “I saw her on yesterday” ci loin “I saw her yesterday” ci ding ahi hi.

senses.heading: Until now
senses.definition_en: Until the present time, especially in questions and negative statements.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun dong cihna ahi a, a diakdiakin dotna leh nialna sentence ah kizang hi.

examples.english: The bus has not arrived yet.
examples.zomi: Bus hong tung nailo hi.

examples.english: Have you finished your homework yet?
examples.zomi: Na inn nasep na zosiang khin hiam?

senses.usage_en: Yet usually comes at the end of questions and negative statements. Still normally comes before the main verb.
senses.usage_zomi: Dotna leh nialna sentence ah yet pen sentence tawp lamah om zel hi. Still ahih leh verb mai ah om ngei hi.

senses.heading: Even now or at some future time
senses.definition_en: Used to say that something may still happen or become true.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu khat mailam hunah piangthei lai ahih kei leh man thei lai cihna ahi hi.

common_phrases.english: the best is yet to come
common_phrases.zomi: a hoih pen hong tung lai ding

examples.english: The team may yet win the competition.
examples.zomi: Team pen kidemna ah gualzo thei lai hi.

examples.english: The situation could yet improve.
examples.zomi: Dinmun hoihzaw thei lai hi.

senses.usage_en: This use of yet emphasizes that a possibility remains open.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih kizangna ah yet in thu khat piangthei lai cihna thahatsak hi.

senses.heading: Nevertheless or despite that
senses.definition_en: Used to introduce a fact that contrasts with what was just stated.
senses.explanation_zomi: Gen khitsa thu tawh a kibanglo napi a man thu khat behlap nadingin kizang hi.

examples.english: The method is simple yet effective.
examples.zomi: Bawldan baih napi phattuam hi.

examples.english: He was tired, yet he continued working.
examples.zomi: Ama tawl napi nasem paisuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Contrastive yet is similar to but, but it often makes the contrast sound more surprising.
senses.usage_zomi: Kibanglohna a lak yet pen but tawh khiatna kinai napi, a lamdangzaw kibanglohna lak hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to refer to the person or people being spoken or written to.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kigenpih ahih kei leh lai kigelh sak mi khat leh mi tampi kawkna pronoun ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: nang na hi; note na hi uh

examples.english: You are welcome to join us.
examples.zomi: Kote tawh na hong kihel thei hi.

examples.english: Are you ready to leave?
examples.zomi: Paikhiat dingin na kiging uh hiam?

senses.usage_en: English you can be singular or plural. Standard Zomi normally distinguishes singular nang from plural note.
senses.usage_zomi: English you in mi khat leh mi tampi tegel kawk thei hi. Standard Zomi ah mi khat pen nang, mi tampi pen note kici hi.

senses.heading: Having lived for only a short time
senses.definition_en: Not old; having lived or existed for only a short time.
senses.explanation_zomi: Kum tampi nungta nailo ahih kei leh om hun sawt nailo cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The programme supports young people.
examples.zomi: Programme in khangno te panpih hi.

examples.english: The tree is still young.
examples.zomi: Singkung pen a no lai hi.

senses.usage_en: Young can describe people, animals, plants, organizations and other things that have not existed for long.
senses.usage_zomi: Young in mi, ganhing, singkung, kipawlna leh hun sawt nailo na dangte gen thei hi.

senses.heading: Suitable for or typical of young people
senses.definition_en: Connected with, intended for or typical of young people.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khangno te tawh kisai, amaute ading kigawm ahih kei leh amaute ngeina bang cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The magazine is written for a young audience.
examples.zomi: Magazine pen khangno sim dingin kigelh hi.

examples.english: The company hopes to attract younger customers.
examples.zomi: Company in customer khangnozaw te hip nuam hi.

senses.usage_en: The comparative form is younger, and the superlative is youngest.
senses.usage_zomi: Young a comparative form pen younger ahi a, a superlative pen youngest ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: Belonging to or connected with the person or people being spoken or written to.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kigenpih mi khat ahih kei leh mi tampi neih ahih kei leh amaute tawh kizom cih lak determiner ahi hi.

examples.english: Please write your name here.
examples.zomi: Hiteng ah na min gelh in.

examples.english: Your children are waiting outside.
examples.zomi: Na tate polam ah ngak uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Your comes before a noun. It may refer to one person or several people; Standard Zomi can mark this distinction through context and plural forms.
senses.usage_zomi: Your pen min mai ah om hi. Mi khat ahih kei leh mi tampi kawk thei a, Standard Zomi ah thu kizopna leh plural limte in tua kilamdanna lak hi.

senses.definition_en: Used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with the person or people being addressed.
senses.explanation_zomi: Thu kigenpih mi khat ahih kei leh mi tampi neih na kawk in, min pen kikhel nadingin kizang pronoun ahi hi.

examples.english: This bag is mine, and that one is yours.
examples.zomi: Hih sakhau keima-a ahi a, tua pen nangma-a ahi hi.

examples.english: Is this phone yours?
examples.zomi: Hih phone nangma-a hiam?

senses.usage_en: Yours stands alone and is not followed by a noun. Use your book, but say “The book is yours.”
senses.usage_zomi: Yours pen amah bek om a, a nungah min om lo hi. Your book ci in zang inla, “The book is yours” ci in zong zang in.

senses.heading: Used when the person doing an action is also affected by it
senses.definition_en: Used when you refers back to the same person as the subject of the sentence.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep bawl mi nang mah in tua nasep a thuak mi zong na hih ciangin kizang reflexive pronoun ahi hi.

examples.english: Be careful not to hurt yourself.
examples.zomi: Nangmah na kiliamsak loh nading pilvan in.

examples.english: Please introduce yourself to the group.
examples.zomi: Pawl mai ah nangma thu kipulaak in.

senses.usage_en: Yourself is singular. When speaking to more than one person, use yourselves.
senses.usage_zomi: Yourself in mi khat bek kawk hi. Mi khat sangin tamzaw a kigenpih ciangin yourselves zang in.

senses.heading: Used to emphasize that you personally did something
senses.definition_en: Used to emphasize that you did something personally, without another person doing it for you.
senses.explanation_zomi: Midang in hong bawlsak hilo a, nangmah in na bawl cih thahatsak nadingin kizang hi.

examples.english: You can check the result yourself.
examples.zomi: Result pen nangmah in enthei nahi hi.

examples.english: You yourself agreed to the plan.
examples.zomi: Nangmah in tua geelna na thukim hi.

senses.usage_en: This emphatic use can often be removed without changing the basic meaning, but it adds strong emphasis.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih thahatsakna yourself lakhia zong sentence khiatna bulpi kikhel lo napi, nangmah na hihna kipsakzaw hi.

senses.heading: The period of life when someone is young
senses.definition_en: The period of a person’s life between childhood and full adulthood.
senses.explanation_zomi: Naupang hun leh kumcing taktak hun kikal a khangno hun ahi hi.

examples.english: He spent his youth in a small village.
examples.zomi: Ama khangno hun khuata neu khat ah zang hi.

examples.english: She learned several languages in her youth.
examples.zomi: Ama khangno lai-in kampau nam pawlkhat sin hi.

senses.usage_en: In this sense, youth is uncountable and refers to a stage of life.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih khiatna ah youth pen simtheih loh min ahi a, nuntakna hun khat kawk hi.

senses.heading: Young people considered as a group
senses.definition_en: Young people collectively, especially teenagers and young adults.
senses.explanation_zomi: Khangno mite a vekpi, a diakdiakin teenage leh kumcing khangno mite ahi uh hi.

examples.english: The centre provides training for local youth.
examples.zomi: Centre in khuami khangnote ading sinna pia hi.

examples.english: Youth unemployment is a serious problem.
examples.zomi: Khangnote nasep neihlohna pen buaina lian ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Collective youth may take a singular or plural verb depending on regional style. Young people is usually clearer in everyday English.
senses.usage_zomi: Pawl khat a kawk youth pen gam tuamtuam laigelh dan dungzui-in singular ahih kei leh plural verb tawh kizang thei hi. Niteng English ah young people kicianzaw hi.

senses.heading: A young man
senses.definition_en: A young man, especially a teenage boy or young adult.
senses.explanation_zomi: Pasal khangno, a diakdiakin teenage ahih kei leh kumcing khangno ahi hi.

examples.english: A local youth helped the injured driver.
examples.zomi: Khuami tangval khat in mawtaw hawlpa liam huh hi.

examples.english: Several youths were playing football in the park.
examples.zomi: Tangval pawlkhat park ah football kimawl uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Countable a youth means a young man, but it can sound formal or impersonal. Young man is often more natural.
senses.usage_zomi: Simtheih a youth in tangval khat cihna ahi napi, thukip ahih kei leh zahtakna tawm bangin gingthei hi. Young man kizang ngeizaw hi.

senses.heading: The number 0
senses.definition_en: The number 0, representing no amount or quantity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Bangzah zong omlo cih lak number 0 ahi hi.

examples.english: The temperature fell below zero last night.
examples.zomi: Zan in khuavot degree ziro nuai ah kia hi.

examples.english: The team won by three goals to zero.
examples.zomi: Team in goal thum leh ziro tawh gualzo hi.

senses.usage_en: In telephone numbers and measurements, 0 is usually pronounced zero. In informal speech, especially in telephone numbers, people sometimes pronounce it oh.
senses.usage_zomi: Phone number leh tehna ah 0 pen zero ci in kiphawng zel hi. Niteng pau ah, a diakdiakin phone number sungah, oh ci in zong kiphawng thei hi.

senses.heading: Nothing or no amount
senses.definition_en: A complete absence of something or the lowest possible amount.
senses.explanation_zomi: Na khat bangmah omlo ahih kei leh a omtheih zah a niam pen cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: There is almost zero chance of rain today.
examples.zomi: Tuni guah zuktheihna bangmah omlo deuh hi.

examples.english: The school has zero tolerance for violence.
examples.zomi: Sanginn in ngongtatna cikmah hunin phal lo hi.

senses.usage_en: Before another noun, zero means “none at all”: zero cost, zero risk, zero support.
senses.usage_zomi: Min dang khat mai ah zero a om ciangin “khat zong omlo” cihna ahi hi: zero cost, zero risk, zero support.

senses.heading: An area with a particular purpose or characteristic
senses.definition_en: An area of land, space or a building that is separated or recognized for a particular purpose or feature.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna ahih kei leh lim tuam khat nei ahih manin kikhen ahih kei leh kiciamteh mun ahi hi.

examples.english: Drivers must slow down in the school zone.
examples.zomi: Sanginn gamkai sungah mawtaw hawlte dam takin hawl ding uh hi.

examples.english: The building is inside a flood zone.
examples.zomi: Building pen tui lianna gamkai sungah om hi.

senses.usage_en: Zone usually refers to an area defined by a rule, purpose, condition or shared characteristic.
senses.usage_zomi: Zone in thukham, ngimna, dinmun ahih kei leh lim kibang khat hangin kiciamteh gamkai kawk zel hi.

senses.heading: One of the areas into which the world is divided for time or climate
senses.definition_en: One of the large regions used to classify time, climate or geography.
senses.explanation_zomi: Hun, khuahun ahih kei leh leitung omzia khen nadingin kizang leitung gamkai lian khat ahi hi.

examples.english: Ohio and California are in different time zones.
examples.zomi: Ohio leh California hun gamkai kibanglo ah om uh hi.

examples.english: This plant grows in a tropical climate zone.
examples.zomi: Hih singkung khuahun lum gamkai ah khang hi.

senses.usage_en: A time zone is a region that uses the same standard time. Locations in different time zones may show different clock times at the same moment.
senses.usage_zomi: Time zone pen hun tehna kibang a zang gamkai ahi hi. Hun gamkai kibanglo muna nai te pen hun kibang laitakin zong kibanglo thei hi.

senses.heading: A mental state of strong concentration
senses.definition_en: An informal expression for a state in which someone is completely focused on an activity.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lungsim pumbup-a ngaihsutna; ngiim mahmah dinmun
senses.explanation_zomi: Mi khat in nasep khat tungah lungsim pumbup a koih in a ngim mahmah dinmun genna niteng kammal ahi hi.

examples.english: The player was in the zone during the final match.
examples.zomi: A nunung kimawlna sungin kimawlpa lungsim pumbupin ngiim hi.

examples.english: Once I start writing, I quickly get into the zone.
examples.zomi: Laigelh ka kipat ciangin ka lungsim manlang takin ngiim hi.

senses.usage_en: In the zone is informal. It means being highly focused and performing naturally and effectively.
senses.usage_zomi: In the zone pen niteng pau ahi hi. Lungsim pumbupin ngiim in pianzia tak leh phattuam takin sem cihna ahi hi.

senses.heading: A member of the Zomi people
senses.definition_en: A person belonging to the Zomi ethnolinguistic community, whose ancestral homeland includes parts of present-day Myanmar, India and Bangladesh.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tuhun Myanmar, India leh Bangladesh gam phel pawlkhat huam Zo gam sung pan hong piang Zomi minam sungah kihel mi ahi hi.

examples.english: Many Zomi people now live in different countries.
examples.zomi: Tuhun Zomi tampi gam tuamtuam ah teng uh hi.

examples.english: She is a Zomi who grew up in the United States.
examples.zomi: Ama United States ah khang Zomi khat ahi hi.

senses.usage_en: Zomi may be used for one person or collectively for the people. Zomi people or the Zomi people is often clearest in English.
senses.usage_zomi: Zomi pen mi khat ahih kei leh Zomite a vekpi kawk thei hi. English ah Zomi people ahih kei leh the Zomi people ci in gelh leh kicianzaw hi.

senses.heading: The Zomi language
senses.definition_en: The language used by Zomi speakers, especially the Standard Zomi variety associated with Tedim and surrounding Zomi communities.
senses.explanation_zomi: Zomite in a zat kampau, a diakdiakin Tedim leh a kimkot Zomi khuamite tawh kizom Standard Zomi kampau ahi hi.

examples.english: This dictionary helps learners understand Standard Zomi.
examples.zomi: Hih dictionary in sinmite Standard Zomi tel nading huh hi.

examples.english: Please translate the sentence into Zomi.
examples.zomi: Sentence pen Zomi-in hong let in.

senses.usage_en: In English, language names normally take no article: say speak Zomi, not speak the Zomi. Use the Zomi language when referring formally to the language.
senses.usage_zomi: English ah kampau min mai ah article om lo hi: speak the Zomi ci loin speak Zomi ci ding ahi hi. Kampau pen thukip takin a gen ciangin the Zomi language ci thei hi.

senses.definition_en: A place where wild animals are kept and shown to the public, often for education, research and conservation.
senses.zomi_equivalents: ganhing huan; gam sa kepna mun
senses.explanation_zomi: Gam sa te kep in mipite ensakna mun, a tamzaw-in pilna, kencian na leh ganhing kepbitna ading kizang ahi hi.

examples.english: The children saw elephants at the zoo.
examples.zomi: Naupang te in ganhing huanah sai mu uh hi.

examples.english: The zoo protects several endangered animals.
examples.zomi: Ganhing huan in mangthang ding lauhuai ganhing nam pawlkhat kem hi.

senses.usage_en: Modern zoos may support education and conservation, but standards of animal care differ between institutions.
senses.usage_zomi: Tuhun ganhing huan te in pilna leh ganhing kepbitna panpih thei napi, ganhing kepdan pen mun khat leh mun khat kibang lo hi.

senses.definition_en: Great energy and enthusiasm for achieving or supporting something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ngimna khat tangtung ahih kei leh thu khat panpih nadingin lawpna leh hanciamna lian tak nei ahihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She approached the project with great zeal.
examples.zomi: Ama project pen lawpna lian tawh sem hi.

examples.english: His zeal encouraged the other workers.
examples.zomi: Ama lawpna in nasem midangte thakhangsak hi.

senses.usage_en: Zeal is strong enthusiasm directed toward a purpose, belief or activity. It can be positive, but excessive zeal may cause poor judgment.
senses.usage_zomi: Zeal pen ngimna, upna ahih kei leh nasep khat tungah lawpna thahat ahi hi. Hoih thei napi, lawplua leh khensatna khial piangsak thei hi.

senses.definition_en: Showing great energy and enthusiasm in supporting a belief, cause or activity.
senses.explanation_zomi: Upna, ngimna ahih kei leh nasep khat panpihna ah lawpna leh hanciamna lian tak lak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She is a zealous supporter of education.
examples.zomi: Ama education panpihna ah lawp mahmah hi.

examples.english: The volunteers were zealous but sometimes impatient.
examples.zomi: Utthu-a nasem mite lawp mahmah napi, hun pawlkhat ah ngakzolo uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Zealous can be approving or critical. Overzealous describes enthusiasm that has become excessive or unreasonable.
senses.usage_zomi: Zealous pen phatna ahih kei leh mawhsakna in kizang thei hi. Overzealous in lawpna a tamlua in ngaihsutna tawh kituak nawnlo cihna ahi hi.

senses.definition_en: An African wild animal related to the horse, with black and white stripes.
senses.explanation_zomi: Sakol tawh a kizom Africa gam sa, a vun tungah dum leh kang a kizeek ahi hi.

examples.english: A herd of zebras crossed the grassland.
examples.zomi: Zebra hon khat lopi gam kantan hi.

examples.english: Every zebra has a different pattern of stripes.
examples.zomi: Zebra khat ciang vun zeek kibanglo nei ciat hi.

senses.usage_en: The plural is zebras. The pronunciation /ˈziːbrə/ is common in American English; British English often uses /ˈzebrə/.
senses.usage_zomi: A plural pen zebras ahi hi. American English ah /ˈziːbrə/ kiphawng a, British English ah /ˈzebrə/ kiphawng zel hi.

senses.heading: Great energy and enjoyment
senses.definition_en: Strong enthusiasm, energy and enjoyment in doing something.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nasep ahih kei leh nuntakna khat lawp, tha leh nuamna tawh bawl ahihna ahi hi.

examples.english: She has a great zest for life.
examples.zomi: Ama nuntakna tungah lunglutna lian tak nei hi.

examples.english: The children joined the activity with zest.
examples.zomi: Naupang te lawp takin tua nasepna ah kihel uh hi.

senses.usage_en: Zest suggests lively enjoyment, not merely willingness to do something.
senses.usage_zomi: Zest in nasep ut maimai sangin tha leh nuamna tawh lawp takin bawl cihna lak hi.

senses.heading: The coloured outer skin of a citrus fruit
senses.definition_en: The thin coloured outer skin of a lemon, orange or another citrus fruit, used to add flavour to food.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lemon vun polam; gah vun namtui
senses.explanation_zomi: Lemon, orange ahih kei leh gah thukha nam dang a vun polam color nei, an sungah limnam behlap nadingin kizang ahi hi.

examples.english: Add some lemon zest to the cake mixture.
examples.zomi: Cake helkhawmna sungah lemon vun polam tawm behlap in.

examples.english: Orange zest gives the sauce a fresh flavour.
examples.zomi: Orange vun polam in sauce limnam thak bang pia hi.

senses.usage_en: Zest is only the thin coloured outer layer. The white layer underneath is bitter and is called the pith.
senses.usage_zomi: Zest pen gah vun polam color nei phel neu bek ahi hi. A nuai-a vun kang pen a kha a, pith kici hi.

senses.definition_en: A line or course that repeatedly changes direction through a series of sharp angles.
senses.explanation_zomi: A phei in pai loin, a vei leh a tak lamah a kawi kawi, kiu hiam tampi nei lai ahih kei leh lampi ahi hi.

examples.english: The path followed a zigzag up the mountain.
examples.zomi: Lampi pen mual tungah kawi-kawi in kahto hi.

examples.english: Draw a zigzag across the page.
examples.zomi: Lai tungah lai kawi-kawi khat gelh in.

senses.usage_en: Zigzag can also be a verb or adjective: The road zigzags uphill; a zigzag line.
senses.usage_zomi: Zigzag pen verb leh adjective in zong kizang thei hi: The road zigzags uphill; a zigzag line.

senses.definition_en: A bluish-white metal used in batteries, protective coatings and many metal mixtures, and also needed by the human body in small amounts.
senses.explanation_zomi: Battery, thir kepna tuamna leh thir hel nam tuamtuam ah kizang thir kang-dum deuh, pumpi in tawmno a kisap mineral zong ahi hi.

examples.english: Zinc protects the metal from rust.
examples.zomi: Zinc in thir pen tui-ekna pan kem hi.

examples.english: The human body needs a small amount of zinc.
examples.zomi: Mihing pumpi in zinc tawmno kisam hi.

senses.usage_en: Zinc is both a chemical element and an essential nutrient. Its chemical symbol is Zn.
senses.usage_zomi: Zinc pen chemical element leh pumpi kisap mineral ahi hi. A chemical lim pen Zn ahi hi.

senses.heading: A fastener with two rows of teeth
senses.definition_en: A device with two rows of small teeth that can be opened or closed by pulling a slider.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan, sakhau ahih kei leh van dang hon leh khak nadingin ha neu nih kikal ah a kiliing zat tawh kizom sak van ahi hi.

examples.english: The zip on my jacket is broken.
examples.zomi: Ka jacket zip sia hi.

examples.english: Close the zip on your bag.
examples.zomi: Na sakhau zip khak in.

senses.usage_en: British English commonly uses zip. American English more commonly uses zipper.
senses.usage_zomi: British English ah zip kizang mahmah a, American English ah zipper kizangzaw hi.

senses.heading: Energy, speed or excitement
senses.definition_en: Lively energy, speed or excitement.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tha, manlangna ahih kei leh lunglawpna nei cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: The music adds some zip to the event.
examples.zomi: La in pawi sungah tha leh lawpna behlap hi.

examples.english: The team’s performance lacked zip.
examples.zomi: Team gamtatna ah tha leh lawpna kicinglo hi.

senses.usage_en: This informal sense describes lively energy or excitement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih niteng pau khiatna in tha, manlangna ahih kei leh lunglawpna gen hi.

senses.definition_en: A fastener consisting of two rows of teeth that are joined or separated by moving a small sliding part.
senses.explanation_zomi: Puan, sakhau leh van dangte hon leh khak nadingin ha neu nih a kiliing zat tawh kizom sak van ahi hi.

examples.english: The zipper on his coat became stuck.
examples.zomi: Ama coat zipper kiptak hi.

examples.english: She repaired the zipper on the bag.
examples.zomi: Ama in sakhau zipper siam hi.

senses.usage_en: Zipper is especially common in American English. British English usually uses zip.
senses.usage_zomi: Zipper pen American English ah kizang mahmah hi. British English ah zip kizangzaw hi.

senses.definition_en: An imaginary band of the sky divided into twelve signs, traditionally connected with the positions of the sun, moon and planets.
senses.explanation_zomi: Nisa, kha leh leitung dangte omna tawh kizom in lim sawmlehnih in kikhen, van tunga ngaihsutna gamkai ahi hi.

examples.english: She asked me about my zodiac sign.
examples.zomi: Ama in ka zodiac lim hong dong hi.

examples.english: The zodiac is traditionally divided into twelve signs.
examples.zomi: Ngeina-in zodiac pen lim sawmlehnih in kikhen hi.

senses.usage_en: The zodiac is used in astrology. Astrology is a belief system and is different from astronomy, the scientific study of space.
senses.usage_zomi: Zodiac pen astrology ah kizang hi. Astrology pen upna system khat ahi a, van leh khuavannuai a science tawh kencian astronomy tawh kibang lo hi.

senses.heading: An imaginary dead person that moves and acts as if alive
senses.definition_en: In stories and films, a dead person imagined as moving and behaving like a living person.
senses.explanation_zomi: Tangthu leh film sungah si khin napi nungta mi bangin a kalsuan leh a gamta si-mi limpuak ahi hi.

examples.english: The film is about a city attacked by zombies.
examples.zomi: Tua film pen zombie te in khuapi a simna thu ahi hi.

examples.english: The actor played a zombie in the horror movie.
examples.zomi: Limpuakpa in horror movie sungah zombie limpuak hi.

senses.usage_en: Zombies are fictional figures in stories, films and games.
senses.usage_zomi: Zombie te pen tangthu, film leh game sunga kingaihsun limpuak ahi uh hi.

senses.heading: A person who is extremely tired or lacking awareness
senses.definition_en: Informally, a person who is so tired that they move or think very slowly.
senses.zomi_equivalents: tawl mahmah mi; si nungta bang
senses.explanation_zomi: Tawl mahmah ahih manin dam takin gamta ahih kei leh ngaihsun zolo mi genna niteng kammal ahi hi.

common_phrases.zomi: ihmut kicinglo in tawl mahmah mi

examples.english: After working all night, I felt like a zombie.
examples.zomi: Zan khat sung ka nasep khit ciangin zombie bangin ka kisa hi.

examples.english: He walked into the kitchen like a zombie.
examples.zomi: Ama zombie bangin anhuanna sungah lut hi.

senses.usage_en: This figurative use is informal and may sound humorous or critical.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih tehkak khiatna pen niteng pau ahi a, nuihsakna ahih kei leh mawhsakna bangin gingthei hi.

senses.definition_en: A scientist who studies animals and their behaviour, structure and environments.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ganhingte, a gamtatna uh, pumpi kibawlna uh leh teenna uh a kencian scientist ahi hi.

examples.english: The zoologist studied the behaviour of elephants.
examples.zomi: Zoologist in sai te gamtatna kencian hi.

examples.english: She hopes to become a zoologist.
examples.zomi: Ama zoologist hih lam-en hi.

senses.usage_en: A zoologist studies animals scientifically. A veterinarian treats sick or injured animals.
senses.usage_zomi: Zoologist in ganhingte science tawh kencian hi. Veterinarian ahih leh ganhing cina ahih kei leh liam te kem hi.

senses.definition_en: The scientific study of animals, including their bodies, behaviour, development and environments.
senses.explanation_zomi: Ganhingte a pumpi uh, gamtatna uh, khanna uh leh teenna uh science tawh kencian pilna ahi hi.

examples.english: She studies zoology at university.
examples.zomi: Ama university ah zoology sin hi.

examples.english: Zoology helps us understand animal life.
examples.zomi: Zoology in ganhing nuntakna tel nading hong huh hi.

senses.usage_en: Zoology is a branch of biology. It focuses specifically on animals.
senses.usage_zomi: Zoology pen biology phel khat ahi hi. Ganhingte bek a diakdiakin kencian hi.

senses.heading: To move very quickly
senses.definition_en: To move somewhere very quickly, often with a continuous sound.
senses.zomi_equivalents: manlangin pai; manlang mahmah in khial
senses.explanation_zomi: A tamzaw-in aw kizom tawh mun khat lamah manlang mahmah in pai cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: A motorcycle zoomed past us.
examples.zomi: Motorcycle khat kote hong kantanin manlang mahmah in pai hi.

examples.english: The children watched the plane zoom into the sky.
examples.zomi: Naupang te in vanleng van tungah manlangin a lenna en uh hi.

senses.usage_en: This sense of zoom is informal and emphasizes very fast movement.
senses.usage_zomi: Hih zoom khiatna pen niteng pau ahi a, manlang mahmah in kalsuan cihna thahatsak hi.

senses.heading: To make an image appear larger or smaller
senses.definition_en: To change the view on a camera, screen or document so that an image appears closer, larger or smaller.
senses.zomi_equivalents: lim lian sak; lim neu sak; zoom
senses.explanation_zomi: Camera, screen ahih kei leh document tungah lim naizaw leh lianzaw, ahih kei leh gamlazaw leh neuzaw bangin kilang sak cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: Zoom in to read the small text.
examples.zomi: Laimal neu sim nadingin lim lian sak in.

examples.english: The camera zoomed out to show the whole building.
examples.zomi: Building pumbup lak nadingin camera in lim neu sak hi.

senses.usage_en: Zoom in makes the subject appear closer. Zoom out shows a wider area.
senses.usage_zomi: Zoom in in en na pen naizaw bangin lian sak hi. Zoom out in mun zaizaw lak hi.

senses.heading: To participate in an online video meeting
senses.definition_en: Informally, to communicate through the Zoom video-conferencing service.
senses.zomi_equivalents: Zoom tawh kikhop; video tawh kimaitai
senses.explanation_zomi: Niteng pau ah Zoom video kikhopna zangin kimaitai ahih kei leh kikhop cihna ahi hi.

examples.english: We zoomed with the team yesterday.
examples.zomi: Zanin team tawh Zoom ah kikhop ung.

examples.english: She will zoom in from home.
examples.zomi: Ama inn pan Zoom kikhopna ah kihel ding hi.

senses.usage_en: The company name Zoom is capitalized. Using zoom as a verb is informal; formal writing may prefer join a video conference.
senses.usage_zomi: Company min Zoom pen lai mal lian Z tawh kigelh hi. Verb a hihna zoom pen niteng pau ahi a, thukip laigelhna ah join a video conference kizangthei hi.
